Shining hook blades that belong to the Sanctified. Their path is unpredictable, and they have various uses.

text: A carefully refined sword forged from the newborn Aerux. The natural patterns whisper of the world's ancient transformations.
A cannon carved from Volcanic Stone. Its unwavering blue light shines through the layers of history, boldly defying the passage of time.
An iron cannon built to fulfill the saint's great wish. It bears the Divine Imprint and unleashes a hail of bullets on the Contrivers' enemies.
Refined with Jixia's Mechcraft technology, this weapon is stronger than ever, yet its wielder's rebellious spirit and relentless pursuit of firepower are the same as before.
Mechwings decorated with delicate, clearly ticking clocks.
Azure fire is contained within, waiting to be unleashed. Legends speak of a great bird that brought the fire, escorting a tower ship to the other side.
A staff woven from Aersilk. No matter how often it breaks, it will always be reborn.
Dark smoke, accompanied by faint whispers, spills from the forest, staining the pure white moonlight.
A longsword woven from Aersilk. The threads gather the aspirations of all living things, creating an endless source of fuel for its power.
A staff passed down in a Northlands tribe, echoing the grace of snowland foxes where white plum blossoms thrive.
A longbow woven from Aersilk. The threads stir, weaving thin wisps of clouds around its frame.
A weapon infused with the saint's power. With his blessing, the Vanquishers can cleave the earth with their blades.
A staff personally created by the saint. Under the saint's guidance, the Enchanters explore the very limits of Sorcery.
Two birds stand steady; one arrow leaves the string, and one falls.
A longsword forged from lava, housing the power of the Crimson Beast. The unquenched fire upon it spreads relentlessly.
Catch them off guard, strike when they are unprepared, paint the storm, and move with divine grace. This technique is recorded in the lecture notes of the Chang'an painter, You Mo.
zh_text: 出其不意，攻其不备，染成风雨，宛若神巧。此技法收录在长安画师悠墨的课堂笔记中。

text: A longbow crafted from dried Aerdense Flower vines. It is said that these vines will begin to grow again with enough light, warmth, and water.

Healing in appearance, decisive in impact.\nIt opens the show and closes the curtain.
The eye of the fallen Bi Fang, preserved by secret arts and set with lotus petals. Its frozen gaze whispers of the bird's lingering spirit.
Slender, sharp bronze blades, with patterns that shine with a blue cold light.
A treasured sword passed down through Novar's family, destined to accompany him on his adventures as he one day forges his own legend.
The crescent moon pierces the sky, scattering thousands of silver stars.\nChasing enemies, and chasing the lingering glow in one's heart.
A helical sword engineered by the Seekers for geological exploration. It can drill through solid stone to analyze mineral compositions.
A bronze sword said to summon the green flames of disaster. The fire in its wielder's eyes will one day consume all.
Azure fire is contained within, waiting to be unleashed. Does this scorching flame bring destruction, or protection?
A Sorcery Artifact woven from Aersilk. The threads drift and dance like joyful fish or the fleeting illusions of the mortal world.
Hooked blades woven from Aersilk. The threads resemble the waxing and waning moon, symbolizing the cycle of life and death.
A giant hammer woven from Aer-silkworm silk.\nThreads connect, and as the fire dragon runs, the sky turns into endless flames.
The blade is like a cloud, or an eagle striking the sky. This is an invincible sword of victory.
A reed stem staff. Its pith holds a faint glow and the power to pierce through dreams.
The Mechwings shine with a radiant golden glow, like shooting stars streaking through the cold night.
The ornate feathers unfurl in the wind, shimmering like banners. Once the sharp edge is donned, one must wield the blade toward the front.

text: The young man's original intention for fighting was to return to those days of carefree laughter.\nNo weeds grow where spears once stood, the fields are fragrant with cooking smoke.
An ancient ballista mounted on the side of a warship, capable of piercing heavy armor.\nThe ancestor of Jiangjun naval weaponry.
Moonlight hangs low along the butterfly wings, silent and calm, yet it guides the heart's desire to where she wishes.
The glazed staff is frozen with old dreams, a point of green light pointing toward distant mountains, memories flickering like a lamp.
A staff crafted from a frost-covered branch. It represents the cycle of life and death.
A longbow crafted from the skeleton of a bronze Mechcraft fish. As an arrow flies, the faint echo of an old song can be heard on the wind.
An ebony staff adorned with amethyst. Golden threads coil around it, accentuating the brilliant glow in the carved dragon's eyes.
A slender hook sword made of obsidian, polished by the repeated strikes of thunderous power.
This valuable sword is made from dragon bones. Skeletons are scattered across the wilderness, silently telling of the dragons' past.
Slender blades forged from frost. When they are swung, streams of ice surge forth, glinting with a cold light.
Dual blades woven from Aersilk. The threads are said to connect the desolate with the vibrant, bridging the gap between stagnation and flourishing.
A glimmer flows from the shattered nightmare, coalescing into a pink core adorned with wish-granting flowers.
This sword was made by a master blacksmith and his wife for a close friend. Its blade is covered with many scars, each a reminder of its long history.
The stars are far, but they journey together. With the right company, no road is ever too long.
A favorite weapon among the Sanctified. The ominous bird spreads its wings, its blue flames scorching the earth.
The tyrant king raises his sword, his eyes as dark as nightmares. He will conquer all. He will devour all.
The staff of an emissary said to bring bountiful harvests. Its light protects all growing things.
A carefully refined blade forged from the newborn Aerux, carrying the silent echoes of history.
A heavy feel that achieves thunderous destruction.
The heat wave sweetens the air and seals in the afternoon sun. With the cannon blast, all your worries are blown away.
This sword is crafted from amber sourced from the Aerfall Highlands. Its glow captures the sunset at the Mausoleum's Peak.
A sacred artifact from the southern continent, lost to the world. A girl has ended her wandering and found a new home.
A demonic blade cast from bronze. Broken gems and countless battle scars silently tell of its past.
The golden law flows, and the ritual is leisurely.\nAfter the clear chime, heaven and earth compose their own magnificent chapter.
This sword is designed to look like the bones of the bronze fish. The sound of its swing is like an echo from a distant past.
A glimmer flowing from a shattered nightmare, condensed into a pink jade giant hammer adorned with wish-granting flowers.
No need to test the enemy, for each strike proclaims his power. Wherever he steps, the youth claims his ground.
A weapon designed by the saint. Under the saint's command, the Vanquishers never feared sacrifice.
Light like icy splendor, blade like frost shadow. Ignoring fate, following only the stars and moon.
The dark green staff head resembles a small rabbit cradling fireflies, whispering forest secrets as the magic resonates.
A greatsword forged from Volcanic Stone. It's so heavy that most people cannot wield it.
A cannon woven from Aersilk. At rest, its power is concealed; unleashed, it is as subtle and swift as the wind.
A ballista woven from Aer-silkworm silk.\nThe firmament cracks, the Aer-essence collapses, and with a slight vibration of the threads, thousands of killing intents are unleashed.
A heartful message requires no words; let a breeze of verdant carry your soul.
A favorite weapon among the Sanctified. The ominous bird spreads its wings, its blue flames scorching the earth.
Makes the scene lively, and makes the scene simple.
A compact version of the Wildfire Cannon. Its size belies its power, capable of wielding enormous force to shake mountains and crack the earth.
A longsword woven from Aersilk. The threads condense, transforming from ethereal mist into a sharp, frosted edge.
A timeworn bronze bow, its frame curving like a crescent moon.
Steel wings used by the Sanctified's special forces. They are modeled on the Sanctifier's robe and decorated with steel feathers.
Obsidian that absorbed thunder power beneath the Ancient Ruins of Lone Mountain, forged into a great hammer. The gathered thunder power carries the faint might of a thunder god.
The mist clears, and the past is revealed once more.\nThis is a silent protection, and also a brand-new promise.
Feathers in order, mechanisms silent. Within a small space, a wing of splendor unfolds.

Cozy, breathable cloth shoes, ideal for treks through the woods.
Light, simple shorts in a cloud-white hue, accented with golden patterns. Very versatile.

A brow makeup inspired by Suan Ni, casting fear into all who behold it.

text: Bright and carefree short hair that gives a cheerful impression.
A soft inner lining resembling rosy clouds, paired with a light, short coat. Fresh and elegant, it blends gentle charm with vitality.
A vibrant radish onesie that really cheers everyone up in the study room.
Walk lightly, as if treading on light reflecting on the fish scales. Each step rings with auspicious melody, awakening the golden autumn.
Some enthusiasts love to cosplay as the River Spirits of Jixia—the Bud Spirits—so they made these onesies.
Be careful when observing River Spirits on the road; some look gentle and reserved, but they get fired up at the slightest touch.

A massive bow wielded by the legendary hero who won the moon's love. 
 
Crafted to protect the embers of civilization, its body is made from laurel wood, and its string is woven from moonlight. 
 
The intricate carvings and patterns on the bow evoke the beauty of the lunar palace. 
 
"Pluck the laurel branch, cut the moon's glow. Lead the pure radiance, ride the golden chariot."
To protect those she holds dear, she will once again summon the endless blizzard, raging like the storms of the Winter Ocean.
A design by battle-scarred Herbalists. Whenever first-years coo over its cuteness, they only respond with a knowing smile.
The wind flutters her hair. Her ears twitch as she turns, trying to catch a scent on the breeze.
A staff personally created by the saint. Under the saint's guidance, the Enchanters explore the very limits of Sorcery.
A staff personally created by the saint. Under the saint's guidance, the Enchanters explore the very limits of Sorcery.
Two-toned boots paired with plain-colored pants, a novel look that subtly embodies the balance of yin and yang.
Waves chase the beach, only to collide head-on with midsummer.
zh_text: 浪花追逐沙滩，却与盛夏撞个满怀。
source_text: 浪花追逐沙滩，却与盛夏撞个满怀。

text: Dark socks that blend into the winter forest, as an azure lion steps softly through the silent fog.
Even if you accidentally step on a banana, don't worry; you're embarking on a smooth new journey.
A mask crafted by a Jixia Seeker, resembling a Saepes and featuring a refined touch of golden leaves framing its design.
The pioneer of Sorcery walks across Jixia dressed in cyan. The scrolls at the belt record the joys and sorrows of every living creature.
Neatly braided short hair with a touch of autumn freedom. Standing atop the peaks, looking at the mountains and clouds with no worries.
Dark boots with lotus patterns, simple and elegant.
Two birds stand steady; one arrow leaves the string, and one falls.
Step into the new year and spread the joy of harvest with every step.
Ting-a-ling... The sound of the clear chimes. Perhaps a message from distant friends, carried by the summer breeze.
A glimmer flows from the shattered nightmare, coalescing into a pink artifact adorned with wish-granting flowers.
All eyes on me—the championship is reserved for the Team of Stars! Someone gifted his trophy before the entire audience.
Star patterns and lunar phases turn into fragments of light, intricately woven into the hair, like whispers forgotten by the universe.
Elegant heels in a perfect harmony of black and white that reflects the balance of yin and yang.
Sunlight reveals the face, and even the rainbow joins in.
official_target_text: Sunlight reveals the face, and even the rainbow joins in.
official_en_text: Sunlight reveals the face, and even the rainbow joins in.

text: A pendant exclusively crafted by Zhuangzi's Heroes' Fanclub. Infused with a specially blended soothing fragrance, it grants insomniacs a peaceful night's sleep.
May time and waves always be by your side. A sheer garment woven from Aersilk, light as mist, tough as steel.
Crystalline dual blades forged from Volcanic Stone. It's said they either cannot be lit or, once ignited, will burn for eternity.
A majestic leaf, carrying the aura of a master thief.
Beside the pansies, the boy in the sweater lies on a picnic blanket, his top bathed in the bright spring sunlight.
zh_text: 三色堇花畔，毛衫少年仰卧野餐毯上，上衣落满春日晴光。
source_text: 三色堇花畔，毛衫少年仰卧野餐毯上，上衣落满春日晴光。

text: A lovely pink radish skin... oh wait, a radish shirt, making one ponder the past of the master thief.
A dark dungaree dress layered over a lemon-yellow crop top, evoking the playful rhythm of dancing blocks.
Bulky yet agile, the mighty radish will pummel all trespassers who dare to step into the garden.
Delicately beaded shoes that allow a maiden to tread lightly over the waves.
Socks adorned with mysterious bronze patterns. Perhaps these woven designs have heard thousands of prayers.
A stylish, flowing pair of gold-threaded trousers with reed patterns and duo colors, carrying the winds of autumn.
No matter where the end is, we'll always be together!  \n \nThese pants are custom-made by a youth not skilled in dressing up, who racked his brains.
White clothes reflecting shadows, standing in the wind.
official_target_text: White clothes reflecting shadows, standing in the wind.
official_en_text: White clothes reflecting shadows, standing in the wind.

text: Mechwings powered by Volcanic Stone. The design was abandoned, as its operating temperature was high enough to set the wings themselves ablaze in mid-flight.
A longsword forged from lava, housing the power of the Crimson Beast. The unquenched fire upon it spreads relentlessly.
A longsword forged from lava, housing the power of the Crimson Beast. The unquenched fire upon it spreads relentlessly.
Catch them off guard, strike when they are unprepared, paint the storm, and move with divine grace. This technique is recorded in the lecture notes of the Chang'an painter, You Mo.

text: Silver threads tie up blue hair, floating among cloud waves, gently brushing against wandering dreams.
A genius puppy leaves green paw prints, a fairy tale in search of vegetables.
A monocle shaped like a Nightmare Butterfly, believed to protect the wearer from nightmares.
Glazed Kun shadows swirl like tides whispering within, unspoken longing sways with the waves, lighting up the journey.

With a light tap of the toes, claw prints are left in the forest and snow. The wind holds its breath, and he never stops.
Flowers bloom in the warm sun, wind stops under the hat brim.

source_text: 花开暖阳中，风停帽檐下。

Slender swords ground from lightning-forged obsidian.
Plump and sturdy leaves, carrying the essence of a bountiful harvest.
A jade lock whose secret remains locked away. The round jade at its center sometimes gleams with golden light, briefly revealing the patterns on the bronze pillars.
White hair tips swaying in the wind, round tiger ears faintly visible, full of vitality and wildness.
Black satin covered in red scales, with flowing fire leaping like surging dragon breath.
Fluffy lion head shoes, leaving cheerful footprints in snowy forests.
Wrapping up all those mischievous little thoughts, just like a cat pretending to be innocent.
As graceful as Dream Butterflies in flight, it shimmers with mesmerizing light and shadow as the wearer moves, like something out of a dream.
Welcome! The Summer Ice Drink Shop is at your service, woof woof!
The bronze helmet, resembling a Mechcraft fish, is both sturdy and mysterious. The golden fish eyes illuminate the path of discovery.
A neat, clean-cut short hairstyle that looks sharp and effortless.
A badge worn by members of the Team of Stars, once your guiding light through the depths of an endless nightmare.
These vibrant trousers are perfect for blending into the festivities of Harvest Fields.
The mountain wind sweeps through the sleeves. Freedom is calling.
This simple, elegant green garment is a favorite among Herbalists, its subtle woven patterns reminiscent of the woods.
New students step through the academy gate in these sturdy cloth boots, ready to leave their footprints all across Jixia.
A toy bunny pulls on clumps of hair, as if it's taking control. "Time to start an adventure!"
Radiant youth on the path to wisdom—this simple, short hair embodies youthful vigor.
A short, sharp cut that keeps hair out of your face for medical work—practical, low-maintenance, and full of youthful energy.
Robust and sun-kissed radish suit, bringing the joy of autumn harvest.

The glasses perched on the head reflect the sky, anticipating the ocean.
Every new student at Jixia wears a hooded coat over dark underclothes as their standard outfit.
A dark-colored cannon that fires dazzling dreams blooming high above.
Seeker-certified warm cotton socks, a great companion for hiking in the wild.
A travel-ready Jixia outfit paired with grey mid-calf boots featuring a relaxed cloud swirl pattern.

Short boots tightly fastened with sturdy buckles, extremely reliable. The long and challenging road awaits students to explore.
Long ponytail on the left, a perky cowlick on top, starting a day full of energy.

With a bamboo hat to shade the face and two bamboo leaves in hand, step into the world of blades and swords. From now on, live freely and walk alone.

Handsome and noble leaves, imbuing the scent of the great monarch.
Flexible and body-sculpting, comfortable short boots. The gold and azure colors are inspired by ancient bronze, yet revitalized on soft fabric.

A snug, form-fitting lining paired with a pale green coat inspired by traditional rain cloaks.

The silver feathers and the crimson jade, crafted separately by two academy legends, are now perfectly inlaid as one.
Azure stockings featuring cute claw prints, beloved by Hunters.
Black bottoms with dark red tones. The fabric is light and durable, giving off a mysterious and capable impression.
Clouds weave water patterns, garments stained with the sound of tides; sea rhythms swirl, wind carries wave-whispers into song.
Fluttering cuffs and flowing aerveins make it feel ready for takeoff.
Seniors all have a tacit line, "If you said so, let's go with it."

Light and elegant top, agile and possessing the elegance and purity of a green crane in the mountains.

Silent in his leaps and landings, he roams an endless road on a journey with no end.

A navy blue top with a light collar, offering an effortless style for explorers who roam far and wide.
An outfit of mountain green and cloud white, capturing the grace and ease of a mountain breeze.
The master designed two sets of swords, heavy and light. Their clever structure allows them to easily break rocks.
As the sword's gleam cuts through the mist, he is baptized with a new name. He who bears the burden of sin shall be the one to end all sins.
Refreshing but not over the top, light and just right. Those who understand sweetness best know when it's time for freshness to take the stage.

A horn that makes the deep, thundering roar of Pu Lao - it's usually the first sound of war.
This sword shines with the color of deep-sea gems. Anyone who underestimates its sharpness will soon regret it.
Healing in appearance, decisive in impact.\nIt opens the show and closes the curtain.
The sea breeze etches creases, like waves traveling through the clear sky, mooring toward the boundless azure sea.
Durable, wrinkle-resistant, and designed for freedom of movement, this outfit is the Snapsters' favorite for exploring the world.
The eye of the fallen Bi Fang, preserved by secret arts and set with lotus petals. Its frozen gaze whispers of the bird's lingering spirit.

Forged over nine lost weekends by School of Mechcraft instructors, this fine armor is reserved only for the best of students.
Don't shake it. It might get angry.
Elegantly shimmering leaves, bearing the grace of a queen.
Plain white stockings, moving like flowing fish shadows, with silver scales embroidered to weave a net of heaven and earth.
Two-tone boots paired with plain trousers are eye-catching and subtly reflect the student's understanding of the principles of Yin and Yang.
Cozy, breathable cloth shoes, ideal for treks through the woods.
Like river waves, transforming into a dancing fish-dragon; a simple and romantic dark-colored top, suitable for combat.
A refreshing and casual hairstyle that gives a sense of heroic freedom.
Seniors all have a tacit line, "If you said so, let's go with it."
A custom-made, very calm Tibetan fox mask for hunters. Wearing it seems to allow you to see through the true form of water monkeys.
Plump and sturdy leaves, carrying the essence of a bountiful harvest.
Steel wings used by the Sanctified's special forces. They are modeled on the Sanctifier's robe and decorated with steel feathers.
Steel wings used by the Divine Forge special forces. They are modeled on the Sanctifier's robe and decorated with steel feathers.
Luxurious radish suit, making you the epitome of elegance that outshines all others.
An accessory crafted by a Jixia artisan in his dream: As the moon sinks into shadowed seas, a divine fish soars through the boundless skies—ocean and heavens in one hue.
Obsidian that absorbed thunder power beneath the Ancient Ruins of Lone Mountain, forged into a great hammer. The gathered thunder power carries the faint might of a thunder god.
A veil with mist and water ripple patterns, evoking the refined elegance of Jixia.
A small tag that binds together the daily lives of classmates and the journey they share.
zh_text: 小小一张，系住同窗日常，也系住一路同行。
source_text: 小小一张，系住同窗日常，也系住一路同行。

text: Dew and sunlight form purple and white light spots on the pant cuffs; every step feels like walking in the lazy breath of spring.
zh_text: 露珠与阳光在裤脚缀成紫白交错的光斑，每一步都像走在春天慵懒的呼吸里。
source_text: 露珠与阳光在裤脚缀成紫白交错的光斑，每一步都像走在春天慵懒的呼吸里。

text: A black and white dress that echoes how Jixia scholars observe the heavens and understand nature, as free and easy as a fish.
Black satin covered in red scales, with flowing fire leaping like surging dragon breath.
Super-cool radish suit, making the wearer look like the king of all radishes.
The dual blades, made from gleaming bones, shine with a cold light. The power of frost seeps through the bones.
Gilded frame and amethyst glow—a haunting hue that mirrors the depths of someone's abyssal eyes.
Mysterious and wise leaves, versed in all scholarly arts... foreseeing the unknown.
A black mask invented by Cannoneers and dyed black after being stolen by Rebels.
A sharp, eye-catching hairstyle that radiates a confident and spirited vibe—like a young phoenix ready for a wider sky.
A genius work by a genius puppy. Put on this fragrant pink rose-colored soft hat and let's go!
The mist clears, and the past is revealed once more.\nThis is a silent protection, and also a brand-new promise.
At night, the conch hums softly, and the pearls shimmer. Who is whispering? The light of the conch and the starlight intertwine, illuminating the long night.
Many new students want to make a stunning debut with a dazzling hairstyle.
Fluffy ears with adorable stripes, cocked to the murmur of forest winds.
Green leaves hang gently and the plumes stir softly. Under the leaves, a tiny theater unfolds the chirping song of the rain.
Fitted with white velvet and a light gold top, just as auspicious snow covers the wheat fields of Harvest Fields. This year is bountiful and the next year holds promise.
A soft inner lining resembling rosy clouds, paired with a light, short coat. Fresh and elegant, it blends gentle charm with vitality.
A firearm reserved for the mightiest who have risen to the heavens, infused with the power of a legendary dragon's heir.
Butterfly wings nestle around her ankles, waiting quietly for fate's design. Petals cling to her skin, as the night whispers its promises in silence.
Looks bulky, but it's actually quite agile. A powerful radish, ready to kick away any thief who dares step into the garden.
Fitted with white velvet and a light gold top, just as auspicious snow covers the wheat fields of Harvest Fields. This year is bountiful and the next year holds promise.
A sharp bone whip forged from interlinked dragon bones, striking with unrelenting force.
A basic cooking knife decorated with interwoven cloud patterns, perfect for beginners.
A pair of thick velvet boots. Crisscross paneled in red and white, like treading snow to find the plum blossoms, where a charming silhouette emerges.
Pants stitched from sturdy leather. Beneath old armor, they become the last line of defense against sharp blades.
A mysterious radish outfit to provide more guidance to young radishes.
Comfortable, light green socks. When the swallows return, let's enjoy a spring day outdoors.
A cute accessory that has become popular among the Sorcery students who train abroad. Reminds people of the little crabs on the beach.
A little frog crouching under a light green lotus leaf, a steaming teapot—is it brewing some brilliant ideas?
The blade shines with flowing light and has star patterns that sparkle. The guard is hollow and shaped like a light butterfly. "To soar to the skies, to chase the stars and catch the moon."
A hundred feathers in order, the mechanism is silent. Within a square inch, a wing of brilliance unfolds.
zh_text: 百翎有序，巧机无声。于方寸之间，舒展一翼华彩。
source_text: 百翎有序，巧机无声。于方寸之间，舒展一翼华彩。

text: Pick some fresh leaves, prepare Naughty Civet's favorite treats, and head into the bamboo grove to play with them.
A stylish gold outfit as pleasant as the sun, ideal for those who need to assemble and repair gadgets.
Dawn mist brushes the skin, carrying Jixia's timeless, poetic elegance.
Weary and curled up in a corner, the most important thing is to get as comfortable as possible.
Carved mirror back, swimming fish and lake reflections. The world within the mirror is poetic and picturesque, a touch of clarity reflecting leisure.
An accessory rumored to enhance a Dreamweaver's connection to dreams during the night.
The warrior ignites the fierce tiger's flames, pouring their rage into the tragic fate of their kin.
Elegant yet comfortable bottoms, equally suited for outdoor adventures and academy soirées.
Wear a Scholar Goose sachet, and studying will never be a worry again. Stuck on a tricky problem? Don't hesitate to ask that strict mentor!
Under the dark night, the Spirit Cat yawns lazily. "Today... don't work hard either, meow."
The Mecharms shine with a radiant golden glow. The light flickers like stars amidst drifting clouds.
The Mecharms shine with a radiant golden glow. The light flickers like stars amidst drifting clouds.
Blue and yellow star cotton slippers, with fluffy pom-poms forming the insole, like walking on clouds.
zh_text: 蓝黄星星棉拖，毛绒绒的团子连成鞋垫，像踩在云朵上。
source_text: 蓝黄星星棉拖，毛绒绒的团子连成鞋垫，像踩在云朵上。

text: Soft, lightweight boots with the protection you need for true mountain exploration.
Young and vibrant leaves, carrying the temperament of Luo Shishu.
The brim hangs low, dew drops shimmer with the morning light on the pansy petals, blurring into brilliance.
zh_text: 帽檐低垂，露珠闪动三色堇花瓣上的晨光，晕开绚烂。
source_text: 帽檐低垂，露珠闪动三色堇花瓣上的晨光，晕开绚烂。

text: When the smoke of war rises, it's time to guard the frontier and defend the realm.
A hairband woven with light-colored floral ornaments, paired with sweet and pretty braids, bringing the fragrant scent of the academy garden.
In the spring of her rebirth, the blades sliced through the chill and claimed a name—so did she.
A warm short jacket with a sleek cut and lively, cute pom-poms, bringing the good news of spring.
Dawn reflects on the sea, long hair adorned with shadows, like waves kissing the horizon.
White bandages are loosely wrapped around her calves. Her figure belongs only to the wilderness of the wind.
Light on your toes, blending the cutest summer echoes into the sea breeze and crashing waves.
zh_text: 足尖一点轻快，将盛夏最可爱的尾音融入海风与潮声。
source_text: 足尖一点轻快，将盛夏最可爱的尾音融入海风与潮声。

text: A badge worn by members of the Team of Stars, once your guiding light through the depths of an endless nightmare.
White bandages casually wrapped around her calves—she belongs to the realm of free wind.
A graceful radish robe that looks down on other radishes, becoming the embodiment of elegance.
Vibrant pink radish suit, making you curious about the bandit's past.
Lightweight boots trimmed in gold with white jade accents and flowing green patterns. Designed for travelers who pause to sense the magical rhythm of Jixia.
A small tag that binds together the daily lives of classmates and the journey they share.
zh_text: 小小一张，系住同窗日常，也系住一路同行。
source_text: 小小一张，系住同窗日常，也系住一路同行。

text: A flick of the ear tips, good luck appears; a swish of the tail, trouble says goodbye.
Fresh, slightly wavy short hair. A gentle naturalist, bringing good luck to Jixia in the spring.
Low-key dark mid-calf socks. Sturdy and flexible, said to be from Xuan Yong.
The star-stream falling with the night flows with every step, writing a silent order in the tranquility.
A dark cyan bronze staff adorned with a navy-blue gem. The gem emits an eerie glow, evoking a sense of impending danger.
A dark cyan bronze staff adorned with a navy-blue gem. The gem emits an eerie glow, evoking a sense of impending danger.
A recorder shaped like a Big-eye Owlet, compact yet versatile. The must-have gear for every Snapster.
Wings woven from Aersilk. The threads surge, raising mountains in one moment and stirring storms in the next.
The mountain wind of Jixia whistles low, tiger ears tremble slightly, lying quietly in the depths of the forest shadows, motionless, yet already charged with the momentum of thunder.
zh_text: 稷下山风低啸，虎耳微颤，静伏于林影深处，未动，却已蓄满雷霆之势。
source_text: 稷下山风低啸，虎耳微颤，静伏于林影深处，未动，却已蓄满雷霆之势。

text: Floating light sways, like a whale touching summer, leaving the scent of lemon in my heart.
Floating light flickers, like a whale gently touching the scent of lemons drifting in summer.
Forest snow blankets the land. Short robe embroidered with lions, a figure dancing gracefully to music.
When leaning over, the cloak drapes into the sea, and the splashing water droplets turn into pearls, hiding the kiss the mermaid never offered.
Let's have a spicy adventure! Otherwise, I'll give you a spicy exit!
Approaching graduation, how do you face the deadly series of questions from your Mechcraft mentor? Put on this hood and blend into the game.
Dark-colored pants with a simple and elegant style from Jixia Academy, featuring a relaxed cloud swirl pattern.
When delicate, ethereal wings gently touch the water, the splashing droplets turn into pearls that hide the mermaid's cherished kiss.
A longbow from Alsahraa, its arrows piercing through falsehood and guarding civilization.
A longbow from Alsahraa, its arrows piercing through falsehood and guarding civilization.
An accessory crafted by the School of Martial Arts, its bold design both exquisite and eye-catching, bearing witness to friendships forged in Jixia.
Take a leap into summer and catch the freshness before anyone else.
zh_text: 先一步跃入夏天，先一步将清爽收入眼底。
source_text: 先一步跃入夏天，先一步将清爽收入眼底。
official_target_text: Take a leap into summer and catch the freshness before anyone else.
official_en_text: Take a leap into summer and catch the freshness before anyone else.

text: Refreshing but not over the top, light and just right. Those who understand sweetness best know when it's time for freshness to take the stage.
zh_text: 清甜不过界，轻快正当时。最懂甜味的人，知道什么时候该让清爽登场。
source_text: 清甜不过界，轻快正当时。最懂甜味的人，知道什么时候该让清爽登场。

text: A black mask invented by Cannoneers and dyed black after being stolen by Rebels.
As graceful as waves on a river, arriving with the tide amidst the falling rain.
Capture the sweetness of summer and share in this floating joy.
zh_text: 圈住夏日的清甜，瓜分这份漂浮的快乐。
source_text: 圈住夏日的清甜，瓜分这份漂浮的快乐。
official_target_text: Capture the sweetness of summer and share in this floating joy.
official_en_text: Capture the sweetness of summer and share in this floating joy.

text: A dignified, weighty metal mask made of bronze, adorned with intricate carvings that exude elegance.
A veil with mist and water ripple patterns, evoking the refined elegance of Jixia.
An accessory crafted by the School of Martial Arts, its bold design both exquisite and eye-catching, bearing witness to friendships forged in Jixia.
Blue fades into white like fabric cut by the wind over the sea, then vanishes into the boundless.
A pack that travels the world with Snapsters, big enough to hold all their creative tools.
Turn heavy pears into a light pack and set off on a happy journey.
A small tag that binds together the daily lives of classmates and the journey they share.
zh_text: 小小一张，系住同窗日常，也系住一路同行。
source_text: 小小一张，系住同窗日常，也系住一路同行。

text: Born of crystallized dreams, these butterfly wings carry their bearer across the endless Dreamscape to the heart of the void.
The artisan boasts about these fire- and explosion-proof stockings but seems to have forgotten that bare arms need protection too.
Covered in puppy paw prints, these are the special work pants from the Veggie Dog Ice Cream Shop.
A heart-melting lemon-colored water gun with cute starfish decorations. It makes you feel like it would spray ice cream.
Refreshing radish suit, reminds you of spring when the radishes stretch out and grow.
The wind flutters his hair. His ears twitch as he turns, trying to catch a scent on the breeze.
With a bamboo hat to shade the face and two bamboo leaves in hand, step into the world of blades and swords. From now on, live freely and walk alone.
zh_text: 笠遮颜，轻携两条竹叶，步入刀光剑影的江湖。从此快意恩仇，自在独行。
source_text: 笠遮颜，轻携两条竹叶，步入刀光剑影的江湖。从此快意恩仇，自在独行。

text: A heavy longbow encased in an obsidian shell, within which surges a thunderous power for ages.
This longbow is made of metal, with ancient patterns carved along its body. A broken string can be replaced, but some farewells last forever.
Durable, woven socks that protect the skin from mountain thorns.
The braid tips adorned with pansies are lightly tied, carrying the morning mist still lingering in the forest.
zh_text: 缀着三色堇的辫梢轻绾，系着林间未散的晨雾。
source_text: 缀着三色堇的辫梢轻绾，系着林间未散的晨雾。

text: This perfectly round hood embodies "Jixia chic" the moment you put it on. Could it be enough to fend off a Scholar Goose's attacks?
Yellow and blue star nightcap, inlaid with crescents and clouds, fully capturing the starry night vibe.
zh_text: 黄蓝星星睡帽，镶着月牙和云朵，星夜氛围感拉满。
source_text: 黄蓝星星睡帽，镶着月牙和云朵，星夜氛围感拉满。

text: Commands the power of ice to dance, condensing a field of extreme cold above the target area. Ancient frost continuously forms icicles that crash to the ground, dealing <IconUltimate></> Ultimate damage to enemies in the area for #Time# seconds.

Casting a Flow Skill creates <Skill_Value><Skill_Number>3</></> <Skill_HL2 ContentRow="1007009">Ice Crystals</> around you. You can have up to <Skill_Value><Skill_Number>9</></> <Skill_HL2>Ice Crystals</> at once; excess <Skill_HL2>Ice Crystals</> will dissipate after a short time. 
<Skill_Ability><Skill_HL2 ContentRow="1007011">Crystal Condensation</></>: Basic Attacks and Flow Skills can be charged to absorb nearby <Skill_HL2>Ice Crystals</>, enhancing the skill's effect. 
<Skill_Ability>Flow Resonance</>: Triggers a Flow Skill after an active resonance Ultimate is cast, generating a blizzard at the target location that deals #Power#<Skill_Value>×<Skill_Number>6</></> Attack damage. 
<Skill_Ability><Skill_HL2>Perfect Dodge</></>: Triggers <Skill_HL2>Perfect Dodge</> to generate <Skill_Value><Skill_Number>3</></> <Skill_HL2>Ice Crystals</>. 
<Skill_Ability>Frost Hunt</>: After <Skill_SP>[ <Skill_HL1>Imprisoning Frost</> ]</> hits, it applies the <Skill_SP>Frost Hunt</> status. While active, targets take <Skill_Value><Skill_Number>10%</></> increased Crit Rate from Frost-attribute attacks. This effect also applies to allies.

每次施放流技时在身边创造<Skill_Value><Skill_Number>3</></>颗<Skill_HL2 ContentRow="1007009">冰晶</>。最多可在身边围绕<Skill_Value><Skill_Number>9</></>颗<Skill_HL2>冰晶</>，额外的<Skill_HL2>冰晶</>将在短暂游离后消失。 
<Skill_Ability><Skill_HL2 ContentRow="1007011">冰晶凝聚</></>：普攻、流技都可蓄力施法吸收附近<Skill_HL2>冰晶</>，提升本次技能效果。

<Skill_Ability><Skill_HL2>完美闪避</></>：触发<Skill_HL2>完美闪避</>后，产生<Skill_Value><Skill_Number>3</></>颗<Skill_HL2>冰晶</>。

The buildings in the city were mainly built using large stones as a foundation, mixed with an appropriate amount of bronze, providing high strength and flexibility. The materials also contain evenly distributed Aerux, which are thought to purify the Dark Star energy. 
 
The architecture of that time was quite advanced. However, according to Luban's experiments, the buildings weren't strong enough to withstand the massive earthquake at the end of the Second Era. The reason they have survived until now is still a mystery. 
 
Many murals were found in the first-floor hall, although many are damaged. Some relatively complete murals depict people taking babies from containers, resembling a birthing ceremony. This suggests a unique belief in reproduction and fertility in that civilization. 
 
In the hall, ceremonial objects made of Aerux, such as Cong, Zhang, and Bi, were discovered, along with bronze masks. This indicates that the location was once an important ritual site. 
 
In various cultures, masks symbolize the idea of losing individuality, imitating animals or spirits. It is currently unknown what the masks found here represent.

Xiaoxun, 
You’ve finally come. I knew you wouldn’t forget our promise. Every year around this time, we’d meet here—looking back on the past, planning the future. But this time, I won’t be able to keep you company in person. 
 
By the time you read this letter, we may have already “missed each other in passing,” because I’m now “asleep” beneath the gravestone at the gate. 
Please don’t be sad. I chose this place carefully, and I’m happy to rest here—it’s where we used to while away our childhood afternoons, fishing together. 
 
Watching you run everywhere for my sake while I lay helpless on a sickbed, feeling my life ebb away—I was deeply pained. Not for myself, nor for the failing of my own body, but because you wasted your youth, your time, your energy, all for someone who was slipping away. 
 
You know I was always afraid of pain. When I was little, even a tumble could make me cry all night, and every time, you would cheer me up with candy. I loved seeing your smile. But ever since my accident, I’ve never seen you smile like that again... 
I knew my illness was beyond saving. And rather than endure the torment of this broken shell of a body—or never again see your smile—I chose to let go. I’ve only gone ahead of you, waiting at the finish line, waiting on the other side of the world. I think you’ll understand my choice. 
 
After I’m gone, you must live well. Let the past fade like smoke. Leave behind the sorrow, carry only the good, and feel life’s warmth for the both of us. 
 
From childhood till now, you’ve always been someone who listened to me. Then listen just once more—take this as my last gift to you. 
Smile often, okay? That was always what I loved most—your smile. 
 
Yunxu

Today, while washing bandages by the stream, a splash of water hit the red string on my wrist. Suddenly, I saw a fifteen-year-old boy emerging from the reeds, his wet hair sparkling with water, holding two greenish bird eggs in his palm. 
"Mayene, look! Freshly laid eggs from the Northern Slope Turtle Dove." 
He treasured the eggs, warming them against his cheeks, his eyelashes glittering with water droplets like crushed diamonds. 
That year, we often lay side by side on the sun-scorched rocks, watching clouds filter through our fingers. 
Later, he was summoned to the Red Falcon Training Hall. 
"Maybe I'll even get to meet General Mulan there!" 
Before he left, he tightened his armguard with a grin reminiscent of our childhood honey thefts, "When it's all over, I'll bring you to Jixia. We'll climb <69D0FF>the highest tree in the Red Falcon Training Hall</> together!"

text:
Second Day of the First Lunar Month
He became a small box wrapped in white linen.
The box was as light as a feather, and the tears that flowed into my mouth tasted bitter and salty.

Fifteenth Day of the First Lunar Month
I arrived at the Red Falcon Hall, clutching the bow he carried when he went to war, and climbed onto the <69D0FF>roof of the Red Falcon main hall</>. By the moonlight, I counted the cracks on the bow over and over again.
zh_text:
正月初二 
他变成了一个白布包着的小小匣子。 
匣子轻得像片羽毛，我尝到眼泪流进嘴里咸得发苦。 
 
正月十五 
我来到了赤隼馆，抱着他出征时那把弓，爬到了<69D0FF>赤隼主殿屋顶</>上，借着月光将弓上的裂纹数了一遍又一遍。

text:
Hurricane Roll 
Trait: A mix of flavors and tonic effects, appear robust as iron, with a gritty, crisp bite. 
Inventor: Yu Huan 
Recipe: 
Dark Blue Betta×3 
Blast Fruit Peel ×5 
Nectar ×7g 
(The rest of the formula has been smeared with ink, leaving it unreadable.) 
 
Notes: 
Incompatible ingredients with nullified medicinal effects; putrid flavor harmful to health. 
The improved method is <5ea8f3>documented separately</> and stored properly. 
It is named <5ea8f3>Rain-kissed Spring Rolls</>. 
Yu Huan, it grieves me deeply to see your hunger for immediate recognition. 
I hope you would repent and stray no further down this path!

text:
Dear Master Mozi, 
 
Perhaps you don't remember me. My name is Luo Anmin. I studied at Jixia years ago and was fortunate enough to attend your lectures. 
 
I now own a Craftworks in Chang'an. Recently, my wife had an accident... She fell from a height and <5ea8f3>will never walk again</>. 
 
She was born into a family of martial artists and has always been fond of swords and weapons. Now, with this unexpected change... It sounds pathetic, but I often cry over this, while she comforts me instead. 
 
I suddenly wondered, if medicine cannot help, <5ea8f3>could your unparalleled Mechcraft skills give my wife new legs</>? 
 
I am willing to pay with all I have for her treatment. I look forward to your response.
zh_text:
墨子亲启： 
 
或许您已经不记得我了，我叫洛安民。多年前曾在稷下学习，还有幸上过您主讲的课程。 
 
如今我在长安开了一家天工坊，但前些日子，妻子遭逢意外……她从高处跌落，<5ea8f3>永远没法再站起来了</>。 
 
我的妻子生于武道世家，从小就喜欢舞刀弄枪，现在遭逢此变……说来可笑，我常因此垂泪，妻子她却会反过来安慰我。 
 
我突然想到，若是医术对此无可奈何，<5ea8f3>那您巧夺天工的机关术能否让我的妻子拥有新的双腿呢？</> 
 
我愿意用我全部身家作为治疗我妻子的报酬，期待您的回信。

A mechanism in the Linglong Tower trial that <69D0FF>guides the trajectory of magic missiles</>.
Attack the deflector in any way to <69D0FF>change its orientation</>.
By adjusting its orientation, you can <69D0FF>guide</> magic missiles in the right direction to shatter the Linglong Tower's core.

Its principle is to absorb magic energy through its shell and deflect the energy's path onto a fixed, set trajectory.

If you intend to inherit this mystery, you may ascend to the <69D0FF>Peak of the Tower of Glory</> and seek out the <69D0FF>Dream-Weaving Task Force</> to make contact. \nFrom then on, the torch is passed to you. May you never forget your original intention and never lose your resolve.

Exclusive Interview: Renowned Iridescent Artist Takes on a New Disciple 
 
 
 
Reporter: Weiyan, Mengchu

Our reporter interviewed the Renji team, one of the top four in this Guixu Dream Trial, and stumbled upon an interesting story. The owner of the food stall at the venue and the engineer responsible for equipment maintenance are actually former members of the Renji team who left after a falling out. However, thanks to the help and mediation of enthusiastic students, the old members reconciled with the captain, and the new members were inspired and encouraged. We believe the Renji team will achieve even better results in the next competition.
Caiyun's voice came through: "Please set the destination to <69D0FF>Old Craftsman's Workshop</>. Can't wait! Can't wait!"
Damage Status: Two parts missing, a bunch of automatons broken. \nCause of Damage: ...Unknown. \nRepair Progress: All repaired.
Recently, Zhao Fengan, the renowned art teacher at Iridescent Stream, has taken a new student from a humble background as his apprentice.

The truth about the incident at the Dream Performance finals remains unclear. However, multiple students who witnessed the event mentioned a mysterious cavern beneath the colorful clouds and speculated about a monster that might be 'symbiotic' with the Cloud Root.

In the last two days, there have been several reports of students spotting unidentified figures in the thick fog. Could they be related to these so-called 'Cloud Root monsters'? Logically, the academy's teachers and the Dream Performance Mobile Team should have fully contained the situation, leaving no unknown monsters behind.

But if those monsters have been 'symbiotic' with the Cloud Root for years, it is theoretically possible for their energy to linger long after their physical forms have dissipated! Although my primary job is to monitor the Cloud Root ecosystem, this hypothesis is impossible to ignore. I will return here tomorrow to observe, hoping to verify my theory soon.
Recently, two reporters from Secrets Scoops discovered a suspicious Rebel camp northwest of Iridescent Stream. Disguised as delivery personnel, they bravely infiltrated the camp...

A mechanism in the Linglong Tower trial that <69D0FF>stores magic missiles</> and allows you to change their trajectory by releasing them again.
Place the Magic Storage Core in the path of a magic missile to absorb and store it.

It has the potential to become a convenient and efficient magic weapon.

However, please note that the Magic Storage Core itself is somewhat dangerous and has a limited capacity for magic energy.
Do not <69D0FF>throw</> it casually after it has stored a large amount of magic energy—it's dangerous!
Do not attempt to modify it into a "magic explosive device"—dangerous! Dangerous! Dangerous!

The four of you have finally overcome your inner demons; my wish is fulfilled. 
 
Recently returned to Jixia, the <69D0FF>Gate-Breaking Villain, Qiang Wuzhong</>, is my sworn brother. He betrayed the righteous path and has caused chaos for a long time, leading to his current infamy. I am also to blame for this. 
 
Since Qiang Wuzhong has returned to Jixia, he is waiting at <Jump>Area|133</> for me to settle the regrets of these past years. 
 
This journey is fraught with danger. It is a pity that as your master, I cannot see you four graduate. There are reasons for this, so please forgive me.

Investigation: Missing Parts at Iridescent Clouds? 
 
 
 
Reporters: Weiyan, Mengchu

Latest: Canyon Competition Highlights \n \nReporters: Weiyan, Mengchu

That student, Xiao Si, whom I met yesterday, is truly interesting.

Although I was a bit rattled when I first saw him... but honestly, anyone would scream if they saw a figure seemingly emerging from the Cloud Roots in such thick fog! He started spouting nonsense about being symbiotic with the Cloud Roots, the flow not yet dissipating, and needing to return something. Thankfully, he later admitted he was joking, or I would have been scared out of my wits.

Once we started talking properly, I realized he is very knowledgeable about history. He spoke about the Thousand Chariots so vividly, as if he had seen it with his own eyes. If there's a chance, I'd really like to chat with him more.

With the material he provided, my new lyrics should be finished soon. Perhaps I should invite some students to listen tomorrow!

Note: No. 5 seems very interested in barbecue. Although its energy core cannot digest organic matter, it seems to enjoy using its own abdominal cavity as a... grill? Constant temperature, even heating—honestly, it's much better than the Academy's ovens.

February 27th

Note: No. 5 has a catchphrase lately: "Boom, boom...". What does this "boom" mean? Is it planning to blow something up? I can rule out "hug".

Beneath the deep pool in the Iridescent Basin, something from the past seems hidden.

Guided by the riddle, I challenged the Exquisite Tower, but the trial was not smooth sailing. At the "Path of Ingenuity: End," the tower's core suddenly overloaded, but fortunately, Master Luban arrived in time to stabilize the situation.\n\nAfter I passed the trials of all six towers, the rumored first key of the Master—the "Keystone of Rock"—turned into a stream of light and fell gently into my hands.

Iridescent Basin is the final stage of the Enlightenment Trials, where students train and test themselves every day. Piner, the teacher in charge of Dainty Vale, recently helped the Aerwatch deal with some Rebels. Rebels keep coming, and there may be a larger threat hidden beneath the surface.

Beneath Jixia lay a hidden marvel, bronze buildings of incredible design stretched far. 
 
I managed to escape the Mechanoid Guards and found the Battle Prep Order in the ruins. Time had blurred most of the text, but phrases like "war is imminent" and "emergency shelter" remained intact. It had once been a sanctuary. 
 
Further inside, claw marks scarred the stone walls. On the broken wooden shelves, I found desperate notes from past explorers. They found no treasure, only dread. Battlefield or sanctuary, it mattered little. In the end, it was all just history. 
 
The antique Volcanic Stone Key might be the only clue left to unlock the truth of this place.

After uncovering the secret behind the "typo," I finally found a clue at the Race Goose, only to discover the key had scattered into three broken-gate student strongholds and reverted to its flow form. I returned the key fragments to the Race Goose, and the broken token was restored under the guidance of the flow. I heard the Master's voice in my ear, and I received the second key—the "Contract of Peers," symbolizing collaboration. The Master's second riddle ends here.

The third riddle involved Lu Ban No. 5. During the Dream Performance accident twelve years ago, No. 5 was deemed 'out of control and dangerous.' To ensure the safety of other students, Master Lu Ban had to seal it away along with the laboratory. Now, however, No. 5 is missing. Following the trail, I found No. 5 hiding at the bottom of Caiyun Pool. It had entered a stress-induced state due to its fear of water, and after a fierce struggle, I managed to calm its agitation. Master Lu Ban's arrival awakened No. 5. It said it just wanted to see the outside world. But its massive frame caused panic among the students. They feared No. 5, and No. 5 feared itself—fearing it would 'lose control' again and hurt the innocent. The truth was revealed: whether twelve years ago or today, No. 5's 'malfunction' wasn't a breakdown, but a clumsy attempt to protect others. Beneath its cold, mechanical shell, a pure heart of guardianship had always been beating. With the misunderstanding cleared, No. 5 naively handed over a 'house key' it had cherished. And this was the Master's third key—the 'Heart of Watchfulness.'
Continue your exploration in "Renaming Day" to uncover more content.

I returned to the top of the Honor Tower with Luban No. 5's core. I heard a familiar voice. It was Luban. He repaired the core and restored Luban No. 5's training function. It can now finally fulfill its original mission after being at the bottom of the lake for years.

As Suchen and I marveled at the grandeur of the Underhall and felt our duty fulfilled, the village chief, Zhong Yan, emerged from the shadows. It was he who had destroyed the stone tablet and obstructed our investigation, all in an attempt to protect the villagers after witnessing the tragedy of Malva. 
 
In the face of Suchen's arguments, the chief recounted the stories of the Sanctified. They had to endure harsh trials. To prevent mass casualties, they established a path of trials to weed out the unworthy.  
 
This path is treacherous even for the young Sanctified, let alone the students... what happened to Malva was a grim warning. Suchen said that the mission of a Seeker is to uncover the secrets of history. But what if uncovering those secrets brings pain? What should we do then? Could there be more secrets to be unearthed in Jixia?
