This piece is inspired by Master's image while guiding students in the training grounds. During every Guxie Mountain trial, Master would spar with the martial arts students alone. His ruler would touch them like a dancing dragon, guiding their martial techniques.

When this item first hit the shelves at Baihui Market, sales were dismal. Later, a martial arts student on a whim brought the doll with him to an exam, and he passed subjects he had repeatedly failed. Since then, rumors spread through the academy that the doll brings good luck for exams, and it became a bestseller overnight.

A multi-functional, adjustable telescopic drying rack made of sturdy, lightweight material.

Inspired by the mecharms of Luban from the Star Team. It features windproof clips, is durable, and has a high load-bearing capacity. It sold out immediately upon release and is a favorite among Jixia students. It is said that many Chang'an mechanists visiting Jixia also keep one as a souvenir.

Due to its telescopic nature, many martial arts students use it as a pull-up bar in their doorways or against walls for training anytime, anywhere. Every school year, the Hundred-Treasures Workshop prepares a batch in advance for freshmen.

Fuzzes are creatures with an affinity for people but can also be rather stubborn. 
They are characterized by their wholly blue coloration and fuzzy fur that feels comfortable to touch. 
Fuzzes are one of the most common types of pets, captivating many people. 
 
Domesticating a Fuzz requires time and effort, but they are incredibly loyal to those who earn their approval. 
However, Fuzzes can be recalcitrant and react poorly to changes in their owners or living conditions.

Flames light up the sky, the sea boils high. 
 
Every Jixia local grows up hearing tales of the Crimson Beast. It is said to be as tall as mountains, with a crimson mane and fiery sparks that turn dark nights into day. 
 
Each step it takes turns the ground beneath it into magma, even causing tundras to sizzle. However, adults always deter the excited children, mentioning that apart from getting wet in an avalanche, it has never been beaten in a combat.  
 
"Beware of playing with fire, or you will wet the bed," the adults warn.

A mini massage hammer meticulously crafted after Zhong Wuyan's iconic hammer. It loosens muscles, improves circulation, and can be used on the whole body. Use it to relax your back during downtime, or to stay alert and focused when busy.

Back in the day, Zhong Wuyan challenged various martial arts schools with a single hammer, even smashing a deep pit into the floor of the Heming Hall. For a time, martial arts students regarded her hammer as a spiritual pillar.

This hammer is affordable and versatile, becoming a hit as soon as it was released. Every time new stock arrived, the rush was chaotic. It is said that Zhong Wuyan tried three times and failed to grab one, only managing to get one on her fourth attempt after using her real hammer to smash the ground and distract others.

Thunder Tiles are invented and refined by students from the School of Mechcraft. 
They are equipped to unleash powerful bolts of lightning. 
Their internal cannon can strike multiple targets, inflicting widespread damage.  
 
Thunder Tiles can also harness the power of thunder to leap across miles, leaving unfortunate students with nowhere to hide from their thunderous projectiles.

Thunderlash Aeroclads, forged from Aerux, are considered one of the most successful creations of the School of Mechcraft. 
They resemble veteran soldiers and possess no weaknesses. 
Their thunderous blades strike with lightning speed, making them formidable. 
During initial tests, most teachers found it challenging to deal with them. 
 
The School of Mechcraft has implemented numerous experimental designs, among which the most important design is the Mech Core which enables tons of modifications. However, the one who created the Mech Core remains unknown.

Stone relics fade with time, as the years deepen around the empty hall. 
 
It was awakened only few times. The old man with a white beard stood before it, followed by diligent young men. 
 
As time passed, the pillar collapsed and the land cracked. 
 
Dual-Axe General woke up amidst the ruins. It didn't know where the liveliness of the past had gone, but it remembered its mission: To protect and defend, until the enemy armies retreat, and until people can dream without concerns.

Mechanoid fighters forged from a mysterious metal. 
 
Larger than Spear Effigies, they stand clad in polished armor that gleams under the light. They wield their spears decisively and with great force, striking fear into those who stand in their path. 
 
Once, they marched as a unified force, but a mysterious turn of fate has scattered them across Jixia.

These giant Saepes carry shields as hard as boulders. 
The shields have been enhanced with special methods, making them impervious to ordinary attacks. 
 
In some folk paintings, giant figures are depicted wielding similar shields.

Stonepines tower above, lush and green, as if standing amidst the clouds.
Treasure hunters and adventurers visiting the Ghostpath City know to steer clear of a certain dark patch of land, even though the soil looks no different from anywhere else, and even supports a dense grove of trees.
But they know those aren't trees—they are a single, colossal trunk, reaching high into the clouds.

Once, the Earth-Shaking Wildwood was just a young Saepes. Time gave it a gargantuan body, but eroded its clarity of mind.
After being abandoned in this cage, it always tries to hold onto everyone who passes by, but people only scream and flee.
It doesn't understand, so with each subsequent attempt, it becomes more forceful and frantic, pushing the very objects of its affection further away.

The Winddriving Fish was created by the School of Sorcery for cultural festivals. 
It flaps its insect wing-like tail fins to stay airborne. 
It charges and releases Sorcery energy through the mouth for attacks. 
 
Cultural events tend to feature a lot of fish-shaped handicrafts. 
People generally believe that fish signify abundance and are a symbol of bountiful harvests and plenty.

Tender buds fill the body, learning to walk clumsily.
When delicate vines take root in the old shell that has become nutrients, a new life begins.
Its thorn-covered body protects the fragile main bud.
The face on the mask is merely a disguise.
At this moment, it is full of longing.
It must embrace and communicate sincerely with every creature it meets for the first time.

Does their cyclical life count as a continuation of the self?
When most of what belongs to the self is replaced, can the core that guides their consciousness remember the former self?

A Big-eye Owlet who admires himself as a genius, styling his feathers in a dashing fashion inspired by his idol. 
His cloak is made from the same white cloth Novar once wrapped around his sword hilt. 
Seeing it as a rival's symbol, he vows to remove it only after defeating Novar. 
 
The Owlet often recounts the tale of his battle with Novar, a fight so intense it ended in a draw. 
In that final moment, Novar resorted to pulling its feathers to claim victory.

Shielded Nebuclads are defensive Mechanoids created from Aerflow crystals by the academy. 
Their two gigantic, crystal-based shields are coated with a special paint. 
Their crystalline structure deadens any impact and leaves no blind spots when defending against attacks. 
 
Their defenses are almost impenetrable. 
Intel on their weak spots has been sold for princely sums in the academy. 
Thus, training with them often centers on whether students can pinpoint and hit their weak spots.

Flame Tiles have perfectly aligned corners, summoning flames that surge both upward and downward. 
A sparrow fledgling is carved into them—so lifelike that it sends a shudder through those who gaze upon it. 
The quad-drive device unleashes punishing flames in layers, each instilling great fear. 
Any land they fight upon becomes a fiery prison, forcing enemies to tread with caution. 
 
A flame will eventually burn out. A spark will be extinguished by the wind. 
Passion is fleeting, but silence is eternal. 
Do not indulge in temporary pleasures, lest the young lose their ambition. 
When regret comes later in life, the elderly blame heaven and others.

A rare fish dwelling in the waters of Jixia. 
 
Occasionally, it leaps above the water, floating momentarily using gas stored in its chest. 
 
When caught in the rays of the setting sun, its deep blue scales shimmer in a dazzling array of rainbow hues. 
 
 
 
Legends say that the Treasure Fish feed on precious stones, and the more vibrant their scales, the greater the treasure hidden in their bellies. 
 
Consequently, treasure hunters are often seen in pursuit, hoping to catch a glimmer of their prized scales.

People who rely on boats may not be good swimmers, yet they can still cross rivers. This saying holds true for the creation of a bronze cube that harnessed the power of the imprint to reach the other side of the ocean. 
 
Since its inception, this cube has tirelessly kept the ship in working order, day and night. Many would gaze at it, wondering if it would protect them on their journey. However, the cube remained silent, its only response being the flickering of its light. 
 
It envisioned a future not too far away, where fleets of ships would embark on a grand voyage across the vast ocean. But it also foresaw that it would not be a part of this adventure. Instead, it would remain stranded in the winding river of history, having fulfilled its purpose long before.

An unyielding gatekeeper, one who can hold the pass against a thousand riders. With a massive shield, it blocks all who stand before it, enduring like a mountain even in ruin. Forged from a fallen hero's shield, it stands as the pinnacle of mechanised defence. 
 
When icy boulders fall off the cliff, there is no retreat. Its core is etched with unbreakable resolve, its defence impenetrable. 
 
Its back faced the country it fought to defend as the underhanded cavalry streamed into the pass. In the dying light of dusk, as shadows stretch long, reinforcements emerge.

He has lingered for a long time in this world, while his companion has returned to where it came. 
 
The Sentinel wanders the valleys. He is a cavalier without a ride. The giant sword on his shoulder shows the hard-to-believe size of his companion. 
 
The only thing he can count on now is the giant sword that's become a part of him. His powerful strike can still cut through mountains and rivers even without a vertical dive. 
 
The dragon rider still holds the pact with the dragon. Since the ride is gone, the place where they parted is likely to be where he will spend the rest of his days.

The Relic Hundred-General is a bronze mechanical commander guarding the Jixia ruins.
Strange patterns cover its bronze structure.
They hold sharp, ancient spears, attacking quickly and lethally.

They have internalized combat tactics and represent the highest command of the bronze mechanical army.

Aershrouds are slightly larger than common cranes.
Their bodies are wholly white, and their wings are a pale shade of blue, reminiscent of the sky. When they take flight, it is as if the heavens themselves have come alive—a truly breathtaking sight.

Thin, elongated feathers grow from their foreheads, which they unintentionally brandish while in flight.

Aershrouds prefer serene environments and are naturally drawn to wise individuals.
As such, they can often be found wandering about the academy campus, towns, or the abodes of hermits.
However, how Aershrouds identify wisdom remains unknown.

Tender buds fill the body, learning to walk clumsily.
When delicate vines take root in the old shell that has become nutrients, a new life begins.
Its thorn-covered body protects the fragile main bud.
The face on the mask is merely a disguise.
At this moment, it is full of longing.
It must embrace and communicate sincerely with every creature it meets for the first time.

Does their cyclical life count as a continuation of the self?
When most of what belongs to the self is replaced, can the core that guides their consciousness remember the former self?

Widely found across Jixia, these deer boast agile and elegant builds. 
Nourished by abundant Aersilk, the males possess sturdy antlers to fend off predators. 
They live in herds with clear divisions of labor. 
 
By nature timid, they are unlikely to attack humans. 
Legend says all things have a spirit, especially on Jixia's ancient and mystical land. 
Even the numerous Cloud Stags and Does are steeped in myths and legends.

The two birds have parted. The disappointed one falls on the mountaintop. 
Bringing a storm, the solitary blue falcon descended from the mountain to the wasteland. 
Flapping its wings, it brings the thunder of the clouds. 
Its flashing eyes gaze at the most valuable things in the world. 
Its unpredictable anger destroys all obstructing rocks. 
Its beauty and aloofness are equally known. 
Apart from venting its emotions, it hardly interacts with any other creatures. 
 
This is the most widely circulated story of the Skyrumble Falcon in the mountain city. 
 
Yet, storytellers often succumb to exaggeration when describing legendary beings. 
In truth, the Skyrumble Falcon is rarely aggressive, preferring to spend its time savoring the cool breeze of the night.

Created by the academy, they stand in front of Adept Sorcerers and wield swords and shields for close-quarters combat. \n \nThey are built to continually advance until damaged to the point of non-functionality. If they encounter obstacles, they will find an alternative path.
Where arrows fly through the forest, falcons are startled into flight. Arrows shot from the depths of the forest will alert anyone who lacks awareness.

Quakecannon Effigies are ancient ranged Mechanoid fighters. 
Their arms have been transformed into cannons that launch projectiles with thunderous force. 
 
Do they occasionally reminisce about the stormy nights etched in their memories amidst the booming of their cannon barrels?

The three Ice Tiles are lined up in a row, and raised to invite the thunder's descent. 
The bitter cold wind is pushing the limit. 
Anyone facing them would feel great fear at their impending mortality. 
The cold air gathers in the core, and the frosted ice is immediately called out, 
conveying the nature of the game. 
 
Luck is like the wind, fleeting in an instant. 
Victory and defeat are decided in a moment of laughter, the outcome of the game and the path of life, all come down to choices.

Bronze for a spine, scales linked in rows.
Engraved patterns on fins, gliding through the air.
An exquisite automaton crafted in the likeness of a diving dragon and fish,
Patrolling the Abyss for a thousand years, breathing wind and frost beneath the stone dome.
Should any intruder covet the treasures stored on the tall ship,
The long alarm will sound, and the greedy shall not escape the fish's maw.

The embers of war have long turned to the dust of ruins,
The old masters are gone, yet it still fulfills its mission of protection,
Until that fisherman's song crosses the sea and returns home.

It lurks in the nightmares of students,
absorbing the obsessions and darkness in people's hearts to reshape itself.
From the bite of a mad wolf to the pounce of a giant bear,
it gradually condenses the power of destruction within endless bestiality.
This shadow born of dreams attempts to break the boundary between reality and illusion, using sharp blades to tear the present world apart.

"The more awake you are in a dream, the more trapped you are in reality."
The awakened shadow projects the despair and darkness from the depths of the soul into people's dreams,
and thus the dream twists into this dark incarnation of disaster.

A Mechcraft warrior wielding a blade of fire. Beneath the black-gold armor, a fiery core burns ceaselessly. The Ten-Thousand-Forge Blade is highly skilled in close-quarters combat, striking with the weight of a mountain. The intense heat of its massive fire blade is enough to melt metal. Few creatures dare to provoke the Ten-Thousand-Forge Blade, and it does not provoke others. Combat is no longer its mission, but its fated destiny.

Tailed Lizardlings, affected by the Dreamscape, possess lovely and ethereal scales as they prowl through the forests in the Dreamscape. 
Swift in their movements, they sustain themselves by feeding on bugs within the Dreamscape. 
 
Herbalist records indicate: "Their tails have medicinal uses, and people often say that dreaming of these lizards wears out both body and soul."
A chubby kitty bursting with mischievous food schemes—yet always full of love and unwavering loyalty for its owner.

Nightmare Spike Bears live in the Dreamscape. They sport unusually colored fur. 
Their cheeks are marked with patterns of Dream Butterflies, and their backs sprout thorn-like manes. 
Only those with a strong will can face their formidable presence without trembling. 
 
Nightmare Spike Bears subsist on the Dream Energy in Dream Thorns and use their prey's fear as seasoning. 
"Courage is your most lethal weapon" is what all Hunters must keep in mind before entering the Dreamscape.

The River Sprite is tiny, with a disproportionately large crown of bright green sprouts. 
It likes to hide in hard-to-spot corners such as under giant rocks or atop trees. 
 
Legend has it that if you're lucky enough to encounter one, it will suddenly jump out and surprise you. 
As for what the surprise might be, you'll have to find out yourself. 
Some scholars collectively call Jixia's River Sprites "Sproutlings."

Despite significant size differences, it can easily be mistaken for the Azure Beast at first glance. 
Its ice-blue fur shimmers under the sun like a peaceful ocean, emitting a soft glow. 
The cold breath it exhales can freeze the surrounding air. 
 
Any creature daring to challenge it struggles to escape its icy grip,  
a relentless winter spreads across the land. 
With its horns and frost,  
it proves that even the smallest beings can wield formidable power.
This goose loves telling jokes, but most of the time, it's the only one laughing!

The genius lost to the past has returned, bringing a dazzling storm of golden starlight and deadly constellation Sorcery. 
 
Stellar Shatter: Hellbound Sentinel moves to the center and summons five celestial spheres that orbit him while he channels. Destroy all five spheres before he finishes channeling, or he will unleash a full-screen attack. 
 
Heavenly Traverse: Hellbound Sentinel summons five hidden constellation shadows and three rotating walls of starlight. Each wall has a gap you can pass through. Move through the gaps to find and destroy all five hidden shadows.

Flames light up the sky, the sea boils high.
Every Jixia local grows up hearing tales of the Crimson Beast.
It is said that the monster is as towering as a mountain, and the sparks from its breath, mixed with its crimson mane, can turn midnight into day.
With every step it takes, it turns the ground beneath it into magma, and even the permafrost of the highlands boils.

To stop the excited children who are eager to try their luck, the adults always add a "however."
However, except for the time it got its head soaked by an avalanche, no one has ever gained the upper hand in a fight with it—be careful not to wet the bed from playing with fire, little one!

These wearable, foldable wings are a favorite among the children of Jixia. After the Team of Stars' victory, Sun Bin's unique mechanical wings became the most sought-after toy overnight. Baihui Workshop released this item to meet the demand, though for safety reasons, they don't actually allow you to fly.\n\nLegend has it that a child begged Sun Bin to take him for a flight on his birthday. After Sun Bin agreed, his laboratory was swarmed by children asking for a ride. The shy and reserved Sun Bin never imagined he would one day become a hero to the kids.

In the advanced challenge, the two Sentinels use stronger teamwork and summon phantom clones to catch you off guard. Sharp eyes are your best defense. 
 
Doomblade Sentinel splits into four phantom clones, each charging a different player. 
 
ALL four phantom clones must hit Pickaxe Sentinel's Inferno Shield to break it. Stay spread out so the clones don't cross paths.

Embermane is a battle-hardened beast that breathes fire and attacks with blade-like claws. It enjoys burning anything that enters its territory, and wherever it stands, the flames linger. 
 
Scorching Inferno: Embermane covers the area in a wave of fire, during which friendly Saepes summon stone pillars around the area one after another. 
 
Pillar Dance: You must jump onto those pillars to avoid the burning ground. Each pillar only supports weight briefly before collapsing, so you and your team need to move and time your jumps carefully. When Embermane's fire attack ends, it becomes exhausted and vulnerable—that is the best moment to deal the most damage.

The Radish King reigns supreme, a terror known far and wide. Its gleaming kitchen knife hints at danger beneath its playful demeanor, as it vows to defend the dignity of the Radishes through battle. 
 
Vine Command: Leaping to the center of the arena, the Radish King knocks back all players, then sounds its horn to ensnare three targets in twisting vines and drag them close. Anyone dragged to the Radish King faces a deadly strike. 
 
Groundbound Cutters: Meanwhile, the knife-wielding Radishes burrow along the edges, chasing unbound players. Guide these little attackers to sever the vines and free your allies before it's too late.
This Preydator is an Aerwatch dedicated to martial arts training and excels as a guard.

Lost Marshals are bronze warriors stationed in the ruins. 
The tips of their bronze pikes are tarnished, yet the Lost Marshals keep them polished, driven by obsession and duty. 
The timeworn pikes gleam menacingly under the moonlight. 
Any creature daring to intrude is mercilessly driven away. 
 
These towering bronze warriors roam the deserted ruins.  
They follow orders that have long since lost their meaning.

A commemorative photo of the Team of Stars' championship victory, beaming with smiles, with Captain Yao holding the trophy in the most prominent position.

After the team won the championship, an artist from the Baihui Workshop was dispatched to the scene to create this sketch and invited Yao to the workshop for a live signing event. Yao later recalled that the enthusiasm of those who bought the painting that day ignited the entire Yungen Town.

Later, students reported that hanging this painting by their bedside made them feel more confident and cheerful. Other students followed suit, and it became one of the best-selling items at the Baihui Workshop.

The Snow-Velvet Fox is a gem-like blue all over, except for its face and chest, where the fur is as white as snow, making it as elegant and noble as a spirit of the frozen world. They are exceptionally agile and flee quickly if anyone approaches, making them difficult to get close to.\n\nAccording to hunter records, the Snow-Velvet Fox seems to be able to sense when a blizzard is ending. During storms, they blend into the snow, leaving only two lines of fine footprints. These tracks have saved countless creatures lost in the blizzard.

[Commanding Vine Bind]: The Radish King leaps to the center of the arena, knocking back all players, then blows a horn to bind three players with vines and drag them toward itself. Players pulled to the Radish King will suffer a fatal slash.\n\n[Ground-Walking Swordsman]: Blade-wielding small radishes appear at the edge of the arena to pursue unbound players. You must lure the small radishes' slashes to cut the vines and save your teammates.

They are tasked with guarding Jixia's ruins. 
Adorned with glowing patterns etched into their bronze bodies, they wield ancient pikes with deadly precision, delivering swift and lethal strikes. 
 
Rebels or curious students alike who venture into the ruins are met with their cold steel.
Bossy Senior and the Runaway Little Puppet

Oil secreted by the Cloudeater when nourished by Aerflow. Once lit, it burns for a long time with a subtle, calming fragrance. It was once used by the people of Jixia for lighting.\n\nA Cloudeater once threw a grease-covered fur ball into a fire, teasing a hunter sitting by the campfire. After his initial panic subsided, the hunter realized this oil was the perfect fuel he had been searching for, and he wrote extensively about it in his observation journal.

Bronze Constructors are Mechanoid workers who repair facilities in ruins. 
Resembling crabs, they have two pincers, walk on four legs, and have bronze shells of Aerux with glittering markings. 
They maintain large bronze facilities as well as Mechanoids. 
 
They are kept busy all day mending things. If not disturbed, they just ignore anyone who comes along.

Rock Civets are occasionally found in places with rich mineral deposits. 
These quirky yet cute creatures wear conical hats and have bluish fur coats resembling the hue of the minerals they dig. 
They are often seen collecting rocks and stones out in the open or busily digging on mountain slopes. 
 
Rock Civets gather to compare the mineral ores they find, using colorful stones and ores to decorate their houses. When in need, they even trade minerals with students from the School of Mechcraft for household items.
A goose doing its best to give praise. Sometimes the truth can be harsh, but a little creative compliment now and then can be nice.

Miner Civets are often found in the caves of Jixia. 
These cute creatures wear conical hats and have dark blue fur coats, allowing them to blend into the dark caves they inhabit. 
They gather ore in the caves and carry them back to their homes. 
 
Many Seekers propose hypotheses to explain this behavior, with the leading theory suggesting that the collected ore serves as building materials. 
Crafters, always in search of more materials, consider Miner Civets their best partners.

The three Ice Tiles are lined up in a row, and raised to invite the thunder's descent. 
 
The bitter cold wind is pushing the limit. Anyone facing them would feel great fear at their impending mortality. 
 
When cold air gathers in the core, the frosted ice is immediately called out, 
conveying the nature of the game. 
 
Luck is like the wind, fleeting in an instant. Victory and defeat are decided in a moment of laughter, the outcome of the game and the path of life, all come down to choices.

A Mechcraft warrior wielding a blade of fire. Beneath the black-gold armor, a fiery core burns ceaselessly. The Ten-Thousand-Forge Blade is highly skilled in close-quarters combat, striking with the weight of a mountain. The intense heat of its massive fire blade is enough to melt metal. Few creatures dare to provoke the Ten-Thousand-Forge Blade, and it does not provoke others. Combat is no longer its mission, but its fated destiny.

[Fire Shield Collision]: The Blade-Severing Spirit locks onto a player to charge, while the Lone Halberd Spirit activates a Fire Shield in the center of the field. Players must lure the Blade-Severing Spirit to collide with the Fire Shield three times to successfully break the shield; otherwise, they will suffer massive screen-wide damage.

Discipline Dogs are small Mechcraft dogs manufactured by the academy. 
While lacking combat abilities, their eyes can record everything they see. 
They are responsible for maintaining discipline and regulating the actions of students in the academy. 
 
Before the invention of the Discipline Dogs, the academy incurred exorbitant fees for daily maintenance and repairs. 
The original design of Discipline Dogs was at least dozens of times larger, possibly to satisfy the desire for victory of some senior student.

Flamedge Aeroclads are melee Mechanoids crafted by the academy using Aerux. 
A gentle flame flows through the Aerux, resembling a stream washing over each Aeroclad. 
In contrast, their blades are ablaze with fire, dazzling opponents like fiery serpents. 
 
Their wooden frames, influenced by the Aerflow, enhance the Flamedge Aeroclads' capabilities.

The Elder Owlet is the incredibly wise elder among the Big-eye Owlets. 
It has long beards and often carries a lantern. 
The Elder Owlet possesses extensive knowledge of ancient tales and engages in conversations with humans alongside other Big-eye Owls. 
 
Fuzi, in particular, considers the Elder Owlet a close friend, relying on it to convey messages. From casual chats to deep discussions, they get along really well.

These wearable, foldable wings are a favorite among the children of Jixia. After the Team of Stars' victory, Sun Bin's unique mechanical wings became the most sought-after toy overnight. Baihui Workshop released this item to meet the demand, though for safety reasons, they don't actually allow you to fly.\n\nLegend has it that a child begged Sun Bin to take him for a flight on his birthday. After Sun Bin agreed, his laboratory was swarmed by children asking for a ride. The shy and reserved Sun Bin never imagined he would one day become a hero to the kids.

Mutated under the Aercocoon's influence, they bear striking purple caps that resemble open umbrellas and expel spore cores as a form of self-defence. \n \nEven seasoned warriors armed with swords and spears keep their distance—not because these creatures are invincible, but because their numbing spores are relentlessly troublesome.

Humanoid combat constructs created by the academy. They usually stand behind the Nimble Vanguards, using staves to fire projectiles from a distance. They are programmed to only attack students attempting the canyon trial. Once their core is damaged, they will move erratically or spin in place.
A strict enforcer of the Academy's rules who takes its job very seriously.

The Rebels turned against the academy as a result of differences in their Martial Arts beliefs. \n \nRebel Hunks are heavily built fighters with powerful arms that let them swing massive hammers easily. They rely on raw strength and often use training methods banned by the academy.

When the storyteller in town speaks of the Radish King, he slams the table and launches into the tale with gleaming eyes: 
 
"At first glance, the creature looks like an enormous radish, blown up to an absurd scale. Its surface is covered in uneven ridges, like earth that has cracked and healed over time. Atop its head, vibrant green leaves sway like towering forest trees. 
 
Beneath those leaves lies a pair of slanted, cunning eyes, glinting with mischief. But what truly draws the eye is the cleaver it carries. The blade gleams under the sun—clearly no ordinary tool—and in its hands, it strikes with terrifying force." 
 
"If you ever encounter it, never underestimate it. Among the creatures born of radish-kind, it stands as one of the fiercest. Its behaviour may defy reason, but one thing is certain: it is no easy opponent."

There was a great tree, for which 8,000 years made up a spring, and another 8,000 years made up an autumn. 
 
The Moonelia Sprout spreads its roots to the shore where clouds swirl, appearing docile and well-behaved most of the time. It stretches out its branches, half flourishing and half withering, creating an environment that fluctuates between brightness and dimness. 
However, anyone who enters its territory will encounter its thick vines pursuing them as tempests. 
 
Herbalists observe the Moonelia Sprout moving slowly on its deep roots. 
"Mortal lives are as mere moments to it. Though the path is long, it walks it slowly, as though it is searching for its homeland."

These giant Saepes carry shields as hard as boulders. 
The shields have been enhanced with special methods, making them impervious to ordinary attacks. 
 
In some folk paintings, giant figures are depicted wielding similar shields.

A beast that prowls in secluded places, rootless, motherless, yet with immense affinity for everything. 
Capable of transforming into any encountered living creature, its true identity remains uncertain. 
Its age and original form are unknown, and imitation might be its way of seeking a place to belong. 
In the time it has wandered throughout Jixia's plains, it has been tirelessly searching for new material, winning, letting go, and winning back again and again in an endless cycle. 
 
At the moment, it is vacillating between the Wolverine, the Embermane, and the Thunderbull. 
It hesitates, ponders, and remains lost. 
Very soon, it will evolve again.

Bronze automatons forged in the likeness of swimming fish, they have patrolled the ruins alone for a thousand years, using long cries and sharp teeth to drive away any intruders coveting their treasures.\n\n[Heavy Cannon Armor-Piercing]: Operate the mechanical turrets in the arena to continuously attack, and use the turret shields to defend against the mechanical copper fish's scale barrages. Sustained bombardment will break the mechanical copper fish's resilience, causing this giant fish to crash to the ground and fall into a brief state of malfunction.

An unyielding gatekeeper, one who can hold the pass against a thousand riders. With a massive shield, it blocks all who stand before it, enduring like a mountain even in ruin. Forged from a fallen hero's shield, it stands as the pinnacle of mechanised defence. 
 
When icy boulders fall off the cliff, there is no retreat. Its core is etched with unbreakable resolve, its defence impenetrable. 
 
Its back faced the country it fought to defend as the underhanded cavalry streamed into the pass. In the dying light of dusk, as shadows stretch long, reinforcements emerge.
High in the clouds, the tiger reigns supreme. The madman who claims to be the strongest master has been waiting with his blade for a long time.

Bats that inhabit the caves of Jixia. 
Their small size and narrow wings allow them to deftly navigate the night sky. 
With extraordinarily sharp hearing, Moon Bats pinpoint their prey in the darkness and strike swiftly. 
 
These small bats typically do not leave their caves, so a sudden swarm of them suggests that disaster might be imminent.

Influenced by the Aercocoon, it absorbs nutrients underground, only revealing a small red section topped with green leaves. 
It springs from the ground to attack when it senses danger. 
 
Despite the Jixia Canteen's efforts to promote its nutritional value, the students are not keen on it. 
"This thing tastes awful," one commented.  
A more likely reason is the unsettling rumor that it moves even while being cooked.

A dark, eerie figure, an incarnate nightmare.
The tall, slender Dreamslayer lurks in the shadows and dreams, waiting for the perfect moment to strike.
The shadows beneath its purple feathers are the prey's final memory, and the moon-blade it wields is the pride of a lone hunter.
The Moon-blade Dreamslayer is born from dreams, one with everything around it.
It moves through the air with ease, its gorgeous slashes like phantoms.

It tears through dream after dream, traversing fantasy after fantasy.
Its dark footsteps are merely the prelude to the hunt; the dreams of the mediocre are the food it survives on.

It sounds as though it is calling its own name. Where it appears, flames raze the place to ashes. 
 
The rusted giant bird struggles to call out. 
It flaps its wings to fly in the sky, eliciting sighs of pity from those who see it. 
Bi Zhuo is burning as though it is preparing its own funeral pyre. 
An aggressive power bursts from its rusted dark markings, consuming the world and itself. 
Where its battered wings fly, saplings wither, and wilted trees smoke alarmingly. 
 
Who changed me? Who am I now? 
It still searches for its rusted past, for jumbled memories of its old nest in that tower ship. 
But it does not know who to ask these questions. Those who know the answer have no desire to bring it home.

A crystal infused with Aerflow. The surging Aerflow within carries the power to grant hope in desperate moments. It is often used to craft ornaments as a symbol of protection.\n\nExhausted from a long battle, the general could no longer dodge the enemy's blade. Yet, the expected pain never came. The crystal on his chest glowed, restoring strength to his arms... When all returned to silence, he pushed aside the enemy's cold body. The crystal on his chest remained warm, accompanying him as he greeted the dawn.

What is clever is that which benefits people; what is clumsy is that which does not.
Built from rare materials, the strongest automaton pushes its components to their absolute limit.
Mechanic arts follow two paths.
The first is 'Material Supremacy.' Every material has a breaking point, and using complex design to circumvent material weaknesses is the most common philosophy.
The second is 'Exploring the Limit.' The Myriad-Pivot Hammer is the ultimate expression of this design philosophy.
When materials are exceptionally tough, what can be achieved?
Its existence provides the answer.

The construction of the Myriad-Pivot Hammer is actually not complex; the philosophy of 'great skill appearing clumsy' is perfectly embodied in the design of this giant automaton.
However, few creatures can withstand even a single casual strike from it.
Its power far exceeds that of a test subject. So, why was this unnatural automaton created?

Quakeshield Nebuclads are defensive Mechanoids created by the academy using Aerflow crystals. 
The swirling purple hue of their massive crystalline shields signifies their unique ability to stun enemies.  
These heavy shields are not just defensive barriers—they excel at exerting relentless offensive pressure on their foes. 
 
Their defensive capabilities remain largely untested,  
as no one has managed to retain control of their weapons long enough to properly assess their full potential.

Aernium, bearing the hallmarks of Jixia's Aerux, its elegant veins evoke gossamer-threaded silk. \nLegend tells that deep beneath Jixia, tremors occasionally thrust veins of this Aernium to the surface. Over time, they crystallized into these very Aerux ores, which contain welling power.

An exquisitely detailed and beautifully crafted Wondrous Maze model.

It perfectly replicates the scene from Kongming's graduation project, making you feel as if you are there. This model is a great way to relieve stress and hone your character.

Legend has it that after Zhuge Liang finished the design of the Wondrous Maze, he invited Zhou Yu to challenge it. Although Zhou Yu refused on the surface, he couldn't resist the temptation and snuck in at night. Little did he know, Zhuge Liang was prepared. After Zhou Yu completed the challenge, Zhuge Liang stayed in the Wondrous Maze for three days and nights. The Wondrous Maze became even more difficult after that. Unfortunately, Zhou Yu had already left school by then and never went back. But after the Baihui Workshop released this model, they received an order from the Three Kingdoms region. The workshop owner speculates that this order most likely came from Zhou Yu.

An unyielding gatekeeper, one who can hold the pass against a thousand riders. With a massive shield, it blocks all who stand before it, enduring like a mountain even in ruin. Forged from a fallen hero's shield, it stands as the pinnacle of mechanised defence. 
 
When icy boulders fall off the cliff, there is no retreat. Its core is etched with unbreakable resolve, its defence impenetrable. 
 
Its back faced the country it fought to defend as the underhanded cavalry streamed into the pass. In the dying light of dusk, as shadows stretch long, reinforcements emerge.

Iceshield Nebuclads are defensive Mechanoids created by the academy using Aerflow crystals. 
The various colors of their massive crystal shields indicate their different elemental attributes. 
Far from being mere defensive tools, these heavy shields are formidable weapons, capable of exerting significant offensive pressure on enemies. 
 
These Mechanoids protect not only restricted zones within the academy but also the precious academic achievements of its students.

Mock not the youth for his foolish words, for there is cold solitude at the end of the Heavenly River.
Since the Star Team won the Pinnacle of Dreams, every student at Jixia knows the name of the Child of Stars. He is passionate and unrestrained, with exaggerated speech and actions. He carves poems into the Star-Gazing Platform, his sword pointing toward the brightest star in the glorious galaxy.
Yet, no one knows he swings his sword every night, driven by a fear of being "mediocre."
No one knows how many times his desperate strikes were fueled by the frustration of collapsing before the mirror.
No one knows that beneath his flamboyant confidence, his heart remains shrouded in shadows from his departed parents.

Perhaps even the Child of Stars himself does not realize that his inferiority, his doubts, his fear of loneliness...
Darkness breeds in the depths of his heart, never sparing him when a dream descends.
Until the moment he embraces the nightmare energy, his roar finds a definitive voice.
He is the nightmare of the Child of Stars, and perhaps, he will become yours as well...

He has lingered for a long time in this world, while his companion has returned to where it came. 
 
The Sentinel wanders the valleys. He is a cavalier without a ride. The giant sword on his shoulder shows the hard-to-believe size of his companion. 
 
The only thing he can count on now is the giant sword that's become a part of him. His powerful strike can still cut through mountains and rivers even without a vertical dive. 
 
The dragon rider still holds the pact with the dragon. Since the ride is gone, the place where they parted is likely to be where he will spend the rest of his days.

The Frostmane Spike Bear dominates the Aerux peak. Its mane has turned to crystal. It is powerful, lonely, and restless, smashing rocks and trees in its wake. Once a target of bounties, it is now a warning to stay away. The town lies in ruins, leaving only decayed wood and scattered fragments.

A Mechcraft warrior wielding a blade of fire. Beneath the black-gold armor, a fiery core burns ceaselessly. The Ten-Thousand-Forge Blade is highly skilled in close-quarters combat, striking with the weight of a mountain. The intense heat of its massive fire blade is enough to melt metal. Few creatures dare to provoke the Ten-Thousand-Forge Blade, and it does not provoke others. Combat is no longer its mission, but its fated destiny.

The tall, slender Dreamslayer lurks in the shadows and dreams, waiting for the perfect moment to strike.
The shadows beneath its purple feathers are the prey's final memory, and the moon-blade it wields is the pride of a lone hunter.
The Moon-blade Dreamslayer is born from dreams, one with everything around it.
It moves through the air with ease, its gorgeous slashes like phantoms.

It tears through dream after dream, traversing fantasy after fantasy.
Its dark footsteps are merely the prelude to the hunt; the dreams of the mediocre are the food it survives on.

A falcon affected by dreams.
It has colorful wings like dream butterflies.
Nightshadow Falcons attack quickly and have a hallucinogenic effect on enemies, making it impossible to tell where they are.

In the Dreamland, the cry of the Nightshadow Falcon is the most distinct—melancholy and cold.
Some say that those who dream of a Nightshadow Falcon will meet with misfortune.

Not obscured by age, accompanied by a uniquely talented spirit. 
People love tales of immortality and the true essence of Martial Arts,  
comforting themselves with the thought that such heroes exist, perhaps hoping to meet one someday. 
Quan Yuan has grown weary of these stories, yet she has become one.  
 
She rarely speaks of her academic past. 
Once rebellious, 
she ultimately found her own path and became a grandmaster. 
Her method of embracing diverse teachings and blending them uniquely has made her an enigmatic figure. 
No one knows why she continues to look youthful, 
but she understands that true immortality lies not in preserving the body but in an ever-persistent spirit that seeks truth.

Lost in the Jixia ruins, they possess a crab-like pincer and a flamethrower that glows with heat. 
They perform maintenance within the ruins and use their flamethrowers to clear obstacles as needed. 
 
A novice Crafter curiously asks, "Would the flamethrower melt its pincer?"

At first glance, this dangerous plant seems ordinary. 
 
A sharp spike coils out from its thorn-covered vine. 
 
The Spike Sprout attacks with the strong vine and deadly spike, making it hard to fend off. 
 
Old books mention the use of its spike: 
 
"...Its tip is like a thorn and can be used in medicine. Can stop bleeding, heal bruises, and regulate energy flow."

The dragon that lurks below, yet untouched by festive clouds, finds companionship not in the skies but amongst the fish and turtles below. 
Submerged at the lake's bottom, the Mechanoid never frets over the careless disturbances of the fish and shrimp below.  
Sunlight dapples the lake surface, crinkling into shattered gold, decorating the vista between colorful clouds and clear waters. 
It silently peers through the glistening waves, observing the people on the shore, golden in their comings and goings. 
Like an aged elder or a dedicated mentor, it serves with deep respect. 
 
It knows, though long accompanied by algae and debris,  
under the protective care of a fatherly figure, not a single crevice in its joints has been tainted by mud. 
It waits in the waters, ready to sternly rebuke the arrogant and foolish, 
and also to assist those promising talents, like koi leaping through the dragon gate, to achieve their potential.

It waits in the waters, ready to sternly rebuke the arrogant and foolish, 
and also to assist those promising talents, like koi leaping through the dragon gate, to achieve their potential.

Reed Hedgehogs live in swamp areas.
They are short and move with the wind along with the reeds.
Ambushing enemies with blowdarts while hiding in the reeds is the specialty of the Reed Hedgehog Arrow Chief.

People nearby use "Reed Hedgehog Poison Dart" to describe people who like to scheme behind others' backs and are ruthless.

The two birds have parted. The defector has returned to the homeland. 
 
With the breaking of the dawn, a Red Falcon flew from across the sea to Jixia, illuminated in the sun's glow. 
 
It is the apex hunter of winged creatures, and each time it dives at its prey, it resembles a ball of divine flame falling from the sky. 
 
Its choice of prey goes far beyond filling its belly. Only the strong are selected. 
 
Hunting is a life-or-death ceremony, only the survivor can enjoy a moment of peace. 
 
No one knows what it is looking for on this land. In fact, it is not looking for anything. This continent is just a branch for it to rest.

Bronze for a spine, scales linked in rows.
Engraved patterns on fins, gliding through the air.
An exquisite automaton crafted in the likeness of a diving dragon and fish,
Patrolling the Abyss for a thousand years, breathing wind and frost beneath the stone dome.
Should any intruder covet the treasures stored on the tall ship,
The long alarm will sound, and the greedy shall not escape the fish's maw.

The embers of war have long turned to the dust of ruins,
The old masters are gone, yet it still fulfills its mission of protection,
Until that fisherman's song crosses the sea and returns home.

[Nut Bait]: The Armored Rat King summons several small armored rats to roll around and cause chaos. One of them carries a special nut; defeating it leaves the nut on the field. The Armored Rat King then pulls all players in and binds two of them with resonance vines (the bound are silenced, and if they get too far apart, they are pulled back). The remaining teammates must pick up the nut to lure the King's charge. The two players connected by vines must pull in opposite directions to use the vines as a tripwire to trip the charging giant rat.

Giant reeders that were born in muddy swamps. 
With strong bodies covered in reeds. 
Though the Reed Epics move slowly, their attacks are incredibly powerful. 
 
These giant reeders often sleep to conserve energy. 
They may sleep for so long at the same spot that people mistake them for ordinary trees.

Razor Nebuclads are melee Mechanoids created by the academy. 
Their bodies are covered with crystals that obscure their energy patterns. 
Wielding a sharp crystal blade, they have beaten back many brave challengers with great speed. 
 
They are undoubtedly a formidable opponent in students' daily training.
Chronicles of Floating Garments and Weapons
It's got a cheerful personality and is curious about everything, though its focus can be rather odd at times.

Inkwings are mischievous creatures found throughout Jixia, resembling jet-colored dragons with curled tails and frontal claws clutching treasure orbs. 
Their rock-like coloration helps them camouflage when playing pranks. 
 
The engraved orbs spewed forth by Inkwings contain mysterious powers, possibly linked to luck and fortune. Traders are obsessed with these orbs but often fall victim to Inkwings' pranks.

The strongman often wanders outside Jixia Academy, gazing at the scholarly atmosphere within. His companions call him "Skyfire Morningstar" because his flaming heavy hammer can easily crush stone into magma. He never mentions that he left scorch marks from his hammer when he betrayed his sect. He viewed his master's self-restraint as cowardice, believing only the heat of his flames could represent his sense of justice.\n\nHowever, after being looked up to as a leader by this group of rebels, he has begun to realize the truth. The process of enlightenment is not as simple as martial arts, and he is not yet ready to apologize to his master.

A bronze mechanical guard dormant in the Jixia ruins, shaped like a tortoise carrying a load. A mobile bronze turret used for defense. The Lost Xuan-Guard lures enemies deep, and these turrets handle the final cleanup. When intruders are surrounded by other bronze guards, the Lost Cannon-Shells are already charging up, ready to move to high ground and target these uninvited guests.
This cat is a beauty queen—any other kitty who sees it will be completely dazzled! Take it out and it's sure to get a lot of attention!

Yet, no one knows he swings his sword every night, driven by a fear of being "mediocre."
No one knows how many times his desperate strikes were fueled by the frustration of collapsing before the mirror.
No one knows that beneath his flamboyant confidence, his heart remains shrouded in shadows from his departed parents.

Perhaps even the Child of Stars himself does not realize that his inferiority, his doubts, his fear of loneliness...
Darkness breeds in the depths of his heart, never sparing him when a dream descends.
Until the moment he embraces the nightmare energy, his roar finds a definitive voice.
He is the nightmare of the Child of Stars, and perhaps, he will become yours as well...

Dwelling in ruins, they are responsible for storing information. 
Covered in patches of rust, they have lost their metallic sheen. 
Furnished with ancient and mysterious cerulean-colored patterns, they move at incredible speeds despite lacking attack abilities. 
 
While their civilization has long withered away, they seem to be waiting for their masters to return and guarding something unknown.

It lurks in the nightmares of students,
absorbing the obsessions and darkness in people's hearts to reshape itself.
From the bite of a mad wolf to the pounce of a giant bear,
it gradually condenses the power of destruction within endless bestiality.
This shadow born of dreams attempts to break the boundary between reality and illusion, using sharp blades to tear the present world apart.

"The more awake you are in a dream, the more trapped you are in reality."
The awakened shadow projects the despair and darkness from the depths of the soul into people's dreams,
and thus the dream twists into this dark incarnation of disaster.

Mosslings are born among the earth's moss, with transparent bodies and budding branches on their heads. 
Curious but timid, they don't have a fixed habitat. 
If they sense a human approaching or attacking, they will hide behind a powerful beast. 
 
Only innocent children might not scare these little creatures.
This mischievous little critter claims to be a "fishing master" and dreams of fish every day.

Palisaepes Spearguards are from the fertile land. 
From a distance, they are twisted vines wielding sharpened spears. 
To effectively combat them, one must close the distance quickly, or risk a prolonged and grueling battle. 
 
Lacking exposure to light, these subterranean Palisaepes exhibit a wildness not seen in surface-dwelling Saepes.

A dark, eerie figure, an incarnate nightmare.
The tall, slender Dreamslayer lurks in the shadows and dreams, waiting for the perfect moment to strike.
The shadows beneath its purple feathers are the prey's final memory, and the moon-blade it wields is the pride of a lone hunter.
The Moon-blade Dreamslayer is born from dreams, one with everything around it.
It moves through the air with ease, its gorgeous slashes like phantoms.

It tears through dream after dream, traversing fantasy after fantasy.
Its dark footsteps are merely the prelude to the hunt; the dreams of the mediocre are the food it survives on.

Legendary creatures that inhabit verdant lands, their rock-like exteriors covered in thick moss for camouflage. 
Often motionless, they wait for prey to approach. 
 
When full, they are docile and may carry weaker creatures on their backs.

The Soaring Chirpshakers are home to four reliefs, with the poison of the highly toxic heartbreak grass in the center, seeping through the beak. An apothecary's unique fermented poison blend that contains flesh-eating bugs is equally unholy. The central glands exhale a purple miasma that insidiously lures and deviates into the abyss. They are ensnared in the depths of gambling and drink, beyond salvation, their minds slowly falling into chaos. Life is a difficult journey as it is; do not walk down the path of no return. Stay faithful to yourself, for this is more valuable than anything else.

They inhabit the waters of Jixia. Occasionally, they jump out of the water and glide using their fins. When they sense danger, they puff up with water or air, turning into spiky balls for protection. \n \nThey are known to be very tasty, but because they are hard to catch and difficult to farm, they are quite expensive.

Legendary creatures dwelling in tranquil places. 
Their rock-like skin is covered in a thick layer of yellow mud, providing excellent camouflage.  
They usually stay still, lying in wait for prey to approach. 
 
When full, they become docile and are known to carry smaller creatures on their backs.

Bronze for a spine, scales linked in rows.
Engraved patterns on fins, gliding through the air.
An exquisite automaton crafted in the likeness of a diving dragon and fish,
Patrolling the Abyss for a thousand years, breathing wind and frost beneath the stone dome.
Should any intruder covet the treasures stored on the tall ship,
The long alarm will sound, and the greedy shall not escape the fish's maw.

The embers of war have long turned to the dust of ruins,
The old masters are gone, yet it still fulfills its mission of protection,
Until that fisherman's song crosses the sea and returns home.

Fighters of the Saepes tribe.
Clad in leaves, with twisted vines wrapped around a crude blowpipe.
Saepes Scouts excel at ambushing enemies from the shadows with blowdarts; the poisoned projectiles leave enemies in constant misery.

According to research, the toxins in Saepes blowdarts come from a variety of sources, including but not limited to: Poison Bubble Buds, Leaf-tailed Lizards, Jade Tear Fruits...

A strange creature from the dream realm.\nIts bizarre umbrella-shaped body extends into four thick and long tentacles.\nWhen the Dream-Binding Thorn encounters prey, it summons dream thorns to trap them and feed on their dreams.

A mechanical warrior wielding a scorching blade, ruthlessly fulfilling its combat destiny with high temperatures that melt everything and heavy slashes.

【Blazing Blade Light Curtain】: The flame-form Flame-Thunder God Blade will leap to one side of the arena, continuously unleashing flame blade waves that cover the entire field. Use the falling flame sword hilts to block.

【Flame-Cast Thunder Soldier】: Sword hilts shattered by blade waves will turn into thunder swords that track the player. If you skillfully guide the direction of the thunder swords, you can severely damage the Flame-Thunder God Blade.

【Thunder-Drawing Sword Array】: The thunder-form Flame-Thunder God Blade will leap to the other side of the arena, directly summoning thunder swords to bombard the entire field like rain.

Melee constructs created by the academy. The Crazed Crystal-Armor form is slightly larger than standard models, with a shinier shell. They wield their blades in a reverse grip with mysterious technique, forcing many students to concede using only the back of their blades. The academy was once divided over their high production cost, until their performance won everyone over.
Aloof and handsome, it never smiled at anyone until it met you.

Flame Tiles are invented and refined by students from the School of Mechcraft.  
An emerald sparrow fledgling is engraved on their surface, radiating different energies based on their elemental attributes. 
 
A word of advice from past challengers who failed: "If you encounter one, circle around to the rear. Remember, the rear is dark-colored!"

[Heavy Hammer Shock Zone]: The Ten-Pivot Heavy Hammer charges and releases a screen-wide shockwave. One player must quickly pick up the mechanical shield dropped on the field to block the attack, while other players stay close behind the shield-bearer to hide. The shockwave will erupt twice in succession; adjust your position in time.

The Windbell Bird was created by the School of Sorcery for cultural festivals. 
Soaring across the skies with its wings, it becomes one with the colors of the clouds. 
It swoops and glides with the wind, its wings shooting beams of high-frequency Sorcery energy. 
 
In many areas of Jixia, wooden kites are an integral part of the local culture. 
This kind of artwork that flies in the wind is filled with people's longing for the sky.

The Mechanical Bronze Fish attempts to destroy the artillery batteries the challenger relies on for counterattacks, dragging the battle into a brutal war of attrition.

[Desperate Battery]: The number of operable mechanical turrets is reduced to two, and the Mechanical Bronze Fish will focus its fire on the turrets, damaging them until they are completely paralyzed.

[Repairing the Magazine]: You must defeat the abandoned mechanisms that constantly emerge in the field, obtain the repair kits they drop, and transport them to the turrets for emergency repairs. If the repaired turrets are continuously maintained, their firepower will be further enhanced.

Frequent visitors to Mistworn Peak, these blue dragonflies have transparent, glassy wings adorned with purple markings at the tips. \nTheir wings beat at extremely high frequencies, granting them exceptional speed and agility in flight. \nHighly alert, they swiftly dart away at the slightest disturbance.

A spirit of the river, tainted by a strange power. 
 
Once a clear, crystalline blue, its body now exudes a thick, ominous purple mist. 
 
Even its innocent face has become shrouded in an indescribable darkness. 
 
 
 
Born of nature, this spirit is now consumed by an unquenchable fury. 
 
It wanders in confusion, hoping that someone will free it from its tormenting curse.

Might as thunder, movement like the sky's roar.
The Thunder-Bull that once galloped across the vast plains carries thunder in its massive horns.
Now it keeps to itself, keeping company only with the purple clouds.
Its dark fur ripples constantly, like a raging sea.
Its territory is its thunder pool, its fortress.
Any creature that steps foot here will face a thousand-fold thunder strike.
Perhaps it once tried to live in a herd, but those who drew near have surely turned to ash.

It wanders, it stands still.
It destroys, it is lost.
Now, the time has come.

Sentry Mechanoids are combat constructs created by the academy. Their perfect geometric design of spheres and cylinders is a masterpiece of the master artificers. These constructs possess immense attack power, easily crushing ordinary soldiers.\n\nSentry Mechanoids typically join the battlefield after key structures are destroyed, helping to accelerate the advance.
Goldie is an affectionate little chatterbox with a puffy bib and a round belly. It is overjoyed just to be with you.

Stone relics fade with time, as the years deepen around the empty hall. 
 
It was awakened only few times. The old man with a white beard stood before it, followed by diligent young men. 
 
As time passed, the pillar collapsed and the land cracked. 
 
Dual-Axe General woke up amidst the ruins. It didn't know where the liveliness of the past had gone, but it remembered its mission: To protect and defend, until the enemy armies retreat, and until people can dream without concerns.

A commemorative photo of the Team of Stars' championship victory, beaming with smiles, with Captain Yao holding the trophy in the most prominent position.

After the team won the championship, an artist from the Baihui Workshop was dispatched to the scene to create this sketch and invited Yao to the workshop for a live signing event. Yao later recalled that the enthusiasm of those who bought the painting that day ignited the entire Yungen Town.

Later, students reported that hanging this painting by their bedside made them feel more confident and cheerful. Other students followed suit, and it became one of the best-selling items at the Baihui Workshop.

An unyielding gatekeeper, one who can hold the pass against a thousand riders. With a massive shield, it blocks all who stand before it, enduring like a mountain even in ruin. Forged from a fallen hero's shield, it stands as the pinnacle of mechanised defence. 
 
When icy boulders fall off the cliff, there is no retreat. Its core is etched with unbreakable resolve, its defence impenetrable. 
 
Its back faced the country it fought to defend as the underhanded cavalry streamed into the pass. In the dying light of dusk, as shadows stretch long, reinforcements emerge.

These deer, found across Jixia, are said to originate from a distant frozen land. 
Their dreamlike blue coats earned them the name "Frost." 
This vivid hue attracts predators rather than camouflaging them. 
Stags bear massive antlers resembling gnarled tree crowns. 
 
Their antlers are highly prized beyond Jixia, inviting poaching. 
Until Hunters enforced strict protection, these deer nearly vanished.

The Rebels turned against the academy as a result of differences in their Sorcery beliefs. 
Using overloaded Aersilk Telepathic Threads, they performed Sorcery Techniques they could not have mastered otherwise. 
The energies they gather and use in their attacks also inflict damage on themselves. 
 
In order to carry more Telepathic Threads, the robes they wear have lots of pockets.

A Mechanoid warrior wielding a blazing sword, with a fiery core that burns relentlessly beneath its crimson armour. 
 
It is great at fighting up close, and its attacks are as strong as a falling mountain. Its huge fire sword is so hot that it can melt metal and stone. 
 
Almost no creature dares to fight it. 
 
Every swing of its sword sends out hot steam and boiling lava. For this warrior, fighting is not just a job—it is its destiny.

[Flame Array]: All stone pillars will rise simultaneously and collapse after bearing weight for a short time.\n\n[Dance Covenant]: The team must act in unison to transfer between pillars, utilizing each one efficiently within the limited time. Any member lagging behind may disrupt the overall rhythm, leading to casualties.

The members of the Meow Gang can't help but sigh when mentioning their former leader.
She was just a lowly student, yet she fought tooth and nail to join the Great Wall Garrison.
Perhaps it was to take care of the mother who adopted her.
Perhaps it was to not let the martial arts passed down by her brother go to waste.
In any case, this arrogant "Boss Meow" resolutely chose a new way of life.

No one knows what she was thinking when she learned of her brother's fate...
She just repeated those moves over and over, even though she already knew them by heart.
Afterward, she continued to run the post house, warmly welcoming travelers.
But some noticed that the token hanging from her waist bore the mark of the Garrison.

Bronze forms its spine, scales interlocked in line. 
Engraved fins gleam, gliding through skies like a dream. 
Crafted in the likeness of hidden serpents and swift fish, 
this intricate Mechcraft has patrolled the Littoral Abyss for millennia, 
breathing frost beneath the stone-domed heavens. 
Should invaders covet treasures stored within the Tower Ship,  
a piercing chime will sound—and none consumed by greed shall escape its jaws.  
 
The ashes of war have long settled as dust upon these ruins. 
Though its creators are gone, it still fulfills its duty, 
until the day a fishing song drifts across the sea, returning home to native shores.

[Red Flame Burning Field]: The Embermane spits out flames, turning the entire field into a sea of fire. At this time, friendly wooden fences will rise in stone pillars around the field.\n\n[Flame Pillar Dance]: Players must jump onto the stone pillars in time to avoid the ground flames. After the fire-breathing ends, the Embermane will enter a state of exhaustion due to energy depletion; this is the best time for full output.

An ancient long-range combat automaton.
The Bailian Cannon Automaton's arms have been modified into heavy cannons, and its gold-plated barrels are extremely durable, never missing a shot.

They wander the ruins of war; though they have lost their mission, they still hold their posts.

A dark, eerie figure, an incarnate nightmare.
The tall, slender Dreamslayer lurks in the shadows and dreams, waiting for the perfect moment to strike.
The shadows beneath its purple feathers are the prey's final memory, and the moon-blade it wields is the pride of a lone hunter.
The Moon-blade Dreamslayer is born from dreams, one with everything around it.
It moves through the air with ease, its gorgeous slashes like phantoms.

It tears through dream after dream, traversing fantasy after fantasy.
Its dark footsteps are merely the prelude to the hunt; the dreams of the mediocre are the food it survives on.

Swiftbolt Falcons influenced by the Dreamscape become Nightshadow Falcons. 
They possess multicolored wings reminiscent of Dream Butterflies. 
Their swift attacks create illusions in enemies, making it difficult for them to discern their surroundings. 
 
In the Dreamscape, Nightshadow Falcons' cries are distinctively melancholic, mournful, and lonely. 
It is believed by some that encountering a Nightshadow Falcon in the dream brings bad luck.

The leader of the Embermanes has fiery hair and blade-like claws. The flames are fierce, but its hair never burns.
Having fought its way to kingship, it leads the pack.
The flames it breathes scorch its throat, making it even more excited.
The burning prey is a playful toy. It is the one in control, while the challenger is only fit to defend.
The Embermane once challenged others, but now, it has become the king.
At this moment, the red shadow standing among the beasts will shock all living things.

With its arrival, the fire ignites.
With its departure, the fire will eventually extinguish.

Extensions of the tribe's will, they are entwined with ancient vines that draw strength from their ancestors to ward off invaders. 
 
They wield twisted, forked staffs that hum with whispers only they can understand. 
 
They guide their tribe's migration, always finding environments ideal for the growth of Saepes trees. 
 
Researchers believe that the unique bond between the Summoners and the Saepes trees is the key to the tribe's prosperity.

Created by Yango, these puppets attack from a distance, launching lethal darts concealed within intricately crafted wooden caskets. Their secret techniques allow the darts to fly in eerie silence.  \n \n"True art requires some distance."

A cold-hearted hunter of the Dreamscape.
Ethereal in form, with magnificent wings and a tail that fans out at the tip.
Armed with a long-handled feather fan, it excels at casting homing magic projectiles and can draw energy from void rifts to unleash wide-sweeping beams.

Legend says these fan-wielding Botu were once scholars obsessed with the arcane. In their pursuit of the ultimate truth, they peered into the Dreamscape and lost their way. In this Dream of Lanke, the illusions they summon are nothing more than fleeting phantoms.

Saepes Catapultors have strange and large purple fruits hanging on their intertwined branches. 
In battle, they fling these highly poisonous fruits to inflict great suffering upon their enemies. 
 
Herbalists generally believe that these fruits form a symbiotic relationship with the Saepes Catapultors.
Dopey is shy and always quotes the rules and regulations of the Student Affairs Committee.

Doomblade Sentinel fights with fiery aggression. Pickaxe Sentinel stands firm and unbreakable like a mountain. They arrive with the Calamity Star to carry out the Sanctified's orders. 
 
Pickaxe Sentinel activates an Inferno Shield while charging up a full-screen attack. The shield protects him during the charge. 
 
Doomblade Sentinel repeatedly charges toward players. 
 
Have Doomblade strike the Inferno Shield three times. After the third hit, the shield breaks, and Pickaxe Sentinel's attack is interrupted.

There is a beast, shaped like a monkey with white ears. It moves like a human walking. Its name is Sim, and eating it is said to improve one's speed. 
 
The beast from the Tree Kingdoms is often found in fictional stories. 
Cloudeater felt bored in his homeland and came to Jixia to seek thrills, inspiring writers with its presence. 
 
With a flourish of its feather fan and a toss of its snowy mane, it transforms its face with a different mask. 
Having claimed Aermore Valley as its own, Cloudeater enjoys playing pranks and making new friends. 
However, few know that Nora once taught it a painful lesson. 
Despite its mischievous nature, Cloudeater means no harm, except to Nora.

A giant ox wandering the wilderness.
Its red and white mane is like a mix of fire and snowflakes.
Its physique is exceptionally robust, with muscle lines that look carved from stone, every inch filled with power and wildness.
Its massive red horns are like two scorching flames, sharp and fierce, seemingly capable of easily piercing any obstacle at any time.

As everyone can see, it is a species that is naturally not to be trifled with.
Once anyone or anything provokes it, it will attack without hesitation, and that violent power is enough to make any opponent shudder.
Its arrogant horns and striking mane are constantly telling explorers—it is no ordinary creature.

In the advanced challenge, Megadrive Hammer's Mech Core goes into overdrive. It teleports and attacks from multiple sites. 
 
Triple Shock: Megadrive Hammer fires three full-screen shockwaves in a row. Before each shockwave, it teleports to the edge of the arena, so each wave comes from a different direction. 
 
Shield Relay: After a player uses the Shield to block a shockwave, that player cannot use the Shield again for a short time. Another teammate must pick up and use the Shield to block the next shockwave coming from a different direction.
An expert hunter who loves freedom. This cat is not easy to tame.

The loner, with hair like snow and claws sharp as blades. Cold as frost, its imposing aura intimidates all. 
It has parted ways with its former companions. 
It exerts its freezing power over others and becomes the leader of its tribe. 
Once leading its tribe out of the icy plains, these beasts born of cold and barren lands rarely encounter true rivals. 
The original inhabitants of its new home have been frozen in ice, leaving only its tribe. 
It had been living in peace since its tribe faced a new crisis. 
 
Its red companion is now a king without a crown. 
The red and blue tribes will one day face each other in battle, but what choice will it make?

The Toxin Puffer inhabits the dangerous waters.  
It has a brightly colored, rounded body with a blunt stinger, looking harmless.  
However, its stinger contains powerful toxins that it exposes when threatened.  
Even the most skilled Toxineers in Jixia show caution when encountering it.  
  
It is said that the Toxin Puffer has a delicious taste, making it a desired ingredient.  
As the saying goes, one bite makes all other flavors seem dull, and eating it is believed to promote longevity.

Doomblade Sentinel fights with fiery aggression. Pickaxe Sentinel stands firm and unbreakable like a mountain. They arrive with the Calamity Star to carry out the Sanctified's orders. 
 
Pickaxe Sentinel activates an Inferno Shield while charging up a full-screen attack. The shield protects him during the charge. 
 
Doomblade Sentinel repeatedly charges toward players. 
 
Have Doomblade strike the Inferno Shield three times. After the third hit, the shield breaks, and Pickaxe Sentinel's attack is interrupted.

Giant reeders born from the mud. 
They have sturdy shields made from mud and wood that are closely tied to their arms with vines. 
A head-on confrontation might not be wise. 
 
Some Seeker who enjoys studying the history of Mechanoids believes that the shields made by Saepes provided significant inspiration for the Crafting Society members who developed the Mechanoids.

The balance between ice and fire has been completely shattered, and the mechanism reveals a cataclysmic, apocalyptic form.\n\n【Sky-Falling Cold Abyss】: The Relic Ice-Fire Guardian leaps into the air, pouring a massive amount of icicles across the arena. If not cleared in time, the icicles will detonate in a chain reaction, covering the entire field. After pouring the icicles, the Relic Ice-Fire Guardian becomes briefly stunned due to excessive energy consumption—this is the perfect moment to finish it off.
Croaky is an affectionate little chatterbox with a puffy bib and a round belly. It is overjoyed just to be with you.

Found in the ruins, their bronze structures are adorned with gold gilding. Their cores emit an eerie blue glow. \nThey order others to repair facilities or carry out maintenance, indicating a strict hierarchy within their underground society. \nEverything operates like clockwork, as if nothing has changed.

Rare in Jixia, they have two horns, soft fur, and are lively and endearing. 
They love playing and are attracted to colorful flowers and fruits. 
 
According to legend, their ancestors helped save a dying civilization. 
The land nurtured these newborn creatures. 
As they walk, flowers bloom and even wild animals show respect.

This place was ruined by excessive flooding. The craftsmen worked around the clock to come up with a solution. 
 
Station Ruins Sentry, shaped like a bastion, hides the secrets of the past. 
 
Its large, many-jointed legs give it remarkable flexibility. 
 
With strong defenses and powerful attacks, it is built for simple, brutal tactics that crush invaders. 
 
Station Ruins Sentry was created to move stones and hold back the sea, leaving behind a vast underground world of winding rivers and strange creatures.

Hazehares are rabbits with fantastically colored fur.
When hidden in the dark, only their bewitching eyes can be seen, often scaring students who venture into Dreamscape.
However, Hazehares frequently appear in Dreamscape. Contrary to their ferocious appearance when concealed in darkness, they have friendly natures and are rumored to help people.

Some lost children claim that they chased a four-eyed rabbit into a purple paradise.
Though children's words are not reliable, these tales add a hint of truth to the myths.

[Fire Shield Collision]: The Blade-Severing Spirit locks onto a player to charge, while the Lone Halberd Spirit activates a Fire Shield in the center of the field. Players must lure the Blade-Severing Spirit to collide with the Fire Shield three times to successfully break the shield; otherwise, they will suffer massive screen-wide damage.

A cold and graceful hunter of the dream world. 
 
Its slender body is adorned with beautiful wings, and its tail fans out behind it. 
 
It wields a long scepter topped with feathers, shooting energy projectiles and summoning beams of energy for wide sweeping attacks. 
 
Legend says these scepter-wielding Dreamslayers were scholars obsessed with Sorcery. They sought forbidden knowledge and lost themselves in dreams. Now, the illusions they create in the dream world are nothing but empty shadows.

Sentry Flamequenchers are modified combat constructs created by the academy. Their perfect geometric design of spheres and cylinders is a masterpiece of the master artificers. These constructs possess immense attack power and the ability to manipulate fire, easily crushing ordinary soldiers.\n\nSentry Mechanoids typically join the battlefield after key structures are destroyed, helping to accelerate the advance.

These birds living in the Dreamscape Area boast ethereal blue feathers. 
Though unable to display, Dreamveil Peahens share the same magnificent light-blue plumage and graceful poise as their mates. 
Their fine down makes precious robes, driving risk-takers to gather shed feathers in the Dreamscape Area. 
 
Long ago, disaster struck Jixia. A fleeing couple strayed into the Dreamscape Area. 
The injured wife slowed them, but the husband refused to abandon her. 
Dream energy consumed them—crown feathers sprouted, arms transformed into wings. Years later, the first Dreamveil Peacock pair appeared.

[Deadly Starfall]: The Calamity Meteorites appearing now are enhanced by the source of the Calamity Star. Their stability is greatly increased, requiring players to pour in stronger attacks to shatter them.\n\n[Vortex Storm]: The rotation speed of the starlight walls becomes extremely fast, and the safe gaps disappear in an instant. Thus, the pressure of tracking the constellation shadows is also greatly increased, posing a huge test to the team's output and coordination.

A variant of Bronze Sunderers, Bronze Ice Sunderers wield the power of ice. 
Whenever they sense a living creature, they get close quickly and use all their power to freeze the surroundings. 
The scattered ice will imprison everything it touches. 
 
While Bronze Constructors serve as repairers, these Sunderers are known as "cleaners."

The Plump River Sprite's enormous, translucent body has attracted the attention of many Jixia students. Its glowing texture looks inviting—what would it feel like to embrace it? 
A verdant sprout crowns its head, leading most scholars to believe that Jixia's River Sprites are plant-like creatures. 
 
Their adorable appearance invites people to approach, but when someone gets too close, they quickly dart away, beckoning from a distance.
