Some suspect this is a ploy to lure victims in, but in truth, they are merely seeking playmates. 
Some scholars collectively refer to these River Sprites as Sproutlings.
Beneath its unique appearance lies a clumsy yet steadfast heart. Though it appears weightless, it can pin down even the sturdiest of stones.

An ancient creature from the dream realm.
Its beak is like a hook, and its claws are as sharp as blades.
The tail rattles as its slender body dances in the air, weaving through dreams.

It attacks particularly quickly at close range and will unexpectedly cast spells during skirmishes.
But the most dangerous situation is when they appear alongside other dream creatures.
If an ordinary person falls into such a trap, they can only pray to be woken up.

Standing on four legs, it often hides in the blazing flames. When it encounters thunder, it fights incessantly. 
 
When the clouds fall, flaming columns reach the sky as this giant flame-breathing lizard razes any land it treads upon to ash. The destruction it causes is difficult to repair, as no greenery can survive its flames. 
 
Many have attempted to vanquish this pestilence, but few have succeeded. Even if they manage to harm it, their actions only further enrage it. 
 
The source of its irritable nature lies in the storm clouds that gather in the skies. 
 
Yearning for a clear crimson dusk, it stops at nothing to achieve it. The battles between these lizard kings appear endless until a person riding a strange steed enters the scene.

This place was ruined by excessive flooding. The craftsmen worked around the clock to come up with a solution. 
 
Station Ruins Sentry, shaped like a bastion, hides the secrets of the past. 
 
Its large, many-jointed legs give it remarkable flexibility. 
 
With strong defenses and powerful attacks, it is built for simple, brutal tactics that crush invaders. 
 
Station Ruins Sentry was created to move stones and hold back the sea, leaving behind a vast underground world of winding rivers and strange creatures.

Lost in the Jixia ruins, they possess crab-like pincers and glowing armor with mysterious markings. 
They use their pincers for maintenance and swap them out as needed. 
 
Their ability to consistently perform tasks remains an unsolved mystery for the Crafters.

A hundred days of ice that sealed the fortress, a thousand miles of fire that burnt between camps.
These words are engraved upon this bronze construct.
This is the ancient craftsmen's ultimate understanding of war, and the interpretation of this mechanism.
Red and blue energies coexist and merge, amplifying artillery fire that no city can withstand.
Yet, it was abandoned beneath the ruins.

Its role as an attacker never had the chance to be showcased.
The horn for the counterattack had not yet sounded, and the craftsmen who built the Frost-Fire Cannon had already sacrificed themselves in the battle to defend it.

Quenched Cannon Effigies are ancient ranged Mechanoid fighters. 
Their arms have been refined, with one covered in frost, while the other sparkling with lightning. The projectiles they launch are deadly, although their melee capabilities are limited. 
 
The Academy's ranged Mechanoid designs draw inspiration from their simple and effective design. 
The simplicity of their design suggests the urgency with which they were manufactured.

The Relic Fire-Crack Armor is a specialized mechanical construct abandoned in the Jixia ruins.
Made of bronze, the upper body resembles a furnace, and the lower body resembles a spider.
When the mechanism is triggered, the patterns flash with fire, warning of an impending explosion.

It is said that after an explosion, the remaining core attracts surrounding bronze to reshape its body.

Its hair is like fire, and its claws are like blades. Although its fire is intense, its hair does not burn. 
 
After numerous battles, the Embermane became the king of its kin. Its flaming breath scorches its throat, further exciting its ferocity. 
 
Burning prey are mere toys to it, as it maintains total control, leaving challengers always on the defensive. 
 
Once a challenger itself, the Embermane has now ascended the throne. It stands head and shoulders above all beasts as a fearsome symbol to all living creatures. 
 
Its arrival brings fire, and its departure hints at the death of those flames.

[Brutal Charge]: The Savage Tiger raises its shield and locks onto a player to charge continuously. The locked player must adjust their position to avoid hitting teammates, while other players can take the opportunity to attack the Savage Tiger's back. The final charge is a red-light skill; dodge in time.\n\n[Earth-Shattering Thunder]: The Savage Tiger leaps to the center of the field and slams the ground repeatedly, creating expanding shockwaves. Players can avoid them by jumping or dodging; the final strike is a red-light skill, so pay extra attention.

Bronze Turrets are defensive Mechanoids found in the ruins. 
Their four legs are bunched together, charging for a powerful blast with their two cannons. 
A single blast is enough to shatter any armor. The only way around them is to avoid them. 
 
For some reason, they have been restless, a sign that this place has never been forgotten.

This strongman always gazes upon Jixia Academy from a distance. 
 
With his devastating hammer, he can easily shatter boulders into dust. Yet, he never speaks of the flaming hammer prints he left behind when he abandoned his mentor. 
 
Viewing his mentor's self-restraint as weakness, he believed that only the heat of flames could manifest true righteousness. 
 
Now appointed as the leader of the youthful Rebels, he has slowly begun to understand his mentor's wisdom. However, this learning curve is as challenging as mastering Martial Arts, and he is not yet ready to offer an apology.
It reads endlessly without pride and observes the world without arrogance. Your loyal and reliable friend.

The lush and vibrant rocky pines reach into the clouds. 
 
Treasure seekers and adventurers visiting Seclusion City instinctively avoid a shadowy area, despite its soil being similar to the surroundings and even hosting a dense forest. 
 
They know it's not an ordinary forest, but a single immense tree reaching skyward. 
 
Once, Ground Shaker was merely a small Saepes. Time endowed it with a massive form but also eroded its once-clear mind. Abandoned in this prison, it constantly attempts to retain anyone passing by, but people usually scream and run away. 
 
Baffled, it becomes more forceful and frantic in its efforts to hold someone close, only to push them further away.

[Triple Shockwave]: The Megadrive Hammer releases three consecutive full-screen shockwaves. Before releasing them, it teleports to the edge of the arena, with each shockwave facing a different direction;\n\n[Mechanism Support]: Before launching a full-screen attack, the Megadrive Hammer summons two mechanical minions, one of which will grab a shield from the field first. The team must prioritize killing the shield-bearing minion to reclaim the shield; otherwise, they will be unable to block the subsequent devastating full-screen attack.

The twin birds have parted, and the broken-hearted have fallen to the mountain peak. 
Carrying a torrential storm, the proud blue falcon descends upon the wasteland from the side of the peak. 
Flapping its wings, it brings the thunder of the clouds. 
Its shimmering eyes gaze upon the most valuable things in the world. 
Its fickle rage obliterates all the rocks that stand in its way. 
Its beauty and reclusive nature are equally famous. 
Beyond venting its emotions, it rarely interacts with any living creature. 
This is the most widely circulated story of the Sky-Thunder Falcon in the mountain city. 
 
Making assumptions about legendary creatures is a common flaw of storytellers. 
It is actually not very aggressive; most of the time, the Sky-Thunder Falcon just wants to enjoy the breeze on a cool night.

Lost in the Jixia ruins, they possess a crab-like pincer and a flamethrower that glows with heat. 
They perform maintenance within the ruins and use their flamethrowers to clear obstacles as needed. 
 
A novice Crafter curiously asks, "Would the flamethrower melt its pincer?"

[Star Vortex Strike]: The Celestial Spirit returns to the center of the field to channel star power, summoning five constellations to rotate around it. Players must quickly destroy all star nodes to interrupt its chant. Success causes its spirit to collapse; failure results in a screen-wide Starfall attack.\n\n[Heavenly Barrier Shuttle]: The Celestial Spirit summons five hidden constellation shadows and drives four constantly rotating starlight walls. There are gaps in the walls for escape. Players must nimbly shuttle between the gaps to find and destroy all hidden constellation shadows.

Compared to the Crimson Beast, the Crimson Feral is much smaller. 
But its presence is no less intimidating. 
Its flowing scarlet fur blazes like flames. 
 
The beast retains its natural ferocity, 
with hard claws and sharp teeth ready to tear apart any challenger. 
Its blazing eyes maintain a vigilant watch, deterring any potential threats.

Bronze Turrets are defensive Mechanoids found in the ruins. 
Their four legs are bunched together, charging for a powerful blast with their two cannons. 
A single blast is enough to shatter any armor. The only way around them is to avoid them. 
 
For some reason, they have been restless, a sign that this place has never been forgotten.

The Radish King is formidable enough, but its cunning tricks are the real headache. Watch out for explosive radishes hidden underground—triggering them will lead to a disaster. 
 
Explosive Ambush: As it leaps to the arena center, the Radish King plants multiple explosive traps. Any player dragged through a trap triggers a blast, leaving scorched terrain that continues to burn. 
 
Save from The Brink: Those knife-wielding Radishes now strike faster than ever. You and your team must carefully navigate traps and fire zones while guiding the Little Radishes to sever the vines. Any misstep can cause casualties.

Backed into a corner, the Saepes King frantically siphons power from its subjects. Its body becomes indestructible, surging with mountain-shattering rage. 
 
Ancient Bulwark: Its thorn armor is heavily fortified, requiring extra effort to break through. 
 
Rage Drain: While in its giant form, the Saepes King's Attack escalates rapidly. You and your team must intercept and attack more efficiently to strive for survival.

The Windcutting Lion was once a highly popular guest performer at Jixia's traditional festivals. 
Its flaming mane and pointed horns show its majestic dignity. 
This Sorcery creation moves with the wind, using its sharp claws and fangs to attack enemies. 
 
Due to the lingering Sorcery energy within it, the Windcutting Lion retains many of the moves it performed for cultural performances and frequently scratches its head or does backflips.

[Heavy Hammer Shock Zone]: The Ten-Pivot Heavy Hammer charges and releases a screen-wide shockwave. One player must quickly pick up the mechanical shield dropped on the field to block the attack, while other players stay close behind the shield-bearer to hide. The shockwave will erupt twice in succession; adjust your position in time.

This lost war machine is the ultimate expression of the ancient craftsmen's theory of 'Ice and Fire Coexistence.' Red and blue energy flows and intertwines within its barrels.\n\n[Frostfire Break]: The Frostfire Guard fires a cold current, trapping one or two players in ice pillars, while firing homing molten missiles at the others. You must lure the missiles to break the ice pillars and save your teammates, otherwise, the missiles will hit you and cause continuous burning.

Tender buds fill the body, learning to walk clumsily.
When delicate vines take root in the old shell that has become nutrients, a new life begins.
Its thorn-covered body protects the fragile main bud.
The face on the mask is merely a disguise.
At this moment, it is full of longing.
It must embrace and communicate sincerely with every creature it meets for the first time.

Does their cyclical life count as a continuation of the self?
When most of what belongs to the self is replaced, can the core that guides their consciousness remember the former self?

An adorable creature, covered in yellow fur. 
It has a gentle nature and is very affectionate. 
They are a common sight in Jixia, deeply woven into everyday life. 
 
Croakies are not big. They like routine. 
Over the years, they have taken on many tasks alongside humans.

These Saepes fighters wield spears with tips resembling buds poised to blossom. 
 
Do not be deceived by their colorful appearance—these weapons possess formidable piercing power. 
 
Saepes take great care of their rough-wrought weapons, often sharpening and polishing them with stones.

Hedgehogs are omnivorous creatures found throughout the land. 
With their beady black eyes, they may look fierce, 
but they are actually quite timid and won't attack anything on sight. 
 
When sensing danger, they curl into a ball with their spines jutting out, which can cause serious damage. 
Some people find Hedgehogs appealing due to their fierce yet cute appearance and keep them as pets.

[Desperate Grain Guard]: The HP of small armored rats is significantly increased, requiring higher firepower to clear quickly. At the same time, the lure range after the nut lands shrinks extremely fast. The coordination between the nut carrier and the vine-pulling teammate must be millisecond-perfect; any delay may lead to failed tripwires and the loss of the granary.

In a land where spring is eternal, 
A friend brought snow, 
awakening the potential of a girl from the wintry realm. 
Thus, she experienced sudden enlightenment, 
Wielding her icy spear to strive for victory.

An unyielding gatekeeper, one who can hold the pass against a thousand riders. With a massive shield, it blocks all who stand before it, enduring like a mountain even in ruin. Forged from a fallen hero's shield, it stands as the pinnacle of mechanised defence. 
 
When icy boulders fall off the cliff, there is no retreat. Its core is etched with unbreakable resolve, its defence impenetrable. 
 
Its back faced the country it fought to defend as the underhanded cavalry streamed into the pass. In the dying light of dusk, as shadows stretch long, reinforcements emerge.

A cold-hearted hunter of the Dreamscape.
Ethereal in form, with magnificent wings and a tail that fans out at the tip.
Armed with a long-handled feather fan, it excels at casting homing magic projectiles and can draw energy from void rifts to unleash wide-sweeping beams.

Legend says these fan-wielding Botu were once scholars obsessed with the arcane. In their pursuit of the ultimate truth, they peered into the Dreamscape and lost their way. In this Dream of Lanke, the illusions they summon are nothing more than fleeting phantoms.

A bronze mechanical guard dormant in the Jixia ruins, shaped like a walking tortoise. The Lost Xuan-Guard blocks intruders, and its method of interception is simple—using its body. By the time intruders realize they are blocked, it is already too late; their escape speed is slowed by the heavy shells of these bronze mechanisms, and they are inevitably trapped in layers of encirclement.

Giant underground Palisaepes. Twisted branches bear special fruits, though they have long since rotted away with time. These Palisaepes are precise throwers; they aim and launch their projectiles in one fluid motion, never missing. Perhaps for more effective defense, the Palisaepes Rot-Throwers intentionally let their 'fruits' decay. It must be said, many creatures are driven away by the stench before they can even get close.

A curious fruit that resulted from the absorption of Aerflow. 
It is at least ten times larger than the average fruit. 
The Inflated Gourd is extremely sensitive to sounds and will squash anything that makes abnormal sounds with its massive body. 
 
The Inflated Gourd has a delectable sweet and tangy flavor with a honeyed aroma. 
Icy Inflated Gourd Juice is a bestseller in Jixia whenever summer comes.

These Saepes fighters wield spears with tips resembling buds poised to blossom. 
 
Do not be deceived by their colorful appearance—these weapons possess formidable piercing power. 
 
Saepes take great care of their rough-wrought weapons, often sharpening and polishing them with stones.

The chieftain of the Jiyu tribe, both brave and upright. It is particularly fond of travelers who come to visit. It has a special love for rainy days, yet it is always cautious and avoids conflict, unwilling to harm any living creature.\n\nLegend has it that its belly holds all the strange tales and anecdotes of Jixia's waters, making it the tribe's famous "storyteller." If you bring its favorite fresh fish, you might just be able to trade for a fascinating legend.

Nightshadow Fledglings, affected by the Dreamscape, display wings as curious and multicolored as the Dreamscape itself. 
With their nimble bodies, the Nightshadow Fledglings effortlessly navigate through the Dreamscape. 
 
Traditionally, dreaming of a Nightshadow Fledgling is considered a bad omen, as the saying goes, "When the Shadow Fledgling enters your dreams, ill fortune shall dog you."

Rebels who turned against the academy due to conflicting martial arts philosophies. They are typically burly with powerful arms. The Rebel Hunks swing their giant hammers like the wind, shaking the very earth. These strongmen pursue brute force, even resorting to training methods banned by the academy.

The soldier, who wielded a greatsword, came from an army outside Jixia. His Flow was drawn to the Calamity Star, and whenever the star struck the land, he would appear with the meteorite and attack any living creature.

Brutalhorn Calves, with a back full of dense brown downy fur, can be found all over the grassy plains of Jixia. 
They have a mild temperament and will only make use of their half-grown horns when attacked. 
 
Since they have better tempers than the adults, they appear incapable of surviving away from their herd. 
Over a long period of time, many have made consistent attempts to tame Brutalhorn Calves, but few have succeeded.

The town's storyteller mentions the Radish King, then suddenly slams the table and says excitedly: 'This monster looks like a giant radish at first glance. Its surface is covered in uneven textures, like cracked earth that has healed. Green leaves sway atop its head like a towering forest tree. Beneath those unique leaves are a pair of cunning, slanted eyes, flickering with mischief. Most striking of all is the kitchen knife it wields. The blade glints in the sun, clearly no ordinary weapon, and it is devastatingly powerful in use. If you encounter it, remember not to underestimate it. It is one of the finest spirit beasts transformed from a radish. It has incomprehensible behavioral logic, but it is undoubtedly a formidable opponent.'

They wield power over the polar cold. 
 
They never smiled. Perhaps their chilling powers have numbed their faces, or they have long given up human emotions in the single-minded pursuit of power. 
 
Their eyes sweep across everything impassively before battle, making opponents shudder. The revolving blades spread the icy mist as though the air was being frozen. Each strike of their blades suffocates with fear. 
 
"Emotions are but excuses for the weak to fear the powerful." 
 
This is a belief shared by the Congealing Twin Blades who choose to spend their days in solitude.

[Triple Shockwave]: The Megadrive Hammer releases three consecutive full-screen shockwaves. Before releasing them, it teleports to the edge of the arena, with each shockwave facing a different direction;\n\n[Shield Synergy]: Each player enters a cooldown after blocking with a shield. Team members must relay the shield to handle consecutive attacks from random directions.

This strongman always gazes upon Jixia Academy from a distance. 
 
With his devastating hammer, he can easily shatter boulders into dust. Yet, he never speaks of the flaming hammer prints he left behind when he abandoned his mentor. 
 
Viewing his mentor's self-restraint as weakness, he believed that only the heat of flames could manifest true righteousness. 
 
Now appointed as the leader of the youthful Rebels, he has slowly begun to understand his mentor's wisdom. However, this learning curve is as challenging as mastering Martial Arts, and he is not yet ready to offer an apology.

The mischievous Ink Lion is born with a dark blue color. 
Some special Ink Lions have dense, dark patterns growing on the fur around their necks. 
Though not large or fierce, the protection they represent is significant. 
 
The Ink Lion is a symbol of good fortune and peace. Their images are often used in paintings. 
Before celebrations, people from Jixia will buy pictures of them to hang in their homes. 
This practice of using them to bless the future with good weather is not as old as you might think.

[Brutal Charge]: The Savage Tiger raises its shield and locks onto a player to charge continuously. The locked player must adjust their position to avoid hitting teammates, while other players can take the opportunity to attack the Savage Tiger's back. The final charge is a red-light skill; dodge in time.\n\n[Earth-Shattering Thunder]: The Savage Tiger leaps to the center of the field and slams the ground repeatedly, creating expanding shockwaves. Players can avoid them by jumping or dodging; the final strike is a red-light skill, so pay extra attention.

A curious fruit that resulted from the absorption of Aerflow. 
It is wrapped in layers of coarse and withered fruit skin. 
The Wailing Bud occasionally breaks free of these trappings to disperse its eye-watering gaseous secretion. 
 
While useful for repelling insects, it has also given students at the Herb Garden a hard time harvesting herbs.

The genius lost to the past has returned, bringing a dazzling storm of golden starlight and deadly constellation Sorcery. 
 
Stellar Shatter: Hellbound Sentinel moves to the center and summons five celestial spheres that orbit him while he channels. Destroy all five spheres before he finishes channeling, or he will unleash a full-screen attack. 
 
Heavenly Traverse: Hellbound Sentinel summons five hidden constellation shadows and three rotating walls of starlight. Each wall has a gap you can pass through. Move through the gaps to find and destroy all five hidden shadows.

The Rebels turned against the academy as a result of differences in their Martial Arts beliefs. \n \nRebel Hunks are heavily built fighters with powerful arms that let them swing massive hammers easily. They rely on raw strength and often use training methods banned by the academy.

An ancient defensive Mechanoid. 
The Heavy Quake Shield Effigy was designed with great practicality. 
The Mechcraft patterns on the tower shield absorb Quake energy, granting it a powerful counterattack capability. 
 
Even now, this design that gives shields counterattack capabilities through energy remains a monumental achievement in Mechcraft.

Icecannon Effigies are ancient ranged Mechanoid fighters. 
Their arms have been transformed into cannons, emanating a chilling aura. 
 
They have frozen countless foes, yet they remain powerless against the march of time.

Bronze Constructors are Mechanoid workers who repair facilities in ruins. 
Resembling crabs, they have two pincers, walk on four legs, and have bronze shells of Aerux with glittering markings. 
They maintain large bronze facilities as well as Mechanoids. 
 
They are kept busy all day mending things. If not disturbed, they just ignore anyone who comes along.

These Saepes fighters wield oversized spiked clubs. Anyone struck by these clubs, even if not severely injured, would suffer from the pain inflicted by the spikes. \n \nBut such weapons are meaningless to their nemesis, the Embermane. Thus, where the Embermane roams, Saepes are rare.

Black rock rich in Aerflow, often used by the people of Jixia to make ink sticks. Disciples accidentally discovered this rock while exploring. When brought near fire, it turns into black liquid, forming a stream. The ink-colored stream is traced with white lines, as if nature itself were using the land as paper to create a natural ink wash painting.

Mock not the youth's passionate declarations, Where the Stellar River ends lies desolate cold. 
Ever since Team of Stars claimed victory in the Enlightenment Trials, every Jixia student knew the name Sword of Stars. Passionate and flamboyant, with exaggerated speech, he carved poetry upon the Stargazing Terrace, his sword pointed toward the brightest star in the glittering Milky Way. 
Yet none knew of the sword he swung each night, driven by his fear of being called "mediocre." 
None knew how much bitter resentment fueled his fiercest blow—resentment born from countless defeats before the mirror. 
None knew that beneath his radiant confidence, shadows lingered in his heart, cast by the absence of his long-gone parents. 
 
Perhaps even Sword of Stars himself did not realize his insecurity, his self-doubt, his dread of loneliness... 
Shadow had festered within him, haunting him relentlessly with every nightfall. 
Not until he embraced the Nightmare Energy did his silent roar finally find a voice. 
He is Sword of Stars's nightmare. And perhaps... he will become yours...

Frostcap Shrooms have undergone mutations under the influence of Aercocoon. They have eye-catching blue caps resembling open umbrellas. 
 
 
 
They release spores as a self-defense mechanism. Someone tried to use the spores to preserve leftovers, but it turned into a real battle to free his hands from the frozen food.

Gourmand Civets, occasionally found in the Jixia wilderness, are cute creatures with fruit-red fur coats, snowy white manes, and conical hats. 
These mischievous creatures enjoy playing pranks and occasionally sneak into human homes to taste food. 
 
However, Gourmand Civets are thankful creatures and leave rare ingredients behind to replace the ones they took. 
Gourmets consider them their favorite, often seeking them out to taste their new recipes. 
As the civets themselves claim, they trade with humans—stealing food is beneath them!

Tigrex, a fierce Rebel leader in the mountain forests, now bursts into the Three-School Showdown. With iron claws and relentless force, he wants to dominate the competition and prove that only destruction shows true power. 
 
Brutal Charge: Tigrex locks onto one player and charges toward them repeatedly. The targeted player should avoid staying close to allies so they don't get hit, while others should attack Tigrex from behind. The final charge is red-glowing. It's stronger, so be careful. 
 
Earth Shaker: Tigrex leaps to the center of the arena and slams the ground several times, sending out circular shockwaves. Jump or dash to dodge the waves. The final slam is red-glowing and is more powerful. Watch out.

As the crisp bell tolls the year's end, a gust of wind brings the sound in. 
The creature, with a blue face and large fangs, wears armor on which bells are hung. 
Although it hardly looks festive, it desires to fit in with humans. However, its fearsome mask causes people to keep their distance. 
Only during festivities can it blend in and bask in a night of amity. 
Despite this, people still fear it. Some sharp-eyed people find it, and it has to break out through the rooftops. 
 
Its creator is long gone, leaving it to search for the familiar figure amongst the crowds at festivals year after year.

[Desperate Fire Shield]: The charges initiated by the four phantom clones of the Blade-Severing Spirit must all be lured into the Lone Halberd Spirit's Fire Shield. Any mistake will result in failure to break the shield, testing the team's precise execution and coordination.
An affectionate little chatterbox with a puffy bib and a round belly. It is overjoyed just to be with you.

A heart frays amid the waves, anxiety turns dreams to nightmares.  
 
The strange beast has returned, stronger than ever. Cloudeater emits a dark purple mist from beneath its snow-white whiskers, tickling your heart with fear. Even if you win this time, what about the next encounter? Is its outlandish appearance the result of a nightmare consuming it? If this continues, who will be the one falling into the nightmare?  
 
The black-robed man, claiming to have mastered the power of dreams, brings illusions of old rivals into the dreams. Defeating the minds of people like this is expedient, but those who remain awake can see through the illusions.  
 
The dreamers stand a chance once the true nature of the illusion is evident.

It reigns atop the Aerux, leaving no space for anything else to endure. 
 
Its mane has crystallised into glittering shards, while its vast shadow stretches across the mountains at dusk. 
 
Born at the Aerux's core, where Aerflow runs densest, it wields overwhelming power—yet finds no worthy foe, and with each passing day, grows ever more alone. 
 
With ease, it shatters boulders and snaps trees, its strength unmatched. Still, no opponent has risen to challenge it. 
 
For years, a nearby town offered rewards for its defeat. Now, that town lies abandoned and in ruins—nothing remains but rotting wood and scattered pages, a silent warning to all who would come near.

A curious fruit that resulted from the absorption of Aerflow. 
Maintaining a pumpkin-like form, they also develop spiky protrusions. 
Their ability to roll makes them perfect for pranking people, much to the annoyance of others. 
 
A humorous tale from Horizon Harbor tells of a family picnic interrupted by these rolling fruits. 
Each family member reacted differently in strategy and thought as they were ambushed by Spikeroll Fruits, creating a dramatic scene.
The snoop of the Croakies, also an unofficial member of the Secrets Club, though the accuracy of its intel is questionable.

A panda demonkin who drifted into the Colorful Cloud Basin. 
He came to the academy with dreams of proving himself, only to be turned away for his uneven academic performance. 
But an old man once told him: "Among any three people, there must be one who can be my teacher." 
He took these words to heart, and seeking advice from students became his form of cultivation. 
 
Since then, a strange "Green Bamboo Hero" has appeared in the Colorful Cloud Basin. 
Rumor has it among the students that there is a formidable eccentric who challenges everyone he meets to a fight. 
Strangely, he shouts out move names from storybooks as he fights. 
And when he leaves after a fight, the nearby food often disappears with him. 
More than his martial arts, it is this appetite that people find most concerning.
It thinks it's a superstar—singing, dancing, and always shining as the brightest star.

Palisaepes Timberbolts live underground, with thick vines that once acted as limbs mutated into giant cannons. 
They excel at shooting enemies from long distances but are poor at melee battles. 
 
Even so, their gigantic bodies are not easily destroyed. 
They prefer finding a vantage point and using the geographic advantage to stop outsiders from entering their territories.

This strongman always gazes upon Jixia Academy from a distance. 
 
With his devastating hammer, he can easily shatter boulders into dust. Yet, he never speaks of the flaming hammer prints he left behind when he abandoned his mentor. 
 
Viewing his mentor's self-restraint as weakness, he believed that only the heat of flames could manifest true righteousness. 
 
Now appointed as the leader of the youthful Rebels, he has slowly begun to understand his mentor's wisdom. However, this learning curve is as challenging as mastering Martial Arts, and he is not yet ready to offer an apology.

Freeze the camp with ice, and burn it with fire. 
 
Those words are carved into the Mechanoid. They show the creator's understanding of war and explain its purpose. 
 
Two energies fused and fed each other, amplifying the cannon fire so no defense could hold. 
 
Yet the Mechanoid lay abandoned beneath the ruins. It never got a chance to be used. The horn for the counterattack never sounded—the craftsmen who built it had already died defending it.

If even flowers fear the fading light of spring, how can we advocate squandering such a fleeting view? 
 
Under a tranquil evening sky, petals gracefully descend in the serene garden, while a child gently sways a boat, tenderly feeding the white herons. Fond memories arise of the first bird raised from an egg, playing in the water with its bright red beak. Known as a Sorcery prodigy from a young age, Manifold Sentinel would have chosen a quiet life if his homeland didn't require his power. 
 
Now, his body is merely a vessel etched with the imprint, his energy unbound like the sea, slowly adjusting to the subtle golden glow. Birds are drawn to light, and perhaps now, he is closer to them than ever. Looking back out of habit for a response, Manifold Sentinel realizes he is alone, with no familiar faces from his youth in sight.

Giant Reedepes born in humid muddy swamps, resembling driftwood or rocks when silent. 
When trouble comes, they awaken from the depths of the pond. 
Their gigantic bodies crush down with a deafening sound and restore peace to the area. 
 
Though their power is terrifying, most animals are attracted to them, as they are part of the ecosystem.

Congealing Twin Blades wield power over the polar cold. 
They never smiled. Perhaps their chilling powers have numbed their faces, or they have long given up human emotions in the single-minded pursuit of power. 
Their eyes sweep across everything impassively before battle, making opponents shudder. The revolving blades spread the icy mist as though the air is being frozen. Each strike of their blades suffocates with fear. 
 
"Emotions are but excuses for the weak to fear the powerful." 
This is a belief shared by the Congealing Twin Blades who choose to spend their days in solitude.

Large lizards commonly found in Jixia. 
They have flamboyant fringes on their heads to scare off enemies. 
They unfurl their fringes and breathe flaming secretions from their mouths when facing enemies. 
 
Scorchtail Lizards closely resemble Leaftail Lizards, possibly a new variant evolved to adapt to arid, hot conditions.

Rebels who turned against the academy due to conflicting martial arts philosophies. They are cunning and agile. Carrying daggers, they strike silently and quickly, seemingly possessing a special ability to mask their own sounds. Rebel Shadowblades excel at ambushing enemies from the shadows, and rumors about them frighten timid students from walking alone at night.

The Shield Effigy is a defensive Mechanoid designed for protection. 
It features high-quality materials and tall, tower-like shields on its arms, with visible energy patterns flowing within. 
 
Research shows that these sturdy shields can withstand most attacks. 
The Intelligence Society suggests that these Mechanoids were placed in key positions during ancient wars.

The core energy of the Ice-Fire Sentinel is losing balance, pushing its combat instincts to the limit.\n\n[Ice-Fire Consumption]: Players trapped in ice pillars will suffer from biting cold, continuously losing HP, and take heavy damage from an ice explosion when the freezing ends. Guiding molten missiles to save them is urgent.

Often found in Jixia ruins, they have a pot-like body and four spider-like legs. 
When alerted, their bodies glow, foreshadowing an impending explosion of flames. 
 
It is said that after exploding, their remaining core attracts nearby bronze to reconstruct their form.

People praise the art of a craft when it benefits others, and criticize it when it does not. 
The strongest Mechanoid, crafted from the rarest materials, has reached the pinnacle of what those materials can support. 
The art of Mechcraft can be divided into two approaches. 
The first is material reverence. All materials have limitations. The most common idea is to use complex designs to compensate for the material's weaknesses. 
The second is to push the limits. The Mega Drive Hammer is the ultimate representation of this design philosophy. 
What can be achieved when materials are exceptionally durable? 
Its existence provides the answer. 
 
The structure of the Mega Drive Hammer is not complex. The idea of "true skill looks like simplicity" is fully embodied in the design of this giant Mechanoid. 
However, few beings can withstand even a casual strike from it. 
Its capabilities far exceed the test level, so why was this extraordinary Mechanoid created?

Saepes Shamans wield staffs with mysterious powers, covered in flowers. 
They channel their unique Sorcery power through their staffs to disrupt enemy movement during combat. 
 
Whenever the Saepes migrate to a new place, they plant trees to modify their new home. The Saepes Shamans' powers are closely linked to the environment.

Brutalhorn Bulls, with a pair of eye-catching bull horns, can be found all over the grassy plains of Jixia. 
They rely on these horns to drive away any intruding creature. 
 
Large protruding spines grow on the backs of Brutalhorn Bulls. 
When food is abundant, they store up fat to survive adverse conditions.

Created by the academy, they shoot fireballs behind Nimble Vanguards. The academy commands them to only attack students who attend the trial. \n \nIf their cores are attacked, they move anomalously or spin in place.

The Rebels turned against the academy as a result of differences in their Martial Arts beliefs. 
They wield swords and dress lightly, agile and nimble. They strike swiftly and decisively. 
 
Rebel Blade Wielders, believing that power is all that matters, do not care for the School of Martial Arts' advocacy for mental cultivation.

The Megadrive Hammer is the ultimate creation of the Academy's "Extreme Exploration" philosophy. It uses unprecedentedly tough materials to push load-bearing limits, and its deceptively simple design ensures that every strike carries the power to crush mountains.

Its hair is like fire, and its claws are like blades. Although its fire is intense, its hair does not burn. 
 
After numerous battles, the Embermane became the king of its kin. Its flaming breath scorches its throat, further exciting its ferocity. 
 
Burning prey are mere toys to it, as it maintains total control, leaving challengers always on the defensive. 
 
Once a challenger itself, the Embermane has now ascended the throne. It stands head and shoulders above all beasts as a fearsome symbol to all living creatures. 
 
Its arrival brings fire, and its departure hints at the death of those flames.

Bifang has turned its obsession with protection into indiscriminate destruction. It deploys an invisible shield made of scorching lightning and begins a cold, endless cleanup cycle.

[Endless Sky-Thunder]: Bifang enters a shielded state and calls down lightning on all players in sequence. It then begins a cycle of random captures; every successful capture means a devastating blow.

[Thunderbreak]: The only way to survive lies in the sealed turrets at the four corners of the arena. You must lure Bifang's lightning to hit the turrets to activate them, then operate the turrets to bombard the shield.

These Saepes fighters wield oversized spiked clubs. Anyone struck by these clubs, even if not severely injured, would suffer from the pain inflicted by the spikes. \n \nBut such weapons are meaningless to their nemesis, the Embermane. Thus, where the Embermane roams, Saepes are rare.

These giant Saepes carry shields as hard as boulders. 
The shields have been enhanced with special methods, making them impervious to ordinary attacks. 
 
In some folk paintings, giant figures are depicted wielding similar shields.

Once vital Mechcraft artisans of a forgotten civilization, Bronze Sunderers have been repurposed as Mechcraft workers with special uses in the ruins. 
 
As the ages passed and this once vibrant culture faded, these tireless Sunderers gradually lost their strength and fell silent. 
 
 
 
With no new buildings to construct, they have taken on the solemn duty of guarding, now their only purpose in this world.

A delicate and elegant chiming alarm clock, a godsend for those who struggle to wake up.

Baihui Workshop specially collaborated with Shye and a renowned palace musician to create this masterpiece. Place this alarm clock by your bedside; it can lull you into sweet dreams at night, ensuring a good night's sleep. In the morning, it will wake you with ethereal, dreamlike chimes. Even Master Zhuangzi highly recommends it.

Master Zhuangzi often gets lost in his dreams and loses track of time. Master Confucius has reminded him many times, but to no avail—Zhuangzi is as prone to falling asleep as ever. The Baihui Workshop alarm clock uses a gentler, more thoughtful way to wake him. Although he is still often half-asleep, at least he no longer misses meetings.

The three Ice Tiles are lined up in a row, and raised to invite the thunder's descent. 
 
The bitter cold wind is pushing the limit. Anyone facing them would feel great fear at their impending mortality. 
 
When cold air gathers in the core, the frosted ice is immediately called out, 
conveying the nature of the game. 
 
Luck is like the wind, fleeting in an instant. Victory and defeat are decided in a moment of laughter, the outcome of the game and the path of life, all come down to choices.

Large and formidable, these constructs wield lightning-crackling pincers that radiate danger. 
Their hum grows louder before releasing thunderbolts, offering a fleeting chance for foes to flee. 
 
In addition to maintenance duties, they are thought to manage energy resupply. 
Jixia's Mechsmiths continue to study the secrets behind their enduring functionality.

Bi Fang, the essence of wood; it looks like a bird and does not eat the five grains.
A giant bronze bird, chirping day and night. Its cry is fierce, and all who hear it weep in sorrow.
Bi Fang has forgotten many things, but it remembers its own name.
Its single leg is rusted, its wings are mottled, but its eyes still burn with a cyan, scorching fire, matching the deep flow-patterns on its body.

The tall ship gave it the mission to fly, to guard, and to fight.
But now the ship has capsized, and it still tries to fulfill its mission, even though everything it could protect has turned to ruins.
So it cries out, to at least hold onto its name, with a pride that is almost shattering:
Bi Fang, Bi Fang.
A humorous and knowledgeable storyteller. Though young, he has already experienced the world's hustle and now seeks only to protect his peaceful corner.

A strange creature from the Dreamscape. 
 
Thorny vines wrap around a Dream Butterfly. 
 
It shoots Dream Energy at prey, putting them into a deep sleep.

This place was ruined by excessive flooding. The craftsmen worked around the clock to come up with a solution. 
 
Station Ruins Sentry, shaped like a bastion, hides the secrets of the past. 
 
Its large, many-jointed legs give it remarkable flexibility. 
 
With strong defenses and powerful attacks, it is built for simple, brutal tactics that crush invaders. 
 
Station Ruins Sentry was created to move stones and hold back the sea, leaving behind a vast underground world of winding rivers and strange creatures.

Tender buds fill the body, learning to walk clumsily.
When delicate vines take root in the old shell that has become nutrients, a new life begins.
Its thorn-covered body protects the fragile main bud.
The face on the mask is merely a disguise.
At this moment, it is full of longing.
It must embrace and communicate sincerely with every creature it meets for the first time.

Does their cyclical life count as a continuation of the self?
When most of what belongs to the self is replaced, can the core that guides their consciousness remember the former self?

This place was ruined by excessive flooding. The craftsmen worked around the clock to come up with a solution. 
 
Station Ruins Sentry, shaped like a bastion, hides the secrets of the past. 
 
Its large, many-jointed legs give it remarkable flexibility. 
 
With strong defenses and powerful attacks, it is built for simple, brutal tactics that crush invaders. 
 
Station Ruins Sentry was created to move stones and hold back the sea, leaving behind a vast underground world of winding rivers and strange creatures.

A cautious and timid deer species, mostly living in mountainous areas.
Compared to other deer, the antlers of the male Pillow-Wind Deer are more fragile.
Explorers believe they are often threatened by Embermane, and their large antlers are useless against it, actually hindering their escape speed.
Once a predator grabs a Pillow-Wind Deer's antlers, they will break them off without hesitation to escape.

Antlers are seen as a symbol of dignity and strength.
But compared to life, these are worth nothing.
A leopard guards the pass for three days long; from one humble rock, a mountain is born. \nHe arrives from afar, becoming a spectacle or perhaps a miracle.

[Mechanical Heavy Shield Charge]: When the Savage Tiger charges with its shield, the shield has independent durability. Players must focus fire to break it to paralyze the boss; otherwise, the final unavoidable red-light charge will deal devastating damage.\n\n[Earth-Shattering Impact]: After charging, the Savage Tiger immediately leaps to the center of the field and slams the ground repeatedly, causing screen-wide shockwave damage. Only by picking up the dropped Mechanical Heavy Shield can you block it; jumping or dodging is useless.

An orphan under the starry sky, a talent in history. After leaving that desolate land with a Croaky, Vesper has always followed in his mentor's footsteps. Selfless battles have left him with dense scars, and a regretful past has etched traces of rebellion into his heart. Vesper is waiting—waiting for his master to teach him the truths of the world, and waiting for the moment his ultimate mission arrives. Thus, he has spent half his life trying to understand his master, his mission, and his honor.

Large lizards commonly found in Jixia. 
They have flamboyant fringes on their heads to scare off enemies. 
They unfurl their fringes and breathe glowing secretions from their mouths when facing enemies. 
 
Glowtail Lizards closely resemble Leaftail Lizards, possibly a new variant evolved to adapt to dark conditions.

The Bone-Leaf Fox in the dreamscape glows with a deep blue light. It has willow-leaf-shaped silver patterns on its back and unique indigo eyes.
Influenced by the dream, these creatures have become more mysterious and agile, making it extremely difficult to see them clearly.

Few who have seen a Bone-Leaf Fox say they possess a pair of soulful eyes.
Because of this, in storytellers' tales, the Bone-Leaf Fox often appears in sorrowful and sentimental stories.
Mischievous and playful, it loves to pull pranks and has a particular fondness for pears.

Heavy Sword Effigies are Mechanoid fighters with a larger build than the Sword Effigies. 
Beneath their ornate metal shells with mysterious patterns lies a robust skeleton. 
These Mechanoids wield their blades swiftly and display high adaptability. 
 
They always appear battle-ready, as if the smoke of war is an eternal backdrop for them.

The relentless harassment has ignited Bifang's mania, and its attacks are as dense as a storm.

[Blazing Thunder Strike]: The scorching lightning bolts will become four consecutive strikes, slamming into the ground more frequently and urgently, posing a severe test for arena positioning.

[Rising Fury]: Shortens the interval between lightning strikes and capture attempts, giving players almost no chance to catch their breath.

The gluttonous Armadillo Rat King has called in backup to steal your supplies, a Sly Rat! It strikes fast. One mistake, and you're down! \n \nIn addition to the standard mechanics, a Sly Rat now charges along a fixed path repeatedly. If it collides with a nut-bearer, the nut will drop. One of you must focus on intercepting it while others clear the smaller rolling Armored Rats, or your formation will fall apart fast.

Reedepes live in wetlands. 
They are short and sway with Typha Grass in the wind. 
They excel at launching surprise attacks with their blowguns while hidden among reeds. 
 
The term "Reedepes darts" is locally used to describe those who are cunning and ruthless.

An ancient long-range combat automaton.
The Bailian Cannon Automaton's arms have been modified into heavy cannons, with the sound of thunder and lightning echoing endlessly.

Amidst the eternal thunder of its cannons, does it occasionally recall the stormy nights of its memories?

Saepes King rules with absolute authority. It uses its scepter to overpower anyone who opposes it. 
 
Vinebind Assault: Thick vines trap all players while Saepes charge in with spears. Break free quickly to avoid the incoming strikes. 
 
Soul Siphon: Saepes King drains life from nearby Saepes, growing huge and wrapping himself in thorn armor that blocks damage. Saepes Catapultors spawn and fling fireballs—grab those fireballs and throw them at Saepes King to shatter his armor. Otherwise, his size and power will keep increasing and threaten to crush the whole area.

The finest Aersilk made from condensed Aerflow. Musicians value it highly and use it to make Guqin strings. It is beloved by the Gongyu family because, when plucked, it sounds like the low groan of a dragon and the rushing of water.\n\nAn ancient dragon once rested in the river valley, breathing out Aerflow. The Aerflow surged with the dragon's mournful cries and was washed by the frigid river water, condensing into pure, supple silk.
This white cat is a proud little princess. Elegance is her motto, though she rarely means what she says.

In the clouds, the mountain lies. Their master wanders the mists day and night. 
The Spike Bear once hailed as the master of mountains. It's now corrupted and driven by instinct. 
Its body is covered in strange markings, and its rational thought is fading away.  
Constantly being tortured, it seeks targets for its rage. 
 
The mountains it once protected have also been corrupted, and memories of their bond are tenuous at best. 
Amidst unending pain, it may find brief moments of peace buried deep within its heart.

This strongman always gazes upon Jixia Academy from a distance. 
 
With his devastating hammer, he can easily shatter boulders into dust. Yet, he never speaks of the flaming hammer prints he left behind when he abandoned his mentor. 
 
Viewing his mentor's self-restraint as weakness, he believed that only the heat of flames could manifest true righteousness. 
 
Now appointed as the leader of the youthful Rebels, he has slowly begun to understand his mentor's wisdom. However, this learning curve is as challenging as mastering Martial Arts, and he is not yet ready to offer an apology.

House spiders absorb Aerflow to spin webs that are light yet extremely durable. Because they have saved many lives, they are considered a symbol of good luck by the people of Jixia.\n\nWhen villagers fleeing from battle hid in the mountains, enemy soldiers pursued them closely. With no way forward, they found only tattered spider webs. In their moment of crisis, the webs seemed to sense their plight and receded, revealing a hidden cave. The villagers crouched inside to hide, and the webs returned to their original state. When the pursuers arrived, they found no trace of the villagers and eventually dispersed.

[Star Vortex Strike]: The Celestial Spirit returns to the center of the field to channel star power, summoning five constellations to rotate around it. Players must quickly destroy all star nodes to interrupt its chant. Success causes its spirit to collapse; failure results in a screen-wide Starfall attack.\n\n[Heavenly Barrier Shuttle]: The Celestial Spirit summons five hidden constellation shadows and drives four constantly rotating starlight walls. There are gaps in the walls for escape. Players must nimbly shuttle between the gaps to find and destroy all hidden constellation shadows.

The Relic Armored Soldier is a bronze mechanical captain guarding the Jixia ruins.
Strange patterns cover its bronze structure.
They hold sharp, ancient spears, attacking quickly and lethally.

It is said that only those with distinguished military service can earn the title of 'Hundred-General'.
Only by defeating one hundred enemies can one command one hundred soldiers.
This Menki is extremely naughty and loves to play pranks. It's a little troublemaker.

[Seed-Explosion Ambush]: When leaping to the center of the field, the Radish King pre-plants multiple explosive small radish traps. Dragged players who pass through traps will trigger area explosions and leave behind burning scorched earth.\n\n[Desperate Support]: The pursuit of the blade-wielding small radishes is more ferocious. The team must precisely guide the radishes to cut the vines while avoiding traps and fire zones; any mistake may lead to casualties.

Cautious and timid, this species of deer is mostly found in mountainous regions. 
 
Female Windrest Deers do not have antlers, but they have thick manes that cover their necks, resembling human beards. 
 
Within the herd, female Windrest Deers use their keen senses to serve as lookouts. 
 
Their high alertness always sends hunters and poachers home empty-handed. 
 
Taking advantage of their agility, they have thrived for generations in the complex terrain of Jixia Mountains.

Palisaepes Brutes are from the fertile land. 
With green leaves swaying on their branch, they tightly grip a rough but heavy spiked club. 
With unmatched strength, Palisaepes Brutes fend off any intruders. 
 
Thanks to their affinity with certain plants, the clubs in the hands of Palisaepes Brutes remain as lively and fresh as ever.

Burrow Wolvines are young Wolvines with snow-white fur and blue scales. 
Though not as experienced as mature ones, Burrow Wolvines also dig holes in which they lie in wait for their prey. 
Burrow Wolvines travel in packs and should not be underestimated. 
 
Hunters often remind their juniors that Burrow Wolvines live in packs and do not move about alone. 
If you encounter what appears to be a lone Burrow Wolvine, do not be too impatient to approach because its partners are likely to be around.

Created by Yango, these puppets chase and get close to enemies before self-destructing. A sensor has been added to each of them to provide guidance, and the ethereal strings to bind their fate to yours.  \n \n"Through the use of colors, I shall enact fading."

Glint Nebuclads are melee Mechanoids created by the academy. 
Arcs of lightning reflect off their blades, giving off an intimidating aura. 
The electric currents surrounding the blades often catch opponents off guard, overwhelming them. 
 
As noted in the Mechanoid Development Memoirs: 
"We studied many schools of swordsmanship and unified their principles to create this."

Glow Lizardlings are commonly found in Jixia. 
Their skin emits a unique faint glow, warning predators with its venomous appearance. 
 
They are believed to be the juvenile stage of the Glowtail Lizard, hence the name.

Melee Mechanoids crafted by the academy using Aerux.  
 
Their bark-like bodies are clad in Aerux armor engraved with curving lines. Each Mechanoid is armed with a wooden sword, executing crisp draws and strikes. 
 
The Aeroclad series consists of basic Mechanoids crafted by the School of Mechcraft, primarily using Aerux and supplemented with metal.

An unyielding gatekeeper, one who can hold the pass against a thousand riders. With a massive shield, it blocks all who stand before it, enduring like a mountain even in ruin. Forged from a fallen hero's shield, it stands as the pinnacle of mechanised defence. 
 
When icy boulders fall off the cliff, there is no retreat. Its core is etched with unbreakable resolve, its defence impenetrable. 
 
Its back faced the country it fought to defend as the underhanded cavalry streamed into the pass. In the dying light of dusk, as shadows stretch long, reinforcements emerge.
Croaky is an affectionate little chatterbox with a puffy bib and a round belly. It is overjoyed just to be with you.

Rebels who turned against the academy due to conflicting sorcery philosophies. They use arm guards to carry more telepathic threads to mitigate energy fluctuations. Unable to cast spells for long, they rely on burst spells, aiming to freeze enemies in an instant. Already in a state of overloaded energy sensing, the low temperatures only deepen their drowsiness.

After the rain, the days get longer and flowers bloom beautifully. 
 
 
 
In the depths of an ancient, dark Oneirland, there is a single, colorful butterfly cocoon. Inside, a girl who controls beautiful dreams sleeps peacefully. She looks calm and seems unaware of the world's troubles and the madness in dreams. She is like a budding flower, protecting pure dreams. 
 
 
 
Some people have seen her delicate wings in the Oneirland and shared the touching story of the Twin Butterfly Envoys. The girl stays silent, letting rumors describe her as a mysterious figure deep in dreams. In the quiet night, she alone embraces and loves all the strange and wonderful dreams created by living beings.
Where arrows fly through the forest, falcons are startled into flight. Arrows shot from the depths of the forest will alert anyone who lacks awareness.

These mysterious eggs can be found everywhere, camouflaging as prey and ambushing unsuspecting victims. 
They move so quickly that it's hard to see how they attack. 
 
Flame Bird Eggs are enveloped in red flames that never burn their own nests. 
This strange phenomenon ranks among Jixia's top ten unsolved mysteries. 
Some theorize that the flames are merely illusions with no real heat—a theory yet to be proven.

Tender buds fill the body, learning to walk clumsily.
When delicate vines take root in the old shell that has become nutrients, a new life begins.
Its thorn-covered body protects the fragile main bud.
The face on the mask is merely a disguise.
At this moment, it is full of longing.
It must embrace and communicate sincerely with every creature it meets for the first time.

Does their cyclical life count as a continuation of the self?
When most of what belongs to the self is replaced, can the core that guides their consciousness remember the former self?

The Ruin-Guarding Mystic Sentinel has awakened ancient constructs buried deep underground, triggering a joint siege.

[Lost Pursuers]: Lost Artillery will prioritize bombarding the Burning Mountain Pivot; players must immediately draw their fire.

[Corroded Clamp]: Lost Clamps will hinder player movement; you must split your forces to clear them. Please defeat the Ruin-Guarding Mystic Sentinel as quickly as possible amidst these multiple interferences.

Deer are widely distributed throughout Jixia, known for their light and elegant posture. 
Female Dust Deer are smaller, with snow-white necks and thick white fluff on their chests. 
They live in mixed-gender groups with clear divisions of labor. 
 
The fur on their backs is light brown, helping them blend into their environment, which is how they got the name "Dust Deer." 
They are often found in lush, scenic areas with abundant vegetation. 
Because of this, they are often seen in legends as a sign of harvest and good fortune.

[Red Flame Burning Field]: The Embermane spits out flames, turning the entire field into a sea of fire. At this time, friendly wooden fences will rise in stone pillars around the field.\n\n[Flame Pillar Dance]: Players must jump onto the stone pillars in time to avoid the ground flames. After the fire-breathing ends, the Embermane will enter a state of exhaustion due to energy depletion; this is the best time for full output.

The two Sentinels act as one, dominating the battlefield through perfect teamwork. Even a small mistake can lead to disaster. \n \nTo break Pickaxe Sentinel's Inferno Shield, ALL four phantom clones of Doomblade Sentinel must strike it. This tests your team's coordination.

They wield power over the polar cold. 
 
They never smiled. Perhaps their chilling powers have numbed their faces, or they have long given up human emotions in the single-minded pursuit of power. 
 
Their eyes sweep across everything impassively before battle, making opponents shudder. The revolving blades spread the icy mist as though the air was being frozen. Each strike of their blades suffocates with fear. 
 
"Emotions are but excuses for the weak to fear the powerful." 
 
This is a belief shared by the Congealing Twin Blades who choose to spend their days in solitude.

Though the Saepes lives long, an end to its life will still come along.
The aged Giant Saepes drags its withered, wooden body, wandering the wilderness.
Its gnarled, mottled branches have witnessed the passage of time, and the rings on its cross-section are beyond counting.
Even so, it remains furious.
As if it wants to leave proof that it lived before turning into rotting wood.

What exactly is a Saepes? Where do their thoughts come from?
These questions no longer matter to it. While Cloudsilk elevated its life, it did not change its fate as a biological entity.

Sentry Flamequenchers are modified battle Mechanoids built by the academy. 
 
The smooth spheres and rounded columns reflect the master Mechsmith's design style. 
 
With powerful weapons and fire control, they far outmatch regular troops. 
 
They are deployed only after key structures are destroyed, then move in to support advancing allies.

Savor the aged wine, and embark on the road. 
 
My young friend, your get-up is vastly different from the ones that I was acquainted with. Things must be very different outside. But since we meet here, this means that life endures, and the dastardly rogues have not gotten their way.  
 
I am dying being slowly consumed by a monster for more than a century. If I can smooth your path, then this is what I must do, so do not grieve. Think only of the beauties of Springbrook Plains, and if you have the time, visit it! My friends in my homeland will be sure to welcome you.

A lighter modeled after the unique design of the Apocalyptor. It is said that Meng Ya even bought one as a collector's item.

Exquisite and compact, this device provides a steady flame and ignites instantly, making it the perfect companion for home, travel, or wilderness camping.

During the Dream-Reverie competition, Meng Ya's Apocalyptor turned the tide with its unstoppable firepower. The Hundred-Treasures Workshop specially invited Meng Ya to craft this device, resulting in a product that perfectly balances utility and aesthetics.

The Rebels turned against the academy as a result of differences in their Martial Arts beliefs. 
 
Rebel Lurkers are naturally cunning and very agile. They use daggers to strike quickly and move almost silently, as if they can muffle their footsteps. 
 
They specialize in ambushing enemies from the shadows. So many rumors surround them that timid students avoid going out after dark.

A rare ore occasionally found in Primaera. Holds the power of the Primal Aura. \nIt is said that Primaera is filled with ores crystallized from particles of vitality power contained within Primal Aura that lingers deep inside its core. Called Primordial Celestite, this type of ore occasionally rises to the surface as a result of natural change or manual excavation.

The Scholar Goose is a well-dressed white goose known for its knowledge and ability to communicate with people. 
Often seen with Hunters, these geese possess incredible memories. 
Their main job is to test the knowledge of Jixia students. 
 
Rumors about talking geese in Jixia are true. 
Visitors to Jixia towns witness geese dressed like scholars evaluating students' school work. 
However, the academy has entrusted the Hunters with raising these special geese, and the method remains closely guarded by the Hunting Society.

Though the Saepes lives long, an end to its life will still come along. 
 
The aged Giant Saepes wanders the plains with its withering body. Its sparse and speckled branches have witnessed the passage of time, evident in the numerous rings within its trunk. 
 
Despite its condition, it remains enraged, as if wanting to leave behind proof of its existence before turning into dead wood. 
 
To it, the origin of Saepes and their thoughts no longer hold significance. Though Aersilk may have prolonged its life, it shares the fate of all living creatures.

[Burning Earth Hell]: Damage from ground flames is significantly increased; even brief contact can be fatal.\n\n[Desperate Pillar Dance]: The number of stone pillars rising on the field is reduced, and they collapse faster. The team must make precise movement decisions within an extremely tight timeframe.

Insects with extremely light bodies and feet that allow them to skim across the water surface effortlessly. 
Their glowing antennae emit a faint luminescence, visible in ponds and swamps during summer. 
 
They also give off an aroma resembling the fragrance of a lotus flower, earning them another name "lotus skimmers." 
People living near ponds and lakes often open their windows at night to enjoy the natural aromas these insects provide.

These creatures have dull, dark colors that allow them to perfectly blend into their environment. 
They are extremely fast and leave ephemeral phantoms of their passage in faint light. 
 
They silently leap within the shadows, appearing as one with the shadowy world. 
Their presence seems to have been forgotten, with no records of any of them being caught before.

A rabbit with fur as translucent as jade.
In the dark, people often mistake it for a large gemstone, so when it moves, it often startles students entering the dream.
Dream Rabbits often appear in dreams; they are friendly and rumored to help humans, though they occasionally play tricks on the greedy.

Legend has it that some have seen them gather together, their light illuminating the entire sky.
However, to this day, this remains just a legend.

Reedepes live in wetlands. 
Their spears are deceptive in appearance with bud-like tips, yet lethal in function. 
 
While their weapons may seem rudimentary, the Reedepes view them as embodying a primal aesthetic.

[Commanding Vine Bind]: The Radish King leaps to the center of the arena, knocking back all players, then blows a horn to bind three players with vines and drag them toward itself. Players pulled to the Radish King will suffer a fatal slash.\n\n[Ground-Walking Swordsman]: Blade-wielding small radishes appear at the edge of the arena to pursue unbound players. You must lure the small radishes' slashes to cut the vines and save your teammates.

The Rebels turned against the academy as a result of differences in their Sorcery beliefs. \n \nThey carry many Telepathic Threads in their wristguards to reduce the harmful effects of energy surges. Because they can't channel power for long, they prefer to unleash explosive blasts that instantly freeze their enemies. The cold from these attacks, combined with their usual sensory overload, makes them even drowsier.

A nimble, short-furred creature known as the Ritual Fish.
They prefer to live in hidden burrows near the waters of Jixia, with round eyes as bright and clear as gemstones.
Because of their elusive nature, their habit of peeking around was once mistaken for a water monkey.

If you are lucky, you might see them neatly arranging fish on the shore, as if performing a ritual, hence the name.
Feeding them fresh fish or simply saying hello might bring a bit of good luck to anglers.
This trait has attracted the attention of hunters and anglers alike.

A beast of many forms, it is filled with longing for the splendors of the world. 
Capable of transforming into any encountered living creature, its true identity remains uncertain. 
Its age and original form are unknown, and imitation might be its way of seeking a place to belong. 
It is lost in the many sights and attractions of Jixia, drawn by the crystal clear Skymirror Lake. It envies the fragrance of Serene Wilds and is awed by the majesty of the Tower of Enlightenment. 
 
It changes continually between the Lizard, the Bears, and the Falcons. 
It is said that when it cannot decide whether to stay or go, it will evolve.

The ancient Wailing Bud, enveloped in sorrow, is unreachable for most people. 
Its crown of wilted leaves emits a tear-inducing gas. 
Those exposed struggle to resist sadness, and even animals lose their appetite. 
So, it exists in solitude, unable to be embraced by other beings. 
 
Legend has it that a flock of scentless birds often kept it company. 
The birds shared tales from distant lands, while it provided sheltering shade. 
One day, however, the birds disappeared. 
Since then, only the mournful wind lingers, and the story fades into a distant memory.

Dwellers of the lakes and wetlands of the Springbrook Plains, these creatures boast vibrant shells and harbor radiant pearls known as the Radiant Firefly. These pearls give off a faint Sorcery energy. \n \nLegend tells of a Sorcery master in Jixia who was passionate about diving and studied various underwater Techniques. One day, he vanished without a trace from the waters where these glowing mussels first appeared.

Fluffycloud often appears in Aerflow-rich valleys and fields, resembling a cloud slowly drifting. 
When attacked, it absorbs power, expands, and eventually bursts into silver-white threads or light spots in the air. 
 
Some believe it's an unidentified mysterious creature, whose true appearance is only revealed the moment its cloud-like shell bursts.

The giant Palisaepes lives underground. The fruits growing on their twisted branches have been encased in hardy shells of ice. 
They are highly accurate throwers who never miss a target. 
 
What could have caused them to cover their fruits in ice? 
Plenty of theories abound, but no definitive answer has been found.

Lost in the Jixia ruins, they possess a crab-like pincer and a flamethrower that glows with heat. 
They perform maintenance within the ruins and use their flamethrowers to clear obstacles as needed. 
 
A novice Crafter curiously asks, "Would the flamethrower melt its pincer?"

Plunging into the depths of despair, 
He donned his mysterious mask before defeat could overtake him. 
As the spirit emerged, nothing could extinguish the fire within. 
He confronted fear and chaos, ultimately discovering his true self.

Crazed Aeroclads are melee Mechanoids crafted by the academy using Aerux. 
Their aggressive Aerux growth makes them appear larger. 
With a gleaming, cold blade, they are more than capable of holding their own in a fight, but always make sure to give failed challengers a chance to try again. 
 
Rebels who've attempted to steal these Mechanoids for study have consistently failed due to the academy's stringent security.

A lighter modeled after the unique design of the Apocalyptor. It is said that Meng Ya even bought one as a collector's item.

Exquisite and compact, this device provides a steady flame and ignites instantly, making it the perfect companion for home, travel, or wilderness camping.

During the Dream-Reverie competition, Meng Ya's Apocalyptor turned the tide with its unstoppable firepower. The Hundred-Treasures Workshop specially invited Meng Ya to craft this device, resulting in a product that perfectly balances utility and aesthetics.

Its beastly eyes flare with savage light, sinews like bronze, claws like iron. Its spine stands firm as bedrock, its strides fierce as a gale. Beneath its vivid pelts, a savage heart pounds madly.  
 
When its colossal hammer falls, the sound is like thunder ravaging the earth, echoing across the wilds. 
 
To this brute, martial strength is nothing more than plunder and conquest. It gathers Rebels in the mountains, raising its banner as self-proclaimed ruler of the wilds. 
 
Despite having risen as the Rebels' leader, Tigrex still yearns for the attention of the legendary hammer-wielding hero. 
 
"At dusk it crept into the tranquil woods; at dawn it charged down the steep mountain."

Menki, with their fluffy ears and round, cuddly bodies, come from the Dreamrealm. Their ears allow them to glide through the air for short distances. They feed on Dreams, and after eating, their stomachs swell, slowing them down. Gently pat their tummies, and they will burp up sparkling bubbles, regaining their agility. \n \nJixia students, take note! If your snacks keep disappearing, it might not be your classmates—it could be the sneaky Menki!

Its hair is like fire, and its claws are like blades. Although its fire is intense, its hair does not burn. 
 
After numerous battles, the Embermane became the king of its kin. Its flaming breath scorches its throat, further exciting its ferocity. 
 
Burning prey are mere toys to it, as it maintains total control, leaving challengers always on the defensive. 
 
Once a challenger itself, the Embermane has now ascended the throne. It stands head and shoulders above all beasts as a fearsome symbol to all living creatures. 
 
Its arrival brings fire, and its departure hints at the death of those flames.

The finest Aersilk made from condensed Aerflow. Musicians value it highly and use it to make Guqin strings. It is beloved by the Gongyu family because, when plucked, it sounds like the low groan of a dragon and the rushing of water.\n\nAn ancient dragon once rested in the river valley, breathing out Aerflow. The Aerflow surged with the dragon's mournful cries and was washed by the frigid river water, condensing into pure, supple silk.

It reigns atop the Aerux, leaving no space for anything else to endure. 
 
Its mane has crystallised into glittering shards, while its vast shadow stretches across the mountains at dusk. 
 
Born at the Aerux's core, where Aerflow runs densest, it wields overwhelming power—yet finds no worthy foe, and with each passing day, grows ever more alone. 
 
With ease, it shatters boulders and snaps trees, its strength unmatched. Still, no opponent has risen to challenge it. 
 
For years, a nearby town offered rewards for its defeat. Now, that town lies abandoned and in ruins—nothing remains but rotting wood and scattered pages, a silent warning to all who would come near.

Rebel Thunderblades are clad in a cloak and carry thunder blades. 
They move swiftly and each slash they execute resembles a dragon coming forth from the abyss with abnormal ferocity. 
The twin blades come with fierce winds and thunderbolts. 
They are formidable. 
 
They could not stand the academy's rules and became the Rebels. 
Like a lightning bolt leaving the clouds that imprisoned it, no one can stop them from chasing their limits now. For now, that is.

Standing on four legs, it often hides in the blazing flames. When it encounters thunder, it fights incessantly. 
 
When the clouds fall, flaming columns reach the sky as this giant flame-breathing lizard razes any land it treads upon to ash. The destruction it causes is difficult to repair, as no greenery can survive its flames. 
 
Many have attempted to vanquish this pestilence, but few have succeeded. Even if they manage to harm it, their actions only further enrage it. 
 
The source of its irritable nature lies in the storm clouds that gather in the skies. 
 
Yearning for a clear crimson dusk, it stops at nothing to achieve it. The battles between these lizard kings appear endless until a person riding a strange steed enters the scene.
A crab-shaped bronze mechanism that looks cute and interesting. After helping it complete its search mission, it will follow you around.

Mini-nose Bilbies are insectivores commonly found in Jixia.
They bury their bodies in the earth, leaving only their petal-like tails visible to lure insects.
If someone approaches, they quickly dig themselves out of the earth and escape, only to burrow back into the soil when it deems things safe.

Since they often move about in flower beds, their claws and tails are covered with pollen. Many young people at Jixia Academy find these creatures adorable, but Mini-nose Bilbies do not care for human affection—everyone is treated as a potential threat from which they must flee.

Despite their names, Scholarly Tigers are small feline creatures with an affinity for human company. 
Their soft, snowy fur is extremely smooth and emits a light, refreshing smell. 
They prefer indoor environments and enjoy playing with children. 
 
They are highly common and regarded as favorite pets among the residents of Jixia. The habit of Scholarly Tigers going to classrooms and listening to lectures often confuses Jixia students. 
Why would any creature enjoy taking classes?

The enraged Hellbound Sentinel channels a chaotic astral flow. His precise Sorcery attacks are lethal—one mistake can kill you. 
 
Star Ring Detonation: Hellbound Sentinel moves to the center, summons five celestial spheres that orbit him while he channels, and creates three expanding circular damage zones. Avoid those zones and destroy all five spheres before he finishes channeling. 
 
Shattered Star Pursuit: The rotating walls speed up, and Hellbound Sentinel summons three extra energy orbs for each player that relentlessly track you. Dodge the orbs, move through the gaps in the walls, and destroy all five hidden constellation shadows.

A guerrilla fighter once held the enemy's border alone, cutting down hundreds of enemies before falling to exhaustion. Though the body perished, his will endured, lingering within the art of war. 
 
His weapon was recovered and reforged into this supreme war Mechanoid. Lightning, ice, and gunfire converge within its frame, while the fighter's unconventional tactics have been fully integrated into its systems. Its long-range combat capabilities are exceptionally refined. 
 
Any force that enters the marshlands against it is already doomed. 
 
They are surrounded—by a single enemy.

The Rebels turned against the academy as a result of differences in their Sorcery beliefs.  
They carry abundant Telepathic Threads in their wristguards to decrease any adverse impacts of energy fluctuations. However, they cannot use spells that last long, so they mostly favor ones with brief and explosive power that can snap-freeze their enemies.  
 
The bone-chilling frost has also caused them to be cold-blooded by nature. Even other Rebels usually avoid picking fights with them.

Lord Botu is a cold hunter who has fallen into the dream. He comes wrapped in darkness, vowing to drag this dream into total destruction.\n\n[Deepest Nightmare]: Lord Botu summons a deep darkness that devours everything. The bright area around the Nightmare Light Platform can protect players from the continuous erosion of the darkness. Only by finding the two Nightmare Feather Guards that appear in the darkness, defeating them to seize the Nightmare Light, and successfully escorting it to the Nightmare Light Platform to light it up, can the darkness be dispelled and force him to appear.

A graceful bird with a slender build whose elegant form belies its surprising strength. 
 
Adult Aerise Birds are plumed in blue and white, with only their crest and flight feathers a striking shade of orange. 
 
When it takes flight, it weaves through the clouds like rays of golden light, leaving behind an aura of ethereal grace.
