Their striking orange feathers once made them targets of excessive hunting, nearly driving them to extinction. Thanks to efforts by Hunters to protect and breed them, their numbers have recovered, and they've formed a deep bond with humans. 
 
 
 
If you encounter an Aerise Bird, greet it with respect—it may even carry its human companions across the skies.

Bi Fang, the essence of wood; it looks like a bird and does not eat the five grains.
A giant bronze bird, chirping day and night. Its cry is fierce, and all who hear it weep in sorrow.
Bi Fang has forgotten many things, but it remembers its own name.
Its single leg is rusted, its wings are mottled, but its eyes still burn with a cyan, scorching fire, matching the deep flow-patterns on its body.

The tall ship gave it the mission to fly, to guard, and to fight.
But now the ship has capsized, and it still tries to fulfill its mission, even though everything it could protect has turned to ruins.
So it cries out, to at least hold onto its name, with a pride that is almost shattering:
Bi Fang, Bi Fang.

The true form of these creatures remains unknown, as the descriptions vary greatly depending on who you ask.
Some claim they have bony leaves like the Boneleaf Fox, while others believe they are accompanied by fog and mist like the Aertint Foxes.

They roam Jixia with graceful steps, effortlessly changing their forms as they move through fields, mountain peaks, wetlands, and even Dreamscape Forest.
Even if someone has seen them before, no one can accurately describe what they look like.

Greenrobes are adorned with vibrant green plumage, accented by tangerine feathers on their crowns, wings, and tail tips.
Though often mistaken for solid green due to the subtle red accents, Greenrobes indeed possess these striking tangerine feathers.

These birds share a natural affinity with aquatic life and frequently groom their feathers near water's edge.
Highly attuned to living creatures, there have been documented cases of Greenrobes guiding weary travelers to water sources during times of drought.

This strongman always gazes upon Jixia Academy from a distance. 
 
With his devastating hammer, he can easily shatter boulders into dust. Yet, he never speaks of the flaming hammer prints he left behind when he abandoned his mentor. 
 
Viewing his mentor's self-restraint as weakness, he believed that only the heat of flames could manifest true righteousness. 
 
Now appointed as the leader of the youthful Rebels, he has slowly begun to understand his mentor's wisdom. However, this learning curve is as challenging as mastering Martial Arts, and he is not yet ready to offer an apology.
Clouds form without purpose, their burst creating a thunderous sound. \nBefore the Grand Nihil, conspire with the vitality of all beings to secure a decisive victory.

The Rebels turned against the academy as a result of differences in their Martial Arts beliefs. \n \nRebel Hunks are heavily built fighters with powerful arms that let them swing massive hammers easily. They rely on raw strength and often use training methods banned by the academy.

They are tasked with guarding Jixia's ruins. 
Adorned with glowing patterns etched into their bronze bodies, they wield ancient pikes with deadly precision, delivering swift and lethal strikes. 
 
Rebels or curious students alike who venture into the ruins are met with their cold steel.

Its beastly eyes flare with savage light, sinews like bronze, claws like iron. Its spine stands firm as bedrock, its strides fierce as a gale. Beneath its vivid pelts, a savage heart pounds madly.  
 
When its colossal hammer falls, the sound is like thunder ravaging the earth, echoing across the wilds. 
 
To this brute, martial strength is nothing more than plunder and conquest. It gathers Rebels in the mountains, raising its banner as self-proclaimed ruler of the wilds. 
 
Despite having risen as the Rebels' leader, Tigrex still yearns for the attention of the legendary hammer-wielding hero. 
 
"At dusk it crept into the tranquil woods; at dawn it charged down the steep mountain."

The Relic Fire-Crack Armor is a specialized mechanical construct abandoned in the Jixia ruins.
Made of bronze, the upper body resembles a furnace, and the lower body resembles a spider.
When the mechanism is triggered, the patterns flash with fire, warning of an impending explosion.

It is said that after an explosion, the remaining core attracts surrounding bronze to reshape its body.

The fur on the Gilded Fox's neck displays flower-like patterns. These mysterious and elegant markings are considered a symbol of luxury, making the Gilded Fox highly prized by noble families.\n\nRecords state that "the Gilded Fox's cry is a thousand-fold melody," as their calls are exceptionally melodious. They only cry out nine times in their lives for unknown reasons, and each cry is unique. Countless members of the Gongyu family have spent their entire lives trying to capture these sounds.

It's a mischievous creature with a light, transparent body and a faint blue glow. 
Many people try to approach these cute-looking creatures, but they gently fly away when someone gets too close. They even turn around and show off their tiny treasure chest. 
 
You must be patient playing with them to get rewarded with the treasures in the chest. 
Rumors say they play such pranks because they enjoy seeing the satisfied smiles on people's faces when they find treasure. 
Although these chests hardly contain anything worthwhile, it's polite to reward these little ones with a smile. 
Some scholars collectively call Jixia's River Sprites "Sproutlings."

The Relic Clamp Armor is a bronze mechanical construct abandoned in the Jixia ruins.
It mimics the appearance of a crab, holding mechanical clamps, with mysterious glowing patterns on its shell.
It usually uses its dual clamps for maintenance work and replaces corresponding attribute parts based on the environment.

How they perform their duties so methodically has always been a puzzle that craftsmen want to solve.

A playful Blue Big-eye Owlet who loves shiny things. 
She hides her treasures in her feathers, 
often preening to inventory her collection. 
 
Her relationship with Shye is actually a partnership. 
When Shye sells treasures, the Blue Big-eye Owlet often assists her.

Doomblade Sentinel fights with fiery aggression. Pickaxe Sentinel stands firm and unbreakable like a mountain. They arrive with the Calamity Star to carry out the Sanctified's orders. 
 
Pickaxe Sentinel activates an Inferno Shield while charging up a full-screen attack. The shield protects him during the charge. 
 
Doomblade Sentinel repeatedly charges toward players. 
 
Have Doomblade strike the Inferno Shield three times. After the third hit, the shield breaks, and Pickaxe Sentinel's attack is interrupted.
With a fierce yet endearing look, Grimble radiates a sense of security. Although it appears light, it can weigh down a stone pedal.

It lurks in the nightmares of students,
absorbing the obsessions and darkness in people's hearts to reshape itself.
From the bite of a mad wolf to the pounce of a giant bear,
it gradually condenses the power of destruction within endless bestiality.
This shadow born of dreams attempts to break the boundary between reality and illusion, using sharp blades to tear the present world apart.

"The more awake you are in a dream, the more trapped you are in reality."
The awakened shadow projects the despair and darkness from the depths of the soul into people's dreams,
and thus the dream twists into this dark incarnation of disaster.

Strange fruits floating around Jixia. 
Their surface is covered with thick, soft fuzz.  
To protect themselves, Streaking Thundranas emit electrical discharges at creatures trying to "pick" them. 
 
If you hear thunder on a clear day, it might not mean rain but rather that someone has disturbed these fruits.

Heavyshield Aeroclads are defensive Mechanoids constructed by the academy using Aerux. 
Aerux generates electric currents that cover their great shields, allowing them to easily counter incoming attacks. 
 
Challenging them requires preparation to prevent numbness. 
Some students from the School of Martial Arts even train in ranged attacks to stand a chance against them.

Clouds rise to bring rain, dew condenses into frost.
Legend has it that an ancient belief exists far beyond the extreme north.
They say that clouds reaching the end of their lives fall to the edge of the world, gradually piling up into a blue mountain range.
And the ice and snow on the mountains turn into new clouds, repeating the cycle to nourish all living things.

Countless explorers have tried to uncover the secrets of the giant mountain, only to freeze to death in the wilderness.
To prevent further tragedies, the Hundred Schools once jointly issued an investigative report, warning people that the peak is actually a dormant exotic beast, and the cold it exhales can freeze even time itself.
Please abandon any plans to go there rashly, unless you are fully prepared to face the biting frost.

Fortune on a gamble, wealth on a roll. 
 
Humanity's bond with gambling has always been complex—feared by some, revered by others. 
 
A simple roll of the dice or a shuffle of the deck can spiral into a haunting obsession. 
 
 
 
And so, the Mechsmiths came up with this cursed creation. 
 
Rows of cannons glow with a menacing blue light, electric currents crackling through its angular frame. 
 
When the shimmering face of victory lights up, it's a signal that a thunderous blow is about to descend.

Infused with Sorcery energy, this dark green jade ring glows with a soft, lustrous sheen. 
 
It unleashes bursts of energy powerful enough to pierce through solid rock with ease. 
 
 
 
Ancient tales speak of jade rings as symbols of peace and stability. 
 
Yet in reality, it's raw power that underpins any enduring age of harmony.

Mushrooms mutated under the influence of the Aercocoon. 
The eye-catching blue caps are not fully open yet. 
Shrivelcap Shrooms release spore cores that, while not forming ice, are cold enough to generate frost flowers. 
 
Compared to their mature versions, Shrivelcap Shrooms may be better suited for use in preservation.

As the core accelerates, the ancient bronze body resonates with the remaining thunder power in the ruins, making the attacks increasingly fierce.\n\n[Thunderous Formation]: The stone pillars are heavy, and the time required to push them down together is significantly increased. The Qingyue General's attacks also become extremely violent, accompanied by lightning strikes.

Freeze the camp with ice, and burn it with fire. 
 
Those words are carved into the Mechanoid. They show the creator's understanding of war and explain its purpose. 
 
Two energies fused and fed each other, amplifying the cannon fire so no defense could hold. 
 
Yet the Mechanoid lay abandoned beneath the ruins. It never got a chance to be used. The horn for the counterattack never sounded—the craftsmen who built it had already died defending it.

The fighter wielded dual blades. As the mockery continued, the enemy leader fell. 
After enduring countless attacks, his body perished, but the dual blades remain. 
The Mechanoid inherited the hero's legacy. 
Frost freezes weapons, and flames melt armor. 
The agile and swift movements have been inherited, and the speed attack skill has reached perfection. 
 
As the wicked army and bandits swept through the village, the one to end the tragedy appeared. 
While the enemy was still laughing, his head was separated.

They live in the wetlands and are born with the will of their ancestors, using their power to protect their kind from enemies. 
 
They carry a twisted, forked staff that hums with mysterious whispers only they can hear. 
 
As leaders of the tribe, their main job is to find the best place for future generations to grow and thrive. 
 
Researchers believe that the special connection between them and their unevolved descendants is the secret to the tribe's success.

Blazing Flamedge Aeroclads are enhanced Mechanoids forged from Aerux, majestic and imposing. 
The academy modified their predecessors, in order to find better students. 
Wielding a fiery blade, they appear as if they could raze the land. 
Their swiftness in attacking poses a significant challenge for most students. 
 
The series of modifications they underwent transformed them into more than just a test of skill. 
The inspiration for these modifications came from a towering mountain of crimson rock in the north, which bathes in twilight and appears on the verge of catching fire every sunset.

A polished figurine carefully sculpted from Aerux, showing Master Fuzi holding his ferule. 
 
This figurine captures Master Fuzi during the Mount Guye Trials, where he skillfully corrected the stances of several Martial Arts students while accepting their challenge. 
 
At first, sales were slow. But everything changed when a Martial Arts student brought the figurine to an exam he had always failed, and finally passed. Soon, word spread that the figurine brings good luck in exams, and it quickly became a bestseller.

Bronze Turrets are defensive Mechanoids found in the ruins. 
Their four legs are bunched together, charging for a powerful blast with their two cannons. 
A single blast is enough to shatter any armor. The only way around them is to avoid them. 
 
For some reason, they have been restless, a sign that this place has never been forgotten.

The Flame-Thunder Blade General's offensive becomes more violent, switching between fire and thunder at shorter intervals.

[Scorching Wave Peaks]: The frequency, quantity, and power of the fire blade light are significantly increased, and the living space is drastically compressed.
[Angry Flame Rapid Burn]: After performing the fire combo slash, it will recover its actions at a faster speed and launch the next round of attacks.

Young Spike Bear.
They have stiff bristles on their heads and are widespread throughout Jixia. Though small, they can curl into a ball to attack.

Spike Bears are mammals; the mother raises the cubs until they are grown, so they are often seen together. If a cub is attacked while alone, it will call for its mother to help.

A panda demonkin who drifted into the Colorful Cloud Basin. 
He came to the academy with dreams of proving himself, only to be turned away for his uneven academic performance. 
But an old man once told him: "Among any three people, there must be one who can be my teacher." 
He took these words to heart, and seeking advice from students became his form of cultivation. 
 
Since then, a strange "Green Bamboo Hero" has appeared in the Colorful Cloud Basin. 
Rumor has it among the students that there is a formidable eccentric who challenges everyone he meets to a fight. 
Strangely, he shouts out move names from storybooks as he fights. 
And when he leaves after a fight, the nearby food often disappears with him. 
More than his martial arts, it is this appetite that people find most concerning.
A mysterious messenger who moves between dreams and reality. Sometimes playful, it enjoys telling scary stories to spook others.

A strange creature from the Dreamscape. 
 
It has an odd umbrella-shaped body with four thick, long tentacles. 
 
When it finds prey, it summons thorny vines to trap them and feeds on their dreams.

This strongman always gazes upon Jixia Academy from a distance. 
 
With his devastating hammer, he can easily shatter boulders into dust. Yet, he never speaks of the flaming hammer prints he left behind when he abandoned his mentor. 
 
Viewing his mentor's self-restraint as weakness, he believed that only the heat of flames could manifest true righteousness. 
 
Now appointed as the leader of the youthful Rebels, he has slowly begun to understand his mentor's wisdom. However, this learning curve is as challenging as mastering Martial Arts, and he is not yet ready to offer an apology.

Icecannon Aeroclads are the upgraded version of the Artillery Aeroclad, made of Aerux by the academy. 
Cannons peek from their Aerux-covered shoulders, shooting cannonballs infused with the power of ice. 
 
Students who challenge them after refining their footwork are often dismayed to find that their opponents have also grown stronger. 
A chilling strike from a cannonball freezes their limbs, a harsh reminder that they still have much to learn.

An exquisitely detailed and beautifully crafted Wondrous Maze model.

It perfectly replicates the scene from Kongming's graduation project, making you feel as if you are there. This model is a great way to relieve stress and hone your character.

Legend has it that after Zhuge Liang finished the design of the Wondrous Maze, he invited Zhou Yu to challenge it. Although Zhou Yu refused on the surface, he couldn't resist the temptation and snuck in at night. Little did he know, Zhuge Liang was prepared. After Zhou Yu completed the challenge, Zhuge Liang stayed in the Wondrous Maze for three days and nights. The Wondrous Maze became even more difficult after that. Unfortunately, Zhou Yu had already left school by then and never went back. But after the Baihui Workshop released this model, they received an order from the Three Kingdoms region. The workshop owner speculates that this order most likely came from Zhou Yu.

These Saepes fighters wield oversized spiked clubs. Anyone struck by these clubs, even if not severely injured, would suffer from the pain inflicted by the spikes. \n \nBut such weapons are meaningless to their nemesis, the Embermane. Thus, where the Embermane roams, Saepes are rare.

Dwelling in ruins, they are responsible for storing information. 
Covered in patches of rust, they have lost their metallic sheen. 
Furnished with ancient and mysterious cerulean-colored patterns, they move at incredible speeds despite lacking attack abilities. 
 
While their civilization has long withered away, they seem to be waiting for their masters to return and guarding something unknown.

Superior Icesword Effigies are Mechanoid fighters made from a mysterious metal with a burly build.  
Their deep red armor stands out on the landscape, an impressive sight. Their insides shine with a fluorescent blue light that chills anyone who lays eyes upon them.  
 
As the creatures they froze have long melted away in decay, they still carry the history to be told, with a body full of blade marks.

Nightmare-Spotted Deer are distributed throughout the Dream Realm. Due to the influence of dream energy, their fur has turned a dark, psychedelic purple, dotted with many light-colored spots. The males grow antlers and have manes on their chests. Their deep, dream-like color has made them mysterious and eerie figures in folklore.\n\nTheir coat color darkens with age. It is rumored that the darkest Nightmare-Spotted Deer possesses special power. Many who have been trapped in nightmares have claimed that it was this deer that guided them to wake up.

Tender buds fill the body, learning to walk clumsily.
When delicate vines take root in the old shell that has become nutrients, a new life begins.
Its thorn-covered body protects the fragile main bud.
The face on the mask is merely a disguise.
At this moment, it is full of longing.
It must embrace and communicate sincerely with every creature it meets for the first time.

Does their cyclical life count as a continuation of the self?
When most of what belongs to the self is replaced, can the core that guides their consciousness remember the former self?

Influenced by the Aercocoon, the Bomb Radish has leaves heavy with fruits. 
 
When it can't escape or avoid danger, it explodes and scatters its seeds to burn enemies. 
 
"Stay away from the Bomb Radish—it's safer for everyone. This bomb doesn't have a fuse," noted a Cannoneer in his research journal.

Intricate metallic patterns adorn its surface, each whispering tales of a forgotten past. 
Though eyeless, its presence exudes a profound, wise gaze felt by all who approach. 
 
Unmoved by storms or waves, it stands as a steadfast guardian. 
Beneath its cold exterior, every creature senses the warmth and strength it silently offers.

These mysterious eggs can be found everywhere, camouflaging as prey and ambushing unsuspecting victims. 
They move so quickly that it's hard to see how they attack. 
 
Some think that they did not come about naturally but were originally one of the other bird egg variants. When a bird egg loses the nest, its survival instinct drives it to absorb negative elements from its surroundings and transform them into toxins that accumulate in its body for self-defense.

The Bronze Flame Sunderer is a Mechcraft worker with special uses in the ruins. 
With its pincers removed, the closer the person gets, the brighter the light on its back, and the faster it moves towards them. 
Following this are often the screams of intruders trying to extinguish the flames. 
 
Fire purifies all, making them the most effective cleaners in the ruins.

A strange creature from the dream realm.
The dream thorn wraps around a deep blue light.
The dream of the Floating Dream Cage Thorn traps prey in a beautiful dream, making them unable to extricate themselves.

Butu once had a desirable life in the past. It is said that the totem symbolizing beautiful dreams records the story of Butu before he became a resident of the dream realm.

In the autumn of ruin, the waters flooded and caused disaster. Craftsmen used heaven-defying skills to create a profound mechanism.
The bronze construct, shaped like a massive roof ridge, conceals the secrets of the past.
Its thick, jointed legs are incredibly agile.
Its perfect balance of defense and impact matches the most primitive style of combat.
It is meant to crush all invaders.

In the nearly boundless underground world of Jixia, complex river routes and unimaginable creatures are hidden.
What were the ancient craftsmen trying to build by using the Ruin-Guard to move mountains and fill seas?

An unyielding gatekeeper, one who can hold the pass against a thousand riders. With a massive shield, it blocks all who stand before it, enduring like a mountain even in ruin. Forged from a fallen hero's shield, it stands as the pinnacle of mechanised defence. 
 
When icy boulders fall off the cliff, there is no retreat. Its core is etched with unbreakable resolve, its defence impenetrable. 
 
Its back faced the country it fought to defend as the underhanded cavalry streamed into the pass. In the dying light of dusk, as shadows stretch long, reinforcements emerge.

The Aero Jellyfish is a floating creature that drifts in the air. 
Resembling an open umbrella with visible veins, it has tendrils that sway in the air. 
Its transparent body reflects the ever-changing landscapes below, creating a mesmerizing display. 
 
It continues to sway, aimlessly carried by the winds, unaware of its next destination.

Bronze Mechcraft guards that look like tortoises lie hidden in the ruins of Jixia. These are mobile bronze turrets used for defense. When enemies appear, these hidden turrets turn around and fire together. \n \nWhen intruders get surrounded by other Bronze guards, Lost Gunners will already be charging up, before moving to the high ground to take aim at these uninvited guests.

This place was ruined by excessive flooding. The craftsmen worked around the clock to come up with a solution. 
 
Station Ruins Sentry, shaped like a bastion, hides the secrets of the past. 
 
Its large, many-jointed legs give it remarkable flexibility. 
 
With strong defenses and powerful attacks, it is built for simple, brutal tactics that crush invaders. 
 
Station Ruins Sentry was created to move stones and hold back the sea, leaving behind a vast underground world of winding rivers and strange creatures.

Bronze Mechcraft guards that look like tortoises lie hidden in the ruins of Jixia. These are stationary bronze turrets used for defense. When enemies appear, these hidden turrets turn around and fire together. \n \nDespite their immobility, their powerful attacks deter anyone seeking the treasures of the ruins. Some Rebels researching cannons are willing to pay high prices for them.

Humans assimilated by the Dreamweaver after falling into the Dreamscape. Even after becoming Nightmare Reavers, they continue to practice Mechcraft, weaving the illusory mirage of a land beyond Jixia in the boundless Dreamscape. "The clearer you are in dreams, the more lost you are in reality." —A piece of advice from a Dream Sorcery Instructor.

These mysterious eggs can be found everywhere, camouflaging as prey and ambushing unsuspecting victims. 
They move so quickly that it's hard to see how they attack. 
 
Nest Eggs have a strong ability to adapt to various conditions for survival. 
Hunters have recently made significant discoveries about these eggs. 
It's very likely that these are not actual embryos but simple mimics.

Beautiful feathers that only a very few Croakies grow when nourished by Aerflow. They are fluorescent white, soft, and light, making them irresistible to touch.\n\nAccording to hunters, Croakies with these white feathers are highly favored by others. The saying that "obtaining a Joy Feather brings good luck in love" seems to have originated among Jixia students from this.

Found throughout Jixia, these creatures are distinguished by a long, uniquely shaped horn on their heads, resembling a delicate petal. 
 
Unlike most insects that blend into their surroundings, they stand out with their vivid pink color. 
 
The elegant, petal-like structure on their heads is admired by Jixia's literati. A renowned musician once wrote of them: "Heavy rain, flying petals—they never fall." The verse perfectly captures their essence. For those wandering through nature, spotting one is a rare and enchanting sight.

Pushed to the brink, the Radish King unleashes its primal fury, encasing itself in an unyielding fortress of twisting thorns. To shatter this impenetrable shell, you must turn its own kin against it—the Radish Bursters. 
 
Thorned Aegis: While dragging your allies, the Radish King generates a tough thorn armor. The knife-wielding Radishes can sever the vines, but the armor remains impervious. 
 
Scorched Assault: Rescued players must guide dormant Radish Bursters to strike the Radish King or lure it onto scorched zones left before. Only sustained burning can gradually wear down its armour, otherwise the armour will persist.

Black rock rich in Aerflow, often used by the people of Jixia to make ink sticks. Disciples accidentally discovered this rock while exploring. When brought near fire, it turns into black liquid, forming a stream. The ink-colored stream is traced with white lines, as if nature itself were using the land as paper to create a natural ink wash painting.

This strongman always gazes upon Jixia Academy from a distance. 
 
With his devastating hammer, he can easily shatter boulders into dust. Yet, he never speaks of the flaming hammer prints he left behind when he abandoned his mentor. 
 
Viewing his mentor's self-restraint as weakness, he believed that only the heat of flames could manifest true righteousness. 
 
Now appointed as the leader of the youthful Rebels, he has slowly begun to understand his mentor's wisdom. However, this learning curve is as challenging as mastering Martial Arts, and he is not yet ready to offer an apology.

[Star Ring Burst]: The Celestial Spirit returns to the field to charge up and summons five constellations that rotate around it. It also releases three layers of expanding ring-shaped area damage. Players must destroy the constellation nodes while dodging continuous ground fire.\n\n[Star-Shattering Soul Chaser]: The wall rotation in the second phase accelerates, and the Celestial Spirit locks onto each player, spawning three tracking energy orbs that persist in pursuit, severely disrupting movement paths. The team must find gaps in the walls to destroy the hidden constellation shadows while evading the energy orbs.

[Mad Rat Charge]: In addition to the original mechanics, an Armored Rat Elite will appear on the field, charging along a fixed route. If the nut carrier is hit, the nut will be dropped. A player must be assigned to intercept the elite and clear the rolling small armored rats; otherwise, the formation will be easily disrupted.

Pome Magpies are a common sight in Springbrook Plains. They are small and shy, so they often stay close together.

Most of the time, they wrap their wings around their bodies and hang upside down from branches, resembling vibrant, colorful fruits that blend seamlessly with their surroundings.

Legend has it that their colors change based on the food they eat, which may explain why vegetables and fruits instinctively avoid them.

Palisaepes Scouts are from the fertile land. 
Their eyes glow with a dim light as they dart about. 
Gripping their darts tightly, they swear to chase away any outsiders. 
 
They have evolved to possess excellent night vision, capable of capturing even the tiniest bit of light in the caves.

A strange creature from the Dreamscape. 
Its odd umbrella-shaped body extends into four thick and long tentacles. 
When the Dreamtangle encounters prey, it summons Dreamthorns to trap the prey, 
and absorbs the dreams from the prey. 
 
Lately, encounters with the Dreamtangle have become more frequent. 
Reports of this terrifying, massive creature attacking Jixia students have come in from all over the Dreamscape.

A dark, eerie figure, an incarnate nightmare.
The tall, slender Dreamslayer lurks in the shadows and dreams, waiting for the perfect moment to strike.
The shadows beneath its purple feathers are the prey's final memory, and the moon-blade it wields is the pride of a lone hunter.
The Moon-blade Dreamslayer is born from dreams, one with everything around it.
It moves through the air with ease, its gorgeous slashes like phantoms.

It tears through dream after dream, traversing fantasy after fantasy.
Its dark footsteps are merely the prelude to the hunt; the dreams of the mediocre are the food it survives on.

Goldshell Turtles live near water. Unlike the Hunchshell Turtles, they have light-colored patterns on their shells that look like a beautiful golden coating in the sunlight.\n\nA long time ago, people saw these turtles with their "golden" shells as symbols of wealth. Because of this, rich families often kept them in their ponds. Throughout history, people have always wanted to be wealthy, so even a regular turtle can become admired if it is linked to wealth, like the Goldshell Turtle.

When the storyteller in town speaks of the Radish King, he slams the table and launches into the tale with gleaming eyes: 
 
"At first glance, the creature looks like an enormous radish, blown up to an absurd scale. Its surface is covered in uneven ridges, like earth that has cracked and healed over time. Atop its head, vibrant green leaves sway like towering forest trees. 
 
Beneath those leaves lies a pair of slanted, cunning eyes, glinting with mischief. But what truly draws the eye is the cleaver it carries. The blade gleams under the sun—clearly no ordinary tool—and in its hands, it strikes with terrifying force." 
 
"If you ever encounter it, never underestimate it. Among the creatures born of radish-kind, it stands as one of the fiercest. Its behaviour may defy reason, but one thing is certain: it is no easy opponent."

Mechanoid fighters forged from a mysterious metal with a burly build. 
 
Their crimson armor is strikingly conspicuous and awe-inspiring. Their giant blades dance in their hands, their attacks as swift and forceful as a torrent. 
 
They are often covered in battle marks, which are just superficial scars. The numerous refinements of their mysterious metallic bodies are evident from these marks. 
 
Remnants of these Mechanoids have been spotted by the Crafters in different places, posing the question: What kind of monster could have torn them apart?

A mini massage hammer meticulously crafted after Zhong Wuyan's iconic hammer. It loosens muscles, improves circulation, and can be used on the whole body. Use it to relax your back during downtime, or to stay alert and focused when busy.

Back in the day, Zhong Wuyan challenged various martial arts schools with a single hammer, even smashing a deep pit into the floor of the Heming Hall. For a time, martial arts students regarded her hammer as a spiritual pillar.

This hammer is affordable and versatile, becoming a hit as soon as it was released. Every time new stock arrived, the rush was chaotic. It is said that Zhong Wuyan tried three times and failed to grab one, only managing to get one on her fourth attempt after using her real hammer to smash the ground and distract others.

Cannon Effigies are ancient ranged Mechanoid fighters. 
Their arms have been modified into cannons, equipped with metal barrels designed to withstand great impact and launch projectiles with deadly accuracy. 
 
They roam war-torn ruins, faithfully carrying out their duties despite having lost their original purpose.

Big-eye Owlets are a species of bird that thrives by living together with humans. 
Despite their small size, their powerful wings allow them to fly across vast distances. 
They possess the ability to learn the languages of various creatures and are highly sensitive to changes in weather. 
 
While often used as message couriers, Big-eye Owlets have a secret side to them. 
The first Big-eye Owlet to cooperate with humans is still active somewhere, but the identity of its human companion remains a secret known only to a few.

The resister faced the enemy with twin blades; before the mockery could fade, the leader's head had fallen.
Pierced by a thousand blades, the body perished, yet the twin blades remained.
Take the hero's lost blades and bestow them upon the Emperor of Mechanisms.
Frost freezes the weaponry, flames melt the armor.
The swift and agile combat style has been inherited; the art of rapid strikes has reached perfection.

The wicked master and his bandits swept through the village, but the one who ends the sorrow has appeared.
The enemy still mocks, but their head is already severed.

Often found in Jixia ruins, they have a pot-like body and four spider-like legs. 
When alerted, their bodies glow, foreshadowing an impending thunderous blast. 
 
After flashing, the sound of their explosion resonates throughout the ruins.

Nightmare-Spotted Deer are distributed throughout the Dream Realm. Due to the influence of dream energy, their fur has turned a dark, psychedelic purple, dotted with many light-colored spots. The does have snow-white necks and no antlers, replaced instead by a patch of pink fluff.\n\nAncient Jixia divination suggests that Nightmare-Spotted Deer feed on human dreams: the stags consume deep dreams, while the does consume shallow ones. Encountering both a stag and a doe in a dream may mean that your dreams are about to fall through.

A lost Sorcery creation of the academy. 
Its flaming light flickers in the sky, while the sorcerous patterns on its copper bell glow a deep, eerie blue. 
The Windring Bell often emits shrill, enchanted trills to attack its enemies. 
 
Whenever the wind blows, its chime echoes far and wide. 
Those familiar with its omen know—when its sound carries, the weather is about to take a turn for the worse.

The rules of the dream realm have become increasingly bizarre. Even a small amount of light has become elusive, and it even quietly devours the vitality of the light-seekers.

[Bizarre Dark Realm]: After the Pitch-Black Nightmare descends, the location of the Nightmare Light Platform will change randomly, making it difficult to predict.

[Nightmare Light Corrosion]: Players holding the Nightmare Light will continuously lose their maximum health. The team must take turns relaying it to successfully escort the light to the destination.

A variant of Bronze Sunderers, Bronze Thunder Sunderers wield the power of thunder. 
Lurking in the shadows, they self-destruct the moment they are disturbed. 
Their cores crackle with lightning, flashing ominously just seconds before the blast. 
 
No one remains composed under their thunderous assault.

[Seed-Explosion Surround]: When giant-sized, it generates self-destructing wooden fences at each player's feet that will explode soon; move away immediately.\n\n[Burning Shield Deadline]: The fire bombs thrown by the Bombardment Guard explode after a short time. Players must pick them up and throw them at the Wooden Fence King within the time limit, or they will lose the key opportunity to break its armor.

They have creamy-white fruits growing on their intertwined branches, emanating an herbal aroma. 
In battle, they fling these tough fruits to inflict great suffering upon their enemies. 
 
Maybe attracting herbs to grow upon them was an evolutionary adaptation.

Doomblade Sentinel fights with fiery aggression. Pickaxe Sentinel stands firm and unbreakable like a mountain. They arrive with the Calamity Star to carry out the Sanctified's orders. 
 
Pickaxe Sentinel activates an Inferno Shield while charging up a full-screen attack. The shield protects him during the charge. 
 
Doomblade Sentinel repeatedly charges toward players. 
 
Have Doomblade strike the Inferno Shield three times. After the third hit, the shield breaks, and Pickaxe Sentinel's attack is interrupted.

The dream realm has now turned into a prison of despair that devours everything, and every glimmer of light is accompanied by the burning of life.

[Abyssal Dream Prison]: The player's continuous erosion by the Dark Nightmare is significantly increased, while healing effects are greatly suppressed.

[Nightmare Light Burning]: The price of holding the Nightmare Light has become heavier, and the rate of losing maximum health has accelerated sharply, forcing the team to complete relays and escorts as quickly as possible.

Megadrive Hammer has gone berserk. It summons Mechanoids and now aims for pure destruction. 
 
Triple Shock: Megadrive Hammer fires three full-screen shockwaves in a row. Before each shockwave, it teleports to the edge of the arena, so each wave comes from a different direction. 
 
Mechcraft Reinforcements: Megadrive Hammer summons two Mechanoids before the shockwaves. One will grab the Shield in the arena. Defeat the Mechanoids and reclaim the Shield so it can protect you from the upcoming shockwaves.

The guerrilla hid at the border, flashing ninety-nine times to annihilate two hundred enemies. Exhausted, he died, but his soul remains, forever etched in martial arts. Taking the hero's discarded cannon, they forged the King of Mechanoids. Lightning and long songs intersect; ice shards and gunfire weave together. The stored, bizarre tactics have merged with the machine, making its long-range skills divine.\n\nAn undefeated army enters the swamp; their defeat is already sealed. They have been surrounded—by one person.

Mechanoid fighters forged from a mysterious metal. 
 
Their gleaming red armor commands attention from everyone. Their spears pulse with immense power, cutting down enemies like a tiger on the hunt. 
 
While their old comrades have turned to dust, their incomplete mission keeps them rooted in place.

These mysterious eggs can be found everywhere, camouflaging as prey and ambushing unsuspecting victims. 
They move so quickly that it's hard to see how they attack. 
 
When you hear a sudden growl of thunder on a sunny day, it may not mean rain is coming—someone might have just disturbed one of them.

Fighters of the Saepes tribe.
Clad in leaves, with twisted vines wrapped around a crude blowpipe.
Saepes Scouts excel at ambushing enemies from the shadows with blowdarts; the poisoned projectiles leave enemies in constant misery.

According to research, the toxins in Saepes blowdarts come from a variety of sources, including but not limited to: Poison Bubble Buds, Leaf-tailed Lizards, Jade Tear Fruits...

Embermane no longer holds back. Its massive, kingly flames erupt across the battlefield, leaving almost no safe space. 
 
Infernal Ground: Fire on the ground deals extreme damage. Even a brief touch can be fatal. 
 
Pillar of Desperation: Fewer stone pillars rise, and they collapse faster than ever. You must make precise, split-second moves to survive.

Radish influenced by the Aercocoon. 
The Ambushing Radish is characterized by stubby limbs, lethargic motions, an indifferent expression, and a tender heart. 
Highly defensive, it hurls radishes at any creature that gets too close. 
 
Herbalists have studied what makes up these radish darts. 
They found it contains radish, Aersilk, and some indigestible binding agents.

Combat Mechanoids crafted from mysterious, exceptionally sturdy metal. Their crimson armor is striking and imposing. They dance with sharp greatblades, their attacks as swift and fierce as a rainstorm. They are often covered in blade marks, yet these only scratch the surface, showing that the metal of their bodies has been tempered countless times. However, craftsmen have found their remains in certain places—what kind of monster could have torn them apart?

Tigrex is a fierce Rebel leader from the mountain forests. After losing the first battle, he stole an experimental Shield from the School of Mechcraft. Now he blends raw rage with Mechcraft power and aims to crush any challenger. 
 
Mechanized Shield Charge: Tigrex charges forward with the Shield. You must destroy that Shield, or Tigrex will unleash a final red-glowing charge that cannot be dodged and deals massive damage. 
 
Earth Shatter: Right after the charge, Tigrex jumps and slams the ground repeatedly, creating full-screen shockwaves. The shockwaves cannot be dodged by jumping or dashing. Only the Shield on the field can block it.

As he dismantled the last Martial Arts hall's emblem, 
He approached the mightiest hall master. 
On an ordinary day, before the morning dew settled, 
He directed his sword towards a remarkable past. 
A new chapter unfolded, revealing boundless possibilities.
Its red cheeks make it look fierce, but once you get close, you'll realize it's a very gentle little fellow.

The eerie flowers of the Dreamscape, like murmurs of an odd dream. Their origins and growth remain a mystery. 
Covered in bizarre wooden textures, each line on their body seems to whisper an ancient curse. 
The large, full buds subtly reveal a mysterious red churning within, as if molten lava might erupt at any moment. 
This vivid, searing hue becomes even more intense and eerie in the Dreamscape. 
 
If it's known to be a dream, why awaken? Better to eternally slumber among the petals. 
The giant flowers sleeping here possess an undeniable allure in the Dreamscape. 
No one knows what those enchanted by them truly see. 
But without a doubt, they are among the most perilous beings within the Dreamscape.

Mutated under the Aercocoon's influence, they bear striking purple caps that resemble open umbrellas and expel spore cores as a form of self-defence. \n \nEven seasoned warriors armed with swords and spears keep their distance—not because these creatures are invincible, but because their numbing spores are relentlessly troublesome.

The one-legged bronze giant bird, carrying an undying obsession, guards this long-capsized treasure ship.

[Blazing Thunder Triple]: Bi Fang selects three players to drop scorching lightning, forming lightning circles on the ground. If the circles overlap, they will explode violently and permanently expand their range. After a while, all lightning circles will spread on their own, significantly compressing the survival space.

[Azure Flame Seize]: Bi Fang swoops down and grabs a player with its sharp claws. Companions must immediately rescue them with all their might, otherwise, Bi Fang will pour its rage onto the entire field.

The chief of a Saepes clan usually has the largest physique in the village. 
Nurtured by Aercocoon, blue crystals have sprouted on its twisted branches. 
When enemies appear, the Aeroward Macroepes will defend the village with everything it has. 
It protects its allies and itself with the shield, and fiercely throws stones at the intruders. 
 
Normally, newborn Saepes get to enjoy the protection of its shade. 
So the Aeroward Macroepes remains perfectly still, quietly watching over these tender young lives.

The Relic Condensing Gun Armor is a bronze mechanical construct abandoned in the Jixia ruins.
The mechanical clamp on the right has been replaced with an ice cannon, emitting cold air from the nozzle.
In the ruins, mechanical devices often overheat, and only extreme cold can eliminate the danger.

For every novice who explores the ruins, a new patient arrives at the Herb Garden to treat frostbite.

The ancient ones saw not the moon of today, yet this very moon once shone upon their way. 
The soldier of stone, wielding a legendary bow, was once a mischievous child who wove grass blades and fought with insects. 
Before becoming a soldier, the Frenzied Sword Sentinel found joy in lying in the grass and playing with insects. 
However, a series of hardships led him to devote himself to the study of Martial Arts. 
 
Forsaking the bond with his flesh, armor imprinted, he felt power surge within, yet despised the golden glow. 
He despised the pale gold glow of his weapon, as insects tended to flee from it, leaving him unable to touch them again. 
Grumbling out of habit, after turning back, he discovered his childhood friend was nowhere to be found.

Heavy Spear Effigies are Mechanoid fighters forged from a mysterious metal. Larger than standard Spear Effigies, they are clad in pristine, tempered armor. Their long weapons strike with direct, powerful force, making intruders think twice. These machines once fought like an army, but some unknown event caused them to scatter across Jixia.

Its beastly eyes flare with savage light, sinews like bronze, claws like iron. Its spine stands firm as bedrock, its strides fierce as a gale. Beneath its vivid pelts, a savage heart pounds madly.  
 
When its colossal hammer falls, the sound is like thunder ravaging the earth, echoing across the wilds. 
 
To this brute, martial strength is nothing more than plunder and conquest. It gathers Rebels in the mountains, raising its banner as self-proclaimed ruler of the wilds. 
 
Despite having risen as the Rebels' leader, Tigrex still yearns for the attention of the legendary hammer-wielding hero. 
 
"At dusk it crept into the tranquil woods; at dawn it charged down the steep mountain."
Though small in appearance, it seems to have a wealth of work experience. Years of labor have left it exhausted, and the bird carries a faint air of weariness.

The Rebels turned against the academy as a result of differences in their Martial Arts beliefs. 
Rebel Toxic Stingers' daggers are not only sharp but conceal deadly poison. 
Any person injured by them will slowly lose their combat abilities due to poisoning. 
 
They do not believe in any code of honor in Martial Arts. What matters to them is winning by any means necessary.

The two berserk powers of the Flame-Thunder Blade General are nearly unbalanced. It attempts to bring down thunder that annihilates everything; only by using its own power against it can you break the deadlock.\n\n[Thunder Meteor Sword Formation]: The Flame-Thunder Blade General flies into the air to accumulate destructive thunder and rains down dense thunder swords on the players. Players must destroy the falling thunder swords while avoiding attacks, pick them up, and throw them back to knock the General out of the air.

The enraged Embermane sends out waves of fire that put your team's coordination to the test. 
 
Synchronized Flames: All stone pillars rise at the same time, but each one stays up for much less time than usual. 
 
Dance of Survival: Plan your moves so everyone uses each pillar efficiently. Any hesitation or delay by a team member can lead to casualties.

Full Moon Bats inhabit the caves of Jixia. 
They have large wings that appear strangely hazy under the moonlight. 
They are capable of flying at extremely high speeds, swiftly locking onto their prey in the dark and pouncing on it with deadly accuracy. 
 
Full Moon Bats gather on the night of the full moon, which is why people often spot groups of them flying about at night.

Ferocious creatures often found in grassy plains and mountainous regions. 
Covered in thick fur that extends to their backs, their bodies are clad in dark scales. 
Wolvines expertly use their sharp front claws to dig burrows, employing underground ambushes to swiftly hunt their prey. 
 
With poor vision, Wolvines generally do not stray far from their territory. 
Yet, a tale has woven its way into Jixia's parental teachings. 
It warns children not to return home too late, lest the Wolvines snatch them away.

An ancient defensive stationary mechanical construct.
The Qiancui Shock Shield Automaton was designed with practicality in mind.
The mechanical patterns on the tower shield channel superior shock elemental energy, giving it powerful counterattack capabilities.

Even today, this design of using energy to grant a shield counterattack capabilities remains a monument in mechanical engineering.

Clouds rise to bring rain, and dew turns to frost again. 
 
Legend has it that an old faith exists in the northernmost lands of the far north: 
A cloud falls to the edge of the world, forming a cornflower-blue mountain. 
The snowy cap of that mountain becomes a new cloud, nourishing living creatures. 
Again and again. 
 
Countless explorers have tried to uncover the secrets of the great mountain but froze to death on the way. 
To prevent further tragedy, the Societies published a report warning that the supposed mountain peak is actually a slumbering beast, exhaling air cold enough to freeze even time. 
"Lay aside those plans of yours to go forth unprepared, unless you are ready to face bone-chilling cold," they advised.

Bronze Sentries hold their position and protect the ruins. 
Shaped like turtles, they carry bronze shells on their backs, with Aerux inside and Mechcraft patterns engraved on their armor. 
Capable of both guerrilla defense and agile offense, they make intruders feel like trapped beasts fighting for survival. 
 
As one Seeker noted, "The story of the tortoise and the hare doesn't apply in the ruins."

[Fire Shield Collision]: The Blade-Severing Spirit locks onto a player to charge, while the Lone Halberd Spirit activates a Fire Shield in the center of the field. Players must lure the Blade-Severing Spirit to collide with the Fire Shield three times to successfully break the shield; otherwise, they will suffer massive screen-wide damage.

This strongman always gazes upon Jixia Academy from a distance. 
 
With his devastating hammer, he can easily shatter boulders into dust. Yet, he never speaks of the flaming hammer prints he left behind when he abandoned his mentor. 
 
Viewing his mentor's self-restraint as weakness, he believed that only the heat of flames could manifest true righteousness. 
 
Now appointed as the leader of the youthful Rebels, he has slowly begun to understand his mentor's wisdom. However, this learning curve is as challenging as mastering Martial Arts, and he is not yet ready to offer an apology.

The Rebels turned against the academy as a result of differences in their Sorcery beliefs. 
Using overloaded Aersilk telepathic threads, they cast Quake spells they could not have mastered otherwise. 
The energies they gather and use in their attacks also inflict damage on themselves. 
 
Their clothing is made from insulating materials to prevent spells from backfiring and causing severe harm.

A variant of Bronze Sunderers, Bronze Thunder Sunderers wield the power of thunder. 
Lurking in the shadows, they self-destruct the moment they are disturbed. 
Their cores crackle with lightning, flashing ominously just seconds before the blast. 
 
No one remains composed under their thunderous assault.

It reigns atop the Aerux, leaving no space for anything else to endure. 
 
Its mane has crystallised into glittering shards, while its vast shadow stretches across the mountains at dusk. 
 
Born at the Aerux's core, where Aerflow runs densest, it wields overwhelming power—yet finds no worthy foe, and with each passing day, grows ever more alone. 
 
With ease, it shatters boulders and snaps trees, its strength unmatched. Still, no opponent has risen to challenge it. 
 
For years, a nearby town offered rewards for its defeat. Now, that town lies abandoned and in ruins—nothing remains but rotting wood and scattered pages, a silent warning to all who would come near.

The Dream Demon of Painted Shadows is the embodiment of darkness in the dream. Now, its ambition has expanded, twisting everyone's dreams into a disaster.

[Three-Phase Illusion]: The Dream Demon of Painted Shadows cycles between wolf, bear, and human forms, each with unique combat tactics.

[Nightmare Seizure]: When in bear or human form, it summons Nightmare Butterflies to snatch a player and fly toward a Nightmare Rift. Teammates must shoot down the butterflies in time, or a devastating explosion will be triggered upon falling into the rift.

To shield her allies from harm. 
To silence the anguished cries. 
She takes on the responsibility alone. 
Even if the fortress may fall and the massive shield may shatter, 
Her unwavering spirit remains, transcending time.

A rodent found in the forests of Jixia, characterized by its gourd-shaped brown shell. Armadillo Rats are docile and retreat into their shells when attacked. Only when their young are threatened will they use their claws and teeth to bite back.\n\nArmadillo Rats love medicinal herbs, so herbalists often follow them in hopes of a harvest. Few herbalists can track them alone, so they often team up with hunters.
A mystical creature attuned to nature, curious about everything. Despite its airy appearance, it can weigh down pedal Mechcrafts.

Giant Palisaepes that reside underground. 
 
With their immense size and fearsome presence, few creatures dare challenge them. Their attacks are devastating, though their movements are slow. 
 
Smaller Palisaepes gather around them, drawn to their strength and seeking shelter. Under their protection, some thrive and grow, eventually becoming towering trees that guard their own domain.

An ancient Jade Tear Fruit surrounded by sorrow, unapproachable by ordinary people.
The corolla, crowded with withered leaves, overflows with a gas that brings people to tears.
Those affected will feel uncontrollable sadness, and even beasts will lose their appetite.
Therefore, it can only live alone in its own place, unable to be accepted by other creatures.

It is said that a flock of Scentless Birds often kept it company.
They brought anecdotes from afar, and it provided a stable, sheltering shade.
But one day, the Scentless Bird flock vanished from the sky.
In the years since, only the sorrowful wind remains, and the story has become a lost echo.

Giant underground Palisaepes. Their massive, imposing frames and terrifying visages mean few creatures dare to oppose them. The Palisaepes Colossus possesses destructive power, though its size makes it clumsy. Small Palisaepes like to gather around the giant ones; this worship and following of the strong stems from their instinct for self-preservation. Some lucky ones will grow strong under this protection, becoming the next towering tree to shelter the land.
Became the exclusive pet of the strong. Motto: "Trophies should always be with the best."

An unyielding gatekeeper, one who can hold the pass against a thousand riders. With a massive shield, it blocks all who stand before it, enduring like a mountain even in ruin. Forged from a fallen hero's shield, it stands as the pinnacle of mechanised defence. 
 
When icy boulders fall off the cliff, there is no retreat. Its core is etched with unbreakable resolve, its defence impenetrable. 
 
Its back faced the country it fought to defend as the underhanded cavalry streamed into the pass. In the dying light of dusk, as shadows stretch long, reinforcements emerge.
With its flashy flame-like markings, this fish is quite dashing. It has a straightforward and cheerful personality, making it an easy friend.

Four legs on the ground, hidden in flames. When lightning strikes, the battle never ends.
When the clouds fall, the wildfire rises.
The fire-breathing giant lizard turns the land it treads into scorched earth.
The scars it leaves are hard to erase, and nothing grows where it passes.
Successive challengers have tried to drive away this disaster, but few have succeeded.
Even wounding it only adds to its fury.
The source of its restlessness is the gloom gathering on the horizon.

It rolls like red clouds, never stopping.
The struggle between the lizard kings was once endless, until the person riding the strange mount appeared.
Its tiny head is always filled with dreams of tasty food. For it, a full belly is the most important thing in its life.

What defines Martial Arts? 
It's the ability to combat beasts and Mechanoids with bare fists. 
Effortlessly facing adversaries, energy surges like a vibrant rainbow. 
Sadly, future generations may never witness this untamed spirit.

In the advanced challenge, the two Sentinels use stronger teamwork and summon phantom clones to catch you off guard. Sharp eyes are your best defense. 
 
Doomblade Sentinel splits into four phantom clones, each charging a different player. 
 
ALL four phantom clones must hit Pickaxe Sentinel's Inferno Shield to break it. Stay spread out so the clones don't cross paths.

Created by Yango, these puppets self-destruct by triggering an implosion within their own bodies. Despite their unarmed appearance, do not be deceived—their destruction culminates in a sudden, thunderous explosion. \n \n"With chaos, I express isolation."

The Ruin-Guarding Mystic Sentinel's protective instincts have been fully triggered, making its advance even more resolute, with every step shaking the earth.\n\n[Relentless Advance]: It ignores all interference and charges toward the Burning Mountain Pivot. Unlike the basic challenge, its pace is faster, significantly shortening the time players have to intercept it.

After experiencing many things in the world, the buds on Saepes Spearguards' crowns have bloomed. The spear in their hands hasn't changed, but the improvement of combat skills has little to do with weapons. Their weapons are crude, but after years of careful care and fighting side by side, the Saepes have become more skilled and ferocious in battle.

Artillery Aeroclads are ranged Mechanoids made of Aerux by the academy. 
Cannons peek from their shoulders, which are covered in Aerux, launching dangerous cannonballs that require effort to handle. 
 
Artillery Aeroclads test students' reactions under heavy fire. 
Many students end up covered in dust and soot when they fail to dodge in time. Artillery Aeroclads are tough to deal with if you haven't practiced enough footwork.

A bronze mechanism crackling with lightning, larger than the average Relic Armor. Purple electricity spills from its giant pincers, the buzzing noise a clear warning of danger. The sound it makes before unleashing a thunderbolt grows louder, giving enemies only a brief window to react. It is speculated that besides maintenance, the Relic Thunder Armor also serves as an energy supply unit within the ruins. Jixia mechanists are trying to figure out the secret to their durability.

The juvenile form of Flamebearer Falcons or Bluegale Falcons. 
Their distinctive fan-shaped crowns have not yet developed. 
These small-sized Falcons are incredibly swift and dive at their prey like lightning upon spotting them. 
 
A long time ago, a theory was shared about how to determine Swiftbolt Falcons' future form: 
"Eggs laid by day hatch into red birds, and those by night into blue."

Embermane is a battle-hardened beast that breathes fire and attacks with blade-like claws. It enjoys burning anything that enters its territory, and wherever it stands, the flames linger. 
 
Scorching Inferno: Embermane covers the area in a wave of fire, during which friendly Saepes summon stone pillars around the area one after another. 
 
Pillar Dance: You must jump onto those pillars to avoid the burning ground. Each pillar only supports weight briefly before collapsing, so you and your team need to move and time your jumps carefully. When Embermane's fire attack ends, it becomes exhausted and vulnerable—that is the best moment to deal the most damage.

Can human craftsmanship ever reach the heights of the sublime? 
 
In the hands of a genius, wood and metal come to life. The Yango Puppet, dressed in its flowing robe, moves with the grace of a learned scholar. It stands guard over a stage, unwavering through all seasons and storms. It recites familiar scripts, adapting them spontaneously to fit the current scene. Spectators are amazed by the puppet's exquisite craftsmanship, clearly the work of a master. During pauses in its dance, the puppet reaches out with a radiant smile, inviting the audience to join the performance, equipped with weapons and secret arts. 
 
"We are held up by invisible threads. Our chains, but also our bond... Dance with me at the fingertips."

Linked telepathically to the Saepes King, the minions enter a frenzy, ready to die for their liege. They carry deadly traps, forcing players to act quickly and with precision. 
 
Explosive Traps: When enlarged, self-destructing Saepes appear beneath each player. Move away immediately to avoid instant damage. 
 
Blazing Shield: Fireballs from Catapultors explode shortly after landing. Pick them up and chuck them at the Saepes King before they blow, or you'll miss the chance to break its parts.

The Caster Sentinel is one of the Trialgiver Sentinels of the ancient Enlightenment Trials. Clad in black armor with gleaming gold laced about its armsit wields a staff infused with sorcery energy, a testament to its boundless wisdom. He has waited here for millennia to pass on his endurance skills. 
 
The foolhardy will never be heroes. The foolhardy will never become heroes. No one understands the way of cunning better than the Caster Sentinel. 
Alongside his challengers, he envisions a thousand outcomes within the war tent, commanding soldiers across distant battlefields. 
 
Can you bring these well-orchestrated battle skills back to the field?

Its beastly eyes flare with savage light, sinews like bronze, claws like iron. Its spine stands firm as bedrock, its strides fierce as a gale. Beneath its vivid pelts, a savage heart pounds madly.  
 
When its colossal hammer falls, the sound is like thunder ravaging the earth, echoing across the wilds. 
 
To this brute, martial strength is nothing more than plunder and conquest. It gathers Rebels in the mountains, raising its banner as self-proclaimed ruler of the wilds. 
 
Despite having risen as the Rebels' leader, Tigrex still yearns for the attention of the legendary hammer-wielding hero. 
 
"At dusk it crept into the tranquil woods; at dawn it charged down the steep mountain."

Luxnails are snails with a wholly bluish-purple appearance and a spiral shell that glows in the dark. \nThey use their hard shells and sharp, hooked spines to protect their soft bodies. \nThey feed on glowing insects, which explains the luminosity of their shells.

The guardian stood firm, a single man holding the pass against a thousand. Giant shields blocked the enemy; though exhausted, it stood like a mountain. Taking the hero's lost shield, the Emperor of Constructs was forged. Ice and rock fell upon the cliff, leaving no retreat for friend or foe. An unyielding belief was embedded in the core, making its defensive techniques unbreakable. Vile iron cavalry flooded the pass, and the defenders turned their backs on their homeland. As the setting sun cast its final glow, reinforcements appeared in the elongated shadows.

They have unknown fruits growing on their intertwined branches, covered in a thick layer of ice. 
In battle, they fling these ice-cold fruits to inflict great suffering upon their enemies. 
 
Did they freeze the fruit, or did the frozen fruit frost them?
A mysterious creature in tune with nature, full of curiosity, and especially fond of you.

Bronze Mechcraft guards that look like tortoises lie hidden in the ruins of Jixia. These are stationary bronze turrets used for defense. When enemies appear, these hidden turrets turn around and fire together. \n \nDespite their immobility, their powerful attacks deter anyone seeking the treasures of the ruins. Some Rebels researching cannons are willing to pay high prices for them.

Sparkcap Shrooms have undergone mutations under the influence of the Aercocoon. Their eye-catching red caps have not fully opened yet. \n \nThey release spores that, while unable to start fires, emit enough heat to drive people away. Their sparks are much milder compared to their mature form Flamecap Shrooms.
The Armored Rat King has been nourished by cloud currents for years. It is massive with thick, hard armor, and it sneaks into the fields to steal grain during village festivals.

Mechanoid fighters forged from a mysterious metal. 
 
Larger than Spear Effigies, they stand clad in polished armor that gleams under the light. They wield their spears decisively and with great force, striking fear into those who stand in their path. 
 
Once, they marched as a unified force, but a mysterious turn of fate has scattered them across Jixia.

Patrol Rangers are Mechanoids created by the School of Mechcraft to patrol and guard Jixia. 
They are equipped with twin cannons carefully designed to retain power despite their small size. 
They aim accurately at opponents until they are destroyed. 
 
Seasoned Hunters make use of the Patrol Rangers' sensors to track animals. 
For example, if a Wolvine goes to the ground, a Patrol Ranger can help provide a rough location.

Nightmare Wolvines are Wolvines affected by the Dreamscape. 
They take on a shadowy and terrifying appearance, with their eyes glowing a dark blue. 
Filled with Dreamscape energy, their front paws grant exceptional speed. 
Although practically blind, Nightmare Wolvines possess the ability to detect disturbances in Dreamscape energy waves nearby. 
 
Some dream analysis books state, "Nightmare Wolvines summon towering waves," suggesting that encountering a Nightmare Wolvine in a dream may foreshadow setbacks and difficulties.

Fighters of the Saepes tribe.
Their most distinct feature is that oversized spiked club.
Anyone struck by it, even if not severely injured by the force, will suffer greatly from the barbs on the club.

However, in the face of their natural predator, the Embermane, these crude Saepes weapons are like mere firewood, so the Saepes are rarely found where the Embermane appears.

A giant beast in the north, with four legs. It hides among thunder and often fights to the death with fire. 
 
When the flames are extinguished, storm clouds rise. 
 
This thunder manipulator is a mortal enemy of the Wreckflame Lizard. Discreet flashes of light surround its large body, hidden within the thunder and lightning. 
 
It deals a painless, instantaneous death to its victims. 
 
Beloved by thunder and lightning, it reigns supreme. 
 
Steady as a stone, it is not easily moved from its perch. Only when the flames of its nemesis begin burning will it raise its head and roar.

Spear Effigies are Mechanoid fighters made from a mysterious metal. 
Clad in damaged armor, they wield spears to warn off anyone who dares to offend at a distance. 
 
They carry the weapons crafted by a long-gone blacksmith, wandering about the battlefield still scarred with unhealed wounds.

The Chaos Ripper Sentinel is one of the Trialgiver Sentinels in the ancient Enlightenment Trials. Clad in black armor with gleaming gold accents on his arms, this sentinel wields dual blades that dance with determination and valiance. Fearless as flame, he has waited here for millennia to pass on his valiance skills. 
 
With no way to counter his madness, the Chaos Ripper Sentinel knows the way of valiance better than anyone else. He and his challengers wield all weapons and build a defense with their deadly dance. However, time's ravages have shattered their unbreakable defense. 
 
Can you bring back these battle skills as fierce as wildfire under the blazing sun?

Saepes Colossi are colossal beings, their towering, moss-covered bodies adorned with flourishing branches. 
While they move slowly, the sheer force of their strikes causes the ground itself to tremble. 
 
To conserve water resources, Saepes Colossi are rarely seen in groups.

The Mechanical Bronze Fish falls into a rage, all ruin mechanisms are activated, and the barrage is as dense as a raging sea.

[Armor-Cracking Tide]: More abandoned Fire-Splitter Armors join the battlefield, attacking from multiple sides.

[Raging Tide]: The Mechanical Bronze Fish's scale barrage becomes faster and more unpredictable, testing the player's precision in operating the turrets and the timing of shield activation.

Aertint Foxes possess snowy white coats adorned with bluish patterns, resembling Aerveins drifting across their bodies.
These creatures are highly elusive but often found in areas shrouded by fog and mist.

Legends suggest that Aertint Foxes can exhale clouds and summon rain. A Hunter and his Seeker brother spent years tracking the Aertint Fox, hoping to uncover the secrets behind Jixia's shifting climate.

A fierce hunter of the dream world. 
 
Tall and covered in feathers, with wings on its back and arms. 
 
It wields a crescent-shaped scimitar, unleashing fast, swirling slashes, and can also smash the ground with a powerful blow to send out a strong shockwave. 
 
Legend says these blade-wielding Dreamslayers were once proud and reckless youths. Their reckless attacks come from their deep arrogance. Find a chance to strike when it gets tired, and you can turn the hunt back on it.

Violabunnies are found throughout Jixia.
They have coats ranging from gray to white and sport a pair of large ears.
Violabunnies move quickly and are naturally timid, making them the most unaggressive creatures in Jixia.

Many people keep Violabunnies as pets since they easily become attached to those who feed them. Growing up with Violabunnies as pets is a common experience for many children due to their docile nature. Although Violabunnies are afraid of humans, offering them food can help alleviate their fears.

Guardian Armadillo Rats are a mutated variant of the Armadillo Rat commonly found in dense forestation. 
They possess massive bodies with rock-hard shells to match. 
In danger, they retract into their shells, ready to counterstrike with their strong limbs. 
 
Rural folklore often speaks of a renowned adventurer who traverses waters using the giant shell of a Guardian Armadillo Rat.

Combat Mechanoids forged from mysterious metals. Armored with gleaming, reinforced scales, they are heavily fortified and intimidating. The Blade Effigies wield their blades with basic, disciplined techniques. One doesn't need to look closely to see the scars covering these machines; the remaining marks seem to tell the story of the hardships they endured as soldiers.

The Frostmane Spike Bear dominates the Aerux peak. Its mane has turned to crystal. It is powerful, lonely, and restless, smashing rocks and trees in its wake. Once a target of bounties, it is now a warning to stay away. The town lies in ruins, leaving only decayed wood and scattered fragments.

The guardian stood firm, a single man holding the pass against a thousand. Giant shields blocked the enemy; though exhausted, it stood like a mountain. Taking the hero's lost shield, the Emperor of Constructs was forged. Ice and rock fell upon the cliff, leaving no retreat for friend or foe. An unyielding belief was embedded in the core, making its defensive techniques unbreakable. Vile iron cavalry flooded the pass, and the defenders turned their backs on their homeland. As the setting sun cast its final glow, reinforcements appeared in the elongated shadows.

A hundred days of ice that sealed the fortress, a thousand miles of fire that burnt between camps.
These words are engraved upon this bronze construct.
This is the ancient craftsmen's ultimate understanding of war, and the interpretation of this mechanism.
Red and blue energies coexist and merge, amplifying artillery fire that no city can withstand.
Yet, it was abandoned beneath the ruins.

Its role as an attacker never had the chance to be showcased.
The horn for the counterattack had not yet sounded, and the craftsmen who built the Frost-Fire Cannon had already sacrificed themselves in the battle to defend it.

The one who stayed behind lingers in this world, while their companion has returned to where it came. The Sentinel wanders the valley, bearing the name of a knight, yet its mount is nowhere to be seen. The oversized greatsword it carries confirms the incredible size of its former partner. Though it now relies solely on the greatsword fused to its body, even without the momentum of a charge, its heavy strikes can still cleave through mountains and rivers.\n\nDragon Knights still uphold their oath to their dragons. Since the dragons are gone, the place where they parted is likely the final resting place for the rest of the knights' lives.

Fighters of the Saepes tribe.
Clad in leaves, with twisted vines wrapped around a crude blowpipe.
Saepes Scouts excel at ambushing enemies from the shadows with blowdarts; the poisoned projectiles leave enemies in constant misery.

According to research, the toxins in Saepes blowdarts come from a variety of sources, including but not limited to: Poison Bubble Buds, Leaf-tailed Lizards, Jade Tear Fruits...

Saepes Summoners are born with the will of their ancestors and use that power to protect their people. Each carries a twisted, forked staff that hums with whispers only Saepes can hear. 
 
As tribal leaders, their main job is to choose the best places for future generations to grow and thrive. 
 
Researchers believe the tribe's success comes from the special bond between them and their younger, unevolved members.

The Armadillo Rat King has long thrived on Aerflow, developing a thick hide and a massive frame. During the Festive Fire Opera, it sneaks into the granaries to raid the crops. 
 
Nut Lure: The King summons several little Armadillo Rats to wreak havoc, one of which carries a special nut. When the nut-bearer is defeated, the nut remains on the field. The Rat King then drags all players closer, ensnaring two with vines. Entangled players will be silenced, and straying too far will snap them back.  
 
Unbound allies must pick up the nut to bait the King's charge, while the entwined pair must pull their vines in opposite directions to trip the charging King. Timing and coordination are key—fail, and the colossal rat keeps rampaging.

Driven by hunger, the Armadillo Rat King unleashes its full strength. Summoned Armored Rats are much tougher, while nut bait now wears off quickly. \n \nThe little Armored Rats now have greatly increased health, requiring heavier firepower to dispatch quickly. Dropped nuts lose their lure range very quickly, so the nut carrier and vine handler must act in perfect sync. Any delay can break the bind and cost you the supply cache.

Saepes King rules with absolute authority. It uses its scepter to overpower anyone who opposes it. 
 
Vinebind Assault: Thick vines trap all players while Saepes charge in with spears. Break free quickly to avoid the incoming strikes. 
 
Soul Siphon: Saepes King drains life from nearby Saepes, growing huge and wrapping himself in thorn armor that blocks damage. Saepes Catapultors spawn and fling fireballs—grab those fireballs and throw them at Saepes King to shatter his armor. Otherwise, his size and power will keep increasing and threaten to crush the whole area.

Melee constructs created by the academy. The Crazed Crystal-Armor form is slightly larger than standard models, with a shinier shell. They wield their blades in a reverse grip with mysterious technique, forcing many students to concede using only the back of their blades. The academy was once divided over their high production cost, until their performance won everyone over.

Tigrex has fully awakened his ancient bloodline. A primal beast with raw power and rock-solid defense is unleashed. 
 
Fury Shield Charge: When Tigrex charges, his Shield becomes much tougher. You must focus your attacks and deal heavy damage to break it. 
 
Earth Shatter: Right after the charge, Tigrex jumps and slams the ground repeatedly, creating full-screen shockwaves. The shockwaves cannot be dodged by jumping or dashing. Only the Shield on the field can block it.

Giant underground Palisaepes. Twisted branches bear special fruits, though they have long since rotted away with time. These Palisaepes are precise throwers; they aim and launch their projectiles in one fluid motion, never missing. Perhaps for more effective defense, the Palisaepes Rot-Throwers intentionally let their 'fruits' decay. It must be said, many creatures are driven away by the stench before they can even get close.

Megadrive Hammer is the pinnacle of the School of Mechcraft's maximization approach. Forged from unprecedentedly tough materials to push the limits of power, every strike packs a devastating punch. Its deceptively simple design hides the force to shake mountains. \n \nHammer Shockwave: After charging, Megadrive Hammer unleashes a full-screen shockwave. One player must grab the dropped shield to block it, while others need to stay close behind the shield-bearer to avoid damage. The shockwave strikes twice in quick succession, so reposition quickly to stay safe.

In the autumn of ruin, the waters flooded and caused disaster. Craftsmen used heaven-defying skills to create a profound mechanism.
The bronze construct, shaped like a massive roof ridge, conceals the secrets of the past.
Its thick, jointed legs are incredibly agile.
Its perfect balance of defense and impact matches the most primitive style of combat.
It is meant to crush all invaders.

In the nearly boundless underground world of Jixia, complex river routes and unimaginable creatures are hidden.
What were the ancient craftsmen trying to build by using the Ruin-Guard to move mountains and fill seas?

A rodent found in the forests of Jixia, characterized by its gourd-shaped brown shell. Armadillo Rats are docile and retreat into their shells when attacked. Only when their young are threatened will they use their claws and teeth to bite back.\n\nArmadillo Rats love medicinal herbs, so herbalists often follow them in hopes of a harvest. Few herbalists can track them alone, so they often team up with hunters.

The Radish King reigns supreme, a terror known far and wide. Its gleaming kitchen knife hints at danger beneath its playful demeanor, as it vows to defend the dignity of the Radishes through battle. 
 
Vine Command: Leaping to the center of the arena, the Radish King knocks back all players, then sounds its horn to ensnare three targets in twisting vines and drag them close. Anyone dragged to the Radish King faces a deadly strike. 
 
Groundbound Cutters: Meanwhile, the knife-wielding Radishes burrow along the edges, chasing unbound players. Guide these little attackers to sever the vines and free your allies before it's too late.

Sentry Mechanoids are combat constructs created by the academy. Their perfect geometric design of spheres and cylinders is a masterpiece of the master artificers.
