These constructs possess immense attack power, easily crushing ordinary soldiers.\n\nSentry Mechanoids typically join the battlefield after key structures are destroyed, helping to accelerate the advance.

Rebels who turned against the academy due to conflicting martial arts philosophies. Rebel Vanguards wield hammers and shields, excelling in defensive counterattacks. Many of them come from outside Jixia, joining the rebels in pursuit of power.

The soldier, who wielded dual blades, came from an army outside Jixia. His Flow was drawn to the Calamity Star, and whenever the star struck the land, he would appear with the meteorite and attack any living creature.

Young Spike Bear.
They have stiff bristles on their heads and are widespread throughout Jixia. Though small, they can curl into a ball to attack.

Spike Bears are mammals; the mother raises the cubs until they are grown, so they are often seen together. If a cub is attacked while alone, it will call for its mother to help.

Four legs on the ground, hidden in flames. When lightning strikes, the battle never ends.
When the clouds fall, the wildfire rises.
The fire-breathing giant lizard turns the land it treads into scorched earth.
The scars it leaves are hard to erase, and nothing grows where it passes.
Successive challengers have tried to drive away this disaster, but few have succeeded.
Even wounding it only adds to its fury.
The source of its restlessness is the gloom gathering on the horizon.

It rolls like red clouds, never stopping.
The struggle between the lizard kings was once endless, until the person riding the strange mount appeared.

The two Sentinels act as one, dominating the battlefield through perfect teamwork. Even a small mistake can lead to disaster. \n \nTo break Pickaxe Sentinel's Inferno Shield, ALL four phantom clones of Doomblade Sentinel must strike it. This tests your team's coordination.

The Hellbound Sentinel, having fully unleashed its primal essence, has become a living catastrophe. Stars swirl in its grasp, threatening unparalleled destruction. 
 
Cataclysmic Stars: The summoned stars are now empowered by their essence, becoming far more stable. You must strike with greater force to shatter them. 
 
Cosmic Vortex: The rotating starlight walls spin at extreme speed, with openings vanishing in an instant. This means immense pressure when hunting down the constellation shadows. It tests the team's DPS and coordination to the limit.

They live in the fertile lands and are born with the will of their ancestors, using their power to protect their kind from enemies. 
 
They carry a twisted, forked staff that hums with mysterious whispers only they can hear. 
 
As leaders of the tribe, their main job is to find the best place for future generations to grow and thrive. 
 
Researchers believe that the special connection between them and their unevolved descendants is the secret to the tribe's success.

In the north of Jixia, there is a giant beast with four legs that likes to hide in lightning and often fights with fire to the death.
When the fire dies, the thunderclouds rise.
The lightning-wielding giant lizard is the mortal enemy of the wildfire giant lizard.
Its massive body, shimmering with faint light, is often hidden within lightning.
It grants its victims a painless death the moment it appears.
It is the darling of lightning and the apex predator of the wilderness.

It rests like a crag, immovable.
Only when the enemy's fire begins to spread will it lift its noble head and let out a roar that shakes the earth.

After enduring the trials of the world, the floral crowns atop the Saepes Brutes have finally bloomed. The massive clubs in their hands are no different than before, but true mastery of martial arts has never been about the weapon itself. While their weapons still fear the scorching flames of the Scorched Fluff, years of careful maintenance and fighting side-by-side mean the Saepes Brutes will no longer give their natural enemies an opening.

Clad in leaves, with twisted vines wrapped around a crude blowpipe.

An unyielding belief was embedded in the core, making its defensive techniques unbreakable. Vile iron cavalry flooded the pass, and the defenders turned their backs on their homeland. As the setting sun cast its final glow, reinforcements appeared in the elongated shadows.

The two birds have parted, and the defector has returned home. Following the sunrise, the Crimson Falcon flies from the edge of the sea to Jixia. It is the king of the sky, diving like falling fire to hunt. Its selection of prey goes far beyond mere hunger; only the strongest are chosen. Hunting is a life-or-death ritual, and only the survivors enjoy a moment of peace.\n\nNo one knows what it seeks in this land, but in truth, the Crimson Falcon is not searching for anything—this continent is merely a branch for it to rest upon.

Tigrex, a fierce Rebel leader in the mountain forests, now bursts into the Three-School Showdown. With iron claws and relentless force, he wants to dominate the competition and prove that only destruction shows true power. 
 
Brutal Charge: Tigrex locks onto one player and charges toward them repeatedly. The targeted player should avoid staying close to allies so they don't get hit, while others should attack Tigrex from behind. The final charge is red-glowing. It's stronger, so be careful. 
 
Earth Shaker: Tigrex leaps to the center of the arena and slams the ground several times, sending out circular shockwaves. Jump or dash to dodge the waves. The final slam is red-glowing and is more powerful. Watch out.

The soldier, who wielded a ringblade, came from an army outside Jixia. His Flow was drawn to the Calamity Star, and whenever the star struck the land, he would appear with the meteorite and attack any living creature.

Flames light up the sky, the sea boils high.
Every Jixia local grows up hearing tales of the Crimson Beast.
It is said that the monster is as towering as a mountain, and the sparks from its breath, mixed with its crimson mane, can turn midnight into day.
With every step it takes, it turns the ground beneath it into magma, and even the permafrost of the highlands boils.

To stop the excited children who are eager to try their luck, the adults always add a "however."
However, except for the time it got its head soaked by an avalanche, no one has ever gained the upper hand in a fight with it—be careful not to wet the bed from playing with fire, little one!

Stone hides the portrait, colors fade away. Springs circle the empty hall, where ages stay.
Since the day of its creation, it has fallen into a long slumber.
In the few times it has awakened,
it saw an old man with a frosty beard standing with his hands behind his back, and a young man in his prime studying diligently behind him.

Stars shift and seas change. The pillars supporting the sky collapse, and the cauldrons supporting the earth crumble.
The Bronze Halberd-Wielder remains oblivious,
sleeping in the empty room, waking from dreams amidst the rubble.
It does not know where the past bustle has gone, only remembering the mission forged into its copper body:
To guard, to guard, until the armies retreat, until the long dream is worry-free.

Heavy Spear Effigies are Mechanoid fighters forged from a mysterious metal. Larger than standard Spear Effigies, they are clad in pristine, tempered armor. Their long weapons strike with direct, powerful force, making intruders think twice. These machines once fought like an army, but some unknown event caused them to scatter across Jixia.

Tender buds fill the body, learning to walk clumsily.
When delicate vines take root in the old shell that has become nutrients, a new life begins.
Its thorn-covered body protects the fragile main bud.
The face on the mask is merely a disguise.
At this moment, it is full of longing.
It must embrace and communicate sincerely with every creature it meets for the first time.

Does their cyclical life count as a continuation of the self?
When most of what belongs to the self is replaced, can the core that guides their consciousness remember the former self?

The one who stayed behind lingers in this world, while their companion has returned to where it came. The Sentinel wanders the valley, bearing the name of a knight, yet its mount is nowhere to be seen. The oversized greatsword it carries confirms the incredible size of its former partner. Though it now relies solely on the greatsword fused to its body, even without the momentum of a charge, its heavy strikes can still cleave through mountains and rivers.\n\nDragon Knights still uphold their oath to their dragons. The genius lost to the past has returned, bringing a dazzling storm of golden starlight and deadly constellation Sorcery. 
 
Stellar Shatter: Hellbound Sentinel moves to the center and summons five celestial spheres that orbit him while he channels. Destroy all five spheres before he finishes channeling, or he will unleash a full-screen attack. 
 
Heavenly Traverse: Hellbound Sentinel summons five hidden constellation shadows and three rotating walls of starlight. Each wall has a gap you can pass through. Move through the gaps to find and destroy all five hidden shadows.

In the advanced challenge, the two Sentinels use stronger teamwork and summon phantom clones to catch you off guard. Sharp eyes are your best defense. 
 
Doomblade Sentinel splits into four phantom clones, each charging a different player. 
 
ALL four phantom clones must hit Pickaxe Sentinel's Inferno Shield to break it. Stay spread out so the clones don't cross paths.

Embermane is a battle-hardened beast that breathes fire and attacks with blade-like claws. It enjoys burning anything that enters its territory, and wherever it stands, the flames linger. 
 
Scorching Inferno: Embermane covers the area in a wave of fire, during which friendly Saepes summon stone pillars around the area one after another. 
 
Pillar Dance: You must jump onto those pillars to avoid the burning ground. Each pillar only supports weight briefly before collapsing, so you and your team need to move and time your jumps carefully. When Embermane's fire attack ends, it becomes exhausted and vulnerable—that is the best moment to deal the most damage.

The Radish King reigns supreme, a terror known far and wide. Its gleaming kitchen knife hints at danger beneath its playful demeanor, as it vows to defend the dignity of the Radishes through battle. 
 
Vine Command: Leaping to the center of the arena, the Radish King knocks back all players, then sounds its horn to ensnare three targets in twisting vines and drag them close. Anyone dragged to the Radish King faces a deadly strike. 
 
Groundbound Cutters: Meanwhile, the knife-wielding Radishes burrow along the edges, chasing unbound players. Guide these little attackers to sever the vines and free your allies before it's too late.

Bronze Constructors are Mechanoid workers who repair facilities in ruins. 
Resembling crabs, they have two pincers, walk on four legs, and have bronze shells of Aerux with glittering markings. 
They maintain large bronze facilities as well as Mechanoids. 
 
They are kept busy all day mending things. If not disturbed, they just ignore anyone who comes along.

Rebels who turned against the academy due to conflicting martial arts philosophies. They are typically burly with powerful arms. The Rebel Hunks swing their giant hammers like the wind, shaking the very earth. These strongmen pursue brute force, even resorting to training methods banned by the academy.

The town's storyteller mentions the Radish King, then suddenly slams the table and says excitedly: 'This monster looks like a giant radish at first glance. Its surface is covered in uneven textures, like cracked earth that has healed. Green leaves sway atop its head like a towering forest tree. Beneath those unique leaves are a pair of cunning, slanted eyes, flickering with mischief. Most striking of all is the kitchen knife it wields. The blade glints in the sun, clearly no ordinary weapon, and it is devastatingly powerful in use. If you encounter it, remember not to underestimate it. It is one of the finest spirit beasts transformed from a radish. It has incomprehensible behavioral logic, but it is undoubtedly a formidable opponent.'

These giant Saepes carry shields as hard as boulders. 
The shields have been enhanced with special methods, making them impervious to ordinary attacks. 
 
In some folk paintings, giant figures are depicted wielding similar shields.

Taking the hero's lost shield, the Emperor of Constructs was forged. Ice and rock fell upon the cliff, leaving no retreat for friend or foe. As the setting sun cast its final glow, reinforcements appeared in the elongated shadows.

A Mechcraft warrior wielding a blade of fire. Beneath the crimson armor, a fiery core burns ceaselessly. The Ten-Thousand-Forge Blade is highly skilled in close-quarters combat, striking with the weight of a mountain. The intense heat of its massive fire blade is enough to melt metal. Few creatures dare to provoke the Blazing Blade Warrior. Every swing is accompanied by scalding steam and churning magma. Combat is no longer its mission, but its fated destiny.

Priests of the Saepes tribe.
They are vines formed from the extension of the tribe's will, capable of using the power of their ancestors to defend against invading enemies.
The scepter they hold is forked and twisted at the top, wreathed in whispers that only they can understand.

Saepes Summoners guide the migration of the Saepes tribe, always finding environments suitable for the growth of Saepes trees.
Researchers believe that the unique connection between the Summoner and the Saepes tree is the key to their tribe's survival and prosperity.

Doomblade Sentinel fights with fiery aggression. Pickaxe Sentinel stands firm and unbreakable like a mountain. They arrive with the Calamity Star to carry out the Sanctified's orders. 
 
Pickaxe Sentinel activates an Inferno Shield while charging up a full-screen attack. The shield protects him during the charge. 
 
Doomblade Sentinel repeatedly charges toward players. 
 
Have Doomblade strike the Inferno Shield three times. After the third hit, the shield breaks, and Pickaxe Sentinel's attack is interrupted.

In the advanced challenge, Megadrive Hammer's Mech Core goes into overdrive. It teleports and attacks from multiple sites. 
 
Triple Shock: Megadrive Hammer fires three full-screen shockwaves in a row. Before each shockwave, it teleports to the edge of the arena, so each wave comes from a different direction. 
 
Shield Relay: After a player uses the Shield to block a shockwave, that player cannot use the Shield again for a short time. Another teammate must pick up and use the Shield to block the next shockwave coming from a different direction.

Doomblade Sentinel repeatedly charges toward players. 
 
Have Doomblade strike the Inferno Shield three times. After the third hit, the shield breaks, and Pickaxe Sentinel's attack is interrupted.

A cold-hearted hunter of the Dreamscape.
Ethereal in form, with magnificent wings and a tail that fans out at the tip.
Armed with a long-handled feather fan, it excels at casting homing magic projectiles and can draw energy from void rifts to unleash wide-sweeping beams.

Legend says these fan-wielding Botu were once scholars obsessed with the arcane. In their pursuit of the ultimate truth, they peered into the Dreamscape and lost their way. In this Dream of Lanke, the illusions they summon are nothing more than fleeting phantoms.

It rolls like red clouds, never stopping.
The struggle between the lizard kings was once endless, until the person riding the strange mount appeared.

The leader of the Embermanes has fiery hair and blade-like claws. The flames are fierce, but its hair never burns.
Having fought its way to kingship, it leads the pack.
The flames it breathes scorch its throat, making it even more excited.
The burning prey is a playful toy. It is the one in control, while the challenger is only fit to defend.
The Embermane once challenged others, but now, it has become the king.
At this moment, the red shadow standing among the beasts will shock all living things.

With its arrival, the fire ignites.
With its departure, the fire will eventually extinguish.

Bronze Turrets are defensive Mechanoids found in the ruins. 
Their four legs are bunched together, charging for a powerful blast with their two cannons. 
A single blast is enough to shatter any armor. The only way around them is to avoid them. 
 
For some reason, they have been restless, a sign that this place has never been forgotten.

The strongman often wanders outside Jixia Academy, gazing at the scholarly atmosphere within. His companions call him "Skyfire Morningstar" because his flaming heavy hammer can easily crush stone into magma. He never mentions that he left scorch marks from his hammer when he betrayed his sect. He viewed his master's self-restraint as cowardice, believing only the heat of his flames could represent his sense of justice.\n\nHowever, after being looked up to as a leader by this group of rebels, he has begun to realize the truth. The process of enlightenment is not as simple as martial arts, and he is not yet ready to apologize to his master.

Stonepines tower above, lush and green, as if standing amidst the clouds.
Treasure hunters and adventurers visiting the Ghostpath City know to steer clear of a certain dark patch of land, even though the soil looks no different from anywhere else, and even supports a dense grove of trees.
But they know those aren't trees—they are a single, colossal trunk, reaching high into the clouds.

Once, the Earth-Shaking Wildwood was just a young Saepes. Time gave it a gargantuan body, but eroded its clarity of mind.
After being abandoned in this cage, it always tries to hold onto everyone who passes by, but people only scream and flee.
It doesn't understand, so with each subsequent attempt, it becomes more forceful and frantic, pushing the very objects of its affection further away.

Lost in the Jixia ruins, they possess a crab-like pincer and a flamethrower that glows with heat. 
They perform maintenance within the ruins and use their flamethrowers to clear obstacles as needed. 
 
A novice Crafter curiously asks, "Would the flamethrower melt its pincer?"

Bronze Turrets are defensive Mechanoids found in the ruins. 
Their four legs are bunched together, charging for a powerful blast with their two cannons. 
A single blast is enough to shatter any armor. The only way around them is to avoid them. 
 
For some reason, they have been restless, a sign that this place has never been forgotten.

The Radish King is formidable enough, but its cunning tricks are the real headache. Watch out for explosive radishes hidden underground—triggering them will lead to a disaster. 
 
Explosive Ambush: As it leaps to the arena center, the Radish King plants multiple explosive traps. Any player dragged through a trap triggers a blast, leaving scorched terrain that continues to burn. 
 
Save from The Brink: Those knife-wielding Radishes now strike faster than ever. You and your team must carefully navigate traps and fire zones while guiding the Little Radishes to sever the vines. Any misstep can cause casualties.

Backed into a corner, the Saepes King frantically siphons power from its subjects. Its body becomes indestructible, surging with mountain-shattering rage. 
 
Ancient Bulwark: Its thorn armor is heavily fortified, requiring extra effort to break through. 
 
Rage Drain: While in its giant form, the Saepes King's Attack escalates rapidly. You and your team must intercept and attack more efficiently to strive for survival.

Tender buds fill the body, learning to walk clumsily.
When delicate vines take root in the old shell that has become nutrients, a new life begins.
Its thorn-covered body protects the fragile main bud.
The face on the mask is merely a disguise.
At this moment, it is full of longing.
It must embrace and communicate sincerely with every creature it meets for the first time.

Does their cyclical life count as a continuation of the self?
When most of what belongs to the self is replaced, can the core that guides their consciousness remember the former self?

Fighters of the Saepes tribe.
The spear tip in their hands resembles a vibrant bud ready to bloom.
Do not be deceived by its colorful appearance and overlook its terrifying piercing power.

Although Saepes weapons are very crude, they cherish them greatly and often use stone tools to polish and maintain them.

The guardian stood firm, a single man holding the pass against a thousand. Giant shields blocked the enemy; though exhausted, it stood like a mountain. Taking the hero's lost shield, the Emperor of Constructs was forged. Ice and rock fell upon the cliff, leaving no retreat for friend or foe. An unyielding belief was embedded in the core, making its defensive techniques unbreakable. Vile iron cavalry flooded the pass, and the defenders turned their backs on their homeland. As the setting sun cast its final glow, reinforcements appeared in the elongated shadows.

The spear tip in their hands resembles a vibrant bud ready to bloom.
Do not be deceived by its colorful appearance and overlook its terrifying piercing power.

Although Saepes weapons are very crude, they cherish them greatly and often use stone tools to polish and maintain them.

The soldier, who wielded a greatsword, came from an army outside Jixia. His Flow was drawn to the Calamity Star, and whenever the star struck the land, he would appear with the meteorite and attack any living creature.

The genius lost to the past has returned, bringing a dazzling storm of golden starlight and deadly constellation Sorcery. 
 
Stellar Shatter: Hellbound Sentinel moves to the center and summons five celestial spheres that orbit him while he channels. Destroy all five spheres before he finishes channeling, or he will unleash a full-screen attack. 
 
Heavenly Traverse: Hellbound Sentinel summons five hidden constellation shadows and three rotating walls of starlight. Each wall has a gap you can pass through. Move through the gaps to find and destroy all five hidden shadows.

Rebels who turned against the academy due to conflicting martial arts philosophies. They are typically burly with powerful arms. The Rebel Hunks swing their giant hammers like the wind, shaking the very earth. These strongmen pursue brute force, even resorting to training methods banned by the academy.

Bronze Constructors are Mechanoid workers who repair facilities in ruins. 
Resembling crabs, they have two pincers, walk on four legs, and have bronze shells of Aerux with glittering markings. 
They maintain large bronze facilities as well as Mechanoids. 
 
They are kept busy all day mending things. If not disturbed, they just ignore anyone who comes along.

Fighters of the Saepes tribe.
Their most distinct feature is that oversized spiked club.
Anyone struck by it, even if not severely injured by the force, will suffer greatly from the barbs on the club.

However, in the face of their natural predator, the Embermane, these crude Saepes weapons are like mere firewood, so the Saepes are rarely found where the Embermane appears.

Tigrex, a fierce Rebel leader in the mountain forests, now bursts into the Three-School Showdown. With iron claws and relentless force, he wants to dominate the competition and prove that only destruction shows true power. 
 
Brutal Charge: Tigrex locks onto one player and charges toward them repeatedly. The targeted player should avoid staying close to allies so they don't get hit, while others should attack Tigrex from behind. The final charge is red-glowing. It's stronger, so be careful. 
 
Earth Shaker: Tigrex leaps to the center of the arena and slams the ground several times, sending out circular shockwaves. Jump or dash to dodge the waves. The final slam is red-glowing and is more powerful. Watch out.

The Frostmane Spike Bear dominates the Aerux peak. Its mane has turned to crystal. It is powerful, lonely, and restless, smashing rocks and trees in its wake. Once a target of bounties, it is now a warning to stay away. The town lies in ruins, leaving only decayed wood and scattered fragments.

Humanoid combat constructs created by the academy. They usually stand behind the Nimble Vanguards, using staves to fire projectiles from a distance. They are programmed to only attack students attempting the canyon trial. Once their core is damaged, they will move erratically or spin in place.

Megadrive Hammer is the School of Mechcraft's ultimate creation. Built from rare materials, it channels all its power into a single strike. Its simple design shows only enormous force—each hit can shake mountains. \n \nHammer Shockwave: After charging, Megadrive Hammer sends out a full-screen shockwave. One player must quickly pick up the Shield from the ground and face the wave to block it. Other players should stay close behind the Shield-bearer to stay safe. The shockwave strikes twice in quick succession, so be ready to move.

Fighters of the Saepes tribe.
Their most distinct feature is that oversized spiked club.
Anyone struck by it, even if not severely injured by the force, will suffer greatly from the barbs on the club.

However, in the face of their natural predator, the Embermane, these crude Saepes weapons are like mere firewood, so the Saepes are rarely found where the Embermane appears.

The gluttonous Armadillo Rat King has called in backup to steal your supplies, a Sly Rat! It strikes fast. One mistake, and you're down! \n \nIn addition to the standard mechanics, a Sly Rat now charges along a fixed path repeatedly. If it collides with a nut-bearer, the nut will drop. One of you must focus on intercepting it while others clear the smaller rolling Armored Rats, or your formation will fall apart fast.

Saepes King rules with absolute authority. It uses its scepter to overpower anyone who opposes it. 
 
Vinebind Assault: Thick vines trap all players while Saepes charge in with spears. Break free quickly to avoid the incoming strikes. 
 
Soul Siphon: Saepes King drains life from nearby Saepes, growing huge and wrapping himself in thorn armor that blocks damage. Saepes Catapultors spawn and fling fireballs—grab those fireballs and throw them at Saepes King to shatter his armor. Otherwise, his size and power will keep increasing and threaten to crush the whole area.

The process of enlightenment is not as simple as martial arts, and he is not yet ready to apologize to his master.

Razor Aeroclads are melee Mechanoids crafted by the academy using Aerux. Their bark-like bodies are clad in Aerux armor etched with curved patterns. Wielding a single wooden blade, every movement from drawing to sheathing is clearly visible.\n\nThe Aeroclad series consists of basic Mechanoids created by the Mechanist Academy using Aerux as the primary material, reinforced with metal.

The guardian stood firm, a single man holding the pass against a thousand. Giant shields blocked the enemy; though exhausted, it stood like a mountain. Taking the hero's lost shield, the Emperor of Constructs was forged. Ice and rock fell upon the cliff, leaving no retreat for friend or foe. An unyielding belief was embedded in the core, making its defensive techniques unbreakable. Vile iron cavalry flooded the pass, and the defenders turned their backs on their homeland. As the setting sun cast its final glow, reinforcements appeared in the elongated shadows.

The two Sentinels act as one, dominating the battlefield through perfect teamwork. Even a small mistake can lead to disaster. \n \nTo break Pickaxe Sentinel's Inferno Shield, ALL four phantom clones of Doomblade Sentinel must strike it. This tests your team's coordination.

Sentry Flamequenchers are modified combat constructs created by the academy. Their perfect geometric design of spheres and cylinders is a masterpiece of the master artificers. These constructs possess immense attack power and the ability to manipulate fire, easily crushing ordinary soldiers.\n\nSentry Mechanoids typically join the battlefield after key structures are destroyed, helping to accelerate the advance.

Rebels who turned against the academy due to conflicting martial arts philosophies. They are cunning and agile. Carrying daggers, they strike silently and quickly, seemingly possessing a special ability to mask their own sounds. Rebel Shadowblades excel at ambushing enemies from the shadows, and rumors about them frighten timid students from walking alone at night.

Though the Saepes lives long, an end to its life will still come along.
The aged Giant Saepes drags its withered, wooden body, wandering the wilderness.
Its gnarled, mottled branches have witnessed the passage of time, and the rings on its cross-section are beyond counting.
Even so, it remains furious.
As if it wants to leave proof that it lived before turning into rotting wood.

What exactly is a Saepes? Where do their thoughts come from?
These questions no longer matter to it. While Cloudsilk elevated its life, it did not change its fate as a biological entity.

Rebels who turned against the academy due to conflicting sorcery philosophies. They use arm guards to carry more telepathic threads to mitigate energy fluctuations. Unable to cast spells for long, they rely on burst spells, aiming to freeze enemies in an instant. Already in a state of overloaded energy sensing, the low temperatures only deepen their drowsiness.

The enraged Hellbound Sentinel channels a chaotic astral flow. His precise Sorcery attacks are lethal—one mistake can kill you. 
 
Star Ring Detonation: Hellbound Sentinel moves to the center, summons five celestial spheres that orbit him while he channels, and creates three expanding circular damage zones. Avoid those zones and destroy all five spheres before he finishes channeling. 
 
Shattered Star Pursuit: The rotating walls speed up, and Hellbound Sentinel summons three extra energy orbs for each player that relentlessly track you. Dodge the orbs, move through the gaps in the walls, and destroy all five hidden constellation shadows.

The guerrilla hid at the border, flashing ninety-nine times to annihilate two hundred enemies. Exhausted, he died, but his soul remains, forever etched in martial arts. Taking the hero's discarded cannon, they forged the King of Mechanoids. Lightning and long songs intersect; ice shards and gunfire weave together. The stored, bizarre tactics have merged with the machine, making its long-range skills divine.\n\nAn undefeated army enters the swamp; their defeat is already sealed. They have been surrounded—by one person.

The process of enlightenment is not as simple as martial arts, and he is not yet ready to apologize to his master.

They are tasked with guarding Jixia's ruins. 
Adorned with glowing patterns etched into their bronze bodies, they wield ancient pikes with deadly precision, delivering swift and lethal strikes. 
 
Rebels or curious students alike who venture into the ruins are met with their cold steel.

Doomblade Sentinel fights with fiery aggression. Pickaxe Sentinel stands firm and unbreakable like a mountain. They arrive with the Calamity Star to carry out the Sanctified's orders. 
 
Pickaxe Sentinel activates an Inferno Shield while charging up a full-screen attack. The shield protects him during the charge. 
 
Doomblade Sentinel repeatedly charges toward players. 
 
Have Doomblade strike the Inferno Shield three times. After the third hit, the shield breaks, and Pickaxe Sentinel's attack is interrupted.

Pushed to the brink, the Radish King unleashes its primal fury, encasing itself in an unyielding fortress of twisting thorns. To shatter this impenetrable shell, you must turn its own kin against it—the Radish Bursters. 
 
Thorned Aegis: While dragging your allies, the Radish King generates a tough thorn armor. The knife-wielding Radishes can sever the vines, but the armor remains impervious. 
 
Scorched Assault: Rescued players must guide dormant Radish Bursters to strike the Radish King or lure it onto scorched zones left before. Only sustained burning can gradually wear down its armour, otherwise the armour will persist.

Combat Mechanoids crafted from mysterious, exceptionally sturdy metal. Their crimson armor is striking and imposing. They dance with sharp greatblades, their attacks as swift and fierce as a rainstorm. They are often covered in blade marks, yet these only scratch the surface, showing that the metal of their bodies has been tempered countless times. However, craftsmen have found their remains in certain places—what kind of monster could have torn them apart?

Pickaxe Sentinel activates an Inferno Shield while charging up a full-screen attack. The shield protects him during the charge. 
 
Doomblade Sentinel repeatedly charges toward players. 
 
Have Doomblade strike the Inferno Shield three times. After the third hit, the shield breaks, and Pickaxe Sentinel's attack is interrupted.

Megadrive Hammer has gone berserk. It summons Mechanoids and now aims for pure destruction. 
 
Triple Shock: Megadrive Hammer fires three full-screen shockwaves in a row. Before each shockwave, it teleports to the edge of the arena, so each wave comes from a different direction. 
 
Mechcraft Reinforcements: Megadrive Hammer summons two Mechanoids before the shockwaves. One will grab the Shield in the arena. Defeat the Mechanoids and reclaim the Shield so it can protect you from the upcoming shockwaves.

Superior Glintspear Effigies are Mechanoid fighters forged from a mysterious metal. Their gleaming red armor commands respect. Driven by internal power, their strikes are precise and lethal, piercing through enemies like a tiger entering its den. Their comrades have long since passed, yet their unfinished mission keeps them standing guard.

Fighters of the Saepes tribe.
Clad in leaves, with twisted vines wrapped around a crude blowpipe.
Saepes Scouts excel at ambushing enemies from the shadows with blowdarts; the poisoned projectiles leave enemies in constant misery.

According to research, the toxins in Saepes blowdarts come from a variety of sources, including but not limited to: Poison Bubble Buds, Leaf-tailed Lizards, Jade Tear Fruits...

Embermane no longer holds back. Its massive, kingly flames erupt across the battlefield, leaving almost no safe space. 
 
Infernal Ground: Fire on the ground deals extreme damage. Even a brief touch can be fatal. 
 
Pillar of Desperation: Fewer stone pillars rise, and they collapse faster than ever. You must make precise, split-second moves to survive.

Tigrex is a fierce Rebel leader from the mountain forests. After losing the first battle, he stole an experimental Shield from the School of Mechcraft. Now he blends raw rage with Mechcraft power and aims to crush any challenger. 
 
Mechanized Shield Charge: Tigrex charges forward with the Shield. You must destroy that Shield, or Tigrex will unleash a final red-glowing charge that cannot be dodged and deals massive damage. 
 
Earth Shatter: Right after the charge, Tigrex jumps and slams the ground repeatedly, creating full-screen shockwaves. The shockwaves cannot be dodged by jumping or dashing. Only the Shield on the field can block it.

Mushrooms mutated by the influence of the Aercocoon. They have eye-catching purple caps resembling open umbrellas. The Umbrella Spore-shroom releases spores as a defensive mechanism.\n\nThose who wield blades and spears keep their distance from these mushrooms. It's not that they are invincible, but their numbing spores are incredibly annoying.

Beast eyes glare with malice, iron claws strike hard. Its spine is like rock, its stride like a gale. Beneath its fur, a violent heart beats. Its hammer strikes like thunder across the plains. Plunder and conquest are its only understanding of martial arts. This tiger-kin bandit leader awaits the mercy of the legendary hammer-wielder. 'Quiet in the woods yesterday, fierce down the mountain today.'

The enraged Embermane sends out waves of fire that put your team's coordination to the test. 
 
Synchronized Flames: All stone pillars rise at the same time, but each one stays up for much less time than usual. 
 
Dance of Survival: Plan your moves so everyone uses each pillar efficiently. Any hesitation or delay by a team member can lead to casualties.

The process of enlightenment is not as simple as martial arts, and he is not yet ready to apologize to his master.

A variant of Bronze Sunderers, Bronze Thunder Sunderers wield the power of thunder. 
Lurking in the shadows, they self-destruct the moment they are disturbed. 
Their cores crackle with lightning, flashing ominously just seconds before the blast. 
 
No one remains composed under their thunderous assault.

Giant underground Palisaepes. Their massive, imposing frames and terrifying visages mean few creatures dare to oppose them. The Palisaepes Colossus possesses destructive power, though its size makes it clumsy. Small Palisaepes like to gather around the giant ones; this worship and following of the strong stems from their instinct for self-preservation. Some lucky ones will grow strong under this protection, becoming the next towering tree to shelter the land.

Taking the hero's lost shield, the Emperor of Constructs was forged. Ice and rock fell upon the cliff, leaving no retreat for friend or foe. An unyielding belief was embedded in the core, making its defensive techniques unbreakable. Vile iron cavalry flooded the pass, and the defenders turned their backs on their homeland. As the setting sun cast its final glow, reinforcements appeared in the elongated shadows.

In the advanced challenge, the two Sentinels use stronger teamwork and summon phantom clones to catch you off guard. Sharp eyes are your best defense. 
 
Doomblade Sentinel splits into four phantom clones, each charging a different player. 
 
ALL four phantom clones must hit Pickaxe Sentinel's Inferno Shield to break it. Stay spread out so the clones don't cross paths.

Embermane is a battle-hardened beast that breathes fire and attacks with blade-like claws. It enjoys burning anything that enters its territory, and wherever it stands, the flames linger. 
 
Scorching Inferno: Embermane covers the area in a wave of fire, during which friendly Saepes summon stone pillars around the area one after another. 
 
Pillar Dance: You must jump onto those pillars to avoid the burning ground. Each pillar only supports weight briefly before collapsing, so you and your team need to move and time your jumps carefully. When Embermane's fire attack ends, it becomes exhausted and vulnerable—that is the best moment to deal the most damage.

Linked telepathically to the Saepes King, the minions enter a frenzy, ready to die for their liege. They carry deadly traps, forcing players to act quickly and with precision. 
 
Explosive Traps: When enlarged, self-destructing Saepes appear beneath each player. Move away immediately to avoid instant damage. 
 
Blazing Shield: Fireballs from Catapultors explode shortly after landing. Pick them up and chuck them at the Saepes King before they blow, or you'll miss the chance to break its parts.

Beast eyes glare with malice, iron claws strike hard. Its spine is like rock, its stride like a gale. Beneath its fur, a violent heart beats. Its hammer strikes like thunder across the plains. Plunder and conquest are its only understanding of martial arts. This tiger-kin bandit leader awaits the mercy of the legendary hammer-wielder. 'Quiet in the woods yesterday, fierce down the mountain today.'

The Armadillo Rat King has long thrived on Aerflow, developing a thick hide and a massive frame. During the Festive Fire Opera, it sneaks into the granaries to raid the crops. 
 
Nut Lure: The King summons several little Armored Rats to wreak havoc, one of which carries a special nut. When the nut-bearer is defeated, the nut remains on the field. The Rat King then drags all players closer, ensnaring two with vines. Entangled players will be silenced, and straying too far will snap them back.  
 
Unbound allies must pick up the nut to bait the King's charge, while the entwined pair must pull their vines in opposite directions to trip the charging King. Timing and coordination are key—fail, and the colossal rat keeps rampaging.

Heavy Spear Effigies are Mechanoid fighters forged from a mysterious metal. Larger than standard Spear Effigies, they are clad in pristine, tempered armor. Their long weapons strike with direct, powerful force, making intruders think twice. These machines once fought like an army, but some unknown event caused them to scatter across Jixia.

In the north of Jixia, there is a giant beast with four legs that likes to hide in lightning and often fights with fire to the death.
When the fire dies, the thunderclouds rise.
The lightning-wielding giant lizard is the mortal enemy of the wildfire giant lizard.
Its massive body, shimmering with faint light, is often hidden within lightning.
It grants its victims a painless death the moment it appears.
It is the darling of lightning and the apex predator of the wilderness.

It rests like a crag, immovable.
Only when the enemy's fire begins to spread will it lift its noble head and let out a roar that shakes the earth.
Don't let its arrogant appearance fool you; it's actually quite timid and has made quite a fool of itself due to its own clumsiness.

Dwelling in ruins, they are responsible for storing information. 
Covered in patches of rust, they have lost their metallic sheen. 
Furnished with ancient and mysterious cerulean-colored patterns, they move at incredible speeds despite lacking attack abilities. 
 
While their civilization has long withered away, they seem to be waiting for their masters to return and guarding something unknown.

The chieftain of the Jiyu tribe, both brave and upright. It is particularly fond of travelers who come to visit. It has a special love for rainy days, yet it is always cautious and avoids conflict, unwilling to harm any living creature.\n\nLegend has it that its belly holds all the strange tales and anecdotes of Jixia's waters, making it the tribe's famous "storyteller." If you bring its favorite fresh fish, you might just be able to trade for a fascinating legend.

A nimble, short-furred creature known as the Ritual Fish.
They prefer to live in hidden burrows near the waters of Jixia, with round eyes as bright and clear as gemstones.
Because of their elusive nature, their habit of peeking around was once mistaken for a water monkey.

If you are lucky, you might see them neatly arranging fish on the shore, as if performing a ritual, hence the name.
Feeding them fresh fish or simply saying hello might bring a bit of good luck to anglers.
This trait has attracted the attention of hunters and anglers alike.
A crab-shaped bronze mechanism that looks cute and interesting. After helping it complete its search mission, it will follow you around.
Though small in appearance, it seems to have a wealth of work experience. Years of labor have left it exhausted, and the bird carries a faint air of weariness.
Became the exclusive pet of the strong. Motto: "Trophies should always be with the best."

A noble and elegant bird with a slender build. The blue-purple icy feathers on its eyelashes resemble the dark, distant mountains, giving it an air of unreachability.\n\nUnlike the Cloud-Unseen, the Distant-Mountain-Dark does not like to be close to humans. When it encounters visitors, it flies away after a brief glance, as if expressing its dissatisfaction at being disturbed. They are often used as a metaphor for those who are highly focused.

A dark, eerie figure, an incarnate nightmare.
The tall, slender Dreamslayer lurks in the shadows and dreams, waiting for the perfect moment to strike.
The shadows beneath its purple feathers are the prey's final memory, and the moon-blade it wields is the pride of a lone hunter.
The Moon-blade Dreamslayer is born from dreams, one with everything around it.
It moves through the air with ease, its gorgeous slashes like phantoms.

It tears through dream after dream, traversing fantasy after fantasy.
Its dark footsteps are merely the prelude to the hunt; the dreams of the mediocre are the food it survives on.

This place was ruined by excessive flooding. The craftsmen worked around the clock to come up with a solution. 
 
Station Ruins Sentry, shaped like a bastion, hides the secrets of the past. 
 
Its large, many-jointed legs give it remarkable flexibility. 
 
With strong defenses and powerful attacks, it is built for simple, brutal tactics that crush invaders. 
 
Station Ruins Sentry was created to move stones and hold back the sea, leaving behind a vast underground world of winding rivers and strange creatures.

For the ideal I hold dear, I'd die a thousand times without regret. 
 
 
 
Between the thin divide of life and death, a figure lingers between two realms. Life was traded for honor, forsaking the mortal form to bring an end to strife, but the power from the imprint was too much to handle. But even in rust, the glory remains eternal. 
 
 
 
Like Volcanic Stone leaping into the fire, brilliance fades into silence. The dust of time forms a mountain of fate that weighs on all. Beneath the lofty mountain, the foolish stand proud and unyielding. They rise above the choice of life or death, heading towards an uncertain future.

Palisaepes Shamans are from the fertile land. 
Holding tightly onto a flowering staff, they use their unique power to enhance allies and weaken enemies. 
 
Records indicate that they mimic human ceremonies and ritualistic behaviors.

A giant beast in the north, with four legs. It hides among thunder and often fights to the death with fire. 
 
When the flames are extinguished, storm clouds rise. 
 
This thunder manipulator is a mortal enemy of the Wreckflame Lizard. Discreet flashes of light surround its large body, hidden within the thunder and lightning. 
 
It deals a painless, instantaneous death to its victims. 
 
Beloved by thunder and lightning, it reigns supreme. 
 
Steady as a stone, it is not easily moved from its perch. Only when the flames of its nemesis begin burning will it raise its head and roar.

Dark wings cry low, disaster looms; shadows sweep through gold and silver light.

Black feathers drift down, and calamity follows. This is the first impression people have of Litian: ominous, dangerous... Pair after pair of uneasy eyes watch him, but Litian never cares.
To Litian, only two things matter: first, flashy moves; second, shiny Ringild. Everything else is trivial and unworthy of mention.

Time long past is buried beneath the yellow sand. Now, Litian works as a treasure hunter, his mission to acquire more Ringild.
Wherever there are Ringild or treasures, Litian will find his way there.
And for the right price, his martial arts and the hook-swords in his hands can be yours to command.

Those who cross the Great Wall shall not return alive.
This stumbling, lost soul was once a vanguard of the Great Wall Garrison.
He once sparred with Kai and shared wine with Hua Mulan.
Until that battle, to protect Mulan, he was infected by the power of monsters.
He once wanted to end his own life, but was stopped by his mother.

Unable to suppress the demonic influence, he locked himself in a cell.
Only by picking up the carving knife in his hand could he soothe his manic bloodlust.
Not just because of those stone statues, but because of the past he could never forget.

Standing on four legs, it often hides in the blazing flames. When it encounters thunder, it fights incessantly. 
 
When the clouds fall, flaming columns reach the sky as this giant flame-breathing lizard razes any land it treads upon to ash. The destruction it causes is difficult to repair, as no greenery can survive its flames. 
 
Many have attempted to vanquish this pestilence, but few have succeeded. Even if they manage to harm it, their actions only further enrage it. 
 
The source of its irritable nature lies in the storm clouds that gather in the skies. 
 
Yearning for a clear crimson dusk, it stops at nothing to achieve it. The battles between these lizard kings appear endless until a person riding a strange steed enters the scene.

The Snow-Velvet Fox is a gem-like blue all over, except for its face and chest, where the fur is as white as snow, making it as elegant and noble as a spirit of the frozen world. They are exceptionally agile and flee quickly if anyone approaches, making them difficult to get close to.\n\nAccording to hunter records, the Snow-Velvet Fox seems to be able to sense when a blizzard is ending. During storms, they blend into the snow, leaving only two lines of fine footprints. These tracks have saved countless creatures lost in the blizzard.

The three Ice Tiles are lined up in a row, and raised to invite the thunder's descent. 
 
The bitter cold wind is pushing the limit. Anyone facing them would feel great fear at their impending mortality. 
 
When cold air gathers in the core, the frosted ice is immediately called out, 
conveying the nature of the game. 
 
Luck is like the wind, fleeting in an instant. Victory and defeat are decided in a moment of laughter, the outcome of the game and the path of life, all come down to choices.

The dragon that lurks below, yet untouched by festive clouds, finds companionship not in the skies but amongst the fish and turtles below. 
Submerged at the lake's bottom, the Mechanoid never frets over the careless disturbances of the fish and shrimp below.  
Sunlight dapples the lake surface, crinkling into shattered gold, decorating the vista between colorful clouds and clear waters. 
It silently peers through the glistening waves, observing the people on the shore, golden in their comings and goings. 
Like an aged elder or a dedicated mentor, it serves with deep respect. 
 
It knows, though long accompanied by algae and debris,  
under the protective care of a fatherly figure, not a single crevice in its joints has been tainted by mud. 
It waits in the waters, ready to sternly rebuke the arrogant and foolish, 
and also to assist those promising talents, like koi leaping through the dragon gate, to achieve their potential.

The two birds have parted. The defector has returned to the homeland. 
 
With the breaking of the dawn, a Red Falcon flew from across the sea to Jixia, illuminated in the sun's glow. 
 
It is the apex hunter of winged creatures, and each time it dives at its prey, it resembles a ball of divine flame falling from the sky. 
 
Its choice of prey goes far beyond filling its belly. Only the strong are selected. 
 
Hunting is a life-or-death ceremony, only the survivor can enjoy a moment of peace. 
 
No one knows what it is looking for on this land. In fact, it is not looking for anything. This continent is just a branch for it to rest.

A dark, eerie figure, an incarnate nightmare.
The tall, slender Dreamslayer lurks in the shadows and dreams, waiting for the perfect moment to strike.
The shadows beneath its purple feathers are the prey's final memory, and the moon-blade it wields is the pride of a lone hunter.
The Moon-blade Dreamslayer is born from dreams, one with everything around it.
It moves through the air with ease, its gorgeous slashes like phantoms.

It tears through dream after dream, traversing fantasy after fantasy.
Its dark footsteps are merely the prelude to the hunt; the dreams of the mediocre are the food it survives on.

The members of the Meow Gang can't help but sigh when mentioning their former leader.
She was just a lowly student, yet she fought tooth and nail to join the Great Wall Garrison.
Perhaps it was to take care of the mother who adopted her.
Perhaps it was to not let the martial arts passed down by her brother go to waste.
In any case, this arrogant "Boss Meow" resolutely chose a new way of life.

No one knows what she was thinking when she learned of her brother's fate...
She just repeated those moves over and over, even though she already knew them by heart.
Afterward, she continued to run the post house, warmly welcoming travelers.
But some noticed that the token hanging from her waist bore the mark of the Garrison.

A giant ox wandering the wilderness.
Its red and white mane is like a mix of fire and snowflakes.
Its physique is exceptionally robust, with muscle lines that look carved from stone, every inch filled with power and wildness.
Its massive red horns are like two scorching flames, sharp and fierce, seemingly capable of easily piercing any obstacle at any time.

As everyone can see, it is a species that is naturally not to be trifled with.
Once anyone or anything provokes it, it will attack without hesitation, and that violent power is enough to make any opponent shudder.
Its arrogant horns and striking mane are constantly telling explorers—it is no ordinary creature.

The twin birds have parted, and the broken-hearted have fallen to the mountain peak. 
Carrying a torrential storm, the proud blue falcon descends upon the wasteland from the side of the peak. 
Flapping its wings, it brings the thunder of the clouds. 
Its shimmering eyes gaze upon the most valuable things in the world. 
Its fickle rage obliterates all the rocks that stand in its way. 
Its beauty and reclusive nature are equally famous. 
Beyond venting its emotions, it rarely interacts with any living creature. 
This is the most widely circulated story of the Sky-Thunder Falcon in the mountain city. 
 
Making assumptions about legendary creatures is a common flaw of storytellers. 
It is actually not very aggressive; most of the time, the Sky-Thunder Falcon just wants to enjoy the breeze on a cool night.

This strongman always gazes upon Jixia Academy from a distance. 
 
With his devastating hammer, he can easily shatter boulders into dust. Yet, he never speaks of the flaming hammer prints he left behind when he abandoned his mentor. 
 
Viewing his mentor's self-restraint as weakness, he believed that only the heat of flames could manifest true righteousness. 
 
Now appointed as the leader of the youthful Rebels, he has slowly begun to understand his mentor's wisdom. However, this learning curve is as challenging as mastering Martial Arts, and he is not yet ready to offer an apology.

A panda demonkin who drifted into the Colorful Cloud Basin. 
He came to the academy with dreams of proving himself, only to be turned away for his uneven academic performance. 
But an old man once told him: "Among any three people, there must be one who can be my teacher." 
He took these words to heart, and seeking advice from students became his form of cultivation. 
 
Since then, a strange "Green Bamboo Hero" has appeared in the Colorful Cloud Basin. 
Rumor has it among the students that there is a formidable eccentric who challenges everyone he meets to a fight. 
Strangely, he shouts out move names from storybooks as he fights. 
And when he leaves after a fight, the nearby food often disappears with him. 
More than his martial arts, it is this appetite that people find most concerning.

A cautious and timid deer species, mostly living in mountainous areas.
Compared to other deer, the antlers of the male Pillow-Wind Deer are more fragile.
Explorers believe they are often threatened by Embermane, and their large antlers are useless against it, actually hindering their escape speed.
Once a predator grabs a Pillow-Wind Deer's antlers, they will break them off without hesitation to escape.

Antlers are seen as a symbol of dignity and strength.
But compared to life, these are worth nothing.

The Bone-Leaf Fox in the dreamscape glows with a deep blue light. It has willow-leaf-shaped silver patterns on its back and unique indigo eyes.
Influenced by the dream, these creatures have become more mysterious and agile, making it extremely difficult to see them clearly.

Few who have seen a Bone-Leaf Fox say they possess a pair of soulful eyes.
Because of this, in storytellers' tales, the Bone-Leaf Fox often appears in sorrowful and sentimental stories.

Deer are widely distributed throughout Jixia, known for their light and elegant posture. 
Female Dust Deer are smaller, with snow-white necks and thick white fluff on their chests. 
They live in mixed-gender groups with clear divisions of labor. 
 
The fur on their backs is light brown, helping them blend into their environment, which is how they got the name "Dust Deer." 
They are often found in lush, scenic areas with abundant vegetation. 
Because of this, they are often seen in legends as a sign of harvest and good fortune.

A rabbit with fur as translucent as jade.
In the dark, people often mistake it for a large gemstone, so when it moves, it often startles students entering the dream.
Dream Rabbits often appear in dreams; they are friendly and rumored to help humans, though they occasionally play tricks on the greedy.

Legend has it that some have seen them gather together, their light illuminating the entire sky.
However, to this day, this remains just a legend.

Its beastly eyes flare with savage light, sinews like bronze, claws like iron. Its spine stands firm as bedrock, its strides fierce as a gale. Beneath its vivid pelts, a savage heart pounds madly.  
 
When its colossal hammer falls, the sound is like thunder ravaging the earth, echoing across the wilds. 
 
To this brute, martial strength is nothing more than plunder and conquest. It gathers Rebels in the mountains, raising its banner as self-proclaimed ruler of the wilds. 
 
Despite having risen as the Rebels' leader, Tigrex still yearns for the attention of the legendary hammer-wielding hero. 
 
"At dusk it crept into the tranquil woods; at dawn it charged down the steep mountain."

It reigns atop the Aerux, leaving no space for anything else to endure. 
 
Its mane has crystallised into glittering shards, while its vast shadow stretches across the mountains at dusk. 
 
Born at the Aerux's core, where Aerflow runs densest, it wields overwhelming power—yet finds no worthy foe, and with each passing day, grows ever more alone. 
 
With ease, it shatters boulders and snaps trees, its strength unmatched. Still, no opponent has risen to challenge it. 
 
For years, a nearby town offered rewards for its defeat. Now, that town lies abandoned and in ruins—nothing remains but rotting wood and scattered pages, a silent warning to all who would come near.

The fur on the Gilded Fox's neck displays flower-like patterns. These mysterious and elegant markings are considered a symbol of luxury, making the Gilded Fox highly prized by noble families.\n\nRecords state that "the Gilded Fox's cry is a thousand-fold melody," as their calls are exceptionally melodious. They only cry out nine times in their lives for unknown reasons, and each cry is unique. Countless members of the Gongyu family have spent their entire lives trying to capture these sounds.

Clouds rise to bring rain, dew condenses into frost.
Legend has it that an ancient belief exists far beyond the extreme north.
They say that clouds reaching the end of their lives fall to the edge of the world, gradually piling up into a blue mountain range.
And the ice and snow on the mountains turn into new clouds, repeating the cycle to nourish all living things.

Countless explorers have tried to uncover the secrets of the giant mountain, only to freeze to death in the wilderness.
To prevent further tragedies, the Hundred Schools once jointly issued an investigative report, warning people that the peak is actually a dormant exotic beast, and the cold it exhales can freeze even time itself.
Please abandon any plans to go there rashly, unless you are fully prepared to face the biting frost.

A panda demonkin who drifted into the Colorful Cloud Basin. 
He came to the academy with dreams of proving himself, only to be turned away for his uneven academic performance. 
But an old man once told him: "Among any three people, there must be one who can be my teacher." 
He took these words to heart, and seeking advice from students became his form of cultivation. 
 
Since then, a strange "Green Bamboo Hero" has appeared in the Colorful Cloud Basin. 
Rumor has it among the students that there is a formidable eccentric who challenges everyone he meets to a fight. 
Strangely, he shouts out move names from storybooks as he fights. 
And when he leaves after a fight, the nearby food often disappears with him. 
More than his martial arts, it is this appetite that people find most concerning.

Nightmare-Spotted Deer are distributed throughout the Dream Realm. Due to the influence of dream energy, their fur has turned a dark, psychedelic purple, dotted with many light-colored spots. The males grow antlers and have manes on their chests. Their deep, dream-like color has made them mysterious and eerie figures in folklore.\n\nTheir coat color darkens with age. It is rumored that the darkest Nightmare-Spotted Deer possesses special power. Many who have been trapped in nightmares have claimed that it was this deer that guided them to wake up.

Tender buds fill the body, learning to walk clumsily.
When delicate vines take root in the old shell that has become nutrients, a new life begins.
Its thorn-covered body protects the fragile main bud.
The face on the mask is merely a disguise.
At this moment, it is full of longing.
It must embrace and communicate sincerely with every creature it meets for the first time.

Does their cyclical life count as a continuation of the self?
When most of what belongs to the self is replaced, can the core that guides their consciousness remember the former self?

An unyielding gatekeeper, one who can hold the pass against a thousand riders. With a massive shield, it blocks all who stand before it, enduring like a mountain even in ruin. Forged from a fallen hero's shield, it stands as the pinnacle of mechanised defence. 
 
When icy boulders fall off the cliff, there is no retreat. Its core is etched with unbreakable resolve, its defence impenetrable. 
 
Its back faced the country it fought to defend as the underhanded cavalry streamed into the pass. In the dying light of dusk, as shadows stretch long, reinforcements emerge.

The resister faced the enemy with twin blades; before the mockery could fade, the leader's head had fallen.
Pierced by a thousand blades, the body perished, yet the twin blades remained.
Take the hero's lost blades and bestow them upon the Emperor of Mechanisms.
Frost freezes the weaponry, flames melt the armor.
The swift and agile combat style has been inherited; the art of rapid strikes has reached perfection.

The wicked master and his bandits swept through the village, but the one who ends the sorrow has appeared.
The enemy still mocks, but their head is already severed.

Nightmare-Spotted Deer are distributed throughout the Dream Realm. Due to the influence of dream energy, their fur has turned a dark, psychedelic purple, dotted with many light-colored spots. The does have snow-white necks and no antlers, replaced instead by a patch of pink fluff.\n\nAncient Jixia divination suggests that Nightmare-Spotted Deer feed on human dreams: the stags consume deep dreams, while the does consume shallow ones. Encountering both a stag and a doe in a dream may mean that your dreams are about to fall through.

An ancient Jade Tear Fruit surrounded by sorrow, unapproachable by ordinary people.
The corolla, crowded with withered leaves, overflows with a gas that brings people to tears.
Those affected will feel uncontrollable sadness, and even beasts will lose their appetite.
Therefore, it can only live alone in its own place, unable to be accepted by other creatures.

It is said that a flock of Scentless Birds often kept it company.
They brought anecdotes from afar, and it provided a stable, sheltering shade.
But one day, the Scentless Bird flock vanished from the sky.
In the years since, only the sorrowful wind remains, and the story has become a lost echo.

Combat Mechanoids forged from mysterious metals. Armored with gleaming, reinforced scales, they are heavily fortified and intimidating. The Blade Effigies wield their blades with basic, disciplined techniques. One doesn't need to look closely to see the scars covering these machines; the remaining marks seem to tell the story of the hardships they endured as soldiers.
zh_text:
神秘金属铸成的作战机关俑。
镶嵌着光泽的甲片的盔甲格外坚固，令人望而生畏。
百炼刀俑手持刀刃，用最基本的一招一式进行战斗。

不需仔细观察，便能轻易发现这机关俑满身伤痕，残存的印记似乎在向大家诉说着作为兵卒所历尽的沧桑。

text:
The Dream Demon of Painted Shadows is the embodiment of darkness in the dream. Now, its ambition has expanded, twisting everyone's dreams into a disaster.

[Three-Phase Illusion]: The Dream Demon of Painted Shadows cycles between wolf, bear, and human forms, each with unique combat tactics.

[Nightmare Seizure]: When in bear or human form, it summons Nightmare Butterflies to snatch a player and fly toward a Nightmare Rift. Teammates must shoot down the butterflies in time, or a devastating explosion will be triggered upon falling into the rift.

[Vine Binding Kill]: The Wooden Fence King releases vines to bind all players and summons Wooden Fence Spear Guards to charge across the field. You must break free from the vines as soon as possible to avoid attacks.\n\n[Spirit-Absorbing Giantization]: The Wooden Fence King absorbs the vitality of surrounding small wooden fences, its body expanding rapidly and covering itself with an indestructible thorn armor. At this time, Bombardment Guards appear on the sidelines throwing fire bombs. Only by picking up the fire bombs and throwing them at the Wooden Fence King's armor can you gradually dismantle its defense; otherwise, its power will continue to grow with its size until it crushes the entire field.

[Nut Bait]: The Armored Rat King summons several small armored rats to roll around and cause chaos. One of them carries a special nut; defeating it leaves the nut on the field. The Armored Rat King then pulls all players in and binds two of them with resonance vines (the bound are silenced, and if they get too far apart, they are pulled back). The remaining teammates must pick up the nut to lure the King's charge. The two players connected by vines must pull in opposite directions to use the vines as a tripwire to trip the charging giant rat.

The Frostmane Spike Bear dominates the Aerux peak. Its mane has turned to crystal. It is powerful, lonely, and restless, smashing rocks and trees in its wake. Once a target of bounties, it is now a warning to stay away. The town lies in ruins, leaving only decayed wood and scattered fragments.
zh_text:
云根贯空之巅，无它者存立。
硕根之上的霸主，鬃毛已化为光莹的晶体。
漆黑的阴影随日落笼罩山麓，肆意的鼾声响破黎明。
它生于云根核心，长于云流富足之所。
它屡战屡胜，却日益孤独。
过剩的能量，让它无处宣泄。
把磐石拍碎，摧万树折腰。
芒鬓巨熊寻不得一个匹敌的对手。

对它持续无数年的悬赏令，早已替换成勿近的警示。
然现在，城镇也已破败，只剩下腐蚀的残木与零碎的断章。

text:
A hundred days of ice that sealed the fortress, a thousand miles of fire that burnt between camps.
These words are engraved upon this bronze construct.
This is the ancient craftsmen's ultimate understanding of war, and the interpretation of this mechanism.
Red and blue energies coexist and merge, amplifying artillery fire that no city can withstand.
Yet, it was abandoned beneath the ruins.

Its role as an attacker never had the chance to be showcased.
The horn for the counterattack had not yet sounded, and the craftsmen who built the Frost-Fire Cannon had already sacrificed themselves in the battle to defend it.
zh_text:
“百日冰封蛮寨，千里火烧连营。”
被镌刻在了这具青铜造物之上。
这是古代匠人对战争的极致理解，亦是这具机关的诠释。
红蓝两种能量相生相融，增幅的炮击没有任何城池能阻挡。
然而，它却被弃置在废墟之下。

它作为进攻者的作用，没有机会得到展现。
反攻的号角还未吹响，而制造燃冰极铳的工匠们，已经牺牲在保卫它的战役之中。

text: The one who stayed behind lingers in this world, while their companion has returned to where it came. The Sentinel wanders the valley, bearing the name of a knight, yet its mount is nowhere to be seen. The oversized greatsword it carries confirms the incredible size of its former partner. Though it now relies solely on the greatsword fused to its body, even without the momentum of a charge, its heavy strikes can still cleave through mountains and rivers.\n\nDragon Knights still uphold their oath to their dragons. Since the dragons are gone, the place where they parted is likely the final resting place for the rest of the knights' lives.
zh_text:
留守者长存世间，陪伴者已归来处。 
游荡在山谷间的铸灵，空有骑士之名，却未见所乘之物。 
它肩扛的夸张巨剑，证实了曾经伙伴难以置信的体型。 
虽然它现在唯一能倚仗的只有与自己融为一体的巨剑，然而即便失去了俯冲之势，它的重击依然穿山截水。 
 
龙骑依旧维系着与龙之间的誓约，既然龙已不在，那它们分离的地方大概就是骑士余生的归宿。

text: [Desperate Fire Shield]: The charges initiated by the four phantom clones of the Blade-Severing Spirit must all be lured into the Lone Halberd Spirit's Fire Shield. Any mistake will result in failure to break the shield, testing the team's precise execution and coordination.

The Armadillo Rat King has long thrived on Aerflow, developing a thick hide and a massive frame. During the Festive Fire Opera, it sneaks into the granaries to raid the crops. 
 
Nut Lure: The King summons several little Armadillo Rats to wreak havoc, one of which carries a special nut. When the nut-bearer is defeated, the nut remains on the field. The Rat King then drags all players closer, ensnaring two with vines. Entangled players will be silenced, and straying too far will snap them back.  
 
Unbound allies must pick up the nut to bait the King's charge, while the entwined pair must pull their vines in opposite directions to trip the charging King. Timing and coordination are key—fail, and the colossal rat keeps rampaging.

A Mechcraft warrior wielding a blade of fire. Beneath the black-gold armor, a fiery core burns ceaselessly. The Ten-Thousand-Forge Blade is highly skilled in close-quarters combat, striking with the weight of a mountain. The intense heat of its massive fire blade is enough to melt metal. Few creatures dare to provoke the Ten-Thousand-Forge Blade, and it does not provoke others. Combat is no longer its mission, but its fated destiny.

Driven by hunger, the Armadillo Rat King unleashes its full strength. Summoned Armored Rats are much tougher, while nut bait now wears off quickly. \n \nThe little Armored Rats now have greatly increased health, requiring heavier firepower to dispatch quickly. Dropped nuts lose their lure range very quickly, so the nut carrier and vine handler must act in perfect sync. Any delay can break the bind and cost you the supply cache.

Saepes King rules with absolute authority. It uses its scepter to overpower anyone who opposes it. 
 
Vinebind Assault: Thick vines trap all players while Saepes charge in with spears. Break free quickly to avoid the incoming strikes. 
 
Soul Siphon: Saepes King drains life from nearby Saepes, growing huge and wrapping himself in thorn armor that blocks damage. Saepes Catapultors spawn and fling fireballs—grab those fireballs and throw them at Saepes King to shatter his armor. Otherwise, his size and power will keep increasing and threaten to crush the whole area.

Lord Botu is a cold hunter who has fallen into the dream. He comes wrapped in darkness, vowing to drag this dream into total destruction.\n\n[Deepest Nightmare]: Lord Botu summons a deep darkness that devours everything. The bright area around the Nightmare Light Platform can protect players from the continuous erosion of the darkness. Only by finding the two Nightmare Feather Guards that appear in the darkness, defeating them to seize the Nightmare Light, and successfully escorting it to the Nightmare Light Platform to light it up, can the darkness be dispelled and force him to appear.

Melee constructs created by the academy. The Crazed Crystal-Armor form is slightly larger than standard models, with a shinier shell. They wield their blades in a reverse grip with mysterious technique, forcing many students to concede using only the back of their blades. The academy was once divided over their high production cost, until their performance won everyone over.
zh_text:
学院制造的近战机关人。
狂刃晶铠形态比一般的晶铠稍大一些，外壳也更加具有光泽。
反握晶刃，刀法高深莫测，仅用刀背就让不少学子无奈认输。

学院内部曾对其昂贵造价有所争议，直到它的表现折服了众人。

text: [Phantom Charge]: The Blade-Severing Spirit splits into four phantom clones to lock onto different players and charge.\n\n[Precision Guidance]: The Halberd-Severing Spirit's fire shield is still on the field. Four players must accurately identify and guide their respective clones to crash into the fire shield, while staying spread out to avoid overlapping paths.

Tigrex has fully awakened his ancient bloodline. A primal beast with raw power and rock-solid defense is unleashed. 
 
Fury Shield Charge: When Tigrex charges, his Shield becomes much tougher. You must focus your attacks and deal heavy damage to break it. 
 
Earth Shatter: Right after the charge, Tigrex jumps and slams the ground repeatedly, creating full-screen shockwaves. The shockwaves cannot be dodged by jumping or dashing. Only the Shield on the field can block it.

A bronze mechanical guard dormant in the Jixia ruins, shaped like a sitting tortoise. A stationary bronze turret used for defense. When facing enemies, the hidden cannons behind the four dark doors will turn and fire in unison. Its immense power, gained at the cost of mobility, deters anyone coveting the ruins' treasures. Some Gate-Breakers who study firearms will pay a high price for these mechanisms.

They are tasked with guarding Jixia's ruins. 
Adorned with glowing patterns etched into their bronze bodies, they wield ancient pikes with deadly precision, delivering swift and lethal strikes. 
 
Rebels or curious students alike who venture into the ruins are met with their cold steel.

Bi Fang, the essence of wood; it looks like a bird and does not eat the five grains.
A giant bronze bird, chirping day and night. Its cry is fierce, and all who hear it weep in sorrow.
Bi Fang has forgotten many things, but it remembers its own name.
Its single leg is rusted, its wings are mottled, but its eyes still burn with a cyan, scorching fire, matching the deep flow-patterns on its body.

The tall ship gave it the mission to fly, to guard, and to fight.
But now the ship has capsized, and it still tries to fulfill its mission, even though everything it could protect has turned to ruins.
So it cries out, to at least hold onto its name, with a pride that is almost shattering:
Bi Fang, Bi Fang.

Giant underground Palisaepes. Twisted branches bear special fruits, though they have long since rotted away with time. These Palisaepes are precise throwers; they aim and launch their projectiles in one fluid motion, never missing. Perhaps for more effective defense, the Palisaepes Rot-Throwers intentionally let their 'fruits' decay. It must be said, many creatures are driven away by the stench before they can even get close.
zh_text:
地下的巨型朴篱。 
扭曲的枝条上结着特殊的果实，但它们早已随着时间的流逝而趋于腐烂。 
这些朴篱都是精准的投掷手，瞄准，掷弹一气呵成，从不失手。 
 
也许是为了实现更有效的防御，朴篱投腐卫故意将它们的“果实”腐化。 
不得不说，很多生物往往还没来得及接近就被熏跑了，效果拔群。

text: Megadrive Hammer is the pinnacle of the School of Mechcraft's maximization approach. Forged from unprecedentedly tough materials to push the limits of power, every strike packs a devastating punch. Its deceptively simple design hides the force to shake mountains. \n \nHammer Shockwave: After charging, Megadrive Hammer unleashes a full-screen shockwave. One player must grab the dropped shield to block it, while others need to stay close behind the shield-bearer to avoid damage. The shockwave strikes twice in quick succession, so reposition quickly to stay safe.

In the autumn of ruin, the waters flooded and caused disaster. Craftsmen used heaven-defying skills to create a profound mechanism.
The bronze construct, shaped like a massive roof ridge, conceals the secrets of the past.
Its thick, jointed legs are incredibly agile.
Its perfect balance of defense and impact matches the most primitive style of combat.
It is meant to crush all invaders.

In the nearly boundless underground world of Jixia, complex river routes and unimaginable creatures are hidden.
What were the ancient craftsmen trying to build by using the Ruin-Guard to move mountains and fill seas?
zh_text:
“墟成之秋，水滥成灾。众匠以夺天之工，造通玄之役。”
形似硕大屋脊的青铜造物，遮蔽着往日辛密。
巨大粗壮的节肢腿部，灵活的难以置信。
相得益彰的防御与冲击力，匹配了最原始的作战方式。
它要碾压一切入侵者。

稷下几乎无边际的地底世界，隐藏着错综复杂的河路与匪夷所思的生物。
古代工匠们利用驻墟玄守移山填海，是为了搭构什么？

text: A rodent found in the forests of Jixia, characterized by its gourd-shaped brown shell. Armadillo Rats are docile and retreat into their shells when attacked. Only when their young are threatened will they use their claws and teeth to bite back.\n\nArmadillo Rats love medicinal herbs, so herbalists often follow them in hopes of a harvest. Few herbalists can track them alone, so they often team up with hunters.
zh_text:
出没于稷下树丛中的一种鼠类。
有着葫芦状的棕色背甲。
铠鼠性格十分温顺，受到攻击时会缩入壳中保护自己。
只有幼崽受到威胁的时候才会用其爪牙撕咬来犯之敌。

铠鼠喜食药草，百草家会小心翼翼跟在他们身后，期盼能有所收获。
能独自追踪到铠鼠的百草家寥寥无几，因此百草家们常与游猎家组队。

text:
A dark, eerie figure, an incarnate nightmare.
The tall, slender Dreamslayer lurks in the shadows and dreams, waiting for the perfect moment to strike.
The shadows beneath its purple feathers are the prey's final memory, and the moon-blade it wields is the pride of a lone hunter.
The Moon-blade Dreamslayer is born from dreams, one with everything around it.
It moves through the air with ease, its gorgeous slashes like phantoms.

It tears through dream after dream, traversing fantasy after fantasy.
Its dark footsteps are merely the prelude to the hunt; the dreams of the mediocre are the food it survives on.

The Dream Demon of Painted Shadows' control over the dream realm deepens, tearing open more Nightmare Rifts, but also making its own creations vulnerable.\n\n[Rift Proliferation]: When the Dream Demon of Painted Shadows changes form, the number of Nightmare Rifts on the field increases, significantly increasing the pressure on teammates to rescue. At the same time, the protection of the Nightmare Butterflies that snatch players is greatly weakened, making them more fragile and easily shattered.

A Bronze Axe General that has been dormant since its creation to fulfill its duty of protection. It awakens among the rubble, its only directive inscribed on its bronze body: expel all intruders.

[Lost Reinforcements]: The Bronze Axe General summons two Lost Cannons to fight alongside it; these should be cleared first.

[Rock Shield Formation]: The Bronze Axe General deploys a shield in the center of the arena and summons stone pillars at the four corners. It then cycles through targeting a single player or all players. Everyone must use the stone pillars as cover to hide, then work together to push the pillars over onto the Bronze Axe General to break its shield and stun it.

The Radish King reigns supreme, a terror known far and wide. Its gleaming kitchen knife hints at danger beneath its playful demeanor, as it vows to defend the dignity of the Radishes through battle. 
 
Vine Command: Leaping to the center of the arena, the Radish King knocks back all players, then sounds its horn to ensnare three targets in twisting vines and drag them close. Anyone dragged to the Radish King faces a deadly strike. 
 
Groundbound Cutters: Meanwhile, the knife-wielding Radishes burrow along the edges, chasing unbound players. Guide these little attackers to sever the vines and free your allies before it's too late.

Sentry Mechanoids are combat constructs created by the academy. Their perfect geometric design of spheres and cylinders is a masterpiece of the master artificers. These constructs possess immense attack power, easily crushing ordinary soldiers.\n\nSentry Mechanoids typically join the battlefield after key structures are destroyed, helping to accelerate the advance.
zh_text:
巡卫巨兵是学院制造的战斗机关。
球体与圆柱的完美几何构造，是机关大师的得意之作。
这种机关兵攻击能力极强，对一般小兵有着碾压之势。

巡卫巨兵一般会在关键建筑被摧毁后才加入战场，帮助己方更快推进。
