text:
It lurks in the nightmares of students,
absorbing the obsessions and darkness in people's hearts to reshape itself.
From the bite of a mad wolf to the pounce of a giant bear,
it gradually condenses the power of destruction within endless bestiality.
This shadow born of dreams attempts to break the boundary between reality and illusion, using sharp blades to tear the present world apart.

"The more awake you are in a dream, the more trapped you are in reality."
The awakened shadow projects the despair and darkness from the depths of the soul into people's dreams,
and thus the dream twists into this dark incarnation of disaster.

Rebels who turned against the academy due to conflicting martial arts philosophies. Rebel Vanguards wield hammers and shields, excelling in defensive counterattacks. Many of them come from outside Jixia, joining the rebels in pursuit of power.
zh_text:
因武道理念不同而与学院作对的破门生。
破门先锋持握槌锤，臂举盾牌，格外擅长防守反击。

这些人许多是来自稷下之外的地方，他们为了追寻力量加入了破门生。

text: [Eternal Barrier]: The thorn armor covering the Wood Fence King's torso becomes exceptionally tough, requiring more fire bombs to break.\n\n[Fury Drain]: The Wood Fence King's attack power rises rapidly while in its giant form. The team must intercept and throw fire bombs with extreme efficiency; any delay will cause the survival space to shrink drastically.

Young Spike Bear.
They have stiff bristles on their heads and are widespread throughout Jixia. Though small, they can curl into a ball to attack.

Spike Bears are mammals; the mother raises the cubs until they are grown, so they are often seen together. If a cub is attacked while alone, it will call for its mother to help.
zh_text:
年幼的刺熊。 
头部亦有着坚硬的鬃毛，广泛分布在稷下各地。 
幼芒熊虽然体型较小，但也会蜷缩成肉球发动攻击。 
 
刺熊是一种哺乳动物，大熊会把小熊抚养成年，所以经常是一大一小出现。如果小熊落单时受到攻击，它们会呼唤大熊前来帮忙。

text:
Stone relics fade with time, as the years deepen around the empty hall. 
 
It was awakened only few times. The old man with a white beard stood before it, followed by diligent young men. 
 
As time passed, the pillar collapsed and the land cracked. 
 
Dual-Axe General woke up amidst the ruins. It didn't know where the liveliness of the past had gone, but it remembered its mission: To protect and defend, until the enemy armies retreat, and until people can dream without concerns.

Four legs on the ground, hidden in flames. When lightning strikes, the battle never ends.
When the clouds fall, the wildfire rises.
The fire-breathing giant lizard turns the land it treads into scorched earth.
The scars it leaves are hard to erase, and nothing grows where it passes.
Successive challengers have tried to drive away this disaster, but few have succeeded.
Even wounding it only adds to its fury.
The source of its restlessness is the gloom gathering on the horizon.

It rolls like red clouds, never stopping.
The struggle between the lizard kings was once endless, until the person riding the strange mount appeared.
zh_text:
“立地四足，常隐于灼炎。遇雷，则斗不休。” 
云落之时，燎火升。 
吞吐烈焰的巨蜥，践踏之地沦为焦土。 
它的造成的伤痕难以消尽，所过之处寸草不生。 
前仆后继的挑战者试图驱逐这一灾害，然成功者寥寥。 
即便伤它分毫，也只是徒增了愤怒。 
它躁动的源头，是天边聚集的阴霾。 
 
它卷若赤霞，不止不休。 
蜥王之间的斗争曾经永无休止，直到那个乘坐怪异坐骑的人出现。

text: The two Sentinels act as one, dominating the battlefield through perfect teamwork. Even a small mistake can lead to disaster. \n \nTo break Pickaxe Sentinel's Inferno Shield, ALL four phantom clones of Doomblade Sentinel must strike it. This tests your team's coordination.

The Ruin-Guarding Mystic Sentinel is a giant bronze construct forged by ancient craftsmen. Shaped like a roof ridge, it crushes all intruders with immense force.\n\n[Bronze March]: This giant construct locks onto the Burning Mountain Pivot as its target, relentlessly advancing on its limbs, and will continuously attack the pivot upon arrival until it is destroyed. Players must do everything in their power to stop its advance.

[Vine Binding Kill]: The Wooden Fence King releases vines to bind all players and summons Wooden Fence Spear Guards to charge across the field. At this time, Bombardment Guards appear on the sidelines throwing fire bombs. Only by picking up the fire bombs and throwing them at the Wooden Fence King's armor can you gradually dismantle its defense; otherwise, its power will continue to grow with its size until it crushes the entire field.

The Hellbound Sentinel, having fully unleashed its primal essence, has become a living catastrophe. Stars swirl in its grasp, threatening unparalleled destruction. 
 
Cataclysmic Stars: The summoned stars are now empowered by their essence, becoming far more stable. You must strike with greater force to shatter them. 
 
Cosmic Vortex: The rotating starlight walls spin at extreme speed, with openings vanishing in an instant. This means immense pressure when hunting down the constellation shadows. It tests the team's DPS and coordination to the limit.

It was awakened only few times. The old man with a white beard stood before it, followed by diligent young men. 
 
As time passed, the pillar collapsed and the land cracked. 
 
Dual-Axe General woke up amidst the ruins. It didn't know where the liveliness of the past had gone, but it remembered its mission: To protect and defend, until the enemy armies retreat, and until people can dream without concerns.

In the north of Jixia, there is a giant beast with four legs that likes to hide in lightning and often fights with fire to the death.
When the fire dies, the thunderclouds rise.
The lightning-wielding giant lizard is the mortal enemy of the wildfire giant lizard.
Its massive body, shimmering with faint light, is often hidden within lightning.
It grants its victims a painless death the moment it appears.
It is the darling of lightning and the apex predator of the wilderness.

It rests like a crag, immovable.
Only when the enemy's fire begins to spread will it lift its noble head and let out a roar that shakes the earth.

燎火灭时，雷云升。 
操弄雷的巨蜥，与燎原巨蜥互为死敌。 
隐隐闪动着辉光的硕大的身躯，常隐于雷电之中。 
会在出现的瞬间赐予受害者无痛苦的毙亡。 
它是雷电的宠儿，是原野顶端的霸者。 
 
它盘若苍岩，岿然不动。

text: After enduring the trials of the world, the floral crowns atop the Saepes Brutes have finally bloomed. The massive clubs in their hands are no different than before, but true mastery of martial arts has never been about the weapon itself. While their weapons still fear the scorching flames of the Scorched Fluff, years of careful maintenance and fighting side-by-side mean the Saepes Brutes will no longer give their natural enemies an opening.

Might as thunder, movement like the sky's roar.
The Thunder-Bull that once galloped across the vast plains carries thunder in its massive horns.
Now it keeps to itself, keeping company only with the purple clouds.
Its dark fur ripples constantly, like a raging sea.
Its territory is its thunder pool, its fortress.
Any creature that steps foot here will face a thousand-fold thunder strike.
Perhaps it once tried to live in a herd, but those who drew near have surely turned to ash.

It wanders, it stands still.
It destroys, it is lost.
Now, the time has come.

Combat Mechanoids forged from mysterious metals. Armored with gleaming, reinforced scales, they are heavily fortified and intimidating. The Blade Effigies wield their blades with basic, disciplined techniques. One doesn't need to look closely to see the scars covering these machines; the remaining marks seem to tell the story of the hardships they endured as soldiers.

镶嵌着光泽的甲片的盔甲格外坚固，令人望而生畏。
百炼刀俑手持刀刃，用最基本的一招一式进行战斗。

不需仔细观察，便能轻易发现这机关俑满身伤痕，残存的印记似乎在向大家诉说着作为兵卒所历尽的沧桑。

text:
Bronze Turrets are defensive Mechanoids found in the ruins. 
Their four legs are bunched together, charging for a powerful blast with their two cannons. 
A single blast is enough to shatter any armor. The only way around them is to avoid them. 
 
For some reason, they have been restless, a sign that this place has never been forgotten.

[Stubborn Plant Protection]: While dragging a teammate, the Radish King generates a sturdy thorn armor. Although the blade-wielding small radishes can cut the vines, they cannot break the armor.\n\n[Scorched Earth Obstacle Breaking]: Rescued players must lure the unactivated self-destructing radishes on the field to collide with the Radish King, or lure it to step onto the previously left burning ground. Only through continuous burning can its armor be gradually dismantled; otherwise, the armor will remain.

The guardian stood firm, a single man holding the pass against a thousand. Giant shields blocked the enemy; though exhausted, it stood like a mountain. Taking the hero's lost shield, the Emperor of Constructs was forged. Ice and rock fell upon the cliff, leaving no retreat for friend or foe. An unyielding belief was embedded in the core, making its defensive techniques unbreakable. Vile iron cavalry flooded the pass, and the defenders turned their backs on their homeland. As the setting sun cast its final glow, reinforcements appeared in the elongated shadows.
zh_text:
守关人岿然不动，一夫当关，千骑莫开。
巨盾阻敌，虽枯不倒，立如峰峦。
取英雄遗盾，锻机关之皇。
冰岩坠落崖间，敌我无路可退。
不屈的坚定信念已嵌入枢核，抵御之技牢不可破。

卑劣铁骑涌入关隘，卫国之躯已背对故土。
当残阳只剩余晖，被拉长的身影中出现了援军。

text: The two birds have parted, and the defector has returned home. Following the sunrise, the Crimson Falcon flies from the edge of the sea to Jixia. It is the king of the sky, diving like falling fire to hunt. Its selection of prey goes far beyond mere hunger; only the strongest are chosen. Hunting is a life-or-death ritual, and only the survivors enjoy a moment of peace.\n\nNo one knows what it seeks in this land, but in truth, the Crimson Falcon is not searching for anything—this continent is merely a branch for it to rest upon.
zh_text:
比翼之鸟已经分离，叛离者回归故土。
跟随日升，从天海边际飞抵稷下的艳阳红隼。
它是天空的狩猎的王者，俯冲捕猎时犹如天火陨落。
傲火隼对猎物的挑选已经远远超越了裹腹的范畴，唯有强大的个体才能被它选中。
狩猎是一场逐命的祭奠，唯有生还者才能享受片刻安宁。

没人知道它到底要在这片土地上寻找什么，但实际上傲火隼并没有在寻找，这片大陆对于它来说只是歇脚的枝丫。

text:
Tigrex, a fierce Rebel leader in the mountain forests, now bursts into the Three-School Showdown. With iron claws and relentless force, he wants to dominate the competition and prove that only destruction shows true power. 
 
Brutal Charge: Tigrex locks onto one player and charges toward them repeatedly. The targeted player should avoid staying close to allies so they don't get hit, while others should attack Tigrex from behind. The final charge is red-glowing. It's stronger, so be careful. 
 
Earth Shaker: Tigrex leaps to the center of the arena and slams the ground several times, sending out circular shockwaves. Jump or dash to dodge the waves. The final slam is red-glowing and is more powerful. Watch out.

[Phantom Charge]: The Blade-Severing Spirit splits into four phantom clones to lock onto different players and charge.\n\n[Precision Guidance]: The Halberd-Severing Spirit's fire shield is still on the field. Four players must accurately identify and guide their respective clones to crash into the fire shield, while staying spread out to avoid overlapping paths.

[Evil Shield Charge]: The Savage Tiger's shield durability is greatly increased during its charge. The team must focus fire to deal massive damage to break it.\n\n[Earth-Shattering Impact]: After charging, the Savage Tiger immediately leaps to the center of the field and slams the ground repeatedly, causing screen-wide shockwave damage. Only by picking up the dropped Mechanical Heavy Shield can you block it; jumping or dodging is useless.

A dark, eerie figure, an incarnate nightmare.
The tall, slender Dreamslayer lurks in the shadows and dreams, waiting for the perfect moment to strike.
The shadows beneath its purple feathers are the prey's final memory, and the moon-blade it wields is the pride of a lone hunter.
The Moon-blade Dreamslayer is born from dreams, one with everything around it.
It moves through the air with ease, its gorgeous slashes like phantoms.

It tears through dream after dream, traversing fantasy after fantasy.
Its dark footsteps are merely the prelude to the hunt; the dreams of the mediocre are the food it survives on.

An ancient defensive stationary mechanical construct.
The Qiancui Shield Automaton was designed with practicality in mind.
The mechanical patterns on the tower shield channel superior elemental energy, making it even harder to shake.

The shields of the mechanical constructs developed by the Academy are largely based on this construction.
It is hard to imagine what kind of enemy would require a mechanical construct with such powerful defensive capabilities.

The mechanism core has gone completely berserk, summoning four abandoned turrets to fight alongside it at the start.

[Thunder Array]: The stone pillars are indestructible under the blessing of thunder; players must work together to break them before they can be toppled. Meanwhile, the General's charge and destructive beam will be accompanied by large-scale lightning strikes across the field.

[Twin Abyssal Terrors]: The Ruin Guardians will be awakened and join the battle. During this time, the Bronze Halberd General will intermittently trigger unavoidable ground-shaking sparks across the field. Players must quickly defeat the Ruin Guardians under the dual pressure of lightning storms and sparks.

[Fire Shield Collision]: The Blade-Severing Spirit locks onto a player to charge, while the Lone Halberd Spirit activates a Fire Shield in the center of the field. Players must lure the Blade-Severing Spirit to collide with the Fire Shield three times to successfully break the shield; otherwise, they will suffer massive screen-wide damage.

Stone relics fade with time, as the years deepen around the empty hall. 
 
It was awakened only few times. The old man with a white beard stood before it, followed by diligent young men. 
 
As time passed, the pillar collapsed and the land cracked. 
 
Dual-Axe General woke up amidst the ruins. It didn't know where the liveliness of the past had gone, but it remembered its mission: To protect and defend, until the enemy armies retreat, and until people can dream without concerns.

Tender buds fill the body, learning to walk clumsily.
When delicate vines take root in the old shell that has become nutrients, a new life begins.
Its thorn-covered body protects the fragile main bud.
The face on the mask is merely a disguise.
At this moment, it is full of longing.
It must embrace and communicate sincerely with every creature it meets for the first time.

Does their cyclical life count as a continuation of the self?
When most of what belongs to the self is replaced, can the core that guides their consciousness remember the former self?

Flames light up the sky, the sea boils high.
Every Jixia local grows up hearing tales of the Crimson Beast.
It is said that the monster is as towering as a mountain, and the sparks from its breath, mixed with its crimson mane, can turn midnight into day.
With every step it takes, it turns the ground beneath it into magma, and even the permafrost of the highlands boils.

To stop the excited children who are eager to try their luck, the adults always add a "however."
However, except for the time it got its head soaked by an avalanche, no one has ever gained the upper hand in a fight with it—be careful not to wet the bed from playing with fire, little one!
zh_text:
“火光烛天，海水如沸。”
每个稷下人都听着猩红神兽的故事度过自己的童年时光。
据说那怪物身量巍峨仿佛高山，呼吸间喷吐出的火星伴着赤色鬃毛，能将子夜照亮成白昼。
它每前行一步，便要将足下的土地踏为岩浆，就连高原的冻土也会沸腾。

为了阻拦听得兴奋跃跃欲试的孩子，大人们此时总要加上一句“不过”。
不过，除了被雪崩打湿脑袋的那次，从没有人能在和它的争斗中占据上风——当心玩火尿炕啊，小家伙！

text:
Stone hides the portrait, colors fade away. Springs circle the empty hall, where ages stay.
Since the day of its creation, it has fallen into a long slumber.
In the few times it has awakened,
it saw an old man with a frosty beard standing with his hands behind his back, and a young man in his prime studying diligently behind him.

Stars shift and seas change. The pillars supporting the sky collapse, and the cauldrons supporting the earth crumble.
The Bronze Halberd-Wielder remains oblivious,
sleeping in the empty room, waking from dreams amidst the rubble.
It does not know where the past bustle has gone, only remembering the mission forged into its copper body:
To guard, to guard, until the armies retreat, until the long dream is worry-free.
zh_text:
“石埋遗像丹青落，泉绕虚堂岁月深。” 
自诞生之日起，它就陷入了长久的沉眠。 
唯有屈指可数的几次醒来， 
面前霜髯老者负手而立，身后弱冠青年勤学苦练。 
 
星移斗转，沧海桑田。撑天之柱倾颓，拄地之釜崩陷。 
青钺铸将浑然不觉， 
安睡于空室之内，梦醒于瓦砾之间。 
它不知昔日喧闹散去了何处，只记得熔铸在铜躯中的使命： 
守护、守护，直到千军溃退，直到长梦无忧。

sleeping in the empty room, waking from dreams amidst the rubble.
It does not know where the past bustle has gone, only remembering the mission forged into its copper body:
To guard, to guard, until the armies retreat, until the long dream is worry-free.

Their long weapons strike with direct, powerful force, making intruders think twice. These machines once fought like an army, but some unknown event caused them to scatter across Jixia.
zh_text:
神秘金属铸成的作战机关俑。
身形比百炼枪俑更加庞大，坚甲如淬洗过般崭新。
长兵出手，直出直入，力达枪尖，让来犯者望而却步。

过去这些机关曾像军队一样作战，后来不知什么变故让它们分散在稷下各地。

text: The one who stayed behind lingers in this world, while their companion has returned to where it came. The Sentinel wanders the valley, bearing the name of a knight, yet its mount is nowhere to be seen. The oversized greatsword it carries confirms the incredible size of its former partner. Though it now relies solely on the greatsword fused to its body, even without the momentum of a charge, its heavy strikes can still cleave through mountains and rivers.\n\nDragon Knights still uphold their oath to their dragons. Since the dragons are gone, the place where they parted is likely the final resting place for the rest of the knights' lives.

它肩扛的夸张巨剑，证实了曾经伙伴难以置信的体型。 
虽然它现在唯一能倚仗的只有与自己融为一体的巨剑，然而即便失去了俯冲之势，它的重击依然穿山截水。

text:
The Relic Hundred-General is a bronze mechanical commander guarding the Jixia ruins.
Strange patterns cover its bronze structure.
They hold sharp, ancient spears, attacking quickly and lethally.

They have internalized combat tactics and represent the highest command of the bronze mechanical army.

Bronze for a spine, scales linked in rows.
Engraved patterns on fins, gliding through the air.
An exquisite automaton crafted in the likeness of a diving dragon and fish,
Patrolling the Abyss for a thousand years, breathing wind and frost beneath the stone dome.
Should any intruder covet the treasures stored on the tall ship,
The long alarm will sound, and the greedy shall not escape the fish's maw.

The embers of war have long turned to the dust of ruins,
The old masters are gone, yet it still fulfills its mission of protection,
Until that fisherman's song crosses the sea and returns home.

It lurks in the nightmares of students,
absorbing the obsessions and darkness in people's hearts to reshape itself.
From the bite of a mad wolf to the pounce of a giant bear,
it gradually condenses the power of destruction within endless bestiality.
This shadow born of dreams attempts to break the boundary between reality and illusion, using sharp blades to tear the present world apart.

"The more awake you are in a dream, the more trapped you are in reality."
The awakened shadow projects the despair and darkness from the depths of the soul into people's dreams,
and thus the dream twists into this dark incarnation of disaster.

The genius lost to the past has returned, bringing a dazzling storm of golden starlight and deadly constellation Sorcery. 
 
Stellar Shatter: Hellbound Sentinel moves to the center and summons five celestial spheres that orbit him while he channels. Destroy all five spheres before he finishes channeling, or he will unleash a full-screen attack. 
 
Heavenly Traverse: Hellbound Sentinel summons five hidden constellation shadows and three rotating walls of starlight. Each wall has a gap you can pass through. Move through the gaps to find and destroy all five hidden shadows.

In the advanced challenge, the two Sentinels use stronger teamwork and summon phantom clones to catch you off guard. Sharp eyes are your best defense. 
 
Doomblade Sentinel splits into four phantom clones, each charging a different player. 
 
ALL four phantom clones must hit Pickaxe Sentinel's Inferno Shield to break it. Stay spread out so the clones don't cross paths.

Embermane is a battle-hardened beast that breathes fire and attacks with blade-like claws. It enjoys burning anything that enters its territory, and wherever it stands, the flames linger. 
 
Scorching Inferno: Embermane covers the area in a wave of fire, during which friendly Saepes summon stone pillars around the area one after another. 
 
Pillar Dance: You must jump onto those pillars to avoid the burning ground. Each pillar only supports weight briefly before collapsing, so you and your team need to move and time your jumps carefully. When Embermane's fire attack ends, it becomes exhausted and vulnerable—that is the best moment to deal the most damage.

The Radish King reigns supreme, a terror known far and wide. Its gleaming kitchen knife hints at danger beneath its playful demeanor, as it vows to defend the dignity of the Radishes through battle. 
 
Vine Command: Leaping to the center of the arena, the Radish King knocks back all players, then sounds its horn to ensnare three targets in twisting vines and drag them close. Anyone dragged to the Radish King faces a deadly strike. 
 
Groundbound Cutters: Meanwhile, the knife-wielding Radishes burrow along the edges, chasing unbound players. Guide these little attackers to sever the vines and free your allies before it's too late.

[Commanding Vine Bind]: The Radish King leaps to the center of the arena, knocking back all players, then blows a horn to bind three players with vines and drag them toward itself. Players pulled to the Radish King will suffer a fatal slash.\n\n[Ground-Walking Swordsman]: Blade-wielding small radishes appear at the edge of the arena to pursue unbound players. You must lure the small radishes' slashes to cut the vines and save your teammates.

A Mechcraft warrior wielding a blade of fire. Beneath the black-gold armor, a fiery core burns ceaselessly. The Ten-Thousand-Forge Blade is highly skilled in close-quarters combat, striking with the weight of a mountain. The intense heat of its massive fire blade is enough to melt metal. Few creatures dare to provoke the Ten-Thousand-Forge Blade, and it does not provoke others. Combat is no longer its mission, but its fated destiny.

[Fire Shield Collision]: The Blade-Severing Spirit locks onto a player to charge, while the Lone Halberd Spirit activates a Fire Shield in the center of the field. Players must lure the Blade-Severing Spirit to collide with the Fire Shield three times to successfully break the shield; otherwise, they will suffer massive screen-wide damage.

Mutated under the Aercocoon's influence, they bear striking purple caps that resemble open umbrellas and expel spore cores as a form of self-defence. \n \nEven seasoned warriors armed with swords and spears keep their distance—not because these creatures are invincible, but because their numbing spores are relentlessly troublesome.

Rebels who turned against the academy due to conflicting martial arts philosophies. They are typically burly with powerful arms. The Rebel Hunks swing their giant hammers like the wind, shaking the very earth. These strongmen pursue brute force, even resorting to training methods banned by the academy.
zh_text:
因武道理念不同而与学院作对的破门生。
他们往往身形壮硕，双臂十分有力。
巨锤在破门力士手中挥动如风，撼天动地。

这些破门生中的大力士十分追求蛮力，甚至采取一些被学院禁止的方式进行训练。

text: The town's storyteller mentions the Radish King, then suddenly slams the table and says excitedly: 'This monster looks like a giant radish at first glance. Its surface is covered in uneven textures, like cracked earth that has healed. Green leaves sway atop its head like a towering forest tree. Beneath those unique leaves are a pair of cunning, slanted eyes, flickering with mischief. Most striking of all is the kitchen knife it wields. The blade glints in the sun, clearly no ordinary weapon, and it is devastatingly powerful in use. If you encounter it, remember not to underestimate it. It is one of the finest spirit beasts transformed from a radish. It has incomprehensible behavioral logic, but it is undoubtedly a formidable opponent.'
zh_text:
城中说书人提及莱菔王，登时拍桌而起，兴致勃勃地说道： 
这怪物，乍一看，活像一颗放大了无数倍的萝卜。 
身体表面布满了凹凸不平的纹理，仿佛是土地裂开后又愈合的痕迹。 
头顶翠绿的叶片摇曳生姿，如同森林里的参天大树。 
它那独特的叶片下，是一双狡黠的斜眼，闪烁着顽皮的光芒。 
这怪物最引人注目的，莫过于它手中的那把菜刀。 
菜刀在阳光下闪闪发光，一看就知道不是凡品，而且用起来实乃威力无匹。 
 
若是诸位遇见，可千万记住，切勿小瞧了它。 
其乃是莱菔所幻灵兽的其中佼佼。 
有着令人难以理解的行为逻辑，但毫无疑问，它并不是一个好对手。

text: Bronze automatons forged in the likeness of swimming fish, they have patrolled the ruins alone for a thousand years, using long cries and sharp teeth to drive away any intruders coveting their treasures.\n\n[Heavy Cannon Armor-Piercing]: Operate the mechanical turrets in the arena to continuously attack, and use the turret shields to defend against the mechanical copper fish's scale barrages. Sustained bombardment will break the mechanical copper fish's resilience, causing this giant fish to crash to the ground and fall into a brief state of malfunction.

An unyielding gatekeeper, one who can hold the pass against a thousand riders. With a massive shield, it blocks all who stand before it, enduring like a mountain even in ruin. Forged from a fallen hero's shield, it stands as the pinnacle of mechanised defence. 
 
When icy boulders fall off the cliff, there is no retreat. Its core is etched with unbreakable resolve, its defence impenetrable. 
 
Its back faced the country it fought to defend as the underhanded cavalry streamed into the pass. In the dying light of dusk, as shadows stretch long, reinforcements emerge.

A dark, eerie figure, an incarnate nightmare.
The tall, slender Dreamslayer lurks in the shadows and dreams, waiting for the perfect moment to strike.
The shadows beneath its purple feathers are the prey's final memory, and the moon-blade it wields is the pride of a lone hunter.
The Moon-blade Dreamslayer is born from dreams, one with everything around it.
It moves through the air with ease, its gorgeous slashes like phantoms.

It tears through dream after dream, traversing fantasy after fantasy.
Its dark footsteps are merely the prelude to the hunt; the dreams of the mediocre are the food it survives on.

What is clever is that which benefits people; what is clumsy is that which does not.
Built from rare materials, the strongest automaton pushes its components to their absolute limit.
Mechanic arts follow two paths.
The first is 'Material Supremacy.' Every material has a breaking point, and using complex design to circumvent material weaknesses is the most common philosophy.
The second is 'Exploring the Limit.' The Myriad-Pivot Hammer is the ultimate expression of this design philosophy.
When materials are exceptionally tough, what can be achieved?
Its existence provides the answer.

The construction of the Myriad-Pivot Hammer is actually not complex; the philosophy of 'great skill appearing clumsy' is perfectly embodied in the design of this giant automaton.
However, few creatures can withstand even a single casual strike from it.
Its power far exceeds that of a test subject. So, why was this unnatural automaton created?

The guardian stood firm, a single man holding the pass against a thousand. Giant shields blocked the enemy; though exhausted, it stood like a mountain. Taking the hero's lost shield, the Emperor of Constructs was forged. Ice and rock fell upon the cliff, leaving no retreat for friend or foe. An unyielding belief was embedded in the core, making its defensive techniques unbreakable. Vile iron cavalry flooded the pass, and the defenders turned their backs on their homeland. As the setting sun cast its final glow, reinforcements appeared in the elongated shadows.
zh_text:
守关人岿然不动，一夫当关，千骑莫开。
巨盾阻敌，虽枯不倒，立如峰峦。
取英雄遗盾，锻机关之皇。
冰岩坠落崖间，敌我无路可退。
不屈的坚定信念已嵌入枢核，抵御之技牢不可破。

卑劣铁骑涌入关隘，卫国之躯已背对故土。
当残阳只剩余晖，被拉长的身影中出现了援军。

text:
Mock not the youth for his foolish words, for there is cold solitude at the end of the Heavenly River.
Since the Star Team won the Pinnacle of Dreams, every student at Jixia knows the name of the Child of Stars. He is passionate and unrestrained, with exaggerated speech and actions. He carves poems into the Star-Gazing Platform, his sword pointing toward the brightest star in the glorious galaxy.
Yet, no one knows he swings his sword every night, driven by a fear of being "mediocre."
No one knows how many times his desperate strikes were fueled by the frustration of collapsing before the mirror.
No one knows that beneath his flamboyant confidence, his heart remains shrouded in shadows from his departed parents.

Perhaps even the Child of Stars himself does not realize that his inferiority, his doubts, his fear of loneliness...
Darkness breeds in the depths of his heart, never sparing him when a dream descends.
Until the moment he embraces the nightmare energy, his roar finds a definitive voice.
He is the nightmare of the Child of Stars, and perhaps, he will become yours as well...

He has lingered for a long time in this world, while his companion has returned to where it came. 
 
The Sentinel wanders the valleys. He is a cavalier without a ride. The giant sword on his shoulder shows the hard-to-believe size of his companion. 
 
The only thing he can count on now is the giant sword that's become a part of him. His powerful strike can still cut through mountains and rivers even without a vertical dive. 
 
The dragon rider still holds the pact with the dragon. Since the ride is gone, the place where they parted is likely to be where he will spend the rest of his days.

A Mechcraft warrior wielding a blade of fire. Beneath the black-gold armor, a fiery core burns ceaselessly. The Ten-Thousand-Forge Blade is highly skilled in close-quarters combat, striking with the weight of a mountain. The intense heat of its massive fire blade is enough to melt metal. Few creatures dare to provoke the Ten-Thousand-Forge Blade, and it does not provoke others. Combat is no longer its mission, but its fated destiny.

A falcon affected by dreams.
It has colorful wings like dream butterflies.
Nightshadow Falcons attack quickly and have a hallucinogenic effect on enemies, making it impossible to tell where they are.

In the Dreamland, the cry of the Nightshadow Falcon is the most distinct—melancholy and cold.
Some say that those who dream of a Nightshadow Falcon will meet with misfortune.

Reed Hedgehogs live in swamp areas.
They are short and move with the wind along with the reeds.
Ambushing enemies with blowdarts while hiding in the reeds is the specialty of the Reed Hedgehog Arrow Chief.

People nearby use "Reed Hedgehog Poison Dart" to describe people who like to scheme behind others' backs and are ruthless.

Engraved patterns on fins, gliding through the air.

Until that fisherman's song crosses the sea and returns home.

[Nut Bait]: The Armored Rat King summons several small armored rats to roll around and cause chaos. One of them carries a special nut; defeating it leaves the nut on the field. The Armored Rat King then pulls all players in and binds two of them with resonance vines (the bound are silenced, and if they get too far apart, they are pulled back). The remaining teammates must pick up the nut to lure the King's charge. The two players connected by vines must pull in opposite directions to use the vines as a tripwire to trip the charging giant rat.

A bronze mechanical guard dormant in the Jixia ruins, shaped like a tortoise carrying a load. A mobile bronze turret used for defense. The Lost Xuan-Guard lures enemies deep, and these turrets handle the final cleanup. When intruders are surrounded by other bronze guards, the Lost Cannon-Shells are already charging up, ready to move to high ground and target these uninvited guests.

A strange creature from the dream realm.\nIts bizarre umbrella-shaped body extends into four thick and long tentacles.\nWhen the Dream-Binding Thorn encounters prey, it summons dream thorns to trap them and feed on their dreams.

A mechanical warrior wielding a scorching blade, ruthlessly fulfilling its combat destiny with high temperatures that melt everything and heavy slashes.

【Blazing Blade Light Curtain】: The flame-form Flame-Thunder God Blade will leap to one side of the arena, continuously unleashing flame blade waves that cover the entire field. Use the falling flame sword hilts to block.

【Flame-Cast Thunder Soldier】: Sword hilts shattered by blade waves will turn into thunder swords that track the player. If you skillfully guide the direction of the thunder swords, you can severely damage the Flame-Thunder God Blade.

【Thunder-Drawing Sword Array】: The thunder-form Flame-Thunder God Blade will leap to the other side of the arena, directly summoning thunder swords to bombard the entire field like rain.

[Heavy Hammer Shock Zone]: The Ten-Pivot Heavy Hammer charges and releases a screen-wide shockwave. One player must quickly pick up the mechanical shield dropped on the field to block the attack, while other players stay close behind the shield-bearer to hide. The shockwave will erupt twice in succession; adjust your position in time.

The Mechanical Bronze Fish attempts to destroy the artillery batteries the challenger relies on for counterattacks, dragging the battle into a brutal war of attrition.

[Desperate Battery]: The number of operable mechanical turrets is reduced to two, and the Mechanical Bronze Fish will focus its fire on the turrets, damaging them until they are completely paralyzed.

[Repairing the Magazine]: You must defeat the abandoned mechanisms that constantly emerge in the field, obtain the repair kits they drop, and transport them to the turrets for emergency repairs. If the repaired turrets are continuously maintained, their firepower will be further enhanced.

Might as thunder, movement like the sky's roar.
The Thunder-Bull that once galloped across the vast plains carries thunder in its massive horns.
Now it keeps to itself, keeping company only with the purple clouds.
Its dark fur ripples constantly, like a raging sea.
Its territory is its thunder pool, its fortress.
Any creature that steps foot here will face a thousand-fold thunder strike.
Perhaps it once tried to live in a herd, but those who drew near have surely turned to ash.

It wanders, it stands still.
It destroys, it is lost.
Now, the time has come.

Stone relics fade with time, as the years deepen around the empty hall. 
 
It was awakened only few times. The old man with a white beard stood before it, followed by diligent young men. 
 
As time passed, the pillar collapsed and the land cracked. 
 
Dual-Axe General woke up amidst the ruins. It didn't know where the liveliness of the past had gone, but it remembered its mission: To protect and defend, until the enemy armies retreat, and until people can dream without concerns.

The guardian stood firm, a single man holding the pass against a thousand. Giant shields blocked the enemy; though exhausted, it stood like a mountain. Taking the hero's lost shield, the Emperor of Constructs was forged. Ice and rock fell upon the cliff, leaving no retreat for friend or foe. An unyielding belief was embedded in the core, making its defensive techniques unbreakable. Vile iron cavalry flooded the pass, and the defenders turned their backs on their homeland. As the setting sun cast its final glow, reinforcements appeared in the elongated shadows.
zh_text:
守关人岿然不动，一夫当关，千骑莫开。
巨盾阻敌，虽枯不倒，立如峰峦。
取英雄遗盾，锻机关之皇。
冰岩坠落崖间，敌我无路可退。
不屈的坚定信念已嵌入枢核，抵御之技牢不可破。

卑劣铁骑涌入关隘，卫国之躯已背对故土。
当残阳只剩余晖，被拉长的身影中出现了援军。

text: A Mechcraft warrior wielding a blade of fire. Beneath the crimson armor, a fiery core burns ceaselessly. The Ten-Thousand-Forge Blade is highly skilled in close-quarters combat, striking with the weight of a mountain. The intense heat of its massive fire blade is enough to melt metal. Few creatures dare to provoke the Blazing Blade Warrior. Every swing is accompanied by scalding steam and churning magma. Combat is no longer its mission, but its fated destiny.
zh_text:
手握炽热战刃的机关战将。 
赤红色铠甲之下那炽热的核心，一刻不息地燃烧着。 
万锻神刃将十分擅长近距离搏斗，攻击袭来之时如同泰山压顶。 
那把巨大火刃的高温足以流金铄石。 
 
几乎没有生物敢于招惹怒炎神刃将。 
它的每一次挥砍，都裹挟着滚烫的蒸汽，翻滚着炽热的岩浆。 
战斗已不是它的使命，而是既定的宿命。

text: [Flame Array]: All stone pillars will rise simultaneously and collapse after bearing weight for a short time.\n\n[Dance Covenant]: The team must act in unison to transfer between pillars, utilizing each one efficiently within the limited time. Any member lagging behind may disrupt the overall rhythm, leading to casualties.

[Red Flame Burning Field]: The Embermane spits out flames, turning the entire field into a sea of fire. At this time, friendly wooden fences will rise in stone pillars around the field.\n\n[Flame Pillar Dance]: Players must jump onto the stone pillars in time to avoid the ground flames. After the fire-breathing ends, the Embermane will enter a state of exhaustion due to energy depletion; this is the best time for full output.

An ancient long-range combat automaton.
The Bailian Cannon Automaton's arms have been modified into heavy cannons, and its gold-plated barrels are extremely durable, never missing a shot.

They wander the ruins of war; though they have lost their mission, they still hold their posts.

A dark, eerie figure, an incarnate nightmare.
The tall, slender Dreamslayer lurks in the shadows and dreams, waiting for the perfect moment to strike.
The shadows beneath its purple feathers are the prey's final memory, and the moon-blade it wields is the pride of a lone hunter.
The Moon-blade Dreamslayer is born from dreams, one with everything around it.
It moves through the air with ease, its gorgeous slashes like phantoms.

It tears through dream after dream, traversing fantasy after fantasy.
Its dark footsteps are merely the prelude to the hunt; the dreams of the mediocre are the food it survives on.

Priests of the Saepes tribe.
They are vines formed from the extension of the tribe's will, capable of using the power of their ancestors to defend against invading enemies.
The scepter they hold is forked and twisted at the top, wreathed in whispers that only they can understand.

Saepes Summoners guide the migration of the Saepes tribe, always finding environments suitable for the growth of Saepes trees.
Researchers believe that the unique connection between the Summoner and the Saepes tree is the key to their tribe's survival and prosperity.
zh_text:
木篱部落的祭司。 
它是种群意志延伸而成的枝蔓，能够借助先祖的力量抵御来犯之敌。 
持握着的权杖在顶端分岔扭曲，其上萦绕着只有它能听懂的呢喃低语。 
 
木篱唤师指引着木篱种群的迁移，它们总能找到适宜木篱树生长的环境。 
研究者们认为，唤师与木篱树的独特联系，是它所在族群繁衍生息的关键所在。

text:
Doomblade Sentinel fights with fiery aggression. Pickaxe Sentinel stands firm and unbreakable like a mountain. They arrive with the Calamity Star to carry out the Sanctified's orders. 
 
Pickaxe Sentinel activates an Inferno Shield while charging up a full-screen attack. The shield protects him during the charge. 
 
Doomblade Sentinel repeatedly charges toward players. 
 
Have Doomblade strike the Inferno Shield three times. After the third hit, the shield breaks, and Pickaxe Sentinel's attack is interrupted.

In the advanced challenge, Megadrive Hammer's Mech Core goes into overdrive. It teleports and attacks from multiple sites. 
 
Triple Shock: Megadrive Hammer fires three full-screen shockwaves in a row. Before each shockwave, it teleports to the edge of the arena, so each wave comes from a different direction. 
 
Shield Relay: After a player uses the Shield to block a shockwave, that player cannot use the Shield again for a short time. Another teammate must pick up and use the Shield to block the next shockwave coming from a different direction.

Doomblade Sentinel repeatedly charges toward players. 
 
Have Doomblade strike the Inferno Shield three times. After the third hit, the shield breaks, and Pickaxe Sentinel's attack is interrupted.

The balance between ice and fire has been completely shattered, and the mechanism reveals a cataclysmic, apocalyptic form.\n\n【Sky-Falling Cold Abyss】: The Relic Ice-Fire Guardian leaps into the air, pouring a massive amount of icicles across the arena. If not cleared in time, the icicles will detonate in a chain reaction, covering the entire field. After pouring the icicles, the Relic Ice-Fire Guardian becomes briefly stunned due to excessive energy consumption—this is the perfect moment to finish it off.

This place was ruined by excessive flooding. The craftsmen worked around the clock to come up with a solution. 
 
Station Ruins Sentry, shaped like a bastion, hides the secrets of the past. 
 
Its large, many-jointed legs give it remarkable flexibility. 
 
With strong defenses and powerful attacks, it is built for simple, brutal tactics that crush invaders. 
 
Station Ruins Sentry was created to move stones and hold back the sea, leaving behind a vast underground world of winding rivers and strange creatures.

[Fire Shield Collision]: The Blade-Severing Spirit locks onto a player to charge, while the Lone Halberd Spirit activates a Fire Shield in the center of the field. Players must lure the Blade-Severing Spirit to collide with the Fire Shield three times to successfully break the shield; otherwise, they will suffer massive screen-wide damage.

A cold-hearted hunter of the Dreamscape.
Ethereal in form, with magnificent wings and a tail that fans out at the tip.
Armed with a long-handled feather fan, it excels at casting homing magic projectiles and can draw energy from void rifts to unleash wide-sweeping beams.

Legend says these fan-wielding Botu were once scholars obsessed with the arcane. In their pursuit of the ultimate truth, they peered into the Dreamscape and lost their way. In this Dream of Lanke, the illusions they summon are nothing more than fleeting phantoms.
zh_text:
梦境中的冷峻猎手。 
体态飘然，翼色瑰丽，尾至末梢展作屏。 
手握长柄羽扇，善施法发射索敌的魔力弹丸，也会牵引虚空裂缝中的能量，化为光束进行大范围横扫。 
 
传说这些持扇的伯屠曾是痴心魔道的学者，为了追求极致，窥探呓境，不慎走火入魔，在这烂柯之梦中，所召出的虚幻也不过是莫须有的泡影。

text: [Deadly Starfall]: The Calamity Meteorites appearing now are enhanced by the source of the Calamity Star. Their stability is greatly increased, requiring players to pour in stronger attacks to shatter them.\n\n[Vortex Storm]: The rotation speed of the starlight walls becomes extremely fast, and the safe gaps disappear in an instant. Thus, the pressure of tracking the constellation shadows is also greatly increased, posing a huge test to the team's output and coordination.

An ancient creature from the dream realm.
Its beak is like a hook, and its claws are as sharp as blades.
The tail rattles as its slender body dances in the air, weaving through dreams.

It attacks particularly quickly at close range and will unexpectedly cast spells during skirmishes.
But the most dangerous situation is when they appear alongside other dream creatures.
If an ordinary person falls into such a trap, they can only pray to be woken up.

Four legs on the ground, hidden in flames. When lightning strikes, the battle never ends.
When the clouds fall, the wildfire rises.
The fire-breathing giant lizard turns the land it treads into scorched earth.
The scars it leaves are hard to erase, and nothing grows where it passes.
Successive challengers have tried to drive away this disaster, but few have succeeded.
Even wounding it only adds to its fury.
The source of its restlessness is the gloom gathering on the horizon.

It rolls like red clouds, never stopping.
The struggle between the lizard kings was once endless, until the person riding the strange mount appeared.
zh_text:
“立地四足，常隐于灼炎。遇雷，则斗不休。” 
云落之时，燎火升。 
吞吐烈焰的巨蜥，践踏之地沦为焦土。 
它的造成的伤痕难以消尽，所过之处寸草不生。 
前仆后继的挑战者试图驱逐这一灾害，然成功者寥寥。 
即便伤它分毫，也只是徒增了愤怒。 
它躁动的源头，是天边聚集的阴霾。 
 
它卷若赤霞，不止不休。 
蜥王之间的斗争曾经永无休止，直到那个乘坐怪异坐骑的人出现。

The Relic Fire-Crack Armor is a specialized mechanical construct abandoned in the Jixia ruins.
Made of bronze, the upper body resembles a furnace, and the lower body resembles a spider.
When the mechanism is triggered, the patterns flash with fire, warning of an impending explosion.

It is said that after an explosion, the remaining core attracts surrounding bronze to reshape its body.

The leader of the Embermanes has fiery hair and blade-like claws. The flames are fierce, but its hair never burns.
Having fought its way to kingship, it leads the pack.
The flames it breathes scorch its throat, making it even more excited.
The burning prey is a playful toy. It is the one in control, while the challenger is only fit to defend.
The Embermane once challenged others, but now, it has become the king.
At this moment, the red shadow standing among the beasts will shock all living things.

With its arrival, the fire ignites.
With its departure, the fire will eventually extinguish.
zh_text:
“群绒之首，其发如火，爪如刃。其火虽盛，发却不燃。”
历战成王，率领群绒的首领。
吐息的烈焰烧灼着咽喉，让它更加兴奋。
被燃烧的猎物，是戏谑的玩物。它才能掌控，而挑战者只配抵挡。
灼绒也曾挑战，但现在的它，业已成王。
此刻，矗立在群兽中的赤影，将震撼所有生灵。

伴随着它的到来，火燃了起来。
伴随着它的离去，火终会熄灭。

text: [Brutal Charge]: The Savage Tiger raises its shield and locks onto a player to charge continuously. The locked player must adjust their position to avoid hitting teammates, while other players can take the opportunity to attack the Savage Tiger's back. The final charge is a red-light skill; dodge in time.\n\n[Earth-Shattering Thunder]: The Savage Tiger leaps to the center of the field and slams the ground repeatedly, creating expanding shockwaves. Players can avoid them by jumping or dodging; the final strike is a red-light skill, so pay extra attention.

The strongman often wanders outside Jixia Academy, gazing at the scholarly atmosphere within. His companions call him "Skyfire Morningstar" because his flaming heavy hammer can easily crush stone into magma. He never mentions that he left scorch marks from his hammer when he betrayed his sect. He viewed his master's self-restraint as cowardice, believing only the heat of his flames could represent his sense of justice.\n\nHowever, after being looked up to as a leader by this group of rebels, he has begun to realize the truth. The process of enlightenment is not as simple as martial arts, and he is not yet ready to apologize to his master.
zh_text:
力士常年徘徊在稷下学院之外，远眺那一方书声朗朗。
伙伴总爱称他一句“天火锤星”，因着那把流火重锤轻易就能把石头碾作岩浆。
但他从未提起过，自己叛离师门时也留下了火焰的锤痕。
师长的克己被他视为懦弱，火痕的炽热才能代表他的义心。

但被这群破门少年视作大哥后，他也逐渐察觉到了个中道理。
只是参悟的过程不比练武简单，对恩师表达歉意一事，他还没有做好准备。

He never mentions that he left scorch marks from his hammer when he betrayed his sect. text:
Stonepines tower above, lush and green, as if standing amidst the clouds.
Treasure hunters and adventurers visiting the Ghostpath City know to steer clear of a certain dark patch of land, even though the soil looks no different from anywhere else, and even supports a dense grove of trees.
But they know those aren't trees—they are a single, colossal trunk, reaching high into the clouds.

Once, the Earth-Shaking Wildwood was just a young Saepes. Time gave it a gargantuan body, but eroded its clarity of mind.
After being abandoned in this cage, it always tries to hold onto everyone who passes by, but people only scream and flee.
It doesn't understand, so with each subsequent attempt, it becomes more forceful and frantic, pushing the very objects of its affection further away.
zh_text:
“仰视岩石松树，郁郁苍苍，如在云中。”
前来幽径城的探宝者与冒险家们都会心照不宣地绕开一处阴暗地，尽管那片泥土和别处并无二致，甚至孕育出一片茂密的树林。
但他们知道，那并非树林而是独木，高不见顶，耸入云端。

曾经，撼地狂木也是一只幼小的木篱，只是年岁给予了它庞然的身躯，也磨去了它清明的神志。
它被抛弃到这座囚笼之后，总是试图挽留每一个经过它身边的人，但人们往往尖叫着逃开。
它不解，便在下一次的挽留中更加用力、更加疯狂，也把它想要亲近的对象越推越远。

text: [Triple Shockwave]: The Megadrive Hammer releases three consecutive full-screen shockwaves. Before releasing them, it teleports to the edge of the arena, with each shockwave facing a different direction;\n\n[Mechanism Support]: Before launching a full-screen attack, the Megadrive Hammer summons two mechanical minions, one of which will grab a shield from the field first. The team must prioritize killing the shield-bearing minion to reclaim the shield; otherwise, they will be unable to block the subsequent devastating full-screen attack.

[Star Vortex Strike]: The Celestial Spirit returns to the center of the field to channel star power, summoning five constellations to rotate around it. Players must quickly destroy all star nodes to interrupt its chant. Success causes its spirit to collapse; failure results in a screen-wide Starfall attack.\n\n[Heavenly Barrier Shuttle]: The Celestial Spirit summons five hidden constellation shadows and drives four constantly rotating starlight walls. There are gaps in the walls for escape. Players must nimbly shuttle between the gaps to find and destroy all hidden constellation shadows.

The Radish King is formidable enough, but its cunning tricks are the real headache. Watch out for explosive radishes hidden underground—triggering them will lead to a disaster. 
 
Explosive Ambush: As it leaps to the arena center, the Radish King plants multiple explosive traps. Any player dragged through a trap triggers a blast, leaving scorched terrain that continues to burn. 
 
Save from The Brink: Those knife-wielding Radishes now strike faster than ever. You and your team must carefully navigate traps and fire zones while guiding the Little Radishes to sever the vines. Any misstep can cause casualties.

Backed into a corner, the Saepes King frantically siphons power from its subjects. Its body becomes indestructible, surging with mountain-shattering rage. 
 
Ancient Bulwark: Its thorn armor is heavily fortified, requiring extra effort to break through. 
 
Rage Drain: While in its giant form, the Saepes King's Attack escalates rapidly. You and your team must intercept and attack more efficiently to strive for survival.

[Heavy Hammer Shock Zone]: The Ten-Pivot Heavy Hammer charges and releases a screen-wide shockwave. One player must quickly pick up the mechanical shield dropped on the field to block the attack, while other players stay close behind the shield-bearer to hide. The shockwave will erupt twice in succession; adjust your position in time.

This lost war machine is the ultimate expression of the ancient craftsmen's theory of 'Ice and Fire Coexistence.' Red and blue energy flows and intertwines within its barrels.\n\n[Frostfire Break]: The Frostfire Guard fires a cold current, trapping one or two players in ice pillars, while firing homing molten missiles at the others. You must lure the missiles to break the ice pillars and save your teammates, otherwise, the missiles will hit you and cause continuous burning.

Fighters of the Saepes tribe.
The spear tip in their hands resembles a vibrant bud ready to bloom.
Do not be deceived by its colorful appearance and overlook its terrifying piercing power.

Although Saepes weapons are very crude, they cherish them greatly and often use stone tools to polish and maintain them.

手中长矛的枪尖犹如娇艳待放的花苞。

木篱的武器虽然十分粗糙，但它们对自己的武器十分爱护，经常用石器打磨维护。

text: [Desperate Grain Guard]: The HP of small armored rats is significantly increased, requiring higher firepower to clear quickly. At the same time, the lure range after the nut lands shrinks extremely fast. The coordination between the nut carrier and the vine-pulling teammate must be millisecond-perfect; any delay may lead to failed tripwires and the loss of the granary.

The guardian stood firm, a single man holding the pass against a thousand. Giant shields blocked the enemy; though exhausted, it stood like a mountain. Taking the hero's lost shield, the Emperor of Constructs was forged. Ice and rock fell upon the cliff, leaving no retreat for friend or foe. An unyielding belief was embedded in the core, making its defensive techniques unbreakable. Vile iron cavalry flooded the pass, and the defenders turned their backs on their homeland. As the setting sun cast its final glow, reinforcements appeared in the elongated shadows.
zh_text:
守关人岿然不动，一夫当关，千骑莫开。
巨盾阻敌，虽枯不倒，立如峰峦。
取英雄遗盾，锻机关之皇。
冰岩坠落崖间，敌我无路可退。
不屈的坚定信念已嵌入枢核，抵御之技牢不可破。

卑劣铁骑涌入关隘，卫国之躯已背对故土。
当残阳只剩余晖，被拉长的身影中出现了援军。

The genius lost to the past has returned, bringing a dazzling storm of golden starlight and deadly constellation Sorcery. 
 
Stellar Shatter: Hellbound Sentinel moves to the center and summons five celestial spheres that orbit him while he channels. Destroy all five spheres before he finishes channeling, or he will unleash a full-screen attack. 
 
Heavenly Traverse: Hellbound Sentinel summons five hidden constellation shadows and three rotating walls of starlight. Each wall has a gap you can pass through. Move through the gaps to find and destroy all five hidden shadows.

The Rebel Hunks swing their giant hammers like the wind, shaking the very earth. These strongmen pursue brute force, even resorting to training methods banned by the academy.

因武道理念不同而与学院作对的破门生。
他们往往身形壮硕，双臂十分有力。
巨锤在破门力士手中挥动如风，撼天动地。

这些破门生中的大力士十分追求蛮力，甚至采取一些被学院禁止的方式进行训练。

text:

Their most distinct feature is that oversized spiked club.
Anyone struck by it, even if not severely injured by the force, will suffer greatly from the barbs on the club.

However, in the face of their natural predator, the Embermane, these crude Saepes weapons are like mere firewood, so the Saepes are rarely found where the Embermane appears.

其最鲜明的特征就是那把特大号的狼牙棒。
被它打中的敌人，就算未被猛力击伤，也会因木棒上的倒刺痛苦不已。

text:
Tigrex, a fierce Rebel leader in the mountain forests, now bursts into the Three-School Showdown. With iron claws and relentless force, he wants to dominate the competition and prove that only destruction shows true power. 
 
Brutal Charge: Tigrex locks onto one player and charges toward them repeatedly. The targeted player should avoid staying close to allies so they don't get hit, while others should attack Tigrex from behind. The final charge is red-glowing. It's stronger, so be careful. 
 
Earth Shaker: Tigrex leaps to the center of the arena and slams the ground several times, sending out circular shockwaves. Jump or dash to dodge the waves. The final slam is red-glowing and is more powerful. Watch out.

[Desperate Fire Shield]: The charges initiated by the four phantom clones of the Blade-Severing Spirit must all be lured into the Lone Halberd Spirit's Fire Shield. Any mistake will result in failure to break the shield, testing the team's precise execution and coordination.

The Frostmane Spike Bear dominates the Aerux peak. Its mane has turned to crystal. It is powerful, lonely, and restless, smashing rocks and trees in its wake. Once a target of bounties, it is now a warning to stay away. The town lies in ruins, leaving only decayed wood and scattered fragments.
zh_text:
云根贯空之巅，无它者存立。
硕根之上的霸主，鬃毛已化为光莹的晶体。
漆黑的阴影随日落笼罩山麓，肆意的鼾声响破黎明。
它生于云根核心，长于云流富足之所。
它屡战屡胜，却日益孤独。
过剩的能量，让它无处宣泄。
把磐石拍碎，摧万树折腰。
芒鬓巨熊寻不得一个匹敌的对手。

对它持续无数年的悬赏令，早已替换成勿近的警示。
然现在，城镇也已破败，只剩下腐蚀的残木与零碎的断章。

text:
Freeze the camp with ice, and burn it with fire. 
 
Those words are carved into the Mechanoid. They show the creator's understanding of war and explain its purpose. 
 
Two energies fused and fed each other, amplifying the cannon fire so no defense could hold. 
 
Yet the Mechanoid lay abandoned beneath the ruins. It never got a chance to be used. The horn for the counterattack never sounded—the craftsmen who built it had already died defending it.

The core energy of the Ice-Fire Sentinel is losing balance, pushing its combat instincts to the limit.\n\n[Ice-Fire Consumption]: Players trapped in ice pillars will suffer from biting cold, continuously losing HP, and take heavy damage from an ice explosion when the freezing ends. Guiding molten missiles to save them is urgent.

Humanoid combat constructs created by the academy. They usually stand behind the Nimble Vanguards, using staves to fire projectiles from a distance. They are programmed to only attack students attempting the canyon trial. Once their core is damaged, they will move erratically or spin in place.
zh_text:
学院制造的人形战斗机关。
平时它们站在近卫巧兵的后面，手持法杖发射火球进行远程攻击。

它们受指令影响只会攻击前来峡谷试炼的学生，魔道巧兵的核心被攻击后会前后左右乱动，或在原地旋转。

One player must quickly pick up the Shield from the ground and face the wave to block it. Other players should stay close behind the Shield-bearer to stay safe. Its hair is like fire, and its claws are like blades. Although its fire is intense, its hair does not burn. 
 
After numerous battles, the Embermane became the king of its kin. Its flaming breath scorches its throat, further exciting its ferocity. 
 
Burning prey are mere toys to it, as it maintains total control, leaving challengers always on the defensive. 
 
Once a challenger itself, the Embermane has now ascended the throne. It stands head and shoulders above all beasts as a fearsome symbol to all living creatures. 
 
Its arrival brings fire, and its departure hints at the death of those flames.

Bifang has turned its obsession with protection into indiscriminate destruction. It deploys an invisible shield made of scorching lightning and begins a cold, endless cleanup cycle.

[Thunderbreak]: The only way to survive lies in the sealed turrets at the four corners of the arena. You must lure Bifang's lightning to hit the turrets to activate them, then operate the turrets to bombard the shield.

Fighters of the Saepes tribe.
Their most distinct feature is that oversized spiked club.
Anyone struck by it, even if not severely injured by the force, will suffer greatly from the barbs on the club.

text:
Bi Fang, the essence of wood; it looks like a bird and does not eat the five grains.
A giant bronze bird, chirping day and night. Its cry is fierce, and all who hear it weep in sorrow.
Bi Fang has forgotten many things, but it remembers its own name.
Its single leg is rusted, its wings are mottled, but its eyes still burn with a cyan, scorching fire, matching the deep flow-patterns on its body.

The tall ship gave it the mission to fly, to guard, and to fight.
But now the ship has capsized, and it still tries to fulfill its mission, even though everything it could protect has turned to ruins.
So it cries out, to at least hold onto its name, with a pride that is almost shattering:
Bi Fang, Bi Fang.

This place was ruined by excessive flooding. The craftsmen worked around the clock to come up with a solution. 
 
Station Ruins Sentry, shaped like a bastion, hides the secrets of the past. 
 
Its large, many-jointed legs give it remarkable flexibility. 
 
With strong defenses and powerful attacks, it is built for simple, brutal tactics that crush invaders. 
 
Station Ruins Sentry was created to move stones and hold back the sea, leaving behind a vast underground world of winding rivers and strange creatures.

[Mechanical Heavy Shield Charge]: When the Savage Tiger charges with its shield, the shield has independent durability. Players must focus fire to break it to paralyze the boss; otherwise, the final unavoidable red-light charge will deal devastating damage.\n\n[Earth-Shattering Impact]: After charging, the Savage Tiger immediately leaps to the center of the field and slams the ground repeatedly, causing screen-wide shockwave damage. Only by picking up the dropped Mechanical Heavy Shield can you block it; jumping or dodging is useless.

The relentless harassment has ignited Bifang's mania, and its attacks are as dense as a storm.

[Blazing Thunder Strike]: The scorching lightning bolts will become four consecutive strikes, slamming into the ground more frequently and urgently, posing a severe test for arena positioning.

[Rising Fury]: Shortens the interval between lightning strikes and capture attempts, giving players almost no chance to catch their breath.

The gluttonous Armadillo Rat King has called in backup to steal your supplies, a Sly Rat! It strikes fast. One mistake, and you're down! \n \nIn addition to the standard mechanics, a Sly Rat now charges along a fixed path repeatedly. If it collides with a nut-bearer, the nut will drop. One of you must focus on intercepting it while others clear the smaller rolling Armored Rats, or your formation will fall apart fast.

An ancient long-range combat automaton.
The Bailian Cannon Automaton's arms have been modified into heavy cannons, with the sound of thunder and lightning echoing endlessly.

Amidst the eternal thunder of its cannons, does it occasionally recall the stormy nights of its memories?

Saepes King rules with absolute authority. It uses its scepter to overpower anyone who opposes it. 
 
Vinebind Assault: Thick vines trap all players while Saepes charge in with spears. Break free quickly to avoid the incoming strikes. 
 
Soul Siphon: Saepes King drains life from nearby Saepes, growing huge and wrapping himself in thorn armor that blocks damage. Saepes Catapultors spawn and fling fireballs—grab those fireballs and throw them at Saepes King to shatter his armor. Otherwise, his size and power will keep increasing and threaten to crush the whole area.

The strongman often wanders outside Jixia Academy, gazing at the scholarly atmosphere within. His companions call him "Skyfire Morningstar" because his flaming heavy hammer can easily crush stone into magma. He never mentions that he left scorch marks from his hammer when he betrayed his sect. He viewed his master's self-restraint as cowardice, believing only the heat of his flames could represent his sense of justice.\n\nHowever, after being looked up to as a leader by this group of rebels, he has begun to realize the truth. The process of enlightenment is not as simple as martial arts, and he is not yet ready to apologize to his master.
zh_text:
力士常年徘徊在稷下学院之外，远眺那一方书声朗朗。
伙伴总爱称他一句“天火锤星”，因着那把流火重锤轻易就能把石头碾作岩浆。
但他从未提起过，自己叛离师门时也留下了火焰的锤痕。
师长的克己被他视为懦弱，火痕的炽热才能代表他的义心。

但被这群破门少年视作大哥后，他也逐渐察觉到了个中道理。
只是参悟的过程不比练武简单，对恩师表达歉意一事，他还没有做好准备。

text: [Star Vortex Strike]: The Celestial Spirit returns to the center of the field to channel star power, summoning five constellations to rotate around it. Players must quickly destroy all star nodes to interrupt its chant. Success causes its spirit to collapse; failure results in a screen-wide Starfall attack.\n\n[Heavenly Barrier Shuttle]: The Celestial Spirit summons five hidden constellation shadows and drives four constantly rotating starlight walls. There are gaps in the walls for escape. Players must nimbly shuttle between the gaps to find and destroy all hidden constellation shadows.

The Relic Armored Soldier is a bronze mechanical captain guarding the Jixia ruins.
Strange patterns cover its bronze structure.
They hold sharp, ancient spears, attacking quickly and lethally.

It is said that only those with distinguished military service can earn the title of 'Hundred-General'.
Only by defeating one hundred enemies can one command one hundred soldiers.

[Seed-Explosion Ambush]: When leaping to the center of the field, the Radish King pre-plants multiple explosive small radish traps. Dragged players who pass through traps will trigger area explosions and leave behind burning scorched earth.\n\n[Desperate Support]: The pursuit of the blade-wielding small radishes is more ferocious. The team must precisely guide the radishes to cut the vines while avoiding traps and fire zones; any mistake may lead to casualties.

Razor Aeroclads are melee Mechanoids crafted by the academy using Aerux. Their bark-like bodies are clad in Aerux armor etched with curved patterns. Wielding a single wooden blade, every movement from drawing to sheathing is clearly visible.\n\nThe Aeroclad series consists of basic Mechanoids created by the Mechanist Academy using Aerux as the primary material, reinforced with metal.

单持木刀，从出鞘到收招，都可以看得一清二楚。

云铠系列是机关学院以云根为主材，辅以金属打造的基础机关人。

text: The guardian stood firm, a single man holding the pass against a thousand. Giant shields blocked the enemy; though exhausted, it stood like a mountain. Taking the hero's lost shield, the Emperor of Constructs was forged. Ice and rock fell upon the cliff, leaving no retreat for friend or foe. An unyielding belief was embedded in the core, making its defensive techniques unbreakable. Vile iron cavalry flooded the pass, and the defenders turned their backs on their homeland. As the setting sun cast its final glow, reinforcements appeared in the elongated shadows.
zh_text:
守关人岿然不动，一夫当关，千骑莫开。
巨盾阻敌，虽枯不倒，立如峰峦。
取英雄遗盾，锻机关之皇。
冰岩坠落崖间，敌我无路可退。
不屈的坚定信念已嵌入枢核，抵御之技牢不可破。

卑劣铁骑涌入关隘，卫国之躯已背对故土。
当残阳只剩余晖，被拉长的身影中出现了援军。

text:
Tender buds and body, learning to walk clumsily. 
 
When tender buds get nutrients from the old body, life begins anew. 
 
Thorns cover the body of the Saepes, protecting the fragile primary bud. The face on the mask serves as a decoy, while the Saepes is filled with anticipation, eager to embrace every creature it encounters for the first time. 
 
Does the new life represent a continuation of its past? When most of its body is renewed, does it remember who it once was?
zh_text:
“幼芽灌躯，蹒跚学步。”
当稚嫩蔓芽盘入化作养分的旧躯壳，新生伊始。
它荆棘密布的身躯保护了脆弱的主芽。
面具上的脸孔也只是伪装。
此时此刻，它饱含憧憬。
一定要与初见的每个生物，真诚地拥抱交流。

它们周而复始的生命，究竟算不算自我的延续？
当归属自身的大部分被替换，它们意识主导的核心，能否记起曾经的自我？

text:
The Ruin-Guarding Mystic Sentinel has awakened ancient constructs buried deep underground, triggering a joint siege.

[Lost Pursuers]: Lost Artillery will prioritize bombarding the Burning Mountain Pivot; players must immediately draw their fire.

[Corroded Clamp]: Lost Clamps will hinder player movement; you must split your forces to clear them. Please defeat the Ruin-Guarding Mystic Sentinel as quickly as possible amidst these multiple interferences.

[Red Flame Burning Field]: The Embermane spits out flames, turning the entire field into a sea of fire. At this time, friendly wooden fences will rise in stone pillars around the field.\n\n[Flame Pillar Dance]: Players must jump onto the stone pillars in time to avoid the ground flames. After the fire-breathing ends, the Embermane will enter a state of exhaustion due to energy depletion; this is the best time for full output.

The two Sentinels act as one, dominating the battlefield through perfect teamwork. Even a small mistake can lead to disaster. \n \nTo break Pickaxe Sentinel's Inferno Shield, ALL four phantom clones of Doomblade Sentinel must strike it. This tests your team's coordination.

Sentry Flamequenchers are modified combat constructs created by the academy. Their perfect geometric design of spheres and cylinders is a masterpiece of the master artificers. These constructs possess immense attack power and the ability to manipulate fire, easily crushing ordinary soldiers.\n\nSentry Mechanoids typically join the battlefield after key structures are destroyed, helping to accelerate the advance.
zh_text:
巡卫淬火兵是学院改良的战斗机关。 
球体与圆柱的完美几何构造，是机关大师的得意之作。 
这种机关兵攻击能力极强，还附加了对火焰的操控，对一般小兵有着碾压之势。 
 
巡卫巨兵一般会在关键建筑被摧毁后才加入战场，帮助己方更快推进。

text: Rebels who turned against the academy due to conflicting martial arts philosophies. They are cunning and agile. Carrying daggers, they strike silently and quickly, seemingly possessing a special ability to mask their own sounds. Rebel Shadowblades excel at ambushing enemies from the shadows, and rumors about them frighten timid students from walking alone at night.
zh_text:
因武道理念不同而与学院作对的破门生。
这群人大多生性狡猾，身手敏捷。
他们侧怀匕首，攻击迅速，行动悄无声息，似乎有着消除自身声音的特殊能力。

破门隐锋擅长在暗处袭击敌人，各种各样的关于破门生的传闻吓得一些胆小的学子不敢独自走夜路。

text:
Though the Saepes lives long, an end to its life will still come along.
The aged Giant Saepes drags its withered, wooden body, wandering the wilderness.
Its gnarled, mottled branches have witnessed the passage of time, and the rings on its cross-section are beyond counting.
Even so, it remains furious.
As if it wants to leave proof that it lived before turning into rotting wood.

What exactly is a Saepes? Where do their thoughts come from?
These questions no longer matter to it. While Cloudsilk elevated its life, it did not change its fate as a biological entity.
zh_text:
“巨篱虽寿，犹有尽时。”
迟暮的巨篱拖着枯木残躯，游荡旷野。
它苍劲斑驳的枝干见证了岁月变迁，断面上的年轮也已无法计数。
即便如此，它依旧愤怒。
仿佛要在化作朽木之前，留下活过的证据。

木篱究竟是什么？它们的思想从何而来？
这些对于它都已经没有意义，云丝虽然升格了它的生命，却没有改变它作为生物的宿命。

text: [Burning Earth Hell]: Damage from ground flames is significantly increased; even brief contact can be fatal.\n\n[Desperate Pillar Dance]: The number of stone pillars rising on the field is reduced, and they collapse faster. The team must make precise movement decisions within an extremely tight timeframe.

[Commanding Vine Bind]: The Radish King leaps to the center of the arena, knocking back all players, then blows a horn to bind three players with vines and drag them toward itself. Players pulled to the Radish King will suffer a fatal slash.\n\n[Ground-Walking Swordsman]: Blade-wielding small radishes appear at the edge of the arena to pursue unbound players. You must lure the small radishes' slashes to cut the vines and save your teammates.

The Rebels turned against the academy as a result of differences in their Sorcery beliefs. \n \nThey carry many Telepathic Threads in their wristguards to reduce the harmful effects of energy surges. Because they can't channel power for long, they prefer to unleash explosive blasts that instantly freeze their enemies. The cold from these attacks, combined with their usual sensory overload, makes them even drowsier.

Lost in the Jixia ruins, they possess a crab-like pincer and a flamethrower that glows with heat. 
They perform maintenance within the ruins and use their flamethrowers to clear obstacles as needed. 
 
A novice Crafter curiously asks, "Would the flamethrower melt its pincer?"

The enraged Hellbound Sentinel channels a chaotic astral flow. His precise Sorcery attacks are lethal—one mistake can kill you. 
 
Star Ring Detonation: Hellbound Sentinel moves to the center, summons five celestial spheres that orbit him while he channels, and creates three expanding circular damage zones. Avoid those zones and destroy all five spheres before he finishes channeling. 
 
Shattered Star Pursuit: The rotating walls speed up, and Hellbound Sentinel summons three extra energy orbs for each player that relentlessly track you. Dodge the orbs, move through the gaps in the walls, and destroy all five hidden constellation shadows.

The guerrilla hid at the border, flashing ninety-nine times to annihilate two hundred enemies. Exhausted, he died, but his soul remains, forever etched in martial arts. Taking the hero's discarded cannon, they forged the King of Mechanoids. Lightning and long songs intersect; ice shards and gunfire weave together. The stored, bizarre tactics have merged with the machine, making its long-range skills divine.\n\nAn undefeated army enters the swamp; their defeat is already sealed. They have been surrounded—by one person.
zh_text:
游击士伏敌边境，九十九闪，灭二百敌。
力竭而亡，其魂不灭，长存武中。
取英豪遗炮，铸成机关之皇。
雷光与长歌交错，冰棱与铳音交织。
寄存的奇诡战术已融入机关，远攻之技出神入化。

无败之师迈入森沼，必输之战已经注定。
它们已被包围，被一个人。

雷光与长歌交错，冰棱与铳音交织。
寄存的奇诡战术已融入机关，远攻之技出神入化。

无败之师迈入森沼，必输之战已经注定。
它们已被包围，被一个人。
official_target_text: The guerrilla hid at the border, flashing ninety-nine times to annihilate two hundred enemies. Exhausted, he died, but his soul remains, forever etched in martial arts. Taking the hero's discarded cannon, they forged the King of Mechanoids. Lightning and long songs intersect; ice shards and gunfire weave together. The stored, bizarre tactics have merged with the machine, making its long-range skills divine.\n\nAn undefeated army enters the swamp; their defeat is already sealed. They have been surrounded—by one person.

text: Lord Botu is a cold hunter who has fallen into the dream. He comes wrapped in darkness, vowing to drag this dream into total destruction.\n\n[Deepest Nightmare]: Lord Botu summons a deep darkness that devours everything. The bright area around the Nightmare Light Platform can protect players from the continuous erosion of the darkness. Only by finding the two Nightmare Feather Guards that appear in the darkness, defeating them to seize the Nightmare Light, and successfully escorting it to the Nightmare Light Platform to light it up, can the darkness be dispelled and force him to appear.

Bi Fang, the essence of wood; it looks like a bird and does not eat the five grains.
A giant bronze bird, chirping day and night. Its cry is fierce, and all who hear it weep in sorrow.
Bi Fang has forgotten many things, but it remembers its own name.
Its single leg is rusted, its wings are mottled, but its eyes still burn with a cyan, scorching fire, matching the deep flow-patterns on its body.

The tall ship gave it the mission to fly, to guard, and to fight.
But now the ship has capsized, and it still tries to fulfill its mission, even though everything it could protect has turned to ruins.
So it cries out, to at least hold onto its name, with a pride that is almost shattering:
Bi Fang, Bi Fang.

The strongman often wanders outside Jixia Academy, gazing at the scholarly atmosphere within. His companions call him "Skyfire Morningstar" because his flaming heavy hammer can easily crush stone into magma. He never mentions that he left scorch marks from his hammer when he betrayed his sect. He viewed his master's self-restraint as cowardice, believing only the heat of his flames could represent his sense of justice.\n\nHowever, after being looked up to as a leader by this group of rebels, he has begun to realize the truth. The process of enlightenment is not as simple as martial arts, and he is not yet ready to apologize to his master.
zh_text:
力士常年徘徊在稷下学院之外，远眺那一方书声朗朗。
伙伴总爱称他一句“天火锤星”，因着那把流火重锤轻易就能把石头碾作岩浆。
但他从未提起过，自己叛离师门时也留下了火焰的锤痕。
师长的克己被他视为懦弱，火痕的炽热才能代表他的义心。

但被这群破门少年视作大哥后，他也逐渐察觉到了个中道理。
只是参悟的过程不比练武简单，对恩师表达歉意一事，他还没有做好准备。

text: Rebels who turned against the academy due to conflicting martial arts philosophies. They are typically burly with powerful arms. The Rebel Hunks swing their giant hammers like the wind, shaking the very earth. These strongmen pursue brute force, even resorting to training methods banned by the academy.
zh_text:
因武道理念不同而与学院作对的破门生。
他们往往身形壮硕，双臂十分有力。
巨锤在破门力士手中挥动如风，撼天动地。

这些破门生中的大力士十分追求蛮力，甚至采取一些被学院禁止的方式进行训练。

text:
Its beastly eyes flare with savage light, sinews like bronze, claws like iron. Its spine stands firm as bedrock, its strides fierce as a gale. Beneath its vivid pelts, a savage heart pounds madly.  
 
When its colossal hammer falls, the sound is like thunder ravaging the earth, echoing across the wilds. 
 
To this brute, martial strength is nothing more than plunder and conquest. It gathers Rebels in the mountains, raising its banner as self-proclaimed ruler of the wilds. 
 
Despite having risen as the Rebels' leader, Tigrex still yearns for the attention of the legendary hammer-wielding hero. 
 
"At dusk it crept into the tranquil woods; at dawn it charged down the steep mountain."

The Relic Fire-Crack Armor is a specialized mechanical construct abandoned in the Jixia ruins.
Made of bronze, the upper body resembles a furnace, and the lower body resembles a spider.
When the mechanism is triggered, the patterns flash with fire, warning of an impending explosion.

It is said that after an explosion, the remaining core attracts surrounding bronze to reshape its body.

The Relic Clamp Armor is a bronze mechanical construct abandoned in the Jixia ruins.
It mimics the appearance of a crab, holding mechanical clamps, with mysterious glowing patterns on its shell.
It usually uses its dual clamps for maintenance work and replaces corresponding attribute parts based on the environment.

How they perform their duties so methodically has always been a puzzle that craftsmen want to solve.

Doomblade Sentinel fights with fiery aggression. Pickaxe Sentinel stands firm and unbreakable like a mountain. They arrive with the Calamity Star to carry out the Sanctified's orders. 
 
Pickaxe Sentinel activates an Inferno Shield while charging up a full-screen attack. The shield protects him during the charge. 
 
Doomblade Sentinel repeatedly charges toward players. 
 
Have Doomblade strike the Inferno Shield three times. After the third hit, the shield breaks, and Pickaxe Sentinel's attack is interrupted.

It lurks in the nightmares of students,
absorbing the obsessions and darkness in people's hearts to reshape itself.
From the bite of a mad wolf to the pounce of a giant bear,
it gradually condenses the power of destruction within endless bestiality.
This shadow born of dreams attempts to break the boundary between reality and illusion, using sharp blades to tear the present world apart.

"The more awake you are in a dream, the more trapped you are in reality."
The awakened shadow projects the despair and darkness from the depths of the soul into people's dreams,
and thus the dream twists into this dark incarnation of disaster.

As the core accelerates, the ancient bronze body resonates with the remaining thunder power in the ruins, making the attacks increasingly fierce.\n\n[Thunderous Formation]: The stone pillars are heavy, and the time required to push them down together is significantly increased. The Qingyue General's attacks also become extremely violent, accompanied by lightning strikes.

Freeze the camp with ice, and burn it with fire. 
 
Those words are carved into the Mechanoid. They show the creator's understanding of war and explain its purpose. 
 
Two energies fused and fed each other, amplifying the cannon fire so no defense could hold. 
 
Yet the Mechanoid lay abandoned beneath the ruins. It never got a chance to be used. The horn for the counterattack never sounded—the craftsmen who built it had already died defending it.

The Flame-Thunder Blade General's offensive becomes more violent, switching between fire and thunder at shorter intervals.

[Scorching Wave Peaks]: The frequency, quantity, and power of the fire blade light are significantly increased, and the living space is drastically compressed.
[Angry Flame Rapid Burn]: After performing the fire combo slash, it will recover its actions at a faster speed and launch the next round of attacks.

text:
Fighters of the Saepes tribe.
Their most distinct feature is that oversized spiked club.
Anyone struck by it, even if not severely injured by the force, will suffer greatly from the barbs on the club.

However, in the face of their natural predator, the Embermane, these crude Saepes weapons are like mere firewood, so the Saepes are rarely found where the Embermane appears.
zh_text:
木篱部落的战士。
其最鲜明的特征就是那把特大号的狼牙棒。
被它打中的敌人，就算未被猛力击伤，也会因木棒上的倒刺痛苦不已。

但在天敌灼绒面前，木篱这些粗犷武器就如同烧火棍一般，因此灼绒出现的地方一般不会有很多木篱。

A strange creature from the dream realm.
The dream thorn wraps around a deep blue light.
The dream of the Floating Dream Cage Thorn traps prey in a beautiful dream, making them unable to extricate themselves.

Butu once had a desirable life in the past. It is said that the totem symbolizing beautiful dreams records the story of Butu before he became a resident of the dream realm.

Pushed to the brink, the Radish King unleashes its primal fury, encasing itself in an unyielding fortress of twisting thorns. To shatter this impenetrable shell, you must turn its own kin against it—the Radish Bursters. 
 
Thorned Aegis: While dragging your allies, the Radish King generates a tough thorn armor. The knife-wielding Radishes can sever the vines, but the armor remains impervious. 
 
Scorched Assault: Rescued players must guide dormant Radish Bursters to strike the Radish King or lure it onto scorched zones left before. Only sustained burning can gradually wear down its armour, otherwise the armour will persist.
