text: [Star Ring Burst]: The Celestial Spirit returns to the field to charge up and summons five constellations that rotate around it. It also releases three layers of expanding ring-shaped area damage. Players must destroy the constellation nodes while dodging continuous ground fire.\n\n[Star-Shattering Soul Chaser]: The wall rotation in the second phase accelerates, and the Celestial Spirit locks onto each player, spawning three tracking energy orbs that persist in pursuit, severely disrupting movement paths. The team must find gaps in the walls to destroy the hidden constellation shadows while evading the energy orbs.

[Mad Rat Charge]: In addition to the original mechanics, an Armored Rat Elite will appear on the field, charging along a fixed route. If the nut carrier is hit, the nut will be dropped. A player must be assigned to intercept the elite and clear the rolling small armored rats; otherwise, the formation will be easily disrupted.

When the storyteller in town speaks of the Radish King, he slams the table and launches into the tale with gleaming eyes: 
 
"At first glance, the creature looks like an enormous radish, blown up to an absurd scale. Its surface is covered in uneven ridges, like earth that has cracked and healed over time. Atop its head, vibrant green leaves sway like towering forest trees. 
 
Beneath those leaves lies a pair of slanted, cunning eyes, glinting with mischief. But what truly draws the eye is the cleaver it carries. The blade gleams under the sun—clearly no ordinary tool—and in its hands, it strikes with terrifying force." 
 
"If you ever encounter it, never underestimate it. Among the creatures born of radish-kind, it stands as one of the fiercest. Its behaviour may defy reason, but one thing is certain: it is no easy opponent."

Combat Mechanoids crafted from mysterious, exceptionally sturdy metal. Their crimson armor is striking and imposing. They dance with sharp greatblades, their attacks as swift and fierce as a rainstorm. They are often covered in blade marks, yet these only scratch the surface, showing that the metal of their bodies has been tempered countless times. However, craftsmen have found their remains in certain places—what kind of monster could have torn them apart?
zh_text:
神秘金属铸成的作战机关俑，身形十分雄壮。 
赤红色的铠甲格外醒目，威风凛凛。 
锋利的巨刃在手中起舞，攻势犹如骤雨疾风。 
 
它们往往浑身刀痕，但是痕迹也仅仅伤及表面。 
可见组成它们身体的神秘金属经过了无数次锤炼。 
但在某些地方，工巧家发现了它们的残片，所以到底是什么怪物撕碎了它？

text:
The rules of the dream realm have become increasingly bizarre. Even a small amount of light has become elusive, and it even quietly devours the vitality of the light-seekers.

[Bizarre Dark Realm]: After the Pitch-Black Nightmare descends, the location of the Nightmare Light Platform will change randomly, making it difficult to predict.

[Nightmare Light Corrosion]: Players holding the Nightmare Light will continuously lose their maximum health. The team must take turns relaying it to successfully escort the light to the destination.

[Seed-Explosion Surround]: When giant-sized, it generates self-destructing wooden fences at each player's feet that will explode soon; move away immediately.\n\n[Burning Shield Deadline]: The fire bombs thrown by the Bombardment Guard explode after a short time. Players must pick them up and throw them at the Wooden Fence King within the time limit, or they will lose the key opportunity to break its armor.

Doomblade Sentinel fights with fiery aggression. Pickaxe Sentinel stands firm and unbreakable like a mountain. They arrive with the Calamity Star to carry out the Sanctified's orders. 
 
Pickaxe Sentinel activates an Inferno Shield while charging up a full-screen attack. The shield protects him during the charge. 
 
Doomblade Sentinel repeatedly charges toward players. 
 
Have Doomblade strike the Inferno Shield three times. After the third hit, the shield breaks, and Pickaxe Sentinel's attack is interrupted.

The dream realm has now turned into a prison of despair that devours everything, and every glimmer of light is accompanied by the burning of life.

[Abyssal Dream Prison]: The player's continuous erosion by the Dark Nightmare is significantly increased, while healing effects are greatly suppressed.

[Nightmare Light Burning]: The price of holding the Nightmare Light has become heavier, and the rate of losing maximum health has accelerated sharply, forcing the team to complete relays and escorts as quickly as possible.

Megadrive Hammer has gone berserk. It summons Mechanoids and now aims for pure destruction. 
 
Triple Shock: Megadrive Hammer fires three full-screen shockwaves in a row. Before each shockwave, it teleports to the edge of the arena, so each wave comes from a different direction. 
 
Mechcraft Reinforcements: Megadrive Hammer summons two Mechanoids before the shockwaves. One will grab the Shield in the arena. Defeat the Mechanoids and reclaim the Shield so it can protect you from the upcoming shockwaves.

Superior Glintspear Effigies are Mechanoid fighters forged from a mysterious metal. Their gleaming red armor commands respect. Driven by internal power, their strikes are precise and lethal, piercing through enemies like a tiger entering its den. Their comrades have long since passed, yet their unfinished mission keeps them standing guard.
zh_text:
神秘金属铸成的作战机关俑。
赤红且光亮的披甲看起来威风凛凛。
内驱发力，劲透尖头，毙敌收枪好似猛虎入洞。

与它相伴的战友已经作古，然而尚未完成的使命让它依旧坚守阵地。

Driven by internal power, their strikes are precise and lethal, piercing through enemies like a tiger entering its den. Their comrades have long since passed, yet their unfinished mission keeps them standing guard.

text:
Embermane no longer holds back. Its massive, kingly flames erupt across the battlefield, leaving almost no safe space. 
 
Infernal Ground: Fire on the ground deals extreme damage. Even a brief touch can be fatal. 
 
Pillar of Desperation: Fewer stone pillars rise, and they collapse faster than ever. You must make precise, split-second moves to survive.

Tigrex is a fierce Rebel leader from the mountain forests. After losing the first battle, he stole an experimental Shield from the School of Mechcraft. Now he blends raw rage with Mechcraft power and aims to crush any challenger. 
 
Mechanized Shield Charge: Tigrex charges forward with the Shield. You must destroy that Shield, or Tigrex will unleash a final red-glowing charge that cannot be dodged and deals massive damage. 
 
Earth Shatter: Right after the charge, Tigrex jumps and slams the ground repeatedly, creating full-screen shockwaves. The shockwaves cannot be dodged by jumping or dashing. Only the Shield on the field can block it.

Mushrooms mutated by the influence of the Aercocoon. They have eye-catching purple caps resembling open umbrellas. The Umbrella Spore-shroom releases spores as a defensive mechanism.\n\nThose who wield blades and spears keep their distance from these mushrooms. It's not that they are invincible, but their numbing spores are incredibly annoying.
zh_text:
受到云蚕影响而变异的蘑菇。 
有着如撑开的花伞般引人注目的紫色菌盖。 
华盖霆菇会向外吐出孢子核，作为保护自身的一种手段。 
 
选择刀枪剑戟作为武器的人都对华盖霆菇敬而远之。 
倒不是说它本身有多么强大不可战胜，只是它那让人手脚酥麻的孢子实在烦人。

text:
The one-legged bronze giant bird, carrying an undying obsession, guards this long-capsized treasure ship.

[Blazing Thunder Triple]: Bi Fang selects three players to drop scorching lightning, forming lightning circles on the ground. If the circles overlap, they will explode violently and permanently expand their range. After a while, all lightning circles will spread on their own, significantly compressing the survival space.

[Azure Flame Seize]: Bi Fang swoops down and grabs a player with its sharp claws. Companions must immediately rescue them with all their might, otherwise, Bi Fang will pour its rage onto the entire field.

The Relic Condensing Gun Armor is a bronze mechanical construct abandoned in the Jixia ruins.
The mechanical clamp on the right has been replaced with an ice cannon, emitting cold air from the nozzle.
In the ruins, mechanical devices often overheat, and only extreme cold can eliminate the danger.

For every novice who explores the ruins, a new patient arrives at the Herb Garden to treat frostbite.

Beast eyes glare with malice, iron claws strike hard. Its spine is like rock, its stride like a gale. Beneath its fur, a violent heart beats. Its hammer strikes like thunder across the plains. Plunder and conquest are its only understanding of martial arts. This tiger-kin bandit leader awaits the mercy of the legendary hammer-wielder. 'Quiet in the woods yesterday, fierce down the mountain today.'

兽眼圆瞪烁凶光，铜筋铁爪逞强梁。 
脊梁坚如磐石，虎步动若烈风。 
斑斓的皮毛下，充斥暴戾的心脏疯狂跳动。 
万钧重锤落，声若蹂躏大地的惊雷，响彻原野。 
 
强掠和洗劫，破坏和征服，是狂徒对武道的唯一理解。 
山中啸聚破门生，绿林高挂大王旗。 
成为恶徒首领的虎魔种兀自期待着，那位传奇重锤侠的垂怜。 
 
“昨日静归林，今朝猛下山。”

text: The two berserk powers of the Flame-Thunder Blade General are nearly unbalanced. It attempts to bring down thunder that annihilates everything; only by using its own power against it can you break the deadlock.\n\n[Thunder Meteor Sword Formation]: The Flame-Thunder Blade General flies into the air to accumulate destructive thunder and rains down dense thunder swords on the players. Players must destroy the falling thunder swords while avoiding attacks, pick them up, and throw them back to knock the General out of the air.

The enraged Embermane sends out waves of fire that put your team's coordination to the test. 
 
Synchronized Flames: All stone pillars rise at the same time, but each one stays up for much less time than usual. 
 
Dance of Survival: Plan your moves so everyone uses each pillar efficiently. Any hesitation or delay by a team member can lead to casualties.

An ancient defensive stationary mechanical construct.
The Qiancui Shock Shield Automaton was designed with practicality in mind.
The mechanical patterns on the tower shield channel superior shock elemental energy, giving it powerful counterattack capabilities.

Even today, this design of using energy to grant a shield counterattack capabilities remains a monument in mechanical engineering.

[Fire Shield Collision]: The Blade-Severing Spirit locks onto a player to charge, while the Lone Halberd Spirit activates a Fire Shield in the center of the field. Players must lure the Blade-Severing Spirit to collide with the Fire Shield three times to successfully break the shield; otherwise, they will suffer massive screen-wide damage.

The strongman often wanders outside Jixia Academy, gazing at the scholarly atmosphere within. His companions call him "Skyfire Morningstar" because his flaming heavy hammer can easily crush stone into magma. He never mentions that he left scorch marks from his hammer when he betrayed his sect. He viewed his master's self-restraint as cowardice, believing only the heat of his flames could represent his sense of justice.\n\nHowever, after being looked up to as a leader by this group of rebels, he has begun to realize the truth. The process of enlightenment is not as simple as martial arts, and he is not yet ready to apologize to his master.
zh_text:
力士常年徘徊在稷下学院之外，远眺那一方书声朗朗。
伙伴总爱称他一句“天火锤星”，因着那把流火重锤轻易就能把石头碾作岩浆。
但他从未提起过，自己叛离师门时也留下了火焰的锤痕。
师长的克己被他视为懦弱，火痕的炽热才能代表他的义心。

但被这群破门少年视作大哥后，他也逐渐察觉到了个中道理。
只是参悟的过程不比练武简单，对恩师表达歉意一事，他还没有做好准备。

text:
It reigns atop the Aerux, leaving no space for anything else to endure. 
 
Its mane has crystallised into glittering shards, while its vast shadow stretches across the mountains at dusk. 
 
Born at the Aerux's core, where Aerflow runs densest, it wields overwhelming power—yet finds no worthy foe, and with each passing day, grows ever more alone. 
 
With ease, it shatters boulders and snaps trees, its strength unmatched. Still, no opponent has risen to challenge it. 
 
For years, a nearby town offered rewards for its defeat. Now, that town lies abandoned and in ruins—nothing remains but rotting wood and scattered pages, a silent warning to all who would come near.

The Dream Demon of Painted Shadows is the embodiment of darkness in the dream. Now, its ambition has expanded, twisting everyone's dreams into a disaster.

[Three-Phase Illusion]: The Dream Demon of Painted Shadows cycles between wolf, bear, and human forms, each with unique combat tactics.

[Nightmare Seizure]: When in bear or human form, it summons Nightmare Butterflies to snatch a player and fly toward a Nightmare Rift. Teammates must shoot down the butterflies in time, or a devastating explosion will be triggered upon falling into the rift.

Giant underground Palisaepes. Their massive, imposing frames and terrifying visages mean few creatures dare to oppose them. The Palisaepes Colossus possesses destructive power, though its size makes it clumsy. Small Palisaepes like to gather around the giant ones; this worship and following of the strong stems from their instinct for self-preservation. Some lucky ones will grow strong under this protection, becoming the next towering tree to shelter the land.
zh_text:
地下的巨型朴篱。
魁梧奇伟的庞大身躯以及骇人的面容都使得鲜有生灵敢与它作对。
朴篱魁卫的攻击有着极强的破坏力，但硕大的体型却也令其表现得笨拙。

小朴篱很喜欢聚集在巨型朴篱的周围，这种对强者的崇拜与跟随源自朴篱自我保护的天性。
它们中的一些幸运儿会在庇护之下茁壮生长，成为下棵荫庇一方的参天巨木。

text: The guardian stood firm, a single man holding the pass against a thousand. Giant shields blocked the enemy; though exhausted, it stood like a mountain. Taking the hero's lost shield, the Emperor of Constructs was forged. Ice and rock fell upon the cliff, leaving no retreat for friend or foe. An unyielding belief was embedded in the core, making its defensive techniques unbreakable. Vile iron cavalry flooded the pass, and the defenders turned their backs on their homeland. As the setting sun cast its final glow, reinforcements appeared in the elongated shadows.
zh_text:
守关人岿然不动，一夫当关，千骑莫开。
巨盾阻敌，虽枯不倒，立如峰峦。
取英雄遗盾，锻机关之皇。
冰岩坠落崖间，敌我无路可退。
不屈的坚定信念已嵌入枢核，抵御之技牢不可破。

卑劣铁骑涌入关隘，卫国之躯已背对故土。
当残阳只剩余晖，被拉长的身影中出现了援军。

text:
In the advanced challenge, the two Sentinels use stronger teamwork and summon phantom clones to catch you off guard. Sharp eyes are your best defense. 
 
Doomblade Sentinel splits into four phantom clones, each charging a different player. 
 
ALL four phantom clones must hit Pickaxe Sentinel's Inferno Shield to break it. Stay spread out so the clones don't cross paths.

The Ruin-Guarding Mystic Sentinel's protective instincts have been fully triggered, making its advance even more resolute, with every step shaking the earth.\n\n[Relentless Advance]: It ignores all interference and charges toward the Burning Mountain Pivot. Unlike the basic challenge, its pace is faster, significantly shortening the time players have to intercept it.

A bronze mechanism crackling with lightning, larger than the average Relic Armor. Purple electricity spills from its giant pincers, the buzzing noise a clear warning of danger. The sound it makes before unleashing a thunderbolt grows louder, giving enemies only a brief window to react. It is speculated that besides maintenance, the Relic Thunder Armor also serves as an energy supply unit within the ruins. Jixia mechanists are trying to figure out the secret to their durability.

Embermane is a battle-hardened beast that breathes fire and attacks with blade-like claws. It enjoys burning anything that enters its territory, and wherever it stands, the flames linger. 
 
Scorching Inferno: Embermane covers the area in a wave of fire, during which friendly Saepes summon stone pillars around the area one after another. 
 
Pillar Dance: You must jump onto those pillars to avoid the burning ground. Each pillar only supports weight briefly before collapsing, so you and your team need to move and time your jumps carefully. When Embermane's fire attack ends, it becomes exhausted and vulnerable—that is the best moment to deal the most damage.

Linked telepathically to the Saepes King, the minions enter a frenzy, ready to die for their liege. They carry deadly traps, forcing players to act quickly and with precision. 
 
Explosive Traps: When enlarged, self-destructing Saepes appear beneath each player. Move away immediately to avoid instant damage. 
 
Blazing Shield: Fireballs from Catapultors explode shortly after landing. Pick them up and chuck them at the Saepes King before they blow, or you'll miss the chance to break its parts.

text:
The Armadillo Rat King has long thrived on Aerflow, developing a thick hide and a massive frame. During the Festive Fire Opera, it sneaks into the granaries to raid the crops. 
 
Nut Lure: The King summons several little Armored Rats to wreak havoc, one of which carries a special nut. When the nut-bearer is defeated, the nut remains on the field. The Rat King then drags all players closer, ensnaring two with vines. Entangled players will be silenced, and straying too far will snap them back.  
 
Unbound allies must pick up the nut to bait the King's charge, while the entwined pair must pull their vines in opposite directions to trip the charging King. Timing and coordination are key—fail, and the colossal rat keeps rampaging.

Heavy Spear Effigies are Mechanoid fighters forged from a mysterious metal. Larger than standard Spear Effigies, they are clad in pristine, tempered armor. Their long weapons strike with direct, powerful force, making intruders think twice. These machines once fought like an army, but some unknown event caused them to scatter across Jixia.
zh_text:
神秘金属铸成的作战机关俑。
身形比百炼枪俑更加庞大，坚甲如淬洗过般崭新。
长兵出手，直出直入，力达枪尖，让来犯者望而却步。

过去这些机关曾像军队一样作战，后来不知什么变故让它们分散在稷下各地。

text:
In the north of Jixia, there is a giant beast with four legs that likes to hide in lightning and often fights with fire to the death.
When the fire dies, the thunderclouds rise.
The lightning-wielding giant lizard is the mortal enemy of the wildfire giant lizard.
Its massive body, shimmering with faint light, is often hidden within lightning.
It grants its victims a painless death the moment it appears.
It is the darling of lightning and the apex predator of the wilderness.

It rests like a crag, immovable.
Only when the enemy's fire begins to spread will it lift its noble head and let out a roar that shakes the earth.
zh_text:
“稷北有巨兽，生四足，喜藏于雷间，常与火死斗。” 
燎火灭时，雷云升。 
操弄雷的巨蜥，与燎原巨蜥互为死敌。 
隐隐闪动着辉光的硕大的身躯，常隐于雷电之中。 
会在出现的瞬间赐予受害者无痛苦的毙亡。 
它是雷电的宠儿，是原野顶端的霸者。 
 
它盘若苍岩，岿然不动。 
只有当天敌之火开始燎原，才会抬起自己高贵的头颅发出震慑的吼叫。

The lightning-wielding giant lizard is the mortal enemy of the wildfire giant lizard.
Its massive body, shimmering with faint light, is often hidden within lightning.
It grants its victims a painless death the moment it appears.
It is the darling of lightning and the apex predator of the wilderness.

It rests like a crag, immovable.
Only when the enemy's fire begins to spread will it lift its noble head and let out a roar that shakes the earth.

text: This web is made from silk spun by house spiders that absorb Aerflow. It is very light but extremely strong. Because these webs have saved lives, they are considered a symbol of good luck in Jixia. \n \nVillagers fleeing the war ran into the woods with enemy soldiers close behind, but the path ahead was blocked by a spiderweb. As they despaired, the web seemed to sense their plight and parted to reveal a hidden cave. The villagers slipped inside, and the web sealed itself once more. When the soldiers arrived, they found no trace of the villagers and gave up the chase.

text:
A beautifully crafted chiming alarm clock, a gift for those who struggle to get out of bed.  
 
Com-fluence specially collaborated with Shye and a renowned Music Society member to create this masterpiece. Placed beside your bed, it gently summons sleep with a soothing chime at night, ensuring a restful night's sleep. In the morning, it wakes you with an ethereal, dreamy ring, like a celestial call to rise. Even Master Zhuangzi highly recommends it. 
 
Master Zhuangzi often got lost in the Dreamscape and forgot the time. Master Fuzi repeatedly reminded him, but to no avail; Master Zhuangzi could still fall asleep at any moment. The Com-fluence alarm clock woke Master Zhuangzi in a gentler, more thoughtful way. Though he still often seemed half asleep, at least he no longer missed meetings.
zh_text:
一款精巧雅致的响铃闹钟，起床困难者的福音。 
         
百汇坊特邀西施，以及知名宫羽家合作，成就这款大师之作。将这款闹钟放在床头，既能在夜晚唤起睡意翩跹入梦境，助你一夜好眠。晨起时又能伴着空灵梦幻的铃音，用天籁唤醒幻梦。就连庄周老师也强烈推荐。 
         
庄周老师神游梦境忘记了时间，夫子老师苦口婆心提醒了很多次，但没有效果，庄周老师一如既往地随时能睡着。百汇坊的闹钟用了更加温柔贴心的方式唤醒庄周老师，虽然他依旧总是半梦半醒，但至少不会在会议的时候缺席了。

text: A crystal infused with Aerflow. The surging Aerflow within carries the power to grant hope in desperate moments. Often fashioned into ornaments, it is worn as a charm of protection. \n \nIn the thick of battle, when a weary general’s body could no longer dodge the enemy’s blade, the expected agony never came. Instead, the crystal upon his chest blazed with light, strength flooding back into his arms. When silence finally fell, he shoved aside his foe’s lifeless body—the crystal still glowing warmly at his heart, keeping him company as he faced the dawn.
zh_text: 蕴含着云流的晶石。涌动其中的云流有着令人绝处逢生的力量。常被人们用来打造饰品，以作守护之意。 \n \n久战至此，将领疲劳的身体已无力躲避敌人的刀锋。可想象的痛苦没有到来，他胸前佩戴的晶石竟焕发出光彩，让力量重归他的双臂……待一切重归寂静，他推开敌人冰冷的躯体，胸前晶石暖意尚存，陪他一同迎接曙光。

A Fuzi doll holding a ruler, intricately carved from cloud root, with a smooth and polished finish.

This piece is inspired by Master's image while guiding students in the training grounds. During every Mount Guye trial, Fuzi would spar with the martial arts students alone. His ruler would touch them like a dancing dragon, guiding their martial techniques.

When this item first hit the shelves at Baihui Market, sales were dismal. Later, a martial arts student on a whim brought the doll with him to an exam, and he passed subjects he had repeatedly failed. Since then, rumors spread through the academy that the doll brings good luck for exams, and it became a bestseller overnight.

A mini massage hammer modeled after Wuyan's iconic hammer. It loosens muscles, improves circulation, and can be used on the entire body. It helps relax during downtime and keeps you alert and focused during busy times. 
 
Wuyan once challenged all the martial arts training halls with a single hammer, leaving a deep hole in He & Ming's training hall. Wuyan's hammer became a symbol of strength for the Martial Arts students. 
 
This practical and affordable hammer was a hit as soon as it was released. Each restock led to chaotic scenes. Wuyan tried and failed three times until, on the fourth attempt, she slammed her hammer on the ground to draw attention and finally secured one.

text:
These wearable, foldable wings are a favorite among the children of Jixia. 
 
After the Team of Stars' victory, Sun Bin's Mechwings became the toy every child wanted. Com-fluence quickly released this product, but for safety, these wings can't actually make you fly. 
         
There's a story that one day, a child asked Sun Bin to take him flying for his birthday, and Sun Bin agreed. After that, his lab was filled with kids hoping for a ride. Shy and quiet, Sun Bin never expected to become a hero to so many children.
zh_text:

text:
An exquisitely detailed and beautifully crafted Wondrous Maze model. 
 
It perfectly replicates the scene from Kongming's graduation project, making you feel as if you're really there. This model is a great way to relieve stress and cultivate your mind. 
 
It is said that after Kongming completed the design of the Wondrous Maze, he invited Zhou Yu to come and challenge it. Although Zhou Yu appeared to decline, he was deeply tempted and secretly went there late at night. However, Kongming had already prepared for this. After Zhou Yu completed the challenge, Kongming closed himself in the Wondrous Maze for three days and three nights. After that, the Wondrous Maze became even more difficult. Unfortunately, Zhou Yu had already graduated and never went there again. However, after Com-fluence released this model, they received an order. The shop owner suspected that this order was very likely from Zhou Yu.
zh_text:
细节精致，美轮美奂的奇门水榭拼装模型。 
         
完全复刻了诸葛亮毕业设计的场景，犹如身临其境。此物模型是减压、磨练心性的消遣佳品。 
         
据传当年诸葛亮完成奇门水榭的设计后，邀请周瑜前往挑战。周瑜虽表面拒绝，内心却禁不住诱惑深夜偷偷前往。哪知诸葛亮早有防备。周瑜完成挑战后，诸葛亮在奇门水榭闭关了三天三夜。这之后的奇门水榭更是难上加难。可惜彼时周瑜已经离校，再也没有去过。但在百汇坊推出该模型后，收到了一个来自三分的订单。坊主推测，该订单极有可能来自周瑜。

text:
An elegant alarm clock and a perfect gift for anyone who loves to sleep in. 
         
Created by Com-fluence in partnership with Shye and renowned Musicians, this clock comes highly recommended by Master Zhuangzi himself. Place it by your pillow to enjoy its gentle chimes as you fall asleep, and wake up refreshed to its soft, airy tones in the morning. 
         
Master Zhuangzi is known for getting lost in his dreams and losing track of time, despite Master Fuzi's reminders. This beautiful clock was designed by Com-fluence to help him wake up on time. Now, even though Master Zhuangzi still loves to dream, he no longer misses important meetings.
zh_text:
一款精巧雅致的响铃闹钟，起床困难者的福音。 
         
百汇坊特邀西施，以及知名宫羽家合作，成就这款大师之作。将这款闹钟放在床头，既能在夜晚唤起睡意翩跹入梦境，助你一夜好眠。晨起时又能伴着空灵梦幻的铃音，用天籁唤醒幻梦。就连庄周老师也强烈推荐。 
         
庄周老师神游梦境忘记了时间，夫子老师苦口婆心提醒了很多次，但没有效果，庄周老师一如既往地随时能睡着。百汇坊的闹钟用了更加温柔贴心的方式唤醒庄周老师，虽然他依旧总是半梦半醒，但至少不会在会议的时候缺席了。

text: Spun from spiders that draw upon Aerflow, this silk is feather-light yet remarkably strong. Because it once saved countless lives, the people of Jixia regard it as a symbol of good fortune. \n \nWhen villagers fled into the mountains to escape pursuit, enemy soldiers closed in fast. text:
A beautifully crafted model of Wondrous Maze, perfectly recreating Kongming's famous graduation project. 
         
This detailed maze offers a relaxing and thoughtful challenge for your mind. 
         
Legend says that after finishing the maze, Kongming invited Zhou Yu to try it. Although Zhou Yu refused at first, he couldn't resist and sneaked in at night—only to find Kongming waiting for him. After Zhou Yu solved the maze, Kongming spent three days and nights inside, making the puzzles even harder. 
 
Unfortunately, Zhou Yu left the academy and never came back. But when Com-fluence released this model, they received an order from the Three Kingdoms, which was believed to be from Zhou Yu himself.

Those who don't know Nivie well think she's like snow—ethereal and fleeting, turning into a pool of cold water once you get close. In truth, one only needs to spend a little time with her to realize that her indifferent exterior cannot hide a sharp and ingenious mind. The Mirror of Ice can reflect me, and it can reflect others. When she is with friends truly worthy of her affection, this cold, snow-like girl overflows with gentle warmth.

Predators always walk alone; only cattle and sheep herd together.

At least that's what Lady Sun told herself when she was studying at the aristocratic girls' academy.

Ever since she picked up that heavy cannon, her passion has been firmly tied to it.

Lady Sun is no longer a little girl who needs to be carefully looked after by her brothers! Loneliness in her heart? Strange looks? In front of the young lady's super firepower, none of that matters!

What should an ideal friend be like?

Gentle, humorous, possess incredible combat power, and be able to do weird things together...

What would it look like when all these fantasies and expectations are blended together?

Lady Sun hugged her massive firearm and laughed carefreely.

"Firearms are my best friends!"

Perhaps she never expected that in the distant Jixia, she would meet a girl from the Southern Wilderness and become fast friends.

In business, it has always been easier said than done. These past few years of drifting between various blacksmith shops have shaken Longya's simple, old-fashioned views to their core. What is a gimmick? What is marketing? Why do weapons of the same quality have such vastly different prices? The overly complex ins and outs have caused Longya a great deal of trouble. But giving up isn't her style. Even after stumbling and getting bruised along the way, the dawn of success is finally beginning to shine! By teaming up with Guidie to participate in the Dream of Return, once they take the championship, the blacksmith shop run by Longya will surely spread throughout Jixia, making her folks back in Guxie Mountain look at her with new respect!

To this day, the expelled students still recall the fear of being dominated by Miss Nivie.
Her cute and naive appearance is just a disguise; in reality, she is a demon king worse than all the expelled students combined!
She is not only well-versed in all sorts of tricks and acts without restraint, but she also keeps a terrifying, monstrous giant beast. Any expelled student unlucky enough to run into her will suffer terrible education and punishment...
Of course, all the rumors circulating about Miss Nivie among the expelled students are just that—rumors. The right to interpret them belongs solely to Nivie and Dabai.

What many don't know is that Nivie actually liked Gui Die from the moment they first met. She was a clever and sensitive girl who always approached with elegant steps—haughty yet adorable—and in every gesture, one could catch a glimpse of the kindness deep within her heart. Their friendship blossomed naturally, growing deeper and more sincere with time. As they embark on the journey to the Dream of Return, what kind of friendship will bloom between them?

It is said that people often don't like those who are too similar to themselves. 
Minka thinks this might be why he initially resisted that little red beast. 
It is stubborn, impulsive, and disobedient, like scorching fire that burns everyone who dares to get close. 
Heh, it's like looking into a strange mirror. 
But the closeness of two hearts is never unreasonable, and who could refuse those big, cute eyes? 
Minka smiled and pulled the struggling little guy into his arms, ruffling its soft, warm, and beautiful scales.

She seemed like the most "unreliable" visitor to the Jixia Academy: reckless, obsessed with agricultural mechanisms, and intimately familiar with market prices. Could she really be the Princess of Jiangjun?

Yet, after casually resolving the spy incident, she condensed everything she saw and thought about in Jixia—from laws and agriculture to trade—into a blueprint for reform. That focus and capability were just another side of her vibrant soul.

Born in the fires of war and raised in chaotic times, she was never destined to be a delicate flower. She will, in her own way, join her brother in carrying Jiangjun toward the future.

The sun is out of reach, and the traveler is still on the road.
Natural disasters took her father's life and destroyed Nivie's hometown.
That day, she stood amidst the ruins, facing her father's cold body, fruitlessly casting the priest's magic she had learned since childhood, over and over, until that familiar rabbit dragged and carried her away from the danger.
Nivie pounded and cried, but the rabbit remained silent until Nivie's voice grew hoarse and she ran out of strength. Only then did the rabbit speak.
"The Northern Wasteland is too cold. I promised your father I would take you to a warm place."
That is how they began their journey.
...The Tower of Babel is getting closer.

The Three Kingdoms are rife with undercurrents, and the world watches every move of the Sun brothers. 
However, behind them stands the Princess of Jiangjun, Lady Sun, wielding a firelock with a look that is three parts cute and seven parts provocative—their secret weapon. 
Family means supporting each other through thick and thin. She can be the pirate-slayer charging at the forefront for the iron-blooded Viceroy, or the vanguard princess moving freely through Cao Wei's formations. But her most important identity will always be as one of the three Sun siblings. The Sun family's affairs, and her brother's affairs, are Lady Sun's top priority. 
"The Young Miss is here, move aside!" 
There's always a surprise after the cannon fire.

The day Longya climbed the old maple tree in her hometown and gazed at the Tower of Babel, her future path was decided. 
Known as the "prodigy who inherited the master's mantle," she left home to seek a different solution. 
From then on, Jixia Academy had a new student: a girl as fiery as a blaze and as proud as the morning sun. 
Though this solitary path of knowledge was filled with difficulties, she never gave up. 
When tuition ran short, she worked to support her studies; when her forging skills were questioned, she opened a blacksmith shop that became the talk of Jixia. 
"A thousand hammer blows are never in vain." 
Longya pursues her own path of forging, not only crafting legendary weapons but also tempering herself in the flames.

April 4, Light Rain, Cloud Cover Ten. This ruin should be like Wangxiang City and Guqiu City, both destroyed by a war; and judging by the styles of the excavated artifacts, all three belong to the same period. It seems this was a war with a very long front line. We all noticed a strange phenomenon: this must have been a supply dock for the defending troops, and the unloading volume was massive, yet no supply facilities of any kind were found in the ruins, not even a warehouse. So the question is, where did all this unloaded cargo go? How did the defenders fill their bellies and replenish their military equipment? Tomorrow we will continue our deep investigation; something must have been missed.
zh_text:
四月四日 小雨 云量十 
这处遗迹应该和望乡城、古丘城一样，都是因一场战争而毁灭；而从发掘到的文物样式来看，它们三者又都属于同一时期。看来，这是一场战线很长的战争。 
我们都注意到了一个奇怪现象，这里肯定是守军的补给码头，卸货量也很大，在遗迹中却没有发现任何补给设施，连仓库都没有。那么问题来了，卸下来的这么多货物去了哪里？守军如何吃饱肚子，补充军备？ 
明天我们要继续深入调查，肯定有所遗漏。

He will never forget his father's eager eyes on that cold winter night.
The ship had been in the cave for who knows how many years; as far back as he could remember, that massive bronze construct had stood there.
Long years had long since washed away people's longing for their homeland.
The legend of the ship his father spoke of was wild and illusory, yet it became the only link between the present and the past.
He remembered his father hunched over his research all day, but when that divine weapon was forged, the monsters followed in its wake.
To prevent people from getting hurt, he lured the monsters to the pass for a final stand, but he underestimated their numbers.
In the cold night, the warrior roared, and blood froze.
His father looked at him intently, then the weapon unleashed a dazzling frost, sealing the monsters and his own burning heart together.
He inherited his father's mantle.
Though his predecessors are long gone, as long as those twin blades remain in his hands, he can return home with that dream.

Recently, the drums have gotten louder. Last night, the fog in the dream thinned a bit, but the drums were louder. April twentieth, Grain Rain. Having left home for two years, I have finally figured out what I truly wish to do. Today the rain has grown lighter, and after a long journey, I have finally arrived at the Baicao Garden to study. Since I have decided to become a healer dedicated to saving lives, I shall begin right here. ...Upon entering the garden, I met Teacher Tong Bo. When I simply expressed my wish to become his disciple, he actually accepted me on the spot, which quite surprised me. He said that as part of the Chixia Academy, education should be provided without discrimination, and no one cares about one's past. I have no close friends in the garden yet, so there is nothing more to say. I write this journal down simply to record my feelings at this moment.
zh_text: 四月二十，谷雨。离开家已经两年了，终于想到了自己愿意做什么。今日雨势渐小，经过长途跋涉，终于来到百草园求学。既然决定要做立志救人的药师，那就从这里开始。……入园便遇见了童波老师，只说了希望拜师的想法，居然就直接收我为徒，倒是令我吃惊。说是稷下学院，当有教无类，过往如何，无人在意。园中尚无熟识好友，不足为谈。以记下此手记，权当记录此刻心情。

Inspired by the red lotus flower found in the southern regions. A girl drifts across the clear water, smiling as she gathers lotus seeds.

text: With a curled tail leaving verdant paw prints, be a cute, slow-exploring, occasionally lost 'Veggie Dog'.
A dazzling delicacy descends from the sky with an energetic young girl—hey, isn't that Minka?
Glimpsing the prophet in a dream, face covered by a deep shadow veil. Seeing no faces, abandoning joy and sorrow, waiting quietly for the moment of extinction.
A glimmer flowing from a shattered nightmare, condensed into a pink jade horizontal blade adorned with wish-granting flowers.
Under the dark night, the Spirit Cat yawns lazily. "Today... don't work hard either, meow."
During the picnic, listening to the soft whispers of the wind and pansies, this is a leisurely long talk that belongs to spring.

text: Carved mirror back, swimming fish and lake reflections. The world within the mirror is poetic and picturesque, a touch of clarity reflecting leisure.
A longsword woven from Aersilk. The threads gather the aspirations of all living things, creating an endless source of fuel for its power.
The ornate feathers unfurl in the wind, shimmering like banners. Once the sharp edge is donned, one must wield the blade toward the front.

text: The blade is like a cloud, or an eagle striking the sky. This is an invincible sword of victory.
A cannon carved from Volcanic Stone. Its unwavering blue light shines through the layers of history, boldly defying the passage of time.
A carefully refined sword forged from the newborn Aerux. The natural patterns whisper of the world's ancient transformations.
Sunlight reveals the face, and even the rainbow joins in.

Pop! With a loud crack, popcorn exploded into a flurry of crispy sounds. The 'Veggie Dog' chased around the stalls, laughter and lanterns swirling together—this blast was the opening act for tonight's carnival.
An ancient metal repeating bow.\nThe bow tips are carved with wave patterns, and it is decorated with bells and ribbons.\nFiring multiple arrows in succession sounds just like the tide.
Inheriting Xuanyong aesthetics, interwoven with black and red, an elegant and sharp dress, surrounded by a mysterious atmosphere.
The coconut just opened its shell, but summer filled it to the brim.
zh_text: 椰子只是开个壳，却被夏天塞满怀。
source_text: 椰子只是开个壳，却被夏天塞满怀。

Modified magic academy attire, stylish and lightweight, better suited for combat.
A warm short jacket with a sleek cut and lively, cute pom-poms, bringing the good news of spring.
Sky Bow: Elegy Under the Moon
A pitch-black left-handed sword, narrow and sharp, wreathed in an ominous aura that brings darkness.
A delicate little hat woven from new willow, adorned with white camellias and lace ruffles. Elegant and cute.
A giant hammer woven from Aer-silkworm silk.\nThreads connect, and as the fire dragon runs, the sky turns into endless flames.
Catch them off guard, strike when they are unprepared, paint the storm, and move with divine grace. This technique is recorded in the lecture notes of the Chang'an painter, You Mo.
zh_text: 出其不意，攻其不备，染成风雨，宛若神巧。此技法收录在长安画师悠墨的课堂笔记中。

text: A plain robe that gathers the clarity and turbidity of the world, with green light subtly embroidering the vast landscapes held in the heart of a Fengwu family member.
Under the late autumn moon, the maple forest turns red. With delicate gluttonous teeth, it devours all truths and lies, the present and the past.
I don't care to steal the spotlight; I just have a problem with playing it safe.
A bronze sword said to summon the green flames of disaster. The fire in its wielder's eyes will one day consume all.
A staff made from reed stalks. Its pith glows faintly and possesses the power to penetrate dreams.
Light, simple shorts in a cloud-white hue, accented with golden patterns. Very versatile.
Brilliant fireworks bloom in the high sky, dazzling and eye-catching. New hopes also blossom in the hearts of everyone in Jixia.
An ornate sword worn by a grandmaster in his later years. One can tell the noble status of its owner at a glance.
A staff woven from Aersilk. No matter how often it breaks, it will always be reborn.
The tail is like a dark flame, swaying gently in the wind. Silent yet powerful, like a drawn bowstring, concealing the full might of martial arts.

A light, sharp, and delicate longsword. The blade is forged repeatedly, revealing mottled star patterns.
The entire body overflows with a soft radiance, and the hilt is intricately carved like a butterfly that has just emerged from its chrysalis.
The sense of impending flight complements the star patterns on the blade perfectly.
Inscribed: "Ascend to the heavens, chase the stars, and embrace the moon."
A common Jixia hairstyle; with just a little grooming, it looks heroic and spirited.
Gods often forget themselves, for they were once human too. The Staff of Questioning, symbol of the Sage's power.
A deep blue earring, with six stars shining in harmony. From the depths of the starry sky, a friend's whisper echoes.
Beside the picnic blanket in the woods, the short socks inadvertently brushed against the pansy patch.

Bouncing around, the genius puppy looks up and gives you an invincible smile.
Twin blades ground from Burning Mountain Stone. They are crystal clear; they do not burn easily, but once ignited, they leave nothing behind.

This sword is designed to look like the bones of the bronze fish. The sound of its swing is like an echo from a distant past.
A carefully refined blade forged from the newborn Aerux, carrying the silent echoes of history.
The sea pushes the sky away, the fragrance of fruit drifts closer, and it is all brightened by the sunlight along with the laughter.

The spring outing in memory, mountains and rivers entering dreams, warm and bright light, intoxicating.

The image of the cursed armor won't leave the Navenian noble's mind. At midnight, a fierce figure appears.
The tyrannical emperor raises his sword and lifts his gaze, casting a nightmare shadow.\nHe will conquer everything; he will devour everything.
A helical sword engineered by the Seekers for geological exploration. It can drill through solid stone to analyze mineral compositions.
An ancient ballista mounted on the side of a warship, capable of piercing heavy armor.\nThe ancestor of Jiangjun naval weaponry.
The wind in the canyon carries the scent of victory, which you can smell even through your helmet.
A longsword forged in a deep cave of Lone Mountain. The obsidian is cracked along the spine, with faint electric light flickering in the gaps.
An elegant hanging-feather bird with golden ginkgo leaves, inspired by the masterpiece of the Jixia calligraphy and painting master, Mo Ran.
Designed by the battle-scarred Baicao family; whenever a freshman says "How cute!", they just give a mysterious smile.
He will traverse boundless time, determined to bring his best friend home.

Silver Feather and Crimson Jade, crafted by two academy legends, are seamlessly fused into one.
A favorite weapon among the Sanctified. The ominous bird spreads its wings, its blue flames scorching the earth.
Let's have a spicy adventure! Otherwise, I'll give you a spicy exit!
Flowers bloom in the warm sun, wind stops under the hat brim.
zh_text: 花开暖阳中，风停帽檐下。
source_text: 花开暖阳中，风停帽檐下。

text: The painter nearly drove themselves mad trying to mix "colorful white," until they discovered the twilight sky.
The heat wave sweetens the air and seals in the afternoon sun. With the cannon blast, all your worries are blown away.
The Mechwings shine with a radiant golden glow, like shooting stars streaking through the cold night.
The initial transformation of the Legendary Blade.
A staff forged from bronze fragments shed from the wings of Bi Fang, fused by scorching blue flames.
Covered in puppy paw prints, these are the special work pants from the Veggie Dog Ice Cream Shop.

An explosive core used to launch split projectiles. The pyramid-shaped core is loaded with multiple upward-facing ports, making it a street-fighting weapon that leaves enemies with nowhere to hide during wartime.

He will never forget his father's eager eyes on that cold winter night.
The ship had been in the cave for who knows how many years; as far back as he could remember, that massive bronze construct had stood there.
Long years had long since washed away people's longing for their homeland.
The legend of the ship his father spoke of was wild and illusory, yet it became the only link between the present and the past.
He remembered his father hunched over his research all day, but when that divine weapon was forged, the monsters followed in its wake.
To prevent people from getting hurt, he lured the monsters to the pass for a final stand, but he underestimated their numbers.
In the cold night, the warrior roared, and blood froze.
His father looked at him intently, then the weapon unleashed a dazzling frost, sealing the monsters and his own burning heart together.
He inherited his father's mantle.
Though his predecessors are long gone, as long as those twin blades remain in his hands, he can return home with that dream.
Resonance: Crimson Blade Dance
Slender, sharp bronze blades, with patterns that shine with a blue cold light.
The horn sounds clear and bright, and fireworks rise into the sky one after another. She plays a tribute amidst the radiance, composing the first overture for the grand ceremony.

A mechanical device made of white jade, glaze, and gold thread, with a cloud-silk hub floating in the air, rotating slowly.\nThose who practice martial arts have hearts as resilient as jade; those who enter the Dao have souls as clear as glaze; those who are skilled craftsmen have thoughts as precise as gold. When the three unite, the clouds flow endlessly, and the ultimate techniques span from ancient times to the present.
A long zither made of metal, with primitive patterns on its frame. Broken strings can be mended, but a reunion may never come.
A staff carved from icicles formed by the Fountain of Youth in the Land of Extreme Cold.\nThe staff body, resembling an old tree, is covered in countless branches, emitting a biting chill.
A heart-melting lemon-colored water gun with cute starfish decorations. It makes you feel like it would spray ice cream.
An ancient broadsword discovered in the ruins of an old battlefield; it was the weapon of a vanguard general during ancient wars.
Initial transformation for the Spirit of Phantom Gauze.

A magical artifact made of blue and purple jade pendants, as if two butterflies are embracing in sleep. Hidden within the jade pendants wrapped in two-colored butterfly wings is the eternal, peaceful dream of a pair of sisters. "At the end of the long dream, we return to eternal sleep."

A thin sword formed by the spiraling of roots and Cloud Silk.
The hair-like roots are knotted together,
while the Cloud Silk within emits a faint, soft glow.
When swung with full force, its momentum is like a collapsing mountain.
An infinite wonderland for the wildest of dreams!
Red scales drift through clear waves, shimmering like golden wheat fields; years have passed since I last sang while wielding my sword.
Soft as peach blossoms, Eastern-style trousers, showcasing the active figure of a naturalist in a snow-dusted courtyard.
Moving silently through the quiet, hidden paths like a blade cutting through the night.
This rebellious attire is actually a modified Jixia Academy uniform worn by a student who left the academy.
A demonic blade cast from bronze. Broken gems and countless battle scars silently tell of its past.

A massive longbow used by a hero favored by the Moon Goddess in myths. A weapon created to protect the spark of civilization. The bow body is made of broken osmanthus, and the string is made of moon-ear clippings.\nIntricate patterns carved on the bow body evoke the legendary jade railings and carved beams of the Moon Palace.\n"Pluck the osmanthus branch and cut the moonlight, draw the clear radiance and ride the golden carriage."
Welcome! The Summer Ice Drink Shop is at your service, woof woof!
The glazed mechanical cannon, once confined to a cave, appears as bright as new when brought back into the sunlight.
White clothes reflecting shadows, standing in the wind.
The crescent moon pierces the sky, scattering thousands of silver stars.\nChasing enemies, and chasing the lingering glow in one's heart.
The brown short hair is light and carefree, bathing in the morning light of a spring picnic.
zh_text: 棕色的短发轻盈悠然，沐浴着春日野餐的晨光。
source_text: 棕色的短发轻盈悠然，沐浴着春日野餐的晨光。

Dual blades woven from Aersilk. The threads are said to connect the desolate with the vibrant, bridging the gap between stagnation and flourishing.
A cannon woven from Aersilk. At rest, its power is concealed; unleashed, it is as subtle and swift as the wind.
A rising star of Chang'an. I bet his signature hat will become a bestseller.

text: The sword's light cuts through the mist. He gains a new name, bearing sins to end all sins.
A little frog crouching under a light green lotus leaf, a steaming teapot—is it brewing some brilliant ideas?

A single-edged blade modified from a crude wooden fence weapon; sturdy and durable. The blade is wrapped in curled cloud roots, exuding lush vitality. It's a bit prickly, though—an invention by a certain eccentric crafter.
No need to test the enemy, for each strike proclaims his power. Wherever he steps, the youth claims his ground.

text: An unusually heavy hammer, rumored to have the power to tear the earth apart. However, even seasoned warriors find it difficult to lift. This powerful weapon remains dormant in the corner of the warehouse, waiting for its master to appear.

There was once a tribe in the Northern Wasteland that upheld an old custom: after a leader died, their staff had to be planted in the eye of the wind for a hundred days, left to be eroded by frost and snow day and night. Once the life force faded, crimson patterns would seep from the handle to the head, like a pulse slowly awakening beneath the frozen earth.

Elders once said that during the dark of the moon, whispers would spill from the staff, thin as silk, only to be swallowed by the wind. No one could tell if they were prayers or sighs, only that when the frost stopped, the crystal at the head of the staff had quietly turned red.

This staff chooses its master in silence. On a night of heavy snow, it will tilt slightly in a certain direction—pointing the way to find the tribe's next leader.

A staff that looks like it grew from a cold lotus. When touched, a chill emanates from the palm; the handle feels like ice crystal, or perhaps some kind of root.

Legend has it that beneath the permafrost of the far north, a cold lotus that never withers took root in the cold rock layer and bloomed quietly. It is said that it was originally an ordinary plant, but it transformed into something else due to a drop of blood from the fingertip of a goddess favored by ice and snow. Through years of wind and snow, its calyx now looks like it was carved from frost, hiding a bone-chilling cold within its layers. Is this ice a salvation for life, or destruction?

In the end, the ice remembered for her in the shape of the calyx—those springs that were frozen in memory and never returned.

A staff carved from ancient Northern Wasteland wood.

Legend has it that deep in the Northern Wasteland stands an ancient, immortal dead tree called "Frost-String." Its branches are like frozen ice strings, emitting a low, mournful wail when the wind blows. The tribes say it is the earth whispering in its sleep, leaving traces across the snowfields.

A priest once carved a staff from this wood, and it has been passed down through generations. At every coming-of-age ceremony, the new priest must touch the staff with their fingertip—if the Frost-String rings, the ice and snow of the Northern Wasteland have accepted your prayer.

A heavy crossbow favored by naval commanders in the Three Kingdoms.\n\nThis crossbow has a primitive design, but its mechanism is stable, accurate, and heavy. Though made of ordinary iron, its draw strength is enough to pierce the hull of a warship.
A great hammer forged from mysterious iron, originally made by a smith for personal use. Its sturdiness and durability were later discovered by martial artists.

Some say it is the Core of the Scorching Sun, forged in fire. Within its crimson-gold hammer head, an eternal celestial fire is sealed. Blazing light replaces traditional patterns; its mere presence is enough to dispel all darkness and cold.\nIt does not burn; it continuously radiates the essence of light and heat. When swung, it is like the sun crossing the sky, incinerating gloom and boiling the seas. Its power is not that of a mortal weapon, but of a vast celestial phenomenon.\nOnly those with a heart as boundless as a clear sky, willing to use themselves as a conduit to ignite the long night, can become the wielder of this light.

A bone staff made by a Northern Wasteland priest, who ground the remains of snow rabbits into beads and strung them onto the staff's rings.\n\nAs the cold northern wind blows, the bells chime crisply, like the gentle call of an old friend. Amidst the light ringing, phantoms of snow rabbits appear before one's eyes, and the voices of ancestors drift from the distant snow, telling stories buried beneath the drifts.

The Young Master of Jiang Prefecture personally crafted this heavy tiger-hunting crossbow. The arrows fly like thunder and lightning, making it impossible for even the swiftest beasts in the forest to track or dodge. Anything hit falls instantly. 'Personally hunting tigers, watch the Young Master.' This crossbow has become a topic of conversation among the scholars of Jiang Prefecture.

The first smithing hammer owned by a young blacksmith.\n\nThe head is made of hundred-forged iron; after a hundred strikes, it is no longer mere stubborn metal. Perhaps every time the young blacksmith swung this hammer thereafter, they whispered, 'A thousand strikes reveal the essence, a hundred refinements forge the tool.'

A pitch-black staff that condenses frost.

At the end of the polar night each year, tribespeople would sit around a bonfire, and the priest would dance with a piece of firewood pulled from the fire as a ritual to pray for the tribe.

After the ritual dance, the priest would gift the firewood to a chosen maiden. It is unadorned with gems or bone, yet in one's hand, it retains a lingering warmth.

A forging hammer used by a blacksmith for many years.\n\nSimple in form, covered in the marks of time. Though made of ordinary iron, it can forge sharpness through thousands of hammerings, heralding the birth of a divine weapon.

A masterpiece of an artisan's painstaking effort, the entire body is like gilded quenched steel, possessing the majestic power of a heavenly soldier.\n\nCrossbowmen unleash fire across the battlefield, turning it into a pond filled with red lotuses, hence it is called the Lotus Torch.

With the heart of a mountain as its bone and earth fire as its soul. Its hammer body flows with a luster of molten gold that never solidifies. Every swing carries the heavy, majestic spirit of shaking mountains. It does not seek the finesse of a clean cut, but rather crushes all obstacles in its path into dust with pure power. Perhaps only a warrior whose strength and conviction are as firm as metal and stone can wield this heavy, blazing weapon.

The twang of strings shatters the vast sea, arrows pierce the sky.

This crossbow was born from a question of defiance: If the heavens have boundaries, what cannot be destroyed?
When the mechanism roars, conventional warfare is overturned, and the tides of fate shift in an instant.
Wherever this crossbow points, the scales of victory tip in favor of endless fighting spirit.

The descendants of the fierce tiger guard the freedom of Jiang Prefecture with their surging battle intent.
A wooden crossbow commonly used by ordinary hunters.\n\nThough nothing special, it is trusted and loved by hunters for its easily accessible materials, sturdy structure, and decent power.

A standard heavy crossbow used by soldiers in the Three Kingdoms' Jiangjun region.\n\nManufactured by military craftsmen, it uses refined steel and high-quality ebony, significantly increasing its range and power.

A simple staff made from beast fur and bones.\n\nAmong the Northern Wasteland tribes, whenever a child is born, the priest crafts a simple staff to ensure the newborn is protected by the spirits of their ancestors.

A staff with a cold crystal suspended at its head, appearing as if carved from a single piece of ice.

Legend has it that in the Abyssal Cold of the North, there exists a strange object shaped like an icicle, containing a faint light. Whenever the wind and snow howl, it flickers as if breathing, absorbing the drifting ice and snow.

In Northern legends, this object is known as the Cold Crystal, formed from the obsessions of thousands of Northern creatures. The sighs of all living things drift into the distant sky, eventually condensing into ice and snow, returning to the earth.

A staff personally crafted by the High Priest of the Northern Wasteland tribes.\n\nThe ritual dance is passed down through generations amidst the snow, and the High Priest changes as the staff is handed down. The first ritual dance under the moon marks the beginning of a young priestess's journey.

text:
These wearable, foldable wings are a favorite among the children of Jixia. 
 
After the Team of Stars' victory, Sun Bin's Mechwings became the toy every child wanted. Com-fluence quickly released this product, but for safety, these wings can't actually make you fly.

I keep having the same dream: the dream is filled with thick fog, I can't see anything, only the sound of drums keeps ringing. The lingering sound remains after I wake up. Recently, the drums have gotten louder. Last night, the fog in the dream thinned a bit, but the drums were louder. The shadow I couldn't catch before was a bit closer this time, but just as I was about to touch it, it dissipated. ...I had the dream again. I woke up in the dream to dead silence, red everywhere, and the drums didn't stop. After the war broke out, everything changed. ...Today is my last time coming here; I go to the battlefield tomorrow. But as long as I think about the war, I can't hear the drums. Perhaps, I will be able to reunite with them soon.

text: Grandpa, I miss you. Everything is fine here. I'm doing mechanism research now, which counts as carrying on our family's legacy. I just fear the war might reach here one day. I can't forget that day when you brought out all the ironware, even your most treasured ancestral iron sword, and we forged the sturdiest city-defense mechanism together, but it was all in vain. The flowers in Jixia are blooming everywhere, looking just like Chang'an used to. I miss the flowers of Chang'an, and even more, the flower cakes there. You said, if the Message Fin could swim across the ocean, could it take another look at my hometown for me?

Perhaps you should cater to the Haidu style by adding a pipe, a trench coat, and a fedora? Or learn from the famous detective image in the latest Jixia novels: wearing an ill-fitting blue suit, black-rimmed glasses, and riding a skateboard? You tried a few combinations, but none were satisfactory. Suddenly, you get an idea: you take some ink, paint Judge Di's face completely black, and add a small crescent moon shape on his forehead. Hmm... this looks more like another upright official...
zh_text: 也许应该迎合海都特色，叼上一个烟斗再加件大衣和绅士帽？或者学习稷下最新话本里的名侦探形象，穿着不合身的蓝色西装，戴着黑框眼镜踩着滑板？试着搭配了几套都不满意。霎时，你来了灵感，取来墨汁将狄大人的脸全部涂黑，又在他的额间点了一个小小的月牙形状。嗯……这样更像是另一位青天大老爷了……

text: Your warm reception caught the other party off guard.
zh_text: 你的热情接待让对方受宠若惊。
source_text: 你的热情接待让对方受宠若惊。

text: You must stop these mech-men from occupying the Sky Tower! You immediately send the academy's most elite Lingyun Guards to establish a defense line. It is unclear which side started it, but the war between humans and machines is about to break out!
zh_text: 必须阻止这些机关人攻占通天塔！你立即派出学院最精锐的凌云卫建立防线。不知是哪方先动的手，人机大战一触即发！
source_text: 必须阻止这些机关人攻占通天塔！你立即派出学院最精锐的凌云卫建立防线。不知是哪方先动的手，人机大战一触即发！

text: Your persistence has paid off; everything was worth it.
zh_text: 你的坚持换来了回报一切都值得。
source_text: 你的坚持换来了回报一切都值得。

text: Host a Grand Event: You decide to take this opportunity to hold a massive campus event.
zh_text: 举办盛会你决定借机举办盛大的校园活动。
source_text: 举办盛会你决定借机举办盛大的校园活动。

text:
Speaking of drowning, to demonstrate realism, the instructor jumped into the water to show emergency procedures. He didn't surface for a long time—his breath-holding skills are incredible! Wait, no!
After you came to your senses, the students scrambled to pull the instructor out. Fortunately, the mentor is strong and was unharmed. However, this lesson was certainly vivid.
zh_text:
说到溺水，为求真实，讲师亲自跳入水里示范溺水的紧急处置。过了好久还没浮出水面，憋气能力了得！不对！
在你反应过来后，学子们七手八脚的把讲师捞了起来，好在导师身强体壮并无大碍。不过这一堂课的确十分生动。

source_text: 你第一次把一局学院经营完整走完

text:
You start chatting with the other party, who is surprised to find that you are a person living in the here and now. Although the speed at which the words appear is nowhere near as fast as in some storybook you imagined, this does not hinder communication between you and the book.
Night after night, a thousand and one nights, the person on the other side of the book told you the truth about this world—about the origin of the world, miracles, and a group of heroes protecting the world in secret. Do you want to join them?
zh_text:
你开始和对方聊天，对方惊讶地发现你居然是活在此时此刻的人。虽然字浮现的速度远没有你想象中的某个话本那么快，但是这不妨碍你和书之间的沟通。
一夜又一夜，一千零一夜，书那边的人为你讲述了这个世界的真相——关于世界的起源、奇迹、与一群在暗中保护世界的英雄。你要加入他们吗？

text: The outing allowed everyone to completely relax their body and mind.
zh_text: 出游让大家身心彻底放松。
source_text: 出游让大家身心彻底放松。

text: Completed a total of 10 academy management sessions

Although you believe most in Jixia Academy are of noble character, it is not uncommon for faculty to abuse their positions for personal gain, coercing students to satisfy their own selfish desires. As the Dean, you have the responsibility and the duty to ensure this sacred place of learning remains a bright and upright sanctuary.
zh_text: 虽然你自觉稷下学院多是品德高尚者，但教职员借职务之便牟利，威逼利诱学子满足自己的一己私欲，也并非什么罕见事迹。作为校长，你有责任，也有义务，确保这学术圣地之上，是一片朗朗乾坤。
source_text: 虽然你自觉稷下学院多是品德高尚者，但教职员借职务之便牟利，威逼利诱学子满足自己的一己私欲，也并非什么罕见事迹。作为校长，你有责任，也有义务，确保这学术圣地之上，是一片朗朗乾坤。

text: The little dragons could not stop fighting and eventually tore the garden apart, fleeing into the deeper wilderness of Dragon Banner Valley.
zh_text: 小龙们无法停止争斗，并最终撕裂了花园，逃往了龙旗谷更远的荒野。
source_text: 小龙们无法停止争斗，并最终撕裂了花园，逃往了龙旗谷更远的荒野。

text: Zhuge Liang pondered for a moment, nodded with slight regret, and indicated he couldn't help. He politely declined the children, and you continued to patrol the perimeter of the Academy, where everything remained as usual.
zh_text: 诸葛亮沉吟了会，略带遗憾地点点头，表示爱莫能助，婉拒了孩子们，你们继续巡视学院周边，一切如常。

text: You plan to build an obstacle course for running on water at Yingxing Lake and invite students to challenge it. Finally, one male and one female champion will be selected to receive a high-speed ice maker newly developed by the School of Mechcraft! So, who would you like to invite to design the course?
zh_text: 你打算在映星湖上搭建一条水上奔跑障碍赛道，邀请学子前来挑战。最终选出男生女生各一位冠军，送出机关学院最新研发的高速制冰机一台！如此，你想请谁来设计赛道呢？

text: Persuade to stop fighting: You decide to patiently persuade the little dragons to stop fighting.
zh_text: 劝说停止争斗 你决定耐心劝说小龙们停止争斗。
source_text: 劝说停止争斗 你决定耐心劝说小龙们停止争斗。

text: To signify a break with the past, Lan planned to change into a new set of clothes. During the fitting, it attracted many students to watch and exclaim how handsome he looked. You had a flash of inspiration and opened a tailor shop in Lan's name, letting him be the model, and business exploded.
zh_text: 为了表示和过去决裂，澜打算换一套新衣服，试衣期间引来众多学子围观惊呼好帅。你灵机一动，以澜的名义开了一家裁缝店，让他当模特，生意爆火。
source_text: 为了表示和过去决裂，澜打算换一套新衣服，试衣期间引来众多学子围观惊呼好帅。你灵机一动，以澜的名义开了一家裁缝店，让他当模特，生意爆火。

text:
The young Wei assassin is ready to make a clean break with his past, and for this, he specifically asked you to improve a set of Jixia school uniforms. The green youth took off his mask, revealing a handsome face. Even the simplest school uniform looked so fitting and trendy on him. Life is never short of an audience, and under Lan's influence, more and more students are coming to customize new-style school uniforms.
You realize that perhaps you can make good use of Lan 's model effect and open a small shop exclusively for assassin heroes! As for the selection...
zh_text:
年少的魏都刺客准备彻底和过去决裂，为此，他专门找你改良了一套稷下校服。青涩的少年取下自己的面具，居然露出一张俊美的面容。最朴素的校服，在他身上也显得那么合身且新潮生活从来不缺少观众，在澜的影响下，前来定制新式校服的学子越来越多。
你意识到，也许可以好好利用一下澜的模特效应，开一家专供刺客英雄们的小店！至于选品嘛……

text: Due to limited funds, you only prepared a few heatstroke prevention tools and did a sloppy job. During the farming process, many students suffered from heatstroke due to physical exhaustion. The students who did not receive the heatstroke prevention tools were indignant and demanded an explanation from you.
zh_text: 由于资金受限，你只草草准备了少许防暑用具敷衍了事，在务农的过程中，不少学子因体力透支中暑倒下，没有拿到防暑用具的学子们愤愤不平，向你讨要说法。

text:
The academy is just starting, and everything is waiting to be done. Many teachers and students report that the cafeteria food quality is unstable—one meal is delicious, the next is frustrating. Before putting the spoon in their mouths, no one knows if they can finish the meal calmly...
When you find the culinary expert in charge of the cafeteria, they just throw back the line: Even a clever housewife cannot cook without rice.
zh_text:
学院起步，百废待兴。许多师生反应食堂伙食水平不稳，一顿美味，一顿糟心，在将饭勺放进口中之前，谁也不知道能不能心平气和地吃完这顿饭……
当你找到负责食堂的肴馔家后，对方也只是丢下一句巧妇难为无米之炊。
source_text:
学院起步，百废待兴。许多师生反应食堂伙食水平不稳，一顿美味，一顿糟心，在将饭勺放进口中之前，谁也不知道能不能心平气和地吃完这顿饭……

source_text: 放入主角（注重学子自身修养）

text:
You step forward and perform a self-created martial arts routine. Your punches are fierce and powerful, and the scholars from various academies are subdued by your presence. You then begin your speech—or rather, a notification. You declare straightforwardly, "Benevolence, Wisdom, Art, Physicality, and Technique should be the standards for evaluating all students." Based on this, you design a complete set of competition questions.
You finish your brief statement, and thunderous applause erupts in the hall, unanimously passing your proposal.
zh_text:
你站出来,打了一套自创的武道拳法,出拳刚猛,虎虎生风,各院学者纷纷被你的威压镇服。随后你开始了演讲,与其说演讲,不如说是一种通知,你直白了当的宣告,"仁智艺体技,应该作为考察各位学子的标准",以此为标准,你设计了一整套完整的竞赛考题。
你简短陈述完毕,会场里响起了雷鸣般的掌声,一致通过你的提案。

source_text: 体魄检定 你决定用力量与行动来为组织命名。

text: The surrounding voices became unbearable, so you burned the book, and no more strange things happened.
zh_text: 周围的声音让你再也无法忍受，你焚毁了这本书，再无奇怪的事发生。
source_text: 周围的声音让你再也无法忍受，你焚毁了这本书，再无奇怪的事发生。

text: Your persistence has paid off; everything was worth it.
zh_text: 你的坚持换来了回报一切都值得。
source_text: 你的坚持换来了回报一切都值得。

text: Those who indulge in pleasure are destined to achieve nothing great, you said to the teachers and students. The cafeteria food didn't improve, but it gave everyone a sense of conviction while dining.
zh_text: 沉沦于享受之中的人注定不会有什么大的作为，你对着一众师生如此说道。食堂的伙食没有什么改善，但却让一众师生在用餐时凭空生出几分信念感。
source_text: 沉沦于享受之中的人注定不会有什么大的作为，你对着一众师生如此说道。食堂的伙食没有什么改善，但却让一众师生在用餐时凭空生出几分信念感。

text: Northern Mountains, you decide to set up defenses in the Northern Mountains.
zh_text: 北面重山，你决定在北面重山布防。
source_text: 北面重山，你决定在北面重山布防。

text: When you hold this sun hat, a flash of inspiration strikes your heart. Why not let the students experience Jixia's farming culture? It can cultivate the students' labor values and improve their comprehensive quality. You decide to lead the students to participate in labor practice activities (farming). No sooner said than done, but as you are about to set off, you may need to be fully prepared.
zh_text: 当你手握着这顶遮阳帽，心头仿佛灵光闪烁，何不让为让学子们感受稷下农耕文化？既可培养学子们的劳动观念，又可提高学子们的综合素质，你决定带领学子们参与劳动实践活动（务农）。说干就干，就在出发之际，你或许需要做好万全准备。

text: The outing allowed everyone to completely relax their body and mind.
zh_text: 出游让大家身心彻底放松。
source_text: 出游让大家身心彻底放松。

text: The students are under too much academic pressure and need psychological counseling.
zh_text: 学子们学业压力过大，需要心理辅导。
source_text: 学子们学业压力过大，需要心理辅导。

text: Assign character, Charisma Check (Attract master teachers with charisma)
zh_text: 放入角色，魅力检定（通过魅力吸引名师）
source_text: 放入角色，魅力检定（通过魅力吸引名师）

text: Seeing your firm attitude, the Gugu Prince makes one final request. Before parting, it hopes you can reenact a scene from a CEO romance novel with it. You choose...
zh_text: 咕呱王子见你态度坚决，向你提出最后一个要求，它希望在分别之前，你能和它重现霸总小说里的一场情节，你选择……
source_text: 咕呱王子见你态度坚决，向你提出最后一个要求，它希望在分别之前，你能和它重现霸总小说里的一场情节，你选择……

text: The weapon was quite effective and sold well. Despite some accidental injuries, students still flocked to this brand-new weapon.
zh_text: 武器收效不错，于是大卖，虽然产生了一些误伤，但学子们仍然对这全新的武器趋之若鹜。
source_text: 武器收效不错，于是大卖，虽然产生了一些误伤，但学子们仍然对这全新的武器趋之若鹜。

text:
Fortunately, although it took some effort, all the hard work paid off. These exchange students were not only amazed by Jixia's beautiful scenery and local customs but were also won over by Jixia's advanced educational philosophy and system.
You understand that when they return, the only things circulating in their academies will be praises for Jixia.
zh_text:
所幸，虽然费了些心思，但一切付出都有回报。这些交换生们不仅对稷下的大好风光、风土人情叹为观止，更是被稷下先进的教学理念与教学制度所折服。
你明白，等他们回去后，流传在他们学院中的，必然只有对稷下的溢美之词。
source_text:
所幸，虽然费了些心思，但一切付出都有回报。这些交换生们不仅对稷下的大好风光、风土人情叹为观止，更是被稷下先进的教学理念与教学制度所折服。
你明白，等他们回去后，流传在他们学院中的，必然只有对稷下的溢美之词。

text: The old man insisted that the mechanical seeds could sprout and still needed a lot of money and manpower. Are you still going to invest?
zh_text: 大爷坚称机关种子能发芽，还需要大量钱和人力。你还投不投？
source_text: 大爷坚称机关种子能发芽，还需要大量钱和人力。你还投不投？

text:
A long time has passed since the event, but you have yet to receive news of Meng Ya's triumphant return. You went to the north yourself and found that Meng Ya had led the students of the Mechanism Academy to build a high wall in the north of the Academy, and even interspersed many custom-made hand-cranked cannons in the wall, turning the defense line into a firepower bunker!
Remembering Meng Ya's determined eyes, you didn't stop him. It seems the northern defense line of Jixia will not have any more problems in the future.
zh_text:
距离事件发生已经过去了很久，可你却迟迟没有等来蒙犽凯旋的消息。你亲自前往北部，发现蒙犽带着机关学院的学生在学院北部筑起了一座高墙，还在墙里穿插设计了很多特制手搓火炮，让防线变成了一个火力碉堡！
想起蒙犽那充满斗志的眼睛，你也没有再阻止他，看来以后稷下的北部防线是不会再出问题了。
source_text:

text: Glimpsing the abyss, reason slowly erodes, and whispers are occasionally heard in the ears.
zh_text: 窥见深渊，理智渐蚀，耳畔偶有低语。
source_text: 窥见深渊，理智渐蚀，耳畔偶有低语。

text: Always reading, learned and diligent; the academy's library has become like your own backyard.
zh_text: 手不释卷，博学笃行，学院藏书阁已如自家后院。
source_text: 手不释卷，博学笃行，学院藏书阁已如自家后院。

text: Overly strict management makes students feel depressed and want to transfer.
zh_text: 过严管理让学生感到压抑想转学。
source_text: 过严管理让学生感到压抑想转学。

text: Refuse Sponsorship: You decide not to continue funding, and the old man's experiment ends here.
zh_text: 拒绝赞助 你决定不再继续投入，大爷的实验到此为止。
source_text: 拒绝赞助 你决定不再继续投入，大爷的实验到此为止。

text: Your presence intimidated Prince Guga, leaving him at a loss for what to do.
zh_text: 你的气势镇住了咕呱王子，它一时不知所措。
source_text: 你的气势镇住了咕呱王子，它一时不知所措。

text: Charm Check: You decide to use your charm and style to impress the exchange students.
zh_text: 魅力检定你决定用魅力与风采打动交换生。
source_text: 魅力检定你决定用魅力与风采打动交换生。

text: Ignore. You decide to turn a blind eye to the actions of the materialist family.
zh_text: 无视 你决定对物币家的行为视而不见。
source_text: 无视 你决定对物币家的行为视而不见。

text: You accepted the marriage proposal, and the next day the Croak Prince brought an entire tribe to settle down.
zh_text: 你接受了求婚，第二天咕呱王子带了一整个部落来定居。
source_text: 你接受了求婚，第二天咕呱王子带了一整个部落来定居。

text: Having defeated the enemies in the Cloud Silkworm Room, the glowing heroes ask you to name the organization.
zh_text: 击败了云蚕间的敌人，发光的英雄们让你给组织起个名字。
source_text: 击败了云蚕间的敌人，发光的英雄们让你给组织起个名字。

text: You talked until you were blue in the face, but the other party still chose another academy.
zh_text: 你说破了嘴对方还是选择了另一所学院。
source_text: 你说破了嘴对方还是选择了另一所学院。

text: The famous students all have their own tempers, making them particularly difficult to manage.
zh_text: 成名的学子们各有脾气管理起来格外头疼。
source_text: 成名的学子们各有脾气管理起来格外头疼。

text:
Question 1: Why does Angela deal so much damage?
Jixia students buzz in! Because she carries a book, and knowledge is power! Correct answer!
Question 2: Beat a bird, name a hero. Jingshan students think for a moment, "Dr Bian!" Correct answer!
...... Question 10: Why does Luna run out of mana so quickly?
Qianku students buzz in, because Luna is also a "Moonlight Clan" member, correct answer!
Everyone has a lot of imagination, and this round of the competition ended in a draw.
zh_text:
第一题：为什么安琪拉的伤害很高？
稷下学子抢答！因为她拿着书，知识就是力量！回答正确！
第二题：揍鸟，打一英雄名。径山学子略加思索，"是扁鹊！"回答正确！
……第十题：为什么露娜的蓝用得快？
千窟学子抢答，因为露娜也算"月光族"了，回答正确！
大家都很有想象力，本轮竞赛战成平局。

text: As a head of school sitting in a high position, one will inevitably overlook the simplest voices of teachers and students. An academy should focus on more than just education; it should also focus on the needs of the people themselves. Now is the time to listen to their voices.
zh_text: 作为一校之长，端坐高位之上，必定会忽视来自师生最朴素的声音。一所学院该关注的不仅仅是教育，还有人本身的诉求。现在，正是时候去倾听他们的声音。

text: Complete Special Character Event: Princess Frost - Ice and Snow World
zh_text: 完成特殊角色事件：王昭君·冰雪大世界
source_text: 完成特殊角色事件：王昭君·冰雪大世界

text:
I have talent, and Kong Ming wants to block me. I step up to sing, and he provides the beatboxing in the back. The Dean's aura is unstoppable, and all opponents surrender!
From then on, you gradually became a new underground legend in Jixia...

我有才艺在身上，孔明想上我阻挡。亲自上阵把歌唱，他在后面口技帮。校长气场不可挡，对手全部投降！
从此，你渐渐成为了稷下一条新的地下传说……

从此，你渐渐成为了稷下一条新的地下传说……

text: You spent a fortune on exchange students who do not appreciate it.
zh_text: 你花了重金交换生并不领情。
source_text: 你花了重金交换生并不领情。

text: The academy is in a financial crisis, and you invest according to Xishi's wealth-building plan.
zh_text: 学院陷入财政危机，你按照西施致富经的方案投资。
source_text: 学院陷入财政危机，你按照西施致富经的方案投资。

text: Late at night, a bunch of radishes filed in, ready to carry away the radishes in your basket.
zh_text: 深夜，一大堆萝卜鱼贯而入准备扛走你菜篮里的萝卜。
source_text: 深夜，一大堆萝卜鱼贯而入准备扛走你菜篮里的萝卜。

zh_text: 新方案有些激进初期运行不顺畅。
source_text: 新方案有些激进初期运行不顺畅。

text: This cooking competition not only provided new ideas for the participants but also opened your eyes. It turns out Jixia has so many ingredients that seem ordinary but are rich in nutrients! In the future, the academy's catering can source ingredients locally, allowing us to eat better for less.
zh_text: 这次厨艺大赛不仅给参与选手提供了新思路，也让你开了眼界。原来稷下还有这么多看似普通却营养丰富的食材！以后学院的餐饮供应可以就地取材，花更少吃更好啦。
source_text: 这次厨艺大赛不仅给参与选手提供了新思路，也让你开了眼界。原来稷下还有这么多看似普通却营养丰富的食材！以后学院的餐饮供应可以就地取材，花更少吃更好啦。

zh_text: 一场校园风波正在酝酿。
source_text: 一场校园风波正在酝酿。

text: Some people just don't buy it.
After several rounds, the rhythm of the academy's operation has been mastered
zh_text: 连开数局后，已经摸清学院运转的节奏
source_text: 连开数局后，已经摸清学院运转的节奏

text: If you can understand the errors and the logic in the scrolls, this society will most easily recognize your meticulous skills.

source_text: 若能把卷页里的错漏与前后章法看明白，这一社便最容易认你这份细致本事。

text: For the upcoming academic assembly, you plan to invite an "Outstanding Graduate," an "Outstanding Student Parent," and a "Model for Employment." After much thought, you realize Jing fulfills all these roles alone.
zh_text: 在即将召开的学年大会上，你准备邀请“优秀毕业生”“优秀学生家长”“毕业就业模范”来参会，想来想去，发现镜一个人就全部满足。
source_text: 在即将召开的学年大会上，你准备邀请“优秀毕业生”“优秀学生家长”“毕业就业模范”来参会，想来想去，发现镜一个人就全部满足。

text: Large Ringild. You decide to invest a large amount of Ringild to comprehensively upgrade teaching aids.
zh_text: 大环金 你决定投入大量环金全面升级教具。
source_text: 大环金 你决定投入大量环金全面升级教具。

text: You found a dilapidated lamp and hung it on a pillar. That night, it emitted a strange light...
zh_text: 你捡到一盏破败的灯挂在柱子上，当晚它散发奇异的光芒……
source_text: 你捡到一盏破败的灯挂在柱子上，当晚它散发奇异的光芒……

text:
He smiles confidently and takes a strange-looking mechanical stick from his backpack. He presses a button, and the top of the stick suddenly unfolds. "Just believe, press it, and it will turn into a giant mechanical man."
You take the stick, only to find that it has no other function besides unfolding. "I'll study it carefully," you say, while gesturing for the herbalist students to take him away for a check-up. As for the stick, it can still be sold for some money as a souvenir.
zh_text:
他自信一笑,从自己的背包里取出了一个看起来有些奇怪的机关棒,按下按钮,棒子顶端的忽地展开。"只要相信,按下他,就能变成巨型机关人。"
你拿过机关棒,却发现它除了那个展开功能外一无所有。"我会好好研究"你一边应付着,一边打个手势让百草家同学们把他带下去检查检查。至于那个棒子,做个纪念品,还是能买些钱的。

text: You successfully repelled the attack of the mechanical puppets.

source_text: 你成功阻击了机关人的进攻。

text: You were too silent, and the audience thought you were unprepared.
zh_text: 你太沉默了台下以为你没准备。
source_text: 你太沉默了台下以为你没准备。

text: You use academic credits as bait to cultivate a group of students. They mingle in class, pretending to chat with others, while secretly noting down the names of these people. You are going to send all these troublemakers to clean up Jixia!
zh_text: 你用学分做诱惑，培养了一批学子。他们混在课堂上，假装和人接话，实则暗暗记下这些人的名单。你要将这些破坏课堂秩序的家伙全发配去打扫稷下卫生！
source_text: 你用学分做诱惑，培养了一批学子。他们混在课堂上，假装和人接话，实则暗暗记下这些人的名单。你要将这些破坏课堂秩序的家伙全发配去打扫稷下卫生！

text: Annual order goal not maintained; academy discipline is lax.
zh_text: 年度秩序目标未稳住，学院纲纪松散。

text: You attend the annual meeting but are called out by Shye to perform a talent.
zh_text: 你参加年会却被西施点名表演才艺。

text: You toss down several gold rings, telling Gu-Gua that you will cover all its future expenses. Gu-Gua is stunned by your extravagance and submits to your dominant aura.
zh_text: 你伸手甩下数枚环金，告诉咕呱它接下来的所有消费都由你承包，咕呱被你的豪气所震慑，折服在你的霸总风范之下。

text: Turmoil and disorder finally brought down this academy that had hoped to be all-inclusive. The lectures were deserted, the courtyards grew empty, and the teachers and students who had once gathered here left one by one during the repeated upheavals. Years of planning ultimately failed to leave behind a true academic tradition, leaving only a courtyard slowly covered by dust and an old dream that no one mentions anymore.
zh_text: 风波与失序终于拖垮了这座本想兼收并蓄的学院。讲席冷落，门庭渐空，曾经汇聚于此的师生也在一次次动荡中各自离去。多年筹谋终究未能留下真正的学统，只余一座被尘土慢慢覆盖的院落，和一段无人再提起的旧梦。
source_text: 风波与失序终于拖垮了这座本想兼收并蓄的学院。讲席冷落，门庭渐空，曾经汇聚于此的师生也在一次次动荡中各自离去。多年筹谋终究未能留下真正的学统，只余一座被尘土慢慢覆盖的院落，和一段无人再提起的旧梦。

text: Everyone is already tired enough from studying, so let's not make this so strict! After a while, you noticed that the students who honestly finished the run were mostly from the Martial Arts Academy. And they actually turned this into a competition, comparing who ran more mileage every day.
zh_text: 大家学习已经够累了，就不要把这件事弄这么严格吧！过了一段时间，你发现老实跑完的学子基本都是来自武道学院的。而且他们居然还把这东西变成了比赛，天天比谁跑的里程更多。
source_text: 大家学习已经够累了，就不要把这件事弄这么严格吧！过了一段时间，你发现老实跑完的学子基本都是来自武道学院的。而且他们居然还把这东西变成了比赛，天天比谁跑的里程更多。

text: The annual meeting prizes Xishi carefully designed did not meet expectations. By the time the blind boxes were opened, the students felt the names sounded grander than the actual surprises, which were increasingly lackluster. The so-called grand prize was also temporarily canceled because your schedule was full. After the excitement faded, everyone only remembered the awkward gap between expectation and reality.
zh_text: 西施精心设计的年会奖品没能达到预期。盲盒拆到最后，学子们只觉得名头一个比一个响，实际惊喜却越来越薄。所谓最终大奖也因为你的日程排不开而临时取消，热闹散去后，大家只记住了这场尴尬的期待落差。
source_text: 西施精心设计的年会奖品没能达到预期。盲盒拆到最后，学子们只觉得名头一个比一个响，实际惊喜却越来越薄。所谓最终大奖也因为你的日程排不开而临时取消，热闹散去后，大家只记住了这场尴尬的期待落差。

text:
Rebuilding the academy involves many tasks, but just at this moment, you fell from a fragile cloud board and broke both your legs. What should you do? As the new principal, how can you protect our academy like this!
Just as you were lamenting the dim future of Jixia, a gurgling sound came from behind you. You turned around to see Dunshan slowly crouching down in front of you, pointing at his head as if inviting you to climb on.
zh_text:
重建学院事务繁多，可偏偏就在这个时候，你从纤弱的云游板上摔了下来，双腿骨折。这可如何是好？身为新校长，这样还怎么守护我们的学院啊！
在你感叹稷下未来一片昏暗时，一阵叽里咕噜的声音在身后响起，你转过身，只见盾山巨大的身躯在你面前缓缓蹲下，伸手指了指自己的脑袋。好像在邀请你上去。
source_text:

text:
You eagerly sign up for the Radish Squat competition and successfully advance, becoming the new Radish King. With a wave of your hand, millions of radishes are at your command, and you decide to use them to rule the world...
Unexpectedly, you are assassinated by a radish spy. When you wake up, you realize it was just a dream, only the radishes in the basket are gone.
zh_text:
你踊跃报名萝卜蹲比赛，并且成功晋级，成为了新一任的萝卜大王，挥一挥手，便是百万萝卜任你差遣，你决定利用萝卜统治世界……
没想到却被萝卜间谍刺杀，等你醒来的时候，你发现只是一场梦，只是菜篮的萝卜不见了。

source_text: 投入更多 你决定继续对大爷的机关种子追加投资。
