text: A scholar, moved by the academic atmosphere, decides to join.
zh_text: 一位学者被学术氛围打动决定加盟。
source_text: 一位学者被学术氛围打动决定加盟。

text: The equipment you prepared for Hua Mulan did not come in handy. The purchased cloud-travel boards, soft armor, and secret recipes each had their own problems; they were either too heavy or didn't fit the cleanup mission. Hua Mulan looked at the mountain of supplies in silence for a moment, and finally only picked out the simplest items.
zh_text: 你为花木兰准备的装备没有派上用场。采购来的云游板、软甲和秘方各有各的问题，不是太重，就是和清剿任务不搭。花木兰看着堆成小山的物资沉默片刻，最终只挑走了最朴素的几件。
source_text: 你为花木兰准备的装备没有派上用场。采购来的云游板、软甲和秘方各有各的问题，不是太重，就是和清剿任务不搭。花木兰看着堆成小山的物资沉默片刻，最终只挑走了最朴素的几件。

text: An angry student bangs on your door and slams the Jixia cafeteria food onto your desk. In such hot weather, with such terrible food, how is everyone supposed to eat this!
zh_text: 愤怒的学子拍响你的房门，将稷下食堂的饭菜摔在你的案头。这么热的天气，这么难吃的饭菜，叫大家怎么下咽啊！
source_text: 愤怒的学子拍响你的房门，将稷下食堂的饭菜摔在你的案头。这么热的天气，这么难吃的饭菜，叫大家怎么下咽啊！

text: The students are struggling under the heavy academic pressure.
zh_text: 学子们在沉重的学业压力下喘不过气。
source_text: 学子们在沉重的学业压力下喘不过气。

text: Cangbing City is a well-known ruin; teams without sufficient knowledge won't be able to uncover its secrets. On this trip, you have collected quite a bit of primary historical material for the history of the Jixia War.
zh_text: 藏兵城是个出了名的遗迹，知识储备不够的队伍可发现不了其中秘辛。此行你们为稷下战争史搜集了不少一手史料。
source_text: 藏兵城是个出了名的遗迹，知识储备不够的队伍可发现不了其中秘辛。此行你们为稷下战争史搜集了不少一手史料。

text: To set an example for the students, you, as headmaster, led everyone in farming. Unexpectedly, you used too much force while hoeing, and the hoe fell into the nearby river. At this moment, a burst of golden light emanated from the river, and a goddess as graceful as a startled swan slowly appeared. Looking at her face, you felt it was very familiar—could it be Zhen Ji? She asked you if you dropped a golden hoe, a silver hoe, or a regular hoe.
zh_text: 为了给学子们一个表率，你作为校长带领大家耕作，没想到锄地时过于用力，锄头掉进了旁边的小河里，此时河中散发出一阵金光，只见一位翩若惊鸿的女神缓缓出现，望着她的面容，你觉得好生眼熟，难道是甄姬？她问你掉的是金锄头还是银锄头还是普通锄头。
source_text: 为了给学子们一个表率，你作为校长带领大家耕作，没想到锄地时过于用力，锄头掉进了旁边的小河里，此时河中散发出一阵金光，只见一位翩若惊鸿的女神缓缓出现，望着她的面容，你觉得好生眼熟，难道是甄姬？她问你掉的是金锄头还是银锄头还是普通锄头。

text: You study them for a long time without a clue, thinking these coins might be wishing coins that grant desires when thrown into water. You toss them all in, but aside from your savings mysteriously decreasing, nothing else happens.
zh_text: 你研究了许久还是没有头绪，觉得这些钱币或许是许愿币，丢尽水里就能满足愿望。于是你把这些钱币全部丢入水中，但除了你的积蓄凭空减少许多之外，并没有出现任何其他变化。
source_text: 你研究了许久还是没有头绪，觉得这些钱币或许是许愿币，丢尽水里就能满足愿望。于是你把这些钱币全部丢入水中，但除了你的积蓄凭空减少许多之外，并没有出现任何其他变化。

text: After being separated, the little dragon is much quieter, and classroom order is restored.
zh_text: 分开后小龙安静许多，课堂秩序恢复。
source_text: 分开后小龙安静许多，课堂秩序恢复。

text: The academy failed to form a strong atmosphere for academic research. Students did not truly engage in research projects, and the guidance from teachers had limited effect, ultimately failing to push the academy to a higher academic level.
zh_text: 学院并未形成浓厚的学术研究氛围。学子们没有真正投入课题钻研，老师们的引导也收效有限，最终未能推动学院达到更高的学术水准。
source_text: 学院并未形成浓厚的学术研究氛围。学子们没有真正投入课题钻研，老师们的引导也收效有限，最终未能推动学院达到更高的学术水准。

text: Sima Yi could not accept the Witch's Cloak. The atmosphere at the rehearsal scene solidified for a time. He stared at the clothes for a long time, and finally put them back into your hands neatly. The strategist alliance was missing a complete look, and the public performance plan was delayed because of this. You can only silently note not to stimulate him like this again in the future.
zh_text: 司马懿没能接受那套魔女斗篷。彩排现场气氛一度凝固，他盯着衣服沉默许久，最终把它整齐地放回你手里。军师联盟少了一套完整造型，公演计划也因此推迟，你只能默默记下以后别再这样刺激他。
source_text: 司马懿没能接受那套魔女斗篷。彩排现场气氛一度凝固，他盯着衣服沉默许久，最终把它整齐地放回你手里。军师联盟少了一套完整造型，公演计划也因此推迟，你只能默默记下以后别再这样刺激他。

text: The seven little dragons happily attended class with the students, even though they didn't understand a word.
zh_text: 七条小龙愉快地和学生们一起上课，尽管它们什么都没听懂。
source_text: 七条小龙愉快地和学生们一起上课，尽管它们什么都没听懂。

text: The academy is in a financial crisis, and you invest according to Xishi's wealth-building plan.
zh_text: 学院陷入财政危机，你按照西施致富经的方案投资。
source_text: 学院陷入财政危机，你按照西施致富经的方案投资。

zh_text: 放入主角，学识检定（学术汇报）
source_text: 放入主角，学识检定（学术汇报）

text: The power of the Burning Mountain Stone is truly not to be underestimated. The young lady carefully designed the yield, and this time it would surely work! Before Lady Sun could even mount the cannon, with a "bang," the modified cannon took off into the air and quickly flew into the distance, becoming the most dazzling shooting star in the Jixia daytime. Fortunately, Lady Sun wasn't actually sitting on the cannon... There was no other way; you had to start from scratch and teach Lady Sun the principles of the Burning Mountain Stone.
zh_text: 燃山石的威力果然不容小觑，大小姐小心翼翼的设计好了当量，这次一定没问题！还不等孙尚香骑上火炮，“嘭”的一声，改装后的火炮腾空而起，迅速朝着远处飞驰而去，化作了稷下白天最耀眼的一颗流星。幸好孙尚香没有真坐在火炮上…… 没办法， 你只能从头开始给孙尚香科普燃山石的原理。
source_text: 燃山石的威力果然不容小觑，大小姐小心翼翼的设计好了当量，这次一定没问题！还不等孙尚香骑上火炮，“嘭”的一声，改装后的火炮腾空而起，迅速朝着远处飞驰而去，化作了稷下白天最耀眼的一颗流星。幸好孙尚香没有真坐在火炮上…… 没办法， 你只能从头开始给孙尚香科普燃山石的原理。

text: Half-doubting, you kiss it: You kissed it, though still half-doubting.
zh_text: 将信将疑亲它一口 你半信半疑地亲了它一口。
source_text: 将信将疑亲它一口 你半信半疑地亲了它一口。

text: Thanks to your generous help, the old man's mechanical workshop was completed ahead of schedule.
zh_text: 由于你的慷慨相助，大爷的机关工坊提前建成。
source_text: 由于你的慷慨相助，大爷的机关工坊提前建成。

text: Well-read and knowledgeable, with all the academy's classics in your heart.
zh_text: 博闻强识，满腹经纶，学院典籍尽在胸中。
source_text: 博闻强识，满腹经纶，学院典籍尽在胸中。

text: First brush with the strange and mysterious, heart slightly rippled, but still able to maintain composure.
zh_text: 初涉诡秘，心神微漾，尚能自持。
source_text: 初涉诡秘，心神微漾，尚能自持。

text: All three core indicators have achieved quality, and the academy enters the near-perfect ending.
zh_text: 三项核心指标皆有成色，学院进入准完美结局。
source_text: 三项核心指标皆有成色，学院进入准完美结局。

text: Unnoticed, the students' eyes grew dim, and the various schools of thought saw fewer and fewer visitors. The academy's vitality quietly dissolved like snow after the start of spring. The academic achievements made by the students under academic pressure remained dazzling, but you would occasionally think while reviewing documents in the headmaster's office, "Is all this really worth it?"
zh_text: 不觉间,学院学子们目光灰暗,一众百家也门可罗雀,学院的生命力像是入春后的积雪一般悄然消融。学院学子们迫于学术压力由学院学子所做的各项学术成果依旧耀眼夺目,不过你偶尔会在校长室审阅文件时想到,"这一切真的值得吗?"
source_text: 不觉间,学院学子们目光灰暗,一众百家也门可罗雀,学院的生命力像是入春后的积雪一般悄然消融。学院学子们迫于学术压力由学院学子所做的各项学术成果依旧耀眼夺目,不过你偶尔会在校长室审阅文件时想到,"这一切真的值得吗?"

text: You successfully became a member of those secretly protecting this world. The other party said that the symbol of your identity would be sent to you soon. When you asked for the time, the other party replied with four words and then suddenly went silent: "Signal is bad." You started writing at the end of the book every day, asking why they didn't reply to your messages. Soon you started telling others about this, but obviously, everyone thought you were crazy.
zh_text: 你成功成了暗中保护这个世界的一员，对方说属于你的身份象征很快会寄到你手里，当你追问时间时，对方回复了四个字后突然杳无音讯，信号好差。你开始每天在书的最后写字，追问对方为什么不回复消息。很快你开始告诉身边其他人这件事，但是显然大家觉得你疯了。
source_text: 你成功成了暗中保护这个世界的一员，对方说属于你的身份象征很快会寄到你手里，当你追问时间时，对方回复了四个字后突然杳无音讯，信号好差。你开始每天在书的最后写字，追问对方为什么不回复消息。很快你开始告诉身边其他人这件事，但是显然大家觉得你疯了。

text: Your efforts have paid off! Now, it's time to go back and face the trivial matters of the academy.
zh_text: 你的努力得到了回报！现在，该回去面对学院的琐碎事务了。
source_text: 你的努力得到了回报！现在，该回去面对学院的琐碎事务了。

text: A medium budget is neither here nor there, and the results are not as expected.
zh_text: 中等预算不上不下效果不如预期。
source_text: 中等预算不上不下效果不如预期。

text: What did you say, collect seven of what?
zh_text: 你说什么，集齐七个什么？
source_text: 你说什么，集齐七个什么？

text: Your momentum was not established when you took the question this time, and Li Bai just laughed and said to come back another day, letting someone else take this seat for today.
zh_text: 你这回接题时气势没立住，李白只笑说改日再来，今日这一席便先让给旁人。
source_text: 你这回接题时气势没立住，李白只笑说改日再来，今日这一席便先让给旁人。

text: Martial Sparring: You decide to test the other's strength through a martial sparring session.
zh_text: 武道切磋 你决定用武道切磋来考核对方实力。
source_text: 武道切磋 你决定用武道切磋来考核对方实力。

text: The report does indeed contain the academy's daily operations, but the text interspersed within is completely unrelated to the academy.
zh_text: 报告上的内容的确是今天学院的运转情况，但中间夹杂着的文字，却与学院完全无关。
source_text: 报告上的内容的确是今天学院的运转情况，但中间夹杂着的文字，却与学院完全无关。

text:
You held a grand academy banquet with delicious food, song and dance performances, and a bonfire party...
The cost in gold rings was unavoidable. But compared to the eager expectations of the teachers and students, what are a few gold rings?
zh_text:
你举办了一场盛大的学院宴会，美食佳肴、歌舞表演、篝火晚会……
环金的花费难以避免。可与满校师生的殷切期待相比，区区环金，又算得了什么呢？

text: Faced with the academy's financial difficulties, Shye shared her idea with you: We should open a shop themed around the academy's heroes to provide students with brand-new goods. You agree with her idea, but she asks you: What should be the main item for our new shop? Wearing that necklace that looks like the eye of a cloud silkworm, you find that you can see the results that different choices might lead to. You decide the main item to promote is:

text: The planner came up with a creative idea: a "Marathon Music Festival"! All the bands are lined up in a long row, and the audience has to run back and forth to experience the different performances. By the end of the festival, the students' lung capacity had been greatly exercised.
zh_text: 策划别出心裁,想出了一场"马拉松音乐节"!将所有乐队排成一长排,听众们需要来回往返跑去感受不同的演出。整场音乐节下来,学子们的肺活量得到了极大的锻炼。
source_text: 策划别出心裁,想出了一场"马拉松音乐节"!将所有乐队排成一长排,听众们需要来回往返跑去感受不同的演出。整场音乐节下来,学子们的肺活量得到了极大的锻炼。

text:
The students of Jingshan Academy and the young students of Qianku City made a brilliant appearance. Under your leadership, can Jixia Academy win the Wanli Contention Competition?
However, who decides the exam questions for this competition? According to convention, each headmaster can propose exam questions, which are then voted on by everyone.
A thought arose in your mind: for students, the five comprehensive qualities of "Benevolence, Wisdom, Art, Physicality, and Skill" are indispensable. You decide to make a proposal based on this.
How can you persuade everyone to pass your proposal?
zh_text:
径山书院的学子,千窟城的年轻学子们闪亮登场。在你的带领下,稷下学院能否在此次万里争鸣竞赛中夺冠?
不过,本次大赛的考题是谁来决定?按惯例,各位校长可以提出考题提案,由众人表决。
冥冥之中有个念头在你脑海升起,对于学子们来说,"仁智艺体技"五项综合素养缺一不可。你决定以此做出提案。
要通过怎样的方式说服大家通过你的提案呢?
source_text:
径山书院的学子,千窟城的年轻学子们闪亮登场。在你的带领下,稷下学院能否在此次万里争鸣竞赛中夺冠?
不过,本次大赛的考题是谁来决定?按惯例,各位校长可以提出考题提案,由众人表决。
冥冥之中有个念头在你脑海升起,对于学子们来说,"仁智艺体技"五项综合素养缺一不可。你决定以此做出提案。
要通过怎样的方式说服大家通过你的提案呢?

text: The admissions office reports that during the process, a newcomer presented a unique student card, claiming that their rank was insufficient to assess him. Confused, they asked for your instructions. Upon arriving at the admissions office, you find a stranger sitting in the examiner's seat. He claims to be a genius personally granted that card by the Three Sages to save the academy in its time of need. His tone is firm, yet he has no proof. As you ponder how to handle this, he proactively challenges you to a duel. He claims to be a master of martial arts, mechanisms, and magic alike. The students present, intrigued, gather around to watch the performance of the acting headmaster and the genius newcomer.
zh_text: 招生处的学子向你汇报，招生过程中，一名新人拿出了一张造型特别的学生卡，并表示以他们的级别无权对他进行考核。他们没有头绪，因此只能来请示你。 你来到招生处，果然看到一个陌生人坐在考官的位置上，他表示自己是被三贤亲手给予那张学生卡，关键时刻来拯救学院的天才。 对方语气斩钉截铁，却空口无凭，你正在思索该怎么处理，他却主动表示和你切磋，武道，机关，魔道，反正他无一不会，无一不精，而在场的学子，也被激起了兴致，纷纷凑过来，打算看看代理校长和天才新生的表现。

text: You pay out of your own pocket to replenish the ingredients for everyone, and the students feast to their heart's content, feeling very satisfied.

source_text: 你自掏腰包为大家补齐了食材，学子们大快朵颐，十分满足。

text: You passionately announced the name, and a yawn came from the audience.

source_text: 你激情宣布了名字，台下传来一个哈欠声。

text:
Perhaps you neglected the discipline of the students; recently, the academy has been in turmoil, with heroes rising everywhere. Students have formed cliques, established their own factions, and stirred up territorial disputes. They have only one ultimate goal.
To challenge you and ask, in this academy, who holds the power? It's time to take action and show them who really has the ability to make Jixia great again.
zh_text:
或许是你疏忽了学子的管教，近期学院内风云变幻，群雄并起。学子们拉帮结派，成立自己的势力，掀起割据纷争。他们最终的目的只有一个。
欲与你讨教一二，试问，在这学院之中，谁主沉浮？是时候该出手了，让他们瞧瞧，是谁才有能力让稷下再次伟大。

text: Even after leaving the Magic Academy, you weren't sure if they had actually agreed... But overnight, a mysterious and ever-changing track appeared on Yingxing Lake. According to students who later participated in the challenge, the insights gained on the track were far more valuable than any ice-making machine. Truly mysterious.

text: You refused the sponsorship and found out the origin of the mechanical core through other channels.

text: You made many efforts, but in the end, you were one step behind and failed to prevent the disaster... By the time the scandal broke, it was all over. Although the academy suffered no material loss, the harm to those involved and the damage to the academy's reputation serve as a reminder to never let such things happen again.
zh_text: 你做了许多努力，可终究还是棋差一招，未能防患于未然……当丑闻传出之时，一切都已经完了。学院虽然没有蒙受实质性的损失，但相关者所受的伤害，学院损失的名誉都警醒着你不要让此类事宜再次发生。

text: You dash into the bedroom to catch the thieving radishes. They scatter in all directions, and in the chaos, they drop a uniquely shaped radish.

text: The academy's atmosphere is lax, and you decide to launch a management overhaul.

source_text: 学院风气懈怠，你决定展开管理整顿。

text:
The Divine Strategist Kongming found you. He plans to conduct some social practice research at Jixia. By analyzing individual samples of students, he aims to summarize a unique methodology, starting with the tertiary service industry, to streamline a combination of measures for Jixia's industrial recovery...
He said a lot of confusing things, and finally Kongming asked you to issue him a logistics business license so he could set up a studio for practical research. So, which direction should you write down?
zh_text:
神机军师诸葛亮找到你，他打算在稷下做一些社会实践的研究，通过对学子们的个体化样本分析，总结出一套独特方法论，从而从第三产业服务业入手，理顺一套针对稷下产业复苏的组合拳……
云里雾里说了很多，最后诸葛亮让你为他签发一张物流经营许可证，以便他成立工作室进行实操研究。所以，该写哪一个方向呢？

text: Meng Ya followed your advice, but the Door-Breakers did not pass through the route where you deployed firearms, but instead caught the Academy off guard. The students discussed behind your back, questioning your decision.

text:
The people from Jingshan Academy won! They cheered and laughed, celebrating this hard-won victory!
The Jixia students were not surprised, because they did not win a single victory in the five rounds of competition . Facing the final awards day, everyone felt ashamed. As the host of this event, Jixia's students' performance was truly unsatisfactory, and as the headmaster, you bear an inescapable responsibility for this.
zh_text:
径山书院的人获胜了！他们欢呼着笑闹着，庆祝这来之不易的胜利！
稷下学子并没有感到意外，因为他们在五轮比赛中没有获得任何一场胜利。面对最终的颁奖日，大家都感到羞愧不已。稷下身为本次赛事的主办方，自家学子的表现实在不尽人意，身为校长的你，对此负有不可推卸的责任。

text:
Li Bai held a poetry recitation conference, where he would recite his own poems in person. On the day of the conference, there was a sea of people. Li Bai danced with his sword and recited the "harmonious version" of the poems with great emotion: "Five-flower horse, thousand-gold fur, call the boy to exchange for milk tea," "Laughing away a cup of fermented rice wine, critical hit in the city"...
Over-execution is opposition. You are surprised by Li Bai's clever creativity. Sure enough, the crowd, feeling itchy all over, began to denounce the academy version of the poetry collection. Faced with the students who threatened to complain to the publisher, the publisher finally restored the unedited version of Li Bai's poems.
zh_text:
李白举办了一场诗朗诵大会，届时他将亲自朗诵自己的诗作。大会当天人山人海，李白挥剑起舞，声情并茂地念起“和谐版”的诗句：“五花马，千金裘，呼儿将出换奶茶”、“笑尽一杯醪糟，暴击人都市中”……
过度执行就是反对，你惊讶于李白如此巧妙的创意。果然，听得满身刺挠的群众开始声讨学院版诗集。?面对着扬言要投诉出版社的学子们，出版方最终恢复了李白诗句的未改动版本。

text: For an academy, students are the foundation of its vitality. If we admit students with poor aptitude, their future failures could tarnish the academy's reputation; if we only select students with exceptional aptitude, the academy will be empty, and beyond failing to meet the needs of normal campus life, it would likely become a laughingstock among other academies. Various potential risks have become clear under your brainstorming; now, what you need to do is very clear...
zh_text: 对一所学院而言，其生命力的根本，便是学子。若是招进了资质太差的学子，日后教坏了传出去，岂不败坏了学院的名声；若是只挑选资质优异的学子，到时候学院内空空荡荡，不谈能否满足正常的校园生活需求，光是传出去，怕是也会惹得其他学院笑话。种种潜在的隐患在你的头脑风暴下清晰起来，现在，你需要做的事已经十分明了……

text: Since taking over as headmaster, you have had to handle not only the academy's internal affairs but also letters from the outside world.
zh_text: 接任校长以来，除了学院内部的大事小情，就连外界发来的信件，也要你一并处理。

text: You threw a punch, but he dodged it, which instead attracted onlookers.
zh_text: 你挥拳过去他躲开了，反引来路人围观。

text:
To film a good promotional video, Li Yuanfang fully utilized his rigorous detective traits, beginning to travel across Jixia's landscape and earnestly learning about every flower and tree. To facilitate recording, an account called "Yuanfang's Popular Science Daily" emerged in the interest circle. Many fans came for his name, and Jixia was bustling with traffic for a time.
Before the promotional video was even filmed, Jixia was already swarming with visitors, and for a moment, you couldn't tell if they came for Jixia or for Li Yuanfang...
zh_text:
为了拍好宣传片，李元芳充分发挥密探严谨的特质，开始游历稷下河山，认真了解每一株花木。为了方便记录，一个叫做“元芳科普日常”的账号在兴趣圈横空出世。许多粉丝慕名前来，稷下一时车水马龙。
宣传片还没拍摄，稷下就已经熙熙攘攘涌入了来客，你一时分不清他们是为了稷下而来，还是为了李元芳而来……

text: Hypnosis: You decided to use hypnosis to test the other party's psychological resilience.

source_text: 催眠术 你决定用催眠术考验对方心理素质。

text:
The smartest minds, the ultimate creativity! Kongming , Zhou Yu, Sima Yi, and Yuan Ge, the "Jixia F4," reunite to bring everyone the strongest group on the continent—the "Brocade Bag Band"! And you, the wisest Dean of Jixia, naturally became their manager!
I heard you took over Jixia and became the Dean.
The new official takes office, and the enemy's formation is the most arrogant.
Those troublemakers heard the news and acted like a pack of hungry wolves.
Lining up at the school gate, singing self-composed rap.
Wanting to use this trick to reclaim the home field at the academy.
Can you tolerate this? My newly formed band! Thinking of this, you can no longer keep a low profile. Hire a powerful outsider to stabilize the scene and let those troublemakers open their eyes and watch.
zh_text:
最聪明的头脑，最极致的创意！诸葛亮、周瑜、司马懿、元歌“稷下F4”强势再聚首，为大家带来大陆最强组合——“锦囊乐队”！而你，稷下最睿智的校长，自然而然成为了他们的经纪人！
听说你入主稷下，当了校长。
新官上任，敌人阵仗最嚣张。
那些破门生闻风，像群饿狼。
排着队在校门口，唱自编的说唱。
想用这招在学院，找回主场。
这你能忍？我刚组建的乐队！想到这里，你不能再低调。请个强有力外援，把场子镇牢，让那群破门生们，开眼瞧好。

text:
Lady Sun had long yearned for the dashing image of flying on a sword in storybooks. This time, she wanted to try flying on a cannon! The young lady carefully designed the payload; this time it would definitely work! Before Lady Sun could even mount the cannon, with a 'bang,' the modified cannon took off into the air, quickly flying away into the distance, turning into the most dazzling meteor in Jixia during the day. Fortunately, Lady Sun wasn't actually sitting on the cannon...
There was no other way; you had to explain the principles of Burning Mountain Stone to Lady Sun from scratch.

孙尚香早就向往话本里御剑飞行的潇洒画面，这次，她想来个御炮飞行！大小姐小心翼翼地设计好了当量，这次一定没问题！还不等孙尚香骑上火炮，“嘭”的一声，改装后的火炮腾空而起，迅速朝着远处飞驰而去，化作了稷下白天最耀眼的一颗流星。幸好孙尚香没有真坐在火炮上……
没办法， 你只能从头开始给孙尚香科普燃山石的原理。

text: He shows a somewhat surprised but fanatical smile, "I knew it, I knew it, you are the special one! They are yours!"

text:
As you stepped onto the path back to the academy, everything that just happened felt as distant as a dream. Yet, the radish in your hand reminded you that it was all real. Back in your bedroom, you collapsed onto your bed, exhausted, and slowly lost consciousness...
After waking up, you found that you had also turned into a radish, fallen into a radish pit, and you...

等你踏上回学院的路，刚才的一切仿佛梦境一般远去。可手里的萝卜又在提醒自己这一切是真实的。回到卧室，你疲惫地瘫在床上，缓缓失去了意识……
醒来后你发现自己也变成了萝卜，掉进萝卜坑里，你……

text:
Welcome to Linglong Canyon, troops, advance! The contestants from each academy in this competition have their own strengths and are evenly matched. Jing Shan students are particularly skilled in strategy and are said to have ten sets of tactics ready. Qian Ku students are disciples of Galo, with particularly outstanding marksmen. Jixia students have the home-field advantage and have also learned the secrets of teamwork from the Star Team.
The three teams of students faced off against each other. The Jixia students fully utilized their home-field advantage, playing steadily in one favorable game and staging a comeback in another, winning both battles to take the championship!
zh_text:
欢迎来到玲珑峡谷，全军出击！本届比赛各院选手各有所长，实力相当。径山学子尤其擅长谋略，据说已经准备好十套战术。千窟学子师承伽罗，射手位尤其突出。稷下学子具有主场优势，还向星之队学习了团队配合的秘诀。
三队学子两两对决。稷下学子充分发挥主场优势，一局顺风局稳扎稳打，一局逆风翻盘，两战两胜，拿下本次比赛冠军！

text: The three-year period has arrived, and the Dream of Return is about to be held as scheduled. Under your leadership, the academy feels reborn. Jixia Academy is no longer what it once was; take this opportunity to show the visiting guests what Jixia Academy looks like today.
zh_text: 三年之期已到，归虚梦演即将如期举行。学院在你的领导下宛若新生，稷下学院已今非昔比，正好借此机会，在各位远道而来的外宾展示展示，如今的稷下学院是何风貌。

text: You drank too much and didn't manage to discuss anything.
zh_text: 你喝多了什么都没商量成。
source_text: 你喝多了什么都没商量成。

zh_text: 你的书桌上出现了一条神秘的项链。

text: Although you believe most in Jixia Academy are of noble character, it is not uncommon for faculty to abuse their positions for personal gain, coercing students to satisfy their own selfish desires. As the Dean, you have the responsibility and the duty to ensure this sacred place of learning remains a bright and upright sanctuary.
zh_text: 虽然你自觉稷下学院多是品德高尚者，但教职员借职务之便牟利，威逼利诱学子满足自己的一己私欲，也并非什么罕见事迹。作为校长，你有责任，也有义务，确保这学术圣地之上，是一片朗朗乾坤。
source_text: 虽然你自觉稷下学院多是品德高尚者，但教职员借职务之便牟利，威逼利诱学子满足自己的一己私欲，也并非什么罕见事迹。作为校长，你有责任，也有义务，确保这学术圣地之上，是一片朗朗乾坤。

text: First experience in the world, handled well; no longer a naive newcomer.
zh_text: 初历世事，应对有方，已非懵懂新人。
source_text: 初历世事，应对有方，已非懵懂新人。

text: The little dragons follow you everywhere. A dragon expert suggests building a garden for them.
zh_text: 小龙们寸步不离地跟着你。龙学家建议为它们建一座花园。
source_text: 小龙们寸步不离地跟着你。龙学家建议为它们建一座花园。

text:
A few days later, Sun Quan appeared before you with a white jade seal, telling you that this was the legendary seal of the Jixia Sage, representing the highest authority of Jixia Academy, and could even command all the wooden fence monsters in the Academy! Sun Quan offered the seal with both hands, congratulating you on being able to call yourself the Great Sage. You were moved to tears, accepted the seal, bid farewell to Sun Quan, and immediately held the seal high, intending to order the wooden fence monsters to join the vigorous construction of the Academy.
After you fled back to the Academy in a disheveled state from the wooden fence monster's nest, you immediately ordered a thorough investigation of all the unofficial history books in Jixia, as their influence on teenagers is immeasurable.
zh_text:
过了几天，孙权带着白玉印章出现在你面前，告诉你这可是传说中稷下大贤者的印信，代表着稷下学院的最高权力，甚至可以号令学院的所有木篱怪！孙权双手奉上印信，恭喜你可以称大贤者了。你感动的热泪盈眶，收下印信拜别孙权，立刻高举印信，打算号令学院的木篱怪投入到轰轰烈烈的学院建设中。
当你灰头土脸的从木篱怪巢穴里逃回学院后，当即下令彻查整个稷下写野史的山寨书，这对青少年的影响不可估量。

text: Throughout history, the rules of the world have boiled down to the law of the jungle, and the academy is no exception. Here, only the strong have the right to present academic papers. Now, try to survive in this brutal academic struggle.

text: The students are still young, and although they are full of vitality, they are also easily led astray. You remembered that martial arts student who, due to peer pressure, used injections developed by the Baicao family for body tempering, and was eventually forced to take a break due to sudden side effects... Perhaps you should provide them with more psychological counseling services.

source_text: 摘点农家蔬菜 你决定去附近农家采摘新鲜蔬菜。

text: Since it is a sacred artifact, let's just worship it. But for some reason, the mischievous students seem to have suddenly become sensible, and the school's discipline has improved compared to before.

text:
Around the theme of "Ten Thousand Miles of Contention," students from various academies had a burst of inspiration. Students from Jingshan Academy brought out a glittering statue, using gold thread to outline various flowers in full bloom. People from Qianku City brought a sand painting; as the sand fell, it revealed a scene of a hundred boats racing. Jixia students used Jixia wheat to make a huge steamed flower bun, with the buns piled up like high mountains, and students from various academies climbing the peaks—it was quite lively.
During the evaluation, Jingshan students thought the steamed flower bun was not formal enough, and Qianku City students thought it was not artistic enough. The Jixia students were unfazed and firmly pointed out that art must be planted in the soil, and only that which originates from life is true art. Once these words were spoken, there were no more objections, and the Jixia students took the top spot!
zh_text:
围绕“万里争鸣”的主题，各院学子灵感爆发。径山书院的人端出了一座金光闪闪的雕像，用金丝勾勒出各式花朵，百花齐放。千窟城的人则带来了一幅沙画，流沙落下，显现出百舸争流的场景。稷下学子则用稷狐麦做了一个巨大的蒸花馍，馍馍堆成高山，各院学子勇攀高峰，好不热闹。
到了作品评选环节，径山书院的学子认为蒸花馍不够正式，千窟城的学子蒸花馍认为不够艺术。稷下学子不以为然，坚定的指出，要把艺术种进泥土里，源于生活的才是真的艺术，此话一出，再无异议，稷下学子拔得头筹！

text:

text: The so-called commissioner sent by the Continental Joint Education Committee kept a straight face while visiting the academy, and every time he saw a teacher lecturing, he would slowly shake his head with a pained expression. Before leaving, he looked at you silently for a long time, then shook his head and left. Not long after, you saw the commissioner's report on the academy: 'The low threshold of the education sector is eye-opening. We may need to think carefully; for educators, sometimes screening is indeed necessary rather than cultivation.'—so it was written at the end of the report. And this was tantamount to a death sentence for Jixia Academy in the education sector.
zh_text: 那位所谓大陆联合教育委员会派来的专员在参观学院时始终板着一张脸，每当他看到教师授课时，总是以一副痛心疾首的表情缓缓摇头。临走时，他沉默地看着你许久，最后摇了摇头便离去了。不出许久，你便看到了那位专员对于学院的报道，“教育界的门槛之低令人大开眼界，我们或许需要慎重思考，对教育者而言，有时确实应该筛选而非培养。”——在报道的结尾，如此写道。而这无异于在教育界内判了稷下学院死刑。

text:
Standing before you is the Jixia outstanding graduate, outstanding student parent, best employment model, Xuanyong campus ambassador, the highest mountain of the Martial Arts Academy...
Senior Sister Dongfang Jing! After reading such a long list of titles in one breath, you almost passed out. Dongfang Jing stood on the stage alone and briefly talked about her past studies at Jixia, drawing waves of cheers from the audience.
zh_text:
站在你们面前的是，稷下优秀毕业生、优秀学生家长、最佳就业模范、玄雍校园大使、武道学院最高的山……
东方镜学姐！一口气念完这么长一段头衔，你都差点背过去。东方镜一个人站在台上，简短讲起在稷下求学的往事，引来台下阵阵声浪。

text:
Emergency! A large number of monsters have suddenly emerged from the north of Jixia, eyeing the academy. Facing such an urgent situation, Meng Ya volunteered to lead a team to the north to guard the academy.
You urged Meng Ya not to act on impulse and just focus on building the defensive line. To be safe, you decided to select the students to accompany Meng Ya.

十万火急！稷下北部方向忽然涌出了很多怪物，对学院虎视眈眈。面对如此紧急的情况，蒙犽主动请缨，要带队前往北方守卫学院。
你叮嘱蒙犽一定不能意气用事，构筑好防线就行了。保险起见，你打算替蒙犽挑选随行的学子。

text: Perhaps you neglected that students still need discipline; recently, the academy has been in turmoil, with heroes rising everywhere, and students repeatedly standing up to accuse you of being unworthy of your position. Students have formed cliques, established their own factions, and stirred up territorial disputes. They have only one ultimate goal—to challenge you and ask, in this academy, who holds the power? It's time to take action and show them who really has the ability to make Jixia great again.

text:
But, what does this have to do with me?
The Jixia student took out a phantom prop and transformed into a small Wood-Fence. Since we are all small Wood-Fences, why make things difficult for a small Wood-Fence like me?
Students from other academies were shocked by the Jixia student's nonchalance and forgot to discuss for a moment. The cloud ship whizzed past, crushing the small Wood-Fence. Fortunately, it was just a wooden model, and no small Wood-Fence was harmed in the process.
But the Jixia student's "spectacular" performance became famous throughout the Honor of Kings continent.
zh_text:
可是,这跟我又有什么关系呢?
稷下学子掏出幻身道具,变身成小木篱。同样都是小木篱,为何要为难我一个小木篱。

text:
The people from Jingshan Academy won! They cheered and laughed, celebrating this hard-won victory!
The Jixia students did not win and could not help but feel disappointed. Jixia was the host of this competition, but failed to win. At this moment, you stood up and affirmed everyone's performance, saying that even though they lost, it was an honorable defeat, and perhaps failure education is also one of the gains brought by this competition. After your encouragement, everyone's mood recovered slightly, and they expressed that they would fight again next year!

text: First completion: Master Luban - The Terminator

source_text: 首次完成鲁班大师·终结者

text:
To ensure the movements were uniform, you had to resort to your "evil arts," letting Yuan Ge lead the dance and using puppet strings to pull the other three strategists into their moves.
Looking at the elegant Yuan Ge, he could remain calm even while manipulating so many strings at once. However, shouldn't you remind him about the boundaries? This time, he's not manipulating puppets, but living people...
After it's over, go find Dr. Leng Chun for some bruise medicine.
zh_text:
为了动作整齐划一，你只得祭出你的“邪修”，让元歌做领舞，用傀儡丝线牵着其他三位军师做动作。
望着一脸优雅的元歌，同时操纵这么多跟丝线也能临危不乱。只不过，你是不是该提醒他一下尺度？这次操纵的不是傀儡而是活生生的人……
事后，再去找冷春医生拿点跌打药吧。

text: A clever mind can always come up with unique ideas, so the planners decided to host an elegant symphony concert. But it wasn't until the day of the performance that you realized this so-called symphony was just the sounds of wooden fences clashing together...
zh_text: 聪明的头脑总能想出与众不同的创意，策划决定搞一场高雅的交响音乐会。但直到表演当天你才发现，这所谓的交响，只是木篱们交相发出的声音……

text: The spear is as I am, and I am as the spear.
You personally interviewed the applicants and assessed them.
zh_text: 你亲自面试应征的学子，对他进行考核。
source_text: 你亲自面试应征的学子，对他进行考核。

text: Your efforts seem like a joke in the face of the students' increasingly furrowed brows, and the repeated setbacks make you realize that you simply cannot reach their hearts... This might just be your lack of ability, but... can all this really be salvaged?
zh_text: 你的努力在学子们日渐皱起的眉头前像是一个笑话，一次又一次的碰壁让你明白，你根本无法走进他们的内心……这或许只是你能力不足，可……这一切真的还可以挽回吗？

text:
You suggested that the young lady modify her firepower. The power of the Burning Mountain Stone is great, and she carefully added it to her cannon. Before firing, Lady Sun felt a bit nervous; she pulled you aside and ignited the cannon remotely with a fuse. The modified cannon took off due to the recoil and flew rapidly into the distance, becoming the most dazzling meteor in Jixia's daytime...
Fortunately, it wasn't Lady Sun herself carrying the cannon...
zh_text:
你建议大小姐改装火力，燃山石的威力很大，大小姐小心翼翼地将它加入了自己的火炮。开火前，孙尚香心里有些打鼓，她把你拉到一边，用引线远程引燃了火炮。改装后的火炮因为后坐力腾空而起，迅速朝着远处飞驰而去，化作了稷下白天最耀眼的一颗流星……
还好还好，不是孙尚香本人扛着火炮……

text: The negotiation with the Automaton leader is a success! The Automatons are willing to live in harmony with the academy, but they demand to be incorporated into the Automaton Academy's establishment and be treated as equals to human students. From then on, the Automatons officially become Jixia students. Yet, you feel a faint unease in your heart, fearing they might be plotting something in secret...

text: You arrived at the martial arts arena and decided to exercise your body after a long time. After experiencing the facilities you spent a lot of money on, you felt that expensive things are indeed good to use. You looked at the students sweating with you in the martial arts arena and a gratified smile appeared on your face. Perhaps, all this could be even better.
zh_text: 你来到了演武场，决定久违地活动活动自己的身体。你体验了一番你花重金置办的设施后，内心感慨着贵的东西就是好用。你看着与你一同在演武场挥洒汗水的学子，脸上露出了欣慰的微笑。或许，这一切还可以更好。

text: A long time has passed since the event, but you have yet to receive news of Meng Ya's triumphant return. You went to the north yourself and found that Meng Ya had led the students of the Mechanism Academy to build a high wall in the north of the Academy, and even interspersed many custom-made hand-cranked cannons in the wall, turning the defense line into a firepower bunker! Remembering Meng Ya's determined eyes, you didn't stop him. It seems the northern defense line of Jixia will not have any more problems in the future.
zh_text: 距离事件发生已经过去了很久，可你却迟迟没有等来蒙犽凯旋的消息。你亲自前往北部，发现蒙犽带着机关学院的学生在学院北部筑起了一座高墙，还在墙里穿插设计了很多特制手搓火炮，让防线变成了一个火力碉堡！想起蒙犽那充满斗志的眼睛，你也没有再阻止他，看来以后稷下的北部防线是不会再出问题了。

text:
The smartest minds, the ultimate creativity! Zhuge Liang, Zhou Yu, Sima Yi , and Yuan Ge, the "Jixia F4," reunite to bring everyone the strongest group on the continent—the "Brocade Bag Band"! And you, the wisest Dean of Jixia, naturally became their manager!
You picked out a few well-fitting performance costumes for the Brocade Bag Band and specifically found band member Sima Yi, intending to let him try them on first. These were all bought after you worked hard to farm in the Canyon: Cocoon-Breaking Robe, Light-Bathed Cloak...
But Sima Yi kept modifying the songs for the performance, unable to achieve the effect he was satisfied with. He said to let the other members choose first, and now he wants to focus on polishing the lyrics. There's no other way, you have to decide.
zh_text:
最聪明的头脑，最极致的创意！诸葛亮、周瑜、司马懿、元歌“稷下F4”强势再聚首，为大家带来大陆最强组合——“锦囊乐队”！而你，稷下最睿智的校长，自然而然成为了他们的经纪人！
你为锦囊乐队挑选了几套合身的演出服，特地找到乐队成员司马懿，打算让他先试试衣服。这些可都是你在峡谷里辛苦发育很久买来的：破茧之衣、沐光斗篷……
可司马懿却一直在修改演出的歌曲，迟迟达不到自己满意的效果。他说先让其他成员选，现在自己要专心打磨歌词了。没办法，只能你来决定了。

text:
Around the theme of "Ten Thousand Miles of Contention," students from various academies had a burst of inspiration. Students from Jingshan Academy brought out a glittering statue, using gold thread to outline various flowers in full bloom. People from Qianku City brought a sand painting; as the sand fell, it revealed a scene of a hundred boats racing.
Jixia students used Jixia wheat to make a huge steamed flower bun, but due to a mistake in the proofing or steaming process, the bun did not rise. It was flat and collapsed, making it impossible to tell what shape it was or what theme it was trying to express.
During the presentation, the Jixia students looked embarrassed and said it was lunch for everyone. The bun tasted good, but it could not be called a work of art.
zh_text:
围绕"万里争鸣"的主题,各院学子灵感爆发。径山书院的人端出了一座金光闪闪的雕像,用金丝勾勒出各式花朵,百花齐放。千窟城的人则带来了一幅沙画,流沙落下,显现出百舸争流的场景。
稷下学子则用稷狐麦做了一个巨大的蒸花馍,但是不知道是发面还是蒸制的环节出了差错,馍馍最后没有蒸起来,是扁塌的,看不出是什么形状想表达什么主题。
到了展示环节,稷下学子面露尴尬表示这是给大家做的午饭。馍馍的味道确实不错,但无法称之为作品。

The high morale caused the team to push forward repeatedly, and before the defensive facilities prepared by the School of Mechcraft were set up, the front line was already in a mess. The monsters were not completely wiped out, but were startled and wandered around, and the vigilance in the north of Jixia is more troublesome than before.

text: Under his guidance, you indeed entered a dream, where you became an ordinary student again, leaving this burden behind. After waking up, you were just about to invite him to become a mentor, but the student next to you was counting Gugus, and as you listened, you fell asleep again.

text:
Holidays are always a peak time for student safety issues. In just a few days, you have already received many reports of injured students. There is no choice; holding a safety education lecture is imminent.
But what content should you choose? Who should you invite to lecture?

假期永远是学生安全问题高发的时候，这才几日，你就已经收到了很多学生受伤的报告了。没办法，举办一场安全教育讲座迫在眉睫。
可是，选择什么内容？请谁来主讲呢？

text:

They want to invite you to help and use your popularity as their special selling point. Zhuge Liang looks at you with a smile and asks what you think.

想邀请你们帮忙，再利用你们的人气作为他们的特殊卖点，诸葛亮笑盈盈看向你，问你意向如何。

text:
To find the cannon she lost, Lady Sun brought you and her brother Sun Quan to search everywhere. After a painstaking search, they finally found a clue in the Dream Weaving Plain. A local scholar said that a tribe of Wood Fence Monsters had been acting very strangely these past few days, gathering in groups on a cliff, and they even seemed to have learned how to use fire to cook food!
Sun Quan realized this might be a clue to the cannon and rushed over, indeed finding the cannon stuck in a crack in the rocks. After a massive effort, the two of them pulled it out together. Just then, swarms of Wood Fence Monsters surged over.
zh_text:
为了寻找被自己弄丢的火炮，孙尚香找来你和兄长孙权一起四下寻找。经过一番苦寻，终于是在织梦原找到了线索。当地采风的风物家说这几日当地的一个木篱怪部落行为很怪异，成群结队的在一处山崖聚集，似乎还学会了使用火制作熟食！
孙权意识到这可能是火炮的线索，连忙赶过去，果然发现了卡在石头缝里的火炮。废了九牛二虎之力，两人合力把它拽了出来。就在此时，成群结队的木篱怪涌了过来。

text: Improve the quality of food in the cafeteria.

Even in Jixia, the principal's job is not easy. Every day there are countless events to handle and mountains of reports to review and approve. You spend a large portion of your time at your desk every day, yet you still feel overwhelmed. Under high pressure, mistakes are inevitable. Faintly, you hear the students' dissatisfaction and sighs, and even though you can't recall when those accusations appeared, you are certain they happened. Just as you are racking your brain to improve your work, you find a uniquely shaped necklace on your desk. You are certain you have never seen it before, yet it sits securely on your desk now. You pick it up, and your fingertips feel a metallic touch, with the surface patterns flickering with a breathing-like shimmer. You examine it closely; the necklace looks like a cloud silkworm, and also like a slightly open eye.
zh_text: 即使在稷下，校长的工作也并不轻松，每天都有着难以计数的事件亟待处理，也有着堆积如山的报告需要查阅，审批。你每天都将大把的时间花费在桌案之间，却仍是力不从心。高压之下，错漏不可避免，隐约间，你听到学院学子们对你的不满与叹息，即便你完全想不起那些指责何时出现，可你确认它实际发生过。就在你绞尽脑汁，想要改进自己的工作时，却发现一个造型别致的项链，出现在你的桌上，你确认自己从未见过它，可它如今却安稳的摆在你的桌子上。你将其拿起来，指尖传来金属般的触感，表面的纹路闪烁着呼吸般的微光。你仔细端详着，项链看着像是云蚕，又像是一只微张的眼睛。

zh_text: 春溪原的木篱怪泛滥成灾，作为新生你本应加入清剿队伍，可奈何你现在是院长，事务繁忙。软磨硬泡下，花木兰终于同意替你参加清剿队。

text:
You decide to hold an unconventional academic seminar. Students don't have to be constrained by topics, formats, or standards, but can speak freely and discuss anything they like.
Suddenly, topics like "On the Necessity of Discussing 'What to Eat for Lunch'" and "Innovative Research on Excuses for Taking Leave" emerge, and the academy is filled with a long-lost vitality.
zh_text:
你决定举办一场不正经学术研讨会。学子们不必拘泥于议题、格式、规范，而是可以畅所欲言，尽情探讨任何内容。
一时之间，诸如《论“中午吃什么”讨论的必要性》、《对于请假借口的创新性研究》等等议题层出不穷，学院焕发了久违的活力。

text: Since taking over as headmaster, you have had to handle not only the academy's internal affairs but also letters from the outside world. Among the mountain of letters, an ornately decorated envelope catches your eye. You open it, and a shimmering card falls onto the table. You pick it up and examine it closely, discovering it is made of a certain metal, yet the pattern is identical to a Jixia student card. You pull the letter from the envelope, which states that the sender is an off-campus student personally taught by the Three Sages of Jixia. Now that the academy is in crisis, they have decided to return to contribute in gratitude to the Sages. Faced with this strange envelope, you find yourself in a dilemma...

text: Trust people, but bear the consequences if you use the wrong ones. This competition caused dissatisfaction due to the tricky evaluation criteria. text: You have never seen such a brilliant duel. The two masters shot at each other from sunrise to sunset, and neither could gain the slightest advantage! The opponent shot fast, but Galo could hide outside his range and strike back hard! The health bars on their protective suits kept jumping, with no sign of decreasing. Other contestants stepped up to break up the fight, but just by approaching the battlefield, they were turned into hedgehogs by the flying arrows. The scene before you seemed to awaken a memory in your brain that shouldn't exist, taking you back to that era dominated by two marksmen...
zh_text: 你从未见过如此精彩的对决，两位大神从日出对射到日落，竟然都没能从对方那里占到一丝便宜！对方射得快，可伽罗可以藏在他射程之外狠狠反击！两人防护服上显示的血条一直在蹦迪，根本没有变少的趋势。其他选手上前拉架，仅仅只是靠近战场，就被飞出的羽箭扎成了刺猬。眼前的景象似乎觉醒了你的脑子里一段不该存在的记忆，回到了那个被两位射手支配的年代……

text: Dressed in idol clothes, with her staff replaced by a microphone, Zhaojun is going to bring the sweetest smile to everyone! For the hardworking Zhaojun, you immediately announced that she would be the lead singer for the "Summer Hedge Music Festival"! On the day of the performance, the boys and girls of the academy heard Zhaojun's name and packed the venue. Looking at the uncontrollable smiles on everyone's faces, you declared today "Jixia Smile Day"! And the name of the idol singer Zhaojun echoed throughout the entire continent!

text: Identify the enemy, defeat the enemy.

The academy is in need of personnel and requires more hands.
After much thought, you decide to send people to explore and recruit talent widely.
Selecting different characters to initiate recruitment will attract different talents.

学院正是用人之际，需要更多人手。
思来想去，你决定派遣人员四处探访，广纳人才。
选用不同角色发起招募，将招揽到不同的人才。

source_text: 带龙上魔道课 你决定带小龙去魔道学院接受教育。

text:
The crafters used a secret mechanical passage to design a horror-themed escape room in the academy called "Noisy Ridge" and cordially invited you to experience it.
You played through it immersively and found it was still lacking something. After analyzing it, it should be the lack of live actors. For this reason, you personally invited a mysterious actor. Perhaps with her authentic performance, the entire project's experience will be more thrilling.
zh_text:
工巧家利用机关密道，在学院里设计了一个名为《吵闹岭》的恐怖主题密室逃脱，诚邀你前往体验。
你沉浸式玩了一圈，发现还差点意思。分析了一下，应该是缺少真人扮演导致的。为此，你亲自请来了一位神秘的演员，也许有她在里面本色出演，能让整个项目的体验感更刺激。

text:
You tried to show your strength to the students, but after implementing it, you found your idea was so ridiculous...
The order of the academy is already in jeopardy. Do you have another chance?
zh_text:
你尝试向一众学子展示自己的实力，直到实施后却发现自己的想法是如此可笑……
学院的秩序已经岌岌可危，你还有下一次机会吗？

source_text: 随机分配初始属性的校长候选。

text: Wait and see. You decide to quietly observe the actions of the radishes.
zh_text: 静观其变 你决定安静观察萝卜们的行动。
source_text: 静观其变 你决定安静观察萝卜们的行动。

text: You were overjoyed, bought it with a large sum of money, and other students were speechless.
zh_text: 你心花怒放，重金买下，其他学子一阵无语。
source_text: 你心花怒放，重金买下，其他学子一阵无语。

text: Physical isolation. You decided to have the little dragons attend classes separately.
zh_text: 物理隔离 你决定将小龙们分开上课。
source_text: 物理隔离 你决定将小龙们分开上课。

text: You found a martial arts master, and the students benefited greatly.
zh_text: 你找到武道高手，学生们受益匪浅。
source_text: 你找到武道高手，学生们受益匪浅。

text:
Jixia students proposed a way to turn waste into treasure by collecting scrap and purifying it with cloud-flow. It is a business with low costs, high returns, and a unique local advantage. However, the startup capital is slightly insufficient, though overall, it is a project with potential.
Qianku students proposed a study-buddy training project, planning to use their strengths to provide guidance to students struggling with their studies, which received high praise from the judges.
Jingshan Academy students took a different approach, proposing a butler automaton project where automatons could take care of people's daily needs. Once proposed, this idea won unanimous approval from the judges, and the Jingshan Academy students won this round.
zh_text:
稷下学子提出变废为宝的办法，收集废品用云流净化，这可以说是一门成本低、收益高，且具有地方独占优势的好生意。但是启动资金略显不足，不过总体来说是一门有潜力的项目。
千窟学子提出伴读培训项目，他们打算利用自己的优势，为学业上有困扰的学子提供指导，评委们给予很高的评价。
径山书院的学子另辟蹊径，提出管家机关人项目，可以由机关人来照顾人们的饮食起居，这个点子一经提出，便收获评委们的一致认可，这一轮径山书院的学子胜出。

text: The annual "Hedge Monster Management Conference" is about to be held in Jixia again! Representatives will come from all places on the continent troubled by Hedge Monsters. Headmaster, please select the venue!
zh_text: 一年一度的“木篱怪治理大会”即将在稷下再度召开！大陆上所有被木篱怪困扰的地方都会派代表前来。请校长选定本次会场地址！

text: The goddess hands you the silver hoe. Unexpectedly, a bunch of students start throwing their own hoes into the river, some claiming they dropped a golden one, others a silver one, and some even start fighting over who goes first. The scene descends into chaos.
zh_text: 女神将银锄头递给了你，没想到一堆学生开始纷纷将自己的锄头抛入河水中，有的喊自己掉的金锄头，有的喊自己掉的银锄头，甚至有人为争先后打了起来，场面混乱不堪。

text: A strange power surges into your body.
zh_text: 一股奇异的力量涌入你的身体。
source_text: 一股奇异的力量涌入你的身体。

text: The exclusive secret soup base of Jixia Food House became an unexpected hit, becoming the most popular check-in spot in all of Jixia. Some even traveled all the way from Chang'an for this delicacy. Your business acumen was recognized by the Merchant, who gave you a precious token.
zh_text: 稷下美食屋独家秘制锅底意外走红，成为全稷下最热门的打卡地，甚至有人为了这口美食，从长安远道而来。你的商业头脑得到了物币家的认可，他将珍贵信物给予了你。

text: The strategy worked and successfully resolved the crisis.
zh_text: 策略奏效成功化解了这场危机。
source_text: 策略奏效成功化解了这场危机。

text: One day, the caretaker of the Dragon Garden called you in a panic. When you arrived, you found that seven growing dragons had almost destroyed the entire garden—they were twisting and fighting together, as if they had lost their minds. You summoned the dragon expert again.
zh_text: 这一天，龙花园的看顾者惊慌地喊你过去，等你到达时发现七条日渐茁壮的龙几乎毁了整个花园——它们扭打在一起，仿佛丧失理智一般乱斗。你再次召集龙学家。
source_text: 这一天，龙花园的看顾者惊慌地喊你过去，等你到达时发现七条日渐茁壮的龙几乎毁了整个花园——它们扭打在一起，仿佛丧失理智一般乱斗。你再次召集龙学家。

text: Mid-Range Budget. You decide to allocate a medium budget to purchase teaching aids.
zh_text: 中环金 你决定拨出中等预算采购教具。
source_text: 中环金 你决定拨出中等预算采购教具。

text:
You found a cute and clingy kitten sister, but as the Jixia headmaster, you are busy with a thousand tasks and worry that you don't have the energy or time to take care of the kitten.
However, in Jixia today, who likes fluffy little animals and is also meticulous and caring? Thinking this, you held the kitten and found Kai.
Kaizer is currently meditating under a waterfall, muttering things like "restrain the magic armor" and "confronting fate," looking like he is practicing. Although he remained unmoved by the kitten, you clearly saw his closed eyelids twitching significantly.
zh_text:
你捡到一只的可爱黏人的猫妹妹，可是稷下校长日理万机，你担心自己没有精力和时间照顾小猫。
不过，如今的稷下，有谁喜欢毛茸茸的小动物，同时还粗中有细有爱心呢？这么想着，你抱着小猫找到了铠。
铠此时在一条瀑布下打座，嘴里念叨着“克制魔铠”、“对峙命运”之类的话，看样子正在修行。虽然面对小猫不为所动，但你明显看见他紧闭的眼皮明显有些抽搐。

text: The name you proposed contains profound scholarship, and everyone agreed unanimously.
zh_text: 你提出的名字蕴含深厚学养，大家一致认可。
source_text: 你提出的名字蕴含深厚学养，大家一致认可。

text: The character sent to search is seriously injured, a portion of funds is deducted to treat the character, and thunder rumbles in the direction of Dragon Banner Valley.
zh_text: 前去寻找的角色重伤，扣一部分资金替角色疗伤，龙旗谷方向雷声大作。
source_text: 前去寻找的角色重伤，扣一部分资金替角色疗伤，龙旗谷方向雷声大作。

text: Charisma: You decide to use your personal charisma to inspire students to follow the rules voluntarily.
zh_text: 人格魅力你决定以人格魅力感化学生自觉遵守纪律。
source_text: 人格魅力你决定以人格魅力感化学生自觉遵守纪律。

text: Master Luban wants to open an automaton testing studio. Do you support the new plan or the old way?
zh_text: 鲁班大师想开机关人检测工作室。你支持新方案还是老办法？
source_text: 鲁班大师想开机关人检测工作室。你支持新方案还是老办法？

text: You decide to host some activities to rekindle the youthful vitality that should be pulsing through the students. You brainstorm with all the faculty and students, racking your brains to find a way for everyone to have more fun... You recall something: when preparing for fun, the air feels so light.
zh_text: 你决定举办一些活动来重新唤回那些，该在学子们身上跃动的，独属于青春的，生命的活力。你向全体师生集思广益，绞尽脑汁找到一种能让大家都能玩得更开心一点的方法……你回想起了一件事，原来在准备玩乐之时，空气是如此轻盈。
source_text: 你决定举办一些活动来重新唤回那些，该在学子们身上跃动的，独属于青春的，生命的活力。你向全体师生集思广益，绞尽脑汁找到一种能让大家都能玩得更开心一点的方法……你回想起了一件事，原来在准备玩乐之时，空气是如此轻盈。

text: You invested Ringild to improve the food, but the results were not ideal. The meals did not become truly delicious, nor did they significantly improve the state of the teachers and students. Everyone just felt that the academy spent money without using it where it mattered most.
zh_text: 你投入环金改善伙食，但效果并不理想。饭菜既没有真正变得可口，也未能明显提升师生状态。大家只觉得学院花了钱，却没有把钱用在刀刃上。

text: After saying goodbye to the Guguas, you returned to your office. You casually placed the flower in a vase in the Dean's office, but to your surprise, a swarm of Guguas flooded in that afternoon and surrounded you, claiming they wanted to welcome you to marry the Gugua Prince. This rose, they said, was a token that only the Gugua Prince's beloved could hold.
zh_text: 等与咕呱告别后，你返回了办公室。你将花随手插入校长办公室的花瓶中，没想到下午一众咕呱涌入将你团团围住，说要迎你与咕呱王子结亲，而这朵玫瑰花，就是咕呱王子心爱之人才能持有的信物。
source_text: 等与咕呱告别后，你返回了办公室。你将花随手插入校长办公室的花瓶中，没想到下午一众咕呱涌入将你团团围住，说要迎你与咕呱王子结亲，而这朵玫瑰花，就是咕呱王子心爱之人才能持有的信物。

text: Something's wrong, better throw it away early. You decide to discard this ominous necklace to stay away from danger.
zh_text: 不对劲，早点丢掉吧 你决定丢掉这条不祥的项链远离危险。
source_text: 不对劲，早点丢掉吧 你决定丢掉这条不祥的项链远离危险。

text: You gathered your strength and wiggled your way out of the radish hole. You happened to run into the radishes, and upon asking, you learned they were holding a memorial for the late Radish King and were requiring all radishes to return to their positions to prepare for the next Radish King election.
zh_text: 你鼓足力气，左扭右扭地将自己挤出了萝卜坑。你碰巧遇到了萝卜们，询问之下，你得知它们们正为死去的萝卜王开哀悼会，并要求所有萝卜归位准备下届萝卜王选举。
source_text: 你鼓足力气，左扭右扭地将自己挤出了萝卜坑。你碰巧遇到了萝卜们，询问之下，你得知它们们正为死去的萝卜王开哀悼会，并要求所有萝卜归位准备下届萝卜王选举。

text: Under your guidance, the little dragons learned to be courteous to each other.
zh_text: 在你的教导下，小龙们学会了互相礼让。
source_text: 在你的教导下，小龙们学会了互相礼让。

text: The next day, you gathered in the rehearsal room again, only to find Zhou Yu had arrived early. He spread his arms with high spirits, and you saw the rafters were filled with the little birds you gave him. With a wave of Zhou Yu's hand, the birds actually chirped in perfect unison with the musical scale—the lingering sound was melodious and beautiful. Everyone was shocked; they hadn't expected the Viceroy to have such strong musical theory skills. From then on, the Brocade Bag Band had some unexpected backing vocals.
zh_text: 次日，你们再次聚首在排练室，却发现周瑜早早到了。他意气风发的张开双臂，只见房梁上站满了你送他的小鸟，随着周瑜大手一挥，小鸟们居然整齐的随着音阶叫了起来，余音绕梁，婉转动听。大家都震惊了，没想到大都督已经有这么强的乐理能力了。从此以后，锦囊乐队多了一些意想不到的伴唱。
source_text: 次日，你们再次聚首在排练室，却发现周瑜早早到了。他意气风发的张开双臂，只见房梁上站满了你送他的小鸟，随着周瑜大手一挥，小鸟们居然整齐的随着音阶叫了起来，余音绕梁，婉转动听。大家都震惊了，没想到大都督已经有这么强的乐理能力了。从此以后，锦囊乐队多了一些意想不到的伴唱。

text: You purchased some decent teaching aids for the academy. Although there is still a gap compared to the equipment used by top-tier academies, it can basically meet daily teaching needs.
zh_text: 你为学院教育购置了一些不错的教具，虽然与顶端学院所用的设备用具仍有差距，但已能基本满足日常的教学需求。
source_text: 你为学院教育购置了一些不错的教具，虽然与顶端学院所用的设备用具仍有差距，但已能基本满足日常的教学需求。

text: You had the School of Mechcraft design an all-around anti-cheating pen. If it detects the user tilting their head or checking notes, the ink cartridge automatically sprays hard-to-wash ink, turning the cheating student's face black. Sure enough, the exam hall is clear, and no one dares to cheat again.
zh_text: 你让机关学院设计了一个全方位反作弊识别笔，只要检测到握笔的人偏头、摸小抄等动作，笔芯就会自动喷出很难洗掉的墨水，让作弊学子变成大黑脸。果然，考场天朗气清，再也没有人敢作弊了。

text: Wine cups and small tables have been set up along the winding stream. Li Bai leans at the head of the table, and those who sign up must first catch the topic he tosses out.
zh_text: 曲水边已经摆开酒盏与短案，李白倚在上首，报名的人得先接住他临手抛来的题。
source_text: 曲水边已经摆开酒盏与短案，李白倚在上首，报名的人得先接住他临手抛来的题。

text: Insert protagonist (Focus on students' academic achievements)

source_text: 放入主角（注重学子学术造诣）

text: Recently, the academy has fallen into a financial crisis. Repairing the old library requires gold, updating a batch of teaching equipment requires gold, and hiring teachers requires gold... Just as you were overwhelmed, a merchant found you. He held a Xishi doll and a book that he claimed was a secret to wealth management written by Xishi. He claimed that he saw you as a one-in-a-million business genius who would surely own a business empire in the future! And now, he promises that as long as you pass his test, he will sell you the precious token in his hand at a very low price... Faced with the three topics given by the merchant, how will you choose?
zh_text: 最近学院陷入财政危机，修缮老旧藏书阁要环金，更新一批教学器具需要环金，聘请教师需要环金……正当你焦头烂额时，一名物币家找到你，他手持西施玩偶与一本自称是西施所作的理财致富秘诀，他称眼观你为万里挑一的商业奇才，日后必将坐拥商业帝国！而现在，他许诺只需通过他的考验，他便将手中珍贵信物以极低价格出售给你……面对物币家所给出三道课题，你会如何抉择？
source_text: 最近学院陷入财政危机，修缮老旧藏书阁要环金，更新一批教学器具需要环金，聘请教师需要环金……正当你焦头烂额时，一名物币家找到你，他手持西施玩偶与一本自称是西施所作的理财致富秘诀，他称眼观你为万里挑一的商业奇才，日后必将坐拥商业帝国！而现在，他许诺只需通过他的考验，他便将手中珍贵信物以极低价格出售给你……面对物币家所给出三道课题，你会如何抉择？

text: It flew into a rage and sent Gugu to surround your office.
zh_text: 它恼羞成怒派咕呱包围了你的办公室。
source_text: 它恼羞成怒派咕呱包围了你的办公室。

text: Under his guidance, you indeed entered a dream, where you became an ordinary student again, leaving this burden behind. After waking up, you were just about to invite him to become a mentor, but the student next to you was counting Gugus, and as you listened, you fell asleep again.
zh_text: 在他的引导之下，你果然进入了梦境，在那里，你重新成为了一个平凡的学子，离开了这份重担。醒来后你正想邀请他成为导师，但旁边的学子正在数咕呱，听着听着你又睡了过去。
source_text: 在他的引导之下，你果然进入了梦境，在那里，你重新成为了一个平凡的学子，离开了这份重担。醒来后你正想邀请他成为导师，但旁边的学子正在数咕呱，听着听着你又睡了过去。

text: Jixia Automaton Industry: You decide to invest in the development of the Jixia automaton industry.
zh_text: 稷下机关人产业 你决定投资稷下机关人产业发展业务。
source_text: 稷下机关人产业 你决定投资稷下机关人产业发展业务。

text: Too much investment, and the students still need time to adapt to the new equipment.
zh_text: 投入过多学生对新设备还需要适应。
source_text: 投入过多学生对新设备还需要适应。

text: Knowledge Reform: You decide to use knowledge as a guide to promote teaching reform.
zh_text: 学识改革你决定以学识为引领推动教学改革。
source_text: 学识改革你决定以学识为引领推动教学改革。

text: You learn that they are holding a memorial service for the Radish King and require all radishes to return to their positions.
zh_text: 你得知它们正为萝卜王开哀悼会，要求所有萝卜归位。
source_text: 你得知它们正为萝卜王开哀悼会，要求所有萝卜归位。

text: The old man's mechanical farmland has achieved initial results.
zh_text: 大爷的机关农田有了初步成果。
source_text: 大爷的机关农田有了初步成果。

text: Improve the quality of food in the cafeteria.
You join forces and make a fortune.
zh_text: 你们联手赚得盆满钵满。
source_text: 你们联手赚得盆满钵满。

text: Although you have managed it with great care, the results are minimal. However, you believe in your heart that as long as you persist, you will succeed.
zh_text: 你虽苦心经营，但收获甚微，但你内心相信，只要坚持努力，一定可以成功。
source_text: 你虽苦心经营，但收获甚微，但你内心相信，只要坚持努力，一定可以成功。

text: At this point, you realize that the ability to foresee the future comes at a high price. You place your hand on the necklace, intending to take it off, only to find it has embedded itself into your flesh. You endure the pain and decide to rip it off.
zh_text: 事已至此，你才警觉，预知未来的能力，背后有着高昂的代价。你将手放在项链上，打算将它摘下，发现它已经镶嵌在你的血肉里，你强撑痛苦决定把它扯下来。
source_text: 事已至此，你才警觉，预知未来的能力，背后有着高昂的代价。你将手放在项链上，打算将它摘下，发现它已经镶嵌在你的血肉里，你强撑痛苦决定把它扯下来。

text:
Dunshan has not been sleeping well since coming to Jixia. He misses home every night and hasn't closed his eyes for a long time, so he wants to ask you for a small favor.
What else is there to say! You immediately expressed that you are duty-bound. Dunshan handed you a package, hoping you could create some elements of his hometown for him.
What kind of environment should be created for Dunshan?
zh_text:
盾山自从来到稷下以后一直都睡不好，每晚都非常想家，已经很久没合眼了，所以想来找你帮他一个小忙。
那还说啥了！你当即表示义不容辞。盾山递给你一个包裹，希望能请你为他营造一点家乡的元素。
该为盾山营造什么样的环境呢？
source_text:
盾山自从来到稷下以后一直都睡不好，每晚都非常想家，已经很久没合眼了，所以想来找你帮他一个小忙。
那还说啥了！你当即表示义不容辞。盾山递给你一个包裹，希望能请你为他营造一点家乡的元素。
该为盾山营造什么样的环境呢？

text: Training Grounds: You decide to go to the training grounds to learn about martial arts training.
zh_text: 演武场你决定前往演武场了解武道训练。
source_text: 演武场你决定前往演武场了解武道训练。

text: Xishi traded the doll for the 'Get Rich Quick' guide, telling you it was actually a summary of her failures.
zh_text: 西施用玩偶换回致富经，告诉你这其实是她的失败总结。
source_text: 西施用玩偶换回致富经，告诉你这其实是她的失败总结。

text: You climb the highest mountain in Jixia and explore the deepest forests to visit renowned masters and gain their help. Your hard work pays off, and your sincerity finally moves them.
zh_text: 你爬上稷下最高的山，探访稷下最幽深的林间，只为探访名师，得其相助。功夫不负有心人，诚意终于打动了名师。
source_text: 你爬上稷下最高的山，探访稷下最幽深的林间，只为探访名师，得其相助。功夫不负有心人，诚意终于打动了名师。

text: You join the merchant, and he tells you that the real way to make money is to teach others how to make money. You feign compliance, collect evidence, and take him down in one fell swoop.
zh_text: 你加入物币家，他告诉你真正赚钱的方法就是教别人赚钱。你假意顺从，收集好证据，将他一举拿下。
source_text: 你加入物币家，他告诉你真正赚钱的方法就是教别人赚钱。你假意顺从，收集好证据，将他一举拿下。

text: The product was highly acclaimed upon launch, helping thousands of patients with chronic insomnia recover. Many students said that after sleeping, even their homework became easy to finish. It sold out quickly, and even led to the emergence of Jixia purchasing services. Your business acumen was recognized by the Coin Master, who gave you a precious token.
zh_text: 产品一经上线大受好评，帮助数千名顽固性失眠患者康复，不少学子表示睡完觉后连功课都完成得易如反掌，很快抢购一空，甚至产生了不少稷下代购服务。你的商业头脑得到了物币家的认可，他将珍贵信物给予了你。
source_text: 产品一经上线大受好评，帮助数千名顽固性失眠患者康复，不少学子表示睡完觉后连功课都完成得易如反掌，很快抢购一空，甚至产生了不少稷下代购服务。你的商业头脑得到了物币家的认可，他将珍贵信物给予了你。

text: Win with Wisdom: You decide to use wisdom and strategy to regulate school discipline.
zh_text: 以智取胜你决定运用智慧与策略规范学纪。
source_text: 以智取胜你决定运用智慧与策略规范学纪。

text: Active Intervention: You decided to take the initiative to teach the little dragons how to get along peacefully.
zh_text: 积极干预 你决定主动教导小龙们和平相处。
source_text: 积极干预 你决定主动教导小龙们和平相处。

text: Leave it alone: You decide to let the little dragons develop freely and not interfere with their squabbles.
zh_text: 放任不管 你决定让小龙们自由发展，不干预打闹。
source_text: 放任不管 你决定让小龙们自由发展，不干预打闹。

text: You call for help everywhere, but it's class time and there's no one around. You have to go further away to find someone, and by the time you return, Gu-Gua is no longer there...
zh_text: 你四处呼救，恰逢上课时分，周围并无人，你只能前往更远的地方寻人，等你回来时，咕呱已不在原地……
source_text: 你四处呼救，恰逢上课时分，周围并无人，你只能前往更远的地方寻人，等你回来时，咕呱已不在原地……

text: The text in the book begins to flicker frequently.
zh_text: 书中的文字开始频繁闪烁。
source_text: 书中的文字开始频繁闪烁。

text: The recruited students are clever, but they only know how to take tests, not how to apply their skills.
zh_text: 招来的学子虽聪明却只会考试不会动手。
source_text: 招来的学子虽聪明却只会考试不会动手。

text: The treasure bought by good luck is worth a lot.
zh_text: 运气不错买到的宝贝价值不菲。
source_text: 运气不错买到的宝贝价值不菲。

text:
You still didn't bother this busy person. On the day of the conference, Dongfang Jing only appeared as an alumna. However, there were so many fans that Dongfang Jing even had to use mirrors to sign autographs for the enthusiastic juniors.
It seems that with so many titles, Dongfang Jing is quite popular even when staying in a crowd.
zh_text:
你还是没有打扰这位大忙人，大会当天，东方镜只以校友的身份出现。奈何粉丝太多，东方镜甚至需要动用镜像来为狂热的学弟学妹们签名。
如此看来，这么多头衔缠身，即使待在人群里，东方镜也如此受欢迎呢。
source_text:
你还是没有打扰这位大忙人，大会当天，东方镜只以校友的身份出现。奈何粉丝太多，东方镜甚至需要动用镜像来为狂热的学弟学妹们签名。
如此看来，这么多头衔缠身，即使待在人群里，东方镜也如此受欢迎呢。

text: You go back to sleep, and the next day, all the radishes in the basket are gone.
zh_text: 你回去睡觉，第二天菜篮的萝卜全没了。
source_text: 你回去睡觉，第二天菜篮的萝卜全没了。

text:
You know well that staying tightly united is the only way for the academy to develop in the long run. Driven by this belief, you travel between different academic factions, spreading the fundamental idea of seeking common ground while reserving differences...
Finally, your efforts paid off; the friction between different academic factions gradually disappeared, and the focus returned to academics itself.
zh_text:
你深知，只有紧紧团结在一起，才是学院能够长远发展的唯一方法。受此信念的驱动，你奔波于不同学术派系之间，传播着求同存异的根本思想……
最终，你的努力取得了回报，不同学术派系之间的摩擦日渐消失，重心重新回到了学术本身。
source_text:
你深知，只有紧紧团结在一起，才是学院能够长远发展的唯一方法。受此信念的驱动，你奔波于不同学术派系之间，传播着求同存异的根本思想……
最终，你的努力取得了回报，不同学术派系之间的摩擦日渐消失，重心重新回到了学术本身。

text: Academic Talent: You decide to prioritize admitting students with academic talent.
zh_text: 学术天赋 你决定优先录取有学术天赋的学子。
source_text: 学术天赋 你决定优先录取有学术天赋的学子。

text: Ringild Outing: You decided to fund an outing for everyone to relax.
zh_text: 环金出游你决定出资带大家出游散散心。
source_text: 环金出游你决定出资带大家出游散散心。

text: The music festival was held as scheduled. You bathed and changed into loose cotton and linen clothes, intending to have a soul-cleansing immersive experience. But as soon as you approached the venue, you heard the intense, exciting sound of electricity. Students, regardless of age or gender, were dancing wildly to the rhythmic drum beats. In the center of the stage, Cai Wenji wore sunglasses, strumming her Huojia, leading a joyous army to shout wave after wave of sound. Now, you are the only one left, silently disheveled in the roaring crowd of students...
zh_text: 音乐节如期举办，你沐浴更衣，换了一身着宽松的棉麻衣服，打算来一场洗涤心灵的沉浸体验。可一靠近会场，却听见了激昂刺激的电流声。学子们不分男女老幼，都在节奏感极强的鼓点里肆意狂舞。舞台中央，蔡文姬戴着墨镜搓着自己的胡笳琴，带着欢歌大军喊出一层又一层的声浪。现在，只剩你一个人在学子们的山呼海啸里默默凌乱……
source_text: 音乐节如期举办，你沐浴更衣，换了一身着宽松的棉麻衣服，打算来一场洗涤心灵的沉浸体验。可一靠近会场，却听见了激昂刺激的电流声。学子们不分男女老幼，都在节奏感极强的鼓点里肆意狂舞。舞台中央，蔡文姬戴着墨镜搓着自己的胡笳琴，带着欢歌大军喊出一层又一层的声浪。现在，只剩你一个人在学子们的山呼海啸里默默凌乱……

text:
To find the cannon she lost, Lady Sun brought you and her brother Sun Quan to search everywhere. After a painstaking search, they finally found a clue in the Dream Weaving Plain. A local scholar said that a tribe of Wood Fence Monsters had been acting very strangely these past few days, gathering in groups on a cliff, and they even seemed to have learned how to use fire to cook food!
Sun Quan realized this might be the cannon Lady Sun lost and rushed over, indeed finding the cannon stuck in a crack in the rocks. After a massive effort, the two of them pulled the cannon out together. Just then, swarms of Wood Fence Monsters surged over.
zh_text:
为了寻找被自己弄丢的火炮，孙尚香找来你和兄长孙权一起四下寻找。经过一番苦寻，终于是在织梦原找到了线索。当地采风的风物家说这几日当地的一个木篱怪部落行为很怪异，成群结队的在一处山崖聚集，似乎还学会了使用火制作熟食！
孙权意识到这可能就是孙尚香弄丢的火炮，连忙赶过去，果然发现卡在石头缝里的火炮。废了九牛二虎之力，两人合力拽出了火炮。就在此时，成群结队的木篱怪涌了过来。

text: You used your authority as headmaster to try to persuade the radishes to attend class, but no one paid attention to your proposal, mocking you for being delusional. Some radishes even thought you were mentally unstable and needed to have your radish sprouts trimmed for treatment.
zh_text: 你拿出校长威严试图劝萝卜们上课，没有人理睬你的提议，并嘲讽你是异想天开，甚至有些萝卜觉得你精神失常，需要好好修剪萝卜秧治疗。
source_text: 你拿出校长威严试图劝萝卜们上课，没有人理睬你的提议，并嘲讽你是异想天开，甚至有些萝卜觉得你精神失常，需要好好修剪萝卜秧治疗。

text: Buy it with money: You decide to spend money to buy these books to see the secrets.
zh_text: 花钱买下 你决定花钱买下这些书看看秘密。
source_text: 花钱买下 你决定花钱买下这些书看看秘密。

text:
You eagerly sign up for the Radish Squat competition. During the competition, your eloquence is outstanding and your logic is clear; you are the king of the Radish Squat, successfully advancing in every round and ultimately winning the competition!
The radishes bow to your charisma and unanimously recognize you as the new Radish King. You point out the direction for the radish world, and for a time, talents gather, and the radishes thrive...
Until one day, you fall into a peaceful sleep, and when you wake up, it all seems like a dream.
zh_text:
你踊跃报名萝卜蹲比赛，在比赛过程中，你的口才十分出众，条理清晰，是萝卜蹲比赛的王者，每一轮都成功晋级，最终获得了比赛的胜利！
众萝卜臣服于你的风采，一致认可你成为新的萝卜大王。你在萝卜界指点江山，一时之间群英荟萃，萝卜们茁壮成长……
直到某天，你安稳地睡去，再醒来时，一切都好像是梦一场。

你踊跃报名萝卜蹲比赛，在比赛过程中，你的口才十分出众，条理清晰，是萝卜蹲比赛的王者，每一轮都成功晋级，最终获得了比赛的胜利！
众萝卜臣服于你的风采，一致认可你成为新的萝卜大王。你在萝卜界指点江山，一时之间群英荟萃，萝卜们茁壮成长……
直到某天，你安稳地睡去，再醒来时，一切都好像是梦一场。

text: A dragon-shaped lamp that appeared out of thin air in the academy, its dragon breath warm, sensing the coming storm.
zh_text: 凭空出现在学院中的龙形灯盏，龙息温热，感应着风暴的来临。
source_text: 凭空出现在学院中的龙形灯盏，龙息温热，感应着风暴的来临。

text: Confiscate its CEO romance novel: You decide to confiscate the CEO romance novel to stop its absurd behavior.
zh_text: 没收它的霸总小说 你决定没收霸总小说制止它的荒唐行为。
source_text: 没收它的霸总小说 你决定没收霸总小说制止它的荒唐行为。

text:
Although you believe most in Jixia Academy are of noble character, it is not uncommon for faculty to abuse their positions for personal gain, coercing students to satisfy their own selfish desires.
As the Dean, you have the responsibility and the duty to ensure this sacred place of learning remains a bright and upright sanctuary.
zh_text:
虽然你自觉稷下学院多是品德高尚者，但教职员借职务之便牟利，威逼利诱学子满足自己的一己私欲，也并非什么罕见事迹。
作为校长，你有责任，也有义务，确保这学术圣地之上，是一片朗朗乾坤。
source_text:
虽然你自觉稷下学院多是品德高尚者，但教职员借职务之便牟利，威逼利诱学子满足自己的一己私欲，也并非什么罕见事迹。
作为校长，你有责任，也有义务，确保这学术圣地之上，是一片朗朗乾坤。

text: You prepare to step up and become Zhaojun's model. After restraining the frantic Dr. Leng Chun, a heartbroken Zhaojun is persuaded by you and begins to cast spells while you strike different poses... Soon, lifelike, never-melting ice sculptures bloom all over Jixia. Many students who had never seen snow before play around the sculptures and pay their respects to Zhaojun. Meanwhile, you shiver in your bed, clutching a steaming cup of cold medicine, and sniffle hard, feeling that it was all worth it...
zh_text: 你准备亲自上阵，成为昭君的模特。在拉住了抓狂的冷春医生以后，一脸心疼的昭君还是被你说服，开始对着摆不同造型的你施起了法……很快，一些栩栩如生永不融化的冰雕在稷下四处开花，许多从未见过冰雪的学子看到这景象，纷纷绕着冰雕玩耍，同时对昭君姑娘表示了敬意。与此同时，你在被窝里冻得瑟瑟发抖，手里捧着滚烫的感冒药，狠狠吸了一下鼻子，感觉一切都是值得的……
source_text: 你准备亲自上阵，成为昭君的模特。在拉住了抓狂的冷春医生以后，一脸心疼的昭君还是被你说服，开始对着摆不同造型的你施起了法……很快，一些栩栩如生永不融化的冰雕在稷下四处开花，许多从未见过冰雪的学子看到这景象，纷纷绕着冰雕玩耍，同时对昭君姑娘表示了敬意。与此同时，你在被窝里冻得瑟瑟发抖，手里捧着滚烫的感冒药，狠狠吸了一下鼻子，感觉一切都是值得的……

text: The merchant sighs but still smiles, "It's a pity you aren't fated with the treasure. It's just as well; they should find a more suitable owner."
zh_text: 商人叹了口气，但仍旧面带笑容，“很可惜，你跟宝贝没缘分，也好，对它们来说，也该找到更合适的主人。”
source_text: 商人叹了口气，但仍旧面带笑容，“很可惜，你跟宝贝没缘分，也好，对它们来说，也该找到更合适的主人。”

text: The little dragons could not stop fighting and eventually tore the garden apart, fleeing into the deeper wilderness of Dragon Banner Valley.
zh_text: 小龙们无法停止争斗，并最终撕裂了花园，逃往了龙旗谷更远的荒野。
source_text: 小龙们无法停止争斗，并最终撕裂了花园，逃往了龙旗谷更远的荒野。

text: Mid-Range Budget. You decide to allocate a medium budget to purchase teaching aids.
zh_text: 中环金 你决定拨出中等预算采购教具。
source_text: 中环金 你决定拨出中等预算采购教具。

text: Faced with the topic you provided, the lecturer racked their brains but couldn't think of how to make this safety education class innovative, so it ended up being a simple reading from a script. Perhaps this was effective too.
zh_text: 面对你给的选题，讲师绞尽脑汁也没想到怎么样能让这堂安全教育课别开生面，最后只能变成了简单的照本宣科。也许，这样也有效果吧。
source_text: 面对你给的选题，讲师绞尽脑汁也没想到怎么样能让这堂安全教育课别开生面，最后只能变成了简单的照本宣科。也许，这样也有效果吧。

text: Under your introduction, Lady Sun learned about Burning Mountain Stone. She excitedly modified her cannon into a Burning Mountain Stone thruster, but during the test fire, the power was so great that she shot the cannon away.
zh_text: 孙尚香在你的介绍下认识了燃山石，她兴高采烈地把自己的火炮改造成了燃山石推进器，却在试射的时候因为威力太大把火炮射丢了。
source_text: 孙尚香在你的介绍下认识了燃山石，她兴高采烈地把自己的火炮改造成了燃山石推进器，却在试射的时候因为威力太大把火炮射丢了。

text: There is still no sign of the mechanical seeds sprouting.
zh_text: 机关种子迟迟没有发芽的迹象。
source_text: 机关种子迟迟没有发芽的迹象。

text: To set an example for the students, you, as headmaster, led everyone in farming. Unexpectedly, you used too much force while hoeing, and the hoe fell into the nearby river. At this moment, a burst of golden light emanated from the river, and a goddess as graceful as a startled swan slowly appeared. Looking at her face, you felt it was very familiar—could it be Zhen Ji? She asked you if you dropped a golden hoe, a silver hoe, or a regular hoe.
zh_text: 为了给学子们一个表率，你作为校长带领大家耕作，没想到锄地时过于用力，锄头掉进了旁边的小河里，此时河中散发出一阵金光，只见一位翩若惊鸿的女神缓缓出现，望着她的面容，你觉得好生眼熟，难道是甄姬？她问你掉的是金锄头还是银锄头还是普通锄头。
source_text: 为了给学子们一个表率，你作为校长带领大家耕作，没想到锄地时过于用力，锄头掉进了旁边的小河里，此时河中散发出一阵金光，只见一位翩若惊鸿的女神缓缓出现，望着她的面容，你觉得好生眼熟，难道是甄姬？她问你掉的是金锄头还是银锄头还是普通锄头。

text: You were right. After Leng Chun joined "Noisy Ridge," the students who came to experience it all called it a blast, and Dr. Leng Chun herself rarely had such a moment to liberate her nature and had a lot of fun. It seems this was a win-win ending. However, some students had poor psychological quality and were scared dizzy and bumped around in the escape room, and came to the infirmary to get medicine with lingering fears. When they pushed aside the curtain and saw Dr. Leng Chun from just now, Jixia added another bizarre academy legend that is hard to distinguish between true and false.
zh_text: 你料的没错，冷春加入《吵闹岭》后，前来体验的学子们都大呼过瘾，而冷春医生自己也难得有这种解放自己天性的时刻，玩的同样很开心。看起来，这是一场双赢的结局。不过，有一些学子心理素质太差，在密室里被吓到晕头转向磕磕碰碰，心有余悸的来到校医馆领药。当他们推开纱帘却看见刚才的冷春医生时，稷下从此又多了一个真假莫辨的学院怪诞传说。
source_text: 你料的没错，冷春加入《吵闹岭》后，前来体验的学子们都大呼过瘾，而冷春医生自己也难得有这种解放自己天性的时刻，玩的同样很开心。看起来，这是一场双赢的结局。不过，有一些学子心理素质太差，在密室里被吓到晕头转向磕磕碰碰，心有余悸的来到校医馆领药。当他们推开纱帘却看见刚才的冷春医生时，稷下从此又多了一个真假莫辨的学院怪诞传说。

text: You eagerly sign up for the Radish Squat competition and successfully advance, becoming the new Radish King. With a wave of your hand, millions of radishes are at your command, and you decide to use them to rule the world... Unexpectedly, you are assassinated by a radish spy. When you wake up, you realize it was just a dream, only the radishes in the basket are gone.
zh_text: 你踊跃报名萝卜蹲比赛，并且成功晋级，成为了新一任的萝卜大王，挥一挥手，便是百万萝卜任你差遣，你决定利用萝卜统治世界……没想到却被萝卜间谍刺杀，等你醒来的时候，你发现只是一场梦，只是菜篮的萝卜不见了。
source_text: 你踊跃报名萝卜蹲比赛，并且成功晋级，成为了新一任的萝卜大王，挥一挥手，便是百万萝卜任你差遣，你决定利用萝卜统治世界……没想到却被萝卜间谍刺杀，等你醒来的时候，你发现只是一场梦，只是菜篮的萝卜不见了。

text: A Storm Dragon flies out from Dragon Valley, its roar piercing through all of Jixia. The dragon flies to your side and gently nudges you with its head, though you don't know which one it is.
zh_text: 一只风暴龙王从龙旗谷飞出，龙啸声穿透了整个稷下。龙飞到你身边，用头轻轻蹭了蹭你，虽然你并不知道它到底是哪一只。
source_text: 一只风暴龙王从龙旗谷飞出，龙啸声穿透了整个稷下。龙飞到你身边，用头轻轻蹭了蹭你，虽然你并不知道它到底是哪一只。

text: Young prodigy. You decide to admit students who are already famous at a young age.
zh_text: 年少成名 你决定录取已经年少成名的学子。
source_text: 年少成名 你决定录取已经年少成名的学子。

text: While you and Zhuge Liang were checking the situation near the academy, you were surrounded by several village children who were weaving straw hats. They wanted to invite you to join them and use you as their special selling point. Zhuge Liang looked at you with a smile and asked what you thought.
zh_text: 你与诸葛亮并肩查看学院附近情况时，被几个村民孩子团团围住，他们正在编制草帽，想邀请你们一起参加，作为他们的特殊卖点，诸葛亮笑盈盈看向你，问你意向如何。
source_text: 你与诸葛亮并肩查看学院附近情况时，被几个村民孩子团团围住，他们正在编制草帽，想邀请你们一起参加，作为他们的特殊卖点，诸葛亮笑盈盈看向你，问你意向如何。

text: You are recognized as not being a real radish as soon as you try to blend in, and you are kicked out.
zh_text: 你刚混进去就被认出不是真萝卜，被赶了出来。
source_text: 你刚混进去就被认出不是真萝卜，被赶了出来。

text: Those who indulge in pleasure are destined to achieve nothing great, you said to the teachers and students. The cafeteria food didn't improve, but it gave everyone a sense of conviction while dining.
zh_text: 沉沦于享受之中的人注定不会有什么大的作为，你对着一众师生如此说道。食堂的伙食没有什么改善，但却让一众师生在用餐时凭空生出几分信念感
source_text: 沉沦于享受之中的人注定不会有什么大的作为，你对着一众师生如此说道。食堂的伙食没有什么改善，但却让一众师生在用餐时凭空生出几分信念感

text: As a head of school sitting in a high position, one will inevitably overlook the simplest voices of teachers and students. An academy should focus on more than just education; it should also focus on the needs of the people themselves. Now is the time to listen to their voices.
zh_text: 作为一校之长，端坐高位之上，必定会忽视来自师生最朴素的声音。一所学院该关注的不仅仅是教育，还有人本身的诉求。现在，正是时候去倾听他们的声音。
source_text: 作为一校之长，端坐高位之上，必定会忽视来自师生最朴素的声音。一所学院该关注的不仅仅是教育，还有人本身的诉求。现在，正是时候去倾听他们的声音。

text: The name of Jixia Academy is growing ever louder, and its academic atmosphere and achievements are renowned far and wide. After academies in Chang'an, Xuanyong, and other places successively proposed academic exchanges and sent exchange student teams, someone finally saw the root cause of Jixia Academy's brilliance—you. As you look at the letter inviting you to travel abroad to share your school management philosophy and policies, your heart beats with excitement and joy, and of course, a little bit of unease.
zh_text: 稷下学院的大名愈发响亮，其学术氛围与学术成果更是享誉一方。在长安、玄雍等地的学院陆续提议学术交流，派遣交换生队伍之后，终于有人看到了稷下学院如此辉煌的根本原因——你。当你看着那封邀请你前往异地分享治校理念方针的信件，心间悦动着兴奋喜悦，当然，还有些许的不安。
source_text: 稷下学院的大名愈发响亮，其学术氛围与学术成果更是享誉一方。在长安、玄雍等地的学院陆续提议学术交流，派遣交换生队伍之后，终于有人看到了稷下学院如此辉煌的根本原因——你。当你看着那封邀请你前往异地分享治校理念方针的信件，心间悦动着兴奋喜悦，当然，还有些许的不安。

text: I must still be dreaming. You feel like you haven't woken up yet and decide to go back to sleep.
zh_text: 我一定没睡醒 你觉得自己没睡醒决定回去再睡。
source_text: 我一定没睡醒 你觉得自己没睡醒决定回去再睡。

text: The merchant stares at you, his eyes holding something you cannot understand. Then, as if he has conceded, he says firmly, "You are right; you are the owner of this coin."
zh_text: 商人定定地望着你,那眼神里有些你看不懂的东西。随后,他却像败下阵来,肯定地说到"您说得不错,您便是这钱币的主人了。"
source_text: 商人定定地望着你,那眼神里有些你看不懂的东西。随后,他却像败下阵来,肯定地说到"您说得不错,您便是这钱币的主人了。"

text: Let it look in the mirror. You decide to let the Gugua Prince look in the mirror to face reality.
zh_text: 给它照照镜子 你决定让咕呱王子照镜子认清现实。
source_text: 给它照照镜子 你决定让咕呱王子照镜子认清现实。

text: Teaching reforms have taken academic standards to a new level.
zh_text: 教学改革让学术水平更上一层楼。
source_text: 教学改革让学术水平更上一层楼。

text:
A group of students returned from Chang'an. Their eyes held undisguised admiration for that land, which is not only prosperous but also possesses highly developed mechanical resources.
Development everywhere has its own subtleties. Hopefully, this journey will leave the students with more than just admiration, but also insights.
zh_text:
一批学子从长安归来，他们的眼中都毫不掩饰对那片土地的赞叹，那里不仅盛和繁华，更是坐拥着高度发达的机关资源。
各地的发展，都有其精妙之处，希望这趟游历，能留给学子的不止是赞叹，还有感悟。
source_text:
一批学子从长安归来，他们的眼中都毫不掩饰对那片土地的赞叹，那里不仅盛和繁华，更是坐拥着高度发达的机关资源。
各地的发展，都有其精妙之处，希望这趟游历，能留给学子的不止是赞叹，还有感悟。

text: You have been ousted, and you are no longer in charge of the academy.
zh_text: 你被赶下台，学院不再由你负责
source_text: 你被赶下台，学院不再由你负责

text: You are evenly matched, but everyone can see that your moves are almost clumsily identical. This comical battle becomes the biggest news among the students.
zh_text: 你和他棋逢对手，但旁人都看出你们两个的招式几乎笨拙的别无二致，这滑稽的一战成了学子们口中最大的新闻。
source_text: 你和他棋逢对手，但旁人都看出你们两个的招式几乎笨拙的别无二致，这滑稽的一战成了学子们口中最大的新闻。

text: You took a multi-pronged approach: using force to deter, balancing rewards and punishments, conducting comprehensive institutional reforms, deepening the supervision system, and calling on all faculty and staff to unite closely with you at the core. You established teaching standards and discipline to fundamentally prevent unscrupulous staff from infiltrating the academy.
zh_text: 你多管齐下，使用武力震慑之余，赏罚兼具，全面进行体制改革，深化监督体系，号召全体教职员以你为核心，紧紧团结在一起。树立教风教纪，从根本上杜绝思想不端正的教职员混入学院。
source_text: 你多管齐下，使用武力震慑之余，赏罚兼具，全面进行体制改革，深化监督体系，号召全体教职员以你为核心，紧紧团结在一起。树立教风教纪，从根本上杜绝思想不端正的教职员混入学院。

text:
He comes before you, intending to show you his exquisite hypnosis.
"Next, repeat after me..."
He whispers sentence by sentence, and you repeat every word accurately. You feel that the strange incantation is indeed guiding the flow within you, but you become increasingly clear-headed. When you open your eyes, you find that the person in front of you has fallen asleep.
zh_text:
他来到你的面前,打算为你展示他精妙的催眠术。
"接下来,复述我的话......"
他一句句低语,你一字不差的重复,竟觉得这陌生的咒语的确引导了你体内的流,可你却愈来愈清醒,当你睁开眼,却发现面前的人已经昏睡了过去。
source_text:
他来到你的面前,打算为你展示他精妙的催眠术。
"接下来,复述我的话......"
他一句句低语,你一字不差的重复,竟觉得这陌生的咒语的确引导了你体内的流,可你却愈来愈清醒,当你睁开眼,却发现面前的人已经昏睡了过去。

text: Having defeated the enemies in the Cloud Silkworm Room, the glowing heroes ask you to name the organization.
zh_text: 击败了云蚕间的敌人，发光的英雄们让你给组织起个名字。
source_text: 击败了云蚕间的敌人，发光的英雄们让你给组织起个名字。

text: You rushed to the farm empty-handed, and the students were moved by your spirit and worked even harder at farming.
zh_text: 你两手空空直冲农场，学子们被你的精神感动，务农更加卖力。
source_text: 你两手空空直冲农场，学子们被你的精神感动，务农更加卖力。

text: The students were scared to death, and the project's reputation is polarized. Leng Chun's Charm +2.
zh_text: 学子们被吓得够呛，项目风评两极分化。冷春魅力+2。
source_text: 学子们被吓得够呛，项目风评两极分化。冷春魅力+2。

text: You watched the academy flourish and felt deeply gratified. The sound of ships from the Hundred-Call Port echoed, and an old friend of yours returned. This time, you will surely stand side by side.
zh_text: 你看着学院极大繁荣，十分欣慰，这里百鸣港的船声响起，一位你的老友归来，这一次，你们一定会携手并肩。
source_text: 你看着学院极大繁荣，十分欣慰，这里百鸣港的船声响起，一位你的老友归来，这一次，你们一定会携手并肩。

text: The Gugu Prince decides to give you one last chance: break the curse and he will let you go.
zh_text: 咕呱王子决定给你最后一个机会：解除诅咒就放过你。
source_text: 咕呱王子决定给你最后一个机会：解除诅咒就放过你。

text: You rub off the outer shell of the copper coin; these are actually coins made of pure gold. You don't recognize the patterns on them, but you can feel a mysterious power.
zh_text: 你将铜钱的外壳搓下，这竟是一批纯金打造的钱币，你并不认识其上绘制的纹案，但能感受到一股神秘的力量。
source_text: 你将铜钱的外壳搓下，这竟是一批纯金打造的钱币，你并不认识其上绘制的纹案，但能感受到一股神秘的力量。

text:
You eagerly sign up for the Radish Squat competition, but during the process, your mouth can't keep up with your actions, and you are eliminated after a few rounds. You then try to escape this bizarre world.
Unexpectedly, you are discovered by the radishes, who believe you are disloyal to the Radish King and do not follow the radish rules, so they throw you into prison. When you wake up dazed, you realize it was just a dream, only the radishes in the basket are gone.
zh_text:
你踊跃报名萝卜蹲比赛，在比赛过程中，你的嘴跟不上你的动作，没几轮就被淘汰了。随后你试图逃离这个光怪陆离的世界。
没想到被众萝卜发现，众萝卜认为你不忠于萝卜王，不遵守萝卜规矩，将你打入大牢。等你迷迷糊糊地醒来，你发现只是一场梦，只是菜篮的萝卜不见了。
source_text:
你踊跃报名萝卜蹲比赛，在比赛过程中，你的嘴跟不上你的动作，没几轮就被淘汰了。随后你试图逃离这个光怪陆离的世界。
没想到被众萝卜发现，众萝卜认为你不忠于萝卜王，不遵守萝卜规矩，将你打入大牢。等你迷迷糊糊地醒来，你发现只是一场梦，只是菜篮的萝卜不见了。

text: Equipment is brand new, and teaching quality has greatly improved.
zh_text: 设备焕然一新教学质量大幅提升。
source_text: 设备焕然一新教学质量大幅提升。

text: Everything bought was a fake, and you lost a small amount of money.
zh_text: 买到的都是赝品亏了一小笔。
source_text: 买到的都是赝品亏了一小笔。

text: Through your careful guidance, the students are diligent and self-disciplined, and the academy's order has taken on a new look.
zh_text: 经过你的悉心教导，学子们勤学自律，学院秩序焕然一新。
source_text: 经过你的悉心教导，学子们勤学自律，学院秩序焕然一新。

text:
Around the theme of "Ten Thousand Miles of Contention," students from various academies had a burst of inspiration. Students from Jingshan Academy brought out a glittering statue, using gold thread to outline various flowers in full bloom. People from Qianku City brought a sand painting; as the sand fell, it revealed a scene of a hundred boats racing.
Jixia students used Jixia wheat to make a huge steamed flower bun, with the buns piled up like high mountains, and students from various academies climbing the peaks—it was quite lively.
In this round of competition, the students from each academy tied again.
zh_text:
围绕"万里争鸣"的主题,各院学子灵感爆发。径山书院的人端出了一座金光闪闪的雕像,用金丝勾勒出各式花朵,百花齐放。千窟城的人则带来了一幅沙画,流沙落下,显现出百舸争流的场景。
稷下学子则用稷狐麦做了一个巨大的蒸花馍,馍馍堆成高山,各院学子勇攀高峰,好不热闹。
本轮竞赛各院学子再次打成平手。
source_text:
