text: You righteously rejected Prince Gugu. Prince Gugu gave a wicked smile, saying it was fascinated by your playing hard to get, and then brought its Gugu followers to join your academy.
zh_text: 你义正言辞地拒绝了咕呱王子，咕呱王子邪魅一笑，表示它对你的欲擒故纵深感着迷，于是带着手下的咕呱加入了你的学院。
source_text: 你义正言辞地拒绝了咕呱王子，咕呱王子邪魅一笑，表示它对你的欲擒故纵深感着迷，于是带着手下的咕呱加入了你的学院。

text: The reform met with resistance and opposition from veteran teachers.
zh_text: 改革遇到了老教师的阻力和抵触。
source_text: 改革遇到了老教师的阻力和抵触。

text: You recruited a large number of students who obey management, although they have average talent and no reputation. However, you have confidence in the academy's education; when they walk out of this academy, they will surely be outstanding talents.
zh_text: 你招收了大量服从管理的学子，虽然他们天赋一般，也没什么名声。不过，你对学院的教育有信心，等他们走出这所学院时，一定会是出类拔萃的人才。
source_text: 你招收了大量服从管理的学子，虽然他们天赋一般，也没什么名声。不过，你对学院的教育有信心，等他们走出这所学院时，一定会是出类拔萃的人才。

text:
You and Zhuge Liang sit down to start weaving straw hats. One crooked hat after another is born from your hands, making the children laugh, and even Zhuge Liang can't help but smile.
You successfully help the children finish the hats. On the way back, Zhuge Liang suddenly takes out an exquisitely woven sun hat from behind and places it on your head. He smiles, shakes his feather fan, and nods at you, saying it's a reward for the principal, a small token of his sincerity.
zh_text:
你和诸葛亮坐下来开始编织草帽，一个个歪歪扭扭的草帽从你手中诞生，逗得孩子们哈哈大笑，诸葛亮也有些忍俊不禁。
你们成功帮孩子们编完草帽，回去路上，诸葛亮突然从背后拿出一顶编织精致的遮阳草帽扣在你头上，他笑着摇摇羽扇，看着你点点头，说是当作给校长的报酬，结小帽以尽心意。

text: What should be the normal reaction when a book sends you a message? You stared at the message on the book, pondered for a few days, and made your decision.
zh_text: 正常人遇到书给自己发消息的时候，一般反应应该是什么？你对着书上的消息，沉思了几日，做出了你的决定。
source_text: 正常人遇到书给自己发消息的时候，一般反应应该是什么？你对着书上的消息，沉思了几日，做出了你的决定。

text: The name is highly infectious, and everyone is inspired by it.
zh_text: 名字感染力极强，所有人都为之振奋。
source_text: 名字感染力极强，所有人都为之振奋。

text: The entire academy's staff and students have suffered through a monotonous life for too long. They urgently need a carnival to detach themselves from the day-to-day academy affairs and release their vitality. You noticed their eager eyes. Now... do you want to give them an answer?
zh_text: 全校师生苦日复一日的生活已久，他们迫切地需要一场狂欢，将自己从日复一日的学院事务中抽离出来，去释放自己的生命力。你注意到了他们殷切的眼神，现在……是否要给他们一个回答呢？

text: The Assassin's Wardrobe, new store grand opening! The owner has personally tested it for a close, breathable fit; the style is trendy and cool, balancing low-key aesthetics with convenience. text:
You silently withdrew your gaze, avoiding eye contact with them. You know everything, but...

source_text: 小龙们无法停止争斗，并最终撕裂了花园，逃往了龙旗谷更远的荒野。

text: The academy is just starting, and everything is waiting to be done. Many teachers and students report that the cafeteria food quality is unstable—one meal is delicious, the next is frustrating. Before putting the spoon in their mouths, no one knows if they can finish the meal calmly... When you find the culinary expert in charge of the cafeteria, they just throw back the line: Even a clever housewife cannot cook without rice.
zh_text: 学院起步，百废待兴。许多师生反应食堂伙食水平不稳，一顿美味，一顿糟心，在将饭勺放进口中之前，谁也不知道能不能心平气和地吃完这顿饭……当你找到负责食堂的肴馔家后，对方也只是丢下一句巧妇难为无米之炊。

text:
The old man excitedly invited you to watch his mechanical seeds. It's hard for you to imagine this combination of machinery and agriculture in a seed, even if it's a tractor?
But the old man insisted that this seed could sprout, and he wanted to set up an irrigation system in Fengyun Wild, which requires a lot of money and manpower. Are you still going to invest?
zh_text:
大爷兴奋地邀请你观看他的机关种子，你很难想象这个机械和农业在种子上结合，哪怕是拖拉机呢？
但大爷坚称这个种子能发芽，他要去丰云野上搞一套灌溉设备，需要大量的钱和人力。你还要投资吗？

text: A more open space and more fresh air have given the young students a place to release their nature, and various violations have decreased since the start of the semester. This renovation really brought you some unexpected surprises.
zh_text: 更加开阔的场地，更多新鲜空气，让正当年少的学子们有了释放天性之处，开学后各种违规行为也因此减少了。这装修，还真是带给你不少意外之喜。

text: You dithered for too long and missed the best opportunity.
zh_text: 你迂回太久错失了最佳时机。
source_text: 你迂回太久错失了最佳时机。

text: Lady Sun found her brother to go look for the cannon she shot away, only to find it stuck in a giant rock and worshipped as a treasure by a group of Wood Fence Monsters.
zh_text: 孙尚香找到哥哥一起去寻找被自己射出去的火炮，没想到卡在了一块巨石里，还被一群木篱怪奉为宝物。
source_text: 孙尚香找到哥哥一起去寻找被自己射出去的火炮，没想到卡在了一块巨石里，还被一群木篱怪奉为宝物。

text: Charm Leadership: You decide to use your charm and leadership to unite all parties.
zh_text: 魅力领导你决定用魅力与领导力团结各方。
source_text: 魅力领导你决定用魅力与领导力团结各方。

text:
You successfully showed your strength to the students, and now they are willing to receive education in the academy system you established...
Of course, this may only be temporary.
zh_text:
你成功向一众学子展示了自己的实力，如今他们心甘情愿地在你建立起的学院系统中接受教育……
当然，这或许也只是暂时的。
source_text:
你成功向一众学子展示了自己的实力，如今他们心甘情愿地在你建立起的学院系统中接受教育……
当然，这或许也只是暂时的。

text: The entire academy's staff and students have suffered through a monotonous life for too long, and they look at you with unwavering determination. They believe that you will definitely not let everyone down.
zh_text: 全校师生苦日复一日的生活已久，而他们看向你的目光坚定不移，他们相信，你绝对不会令大家失望。
source_text: 全校师生苦日复一日的生活已久，而他们看向你的目光坚定不移，他们相信，你绝对不会令大家失望。

text: Discovered that the cafeteria worker is someone who brings a mech core to work to pick vegetables.
zh_text: 发现食堂大爷是带机关核上班择菜的人。
source_text: 发现食堂大爷是带机关核上班择菜的人。

text:
Question 1: Why does Angela deal so much damage?
Qianku students buzz in! Because she carries a book, and knowledge is power! Correct answer!
Question 2: Beat a bird, name a hero.
Jixia students buzz in, "Hou Yi! He shot the Golden Crow!" Unfortunately, no.
Jingshan students think for a moment, "Dr Bian!" Correct answer! ......
Question 10: Why does Luna run out of mana so quickly?
Jixia students buzz in, because she likes blue. Incorrect.
Qianku students answer again, because Luna is also a "Moonlight Clan" member, correct answer!
The Jixia students were very fast, but unfortunately, their brains didn't turn fast enough to understand the questioner's intent, and they lost regretfully.
zh_text:
第一题:为什么安琪拉的伤害很高?
千窟学子抢答!因为她拿着书,知识就是力量!回答正确!
第二题:揍鸟,打一英雄名。
稷下学子抢答,是"后羿!他射金乌!"可惜不是。
径山学子略加思索,"是扁鹊!"回答正确!......
第十题:为什么露娜的蓝用得快?
稷下学子抢答,因为她喜欢蓝色。错误。
千窟学子再答,因为露娜也算"月光族"了,回答正确!
稷下学子手速很快,可惜脑筋没有转过来,没有看懂出题人的意图,遗憾落败。

text:
You took Hua Mulan to Frostcloud Town: Burning Mountain Stone new-power Cloud-Roaming Boards in the East Market; Cloud-Root enchanted gold-silk soft armor in the West Market; secret recipes of the Hundred Herbs family for strengthening muscles and bones in the South Market; and mysterious iron-refined Cloud God-Weapons in the North Market. You spent a lot of Ringild to upgrade Mulan's equipment and watched her head to her destination.
Perhaps those Wood-Fence Monsters would never imagine that this equipment, capable of taking down God-Smiths, was bought by you to deal with them...
zh_text:
你带着花木兰前往霜云镇，东市买燃山石新动力云游板；西市买云根附魔金丝软甲；南市买强筋健骨百草家秘方；北市买玄铁精锻铸云神兵。你花了不少环金为木兰升级装备，目送她前往目的地。
也许那群木篱怪始终不会想到，这些能够把神铸者都干趴下的装备，居然被你买来对付它们……

source_text: 知材广场 你决定前往知材广场了解物资储备。

text: Since the cafeteria food is terrible, let the students hunt for themselves! Soon, many magical foods appeared in Jixia, such as "Fried Proud Fire Falcon Nuggets" and "Strange Meat Patties." It's just that I don't know if there will be any strange buffs after eating these...
zh_text: 既然食堂饭菜难吃，那就让学子们自己打猎吧！很快，稷下出现了很多诸如“炸傲火隼块”、“怪味肉排”的神奇食物。就是不知道吃完这些会不会有奇怪的增益……

text: Looking at Zhou Yu's surprised and slightly angry face, you quickly called a stop to the game and invited everyone to taste the new special drinks from the Baicao family. Everyone toasted the day's 'cannon-fire king,' and the air inside and outside the mahjong parlor was filled with joy.
zh_text: 看着满脸诧异微微愤怒的周瑜，你赶紧叫停了游戏，并请众人一起品尝百草家的新特饮，大家一起敬了敬今天的点炮王，麻将馆内外充满了快活的空气。

text: As you use this power more and more, you become increasingly adept at foreseeing the future. Therefore, when a student places today's report on your desk, you are smiling and confident. But when you flip open the cover, the text before you leaves you horrified...
zh_text: 随着你越来越多的使用这份力量，对未来的预知你也愈加得心应手。因此当学子将今天的报告放在你的案头，你面带微笑，胸有成竹。可当你翻开封面，面前的文字，让你大惊失色……

text: The strategy worked and successfully resolved the crisis.
zh_text: 策略奏效成功化解了这场危机。
source_text: 策略奏效成功化解了这场危机。

text: You rescued the croak, and it found warmth in your arms.
zh_text: 你救起了咕呱，它在你的怀里得到了温暖。
source_text: 你救起了咕呱，它在你的怀里得到了温暖。

text: You discover several problems in the cafeteria management and solve them in time.
zh_text: 你发现食堂管理中的若干问题并及时解决。
source_text: 你发现食堂管理中的若干问题并及时解决。

text: At the Frostcloud Town book stall market, a mysterious person holding a pile of books thinks you are a genius with extraordinary potential.
zh_text: 霜云镇书摊集市，一个神秘人抱着一堆书觉得你是骨骼精奇的天才。
source_text: 霜云镇书摊集市，一个神秘人抱着一堆书觉得你是骨骼精奇的天才。

text: The little dragons could not stop fighting and eventually tore the garden apart, fleeing into the deeper wilderness of Dragon Banner Valley.
zh_text: 小龙们无法停止争斗，并最终撕裂了花园，逃往了龙旗谷更远的荒野。
source_text: 小龙们无法停止争斗，并最终撕裂了花园，逃往了龙旗谷更远的荒野。

text:
Without needing any words, you just need to stand on the podium, and everything about Jixia Academy's success seems to have an answer. People who call themselves educators sit below, staring at your golden figure, trying to dig out the secret of Jixia Academy's success from you, but unfortunately, it is all in vain.
After this battle, the academy has become world-famous. Even the most ordinary cloud-gatherer in Xiyunluo cannot help but puff out their chest when thinking of Jixia Academy's glorious achievements.
zh_text:
无需任何言语，你只需要站在讲台之上，稷下学院的一切成功仿佛都有了答案。一位位自诩教育者的人坐在台下，凝视着你泛着金辉的身影，试图从你身上挖掘出稷下学院成功的秘诀，可惜，这一切不过徒劳。
经此一役，学院已然举世闻名，即使是西云落最平凡的采云人，一想到稷下学院的辉煌成就，也会不由自主地挺起胸膛。

text: For an academy, students are the foundation of its vitality. If we admit students with poor aptitude, their future failures could tarnish the academy's reputation; if we only select students with exceptional aptitude, the academy will be empty, and beyond failing to meet the needs of normal campus life, it would likely become a laughingstock among other academies. Various potential risks have become clear under your brainstorming; now, what you need to do is very clear...
zh_text: 对一所学院而言，其生命力的根本，便是学子。若是招进了资质太差的学子，日后教坏了传出去，岂不败坏了学院的名声；若是只挑选资质优异的学子，到时候学院内空空荡荡，不谈能否满足正常的校园生活需求，光是传出去，怕是也会惹得其他学院笑话。种种潜在的隐患在你的头脑风暴下清晰起来，现在，你需要做的事已经十分明了……

text: The new school year has begun, and the academy needs to recruit new students. What criteria will you use for admission?
zh_text: 新学年开始，学院需要招录新生。你按什么标准招生？
source_text: 新学年开始，学院需要招录新生。你按什么标准招生？

text: The Continental Education Committee is here for an inspection.
zh_text: 大陆教育委员会前来视察。
source_text: 大陆教育委员会前来视察。

text: The research on mechanical seeds has made a breakthrough.
zh_text: 机关种子的研发取得了突破。
source_text: 机关种子的研发取得了突破。

text: Greed often leads to failure; you didn't anticipate that the Academy currently lacks the capacity to host a summer camp of this scale. The expectant students were very disappointed, and the planned week-long summer camp ended prematurely due to a lack of members.
zh_text: 贪心不足蛇吞象，你没有料到现在学院的能力并没有办法承办这样规模的夏令营。满怀期待的学子们在营里十分失望，原定为期一周的夏令营计划因为成员不足而草草收场。
source_text: 贪心不足蛇吞象，你没有料到现在学院的能力并没有办法承办这样规模的夏令营。满怀期待的学子们在营里十分失望，原定为期一周的夏令营计划因为成员不足而草草收场。

text: You discover that the source of the seven little dragons' power is highly consistent, and the different powers they display seem to be just an appearance.
zh_text: 你发现了七条小龙力量来源高度一致，它们展现出的不同力量似乎只是一种表象。
source_text: 你发现了七条小龙力量来源高度一致，它们展现出的不同力量似乎只是一种表象。

text:
Everyone discussed it in a hubbub; some advocated changing course, while others argued that as bystanders, they had no decision-making power. Some reckless students even started grabbing the Cloud Ship's helm.
Jixia students stood up, calling on everyone from all academies to unite and not panic. They proposed that all students work together to force the Cloud Ship to stop. The Cloud Ship dilemma actually found an optimal solution; no wooden fences were damaged, and these fences were just wooden models.
The excellent performance of the Jixia students was praised by students from all academies.
zh_text:
大家七嘴八舌的讨论，有人主张变道，有人主张作为旁观者没有决定权。有些莽撞的学子甚至开始抢夺云舟的舵盘。
稷下学子站了出来，呼吁所有学院的人团结一致，不要慌乱。并提议全部学子一起努力，逼停云舟。云舟难题竟然找到了最优解，没有木篱受到伤害，而且这些木篱是木头做的模型。
稷下学子的优异表现，让各院学子纷纷赞叹不已。

text: There are more and more new students in Jixia, and arranging their food, clothing, housing, and transportation has become a big problem, especially accommodation. Currently, Jixia no longer has enough dormitories for the new students.
zh_text: 稷下的新学子越来越多，安置他们的衣食住行成了大问题，尤其是住宿。眼下稷下已经没有足够的校舍给新学子们了。

text: Continue Description. You decide to ignore the mockery and continue telling the story of the miracle.
zh_text: 继续描述 你决定无视嘲笑继续讲奇迹的故事。
source_text: 继续描述 你决定无视嘲笑继续讲奇迹的故事。

text: Everyone returned with a full load, and dinner is sorted.
zh_text: 大家满载而归，晚餐有了着落。
source_text: 大家满载而归，晚餐有了着落。

text: Learning that the seven little dragons are fighting each other until only one survives is the fate of these little dragons, and you are heartbroken. In your eyes, the little dragons are like children you raised, and now you have to make a choice.
zh_text: 得知七条小龙彼此争斗，直至一条存活是这些小龙的宿命，你揪心不已。小龙在你眼里仿佛你养大的孩子，现在你要做出抉择。
source_text: 得知七条小龙彼此争斗，直至一条存活是这些小龙的宿命，你揪心不已。小龙在你眼里仿佛你养大的孩子，现在你要做出抉择。

text: You tried to show your strength to the students, but after implementing it, you found your idea was so ridiculous... The order of the academy is already in jeopardy. Do you have another chance?
zh_text: 你尝试向一众学子展示自己的实力，直到实施后却发现自己的想法是如此可笑……学院的秩序已经岌岌可危，你还有下一次机会吗？
source_text: 你尝试向一众学子展示自己的实力，直到实施后却发现自己的想法是如此可笑……学院的秩序已经岌岌可危，你还有下一次机会吗？

text: The astrologer's prophecy failed this time. After Zhou Yu sat across from you, he didn't lose; instead, he played more steadily, and you and the Sun siblings made mistake after mistake. The lively atmosphere in the mahjong parlor gradually solidified, and in the end, only the three of you were left in silence, staring at Zhou Yu's calm hand.
zh_text: 占星师的预言这次没能奏效。周瑜坐在你对面后非但没有点炮，反而越打越稳，你和孙家兄妹接连失手。麻将馆里原本准备好的快活空气渐渐凝固，最后只剩你们三人对着周瑜冷静的牌面陷入沉默。

text: When you hold this sun hat, a flash of inspiration strikes your heart. Why not let the students experience Jixia's farming culture? text:

text:
You look at the uniquely designed student card in your hand with the words "Sanxian-Approved" printed on it, and you can't help but feel confused. You have been in charge of the academy for some time, but you have no memory of this student card.
Just then, a student from the admissions office reports to you that during the admissions process, a newcomer claimed to be a "Sanxian-Approved" special recruit and stated that their level was not high enough to assess him. They had no idea what to do, so they had to come to you for instructions.
You arrive at the admissions office and indeed see a stranger sitting in the examiner's seat. He claims that he was personally given that student card by the Sanxian and is a genius who has come to save the academy at a critical moment. He didn't expect the student card to be stolen by a villain.
The other party's tone is firm, but he has no proof. Just as you are thinking about how to handle this, he notices the student card in your hand and takes the initiative to suggest a duel with you—martial arts, mechanics, magic, he claims to be proficient in everything. The students present are also intrigued and crowd around, intending to see the performance of the acting principal and the genius newcomer.
zh_text:
你看着手里造型别致,印着"三贤钦定"几个大字的学生卡,不禁疑惑起来。你执掌学院已有一段时间,对这学生卡却毫无记忆。
正在此时,招生处的学子向你汇报,招生过程中,一名新人声称自己乃是"三贤钦定"的特招生,并表示以他们的级别无权对他进行考核。他们没有头绪,因此只能来请示你。
你来到招生处,果然看到一个陌生人坐在考官的位置上,他表示自己是被三贤亲手给予那张学生卡,关键时刻来拯救学院的天才。没想到这学生卡却被奸人窃走。
对方语气斩钉截铁,却空口无凭,你正在思索改怎么处理,他却注意到了你手中的学生卡,主动表示和你切磋,武道,机关,魔道,反正他无一不会,无一不精,而在场的学子,也被激起了兴致,纷纷凑过来,打算看看代理校长和天才新生的表现。
source_text:
你看着手里造型别致,印着"三贤钦定"几个大字的学生卡,不禁疑惑起来。你执掌学院已有一段时间,对这学生卡却毫无记忆。
正在此时,招生处的学子向你汇报,招生过程中,一名新人声称自己乃是"三贤钦定"的特招生,并表示以他们的级别无权对他进行考核。他们没有头绪,因此只能来请示你。
你来到招生处,果然看到一个陌生人坐在考官的位置上,他表示自己是被三贤亲手给予那张学生卡,关键时刻来拯救学院的天才。没想到这学生卡却被奸人窃走。
对方语气斩钉截铁,却空口无凭,你正在思索改怎么处理,他却注意到了你手中的学生卡,主动表示和你切磋,武道,机关,魔道,反正他无一不会,无一不精,而在场的学子,也被激起了兴致,纷纷凑过来,打算看看代理校长和天才新生的表现。

text: You lost the Gugu King election with zero votes.
zh_text: 你以零票落选咕呱王选举。
source_text: 你以零票落选咕呱王选举。

text: Decline with an excuse: You made an excuse to politely decline the invitation.
zh_text: 借故推辞你找了个借口婉拒邀请。
source_text: 借故推辞你找了个借口婉拒邀请。

text: You grit your teeth and persist, but progress remains slow.
zh_text: 你咬牙坚持但进展依然缓慢。
source_text: 你咬牙坚持但进展依然缓慢。

text: You leaped into the water and successfully saved the Guga. After waking up, the Guga decided you were its savior and gave you a rose as a reward.
zh_text: 你奋力跃入水中，成功将咕呱救上岸。咕呱醒来后，认定你就是他的救命恩人，并送给你一朵玫瑰花作为报答。
source_text: 你奋力跃入水中，成功将咕呱救上岸。咕呱醒来后，认定你就是他的救命恩人，并送给你一朵玫瑰花作为报答。

text: You gather the ingredients, and the students eat with great relish, remarking that even wild mountain fare has its own unique charm.
zh_text: 你们补齐食材，学子们吃得津津有味，表示山肴野蔌也别有滋味。
source_text: 你们补齐食材，学子们吃得津津有味，表示山肴野蔌也别有滋味。

text: Charm Check: You decide to use your charisma to name the organization.
zh_text: 魅力检定 你决定用感召力来为组织命名。
source_text: 魅力检定 你决定用感召力来为组织命名。

text: The academy is getting on the right track and is flourishing. Teaching is in full swing, and as the headmaster, you still shoulder the heavy responsibility of planning, supervising, scheduling, and setting the direction for teaching...
zh_text: 学院开始步入正轨，学院一片欣欣向荣。教学也正在如火如荼的进行之中，而你作为一校之长，还肩负着规划监修排课，规划教学方向的重任……
source_text: 学院开始步入正轨，学院一片欣欣向荣。教学也正在如火如荼的进行之中，而你作为一校之长，还肩负着规划监修排课，规划教学方向的重任……

text:
You found a dilapidated lamp in the fog and hung it on the lamp post at the door. That night, the lamp emitted a strange light.
The next morning, you were surprised to find that the lamp seemed to have grown vines, extending lines along the lamp post, and six other lamps of different colors appeared behind the first one.
zh_text:
你从雾中发现了一盏破败的灯，将它随手挂在门口的灯柱上，当晚灯散发着奇异的光芒。
第二天一早，你惊讶地发现灯仿佛生了藤蔓，沿着灯柱伸展灯线，在第一盏灯后面又出现了六盏灯，颜色各异。
source_text:
你从雾中发现了一盏破败的灯，将它随手挂在门口的灯柱上，当晚灯散发着奇异的光芒。
第二天一早，你惊讶地发现灯仿佛生了藤蔓，沿着灯柱伸展灯线，在第一盏灯后面又出现了六盏灯，颜色各异。

text: You failed to catch those who tried to attack the Miracle. At the critical moment, the heroes standing in the light stepped forward, saw through the enemy's schemes, and wiped them out in one fell swoop. Amidst the cheers of the crowd, the heroes quietly retreated. This disturbance seemed like nothing more than a brief interlude.
zh_text: 你没能抓住那些试图攻击奇迹的人。危机时刻，那些站在光里的英雄站了出来，识破敌人诡计，将其一举歼灭。在众人的阵阵欢呼里，英雄悄然退去。这场风波，仿佛不过是一段短暂插曲。
source_text: 你没能抓住那些试图攻击奇迹的人。危机时刻，那些站在光里的英雄站了出来，识破敌人诡计，将其一举歼灭。在众人的阵阵欢呼里，英雄悄然退去。这场风波，仿佛不过是一段短暂插曲。

text: Physique Search: You decide to seek out teachers with outstanding physiques.
zh_text: 体魄寻访 你决定寻访体魄出众的教师。
source_text: 体魄寻访 你决定寻访体魄出众的教师。

text: Your defensive line was as solid as a rock, successfully blocking the attack.
zh_text: 你的防线坚如磐石，成功挡下了进攻。
source_text: 你的防线坚如磐石，成功挡下了进攻。

text: You accompanied Zhou Yu on a slow walk through Jixia. During your chat, Zhou Yu seemed to be distracted by the sound of birds nearby. He walked under a tree and chirped in bird language, telling the birds that some notes were off, even demonstrating himself. You shook your head. Perhaps you should go to the herbalist and get some calming herbs to let Zhou Yu get some proper rest.
zh_text: 你陪着周瑜在稷下慢慢散步，谈笑间，周瑜似乎又被一旁的鸟叫声吸引了。他走到树下用鸟语叽叽喳喳的和小鸟说有几个音没发对，甚至还亲自示范起来。你摇了摇头，也许，该去找百草家要一点安神的草药，先让周瑜好好休息一下吧。
source_text: 你陪着周瑜在稷下慢慢散步，谈笑间，周瑜似乎又被一旁的鸟叫声吸引了。他走到树下用鸟语叽叽喳喳的和小鸟说有几个音没发对，甚至还亲自示范起来。你摇了摇头，也许，该去找百草家要一点安神的草药，先让周瑜好好休息一下吧。

text: You recruited a large number of students who became famous at a young age. Although you don't know how good they really are, at least now, with their help, the academy has its own reputation.
zh_text: 你招收了大量年少成名的学子，虽然不知他们水平到底如何，但至少，现在借助他们，学院也有了自己的名气。
source_text: 你招收了大量年少成名的学子，虽然不知他们水平到底如何，但至少，现在借助他们，学院也有了自己的名气。

text: Turn back and attack the Cloud Silkworm
Core goal achieved; the academy has established its reputation for scholarship.
zh_text: 核心目标达成，学院已具名学之势。
source_text: 核心目标达成，学院已具名学之势。

text: You proposed that you want to be the Croak King, but the Croak Prince refused, stating that only those who are with him and pass the test can rule all croaks.
zh_text: 你提出你要当咕呱王，咕呱王子拒绝，表示只有和他在一起并通过考验的人才能统御全咕呱。
source_text: 你提出你要当咕呱王，咕呱王子拒绝，表示只有和他在一起并通过考验的人才能统御全咕呱。

text: You are evenly matched, but everyone can see that your moves are almost clumsily identical. This comical battle becomes the biggest news among the students.
zh_text: 你和他棋逢对手，但旁人都看出你们两个的招式几乎笨拙的别无二致，这滑稽的一战成了学子们口中最大的新闻。
source_text: 你和他棋逢对手，但旁人都看出你们两个的招式几乎笨拙的别无二致，这滑稽的一战成了学子们口中最大的新闻。

text: Ignore. You decide to turn a blind eye to the actions of the materialist family.
zh_text: 无视 你决定对物币家的行为视而不见。
source_text: 无视 你决定对物币家的行为视而不见。

text: Seeing your firm attitude, the Gugu Prince makes one final request.
zh_text: 咕呱王子见你态度坚决，向你提出最后一个要求。
source_text: 咕呱王子见你态度坚决，向你提出最后一个要求。

text: Under the scorching sun, everyone soon became miserable.
zh_text: 烈日炙烤下大家很快就苦不堪言。
source_text: 烈日炙烤下大家很快就苦不堪言。

text: The canteen old man wants to build a mechanism workshop and needs you to sponsor some money and manpower.
zh_text: 食堂大爷想建机关工坊，需要你赞助一些钱和人力。
source_text: 食堂大爷想建机关工坊，需要你赞助一些钱和人力。

text: Things are looking bad; those who went to Dragon Banner Valley to find the little dragon are either seriously injured or missing. You cannot sit idly by and decide to seal off Dragon Banner Valley to prevent further disasters.
zh_text: 大事不妙，前去龙旗谷寻找小龙的人要么重伤，要么下落不明。你无法坐视不理，决定封锁龙旗谷，防止出现更多祸端。
source_text: 大事不妙，前去龙旗谷寻找小龙的人要么重伤，要么下落不明。你无法坐视不理，决定封锁龙旗谷，防止出现更多祸端。

text: Under your leadership, the academy has gained great fame, and many institutions have applied to send students for exchange programs. Exchange students from other academies have arrived at Jixia. Perhaps, one should be a bit more cautious when dealing with them...
zh_text: 在你的领导下，学院一时名声大噪，不少学院提出申请，希望可以选一批学生前往交流学习。来自其他学院的交换生已抵达稷下，或许，对待交换生还是应该慎重一点……
source_text: 在你的领导下，学院一时名声大噪，不少学院提出申请，希望可以选一批学生前往交流学习。来自其他学院的交换生已抵达稷下，或许，对待交换生还是应该慎重一点……

text: Everyone worked together to save Gugu to the shore.
zh_text: 大家齐心协力把咕呱救上了岸。
source_text: 大家齐心协力把咕呱救上了岸。

text: You decide to send a dragonologist to investigate these strange lights.
zh_text: 你决定派一位龙学家前去探查这些奇怪的灯。
source_text: 你决定派一位龙学家前去探查这些奇怪的灯。

text: Complete Special Character Event: Novar - The Fourth Academy
zh_text: 完成特殊角色事件：东方曜·第四学院
source_text: 完成特殊角色事件：东方曜·第四学院

text: Pretend nothing happened. You decide to act as if nothing occurred and let the situation blow over on its own.
zh_text: 装作无事 你决定当作没发生让风波自行平息。
source_text: 装作无事 你决定当作没发生让风波自行平息。

text: The effect of personal charisma is slow, and no results were seen in the short term.
zh_text: 人格魅力的效果来得较慢短期内未见成效。
source_text: 人格魅力的效果来得较慢短期内未见成效。

text: Learning that the seven little dragons are fighting each other until only one survives is the fate of these little dragons, and you are heartbroken. In your eyes, the little dragons are like children you raised, and now you have to make a choice.
zh_text: 得知七条小龙彼此争斗，直至一条存活是这些小龙的宿命，你揪心不已。小龙在你眼里仿佛你养大的孩子，现在你要做出抉择。
source_text: 得知七条小龙彼此争斗，直至一条存活是这些小龙的宿命，你揪心不已。小龙在你眼里仿佛你养大的孩子，现在你要做出抉择。

text: The frantic activity only increased the pressure.
zh_text: 活动手忙脚乱反而增加了压力。
source_text: 活动手忙脚乱反而增加了压力。

text: Dragonologists discovered that these dragons are born from dragon breath. No matter how close a brood of hatchlings is, only one can survive. It will consume the breath of all its siblings to become the most powerful dragon. This is their fate.
zh_text: 龙学家们发现，这种龙生于龙息，每一窝小龙无论如何要好，最后都只能有一条龙活下去，它会吞噬掉所有兄弟姐妹的龙息，成为最强大的龙，这是宿命。
source_text: 龙学家们发现，这种龙生于龙息，每一窝小龙无论如何要好，最后都只能有一条龙活下去，它会吞噬掉所有兄弟姐妹的龙息，成为最强大的龙，这是宿命。

zh_text: 你走开了，心里一片轻松。
source_text: 你走开了，心里一片轻松。

text: You found a dilapidated lamp in the fog and hung it on the lamp post at the door. That night, the lamp emitted a strange light. The next morning, you were surprised to find that the lamp seemed to have grown vines, extending lines along the lamp post, and six other lamps of different colors appeared behind the first one.
zh_text: 你从雾中发现了一盏破败的灯，将它随手挂在门口的灯柱上，当晚灯散发着奇异的光芒。第二天一早，你惊讶地发现灯仿佛生了藤蔓，沿着灯柱伸展灯线，在第一盏灯后面又出现了六盏灯，颜色各异。
source_text: 你从雾中发现了一盏破败的灯，将它随手挂在门口的灯柱上，当晚灯散发着奇异的光芒。第二天一早，你惊讶地发现灯仿佛生了藤蔓，沿着灯柱伸展灯线，在第一盏灯后面又出现了六盏灯，颜色各异。

text:
You plan to host an Ice and Snow World to satisfy the students' desire to play in the snow. But the academy's craftsmen are all too busy to attend to this.
Just as you are worrying, a lifelike ice flower is handed to you. You turn around and find Zhaojun looking at you with a smile. That's right, maybe you can ask Zhaojun to make ice sculptures; it would be effortless!
As for the model, you seem to have a bold idea.
zh_text:
你打算开办一个冰雪大世界，好好满足一下学子们想玩雪的愿望。可学院的工巧家们都很忙，无暇顾及此事。
正当你苦恼的时候，一支栩栩如生的冰花递了过来。你回头，发现昭君正笑盈盈地看着你。对啊，也许可以让昭君出手做冰雕，不费吹灰之力啊！
至于模特嘛，你似乎有一个大胆的想法。
source_text:
你打算开办一个冰雪大世界，好好满足一下学子们想玩雪的愿望。可学院的工巧家们都很忙，无暇顾及此事。
正当你苦恼的时候，一支栩栩如生的冰花递了过来。你回头，发现昭君正笑盈盈地看着你。对啊，也许可以让昭君出手做冰雕，不费吹灰之力啊！
至于模特嘛，你似乎有一个大胆的想法。

text: Unnoticed, the students' eyes grew dim, and the various schools of thought saw fewer and fewer visitors. The academy's vitality quietly dissolved like snow after the start of spring. The academic achievements made by the students under academic pressure remained dazzling, but you would occasionally think while reviewing documents in the headmaster's office, "Is all this really worth it?"
zh_text: 不觉间，学院学子们目光灰暗，一众百家也门可罗雀，学院的生命力像是入春后的积雪一般悄然消融。学院学子们迫于学术压力所做的各项学术成果依旧耀眼夺目，不过你偶尔会在校长室审阅文件时想到，这一切真的值得吗？
source_text: 不觉间，学院学子们目光灰暗，一众百家也门可罗雀，学院的生命力像是入春后的积雪一般悄然消融。学院学子们迫于学术压力所做的各项学术成果依旧耀眼夺目，不过你偶尔会在校长室审阅文件时想到，这一切真的值得吗？

text: Teachers who admire the academy's reputation come to join.
zh_text: 仰慕学院名声的教师慕名而来。
source_text: 仰慕学院名声的教师慕名而来。

text: The little dragons could not stop fighting and eventually tore the garden apart, fleeing into the deeper wilderness of Dragon Banner Valley.
zh_text: 小龙们无法停止争斗，并最终撕裂了花园，逃往了龙旗谷更远的荒野。
source_text: 小龙们无法停止争斗，并最终撕裂了花园，逃往了龙旗谷更远的荒野。

text: Knowledge Check: You decide to use knowledge and wisdom to win over the exchange students.
zh_text: 学识检定 你决定用学识与智慧征服交换生。
source_text: 学识检定 你决定用学识与智慧征服交换生。

text: Golden Hoe: You tell the River God that the one you dropped was a golden hoe.
zh_text: 金锄头 你告诉河神你掉的是金锄头。
source_text: 金锄头 你告诉河神你掉的是金锄头。

text: Thanks to your care, the students' psychological issues have been effectively alleviated, and immature choices made under environmental or academic pressure have been timely avoided. Seeing the smiles return to their faces, you can't help but whisper—this is truly wonderful.
zh_text: 在你的重视之下，学子们的心理问题得到有效缓解，一些迫于环境压力、学术压力等各类问题所做出的不成熟的选择被及时规避。你看着学子们重新绽放在脸上的笑容，不由得低喃一声——这样真好。
source_text: 在你的重视之下，学子们的心理问题得到有效缓解，一些迫于环境压力、学术压力等各类问题所做出的不成熟的选择被及时规避。你看着学子们重新绽放在脸上的笑容，不由得低喃一声——这样真好。

text:
After much thought, you decide to wait and see. After all, if they truly are the talent chosen by the Three Sages, they will surely come to the academy on their own to demonstrate their true skills. But if they make excuses and don't show up...
You wait in secret, hoping not to be left disappointed.
zh_text:
思前想后，你决定静观其变。毕竟如果对方真是三贤选定的人才，必定会主动来到学院，展现真才实学。但若是推脱不来……
你暗自期待，希望不要让你空欢喜一场。
source_text:
思前想后，你决定静观其变。毕竟如果对方真是三贤选定的人才，必定会主动来到学院，展现真才实学。但若是推脱不来……
你暗自期待，希望不要让你空欢喜一场。

text:
Great academies always need music festivals. Understanding the importance of balancing work and rest, you prepare to host the "Summer Wood-Fence Music Festival" at the Retrograde Camp for all of Jixia to enjoy and relax.
Looking at the campfire in the camp, a warmth fills your heart. Why not add a gentle and soothing concert, just like now, in these peaceful and beautiful times? Thinking of this, you decide on the lead singer in your mind: someone gentle, cute, and healing. The only one who can do this is none other than Cai Wenji ! As for what kind of music to choose, you also have an answer.
zh_text:
伟大的学院总是需要音乐节的，你深谙劳逸结合的道理，准备在溯洄营地开办一场面向整个稷下的“夏季木篱音乐节”，让学子们好好放松放松。
望着营地的篝火，你的心里涌上一丝暖意，要不，再插播一场温和而舒缓的音乐会好了，就像现在一样，岁月平和美好。想到这里，你在心里想好了主唱的人选，要温柔、要可爱、要治愈。能做到这一点的，非蔡文姬莫属！至于选什么样的音乐，你也有了个答案。
source_text:
伟大的学院总是需要音乐节的，你深谙劳逸结合的道理，准备在溯洄营地开办一场面向整个稷下的“夏季木篱音乐节”，让学子们好好放松放松。
望着营地的篝火，你的心里涌上一丝暖意，要不，再插播一场温和而舒缓的音乐会好了，就像现在一样，岁月平和美好。想到这里，你在心里想好了主唱的人选，要温柔、要可爱、要治愈。能做到这一点的，非蔡文姬莫属！至于选什么样的音乐，你也有了个答案。

text:
The Wood-Fence Monsters on Cloudfall Heights are overrunning the place again! According to the academy's previous plan, this year's incoming class should form teams to clear them out.
However, you are the Dean now and cannot go yourself. As it happens, Mulan has been in Jixia for a long time and is itching for action, so she volunteers to join the clearing team in your place. You are deeply moved and decide to personally purchase a set of top-tier equipment for Mulan !
zh_text:
云落高地的木篱怪又又又泛滥了！按照之前学院的规划，今年该你们新入学的这一届学子组好队伍，前往清剿。
可是现在你已经是校长了，没法亲自前往。正巧木兰在稷下待了很久，手痒难耐，主动请缨替你加入清剿队。你十分感动，要亲自为木兰购置一套上好的装备！
source_text:

可是现在你已经是校长了，没法亲自前往。正巧木兰在稷下待了很久，手痒难耐，主动请缨替你加入清剿队。你十分感动，要亲自为木兰购置一套上好的装备！

text:
After experiencing so many things together, Li Bai has become a celebrity at Jixia. He has more and more fans. You and Shye both realize that this is a good promotional opportunity. Taking advantage of this momentum, we might be able to use Li Bai's influence to promote our Jixia Academy to the entire continent!
If we spread the advertisement, wouldn't the effect be even better? For this reason, you bring Shye and Li Bai together to discuss the direction and strategy of the promotion.
zh_text:
在一起经历了这么多的事情以后，李白俨然成了稷下的红人。他的粉丝也越来越多。你和西施都意识到，这是一次良好的宣传机会，借着这股劲儿，说不定可以借李白的影响力，向整片大陆宣传我们稷下学院！
如果把广告散布出去，岂不是效果会更好？为此你找来西施和李白，商讨宣传方向和策略。

在一起经历了这么多的事情以后，李白俨然成了稷下的红人。他的粉丝也越来越多。你和西施都意识到，这是一次良好的宣传机会，借着这股劲儿，说不定可以借李白的影响力，向整片大陆宣传我们稷下学院！

text: You leaped into the water and successfully saved the Guga.
zh_text: 你奋力跃入水中，成功将咕呱救上岸。
source_text: 你奋力跃入水中，成功将咕呱救上岸。

text: You burned the book, and the giggling dissipated along with it.
zh_text: 你烧了书，嬉笑声也随之消散。
source_text: 你烧了书，嬉笑声也随之消散。

text: After cleaning it up, you find that this mechanical core looks very precise, and why would a mechanical core fall into a pot? You decide to investigate the source of the mechanical core.
zh_text: 你清洗一番之后，发现这个机关核看上去非常精密，而且机关核为啥会掉锅里啊？你决定追查机关核的来源。
source_text: 你清洗一番之后，发现这个机关核看上去非常精密，而且机关核为啥会掉锅里啊？你决定追查机关核的来源。

text: You left your time for other matters.
zh_text: 你把时间留给了其他事务。
source_text: 你把时间留给了其他事务。

text: The strategy was too complex, and it was riddled with flaws during execution.
zh_text: 策略过于复杂执行起来漏洞百出。
source_text: 策略过于复杂执行起来漏洞百出。

text: The Void Dream Performance was successfully completed; the academy took a step closer to becoming a world-renowned institution.
zh_text: 归虚梦演顺利完成，学院向天下名学更进一步。
source_text: 归虚梦演顺利完成，学院向天下名学更进一步。

text: The students are still young, and although they are full of vitality, they are also easily led astray.
zh_text: 学子们年纪尚轻，虽朝气蓬勃，却也容易步入歧途。
source_text: 学子们年纪尚轻，虽朝气蓬勃，却也容易步入歧途。

text: Dunshan's hometown must be the Great Wall, you thought, opening the package. Could it be bricks for repairing the Great Wall? But after seeing what was inside, you were a bit confused. After meeting Dunshan's pleading gaze, you followed his request, held that hand-drawn defense tower health bar high above your head, and sat motionless on top of him. Sure enough, Dunshan fell into a peaceful sleep beneath you. So, this was his hometown after all?
zh_text: 盾山的家乡，应该是长城吧。你这么想着，打开了那个包裹，莫非里面是修筑长城用的砖头？可看清包里的东西后，你有些疑惑。对上盾山请求的眼神后，你还是按照他的要求，把那张手绘的防御塔血条高高举过头顶，坐在他头顶一动不动。果然，盾山便在你身下安心的睡着了。原来，这才是他的故乡吗？
source_text: 盾山的家乡，应该是长城吧。你这么想着，打开了那个包裹，莫非里面是修筑长城用的砖头？可看清包里的东西后，你有些疑惑。对上盾山请求的眼神后，你还是按照他的要求，把那张手绘的防御塔血条高高举过头顶，坐在他头顶一动不动。果然，盾山便在你身下安心的睡着了。原来，这才是他的故乡吗？

text: You searched for a long time but didn't find a suitable candidate.
zh_text: 你寻访许久也没找到合适人选。
source_text: 你寻访许久也没找到合适人选。

text: First completion: Princess Frost - Frozen World
zh_text: 首次完成王昭君·冰雪大世界
source_text: 首次完成王昭君·冰雪大世界

text: The old man's workshop turned out to be an experimental field. He said the end of mechanics is farming, and he asked you to continue sponsoring him.
zh_text: 大爷的工坊竟是一片试验田，他说机关的尽头是种地，请你继续赞助。
source_text: 大爷的工坊竟是一片试验田，他说机关的尽头是种地，请你继续赞助。

text: You joined, but he quickly ran off with the money.
zh_text: 你加入了但他很快卷款跑路。
source_text: 你加入了但他很快卷款跑路。

text: The little dragons could not stop fighting and eventually tore the garden apart, fleeing into the deeper wilderness of Dragon Banner Valley.
zh_text: 小龙们无法停止争斗，并最终撕裂了花园，逃往了龙旗谷更远的荒野。
source_text: 小龙们无法停止争斗，并最终撕裂了花园，逃往了龙旗谷更远的荒野。

text: The student feels enlightened after talking with you.
zh_text: 学生与你交流后豁然开朗。
source_text: 学生与你交流后豁然开朗。

text: Criminals, you have nowhere to run!
zh_text: 罪犯们，你们已无路可逃！
source_text: 罪犯们，你们已无路可逃！

text: Your company failed to move him; he needs more professional help.
zh_text: 你的陪伴没能打动他，他需要更专业的帮助。
source_text: 你的陪伴没能打动他，他需要更专业的帮助。

text: Zhuge Liang pondered for a moment, nodded with slight regret, and indicated he couldn't help. He politely declined the children, and you continued to patrol the perimeter of the Academy, where everything remained as usual.
zh_text: 诸葛亮沉吟了会，略带遗憾地点点头，表示爱莫能助，婉拒了孩子们，你们继续巡视学院周边，一切如常。
source_text: 诸葛亮沉吟了会，略带遗憾地点点头，表示爱莫能助，婉拒了孩子们，你们继续巡视学院周边，一切如常。

text: You watch his slow punch, feel the gentle force like a caress, and then pin him to the ground with a backhand. You call over a student from the Hundred Herbs family, and after an examination, it is discovered that he indeed has some mental issues. The students watching the match spread the news of your heroic performance throughout the academy.
zh_text: 你注视着他缓慢的来拳，感受着如同抚摸一样的温和力道，接着反手把他按在地上。你叫来了百草家的同学，经过检查，发现他的精神确实有些问题，而观战的学子们，则将你的英勇表现传遍了学院。
source_text: 你注视着他缓慢的来拳，感受着如同抚摸一样的温和力道，接着反手把他按在地上。你叫来了百草家的同学，经过检查，发现他的精神确实有些问题，而观战的学子们，则将你的英勇表现传遍了学院。

text: Blockade Dragon Banner Valley: You ordered a blockade of Dragon Banner Valley to prevent the danger from spreading.
zh_text: 封锁龙旗谷 你下令封锁龙旗谷防止危险蔓延。
source_text: 封锁龙旗谷 你下令封锁龙旗谷防止危险蔓延。

text: Those who indulge in pleasure are destined to achieve nothing great, you said to the teachers and students. The cafeteria food didn't improve, but it gave everyone a sense of conviction while dining.
zh_text: 沉沦于享受之中的人注定不会有什么大的作为，你对着一众师生如此说道。食堂的伙食没有什么改善，但却让一众师生在用餐时凭空生出几分信念感。
source_text: 沉沦于享受之中的人注定不会有什么大的作为，你对着一众师生如此说道。食堂的伙食没有什么改善，但却让一众师生在用餐时凭空生出几分信念感。

text: Under your leadership, the academy has gained great fame, and many institutions have applied to send students for exchange programs. Exchange students from other academies have arrived at Jixia. Perhaps, one should be a bit more cautious when dealing with them...
zh_text: 在你的领导下，学院一时名声大噪，不少学院提出申请，希望可以选一批学生前往交流学习。来自其他学院的交换生已抵达稷下，或许，对待交换生还是应该慎重一点……
source_text: 在你的领导下，学院一时名声大噪，不少学院提出申请，希望可以选一批学生前往交流学习。来自其他学院的交换生已抵达稷下，或许，对待交换生还是应该慎重一点……

text: The little dragons have grown up healthy under your careful care and have formed a bond with you.
zh_text: 小龙们在悉心照料下健康长大，与你建立了羁绊。
source_text: 小龙们在悉心照料下健康长大，与你建立了羁绊。

text: Blockade successful; the danger has been contained within a certain range.
zh_text: 封锁成功，危险被控制在一定范围。
source_text: 封锁成功，危险被控制在一定范围。

text: You discover the shortage of supplies and replenish them in time to ensure the academy's operation.
zh_text: 你发现物资短缺并及时补充保障了学院运转。
source_text: 你发现物资短缺并及时补充保障了学院运转。

text:
Pushing aside leaves and turning over stones, the creatures in the fields are truly diverse in all shapes and sizes, scaring many students so much that they are afraid something might crawl into their beds at night...
However, under your guidance, many students have also experienced the subtle harmony of the ecosystem.
zh_text:
扒开叶子翻起石头，农田生灵真是大大小小千姿百态，把好些学子吓坏，夜里睡觉都生怕有什么爬上床铺来……
不过在你的引导下，不少学子也体验到万物生态的微妙和谐。

不过在你的引导下，不少学子也体验到万物生态的微妙和谐。

text: You try to gather information, but the radishes become suspicious of you, a strange radish, and think you are a spy from elsewhere, so they tie you up to sacrifice you to the culinary expert. You escape with great effort, but you are exhausted.

source_text: 萝卜们准备用萝卜蹲选举新一任萝卜王。

text: Since taking over as headmaster, you have had to handle not only the academy's internal affairs but also letters from the outside world.
zh_text: 接任校长以来，除了学院内部的大事小情，就连外界发来的信件，也要你一并处理。
source_text: 接任校长以来，除了学院内部的大事小情，就连外界发来的信件，也要你一并处理。

text: In the dance studio, the three strategists were panting and sore. Once masters of strategy, they each held their own opinions, all believing their rhythm was the most perfect. With no other choice, you had to resort to your "evil cultivation," making Yuan Ge the lead dancer and using puppet strings to pull the other three strategists through the movements. Watching the elegant Yuan Ge, he could remain calm even while manipulating so many strings at once. However, shouldn't you remind him about the boundaries? This time, he's not manipulating puppets, but living people...
zh_text: 练舞室里，三位军师气喘吁吁腰酸背痛，曾经运筹帷幄的他们各执己见，都认为自己的节奏是最完美的。无奈之下，你只得祭出你的“邪修”，让元歌做领舞，用傀儡丝线牵着其他三位军师做动作。望着一脸优雅的元歌，同时操纵这么多根丝线也能临危不乱。只不过，你是不是该提醒他一下尺度？这次操纵的不是傀儡而是活生生的人……

text: While you and Zhuge Liang were checking the situation near the academy, you were surrounded by several village children who were weaving straw hats. They said they had too many hats and might not finish them today, so they wanted to invite you to help and use your popularity as their special selling point. Zhuge Liang looked at you with a smile and asked what you thought.
zh_text: 你与诸葛亮并肩查看学院附近情况时，被几个村民孩子团团围住，他们正在编织草帽，表示草帽太多，今天不一定编的完，想邀请你们帮忙，再利用你们的人气作为他们的特殊卖点，诸葛亮笑盈盈看向你，问你意向如何。

zh_text: 引起了部分学生的抵触情绪。

text:
Looking into the distance, a dark mass of mechanical beings is wandering over Fengyunya, surrounding the Tongtian Tower and the Baiming Port...
You realize that this crisis is hard to solve by force alone. You finally negotiate with the leader of the mechanical beings—

There's no helping it; there are only so many dorms. Even a clever housewife can't cook without rice, and the principal is in a tough spot, so everyone will just have to squeeze in! However, this actually strengthened the friendship between students and made everyone more united.

text: You start chatting with the other party, who is surprised to find that you are a person living in the here and now. Although the speed at which the words appear is nowhere near as fast as in some storybook you imagined, this does not hinder communication between you and the book. Night after night, a thousand and one nights, the person on the other side of the book told you the truth about this world—about the origin of the world, miracles, and a group of heroes protecting the world in secret. Do you want to join them?
zh_text: 你开始和对方聊天，对方惊讶地发现你居然是活在此时此刻的人。虽然字浮现的速度远没有你想象中的某个话本那么快，但是这不妨碍你和书之间的沟通。一夜又一夜，一千零一夜，书那边的人为你讲述了这个世界的真相——关于世界的起源、奇迹、与一群在暗中保护世界的英雄。你要加入他们吗？
source_text: 你开始和对方聊天，对方惊讶地发现你居然是活在此时此刻的人。虽然字浮现的速度远没有你想象中的某个话本那么快，但是这不妨碍你和书之间的沟通。一夜又一夜，一千零一夜，书那边的人为你讲述了这个世界的真相——关于世界的起源、奇迹、与一群在暗中保护世界的英雄。你要加入他们吗？

text: I believe this world needs a hero like me! Inspired by the words in the book, you resolve to take on the mission of protecting the world.
zh_text: 我认为这个世界需要我这个英雄！ 你被书中的话语激发，决心承担守护世界的使命。
source_text: 我认为这个世界需要我这个英雄！ 你被书中的话语激发，决心承担守护世界的使命。

text: After researching for several days, Sun Quan appeared before you with a white jade seal, telling you that this was the legendary seal of the Great Sage of Jixia, representing the highest authority of Jixia Academy, and could even command all the wooden hedge monsters in the academy! Sun Quan presented the seal with both hands, congratulating you on being able to call yourself the Great Sage. Moved to tears, you immediately held the seal high, intending to command the academy's wooden hedge monsters to throw themselves into the vigorous academy construction. When you fled back to the academy, covered in dirt from the wooden hedge monster nest, you immediately ordered a thorough investigation into all the unauthorized books on Jixia's unofficial history, as their influence on young people was immeasurable.
zh_text: 查阅了几天，孙权带着白玉印章出现在你面前，告诉你这可是传说中稷下大贤者的印信，代表着稷下学院的最高权力，甚至可以号令学院的所有木篱怪！孙权双手奉上印信，恭喜你可以称大贤者了。你感动的热泪盈眶，立刻高举印信，打算号令学院的木篱怪投入到轰轰烈烈的学院建设中。当你灰头土脸的从木篱怪巢穴里逃回学院后，当即下令彻查整个稷下写野史的山寨书，这对青少年的影响不可估量。
source_text: 查阅了几天，孙权带着白玉印章出现在你面前，告诉你这可是传说中稷下大贤者的印信，代表着稷下学院的最高权力，甚至可以号令学院的所有木篱怪！孙权双手奉上印信，恭喜你可以称大贤者了。你感动的热泪盈眶，立刻高举印信，打算号令学院的木篱怪投入到轰轰烈烈的学院建设中。当你灰头土脸的从木篱怪巢穴里逃回学院后，当即下令彻查整个稷下写野史的山寨书，这对青少年的影响不可估量。

text: Improve the quality of food in the cafeteria.
The self-heating hot pot is very popular, and the students are paying for it one after another.
zh_text: 自热火锅大受欢迎学子们纷纷掏钱。
source_text: 自热火锅大受欢迎学子们纷纷掏钱。

zh_text: 孙尚香的火炮改造出了事故，她请你赴宴共商对策。
source_text: 孙尚香的火炮改造出了事故，她请你赴宴共商对策。

text: A Storm Dragon King flew out from Dragon Valley, its roar piercing through all of Jixia. The dragon flew to your side and gently nudged you with its head, though you had no idea which one it actually was.
zh_text: 一只风暴龙王从龙旗谷飞出，龙啸声穿透了整个稷下。龙飞到你身边，用头轻轻蹭了蹭你，虽然你并不知道它到底是哪一只。

source_text: 你的学识太深奥对方听得一头雾水。

zh_text: 打听消息 你决定变成萝卜混入其中打探消息。
source_text: 打听消息 你决定变成萝卜混入其中打探消息。

text: Requires a character with high knowledge. You decide to send someone knowledgeable to Dragon Valley.
zh_text: 要求高学识角色 你决定派学识渊博之人前往龙旗谷。
source_text: 要求高学识角色 你决定派学识渊博之人前往龙旗谷。

text: Ambush successful; the enemy is routed in one fell swoop.
zh_text: 伏击成功，敌人被一举击溃。
source_text: 伏击成功，敌人被一举击溃。

text: Power is the very reason for dominance. The academy has become a new academic proving ground. Fortunately, you were elected as the referee by everyone. Although no one listens to you when they get heated in a fight, and you occasionally get hit by stray tomatoes or water bottles, that’s not a bad thing. After all, it gives you a reason to join the fray yourself, doesn't it?
zh_text: 力量，正是称霸的理由。学院俨然成为新的学术试炼场。幸好你被大家推举为裁判，虽然打架上头时没人会听你发言，偶尔你还会被飞过来的番茄或水壶误伤，但这没什么不好。毕竟这给了你亲自下场参战的理由，不是吗？

zh_text: 经过五轮比赛的激烈角逐，万里争鸣比赛圆满结束。到了最终的颁奖日，总冠军将花落谁家？稷下，径山，千窟，谁将笑到最后？

zh_text: 星之队要和圭蝶战队举行球赛，经过投票和推荐，孙膑被选为了守门员。可是他行动不便，只能请你帮忙维护他的假肢，关键时刻还要推着他。

text: Dongfang Jing was indeed excellent enough, but she couldn't speak for all the representatives. With too many titles and mixed expectations, the heads of the various academies felt their own demands weren't truly addressed after listening to her. In the end, the conference had to temporarily add several more representatives, and the budget wasn't saved.
zh_text: 东方镜确实足够优秀，却没能替所有代表发言。头衔太多、期待太杂，各院负责人听完后反而觉得自己的诉求没有被真正照顾。大会最终还是临时增设了好几位代表，预算并没有省下来。
source_text: 东方镜确实足够优秀，却没能替所有代表发言。头衔太多、期待太杂，各院负责人听完后反而觉得自己的诉求没有被真正照顾。大会最终还是临时增设了好几位代表，预算并没有省下来。

text: You accepted the love of the Croak Prince, but the school was flooded with a large number of croaks, and the students complained bitterly.
zh_text: 你接受了咕呱王子的爱意，但学校也因此涌入了大量咕呱，学生们怨声载道，苦不堪言。
source_text: 你接受了咕呱王子的爱意，但学校也因此涌入了大量咕呱，学生们怨声载道，苦不堪言。

source_text: 书上的空白页突然出现了文字……

source_text: 你提出的名字过于深奥，大家面面相觑。

zh_text: 河神摇头：你明明掉的不是金锄头。
source_text: 河神摇头：你明明掉的不是金锄头。

text: You found a stray kitten sister who was separated from her brother, and thinking of Kai, who has always loved cats and is a sister-complex, you sent the kitten to him.
zh_text: 你捡到一只和哥哥走散的流浪的小猫妹妹，想到一向爱猫又妹控的铠，把小猫送了过去。
source_text: 你捡到一只和哥哥走散的流浪的小猫妹妹，想到一向爱猫又妹控的铠，把小猫送了过去。

text: The academy's charm is not enough to attract ideal teachers.
zh_text: 学院魅力还不够没能吸引到理想教师。
source_text: 学院魅力还不够没能吸引到理想教师。

text: You missed the annual meeting grand prize, which was won by a random passerby.
zh_text: 你错过了年会大奖被随机路人抽走。
source_text: 你错过了年会大奖被随机路人抽走。

text: You ask the radishes, and some are won over by your charm, telling you that all the radishes must return to attend the funeral of the former Radish King.
zh_text: 你出声询问萝卜，有的萝卜被你的魅力折服，告诉你所有萝卜都要回去参加先王萝卜的葬礼。
source_text: 你出声询问萝卜，有的萝卜被你的魅力折服，告诉你所有萝卜都要回去参加先王萝卜的葬礼。

text: This book doesn't contain a single coherent sentence; you must compare it with various other books to understand it.
zh_text: 这本书里并没有一句人话，你必须通过各式各样的书籍进行比对才能读懂。
source_text: 这本书里并没有一句人话，你必须通过各式各样的书籍进行比对才能读懂。

text: Countless vicious words came at you from all directions. Faced with everyone's accusations, you, having made no real achievements, were unable to argue and had to hide in your residence, waiting for the storm to pass. When you saw the news that the new principal had taken office, you knew that perhaps it was time for this dream to end.
zh_text: 无数恶毒的言语铺天盖地向你袭来，面对众人的指责，没有做出实绩的你无力与其争辩，只得躲在自己的居所等待风波过去。等你看到了新校长走马上任的消息，你知道，这场梦或许是时候该结束了。
source_text: 无数恶毒的言语铺天盖地向你袭来，面对众人的指责，没有做出实绩的你无力与其争辩，只得躲在自己的居所等待风波过去。等你看到了新校长走马上任的消息，你知道，这场梦或许是时候该结束了。

text: When you hold this sun hat, a flash of inspiration strikes your heart. Why not let the students experience Jixia's farming culture? It can cultivate the students' labor values and improve their comprehensive quality. You decide to lead the students to participate in labor practice activities (farming). No sooner said than done, but as you are about to set off, you may need to be fully prepared.
zh_text: 当你手握着这顶遮阳帽，心头仿佛灵光闪烁，何不让学子们感受稷下农耕文化？既可培养学子们的劳动观念，又可提高学子们的综合素质，你决定带领学子们参与劳动实践活动（务农）。说干就干，就在出发之际，你或许需要做好万全准备。
source_text: 当你手握着这顶遮阳帽，心头仿佛灵光闪烁，何不让学子们感受稷下农耕文化？既可培养学子们的劳动观念，又可提高学子们的综合素质，你决定带领学子们参与劳动实践活动（务农）。说干就干，就在出发之际，你或许需要做好万全准备。

text: Xishi traded the doll for the 'Get Rich Quick' guide, telling you it was actually a summary of her failures.
zh_text: 西施用玩偶换回致富经，告诉你这其实是她的失败总结。
source_text: 西施用玩偶换回致富经，告诉你这其实是她的失败总结。

text: The old method was slow but steady, and no mistakes were made.
zh_text: 老办法虽慢但稳没有出任何纰漏。
source_text: 老办法虽慢但稳没有出任何纰漏。

text: You invested heavily in a desperate gamble, but due to lack of experience, you failed to recruit qualified teachers. With poor facilities, the transformation failed, and the academy's reputation plummeted.
zh_text: 你重金投入孤注一掷，但由于经验不足，没招到符合条件的老师，设备条件简陋，转型失败，学院名声一落千丈。
source_text: 你重金投入孤注一掷，但由于经验不足，没招到符合条件的老师，设备条件简陋，转型失败，学院名声一落千丈。

text: You threw these coins into a pile of Ringild. A few days later, you discovered that the copper outer shell of the coins had disappeared, revealing pure gold coins underneath. You do not recognize the patterns drawn on them, but you can feel a mysterious power.
zh_text: 你把这些钱币丢入了一大堆环金之中，几天之后，你发现钱币的铜质外壳消失了，露出了下方的纯金钱币。你并不认识其上绘制的纹案，但能感受到一股神秘的力量。
source_text: 你把这些钱币丢入了一大堆环金之中，几天之后，你发现钱币的铜质外壳消失了，露出了下方的纯金钱币。你并不认识其上绘制的纹案，但能感受到一股神秘的力量。

text: To help students experience Jixia's agricultural culture, you lead them in farming activities.
zh_text: 为让学子感受稷下农耕文化，你带领大家参与务农。
source_text: 为让学子感受稷下农耕文化，你带领大家参与务农。

text: The seven growing dragons wrestled together, nearly destroying the garden.
zh_text: 七条日渐茁壮的龙扭打在一起，几乎毁了花园。
source_text: 七条日渐茁壮的龙扭打在一起，几乎毁了花园。

text:
Grand Viceroy Zhou Yu lightly adjusts his brocade robe, intending to bring military strategy to the mahjong table. He wanders between three tables. He directs you and the Sun siblings to win several rounds in a row. No matter how tricky the situation, the Viceroy can accurately calculate others' tiles, as if he were personally setting up your winning hands. After a long afternoon of battle, the three of you emerge victorious.
In your joy, you invite Zhou Yu to drink a celebratory toast. Of course, what you are actually drinking is the latest fermented rice-flavored beverage from the Baicao family.
zh_text:
周瑜大都督轻撩锦袍，要把兵法搬上牌桌。他游走在三台麻将桌间。纷纷指挥你和孙家兄妹连胜好几轮，不管多刁钻，大都督都能精准算到别人的牌，就像是他亲自在点你们的炮一样。鏖战一下午，你们三人大获全胜。

text: Buy two fewer to try it out

You have to admit that even in these absurd, dream-like days, you still worry about wealth.
Breaking free from your wandering thoughts, you find yourself at a strange stall. The vendor, wearing glasses, is carefully tending to every little trinket on the table. When he looks up and notices you, he immediately smiles, "Come take a look at these treasures, there must be something you like."
Your eyes scan the table, which is filled with a dazzling array of items, most of which you cannot name.
You observe the objects carefully; they are exquisitely crafted and uniquely shaped, yet there is an indescribable feeling, as if they each have a life of their own and are begging you to take them back with you. Among them, a string of copper coins catches your eye.
"You..." The merchant notices your gaze, and his tone immediately takes on a fanatical tremor, "You want it? You actually want it!"
You want to ask about its origin, but he immediately makes a "shh" gesture, "Those who know, know. I won't answer any questions about it. The only thing you need to think about is whether you want it."
Looking at these copper coins, you fall into deep thought.
zh_text:
你不得不承认，即便是在这荒诞如梦的日子里，你同样会因为财富发愁。
从胡思乱想中挣脱出来，你发觉自己走到了一个陌生的摊位前，摊主戴着眼镜，仔细地打理着桌上的每一个小玩意。当他抬起头注意到你，立刻露出笑容，"来看看这些宝贝，一定有你喜欢的。"
你的眼神扫过桌面，其上摆放的物品琳琅满目，可绝大多数你都叫不出名字。
你仔细观察着其中的物件，做工精美，造型别致，却有种说不出的感觉，仿佛他们各有生命，正在请求你将它们带回你的身边。而其中，一串铜钱，紧紧抓住了你的眼睛。
"你……"商人注意到你的眼神，他的语气立刻附上一层狂热的颤抖，"你要它？你居然想要它！"
你想要询问它的来历，他却立刻比出一个"嘘"的手势，"懂得都懂，我不会回答任何有关它的问题，你唯一要思考的，就是你是否想要它。"
看着这些铜钱，你陷入了沉思。

text:
Welcome to Linglong Canyon, troops, advance! The contestants from each academy in this competition have their own strengths and are evenly matched. Jing Shan students are particularly skilled in strategy and are said to have ten sets of tactics ready. Qian Ku students are disciples of Galo, with particularly outstanding marksmen. Jixia students have the home-field advantage and have also learned the secrets of teamwork from the Star Team.
The three teams of students faced off against each other. The Jixia students had good momentum, winning their first match against Jing Shan! But they were suppressed by the marksmen in the match against Qian Ku and failed to win. In the match between Qian Ku and Jing Shan, the Jing Shan students eventually staged a comeback. The competition ended in a three-way tie!
zh_text:
欢迎来到玲珑峡谷，全军出击！本届比赛各院选手各有所长，实力相当。径山学子尤其擅长谋略，据说已经准备好十套战术。千窟学子师承伽罗，射手位尤其突出。稷下学子具有主场优势，还向星之队学习了团队配合的秘诀。
三队学子两两对决。稷下学子势头不错，与径山的比赛首战告捷！但与千窟学子比赛时遭遇射手压制，未能获胜。千窟与径山的比赛，最终被径山学子逆风翻盘。本次比赛三方战至平局！

text:
But, what does this have to do with me? The Jixia student took out a phantom prop and transformed into a small Wood-Fence.
Since we are all small Wood-Fences, why make things difficult for a small Wood-Fence like me? Students from other academies were shocked by the Jixia student's nonchalance and forgot to discuss for a moment. The cloud ship whizzed past, crushing the small Wood-Fence. Fortunately, it was just a wooden model, and no small Wood-Fence was harmed in the process.
But the Jixia student's "spectacular" performance became famous throughout the Honor of Kings continent.
zh_text:
可是，这跟我又有什么关系呢？稷下学子掏出幻身道具，变身成小木篱。
同样都是小木篱，为何要为难我一个小木篱。其他学院的学子们震惊于稷下学子的漫不经心，一时忘记了讨论。云舟呼啸而过，碾过小木篱，幸好只是木头做的模型，过程中没有小木篱受到伤害。
但稷下学子的“精彩”表现，在王者大陆出了名。

text:
Speed is the essence of war; the crusade against the Wood Fence Monsters should be light and swift! You selected six legendary pairs of boots for Mulan—Swift, Calm, Enduring, Resistant, Arcane, and Rapid—hoping to significantly boost her movement speed.
Watching Mulan dash away faster than an arrow released from a bow, it is hard to imagine what an indescribable existence she will be in the eyes of those Wood Fence Monsters.
zh_text:

text:
Dressed in idol clothes, with her staff replaced by a microphone, Zhaojun is going to bring the sweetest smile to everyone!
As the lead singer for the "Summer Hedge Music Festival," on the day of the performance, the boys and girls of the academy heard Zhaojun's name and packed the venue. Looking at the uncontrollable smiles on everyone's faces, you thought that if her singing could spread beyond Jixia, those smiles would spread across the whole world.
To this end, you contacted the Craftsmen and the Automaton Academy to record Zhaojun's singing onto records. Soon, the heavenly voice of the idol singer will spread far and wide.
zh_text:
穿上了偶像的衣服，法杖换成麦克风，昭君要为大家带来最甜美的笑容！

text: First completion of Novar · Fourth Academy

text: Thanks to your care, the students' psychological issues have been effectively alleviated, and immature choices made under environmental or academic pressure have been timely avoided. Seeing the smiles return to their faces, you can't help but whisper—this is truly wonderful.
zh_text: 在你的重视之下，学子们的心理问题得到有效缓解，一些迫于环境压力、学术压力等各类问题所做出的不成熟的选择被及时规避。你看着学子们重新绽放在脸上的笑容，不由得低喃一声——这样真好。
source_text: 在你的重视之下，学子们的心理问题得到有效缓解，一些迫于环境压力、学术压力等各类问题所做出的不成熟的选择被及时规避。你看着学子们重新绽放在脸上的笑容，不由得低喃一声——这样真好。

text: Accept: You decide to accept Prince Gugu's marriage proposal.
zh_text: 接受 你决定接受咕呱王子的求婚。
source_text: 接受 你决定接受咕呱王子的求婚。

text: A mascot for Xishi's business, a round-faced doll said to bring financial luck.
zh_text: 西施商道上的吉祥物，一只圆脸布偶，据说能带来财运。
source_text: 西施商道上的吉祥物，一只圆脸布偶，据说能带来财运。

text: Renovation is a complex task, and despite spending way over budget, the results were mediocre. Let's treat this as a learning experience. Fortunately, it was completed before the start of the semester, so normal teaching was not disrupted.
zh_text: 千头万绪装修难，效果平平还花超了不少，这次就当是积累经验吸取教训了。好在赶在开学前顺利完工，没有耽误正常教学秩序。
source_text: 千头万绪装修难，效果平平还花超了不少，这次就当是积累经验吸取教训了。好在赶在开学前顺利完工，没有耽误正常教学秩序。

text: You successfully got these books at a low price.
zh_text: 你成功用低价拿到了这些书。
source_text: 你成功用低价拿到了这些书。

text: Since taking over as headmaster, you have had to handle not only the academy's internal affairs but also letters from the outside world.
zh_text: 接任校长以来，除了学院内部的大事小情，就连外界发来的信件，也要你一并处理。
source_text: 接任校长以来，除了学院内部的大事小情，就连外界发来的信件，也要你一并处理。

text: The reform met with resistance and opposition from veteran teachers.
zh_text: 改革遇到了老教师的阻力和抵触。
source_text: 改革遇到了老教师的阻力和抵触。

text: The Gate-Breaker challenge failed, and the Academy suffered a defeat in the final battle.
zh_text: 破门生挑战失败，学院在临门一战中折戟。
source_text: 破门生挑战失败，学院在临门一战中折戟。

text:
The smartest minds, the ultimate creativity! Zhuge Liang, Zhou Yu, Sima Yi, and Yuan Ge , the "Jixia F4," reunite to bring everyone the strongest group on the continent—the "Brocade Bag Band"! And you, the wisest Dean of Jixia, naturally became their manager!
You heard that the other three strategists seem to intend to let Senior Yuan Ge be the lead singer, and for a moment you didn't know if they were joking or serious. However, adhering to the principle of teaching students according to their aptitude, you chose to let him be the "dance lead" of the Brocade Bag Band. Thinking of your own "embarrassed" appearance when you were tested by the mechanical puppet, surely Senior Yuan Ge can use his unique aesthetics to design a dance that blows up the whole scene... right!
zh_text:
最聪明的头脑，最极致的创意！诸葛亮、周瑜、司马懿、元歌“稷下F4”强势再聚首，为大家带来大陆最强组合——“锦囊乐队”！而你，稷下最睿智的校长，自然而然成为了他们的经纪人！
你听说其他三位军师似乎有意让元歌学长担任主唱，你一时不知道他们是在开玩笑还是认真的。不过秉承因材施教的原则，你选择让他担任锦囊乐队的“舞蹈担当”。想到当时被机关傀儡考验时自己的“狼狈”模样，想必元歌学长一定可以用他独特的美学，设计出炸翻全场的舞蹈……吧！
source_text:

text: You watch his slow punch, feel the gentle force like a caress, and then pin him to the ground with a backhand. You call over a student from the Hundred Herbs family, and after an examination, it is discovered that he indeed has some mental issues. The students watching the match spread the news of your heroic performance throughout the academy.
zh_text: 你注视着他缓慢的来拳，感受着如同抚摸一样的温和力道，接着反手把他按在地上。你叫来了百草家的同学，经过检查，发现他的精神确实有些问题，而观战的学子们，则将你的英勇表现传遍了学院。
source_text: 你注视着他缓慢的来拳，感受着如同抚摸一样的温和力道，接着反手把他按在地上。你叫来了百草家的同学，经过检查，发现他的精神确实有些问题，而观战的学子们，则将你的英勇表现传遍了学院。

text: Just as the weapon was about to strike the Cloud Silkworm, a golden light dispelled all the darkness.
zh_text: 武器即将攻击到云蚕时，金色的光驱散了一切黑暗。
source_text: 武器即将攻击到云蚕时，金色的光驱散了一切黑暗。

text:
Today is library organization day. You arrived at the archives as scheduled and happened to meet Sun Quan , who was looking up ancient books on the Three Kingdoms. He naturally joined you in organizing.
Just as you were cleaning a corner, an old treasure chest caught your attention. Sun Quan opened the box, and inside lay a seal carved from white jade. Out of curiosity, you leaned in. Sun Quan didn't know what it was and planned to go back and check the ancient books to study it.
zh_text:
今天是图书馆整理日，你如期来到了藏书室，恰好在这里遇到了正在查阅三分之地古籍的孙权，他很自然的加入了你一起整理。
就在你们清扫角落的时候，一个破旧的宝箱引起了你们的注意。孙权打开盒子，里面赫然躺着一块白玉雕成的印章。出于好奇，你也凑了过去。孙权不知道这是什么，打算回去再看看古籍，研究一下。
source_text:

text: Persuade to stop fighting: You decide to patiently persuade the little dragons to stop fighting.
zh_text: 劝说停止争斗 你决定耐心劝说小龙们停止争斗。
source_text: 劝说停止争斗 你决定耐心劝说小龙们停止争斗。

text: After managing the academy many times, the administration has become increasingly proficient.
zh_text: 多次治院之后，院务推进开始愈发熟练
source_text: 多次治院之后，院务推进开始愈发熟练

text: A strange fog is drifting from the direction of Dragon Banner Valley; you lead a team to investigate.
zh_text: 龙旗谷方向飘来奇怪的雾，你带人前往探查。
source_text: 龙旗谷方向飘来奇怪的雾，你带人前往探查。

text: First completion: Sun Quan - The Great Sage
zh_text: 首次完成孙权·可以称大贤者了
source_text: 首次完成孙权·可以称大贤者了

text:
As the dignified Principal of Jixia, why would you need help from others? Ignoring Zhou Yu's kindness, you sat down at the card table yourself.
Before long, cheers and applause erupted from the Sun siblings' side of the table. Only you were left scratching your head amidst the sound of constant losses. At this moment, Zhou Yu, having finished guiding the siblings, put aside past grievances and came over to offer you advice. Finally, you won your first game of the day!
zh_text:
堂堂稷下校长，怎还需要他人帮忙？你不顾周瑜的好意，自己就坐上了牌桌。
不出一会儿，孙家兄妹的桌上纷纷传来喝彩和欢呼的声音。只有你，在一轮轮的点炮声中抓耳挠腮。这时指导完兄妹俩的周瑜不计前嫌，走过来主动替你出谋划策。终于，你赢下了今天第一把！
source_text:

text: Failure is the mother of success. Perhaps you will succeed next time?
zh_text: 失败乃成功之母，或许下一次可以成功呢？
source_text: 失败乃成功之母，或许下一次可以成功呢？

text: You leap into the water, but because you are a poor swimmer, you begin to drown. You try to call for help, but water enters your nasal cavity, and a feeling of suffocation washes over you. Ultimately, you have no strength left to save the Guga and can only save yourself by crawling ashore.
zh_text: 你跃入水中，但由于水性不佳溺水，你想大声呼救，水呛入你的鼻腔中，窒息感扑面而来，最终你再也没有力气救咕呱，只能自救爬上岸来。
source_text: 你跃入水中，但由于水性不佳溺水，你想大声呼救，水呛入你的鼻腔中，窒息感扑面而来，最终你再也没有力气救咕呱，只能自救爬上岸来。

text:
Another return without success...
You pretend to be calm on the surface, but inside you are praying over and over again that this will not evolve into a worse situation. After they leave the academy, you spend every day in anxiety, until news comes from afar—"Jixia Academy is not what it claims to be, its academic level is a mess, and the principal tried to corrupt people's hearts with habitual tactics"...
Seeing this, your hanging heart finally slowly settles...
zh_text:
又一次的无功而返......
你表面装作平静,内心却在一遍又一遍地祈求着这一切不要演变为更为糟糕的事态。等他们离开学院之后,每一天你都在忐忑中度过,直到远方传来消息--"稷下学院名不副实,学术水平一塌糊涂,院长试图以惯用手法腐化人心"......
看到这里,你那颗悬着的心终于缓缓落下......

text: A poem, a bucket of wine, a long song, a sword to the ends of the earth.

source_text: 一篇诗，一斗酒，一曲长歌，一剑天涯。

text: On a deep night when you finally understood, new text suddenly appeared on the last few blank pages of your book.
zh_text: 某一个你终于读懂的深夜，在你书卷的最后几页白纸上，忽然出现了新的文字。
source_text: 某一个你终于读懂的深夜，在你书卷的最后几页白纸上，忽然出现了新的文字。

text: The name you proposed contains profound scholarship, and everyone agreed unanimously.
zh_text: 你提出的名字蕴含深厚学养，大家一致认可。
source_text: 你提出的名字蕴含深厚学养，大家一致认可。

text: Encountered a storm on the road that delayed the trip.
zh_text: 路上遇到了风暴耽误了行程。
source_text: 路上遇到了风暴耽误了行程。

text: In the dance studio, the four strategists were panting and sore. Once masters of strategy, they each held their own opinions, all believing their rhythm was the most perfect. To settle the argument, you decided to join in yourself! But years of desk work as Dean have left your body noticeably uncoordinated. Helpless, you had to ask Yuan Ge to attach puppet strings to you and dance with you. However, shouldn't you remind him about the boundaries? This time, he's not manipulating puppets, but living people... Afterwards, go find Dr. Lengchun for some bruise medicine.
zh_text: 练舞室里，四位军师气喘吁吁腰酸背痛，曾经运筹帷幄的他们各执己见，都认为自己的节奏是最完美的。为了平息争论，你打算亲自上阵！可常年伏案的校长工作让你身体也出现了明显的不协调。无奈，你只好请元歌为你装上傀儡丝线，带着你一起跳。只不过，你是不是该提醒他一下尺度？这次操纵的不是傀儡而是活生生的人……事后，再去找冷春医生拿点跌打药吧。
source_text: 练舞室里，四位军师气喘吁吁腰酸背痛，曾经运筹帷幄的他们各执己见，都认为自己的节奏是最完美的。为了平息争论，你打算亲自上阵！可常年伏案的校长工作让你身体也出现了明显的不协调。无奈，你只好请元歌为你装上傀儡丝线，带着你一起跳。只不过，你是不是该提醒他一下尺度？这次操纵的不是傀儡而是活生生的人……事后，再去找冷春医生拿点跌打药吧。

zh_text: 魅力检定 你决定用感召力来为组织命名。

zh_text: 大环金 你决定投入大量环金全面提升食堂质量。
source_text: 大环金 你决定投入大量环金全面提升食堂质量。

text: You continue to sponsor, but the farmland experiments are progressing slowly.
zh_text: 你继续赞助，但农田实验进展缓慢。
source_text: 你继续赞助，但农田实验进展缓慢。

text: Zhaojun accidentally froze you into an ice sculpture, but you seem to have a new idea: you plan to have Zhaojun create a whole set of statues.
zh_text: 昭君不小心把你冻成了冰雕，可是你似乎有了一个新主意，打算让昭君做出一整套雕像。
source_text: 昭君不小心把你冻成了冰雕，可是你似乎有了一个新主意，打算让昭君做出一整套雕像。

text:
The students of Jingshan Academy and the young students of Qianku City made a brilliant appearance. Under your leadership, can Jixia Academy win the Wanli Contention Competition?
However, who decides the exam questions for this competition? According to convention, each headmaster can propose exam questions, which are then voted on by everyone.
A thought arose in your mind: for students, the five comprehensive qualities of "Benevolence, Wisdom, Art, Physicality, and Skill" are indispensable. You decide to make a proposal based on this.
How can you persuade everyone to pass your proposal?
zh_text:
径山书院的学子、千窟城的年轻学子们闪亮登场。在你的带领下，稷下学院能否在此次万里争鸣竞赛中夺冠？
不过，本次大赛的考题是谁来决定？按惯例，各位校长可以提出考题提案，由众人表决。
冥冥之中有个念头在你脑海升起，对于学子们来说，“仁智艺体技”五项综合素养缺一不可。你决定以此做出提案。
要通过怎样的方式说服大家通过你的提案呢？

zh_text: 自热火锅的创意并未受到学子们欢迎，毕竟大家还是更偏向新鲜美味的食物，特别是当你公开宣称这可是新鲜制作的，彻底让生意陷入谷底。
source_text: 自热火锅的创意并未受到学子们欢迎，毕竟大家还是更偏向新鲜美味的食物，特别是当你公开宣称这可是新鲜制作的，彻底让生意陷入谷底。

text: Unnoticed, the students' eyes grew dim, and the various schools of thought saw fewer and fewer visitors. The academy's vitality quietly dissolved like snow after the start of spring. The academic achievements made by the students under academic pressure remained dazzling, but you would occasionally think while reviewing documents in the headmaster's office, "Is all this really worth it?"
zh_text: 不觉间，学院学子们目光灰暗，一众百家也门可罗雀，学院的生命力像是入春后的积雪一般悄然消融。学院学子们迫于学术压力所做的各项学术成果依旧耀眼夺目，不过你偶尔会在校长室审阅文件时想到，这一切真的值得吗？

text:
The value of the Divine Strategist continues to rise; waving a fan, he is a famous general, and picking up a mic, he is a singing king. Zhuge Liang's silver-tongued words were like silver spears; the Gate-Breakers were no match, surrendered one after another, left in disgrace, and had no face to show off anymore.
From then on, there was another underground legend about Senior Zhuge in the Academy...

从此，学院里又多了一条关于诸葛学长的地下传说……
