text: Protagonist's Charisma attribute is greater than 15
Academic Achievement: You decide to make academic achievement your core educational policy.
zh_text: 学术造诣 你决定以学术造诣为核心教育方针。
source_text: 学术造诣 你决定以学术造诣为核心教育方针。

text:
To support your career as a principal, the Gugu Prince gives an order for all Gugus to join your academy, declaring that his people must be pampered. Now everything is in chaos.
Many Gugu workstations have completely shut down, and many people seeking help have crowded into your office. Looking at the proud Gugu Prince, you...
zh_text:
咕呱王子为了支持你的校长事业，一声令下号令所有咕呱加入你的学院，扬言他的人必须狠狠宠，这下可乱了套。
许多咕呱工作的岗位彻底停摆，许多求助者挤进了你的办公室，你看着一脸骄傲的咕呱王子，你……
source_text:
咕呱王子为了支持你的校长事业，一声令下号令所有咕呱加入你的学院，扬言他的人必须狠狠宠，这下可乱了套。
许多咕呱工作的岗位彻底停摆，许多求助者挤进了你的办公室，你看着一脸骄傲的咕呱王子，你……

text: You look for a long time and finally conclude that these are just ordinary copper coins. You sigh and curse the stall owner in your heart.
zh_text: 你看了半天终于得出结论，这就是一批普通的铜钱，你叹了口气，同时在心里狠狠骂了摊主几句。
source_text: 你看了半天终于得出结论，这就是一批普通的铜钱，你叹了口气，同时在心里狠狠骂了摊主几句。

text: You try to mediate, but the little dragons just make more of a scene.
zh_text: 你试图调解但小龙们闹得更凶了。
source_text: 你试图调解但小龙们闹得更凶了。

text: The Sanctified's trial was recently discovered near Littoral Cave. Many explorers tried to uncover its secrets, but all returned empty-handed after being driven off by a terrifying Bronze Fish with a massive mouth.
Obtain after unlocking the Battle Pass
Push stone walls with ancient carvings to reveal hidden secrets behind them.
Some stones can be broken if you heat them and then cool them quickly.
Sorcery is about reading Flow and harnessing its power.
Once a princess in a political marriage, she is now the ice goddess of the Northlands, keeping peace with her strength and kindness.
Mechcraft uses different types of energy to power all kinds of creations.
Wild beasts roam the wilderness. Most are fierce predators and may see humans as prey.
Aerweavers turn Aerflow into Aersilk, a key material for building Mechcraft creations and bringing Mech Cores into operation.
Some Jixia vegetables look common but are actually much more aggressive.
Learning through practice. Students design Mechcraft creations that control Aerflow. Mozi is the Headmaster.
Some creatures in Dreamscape have mutated and become more dangerous.
Sorcery brought many ritual items to life, but an accident made them lose control and turn aggressive.
A Team of Stars member from the School of Martial Arts, General Meng Tian's son, Meng Ya has a fiery temper and loves cannons.
By connecting with the Flow of other Heroes, you can copy their special abilities.
A Team of Stars member from the School of Sorcery, Shye is a clever treasure hunter who has stepped out of her hardships.
The Enlightenment Trials assign contestants three random trials during the Grand Ceremony.
Dream Rifts show illusions from lingering obsessions. They can carry you far away or pull you into another dream in Oneirland.
Completing the final battle in Unrealm unlocks an extra choice chest. Don't forget to open it!
People with a talent for Sorcery can see visions in dreams by reading butterfly marks.
Draconic runes were imprinted on the Dragonriders, allowing them to use the dragons' power.
Use certain skills on enemies that are using Red-Glowing special skills to make them Pass Out.
The Glider created by the Bracer lets you descend safely from high places.
Captain of the Team of Stars, Novar is a passionate swordsman from the School of Martial Arts. He has his Star Power and the dream of heroism.
Flow is the basic building block of all life and the source of all power. Each person's Flow is unique.
Merchants from Chang'an, Navenia, and Alsahraa come to Jixia to trade goods and share information.
Metamorph Mystide: Novar - Echo of Cloudeater
The Team of Stars—Captain Novar, Shye, Meng Ya, Sun Bin, and Luban—won the last Enlightenment Trials. Now, you've joined them.
Aerux is condensed Aerflow, which forms root-like structures underground. It sometimes breaks through the surface.
Saepes are smart plants found all over Jixia. They form tribes that are led by their large members.
Team of Stars built Star No. 7 with love to revive Luban's most cherished creation.
The academy creates Mechanoids for training and patrol. It is said that they are inspired by those in the bronze ruins.
Collect Aerpower Chips from Aersilk Pickers in Jixia Mountains to power Mechcraft facilities or exchange them for rewards.
Dreamslayers hunt those who enter Dreamscape. \nLegend says they are lost, bird-like youth.
Jixia's top contest, the Enlightenment Trials, has teams of five compete for a chance to meet the Aercocoon in person.
Those with Ziya's Imprint gain a big boost in power.
A Team of Stars member from the School of Mechcraft, Luban created Luban No. 7. Although he seems aloof, he is truly passionate about Mechcraft.
Press Dash to dodge an incoming strike with perfect timing and enhance the next Basic Attack shortly after.
Trusted by students and faculty, the student-run Student Affairs Committee handles academic and daily matters.
Menki are Dreamrealm creatures that feed on Dream Butterflies. They look clumsy yet nimble.
The Aercocoon strengthens Flow to create Aerflow, which nourishes Jixia's land and supports farming.
Attacking a Passed Out enemy can knock them out again and deal extra damage.
Woven from Aerflow using Aerweavers, Aersilk is used for Mechcraft creations and everyday tools due to its versatility.
Some ores crack if heated and then quickly cooled; force alone won't break them.
Attacks charge the Ultimate when they hit.
Deal enough damage to the enemy with Stance Broken to unlock Stance Broken Execution.
Crafters created the Aero Irrigator for automatic watering. Use your Grappler to attach underneath for a scenic ride.
By following the Sorcery rules, Sorcery Runes create Sorcery Circles that cast various effects.
Yango, a genius puppeteer and Mechcraft graduate, lost his voice as a child and now speaks through his Mechanoid Puppet.
Each Wonder, left by ancient deities, holds unique powers that shape nature and civilization.
Aersilk ziplines help students travel between schools and cross mountains quickly.
The renowned academy attracts students from all over Primaera. Guided by the Three Sages, they are encouraged to seek truth in their own way.
Kongming, a legendary Jixia graduate and brilliant strategist, is on a lifelong quest for knowledge.
Step across the invisible tiles to reach the destination. \n \nThe wheat scent on the wind will show you the way.
Zhuangzi, head of the School of Sorcery, is a dream master. Despite being drowsy and cryptic, his advice always guides students.
Some enemies may enter Defense before launching a powerful attack. Deal enough damage to interrupt them and cause Defense Broken.
Attacks deplete an enemy's Stance Bar. \nWhen the bar is depleted, the enemy's Stance breaks and takes more damage.
Heir of Madinat Erudit, she travels with her bow to recover lost books and rebuild her home.
Used to power Mechcraft creations, Mech Cores have special designs for storing Flow, showing advanced technology.
Creates a Sorcery Circle that pulls in enemies and Orbs, then deals damage.
The devoted young follower of Ziya is proudly seeking Staff of Sanctification in Jixia.
Some enemies expose weak points during battle. Strike those spots to cause Weakness Broken.

Thieves are after the Littoral Spirit Drive hidden in the ship's core. If it's stolen or damaged, the whole ship could become unstable and everyone would be in danger. Only the bravest and most skilled can enter the deadly core and restore its stability.
Obtained via Profound Crystal Spirit Encounter
Complete Routine quests to earn Bracer EXP and level up your Bracer.
Dragons are legendary beings that control the weather and can shape-shift. Some say they still exist in Jixia.
Different Vitality Trials drop different upgrade materials.
In Jixia, the three schools fiercely compete. Most students play fair, but watch out—some people are secretly plotting.
Clash-type Flow Styles have skills that can Parry or Negate attacks, allowing you to interrupt enemies' special skills.
Treasure Probes guide you to the locations of hidden treasure chests.
Earn Dream Butterflies based on your highest challenge progress to unlock area rewards.
Strange noises have been heard coming from deep in the Underhall. Some students think Mechcraft devices might be causing them. Go for a careful investigation to find out what's happening.
Power Rankings at the center of the Enlightenment Plaza are the top concern for Jixia students.
Everyone's path to seeking the truth is unique. In addition to joining one of the three schools, students can also join one or more Societies.
A highly dangerous object in the Forbidden Chamber has gone out of control. Begin containment procedures immediately. Only authorized students may participate. Proceed with extreme caution.
Some youths leave or are expelled from the academy for rebelling against its rules, causing ongoing trouble.
The Aership travels between Jixia Academy and the towns at the foot of the mountains, offering a scenic view from above.
Flow is the basic building block of all life and the source of all power. Each person's Flow is unique.
To learn a new Flow Style, the guide on the Flow Style screen is a great place to start.
Aerpower Chips found on Aersilk Pickers can activate Dashing Wings, Barrier Domes, and Zipline.
The remnants of dreams can be traded for rare items.
Anglers love fishing and know a lot about the habits of aquatic creatures. Everyone envies their relaxed lifestyle.
Obtained via Crystal Amber Spirit Encounter
Neglected arms can be dangerous. Cannoneers love refining their cannons as well as designing fireworks.
Bathing in springs mixed with Aersilk leaves you refreshed, rested, and full of energy.
Puppeteers craft lifelike wooden figures. As Jixia's most mysterious group, they seldom show up in person.
The ancient inscription holds clues to a hidden location. Follow the clues and use your Bracer to sense the hidden chest.
Multiple hits in a very short time count as 1 Hit.
Use Aerflow Valves to guide the Aerflow from its containers to the endpoints.
Feralis means all non-humans. Jixia Academy welcomes everyone, treating feralis and humans as equals.
Floating mineral particles in the Underhall hold the same ancient energy as Volcanic Stone.
Basic Attacks and skills charge Flow Execution when they hit. When energy is full, you can perform Flow Execution on the target.

Astrologers have detected a rare astral event that only happens once every hundred years. They need someone to activate the Chrono Teller so they can study the powerful Sorcery energy contained in the stars.
Fuzi, founder of the academy and head of the School of Martial Arts, is a strict teacher as well as a happy old man who enjoys time with students.
Skill is admired when it helps others. Crafters use raw materials to make tools, focusing on public service.
Ziya learned how to reshape Flow from ancient Sorcery. His Imprint can strengthen both living creatures and objects.
Go to the Shop to redeem with Crystal Amber
Control the Flow to connect with Heroes and copy their special abilities.
The academy uses Mechanoids with special designs for different tasks.
Most Flow Styles' Ultimates and other powerful skills can also interrupt enemies' special skills.

Desolate Woodland is always filled with rustling at night. A student said Saepes gathered in a circle, their branches swaying as if chanting a spell, then scattered when a flame came near. What are these little creatures plotting?
A Seeker is paying high prices for inscriptions found on broken stone tablets. Restore the tablets and copy the inscriptions!
Lychill heals students in Jixia Academy. With a mysterious past, she is charming, strong-willed, and skilled in making potions.

Near the Dreamy Grotto, a silent spatial rift has opened beneath the trees' shifting shadows. Monster whispers fill the night. To learn the truth, you must enter the rift—a strange, broken world. Whose forgotten dream does this place belong to?
Time is limited. Pick up blue timepieces on the track to extend the countdown.
Hunters in the wild learn nature from wild beasts and protect Jixia's ecology.
After using an Ultimate, switch to the standby Flow Style to use its Chain Skill.
Martial Arts training involves guiding Flow through your breath and strengthening your body.
The Wonder in Jixia, the Aercocoon strengthens Flow to create Aerflow, which nourishes Jixia's land and supports farming.
Some Martial Arts experts from the academy or elsewhere open Training Halls where they offer practice spaces for disciples.
Enter Mistveil Entanglement. In this state, your Basic Attacks can bounce and heal allies. \nYour next 2 casts of Mistveil Orb each launch 3 Orbs and deal increased damage.
If your Gear Rating is higher than your enemy's, your Flow Style will deal more damage. \nIf your Gear Rating is lower, your Flow Style will deal less damage and take more damage.
The eldest son of a Navenian clan, Kaizer inherited the Demonic Armor Power. But to escape the curse, he became a Great Wall Guard.
Some Mighty Foes have prerequisites, which you can view on the map.

Ride your Aerrider and race to the finish line. \n \nThe ancient wheat seeds are fragile and wither quickly. Beat the clock, break through the ruins, protect the harvest's spark, and reach the other side.
A Team of Stars member from the School of Mechcraft, Sun Bin is shy but determined, and has the power to manipulate time.
Each run in Dreamwalk Odyssey has different challenges that grant extra time.
Train body and mind through Martial Arts. Students temper their spirits and train their bodies. Fuzi is the Headmaster.
Each run in Dreamwalk Odyssey has different Perks. Check the descriptions at the entrance if you're struggling.
Mozi, head of the School of Mechcraft, built Jixia Academy and the city of Chang'an. He seeks peace through his Mechcraft skills.
Dream Envoys from the Dreamrealm are prophets among Dreamweavers. The Finedream and Nightmare Envoys keep the Dreamrealm balanced.
Use the Bracer to sense Flow changes, track footprints, and follow scents nearby.
Astrologers can see glimpses of the future, but cannot change fate.
Kongming set up a series of challenges for Zhou Yu, which included jumping between platforms and battling giant Mechanoids.
Each Wonder, left by ancient deities, holds unique powers that shape nature and civilization.
The Aerwatch is a group of elite guards led by Master Fuzi. They handle monster threats and choose the best students from the three schools.
Fans of outstanding students form a group to support and admire their idols.
Some Elite enemies can be enhanced with Origin Cores after they're defeated to unlock Awakening Challenges.
Some Elite enemies can be enhanced with Origin Cores after they're defeated to unlock Awakening Challenges.
The Dreamrealm is a shifting world that connects dreams and reality.
Traders use math skills to manage Jixia's economy. Ringild flows with each abacus click.
The Grappler created by the Bracer helps you move fast and cross tough terrain.
Everything that happens leaves traces. The Bracer can use Flow to recreate past events.
Dreamweavers are wise Dreamrealm beings who feed on Dream Energy and shape dreams.
Enforcer Ziya, wielding the power of Sanctification, co-founded the academy with Fuzi but left over differences. Now he is unsealed.
Unlock massive rewards like Resonance and Transfiguration
Pass over blue boost pads on the track for a burst of speed.
Dream energy is a rare type of Flow characterized by butterfly marks. It is risky, and only a few, like Master Zhuangzi, have mastered it.
The Three Sages set entrance exams with help from teachers and alumni. Students can also enroll via a special exam using seniors' credits.
Obtained via Profound Crystal Spirit Encounter
Strange noises have been heard coming from deep in the Underhall. Some students think Mechcraft devices might be causing them. Go for a careful investigation to find out what's happening.
Spending Vitality once unlocks all challenge chests in Valorquest.

To thank the students for their help, the villagers hold a festival with traditional activities like a bonfire, drumming, and planting new crops. But a giant radish suddenly burst out of the ground and began ruining the party. We need to stop it!
The Gear Index lets you browse all gear, filter by Perks, and see how to obtain them.
The Sorcery-inscribed totems are made to control dreams, stabilizing the Dreamrealm and stopping its spread.
Dream Butterflies are Dream Energy manifestations, found only in the Dreamrealm where Dream Energy is rich.
Obtained via Profound Crystal Spirit Encounter
Gourmets are known for their refined taste, creative recipes, and unique use of ingredients.
Some enemies have breakable parts. Break these parts to increase the damage they take.

The Sanctified's trial was recently discovered near Littoral Cave. Many explorers tried to uncover its secrets, but all returned empty-handed after being driven off by a terrifying Bronze Fish with a massive mouth.
After a Follow-up Skill hits or a Perfect Dodge, your next Basic Attack is enhanced into Quietus Blow, which greatly charges Flow Execution.
Switch in a Flow Style from Standby.
Some enemies have Sorcery Shields that absorb damage and prevent Stance depletion. Break the shield with attacks to interrupt the enemy.
Mechcraft creations appear randomly in Scourges. Use them to your advantage.
Obtained via Crystal Amber Spirit Encounter
The Tower of Enlightenment hosts Jixia Academy's classes, ceremonies, and administration.
Reach the finish line before time runs out. \n \nAs the skies shift and the old crops fail, explore the ruins to recover the ancient wheat seeds and restore life to the fields.
Higher World Level unlocks new content and better drops, but also makes enemies tougher.
Heroic leader of the Great Wall Guards, Mulan welcomes all and builds a home for her companions at the Great Wall.
Your fate brings you to the legends of this land. Find relics, uncover stories, and discover secrets of the past.
The Bracer, given by a mysterious girl, resonates with the Wonder and Flow to unlock different powers.
Bronze Mechanoids guard ruins with weapons, staying loyal to their duty through the ages.
The woman you meet by Pearlized Lake silently observes what is happening, her gentle eyes seeming that she knows everything.
The School of Mechcraft uses three huge Aerweavers to make Aersilk for Mechcraft creations.
The truth is what you make of it.
Powered by Aerpower Chips, Dashing Wings let you leap and climb mountains freely.
Fuzi, Zhuangzi, and Mozi are the Three Sages who rebuilt Jixia Academy as its headmasters.
Focuses on things' essence. Students study Sorcery and learn nature's laws from the Wonder. Zhuangzi is the Headmaster.
Eight ancient trial pillars stand in East Aerfall Highlands. Each requires the restoration of three bronze spheres.
Captain Novar led the Team of Stars—Shye, Meng Ya, Sun Bin, Luban—to win the last Enlightenment Trials.
Seekers are expert treasure hunters and archaeologists, searching Jixia for lost history and secrets.
Herbalists are plant experts and Jixia's top authorities on botany and healing.
Reach the finish line before time runs out. \n \nAs the skies shift and the old crops fail, explore the ruins to recover the ancient wheat seeds and restore life to the fields.
Lush bushes make great hiding spots.
Music soothes the soul. Musicians pursue their art with relentless dedication. Their melodies resonate with passion and longing.
As the name suggests, Intelligencers work in intelligence. They are also skilled speakers and persuaders.
Luban's latest creation turns Foxtail Wheat into Harvest Brew. Control heat and water for the best flavor.
The Illusive Realm was formed by unstable Dream Energy, which constantly harms creatures inside. You need Lucid Herbs and Dream Wood to stay awake there.
Dry vines that have grown for years are incredibly tough. Use fire to burn them away.
The Secrets Club was formed by the Intelligencers to uncover Jixia's hidden legends, treasures, and unknown history.
Step forward bravely—the invisible path may appear. Watch your step and remember the paths you've taken.
The Sentinels are a select group of the Sanctified who passed the trials. They are immortal but forever bound by the Sorcery Circles.

Practice to understand all things.\nStudents study mechanics here, learning materials, construction, molding, and inspection, using man-made objects to control the flow of clouds. Mozi, one of the Three Sages of Jixia, serves as the Dean.
zh_text: “实践认知万物。”\n学子们在此修习机关术，知材、营造、塑织、检校，以人造之物御使云流。\n稷下三贤之一的墨子担任院长。
source_text: “实践认知万物。”\n学子们在此修习机关术，知材、营造、塑织、检校，以人造之物御使云流。\n稷下三贤之一的墨子担任院长。
official_target_text: Practice to understand all things.\nStudents study mechanics here, learning materials, construction, molding, and inspection, using man-made objects to control the flow of clouds. Mozi, one of the Three Sages of Jixia, serves as the Dean.
official_en_text: Practice to understand all things.\nStudents study mechanics here, learning materials, construction, molding, and inspection, using man-made objects to control the flow of clouds. Mozi, one of the Three Sages of Jixia, serves as the Dean.

text: A powerful creature that exists in legends, capable of controlling weather, influencing living beings, and even shapeshifting.\nSome scholars point out that dragons still haunt certain parts of Jixia.
zh_text: 一种存在于传说之中的强大生物，能操控气象，影响生物，甚至化形。\n有些学者指出，稷下的某些地方依旧有龙出没。
source_text: 一种存在于传说之中的强大生物，能操控气象，影响生物，甚至化形。\n有些学者指出，稷下的某些地方依旧有龙出没。
official_target_text: A powerful creature that exists in legends, capable of controlling weather, influencing living beings, and even shapeshifting.\nSome scholars point out that dragons still haunt certain parts of Jixia.
official_en_text: A powerful creature that exists in legends, capable of controlling weather, influencing living beings, and even shapeshifting.\nSome scholars point out that dragons still haunt certain parts of Jixia.

text: A group of young people who were either expelled from the academy or dropped out due to dissatisfaction with its system. They are mischievous, unruly, and often cause trouble—a force that gives the academy quite a headache.
zh_text: 一群被学院强制开除或者不满学院制度主动退学的年轻人。\n他们性格顽劣、不受管教，常常闹出乱子，是令学院颇为头疼的一股力量。
source_text: 一群被学院强制开除或者不满学院制度主动退学的年轻人。\n他们性格顽劣、不受管教，常常闹出乱子，是令学院颇为头疼的一股力量。
official_target_text: A group of young people who were either expelled from the academy or dropped out due to dissatisfaction with its system. They are mischievous, unruly, and often cause trouble—a force that gives the academy quite a headache.
official_en_text: A group of young people who were either expelled from the academy or dropped out due to dissatisfaction with its system. They are mischievous, unruly, and often cause trouble—a force that gives the academy quite a headache.

text: An inscription containing ancient energy records a secret location. \nDecipher the clues, follow the trail, and interact with the Flow to reveal the hidden treasure chest.
zh_text: 残存着古老能量的碑刻，记载着一处隐秘的方位。 \n解读线索，寻踪而至，以元流感应交互，隐藏的宝箱自会显现。
source_text: 残存着古老能量的碑刻，记载着一处隐秘的方位。 \n解读线索，寻踪而至，以元流感应交互，隐藏的宝箱自会显现。
official_target_text: An inscription containing ancient energy records a secret location. \nDecipher the clues, follow the trail, and interact with the Flow to reveal the hidden treasure chest.
official_en_text: An inscription containing ancient energy records a secret location. \nDecipher the clues, follow the trail, and interact with the Flow to reveal the hidden treasure chest.

text: “Demon species” is not a single ethnic group, but a collective term humans use for those not of their own kind.\nJixia Academy is inclusive; demon species and humans live together as equals, and many demon species from all over the continent come here to study.
zh_text: “魔种”并非一个族群，而是人类对非我族类的统称。\n稷下学院兼容并包，魔种与人类平等相处，有不少大陆各地的魔种前来求学。
source_text: “魔种”并非一个族群，而是人类对非我族类的统称。\n稷下学院兼容并包，魔种与人类平等相处，有不少大陆各地的魔种前来求学。
official_target_text: “Demon species” is not a single ethnic group, but a collective term humans use for those not of their own kind.\nJixia Academy is inclusive; demon species and humans live together as equals, and many demon species from all over the continent come here to study.
official_en_text: “Demon species” is not a single ethnic group, but a collective term humans use for those not of their own kind.\nJixia Academy is inclusive; demon species and humans live together as equals, and many demon species from all over the continent come here to study.

text: Uniting body and mind, entering the Dao through martial arts. Students practice martial arts here to hone their character and train their bodies. The academy is headed by the Old Master, one of the Three Sages of Jixia.
zh_text: “身心相合，以武入道。”\n学子们在此修习武道，打磨心性，练体为武。\n由稷下三贤之一的老夫子担任院长。
source_text: “身心相合，以武入道。”\n学子们在此修习武道，打磨心性，练体为武。\n由稷下三贤之一的老夫子担任院长。
official_target_text: Uniting body and mind, entering the Dao through martial arts. Students practice martial arts here to hone their character and train their bodies. The academy is headed by the Old Master, one of the Three Sages of Jixia.
official_en_text: Uniting body and mind, entering the Dao through martial arts. Students practice martial arts here to hone their character and train their bodies. The academy is headed by the Old Master, one of the Three Sages of Jixia.

text: Some Elite enemies can be enhanced with Origin Cores after they're defeated to unlock Awakening Challenges.
“Insight into essence, mastery of power.”\nStudents study magic here, observe miraculous creations, and research the laws of all things.\nIt is headed by Zhuangzi, one of the Sages of Jixia.
zh_text: “洞悉本质，掌握力量。”\n学子们在此修习魔道，观奇迹造物，研万物规律。\n由稷下三贤之一的庄周担任院长。
source_text: “洞悉本质，掌握力量。”\n学子们在此修习魔道，观奇迹造物，研万物规律。\n由稷下三贤之一的庄周担任院长。
official_target_text: “Insight into essence, mastery of power.”\nStudents study magic here, observe miraculous creations, and research the laws of all things.\nIt is headed by Zhuangzi, one of the Sages of Jixia.

text:
Notice:
First, this game is a complex role-playing game suitable for users aged 12 and above. Minors are advised to play under parental supervision.
Second, this game is based on a fictional story and an Eastern fantasy worldview. The visuals are vibrant, and the music is lively and stirring. Some hero characters have been appropriately adapted from history and will not be confused with reality. Players will meet familiar Honor of Kings heroes and write their own stories in the Honor of Kings continent through combat, exploration, and training. The game focuses on exploring a vast fantasy world, and some combat content is non-realistic, ensuring no confusion with real life. Players are encouraged to achieve goals through thinking and training. The game includes a text-based social system for strangers, which is managed in accordance with relevant laws and regulations.
Third, in accordance with national requirements, the game features a real-name authentication system. Users who have not passed authentication cannot enter the game. Users identified as minors cannot enter the game except on Fridays, Saturdays, Sundays, and statutory holidays from 20 to 21.
Some gameplay and items in the game require payment. According to Tencent's health system regulations, users identified as minors will be subject to the following management:
Users under 12 years old cannot make payments. For minor users aged 12 to under 16, a single top-up cannot exceed 50 RMB, and the cumulative monthly top-up cannot exceed 200 RMB. For minor users aged 16 and above, a single top-up cannot exceed 100 RMB, and the cumulative monthly top-up cannot exceed 400 RMB.
Fourth, players need to develop characters based on different resonance traits and allocate resources reasonably to increase their strength, which helps exercise logical thinking and judgment. During combat, attacking or dodging based on the opponent's movements helps exercise hand-eye coordination and reaction speed.
zh_text:
提示说明：
一、本游戏是一款玩法相对复杂的角色扮演类游戏，适用于年满12周岁及以上的用户，建议未成年人在家长监护下使用游戏产品。
二、本游戏基于架空的故事背景和东方幻想世界观，画面色彩鲜明、配乐活泼激昂，部分英雄角色有基于历史的适量改编，不会与现实相混淆。玩家将结识熟悉的王者英雄，在战斗、探险与历练的过程中，谱写自己在王者大陆的故事。游戏以广阔的幻想世界探索为主要玩法，部分对抗内容以非写实的形式出现，不会与现实生活相混淆，鼓励玩家通过思考和训练达成目标。游戏中有基于文字的陌生人社交系统，但社交系统的管理遵循相关法律法规。
三、根据国家相关要求，游戏中有用户实名认证系统，未通过实名认证的用户不可进入游戏；认证为未成年人的用户除周五、周六、周日及法定节假日每日20时至21时外其他时间均不可进入游戏。
游戏中部分玩法和道具需要付费。根据腾讯健康系统管理规定，认证为未成年人的用户将接受以下管理：
未满12周岁的用户不能付费；12周岁以上未满16周岁的未成年人用户，单次充值金额不得超过50元人民币，每月充值金额累计不得超过200元人民币；16周岁以上的未成年人用户，单次充值金额不得超过100元人民币，每月充值金额累计不得超过400元人民币。
四、游戏中玩家需要根据不同的共鸣特性养成角色，并合理的分配资源来提升自身的强度，有助于锻炼玩家的逻辑思维能力与思考判断能力；战斗中根据对手的动作进行攻击或躲避，有助于锻炼玩家的手眼协调能力和快速反应能力。

I. This game is a relatively complex role-playing game for users aged 12 and above. Minors are advised to use the game under parental supervision.

Some hero characters are moderately adapted from history and will not be confused with reality. Players will meet familiar Honor of Kings heroes and write their own story in Primaera through combat, exploration, and training. The main gameplay is exploration of a vast fantasy world. Some combat content appears in a non-realistic form and will not be confused with real life. The game encourages players to achieve goals through thinking and training. The game includes a text-based stranger social system, and its management follows relevant laws and regulations.
III. In accordance with national requirements, the game has a real-name verification system. Users who have not completed real-name verification cannot enter the game. Users verified as minors cannot enter the game except from 20 to 21 on Fridays, Saturdays, Sundays, and statutory holidays. Some gameplay and items in the game require payment. Under Tencent Health System rules, users verified as minors are subject to the following management: users under 12 cannot make payments; minors aged 12 and above but under 16 may spend no more than 50 yuan per transaction and no more than 200 yuan per month; minors aged 16 and above may spend no more than 100 yuan per transaction and no more than 400 yuan per month.
IV. In the game, players need to develop characters according to different Resonance traits and allocate resources reasonably to improve their strength, which helps exercise logical thinking and judgment. Attacking or dodging according to opponents' actions in combat helps exercise hand-eye coordination and quick reaction ability.

<span color="#ffe398">Ranking Rules</> 
     Scourges: Twindread rankings reset at the start of each event. 
     Rankings are based on your best performance. 
     Best Performance: Successful runs are ranked by completion time; unsuccessful runs are ranked by the maximum health depleted from the peak monsters. 
 
<span color="#ffe398">Temperature Mechanism</> 
     Skills and environments from the Crimson Beast and Azure Beast affect your temperature. Imbalance results in penalties: 
             High Temperature: Launched by explosions, heavy damage, and reduced healing for a duration. 
             Low Temperature: Stamina drained, heavy damage, and slowed Stamina recovery for a duration. 
     When one peak monster is active, the other will randomly fire ice or lava projectiles from offstage. 
     Destroy Ice Crystals or lava pillars to regulate your temperature. Destroying them creates a zone that continuously cools or heats you. 
 
<span color="#ffe398">Final Stand</> 
     When a peak monster's health drops below 25%, it will focus all attacks on one player, ignoring all other Threat sources.

<span color="#ffe398">排行规则</> 
     灾兽双影排行榜每次活动开启后重置。 
     参与灾兽双影将根据最佳成绩进行排名。

     玩家可以通过摧毁冰晶柱、熔岩柱来调控温度，摧毁柱子后，处于范围内的玩家会持续的降温或升温。 
 
<span color="#ffe398">最终时刻</> 
     当顶峰怪物处于25%生命值以下时，将会始终合力集火同一名玩家，此时无法再被其他仇恨技能拉扯仇恨。

text:
<span size="26">Score</>
Play ranked matches on the Open World tables to earn Rank Points. Ranked tables are only accessible via ranked matchmaking.
Casual and Portable tables do not affect Rank Points.

Final scores depend on your team's ranking, whether you doubled down, and the rank difference between teams.
• No rank restrictions for teams; solo matchmaking prioritizes players of similar skill.
• Doubling Multiplier: Determined by your own doubling status and the opponents'. Your partner's doubling does not affect yours.
• Win/Loss Multiplier: Depends on the team's final rankings. First + Second place yields the highest multiplier.
• Rank Difference Multiplier: 2x for a difference of 2+ levels, 1.5x for 1 level, and 1x for less than 1 level.

<span size="26">Ranks</>
Players are divided into ranks based on cumulative points:
• Table King: 6500 points
• Control Master: 2400 points
• Strategy Expert: 650 points
• Deck Builder: 200 points
• Rookie: 0 points
Some ranks have sub-tiers. Check the ranked table to view your progress and rewards.
Reach the threshold for a new rank to automatically claim exclusive rewards.
zh_text:
<span size="26">积分</>
在大世界的排位牌桌进行牌局可赢取段位积分。排位牌桌只能通过排位匹配开局。
娱乐牌桌和便携牌桌的游戏不影响段位积分。

玩家结算得分与同阵营玩家的结算排序、是否加倍、阵营双方的段位差距相关。
• 不限制组队时玩家间的段位差；单人匹配时，会优先匹配实力相近的玩家。
• 加倍倍率：由对手加倍情况和自身加倍状态共同决定，队友加倍不影响自己的加倍倍率。
• 胜负倍率：取决于玩家名次组合，胜方头游+二游倍率最高，其他组合递减。
• 段位差倍率：反映双方段位差异，差2级及以上则为2倍，差1级为1.5倍，差距小于1级为1倍。    

<span size="26">段位</>
玩家段位依据累计积分进行划分多个大段位：
• 牌桌王者：6500分
• 控场大师：2400分
• 博弈专家：650分
• 组牌高手：200分
• 新锐牌手：0分
部分大段位由多个小段位构成，具体可交互排位牌桌查看自己的段位信息和积分进度。
当玩家积分达到新段位的解锁阈值时，即可自动获取该段位对应的专属奖励。

text:
<span size="26">Hand Ranking Order</>
King Bomb > 10-Bomb > 9-Bomb > 8-Bomb > 7-Bomb > 6-Bomb > Straight Flush > 5-Bomb > 4-Bomb > Other Hands

<span size="26">Bomb and Straight Flush Hands</>
• King Bomb: Two Big Jokers and two Small Jokers; the King Bomb is the highest-ranking hand.
• 4-Bomb ~ 10-Bomb: Four or more cards of the same rank; more cards make a larger bomb. If the number of cards is the same, the higher rank is larger.
• Straight Flush: A sequence of cards of the same suit; any Straight Flush is larger than a 5-Bomb. Straight Flushes are compared by rank, not by suit.

<span size="26">Other Hands</>
Other hands can only be compared against the same type of hand.
• Steel Plate: Two sets of three consecutive ranks; the smallest is AAA222, and the largest is KKKAAA.
• Straight: Five cards of consecutive ranks; the smallest is A2345, and the largest is 10JQKA.
• Three Consecutive Pairs: Three sets of consecutive pairs; the smallest is AA2233, and the largest is QQKKAA.
• Three-of-a-Kind with Pair: Three cards + a pair. Only the rank of the three-of-a-kind is compared, not the pair.
• Three-of-a-Kind: Three cards of the same rank.
• Pair: Two cards of the same rank.
• Single: Any single card.
zh_text:
<span size="26">牌型大小顺序</>
王炸 → 十炸 → 九炸 → 八炸 → 七炸 → 六炸 → 同花顺 → 五炸 → 四炸 → 其他牌型

<span size="26">炸弹和同花顺牌型</>
• 王炸：大王、小王各两张；王炸为最大牌型。
• 四弹~十炸：四张或四张以上牌点相同的牌；张数越多，炸弹越大；张数相同时，点数越大，炸弹越大。
• 同花顺：由同一花色的卡牌构成的顺子牌型；任意同花顺都比五炸大。同花顺之间比较点数，不比较花色。

<span size="26">其他牌型</>
其他牌型需是相同牌型方能比较大小。
• 钢板：由两组点数连续的三张组成，最小钢板是AAA222，最大是KKKAAA。
• 顺子：五张点数连续的牌，最小的顺子是A2345，最大的顺子是10JQKA。
• 三连对：三组点数连续的对子；最小的三连对是AA2233，最大的是QQKKAA。
• 三带二：三张+对子。三带二牌型之间，只比较三张的牌点大小，不比较对子的大小。
• 三张：三张点数相同的牌。
• 对子：两张点数相同的牌。
• 单张：任意一张单牌。

text:
<span size="26">Overview</> 
Guandan is a four-player team game. You and the player opposite you are partners, while the players to your left and right are your opponents. 
 
<span size="26">Turn Order</> 
In the first round, the system randomly selects a player to lead. In subsequent rounds, the player who finished first in the previous round leads. 
Players take turns playing cards in a counter-clockwise direction. You must play a higher-ranking card combination or a stronger bomb to beat the previous player's cards. 
If no one can beat the current cards, the last player to play becomes the leader for the next round and can play any valid combination. 
 
<span size="26">Passing the Lead</> 
If a player finishes all their cards and no other player can beat their last play, the lead passes to their partner. 
 
<span size="26">Deck Composition</> 
The game uses two decks of cards, totaling 108 cards. Each player is dealt 27 cards. 
Cards matching the current "Level" are <FFE398>Level Cards</>. Level Cards are higher than all other cards except for the Jokers. 
 
<span size="26">Card Ranking</> 
Big Joker → Small Joker → Level Card → A → K → Q → J → 10 → 9 → 8 → 7 → 6 → 5 → 4 → 3 → 2 
Level Cards of the Heart suit are <FFE398>Wildcards</>. Wildcards can substitute for any card except Jokers to form combinations. 
 
<span size="26">Leveling Up and Winning</> 
Both teams start at the same level. In team games, the starting level is 2; otherwise, it is random. 
After a round, players are ranked by who finishes their cards first. The first to finish is the winner, followed by second, third, and last place. The winning team's level increases based on the partner's rank: 
• First + Second: Level up by three 
• First + Third: Level up by two 
• First + Last: Level up by one 
 
<span size="26">Must-Win at A</> 
If the winning team's current level is below A, but the level-up would exceed A, they will only reach A. Successfully winning a round at level A grants overall victory, and both teams' levels reset to 2 for the next game.
zh_text:
<span size="26">概述</> 
掼蛋玩法为四人捉对厮杀，本家和对家搭档组成己方，上家和下家组成对方。 
 
<span size="26">出牌顺序</> 
首局由系统随机指定一名玩家先出牌，随后每局的首出牌权由上一局的“头游”获得。 
跟牌时，玩家按照逆时针方向依次出牌。跟牌玩家必须打出更大的相同牌型或更大的炸弹进行压制。 
若无人跟牌，则最后出牌者成为新一轮的领出牌，可选择任意牌型打出，开启新一轮的出牌。 
 
<span size="26">接风</> 
任意玩家出完最后一手牌后，如果没有玩家跟牌，则由其对家搭档出牌。 
 
<span size="26">牌的组成</> 
游戏采用两副牌，共108张，开局每人发27张牌。 
点数对应本局”级数“的牌即为<FFE398>级牌</>。级牌比除大小王之外所有牌都大。 
 
<span size="26">牌的大小顺序</> 
大王 → 小王 → 级牌 → A → K → Q → J → 10 → 9 → 8 → 7 → 6 → 5 → 4 → 3 → 2 
红心花色的级牌为<FFE398>万能牌（逢人配）</>，万能牌能替代除了大小王之外的任何牌，用以组成牌型。 
 
<span size="26">级牌升级与胜负</> 
开局双方级数相同，若组队游戏则起始级数默认为2，否则起始级数随机确定。 
一局结束后，按出完所有手牌的顺序决定名次，最先出完的玩家为头游，之后是二游、三游和末游。头游玩家一方获得本局胜利，按头游队友的名次确定升级幅度，升级后的级数作为下一局的级数。 
• 头游 + 二游：升三级 
• 头游 + 三游：升二级 
• 头游 + 末游：升一级 
 
<span size="26">逢A必打</> 
如果胜方当前级数不到A，升级后级数将超过A，则实际升级到A。如从A继续升级成功，则获得大局胜利，下一局双方级数同时重置为2。

1. Purchasing a Radish Blind Box gives you a random chance to obtain 1 out of 8 radish-themed outfits. You can purchase 1 box or 1 boxes or 6 boxes. 
2. The outfits in the Radish Blind Box include 2 hidden items and 6 basic items. Radish King and Radish Queen are hidden items, while Radish Sage, Radish Bandit, Radish Fresh, Radish Knight, Radish Poet, and Radish Harvest are basic items. 
3. Blind boxes open automatically upon purchase. You will prioritize obtaining items you do not yet own. Once you have collected all basic items, any further basic items obtained from blind boxes will be automatically converted into 20 Radish Coins. Once you have collected all hidden items, you will only receive basic items from further purchases and cannot obtain duplicate hidden items. 
4. After accumulating enough Radish Coins, you can also exchange them for hidden items. If you obtain the same item from a blind box after exchanging for it, it will be automatically converted into 240 Radish Coins. 
5. Radish Coins will be reclaimed by the system after the Radish Blind Box event ends. Please pay attention to the sale period and exchange your rewards in time. 
6. During the Radish Blind Box event, collect any two Radish outfits to claim the Radish Gaze headpiece. 
 
Probability: 
Hidden items: 1.5% 
Basic items: 98.5%

1. 购买萝卜卜盲盒可随机从8款萝卜主题时装中获取1款，1次可购买1盒或6盒。 
2. 萝卜卜盲盒中的时装包含2款隐藏款与6款基础款。其中萝国王、萝王后为隐藏款，萝半仙儿、萝大盗、萝清新、萝侠客、萝诗书、萝丰收为基础款。 
3. 购买盲盒后会自动开启，获得基础款或隐藏款时优先获取其中未拥有的款式。购买盲盒获得全部基础款后，继续购买盲盒获得基础款时将会自动转化为20个照运金币·萝卜。购买盲盒获得全部隐藏款后，继续购买盲盒只可获得基础款，无法重复获取隐藏款。 
4. 累计获取足够数量的照运金币·萝卜后，也可通过消耗照运金币·萝卜兑换隐藏款，若在兑换隐藏款后再次通过购买盲盒获取相同款式，则自动转化为240个照运金币·萝卜。 
5.照运金币·萝卜在萝卜卜盲盒下架后会被系统回收，请注意盲盒售卖时间并及时兑换奖励。 
6. 萝卜卜盲盒上架期间，收集任意两款萝卜卜时装，即可领取萝之凝视头饰。

隐藏款：1.5% 
基础款：98.5%

<span color="#ffe398">Kun Dream Trial</>
     A trial space reconstructed by Zhuangzi through the Dao of Dreams, modeled after the Kun Dream.
     Clear the stage by defeating all enemies. First-time clears grant a First-Clear Reward.
     In the Kun Dream Trial, difficulty and rewards are unaffected by the Flow Realm.

<span color="#ffe398">Challenge Objectives</>
     Each stage features unique challenge objectives, which are evaluated and recorded upon completion.
     Earn a corresponding number of Dream Butterflies based on your best historical record for the current stage.
     Accumulate a certain number of Dream Butterflies in a region to unlock regional rewards.
     As you progress through regions, stage difficulty increases and includes more challenge objectives.

<span color="#ffe398">Phantasm Mode</>
     With the Kun as your vessel and the butterfly as your guide—traverse three layers of illusion to perceive your true self.
     Phantasm contains 50 high-difficulty stages divided into three regions: Stages 1-20 (Shallow Realm), 21-40 (Deep Realm), and 41-50 (Abyssal Realm).

<span color="#ffe398">Fallen Dream Mode</>
     The phantasm shatters, the eternal night descends—fall into the abyss to hone your true essence.
     Permanently unlocked after clearing Phantasm; content and rewards are updated periodically.
     Each Fallen Dream season contains 18 high-difficulty stages divided into two regions: Stages 1-12 (Dark Night Realm) and 13-18 (Nightmare Realm).
     Before starting, you must set up Vanguard and Reserve lineups. Each Resonance and Spirit Summon can only be used in one lineup.
     If the Vanguard lineup falls, you can continue the challenge with the Reserve lineup within a limited time.
     New Shelter effects are introduced with each Fallen Dream update. Choose one for your team before starting.
     Additionally, the Nightmare Realm features environmental mechanics unique to the current season.

<span color="#ffe398">Kun Dream Shop</>
     Use Kun Dream Crystals, obtained from stage and regional rewards, to redeem valuable items.

<span color="#ffe398"> Refresh Rules </>
     The Beast Co-op Leaderboard refreshes 1 time(s) every 3 week(s). The leaderboard resets upon each refresh.
     Rewards refresh 1 time(s) every Monday. Point rewards reset after each refresh.

<span color="#ffe398"> Point Rules </>
     Beast Co-op points consist of base points and bonus points. Base points are earned for each wave of monsters defeated. Faster completion yields more bonus points. Points can be earned repeatedly.
     Master difficulty: Base points 1200, bonus points 650.
     Veteran difficulty: Base points 1500, bonus points 1200.
     Elite difficulty: Base points 3000, bonus points 1600.
     Excellence difficulty: Base points 4200, bonus points 2200.
     Grandmaster difficulty: Base points 6000, bonus points 2850.

<span color="#ffe398"> Ranking Rules </>
     Participate in Beast Co-op to be ranked based on your best performance.
     Rankings are prioritized by the highest difficulty cleared. If difficulties are the same, the faster completion time ranks higher.

     精通难度基础积分为1200，额外积分为650。 
     资深难度基础积分为1500，额外积分为1200。 
     菁英难度基础积分为3000，额外积分为1600。 
     卓越难度基础积分为4200，额外积分为2200。 
     宗师难度基础积分为6000，额外积分为2850。

     排名优先根据通关最高难度排行，通关难度相同以通关该难度用时进行排名，用时越短排名越高

<span color="#ffe398">Introduction</> 
     Divine Deduction has multiple difficulties. Each difficulty requires clearing the previous one and reaching the required Flow Realm to unlock. 
<span color="#ffe398">Basic Rules</> 
     Players can advance their siege engines to push enemy towers. Destroy all towers and the enemy crystal to win. 
<span color="#ffe398">Gold Usage</> 
     During the mode, all team members receive an equal amount of gold after defeating enemies. When you have enough gold, click the purchase button on the left to spend it and select one ability from several random options as a reward. 
<span color="#ffe398">Spirit Beast Rules</> 
     On the Divine Deduction map, Crimson and Azure Spirit Beasts will spawn on the left and right platforms respectively. 
     Defeating the corresponding Spirit Beast grants the entire team Red or Blue Buffs, as well as a large amount of gold. 
     Red Buff: Restores a certain amount of HP per second. 
     Blue Buff: Periodically charges your Ultimate. 
<span color="#ffe398">Reward Rules</> 
     First-clear rewards are granted for each difficulty. These rewards do not reset and can only be obtained once.

<span color="#ffe398">Wonderland</>
     Wonderland is a high-difficulty challenge mode. Team up with partners to win each battle and claim the corresponding rewards.

<span color="#ffe398">Reward Rules</>
     Wonderland consists of multiple stages. Clear a stage to earn its specific rewards. Reward counts for each stage are calculated independently.

<span color="#ffe398">Reward Refresh Rules</>
     Each stage has 2 reward count(s) per week, which refresh at 4 AM every Monday.
zh_text:
<span color="#ffe398">奇境</> 
     奇境是一种高难度的挑战关卡，与伙伴结伴赢得其中每场战斗，即可获得该场战斗对应的奖励。 
 
<span color="#ffe398">奖励规则</> 
     奇境中包含多个关卡，突破对应关卡后，将会获得该关卡对应的奖励，各关卡间奖励次数单独计算。 
 
<span color="#ffe398">奖励刷新规则</> 
     每周各关卡拥有2次奖励次数，该次数将在每周一凌晨4点刷新。

text:
<span color="#ffe398">Rankings</> 
 
Rankings for Scourges: Twindread reset at the start of each event. 
 
Your ranking uses your best performance: for successful runs, faster completion times rank higher; for unsuccessful runs, lower enemy remaining Health ranks higher. 
 
<span color="#ffe398">Temperature</> 
 
Temperature changes based on the environment and when Crimson Beast or Azure Beast uses their skills. 
 
High Temperature: Causes an explosion that launches you into the air, deals heavy damage, and temporarily reduces healing effects. 
 
Low Temperature: Drains Stamina, deals heavy damage, and temporarily slows Stamina recovery. 
 
While only one enemy is active on the battlefield, the other will send ice or lava pillars from offstage. Destroy these pillars to help you cool down or heat up. 
 
<span color="#ffe398">Final Stand</> 
 
When an enemy's health drops below 25%, it locks onto one player, and its target cannot be changed.
zh_text:
<span color="#ffe398">排行规则</> 
     灾兽双影排行榜每次活动开启后重置。 
     参与灾兽双影将根据最佳成绩进行排名。 
     最佳成绩：当挑战成功时，优先依据挑战时间进行排名；未挑战成功时，则依据击败顶峰怪物最大生命值进行排名。 
 
<span color="#ffe398">温度机制</> 
     该玩法下猩红神兽、蔚蓝神兽的技能和环境将会影响玩家温度，当温度失衡时将受到相应温度机制的惩罚。 
             高温：被爆炸击飞，并受到巨额伤害，一段时间内治疗效果降低。 
             低温：清空体力，并受到巨额伤害，一段时间内体力恢复速度减慢。 
     顶峰怪物单独在场时，另一场外顶峰怪物会随机向场内释放远程冰柱、炎柱攻击。 
     玩家可以通过摧毁冰晶柱、熔岩柱来调控温度，摧毁柱子后，处于范围内的玩家会持续的降温或升温。 
 
<span color="#ffe398">最终时刻</> 
     当顶峰怪物处于25%生命值以下时，将会始终合力集火同一名玩家，此时无法再被其他仇恨技能拉扯仇恨。

text:
<span color="#ffe398">Dreamwalk Odyssey</>
     Dreamscape Chronicles has 12 levels. To unlock levels 1-4 of the Floating Life, you must reach the corresponding Origin Level and Wave Flow Realm, and clear the previous level. For Floating Life 5 and Transcendent 1-7, you must reach Wave Flow Realm 7 and achieve a Perfect rating on the previous level.

<span color="#ffe398">Random Rules</>
     Weekly Secret Spells reset every Monday. The difficulty of the Weekly Secret Spells varies based on the difficulty level. Dungeons and their corresponding Secret Spells are randomized daily.
 
<span color="#ffe398">Selection Pool</>
     Three-school Showdown, Stargazing Mysteries, Festive Fire Play, and Seapes Shadows.

<span color="#ffe398">Stamina-Free Rules</>
     Dreamscape Chronicles offers one free challenge attempt daily. If successful, opening the reward chest will not consume Dream Dew. This attempt resets daily at 4:00.

<span color="#ffe398">Daily Reward Rules</>
     Complete a Dreamscape challenge (any rating) to receive full daily rewards. Daily rewards for Transcendent 1-7 are identical.

<span color="#ffe398">Weekly Reward Rules</>
     Weekly rewards are settled every Monday at 4:00 based on the highest level cleared with a Perfect rating during the previous week.
zh_text:
<span color="#ffe398">梦行奇谭</>
     梦行奇谭共有12层，浮生1-4层解锁需要达到对应的元流等级和波流境界并且通关上一层，浮生5、超凡1-7层需要达到波流境界7并且上一层评分达到完美。

<span color="#ffe398">随机规则</>
     周秘咒每周一进行一次重置，不同难度下，周秘咒的难度会有不同。副本与其对应的副本秘咒每日随机一次。
 
<span color="#ffe398">随机范围</>
     三院争锋、观星解异、瑞火社戏、林地篱影。

<span color="#ffe398">免体力规则</>
     梦行奇谭每日有一次免费挑战次数，该次挑战成功后，开启奖励宝箱将不会消耗梦华清露，该次数将在每日凌晨4点刷新。

<span color="#ffe398">日奖励发放规则</>
     每日完成梦行(任何评级)即可获得全额每日奖励，超凡1-7层日奖励完全相同。

<span color="#ffe398">周奖励发放规则</>
     周奖励每周一凌晨4点进行结算，根据上周达成完美评级的最高层数结算奖励。

There are four Valorquests, each a story-based challenge. Team up to clear a challenge, and spend Vitality to earn Gear rewards. 
 
<span color="#ffe398">Challenges</> 
Three-school Showdown, Starlight Exploration, Festive Fire Opera, and Seapes Shadows.

The first chest you open each day in Valorquests doesn't consume Vitality. This free chest resets at 4:00 AM daily.

text:
A magical creature that inhabits lush lands.
Its rock-like skin is covered with a thick layer of moss, providing excellent camouflage.
They spend most of their time motionless, waiting for prey to come to them.

They are quite docile when full and often carry smaller creatures on their backs.
Eating a certain food long-term makes their feathers green. That's an interesting topic. Do their diets change color with the seasons and habitats?

Strange fruits that float throughout Jixia.
Their surfaces are covered in thick, soft fuzz.
To protect themselves, Thunderfruits discharge electricity at any creature that tries to "pick" them.

When you hear a thunderclap on a sunny day,
it doesn't necessarily mean it's going to rain; it might just mean someone accidentally disturbed them.
Its schedule is interesting: it works while humans sleep and finishes before they wake.
The phenomenon of pairs flying low, combined with legends about Phantom Screen Birds, offers an intriguing hypothesis: the bond between these birds may stem from some profound obsession.

Birds that live in dream areas. They possess dreamy blue feathers.
Male Dream Screen Birds have light blue wings covered in gorgeous patterns, accented with pink, dark blue, and white. When they spread their tails, it's like a colorful painting, and their feathers are often sold as expensive jewelry materials.
Although female Dream Screen Birds do not spread their tails, they also have brilliant light blue feathers and an elegant, dignified posture. Their fine down can be made into expensive, luxurious clothing, so people always risk danger to come to the dream area to collect the down they shed.

In dreams, male and female Dream Screen Birds often appear together, wandering and flying low in the dream forest with elegant postures.
The male and female birds are closely attached and have a deep affection for each other.
Legend has it that if a male bird appears alone, its colorful screen will turn into an absurd and eerie nightmare, gradually swallowing people's consciousness.
If a female bird appears alone, it will bring peaceful dreams and a good night's sleep to humans.

It is said that many years ago, Jixia suffered a disaster. A couple, while fleeing, accidentally entered the dream area.
Because the wife was injured on the road, she had difficulty moving, but the husband was unwilling to leave her behind to escape alone.
They were eroded by dream energy, with brilliant crest feathers growing on their heads and their arms turning into wings, gradually losing their human appearance. Years later, the first pair of Dream Screen Birds appeared.

The difference between a Blurry Rabbit and a normal rabbit is that its ears have evolved a form of camouflage. The patterns on their ears look like a pair of giant eyes. This special pattern serves to confuse natural predators. Seen from the front, those eyes look like spirits from a dream, intimidating any enemy that approaches with ill intent. Where these eyes came from and why has always been a subject of debate. But there is no denying that these eerie eyes have indeed earned the Blurry Rabbit a rare peace in a survival-of-the-fittest environment.
A loyal and ancient messenger, still delivering messages that no one is there to receive. Perhaps its waiting is, in itself, the most complete record of a lost civilization.
Being nearly invisible before maturity is a brilliant survival strategy, allowing it to evade reckless gatherers.
Golden Wood-Born fruit hanging from branches, edible. Pairs well with meat dishes to effectively cut through greasiness.

A radish affected by Cloud Silkworms.
Short limbs, sluggish movements, a disdainful expression, and a sensitive heart.
Stealth Radishes have a strong sense of self-preservation and will throw radishes at any creature that approaches them.

Some herbalists have studied the composition of these radish darts. They consist of radish, cloud silk, and some indigestible waste that acts as a binder...

A staple grain crop from the Dreamweave Plains.
It looks like a fox's tail and becomes fluffier when ripe.

Some small insect-eating animals hide in the Jixia Fox-Wheat fields, using the wheat's fox-tail appearance to confuse predators, forming a symbiotic relationship with the plant.

Its appearance has never been glimpsed by humans, and it has vastly different images in various legends.
Some say it has bone leaves resembling a Bone-Leaf Fox, while others say it is accompanied by clouds like a Cloud-Trace Fox.

It walks through Jixia with the most graceful steps.
Wilderness, mountain peaks, wetlands, and even the Forest of Dreams—it changes its posture leisurely and unrestrainedly.
Although some may have seen its form, no one can describe its exact appearance.
I recall that these fruits have a clever self-defense strategy: like an arrow drawn but not released, they warn first and show their edge later, leaving room for both sides.
Using big eyes to scare people? A clever trick! It seems that not only humans, but little rabbits also understand the value of a surprise attack.
When it's cold, they huddle together for warmth, shielding the weakest among them in the center... This tenderness is even more precious and warm than their blue fur.
Records of it are the most mysterious of all living things. My notebook was once filled with its outlines, only for me to cross them all out in the end.
This bird is revered as a symbol of focus. I partially agree; after all, without enough patience, you can't even see its tail feathers clearly, let alone study them.

Mechanical constructs living in ruins, once used to record text and store information.
Their bodies are made of ancient bronze, with dull metallic luster and occasional rust.
There are ancient and mysterious sky-blue patterns on their bodies.
These constructs have no attack ability but move relatively fast.

Civilization has long since vanished, but the constructs are still waiting for their departed masters to return.
No one knows what it is guarding.

The Snout-Mouse is a common animal in Jixia that feeds on insects. It always buries its entire body in the soil, leaving only its petal-shaped tail exposed to attract small flies. If someone approaches, the Snout-Mouse will burrow out of the soil and flee, only to return once it is safe. Because it often moves through flower beds, its claws and tail are covered in pollen. Many young students at Jixia Academy love these cute rodents. However, the Snout-Mouse doesn't care who likes it; it will run away from anyone who gets too close.

A small, cute, and lovable purple spider that lives in the Dreamweave Plains.
In the dead of night when everyone is fast asleep, it works silently and diligently to weave fine spiderwebs.
When the morning sun shines, the webs are adorned with many crystal-clear dewdrops, looking like pearl necklaces.

Many children believe that these spiders are among the creators of dreams.
Perhaps their mysterious purple color comes from listening to the whispers in children's dreams.
The industrious little spiders use silk to collect fragments of dreams, weaving them into the shape of dreams, waiting for the sleepers to claim them.
A missing expert, glowing pearls... doesn't this sound like the beginning of some strange tale? Oh, I'm just kidding, you weren't actually scared, were you?

You dreamed you turned into a walking radish that threw radishes at everyone passing by? Hmm, I think I saw you too. As for whether what I saw was a radish or you... in dreams and reality, who can really say?
A child claimed to have followed it into a purple paradise. As a researcher, I have yet to verify the existence of this paradise.

A rare edible mushroom, crystal clear like shimmering bubbles. Known by gourmets as the 'Fairy Mushroom,' it can be cooked into various delicacies. Before maturing, its nearly transparent bulb allows it to grow safely in the territories of insects and beasts. Only when the flower stalk stands upright can you see the plump, translucent fruit. If you try to pick it rashly, you'll only catch a phantom.

Fruit Magpies are common birds in Springbrook Plains.
They are as timid as they are small, so they often huddle together.
Most of the time, they wrap themselves in their wings and hang upside down from branches.
Blending into their environment, they look just like green fruits.

Legend has it that the color of a Fruit Magpie is closely related to the green fruits and vegetables it eats.
Perhaps because of this, green plants instinctively keep their distance from these harmless creatures.

Deer found throughout Jixia, legend says they originally came from the distant, bitter cold lands. 
Their fur is a dreamy, elegant cold blue, hence the name "Gloom-Orchid". 
This blue fur, which does not blend into the environment, makes them more attractive to predators. 
Male Gloom-Orchid Deer grow massive antlers, resembling the tangled canopy of an ancient tree. 
Female Gloom-Orchid Deer only grow a pair of short, velvet-like antlers; while difficult to defend against predators, this makes them more agile. 
 
Although severe cold is rare in Jixia, it has been observed that Gloom-Orchid Deer herds huddle together during cold weather, protecting the old and weak in the center. 
Explorers believe this may stem from ancient habits inherited from their cold homeland. 
 
Their antlers are highly valuable outside of Jixia, which brought them unexpected disaster. 
They were nearly extinct until explorers began to strictly protect them.
According to my records, a confused traveler once leaned against it to rest, complaining that the stone was too cold. He didn't jump up in fright until the stone started moving.

Ancient texts record that the Jade Ring symbolizes peace, but the person who created it clearly had their own interpretation. Ignoring its destructive power, from the perspective of craftsmanship and aesthetics, it is a masterpiece.
Winning should be done in style, and eating should be done with gusto! With this to cleanse the palate, my victory will taste all the more pure.

Absorbs the strange fruit produced by cloud currents. 
It is dozens of times larger than a normal fruit. 
Peng-Hu Fruit is extremely sensitive to sound and will use its massive body to crush anything that makes a strange noise. 
 
Peng-Hu Fruit is sweet and sour, with a honey-like fragrance. 
Iced Peng-Hu juice is very popular in Jixia during the summer.

A magic-path creation shaped like a jade ring, dark green throughout with a warm luster.
The energy beams shot from it are swift and intense, capable of easily piercing rock.

In ancient legends, a high-quality jade ring represents long-lasting and stable peace.
In fact, only powerful strength is the most important cornerstone of a peaceful and prosperous age.

The Cloud-Trace Fox is snow-white, dotted with specks of blue, with intricate patterns like ancient cloud motifs flowing over its body.
The Cloud-Trace Fox is elusive, but it loves mist and can often be found in areas where mist is frequent.

Thus, there is a rumor that the Cloud-Trace Fox can swallow clouds and spit mist, and ride the clouds to command the rain.
Two hunters, brothers who are naturalists, have been tracking the Cloud-Trace Fox for years, hoping to discover the patterns behind Jixia's climate changes.
The tails of these rodents are lures they use to fish for insects. Because of their iconic petal-shaped tails and cute appearance, many young people in Jixia love them.

Entirely green, with only a few red feathers adorning the crest, wingtips, and tail. 
Because there are so few red feathers, people often mistake it for being entirely green, seeing green as red. 
But the red feathers on the Green-Clad are indeed real. 
 
Green-Clads love cleanliness and are often seen washing their wings by the water, which makes them close to water-dwelling creatures. 
They seem to sense the state of other living things; there are records of them guiding travelers suffering from extreme dehydration to water sources.

A noble and elegant bird with a slender figure.
The long, blue-purple icy feathers on its forehead, like distant mountains, make it seem unreachable.

Unlike the Cloud-Unseen, the Distant-Mountain-Dai does not like to be close to humans.
Even when it encounters visitors, it flies away after a fleeting glance, as if expressing its dissatisfaction with the disturbance to its peace.
They are also often used as a metaphor for focused individuals.

Mosslings are born among the earth's moss, with transparent bodies and budding branches on their heads. 
Curious but timid, they don't have a fixed habitat. 
If they sense a human approaching or attacking, they will hide behind a powerful beast. 
 
Only innocent children might not scare these little creatures.
Its symbiotic relationship with small insectivores is worth noting: one provides camouflage, the other provides protection—a truly stable alliance.
Draped in cloud patterns and accompanied by mist, this is perhaps the perfect interpretation of living in seclusion.
I've seen these crystal-clear little creatures among the moss in Jixia. Their budding sprouts look just like tiny ice crystals—very unique.

A rare clam that dwells at the bottom of the stream.
Its shell is brilliantly colored, and the pearl it holds within glows with a faint, magical energy.

Legend has it that a master of magic in Jixia was once obsessed with diving and studying underwater arts. One day, he vanished from the shore, and soon after, glowing, magical pearls began to appear beneath the waters where he disappeared.
I spent a week recording the relationship between a certain rabbit's emergence from its burrow and weather changes. The villagers often treat it as a living barometer.

The snow-white Run Rabbit is very lovable and is often used as inspiration for children's toys.

It is rumored that Run Rabbits are particularly sensitive to the weather, which may be related to their love for fresh plants.
Travelers often observe them foraging after rain.
Villagers also predict when the weather will clear up by observing the movements of the Run Rabbits.

A rabbit with fantastical fur colors.
When hiding in the dark, people can only see its hypnotic eyes, which often terrify students who wander into dreams.
Mengtu often appear in dreams, but unlike their fierce appearance in the dark, they are friendly and are rumored to often help humans.

Children who have gone missing once claimed they followed a four-eyed rabbit into a purple paradise.
However, the words of children don't count for much, just adding a touch of reality to the legend.

The Golden Carriage Turtle lives in waterside areas.
Compared to the simple Anchun Turtle, the Golden Carriage Turtle has light-colored patterns on its shell.
Under the sunlight, these patterns look like gorgeous gilding on the shell, appearing incredibly noble.

Long ago, people used these turtles with golden-embedded shells as a symbol of wealth.
Therefore, Golden Carriage Turtles are often kept in ponds by wealthy families.
Wealth is something people have chased throughout history.
As long as one is even slightly associated with it, even an ordinary turtle will be highly praised.
It is quite unique among birds to be able to sense a traveler's dehydration and lead them to water.
This fruit suddenly fell down last time, luckily I used my Star Power to dodge it easily. How about that, pretty cool move, right?
Look at that flashy style! Even the turtle shell is imitating the light of the stars, but when it comes to shining, no one beats me, Novar!

text: Classmate, could you come to the Martial Arts Academy plaza? There's something I'd like to ask of you.

Classmate, long time no see! Do you remember me? I'm Gan Ce, the chronicler who twisted his ankle at Ling-Shuang Pond while conducting an in-depth investigation. Thanks to your help, my article is expected to be the front-page headline in the new special edition of the Colorful Clouds Chronicle! After reading it, the editors were deeply moved. With Jixia facing difficulties, this article will be a great inspiration to our classmates, encouraging them to follow that senior's example and contribute what they can to Jixia. Furthermore, this discovery has significant implications for us chroniclers. On one hand, it proves that our investigation of the Colorful Clouds Basin was not thorough enough and had many oversights. On the other hand, it proves that we do have the capability to uncover what happened in this land. Everyone is now highly motivated to investigate the Colorful Clouds, which is a good thing.\n     Oh, right! Since we discovered this together, I listed you as a co-author on the article. Hehe, you deserve credit for this.\n     Thanks again for your help. I hope we meet again soon.
Please come to the Martial Arts Academy to find me immediately
Classmate, our findings are about to be published!

Classmate, I am Jing Qiu of the Lingyun Guard. Thanks to your help, the last student who went missing in the dream has returned to camp just now! To thank you for your contribution to the rescue, the Lingyun Guard has decided to award you a medal. Unfortunately, I have other urgent matters to attend to, so I've asked Teacher Ling Jing, who is stationed at the camp, to pass it to you. Teacher Ling Jing usually treats students on the upper level of the Mengyu Lake Feiyu Terrace camp. Remember to go get it when you have time!

The completely out-of-control Megadrive Hammer summons mechanical guards to fight in coordination. The instruction failure caused by the core overload has twisted the "Polar Exploration" philosophy into pure logic of destruction.

[Triple Shockwave]: The Megadrive Hammer releases three consecutive full-screen shockwaves. Before releasing, it will teleport to the edge of the arena, with each of the three shocks facing a different direction.

[Mechanical Support]: The Megadrive Hammer summons two mechanical minions before launching its full-screen attack, one of which will grab the shield on the field first. The team must prioritize killing the shielded minion to reclaim the shield, otherwise, they will be unable to block the subsequent devastating full-screen attack.

The Radish King is not only powerful in combat, but its cunning strategies are also a headache. Beware of the explosive mini-radishes hidden in the ground; triggering a trap will have unimaginable consequences.

[Seed Ambush]: When jumping to the center of the arena, the Radish King will pre-bury multiple explosive mini-radish traps. Players who are dragged and pass through the traps will trigger an area explosion and leave behind burning scorched earth.

[Desperate Support]: The sword-wielding mini-radishes pursue more fiercely. The team must precisely guide the mini-radishes to cut the vines while avoiding traps and fire zones. Any mistake could lead to casualties.
Legacy of Divine Refining: Flame-Thunder Blade General | Challenge Guide
Echoes of Burning Mountain: Ruin-Stationed Mysterious Guardian | Challenge Guide
Three-school Showdown: Wanshu Hammer | Enhanced Guide

Manhu, the leader of the rogue 'Broken Gate' faction who once terrorized the mountains, has unveiled an experimental shield looted from the Institute of Mechanics after his initial defeat. His savage strength, augmented by mechanical arts, is now even more terrifying as he vows to crush all challengers.

[Mechanical Shield Charge]: When Manhu charges with his shield, the shield has its own health bar. Players must focus fire to break it and paralyze him; otherwise, the final, undodgeable red-glow charge will deal devastating damage.

[Earth-Shaking Slam]: After charging, Manhu immediately leaps to the center of the arena and slams the ground repeatedly, creating a full-screen shockwave attack. Only by picking up the dropped Mechanical Heavy Shield can you block it; jumping or dodging will be of no use.

Lord Botu is a cold hunter who has fallen into the dream. He comes wrapped in darkness, vowing to drag this dream into total destruction.\n\n[Deepest Nightmare]: Lord Botu summons a deep darkness that devours everything. The bright area around the Nightmare Light Platform can protect players from the continuous erosion of the darkness. Only by finding the two Nightmare Feather Guards that appear in the darkness, defeating them to seize the Nightmare Light, and successfully escorting it to the Nightmare Light Platform to light it up, can the darkness be dispelled and force him to appear.
Legacy of Divine Refining: Bifang | Hard Guide

The Fence King dominates the will of the Fence tribe with an overbearing presence. The scepter it wields symbolizes royal authority, used both to ruthlessly enslave its weak subjects and to fiercely repel invading enemies.

[Vine Bind]: The Fence King releases vines to bind all players and summons Fence Spearmen to charge across the field. Break free from the vines quickly to avoid the attack.

[Spirit Absorption Giantization]: The Fence King absorbs the life force of nearby small Fences, causing its body to swell rapidly and become covered in an indestructible thorn armor. During this time, Bombing Guards will appear on the sidelines to throw fire bombs. You must pick up the fire bombs and throw them at the Fence King's armor to gradually dismantle its defenses; otherwise, its power will continue to grow along with its size until it crushes everyone.
Three-school Showdown: Savage Tiger | Hard Guide

This lost war machine is the ultimate expression of the ancient craftsmen's theory of 'Ice and Fire Coexistence.' Red and blue energy flows and intertwines within its barrels. \n \n[Frostfire Break]: The Frostfire Guard fires a cold current, trapping one or two players in ice pillars, while firing homing molten missiles at the others. You must lure the missiles to break the ice pillars and save your teammates, otherwise, the missiles will hit you and cause continuous burning.

The two berserk powers of the Flame-Thunder Blade General are nearly unbalanced. It attempts to bring down thunder that annihilates everything; only by using its own power against it can you break the deadlock.\n\n[Thunder Meteor Sword Formation]: The Flame-Thunder Blade General flies into the air to accumulate destructive thunder and rains down dense thunder swords on the players. Players must destroy the falling thunder swords while avoiding attacks, pick them up, and throw them back to knock the General out of the air.

The Heavenly Fiend Casting, having unleashed its full origin, has become a natural disaster itself. The stars swirl endlessly in its hands, bringing incomparable destructive power.

[Absolute Fiend Meteor]: The disaster meteorites appearing now are empowered by the Disaster Star origin. Their stability is greatly increased, requiring players to exert more powerful attacks to shatter them.

[Cosmic Vortex Storm]: The rotation speed of the starlight walls has become extremely fast, and the safe gaps vanish in an instant. Consequently, the pressure of tracking the constellation shadows has also increased significantly, posing a great test to the team's output and coordination.
Legacy of Divine Refining: Bifang | Challenge Guide
Legacy of Divine Refining: Bronze Fish Mechanism | Hard Guide

The Armored Rat King has been nourished by cloud currents for years. It is massive with thick, hard armor, and it sneaks into the fields to steal grain during village festivals.\n\n[Nut Lure]: The Armored Rat King summons multiple small Armored Rats to roll around and cause chaos. One of them carries a special nut; defeat it to leave the nut on the field. The Armored Rat King then pulls all players closer and binds two of them with resonance vines (the bound players are silenced, and if they move too far apart, they are pulled back). Other teammates must pick up the nut to lure the King into charging. The two players connected by the vines must pull in opposite directions to use the vines as a tripwire to trip the charging giant rat.

Bronze automatons forged in the likeness of swimming fish, they have patrolled the ruins alone for a thousand years, using long cries and sharp teeth to drive away any intruders coveting their treasures.\n\n[Heavy Cannon Armor-Piercing]: Operate the mechanical turrets in the arena to continuously attack, and use the turret shields to defend against the mechanical copper fish's scale barrages. Sustained bombardment will break the mechanical copper fish's resilience, causing this giant fish to crash to the ground and fall into a brief state of malfunction.
Legacy of Divine Refining: Bronze Fish Mechanism | Normal Guide

A Bronze Axe General that has been dormant since its creation to fulfill its duty of protection. It awakens among the rubble, its only directive inscribed on its bronze body: expel all intruders.

[Lost Reinforcements]: The Bronze Axe General summons two Lost Cannons to fight alongside it; these should be cleared first.

[Rock Shield Formation]: The Bronze Axe General deploys a shield in the center of the arena and summons stone pillars at the four corners. It then cycles through targeting a single player or all players. Everyone must use the stone pillars as cover to hide, then work together to push the pillars over onto the Bronze Axe General to break its shield and stun it.

The Ruin-Guarding Mystic Sentinel has awakened ancient constructs buried deep underground, triggering a joint siege.

[Lost Pursuers]: Lost Artillery will prioritize bombarding the Burning Mountain Pivot; players must immediately draw their fire.

[Corroded Clamp]: Lost Clamps will hinder player movement; you must split your forces to clear them. Please defeat the Ruin-Guarding Mystic Sentinel as quickly as possible amidst these multiple interferences.

Scorch-Fuzz no longer underestimates its opponents and will unleash its true kingly flames. The power of the sea of fire is enough to incinerate everything, compressing the prey's living space to the limit.

[Burning Hell]: Ground fire damage is significantly increased; even brief contact can be fatal.
[Desperate Pillar Dance]: The number of stone pillars rising on the field has decreased, and they collapse faster. The team must make precise movement decisions within an extremely tight timeframe.

Manhu, the leader of the rogue 'Broken Gate' faction who once terrorized the mountains, tramples upon the martial code with his bronze-sinewed limbs and iron claws. He has infiltrated the venue of the Three Academies' tournament, attempting to crush this grand event with brute force to prove that destruction is the only true 'strength'.

[Brutal Charge]: Manhu raises his shield and locks onto a player, charging repeatedly. The target must adjust their position to avoid hitting teammates, while others can seize the opportunity to attack Manhu's back. The final charge is a red-glow skill; dodge it in time.

[Earth-Shattering Thunder]: Manhu leaps to the center of the arena and slams the ground repeatedly, creating spreading shockwaves. Players can jump or dodge to avoid them. The final strike is a red-glow skill; pay extra attention.
Three-school Showdown: Wanshu Hammer | Challenge Guide

The Dream Demon of Painted Shadows has created more variables for groundless nightmares, making illusions and creations increasingly chaotic.

[Dream Demon Frenzy]: The Dream Demon of Painted Shadows summons more Nightmare Butterflies, but their defense is reduced. Additionally, all bosses' attack power and HP are increased.
Other additional affixes may make the Dream Demon's mechanics more threatening, such as extra hypnosis skills, increased Nightmare Butterfly HP, or strengthening all bosses.

Prioritize clearing the Nightmare Butterflies quickly and be careful to avoid the high damage from the Dream Demon of Painted Shadows!
