text: Echoes of Burning Mountain: Relic Ice-Fire Guardian | Hard Guide

The starving King Armadillo has brought out his true skills. The summoned Armadillos are stronger and more durable, and the effective duration of the Nut Bait is significantly reduced.\n\n[Desperate Grain Guard]: The Armadillos' HP is significantly increased, requiring more firepower to clear quickly. Meanwhile, the lure range of the nuts shrinks rapidly after landing. The coordination between the nut-holder and the vine-pulling teammate must be millisecond-perfect; any delay could lead to a failed trap and a lost granary.

Scorch-Fuzz is the leader of a beast herd that has become king through many battles. This beast breathes seas of flames, its claws are like blades, and it enjoys teasing its prey with fire. Where its red figure stands is a realm of eternal flame.

[Crimson Burning Field]: Scorch-Fuzz breathes scorching flames, turning the entire field into a sea of fire. Friendly wooden fences will rise in sequence around the field.
[Flame Pillar Dance]: Players must jump onto the stone pillars in time to avoid the ground flames. After the fire-breathing ends, Scorch-Fuzz will enter a state of exhaustion, which is the best time to go all out.

The spirit of the Calamity Blade is forged with fiery courage, while the spirit of the Lone Halberd is forged with mountain-like resilience. Both appear amidst the disaster, solely to uphold the duty of the Divine Smith.\n\n【Fire Shield Charge】: The Calamity Blade spirit will lock onto a player and charge, while the Lone Halberd spirit activates a fire shield in the center of the arena. The player must lure the Calamity Blade spirit to charge into the fire shield three consecutive times to break it; otherwise, they will suffer massive full-screen damage.

The Megadrive Hammer is the ultimate creation of the Academy's "Extreme Exploration" philosophy. It uses unprecedentedly tough materials to push load-bearing limits, and its deceptively simple design ensures that every strike carries the power to crush mountains.\n\n[Hammer Shockwave]: The Megadrive Hammer charges up and releases a full-screen shockwave. One player must quickly pick up a mechanical shield dropped on the field to block the attack, while others hide behind the shield-bearer. The shockwave will erupt twice in succession, so adjust your positioning accordingly.
Dream Demon of Painted Shadows Strategy

The core energy of the Ice-Fire Sentinel is losing balance, pushing its combat instincts to the limit. \n \n[Ice-Fire Consumption]: Players trapped in ice pillars will suffer from biting cold, continuously losing HP, and take heavy damage from an ice explosion when the freezing ends. Guiding molten missiles to save them is urgent.

The Savage Tiger, having fully unleashed its ancient demon bloodline, has lost its sanity. The baleful energy boiling within its body grants it even more formidable strength and defense, making it look like an ancient beast reborn.

[Baleful Shield Charge]: The Savage Tiger's shield value increases significantly during its charge. The team must focus fire to deal massive damage to break it.

[Earth-Shattering Slam]: After charging, the Savage Tiger immediately leaps into the center of the arena and slams the ground repeatedly, creating a full-screen shockwave attack. Only by picking up the dropped mechanical heavy shield can you block it; jumping or dodging will be of no use.

The Ruin-Guarding Mystic Sentinel is a giant bronze construct forged by ancient craftsmen. Shaped like a roof ridge, it crushes all intruders with immense force.\n\n[Bronze March]: This giant construct locks onto the Burning Mountain Pivot as its target, relentlessly advancing on its limbs, and will continuously attack the pivot upon arrival until it is destroyed. Players must do everything in their power to stop its advance.

The gluttonous Armored Rat King has summoned stronger allies to steal the food! The Elite Armored Rats are agile, with more devious interference and charging tactics. One wrong move and you'll be knocked flat!\n\n[Frenzied Rat Charge]: In addition to the original mechanics, an Elite Armored Rat will appear in the arena, repeatedly charging along a fixed path. If the nut-carrier is hit, the nut will be dropped. A player must be assigned to intercept the elite and clear out the rolling small rats, or the formation will easily be disrupted.

source_text: 平坑填海莱菔大王攻略

text: Echoes of Burning Mountain: Ruin-Stationed Mysterious Guardian | Hard Guide

The relentless harassment has ignited Bifang's mania, and its attacks are as dense as a storm.

[Blazing Thunder Strike]: The scorching lightning bolts will become four consecutive strikes, slamming into the ground more frequently and urgently, posing a severe test for arena positioning.

[Rising Fury]: Shortens the interval between lightning strikes and capture attempts, giving players almost no chance to catch their breath.

The mechanism core has gone completely berserk, summoning four abandoned turrets to fight alongside it at the start.

[Thunder Array]: The stone pillars are indestructible under the blessing of thunder; players must work together to break them before they can be toppled. Meanwhile, the General's charge and destructive beam will be accompanied by large-scale lightning strikes across the field.

[Twin Abyssal Terrors]: The Ruin Guardians will be awakened and join the battle. During this time, the Bronze Halberd General will intermittently trigger unavoidable ground-shaking sparks across the field. Players must quickly defeat the Ruin Guardians under the dual pressure of lightning storms and sparks.

The Ruin-Guarding Mystic Sentinel's protective instincts have been fully triggered, making its advance even more resolute, with every step shaking the earth.\n\n[Relentless Advance]: It ignores all interference and charges toward the Burning Mountain Pivot. Unlike the basic challenge, its pace is faster, significantly shortening the time players have to intercept it.
Three-school Showdown: Savage Tiger | Enhanced Guide

The balance between ice and fire has been completely shattered, and the mechanism reveals a cataclysmic, apocalyptic form. \n \n【Sky-Falling Cold Abyss】: The Relic Ice-Fire Guardian leaps into the air, pouring a massive amount of icicles across the arena. If not cleared in time, the icicles will detonate in a chain reaction, covering the entire field. After pouring the icicles, the Relic Ice-Fire Guardian becomes briefly stunned due to excessive energy consumption—this is the perfect moment to finish it off.

In the advanced challenge, the Twin Casting Spirits deploy tacit tactical coordination. Their swift clone surprise attacks are hard to guard against, and only by relying on keen insight can you find a strategy to defeat the enemy.

[Phantom Charge]: The Blade Casting Spirit will split into four phantom clones, locking onto different players to charge.

[Precision Guidance]: The Halberd Casting Spirit's fire shield is still on the field. Four players must accurately identify and guide their respective clones to crash into the fire shield, while staying dispersed to avoid overlapping paths.

The Mechanical Bronze Fish attempts to destroy the artillery batteries the challenger relies on for counterattacks, dragging the battle into a brutal war of attrition.

[Desperate Battery]: The number of operable mechanical turrets is reduced to two, and the Mechanical Bronze Fish will focus its fire on the turrets, damaging them until they are completely paralyzed.

[Repairing the Magazine]: You must defeat the abandoned mechanisms that constantly emerge in the field, obtain the repair kits they drop, and transport them to the turrets for emergency repairs. If the repaired turrets are continuously maintained, their firepower will be further enhanced.

The one-legged bronze giant bird, carrying an undying obsession, guards this long-capsized treasure ship.

[Blazing Thunder Triple]: Bi Fang selects three players to drop scorching lightning, forming lightning circles on the ground. If the circles overlap, they will explode violently and permanently expand their range. After a while, all lightning circles will spread on their own, significantly compressing the survival space.

[Azure Flame Seize]: Bi Fang swoops down and grabs a player with its sharp claws. Companions must immediately rescue them with all their might, otherwise, Bi Fang will pour its rage onto the entire field.
Legacy of Divine Refining: Bronze Fish Mechanism | Challenge Guide

Driven to a dead end, the Wood-Fence King frantically demands power from its subjects. Its body becomes indestructible, and its violent power is enough to shatter mountains and break cliffs.

[Ancient Bastion]: The thorn armor covering the Wood-Fence King's torso becomes exceptionally tough, requiring more fire bombs to break.

[Fury Drain]: The Wood-Fence King's attack power rises rapidly during its giant form. The team must intercept and throw fire bombs with high efficiency; any delay will cause the survival space to deteriorate rapidly.

The Megadrive Hammer's mechanical core overloads during advanced challenges, pushing its performance to the limit and creating a precise killing formation through teleportation and multi-angle strikes.

[Triple Shockwave]: The Megadrive Hammer releases three consecutive full-screen shockwaves. Before each, it teleports to the edge of the arena, with each shockwave facing a different direction.

[Shield Synergy]: Each player enters a cooldown after blocking with the shield. Teammates must take turns picking up the shield to handle the continuous attacks from random directions.
Legacy of Divine Refining: Flame-Thunder Blade General | Hard Guide

The Dream Demon of Painted Shadows is the embodiment of darkness in the dream. Now, its ambition has expanded, twisting everyone's dreams into a disaster.

[Three-Phase Illusion]: The Dream Demon of Painted Shadows cycles between wolf, bear, and human forms, each with unique combat tactics.

[Nightmare Seizure]: When in bear or human form, it summons Nightmare Butterflies to snatch a player and fly toward a Nightmare Rift. Teammates must shoot down the butterflies in time, or a devastating explosion will be triggered upon falling into the rift.

The Twin Spirit Forgers are one in mind and spirit. They dominate the battlefield with seamless coordination; any minor mistake will trigger a complete energy runaway.\n\n[Desperate Fire Shield]: The charges initiated by the four phantom clones of the Jie Blade Spirit Forger must all be guided into the Fire Shield of the Guji Spirit Forger. Any mistake will lead to a failure to break the shield, putting the team's precision and coordination to the ultimate test.

Facing strong enemies, the Radish King decides to use all its might. The thorn armor wrapped around its body is unbreakable; perhaps only the self-detonating radishes of the same origin can defeat it.

[Stubborn Plant Protection]: While dragging a teammate, the Radish King generates sturdy thorn armor. Although the small radishes with knives can cut the vines, they cannot break the armor.

[Scorched Earth Barrier Break]: Rescued players must guide the inactive self-detonating radishes on the field to collide with the Radish King, or lure it into the burning ground left behind. Only through continuous burning can its armor be gradually dismantled; otherwise, the armor will remain.
Dream Demon of Painted Shadows Strategy

As the core accelerates, the ancient bronze body resonates with the remaining thunder power in the ruins, making the attacks increasingly fierce.\n\n[Thunderous Formation]: The stone pillars are heavy, and the time required to push them down together is significantly increased. The Qingyue General's attacks also become extremely violent, accompanied by lightning strikes.
Legacy of Divine Refining: Flame-Thunder Blade General | Normal Guide
Echoes of Burning Mountain: Relic Ice-Fire Guardian | Challenge Guide

The Flame-Thunder Blade General's offensive becomes more violent, switching between fire and thunder at shorter intervals.

[Scorching Wave Peaks]: The frequency, quantity, and power of the fire blade light are significantly increased, and the living space is drastically compressed.
[Angry Flame Rapid Burn]: After performing the fire combo slash, it will recover its actions at a faster speed and launch the next round of attacks.
Echoes of Burning Mountain: Relic Ice-Fire Guardian | Normal Guide

Deadly Void energy condenses around you; only by becoming each other's salvation can you survive.

[Void Orb]: Periodically, a rotating Void Orb will spawn near the player. It can only be cleared by another player touching it. If it is not cleared within a certain time, the Void Orb will self-destruct, dealing massive area damage.
Additional modifiers may cause the Void Orb to deal more damage, be harder to clear, or respawn faster.

Coordinate with your teammates to quickly clear everyone's Void Orbs!

text:
The shadow follows silently; every injury deepens its corruption. Only precise counterattacks can tear through the shadow.

[Shadow Value]: Taking damage accumulates Shadow Value. Once full, it triggers an explosion, causing damage and stun to yourself. Successfully countering red-light attacks reduces Shadow Value.
Other additional affixes may make Shadow Value accumulate faster, harder to remove, or deal more damage.

Avoid accumulating Shadow Value and counter red-light attacks to reduce it!

A genius of spirit-casting lost in ancient times, they summon golden radiance to fend off enemies with precise and lethal stellar arts.

[Star Vortex Strike]: The Tiansha Spirit-Caster returns to the center of the arena to channel stellar power, summoning five constellations that orbit them. Players must quickly shatter all star nodes to interrupt the chant. Success will cause the spirit to dissipate; failure will result in a screen-wide Starfall attack.

[Heavenly Barrier Shift]: The Tiansha Spirit-Caster summons five hidden constellation shadows and drives four rotating walls of starlight. There are gaps in the walls for escape; players must nimbly weave through them to find and shatter all the hidden constellation shadows.
Three-school Showdown: Savage Tiger | Challenge Guide

Lord Botu hunts ruthlessly in the darkness, and the only hope in the darkness also hides a dangerous price. 
 
[Botu's Hunt]: The erosion effect of the darkness in the Deepest Nightmare is greatly increased. The Nightmare Light Platform will appear at random locations, and players escorting the Nightmare Light will continuously lose their maximum HP. In addition, all bosses' attack and defense are increased. 
Other additional entries may make the Deepest Nightmare deal more damage, make the Nightmare Light more threatening, or strengthen all bosses and cause barrage attacks. 
 
Pay attention to rotation when escorting the Nightmare Light! Beware of Lord Botu's high damage.
Echoes of Burning Mountain: Azure Axe Casting General | Normal Guide
Echoes of Burning Mountain: Ruin-Stationed Mysterious Guardian | Normal Guide

The Radish King reigns supreme, its power shaking all directions. It carries a kitchen knife on its shoulder with a cold glint; its behavior seems mischievous but hides murderous intent, vowing to defend the dignity of the Radish clan through battle.

[Command Vine Bind]: The Radish King jumps to the center of the arena, knocking back all players, then blows a horn to bind three players with vines and drag them toward itself. Players pulled in front of the Radish King will suffer a fatal slash.

[Ground-Walking Swordsman]: Sword-wielding mini-radishes appear on the sidelines, burrowing to pursue unbound players. You must guide the mini-radishes' slashes to cut the vines to save your teammates.
Legacy of Divine Refining: Bifang | Normal Guide

The enraged Heavenly Evil Spirit begins to stir up more violent star currents. Amidst precise spell manipulation, murderous intent emerges; one wrong step leads to disaster.

[Star Ring Burst]: The Heavenly Evil Spirit returns to the field to charge and summons five constellation rings that rotate, while also releasing three layers of expanding ring-shaped area damage. Players must break the constellation nodes while dodging continuous ground fire.

[Star-Shattering Soul Chase]: In the second phase, the wall rotation accelerates, and the Heavenly Evil Spirit will lock onto each player to generate three tracking energy orbs that continuously pursue them, severely disrupting movement paths. The team must find gaps in the walls to break the hidden constellation shadows while avoiding the energy orb attacks.

The Wood-Fence Kin, who share a psychic bond with the Wood-Fence King, have fallen into a frenzy and are sworn to protect their kin and king. They carry deadly traps, forcing players to make precise counterattacks within a limited time.

[Explosive Swarm]: When they grow giant, they will spawn self-destructing Wood-Fences at each player's feet. You must move away immediately.

[Burning Shield Deadline]: The fire bombs thrown by the Bombardment Guards will explode shortly after hitting the ground. Players must pick them up and throw them at the Wood-Fence King within the time limit, or they will lose the critical window to break its armor.

Bifang has turned its obsession with protection into indiscriminate destruction. It deploys an invisible shield made of scorching lightning and begins a cold, endless cleanup cycle.

[Endless Sky-Thunder]: Bifang enters a shielded state and calls down lightning on all players in sequence. It then begins a cycle of random captures; every successful capture means a devastating blow.

[Thunderbreak]: The only way to survive lies in the sealed turrets at the four corners of the arena. You must lure Bifang's lightning to hit the turrets to activate them, then operate the turrets to bombard the shield.

The Mechanical Bronze Fish falls into a rage, all ruin mechanisms are activated, and the barrage is as dense as a raging sea.

[Armor-Cracking Tide]: More abandoned Fire-Splitter Armors join the battlefield, attacking from multiple sides.

[Raging Tide]: The Mechanical Bronze Fish's scale barrage becomes faster and more unpredictable, testing the player's precision in operating the turrets and the timing of shield activation.

A mechanical warrior wielding a scorching blade, relentlessly fulfilling its destiny of combat with high-temperature strikes that melt everything in their path.

[Blazing Blade Curtain]: The Flame-form Flame-Thunder God Blade leaps to one side of the arena, continuously unleashing waves of fire that cover the entire field. Use the falling flame hilts to block.

[Flame-Forged Thunder Soldiers]: Hilts shattered by the blade waves transform into thunder swords that track the player. Cleverly guiding the direction of these thunder swords can deal heavy damage to the Flame-Thunder God Blade.

The enraged Scorching Velvet spits out fierce flames, its sea-of-fire offensive becoming increasingly turbulent, testing the team's coordination and anticipation amidst the blaze.

[Flame Array]: All stone pillars will rise simultaneously; each pillar will collapse after bearing pressure for a moment.

[Covenant of Dance]: The team must act in unison to transfer sequentially, efficiently utilizing every stone pillar within the limited time. Any member lagging behind may disrupt the overall rhythm, leading to casualties.

You find a disciple's training record written by an unknown author on the shelves of He & Ming's Training Hall. What secret does it hold?

Dr. Lychill is the perfect guide, showing you every creative exhibit with practiced grace. But which invention is hers? The aromatherapy? The broom? Or the massage device? No, it's that uniquely flavored dessert! If you thought you had her figured out, think again.

In Qingyi Pavilion, Master Fuzi is tossing the wok with gusto, while you wait expectantly as his food critic. "Lesson of Love," "Growing Pains"... surely the dishes would be packed with flavor, just as the names brim with meaning!  \n \nYou watch the students dig in, see their expressions change... Well, everyone has their strengths, and even the great Master Fuzi has a few things he's not quite so skilled at.
Someone stole the desserts from a Gourmet in Enlightenment Plaza! But no thief can escape the watchful eyes of General Mulan.
Another student from the School of Sorcery is lost in the Dreamscape. Master Zhuangzi has been called in to resolve the crisis...

With the deadline looming, you witnessed an uncharacteristically assertive Sun Bin pressing a reluctant Master Mozi to begin reviewing the academy's budget. Facing the array of wonderful inventions and creative ideas... you suddenly understand Master Mozi's procrastination. Imagination is limitless, but funds are not. Who could bear to snuff out these wild sparks of inspiration?

Strong! Bold! Unstoppable! Master Fuzi's bodybuilding contest is all about showcasing beauty in every form. Muscular physiques? Check. Gorgeous hair? Of course. Giant mechanical contraptions... why not! At this festival of self-expression, anyone can stand out in their own unique way.

Who would've thought? Turns out Master Fuzi is the heart of Jixia's rumor mill. From grand events to household drama, he's privy to everything and never hesitant about sharing. Naturally, no gossip session would be complete without him! Get ready as Master Fuzi takes the stage and regales everyone with the juiciest inside scoops.

Since joining the Team of Stars, you've heard stories about Mr. Luban and No. 7. The stack of missing person notices carries the weight of a father's heartache. Stubbornly, in his own way, he's never stopped searching for his lost child. But what's lost can be found. Just like the loudspeaker recovered with everyone's help, two connected hearts are sure to reunite one day.
Meng Ya was stopped by the Discipline Dog at Upstream Camp! Did he get into trouble again?
Master Zhuangzi says he's waiting for two people in Dragon Valley. Vlinder is already here—when will the other one arrive?
Sun Bin and Luban are putting up missing-person flyers in Enlightenment Plaza. Maybe you can lend them a hand.

There's always something new in Frostcloud Town... like the claw machine testing Meng Ya's patience. After narrowly missing the gold egg (which would grant him the Team of Stars plush) for the umpteenth time, he finally turns to you for help.  \n \nJust flip the joystick and watch the claw snap, simple as that. But if the gold egg slips away again... would he actually blow the thing to bits?

Master Zhuangzi drifts between dreams and waking. He notices the anxiety Vlinder hides beneath her pride and the exhaustion you conceal with your brilliance. With him, there is a quiet walk, a deep sleep, and gentle, attentive care—soft and nourishing like spring rain.
Three Herb Packs (Part One): In Progress

Some students are just too enthusiastic about "revamping" the Discipline Dog. Like Meng Ya, brandishing his Mechcraft tools, or Novar, who sneaked in a few new features. Unfortunately, their ambitious project was soon cut short by the righteous Sun Bin. Perhaps the doggo could use some upgrades? But watching Sun Bin's earnest admonition, you quietly let the idea drop.
Fuzi is stepping in as today's chef at Qingyi Pavilion! Head to Darkpool Camp to sample his brand-new secret recipes.
The Case of the Missing Dessert: Complete

The Gourmet's dessert has vanished into thin air! Who perpetuated this appalling heist? Fortunately, with General Mulan and you on the case, the culprit would not get away scot-free. Through observation and tracking, the suspect's trail became clear. At last, you found the stolen sweets—and a small Mechanoid, collapsed from drained power.

Master Mozi is esteemed for his finesse with Mechcraft, while the disciples of Roaring Tiger Training Hall are equally renowned for their rough handling of teaching tools. Novar and Shye are endorsing a beverage shop in Aerux Town? Now you're curious what their drinks taste like.

Master Fuzi always wears a kind smile. Only when you stumbled upon him angling alone did you notice the age etched into the lines on his face. He invited you to sit, reminiscing about days gone by and a close friend now estranged. The fish never bit, and that old friend would never sit by his side again.

text:
In the shelter, our bodies survived, but we were cut off from sunlight, time, and the rest of the world. 
 
Many of us feared we'd never see home again. 
 
My friends and I gathered scattered relics and, through the power of the Sanctified Enchanters, forged them into a treasure for those yet to come. 
 
We carved three stone tablets to bear witness. 
 
One day, the treasure will resurface, but the time we lost can never be reclaimed.
zh_text:
自入避难所，虽得以保全性命，但未见日升日落，已不知地上年月。 
 
众人皆悲叹不已，恐再无归乡之日。 
 
我与友人集各方珍宝，借神铸异士之力合为珍宝，以诱后人发现。 
 
已刻三方石碑，记我辈避难工舍故事，后人观览即可知全貌。 
 
宝藏有重现之日，离人无再少之年。

Finally, we went to Yu Huan's shop where I ordered a dish that looked mild but was actually very spicy just to prank her. She ended up drinking water while hitting me. That night, when I was about to let her stay in my female classmate's dorm, she told me she didn't need to and then turned into a Croaky and ran into the forest. That's when I woke up.

text:
We left our home with anxiety. 
 
Despite the help from the academy that ensured our basic needs were met, the elders were heartbroken and the children wept, for they had to leave their homes with an uncertain future. 
 
While the underground cave offered a dim light, it could never compare to the sunlight above. 
 
I often recall the spring breeze over the riverbanks and the autumn leaves covering the distant mountains—such beautiful scenes still linger in my mind. Yet, after living in the cave for so long, I fear that one day I will forget them. 
 
So I carve these words into stone, so that when I finally leave the cave, I can remember the feelings of this day.
zh_text:
自入天柱下，众人忧心忡忡。 
 
虽有学院诸君相助，衣食住行无虞，但背井离乡，前路未卜，老者心伤，童子垂泪。 
 
天柱虽有幽兰微光，然不可与天光媲美。 
 
每忆春风抚溪原，秋叶罩远山种种盛景，尚在眼前。但久居深洞，恐怕迟早有忘却之时。 
 
且刻于石上，待有离洞之日，可回忆今日所感。

text:
It was my first time stepping into the Dreamrealm. Although Master Zhuangzi had often urged me to seek answers within my own dreams, I still lacked the courage to face them directly. 
 
But this dream was too strange—like a dagger thrust straight into my heart. In the end, it was something no one else could help me with. 
 
Still, I was fortunate this time. The three of them happened to be at my side. Perhaps, when I was bound by nightmares, they could lend me their strength once more. 
 
Yet things did not unfold as expected. Not long after we entered the Dreamy Grotto, the shadows thickened, and a voice began to stir. 
 
Only I could hear the hazy whispers hidden in the smoke. Louder, louder—the fear left my legs weak. Meanwhile, the other three walked on as if nothing had happened, leaving me behind. 
 
I used every ounce of strength to chase after them, following the path they had taken, but I could never catch up. All I could do was wander, lost within the grotto. 
 
At last, I reached the grotto’s depths. There, a solitary figure sat on a rock, arms wrapped around her knees. At the sound of my footsteps, she lifted her head. Her clear eyes sent a jolt of confusion and unease through me. 
 
So this was the fabled Fine Dream Emissary... 
 
She, too, looked surprised. For a moment she stared blankly, before her gaze softened—there was even a touch of... pity? 
 
I tried to speak, to ask about the nightmares that bound me so tightly. But no sound would leave my throat. 
 
She rose slowly, spreading her wings with a gentle grace. Then she spoke: “Dreamer, the one who can untangle the cause and effect of your dreams is already by your side. But the truth is too cruel for you as you are now. I only wish the nights of Jixia were an endless dream from which we’d never wake. Yet when dawn arrives, all dreams dissolve into dew, vanishing without a trace...” 
 
“Please... forgive me...” 
 
Faint light from the grotto drifted across her wings, reminding me of the lonely moon that hung over Wei Commandery skies, and the lullabies I once heard in childhood. My consciousness began to drift away... 
 
When I opened my eyes again, I saw the familiar faces of my three companions. I never knew why Kongming’s clothes were drenched, or why Zhou Yu’s hair looked singed by flame, or why Yango wore an expression of quiet happiness... 
 
It was a rare, peaceful sleep. 
But still... the truth behind my nightmares remained beyond reach.
zh_text:
这是我第一次踏入梦域，虽然庄周老师多次建议我自己去梦中寻找答案，但我还是不敢去直面它。 
 
但这梦实在是过于离奇又像一柄尖刀直刺我的内心，终究是无法求助别人。 
 
也好，这次凑巧这三个家伙在身旁，希望他们能在我被噩梦缠身的时候再帮我一把吧。 
 
但是始料未及的是刚进入绮梦窟不久，阴霾渐浓，一个声音逐渐响起。 
 
只有我一个人能听到烟雾中隐藏着朦胧的低语，声音越来越大，恐惧让我感到两腿发软。其余三人只是自顾自的走开了…… 
 
我拼尽全力沿着三人离开的方向追赶，却怎也找不到，只能在洞窟中四处打转。 
 
当我来到绮梦窟最深处，只看到一个落寞的身影坐在双手抱膝坐在石头上，听到我的脚步声她也抬起了头，清澈的眼眸让我内心感到了一阵慌乱。 
 
这就是传说中的美梦使者…… 
 
她似乎也有点惊讶，怔怔的看着我，稍后眼神变得柔和起来，甚至有几分……怜惜？ 
 
我想要张口发问，关于那些缠绕我的噩梦究竟是怎么回事，却发现我根本无法发出声音， 
 
她缓缓站起身，轻轻地舒展开羽翼。然后说道：“梦者，解开梦中因果之人就在你的身边。但这答案对于现在的你来说过于残酷。多希望稷下的夜晚是个永不会醒来的无尽长梦，但当梦醒时分，这一切会化为一滴朝露，随着黎明的到来而消失无踪……” 
 
“请你……原谅……” 
 
洞中微弱的荧光撒在她羽翼上，让我想起魏郡天空中孤悬的明月，耳畔响起了童年的歌谣……我的意识逐渐飘向远方…… 
 
再次睁开眼，面前还是那三个家伙熟悉的脸，虽然不知道为什么诸葛亮的衣服湿透了，周瑜的头发好像被火燎过一样，至于元歌，不知为何看起来很幸福…… 
 
久违的安眠，可惜……还是没有获得噩梦背后的答案。

I used every ounce of strength to chase after them, following the path they had taken, but I could never catch up. All I could do was wander, lost within the grotto. 
 
At last, I reached the grotto’s depths. There, a solitary figure sat on a rock, arms wrapped around her knees. At the sound of my footsteps, she lifted her head. Her clear eyes sent a jolt of confusion and unease through me. 
 
So this was the fabled Fine Dream Emissary... 
 
She, too, looked surprised. For a moment she stared blankly, before her gaze softened—there was even a touch of... pity? 
 
I tried to speak, to ask about the nightmares that bound me so tightly. But no sound would leave my throat. 
 
She rose slowly, spreading her wings with a gentle grace. Then she spoke: “Dreamer, the one who can untangle the cause and effect of your dreams is already by your side. But the truth is too cruel for you as you are now. I only wish the nights of Jixia were an endless dream from which we’d never wake. Yet when dawn arrives, all dreams dissolve into dew, vanishing without a trace...” 
 
“Please... forgive me...” 
 
Faint light from the grotto drifted across her wings, reminding me of the lonely moon that hung over Wei Commandery skies, and the lullabies I once heard in childhood. My consciousness began to drift away... 
 
When I opened my eyes again, I saw the familiar faces of my three companions. I never knew why Kongming’s clothes were drenched, or why Zhou Yu’s hair looked singed by flame, or why Yango wore an expression of quiet happiness... 
 
It was a rare, peaceful sleep. 
But still... the truth behind my nightmares remained beyond reach.

Dear Master Mozi, 
 
Perhaps you don't remember me. My name is Luo Anmin. I studied at Jixia years ago and was fortunate enough to attend your lectures. 
 
I now own a Craftworks in Chang'an. Recently, my wife had an accident... She fell from a height and will never walk again. 
 
She was born into a family of martial artists and has always been fond of swords and weapons. Now, with this unexpected change... It sounds pathetic, but I often cry over this, while she comforts me instead. 
 
I suddenly wondered, if medicine cannot help, could your unparalleled Mechcraft skills give my wife new legs? 
 
I am willing to pay with all I have for her treatment. I look forward to your response. 
 
Luo Anmin

text:
Mysterious Music at Joy Pool 
 
Recently, there have been many rumors about a strange melody coming from Joy Pool. 
 
Years ago, I was lucky enough to hear this beautiful music myself and thought it was just a skilled Musician playing. But now, the melody has returned and become a mystery. I have been searching for clues to find out the truth. 
 
So far, I have found two main theories: One says the melody is a secret tune passed down by a Musician, although no one has actually seen them. The other theory, from a Musician I interviewed near Joy Pool, is that the music comes from a mysterious creature. 
 
However, after spending three nights at Joy Pool, I have not seen any creature making music. The Secrets Club invites everyone to share any clues they have, so together we can solve this mystery and reveal the truth.
zh_text: 乐涧池午夜神秘曲乐：传奇还是现实？ 近来一则有关乐涧池的奇闻传得沸沸扬扬。笔者曾有幸于多年之前亲耳聆听过此天籁之声，原以为那不过是高人即兴所奏，没想到时隔多年之后，此神秘曲乐声再次响起。似幻似真，如今已成为传世之谜。 为解开此事，我亦奔走于村镇窄巷，只为寻找蛛丝马迹。如今得到了两种传言： 其一，有言此般仙乐唯有宫羽家秘传才可临世，不过此事并无人亲眼见证。 其二，在乐涧池一带采访到一位采风的宫羽家，称此为神秘生灵所为。然而笔者蹲守三晚，并未见识到所谓神秘生灵奏乐。 秘闻社呼吁各位能多多提供线索，解开此谜，届时也将公开披露，大白真相。

January 13 
Starting today, the <5ea8f3>Pouncing Jump</> became a routine. I couldn't keep up with today's training load and got punished by Master with cleaning duties after dinner. Ah, I feel like I'm just not cut out for this. 
 
March 5 
I'm getting used to the current training intensity, and I'm actually making pretty good progress, thanks to the senior disciple. Today, I saw a master who came to challenge our Training Hall. The fight between him and Master was intense and thrilling to watch. It turns out Master hasn't even been using a tenth of his strength when training us. 
 
July 8 
Yesterday's spar at another Training Hall left me with a small bruise, nothing serious, and clearly not intentional. I had already put it behind me, but Master hadn't. He left first thing this morning and returned late, heavily bruised. The senior disciples were shocked. Master said he had taught them a lesson, then told me to work harder so I could uphold the Roaring Tiger Training Hall's honor.

从今天开始就要挑战<5ea8f3>飞虎跳</>了，这种强度没能坚持下来，晚饭后就被师父罚去打扫卫生了。哎，感觉自己不是块练武的材料。 
 
三月五日 
差不多已经习惯了当前的训练量，我的进步还是蛮快的。多亏了师兄。今天还看到了前来踢馆的高手，师父和他打得很凶险，看着十分精彩，看来平时练我们根本没用到十分之一的实力。

昨天去挑战别的武馆，不小心受了点小伤，对方也不是故意的，就没在意。结果今天师父非要说给我找回场子，就去那家武馆踢馆了，傍晚回来的时候鼻青脸肿得比我还狼狈，把师兄们吓了一跳，但是他咧着嘴笑着跟我说把那个武馆教训得很惨，我也要努力修炼不给师父和虎啸堂丢脸。

text:
After many setbacks, I finally neutralized the side effects of the Mechcraft exoskeleton. But to keep greedy eyes away, I’ve publicly declared the project a failure. 
 
All further work must proceed in secret. To simplify the design and make it practical, the research has been refocused into assistive Mechcraft prosthetics. 
 
Once Luo Anmin’s commission is fulfilled, we can move into limited mass production of prosthetics for various parts of the body. Distribution will be handled by me alone, to ensure they never fall into the wrong hands. 
 
If those who come after uncover the secrets of this place, I beg you—tell no one. Only the bearer of this letter is authorized to access the control console; press the switch within, and my findings will remain concealed. 
 
Peace was hard-won. Think carefully before you act, and do not let the embers of war spread through the world again.
zh_text:
几经波折，终于成功消除了机关外骨骼的副作用。但为了躲开那些别有用心之人的觊觎，我不得不对外宣称研究失败。

后续研究需秘密进行，为简化外形与方便使用，研究课题升级为助残机关义肢。

在完成洛安民的委托后，可投入量产各个身体部位的助残义肢，由我统一发放，定不会让其落入恶人之手。

若有后人知晓此地秘辛，还请勿要声张，持此信笺者，方可获取操控台的使用权限，按下其中开关后我的研究成果便会继续隐藏。

如今的和平来之不易，请三思而后行，勿要让战争的火种流传世间。

January 13 
Today, I began training with the <5ea8f3>Pouncing Jump</>. I couldn't handle it and was punished by Master to clean up after dinner. I feel like I'm not cut out for martial arts. 
 
March 5 
I've almost adapted to the current training intensity, and my progress has been quite rapid, thanks to my senior. Today, I witnessed a challenger. Master's fight with him was fierce and exciting, indicating that our usual training barely taps into a tenth of our potential. 
 
July 8 
Yesterday, I challenged another training hall and sustained a minor injury. Neither of us intended to harm, so I didn't make an issue of it. However, today Master insisted on avenging me by challenging that training hall. When he returned in the evening, he was more battered than I was, which shocked my seniors. Yet, he grinned and said he taught that training hall a harsh lesson. I must work hard to honor Master and the Roaring Tiger Training Hall.
zh_text:
一月十三日 
从今天开始就要挑战<5ea8f3>飞虎跳</>了，这种强度没能坚持下来，晚饭后就被师父罚去打扫卫生了。哎，感觉自己不是块练武的材料。 
 
三月五日 
差不多已经习惯了当前的训练量，我的进步还是蛮快的。多亏了师兄。今天还看到了前来踢馆的高手，师父和他打得很凶险，看着十分精彩，看来平时练我们根本没用到十分之一的实力。 
 
七月八日 
昨天去挑战别的武馆，不小心受了点小伤，对方也不是故意的，就没在意。结果今天师父非要说给我找回场子，就去那家武馆踢馆了，傍晚回来的时候鼻青脸肿得比我还狼狈，把师兄们吓了一跳，但是他咧着嘴笑着跟我说把那个武馆教训得很惨，我也要努力修炼不给师父和虎啸堂丢脸。

Research Project: 
Elimination of Mechcraft Exoskeleton Side Effects 
 
Conclusion: After extensive testing, we remain unable to completely eliminate the side effects associated with using the exoskeleton. The mental strain-induced dizziness and visual hallucinations persist. 
 
As the side effects of the exoskeleton cannot be fully eliminated, research should be immediately terminated to prevent more severe consequences.

机关外骨骼副作用消除

text:
Though Master Zhuangzi wanted to bring us four together, failing us outright was a bit extreme. Still, without such drastic measures, the other three might have simply laughed off his warning. 
 
Dreamwhisper Lake was once a haven of fine dreams and peace. I wonder what kind of twist he had in mind. 
 
As we entered the lake area, the mist grew thicker until, before I knew it, the others were gone. 
 
The mist seemed alive, slowly writhing as if whispering something. I began to panic... 
 
Then I turned and saw myself standing right behind me! What was going on? I was standing behind myself? Then who was I? 
 
I looked down at my arms. The carved patterns on my palms were so familiar... 
 
Was I a puppet? 
 
As I stood there in shock, "I" mounted a white horse and started moving. 
 
Where was "I" going? An ominous feeling crept over me. 
 
This had to stop! Though I couldn't make a sound, I quickened my pace, but the white horse galloped faster. 
 
I gave it everything, and just as I was about to catch up with "myself," a sharp whistling cut through the air. 
 
Then a hail of arrows came, and I had nowhere to hide. 
 
The spot where I was hit felt wet... was it bleeding... 
 
Slowly, I opened my eyes... A fluffy little creature stared at me before blowing me a bubble. 
 
Was that just... a dream? Or did this little creature rescue me from the dream?
zh_text:
虽然庄周老师有心把我们四个人聚到一起，但直接给我们四个人挂科有点太极端了吧。不过不采用这种手段，也许他们三人只会对庄周老师的信息一笑置之。 
 
梦语湖本来也是美梦祥和之地，不知道老师卖的什么关子？ 
 
随着我们走入湖区，云雾在不知不觉间变得浓重，直到我发现，不知何时，周围的其他人不见了。 
 
四周的雾气像是有生命一般，缓缓蠕动着，仿佛在低语着什么，我有些慌张…… 
 
直到我转头发现，我就站在我身后！这究竟是怎么回事？我在我身后？那谁是我？ 
 
我低下头看到自己的手臂，手掌上被雕琢而出的纹路是那么熟悉…… 
 
我是傀儡？ 
 
正当我错愕之时，“我”跨上了一批白马，开始前行。 
 
“我”要去哪里？我心中隐约有种不祥的预感。 
 
不能继续前进了！我不能发出声来，只能加快脚步，白马却越跑越快。 
 
我用尽全力去追赶，终于快要追到“我”的时候，突然一阵急促的尖啸划破长空。 
 
随后无数支箭射了过来，而我却无处躲避。 
 
中了箭的地方湿湿的……是血流出来么…… 
 
慢慢地，我睁开眼……一个毛茸茸小家伙呆呆地看着我，然后向我吐了个泡泡。 
 
刚刚难道只是……一场梦？还是这个小家伙从梦中拯救了我？

text:
November 20
Ever since we visited the Forbidden Chamber and learned of that sealed knowledge, everything has changed.

I told him he was too obsessed with the destructive power of ancient sorcery, but he claimed it was I who had changed—that the Academy had influenced me so deeply that I had forgotten my "mission."

When he left, Xinwuwei chased after him with a mechanical toy in its mouth, but I immediately ordered it to stop.
It was so frightened it didn't dare move, and that was when I realized it couldn't understand the complex relationships between people, nor why friends could become enemies overnight.

Qin Xiao, oh Qin Xiao, I feel like I can see you less and less clearly. You don't even remember many of the things we experienced together.
We created Xinwuwei to prove ourselves, but did you pay a price I know nothing about?
<69D0FF>Yet true monsters can still maintain a pure and kind nature.</>
<69D0FF>And yet, despite how hard I tried to hold onto your hand, I still became your enemy.</>

The Divine Forge lineage is already unrecognizable; what "mission" is there left to speak of?
Before Xinwuwei is tainted by the filth of this world, I think it is time to take it away.
zh_text:
十一月二十日
自从我们去过秘禁阁，了解了那些尘封的知识，一切就都变了。

我说他太痴迷上古魔道术带来的破坏性，他反而说是我变了，学院对我影响太深，让我忘记了自己的“使命”。

他走的时候，辛午未叼着机关玩具追他，我立刻喝止了它。
它吓得动都不敢动，我才意识到，它无法理解人与人之间复杂的关系，也无法理解朋友为何会一夜之间变成敌人。

秦霄啊秦霄，我好像越来越看不清你，很多原本我们一起经历的事，你都记不得。
我们一起创造辛午未本是为了证明自己，但你是不是还付出了，我不知道的代价？
<69D0FF>可真正的怪物都能保持单纯善良的本性。</>

source_text:
十一月二十日
自从我们去过秘禁阁，了解了那些尘封的知识，一切就都变了。

我说他太痴迷上古魔道术带来的破坏性，他反而说是我变了，学院对我影响太深，让我忘记了自己的“使命”。

他走的时候，辛午未叼着机关玩具追他，我立刻喝止了它。
它吓得动都不敢动，我才意识到，它无法理解人与人之间复杂的关系，也无法理解朋友为何会一夜之间变成敌人。

秦霄啊秦霄，我好像越来越看不清你，很多原本我们一起经历的事，你都记不得。
我们一起创造辛午未本是为了证明自己，但你是不是还付出了，我不知道的代价？
<69D0FF>可真正的怪物都能保持单纯善良的本性。</>
<69D0FF>而我那么尽力地握住你的手，还是成了你的敌人。</>

神铸一脉早已面目全非，哪还有“使命”可言。
在辛午未染上人世的尘污之前，我想，是时候带它离开了。

text:
Day 3 
 
We arrived near Bastion Fort. Along the way, we encountered Shye, who showed a keen interest in ancient artifacts and decided to join our expedition. 
 
This area is desolate, an abandoned realm of the past, devoid of human presence. Shye claimed she could sense numerous untouched treasures lying buried, deep within the confines of the old city, untouched and unexplored. 
 
After a careful search, Shye quickly mapped out a route into Bastion Fort, as if she knew the place like the back of her hand. Although our goal was archaeological while hers was treasure hunting, our collaboration proved quite enjoyable.
zh_text:
第三日 
 
我们抵达了藏兵城附近。途中偶遇西施，她对古物颇感兴趣，便与我们探险队同行。 
 
这片区域一片荒寂，仿佛是被遗弃的古境，没有任何人的踪影。西施说她能感觉到这里潜藏着许多未被发掘的宝藏，它们就沉睡在这座古城的深处，无人问津。 
 
仔细探查后，西施迅速地制定了一条进入藏兵城的寻宝路线，就仿佛她曾经来过这里一般轻车熟路。虽然我们是为了考古，而她的本意是寻宝，但求同存异的合作还是非常令人愉快的。

text:
Outskirts, Cloudy and Rainy 
 
We took a walk to a small pavilion outside Frostcloud Town. The scenery was so beautiful, it felt like a work of art made by nature. This inspired me to try an experiment: I wanted to see if Luban No. 7 could paint. 
 
Soon, he made his very first painting. His style was unique and had a Mechcraft beauty. Even though the painting was simple and a bit funny, it showed that he could understand the feelings between people and nature. It was just a little childish. 
 
I almost forgot to write down the experiment results. But now, I think I'll stop keeping records. 
 
Luban No. 7 shouldn't be treated like an ordinary Mechanoid. He is different. He is...my child.

text:
January 22 
 
Li Bai visited again today. Such a refined customer is rare, so I offered him a flask of wine and shared my concerns. 
 
My family has sold brews in Dreamweave Plains for generations. Customers love the taste. If I change it, there might be problems. Besides, the formula is the most important thing my father left me. How can I alter it casually? 
 
Li Bai seemed about to say something but smiled instead: "Never mind. Let's not talk about this." Then he drank with me, sharing his travels while I discussed brewing. As we drank and chatted, I fell asleep. 
 
When I woke up, Li Bai was gone, leaving only money on the table and two empty cups. 
 
Lu Changping
zh_text:
一月二十二日 
 
没想到今天李白又来了，难得有这么有品位的客人，我主动请了他一坛酿。也向他解释了我的顾虑。 
 
我祖祖辈辈都在织梦原卖酿，客户都认可这个味道，我要是贸然改动会不会出问题呢？更何况这配方是父亲留给我最重要的东西，我怎么能随便改变呢？ 
 
李白似乎要说些什么，但又止住了，只是笑道：“也好，也好。算了，不谈这些了。”随后拉着我一同畅饮起来。他一边喝，一边跟我聊他在各处的见闻，我则跟他聊酿造的心得。喝着喝着，聊着聊着，我就睡着了。 
 
当我醒来的时候，哪里还有李白的踪影，只剩下摊在桌子上的钱，还有一对空空的陶杯。 
                                                                                          鹿长平

text:
Dear Mr. Shi Yu, 
 
It's great to see that we're slowly pulling ourselves together. 
 
I've met some extraordinary people recently: Shye has a beautiful smile; A hot-headed boy who uses cannons is very much like you; Novar always exudes confidence; A man who's a bit older often stared at my Mechwings and crafted new ones for me. I will show them to you next time. 
 
We've formed the Team of Stars and are competing in the academy's Enlightenment Trials. Have you heard of it? 
 
They remind me of the days with you and Tian Ji. Perhaps they will become my new friends. 
 
Sun Bin
zh_text:
时煜师傅： 
我们都在慢慢振作起来，真是太好了。 
最近我认识了几个很特别的人，想听我讲讲吗？ 
 
有一个名叫西施的姐姐，笑起来很好看；一个暴躁的，使用机关枪炮的小子，他的脾气有时会让我想起你；一个非常自信，仿佛在闪闪发光的男孩，叫东方曜……还有一个怪大叔，他总是用很怪的眼神盯着我的机关翼，结果，他是认为我的机关翼积累了不少问题，送了我一对新的……之后我来时捎给你看看。 
 
对了，我们要组成一支叫“星之队”的队伍，去参加学院“归虚梦演”的比赛。你听说了吗？ 
 
他们给我的感觉，很温暖，就像田忌和你一样……也许他们会是我的新朋友。 
                                                                                                                                                                       孙膑

I see black thorns growing from deep within the dream, slipping through cracks and reaching into the real world. 
 
They spread as lakes dry up, forests burn, and Dreamweavers mourn. 
 
They tighten their grip as the ground shakes, towers collapse, and Dreamers cry in despair. 
 
When the thorns have decayed, only darkness is left. A butterfly appears and gently lands on the tip of a thorn.

黑色荆棘缠绕，山峦崩塌，高塔摧折，废墟里梦者们在怮哭。

text:
November 16th
Just like its escape, <69D0FF> someone intentionally taught it to harm others. </>

<69D0FF> He actually intended to raise Xinwuwei as a weapon to realize his ambitions. </>

I paced back and forth in the basement, knocking things over. It lay there obediently, knowing I was angry.
It cannot distinguish between good and evil like a human, so how could it be capable of malicious harm?
I told Xinwuwei that I would protect it.
It understood, and happily went back to pouncing on its mechanical toy.

I suddenly remembered what he taught Xinwuwei:
"Before you, people fall into three categories.
Those who turn and run are prey.
Those who attack are enemies.
Those willing to shake hands with a monster are friends."
zh_text:
十一月十六日                                                            
和它逃跑一样，<69D0FF>是有人故意教它伤人的。</>

<69D0FF>他居然真的想把辛午未培养成实现野心的武器。</>

我在地下室走来走去，弄翻了很多东西，它乖巧地趴着，它知道我在生气。
它不像人一样能分清善恶好坏，又何谈恶意伤人？
我对辛午未说，我会保护它。
它听懂了，又开心地扑咬它的机关玩具。

我突然想起他教辛午未的话：
“在你面前，人可以分为三类。
转身逃跑的是猎物。
动手攻击的是敌人。
愿意和怪物握手的，就是朋友。”

text:
Xun, 
 
By the time you read this, you've probably uncovered the secret of the clock. 
 
I stumbled upon it by chance, not knowing how it works. Could it be that it contains a fragment of a time Mechcraft? Ha! It actually <69D0FF>reverses time for a short moment</>. 
 
I've always thought that as long as you and I are together, I wouldn't need something like this, even when we're in trouble. 
 
But then again, what if this clock proves useful to you? 
 
Although I worry that the Time Fragment is unstable, I hope it gives you one more option. But more than that, I hope you never have to use it...

text:
Dear Master Mozi, 
 
You probably don't remember me. My name is Luo Anmin. Many years ago, I had the chance to study in Jixia and even attended your lectures. 
 
Now, I run a workshop in Chang'an called Craftworks. However, a tragedy has befallen my family. My wife recently suffered a devastating fall from a great height. Though her life was spared, she might never be able to stand again. 
 
Born into a martial arts family, she loved to fight with weapons. I sometimes cry over her fate, but she always comforts me. 
 
If medicine cannot cure her, could your brilliant Mechcraft skills grant her a pair of new legs? 
 
I'm willing to give you everything I have in exchange for my wife's ability to walk. I await your reply with hope. 
 
Sincerely, 
 
Luo Anmin
zh_text:
墨子亲启：

或许您已经不记得我了，我叫洛安民。多年前曾在稷下学习，还有幸上过您主讲的课程。

如今我在长安开了一家天工坊，但前些日子，妻子遭逢意外……她从高处跌落，永远没法再站起来了。

我的妻子生于武道世家，从小就喜欢舞刀弄枪，现在遭逢此变……说来可笑，我常因此垂泪，妻子她却会反过来安慰我。

我突然想到，若是医术对此无可奈何，那您巧夺天工的机关术能否让我的妻子拥有新的双腿呢？

我愿意用我全部身家作为治疗我妻子的报酬，期待您的回信。

洛安民顿首

text:
Monthly tests? Endless stress! 
 
Take a nap, then you'll be back! 
 
If you get sleepy in class, cover your face with a book. To avoid getting caught, you can even draw small eyes on your eyelids—just make sure they are not too big! 
 
For the mountaineering test, ask the villagers for a detailed map so you can find shortcuts. 
 
And remember, change up your excuses for missing class—sick leave, personal leave, family leave, etc. Just don't use too many in one month!
zh_text:
知识月月考，学生心焦焦。
与其挠破头，不如睡大觉。

上课时犯困，可以用书本挡住脸，若被发现，可以在眼皮上画个眼睛，切记不要画得太大，经验之谈！

登山考试时，定要向周边村民要来详细路线图，以便抄近路。

请假时，需用不同理由，病假、事假、探亲假等等。在一个月内请假最好不要太过频繁，切记！

text:
For many years, the Brew Barrel invented by Mechcraft students has been a great help to the people of Dreamweave Plains. However, the wear and tear over the years has still taken its toll on the Mechcraft. Additionally, the operation of the Brew Barrel is still too cumbersome for ordinary people. 
 
During his time at school, Master Luban traveled to Dreamweave Plains. After learning of this situation, he responded to Master Mozi's call and took on the task of improving the Brew Barrel. After three months of development, he finally completed the improvement. It increased the extraction of Aerux and greatly optimized the efficiency of the Mechcraft, further enhancing the taste of Aerux Brew. 
 
To thank Master Luban, Harvest Fields sent him many specialties, all of which were eventually given to the canteen of Jixia Academy.
zh_text:
多年来，机关学子发明的甑桶对织梦原上的百姓起到了很大的帮助。但是长年累月的损耗还是对机关产生了影响。同时，甑桶操作起来，对普通人来说还是过于繁琐。 
 
鲁班大师在校期间，游历至织梦原。他了解到此情况后，响应墨子老师的号召，主动担任了甑桶改良的任务。经过长达三个月的研发，终于完成了甑桶改良。既提高了云根萃取的含量，又大大优化了机关运行的效率，更是让云井酿的口感更上一层楼。 
 
丰云野为答谢鲁班大师的研发，送了他许多特产，最后都被鲁班大师送到了稷下学院的食堂中。

text:
After a lot of hard work, I have removed the side effects of the Mechcraft exoskeleton. To keep it safe from misuse, I announced publicly that the project had failed. 
 
From now on, all research must stay secret. I have also redesigned the project as the Mechcraft prosthetic to make it simpler and easier to use. 
 
Once I complete Luo Anmin's request, I will start mass-producing the prosthetic parts, but I will make sure they never fall into the wrong hands. 
 
If anyone discovers this place in the future, do not reveal anything. Only the person holding this letter can use the control panel. Pressing the switch will hide all my work. 
 
Remember: today's peace was hard-won. Protect it carefully.
zh_text:
几经波折，终于成功消除了机关外骨骼的副作用。但为了躲开那些别有用心之人的觊觎，我不得不对外宣称研究失败。

后续研究需秘密进行，为简化外形与方便使用，研究课题升级为助残机关义肢。

在完成洛安民的委托后，可投入量产各个身体部位的助残义肢，由我统一发放，定不会让其落入恶人之手。

若有后人知晓此地秘辛，还请勿要声张，持此信笺者，方可获取操控台的使用权限，按下其中开关后我的研究成果便会继续隐藏。

如今的和平来之不易，请三思而后行，勿要让战争的火种流传世间。

text:
Odora, 
 
If you're reading this note, you must have discovered the secret of the clock. 
 
I once got it by chance and have no idea how it works—maybe there's a time mechcraft fragment inside? Haha... it actually <69D0FF>lets time rewind temporarily</>. 
 
I always thought that even if things were difficult, as long as I was with you, I'd never have to use it. 
 
But maybe it could be of use to you... 
 
Though I worry the time fragment is unstable, I hope it gives you one more chance to choose... and I truly hope you'll never need to use it...
zh_text:
薰儿， 
 
当你看到这张小纸条的时候，想必已经发现了钟表的秘密。 
 
我曾经无意获得了这块钟表，不知道是什么原理，也许里面有一块时间机关的碎片？哈哈，竟然能<69D0FF>让时间短暂倒流</>。 
 
一直觉得就算遇到了困难，只要能和你一起，也用不着这玩意儿。 
 
可又觉得万一这个钟表对你来说有用呢？ 
 
虽然担心时间碎片不稳定，希望你能多一次选择的机会，更希望永远没机会用到……

Novar has returned with a new student who passed Yango's exam to enter the academy—quite an impressive feat! 
 
Despite losing many memories, the new student remains composed and excels in all courses, earning high praise from teachers and the Three Sages. By working together, I always feel cared for and encouraged.

text:
In the shelter, our bodies survived, but we were cut off from sunlight and the passage of time. 
 
Many of us feared we'd never see home again. 
 
My friends and I gathered scattered relics and, through the power of the Sanctified Enchanters, forged them into a treasure for those to come. 
 
We carved three stone tablets to bear witness. 
 
One day, the treasure will resurface, but the time we lost can never be reclaimed.
zh_text:
自入避难所，虽得以保全性命，但未见日升日落，已不知地上年月。 
 
众人皆悲叹不已，恐再无归乡之日。 
 
我与友人集各方珍宝，借神铸异士之力合为珍宝，以诱后人发现。 
 
已刻三方石碑，记我辈避难工舍故事，后人观览即可知全貌。 
 
宝藏有重现之日，离人无再少之年。

text:
Dear Shye, 
 
Thank you for your quick action in helping us recover our goods. The Navenian merchants tried to take advantage of us, but thanks to you, everything was safely returned to the union. In the future, we will conduct background checks when dealing with Navenian merchants, since we can't always rely on someone as kind as you. 
 
We have also heard about your partnership with Com-fluence and would be honored to work with you as well. The union will always have a consultant position available for you. If you are interested, please visit us to discuss the details. We promise to offer you only the best. 
 
As a small token of our gratitude, please accept this Sorcery crystal. 
                                                                                                                                                            Northton Trade Union

随信奉上魔道水晶聊表谢意。

text:
A certain Wu Zi will bring disaster in dreams. Hurry to Dreamwhisper Lake, or it will be too late. Even a Croaky could see through this simple trick. Why leave such a vague note? 
 
Why did Zhuangzi involve those three, especially Kongming, when he could have come to me alone? Clearly, he has no interest in dreams or Dreamweavers. 
 
Never mind. It seems even Zhuangzi needs our wisdom. 
 
The mist is growing thicker... purple turning black, the smell of fireworks growing stronger, the air drying... even breathing makes me restless. Is the lake on fire? 
 
"Overseer! East wind sweeping, fires blazing, ships destroyed!" a soldier shouts to me. 
 
Where am I? Is this towering inferno my doing? 
 
I seem to see a familiar figure at the edge of the smoke, bowing respectfully. 
 
Kongming! 
 
Have I finally surpassed him? Is this what they call... a fine dream? 
 
The smoke and heat feel almost too real... Wait! This isn't a dream! There's real fire! 
 
How can there be so many flames around Dreamwhisper Lake? Is this a trap set by Zhuangzi?
zh_text:
“有名武子者，将于梦中起凶祸，速至梦语湖，迟则为患。”这种粗浅的策略连咕呱都能轻易识破，何必留这么一张没头没尾的字条呢？ 
 
庄周为何不独找我一人，却要拉上他们三个，尤其是那个孔明？明明他对梦和织梦者没有丝毫的兴趣。 
 
算了，也罢。这下连庄周都需要借助我们的智慧了吧？ 
 
只是这雾气渐浓……由紫转黑，里面夹杂着烟火的气味也逐渐变浓，空气也从湿润转为干燥，连吸入肺中的空气都让人焦躁不安……难道湖水也会燃烧么？ 
 
“都督！东风浩荡，烽火引燃，连舟已破！”一身戎装的人大声向我嚷到。 
 
这是何处的战场，这通天的大火，是我的杰作么？ 
 
烽烟尽头我似乎看到了一个熟悉的身影，那个人毕恭毕敬地向我鞠了一躬。 
 
是孔明！ 
 
终于有一天，我胜过他了么？原来这就是所谓的……沉浸于美梦么？ 
 
可这烽烟与火的炙烤未免也太真了点……不对！这不是梦！原来是真的有火焰！ 
 
怎么梦语湖畔还会有如此多的火焰结实！这难道是庄周布设好的陷阱么！

A Martial Arts student: Victory. He was bold enough to challenge me, but I've never feared anyone in the Azure Arena. 
Bai He: Defeat. The rain threw off my skills. 
Lian Po: Defeat. I wasn't well-fed before the match. I almost broke through his defense, but hunger drained my strength. 
Qing Xiaotian: Draw. He injured my student, and I lost control in my anger. Otherwise, I would've shattered his cannon. 
Wuyan: Defeat. Last night's meal at Qingyi Pavilion was a mistake—the spicy food upset my stomach. 
... 
Fuzi: Defeat. Again! That old fox always has tricks up his sleeve. It's just not fair!

text:
January 21 
 
I saw Li Bai today. It was a complete surprise. Just as the stories say, he is cool and seems above ordinary concerns. He bought a bottle of Ageon Brew and clearly enjoyed it. 
 
Afterward, he suggested adding fruit juice to improve the flavor. I disagreed, since it would cover up the brew's pure aroma. He called me stubborn, and maybe I am. But if staying true to tradition is stubbornness, I'm proud of it. 
 
I always thought of Li Bai as just a poet and swordsman, but he also knows a lot about brewing. 
 
Lu Changping
zh_text:
一月二十一日 
 
没想到今天遇到了大名鼎鼎的李白，果然跟传说中一样，潇洒风流，超凡脱俗。他一上来便买了一壶光阴酿来喝，痛快极了，还找到我，向我提议改进一下光阴酿。 
 
李白认为应该给光阴酿增添一些果香，比如加些果汁，丰富光阴酿的口感和层次。但我不这么认为，我觉得那样会影响光阴酿本身的醇香。他说我顽固。当然要顽固，如果说坚持老味道就是顽固的话，我宁愿顽固一辈子。 
 
只不过，以前只知道李白的剑术和诗都很有名，没想到对酿居然也有研究。 
                                                                                           鹿长平

text:
The monthly exam looms near, and students are filled with fear. 
Instead of worrying, why not take a nap? 
 
During class, you can hide your face with a book. If you get caught, just paint another eye on your eyelid. Just remember, don't paint it too big! 
 
During the mountaineering exam, be sure to ask the villagers for a detailed map so you can take shortcuts. 
 
When taking leave, use different excuses such as sick leave, personal leave, or family visit leave. It is best not to take leave too frequently in a month!

知识月月考，学生心焦焦。
与其挠破头，不如睡大觉。

上课时犯困，可以用书本挡住脸，若被发现，可以在眼皮上画个眼睛，切记不要画得太大，经验之谈！

登山考试时，定要向周边村民要来详细路线图，以便抄近路。

请假时，需用不同理由，病假、事假、探亲假等等。在一个月内请假最好不要太过频繁，切记！

text:
Inventor: Xun Rihua, School of Mechcrafts 
Slogan: Croaky Croaky, the hungry winner! 
Concept: With the sharpest sense of smell for food, they charge as a group once they find something tasty and leave not a crumb behind, helping to finish all the leftovers in the canteen. 
Additionally, the Croaky Squad is skilled at mimicking the sounds of baby Croakies, creating a constant stream of distracting noise for opponents during competitions and serving as playful companions in daily life.

发明者：机关学子荀日华
口号：咕呱咕呱，馋嘴赢家！
发明创意：拥有最敏锐的美食感应，一旦发现美食便成群结队冲上前去，风卷残云般消灭食物，平时可消灭食堂剩饭。
同时，咕呱小队善于模拟幼年咕呱的叫声，赛时可以不间断的语音噪声干扰对手，平时也可作为玩伴。

text:
Master Zhuangzi wanted the four of us to come together. But failing our classes? That seemed too extreme... And maybe the others never cared about it. 
 
Dreamwhisper Lake was always peaceful and surreal. What was Master Zhuangzi up to? 
 
As we walked in, the mist surrounded us. Suddenly, the others were gone. 
 
The mist seemed alive, whispering around me. I started to feel nervous... 
 
I turned around and saw "myself" standing there. Was that really me? Who was that? 
 
I looked at my hands and noticed strange patterns. 
 
A puppet? 
 
I was shocked and watched as "I" got on a white horse and rode away. 
 
Where was "I" going? I felt a sense of dread. 
 
I tried to shout, but no sound came out. I ran after "me," but the horse sped up. 
 
Just as I was about to catch up, a scream rang out. 
 
Arrows rained down from the sky, and there was nowhere to hide. 
 
I felt something wet—was it blood? 
 
Slowly, I opened my eyes. A fluffy creature was looking at me and blew a bubble. 
 
Was it all a dream? Did this little one save me?
zh_text:
虽然庄周老师有心把我们四个人聚到一起，但直接给我们四个人挂科有点太极端了吧。不过不采用这种手段，也许他们三人只会对庄周老师的信息一笑置之。 
 
梦语湖本来也是美梦祥和之地，不知道老师卖的什么关子？ 
 
随着我们走入湖区，云雾在不知不觉间变得浓重，直到我发现，不知何时，周围的其他人不见了。 
 
四周的雾气像是有生命一般，缓缓蠕动着，仿佛在低语着什么，我有些慌张…… 
 
直到我转头发现，我就站在我身后！这究竟是怎么回事？我在我身后？那谁是我？ 
 
我低下头看到自己的手臂，手掌上被雕琢而出的纹路是那么熟悉…… 
 
我是傀儡？ 
 
正当我错愕之时，“我”跨上了一批白马，开始前行。 
 
“我”要去哪里？我心中隐约有种不祥的预感。 
 
不能继续前进了！我不能发出声来，只能加快脚步，白马却越跑越快。 
 
我用尽全力去追赶，终于快要追到“我”的时候，突然一阵急促的尖啸划破长空。 
 
随后无数支箭射了过来，而我却无处躲避。 
 
中了箭的地方湿湿的……是血流出来么…… 
 
慢慢地，我睁开眼……一个毛茸茸小家伙呆呆地看着我，然后向我吐了个泡泡。 
 
刚刚难道只是……一场梦？还是这个小家伙从梦中拯救了我？

text:
Dear Master Shi Yu, 
We are slowly recovering. It's great to hear. 
Recently, I met a few remarkable people. Would you like to hear about them? 
 
There's an elegant lady named Shye with a beautiful smile; a hot-tempered young man who uses Mechcraft cannons—he reminds me of you sometimes; and a confident, radiant boy named Novar... Oh, and there's a strange old man who kept giving me weird looks at my Mechwings. Turns out, he thought my Mechwings had some issues and gifted me a new pair... I'll bring them for you to see when I visit next time. 
 
By the way, we're forming a team called the "Team of Stars" to participate in the Academy's "Enlightenment Trials" competition. Have you heard about it? 
 
They give me a warm feeling, just like Tian Ji and you... Perhaps they will become my new friends. 
 
Sun Bin
zh_text:
时煜师傅： 
我们都在慢慢振作起来，真是太好了。 
最近我认识了几个很特别的人，想听我讲讲吗？ 
 
有一个名叫西施的姐姐，笑起来很好看；一个暴躁的，使用机关枪炮的小子，他的脾气有时会让我想起你；一个非常自信，仿佛在闪闪发光的男孩，叫东方曜……还有一个怪大叔，他总是用很怪的眼神盯着我的机关翼，结果，他是认为我的机关翼积累了不少问题，送了我一对新的……之后我来时捎给你看看。 
 
对了，我们要组成一支叫“星之队”的队伍，去参加学院“归虚梦演”的比赛。你听说了吗？ 
 
他们给我的感觉，很温暖，就像田忌和你一样……也许他们会是我的新朋友。 
                                                                                                                                                                       孙膑

text:
Wu Zi will bring disaster in dreams. Hurry to Dreamwhisper Lake, or something bad will happen. 
 
Even a Croaky could see this was an obvious trick. Why would someone leave a note like that? 
 
Zhuangzi could have just talked to me directly. Why involve the others, especially Kongming? He doesn't care about dreams or Dreamweavers at all. 
 
Well, it seems even Zhuangzi needs our help now. 
 
But the mist is getting thicker, changing from purple to black, and there's more of that strange, unsettling smoke. The air feels dry... Can a lake even catch fire? 
 
"Commander! The east wind is rising, the beacons are lit, and the ship chains have snapped!" a soldier shouted. 
 
What kind of battle is this? Did I start this fire? 
 
Through the smoke, I see someone bowing to me. 
 
Wait... is that Kongming? 
 
Did I finally defeat him? Is this the kind of dream you never want to wake up from? 
 
But the heat is real—it's burning. No, this isn't a dream. The fire is real! 
 
Why is Dreamwhisper Lake burning? Is this all part of Zhuangzi's plan?
zh_text:
“有名武子者，将于梦中起凶祸，速至梦语湖，迟则为患。”这种粗浅的策略连咕呱都能轻易识破，何必留这么一张没头没尾的字条呢？ 
 
庄周为何不独找我一人，却要拉上他们三个，尤其是那个孔明？明明他对梦和织梦者没有丝毫的兴趣。 
 
算了，也罢。这下连庄周都需要借助我们的智慧了吧？ 
 
只是这雾气渐浓……由紫转黑，里面夹杂着烟火的气味也逐渐变浓，空气也从湿润转为干燥，连吸入肺中的空气都让人焦躁不安……难道湖水也会燃烧么？ 
 
“都督！东风浩荡，烽火引燃，连舟已破！”一身戎装的人大声向我嚷到。 
 
这是何处的战场，这通天的大火，是我的杰作么？ 
 
烽烟尽头我似乎看到了一个熟悉的身影，那个人毕恭毕敬地向我鞠了一躬。 
 
是孔明！ 
 
终于有一天，我胜过他了么？原来这就是所谓的……沉浸于美梦么？ 
 
可这烽烟与火的炙烤未免也太真了点……不对！这不是梦！原来是真的有火焰！ 
 
怎么梦语湖畔还会有如此多的火焰结实！这难道是庄周布设好的陷阱么！

Wu Zi will bring disaster in dreams. Hurry to Dreamwhisper Lake, or something bad will happen. 
 
Even a Croaky could see this was an obvious trick. Why would someone leave a note like that? 
 
Zhuangzi could have just talked to me directly. Why involve the others, especially Kongming? He doesn't care about dreams or Dreamweavers at all. 
 
Well, it seems even Zhuangzi needs our help now. 
 
But the mist is getting thicker, changing from purple to black, and there's more of that strange, unsettling smoke. The air feels dry... Can a lake even catch fire?

What kind of battle is this? Did I start this fire? 
 
Through the smoke, I see someone bowing to me. 
 
Wait... is that Kongming? 
 
Did I finally defeat him? Is this the kind of dream you never want to wake up from? 
 
But the heat is real—it's burning. No, this isn't a dream. The fire is real! 
 
Why is Dreamwhisper Lake burning? Is this all part of Zhuangzi's plan?

text:
Day 6 
 
We returned safely to camp with Shye, though she seemed disappointed. It was clear she loved exploring ancient ruins, but she chose to come back with us to keep everyone safe. 
 
That evening, we relaxed and laughed around the campfire. Shye shared her dream with us: she wants to form her own team, not for research, but for treasure hunting, which is what she truly enjoys. I believe she will make her dream come true.
zh_text:
第六日 
西施随我们探险队一起安全抵达了营地。从她脸上遗憾的表情我能看出，她对遗迹秘境充满了热情和喜爱，但对于没有充足准备的探险还是为了所有人选择了安全为上。 
 
我们和她一同围坐在篝火边欢声笑语，畅所欲言。西施便给我们说起她的梦想，说她想要组建一个像我们一样的团队，不过不是为了探险，而是为了寻宝。毕竟那是她最大的志愿和乐趣，我相信她会实现的。

text:
Day 5 
 
The long-sealed Mausoleum is rarely visited, and the amount of undiscovered treasures within goes without saying. The ancient structures and mysterious inscriptions have become even more enigmatic with the passage of time. However, a powerful energy permeates the air, making us all feel uneasy. 
 
Shye spoke up first, perhaps sensing our unease. She felt that we were not fully prepared for this expedition and that rushing in would be irresponsible. After hearing everyone's opinions, we returned to camp to regroup. She decided to come back another day with her Team of Stars.
zh_text:
第五日 
 
尘封已久的归陵鲜有人迹，其中未发掘的珍宝数量不言而喻。古老的建筑和神秘的雕刻在时间的洗礼下显得更加神秘莫测。然而，还有一股强大的能量弥漫在空气中，让我们所有人都有些局促不安。 
 
也许是发现了我们的异样，西施率先表达了看法，她认为此次探险还是缺乏完善的准备，冒然进入是对大家的不负责任。在所有人的意见归总之后，我们回到了营地进行休整。而她决定改日有机会和星之队的同伴再前来。

text: I can never forget the bone-chilling fear! It was like a Nightmare—a shadowy monster, both human and inhuman, surging forth with a force capable of destroying the world. In an instant, calamity engulfed the village. Relentless flames consumed everything, and under the monster's rampage, homes crumbled into ruins. Screams echoed everywhere, and many who couldn't escape in time were gravely injured. My mother took a heavy blow to her leg while protecting me. The enemies' cruel acts filled the village with despair. Fortunately, during our frantic escape, we encountered a squad of soldiers. Their armor bore unique patterns that shone like a glimmer of light in the darkness, a symbol of hope. Under their protection, we fled to a cave for refuge. The Saepes around the cave seemed to sense the danger and quickly sealed off the entrance, allowing us to narrowly escape the monster's pursuit. Once inside, we gathered around a campfire to prepare food. In that brief moment of calm, our anxious hearts found slight solace. But this peace was only an illusion. The dreadful monster still roamed the wilderness, like a dark shadow ready to pounce at any moment, filling us with dread. What should we do next?
zh_text: 我始终无法忘却那种深入骨髓的恐惧！那是宛如噩梦般的存在，漆黑且似人非人的怪物，仿若带着毁灭世界的力量汹涌来袭。 刹那间，村庄便被灾难笼罩。熊熊大火无情地烧毁了村庄，房屋在怪物的肆意践踏下沦为一片废墟。一时间，惨叫连连，许多来不及逃跑的人都身负重伤，我的母亲为了护我，腿部也遭受重创。那些敌人的残忍行径，让整个村庄处处弥漫着凄惨的气息。 幸运的是，在我们仓皇逃亡的路上，遇到了一队士兵。他们身上战甲有着十分特别的花纹，那独特的图案就像黑暗中的一丝曙光，象征着希望。在士兵的保护下，我们逃至一处洞穴避难。洞穴周围的木篱似乎也察觉到危险，匆忙堵死了洞口，这才让我们侥幸摆脱了怪物的追击。进入洞穴后，大家围坐在篝火旁准备食物，在这片刻的宁静中，不安的心也稍微有了一丝慰藉。 然而，这平静不过是短暂的假象。那可怕的怪物依旧在荒野游荡，好似一团随时会向我们扑来的黑暗阴影，让人心惊胆战。接下来，我们应该何去何从？

text: The East Aerfall Highlands were once mysterious and unexplored. The first time I crossed the Crosswind Bridge, I was accompanied by a few adventurous souls. We spent our days exploring the unknown and our nights sharing information and huddling around the stove. As more adventurers arrived, the East Aerfall Highlands were no longer a dangerous place. Supplies and cutting-edge equipment were transported in, while artifacts were sent to the Academy and various locations in Jixia for research. This small tent stood with me as witness to the birth of Aerdeep Camp.
zh_text: 东云落高地，彼时神秘莫测，鲜有学子足迹。 初次跨过绝云桥之时，我与风物家们同行，驻扎于此。 我们白天外出考察、探索未知，夜间分享情报、围炉取暖。 而后，更多的探险者纷至沓来。东云落高地不再是天险之地。补给品和最前沿的仪器运输了进来，文物则被运往学院和稷下各地研究。 这顶小帐篷，与我一起见证了云深营地的诞生。

Shye: 
 
Thanks to your timely intervention that day, our goods were finally returned safely to the guild. Those Navenian merchants were incredibly cunning—they actually tried to get something for nothing! text:
It was my first time entering the Dreamrealm. Master Zhuangzi had always told me to look for answers in dreams, but I never had the courage to try. 
 
Dreams felt too strange and personal. I didn't want to share them with anyone. 
 
But this time, the other three were nearby. I thought maybe they'd notice if something went wrong. 
 
Soon after we entered the Dreamy Grotto, dark mist covered the path, and I heard a voice whispering. 
 
I was the only one who could hear it. The whispers grew louder and filled me with fear, making me freeze in place. The others just walked away. 
 
I tried to follow them, but they disappeared into the mist. 
 
Deeper in the cave, I saw someone sitting alone on a stone, hugging her knees. When I got closer, she looked up at me. Her clear eyes made me feel a rush of emotions. 
 
It was the Finedream Weaver. 
 
At first, she looked surprised, but then her eyes softened—was that compassion? 
 
I wanted to ask her about the nightmares that haunted me, but I couldn't speak. 
 
She stood up gracefully and spread her wings. "Dreamer," she said, "the answer is with someone close to you. But you're not ready for the truth yet. If only the night in Jixia could last forever, so you could stay in this dream. But dawn is coming, and everything will disappear like morning dew." 
 
"I'm sorry..." 
 
Her wings shimmered, reminding me of the lonely moon over Wei. I heard a lullaby from my childhood... 
 
When I opened my eyes, the others were there. Kongming was soaking wet, Zhou Yu's hair was singed, and Yango actually looked... happy. 
 
I finally had a peaceful sleep... but I still didn't know what caused my nightmares.
zh_text:
这是我第一次踏入梦域，虽然庄周老师多次建议我自己去梦中寻找答案，但我还是不敢去直面它。 
 
但这梦实在是过于离奇又像一柄尖刀直刺我的内心，终究是无法求助别人。 
 
也好，这次凑巧这三个家伙在身旁，希望他们能在我被噩梦缠身的时候再帮我一把吧。 
 
但是始料未及的是刚进入绮梦窟不久，阴霾渐浓，一个声音逐渐响起。 
 
只有我一个人能听到烟雾中隐藏着朦胧的低语，声音越来越大，恐惧让我感到两腿发软。其余三人只是自顾自的走开了…… 
 
我拼尽全力沿着三人离开的方向追赶，却怎也找不到，只能在洞窟中四处打转。 
 
当我来到绮梦窟最深处，只看到一个落寞的身影坐在双手抱膝坐在石头上，听到我的脚步声她也抬起了头，清澈的眼眸让我内心感到了一阵慌乱。 
 
这就是传说中的美梦使者…… 
 
她似乎也有点惊讶，怔怔的看着我，稍后眼神变得柔和起来，甚至有几分……怜惜？ 
 
我想要张口发问，关于那些缠绕我的噩梦究竟是怎么回事，却发现我根本无法发出声音， 
 
她缓缓站起身，轻轻地舒展开羽翼。然后说道：“梦者，解开梦中因果之人就在你的身边。但这答案对于现在的你来说过于残酷。多希望稷下的夜晚是个永不会醒来的无尽长梦，但当梦醒时分，这一切会化为一滴朝露，随着黎明的到来而消失无踪……” 
 
“请你……原谅……” 
 
洞中微弱的荧光撒在她羽翼上，让我想起魏郡天空中孤悬的明月，耳畔响起了童年的歌谣……我的意识逐渐飘向远方…… 
 
再次睁开眼，面前还是那三个家伙熟悉的脸，虽然不知道为什么诸葛亮的衣服湿透了，周瑜的头发好像被火燎过一样，至于元歌，不知为何看起来很幸福…… 
 
久违的安眠，可惜……还是没有获得噩梦背后的答案。

text:
Day 3 
 
We reached the area near Bastion Fort. On the way, we met Shye, who was very interested in ancient relics and decided to join our expedition. 
 
The area was completely deserted, with no signs of people—just the remains of the past. Shye said she could sense many hidden treasures buried there. 
 
After exploring the area, Shye quickly mapped out a route into Bastion Fort, as if she was already familiar with it. Even though our goal is research and hers is finding treasures, we can still work well together.
zh_text:
第三日 
 
我们抵达了藏兵城附近。途中偶遇西施，她对古物颇感兴趣，便与我们探险队同行。 
 
这片区域一片荒寂，仿佛是被遗弃的古境，没有任何人的踪影。西施说她能感觉到这里潜藏着许多未被发掘的宝藏，它们就沉睡在这座古城的深处，无人问津。 
 
仔细探查后，西施迅速地制定了一条进入藏兵城的寻宝路线，就仿佛她曾经来过这里一般轻车熟路。虽然我们是为了考古，而她的本意是寻宝，但求同存异的合作还是非常令人愉快的。

text:
Though I have no interest in the Philosophy of Dreams, Zhuangzi went to the trouble of setting this up for us. I might as well go and see what he wants to teach me. 
 
He failed the four of us and even left a note. This trap is a bit too obvious. 
 
Still, this is his style. 
 
But once I reached the center of Dreamwhisper Lake, surrounded by mist, even the other three, who are usually so cautious, got separated from me. 
 
Perhaps it was the influence of the dream, but my body grew heavier, and even breathing became difficult... 
 
It wasn't until I looked up that I realized I was inside a military camp? 
 
The flickering lights in the tent formed a pattern of Nover. As they grew brighter, I felt life flowing into me. 
 
Then a cold gust swept in, extinguishing the lights. In that instant, my blood froze, as if I'd lost all life. 
 
The cold lake water soaked through my clothes, and Zhuangzi smiled at me as usual. 
 
"Who shall awaken from the great dream?" he asked.
zh_text:
虽然我对梦之道毫无兴趣，但是庄周既然专门为我们四个人设了局，不妨去看看他又想要教我点什么。 
 
专门挂我们四个人的科，还留下字条，这陷阱未免有些太明显了。 
 
这也算是那个飘忽不定的贤人的风格。 
 
只是未曾想，来到湖水氤氲的梦语湖中央，一阵迷雾后，其他三个一向慎重的人竟然也能和我走散。 
 
也许是梦的影响，身体越发沉重，连呼吸都变得困难起来了…… 
 
直到抬起头，才发现我竟然已进入了军队的营帐？ 
 
帐篷中的灯火明灭可见，组成了星曜的图案。随着灯火越来越明亮，我感到生命力逐渐地汇聚在我的身上。 
 
忽然一整寒风来袭，灯火随之尽灭。一瞬间我的血液也被这寒风所冻结，仿佛失去生命一般。 
 
寒冷的湖水打湿我的衣衫，庄周一如既往地微笑着盯着我。 
 
“大梦谁先觉？”他问道。

text:
November 20
Ever since we visited the Forbidden Chamber and learned of that sealed knowledge, everything has changed.

I told him he was too obsessed with the destructive power of ancient sorcery, but he claimed it was I who had changed—that the Academy had influenced me so deeply that I had forgotten my "mission."

When he left, Xinwuwei chased after him with a mechanical toy in its mouth, but I immediately ordered it to stop.
It was so frightened it didn't dare move, and that was when I realized it couldn't understand the complex relationships between people, nor why friends could become enemies overnight.

Qin Xiao, oh Qin Xiao, I feel like I can see you less and less clearly. You don't even remember many of the things we experienced together.
We created Xinwuwei to prove ourselves, but did you pay a price I know nothing about?
<69D0FF>Yet true monsters can still maintain a pure and kind nature.</>
<69D0FF>And yet, despite how hard I tried to hold onto your hand, I still became your enemy.</>

The Divine Forge lineage is already unrecognizable; what "mission" is there left to speak of?
Before Xinwuwei is tainted by the filth of this world, I think it is time to take it away.
zh_text:
十一月二十日
自从我们去过秘禁阁，了解了那些尘封的知识，一切就都变了。

我说他太痴迷上古魔道术带来的破坏性，他反而说是我变了，学院对我影响太深，让我忘记了自己的“使命”。

他走的时候，辛午未叼着机关玩具追他，我立刻喝止了它。
它吓得动都不敢动，我才意识到，它无法理解人与人之间复杂的关系，也无法理解朋友为何会一夜之间变成敌人。

秦霄啊秦霄，我好像越来越看不清你，很多原本我们一起经历的事，你都记不得。
我们一起创造辛午未本是为了证明自己，但你是不是还付出了，我不知道的代价？
<69D0FF>可真正的怪物都能保持单纯善良的本性。</>
<69D0FF>而我那么尽力地握住你的手，还是成了你的敌人。</>

神铸一脉早已面目全非，哪还有“使命”可言。
在辛午未染上人世的尘污之前，我想，是时候带它离开了。

速回，珍重。

text: Master, I recently had a puzzling dream and would like your insight: \n \nI dreamed that a childhood friend came to visit me at Jixia. We first went to the Stargazing Terrace for a divination. I don't remember the question, but I was very happy with the answer. Then we went to see a performance, and she was startled by the lifelike puppets. Finally, we went to Yu Huan's shop where I ordered a dish that looked mild but was actually very spicy just to prank her. She ended up drinking water while hitting me. That night, when I was about to let her stay in my female classmate's dorm, she told me she didn't need to and then turned into a Croaky and ran into the forest. That's when I woke up.

text:
The Brew Barrel Prototype had been used in Dreamweave Plains for many years, but over time it became worn out and too complicated to use. 
 
When Luban visited Dreamweave Plains and learned about these issues, he agreed to help at Mozi's request. After three months of work, Luban finished the upgrades: he made the device more efficient, easier to use, and improved the taste of the brew. 
 
To thank him, the people of Harvest Fields gave Luban local specialties, which he later donated to the academy's canteen.
zh_text:
多年来，机关学子发明的甑桶对织梦原上的百姓起到了很大的帮助。但是长年累月的损耗还是对机关产生了影响。同时，甑桶操作起来，对普通人来说还是过于繁琐。 
 
鲁班大师在校期间，游历至织梦原。他了解到此情况后，响应墨子老师的号召，主动担任了甑桶改良的任务。经过长达三个月的研发，终于完成了甑桶改良。既提高了云根萃取的含量，又大大优化了机关运行的效率，更是让云井酿的口感更上一层楼。 
 
丰云野为答谢鲁班大师的研发，送了他许多特产，最后都被鲁班大师送到了稷下学院的食堂中。

text:
We entered the Underhall, but everyone was on edge. 
 
The academy helped where they could, but homesickness weighed on all of us. 
 
The orchid glow could never replace sunlight. 
 
I remembered the breeze on the Springbrook Plains and the falling leaves of autumn, still vivid in my heart. I feared time might steal even those memories. 
 
So I carved them here, to remind myself of what I once loved.
zh_text:
自入天柱下，众人忧心忡忡。 
 
虽有学院诸君相助，衣食住行无虞，但背井离乡，前路未卜，老者心伤，童子垂泪。 
 
天柱虽有幽兰微光，然不可与天光媲美。 
 
每忆春风抚溪原，秋叶罩远山种种盛景，尚在眼前。但久居深洞，恐怕迟早有忘却之时。 
 
且刻于石上，待有离洞之日，可回忆今日所感。

text: I can never forget that deep-seated fear! It was like a nightmare—dark, inhuman monsters that seemed to wield the power of destruction. In an instant, the village was overrun with disaster. Fire mercilessly swept through, destroying homes, and monsters trampled houses into ruins. There were screams everywhere; many who couldn't escape were badly injured. My mother was hurt badly protecting me. The enemy's brutal actions filled the entire village with a tragic atmosphere. Fortunately, during our panicked escape, we met a group of soldiers. Their armor bore special markings that resembled a glimmer of hope in the darkness. Under their protection, we took refuge in a cave. The Saepes around the cave seemed to sense the danger and quickly blocked the entrance, finally allowing us to escape the monsters. Inside the cave, we sat around a campfire and prepared food. In that brief moment of peace, our anxious hearts found a little comfort. But this peace was short-lived. The terrifying monster was still roaming the wilderness, like a dark shadow ready to pounce on us at any moment, filling our hearts with fear. What should we do next?
zh_text: 我始终无法忘却那种深入骨髓的恐惧！那是宛如噩梦般的存在，漆黑且似人非人的怪物，仿若带着毁灭世界的力量汹涌来袭。 刹那间，村庄便被灾难笼罩。熊熊大火无情地烧毁了村庄，房屋在怪物的肆意践踏下沦为一片废墟。一时间，惨叫连连，许多来不及逃跑的人都身负重伤，我的母亲为了护我，腿部也遭受重创。那些敌人的残忍行径，让整个村庄处处弥漫着凄惨的气息。 幸运的是，在我们仓皇逃亡的路上，遇到了一队士兵。他们身上战甲有着十分特别的花纹，那独特的图案就像黑暗中的一丝曙光，象征着希望。在士兵的保护下，我们逃至一处洞穴避难。洞穴周围的木篱似乎也察觉到危险，匆忙堵死了洞口，这才让我们侥幸摆脱了怪物的追击。进入洞穴后，大家围坐在篝火旁准备食物，在这片刻的宁静中，不安的心也稍微有了一丝慰藉。 然而，这平静不过是短暂的假象。那可怕的怪物依旧在荒野游荡，好似一团随时会向我们扑来的黑暗阴影，让人心惊胆战。接下来，我们应该何去何从？

text:
January 21st 
 
I never expected to meet the famous Li Bai today. He is just as legendary as they say—charming, elegant, and extraordinary. As soon as he arrived, he bought a jug of Ageon Brew and enjoyed it immensely. Then he approached me and proposed improving the Ageon Brew. 
 
Li Bai suggested adding some fruit fragrance to the Ageon Brew, such as fruit juice, to enhance its texture and flavor. However, I disagreed, feeling it would affect the brew's natural aroma. He called me stubborn. Of course, I am stubborn. If sticking to the traditional flavor is considered stubborn, then I would rather be stubborn for the rest of my life. 
 
Interestingly, while Li Bai is known for his swordsmanship and poetry, I didn't expect him to have such a deep understanding of brewing as well. 
 
                                                                                           Lu Changping
zh_text:
一月二十一日 
 
没想到今天遇到了大名鼎鼎的李白，果然跟传说中一样，潇洒风流，超凡脱俗。他一上来便买了一壶光阴酿来喝，痛快极了，还找到我，向我提议改进一下光阴酿。 
 
李白认为应该给光阴酿增添一些果香，比如加些果汁，丰富光阴酿的口感和层次。但我不这么认为，我觉得那样会影响光阴酿本身的醇香。他说我顽固。当然要顽固，如果说坚持老味道就是顽固的话，我宁愿顽固一辈子。 
 
只不过，以前只知道李白的剑术和诗都很有名，没想到对酿居然也有研究。 
                                                                                           鹿长平

text:
Day 6 
Shye arrived at the camp safely with our expedition team. I could tell from her expression that she was sorry. She is very enthusiastic about exploring the ruins, but she chose safety over an ill-prepared expedition. 
 
We sat around the campfire, chatting and laughing. Shye shared her dream of forming a team like ours, but not for exploration, for treasure hunting. After all, that is her greatest aspiration and pleasure. I believe she will make it come true.
zh_text:
第六日 
西施随我们探险队一起安全抵达了营地。从她脸上遗憾的表情我能看出，她对遗迹秘境充满了热情和喜爱，但对于没有充足准备的探险还是为了所有人选择了安全为上。 
 
我们和她一同围坐在篝火边欢声笑语，畅所欲言。西施便给我们说起她的梦想，说她想要组建一个像我们一样的团队，不过不是为了探险，而是为了寻宝。毕竟那是她最大的志愿和乐趣，我相信她会实现的。

text:
Inventor: Zheng Feng, School of Mechcrafts 
Slogan: "Gentle Kitebird, guardian of the young!" 
Concept: This Mechcraft is made from the feathers of various birds in Jixia, combined with sturdy Mechwings, and exhibits extraordinary patience while being immune to noise. 
Its large wings fold in front to form a cradle, providing rest for weary students and Mechcrafts. Those embraced by it may fall asleep peacefully, or even lose their fighting spirit, becoming as helpless as a baby.

I saw a torrent of black thorns that originated from the deepest part of the dream, snaking through the cracks in the Somnicell, spilling from the dream into reality. 
 
The black thorns spread, the lake dried up, and the forest caught fire. The Dreamweavers lamented in the fire. 
 
The black thorns entwined, the mountains crumbled, and the tall towers snapped. The Dreamers trembled and wept in the ruins. 
 
The black thorns decayed, leaving only dark emptiness in the world. A butterfly fluttered its wings alone, finally coming to rest on the tip of a thorn.

黑色荆棘缠绕，山峦崩塌，高塔摧折，废墟里梦者们在怮哭。

text: Yesterday, after an intense training session, I collapsed from exhaustion and fell asleep in the training hall. When I woke up, my beloved longsword, with its distinctive long tassel, was gone. If anyone finds it, please return it to me as soon as possible. \n \nI was on duty yesterday and noticed you asleep while I was sweeping. text:
Day 5 
 
Very few people have ever entered the long-sealed Mausoleum, so its treasures are still untouched. This ancient building and mysterious carvings are even more puzzling now. We could all feel a strong, tense energy in the air, which made us uneasy. 
 
Sensing the tension, Shye spoke up first. She said we weren't ready and that it would be risky to go in unprepared. After talking it over, we decided to return to camp. Shye planned to come back another time with the Team of Stars.
zh_text:
第五日 
 
尘封已久的归陵鲜有人迹，其中未发掘的珍宝数量不言而喻。古老的建筑和神秘的雕刻在时间的洗礼下显得更加神秘莫测。然而，还有一股强大的能量弥漫在空气中，让我们所有人都有些局促不安。 
 
也许是发现了我们的异样，西施率先表达了看法，她认为此次探险还是缺乏完善的准备，冒然进入是对大家的不负责任。在所有人的意见归总之后，我们回到了营地进行休整。而她决定改日有机会和星之队的同伴再前来。
