text:
November 16 
 
<69D0FF>It was trained to escape and hurt others.</> <69D0FF>HE wanted to turn it into a weapon for his own goals.</> 
 
I went into the basement, angry, and started knocking over furniture. It just lay there, sensing that I was upset. It can't even tell right from wrong—how could it hurt anyone on purpose? I promised it that I would protect it. It seemed to understand and happily ran over to its toy. 
 
That's when I remembered what he once said: "There are three kinds of people. Those who run are prey. Those who attack are enemies. But those who shake your hand are friends."
zh_text:
十一月十六日                                                            
和它逃跑一样，<69D0FF>是有人故意教它伤人的。</>

<69D0FF>他居然真的想把辛午未培养成实现野心的武器。</>

我在地下室走来走去，弄翻了很多东西，它乖巧地趴着，它知道我在生气。
它不像人一样能分清善恶好坏，又何谈恶意伤人？
我对辛午未说，我会保护它。
它听懂了，又开心地扑咬它的机关玩具。

我突然想起他教辛午未的话：
“在你面前，人可以分为三类。
转身逃跑的是猎物。
动手攻击的是敌人。
愿意和怪物握手的，就是朋友。”

text:
I'm not usually interested in the Philosophy of Dreams, but since Zhuangzi set this up for the four of us, I decided to join in. 
 
Failing our classes? That trick was way too obvious. 
 
That's just like him. 
 
Strangely, when I reached the misty center of Dreamwhisper Lake, even the other three—who are usually so careful—disappeared. 
 
Maybe it was the dream, but I started to feel heavier, and every breath became harder. 
 
When I looked up, I found myself inside a military tent. 
 
The lights in the tent flickered like stars. As they grew brighter, I felt a warm feeling inside me. 
 
Suddenly, a cold wind rushed in and blew out the lights. I felt frozen, as if all the life had been drained from me. 
 
Soaked in icy lake water, I saw Zhuangzi smiling at me, just like always. 
 
"Who do you think will wake up from the dream first?" he asked.
zh_text:
虽然我对梦之道毫无兴趣，但是庄周既然专门为我们四个人设了局，不妨去看看他又想要教我点什么。 
 
专门挂我们四个人的科，还留下字条，这陷阱未免有些太明显了。 
 
这也算是那个飘忽不定的贤人的风格。 
 
只是未曾想，来到湖水氤氲的梦语湖中央，一阵迷雾后，其他三个一向慎重的人竟然也能和我走散。 
 
也许是梦的影响，身体越发沉重，连呼吸都变得困难起来了…… 
 
直到抬起头，才发现我竟然已进入了军队的营帐？ 
 
帐篷中的灯火明灭可见，组成了星曜的图案。随着灯火越来越明亮，我感到生命力逐渐地汇聚在我的身上。 
 
忽然一整寒风来袭，灯火随之尽灭。一瞬间我的血液也被这寒风所冻结，仿佛失去生命一般。 
 
寒冷的湖水打湿我的衣衫，庄周一如既往地微笑着盯着我。 
 
“大梦谁先觉？”他问道。

Inventor: Zheng Feng, School of Mechcraft 
Slogan: "Gentle Kitebird, guardian of the young!" 
Concept: This Mechcraft is made from the feathers of various birds in Jixia, combined with sturdy Mechwings, and exhibits extraordinary patience while being immune to noise. 
Its large wings fold in front to form a cradle, providing rest for weary students and Mechcrafts. Those embraced by it may fall asleep peacefully, or even lose their fighting spirit, becoming as helpless as a baby.

text: Legendary or Reality? The Mysterious Midnight Melody at Joy Pool: Recently, a strange tale about Joy Pool has been circulating. The writer was once fortunate enough to hear this heavenly music personally many years ago, thinking it was just an improvisation by a master. Unexpectedly, after many years, the mysterious melody has sounded again. It seems both dreamlike and real, now becoming a legendary mystery. To unravel this, I have searched the narrow alleys of the village, seeking any clues. Now, I have gathered two types of rumors: Firstly, it is said that such celestial music can only be produced by one under the Music Society's secret teachings, though no one has witnessed this personally. Secondly, a musician from the Music Society near Joy Pool attributed it to mysterious creatures. However, after watching for three nights, I did not see the so-called mysterious creatures playing music. The Secrets Club appeals to everyone to provide more clues to solve this mystery, which will then be publicly disclosed to reveal the truth.
zh_text: 乐涧池午夜神秘曲乐：传奇还是现实？ 近来一则有关乐涧池的奇闻传得沸沸扬扬。笔者曾有幸于多年之前亲耳聆听过此天籁之声，原以为那不过是高人即兴所奏，没想到时隔多年之后，此神秘曲乐声再次响起。似幻似真，如今已成为传世之谜。 为解开此事，我亦奔走于村镇窄巷，只为寻找蛛丝马迹。如今得到了两种传言： 其一，有言此般仙乐唯有宫羽家秘传才可临世，不过此事并无人亲眼见证。 其二，在乐涧池一带采访到一位采风的宫羽家，称此为神秘生灵所为。然而笔者蹲守三晚，并未见识到所谓神秘生灵奏乐。 秘闻社呼吁各位能多多提供线索，解开此谜，届时也将公开披露，大白真相。

text:
In the hidden corners of Jixia, there was a trial inside the Dreamscape. 
 
Four brilliant strategists took part. But even with all their wisdom, they couldn't escape the dream's hold. Caught between dream and reality, they saw disturbing visions. 
 
As the dream continued, history began to change.
War raged, and the Jixia Academy was lost to the past. The sages resisted, leaving behind miracles and hope. Through the reshaping of the Cloud Silkworm, the academy was reborn.

Since entering the shelter, we have survived, but we haven't seen the sun rise or set, and we have lost track of time.

Everyone is filled with sorrow, fearing we will never return home.

My friends and I have gathered treasures from all over and, with the help of a master smith, combined them to lure future generations to find them.

I have carved three stone tablets to record the story of our refuge; those who view them will know the whole truth.

Treasures may be rediscovered, but the years of the displaced will never return.

Containment Protocol:
Stay in well-lit areas. Use light.

Artifact Description:
A formless darkness; anything or anyone it envelops disappears.

Use light generated by ███ to constrain its movements.

Morning: Buy the first batch of freshly baked Croaky Yolk Tarts. Attend the Frostcloud Energy Brew tasting at the Ingenious Tea Shop—must look sharp. Discuss astrology with the astrologer at the Fate-Asking Pavilion. Afternoon: Practice sword swings 300 times. Head to the Martial Arts Academy to spar with classmates. Visit Fuzi; he's asking for my progress report again. Evening: Write back to Mayene. Haidu is too far, and postage is so expensive.
Two weapons rest on the wooden rack. One is the sword frequently used by Novar. The other is of a similar style but looks brand new, with no signs of use.

Master, I recently had a puzzling dream and would like your insight: I dreamed that a childhood friend came to visit me at Jixia. We went to the Star-Gazing Platform for divination, but I can't remember the question, only that I was happy with the answer. Later, we watched a performance, and she was startled by a lifelike puppet. Finally, we went to Yu Huan's shop, where I played a prank on her by ordering a dish that looked mild but was actually very spicy. She was so spicy that she hit me while drinking water. At night, when I took her to the female students' dormitory to stay, she told me she didn't need to, then turned into a frog and hopped into the forest, and then I woke up.

Shye happened upon Hang Shen's home, which had been demolished by monsters, leaving his family frightened and ill. She took the initiative to help them find shelter and provided money for repairs, solving Hang Shen's urgent problem.

Since entering the Sky Pillar, everyone has been filled with anxiety.

Although the academy has helped ensure our basic needs are met, we are far from home with an uncertain future. The elders are heartbroken, and the children are in tears.

Though the Sky Pillar has a faint glow, it cannot compare to the light of the sun.

I still see the spring breezes over the creek and the autumn leaves on the distant mountains in my mind. But living in this deep cave, I fear I will eventually forget them.

I carve these words into stone so that if we ever leave this cave, we may remember what we felt today.

When calamity struck, we forged glory from our faith. The pure lands of the past now rely on our own hands to reclaim. Gathering the faith of many creates a new fruit, both bitter and sweet. Unless experienced firsthand, no one knows its true meaning. The ancient contract began at the dawn of time and continues unbroken.

Jixia Academy was once destroyed in war, but it was rebuilt using the power of the Aercocoon and flourished under Fuzi's leadership. Zhuangzi and Mozi also made important contributions. Today, the academy stands as a cultural and academic treasure of Primaera, starting a new era of greatness.
Faded stories of the Finedream Envoy and her people.

Set up hidden fires, iron fences, and bunkers from here. The enemy is attacking fiercely, and the battle is spreading. The soldiers do not extinguish their fighting spirit, holding the line to protect all living beings. The movement of the wooden fence is not a betrayal. Standing tall, it saves the refuge. Heroes fight hard, counterattacking in desperate situations, and the arch-enemy will eventually submit.

A cruel prophecy predicts an inescapable fate, and the destined day nears.\n\nThe future foreseen in dreams will be shrouded in thorns, with both dream and reality collapsing into disaster. How will she face it?

Dear Master Fuzi:
Yesterday, I helped the kitchen process a batch of dried fish and accidentally ate a bit too much. Considering Mayene's helpful nature, could you please grant me leave? I won't be attending class today.
Applicant: Mayene

Approval Status: Rejected.
Mayene, stop trying to fool me with such ridiculous excuses! And if I recall correctly, this is your eighteenth leave request this month. Enough is enough—don't even think about taking any more leave this month.

Letter received.\n\nDreaming of a friend turning into a Croaky is quite interesting, but dreaming of family and friends is very normal and represents our feelings and longing for them. Spending a day playing with her and teasing her with your familiarity with the Jixia Hundred Schools represents your desire to spend quality time with her. Finally, her turning into a Croaky and running away represents your reluctance to let her go and your fear that she might become someone you can no longer understand. I think you already know your heart; write her a letter.

The airy dream was scattered by merciless cold winds; all that remained in sleep was chill and gloom.

Scout Maple, decisive and valiant, gallops across the battlefield with peerless archery. On April 22nd, our forces were ambushed in the valley and outnumbered. Maple shot down 45 enemy Shadow Assassins, protecting our troops and ensuring the safe return of the elderly, women, and children. This military commendation and the great bow "Enduring Valiance" are hereby awarded in recognition of these deeds.

It was my first time stepping into the Dreamrealm. Although Master Zhuangzi had often urged me to seek answers within my dreams, I was too afraid to face them.

But this dream was so bizarre, piercing my heart like a blade, and I had no one else to turn to.

Perhaps it was for the best that these three were with me; I hoped they could help me again if I were trapped in a nightmare.

But unexpectedly, shortly after entering the Dream Cave, the haze thickened, and a voice began to rise.

Only I could hear the faint whispers hidden in the smoke. The sound grew louder, and fear made my legs go weak. The other three just walked off on their own...

I tried my best to chase after them, but I couldn't find them and ended up wandering around the cave.

When I reached the deepest part of the cave, I saw a lonely figure sitting on a rock with her arms around her knees. She looked up when she heard my footsteps, and her clear eyes made me feel a sense of panic.

This was the legendary Dream Messenger...

She seemed a bit surprised, staring at me blankly. A moment later, her expression softened, even showing a hint of... pity?

I wanted to ask about the nightmares that plagued me, but I found I couldn't make a sound.

She stood up slowly, gently spreading her wings, and said: "Dreamer, the one who can unravel the cause and effect in your dreams is by your side. But this answer is too cruel for you right now. How I wish the nights in Jixia were an endless dream that never wakes, but when the dream ends, all of this will turn into a drop of morning dew, vanishing with the dawn..."

"Please... forgive me..."

The faint fluorescence in the cave spilled onto her wings, reminding me of the lonely moon hanging in the sky over Weijun, and a childhood lullaby echoed in my ears... My consciousness drifted away...

When I opened my eyes again, I saw the familiar faces of those three. Although I don't know why Zhuge Liang's clothes were soaked, Zhou Yu's hair looked singed, and as for Yuange, he looked strangely happy...

A long-awaited peaceful sleep, but unfortunately... I still didn't get the answer behind the nightmares.

I am willing to offer my entire fortune as payment for her treatment. I look forward to your reply.

Respectfully, Luo Anmin

据秘禁阁的观察发现，丁午亥其实是一种十分单纯的生物，它们观察世界的方式便是模仿并变换成不同的生物，并学习它们的生活习性。但它们常常会模拟一些危险的生物，这也使得丁午亥具有一定程度的危险性。

因此，秘禁阁会在游猎家研究出与丁午亥沟通的方法之前，暂时负责其收容工作。

注意：请勿擅自靠近或接触丁午亥，否则后果自负。

text: I hope my friend, wherever you are, whether in the past or future, you are safe and sound.

Wenbai mentioned that Senior Mayene is famous at the academy for slacking off, skipping classes, and spending all her time on the rooftops. Despite rarely training, her natural talent makes her one of the top students at the Martial Arts Academy.
Miao Yao introduced the important landmarks around Aerdeep Camp, pointed out the location of Zhuge Liang's tent, and described the grand sight of the Hundred Schools gathering here.

January 13
Starting today, I have to challenge the <5ea8f3>Tiger Leap</>. I couldn't keep up with the intensity and was punished by Master to clean up after dinner. Sigh, I don't think I'm cut out for martial arts.

March 5
I've mostly gotten used to the current training load, and I'm progressing quite fast. Thanks to my senior brother. Today, I saw a master come to challenge our dojo. Master fought him fiercely; it was spectacular. It seems Master doesn't even use a tenth of his strength when training us.

July 8
I accidentally got a minor injury while challenging another dojo yesterday. The other guy didn't mean it, so I didn't mind. But today, Master insisted on getting payback for me and went to challenge that dojo. He came back at dusk bruised and battered, looking even worse than me. It scared my senior brothers, but he just grinned and told me he taught that dojo a lesson. I must work hard to cultivate and not bring shame to Master or the Tiger Roar Hall.

Experiment Project:
Elimination of Mechcraft Exoskeleton Side Effects

Conclusion: After extensive testing, the side effects of using the exoskeleton cannot be completely eliminated. Dizziness and hallucinations caused by mental load persist.

The side effects of the exoskeleton cannot be fully eliminated. To prevent more serious consequences, research should be terminated immediately.

I hesitated for a long time before making this decision. After all, the seventh chapter of the Seven Chapters of Furious Battle is the most powerful combat technique of the Vanquisher, and it was a testament to our clan's former glory. But when I secretly practiced this technique one last time and felt an unprecedented burden, I knew that this skill had become a seed of disaster for us. For those who have lost the power of the Imbued, a technique that is too powerful is a force that their bodies cannot withstand. If this is true even for me, how can it be different for children who have never been Imbued? To prevent children who cannot resist the temptation from secretly practicing and ultimately harming themselves, I had to destroy the seventh chapter of the Seven Chapters of Furious Battle to sever the power of this forbidden technique.

The seniors say there's <69D0FF>a shapeshifting monster lurking in the Restricted Ground</>. It can mimic human shadows and kill without a trace... Students who try to steal the secret arts either end up severely injured or driven mad...

Ha! That might scare others, but it won't scare me!

I've made full preparations. Once I get my hands on the ancient magic arts, I'll make you all look at me with new eyes!

Inventor: Cheng Gang, School of Mechcraft\nSlogan: Nimble civet, hidden perfectly!\nConcept: Modeled after the Jixia Naughty Civet, this device features a flexible movement mechanism. Inspired by the civet's medicine-pounding, it is equipped with a mechanical hoe to quickly dig tunnels and burrow underground, allowing it to vanish during combat and reappear silently beside the opponent. Can also be used for agricultural assistance.
Peace has become an illusion. Foreseeing that chaos is about to spread, the Watchers set out to find a way to salvation.
Xiaoxi introduced the tent where Kongming once lived, along with his past achievements. He also mentioned that he is striving to follow in Kongming's footsteps.
Disaster arrives as expected. Sacrifice becomes the Watchers' final weapon, and a glimmer of hope is faintly ignited.

Set up hidden fires, iron fences, and bunkers from here. The enemy is attacking fiercely, and the battle is spreading. The soldiers do not extinguish their fighting spirit, holding the line to protect all living beings. The movement of the wooden fence is not a betrayal. Standing tall, it saves the refuge. Heroes fight hard, counterattacking in desperate situations, and the arch-enemy will eventually submit.
A wooden gourd identical to Li Bai's sits spotless on the desk.
Miao Yao introduced the important landmarks around Aerdeep Camp, pointed out the location of Zhuge Liang's tent, and described the grand sight of the Hundred Schools gathering here.
Peace has become an illusion. Foreseeing that chaos is about to spread, the Watchers set out to find a way to salvation.
The main job for new members of the Secrets Club is to organize submissions. It introduces theories about the club's origins and explains that there are no barriers to submitting work.
Disaster arrives as expected. Sacrifice becomes the Watchers' final weapon, and a glimmer of hope is faintly ignited.

Scout Maple, decisive and valiant, gallops across the battlefield with peerless archery. On April 22nd, our forces were ambushed in the valley and outnumbered. Maple shot down 45 enemy Shadow Assassins, protecting our troops and ensuring the safe return of the elderly, women, and children. This military commendation and the great bow "Enduring Valiance" are hereby awarded in recognition of these deeds.

Though Master Zhuangzi wanted to bring us four together, failing us outright was a bit extreme. Still, without such measures, perhaps the other three would have just laughed off his message.

Mengyu Lake is usually a place of peaceful dreams. I wonder what the Master is up to?

As we walked into the lake area, the clouds and mist grew thick before I realized that the others had disappeared.

The mist around me seemed alive, slowly writhing as if whispering something. I felt a bit panicked...

Until I turned and saw myself standing behind me! What is going on? I am behind myself? Then who am I?

I looked down at my arm; the patterns carved into my palm were so familiar...

Am I a puppet?

Just as I was stunned, "I" mounted a white horse and began to move forward.

Where is "I" going? I had a vague, ominous feeling.

I can't let it continue! I couldn't make a sound, so I just quickened my pace, but the white horse ran faster and faster.

I chased with all my might, and just as I was about to catch up to "I", a sharp whistle pierced the sky.

Then countless arrows flew over, and I had nowhere to hide.

The place where I was hit felt wet... is it blood flowing out...

Slowly, I opened my eyes... a furry little creature was staring at me blankly, then blew a bubble at me.

Was that just... a dream? Or did this little guy save me from it?

In the deep mist of the great dream, the proud hunter impales its sorrowful prey upon the thorns.

After being awakened from the cruel dream, reality changes as well.

The answer to the question of what is real and what is illusion... is hidden at the end of the Butterfly Envoy's trail.

I leave this record as a warning to those who follow. The disaster beast's body is hard as iron, its soul as solid as stone; even the mechanisms of the extraction machine could not deal it a heavy blow. With no other choice, I intend to restart the power of the Sealed Gods left behind by the Council Chamber and subdue it myself. I am willing to bear the power of the Sealed Gods! I am proud to be a God-Smith!
The central pillar provides shelter. A place to rest, and a refuge from the war.

November 20th
Ever since we visited the Forbidden Chamber and learned those sealed truths, everything has changed.

I told him he was too obsessed with the destructive nature of ancient magic, but he claimed I was the one who changed—that the academy had influenced me too deeply, making me forget my "mission."

When he left, Xin Wuwei tried to follow him with its mechanical toy, but I immediately stopped it.
It was so scared it didn't dare move. That’s when I realized it couldn't understand the complex relationships between people, nor why friends could become enemies overnight.

Qin Xiao, oh Qin Xiao, I feel like I can see you less and less. You don't even remember many of the things we experienced together.
We created Xin Wuwei to prove ourselves, but did you pay a price I don't know about?
<69D0FF>Even true monsters can maintain a pure and kind nature.</>
<69D0FF>Yet, despite how hard I tried to hold your hand, I still became your enemy.</>

The Divine Smith lineage is already unrecognizable; there is no "mission" left to speak of.
Before Xin Wuwei is stained by the filth of this world, I think it's time to take it away.

Day 3

We arrived near Bastion Fort. Along the way, we encountered Shye, who showed a keen interest in ancient artifacts, so she joined our expedition team.

This area is desolate, like an abandoned ancient realm, with no signs of anyone. Shye said she could feel many undiscovered treasures hidden here, sleeping deep within this ancient city, ignored by all.

After a careful search, Shye quickly mapped out a treasure-hunting route into Bastion Fort, as if she had been here before. Although we were here for archaeology and her intention was treasure hunting, our cooperation was quite pleasant.

When the light fades, our faith defies the darkness. When the light returns, the warriors shall come home. Remember those who have not returned, and do not forget those who have; wherever this lamp shines is our home. May the ancient roar echo eternally, deep and resolute, awakening the hope that lies dormant.
The Mystery of the Headless Statue

Dear Shye,

It seems your business is doing well. I am pleased that your commercial talents can be put to use in Jixia. As for the income from the Com-fluence Models, I think it's best if you manage it yourself. I've heard reports of monster attacks in the Jiebei region recently; perhaps you could use it to help the victims, which would be a testament to their trust in Jixia.

Zhuangzi

Outskirts, Cloudy and Rainy. We took a walk to a small pavilion outside Frostcloud Town. The scenery was so beautiful, it felt like an art gallery created by nature. This gave me an idea: I wanted to test if Luban No. 7 had the ability to paint. He accepted my proposal, and a moment later, he used his unique brushstrokes to create the first painting of his life for me. The painting was full of mechanical beauty. Although it was just a few strokes and made me laugh and cry at the same time, it proved that he could perceive the emotions between scenery and people. It was just a bit immature... I almost forgot to record the experimental data again. Experimental data... let's stop recording here. No. 7 should not be treated as an ordinary mechanism. He is different. He is... my child.
The Mechcraft dummy Novar uses for martial arts practice is quite worn out, showing signs of heavy use.

January 22

Li Bai visited again today. It's rare to have such a refined customer, so I offered him a flask of brew on the house and explained my concerns.

My ancestors have been selling brew in Dreamweave Plains for generations, and our customers love this taste. Would it cause problems if I changed it rashly? Besides, this recipe is the most important thing my father left me; how could I change it so easily?

Li Bai seemed to want to say something, but stopped, only smiling: "Fair enough, fair enough. Never mind, let's not talk about this." He then invited me to drink with him. As he drank, he told me about his travels, and I shared my brewing insights. As we drank and chatted, I eventually fell asleep.

When I woke up, Li Bai was nowhere to be found, leaving only money on the table and a pair of empty ceramic cups.
                                                                                          Lu Changping

Inventor: Penn, School of Mechcraft\nSlogan: Devour the sky, laugh at the moon, fearless of storms!\nConcept: Powered by a self-strengthening mechanical core, it can unleash unparalleled speed and power in an instant to capture targets with lightning efficiency. Even in the dark, the mechanical hound can pinpoint opponents with its keen sense of smell and hearing, leaving nowhere for lurkers to hide.

Dear Mozi, my friend,

I've heard that you've become deeply engrossed in researching Mechcraft exoskeletons lately. I am somewhat concerned, so I'm writing to nag you a bit.

As far as I know, exoskeletons are cheap to produce and powerful in effect. They should have been invincible weapons of war, but they aren't widely used precisely because of their severe side effects. Now that you are so devoted to this research, are you secretly working for some general?

Just kidding. I trust you know what you're doing, but this thing is dangerous. One wrong step, and you could go down the wrong path.

- Laozi
A giant Mechanoid once brought disaster to Jixia. Now, its weapons, head, hands, and armor are scattered in ruins across Springbrook Plains.

Master Shi Yu: 
We are all slowly pulling ourselves together, which is great. 
I've met some very special people recently. Do you want to hear about them? 
 
There is a sister named Shye who has a beautiful smile; a grumpy kid who uses machine guns and cannons, whose temper sometimes reminds me of you; a very confident boy who seems to shine, named Novar... And a strange uncle who always stared at my mechanical wings with a weird look. It turned out he thought my wings had accumulated quite a few issues and gave me a new pair... I'll bring them for you to see when I come next time. 
 
By the way, we are going to form a team called "Team Star" to participate in the academy's "Void Dreamscape" competition. Have you heard of it? 
 
They make me feel very warm, just like Tian Ji and you... Perhaps they will be my new friends. 
                                                                                                                                                                       Sun Bin

A new Butterfly Envoy has been born among the Dreamweavers. The new envoy, reborn with magnificent wings, will shoulder the burden of the prophet.\n\nThe ethereal dream will eventually transform into a butterfly, and the responsibility between dream and reality has suddenly fallen upon her.

I foresee overwhelming black thorns originating from the deepest part of dreams, winding through the cracks of the Dreamland and entering reality from the dream.

Black thorns surge, lakes dry up, forests burn to ash, and the Dreamweavers lament in the fire.

Black thorns entwine, mountains collapse, towers crumble, and the dreamers weep in the ruins.

Black thorns decay, leaving only dark nothingness in the world. A butterfly flaps its wings in solitude, finally coming to rest on the tip of a thorn.

Master Shi Yu:
Sorry for making you worry. I've been busy developing mechanical legs to replace my own, which is why I haven't been around... I finally finished them today.

I fell many times when I first tried to walk, but I've mastered it now, and life should return to normal soon. If Tian Ji were still here, he might have encouraged me...

It feels like just yesterday when Tian Ji introduced us. You still haven't accepted that he's gone, have you? I heard you haven't been to Shi Sheng lately, and I'm a bit worried. If you see this, please write back as soon as you can, okay?
                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                                       Sun Bin

January 22

Li Bai visited again today. It's rare to have such a refined customer, so I offered him a flask of brew on the house and explained my concerns.

My ancestors have been selling brew in Dreamweave Plains for generations, and our customers love this taste. Would it cause problems if I changed it rashly? Besides, this recipe is the most important thing my father left me; how could I change it so easily?

Li Bai seemed to want to say something, but stopped, only smiling: "Fair enough, fair enough. Never mind, let's not talk about this." He then invited me to drink with him. As he drank, he told me about his travels, and I shared my brewing insights. As we drank and chatted, I eventually fell asleep.

When I woke up, Li Bai was nowhere to be found, leaving only money on the table and a pair of empty ceramic cups.
                                                                                          Lu Changping

Dear Master Fuzi:
Yesterday, I helped the kitchen process a batch of dried fish and accidentally ate a bit too much. Considering Mayene's helpful nature, could you please grant me leave? I won't be attending class today.
Applicant: Mayene

Approval Status: Rejected.
Mayene, stop trying to fool me with such ridiculous excuses! And if I recall correctly, this is your eighteenth leave request this month. Enough is enough—don't even think about taking any more leave this month.

According to my recent observations, you all struggle to handle flashy and smooth moves and styles. This shouldn't be a problem. When facing such opponents, if they are fast, you must be even faster than them. To improve your speed, all daily training will follow a new routine from now on:
First, the time requirement for Flying Tiger Jumps and Tiger Tail Plank Walks is halved. You must be faster than your yesterday's self every single day!
Second, the daily quantity of basic actions such as blade swings and punches is doubled. You still need to build a solid foundation for me!
Third, add at least two more weighted sandbags to each person. The more you add, the faster you'll be when you take them off!

Keep it up and work hard, little pups!

I almost forgot to record the experimental data again. Experimental data... let's stop recording here. No. 7 should not be treated as an ordinary mechanism. He is different. He is... my child.

The builder of Chang'an, Master Mozi earned great fame across the continent. He advocated using technology to improve the world and end conflicts. He designed the Aerflow Weaver and constructed school buildings, bringing prosperity to Jixia.

I hesitated for a long time before making this decision. After all, the seventh chapter of the Seven Chapters of Furious Battle is the most powerful combat technique of the Vanquisher, and it was a testament to our clan's former glory. But when I secretly practiced this technique one last time and felt an unprecedented burden, I knew that this skill had become a seed of disaster for us. November 16th
Just like when it ran away, <69D0FF>someone intentionally taught it to harm others.</>

<69D0FF>He actually wanted to train Xin Wuwei into a weapon to realize his ambitions.</>

I paced around the basement, knocking things over. It just lay there obediently; it knew I was angry.
It can't distinguish between good and evil like a human, so how could it be capable of malicious harm?
I told Xin Wuwei that I would protect it.
It understood, and happily went back to biting its mechanical toy.

I suddenly remembered what he told Xin Wuwei:
"In front of you, people can be divided into three types.
Those who turn and run are prey.
Those who attack are enemies.
Those who are willing to shake hands with a monster are friends."

Xun,

By the time you read this, you've likely discovered the secret of the clock.

I stumbled upon this clock by chance. I'm not sure how it works—perhaps it contains a fragment of a time mechanism? Haha, it can actually <69D0FF>briefly reverse time</>.

I always felt that as long as I was with you, I wouldn't need such a thing, no matter the difficulty.

But I also thought, what if this clock could be useful to you?

Though I worry about the instability of the time fragment, I hope it gives you an extra chance—and even more so, that you never have to use it...

The Aerux Well in Dreamweave Plains has supported the land for a thousand years. The Brew Barrel Prototype once made excellent brews, but it became worn out over time. After three months of careful work, Luban upgraded the Brew Barrel. The new brew tastes even better and is now popular throughout Harvest Fields.

Yao:

Winning the Enlightenment Trials is a testament to your strength. Well done.
After this, don't worry about me.
Just focus on what you need to do.

                                                                                                                                        Jing
A massive bow named "Enduring Valiance" with an inscription: "To Scout Maple, a warrior of legendary deeds. This hero's bow is forged in your honor."
The Academy has produced many heroes who declare their own truths. The convergence of ideas has turned Jixia into the paradise it is today.

Dear Master Mozi,

Perhaps you don't remember me. My name is Luo Anmin. I studied at Jixia years ago and was fortunate enough to attend your lectures.

I now run a workshop in Chang'an, but my wife recently suffered an accident... She fell from a great height and will never be able to stand again.

My wife was born into a family of martial artists and has loved weapons since she was a child. Now that this has happened... it's laughable, but I often weep because of it, while she is the one who comforts me.

I suddenly wondered, if medicine is helpless in this matter, could your ingenious mechanism arts grant my wife new legs?

I am willing to offer my entire fortune as payment for her treatment. I look forward to your reply.

Respectfully, Luo Anmin

Experiment Project:
Exploring Mechcraft Exoskeleton Strength

Conclusion: The enhancement the exoskeleton provides to human physical function is terrifying. It not only grants one a body of steel, capable of lifting mountains, but also the agility of a bird flying through the woods.

When calamity struck, we forged glory from our faith. The pure lands of the past now rely on our own hands to reclaim. Gathering the faith of many creates a new fruit, both bitter and sweet. Unless experienced firsthand, no one knows its true meaning. The ancient contract began at the dawn of time and continues unbroken.

Inventor: Ye Chiu, School of Mechcraft\nSlogan: Irresistible flavors for everyone, even the pickiest eaters!\nConcept: Combines the finest dishes from the master chefs of Frostcloud Town with premium mechanical materials to cook irresistible food in record time, distracting opponents' senses to lure them into a trap.

Students from the School of Mechcraft have shown amazing creativity. Ping Yin's Mechcraft Dog is incredibly fast. Ye Chiu's Mechanoid Cook makes delicious food. Xun Rihua's Croaky Squad creates chaos. Zheng Feng's Mechanoid Bird brings peace. Cheng Gang's Mechanoid Civet is great at surprise attacks. Who do you think should win?

Mechanism Name: Brew Barrel Prototype

Purpose: Used to steam and purify water when toxic substances increase.

Applicable Scenarios: During periods of abnormal Aerflow, when aquatic life mutates.

Development Team: Jixia Academy, School of Mechcrafts.

Acknowledgements: Mr. Yun Shunqi, a villager of Fengyunye.

A butterfly flutters its wings above still waters. Ripples spread with the breeze, turning into waves that shade the sun. In this unbalanced paradise, all things will sink into a dream from which they cannot wake...

Master Fuzi rebuilt Jixia Academy, embracing a policy of universal education, welcoming talented individuals from across the world, and spreading the torch of knowledge across the continent once more.

Monthly tests? Endless stress! Instead of scratching your head, just take a nap.

If you get sleepy in class, cover your face with a book. If you get caught, draw an eye on your eyelid—just don't make it too big, speaking from experience!

For the mountain climbing exam, make sure to ask the local villagers for a detailed map so you can take a shortcut.

When asking for leave, use different excuses: sick leave, personal leave, visiting family, etc. Don't take leave too often within a month, remember that!
Hidden beneath Dragon Valley is a secret chamber with four large murals showing the alliance between the Sanctified and the dragons. Today, only ruins and dragon bones are left to tell their story.

The headless statue in Springbrook Plains gets a lot of attention. Some students try to climb it, while others are curious about its history. Who is the statue meant to represent? Look for clues around Springbrook Plains.

The text notes that the difficulty in replicating the giant automaton lies in its internal structure and power source. Researchers at the helmet have identified the location of the power core, while those at the giant hand are still investigating its mechanical construction.

Chang Xiaodee loves poetry and uses Sorcery runes to record her poems. About one in ten villagers have inherited Sorcery, and the Sorcery here seems to be a bloodline inheritance that cannot be spoken of to outsiders.

While developing Luban No. 7, Luban traveled with him across the West Aerfall Highlands to enhance its functionality. But eventually, the experiment was abandoned as Luban had found something far more valuable.

For many years, the Brew Barrel invented by Mechcraft students has been a great help to the people of Dreamweave Plains. However, years of wear and tear have taken their toll on the mechanisms. At the same time, the operation of the Brew Barrel was still too cumbersome for ordinary people.

During his time at school, Master Luban traveled to Dreamweave Plains. Upon learning of this, he responded to Master Mozi's call and took on the task of improving the Brew Barrel. After three months of research and development, he finally completed the improvements. This not only increased the extraction content of Cloud Root but also greatly optimized the efficiency of the mechanism, and even further improved the taste of Cloud Well Brew.

To thank Master Luban for his research, Feng Yunya sent him many local specialties, all of which were eventually donated by Master Luban to the Jixia Academy cafeteria.
Disaster never halts for individual sacrifice, yet resolute mountain passes divide the fires of war.
The headless statue currently studied by many was once investigated by Sima Yi.
Using her sharp business sense, Shye helped the Northton Trade Union uncover the Navenian merchants' scheme and protect their goods. She then donated her reward to help disaster survivors.
Though the dragon has passed, its soul endures. Offer your respects here. The stars may shift, but the oath remains unchanged. Though the night be long, the flame shall not dim.

Item Name: Forbidden Item Ding-Chou-Yin (Mechanoid)
Danger Level: Class D
Status: Contained
Description: Originally an unamed Mechcraft Kite, its appearance and power do not match at all. It is aggressive towards males wearing specific styles of white clothing, with eighty-two recorded injury cases. According to victims, this item sprays fire when its appearance is criticized. According to investigations, this item was made by the academy student Zhou Yu. Although its mechanoid power has not reached the top tier, its unknown aggressiveness meets containment criteria.
Note: Although this item has been contained for some time, the surrounding temperature is still showing an upward trend for unknown reasons. Staff members are requested not to approach while wearing white clothing.

After many setbacks, I finally neutralized the side effects of the Mechcraft exoskeleton. But to keep greedy eyes away, I had to claim the research was a failure.

Subsequent research had to be conducted in secret. To simplify the design and improve usability, the project was upgraded to assistive mechanical prosthetics.

After completing Luo Anmin's commission, I can begin mass-producing these prosthetics for various body parts. I will distribute them personally to ensure they never fall into the hands of the wicked.

If any descendants discover the secrets here, please do not speak of them. Only those holding this note can access the control console; press the switch within, and my research will remain hidden.

Today's peace is hard-won. Please think twice before acting, and do not let the sparks of war spread across the world.

Item Name: Forbidden Item Ding-Chou-Yin (Mechanoid)
Danger Level: Class D
Status: Contained
Description: Originally an unamed Mechcraft Kite, its appearance and power do not match at all. It is aggressive towards males wearing specific styles of white clothing, with eighty-two recorded injury cases. According to victims, this item sprays fire when its appearance is criticized. According to investigations, this item was made by the academy student Zhou Yu. Although its mechanoid power has not reached the top tier, its unknown aggressiveness meets containment criteria.
Note: Although this item has been contained for some time, the surrounding temperature is still showing an upward trend for unknown reasons. Staff members are requested not to approach while wearing white clothing.

text:
To Lian Po:

I've heard rumors of your impressive martial skills, but there are too many braggarts these days. I, Ling Hu, am highly skeptical of your actual strength. I grant you the opportunity to challenge me and receive my guidance. Meet me at [Location] on [Date] at [Time] to settle this. Don't be late.

Ling Hu

Inventor: Ye Chiu, School of Mechcraft\nSlogan: Irresistible flavors for everyone, even the pickiest eaters!\nConcept: Combines the finest dishes from the master chefs of Frostcloud Town with premium mechanical materials to cook irresistible food in record time, distracting opponents' senses to lure them into a trap.

Xun,

By the time you read this, you've likely discovered the secret of the clock.

I stumbled upon this clock by chance. I'm not sure how it works—perhaps it contains a fragment of a time mechanism? Haha, it can actually <69D0FF>briefly reverse time</>.

I always felt that as long as I was with you, I wouldn't need such a thing, no matter the difficulty.

But I also thought, what if this clock could be useful to you?

Though I worry about the instability of the time fragment, I hope it gives you an extra chance—and even more so, that you never have to use it...

The builder of Chang'an, Master Mozi earned great fame across the continent. He advocated using technology to improve the world and end conflicts. He designed the Aerflow Weaver and constructed school buildings, bringing prosperity to Jixia.

Inventor: Cheng Gang, School of Mechcraft\nSlogan: Nimble civet, hidden perfectly!\nConcept: Modeled after the Jixia Naughty Civet, this device features a flexible movement mechanism. Inspired by the civet's medicine-pounding, it is equipped with a mechanical hoe to quickly dig tunnels and burrow underground, allowing it to vanish during combat and reappear silently beside the opponent. Can also be used for agricultural assistance.
In a desperate situation, a low, ancient roar pierces the night. A tribe from the sky brings new stories.

Mayene has made a name for herself at the School of Martial Arts by skipping class with a quick "time to bail!" before heading to the roof. She's got a ton of excuses for leave requests, and her How to Pet the Bubble Fish is a campus hit.

When the light fades, our faith defies the darkness. When the light returns, the warriors shall come home. Remember those who have not returned, and do not forget those who have; wherever this lamp shines is our home. May the ancient roar echo eternally, deep and resolute, awakening the hope that lies dormant.
At the place where the dragon's bones lie, people light lanterns to pray for the warriors' safe return and to mourn those who never gave up.

A student at the School of Sorcery was troubled by strange dreams and asked for help. In one dream, he kept waking up in Frostcloud Town. In another, a childhood friend visited Jixia and turned into a Croaky. A teacher at the North Dream Repository gave helpful advice.

Morning: Buy the first batch of freshly baked Croaky Yolk Tarts. Attend the Frostcloud Energy Brew tasting at the Ingenious Tea Shop—must look sharp. Discuss astrology with the astrologer at the Fate-Asking Pavilion. Afternoon: Practice sword swings 300 times. Head to the Martial Arts Academy to spar with classmates. Visit Fuzi; he's asking for my progress report again. Evening: Write back to Mayene. Haidu is too far, and postage is so expensive.

Li Bai once enjoyed Time Brew in Dreamweave Plains. He suggested Lu Changping add a fruit flavor to improve it, but the latter, loyal to his family's traditional recipe, refused. Despite their disagreement, they still shared drinks and traded stories and brewing tips.

Party A: Xishi
Party B: Baihuifang
After negotiation between Party A and Party B, an agreement has been reached on the following terms, which are mutually binding and to be observed.

Article 1: Design Commercial Authorization
Party A authorizes Party B to use the "Star Squad" likeness to create non-scale models and publicly sell them at Party B's venue.
If Party B needs to add new designs during the sales process, the agreement must be renegotiated with Party A.

Article 2: Pricing and Quantity
In actual commercial activities, Party B shall abide by the following covenants:
The selling price of the models shall not be higher than the average price of other commodities of the same type.
Model sales shall adopt a limited-quantity sales model, with a total of no more than one hundred pieces per single sale.
If it is necessary to increase the pricing or additional production quantities, the agreement must be renegotiated with Party A.

Article 3: Profit and Sharing
Party B shall open accounts during the sales process, promptly register various information, and cooperate with Party A's inspection.
Party A and Party B agree that the profits obtained from sales will be shared in a six-to-four ratio.

乙方：百汇坊 
甲乙双方经协商，对以下各条款达成协议，相互约束并遵守。 
 
第一条：造型商业授权 
甲方授权乙方使用“星之队”形象制作非等比模型，并于乙方场地进行公开售卖。 
乙方在销售过程中，如需添加新设计，应重新与甲方商定协议。 
 
第二条：定价及数额 
在实际商业行为中，乙方应遵守如下约定： 
模型售价不得高于其他同类型商品的均价。 
模型贩售应采用限量销售模式，单次售卖总数不超过一百个。 
如需提高定价，或追加制作数量，应重新与甲方商定协议。 
 
第三条：利润与分成 
乙方在销售过程中应公开账目，及时登记各类信息，配合甲方查验。 
甲乙双方约定销售所获利润额按六比四分成。

text: The key to stabilizing the Great Dream is hidden in the northern cave. The Butterfly Envoy will fulfill her duty one last time.\n\nEven knowing that the light is the heart of the fire that burns destiny, she heads there resolutely. Is she a butterfly? Or a moth?
A mechanical creation with a faint signature, "Tian Ji" is barely legible. Its design is round and charming, and its demeanor is somewhat familiar—like a certain Jixia student...

Master Shi Yu: Recently, Yao brought back a new student who passed the exam set by Senior Yango and successfully entered the academy. It's amazing! This new student has forgotten many things, but their conduct remains rational and measured. They've completed all the academy courses well, and the mentors and deans have given them high praise. Plus... they are a very gentle person... I always feel like they are more mature than all of us. They even take care of me, praise me, and I feel very at ease when we act together... If there's a chance, I'll bring the new student to Shi Sheng to see you! Sun Bin

Crosswind Bridge, Sunny I remember bringing Luban No. 7 to Crosswind Bridge hoping he could help with the experiment, but who would have guessed he was afraid of heights? He almost fell right off. It seems I still need to look into why small mechanoids are afraid of heights. For now, I can only try to comfort him. Luckily, his emotions stabilized shortly after, and he forgot all about it, counting clouds by himself on the bridge. Such a child... Almost forgot to record experimental data. Environment Humidity: Thirty. Emotional Data: Thirty.

text:
I hope this month's treasure hunt yields the expected results. 
I hope next month's business is booming. 
By the way, I hope the Star Team has a happy and smooth time at the next Dream of the Void performance. 
I'm not a greedy person, but if only one of these wishes can come true, let it be the last one.

Since entering the shelter, we have survived, but we haven't seen the sun rise or set, and we have lost track of time.

Everyone is filled with sorrow, fearing we will never return home.

My friends and I have gathered treasures from all over and, with the help of a master smith, combined them to lure future generations to find them.

I have carved three stone tablets to record the story of our refuge; those who view them will know the whole truth.

Treasures may be rediscovered, but the years of the displaced will never return.

The Forbidden Chamber stores many dangerous items. Some can create storms, some can change shape, and some have mysterious origins. Staff use strict procedures to keep these objects contained and to manage any possible risks.

Shye,

Thanks to your righteous words that day, our goods finally returned safely to the Chamber of Commerce. Those Navenian merchants were truly cunning, trying to get something for nothing! We have decided that in the future, we will conduct preliminary investigations before doing business with Navenians. After all, we won't always have a kind person like you to help us.

Additionally, we heard you are cooperating with the Com-fluence Workshop, and we would very much like to work with you. The Chamber of Commerce will always keep a consultant position open for you. If you are interested, you are welcome to come to the Chamber for a detailed discussion, and we will do our best to offer you the top-tier rewards.

Enclosed is a Magic Crystal as a token of our gratitude.

Jiebei Chamber of Commerce

Located between the wheat fields of Dreamweave Plains, the Aerux Well is a natural spring that has existed for thousands of years. The water is clear and pure, rich in Aerux energy. Drinking it strengthens the body, and using it for irrigation nourishes crops, causing plants to grow exceptionally lush.

A certain Wu Zi will bring disaster in dreams. Hurry to Dreamwhisper Lake, or it will be too late. Even a Croaky could easily see through such a crude strategy; why leave such a cryptic note?

Why didn't Zhuangzi just come to me alone instead of dragging those three along, especially Kongming? He has absolutely no interest in dreams or Dreamweavers.

Oh well, whatever. So even Zhuangzi needs to rely on our wisdom now?

But this fog is getting thicker... turning from purple to black. The smell of smoke and fire is growing stronger, and the air is shifting from humid to dry—even breathing it in makes one feel restless... Could the lake water actually be burning?

"Commander! The east wind is howling, the signal fires are lit, and the fleet is broken!" someone in armor shouted at me.

Where is this battlefield? Is this towering inferno my own handiwork?

At the end of the smoke, I seem to see a familiar figure, bowing respectfully to me.

It's Kongming!

Have I finally surpassed him? So this is what they call... being lost in a dream?

But the heat of this smoke and fire feels far too real... No! This isn't a dream! There really is fire!

How could there be so many fire crystals by Dreamwhisper Lake? Is this a trap set by Zhuangzi?!

Although the village appears peaceful and isolated, it is far from ordinary. Some villagers have Martial Arts skills, unusual strength, and even Sorcery powers. These abilities suggest the village has a secretive and mysterious history.

Martial Arts Student: Win. He was overconfident. I've never been afraid of anyone in the Azure Arena.
Bai He: Lose. It was raining, didn't perform well.
Lian Po: Lose. Didn't eat before leaving, almost broke his defense, but then I got hungry.
Qing Xiaotian: Draw. He hurt my apprentice, and my anger affected my performance, otherwise I would've snapped his cannon.
Zhong Wuyan: Lose. Shouldn't have gone to Qingyixuan last night, my stomach hurts from the spice.
..................
Lao Fuzi: Lose. Zheng Zheng Zheng Yi. The old fox hides his moves and cheats every time, I'm not convinced!

Yao:

Winning the Enlightenment Trials is a testament to your strength. Well done.
After this, don't worry about me.
Just focus on what you need to do.

                                                                                                                                        Jing
Time to bail is Mayene's catchphrase. Some students use it as a signal to skip class.

Academy Observatory — Sunny. Wanting to add some novel elements to the academy observatory for a change, I brought Luban No. 7 along here. He pointed at the starry sky and said: If we could move the stars in the sky to the observatory, I could figure out how stars travel through that galaxy. Thus, the "Triple Floating Orbit and Continuously Rotating Spherical Basket" was born, simulating the trajectories of planets in the universe. At that moment, I felt that No. 7, just like any other child, possessed unique and whimsical ideas. I am proud of him. Experimental data recorded below. Environmental humidity: Ten. Emotional data: Seventy.

text: Mayene on How to Slack Off

A butterfly flutters its wings above still waters. Ripples spread with the breeze, turning into waves that shade the sun. In this unbalanced paradise, all things will sink into a dream from which they cannot wake...

The Forbidden Chamber in the back mountain is now closed, but monster legends persist, drawing many students to investigate. It turns out that a teacher named Ling Yu once worked in the Forbidden Chamber and created the Sin-Wu-Wei with his good friend Qin Xiao, even mentioning that a "mission" still needed to be completed. Who on earth were they working for?
zh_text: 后山禁院现已闭院，但流传着怪物传说，引得不少学子前去探秘。原来禁院曾经有一位教师凌羽，与好友秦霄共同创造了辛午未，还提到尚有“使命”需要完成，他们究竟为谁效力？

text: I've been busy handling some affairs at the North Dream Repository lately, so my replies have been a little slow—sorry about that!\n\nI have a general understanding of the recurring dream you described. The first dream likely occurred during your previous exam period. Frequently "waking up" multiple times in the dream indicates that you were feeling anxious at the time, which affected your sleep, while the several trips to Frostcloud Town represent your desire to relax and have fun with your classmates after the long preparation for the exams.

Vanquishers are swift and agile, capable of evading incoming attacks. \nEnchanters are smart and skilled at neutralizing attacks with tricks. \nContrivers utilize their skills in Mechcraft to keep any situation under control.

A new Butterfly Envoy has been born among the Dreamweavers. The new envoy, reborn with magnificent wings, will shoulder the burden of the prophet.\n\nThe ethereal dream will eventually transform into a butterfly, and the responsibility between dream and reality has suddenly fallen upon her.
An enrollment certificate with Fuzi's signature and commentary: Break old rules, defy rigid norms, create opportunities, and let your brilliance shine.
The trophy won by Jixia's Team of Stars in the Enlightenment Trials, gleaming with dazzling brilliance.

January 21

I didn't expect to meet the famous Li Bai today. He is just as the legends say—elegant, dashing, and otherworldly. He bought a flask of Time Brew immediately and drank it with great gusto. He even approached me to suggest improvements to the brew.

Li Bai thinks I should add some fruitiness, like fruit juice, to enrich the flavor and layers of the Time Brew. I disagree; I feel that would ruin the brew's original mellow aroma. He called me stubborn. Well, if insisting on the classic taste is stubborn, then I'd rather be stubborn for a lifetime.

I only knew Li Bai for his famous swordsmanship and poetry; I never expected him to be a connoisseur of brewing as well.
                                                                                           Lu Changping

The key to stabilizing the Great Dream is hidden in the northern cave. The Butterfly Envoy will fulfill her duty one last time.\n\nEven knowing that the light is the heart of the fire that burns destiny, she heads there resolutely. Is she a butterfly? Or a moth?

The messenger who grants fine dreams quietly shed its splendid wings in the long night.

Like dew at dawn, it left no trace behind.

The lost memento is the key to all mysteries...
According to editor ▮▮ intelligence, the reclusive Intendant of the Forbidden Chamber is obsessed with the path of immortality! ▮▮▮▮ Evil mechanism!

The Enlightenment Trials are a significant celebration for Jixia's students, and Aerux Town is a crucial stop for those traveling to participate. With the coming and going of students, the commerce of Aerux Town has taken on a completely different direction. Among them, the Baihui Workshop is worth mentioning; they publish and sell many products related to academy celebrities, which have become popular among students...

Dear Shye,

Thank you very much for helping us authenticate the antiquities a while ago. Based on your insights, we have arranged for professional restorers and appraisers to protect them. Due to their rarity, we may not consider selling them and will keep them for collection and exhibition instead.

As a token of our gratitude, we have found a little something interesting for you, and we hope it brings you some joy.

Association of Antiquity Appraisers

Sun Bin tried to start over by working hard to study Mechcraft. Even though he is now a member of the Team of Stars, he never forgets his old friend. The Mechanoid named Tian Ji is a symbol of how much he misses him.

Monthly tests? Endless stress! Instead of scratching your head, just take a nap.

If you get sleepy in class, cover your face with a book. If you get caught, draw an eye on your eyelid—just don't make it too big, speaking from experience!

For the mountain climbing exam, make sure to ask the local villagers for a detailed map so you can take a shortcut.

When asking for leave, use different excuses: sick leave, personal leave, visiting family, etc. Don't take leave too often within a month, remember that!

Inventor: Xun Rihua, School of Mechcraft\nSlogan: Croaky Croaky, the hungry winner!\nConcept: Possesses the keenest sense for gourmet food; once detected, they swarm in groups to devour everything in sight, often used to clean up cafeteria leftovers. The Croaky Squad is also adept at mimicking the calls of young Croakies, providing constant noise interference during competitions or serving as playmates.

Containment Protocol:
Stay in well-lit areas. Use light.

Artifact Description:
A formless darkness; anything or anyone it envelops disappears.

Use light generated by ███ to constrain its movements.

Dear Mozi, my friend,

I've heard that you've become deeply engrossed in researching Mechcraft exoskeletons lately. I am somewhat concerned, so I'm writing to nag you a bit.

As far as I know, exoskeletons are cheap to produce and powerful in effect. They should have been invincible weapons of war, but they aren't widely used precisely because of their severe side effects. Now that you are so devoted to this research, are you secretly working for some general?

Just kidding. I trust you know what you're doing, but this thing is dangerous. One wrong step, and you could go down the wrong path.

- Laozi

Zhuangzi mastered the Way of Sorcery, exploring Oneirland and establishing connections with the Dreamweavers. He guides students to understand the essence of all things and pursue the state of universal oneness.

It finally worked! 
 
This device... it made me younger overnight. Your illness can be cured now, right? 
 
I dreamed of you last night. We spent decades together in that dream. One day, you turned to me and said, "Life is so short, but at least we were together." 
 
I regret the choices I made. It wasn't until you became seriously ill, until time was running out for you, that I realized how much we had missed together. 
 
Maybe this device will make you young again too. Maybe we'll get a second chance. 
 
But my waking time is getting shorter every day. I have to find you quickly... Hurry! Mechcraft! 
 
(The handwriting becomes increasingly distorted.)

Recently, research into ancient Sorcery has led to several malicious incidents. <69D0FF>Teacher Ling Yu is still missing.</>

To prevent the situation from worsening, the academy is temporarily closed. Students, please wait patiently for further notice.

<69D0FF>A Sorcery construct is on the loose.</> If you see it, report it to Teacher Hao Qiang at the Martial Arts Academy immediately. Do not approach it.
Wu Yiwang introduces the strange circle on Fengyun Field to people, claiming it was left by the sword energy of a drunken swordsman from the past. It is truly amazing.
Wooden crates, copper pots, and an extinguished campfire are left along the cave path. The crates seem to contain food scraps and daily supplies.
According to editor ▮▮ intelligence, the reclusive Intendant of the Forbidden Chamber is obsessed with the path of immortality! ▮▮▮▮ Evil mechanism!

The Secrets Club was started by Intelligencers. Its members gather secrets, legends, folk stories, and information about hidden treasures in Jixia that are not found in official records. They share exciting stories that encourage students to explore the wild.
The text mentions the mechanical armor plates found in Chunxi Plains, as well as the nearby giant spear and giant hand, speculating that they all originated from a colossal automaton.

Dear Shye,

Thank you very much for helping us authenticate the antiquities a while ago. Based on your insights, we have arranged for professional restorers and appraisers to protect them. Due to their rarity, we may not consider selling them and will keep them for collection and exhibition instead.

As a token of our gratitude, we have found a little something interesting for you, and we hope it brings you some joy.

Association of Antiquity Appraisers

The Enlightenment Trials are a significant celebration for Jixia's students, and Aerux Town is a crucial stop for those traveling to participate. With the coming and going of students, the commerce of Aerux Town has taken on a completely different direction. Among them, the Baihui Workshop is worth mentioning; they publish and sell many products related to academy celebrities, which have become popular among students...

Master Shi Yu:
I've found a perfect place to gather energy! It's at the Stargazing Terrace!

I know you'll scold me, maybe even point your finger at me and say, "Stop doing those damn experiments!" But even if there's the slightest chance, I have to try.

One day, I will find a way to bring him back from where he disappeared.
                                                                                                                                                                        Sun Bin

The Cangyuan Trial is held to select the most exceptional talents of our people.
It requires tempering the spirit and honing the body.
True gold fears no fire, and every skill has its use.
Defending our home is a duty we cannot shirk.
A massive bow named "Enduring Valiance" with an inscription: "To Scout Maple, a warrior of legendary deeds. This hero's bow is forged in your honor."

Though Master Zhuangzi wanted to bring us four together, failing us outright was a bit extreme. Still, without such measures, perhaps the other three would have just laughed off his message.

Mengyu Lake is usually a place of peaceful dreams. I wonder what the Master is up to?

As we walked into the lake area, the clouds and mist grew thick before I realized that the others had disappeared.

The mist around me seemed alive, slowly writhing as if whispering something. I felt a bit panicked...

Until I turned and saw myself standing behind me! What is going on? I am behind myself? Then who am I?

I looked down at my arm; the patterns carved into my palm were so familiar...

Am I a puppet?

Just as I was stunned, "I" mounted a white horse and began to move forward.

Where is "I" going? I had a vague, ominous feeling.

I can't let it continue! I couldn't make a sound, so I just quickened my pace, but the white horse ran faster and faster.

I chased with all my might, and just as I was about to catch up to "I", a sharp whistle pierced the sky.

Then countless arrows flew over, and I had nowhere to hide.

The place where I was hit felt wet... is it blood flowing out...

Slowly, I opened my eyes... a furry little creature was staring at me blankly, then blew a bubble at me.

Was that just... a dream? Or did this little guy save me from it?

Development Log Day 47:
Fermentation starter and vessel completed. 23 modifications made.
Fermentation vessel under modification; the sedimentation device needs improvement. 12 modifications made.

Development Log Day 69:
Distiller research completed. No modifications.

Development Log Day 71:
Sealing and canning device pending research, estimated 15 days.
(Need to collect more data on brewing techniques. Although I've conducted 67 experiments, I'm still not quite at the perfect flavor.)

Luban

Master Shi Yu: 
We are all slowly pulling ourselves together, which is great. 
I've met some very special people recently. Do you want to hear about them? 
 
There is a sister named Shye who has a beautiful smile; a grumpy kid who uses machine guns and cannons, whose temper sometimes reminds me of you; a very confident boy who seems to shine, named Novar... And a strange uncle who always stared at my mechanical wings with a weird look. It turned out he thought my wings had accumulated quite a few issues and gave me a new pair... I'll bring them for you to see when I come next time. 
 
By the way, we are going to form a team called "Team Star" to participate in the academy's "Void Dreamscape" competition. Have you heard of it? 
 
They make me feel very warm, just like Tian Ji and you... Perhaps they will be my new friends. 
                                                                                                                                                                       Sun Bin
The headless statue currently studied by many was once investigated by Sima Yi.

The Cangyuan Trial is held to select the most exceptional talents of our people.
It requires tempering the spirit and honing the body.
True gold fears no fire, and every skill has its use.
Defending our home is a duty we cannot shirk.
A wooden gourd identical to Li Bai's sits spotless on the desk.
In a desperate situation, a low, ancient roar pierces the night. A tribe from the sky brings new stories.

Theme 1: It is said that every midnight, mysterious singing is heard from Joy Pool. Is it the Music Society's secret performance, or does this music come from other creatures? Comment: This topic has high recent interest and is worth writing about, but requires field investigation for more information. Theme 2: The latest issue of "Guessing the True Identity of the Mysterious Statue" caused a huge reaction, with three hundred students participating in the vote. Comment: The guesses are still all over the place; it is recommended to communicate further with the Ethnographer before considering publication. Theme 3: Recently, the Gatebreakers have been active near the giant Automaton. What evil plan do they have this time, and which heroic student will step in to stop them? Comment: Close monitoring is recommended, but please stay safe.

While exploring Mozi's abandoned laboratory, you and Mek discovered that Mozi's research on the Mechcraft exoskeleton was officially shut down because it was considered too risky. However, the research secretly continued and was successful, which helped the paralyzed wife of Mozi's friend.

The seniors say there's <69D0FF>a shapeshifting monster lurking in the Restricted Ground</>. It can mimic human shadows and kill without a trace... Students who try to steal the secret arts either end up severely injured or driven mad...

Ha! That might scare others, but it won't scare me!

I've made full preparations. Once I get my hands on the ancient magic arts, I'll make you all look at me with new eyes!

Inventor: Penn, School of Mechcraft\nSlogan: Devour the sky, laugh at the moon, fearless of storms!\nConcept: Powered by a self-strengthening mechanical core, it can unleash unparalleled speed and power in an instant to capture targets with lightning efficiency. Even in the dark, the mechanical hound can pinpoint opponents with its keen sense of smell and hearing, leaving nowhere for lurkers to hide.
Time to bail is Mayene's catchphrase. Some students use it as a signal to skip class.

Chang Xiaodee loves poetry and uses Sorcery runes to record her poems. About one in ten villagers have inherited Sorcery, and the Sorcery here seems to be a bloodline inheritance that cannot be spoken of to outsiders.

Maple is the head of Red Falcon Training Hall and is known for her strict discipline and high standards, which come from her experience with the Great Wall Guards. She arrived in Jixia alone, carrying a letter of commendation, a large bow as a symbol of her achievements, and the good wishes from her former comrades.

Kongming and the Seekers set up a camp while exploring the highlands together. Over time, this camp became a base for expedition teams and travelers. The name "Aerdeep Camp" was first written at Kongming's simple desk.

A certain Wu Zi will bring disaster in dreams. Hurry to Dreamwhisper Lake, or it will be too late. Even a Croaky could easily see through such a crude strategy; why leave such a cryptic note?

Why didn't Zhuangzi just come to me alone instead of dragging those three along, especially Kongming? He has absolutely no interest in dreams or Dreamweavers.

Oh well, whatever. So even Zhuangzi needs to rely on our wisdom now?

But this fog is getting thicker... turning from purple to black. The smell of smoke and fire is growing stronger, and the air is shifting from humid to dry—even breathing it in makes one feel restless... Could the lake water actually be burning?

"Commander! The east wind is howling, the signal fires are lit, and the fleet is broken!" someone in armor shouted at me.

Where is this battlefield? Is this towering inferno my own handiwork?

At the end of the smoke, I seem to see a familiar figure, bowing respectfully to me.

It's Kongming!

Have I finally surpassed him? So this is what they call... being lost in a dream?

But the heat of this smoke and fire feels far too real... No! This isn't a dream! There really is fire!

How could there be so many fire crystals by Dreamwhisper Lake? Is this a trap set by Zhuangzi?!

Forbidden Artifact Name: Forbidden Artifact D-Wu-Hai (Strange Beast)
Danger Level: Class B
Status: Strict Containment
Description: A peculiar creature captured in the Jixia Wilderness. Its true form is a mass of purplish-black gel-like substance capable of transforming into other creatures it comes into close contact with.

The origin and age of D-Wu-Hai are untraceable, but Jixia folklore contains scattered records related to it, such as the Legend of the Doppelganger and the True and False Bear Assassins...

Observations by the Forbidden Chamber reveal that D-Wu-Hai is actually a very simple creature. Its way of observing the world is by imitating and transforming into different creatures and learning their living habits. However, it often mimics dangerous creatures, which also gives D-Wu-Hai a certain degree of danger.

Therefore, the Forbidden Chamber will temporarily handle its containment until rangers discover a method to communicate with D-Wu-Hai.

Note: Do not approach or touch D-Wu-Hai without authorization, or bear the consequences at your own risk.
zh_text:
秘禁品名：秘禁丁午亥（奇兽）
危险等级：乙级
状态：严密收容
介绍：于稷下荒野捕捉到的奇异生物，本体是一团紫黑色的凝胶状物体，能够将自身转化成其他与之近距离接触的生物形态。

丁午亥的来源与年龄已不可考，但在稷下的传说故事中也有只鳞片羽和它相关的记载，例如：二重身的传说、真假刺熊……

据秘禁阁的观察发现，丁午亥其实是一种十分单纯的生物，它们观察世界的方式便是模仿并变换成不同的生物，并学习它们的生活习性。但它们常常会模拟一些危险的生物，这也使得丁午亥具有一定程度的危险性。

因此，秘禁阁会在游猎家研究出与丁午亥沟通的方法之前，暂时负责其收容工作。

注意：请勿擅自靠近或接触丁午亥，否则后果自负。

text:
Day 6 
Xishi arrived safely at camp with our expedition team. From the look of regret on her face, I could tell she was passionate about the ancient ruins, but she chose safety over an ill-prepared expedition for everyone's sake. 
 
We sat around the campfire with her, laughing and talking freely. Xishi shared her dream with us—not of exploring, but of treasure hunting. After all, that is her greatest passion and joy, and I believe she will achieve it.

Aerux Town was built based on the Great Aerux. As the population grew, the influx of people led to the construction of the Aerux Inn at the top of the Aerux to meet various needs. The inn has been in business for many years, focusing on clouds and driving the export of local specialties, gradually transforming the town from a transit point into a starting point...

Day 5 
 
The long-sealed Mausoleum is rarely visited, and the amount of undiscovered treasures within goes without saying. The ancient architecture and mysterious carvings seem even more enigmatic under the passage of time. However, a powerful energy permeates the air, leaving us all feeling a bit uneasy. 
 
Perhaps sensing our unease, Xishi was the first to speak up. She felt that this expedition lacked proper preparation and that entering blindly was irresponsible to everyone. After gathering everyone's opinions, we returned to camp to rest. She decided to return another day with her companions from the Star Team.

I can never forget that bone-chilling fear! It was like a nightmare—a shadowy monster, both human and inhuman, surging with the power to destroy the world. In an instant, the village was engulfed in disaster. Roaring fires mercilessly consumed everything, and homes were reduced to ruins under the monster's trampling. Screams filled the air; many who couldn't escape were severely injured, and my mother suffered a grave leg injury while protecting me. The cruelty of those enemies left the entire village reeking of misery. Fortunately, as we fled in panic, we encountered a squad of soldiers. Their armor bore very special patterns, unique designs that were like a glimmer of hope in the darkness. Under their protection, we escaped to a cave for shelter. The wooden fence around the cave seemed to sense the danger and hurriedly blocked the entrance, allowing us to narrowly escape the monster's pursuit. Once inside, everyone sat around the campfire to prepare food, and in that brief moment of peace, our anxious hearts found a little solace. However, this calm was but a fleeting illusion. That terrifying monster is still roaming the wilderness, like a dark shadow ready to pounce on us at any moment, leaving us trembling with fear. Where should we go from here?

In the deep mist of the great dream, the proud hunter impales its sorrowful prey upon the thorns.

After being awakened from the cruel dream, reality changes as well.

The answer to the question of what is real and what is illusion... is hidden at the end of the Butterfly Envoy's trail.

The East Aerfall Highlands were once mysterious and unexplored. The first time I crossed the Crosswind Bridge, I was with the naturalists, and we camped here. We went out during the day to investigate and explore the unknown, and shared intelligence and huddled around the fire at night. Later, more explorers flocked here. The East Aerfall Highlands were no longer a dangerous place. Supplies and cutting-edge instruments were transported in, and artifacts were shipped to the academy and various parts of Jixia for research. This small tent witnessed the birth of the Cloud-Deep Camp with me.
Items Contained in the Forbidden Chamber

We went out during the day to investigate and explore the unknown, and shared intelligence and huddled around the fire at night. Later, more explorers flocked here.
