Experiment Project:
Elimination of Mechcraft Exoskeleton Side Effects

Conclusion: After extensive testing, the side effects of using the exoskeleton cannot be completely eliminated. Dizziness and hallucinations caused by mental load persist.

The side effects of the exoskeleton cannot be fully eliminated. To prevent more serious consequences, research should be terminated immediately.

We master craftsmen build with mechanisms, casting a furnace within and adding bronze wings. With supreme blue flames to burn away the dross, the creation is forged, known as Bi Fang. The cave is rich in copper ore, refined by the blue flames of Bi Fang to produce cyan-smelted gold. This metal is indigo through and through, shaped like a blade, with excellent ductility and resistance to melting, perfect for forging legendary weapons.

The text mentions that researchers at the Giant Hand are dismantling it. If the power issue is resolved, the automaton could be reactivated. Furthermore, the giant automaton technology here seems vastly different from the current Jixia mechanics.
Two weapons rest on the wooden rack. One is the sword frequently used by Novar. The other is of a similar style but looks brand new, with no signs of use.

The airy dream was scattered by merciless cold winds; all that remained in sleep was chill and gloom.

When gentle visions are replaced by solid ice, does it signal the end of a tender ideal?

After the winds and snow scattered the dream... the dreamer was nowhere to be found... Where did she go?

Shye,

Thanks to your righteous words that day, our goods finally returned safely to the Chamber of Commerce. Those Navenian merchants were truly cunning, trying to get something for nothing! We have decided that in the future, we will conduct preliminary investigations before doing business with Navenians. After all, we won't always have a kind person like you to help us.

Additionally, we heard you are cooperating with the Com-fluence Workshop, and we would very much like to work with you. The Chamber of Commerce will always keep a consultant position open for you. If you are interested, you are welcome to come to the Chamber for a detailed discussion, and we will do our best to offer you the top-tier rewards.

Enclosed is a Magic Crystal as a token of our gratitude.

Jiebei Chamber of Commerce

Wenbai mentioned that Senior Mayene is famous at the academy for slacking off, skipping classes, and spending all her time on the rooftops. Despite rarely training, her natural talent makes her one of the top students at the Martial Arts Academy.

It worked! 
 
This Mechcraft has actually turned me back into my student self overnight. Your illness must be curable now, right? 
 
Last night, I dreamed of you again. We spent decades together in that dream. Then one day, you suddenly said, "Life is short. At least we have each other." 
 
I regret my past choices. Now that your illness has taken its toll, I realize how much we've missed together. 
 
I hope this Mechcraft can help you regain your youth, so you can live again. 
 
But I'm losing my waking hours every day... I must hurry and find you... Quick! My Mechcraft! 
 
(The writing becomes increasingly distorted)
A life-sized cutout of Li Bai. It is spotless, as if it is cleaned frequently.

Aerux Town sits on a major road in Jixia and has grown with the academy's success. Built on the great Aerux, it exports unique goods worldwide. During the Enlightenment Trials, students' rising demand for Com-fluence products turns the town into a lively marketplace.
The text mentions that no records exist for the giant statue and speculates on several reasons for this omission.

It was my first time stepping into the Dreamrealm. Although Master Zhuangzi had often urged me to seek answers within my dreams, I was too afraid to face them.

But this dream was so bizarre, piercing my heart like a blade, and I had no one else to turn to.

Perhaps it was for the best that these three were with me; I hoped they could help me again if I were trapped in a nightmare.

But unexpectedly, shortly after entering the Dream Cave, the haze thickened, and a voice began to rise.

Only I could hear the faint whispers hidden in the smoke. The sound grew louder, and fear made my legs go weak. The other three just walked off on their own...

I tried my best to chase after them, but I couldn't find them and ended up wandering around the cave.

When I reached the deepest part of the cave, I saw a lonely figure sitting on a rock with her arms around her knees. She looked up when she heard my footsteps, and her clear eyes made me feel a sense of panic.

This was the legendary Dream Messenger...

She seemed a bit surprised, staring at me blankly. A moment later, her expression softened, even showing a hint of... pity?

I wanted to ask about the nightmares that plagued me, but I found I couldn't make a sound.

She stood up slowly, gently spreading her wings, and said: "Dreamer, the one who can unravel the cause and effect in your dreams is by your side. But this answer is too cruel for you right now. How I wish the nights in Jixia were an endless dream that never wakes, but when the dream ends, all of this will turn into a drop of morning dew, vanishing with the dawn..."

"Please... forgive me..."

The faint fluorescence in the cave spilled onto her wings, reminding me of the lonely moon hanging in the sky over Weijun, and a childhood lullaby echoed in my ears... My consciousness drifted away...

When I opened my eyes again, I saw the familiar faces of those three. Although I don't know why Zhuge Liang's clothes were soaked, Zhou Yu's hair looked singed, and as for Yuange, he looked strangely happy...

A long-awaited peaceful sleep, but unfortunately... I still didn't get the answer behind the nightmares.
The main job for new members of the Secrets Club is to organize submissions. It introduces theories about the club's origins and explains that there are no barriers to submitting work.

Master Fuzi rebuilt Jixia Academy, embracing a policy of universal education, welcoming talented individuals from across the world, and spreading the torch of knowledge across the continent once more.
The trophy won by Jixia's Team of Stars in the Enlightenment Trials, gleaming with dazzling brilliance.

Inventor: Xun Rihua, School of Mechcraft\nSlogan: Croaky Croaky, the hungry winner!\nConcept: Possesses the keenest sense for gourmet food; once detected, they swarm in groups to devour everything in sight, often used to clean up cafeteria leftovers. The Croaky Squad is also adept at mimicking the calls of young Croakies, providing constant noise interference during competitions or serving as playmates.
I want to surpass Li Bai to become the world's best swordsman. Only then can I truly stand shoulder-to-shoulder with my sister.

Day 3

We arrived near Bastion Fort. Along the way, we encountered Shye, who showed a keen interest in ancient artifacts, so she joined our expedition team.

This area is desolate, like an abandoned ancient realm, with no signs of anyone. Shye said she could feel many undiscovered treasures hidden here, sleeping deep within this ancient city, ignored by all.

After a careful search, Shye quickly mapped out a treasure-hunting route into Bastion Fort, as if she had been here before. Although we were here for archaeology and her intention was treasure hunting, our cooperation was quite pleasant.

Although I have no interest in the Philosophy of Dreams, since Zhuangzi went to the trouble of setting this up for us four, I might as well see what he wants to teach me.

Failing us four specifically and leaving a note—this trap is a bit too obvious.

That's the style of that elusive sage, I suppose.

I just didn't expect that after arriving at the misty center of Mengyu Lake, the other three, who are usually so cautious, would end up separated from me.

Perhaps it was the influence of the dream; my body felt heavier, and even breathing became difficult...

Until I looked up and realized I had entered an army camp?

The flickering lights in the tents formed the pattern of constellations. As the lights grew brighter, I felt life force gradually gathering within me.

Suddenly, a cold wind blew, and the lights went out. In an instant, my blood was frozen by the cold wind, as if I had lost my life.

The cold lake water soaked my clothes, and Zhuangzi was staring at me with his usual smile.

"Who is the first to awaken from the great dream?" he asked.

Vanquishers are swift and agile, capable of evading incoming attacks. \nEnchanters are smart and skilled at neutralizing attacks with tricks. \nContrivers utilize their skills in Mechcraft to keep any situation under control.
Disaster never halts for individual sacrifice, yet resolute mountain passes divide the fires of war.

November 20th
Ever since we visited the Forbidden Chamber and learned those sealed truths, everything has changed.

I told him he was too obsessed with the destructive nature of ancient magic, but he claimed I was the one who changed—that the academy had influenced me too deeply, making me forget my "mission."

When he left, Xin Wuwei tried to follow him with its mechanical toy, but I immediately stopped it.
It was so scared it didn't dare move. That’s when I realized it couldn't understand the complex relationships between people, nor why friends could become enemies overnight.

Qin Xiao, oh Qin Xiao, I feel like I can see you less and less. You don't even remember many of the things we experienced together.
We created Xin Wuwei to prove ourselves, but did you pay a price I don't know about?
<69D0FF>Even true monsters can maintain a pure and kind nature.</>
<69D0FF>Yet, despite how hard I tried to hold your hand, I still became your enemy.</>

The Divine Smith lineage is already unrecognizable; there is no "mission" left to speak of.
Before Xin Wuwei is stained by the filth of this world, I think it's time to take it away.

A woman tried to learn forbidden secrets to turn back time and save her friend. When she finally succeeded, the dangerous side effects made her stop. Actually, the clock her friend had given her already held the solution.

I shall strive to reach the forbidden land, yearning only to perish alongside it. To those who come later, if you have received orders to reinforce this position, turn back immediately upon reading this. The situation has exceeded our initial expectations and hope is slim; I am rescinding my request for reinforcements. Turn back, and take care.

Stonecraft Garden, Cloudy. Today I took Luban No. 7 to the Stonecraft Garden and taught him how to play hide-and-seek. He was thrilled when he heard it, and I hid him in a slightly secluded corner. Then I started counting. When I counted to one and turned around, he was nowhere to be found. While I anxiously searched everywhere and was about to activate the ascending flight Mechcraft wings to fly into the air, a soft chuckle interrupted my actions. I spotted him amidst a pile of stones, and just as he noticed my anxious expression, he suddenly ran over and hugged me. My annoyance and anxiety instantly vanished into thin air. text: I've been busy handling some affairs at the North Dream Repository lately, so my replies have been a little slow—sorry about that!\n\nI have a general understanding of the recurring dream you described. The first dream likely occurred during your previous exam period. Frequently "waking up" multiple times in the dream indicates that you were feeling anxious at the time, which affected your sleep, while the several trips to Frostcloud Town represent your desire to relax and have fun with your classmates after the long preparation for the exams.

Lu Buqi is training the next generation of village protectors. Lu Buqi's father once left six martial arts cultivation methods on the bronze vessels in the ancestral hall, but the seventh was missing.
An enrollment certificate with Fuzi's signature and commentary: Break old rules, defy rigid norms, create opportunities, and let your brilliance shine.

Master, I recently had a puzzling dream and would like your insight: I dreamed that a childhood friend came to visit me at Jixia. We went to the Star-Gazing Platform for divination, but I can't remember the question, only that I was happy with the answer. Later, we watched a performance, and she was startled by a lifelike puppet. Finally, we went to Yu Huan's shop, where I played a prank on her by ordering a dish that looked mild but was actually very spicy. She was so spicy that she hit me while drinking water. At night, when I took her to the female students' dormitory to stay, she told me she didn't need to, then turned into a frog and hopped into the forest, and then I woke up.
The central pillar provides shelter. A place to rest, and a refuge from the war.
Once Upon a Time in Labyrinth Cave

For many years, the Brew Barrel invented by Mechcraft students has been a great help to the people of Dreamweave Plains. However, years of wear and tear have taken their toll on the mechanisms. At the same time, the operation of the Brew Barrel was still too cumbersome for ordinary people.

During his time at school, Master Luban traveled to Dreamweave Plains. Upon learning of this, he responded to Master Mozi's call and took on the task of improving the Brew Barrel. After three months of research and development, he finally completed the improvements. This not only increased the extraction content of Cloud Root but also greatly optimized the efficiency of the mechanism, and even further improved the taste of Cloud Well Brew.

To thank Master Luban for his research, Feng Yunya sent him many local specialties, all of which were eventually donated by Master Luban to the Jixia Academy cafeteria.

Dear Shye,

It seems your business is doing well. I am pleased that your commercial talents can be put to use in Jixia. As for the income from the Com-fluence Models, I think it's best if you manage it yourself. I've heard reports of monster attacks in the Jiebei region recently; perhaps you could use it to help the victims, which would be a testament to their trust in Jixia.

Zhuangzi

Located in the north, Aerux Town is a crucial thoroughfare for Jixia. Shops gradually gathered in the town, becoming a hub for trade. With the prosperity of Jixia Academy, scholars from all schools gathered here, making the town more livable and turning it into a major residential hub for merchants.
Our people had always lived in Springbrook Plains, in tune with the turning seasons. But the war shattered that peace...

text: Shye and the Seekers went on an expedition to Bastion Fort and the Mausoleum. However, a strong energy at the Mausoleum's entrance forced them to stop. Still curious about what was inside, Shye decided she would come back another time with the Team of Stars.

Since entering the Sky Pillar, everyone has been filled with anxiety.

Although the academy has helped ensure our basic needs are met, we are far from home with an uncertain future. The elders are heartbroken, and the children are in tears.

Though the Sky Pillar has a faint glow, it cannot compare to the light of the sun.

I still see the spring breezes over the creek and the autumn leaves on the distant mountains in my mind. But living in this deep cave, I fear I will eventually forget them.

I carve these words into stone so that if we ever leave this cave, we may remember what we felt today.

I can never forget that bone-chilling fear! It was like a nightmare—a shadowy monster, both human and inhuman, surging with the power to destroy the world. In an instant, the village was engulfed in disaster. Roaring fires mercilessly consumed everything, and homes were reduced to ruins under the monster's trampling. Screams filled the air; many who couldn't escape were severely injured, and my mother suffered a grave leg injury while protecting me. The cruelty of those enemies left the entire village reeking of misery. Fortunately, as we fled in panic, we encountered a squad of soldiers. Their armor bore very special patterns, unique designs that were like a glimmer of hope in the darkness. Under their protection, we escaped to a cave for shelter. The wooden fence around the cave seemed to sense the danger and hurriedly blocked the entrance, allowing us to narrowly escape the monster's pursuit. Once inside, everyone sat around the campfire to prepare food, and in that brief moment of peace, our anxious hearts found a little solace. However, this calm was but a fleeting illusion. That terrifying monster is still roaming the wilderness, like a dark shadow ready to pounce on us at any moment, leaving us trembling with fear. Where should we go from here?

No one has ever seen the true form of Forbidden Artifact G-Xin-Zi. Its external shape and structure change when unobserved. Its birth is suspected to be related to the research of forbidden sorcery arts.

text: The Academy has produced many heroes who declare their own truths. The convergence of ideas has turned Jixia into the paradise it is today.

Letter received.\n\nDreaming of a friend turning into a Croaky is quite interesting, but dreaming of family and friends is very normal and represents our feelings and longing for them. Spending a day playing with her and teasing her with your familiarity with the Jixia Hundred Schools represents your desire to spend quality time with her. Finally, her turning into a Croaky and running away represents your reluctance to let her go and your fear that she might become someone you can no longer understand. I think you already know your heart; write her a letter.

January 21

I didn't expect to meet the famous Li Bai today. He is just as the legends say—elegant, dashing, and otherworldly. He bought a flask of Time Brew immediately and drank it with great gusto. He even approached me to suggest improvements to the brew.

Li Bai thinks I should add some fruitiness, like fruit juice, to enrich the flavor and layers of the Time Brew. I disagree; I feel that would ruin the brew's original mellow aroma. He called me stubborn. Well, if insisting on the classic taste is stubborn, then I'd rather be stubborn for a lifetime.

I only knew Li Bai for his famous swordsmanship and poetry; I never expected him to be a connoisseur of brewing as well.
                                                                                           Lu Changping

To Lian Po:

I've heard rumors of your impressive martial skills, but there are too many braggarts these days. I, Ling Hu, am highly skeptical of your actual strength. I grant you the opportunity to challenge me and receive my guidance. Meet me at [Location] on [Date] at [Time] to settle this. Don't be late.

Ling Hu

Party A: Xishi
Party B: Baihuifang
After negotiation between Party A and Party B, an agreement has been reached on the following terms, which are mutually binding and to be observed.

Article 1: Design Commercial Authorization
Party A authorizes Party B to use the "Star Squad" likeness to create non-scale models and publicly sell them at Party B's venue.
If Party B needs to add new designs during the sales process, the agreement must be renegotiated with Party A.

Article 2: Pricing and Quantity
In actual commercial activities, Party B shall abide by the following covenants:
The selling price of the models shall not be higher than the average price of other commodities of the same type.
Model sales shall adopt a limited-quantity sales model, with a total of no more than one hundred pieces per single sale.
If it is necessary to increase the pricing or additional production quantities, the agreement must be renegotiated with Party A.

Article 3: Profit and Sharing
Party B shall open accounts during the sales process, promptly register various information, and cooperate with Party A's inspection.
Party A and Party B agree that the profits obtained from sales will be shared in a six-to-four ratio.

text:
Day 6 
Xishi arrived safely at camp with our expedition team. From the look of regret on her face, I could tell she was passionate about the ancient ruins, but she chose safety over an ill-prepared expedition for everyone's sake. 
 
We sat around the campfire with her, laughing and talking freely. Xishi shared her dream with us—not of exploring, but of treasure hunting. After all, that is her greatest passion and joy, and I believe she will achieve it.

Recently, research into ancient Sorcery has led to several malicious incidents. <69D0FF>Teacher Ling Yu is still missing.</>

To prevent the situation from worsening, the academy is temporarily closed. Students, please wait patiently for further notice.

<69D0FF>A Sorcery construct is on the loose.</> If you see it, report it to Teacher Hao Qiang at the Martial Arts Academy immediately. Do not approach it.

Inventor: Zheng Feng, School of Mechcraft\nSlogan: Gentle Kitebird, guardian of the young!\nConcept: Crafted from shed feathers of various Jixia birds combined with sturdy mechanical wings, this device possesses immense patience and is immune to noise. Its massive wings fold forward to form a cradle for tired students and mechs to rest. Being embraced by it can lull one to sleep or, in extreme cases, drain one's fighting spirit until they become as helpless as an infant.

I foresee overwhelming black thorns originating from the deepest part of dreams, winding through the cracks of the Dreamland and entering reality from the dream.

Black thorns surge, lakes dry up, forests burn to ash, and the Dreamweavers lament in the fire.

Black thorns entwine, mountains collapse, towers crumble, and the dreamers weep in the ruins.

Black thorns decay, leaving only dark nothingness in the world. A butterfly flaps its wings in solitude, finally coming to rest on the tip of a thorn.
I want to surpass Li Bai to become the world's best swordsman. Only then can I truly stand shoulder-to-shoulder with my sister.

South of Dragon Valley lies the starting point of a historic journey. At that time, humans and dragons joined forces to cleanse the world. Thousands of heroes donned their armor, crossing passes to purge the enemy. The eternal lamp never goes out, waiting only for the return of old friends.
A mechanical creation with a faint signature, "Tian Ji" is barely legible. Its design is round and charming, and its demeanor is somewhat familiar—like a certain Jixia student...
It depicts the headless statue's silent testimony to the past, and the ghostly feeling it evokes at night.

Master, I recently had a puzzling dream and would like your insight: \n \nThe first dream was of me and my roommate going to Frostcloud Town, where we met a female classmate we were close to. We spent the evening in town and returned late. Then I woke up in my dorm and realized it was a dream. We went to the town again, but this time we met a male classmate. We stayed overnight and I woke up in my bed again. This cycle repeated with different places and people until the seventh time, after which it took me a good while to realize I was really awake.

Yesterday, after an intense training session, I collapsed from exhaustion and fell asleep in the training hall. When I woke up, my beloved long-bladed sword, which has a long tassel on the hilt, was missing. Could the student who found it please return it to me immediately?\n\nI was the duty student yesterday. When I saw you sleeping while sweeping, I originally intended to wake you up. But the Master walked up to you quietly and said that a martial artist should never be separated from their blade, and that sleeping so unguardedly was unacceptable, so he took the blade that had fallen beside you. You'll have to go ask him for it. Good luck.

Mechanism Name: Brew Barrel Prototype

Purpose: Used to steam and purify water when toxic substances increase.

Applicable Scenarios: During periods of abnormal Aerflow, when aquatic life mutates.

Development Team: Jixia Academy, School of Mechcrafts.

Acknowledgements: Mr. Yun Shunqi, a villager of Fengyunye.

We stayed overnight and I woke up in my bed again. This cycle repeated with different places and people until the seventh time, after which it took me a good while to realize I was really awake.

November 10 
I locked the Mechcraft well. How did it escape? 
 
Fortunately, I found it on the outskirts. 
It transformed into an Embermane, then a Bolthorn Bull, and finally a Wolvine chasing its tail. 
 
<69D0FF>Qin Xiao said the basement was constraining its destructive nature and brought it a Mechcraft toy.</> 
 
But how could a Mechcraft even have urges? 
Looking at the broken toy, I finally began to wonder.
The text mentions that no records exist for the giant statue and speculates on several reasons for this omission.
Our people had always lived in Springbrook Plains, in tune with the turning seasons. But the war shattered that peace...
The Mechcraft dummy Novar uses for martial arts practice is quite worn out, showing signs of heavy use.

Day 5 
 
The long-sealed Mausoleum is rarely visited, and the amount of undiscovered treasures within goes without saying. The ancient architecture and mysterious carvings seem even more enigmatic under the passage of time. However, a powerful energy permeates the air, leaving us all feeling a bit uneasy. 
 
Perhaps sensing our unease, Xishi was the first to speak up. She felt that this expedition lacked proper preparation and that entering blindly was irresponsible to everyone. After gathering everyone's opinions, we returned to camp to rest. She decided to return another day with her companions from the Star Team.

I shall strive to reach the forbidden land, yearning only to perish alongside it. To those who come later, if you have received orders to reinforce this position, turn back immediately upon reading this. The situation has exceeded our initial expectations and hope is slim; I am rescinding my request for reinforcements. Turn back, and take care.

Throwing a precious item into Pearlized Lake is said to bring your wish to life. It's a beloved ritual among Jixia students. Look closely into the water, you might find wishes left by several Team of Stars members.

Aerux Town was built based on the Great Aerux. As the population grew, the influx of people led to the construction of the Aerux Inn at the top of the Aerux to meet various needs. The inn has been in business for many years, focusing on clouds and driving the export of local specialties, gradually transforming the town from a transit point into a starting point...

We master craftsmen build with mechanisms, casting a furnace within and adding bronze wings. With supreme blue flames to burn away the dross, the creation is forged, known as Bi Fang. The cave is rich in copper ore, refined by the blue flames of Bi Fang to produce cyan-smelted gold. This metal is indigo through and through, shaped like a blade, with excellent ductility and resistance to melting, perfect for forging legendary weapons.

November 16th
Just like when it ran away, <69D0FF>someone intentionally taught it to harm others.</>

<69D0FF>He actually wanted to train Xin Wuwei into a weapon to realize his ambitions.</>

I paced around the basement, knocking things over. It just lay there obediently; it knew I was angry.
It can't distinguish between good and evil like a human, so how could it be capable of malicious harm?
I told Xin Wuwei that I would protect it.
It understood, and happily went back to biting its mechanical toy.

I suddenly remembered what he told Xin Wuwei:
"In front of you, people can be divided into three types.
Those who turn and run are prey.
Those who attack are enemies.
Those who are willing to shake hands with a monster are friends."

I hope this month's treasure hunt yields the expected results. 
I hope next month's business is booming. 
By the way, I hope the Star Team has a happy and smooth time at the next Dream of the Void performance. 
I'm not a greedy person, but if only one of these wishes can come true, let it be the last one.
Though the dragon has passed, its soul endures. Offer your respects here. The stars may shift, but the oath remains unchanged. Though the night be long, the flame shall not dim.

Dear Maple, how have you been? It's been years since we last served together at the Great Wall. I hear Jixia is full of talent and that the Red Falcon Pavilion is strictly disciplined under your management, just like a military camp. I can't wait to visit. I've sent some timber with this letter for making bows. You mentioned before that you liked that fragrant wood—it's perfect for carving trinkets. I've commissioned a merchant to send some extra your way. That's all for now. Looking forward to our reunion! Your old friend from the Garrison.

text:
Although I have no interest in the Philosophy of Dreams, since Zhuangzi went to the trouble of setting this up for us four, I might as well see what he wants to teach me.

Failing us four specifically and leaving a note—this trap is a bit too obvious.

That's the style of that elusive sage, I suppose.

I just didn't expect that after arriving at the misty center of Mengyu Lake, the other three, who are usually so cautious, would end up separated from me.

Perhaps it was the influence of the dream; my body felt heavier, and even breathing became difficult...

Until I looked up and realized I had entered an army camp?

The flickering lights in the tents formed the pattern of constellations. As the lights grew brighter, I felt life force gradually gathering within me.

Suddenly, a cold wind blew, and the lights went out. In an instant, my blood was frozen by the cold wind, as if I had lost my life.

The cold lake water soaked my clothes, and Zhuangzi was staring at me with his usual smile.

"Who is the first to awaken from the great dream?" he asked.

A gathering place for hunters organized by the Hunters. Hunters from all over come here to exchange skills. Through hunting simulation instruments, they simulate the habitats of disaster beasts and engage in combat. The capable can even climb the Hunter Leaderboard and earn recognition from the Hunters.

When in bear or human form, it summons Nightmare Butterflies to grab a player and fly toward the Nightmare Rift. Teammates must shoot down the butterflies in time; otherwise, falling into the rift will trigger a devastating explosion.
The Fence King will summon self-destructing Fences with higher damage at a higher frequency.
The Wanshu Hammer releases three consecutive full-screen shockwaves. Before each release, it teleports to the edge of the arena, with each shockwave facing a different direction.

Periodically, 1 Void Orb(s) will spawn around each player, rotating continuously. Players can touch the Void Orbs to eliminate them and gain Crit Damage +15% for 30 seconds. If a Void Orb still exists 20 seconds after spawning, it will explode, dealing massive AoE damage.
zh_text: 每隔一段时间，在每个玩家身边生成1个持续绕玩家旋转的虚空球。玩家触碰虚空球可以消除虚空球，并获得暴击伤害+15%效果，持续30秒。若虚空球生成20秒后依然存在，则会爆炸造成大范围伤害。

text: Periodically, 4 lightning zones are generated on the ground. Entering a zone activates it, causing lightning to strike and deal damage. The player who triggers the zone gains 5% All-round Adeptness for 30s. If a zone is not activated within 30 seconds, it explodes, dealing even higher large-area damage.

The Sky-Slayer Spirit returns to the arena to charge and summon five rotating constellations, while also releasing three layers of expanding ring-shaped area damage. Players must dodge the continuous ground fire while shattering the constellation nodes.
Damage from ground fire is significantly increased; even brief contact can be fatal.
The Brutal Tiger's shield durability increases significantly during its charge; the team must focus fire to break it.

Every so often, 2 ice pillars with significantly increased HP will spawn at random locations on the field. If not destroyed within 30 seconds of spawning, they will explode, dealing massive damage in a large area. Players who destroy an ice pillar will receive a shield equal to 30% of their active character's Max HP.

After charging, the Brutal Tiger immediately leaps to the center and slams the ground repeatedly, causing a screen-wide shockwave. Only by picking up the dropped Mechanism Shield can you block it; jumping or dodging will not help.

The Halberd-Slayer Spirit's fire shield remains on the field. Four players must accurately identify and lure their respective clones into the shield while staying spread out to avoid overlapping paths.
Each player enters a cooldown after blocking with a shield. Teammates must take turns picking up shields to handle the continuous attacks from random directions.
After the Darkest Nightmare descends, the location of the Nightmare Light Platform will change randomly, making it hard to predict.
The Radish King will intermittently summon self-destructing radishes with significantly increased damage
Every so often, Mechanical Academy students with significantly increased HP will spawn at random locations on the field. They provide a 20% damage reduction aura to nearby enemies.
Blade-wielding small radishes appear on the sidelines to hunt down unbound players. You must lure their slashes to cut the vines and rescue your teammates.

The Wood Fence King absorbs the life force of nearby small wood fences, expanding rapidly and covering itself in impenetrable thorn armor. Bomb-throwing guards appear on the sidelines; only by picking up their fire bombs and throwing them at the King's armor can its defenses be dismantled. Otherwise, its power will grow with its size until it crushes everything.

The Bomb-Thrower's fire bombs explode shortly after landing. Players must pick them up and throw them at the Wooden Fence King within the time limit; otherwise, you will lose the critical window for armor-breaking.
15 seconds after one Casting Boss dies, both will immediately go berserk.

Every so often, 2 ice pillars with higher HP will spawn at random locations on the field. If not destroyed within 30 seconds of spawning, they will explode, dealing higher damage in a large area. Players who destroy an ice pillar will receive a shield equal to 30% of their active character's Max HP.

The rotation speed of the starlight walls has become extremely fast, and the escape gaps vanish in an instant. The pressure of tracking the Constellation Shadows is greatly increased, posing a massive test to the team's output and coordination.

Periodically, 4 Water Orbs are generated on the field, slowly flying toward the boss. Players can touch the orbs to eliminate them and restore 25% Ultimate energy to the on-field resonance. If they hit a monster, they restore a larger amount of HP to the monster.
The summoned Nightmare Butterflies have significantly increased life force and are harder to defeat quickly.
The cost of holding the Nightmare Light has become heavier, and the rate of Max HP loss has accelerated sharply, forcing the team to complete the relay and escort as quickly as possible.
The Brutal Tiger leaps to the center and slams the ground repeatedly, creating spreading shockwaves. Players can jump or dodge to avoid them. Watch out for the final hit, which is a red-light skill.
The Phantom Nightmare cycles between Wolf, Bear, and Human forms, each with unique combat tactics.
If the monster's red-glint skill is not countered, the monster will immediately recover 20% of its Posture Bar after using the skill.
The Wood Fence King uses vines to bind all players and summons Wood Fence Spear Guards to charge across the field. You must break free from the vines immediately to avoid the attacks.
The Embermane's breath turns the entire field into a sea of fire. Friendly wood fences will rise as stone pillars around the arena.

Grand Lord Botu summons a deep darkness that consumes everything. The illuminated area around the Nightmare Light Platform protects players from the darkness's continuous erosion. You must find and defeat the two Nightmare Feather Guards emerging from the darkness, seize their Nightmare Light, and successfully escort it to the platform to light it, dispelling the darkness and forcing the boss to reveal itself.
The number of stone pillars rising on the field has decreased, and they collapse faster. The team must make the most precise movement decisions under extreme time pressure.
The player holding the Nightmare Light will continuously lose Max HP. The team must take turns in a relay to escort the light to the destination.

The Wooden Fence King will throw "Sacrificial Offerings" into the arena for Zhuorong. For every offering Zhuorong eats, its ATK increases by 15% for 15 seconds. Players can also eat offerings to restore 20% of the active resonance's HP.
All stone pillars will rise simultaneously, and each will collapse after bearing pressure for a moment.
Armadillo Rat King summons more Armadillo Rats.

When leaping to the center of the arena, the Radish King pre-plants multiple explosive radish traps. If a dragged player passes through a trap, it triggers an area explosion and leaves behind scorched earth.

All four phantom charges from the Blade-Slayer Spirit must be lured into the Halberd-Slayer Spirit's fire shield. Any mistake will result in a failed shield break, putting the team's precision and coordination to the ultimate test.
When charging with his shield up, Tigrex summons 2 additional Elite Rebels to charge from the flanks.
The blade-wielding small radishes are more aggressive. The team must precisely lure them to cut the vines while avoiding traps and fire zones. Any mistake could lead to casualties.

Periodically, 1 Void Orb(s) will spawn around each player, rotating continuously. Players can touch the Void Orbs to eliminate them and gain Crit Damage +15% for 30 seconds. If a Void Orb still exists 20 seconds after spawning, it will explode, dealing even higher massive AoE damage.

text: Rescued players must guide the inactive Self-Destruct Radishes on the field to ram into the Radish King, or lure it into the burning ground left behind. Only through continuous burning can its armor be dismantled; otherwise, it will remain.

The Radish King leaps to the center of the field, knocking back all players. It then blows its horn, binding three players with vines and dragging them toward itself. Players pulled to the Radish King will suffer a fatal slash.

At regular intervals, 4 Thunder Zones spawn on the ground. Entering a Thunder Zone activates lightning, dealing damage and increasing all players' Attack by 5% for 30s (stackable). Thunder Zones not activated within 30s explode, dealing damage to a large area.

The coordination between the nut-bearer and the vine-pulling teammate must be millisecond-perfect; any delay could lead to a failed trap and a lost granary.
The Calamity Meteor that appears now is empowered by the Source of Calamity, significantly increasing its stability. Players must unleash stronger attacks to shatter it.
When giant-sized, it spawns explosive wooden fences at each player's feet. Move away immediately.
Meteor impact sites leave behind a "Stardust Contamination Zone," dealing significant damage for 20s.

When the Phantom Nightmare changes forms, the number of nightmare rifts on the field increases, putting more pressure on teammates to rescue. Meanwhile, the Nightmare Butterflies that abduct players become much weaker and more fragile.

In the second phase, the walls rotate faster, and the Sky-Slayer Spirit locks onto each player, spawning three tracking energy orbs that persist in pursuit, severely hindering movement. The team must dodge the energy orbs while finding gaps in the walls to shatter the hidden Constellation Shadows.
The team must move in unison and transfer sequentially, efficiently utilizing every stone pillar within the limited time. Any member lagging behind may disrupt the rhythm and lead to casualties.
If the monster's red-glint skill is not countered, the monster will immediately recover 40% of its Posture Bar after using the skill.

The Sky-Slayer Spirit returns to the center to channel star power, summoning five constellations that rotate around it. Players must quickly shatter all star nodes to interrupt the chant. Success causes the spirit to dissipate; failure results in a full-screen Starfall attack.
When the Brutal Tiger charges with its shield, the shield has its own durability. Players must focus fire to break it, or the final unavoidable red-light charge will deal devastating damage.

Periodically, four orbs will spawn on the field. When a player approaches an orb, it will emit a 360° red light attack. Successfully countering the red light will shatter the orb and restore 15% Ultimate energy to the entire team. If an orb remains 20 seconds after spawning, it will explode, dealing damage to all players.

In addition to the original mechanics, an Elite Armor Rat appears, charging along a fixed route. If the nut-carrier is hit, the nut is dropped. A player must be assigned to intercept the elite and clear the rolling small rats, or the formation will easily be disrupted.
The Wood Fence King's attack power spikes during its giant form. The team must efficiently intercept and throw fire bombs; any delay will cause the survival space to shrink rapidly.

After charging, the Wanshu Hammer releases a full-screen shockwave. One player must quickly pick up a mechanical shield dropped on the field to block the attack, while other players must stay close behind the shield-bearer to avoid damage. The shockwave will erupt twice in succession; adjust your positioning accordingly.
The thorn armor covering the Wood Fence King's torso has become exceptionally tough, requiring more fire bombs to break.

Nightmare Ripples overflowing from the Nightmare Rift are spreading at an accelerated rate, rapidly eroding the already limited survival space.

Players must lure the Blade-Slayer Spirit into crashing into the fire shield three times to break it; otherwise, the team will suffer massive full-screen damage.

text: Old Mechanoids stir up a dust cloud as they assemble in the mossy, bronze arena.
A Desolate Tower strands atop the Stone Extraction Hall. The facility has lain silent for years, weathered by the passage of time.
One of the three Spirit Gold Pivots, lying dormant in the ice.
The scent of herbs leads to a peaceful sanctuary where the Herbalist studies.
The poor Croaky's caught in a trap. Find the switch and set it free!

The secret trial of the Honor Tower has unexpectedly appeared. Phantoms flicker within, reflecting the past dispute between the Master and Mayene over the journey to Haidu. Rulers clash with fists, expectations collide with obsessions—right and wrong remain to be seen.
The cavern leading deep underground is shrouded in darkness, where formidable enemies lie in wait.

When the dragon fell, the Dragon Bone Altar rose in its honor, with three trial grounds sealed beneath. Join the Seeker squad in Dragon Valley to investigate the Dragon Bone Wind Chime and uncover the lost story of the dragon.
One of the three Spirit Gold Pivots, where ancient machines still wander, faithfully performing their duties.
Where clouds part to reveal the sea, past memories rise and fall with the tide.
Powerful lizards inhabit a cave at the lake's bottom.
Mechanism Challenge! A puzzle-solving path for the quick-witted.
On the steep mountain, where Mechcraft and nature intricately intertwine, only those with swiftness can unravel its puzzles.
The Spike Bears' den lies under the shadows of mysterious blue trees, where glimpses of these giant beasts can occasionally be seen in peaceful slumber.
Three Mechanoids around the central pillar remain sealed. Their designs are worth studying.
A concealed cave nestled by seaside cliffs beneath a grand bronze statue, its entrance sealed by an unknown force.
These long-abandoned ruins conceal treasures of the past behind cryptic puzzles.
Within these ruins, gravity is harnessed to manipulate spheres and connect the Bronze Mechcraft.
Keep ascending with the huge dragon bones to find the bronze Lamp Wick, which is filled with the dragon's power.

The Herb Garden is tucked away in a corner, once a hideout for Dr Bian to study forbidden arts. After many years, the lingering poison has never dissipated. But this poison doesn't just devour flesh and bone; it corrupts the heart.
These submerged ruins lie in wait, concealing unknown perils or elusive puzzles.
A massive bronze structure rises from the ground, its entrance sealed shut. Only those bearing a matching pair of talismans may enter.
The Spirit Mechanism hides a mystery, waiting to be revealed behind the stone wall.
A worried Herbalist is searching for his research notes in the garden where Aerdense Flowers grow. Dangerous monsters are hiding nearby.
Trees and plants grow thick. Danger quietly hides in the shadows.
Fluffy is in trouble. Help it return safely to its master.
The entrance to the finals of the Great Mirage, established by the Three Sages of Jixia. The Academy built this arena specifically to teach students how to traverse the Linglong Canyon.
This valley, once shielded by an ancient Sorcery circle, is now a secluded area rarely visited, home only to wolves, bears, falcons, and Rebels.

Purifying the spirit roots eliminates hidden ailments; a bright mirror reflects the heart and illuminates the void. In the sealed cave of the Herb Garden, there remains a spiritual medicine that ends pain, but it is also a poison that extinguishes consciousness. When a conceited healer twists benevolence, benevolence becomes a delirious poison; when a lost warrior faces pain, pain becomes a clear mirror reflecting the path of the heart; when a fool treats shackles as blessed thorns, the thorns will also cultivate poisonous seeds. The former victim transforms into a poisonous healer, and fanaticism drives her to practice the way of treating unmanifested diseases. Yet, she has forgotten the warning of another suffering soul—"A 'cure' that strips away the self is no salvation at all."
Only those who understand the laws of light can uncover the secrets within these ancient, yet precise, ruins.

The Herb Garden is tucked away in a corner, once a hideout for Dr Bian to study forbidden arts. After many years, the lingering poison has never dissipated. But this poison doesn't just devour flesh and bone; it corrupts the heart.
A lake monster ate the child's essay? The title seems to be... "My Hero Novar"...
A building constructed to contain dangerous artifacts; even if intruders manage to evade the Sentinel Drives outside, the labyrinth within and its defensive mechanisms present formidable challenges.
Boats move up and down with the current. The experiments have not produced clear results.
The standing ruins of the Sentry Tower conceal treasures from the past, hidden behind obscure puzzles.
The secluded cave featuring winding paths is inhabited by numerous Saepes and a plant that mysteriously causes tears.
The siblings are having a spat. How can you help them make up?
Lizards use their sharp teeth and claws to deter intruders from entering their territory.
An enormous fiery falcon occupies this place, and its heat causes nearby plants to wither.
The Three Sages have put a limit on entering this area. It's rumored to contain an invisible beast, so the place is heavily guarded by strict defenses.
Lurking Xuan-Guard mechanisms, protecting secrets unknown beneath the ice.
Winding paths in the ruins conceal ancient treasures hidden behind cryptic puzzles.

Wondrous Maze is the final-year project of the famous graduate, Kongming. Its complex and impressive design has attracted many challengers, but only a few have succeeded. What challenges lie beyond its high walls?
This viewing platform, built by the legendary Kongming, offers a stunning view of the Jixia Forehill. Legend has it that this was Kongming's favorite spot for studying Sorcery.
Scholarly Tiger is trapped by the Mechcraft. Find a way to free it!
These submerged ruins lie in wait, concealing unknown perils or elusive puzzles.
Giant trees that grow on the cliffside, often serving as nesting sites for birds of prey.
Rebels have seized the Crafter's storehouse. The tools meant to help the people must not be allowed into their hands.
Time's gentle melody echoes through the Dragon Bone Wind Chime, harmonizing the will of the people into one.
Armored Mechanoids stand guard at the gate to the ancient room.
This Mechcraft crossbow, designed by the academy to train shooting precision, was once all the rage at Jixia Academy.
The bottomless cave may conceal some ancient secrets.
This study, constructed by the legendary student Kongming, appears simple and unadorned, yet it holds hidden depths.
Ruins buried deep within the mountain walls, concealing perilous creations and enigmatic riddles.
Playful and friendly, Naughty Civets get along with everyone. Don't let the troublesome Rebels ruin their cheerful mood.
The Spike Bear dwells within the cave, and it is said that explorers who ventured inside were never seen again.
The lookout offers a stunning view, and a kind man created an Aersilk Orb game there for children to enjoy.
This cave used by the Dreamweavers to store Dream Cocoons also serves as an emergency shelter for the Menkis during times of danger.
The work lies unfinished. Unknown changes may come to pass.
The elegant pavilion stands silently by the lake, awaiting the treasures hidden within the pond to be revealed.
These long-abandoned ruins conceal treasures of the past behind cryptic puzzles.
Volcanic Stone fuels the growth of strange, Sorcery-infused plants that dominate this area.

Strange books and rogue Mechanoids are just a small part of the dangers inside the Forbidden Chamber, the most mysterious and heavily guarded building at Jixia Academy. Anyone who tries to enter without permission will face serious consequences.
Three young girls are enthusiastically inviting passersby to join their little treasure hunt...
The playing field of the Alsahraan archer, Sango, who welcomes all daring challengers.
The Dream Envoy's statue stands in silent vigil, as Rebels are torn by the allure of false dreams.
The moving water contains the secret to finding the treasure that sank long ago.
The towering, silent monument stands firm, its five dim lamps weathering the passage of time, awaiting the moment they may shine again.

Later, you returned to that deserted cave, but there was no more joyful singing.  
You napped at the desk and woke up to find Master Zhuangzi sitting beside you.  
"Isn't the nightmare over?"  
In your confusion, he smiled gently.  
"Remember? Free and boundless."  
As you closed your eyes in the midst of his song, you became a giant bird soaring through the skies, then a massive fish swimming in a sea of stars.  
When you opened your eyes again, the lecture had ended. It was the end of a Sorcery class.  
"I had a very long dream..."  
As you spoke his words, a Dream Butterfly landed on your shoulder.  
I am the butterfly, or is the butterfly me?

Time brings people together and takes them apart. Treasure these moments.\n\nThe deserted ancient ruins were now Saepes territory, cut off from the outside world. But a Secrets Club member whispered of hidden treasure inside. You braved deadly traps to find it, only to discover an age-old stream of Zhou Yu and Kongming. Time seemed to freeze as you witnessed their rivalry, tough choices, and true feelings... A destined meeting, and a bittersweet farewell.
Experience the art of brewing at one of Harvest Fields' four finest breweries, nestled deep within Aerux Well.
Mechanism Challenge! A puzzle-solving path for the quick-witted.
Anyone passing through must watch out for Wolvines hiding underground.
The mining district stretches deep underground, where the ancient drilling rig lies dormant. It houses a hidden Volcanic Stone Key, which is essential for reactivating this ancient structure.
A group of small Saepes has gathered here, and one of them looks noticeably different.
The standing ruins of the Sentry Tower conceal treasures from the past, hidden behind obscure puzzles.
A field rich with wildlife and a popular observation site for Hunters. Yet recent beast attacks have severely disrupted their work, and the creature behind these assaults still remains at large.

Mozi watches over peace, and he watches over Mozi.
When the core expands into the Tianheng system, and projections stream data into Mozi's mecha, is it merely an emotionless and identityless system, or the sly smirk of the old codger?
The Artisan Servant records all mecha repair failures, and emotional monitoring data shows that during repairs, Mozi is seventy percent focused, twenty percent apologetic, and ten percent... The Artisan Servant cannot comprehend what sorrow mixed with banter could be.
At the end of the Artisan Servant's records, when the Tianheng system patiently explains its feature overview to Mozi using Heng's voice and mechanical emotions, there is a profound sense of relief and nothing more.
So, old man, you've been able to hear all along, haven't you?
zh_text:
墨子守望和平，他守望墨子。
当核心展开为天衡系统，投影随着数据注入墨子机甲，它究竟只是一个没有感情与身份的系统，还是老家伙的狡黠一笑？
神工役记录着所有机甲失败修复记录，情绪监控数据显示，修复时的墨子是七分专注二分歉疚还有一分……神工役不解，什么是混杂着戏谑的悲伤？

text: Yan Ling, champion of the Azure Arena, awaits new challengers here. Her tempestuous swordplay leaves opponents no room to catch their breath.
The deep, shadowy cave, shrouded in darkness, conceals enigmatic puzzles hidden from the light of day.
Time's gentle melody echoes through the Dragon Bone Wind Chime, shimmering with the people's most cherished admiration.
A camp occupied by the Rebels, whose wild and rebellious nature is matched by formidable strength, forcing students to steer clear.
Above the Meeting Hall lies an altar. Light both torches to claim the offerings.
Experience the art of brewing at one of Harvest Fields' four finest breweries, where wines are expertly aged with time.
The Hunters' camp in Wu Mian is dedicated to studying the Frost Kodiak. Its doors are open to any brave challenger.
My claws won't spare anyone who disturbs my peace!
Amidst the natural flora of these Mechcraft Ruins, be cautious of wild beast attacks as you explore.
Divine Imprint energy condenses creations on the giant Divine Imprint Shaping Table, while bronze particles slowly gather nearby.
A particular fruit on a tree has left a Herbalist troubled...
A slope with a view of the entire valley. A favorite gathering spot for Saepes elders, thanks to its abundant sunshine.
The statue stands silently in the forest, while the Croaky will lead you to the secrets of unlocking the statue's treasure.
There are dangers along the road. Travelers, be careful.

Traces of Yango's puppet research can still be found in Old Citadel. Yango was once a gloomy young man, but he became remarkable for creating lifelike puppets. What inspired this transformation within these crumbling walls?
Hunter Yan Shanxi lives by the cliff and welcomes anyone brave enough to challenge him.
These ancient, intricately designed ruins can be conquered only by the agile.
These long-abandoned ruins conceal perilous combat behind crumbling bronze barriers.
The falcon nest perched atop the cliff offers a glimpse into the scenery that the falcon sees daily.
A squad of Rebels camping near the central pillar is eyeing the relics with greed.

The past is gone, but the broken stele endures.
The place where the spirits rest is marked by a broken stele that silently symbolizes the scars of hidden history. Those who come to pay their respects and the souls of the spirits echo, like metal and stone.
Within the Mausoleum, remnants of the past century remain. You hear the conversations during the Three Sages' memorial, and see the inscriptions carved by Fuzi himself. The past becomes vividly clear.
The broken stele hangs alone, and echoes emerge—The Sanctifier came alone to pay his respects. Dissatisfied with the world's forgetfulness, he struck and shattered the stele erected by Fuzi. Immediately, the names of the deceased shimmered on the walls. The lost souls, sensing the Taigong's return, knelt in reverence. The reunion of teacher and students made a century seem like the blink of an eye.
"Every name on that wall is etched in my heart."
This Mechcraft crossbow, designed by the academy to train shooting precision, was once all the rage at Jixia Academy.
The most white-hot challenge of Enlightenment Trials! Ready to face the earth-melting blow?
Work together to rescue the Croaky stranded midair.
Arcana Challenge! A path of enlightenment to understand all the wonders of the world!

The area around Bastion Fort was originally used as a testing ground for Mechcraft movement. The pillars around it bear the traces of heavy Mechanoid footsteps. The ancient Darkiron spear, once used for Mechanoid experiments, is stored here.
Being scatterbrained during a picnic isn't good, help this quarreling pair of seniors.
The wild plants in the old, abandoned herb nursery have grown out of control and are now a hidden danger.
Long-abandoned ruins that hold a cryptic puzzle linked to the altar atop Duskview Peak.

The long light turns to ash, the traveler returns late. When the Honor Tower's ultimate trial is triggered, through the flow of time, you and Yuanfen witness a sealed past—the Master once set a harsh trial, forcing Mayene to face her Haidu trauma. There are things in life one cannot avoid; the dream of slacking off will always be awakened by the waves of growth. As the Master's most troublesome genius student, how could she not understand his intentions? So, she made her choice. She just didn't know then that those unspoken concerns would turn into a silent farewell across life and death. "Master, leave a lamp on, waiting for me to come home..."
Ruins aren't playgrounds. Find a way to help that naughty child get down safely.
In the dragon's jawbone, Mechcraft soldiers remain, their presence still echoing the fierce battle from long ago.
Students practice their archery skills near Darkpool Camp.
A giant beast lurking in the gully caves beneath the ship, hiding in the dark with a ferocious appearance.
Only those who understand the laws of light can uncover the secrets within these ancient, yet precise, ruins.
A realm of dreamlike illusions, where solving its mysteries requires traveling between the cracks.
Defeat the Mechcraft soldiers stationed at these ruins to uncover the hidden secrets lying beneath Greenwhisper Pool.
Everyone has the right to slack off, and there's a master slacker in the teahouse.
Croaky is playing hide-and-seek with Master. Find it quickly, don't let the beasts get ahead.
One of the three Spirit Gold Pivots, guarded silently by the twin mechanical sentinels.
A powerful weapon remains sealed at the central pillar.
An ancient altar stands atop the mountain, once used for offerings to the Bronze Ivy in sacred rituals. Only by finding the special Twin Bronze Ivies can the ceremony be reactivated.
A camp occupied by the Rebels, whose wild and rebellious nature is matched by formidable strength, forcing students to steer clear.
Stand where wild winds howl and see if the hurricane breaks all or yields to you.
Massive pillars stand motionless on top of the Shelter. Returning them to their original positions might uncover a hidden past.
The serene valley, with its lush foliage, is a coveted haven for the Saepes tribe.
Howls rise from the mountain den. Help the Hunter destroy the hungry Wolvine pack.

Tomorrow, we venture into the world, but let us never forget our days at school. 
Beyond the Wondrous Maze's towering walls, you meet several students from Team Wondrous Maze and join in their earnest, if slightly naive, challenges. Trial after trial, you make your way to the maze's heart, where you stumble upon a secret veiled by ingenious design. It reveals the story of several legendary students, just before their farewell to Jixia. 
What was once a beautiful tale faded with time, as those students waved goodbye and set out into the world. Years later, when they meet again amidst the flames of the Three Kingdoms war, will they recall the verses still echoing beneath the maze? 
Let the moonlight of Jixia cleanse my sorrows...
Walk Zhuangzi's way someday. Let all your troubles drift away. \n \nThe Cocoon is not past. The butterfly's not to stay.
Warlike Saepes gather at this arena.

The Herb Garden is tucked away in a corner, once a hideout for Dr Bian to study forbidden arts. After many years, the lingering poison has never dissipated. But this poison doesn't just devour flesh and bone; it corrupts the heart.
Sorcery Master Rou Zhai lives here alone to study the Philosophy of Dreams, but she is always open to anyone brave enough to challenge her.
The secret chamber is sealed with a complex device. Is it a laboratory or a home? Many rumors surround it.
The massive ruins underwater reveal the lost glory of the past.
Ruins submerged in water, where precious talismans are protected by intricate puzzles.
The treacherous winding path demands caution with every step as you evade the relentless pursuit of the raging Mechanoids.
A building constructed to contain dangerous artifacts; even if intruders manage to evade the Sentinel Drives outside, the labyrinth within and its defensive mechanisms present formidable challenges.
These long-abandoned ruins conceal treasures of the past behind cryptic puzzles.
In the clear pond, water and mechanisms artfully intertwine, with hidden puzzles awaiting discovery.
Get the ball to the destination to reveal clues about the secrets hidden deep in Greenwhisper Pool.
The drill rig must be activated to open up a path to the Volcanic Stone Key.
A Croaky is racing a Scholarly Tiger. But can a Croaky even run? The outcome of this race for honor will soon be decided.
Strange rocks have appeared by the cliff overnight. What secrets do they hide?

Purifying the spirit roots eliminates hidden ailments; a bright mirror reflects the heart and illuminates the void. In the sealed cave of the Herb Garden, there remains a spiritual medicine that ends pain, but it is also a poison that extinguishes consciousness. When a conceited healer twists benevolence, benevolence becomes a delirious poison; when a lost warrior faces pain, pain becomes a clear mirror reflecting the path of the heart; when a fool treats shackles as blessed thorns, the thorns will also cultivate poisonous seeds. The former victim transforms into a poisonous healer, and fanaticism drives her to practice the way of treating unmanifested diseases. Yet, she has forgotten the warning of another suffering soul—"A 'cure' that strips away the self is no salvation at all."
Students test their agility against numerous traps in a race to the top.
Experience the art of brewing at one of Harvest Fields' four finest breweries, by the side of Autumn Lake.
A training hall built against the mountain, known for its strict discipline. Students are always practicing archery under the red maples.
Seekers' skills in exploring ancient ruins are exceptional, but when it comes to movement techniques—well, let's just say they still have a long way to go.
The Saepes King occupies Aerux Hollow's heart to absorb vast amounts of Aerflow energy.
This observation tower, constructed by the Academy in Dragon Valley, grants access to its topmost level exclusively to students who have passed the Throwing Trial.
A high-ground position held by Saepes.
Only people who know Northton well can access the underground library.
Ruins buried underground, concealing ancient treasures behind cryptic puzzles.
The large rock formation is interwoven with an intriguing puzzle, waiting to be unraveled through exploration and insight.

Here sits the Aerflow Conduit, a labyrinth of Mechcraft and riddles. Rumor has it there's more beneath the surface—a hidden underground chamber, where gears spin and click endlessly, yet time seems to stand still.
The Seekers have set up a camp to study the dragon remains. At the center of the site is the dragon's spine, which holds a bronze Lamp Wick infused with the dragon's power.
These ruins lie hidden within the cave, hiding ancient treasures behind cryptic puzzles.
Herb Garden: Like Toxin, Like Tonic
A wounded little Saepes. Help it overcome its hardships.
A Mechcraft chamber crafted by the academy to test the valor and prowess of those who dare to enter.
Test new forging fire, repair all machines with skilled hands.
Chu Dachuang is hot-tempered but responsible. He watches over the vegetable patch and is ready to face any challenger.
Croaky is furious, and that never ends well. How can you bring the runaway Croaky back to its owner? Maybe a friend of animals can help.
By the roadside leading to Aermore Valley, one can faintly hear someone playing a melody.
An old man runs a stall on the way to the camp, but it's too far from the camp.
Arcana Challenge! A path of enlightenment to understand all the wonders of the world!
A Mechcraft Kite crashed by the lake while searching for treasure. What secret lies behind this mishap?
Herb Garden: Like Toxin, Like Tonic

In this rarely visited old workshop, only the occasional sound of mechanisms running reminds treasure-hunting adventurers that this place was once the site where a Jixia master created their inventions.\n\n(Secret Society Tip: If you are looking for a way in, try visiting <69D0FF>Path of Ingenuity: End</> to learn about <69D0FF>Fuzi's Riddle</> and find clues there.)
A solitary stone tower stands in the Stone Extraction Hall, untouched for years.
In the depths of the water pond lies a hidden treasure guarded by a ferocious giant lizard. The only way to get it might be to drain the water.
The key forged from Volcanic Stones is radiating potent energy.
When the Wondrous Maze was constructed, the legendary student Kongming once gazed upon the panoramic view from here. It is said that he left behind some of the Mechcraft parts he used back then.
The former head of Red Falcon Training Hall welcomes all brave challengers.
Time's gentle melody echoes through the Dragon Bone Wind Chime, carrying the cherished hopes of generations.
A huge, ancient spirit-gold ring stands tall, connecting the path to open the tower ship.
On clear waters, old friends reunite.

By the Dreamy Trail, a lone wanderer has taken refuge, bearing the fate of Dreamscape incursions alone, lest others be brought into their misfortune. Even the wolf accustomed to solitude now yearns for aid.
A column of thick smoke rises from the cliffs. Looks like something crashed nearby.
Deep within the underground cavern, fierce and dangerous creatures lie in wait.
The ancient mechanical core guards the Littoral Towership, using the power of bronze to drive the entire ship.
The lookout at Bastion Fort gives you a wide view of the fortress and the landscape beyond. This spot is also where the stolen Lava-red Copper Spear was last seen.
Beware of this cave, home to the Wolvine tribe. Stay alert for their stealthy underground ambushes.
A key is required to activate the treasure vault in the archive, which operates through a unique mechanism.
In the underground warehouse near Aerux, uninvited guests are eyeing the precious treasures within.
These long-abandoned ruins conceal treasures of the past behind cryptic puzzles.
Beneath the ruins lies a hidden Skywell, where dedicated research unveils thunderous revelations.

The forbidden chaos was born of human desire.
Deep within the Forbidden Chamber, the rogue contraband "Dingwuhai" whispers to you, recounting the tragedy of that year.
A soul torn apart by fate could not bear these fond memories, and ultimately transformed into a taboo out of obsession.
Amidst the aurora illusions, Zhuge Liang once painted the colors of this world for him, yet could never conceal the gloom of destiny. When the pervasive aurora dissipated, only the eternal struggle of "Dingwuhai" between human nature and obsession remained. As the dust settled in the Forbidden Chamber, naught but splendor and sorrow lingered.
With so many people in the world, why did it have to be you...
zh_text:
秘禁之乱，始于人心。
秘禁阁的深处，失控的违禁品"丁午亥"在向你低语，述说着当年的那一场悲剧。
一个被命运撕裂的灵魂，无法承受这份美好的回忆，最终因执念化作禁忌之物。
极光的幻象中，诸葛亮曾为他描绘这世间色彩，却终究无法掩盖命运的灰暗。漫天的极光散去后，只留下“丁午亥”在人性与执念中永恒的挣扎。秘禁阁的尘埃落定，唯留一片绚烂与哀伤。
天下这么多人，为什么偏偏是你……

text: Formidable Mechanoids defend the Shelter's Volcanic Stone Key against intruders.
A camp occupied by the Rebels, whose wild and rebellious nature is matched by formidable strength, forcing students to steer clear.
With its cannon barrels still hot, the guardian stands ready to unleash its firepower on the next intruder.
Long-abandoned ruins with puzzles that might spark a chuckle when solved.
One of the three powerful Mechanoids guarding the Underhall. With its unstoppable blade, it stands firm to uphold the vow of repelling all intruders.
The long-abandoned ruins, where time has quietly passed, but the Mechcraft within remains operational.

Fuzi, Zhuangzi, and Mozi often visit this place to honor the brave people who died in the war. They also created challenges here to help students remember the heroes' spirit. However, an unexpected visitor recently came back, and now the stone tablet inside has been broken.
Adventurous Saepes have climbed to the highest point and claimed it as their territory.
An elder Toxineer conducted experiments in the cave, unleashing dangerous toxins that now make it difficult for outsiders to approach.
Only those who understand the laws of light can uncover the secrets within these ancient, yet precise, ruins.
Zhi Ren waits at the mountain path, searching for challengers worthy of a duel.
The deep cave stretches vast and silent, concealing secrets within its winding depths.
A camp occupied by the Rebels, whose wild and rebellious nature is matched by formidable strength, forcing students to steer clear.
A large, dormant drill, sealed and unused for many years.
The pillar supports the entire underground space. The ultimate answer is likely found within the Ascension Hall at the top.
Desolate Woodland: Echoes of the Past
This place acts as a focal point for dispersed Sorcery energy, drawing many Sorcery Students to train here.
This area is inhabited by bears and their cubs, which have attracted some small Saepes.
Odd piles of wood that won't catch fire are set in the empty field. If the flames finally start, will they fulfill the wishes in someone's heart?
The linked mechanism copper armor in the deep ravine guards the ancient spirit gold ring.
The Butterfly Envoy's statue stands in silence, while the ceremonial grounds' entrance is sealed with dust. The once-pure dreams lie shattered here, replaced by a nightmare that shall never awaken.

Spiritual roots cleansed of impurity, warding off disease before it takes hold. A clear mirror reflecting the heart, illuminating the path to enlightenment. 
In the sealed cave of the Herb Garden, a divine elixir that ends suffering lies hidden, yet it is also a deadly poison that annihilates consciousness. 
When a self-righteous healer distorts mercy, that mercy turns into a deadly toxin; when a lost warrior confronts pain, that pain becomes a mirror that illuminates the path to enlightenment; and when a fool mistakes chains for thorny blessings, those thorns will nurture seeds of poison. 
A former victim transformed into a toxic healer, driven by zeal to once again practice the art of preventing disease. Yet she has forgotten the warning from another soul who endured immense suffering: 
"A 'cure' that strips one of even their own self is not redemption."
Underwater, there is a bronze tablet that showcases the intricate design of ancient bronze furniture.
The Herbalists' aromatherapy retreat. May the herbs soothe your woes.
Only those who understand the laws of light can uncover the secrets within these ancient, yet precise, ruins.
Within these ruins, gravity is harnessed to manipulate spheres and connect the Bronze Mechcraft.
An old man sits alone by the cliff, troubled. How can you ease his burden?
Wolvine chaos has left this temporary outpost in ruins, its structures bearing the scars of sharp teeth and claws.
A key is required to activate the treasure vault in the archive, which operates through a unique mechanism.
A camp occupied by the Rebels, whose wild and rebellious nature is matched by formidable strength, forcing students to steer clear.
These submerged ruins lie in wait, concealing unknown perils or elusive puzzles.
One of the three powerful Mechanoids guarding the Underhall. With its unparalleled strength, it possesses a brutal capability to crush any intruder.
Herb Garden: Like Toxin, Like Tonic
The keys needed to activate the ruined structure are missing.

The Herb Garden is tucked away in a corner, once a hideout for Dr Bian to study forbidden arts. After many years, the lingering poison has never dissipated. But this poison doesn't just devour flesh and bone; it corrupts the heart.

These crumbling war ruins have become a dangerous stronghold now controlled by the Saepes. Few people know that Zhou Yu and Kongming once visited this place as students, and no one knows why they came or what they were looking for.
Aersim is a popular among students.
Beneath the water lies a secret realm, where intricate puzzles cleverly conceal a playful jest.
An imposing ice bulwark that dominates the arena.
One of the three powerful Mechanoids underground, it has impenetrable armor and is tasked with eliminating intruders.
History and danger are sealed together in this archive. It houses the Volcanic Stone Key, which is essential for reactivating this ancient structure.
Bronze pillars stand unevenly scattered, and only those with graceful agility can claim the treasures of the past.
Rebels have taken over these ancient ruins. In an underground chamber decorated with murals, there's a bronze Lamp Wick that holds the dragon's power.
A camp occupied by the Rebels, whose wild and rebellious nature is matched by formidable strength, forcing students to steer clear.
These ruins lie hidden within the cave, their entrance submerged beneath the lake's surface.
A peaceful mountain path, yet a toy thief lurks—Who stole the child's beloved Mechanoid?
Long-abandoned ruins, still guarded by Mechcraft soldiers.
Experience the art of brewing at one of Harvest Fields' four finest breweries, in the warm scent of wheat fields.

In a quiet corner of Aerfall Highlands, a stone tablet at the entrance to Bastion Fort bears inscriptions recounting the forging of Mozi Mechanoid. Venture into the dust-ridden testing chambers within, where Servants still carry out their age-old duties.
The Dream Envoy's statue stands in silent vigil, as hazy dreams of the past drift through shimmering light.
The Rebels are seeking to solve certain puzzles.
The graceful pavilion exudes tranquility and elegance by day, yet under the cover of night, it reveals a hidden side.
Rebels reached the central pillar first and created difficulties for the expedition team.
Located in the lower cabin of the treasure ship, the Jade Heart Chamber conceals mysterious mechanisms, waiting to be discovered.
Suspended by the power of the Dreamscape, the building lies in ruins. Time is of the essence if you wish to rescue those trapped below.
Tall bronze columns rise from the marshy ground. Mechanoids guard this area to protect a bronze Lamp Wick infused with the dragon's power.
Towering ruins conceal ancient treasures hidden behind cryptic puzzles.
The traces left by the Rebels after their raid seem to lead straight to a cave.

From carved wood, a brilliance was born. As the ancient strings hum once more, amidst the whispers of Yango's puppeted maze, you are invited to take a seat and witness the drama of memories. The young Yango, speechless with fear, created a puppet that could speak for him, vivid and lifelike, under Kongming's encouragement. Later, as war erupted, he feigned defection, using his puppet's clever words to sow discord in Cao's camp, devising the strategy of the iron-chain boat to successfully aid his senior. Yet, he himself fell into the boundless sea, leaving only regret. No one knows how he exhausted all his strength to return here, deep within the ruined walls, leaving behind a puzzle solvable only by his senior's voice: "I wish for nothing, only that you may always smile."
In the open area near the dragon bone, many gather to enjoy the melodious tunes performed by the Musicians.
A mechanism chamber on the flank of the towering ship, equipped with a small divine pattern shaping table for designing and crafting intricate mechanisms.
These ruins lie hidden within the cave, concealing perilous combat behind remnants of bronze barriers.
The Rebels' stronghold for breeding Dreamscape Monsters is an underground lair, meticulously designed with the confidence that no one can breach its defenses.

Purifying the spirit roots eliminates hidden ailments; a bright mirror reflects the heart and illuminates the void. In the sealed cave of the Herb Garden, there remains a spiritual medicine that ends pain, but it is also a poison that extinguishes consciousness. When a conceited healer twists benevolence, benevolence becomes a delirious poison; when a lost warrior faces pain, pain becomes a clear mirror reflecting the path of the heart; when a fool treats shackles as blessed thorns, the thorns will also cultivate poisonous seeds. The former victim transforms into a poisonous healer, and fanaticism drives her to practice the way of treating unmanifested diseases. Yet, she has forgotten the warning of another suffering soul—"A 'cure' that strips away the self is no salvation at all."
Herb Garden: Like Toxin, Like Tonic
The silent Mechcraft fighter stands here, spear in hand, loyally fulfilling an unfinished duty.
Liao, one of Master Fuzi's Four Disciples, welcomes anyone brave enough to challenge him.
Martial Arts Challenge! Every punch counts on the road to becoming a talent!
The once-grand shelter is now filled with perils. It houses the Volcanic Stone Key that can reactivate this ancient structure.
The abandoned mine is rarely visited and requires three keys to unlock the secrets hidden inside.
A secret base of the Rebels, where they carefully plan their operations, viewing Embermane as their primary target.
Moving platforms will lead you to gold pinions and azure flames. Overcome the toughest challenge to prove yourself as the true champion.
An unknown force lifts the heavy stones, hiding a secret that awaits discovery.
Guests gather like clouds, returning from a thousand miles away.
Martial Arts Challenge! Every punch counts on the road to becoming a talent!
When united, the brothers can overcome any challenge. Yet sometimes, friction between siblings is unavoidable.
A climbing camp designed for students to practice agility safely.
The Dream Envoy's statue stands in silent vigil, as malice hides its fangs within honeyed dreams.
Let the light meet the two pillars to activate the final trial.
The ruins lie hidden below the cave, guarded by Mechanoids protecting ancient treasures.
An ancient Sorcery Circle in the Meeting Hall guards its secrets.
A secret camp occupied by the Rebels, where fierce beasts are confined within sturdy cages.
A peculiar plant, catalyzed by Volcanic Stone, brimming with Aerflow energy.
The mysterious stone tablets scattered around the Shelter may reveal secrets through their inscriptions.
Find the box buried in the mountain and help the old lady recover her memories.
A heavily guarded Sentry Tower outside the Forbidden Chamber, barring students from entering.
The steep cave, both perilous and elegant, draws in students yearning for seclusion and transcendence.
The ancient yet intricate ruins only reveal their secrets to those who understand the art and intricacies of light.
