In the sealed cave of the Herb Garden, there remains a spiritual medicine that ends pain, but it is also a poison that extinguishes consciousness. When a conceited healer twists benevolence, benevolence becomes a delirious poison; when a lost warrior faces pain, pain becomes a clear mirror reflecting the path of the heart; when a fool treats shackles as blessed thorns, the thorns will also cultivate poisonous seeds. The former victim transforms into a poisonous healer, and fanaticism drives her to practice the way of treating unmanifested diseases. Yet, she has forgotten the warning of another suffering soul—"A 'cure' that strips away the self is no salvation at all."
A forgotten corner of the Herb Garden that once sheltered Dr Bian's forbidden research. Though years have passed, the poison lingers—not to ravage the flesh, but to corrupt the soul.

The long light turns to ash, the traveler returns late. When the Honor Tower's ultimate trial is triggered, through the flow of time, you and Yuanfen witness a sealed past—the Master once set a harsh trial, forcing Mayene to face her Haidu trauma. She just didn't know then that those unspoken concerns would turn into a silent farewell across life and death. "Master, leave a lamp on, waiting for me to come home..."

You'll also need insights from <69D0FF>Heng Jun</> in the weapon crafting chamber at the northeast corner of the <Jump>Area|121</> and <69D0FF>Ziqian</> on the second floor of the <Jump>Area|127</>. \n \nLiu Jiao, who had tried the challenge, gave you the Universal Key.
Visiting a Master in the Sea of Clouds

The Dreamscape Hunter uses a clever disguise that blurs the line between dreams and reality. It hunts not only dreams but also people's hearts. When you face yourself, are you truly yourself—or someone else?

Thanks to your efforts, today's dream has been peaceful and serene. You may bring the residue dream to the gentle creature below ground. What strange tragedies and comedies await every dreamer who steps into the Dreamrealm tomorrow?
The Lone Traveler Trapped in the Snow
Mystery of the Giant Saepes: Childhood Memory
With the old Starmaps, the Chrono Teller presented a stunning canopy of stars over the dome. The secrets of Mechcraft and Astrology were revealed to everyone.
Mystery of the Giant Saepes: Prologue
After awakening all four statues, the hidden history of the Central Pillar has finally been brought to light.

Though the Stabilization Ritual is complete, it seems there are still troubles in the wheat field that demand your attention. \n  \nHead to the <69D0FF>wheat field</> around <Jump>POI|2040100</> to investigate.
A young man from the Secrets Club arrived at the Red Falcon Training Hall, determined to uncover its age-old secrets...
The lone wolf is safe for now. But what if the waking world is just another dream?
Ring the Bell and Make a Wish
There's a savage Ironbiter roaming Iridescent Basin? What a huge misunderstanding! Let go of your prejudices—Xuan Xiao doesn't eat people, and the two journalists aren't unethical at all.
Mystery of Red Falcon Training Hall

Never expected an Armadillo Rat to be so tame. With your careful guidance, the clumsy creature completed the challenge. Its fluffy head is truly adorable. With all Adee gave you, find Shi Peng in <Jump>Area|92</> to claim your rewards.

On the <Jump>Area|1002</>'s third floor stands a silent stone tablet, its inscription a remembrance of bygone days. The ancients noted: Two more such stone tablets remain on the Shelter's first and second floors.
After you helped Jiashu with the tree, he gave you a Runestone he had found. The Runestone might be linked to the four statues.
Prejudice Like a Mountain Finally Cleared
Two reporters from Iridescent Weekly have successfully completed the interview. To read their full stories, head to the newsstand in Prisma Pavilion.
Down in the canyon, you discovered an unremarkable cave that shimmered with a strange light. This place isn't the work of nature. It must hide something.
You searched through <Jump>Area|1004</> and found an activation device, faintly marked with the numeral "II."
You searched through <Jump>Area|1004</> and found an activation device, faintly marked with the numeral "III."
Adored by everyone? It's a whirlwind of distorted dreams and desires. Widespread popularity may bring unexpected troubles.

The flyer also recorded another riddle: I patrol the arena, waving my wings with vigor, gathering the tide of glory. I observe the whole situation, reflecting on gains and losses; I am the witness of the game and the lighthouse of wisdom.

The ancients hid their treasures somewhere in the Underhall Shelter. The three stone tablets will lead you to the true prize.
An ancient whisper rides the wind—deep in the forest of Dragon Valley lies a forgotten secret chamber. Find the two keys to unseal the hidden vault!

The hidden chamber under Kongming's residence has been unlocked. You stumbled upon a mysterious stone. 
 
It appears to be a Runestone used by Societies to quell disasters during the Aerflow Commotion. 
 
The stone's patterns match those at the <69D0FF>altar near the Harvest Bell</>. Consult with the locals nearby to uncover more about its significance.

You and Baili Leo finally pieced together the story. A gifted master who failed to teach his skills left behind a legendary bow. With all his archery secrets collected, the mystery is solved, and Mountain's Requiem has a new owner.
The top of the Forbidden Chamber might be worth another look...

Found The Three Principles of Archery III after rescuing a Hunter who was trapped in a cave by a Spike Bear. Lesson learned: eating on time is important.
As you climb the ancient path snaking upward, a solitary tower looms above, waiting for its visitors in grim silence.

At the Seekers' Camp south of <Jump>Area|89</>, you meet a Crafter admiring the beauty of Aerdense Flowers. She's deep in thought about how these flowers helped repel the Black Cloud Monster that once threatened Harvest Fields.

Huangfu Cai, a friend of Qing Peng, got into danger while exploring the caves beneath <Jump>Area|94</>. After you rescued him, he said Qing Peng might have gone to <Jump>POI|2050100</> or <Jump>POI|2050110</>.
Ancient, reclusive beings have been sighted again around Dreamwhisper Lake. Why are they here?

In the <Jump>Area|22</>, the <Jump>Area|72</> and the <Jump>Area|68</> are said to hide two talismans. Together, they reveal the path to the Mausoleum's Peak. \n \nExplore the Bastion Fort and the Mausoleum to find them.

After passing through the perilous broken ravine, you finally step into the treasure ship and continue deeper.
Actions matter more than words. Mechcraft Kites in <Jump>Area|32</> inspire students and symbolize fleeting youth. Explore freely and enjoy every moment, because time passes quickly.

Many seemingly dangerous creatures in Jixia have a tender side—one you can only perceive by truly understanding their nature. What you gained was not just the satisfaction of clearing a challenge, but the pure bond that blossoms from coexisting with natural life.
The long-hidden treasure has finally been revealed. An age-old wish has come true, now only an echo in the empty, timeworn hall.

Even though it's forbidden, Seekers keep investigating the mysteries of the Eight Trial Pillars in <Jump>Area|22</>. But someone is secretly interfering with their work. \n \nClear the challenges at the <69D0FF>Eight Trial Pillars</>.
Save the Students Trapped in Dream
Only students who are both well-informed and physically fit can successfully retrieve the Mechcraft Kites. Those who succeed will earn rewards that match their effort.
They say the Underhall's Meeting Hall conceals a great mystery. Find the secret key to unlock its secret chamber and claim a long-lost treasure.
We all envy the first person to eat a crab, but who can easily break through their own inner shackles? After Pu Bei let go of the stone in his heart, he felt enlightened.

The Windling Fish is agile and leaps with grace, elusive between sky and water. It often appears by the <Jump>Area|93</> in Northton. \n \nAfter finishing the Windling Fish's agility training, you picked up quite a few bits of trivia. Adee also said that in the field of white flowers due west of the Riverside Ruins, the clumsy little Armadillo Rat is still waiting for you.
Something is wrong with her companion. When she wakes from the dream, he is gone.
Those two reporters are going to extreme lengths for a sensational story—seems even the arena staff are full of hidden talents!

After collecting all three keys, you delved deep into the Abandoned Mine, defeated the deranged Contraption Master in a hidden chamber, and recovered a Runestone fragment shaped like a butterfly wing. <69D0FF>Qing Ze</> on the second floor of <Jump>Area|163</> might know what it is.
A Seeker in <5E5F68>Dragon Valley</> is unraveling the secrets of dragons...

Find the key hidden at the tip of the dragon's tail. There, soldiers still linger, those who once raised memorials and whispered prayers for their fallen brothers.
Following the clues to <Jump>POI|2050110</>, you turn at Huangfu Cai's shouts to find Bai Yan unconscious on the ground and Qing Peng mumbling in a daze beside the Dream Energy Stone.
To encourage students to explore beyond the academy, Mechcraft Kites have been placed across <Jump>Area|32</>. Find them and bring them to Du Qin in <Jump>Area|92</> to claim generous rewards.

The key opens the innermost room. It's worth exploring.
The targets are perfectly hidden in the scenery. When you shoot them, they open the path to a Cloudrest Key inside a Stone Bud.
The two tokens fit perfectly into the wall. The treasure's seal disappeared.
Find the key hidden in the dragon's jaw. When light catches its surface, shadows of ancient warriors flicker into view, their valiant battles etched in time.
After placing the Divine Imprint Runestone on one of the statues, it restored its former glow.

text:
With Master Luban's heart finally at peace, he and Number Five left ahead of us. It wasn't until I regained my senses that I noticed Yuan Rusong had appeared out of nowhere.

He didn't state his purpose, but I knew this seemingly casual "member of the Secret Society" was more than he appeared. From that very first flyer, his hand had been in everything. I just never expected... he was the current head of the Dream-Weaving Task Force!

Now, with all three keys collected, they have transformed into a stream of light, merging into a unique invitation that guides me to the top of <Jump>Area|128</>. Will I... truly be able to "see" the Master there?
The head of Garden of Solace seems to be troubled about something...
The rigid find no new paths
By staying true to the core values of journalism, Lin Mengchu has been promoted to Editor-in-Chief of Iridescent Weekly.

From Master Luban, I learned that the answer to the third riddle is his old laboratory from twelve years ago.

I took the key he gave me and entered the Craftsman's Workshop alone. After bypassing the security mechanisms, I discovered that Luban No. 5, who should have been left here, was nowhere to be found.

Master Luban concluded that Yuan Rusong was the one who restarted No. 5, and the key to the third riddle is in No. 5's hands. The priority now is to find No. 5.

According to his memory, No. 5 used to like going to the side of <Jump>Area|132</>. No time to lose, let's go.

text:
After obtaining the second key, the Master's final riddle finally surfaced: I sleep in the wilderness, silent and still, nurturing the wonders of Tian Gong. I test your choices, weigh your gains and losses; I am a forbidden cage, and a crossroads to the truth.

Tian Gong's wonders... sounds like it has to do with "mechanisms." Since it involves mechanism arts, I might as well ask <69D0FF>Master Luban</> for advice. As one of the best mechanism masters in Jixia, he might find a clue to break the deadlock.

Master Luban was just repairing that exquisite tower at <Jump>POI|2090050</>. If I go now, I should still be able to catch him.
Every step a mistake, looking at each other with no end? No, the four students you helped have already headed to <Jump>Area|133</>. This time, it will be their turn to repay Bu Luling's kindness.
To cultivate humility is to accept one's own imperfections. Though, is making peace with oneself ever easy? Yang Qiao, will you still compare yourself to Novar in the future?
Apprentices conspire to repay the spring sunshine

The last ten miles of a hundred-mile journey mark the halfway point. How many have set off with high spirits only to fail at the very end—it's time for Liang Ziyi to learn to reflect on the past in a grounded way.
Bu Lu Ling of Lingxin Garden asks you to find his four students near the Road of Wujun, the Crimson Spirit Beast Valley, the Southeast Coast, and the Bear Cave...
After you helped Bu Luling find his four students, he left a letter and departed without saying goodbye. Perhaps heading north to <Jump>Area|133</> will explain everything.

Just as I suspected, the answer to the second riddle is that racing goose that often wanders around the Honor Tower.

I passed its strange and abstract test, thinking I would pass the trial and get the Master's second key, but... that goose actually lost the key!

According to the clues, the key was taken by three gate-crashing students wandering in Linglong Canyon—

<69D0FF>Du Sichi</>: Often wanders near <Jump>POI|2090100</> on the east side of the canyon, occupying the Linglong Beast Garden that originally belonged to the academy.
<69D0FF>Lu Youjie</>: Hiding in <Jump>POI|2090120</> in the northwest mountains, a bossy fellow.
<69D0FF>Gong Weicheng</>: Hiding in <Jump>POI|2090270</> to the south, seems to be studying mechanisms there.

In short, I need to find the key first, then take it back to <69D0FF>show that goose</>.
For a shred of the truth, Reporter Lin actually ventured alone into the Peril Camp! Luckily, it wasn't a "one-way trip."
Supporting each other and becoming each other's backbone—perhaps that is the meaning of family. May there always be a star guarding the path home for the weary traveler.

I ran into a weirdo named Yuan Rusong who claims to be a member of the 'Secret Society.' He shoved a strange flyer into my hand, claiming that Fuzi left three unsolved mysteries in the Caiyun Basin, and that whoever solves them will receive 'Fuzi's Gift.'

Unfolding the flyer, the first riddle caught my eye: I stand in the canyon, silent and wordless, echoing with the shouts of heroes. I hone courage, temper the will; I am a bulwark of watch, and a ladder to victory.

'Bulwark of watch' clearly points to the <69D0FF>six exquisite towers</> standing in the canyon. Since that's the case, I might as well go and see what mysteries the legendary riddle holds.
Two reporters from Iridescent Weekly are planning to travel across the Iridescent Basin and conduct a series of news reports...
The arrogant are trapped by their own narrow view
The Guide personally goes to slay the Heart Demon
An impatient mind is hard to settle
In every heavy snowfall of the future, we will turn into snowflakes and land on each other's shoulders.
A careless thought leads to a mistake
Snow from memories fell in Jixia, and the days of the past surged forth. Bululing struggles in regret and pain. What choice must he make to save each other?
They say the devil is in the details, and a single wrong thought can determine our entire lives—Zeng Yuncheng must have realized this by now, right?

The statue activated as it absorbed the Runestone's power.
Among the ruins at <5E5F68>the Underhall</>, something from the past seems hidden.
The tower lies hidden and deserted. No one visits it anymore. Once a thriving place, it has been forgotten by time.
All three devices have been activated, but the drill still won't start. There's something amiss.
The treasure is yours, but greater challenges lie ahead.
The drill whirs back to life, but something's hidden at its top. Could this be the secret it's guarding?

The key is within reach. Take it and unlock the treasure!
The Runestone activated one of the statues.
The words left by those who sought refuge here have finally been heard. Yet, their ultimate fate remains unknown.

He concealed the keystone and left a warning message, urging future explorers not to open the chamber.  \n \nHelp the Seekers with their crisis, find the <69D0FF>Key</> <69D0FF>under the Central Pillar</>, and use it to get inside the Central Pillar.

The two tokens are reunited, unlocking a treasure sealed for years. The ancient Mechanoids had faithfully guarded the tokens, challenging those who came with remarkable skill.
The treasures hidden in these ancient ruins may echo the sorrowful prayers of the people who once lived here. The Underhall likely holds even more mysteries waiting to be discovered.

The <Jump>Area|1004</> is accessible only through a ground-level entrance. Visit the war-ravaged Springbrook Plains for more clues... Head to <Jump>Area|40</> to find out how to enter the <69D0FF>Stone Extraction Hall</> and activate the <69D0FF>Illuminator</> at the top.
The four statues are awakened! Press on, as greater challenges lie ahead.

Is Everspring completely overtaken by the monster, or is there still a spark of consciousness left? The answer lies within the <Jump>Area|1008</>, but be prepared for a fierce battle. Enter the central pillar and confront Everspring.

The once-majestic underground city now lies in ruins, its splendor long lost to ancient wars. Within the desolate hall, the remnants of gigantic beast claws suggest that Everspring managed to lure the monster in. It seems that reigniting the Illuminator is the key to unveiling the deeper secrets of <Jump>Area|1000</>. \n \nFind the <69D0FF>Volcanic Stone Key</> in the Shelter.
In <Jump>Area|1101</>, ancient Mechanoids still guard the Martial Arts legacies of a bygone era.
The ancient cannon effigy finally falls, dropping a token it has clutched till this day. Its shape seems to match one of the recesses in the wall of <Jump>Area|1105</>.
After helping Yuh Ming collect three Mech Cores, you acquired a Runestone brimming with potent energy—it must be the key to awakening the four statues.
After awakening all four statues, the hidden history of the Central Pillar has finally been brought to light.

On the <Jump>Area|1002</>'s third floor stands a silent stone tablet, its inscription a remembrance of bygone days. The ancients noted: Two more such stone tablets remain on the Shelter's first and second floors.
After you helped Jiashu with the tree, he gave you a Runestone he had found. The Runestone might be linked to the four statues.
You searched through <Jump>Area|1004</> and found an activation device, faintly marked with the numeral "II."
You searched through <Jump>Area|1004</> and found an activation device, faintly marked with the numeral "III."
The ancients hid their treasures somewhere in the Underhall Shelter. The three stone tablets will lead you to the true prize.
Battle in the Stone Extraction Hall
Use the <69D0FF>Volcanic Stone Key</> to activate the three Illuminators in <Jump>Area|1000</> and create a path to the central pillar. Activate <69D0FF>the Illuminator at the top of the Shelter</>.
You searched through <Jump>Area|1004</> and found an activation device, faintly marked with the numeral "I."
As you climb the ancient path snaking upward, a solitary tower looms above, waiting for its visitors in grim silence.
The long-hidden treasure has finally been revealed. An age-old wish has come true, now only an echo in the empty, timeworn hall.
They say the Underhall's Meeting Hall conceals a great mystery. Find the secret key to unlock its secret chamber and claim a long-lost treasure.
The two tokens fit perfectly into the wall. The treasure's seal disappeared.
After placing the Divine Imprint Runestone on one of the statues, it restored its former glow.

After the trials of crises and puzzles, the secrets deep within the tower ship were revealed one by one. This massive ship sailed into Jixia and was sealed here. The former glory belonging to the Divine Forger has finally seen the light of day again.
As the hatch of the cabin opens, the Littoral Spirit Drive appears. This mechanical core that powers the entire building ship is ready and waiting for someone to arrive.
The massive tower ship stands before you; deep within its core, you may find unusual secrets.
Activate the Spirit Gold Ring. With the surge of energy, the long-dormant building ship finally regains its vitality.

text: Even the longest journey begins with a single step. The first challenger to glide down from a great height likely never knew if they could land with such precision and grace. \nNow, gliding through the air has become a routine practice in movement training for Jixia's new students. The Academy, inspired by the unyielding spirit of successive classes, awards Credits in recognition. We hope all students remain steadfast in their efforts. \nThis course will be held at Crosswind Bridge.
The Astrology Center can unravel any mysteries about astrology.

Agile movement is vital in martial arts, requiring quick decisions and nimble actions. It's a true test of speed, temperament, and judgment. \nThose interested in this specialized training course should head to the Spring Glades.
Get the Wooden Sword on the East Roof

The essence of Sorcery is understanding the law of Flow and redirecting it through your inner pathways. This is the most challenging part of learning Sorcery, as it requires students to recognize the core patterns of Sorcery techniques. To help with this, the School of Sorcery has arranged for Xia Ruifan to explain important examples of Sorcery techniques, using work from both Jixia students and masters across Primaera.

Besides the Qingyi Pavilion and Azure Arena, Darkpool Camp also hides a secret climbing trail behind the waterfall. Legend says a peerless martial master found this shortcut by observing stone cliffs in the pond's reflection.

Situated in the West Aerfall Highlands, Red Falcon Training Hall is led by a stern Head Trainer who manages the place with military discipline. Disciples here are known for their dedication and hard work. Those seeking to train here must be prepared for a tough challenge.

Check Worldpedia to locate Rebels. 
 
Though expelled, their ambitions remain. Challenging them offers a chance to refine your skills. 
 
Recently, locals have reported sightings of Rebels causing disturbances around Jixia. Despite having left the academy, their dedication to martial arts remains strong, frequently challenging passersby. Confront them to restore peace and hone your own skills. 
 
Defeat Rebels, not limited to the ones in the designated area, to complete the quest.

More and more wild beasts are reported roaming Springbrook Plains freely. They block roads and cause residents to fear for their safety. Many have appealed to the academy for help. The academy invites students to clear the beasts and ensure people's safety. Students can also hone their combat skills. 
 
 
 
Defeat Beasts, not limited to the ones in the designated area, to complete the quest.
Situated beneath the waterfalls behind Frostcloud Town, this Trial Circle is a popular training spot for many Jixia students. Test your mettle in this trial, at a level that matches your skill.

Great scenery is found in bold places, earned through effort and perseverance. In Northton, there is a canyon so wide that even birds cannot cross it. 
 
Training is like rowing upstream; one must push forward against the current. Though numerous students challenge this canyon, few have succeeded in crossing it. 
 
The current record for the fastest crossing is held by Shye from the Team of Stars. The Academy encourages all students to focus inward, seek personal breakthroughs, and not be intimidated by difficulty.  
 
For those with the ambition to surpass this record, go to the pavilion north of Autumn Village to participate.

Mayene is known as the genius of the School of Martial Arts, but she's also famous for skipping classes and causing trouble for her teachers. One night, she sneaked out of the school and jumped across the canyon northeast of Red Falcon Training Hall. She startled a Herbalist who was out gathering herbs and saw her flying through the night sky like a shooting star. 
 
After hearing the Herbalist's story, many students, inspired by Mayene's reputation, started training in the canyon, hoping to follow in her footsteps. Mayene jokingly calls this route "The Top-Secret Special Training Path I'm Too Lazy to Name." 
 
Note: While Mayene's skills are impressive, her habit of skipping classes is not something to copy!

Check Worldpedia to locate Humanoids. 
 
The Training Humanoids help you with your martial arts training. 
 
Entrusted by the School of Martial Arts, the School of Mechcraft is dedicated to enhancing the capabilities of training Mechanoids to fulfill their roles as training partners. Recently, the academy has been seeking volunteers to test these Mechanoids, encouraging students to participate in these trials and contribute to the glory of martial arts. 
 
Defeat Humanoids, not limited to the ones in the designated area, to complete the quest.

Even the longest journey begins with a single step. The first challenger to scale the waterfall likely never knew if they could leap from step to step and stand atop what they once looked up to. \nNow, scaling the waterfall has become a routine practice in movement training for Jixia's new students. The Academy, inspired by the unyielding spirit of successive classes, awards Credits in recognition. We hope all students remain steadfast and continue to reach new heights. \nThis course will be held downstream at Mauvemist Valley.
Theoretical: All Kinds of Martial Arts
A recent batch of intricate machinery was ruined by a group of Rebels. I need someone to teach them a lesson, and perhaps even get them to mend their ways.

While Martial Arts emphasizes daily practice and training, theoretical learning is just as important. Practice builds martial power, but theory ensures its proper application. In this theory class, you'll learn force techniques, understanding the difference between controlled force and brute strength, helping you excel in real combat. The lesson will be taught by Martial Arts Mentor Xia An. If you're interested, please speak to Xia An directly.

In Martial Arts, the weapon is a vital extension of the practitioner, and materials influence its every key aspect, from flexibility to sharpness. This session, led by an experienced weapons merchant, will cover these topics. To participate, find Xiaoxiao at the plaza.

The Herb Society uses the common Pawpaw in Jixia as a medicinal medium to make healing medicines such as Waxgrass Powder. 
 
In this lesson, students are tasked with gathering a single Pawpaw to study its medicinal properties and understand the principles of herbal remedies. 
 
Note: Obtaining this item through purchase or other indirect means is not permitted. Students must collect it personally.

To know one's ignorance is not true ignorance; to recognize one's confusion is not true confusion. The knowledge of Sorcery is as vast as the stars in the sky—an endless quest, unattainable in a single lifetime. Yet even a small step forward brings its own joy. 
This course is designed to deepen the student's understanding of the basic principles of Sorcery.  
 
Interested students can find Zhijian in the Sorcery classroom on the first floor of the Tower of Enlightenment for more details.

Check Worldpedia to locate Ruins Guards. 
 
"Observe the ruins and seek their origin; let the past and the present be our teachers." 
Crafted by the masters of old, the Ruins Guards represent the pinnacle of ancient craftsmanship and wisdom. Though their designs can no longer be fully recreated, using them in battle offers students a unique opportunity to analyze their structures and understand their intricacies. In this challenge, students will attempt to defeat these Ruins Guards. 
 
Defeat Ruins Guards, not limited to the ones in the designated area, to complete the quest.

Mechcrafts represent the pinnacle of human ingenuity, embodying the concept of "artificial life." To truly connect with the essence of Mechcrafts, one must first understand their core principles. 
 
This course is designed to guide students in unraveling the intricacies of Mechcrafts while sharpening their skills. The theory class is taught by Gong Ye, a seasoned Mechcraft student. 
 
 
 
If you are interested, head to the School of Mechcraft to enroll in the class.

The rapids surge with power; focus is key. Swiftly ascend the rainbow terrace and attune yourself to the ever-changing nature of all things—a vital test for those dedicated to the path of sorcery. May each student gain insight and clarity in the process. Go to the base of the Mauvemist Valley waterfall to begin this journey of enlightenment.

Defeat Functional Mechanoids, not limited to the ones in the designated area, to complete the quest.

Students are asked to collect a single bellflower for study while experiencing the natural ecosystem of Jixia.

Mechcraft, the pinnacle of craftsmanship. \nThroughout our history, theoretical debates have often sparked innovative inventions. If you're interested in today's theoretical class, find Faan Jat inside the Tower of Enlightenment.

The ever-changing world embodies both strength and elegance. The path of martial arts requires not only physical training but also a deep understanding of theory to harmonize the body and mind. This course focuses on martial arts theory. Visit the Meditation Hall and speak with Xia An.

The School of Martial Arts emphasizes agility, resilience, and strength. All students must strive to unlock their bodies' and spirits' full potential. \nThis course, led by Mr. Fufeng, offers insights into various training stages. Everyone is welcome to join us!
Precious ancient scrolls have been found inside the ruins. \nThey are well guarded, however, and whether you can retrieve them successfully lies in your understanding of the environment.
Deliver Both Martial Arts Flags to Zeeyun

Situated in the east of Springbrook Plains, He & Ming's Training Hall is a revered destination for aspiring disciples who wish to hone their skills. Test your mettle in this trial, at a level that matches your skill.
Theoretical: The Art of Force Control
Sorcery scrolls are scattered throughout the ruins guarded by Mechanoids. Your ability to find them will depend on your understanding of nature.

Three feet of ice doesn't form in a single day. Movement training is a crucial aspect of mastering martial arts. Give it your all and strive to reach the pinnacle as quickly as possible. How can that not be a thoroughly satisfying challenge? \n \nAnyone who wishes to challenge the record held by the talented student Nora would be offered Credits. The challenge is at the waterfall south of Frostcloud Town.

Among its inhabitants are Nightmare Beasts, creatures born from and transformed by the power of nightmare. These beings are fierce and unrestrained, roaming and attacking at will, requiring cautious handling. 
 
To foster a safer training environment, the Academy has established this course, encouraging capable students to assist in clearing these Nightmare Beasts.

Visit Martial Arts Instructor Fufeng for guidance. He will surely lead you to fruitful learning.

Recently, locals have reported sightings of Rebels causing disturbances around Jixia. Despite having left the academy, their dedication to martial arts remains strong, frequently challenging passersby. Confront them to restore peace and hone your own skills. 
 
Defeat Rebels, not limited to the ones in the designated area, to complete the quest.
The Saepes live here in packs, ready to drive out any who trespass on their land.

Sorcery students, with their refined tastes, have recently taken a liking to the balanced sweetness of the Clawshooter Fruit, a red-flowered plant from Springbrook Plains. \nStudents should each collect one to explore its harmonious flavors. \nNote: Obtaining this item through purchase or other indirect means is not permitted. Students must collect it personally.
Spring brings growth, fall brings fruit, with branches heavy with ripe produce. \nIn its prime, the Saepes sways with plentiful fruit, thanks to the fertile soil.
Agile movement is vital in martial arts, which requires quick decisions and nimble actions. It's a true test of speed, temperament, and judgment. Go to the Nameless Statue in Springbrook Plains.

Check Worldpedia to locate Beasts. 
 
 
 
More and more wild beasts are reported roaming Springbrook Plains freely. They block roads and cause residents to fear for their safety. Many have appealed to the academy for help. The academy invites students to clear the beasts and ensure people's safety. Students can also hone their combat skills. 
 
 
 
Defeat Beasts, not limited to the ones in the designated area, to complete the quest.
Situated beneath the waterfalls behind Frostcloud Town, this Trial Circle is a popular training spot for many Jixia students. Test your mettle in this trial, at a level that matches your skill.

Great scenery is found in bold places, earned through effort and perseverance. In Northton, there is a canyon so wide that even birds cannot cross it. 
 
Training is like rowing upstream; one must push forward against the current. Though numerous students challenge this canyon, few have succeeded in crossing it. 
 
The current record for the fastest crossing is held by Shye from the Team of Stars. The Academy encourages all students to focus inward, seek personal breakthroughs, and not be intimidated by difficulty.  
 
For those with the ambition to surpass this record, go to the pavilion north of Autumn Village to participate.

Mayene is known as the genius of the School of Martial Arts, but she's also famous for skipping classes and causing trouble for her teachers. One night, she sneaked out of the school and jumped across the canyon northeast of Red Falcon Training Hall. She startled a Herbalist who was out gathering herbs and saw her flying through the night sky like a shooting star. 
 
After hearing the Herbalist's story, many students, inspired by Mayene's reputation, started training in the canyon, hoping to follow in her footsteps. Mayene jokingly calls this route "The Top-Secret Special Training Path I'm Too Lazy to Name." 
 
Note: While Mayene's skills are impressive, her habit of skipping classes is not something to copy!

Check Worldpedia to locate Humanoids. 
 
The Training Humanoids help you with your martial arts training. 
 
Entrusted by the School of Martial Arts, the School of Mechcraft is dedicated to enhancing the capabilities of training Mechanoids to fulfill their roles as training partners. Recently, the academy has been seeking volunteers to test these Mechanoids, encouraging students to participate in these trials and contribute to the glory of martial arts. 
 
Defeat Humanoids, not limited to the ones in the designated area, to complete the quest.
Though the Saepes lives long, an end to its life will still come along. \nThe aged Giant Saepes wanders the plains with its withering body.
As the clouds descend, the wolves lie in wait, ready to hunt down any creature that dares to wander alone.

Even the longest journey begins with a single step. The first challenger to scale the waterfall likely never knew if they could leap from step to step and stand atop what they once looked up to. \nNow, scaling the waterfall has become a routine practice in movement training for Jixia's new students. The Academy, inspired by the unyielding spirit of successive classes, awards Credits in recognition. We hope all students remain steadfast and continue to reach new heights. \nThis course will be held downstream at Mauvemist Valley.
Theoretical: All Kinds of Martial Arts
A recent batch of intricate machinery was ruined by a group of Rebels. I need someone to teach them a lesson, and perhaps even get them to mend their ways.

While Martial Arts emphasizes daily practice and training, theoretical learning is just as important. Practice builds martial power, but theory ensures its proper application. In this theory class, you'll learn force techniques, understanding the difference between controlled force and brute strength, helping you excel in real combat. The lesson will be taught by Martial Arts Mentor Xia An. If you're interested, please speak to Xia An directly.

In Martial Arts, the weapon is a vital extension of the practitioner, and materials influence its every key aspect, from flexibility to sharpness. This session, led by an experienced weapons merchant, will cover these topics. To participate, find Xiaoxiao at the plaza.

The Herb Society uses the common Pawpaw in Jixia as a medicinal medium to make healing medicines such as Waxgrass Powder. 
 
In this lesson, students are tasked with gathering a single Pawpaw to study its medicinal properties and understand the principles of herbal remedies. 
 
Note: Obtaining this item through purchase or other indirect means is not permitted. Students must collect it personally.

To know one's ignorance is not true ignorance; to recognize one's confusion is not true confusion. The knowledge of Sorcery is as vast as the stars in the sky—an endless quest, unattainable in a single lifetime. Yet even a small step forward brings its own joy. 
This course is designed to deepen the student's understanding of the basic principles of Sorcery.  
 
Interested students can find Zhijian in the Sorcery classroom on the first floor of the Tower of Enlightenment for more details.

Check Worldpedia to locate Ruins Guards. 
 
"Observe the ruins and seek their origin; let the past and the present be our teachers." 
Crafted by the masters of old, the Ruins Guards represent the pinnacle of ancient craftsmanship and wisdom. Though their designs can no longer be fully recreated, using them in battle offers students a unique opportunity to analyze their structures and understand their intricacies. In this challenge, students will attempt to defeat these Ruins Guards. 
 
Defeat Ruins Guards, not limited to the ones in the designated area, to complete the quest.

Mechcrafts represent the pinnacle of human ingenuity, embodying the concept of "artificial life." To truly connect with the essence of Mechcrafts, one must first understand their core principles. 
 
This course is designed to guide students in unraveling the intricacies of Mechcrafts while sharpening their skills. The theory class is taught by Gong Ye, a seasoned Mechcraft student. 
 
 
 
If you are interested, head to the School of Mechcraft to enroll in the class.

The rapids surge with power; focus is key. Swiftly ascend the rainbow terrace and attune yourself to the ever-changing nature of all things—a vital test for those dedicated to the path of sorcery. May each student gain insight and clarity in the process. Go to the base of the Mauvemist Valley waterfall to begin this journey of enlightenment.

In the Evernull Forest, atop a towering statue of a goddess, a crystal glows with a purple light. It seems that many students are curious to take a closer look. Why not seize the moment when the teachers aren't looking? Just don't get caught, or you're in for it!

The graceful Bellflower thrives in Jixia and is prized by the Healers for its health-promoting properties. 
 
Students are asked to collect a single bellflower for study while experiencing the natural ecosystem of Jixia. 
 
Note: Obtaining this item through purchase or other indirect means is not permitted. Students must collect it personally.

Without a solid foundation, progress slows, and the risk of injury increases. \n \nTo help students balance their training, the School of Martial Arts has appointed Instructor Xia An to lead a basic martial arts course. Interested students are encouraged to join.

The way combat Mechanoids are designed affects the tactics students should use against them. Crafter Lianxin has started a course at the Designer's Square to teach students how to design, build, and use combat Mechanoids.
As the crisp bell tolls the year's end, a gust of wind brings the sound in. \nThe creature, with a blue face and large fangs, wears armor on which bells are hung.

Mechcraft, the pinnacle of craftsmanship. \nThroughout our history, theoretical debates have often sparked innovative inventions. If you're interested in today's theoretical class, find Faan Jat inside the Tower of Enlightenment.

The ever-changing world embodies both strength and elegance. The path of martial arts requires not only physical training but also a deep understanding of theory to harmonize the body and mind. This course focuses on martial arts theory. Visit the Meditation Hall and speak with Xia An.

The School of Martial Arts emphasizes agility, resilience, and strength. All students must strive to unlock their bodies' and spirits' full potential. \nThis course, led by Mr. Fufeng, offers insights into various training stages. Everyone is welcome to join us!
Precious ancient scrolls have been found inside the ruins. \nThey are well guarded, however, and whether you can retrieve them successfully lies in your understanding of the environment.
Deliver Both Martial Arts Flags to Zeeyun

Situated in the east of Springbrook Plains, He & Ming's Training Hall is a revered destination for aspiring disciples who wish to hone their skills. Test your mettle in this trial, at a level that matches your skill.
Theoretical: The Art of Force Control
Aerux reaches the sky and dominates the peak, with nothing else standing in its place. \nThe ruler atop the massive roots, its mane has transformed into glistening crystals.
Sorcery scrolls are scattered throughout the ruins guarded by Mechanoids. Your ability to find them will depend on your understanding of nature.

Three feet of ice doesn't form in a single day. Movement training is a crucial aspect of mastering martial arts. Give it your all and strive to reach the pinnacle as quickly as possible. How can that not be a thoroughly satisfying challenge? \n \nAnyone who wishes to challenge the record held by the talented student Nora would be offered Credits. The challenge is at the waterfall south of Frostcloud Town.
Precious ancient scrolls have been found inside the ruins. \nThey are well guarded, however, and whether you can retrieve them successfully lies in your understanding of the environment.

The Crackle has unique ridges that attract animals, aiding in seed dispersal. Some Hunters use it to lure beasts for research. \nPlease collect one and study its fascinating properties. \nNote: You must collect this item in person. Purchasing or obtaining it by other means is not allowed.

Martial Arts students often prioritize personal training, but studying others' techniques is an invaluable path to greater strength. 
 
Want to learn new skills, reach higher levels, or master the art of countering? 
 
Visit Martial Arts Instructor Fufeng for guidance. He will surely lead you to fruitful learning.

This course seeks to explore the visions in Master Zhuangzi's dreams, providing insights beyond words.  \n \nIf you wish to seek this hidden knowledge, go to the Enlightenment Plaza and find Instructor Gu Mo.

Hone your body and cultivate your mind to become one with the universe. Adapting to various terrains is an essential skill for martial arts students. Training on steep cliffs not only enhances agility but also offers breathtaking views. \nThis footwork class location was recommended by Wuyan, a distinguished graduate of the School of Martial Arts. If you're interested, head to the foot of Scarlet Slope to begin the trial.

Martial arts training is about refining oneself. Using the natural world as a training ground to sharpen one's will and refine one's movements provides an ideal path for growth. Nora, one of Jixia Academy's top students, enthusiastically recommends a cliff in Northton that's perfect for climbing practice. Start your ascent at dawn to experience the sunrise along the way and embody the essence of "chasing the clouds". \n \n"Millions of shattered mirrors, millions of shining suns." —Nora

Everything has its laws. Only by touching the essence can one understand all things. To help students understand the nature of things, the academy has set up a Material Analysis course, starting with the most common materials. This course features practical knowledge shared by experienced merchants. Students who wish to participate should go to the Mountain Front Plaza and find Ruoyin.

text: Strange rumors about a water monster have been circulating in Serene Wilds. Head to the Ranger's Camp to hear these sensational stories.

You saved an injured Nianfang beast and learned from a veterinarian named Kui that it may have been wounded by the widely rumored 'Water Monkey.' Following the clues, you found the Water Monkey's habitat, met the naturalist Chenzang, and learned that the so-called 'Water Monkey' is actually a magical creature from Jixia called a 'Sacrificial Fish.' While investigating why they wandered here, you found a poaching camp disguised as a clinic. It turns out Kui was the mastermind behind it all, using his status as a vet to poach magical creatures. After defeating Kui, Chenzang plans to organize ecological compensation and has temporarily placed the Sacrificial Fish in Anyu Lake...

After the Dream Performance finals, a message came from the Student Affairs Committee inviting you to gather at an unfamiliar location. Although the reason wasn't stated, it's worth checking out...\nTip: After meeting the conditions, go to [Interest Circles] - [Partners], read and reply to the message from [Student Affairs Committee Group Chat] to unlock this quest.

Strange dance moves have appeared in Lingxin Garden. Lu Huaiqing claims this is the miraculous effect of a new sedative medicine and invites you to help distribute it for the benefit of the students. This medicine might also lead you to a unique landscape.

Pale blue stone pillars support the Court of Green Flames, and cyan stars awaken sleeping wings... Strange calls echo from the depths of the Littoral Cave, as if watching, as if waiting. If you have time, why not go take a look?
Where did those butterflies come from, and what is this banquet... For now, I have no choice but to follow them and find out.

The Enlightenment Trials footage is damaged, and key segments cannot be restored, much to the distress of the Secret Society. Thanks to you, the heroic deeds of the past have been brought back to life, allowing us to glimpse the bravery of former contestants and helping the Secret Society recreate legendary moments. Without an audience, there is no legend—you, too, are a creator of legends.

The Pearlized Tree has heard countless wishes and witnessed your meeting with Senara. Senara slowly explains the true meaning of the tree: plants will eventually wither, and wishes may be forgotten, but the person in one's heart will never fade with time. Her words fall upon your heart like wind through branches, leaving you with a sense of déjà vu...

Cui Ran's passion was manipulated by Wu Jiu, who convinced him that the "Fire Dragon Cannon" could protect the academy. However, as the creator of the Fire Dragon Cannon, Xing Mang knows better than anyone the dangers it hides. Wu Jiu has been egging Cui Ran on from the sidelines, and behind his words and actions, there seems to be a hidden secret... Time is running out. You have agreed to meet Xing Mang at the "seaside" and must act quickly to prevent the tragedy from repeating...

Though the smoke of the great war has cleared, the academy is still scarred and in need of repair. You came to Cloudhaven hoping to help Teacher Xingmang shoulder the academy's burdens, only to stumble upon a dispute between the Lingyun Guard and Xingmang. It seems trouble is brewing in the Caiyun Basin again...
A storyteller seems to be composing a tale about Qiansi and testing it around Caiyun Basin. What will her lyrics say?...

The day after the finals accident, you suddenly receive a message from the Scholar's Committee summoning you to a remote location. Unexpectedly, you find a banquet that the Master had set up here in advance. Sitting alone at the table, memories of the past gradually surface...
Aerwatch Siyue's Reminder: Should you insist on venturing into the perilous Oneirland, you must first seek her out at the camp near Dreamy Trail to learn more...

After the "Shuchun Bud Out-of-Control Incident," a major conflict broke out between the Shuchun and Wangqiu factions in the Herb Garden. Previously, the incident caused injuries to several students, leading to a disagreement on how to handle the Shuchun Bud—the Wangqiu faction believed it should be destroyed to protect student safety and the ecological balance of the Herb Garden; while the Shuchun faction believed they should take this opportunity to manage and study it.\nPhysicians have benevolent hearts, and both factions originally intended to save lives, but which choice is truly correct...\nIf each faction could use their own strengths to work together on improving and studying the Shuchun Bud, perhaps the result would be different?

text: Upon arriving at the tower ship, Yushu launched a surprise attack. The Cangyuan Armor blocked a fatal blow for you, and the figure of Gongzhi appeared. It turns out his experiment to transfer his consciousness into a mechanism failed years ago, and his remaining consciousness survived solely due to the call of the Cangyuan Armor.\nIn the end, Gongzhi left behind the method to reshape the Cangyuan Armor before fading away completely. You and the Cangyuan Armor became the only witnesses to his short yet long life.

Inside Guanyun Manor, a butterfly that speaks human language leads you into a dreamlike banquet. At this banquet, those who have passed and those who have left have all returned. As you drink and toast, eyes blurred by wine, are you truly missing the people of the past, or the peace you once knew?
This is the wish-making sanctuary known to everyone in Jixia—the Pearlized Tree. If you tell it your wish, how will its branches, leaves, and flower shadows respond?

Master Fuzi has taught many students at Jixia, and his invitations carry great weight. During the Jixia Incident, Lu Huaiqing fell into a nightmare, and in his loss of control, he dragged everyone in the Lingxin Garden into his hallucinations. The invitation Master once gave him became the thread holding his sanity together. Only by reliving the old dream of Master's invitation can his reason be awakened and a field of clarity be planted.

You encounter a storyteller singing a fictional tale of "Qiansi and the Cloud-Root Monster." This version of events is vastly different from the past you know. When you ask her about it, she reveals that the fabricated parts were told to her by a classmate named "Xiao Si." Who is spreading these lies? You decide to find this "Xiao Si" and get to the bottom of it. As the mist thickens, the Xiao Si who appears is none other than Qiansi from your student days. He chats with you about his past while making Fengyun Cakes—those simple, humble treats that hold a surprisingly vital power. As you wake from the dream and the mist clears, you look at the academy badge in your hand, listening to the song of a story that both belongs and doesn't belong to Qiansi, feeling a complex mix of emotions.

Deep within the Spirit Mechanism lies a hidden secret—a secret chamber. Who is the owner of this chamber? And what secrets are hidden within the small mechanisms they left behind?

text: Everything began with the War of God's Fall. Nuwa and Dijun clashed over the Miracle, leading to the fall of all gods. Before she vanished, Nuwa left behind prophecies and hopes for the future.
On the battlefield of ruin, heroes stand with you to launch a fierce assault against the powerful enemy.
As everyone was fighting, Qiansi leaped down from above. The power of the Divine Mark erupted from his body, strengthening his original shell and forming even more violent and powerful strength.
Mulan battles the "Heartless," only to be shocked by the very scar that once saved her. Aunt Li tearfully reveals the truth: "I was bitten while trying to save you..."

Mulan offers her sword as a sacrifice, performing the 'Blade Tempers the Setting Sun, Returning Geese Never Depart' stance. Entrusting her grief to the heroic spirits, only history and her departing silhouette remain where the purple light fades.

Inside the Tower of Enlightenment, Zhuangzi, who was guarding the Cloud Silkworm, was defeated by the combined efforts of Jiang Ziya and a mysterious figure in black. Jiang Ziya took the Cloud Silkworm core and left. Zhuangzi exhausted his own power to replace the Cloud Silkworm and take his place in the Tower of Enlightenment.
First Encounter at the Pearl Tree
As you step into the cave, the ground shakes. Gan Si lets out a pained cry as he breaks free from the Cloud Root Pillar.

Under the witness of the stone statues, Hua Mulan uses military orders to awaken Li Xun's remaining will. Together, they sing the frontier song, executing demons with discipline. As the strings snap, humanity returns, leaving only the tragic echo of 'Warrior, do not return...'
First Encounter at the Pearl Tree

You failed to stop Di Xin, and the world crumbled in his hands. The Primordial Priest blocked a fatal blow for you and sent you away from this world. As you parted, she gently said that this would not be the end of everything.
The heroes fight alongside you, but one by one they fall before the overwhelming power. They cleared the path for you and escorted you to Di Xin; you now face him carrying their will.
The Great Wall Garrison fights the monsters in blood. Li Xun's sacrifice ignites Hua Mulan's desperate resolve...

Master and Jiang Ziya fought. Qian Si appeared to persuade them to stop, but Jiang Ziya recognized him as his former student and killed him anyway. Master was furious, and Jiang Ziya, having regained his full power, severely injured everyone present. At the critical moment, Master used his body as a shield, sacrificing himself to save everyone. You and the others fell unconscious, and Jiang Ziya left in silence.
A strange black mist suddenly strikes, surrounding you and Qinglan. The source is none other than the Youying, who hasn't been seen for days...
Just as Qiansi was about to take you down with him, he discovered your academy crest. Recognizing you as a Jixia student, he regained his senses and saved you, falling into the abyss alone.

Just as you reached out to take the mark, a violent force of Conferred Gods surged into the arena, binding everyone. Jiang Ziya, the man in black, and Xingli descended from the sky. Master arrived, broke the bindings, and confronted Jiang Ziya in anger.
Li Xiaomiao wins a narrow victory through trickery, but Mulan sees through her sword style in three moves, causing her to lose in embarrassment and accidentally reveal her Guardian token.
Xingmang is excited about finding the mechanism core, but Wujiu's cannonballs are everywhere. After a blinding flash of fire, everything around seems to have gone still...
Kui attempts a sneak attack on Chenzang from behind, but is blocked by the Festival Fish Clan Chief...

You combined the two Sentinel's Talismans, but what lies beyond the gate? Following the instructions, the search led to unexpected discoveries. However, unlocking the gate proved more challenging than expected. \n \nFind the hidden gate in the <69D0FF>village</> by following the clues on the <69D0FF>back of the talisman</>.

Everything about Zhaochou's treasure vault feels off—it looks more like an old lab of Luban's... And there's no treasure at all! 
 
Worse, you've found a Rebel hiding inside. What's his tie to Zhaochou? And what did she mean by "killing two birds with one stone"? 
 
Time to get some answers at <69D0FF>Horizon Retreat</>.
Among the ruins at <5E5F68>the Underhall</>, something from the past seems hidden.
Ring the Harvest Bell and collect the weapon beside Uncle Yun.

The Stone Extraction Hall is accessible only through a ground-level entrance. Visit the war-ravaged Springbrook Plains to find out how to enter the <69D0FF>Stone Extraction Hall</> and activate the <69D0FF>Illuminator</> at the top.

Heng Jun, a teacher at the School of Martial Arts, forged a sharp sword to try to break the seal. Unfortunately, the sword snapped. The Martial Arts power alone wasn't enough. 
 
Heng Jun told you he gave the <69D0FF>Broken Sealbreaker</> to <69D0FF>Long Ling</>, who is <69D0FF>taking inventory in the school's northeastern weapon forge</>. Finally, you found it from the Rebels by the pond west of the School of Martial Arts. 
 
You'll also need help from <69D0FF>Liu Jiao on the second floor of the School of Mechcraft</> and <69D0FF>Ziqian on the second floor of the School of Sorcery</>.
A Seeker in <5E5F68>Dragon Valley</> is unraveling the secrets of dragons...

Strange Dream Energy has caused abnormal phenomena at <69D0FF>Waterfall View Pavilion</>, <69D0FF>Aerux Yard</>, and <69D0FF>Hunting Camp</> in Northton. According to Dreamweaver Qing Ze, all clues point to the <69D0FF>Abandoned Mine</> southeast of Aerux Inn, north of Autumn Creek and south of the teahouse. Investigate the abnormal locations to find a way into the mine. \n \nThe owner of <69D0FF>Dreamish Teahouse</>, east of Aerux Town, has more information. Pay her a visit first.
Battle in the Stone Extraction Hall
Rumor has it that a forbidden zone at <5E5F68>Jixia Academy</> hides treasures left by predecessors.

Iridescent Basin is the final stage of the Enlightenment Trials, where students train and test themselves every day. Piner, the teacher in charge of Dainty Vale, recently helped the Aerwatch deal with some Rebels. Rebels keep coming, and there may be a larger threat hidden beneath the surface. \n \nPiner trusts you, but you must prove your strength first. Complete the six <69D0FF>Treasure Tower Trials</> to join the investigation.
Finding a Way into the Underhall
You have collected the five bronze armor pieces that honor Everspring and his squad's bravery. \n \nPlace them at the <69D0FF>top of Littoral Cave</>.

Zhaochou, the owner of Horizon Retreat, shared her troubles after learning of your intentions. 
 
She revealed that recently, three Rebel leaders have caused havoc in Iridescent Basin and even stole her ancestral treasures. Desperate for help, she has issued bounties for their capture. 
 
You promised to assist her in retrieving the three stolen <69D0FF>ancestral treasures</> and confronting these notorious Rebel leaders.
Folks in a town of <5E5F68>Northton</> suffer from nightmares—what's going on?
Legend says the <5E5F68>Jixia Forehill</> echoes tales of Zhou Yu and Kongming's battles of wit.

After you found the three keys in the secret chambers, Kongming's letter revealed the true story behind his "rivalry" with Zhou Yu. Now go to the underwater chamber in <69D0FF>Wondrous Maze</> to uncover the outcome of their contest.

Each item represents a school's effort, yet none succeeded in breaking the seal. Perhaps combining them might yield a solution... \n \nSeek help from <69D0FF>Liu Jiao in the top-floor room of the School of Mechcraft</>.

After two decades, the three Contrivances have been reunited, and Piner has disclosed the truth about the Enlightenment Trials back then. \n \nIt's time to take the three Contrivances and explore the secrets lying beneath the depths of <69D0FF>Iridescent Pond</>.

The fragment belongs to the Dream Envoy's Fine Dream Runestone. It is required to restore the balance of Dream Energy. \n \n<69D0FF>Qing Ze's stone tablet</> shows the Dream Totem at Dreamwhisper Lake. Take every Runestone fragment you find in <69D0FF>Dreamwhisper Lake</> to the <69D0FF>Dream Totem</> to end the nightmare crisis in Aerux Town.

You followed Zhi Rui's research log and found all five Lamp Wicks. They now glow after absorbing energy from dragon bones. \n \nNow, it's time to light the <69D0FF>Lamps of Return</> at Sunken Stele Pond.

Is Everspring completely overtaken by the monster, or is there still a spark of consciousness left? The answer lies within the central pillar, but be prepared for a fierce battle. Enter the central pillar and confront Everspring.

Ziqian from the School of Sorcery failed to unlock the seal using her Sorcery Technique. 
 
Consult <69D0FF>Ziqian on the second floor of the School of Sorcery</>, find the <69D0FF>three cats on the first floor</>, and pet them to obtain the <69D0FF>lens</>. Then, give the lens to Ziqian to restore the Sorcery Circle and obtain the <69D0FF>Mirage Gem</>. 
 
Sorcery alone may not be enough. You'll also need insights from <69D0FF>Liu Jiao in the top-floor room of the School of Mechcraft</> and <69D0FF>Heng Jun in the weapon crafting chamber at the northeast corner of the School of Martial Arts</>.

The Meeting Hall is accessible only through a ground-level entrance. Investigate the ruins in Aerfall Highlands to find out how to enter the <69D0FF>Meeting Hall</> and activate the <69D0FF>Illuminator</> at the top.
The two talismans found in water contain familiar energy. They could probably lead to the Underhall. Head to the grand structure deep within <69D0FF>Cloudshatter Vale</>.

The keepsake has been restored, but a ritual is still necessary to fully stabilize the Dream Energy. \n \nGo to <69D0FF>the cave north of the Dream Totem</> and perform the ritual in its <69D0FF>depths</>.

Beyond the dust-covered door lay the ancient Underhall, hidden underground for many years. You've entered this space before, but this seems to be a different corner. \n \nEnter <69D0FF>the Underhall</>.
Go to <5E5F68>Springbrook Plains</> to find the mysterious Seeker and uncover untold history.
After collecting three keys, you defeated Contraption Master in his secret chamber and obtained a butterfly-wing-shaped Runestone fragment. \n \nTake this <69D0FF>fragment</> to <69D0FF>Qing Ze</>.
A Seeker captain is seeking help at <5E5F68>Aerfall Highlands</>...
The Dreamslayer appeared during the ritual. You defeated it and found a feather from it. \n \nBring this feather to <69D0FF>Qing Ze</> to find out more information.

The ruins across Springbrook Plains hint at a past war, but the details are lost. A mysterious Seeker says a hero changed the course of that battle. What became of him? The ruins might hold the answer. 
 
Go to the top of <69D0FF>Littoral Cave</> to view the mural. Then search for clues at these five locations around Springbrook Plains: 
 
<69D0FF>1. Inside the Mechanoid Head (northwest)</> 
 
<69D0FF>2. Old Citadel (southwest)</> 
 
<69D0FF>3. The outpost west of the Desolate Fortress</> 
 
<69D0FF>4. The ruins southwest of Emerald Meadows</> 
 
<69D0FF>5. The ruins northwest of Spring Glades</>

After you finished the prayers, a faint golden light rose around the Harvest Bell and activated the nearby altars. 
 
You learned the ritual's purpose: it honors <69D0FF>the Crafters, Hunters, Herbalists, and Anglers</> who worked to stabilize the Aerflow over Harvest Fields. 
 
<69D0FF>The four altars around the Harvest Bell are still empty.</> Each likely represents one of those <69D0FF>Societies</>.
Someone has been sabotaging the Enlightenment Trials and disrupting the competition. A crisis draws near in Iridescent Basin...

Even though it's forbidden, Seekers keep investigating the mysteries of the Eight Trial Pillars in East Aerfall Highlands. But someone is secretly interfering with their work. \n \nClear the challenges at the <69D0FF>Eight Trial Pillars</>.

After you restore the five armor pieces, the statue is complete, and the mural reveals two new locations—<69D0FF>Ruins by Pearlized Lake</> and <69D0FF>Lake in Cloudshatter Vale</>. Are there any clues that lead to the Underhall?

After you completed the seven challenges Kongming left at the Aerflow Towers in Jixia Mountains, the seal on his old residence was broken. \n \nEnter <69D0FF>Kongming's old residence</> at <69D0FF>Feather Hill</>.

The forgotten history of Jixia reveals the fourth school once located in the now-off-limits area. Legend has it that the students left behind a challenge before departing. The three schools competed to solve it but failed. Some teachers might have more information. \n \nSpeak with <69D0FF>Liu Jiao in the top-floor room of the School of Mechcraft</>, <69D0FF>Heng Jun in the weapon crafting chamber deep in the northeastern corner of the School of Martial Arts</>, and <69D0FF>Ziqian on the second floor of the School of Sorcery</> to gather information. Then proceed to investigate the <69D0FF>Restricted Ground</>.
Volcanic Stone Keys are used to activate the three Illuminators to create a path to the central pillar. \n \nActivate the <69D0FF>Illuminator</> at the <69D0FF>top of the Shelter</>.

Zhi Rui is studying the dragon remains, the mysterious bronze Mechcraft devices, and the unlit lamps in Dragon Valley to learn what happened before the dragon fell. \n \nFind her <69D0FF>lost research note</> in Sunken Stele Pond, and then follow its clues to recover <69D0FF>the five Bronze Lamp Wicks</>.

During the Harvest Festival, celebrations are in full swing. At Harvest Fields, you met Uncle Yun, who shared that a key part of the festival is the Stabilization Ritual. \n \nUncle Yun suggested visiting the <69D0FF>Four Blessing Sites</> and provided the directions.
Villagers on the <5E5F68>Dreamweave Plains</> are preparing a secret ritual for the Harvest Festival...

Zhi Rui said Team Dragonscale, a team of Seekers, is preparing to explore Dragon's Graveyard. You might find important clues there. \n \nThe Dragon's Graveyard will be open to the public <69D0FF>after the Enlightenment Trials</>. Look for Team Dragonscale's <69D0FF>Yang Ling</> there to see if you can help.

The once-majestic underground city now lies in ruins, its splendor long lost to ancient wars. Within the desolate hall, the remnants of gigantic beast claws suggest that Everspring managed to lure the monster in. It seems that reigniting the Illuminator is the key to unveiling the deeper secrets of the Underhall. \n \nFind the <69D0FF>Volcanic Stone Key</> in the Shelter.

The hidden chamber under Kongming's residence has been unlocked. It seems Kongming expected Zhou Yu's investigation and hid the items Zhou Yu might be looking for in three secret chambers across Jixia Mountains... \n \nFind the other two keys in the underground chambers <69D0FF>north of Stargazing Terrace</> and <69D0FF>north of Wondrous Maze</>.

Kongming and Zhou Yu were both prodigies at Jixia Academy. Their rivalry became a legend at the academy, but who won remains unknown. A member of the Secrets Club is now investigating. \n \nTo find more clues, try Kongming's <69D0FF>challenges at the Aerflow Towers</> in Jixia Mountains, or explore his <69D0FF>old residence</> on <69D0FF>Feather Hill</>.

Before the monster took control and forced him to attack others, Everspring entered the hidden chamber in the central pillar. He planned to seal the monster with himself. He hid the key and left a warning telling future explorers not to open the chamber... Help the Seekers with their crisis, find <69D0FF>the key</> <69D0FF>under the Central Pillar</>, and use it to find Everspring.

The hidden history is about to be unveiled, and only the final crucial step remains to obtain the hidden treasure. \n \nProceed to the <69D0FF>underground hall of the Restricted Ground</> and use the <69D0FF>Magicbreaker Key</> to unlock the Entangled Lock.
The Dragonroar Horn is too heavy to use. What kind of sound will it make? \n \nThe <69D0FF>Dragon Sentinel</> at Sunken Stele Pond might know something.

In the East Aerfall Highlands, the Bastion Fort and the Mausoleum are rumored to house two hidden Talismans. When combined, they reveal the path to Mausoleum's Peak. \n \nExplore the <69D0FF>Bastion Fort</> and the <69D0FF>Mausoleum</> to find the two Talismans.

It seems the Dragon Horn needs to be combined with another item to be played. Meanwhile, Zhi Rui believes the Whistle Piece acquired from the Dragon Sentinel might be related to a certain musical instrument. You need the assistance of Musicians. \n \nConsult <69D0FF>Musician Geqing</> who comes to Dragons' Graveyard for inspiration.
Though the Stabilization Ritual is complete, it seems there are still troubles in the wheat field that demand your attention. \n \nHead to the <69D0FF>wheat field</> to investigate.
Ring the Bell and Make a Wish
The gate to the Underhall has opened. Did Everspring's plan succeed? You'll find the answer inside <69D0FF>the Underhall</>.

You returned to the top of the Honor Tower with Luban No. 5's core.

A familiar voice rang out.

It turned out that Master Lu had also come to the Exquisite Tower, and he helped repair the Luban core and restore its training functions.

The pure heart buried at the bottom of the lake for years could finally fulfill its original mission under the colorful clouds.

Chronicle completed

Tick-tock, tick-tock... Sun Bin looked down in shock. The pocket watch, which had remained silent since Tian Ji's departure, suddenly started ticking again. Tian Ji — he's here! Sun Bin realized, his heart pounding. He wanted to run toward the path's end, but a shadowy figure appeared there, gesturing for him to leave. "Tian Ji, is that you?" Sun Bin cried out, "Why can't I come closer?" The shadow pointed behind Sun Bin, where a door appeared. A voice echoed in the space, "There are people waiting for you back there."  \nAll of a sudden, Tian Ji's words came back to him," The answer lies in time. Past, or future..." Sun Bin stared at his pocket watch, realization dawning. With a final glance at the shadow, his heart brimming with sadness and longing, Sun Bin turned and walked to the door. "I will see you again. Promise."

Rufeng intervenes, blocking the attack and transferring energy to the Death Knell. The Death Knell shatters, causing the space to tremble, and the Singing Bird lets out a mournful cry before disappearing. Xueyi faints, and the space collapses. With your deadly strike, Xin fell. Suddenly, the man in black reappeared, trying to persuade you. Dark smoke gathered underfoot as the scene dimmed. The camera zoomed in on the man in black's face before shifting to a new setting: the Dream Trial Illusory Realm. The man in black resurrected Xin and then disappeared. A piercing wail echoed through the sky as heroic energy flowed from a nearby hero statue, spiraling toward Xin's lifeless body. Dark purple energy tore through his back, accompanied by desperate screams. The hero's shadow struggled to break free but was consumed by the void. Wing-like energy lifted Xin high into the air before he crashed back down. The wails abruptly ceased. Xin opened his eyes, now wearing the Cloak of the Dead. "Control the Wonders. Dominate all beings!" he declared, his voice filled with fury and determination. Xin was ready to conquer like a supreme ruler.

text: 1. Tier Rules: Ranked matches are divided into <Instruction_RPVP>7 major tiers</>, which are: <Instruction_RPVP>Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, Master, Grandmaster</>; Bronze and Silver tiers have Ⅰ~Ⅲ, <Instruction_RPVP>3 sub-tiers</>; Gold and Platinum tiers have Ⅰ~Ⅳ, <Instruction_RPVP>4 sub-tiers</>; Diamond and Master tiers have Ⅰ~Ⅴ, <Instruction_RPVP>5 sub-tiers</>; <Instruction_RPVP>Grandmaster</> does not have sub-tiers, but instead <Instruction_RPVP>advances based on star count</>;[br] [br]2. Reaching 26 stars in Grandmaster will promote you to <Instruction_RPVP>Mythic Grandmaster</>, 51 stars to <Instruction_RPVP>Legendary Grandmaster</>, and 101 stars to <Instruction_RPVP>Supreme Grandmaster</>;[br] [br]3. Promotion, Demotion, and Tier Change Rules: When at max stars, a promotion or tier-up match is triggered. Winning results in a promotion or tier-up with 1 star; when at 0 stars, a demotion match is triggered. If you lose without tier protection active, you will be demoted. After reaching the Grandmaster tier, if you are at 0 stars and lose a match without tier protection, you will be demoted to Master Ⅰ; Bronze and Silver tiers do not lose stars;[br] [br]4. Tier Gap Rules: When matchmaking in a party, the <Instruction_RPVP>party leader's</> and <Instruction_RPVP>party members'</> <Instruction_RPVP>tier gap</> cannot exceed a certain range, or matchmaking cannot begin.
zh_text: 1. 段位规则：排位赛一共分为<Instruction_RPVP>7大段位</>，分别是：<Instruction_RPVP>倔强青铜、秩序白银、荣耀黄金、尊贵铂金、永恒钻石、至尊星耀、最强王者</>；其中倔强青铜和秩序白银有Ⅰ~Ⅲ，<Instruction_RPVP>3个小段位</>；荣耀黄金和尊贵铂金有Ⅰ~Ⅳ，<Instruction_RPVP>4个小段位</>；永恒钻石和至尊星耀有Ⅰ~Ⅴ，<Instruction_RPVP>5个小段位</>；<Instruction_RPVP>最强王者</>不区分小段位，而是<Instruction_RPVP>根据星数升级</>；[br] [br]2. 最强王者达到26星将会升级为<Instruction_RPVP>无双王者</>，51星升级为<Instruction_RPVP>荣耀王者</>，101星升级为<Instruction_RPVP>传奇王者</>；[br] [br]3. 晋级、降级、晋段、降段规则：满星状态下触发对应的晋级或晋段赛，胜利后晋级或者晋段且得到1星；0星状态下触发降级赛或降段赛，在没有开启段位保护的情况下失败后会降级或者降段；升入最强王者段位后，如果在0星且没有开启段位保护的情况下，再输一场会降段到星耀Ⅰ；青铜、白银段位不会掉星；[br] [br]4.段位差规则：组队匹配时，<Instruction_RPVP>队长</>与<Instruction_RPVP>队员</>的<Instruction_RPVP>段位差</>不能超过一定范围，否则将不能开始匹配。

Diamond and Master tiers have Ⅰ~Ⅴ, <Instruction_RPVP>5 sub-tiers</>. <Instruction_RPVP>Grandmaster</> does not have sub-tiers, but instead <Instruction_RPVP>ranks up based on stars</>.[br] [br]2. Once a Grandmaster reaches 26 stars, they promote to <Instruction_RPVP>Mythic</>; at 51 stars, they promote to <Instruction_RPVP>Legendary</>; at 101 stars, they promote to <Instruction_RPVP>Eternal</>.[br] [br]3. Promotion, Demotion, and Tier Change Rules: When at max stars, you trigger a promotion match; winning grants a promotion and 1 star. At 0 stars, you trigger a demotion match; if you lose without tier protection, you will be demoted. After reaching Grandmaster, if you are at 0 stars without tier protection, losing one more match will demote you to Master Ⅰ. Bronze and Silver tiers do not lose stars.

Normal gameplay behavior can restore Credibility Score:[br]         <Instruction_RPVP1>Logging in daily restores 2 points;</>[br]         <Instruction_RPVP1>Completing a match normally without any violations restores 1 point;</>[br]         <Instruction_RPVP1>A maximum of 10 points can be restored daily;</>[br][br]4. text:
This is Trial Mechcraft: Stormswift 
 
Enhanced from the first-generation teleportation Mechcraft "Stormrise", it now has the ability to turn invisible, making it elusive and unpredictable. Participants in the trial must be cautious. 
 
 
 
Trial Record: 
 
After the first trial, the Vanquisher squad took a detour through a narrow pass to avoid being surrounded by enemies—a clever move. 
 
... 
 
During the twelfth trial, Enchanter Fang Ron seized the high ground and focused fire on the Mechcraft—a long-term strategy, but ultimately failed due to a mistake. 
 
... 
 
During the thirty-fourth trial, Contriver An Ji and his team worked together to break through the Barrier of Stormswift. Enchanter Yan Hui feigned an attack with ice crystals. The Vanquisher Wu Gong finish it with the finial stike. The three of them work in perfect harmony. Well done.
zh_text:
此为试炼机关：风驰 
基于初代瞬移机关 “风启” 打造，更添隐形之能，行踪飘忽、神出鬼没。参与试炼者，务必小心谨慎。 
 
试炼记录： 
试炼一周回，斗士小队迂回狭窄隘口，避免四面受敌，为妙计。 
…… 
试炼十二周回，异士方荣抢占制高险地，集火强攻机关，为远谋，然不慎惜败。 
…… 
试炼三十四周回，劳士安及带队通力协作，破风驰屏障；异士妍慧以冰晶佯攻；斗士武戈给予终结一击，三者配合默契，为善。

此为试炼机关：风驰 
基于初代瞬移机关 “风启” 打造，更添隐形之能，行踪飘忽、神出鬼没。参与试炼者，务必小心谨慎。 
 
试炼记录： 
试炼一周回，斗士小队迂回狭窄隘口，避免四面受敌，为妙计。 
…… 
试炼十二周回，异士方荣抢占制高险地，集火强攻机关，为远谋，然不慎惜败。 
…… 
试炼三十四周回，劳士安及带队通力协作，破风驰屏障；异士妍慧以冰晶佯攻；斗士武戈给予终结一击，三者配合默契，为善。

After the first trial, the Vanquisher squad took a detour through a narrow pass to avoid being surrounded by enemies—a clever move. 
 
... 
 
During the twelfth trial, Enchanter Fang Ron seized the high ground and focused fire on the Mechcraft—a long-term strategy, but ultimately failed due to a mistake. 
 
...

After becoming a Godforged, many envied me. At first, I thought it was great: power, respect, glory.

But is sacrifice the destiny of a Godforged? In the last battle, I was the only survivor of a ten-man squad. I can't turn back; I can only move forward. But I don't want to die yet—there's research unfinished, a promise I made to her. I can't just throw my life away.

But I can't show weakness. As a Godforged, I have to fight whether I'm ready or not.
I can do this. I must.
