text: Chronicles of Chengxin: Home is Elsewhere

1. When testing mechanical creations, one must fully grasp the potential risks of various mechanisms and make preparations in advance to prevent trouble before it happens.

2. The mechanism testing chamber is equipped with high-strength testing automatons used to test the performance of new mechanical creations; it is strictly forbidden to use them for other purposes.

3. During the testing process, one must closely monitor the performance of the mechanism; if any abnormalities are found, they must be reported immediately.

We've collected a massive amount of samples in our search for more bionic mechanism prototypes. Honestly, it feels more like a field trip than research.

Yesterday, when they were catching shrimp and crabs in the river, someone got pinched and started wailing, while another was terrified by a spider disguised as a rock. You wouldn't recognize them as the usually stoic people they are.

Deep in the Jixia Valley, we found a giant bird. When it spread its wings to take flight, it looked like it was going to pierce the clouds... I feel like it could serve as a prototype for my mechanism research!

The team next door is planning to challenge me to a contest once they finish their project. I heard they want to make a 'bomb crab'? I wonder what that will look like...

Project Phase: Phase II (Functional Integration and Optimization)
According to the research proposal, this phase focuses on the development of bionic mechanisms. Stage results have been achieved, with specific experimental content as follows:
I. Motion Bionic Module
II. Perception and Environmental Interaction Module
III. Key Technical Breakthroughs
Experimental results show that branding divine patterns on the surface of the mechanisms can significantly enhance the strength of the creations and allow for precise control. Currently, bionic mechanisms based on creatures such as spiders, crabs, and turtles have become stable, and the addition of more bionic creations can be considered.

April 10th
Biomimetic mechanism behavior model test #121:
By observing the behavior patterns of real creatures, we extract core characteristics like attacking and defending, and convert them into executable commands for the mechanisms.

May 2nd
Biomimetic mechanism behavior model test #255:
Behavior models for ground slamming, laser firing, and remote targeting have stabilized. However, without terrain perception and autonomous walking, they are not ready for combat.

June 20th
After the new researcher joined, we made a major breakthrough in environmental perception and terrain interaction. All types of biomimetic mechanisms can now dash forward. With further research, they will surely play a huge role in combat.

To Sui'an:
Zhenniang should have kept her promise to meet at the pier. However, with the war intensifying, my father-in-law and I have decided to make a last stand to clear out the enemy.
Zhenniang is naturally reluctant to part, especially since Ping'er is still young, but for the sake of the bigger picture...
I only hope that you and our child have a safe journey. I hope you will carry forward the art of mechanisms and benefit our people.
Do not worry about me.

No.022 - Research Record
Respected Butterfly Envoy, according to research, fragments containing dream energy have many uses.
1. Can be used to unlock dream energy seals.
2. Can be absorbed by dream creatures to make them stronger.
3. For humans, holding dream fragments can prevent interference from the dream realm and maintain mental balance.

April 20th
I keep hearing metal grinding sounds during the night shift, but it stops when I get close. It's creepy—who's still doing experiments in the building at night?
I think I caught a glimpse of Gongzhi that night; he just said he dropped something. That kid is so quiet, he really worries me.
By the way, have we been scrapping too many mechanisms lately? I have to report the total to that guy who cleans up the wreckage tomorrow. He complains every time; I hope he doesn't drag me into cleaning up too.

Utility: Located in the Littoral Cave, one of the "instructors" for the Divine Caster's daily trials, providing flexible and varied combat scenarios for the trials.

Lizards in Jixia are mostly gregarious. When threatened, the lizard pack will form a special formation and <span color="#07AAFFFF">launch a coordinated attack</>, showing great intelligence.

These lizards also exhibit features of co-evolution with their environment: for example, the tails of some lizards resemble leaves, making them perfect biological models for natural camouflage!

In addition, their diet is also worth noting—it includes special mushrooms. After eating mushrooms of different elements, the lizard's attack attributes will change accordingly.
Inspired by this, perhaps we can design different elemental attack attributes for mechanical constructs.

April 3rd

Research on humanoid mechanism subjects can now officially begin.

May 10th

I keep having the same dream: the dream is filled with thick fog, and I can't see anything. Only the sound of drums keeps ringing, and the echo remains after I wake up. Recently, the drums have been getting louder.
Last night, the fog in my dream thinned, but the drums grew louder. The shadow I couldn't catch before was a bit closer this time, but just as I was about to touch it, it dissipated.
...
I had the dream again. I woke up in the dream to dead silence, with red everywhere, and the drums hadn't stopped. After the war broke out, everything changed.
...
Today is my last time coming here; I'm heading to the battlefield tomorrow. But as long as I think about the war, I can't hear the drums. Perhaps I'll be reunited with them soon.

Grandpa, I miss you.
Everything is fine here. I'm doing research on mechanisms now, which counts as carrying on our Yu family's legacy.

I'm just afraid the war will reach here one day. I can't forget that day when you took out all the ironware, even that ancestral iron sword you treasured most, and we forged the sturdiest defensive mechanism together, but it was all in vain.

Jixia is covered in mountain flowers, just like Chang'an used to be. I miss the flowers of Chang'an, and even more, the flower cakes there. Do you think if the Letter-Fin could swim across the ocean, it could take another look at our hometown for me?

I was quite excited to receive a biological research task, but... I thought I'd be observing fierce beasts like bears or wolves, why is it a turtle! 
 
March 18th 
I've been in a standoff with this turtle for half a day, it hasn't moved at all. The shell is a good thing, though; this integrated skeleton is truly tough... If used on a machine, the protection would be greatly improved! However, this kind of mechanism is probably better suited for prolonged battles than for charging. 
 
April 3rd 
I was really startled while trying to feed it today. I didn't expect this slow-looking guy to have such a strong bite! It clamped onto the tongs and wouldn't let go. Maybe I can add some instantaneous strike functions! Like a surprise cannon mechanism...

They sought only to bide their time, harness the power of God-forging, and eventually restore glory, return to their homeland, and reclaim their home.

Iron armor treads upon the mountains and rivers, the flames of war bring disaster to the people. Tears of blood stain the courtyard steps, wives and children suffer.
Boarding the treasure ship to leave the homeland, losing our home before even dying.
Thus, this monument is erected to honor the loyalty of the soldiers and remember the innocent lives lost.

Heroic souls never perish, their names carved into the green mountains:
Qin Feng, Zhao Chengyun, Lin Sui'an, Chen Yan, Lin Qiuwu, Xiao Jichen, Gu Yi...
Nation and family grieve together, never to be forgotten:
Su Zhenzhen, Jing E, Liu Changji, Mo Tongfeng, Wu Wanrong, Cui Songshou...

Courage remains, buried with the iron armor. Where the spring mountains are green, all is a resting place. When the autumn wind sighs, all ages share the same sorrow.
Not in the same bed in life, but in the same monument in death, protecting our nation together.
Erecting this monument is not just to record names, but to let future generations know: the word 'peace' is heavy as a thousand jun. The responsibility of guarding home lies with you and me. Do not forget, do not forget.

text:
Day 1 Underground

After drifting in the underground waterways for several days, my raft almost crashed into the reefs, and I got separated from Ah Ping and Ah An... Fortunately, we finally reached our destination today. However, as soon as we got out of the water, we were chased by a group of Mechanoids. Oh no, these guys are really rough; luckily, I ran fast, or I'd be like those guys next door, all battered up.

Day 5 Underground

We were resting at the camp when suddenly the ground started shaking violently. It was terrifying. When we went out on patrol at night, we discovered a group of Jixia Academy students who had appeared out of nowhere. Did they get in using that crashed flying Mechcraft? I need to report this to the boss immediately. Luckily, there aren't many of them, and some seem to be weak bookworms. We can't let them snatch the treasure we've found.

Day 7 Underground

Today, the boss took advantage of their carelessness and led us to seize plenty of supplies. You reap what you sow, bookworms! This is how cruel the world is!

Day 10 Underground

It's been ten days since we entered the underground, and we still haven't found any way to access the central pillar. Could it be that the information that mysterious person gave the boss was false? After all, the boss said he was only seventy percent sure. Sigh, my guess is the boss got conned and is taking it out on us. Alas, when will this anxious life ever end?
zh_text:
进入地下的第一天 
在地下水道飘了几天，中间好几次木筏差点撞碎在礁石上，还和阿平阿安他们失散了……还好今天终于到地方了。但我们刚从水里出来就被一群机关人追着打。哎呀，这帮家伙下手真是狠，幸亏我跑得快，不然我就得像隔壁那几个兄弟一样全身挂彩了。 
 
进入地下的第五天 
我们正在营地休整，突然这里开始剧烈震动，太吓人了。晚上出去巡逻的时候，发现不知道什么时候多了一帮稷下学院的家伙，是用那个坠毁的飞行机关进来的吗，得赶紧汇报给老大。还好他们的人数不多，似乎有几个还是手无缚鸡之力的弱书生。不能眼睁睁让他们把到手的宝藏抢走。 
 
进入地下的第七天 
今天老大趁他们不注意，带领我们抢走了好多物资。自求多福吧！书呆子们，这个世界就是如此残酷！ 
 
进入地下的第十天 
已经是进入地下的第十天了，完全找不到任何进入主柱的眉目。难道说那个神秘人给老大的情报是假的？毕竟老大说也只有七成把握。唉，我猜啊，就是老大被骗了然后折磨我们。唉，这提心吊胆的日子什么时候是个头啊。
source_text:
进入地下的第一天 
在地下水道飘了几天，中间好几次木筏差点撞碎在礁石上，还和阿平阿安他们失散了……还好今天终于到地方了。但我们刚从水里出来就被一群机关人追着打。哎呀，这帮家伙下手真是狠，幸亏我跑得快，不然我就得像隔壁那几个兄弟一样全身挂彩了。 
 
进入地下的第五天 
我们正在营地休整，突然这里开始剧烈震动，太吓人了。晚上出去巡逻的时候，发现不知道什么时候多了一帮稷下学院的家伙，是用那个坠毁的飞行机关进来的吗，得赶紧汇报给老大。还好他们的人数不多，似乎有几个还是手无缚鸡之力的弱书生。不能眼睁睁让他们把到手的宝藏抢走。 
 
进入地下的第七天 
今天老大趁他们不注意，带领我们抢走了好多物资。自求多福吧！书呆子们，这个世界就是如此残酷！ 
 
进入地下的第十天 
已经是进入地下的第十天了，完全找不到任何进入主柱的眉目。难道说那个神秘人给老大的情报是假的？毕竟老大说也只有七成把握。唉，我猜啊，就是老大被骗了然后折磨我们。唉，这提心吊胆的日子什么时候是个头啊。
official_target_text:
Day 1 Underground

After drifting in the underground waterways for several days, my raft almost crashed into the reefs, and I got separated from Ah Ping and Ah An... Fortunately, we finally reached our destination today. However, as soon as we got out of the water, we were chased by a group of Mechanoids. Oh no, these guys are really rough; luckily, I ran fast, or I'd be like those guys next door, all battered up.

Day 5 Underground

We were resting at the camp when suddenly the ground started shaking violently. It was terrifying. When we went out on patrol at night, we discovered a group of Jixia Academy students who had appeared out of nowhere. Did they get in using that crashed flying Mechcraft? I need to report this to the boss immediately. Luckily, there aren't many of them, and some seem to be weak bookworms. We can't let them snatch the treasure we've found.

Day 7 Underground

Today, the boss took advantage of their carelessness and led us to seize plenty of supplies. You reap what you sow, bookworms! This is how cruel the world is!

Day 10 Underground

It's been ten days since we entered the underground, and we still haven't found any way to access the central pillar. Could it be that the information that mysterious person gave the boss was false? After all, the boss said he was only seventy percent sure. Sigh, my guess is the boss got conned and is taking it out on us. Alas, when will this anxious life ever end?

text: 《The Blood Sacrifice Case: Moon Family Investigation Report》

《The Blood Sacrifice Case: Moon Family Investigation Report》
...
The Moon Family, one of the ruling families of Sea City, is known for their magic and swordsmanship, with a family crest shaped like a crescent moon.
Upon investigation, members of the family have suddenly exhibited strange symptoms for generations, followed by madness and the commission of bloody tragedies.
It is speculated that some kind of curse flows in their family bloodline, and the "strange symptoms" are actually the eruption of a curse seal.
...
Several years ago, the "curse" was fulfilled again. A man in the family slaughtered his kin, then fled Sea City, his whereabouts unknown.
...

Solving it must have taken considerable time. \nI must remind you of another puzzle nearby—located north of here, hidden beneath a sheer cliff wall hundreds of feet high. \nBeside it, a waterfall cascades into the depths, making a breathtaking view. May this sight stir your spirit and fill you with valor!
When foreign enemies invade, the access between the Pillar of Elevation and the Hall of Sanctification must be severed. The pillar turns yellow, sealing the passage.

Congratulations on finding one of the puzzles! You are one step closer to beating me. \nHere's a hint for another puzzle nearby: it is hidden within a mountain along the road to the east. Look for a winding path that leads into shadows. \nClimb up and enjoy the view. It might help you relax.

The Greenwhisper Treasure helped me get in. 
It is said that one needs to unite seven keys and head north into the deep cave to solve the Mechcraft riddle. 
 
It sounds like a puzzle. I'll pass. 
 
Could it be a trial set up by Master Mozi? Bring it on. 
 
A treasure that requires three keys to unlock? Must be something good.

Seal the gates! Hold the hall! The invaders cannot enter without Volcanic Gravel!
Fish are fond of the fragrance of lotus.

North represents Fire, West represents Metal, East represents Water, Southwest represents Wood, and Southeast represents Earth. \nFire begets Earth, Earth begets Metal, Metal begets Water, Water begets Wood, Wood begets Fire. \nFollow the generative cycle, and what you seek shall be revealed.

When Zhuangzi first arrived in Jixia, he showed great talent, but lacked control over the Dreamscape. \nZiya, seeing his potential, created the Dream Totem in the northern forest of Jixia to stabilize the Dreamscape, allowing Zhuangzi to train and master it.
The barrier can be controlled from the outside.
I've reached my limit. My fear of heights still lingers. \n \nThere must be even greater treasures at the top. I'll hone my skills and challenge again!

My wounds won't stop bleeding, and I'm losing my strength. I fear it's too late for me to be saved... \n \nI hid the treasure <69D0FF>in the middle of the ring-shaped lake south of Sunken Stele Pond</>. Let those who come after seek them, should fortune guide their steps.

text: Records show, "Every thirty miles, a beacon tower is built on a high mountain peak. If there are hills that block the view, additional towers are built to ensure each tower has a clear view of the next. Along the borders, walls are built around the perimeter of the beacon towers." This appears to be an ancient beacon tower used to monitor the coastline. It was believed that once a beacon was lit, all others would soon follow, signaling the approach of enemies. Now, only one ruined beacon tower remains. Nothing lasts forever, indeed...
It seems damaged due to a collapse at the base.
From here onward lies the great hall of our people. Guard well the Volcanic Stone Key.
The test subject “NO. 4GL” was observed devouring the Swiftbolt Red Falcon, after which the surrounding mist took on the shape of wings. NO. 4GL appears to possess shapeshifting abilities.

June 8 
Children playing on the lake islet discovered unusual undercurrents at the lakebed. 
 
June 9 
Seeker Qing Peng conducted a preliminary dive and reported findings to Jixia Academy. 
 
June 12 
Qing Peng and mages from the School of Sorcery formed an archaeology team and began setting up excavation facilities. 
 
June 14 
Water-repelling wards completed; the lakebed ruins made accessible. 
 
June 15 
The archaeology team entered the ruins for investigation. 
 
June 17 
Survey confirmed the site as a refuge ruin—the northernmost such encampment discovered to date. 
 
June 20 
Artifacts of the Sanctified transported to Jixia Academy for safekeeping. With their mission complete, the team will soon return.
The Dreamy Cave is a miraculous creation. It has completely transcended the laws of nature. Is this the power of dreams? \nBut what are these strange thorns all about. They are not perfect enough.

The two armies face off. The seal is undone.

Well done, Yu. This should be easy for you. 
It's been a while since we had a real match. Our last fight was so intense that we almost destroyed the Darkpool Camp. 
I hope we can find an open space for a good fight in the future. 
Don't forget to check out the <69D0FF>nearby Aerweavers</>!

Breakthroughs in the Academy’s Mechanoid research now allow them to switch weapons and forms at will, greatly enhancing their combat power. As their strength has exceeded safe limits, they have been confined to the Forbidden Chamber for continued testing under controlled conditions.
The Stone Extraction Hall is a crucial mine for Volcanic Stone. It must be protected!

Congratulations on finding one of the puzzles! You're one step closer to beating me. 
I must confess, I tampered with Mr. Yu Huan's special dish that made your stomach upset for so long. 
I had meant well, trying to keep the fish fresh with ice fruit. Who would have thought it could cause diarrhea? 
Search <69D0FF>the loom to the south</> more carefully!
Mysterious Stone Tablet: Southwest of the Mausoleum

I'm impressed, Yu, you've discovered the seventh Aerflow Tower, truly remarkable. That was a good point for you, narrowing the score to ninety-six to ninety-four. Well done. \n \nI've heard about your recent investigations regarding the Academy's history and future. The clues I have might interest you, but I can't just hand them over that easily. I've placed them in a secret chamber in the Wondrous Maze. To access the chamber, you'll need three keys, located in the underground here, at the northern part of the Stargazing Terrace, and in the northern part of the Wondrous Maze, all hidden in my secret bases. I'm not trying to play games with you, but achieving your goals will require some effort.

Well done, Zhou Yu. I spent a lot of time and effort preparing so many Mechanoids. \nI remember the two of us getting surrounded by a mob of Saepes when we arrived at Jixia. We took a beating, but we managed to fend them off in the end. \nTo be honest with you, I was a little scared at that time, but you were fearless, and I was very impressed. Remember to check the <69D0FF>nearby Aerweavers</>!

With the Enlightenment Trials approaching, the daily mining quota of Volcanic Stone will be increased by 50% effective immediately to ensure smooth infusion for the victors. \nDuring this period of accelerated extraction, strict attention must be paid to maintaining safety and stability in the Volcanic Stone quarries, and to the timely clearing of Volcanic Stone dust.

This place appears to be the meeting hall of the Sanctified artisans, where they discuss mining plans daily. \nHowever, traces suggest it was also used for the Enlightenment Trials, as a venue for the organizers to discuss competition matters.

In those days, when I first tested the Eight Sentinels, I was full of ambition, eager for a chance to prove myself. Yet now, with war raging without end, I realize it was the peaceful years of the past that were truly worth cherishing. \n \nI have hidden my treasures within the <69D0FF>Eight Sentinels, in the northern reaches of Tranquil Hill</>. Let those who come after seek them, should fortune guide their steps.
The emergency escape tunnel at the roof of the hallway is closed. Should there be an emergency, it can be unsealed using this switch.

The Life Particle teleport function has been successfully integrated with Mechcrafts. This technology is now applied to the Academy Patrol Drones, serving to protect the Academy’s confidential facilities and to prevent students from entering dangerous areas.
Stone Extractor Maintenance Regulations \n \nKeep away from the flywheel when the Stone Extractor is activated!

Well done, Zhou Yu, on finding one of the puzzles. This should be no challenge for you. \nHere's a hint about another nearby puzzle: it's in the southwest, amid the boulders of a rift. \nTwo rock walls form an arch like a doorway, awaiting your visit.
Mysterious Stone Tablet: Outside Old Citadel
At night, strange sounds come from the white flower beds on the nearby cliff, as if something is coming out of the ground.

(The note is water-soaked, and the writing is blurred. Only a few words are barely legible.) \n \nSearch... for several days... I found... Key... main pillar... below... From the northwest... down... down... should be the destination...
Someone at the camp was bragging about digging for treasure near the Stargazing Terrace. You guys hear? We’ll tail them from a distance—once they’ve got the goods, we’ll hit them with a surprise.

Well done, Yu. These Mechanoids are not ordinary creations. I carefully crafted them, tailoring them to your abilities. \n \nBe sure to <69D0FF>head north</> to find the rest of the Aerflow Towers to avoid missing any.
To the west, clouds gather and fortune unfolds. Amidst Embermane's lair, the sacred text takes shape.

I am a member of the Puppet Society, soon to wander the world, leaving my dwelling behind in vain. Last night I gazed upon the stars and divined this formation. Whoever among future generations can break this array shall rightfully claim my star chart. Thus do I announce to the teachers and students of Jixia!
The lair of the Volcanic Stone, hidden yet the source of all things' motion. \nOnly through its eternal vigil by posterity shall a millennium of peace unfurl.

As one of the Sanctified, it is my duty to fight and protect Jixia. 
Yet with a sick wife and a young daughter, I fear leaving them behind with no one to care for them. 
Torn between duty and family, I painfully choose to abandon my post and flee north with my loved ones, away from the battlefield. 
May peace come soon...
I have been examining this site for three days and my supplies are running low. I need to make my way to the central pillar and rendezvous with the others via the path at the top while I still can.
A colorful commemorative album, filled with various stickers, including a golden ferule, a plump Bubble Fish, and an imposing Mechanoid.
Sit in the spring brook, look south to the Aerfall. \nThe glory will return on the day you come back.
The key guardians are here! Leave, intruders!

Well done, Yu. Your keen eyes and agility are impressive. 
 
At the Academy, we often discussed the practical use of Sorcery Techniques in discerning hidden patterns. Such arts are adept at veiling truth in the unseen; what the eye perceives will always have its limits, but the sincere of heart may yet behold it. 
 
Do pay close attention to the <69D0FF>southern Aerflow Tower</>.

The Academy has decided to reactivate several Path of Heroes trials located in the Jixia Mountains. These trials won't affect your academic performance, but you can attempt them daily to track your progress in your studies. 
The Academy has repaired some trial devices, adjusted the difficulty levels, and reset the rewards. Everyone is welcome to take on these challenges. 
However, please be cautious as some of the ruins and caves have not been fully explored, and their dangers are unknown. 
Proceed with caution and avoid pushing beyond your limits! This applies especially to students from the School of Martial Arts. 
 
The Seeker Society has released a strict statement—all stone tablets in the mountains are under their protection. Violators will face corresponding consequences.

Blend in as a Jixia student in the northern mountains and keep a low profile. Gather intel on why the Academy is building Aerweavers there, especially focus on the two large ones on the west side. And again—keep a low profile.

With the Enlightenment Trials approaching, this hall is hereby requisitioned for use by the Trial Preparatory Committee. \nAll matters regarding excavation should be directed to the Stone Extraction Hall for further discussion.

Product: Common Clay Jar 
Place of Production: Aerux Town 
Quantity: 10 
Unit Price: One bundle of Aersilk

November 29 
Met with Shen Song at Shaoyang’s Elixir Hall. We talked about the Enlightenment Trials arena, nearly finished in its construction, and everyone was brimming with excitement... 
 
December 3 
Today Shen Song and Shaoyang came to visit me at White Plum. Full of enthusiasm, they decided to enter next year’s very first Enlightenment Trials. Our preliminary team was formed! 
 
December 10 
While training at the arena today, I met two outstanding students. After a good talk, I was able to invite them to join us. The Chyron Warriors are now assembled!
The Enlightenment Trials consist of three parts: Bubble Fish Riot, Pearlized, and Dreams within Dreams.
A colorful commemorative album, filled with various stickers, including a golden ferule, a plump Bubble Fish, and an imposing Mechanoid.
Radiance from the heavens sets the lake agleam, while the emerald path hides a cavern in its depths.

Bet you're surprised I cracked this Mechcraft door with ease. No need to complete your long list of trials now. 
Thanks for the kind gesture, but I've already found the place. 
What? You think I'd let you make up for those ten wins? 
Never mind. Since we're about to graduate, no hard feelings. 
My brother wrote to say he's expecting me back in the Three Kingdoms. What are your plans?
The sandbox simulation emphasizes the coordination of Mechcrafts and the unity of the real and the illusory, to cultivate the wisdom of our people.

Hosted by the School of Martial Arts, with the School of Mechcraft and Aerux Town as co-sponsors, the “Autumn Streams Vertical Rush Challenge” competition begins today! \nAll skilled challengers are welcome to register! \nNewcomers with an interest in Vertical Rush are also encouraged to join. The School of Martial Arts’ climbing champion will be giving an introductory class for first-time participants.
Circle of life. Prosperity and wealth. \n \nThe three lights join as one. The pillar stands eternal.
To pray for clear waters, the Lake Guards sink treasures to the lake's bottom annually, showing their sincerity.

Where the Aerux <69D0FF>entwines</>, streams cascade down the stone walls. \nWhere the Aerux <69D0FF>spirals upward</>, life flourishes, nourished by the springs. \nSeek the <69D0FF>end of these twin streams</>—there lies the <69D0FF>token of the forest</>, and the gate shall open.

After days of fierce battle, we finally struck down the enemy’s giant. Here we raised its arm in remembrance of our victory, as the horn of counterattack sounded that very day. \n \nI have hidden a treasure at the <69D0FF>wrist of the Giant Hand Ruins</>. Let those who come after seek them, should fortune guide their steps.
Mysterious Stone Tablet: North of Mirror Lake
Well done, Zhou Yu. I knew these monsters couldn't stop you. \nThere are more puzzles waiting for you at the <69D0FF>Aerweavers to the east</>.

To the Rebel continuing the quest: \nI suspect I've been exposed, the Forbidden Chamber has noticed me. There are <69D0FF>two Aerweavers nearby</>, and many students have come to challenge the trials beneath them, but they show little interest in the Aerweavers themselves. Once the dust settles, I will slip away to seek help. If you continue the quest, remember to conceal your identity as a Rebel. Good luck.

Important supplies are stored at the elevator, secured by an anti-theft Mechcraft. \n"From north to west, then east to south—trace the path of lightning." Follow this sequence to disable the alarm. \nBe warned: a single mistake in the order will immediately trigger the Mechcraft.
Take the river downstream. The key is in the ruins to the east of Old Citadel.
Tomorrow, my people and I will head off to war. I've left some useful items here. If I don't make it back from the battlefield, whoever discovers them is welcome to keep them.
Jixia Academy encourages exploration and has set up many such challenges for you. \nThere is another opener on the other side of the mountain gate. Keep it up!

Confidential reports from Ripple Harbor have noted unusual Rebel activities. To prevent any incidents in the mountains, you are ordered to monitor the Rebels by patrolling the area east of the Forbidden Chamber. During your patrols, pay close attention to the <69D0FF>Northeastern peaks</>, as well as the safety of the essential Academy facilities, the <69D0FF>Aero Plateaus</>, located in the <69D0FF>east and west</>.
Jixia Academy encourages exploration and has set up many such challenges for you. \nThere is another opener on the other side of the mountain gate. Keep it up!
In those dark hours when invaders stormed Jixia, by the Sanctifier's order we sealed the Key to the Eternity Cauldron here. May our descendants return to reignite the power of Divine Imprint
Strange Stones Ignite the Peaks, shining like the radiant blaze. \nBestowing us unlimited power, to break through any obstacles. \n
From here onward lies the great hall of our people. Guard well the Volcanic Stone Key.

An old lamp with a long-extinguished light. Inscribed below it are ancient words: "When the light rises, it shall be the return of the Dragonrider. At that time, humans and dragons will join forces to vanquish all enemies. The bond between the two races will endure forever, as will this oath."
To the south, fierce beasts often feed by the lake. Please stay away from the water.

Yu, I've prepared the themes for this challenge. 
There are <69D0FF>six puzzles</>, each located near the most conspicuous <69D0FF>Aerweavers</> in the Jixia Mountains. 
Complete all six puzzles and collect the <69D0FF>key fragments</> to <69D0FF>unlock the Mechcraft door</> and claim the your reward—a clue to that place you've long yearned to explore. 
Don’t you want to win back everything in one game? 
Best of luck 
 
P.S. The score is now 95 to 87, and I'm close to reaching my 100th victory. 
Time's slipping away for your comeback.

<69D0FF>Cape of Millisails</> 
<69D0FF>Every night at Cape of Millisails</>, a strange Saepes-like shadow would appear by the sea. 
I cautiously approached for a closer look and realized that this Saepes shadow held no hostility. It just wandered through the ruins of Cape of Millisails, pausing now and then, as if it were thinking, or <69D0FF>searching something...</> 
Could it be that what this shadow is searching for is related to the <69D0FF>Giant Saepes of Saepes Retreat</>? 
 
Labyrinth Cave 
Wherever Saepes are found, the vegetation is lush, and even dead trees sprout new shoots. I wonder if Saepes simply prefer environments with dense vegetation, or if the presence of Saepes actually nourishes the vegetation. 
Additionally, I have observed that most Saepes tend to congregate around Aerux. Could there be some kind of connection between <69D0FF>Saepes and Aerux</>? 
 
Note: I've lost countless observation journals already. When will I stop being so careless? This brand new one cannot get lost too, remember!

Small, unidentified rare beasts have been sighted to the <69D0FF>north</> of this location. Visitors must observe the following rules:
First, it is reported that the beasts are not aggressive, so please refrain from showing hostility.
Second, the beasts often appear on sunny mornings; please move quietly to avoid startling them.
Third, it is normal for the beasts to chase after small animals like violet rabbits; please do not interfere.

此地<69D0FF>北方</>有小型珍兽出没，目前正体未明，请来者遵守以下规定： 
其一，据悉珍兽没有攻击性，请收敛敌意。 
其二，珍兽常出没于晴天上午，请来者小声前行，避免惊扰珍兽。 
其三，珍兽与堇兔等小动物互相追逐属正常现象，请勿干扰。

text:
Linchong Siege Tower: A mobile and retractable siege Mechcraft designed to launch projectiles at enemies. It took three months to complete the design. 
Though it earned unanimous praise from the School of Mechcraft and secured my graduation. 
Master Mozi enlightened me: Conquering cities and seizing lands is an act of injustice, bringing only calamity to the people. 
This profound realization led me to abandon the siege tower. From now on, I vow to dedicate the knowledge gained from Jixia to Mechcraft Arts that bring joy and convenience to humanity.

Congratulations, Zhou Yu, on solving one of the puzzles! I never expected your skills to be so impressive. \nThough we both favor the elegance of the Sorcery, skill training like agility exercises must not be neglected. When encountering powerful enemies in the future, it’s wise to have a backup plan to flee when necessary. \nHead north, and you’ll find no more puzzles. Try exploring the <69D0FF>Aerweaver in the south</> for more clues.

I overheard some Seeker Society members talking about treasure hunting at the Stargazing Terrace. Apparently, there's treasure hidden along the cliff and in the lake! Let's discuss the details in person at the north cliff of the Stargazing Terrace.
Legend has it that the greatest swordsman of the Second Era retired to the rear peak of these ruins. Only the most agile are worthy of the challenge.

Cape of Millisails 
<69D0FF>Every night at Cape of Millisails</>, a strange Saepes-like shadow would appear by the sea. 
I cautiously approached for a closer look and realized that this Saepes shadow held no hostility. It just wandered through the <69D0FF>ruins of Cape of Millisails</>, pausing now and then, as if it were thinking, or <69D0FF>searching something...</> 
Could it be that what this shadow is searching for is related to the <69D0FF>Giant Saepes of Saepes Retreat</>? 
 
Labyrinth Cave 
Wherever Saepes are found, the vegetation is lush, and even dead trees sprout new shoots. I wonder if Saepes simply prefer environments with dense vegetation, or if the presence of Saepes actually nourishes the vegetation. 
Additionally, I have observed that most Saepes tend to congregate around Aerux. Could there be some kind of connection between <69D0FF>Saepes and Aerux</>? 
 
Note: I've lost countless observation journals already. When will I stop being so careless? This brand new one cannot get lost too, remember!

1. Do not bring flammable materials on board the Aership. 
2. Do not throw objects from high altitudes during the journey. 
3. Martial Arts students are not allowed to climb or hang from ropes during the journey. 
4. Sorcery students are prohibited from casting spells during the journey. 
5. Mechcraft students must keep their Mechcraft silent throughout the journey. 
6. Passengers bringing Croakies on board must keep them under supervision at all times.

The armory is of utmost importance and must not fall. By order, I have hidden supplies across this area, to be drawn upon in wartime and to ease urgent need. \n \nI have concealed my treasures at the <69D0FF>northeastern Ferry Stone of Cloudfall Cliff, on the small hill south of Bastion Fort</>. Let those who come after seek them, should fortune guide their steps.
I have been examining this site for three days and my supplies are running low. I need to make my way to the central pillar and rendezvous with the others via the path at the top while I still can.
Legend has it that making a wish at the center of the purple flower garland will bring an unexpected surprise.
Pillars piercing heavens, bearing firm the dome; \nGuard our sword-bound kin in their eternal home.
Mechcraft notes. Subjects range from the history of Jixia Mechcraft to Dawnsong's Mechcraft exams. Filled with complex drawings and jargon.
Scattered tools and adornments indicate Volcanic Stone miners lived here. Judging by the decor and remaining records, the miners held their work in great reverence.
The Observatory is temporarily closed to the public for renovations.
The secret vault holds three precious Dream Stones. Placing them on the Dream Pedestal will activate the Dreamcatcher and release tremendous energy.

Seniors told me that Saepes have thrived for generations within the cave under the Great Aerux. This place seems to be their stronghold, where the nourishment of Aerux accelerates the growth of Saepes. They can't be wiped out once they manage to take root, unless we can dislodge their seeds.

The enemy is approaching, but our soldiers remain steadfast. It's too early to call this our final stand. After all, beyond the Crosswind Bridge, there is still a glimmer of hope of survival in the east of Aerfall. \nI hid the treasure at the <69D0FF>southern end of the Crosswind Bridge</>. Those with fate on their side may find it.
NO. 4GL got out of control after devouring multiple wild animals. Research has been suspended on an emergency basis, and Mechanoids are dispatched to monitor NO. 4GL.

Practice makes perfect. 
Accurate, consistent, and calm in archery. 
Temper your heart, intelligence, and morality. 
Cultivate a strong mind with unwavering focus.

Today's defeat lies not in our valor, but in the cruel turn of fate's wheel. As a commander, I refuse to cling to life while my broken body may yet buy moments against the enemy tide. \n \nMy treasure rests <69D0FF>beneath the southern falls of Frostcloud Town</>, awaiting those destined to claim it.
The last row is great, as I won't be asked to answer any questions.

Damn it! Just one key away from unlocking the treasure vault! 
 
I know it lies in the secret chamber beneath the library, yet it is heavily guarded, impossible to breakthrough... 
 
This is so frustrating!

South of the Littoral Cave, a hidden path leads into the depths. 
This path takes you to a place where no shadows fall. 
The stuff of Sanctifier was forged by the Sentinel. 
Amidst layers of secrets, the treasure lies concealed.

Small, unidentified rare beasts have been sighted to the <69D0FF>north</> of this location. Visitors must observe the following rules:
First, it is reported that the beasts are not aggressive, so please refrain from showing hostility.
Second, the beasts often appear on sunny mornings; please move quietly to avoid startling them.
Third, it is normal for the beasts to chase after small animals like violet rabbits; please do not interfere.

text:
The excavation of this site has been completed recently. 
The Seeker Society has escorted the relevant artifacts back to Jixia Mountains with the Sorcery students. 
The archaeological facilities at the bottom of the well and the water-proofing Sorcery are no longer maintained. 
Please do not explore the well based on your confidence in your swimming skills.

The war is raging on. I have been ordered to guard the path to Seclusion City from here. I must be as resolute as iron and handle things with care. Only then I can fulfill my duty and fend off the enemies. \n \nI hid the treasures <69D0FF>in the military camp north of Dusklight Pavilion</>. Those with fate on their side may discover them.
An unidentified creature has been captured, exhibiting a pale blue fluorescent mist as its physical form. Its capabilities remain unknown. Temporarily named NO. 4GL

Remember our first meeting by the lake? 
You arrived out of breath from the north, claiming to have seen a rare Energy Crystal in a cave. You said a Spike Bear King and a large Saepes were fiercely fighting over it. 
I couldn't help but laugh at such an absurd story! 
You promised to take me to that cave after your return from Chang'an. I'm holding you to that!
Might need to reinforce the cage, or get a bigger one. \nKeep a close eye on these Wolvines!
A torn booklet titled "Idol Memorial" reveals extensive records about Shye's movements—specific restaurant she frequented, locations visited, and other personal itineraries.
Enemy incoming! Those without special order should evacuate at once! \n \nP.S. Take care, my friend. If we cross paths again, keep today in mind.

My friends! Your long-awaited Traveler Series: Jixia Mountains North has just updated!  
This update proved to be quite the undertaking, as the vast expanse of the mountains presented unforeseen perils.  
  
We're excited to share our top hiking trail recommendations:  
The top recommendation is the Aership route. A literal godsend to those who are not fans of true hiking, the Aership route offers scenic views and brings you straight to the Academy at the peak quietly.  
We next recommend the Dashing Wings, especially for you thrill-seekers. Master Mozi and the School of Mechcraft have crafted an exhilarating experience, launching you skyward with efficiency and reliability.  
The last is the hiker's trail. Hikers can follow the Path of Heroes to personally retrace the steps of previous Academy students who endured this rite of passage.  
  
A word of caution:  
The Mountains are dotted with ruins and caves, often inhabited by fearsome monsters. Heed the Academy's signs and warnings, and new students, please refrain from venturing inside!  
Look forward to my next guide in the Traveler Series.

To the traveler: 
All that you seek lies ahead. 
Look around, and the treasure will reveal itself when you have broken through the illusions. 
With courage, open the casket to reveal the realm behind the door.
The Path of Trials will be fraught with difficulties. Beware of the beasts along the way, and remember to protect the Academy's facilities.
NO. 4GL is fully matured into avian organism, indistinguishable from a true Swiftbolt Red Falcon. Next objective: Determine if NO. 4GL can consume multiple species and adapt to various forms.

Current research indicates a single Mechcraft powers the entire Workers' Dorms. My analysis places it at the pinnacle of this structure \n \nStrangely, there should be three such Mechcrafts. But where are the other two? I need to investigate this Stone Extraction Hall place.

Aercocoon is the Wonder of Jixia, perched atop the Tower of Enlightenment. 
It is enveloped in a cocoon made of Aersilk, hence its name. No one knows what truly inside. 
Aerflow is a gaseous substance that flows from Aercocoon. Since Aerflow solidifies rapidly into Aersilk, only the Jixia Academy has the knowledge to to utilize it directly.. 
Aersilk, solidified from Aerflow, is a versatile material widely used by the inhabitants and scholars of Jixia. 
Without human intervention, the accumulated Aersilk forms Aerux, which is strong and challenging to harvest. Only a few experts master the skills to shape and guide Aerux.

The Forbidden Chamber is responsible for the management and containment of forbidden artifacts, including Mechcraft constructs creation, enchanted items, and corrupted beings. Further research on these subjects is conducted within the chamber.
The broken wall teems with greenery in its cracks. It still remains unyielding amidst the ruins.

A scroll that remains curiously dry even submerge in water. \nIt bears the words: "Water-deflecting sorcery scroll. Use immediately once unsealed." \nThere is a line of tiny script below: "Water cannot pass through, but people can. Once you reach the dry area, make sure to replenish your water."
Stone Extractor Maintenance Regulations \n \nKeep away from the flywheel when the Stone Extractor is activated!

text:
Brother Yu, I have set the challenges for this time.
There are a total of <69D0FF> six puzzles </>, all located near the most prominent <69D0FF> looms </> in the Jixia mountains.
Complete these six puzzles to collect the <69D0FF> key fragments </>, which are required to <69D0FF> open the mechanism door </> and claim the rewards.
Inside, you will find clues to the place you have always been so curious about.
Do you want to win back everything you lost to me before?
I look forward to seeing your performance.

A reminder: the current record is ninety-five to eighty-seven, and I am about to reach one hundred victories.
If you don't hurry, you won't have a chance to turn the tables.
zh_text:
瑜兄，这次的题目我设好了。
<69D0FF>一共有六处谜题</>，都设置在稷下山区最显眼的<69D0FF>织机附近</>。
完成这六处谜题凑齐<69D0FF>钥匙碎片</>，才能<69D0FF>开启机关门</>拿到奖励。
里面可是有你一直都很好奇想去的地方的线索哦。
想不想把之前输给我的一次性赢回来？
期待你的发挥。

提醒一下：现在记录是九十五对八十七，我即将达成百胜战绩。
再不抓紧你可就没有翻盘的机会了。

Dear old friends, 
 
If you're reading this letter, it means you've already succeeded. I'm sorry for leaving you with this final surprise. 
 
We've fought side by side, supported each other, and even argued fiercely in competitions. We are classmates, friends, and like family. The academy is our shared home, something we built and protected together. But over time, we each became focused on our own fields. The four schools started to compare and compete, sometimes even attacking each other. We all chased after greater power, but that power has started to break us apart. 
 
Our fading abilities and our old pride are pulling us in different directions. Not wanting you to see us at our lowest, we chose to leave quietly to keep our dignity. But before we go, please let us do one last thing for the academy. 
 
The challenge we left behind can only be solved if the three schools work together. We hope that, through this, the pride and ambition that once separated us will now bring you back together. 
 
Since the Sanctifier left, everyone has tried hard to keep things going, but we still feel lost. We are no longer the heroes we once were, and we can't reach the heights we dreamed of. But you still have a chance. If you combine your wisdom and strength, we believe you can achieve something truly great. 
 
We don't know if we'll ever meet again. Even if we don't, we trust you will carry on our shared hopes and dreams. We wish you all the best, wherever life takes you.
zh_text:
老朋友们： 
如果你们看到这封信，相信你们已经成功了，抱歉以这样的方式给你们开了最后的玩笑。 
我们曾并肩战斗，互相陪伴，也曾为比赛针锋相对，争得面红耳赤。我们是同学、朋友、也是家人。学院是我们共同守护和建造的家园，但不知从什么时候起，我们越来越专注在自己的领域内，四学院之间互相比较，互相攻击，我们追求极致的力量，但这力量却在让整个学院分崩离析。 
日渐衰微的能力和曾经的骄傲像两股相反的力，正将我们撕碎。不愿朋友窥见狼狈，我们决定用自我放逐的方式保留最后的尊严，但离开前，请允许我们为学院做最后一件事。 
 
留下的挑战需要聚合三院之力方可打开，希望在这过程里，曾拉着我们远离彼此的骄傲和追求，再将你们重新聚在一起。 
太公离去，大家虽奋力维系，仍似浮萍飘零。我们是失去了荣光的无名者，不再有力量企及那个我们曾并肩追求的高度，但你们仍然有机会，将你们的智慧与力量融合在一起，我们相信，那将是最靠近极致的力量。 
不知此生还能否再见，即使不能，也相信你们会带着我们共同的愿望一直走下去，祝福你们，无论多久，无论多远。

《Canglang Secret Scroll: Part II》 
When the Zhaoge conflict began, the Master and the Grand Duke co-governed the Jixia Academy, launching the Canglang ship as a sanctuary. The Grand Duke forged the "Divine Work Mechanism" on the ship, while the Master spread the philosophy of "Education for All." 
As the fires of war grew, the Grand Duke became convinced that the "Divine Forging" method was the only way to save the world. Using the power of burning mountains, he selected warriors among the survivors to activate the Divine Seal. Though the survivors gained divine power, they were no longer human in form. 
The Master advised against it, but the Grand Duke replied: "Without passing through the ordeal of death, how can one speak of rebirth?" 
The war dragged on, the Divine Forging trials intensified, and many perished. 
The Master could not bear to watch and tried to persuade him repeatedly, but to no avail. Finally, he sank the ship to the bottom of the Canglang. 
Afterward, the Grand Duke traveled the Nine Provinces alone, pursuing his unfinished destiny; the Master returned to Jixia to teach the masses. 
Later generations sighed: One was obsessed with life and death, the other transcended existence itself, yet both paths led to the same end.

That student, Xiao Si, whom I met yesterday, is truly interesting.

Although I was a bit rattled when I first saw him... but honestly, anyone would scream if they saw a figure seemingly emerging from the Cloud Roots in such thick fog! He started spouting nonsense about being symbiotic with the Cloud Roots, the flow not yet dissipating, and needing to return something. Thankfully, he later admitted he was joking, or I would have been scared out of my wits.

Once we started talking properly, I realized he is very knowledgeable about history. He spoke about the Thousand Chariots so vividly, as if he had seen it with his own eyes. If there's a chance, I'd really like to chat with him more.

With the material he provided, my new lyrics should be finished soon. Perhaps I should invite some students to listen tomorrow!

There's a burnt smell in the dark, and the shadows on the ground have come to life. They were originally marks left by fire, but suddenly they grew arms and legs. They are covered in the armor pieces of the Zhaoge soldiers... They are walking toward me, getting closer and closer!
Suddenly, a hand grabs my throat. I want to scream, but my throat feels stuck, and I can't breathe.
The helmet of the shadow in front is shattered. How is it... his empty eye sockets are staring at me. They all swarm up. No, they aren't Zhaoge soldiers; they are my colleagues! Some have half their faces missing, some have broken arms, yet they still reach out to grab me. They don't open their mouths, but I can hear them: "It's your fault! How could you survive alone!"
...
I wake up with a start... Why won't even my memories let me go?
No, they are right. I just haven't tried hard enough. I must prove myself.

There are plenty of clocks in Jixia—just like those stubborn people—that need fixing, but I'm done! 
 
Owner Shi Yu has let all of us apprentices go. We regret to inform you that Yongsheng Clock Shop will be closed indefinitely starting today. 
 
We are truly grateful for your support over the years. We hope you will continue to treasure every moment, just as you cherished each unique clock we made for you. 
 
Thank you for your understanding.

text:
To my niece Zetian, peace be with you: 
 
I have received the message from Envoy Wan'er and have already dispatched Dean Mozi to Chang'an to prioritize the repair of the city's damaged mechanisms. As for Jiang Ziya's escape, while his tracks have indeed appeared in Jixia, we do not require any aid from Chang'an. 
 
Standing against your own master is no easy task. As the Empress of Chang'an, you bear responsibilities far greater than before. I understand your concerns, but please rest assured—these old bones of mine are still capable of protecting Jixia. I also believe Jiang Ziya has come only for me and harbors no other ill intent. As the saying goes, the one who tied the bell must be the one to untie it. Our disagreement began in Jixia, and it should end in Jixia... After all these years, it is time to catch up. 
 
Old Master. 
 
Note: 
Master, this letter has been translated into a secret report by the Mechanism Academy and sent to Chang'an as you instructed. I am returning the original file to you for safekeeping—Xingmang.

Upset! A massive upset! Yesterday's Firearms Competition absolutely 'blew' everyone away! The highly anticipated favorites all fell, and the champion was none other than the 'King of Destruction' who strikes fear into the entire academy—Xingmang!
Who would believe it? The same Xingmang who once caused an explosion in the classroom, nearly blew the school roof off, and has been threatened with expulsion five times!
Somehow, after entering Jixia, he went around challenging everyone, bombing the challenge automaton '666' at the Linghu Pavilion, leaving deep craters in the Red Falcon Pavilion's grounds, and smashing the herb garden at the Suhui Camp, landing himself on the blacklist of all staff and students.
But who could have guessed that this student, who gives so many teachers a headache, would shock everyone in yesterday's competition! In the highly professional fields of firearm tuning, trajectory calculation, and live-fire shooting, he displayed extraordinary talent and focus, crushing all other contestants to take the crown!
Our paper reached out to the new champion's 'talent scout'—firearms instructor Li, but Teacher Li claimed the real scout was someone else! It was this mysterious person who insisted against all opposition that he be recommended to Teacher Li, saying that with proper guidance, even a 'rough stone' could become a gem.
Now that the gem has begun to shine, who is this mysterious person? Stay tuned for our next report!

To Master:

When you were at Cloud Mirror Lake the other day, you asked me a few things about maintaining a fishing rod. I thought about it for a long time afterward, so I just came down here and cast a few lines myself. If you want to catch big fish near this cape, fishing gear is important, but experience is what matters more. The currents under this sea are complex and the coral is dense. Without an experienced angler, a novice will find it hard to get a bite. As for my catch today, I'll leave it in this basket as a gift for you. It's not much, but please accept it!

Angler, Tang Yingliu.

P.S.: I'm not good with words and didn't mean to imply you don't know how to fish. Please forgive me. Let's cast a line together when you have time.

May 5th
The Spirit-Soothing Powder has been a huge help lately! I can finally be of use to everyone!
I must take good care of this field!

Autumn is here again, but the war still hasn't ended. 
News from the front lines says the situation is worsening. Even someone from the champion Dream-Performance team has reportedly fallen in battle. <69D0FF>Senior</> is devastated. 
More classmates have gone to Chunxi Plain to face Zhaoge, but I'm still stuck guarding this reservoir... 
It can't be helped. Who told me I wasn't strong enough? After three years of study, I can still only perform simple water-to-ice condensation... 
Thankfully, <69D0FF>Senior</> is also staying behind in the rear. Otherwise, what would I do all alone here... 
 
■ Month 6, Overcast 
Classmates sent word today that the situation is dire and the front lines are in urgent need of combatants. 
<69D0FF>Senior</> told me he wants to petition the teacher to voluntarily accept that power... 
I don't know what will happen if it's forced upon them... 
 
■ Month 8, Heavy Rain 
Is this what forced infusion is? They, they all... (The rest of the sentence is blurred due to water damage) 
Why, why am I so weak... 
 
■ Month 20, Rain 
I went to Fengyun Wilds alone today... Was it always this cold? 
On the way back, I met classmates escorting those who had undergone forced infusion back to recover... 
They said as long as there is Cloud Root, these people can still be saved, and they need someone to help look after them. 
I'm a coward who wouldn't dare accept that power like <69D0FF>Senior</>... but by taking care of them, I suppose I've done my part for Jixia? 
There seem to be some unfamiliar faces in Caiyun, something's not right... 
 
■ Month 27, Cloudy 
That's someone from Zhaoge! Good thing I intercepted his message. 
Even though I sent word to the front, it might be too late... 
If it is, then... then I'll risk my life to stop him! 
Cloud Root is their last hope... 
I cannot, absolutely cannot let Zhaoge find the sanctuary. 
 
(The diary ends abruptly)

Crafting Unique Fireworks
Unique fireworks are designed to create specific, intricate patterns in the sky. Key aspects of their production include:
<69D0FF>First, Pattern Composition</>
Pyrotechnicians control the ratio and spatial distribution of different powders within the firework shell to form a complete pattern. Thanks to recent advancements in Arcana and Mechanocraft, it is now possible to use a <69D0FF>Shaping Machine</> to capture designs and automate this process.
<69D0FF>Second, Burning Rate</>
When selecting powders for unique fireworks, there is a preference for <69D0FF>powders with a stable and moderate burning rate</>, ensuring the pattern remains visible for a longer duration.
<69D0FF>Third, Flame Color</>

Chapter 1: Dress Code
Before inviting a Sleepstone Beast to dance with you, appropriate attire is required. For a Sleepstone Beast, its dance partner should wear a grass skirt woven from fresh grass leaves, with the upper body adorned with ancient vines. The Sleepstone Beast particularly prefers its dance partner to choose branches and leaves of the Guisui tree to weave the grass skirt. Of course, Zhiyun wood is also a good choice, and if paired with swaying skirt leaves as skirt decorations, that would be even better. But remember not to choose split-fruit wood, or you will kick off a storm-like battle instead of completing an elegant dance. Headwear is best styled as a hat carved from cloud-ball stone; do not choose dull-colored rock materials, as this will make the Sleepstone Beast feel extremely drowsy.

Chapter 2: Basic Etiquette
Many people do not understand the invitation etiquette for dancing with a Sleepstone Beast, often resulting in people turning into their beloved pillows rather than dance partners. First, disturbing a resting Sleepstone Beast and shouting or urging it to wake up and dance with you is strictly discouraged. The correct method is to first find a sleeping Sleepstone Beast in the wild, then use a Zhanchi wood branch to sweep across its hard crown. According to the practical experience of well-known ranger Hu Qianqian, continuously clearing the moss on its head about twelve hundred times will successfully awaken the Sleepstone Beast. If it does not stand up and roar angrily at you, then congratulations, your dance invitation has been successfully accepted. Otherwise, you should leave as soon as possible, or else you can only wait for passing rangers to rescue you from its embrace.

Chapter 3: Dance Rhythm
A Sleepstone Beast that enters a dancing state will not move, and you, as its recognized dance partner, should sit gracefully before it, gently shaking the stone-carved hat on your head, with your arms naturally extended and swaying like a freely growing wild grass. If the Sleepstone Beast's gaze follows your movements, it means it has begun dancing with you. At this point, the choice of dance steps depends on how you twist your neck, trying your best not to shake your shoulders. In addition, never lower your head. If the stone-carved hat falls off, you should leave immediately; otherwise, keep your posture completely unchanged and wait for the Sleepstone Beast to close its eyes again.

第一章 着装要求  
在邀请一只眠石兽与你共舞之前，需要穿着合适的服装。对眠石兽来说它的舞伴应该穿有新鲜草叶编织的草裙，上身饰有古老的藤蔓。眠石兽尤其中意它的舞伴选择桂岁木的枝叶来编织草裙，当然织云木也是不错的选择，如果能搭配摇裙叶作为裙摆的装饰，那就再好不过了。但是切记不要选裂果木，否则你将掀起一场狂风骤雨般的战斗，而不是完成一支优雅的舞蹈。头饰以云球石雕刻的帽子为佳，不要选择颜色黯淡的岩石材料，这会让眠石兽备感困倦。 
 
第二章 基本礼仪  
很多人并不了解与眠石兽共舞的邀请礼仪，导致了时常会有人变成它们心爱的枕头，而不是舞伴。首先，打扰一只眠石兽休息，大喊大叫催它醒来与你跳舞是绝不可取的。正确的方式应当先在野外找到一只沉睡的眠石兽，然后使用战迟木的树枝扫过它坚硬的头顶。根据知名游猎家胡芊芊的实践经验，持续清理它头顶的青苔大约一千两百次左右，这时眠石兽就会被成功唤醒，如果它没有站起身来向你生气吼叫，那么恭喜，舞蹈的邀请已经被它成功接受了，反之，你应当尽快离开，否则只有等待过路的游猎家将你从它的怀抱中拯救出来。 
 
第三章 舞蹈节奏

Prototype No. 4: Success. Flow input is more stable than before. 
...

The truth about the incident at the Dream Performance finals remains unclear. However, multiple students who witnessed the event mentioned a mysterious cavern beneath the colorful clouds and speculated about a monster that might be 'symbiotic' with the Cloud Root.

In the last two days, there have been several reports of students spotting unidentified figures in the thick fog. Could they be related to these so-called 'Cloud Root monsters'? Logically, the academy's teachers and the Dream Performance Mobile Team should have fully contained the situation, leaving no unknown monsters behind.

But if those monsters have been 'symbiotic' with the Cloud Root for years, it is theoretically possible for their energy to linger long after their physical forms have dissipated! Although my primary job is to monitor the Cloud Root ecosystem, this hypothesis is impossible to ignore. I will return here tomorrow to observe, hoping to verify my theory soon.

To the Great Sage Fuzi:

Respectfully, I have received your previous letter. I apologize for the delay in responding due to being tied up with trivial matters.

Regarding the matter of the Grand Duke escaping the seal, there has been much discussion within the Xuandu Temple, yet opinions remain divided and inconclusive. Especially with the Yuhang Department acting so aggressively and frequently applying pressure, there are many within the temple advocating for the crusade against Duke Jiang. As indicated in your previous letter, I will do my utmost to reconcile the current situation, quell the discord, and strive for a glimmer of hope for a peaceful resolution. As for the Empress, I am afraid my virtue is thin and my ability weak; I am unable to share more of your burdens.

Respectfully submitted. No need to reply.

Respectfully, Hermit Huaizhen. Written on behalf by Yun Ying at the Liangyi Gate.

Those people at the academy don't understand the sophistication of my research at all! Hurting people... I didn't do it on purpose; it was all for the sake of researching those ancient parts!
If I had this power back in Xuanyong... if I had it during that accident under the sea trench, Mom and Dad wouldn't have... Never mind. Since the academy doesn't want me, I'll just leave.

Page 2
I've looked in so many places, and only that underwater cave entrance is the most suitable... The things that hurt me can also be used to protect me. The mechanical arm is like that, and so is the water. I'll choose this place.
I'll make preparations today and move all my tools over as soon as possible. As for Yang Ling... as long as she stays far away from me, those people at the academy shouldn't bother her.

Page 3
My current progress isn't fast enough; I need to collect more ancient mechanical parts...
It's time to move to another place, even if it means going to that place underground... I can't hesitate; there's no time to be afraid!

I overslept when I went to watch the sunrise with my brother last time...
The weather has been nice these past few days, maybe we should go again.

Why, why, why, why!
You clearly promised to protect me, to always be with me!

Silk Ginseng prefers cool temperatures and should be planted in moist, loose soil. After tilling and weeding, remove any stones. Ferment Jihu Barley husks and animal dung to create fertilizer, applying it when the seedlings sprout. Regularly remove weeds monthly and spray insecticide. Silk Ginseng tolerates shade, with light exposure neither too strong nor too weak. Five months after flowering, it is fully mature and ready for use as a medicinal herb.

Dear Tigon, 
 
It's been a while. I hope you're not practicing new moves behind my back. 
 
I've been away from Jixia for some time, but I haven't slacked off one bit. I reflect every day—it's no easy task. But I can feel my willpower getting stronger, so it's all worth it. 
 
People who have returned say that Roaring Tiger Training Hall is thriving and your skills are improving. That makes me very happy! Do you remember how we used to have big meals after our sparring sessions? Just thinking about that small, dirty restaurant makes my mouth water. 
 
I know that mastering martial arts takes time, and I'll probably be away training for quite a while longer. How are things at Jixia? Are you doing well?
Dragon bones are incredibly sturdy. What kind of powerful enemy could have left such scars on something as hard as rock?

Top Treasure Hunters in Jixia 
 
 
 
1st: Shye 
 
Achievements: 
 
In all the ruins of Jixia, two things are always present — evidence of civilization and traces of Shye. 
 
Shye's keen sense of treasures, precise judgment of their value, and stealthy techniques make her the undisputed leader. As a result, the Seekers frequently commission Shye to recover the most elusive treasures for research.

This volume introduces the many Societies of Jixia. 
 
 
 
Seeker Society: 
 
 
 
From dawn to dusk, the Seekers roam across all of Jixia. Treasure-hunting, expeditions, archaeology—there is little they haven't mastered. 
 
 
 
They care nothing for worldly fame or fortune; only new discoveries can quicken their pulse. 
 
 
 
To most people, a Seeker is always hurrying past with a pack on their back, but ask them about the countryside or hidden ruins, and they'll talk for hours. 
 
 
 
And of course, many of the chilling stories that circulate through Jixia? Those are their handiwork too. 
 
 
 
Music Society: 
 
 
 
With voices clear as jade, melodies flowing like strings of pearls, the Musicians are unrivaled in their command of rhythm. Lovers of stillness, they often seek inspiration in nature. 
 
 
 
People describe them as refined, even exquisite. Their high standards in food, dress, and daily life are not born of vanity, but of care for the hands that shape their music. 
 
 
 
They strive for purity of spirit and integrity of bearing. When they perform, their eyes are lowered, their thoughts drift free, and every listener is moved. 
 
 
 
And if you wish to anger these elegant Musicians, there is one sure way—play out of tune before them. 
 
 
 
Astrology Society: 
 
 
 
Read the clouds, mark the days; choose the hour, cast the sign. The Astrologers can glimpse the future, but they cannot alter its course. Many have tried to use divination to bend fate, only to find their efforts in vain. 
 
 
 
To most people, Astrologers seem indifferent. In truth, destiny is already written into their charts, beyond anyone's power to change. They are at once the most faithful servants of fate and its most secret rebels, forever searching for a way to break the deadlock of tomorrow. 
 
 
 
And if you ever worry about what lies ahead, you can always slip them a few coins to read your fortune—or even predict how your exams will go. 
 
 
 
Trading Society: 
 
 
 
When the abacus clacks, gold flows like water. The Traders' abacus is Jixia's most valuable tool. They hold the city's economy in their hands, and no account is beyond their reach. 
 
 
 
People remember them as rigorous and precise. A single misplaced figure can make them frown and reset the entire ledger. 
 
 
 
That same habit shapes their daily lives: ornaments must hang at just the right length from their belts; meals may be plain, but the tableware must be set with exact care. These quirks may try one's patience, yet no one doubts their reliability. 
 
 
 
Bring them a promising idea, and they may invest. But their standards are high, and no one should expect them to make a losing bargain. 
 
 
 
Cannon Society: 
 
 
 
Arms are as fire—unchecked, they burn themselves out. No one loves gunpowder and firearms like the Cannoneers. They tinker endlessly, reshaping their weapons into every form imaginable to satisfy their eccentric whims. 
 
 
 
Few dare provoke them, for their tempers are as volatile as the fire they wield—an ill-chosen word can set them off like a misfired cannon. 
 
 
 
Yet they are also Jixia's most romantic souls. They craft the city's most dazzling fireworks, sending the wishes of the people blazing across the night sky. 
 
 
 
But romance has its price. Many Cannoneers go about with smoke-stained faces, singed clothes, and voices hoarse from ears that never stop ringing. 
 
 
 
Intelligence Society: 
 
 
 
Calculate the risks, win with words. The Intelligencers are Jixia's silver tongues. Skilled in rhetoric and strategy, they know how to win trust, sway hearts, and strike bargains. In mere moments they can forge connections, and some even make their living by gathering information. 
 
 
 
Though their thoughts run deep, they never show it. Many wear a careless grin, joking and jesting to put others at ease—an act meant to mask their true intent. 
 
 
 
It is almost impossible to spot an Intelligencer on sight. But while their own identity remains hidden, yours will not escape their notice.

Senior Sun Bin stopped by to check our patrol zone today. He noticed the path ahead was full of hidden dangers, so he told us not to push forward for now and put up a warning sign instead. 
 
I asked why he advised against exploring off-path. He just rested a hand on his Mechcraft legs. People say he was badly injured years ago after a beast attack during a field expedition, falling off a cliff in the chaos. That was when I realized I had touched on something sensitive. 
 
But Sun Bin didn't get upset. With his usual calm, he simply said that if any students lose their way out in the wild, our job is to help guide them back safely.

Aerfall Highlands: Venture into the unknown, exploring ancient war ruins and mysterious remnants of a forgotten civilization. 
 
We settled in Frostcloud Town for the night. Beyond this town lies a mountainous highland region known as Aerfall Highlands, where Aersilk is said to originate. I've always been fascinated by its unique properties—both incredibly light and strong at once. Its versatility is astounding, used in clothing, weapons, construction, and even cuisine, adapting to various needs. No wonder it's renowned across Navenia. I was so captivated that I almost forgot to write about this place. 
 
I joined an expedition group from Frostcloud Town, consisting of Herbalists, Gourmets, Seekers, Hunters, Martial Arts students, and Sorcery students from Jixia Academy. Through them, I learned about the rich history of Frostcloud Town, how all Societies contributed to transforming it from a village into a thriving hub, making it a vital learning ground for their disciples. 
 
After sharing stories about the legendary explorer Macaroni, we ventured deep into West Aerfall Highlands, discovering breathtaking landscapes. The Seekers provided insightful commentary along the way, while the Herbalists and Gourmets prepared delicious meals during our breaks. These eastern travelers showed remarkable humility and courtesy, offering me the best food and apologizing for the limitations due to scarce ingredients and simple cooking conditions. 
 
In truth, these dishes were far more flavorful than the leftovers my mother brought home from her customers when I was young. Those early experiences taught me never to waste food and to truly appreciate good cuisine. I wish I could bring these exotic flavors back to my mother in Navenia. After asking the Gourmets for recipes, we continued our journey. 
 
Turning east before reaching Aermore Valley, we regretfully missed the dreamlike scenery within, but the Seekers urged us to hurry, warning that the valley's Aerflow nurtures Cloudeater, a monster that would pose significant risks to our journey. 
 
Upon reaching East Aerfall Highlands, the students began their studies and explorations. Accompanying them, I visited the lost Sanctified necropolis, which holds remnants of their civilization now lost to time. All that remains are ancient Mechanoids and grand architectural ruins, testifying to the brutality of past wars and the tales they tell.

Topic: Are Croakies happy? 
 
Definitely! They bounce around happily every day. 
Their happiness can't be measured by human standards; we need a different set of criteria for them. 
They aren't happy because the concept of happiness doesn't exist in their minds. 
I disagree. Human children don't know the definition of happiness, but they still feel it. 
I think they're happy because they don't have to worry about these questions like you do.

Dear Husband and Daughter, 
 
 
 
I hope this letter finds you both well! 
 
It's been months since I was sent to Springbrook Plains for medical support. You two haven't been causing trouble at home, have you? If you bring back fish and don't finish them, make sure they go straight into the ice chest—or they'll stink up the whole house! And don't you dare slack off with the chores. If I come back to find the place a mess, you'll both have me to answer to! 
 
Has Lulu grown taller again? It's about time she started learning to fish instead of spending all day playing. And you too, Jun—don't think I'll let you off easy if you get rusty with your skills. Without my special herbal bait, have you really been catching anything lately? You'd better write me back soon with a full report! 
 
I can hardly believe how long I've been away from Frostcloud Town already. If it weren't for the wild beasts here, injuring villagers and students alike, I wouldn't have been sent to Springbrook Plains for so long. I miss the sweets at Tata's so much—has she added anything new to the menu?

Dear old friends, 
 
If you're reading this letter, it means you've already succeeded. I'm sorry for leaving you with this final surprise. 
 
We've fought side by side, supported each other, and even argued fiercely in competitions. We are classmates, friends, and like family. The academy is our shared home, something we built and protected together. But over time, we each became focused on our own fields. The four schools started to compare and compete, sometimes even attacking each other. We all chased after greater power, but that power has started to break us apart. 
 
Our fading abilities and our old pride are pulling us in different directions. Not wanting you to see us at our lowest, we chose to leave quietly to keep our dignity. But before we go, please let us do one last thing for the academy. 
 
The challenge we left behind can only be solved if the three schools work together. We hope that, through this, the pride and ambition that once separated us will now bring you back together. 
 
Since the Sanctifier left, everyone has tried hard to keep things going, but we still feel lost. We are no longer the heroes we once were, and we can't reach the heights we dreamed of. But you still have a chance. If you combine your wisdom and strength, we believe you can achieve something truly great. 
 
We don't know if we'll ever meet again. Even if we don't, we trust you will carry on our shared hopes and dreams. We wish you all the best, wherever life takes you.

I felt reborn as I regained control of my body. My steps were light, and my heart was clear of any shadows. 
 
However, the classmates who had bullied me at the academy didn't let up. But I was no longer the weak Ruan Xiaoguai from before. Senior Yango had unintentionally taught me puppetry, and I skillfully made them taste the consequences of their actions without revealing myself. 
 
It didn't take long for my classmates to realize that I was no longer the pushover they knew. Everything about me gradually returned to normal, and for the first time, campus life felt peaceful and beautiful. 
 
Yet, every time I heard others mention "Senior Yango," my heart would involuntarily skip a beat. The time spent with him, though filled with the constraints of puppets, now only brought warmth and gratitude when remembered. 
 
I knew I had never let go of him. 
 
Several times, I couldn't help but secretly glance at Senior Yango from afar. He was still so dazzling, so unreachable. I understood that I was just an ordinary student, with an insurmountable gap between us. Yet, simply looking at him from afar gave me immense satisfaction. 
 
I thought our relationship could only remain in the past, like two parallel lines destined never to intersect. Unexpectedly, we met again during an event at Pastoral Garden. 
 
I stole glances at him several times, each time meeting his gaze. Could it be that he recognized me or remembered helping me at the library? I unconsciously clenched the handkerchief in my pocket; if only I could return it to him. 
 
When the event ended, I nervously approached him. His gaze left me breathless. 
 
"This is yours. Thank you, Senior." Despite my progress, I still felt timid facing him. 
 
He took the handkerchief without saying much. As I tried to escape, he firmly grasped my wrist. Smiling, he looked at me with a commanding gaze, as if he had already seen through all my disguises. 
The puppet beside him softly said, "Little puppet, where do you think you're going?" 
 
I froze. How did he recognize me? He sighed and told me everything. 
 
From the beginning, he knew I was Ruan Xiaoguai. Curious why I was among his puppets, he investigated and learned the whole story. Puppetry wasn't something he accidentally taught me; it was intentional, hoping I would become stronger and better able to protect myself. 
 
After learning of our misunderstanding, he chose not to explain immediately, allowing me to leave. Following my departure, he became preoccupied with thoughts of me. When I sought out Master Zhuangzi, he was the first to learn of it, guiding me to find the herb. The voice during the ritual wasn't my hallucination; it was him, caring for me and personally performing the ceremony. 
 
So... he had been watching over me all along, silently taking care of me. 
 
His handsome face blurred before me as I realized I was crying again. 
 
Whether I'm a puppet or an ordinary student, Senior Yango's concern and care for me never changed. 
 
And I am no longer the puppet who only knows how to run away. I've grown, becoming strong and independent, thanks to Senior Yango. Perhaps now, I deserve to stand by his side. 
 
"Don't run anymore. Stay with me." 
 
I nodded, unable to resist asking, "But Senior, when did you start noticing me?" 
 
The puppet replied on his behalf, "From our first encounter, your tears reminded me of a crying kitten, making me think of my own broken self." 
 
"I wanted to stop your tears, but I never imagined your smile would be so radiant." 
 
I smiled, reaching for his hand. "Then, Senior, from now on, you'll have to look at my smile every day." 
 
-End of This Volume- 
 
 
Epilogue: 
This marks the end of my tenth book as a novelist. From here, Xiaoguai and Senior will surely live happily ever after. 
Thank you to all students for your support, especially the Heroes' Fanclub members throughout the serialization. Everyone finds themselves within stories. Until the next book!

I've encountered many shadows in my time, but never did I imagine there could be such a pitch-dark, eerie place within the corners of Jixia Academy—the Forbidden Chamber. 
 
 
 
Nestled within the northern cliffs of Jixia, there's a hidden path that only the keenest eyes can spot—the sole entrance to the Forbidden Chamber. Once you step inside, not only do your spells lose their potency, but even the functioning of Mechcrafts becomes severely disrupted. 
 
 
 
Yet, this challenge didn't deter me. With the help of my colleagues, I successfully ventured into this mysterious and ominous place. But as the fog cleared, a deeper darkness engulfed me. 
 
 
 
There's a room, shrouded entirely in darkness, where the shadow itself is a unique entity imprisoned within. This entity devours anything that enters, dragging it into a cold, pitch-black world. Fortunately, my unwavering pursuit of light and strong willpower allowed me to dispel this darkness. 
 
 
 
After leaving the room, I was suddenly confronted by a peculiar rooster in the corridor. Out of kindness, I tried to help the creature, but to my shock, it multiplied into a frenzy of roosters, attacking me wildly and nearly pecking away the notes I had just written. 
 
 
 
And that's not all—deeper within the chamber lie even greater dangers. The chains binding these entities are made from Jixia Academy's Aercocoon Aersilk, undoubtedly a secret weapon crafted by the Academy to harness terrifying power. 
 
 
 
As I was about to make my escape, I caught a glimpse of a runaway Mechcraft wooden ox, followed by a sinister Mechanoid tiptoeing behind it. I barely escaped with my life, almost silenced by the Academy. 
 
 
 
One can only wonder, what kind of twisted mind could create such monsters? It's truly a chilling thought!
