Used for the manufacture of Divine Pattern mechanisms. By switching the input Divine Pattern patterns and behavioral modes, one can construct and shape mechanisms and test the behavioral sequences and performance of different mechanisms.\nIt also includes the design and production of bionic mechanisms, such as turtle-shaped Xuan-Guard, crab-shaped Copper Armor, etc., all of which are exquisite mechanisms created by the God-Forged using organisms as prototypes.
The giant bronze pillars can be controlled via mechanism pedals to close and activate them.

The <ffdda4>[Energy Core]</> that powers the Linglong Tower is the source of its continuous operation. Destroy the <ffdda4>[Energy Core]</> during the trial to stop the tower and complete the challenge.

Only when touched by the ripples of power can the Floating Dream Stone bloom with brilliance.\nUse skills to awaken the long-dormant Floating Dream Stone to release its dream energy. As the stone platform rises, the stairs will emerge.
The truth often lies beyond sight.\nTrust your memory and resolve, and take a leap of courage. The paths hidden by magic energy will reveal themselves beneath your feet.
Use the corresponding Burning Mountain Keystone to activate the Light-Driving Platforms in the three areas on the outskirts of the Heavenly Pillar Ruins.
A token left behind by a god in legend, condensing the power to perceive the world. It usually floats high up and can be collected to stimulate potential.

The stone formation has stood silent for ages, hiding profound mysteries within.\nRotate the stone pillars to align their directions and return them to their places to awaken the dormant ancient formation.

In the fissures of the Phantom Dream, mirages born of obsession still linger. Pass through a <ffdda4>Dream Rift</> to travel instantly to distant places, or even fall into dreams still trapped in the <ffdda4>Land of Phantom Dreams</>.
A seemingly ordinary mechanism, yet it hides the principles of intricate craftsmanship.\nObserve the clues nearby to find the secret to activating it.
In the <ffdda4>Dream Realm</>, there are sobering <ffdda4>Dream-Dissolving Buds</>. Consuming a <ffdda4>Dream-Dissolving Bud</> provides continuous resistance to the effects of the lingering dream.
Clear the meridians to solve the puzzle.\nConnect the circuits to guide the energy to the destination to complete the puzzle.

A mechanical core of suspended light, bearing the resonance of genius and the confrontation of fate.\nClear the Trial of the Cloud Platform, stand on the central circular pedal to interact with the core, and the shimmering light will activate the platform.
Place the Dream-Energy-infused Dream Pearl into the Dream Washer to power the large construct.
Rockfall traps that players can trigger. Once triggered, they crash to the ground, dealing significant damage to enemies in the area.
An inscription containing ancient energy records a secret location. \nDecipher the clues, follow the trail, and interact with the Flow to reveal the hidden treasure chest.
But a mechanism sensitive to flames should be a relic from the Primordial Era.
A device driven by the power of divine patterns that can synchronize with other divine pattern mechanisms to control their operation.
A target-shaped mechanism that switches states when hit by an attack.\nCraftsmen took inspiration from it to derive thousands of clever puzzles. Solve the puzzles to receive generous rewards.
When all giant pillars are closed, aim the light beams at the appropriate positions to activate the mechanism and open the gate to the Azure Flame Court.
Tiny river spirits that occasionally appear in Jixia, emitting a dim, fluorescent glow. Touching them grants a glimmer of healing power.
Watch out for those fragile creations; a single strike might be enough to shatter them instantly.
The withered vines have become as tough as iron over time. Blades cannot sever them; only fire can break their hold.
The Bronze Heavy Cannon's shield can block damage at critical moments.
Cloud-reaching tokens, gathering clouds for use.\nJixia students can consume Cloud Energy Tokens to activate mountain mechanisms, or exchange them for rewards at the Token Exchange mechanism.
A marvelous mechanism woven from cloud silk. Lightweight and flexible, it can hover in the air. It can both nourish the fields and guide travelers on their journey.

The Dream Energy space-time has generated large areas of <ffdda4>Dream Illusions</>. Entering this area will continuously apply the <ffdda4>Dream Haunting</> debuff.\n<ffdda4>Dream Haunting</> will trap players in an illusion, continuously reducing their <ffdda4>Max HP</>, while simultaneously increasing their <ffdda4>Attack</> and <ffdda4>Life Steal</>.
An ordinary object, its value is hardly enough to bring joy, but at least it can be another mark of a long journey.
The most humble yet charming object. Of course, the real attraction lies in what's inside.\nThe more ornate the chest, the more precious the treasure inside tends to be.
A hard ore that cannot be moved by ordinary means.\nIt can only be made brittle and shattered by rapid temperature changes in a short period.
Where life goes, there is an echo.\nTouch the lingering shadows of the flow, and the Ring of Origin can reconstruct images to reproduce scenes of the past.
Where the light points, treasures await.\nOnce activated, it will point to a specific location. Follow the device's sequence to activate it and reveal hidden treasure chests.
A young River Spirit with a sprout on its head and a naive expression.\nTouch it gently to show friendliness, and you will receive a gift from nature.

A unique phenomenon where Jixia mountain springs and cloud silk converge. Those who bathe in it feel energized, their fatigue swept away, and their stamina fully restored, as if it were inexhaustible.

In the <ffdda4>Dream Realm</>, there are sobering <ffdda4>Dream-Dissolving Camellias</>. The dream energy they contain spreads through their branches and leaves to nearby areas, which can dispel the negative effects of the lingering dream.

The sturdy mechanical claw always seems to lose its grip at the most critical moment—\nBut who could resist the temptation of a cute doll and not try their luck again?\nFortunately, as a master craftsman, one can always forge a Gwa-Gwa Coin and give it another shot!
Lush grass is an excellent natural hiding place.\nEvery patch of unexplored greenery may hide a deadly ambush.
A gate locked by complex, precision mechanisms. Only by finding the one-of-a-kind key can the confinement be undone.

An ancient mechanical lift from a previous era. Though old, it still functions, connecting the Academy Plaza to the eastern cliff of the Jixia mountain range.\nYou must find the hidden switch in the Tiger Roar Hall to activate it.

No risk, no reward.\nYou must crouch and sneak, using the blind spots of the mechanisms to approach cautiously, and remain still when the detection field is near.\nOnce you reach the chest, break the mechanism hub to open it.
Residual energy fragments left behind after a dream shatters. The Menki should be interested in these.
Pass through the light waterfall to teleport to the Main Pillar of Heaven.
The Bronze Heavy Cannon deals high Toughness damage and can knock down Mechanical Bronze Fish.
The Shadow Rift will continuously summon Dream-Floating Thorns. Hold the interaction key to close the Shadow Rift.
Treasures are buried deep in the earth, recorded only on maps. Find the burial site and use the Ring of Origin to sense them, so the treasure may be revealed to the world once more.
A mechanism that senses light. Adjust the beam angle and use its refraction to hit the light-sensitive mechanism for unexpected results.
Though buried under wind-eroded rocks, the light within the box is still clearly visible. Use a plunging attack to destroy the rubble, and the treasure chest will see the light of day again.
The extractor can only be activated after enabling three Energy Hubs.

To win in a small space, one must make good use of the natural momentum and skillfully control changes.\nActivate to raise moving stone slabs, use your abilities flexibly to reach the finish line, and obtain the final reward.
The ancient stone tablet looks sturdy, but its interior has long been eroded by time.\nAny sacrilegious touch will invite its counterattack.
An automated elevator that requires no effort from passengers.
Barriers that are hard to destroy with brute force can only be dissolved with Cloud Energy. Insert a Cloud Energy Token into the Cloud Energy Mechanism to dispel the Sorcery barrier.
Unravel the light to break the seal.\nTouch the mechanism switch, observe the trajectory of the unraveling light, and activate the corresponding mechanisms in order to break the seal.
The Linglong Tower attack module will periodically fire <ffdda4>【Missiles】</> at threatening targets within range.
All Light-Riding Platforms in the Tianzhu Ruins have been restarted, and the Lightfall has been reactivated.

The stele is shattered, its true words buried in dust.\nCollect the fragments and reassemble the stele to use the Meta-Ring to make a rubbing of the complete inscription. The rubbings can be exchanged for rewards at the regional shop.

Master Luban's improved, next-generation brewing mechanism turns Jixia Fox-Wheat into the Fengyun Wilds' specialty, Fengyun Brew.\nHe simplified the complex brewing process of the past, increasing both efficiency and success rates. Now, you only need to step on the pedal to maintain the mechanism's power, then hit the targets on the left and right to ensure both temperature and humidity reach the required levels. However, if power, temperature, or humidity drops to zero, the brewing fails.

A mysterious mechanism is attached to the treasure chest, with magic energy surging like a dark tide.\nWhen approaching the chest, you must jump nimbly to dodge the oscillating magic energy attacks.\nOnce close to the chest, destroy the mechanism hub to open it.

<ffdda4>[Magic Storage Core]</> can interfere with the Linglong Tower's targeting mechanism, attracting <ffdda4>[Missiles]</> to charge itself. Once charged, the <ffdda4>[Magic Storage Core]</> can be controlled to release the absorbed missile energy.
A Light-Weaving Machine infused with magic, storing puzzles hidden within light and shadow.\nRotate the projection to complete the seal and solve the puzzle.

Used for performance testing of mechanical constructs in the Mechcraft Lab. It hangs above the Mechcraft Lab daily and descends after the test is started, releasing test mechanical warriors.\nThe test includes multiple rounds of assessment, covering fire resistance, cold resistance, mobility, etc., and is a comprehensive performance verification for mechanical constructs.
An ancient tree stump containing Aerflow, still shielding the secret treasure of the wood core from the elements.\nBurn or split the stump to reveal the treasure chest.

A device used to solve puzzles, which can open sealed mechanisms.\nDefeat guards or solve puzzles to open sealed mechanisms.\nPay attention to the color of the light in the mechanism; it will change according to the state of the mechanism.

Used to power the bronze mechanical constructs in the Littoral Towership, it can be found on some special transport constructs.\nThe tower ship area is rich in copper mines, and the God-Forged used local materials to manufacture Spirit Drive Cores and various mechanical constructs.
The <ffdda4>Transfer Prism</> can store and conduct energy. They come in identical pairs. The <ffdda4>Missiles</> fired by the Linglong Tower can be transmitted between prisms of the same shape.
Magical creatures occasionally seen in Jixia that love a good game of tag. Try to keep up with them to earn rewards from this chase.
Eight ancient trial pillars left on the Dongyunluo Highlands. Find and activate the three bronze ball mechanisms to fully raise the Spirit-Casting Stone Pillar.
A condensate containing rich magic power. Upon intense impact, the power within will instantly erupt.
Board the Cloud Boat and start a journey through the clouds.\nRide the Cloud Boat to view the beauty of Jixia from high altitude and reach various parts of Jixia.

Step onto the platform and use the Cloud Energy Chip to activate the mechanism, and the lightweight wings gifted by that genius youth will unfold for you.\nFeel the vibration of the interlocking gears and soar into the clouds on the rising currents.
Use Frozen Fruit to reveal invisible monsters in the Cangyuan Mystery.

Look at the picturesque mountains and rivers beneath your feet, and listen to the wind whistling like a song—\nThis journey to Lingxiao is better shared than enjoyed alone. Why not invite a companion to enjoy this beautiful scenery of birds flying together?
Challengers who ascend through the clouds will be rewarded for their courage to touch the sky.\nDodge the mechanism's interference, overcome obstacles, and the first to reach the finish line wins.
Use Frozen Fruit to break monster shields in the Cangyuan Mystery.
A <ffdda4>Trial Point</> set up by Master Zhuangzi at Dream-Whisper Lake. Completing it will grant generous rewards.
Lake light flickers, battle intent rings out.\nDefeat the guards of the Zhuji Lake Trial Array to obtain rewards.

This kite-bird, which should have flown gracefully, has become a mechanical beast that could go berserk at any moment due to a malfunctioning core gear. No one can predict if it will soar into the sky or crash into your back in the next second...\nHelp Du Qin recover the runaway mechanical kite-birds in the northern border. Once completed, you can exchange for rewards with her in Yungen Town.

Light the Return Lamp with a mechanism wick to awaken the vows of the past. It was once a signpost for the God-Forged, and now it waits for new travelers at the corner of Dragon Valley. Do not fear the long night; this glimmer will guide your way.
At the end of the parabola lies a mysterious gift.\nAim, charge, and throw—hit the ring in the center of the mechanism to get the reward.

The <ffdda4>[Phase Deflector]</> developed by the School of Mechcrafts can reflect the <ffdda4>[Missiles]</> fired by the Exquisite Tower. Attack the deflector to adjust its orientation and change the missile's flight trajectory.

The strange dream patterns left by the Dreamweavers on the rocks of the Dreamland seem to contain the profound mysteries of the Way of Dreams. Exploring by adjusting your view at designated locations to piece these patterns together is also a trial to understand the Way of Dreams.
Mechanical technology and magic arts are cleverly combined to create invisible stone slabs that guide students to hidden paths.\nWhere there seems to be no way forward, hidden slabs will appear.
Some cloud silk will slowly settle and condense into crystals of various sizes. These crystals are sturdy and reliable, and are considered precious materials by many.

A mechanism built by the Godsmiths who guarded Dragon Banner Valley during the war, used to sense the energy contained within dragon bones. Once energy flows into the Enlightenment Core within, it emits a bright glow. Remove the wick to light the Return Lamp.
Dream thorns have trapped the body of the River Spirit, but they cannot bind its heart that yearns for freedom.\nIf you can find a way to help, the River Spirit will have a gift for you.

Located above the Mechcraft Lab, it powers the entire facility and serves as the mechanism hub for opening the ship's passages.\nIt is currently abandoned and requires a Spirit Drive Core to be reactivated.
When the mechanism starts, the Cloud Silk Orbs will dance in the wind and scatter everywhere.\nCatch them all before they dissipate into the wind.
The Cloud-Tether can be linked and synchronized with Dream Butterflies. Follow the guidance of the Dream Butterflies to roam the land of dreams together.
Time passes, but the radiance on the stone wall has not faded in the slightest. Try pushing the stone wall engraved with divine patterns to activate the power hidden within.
A precision-floor-selecting elevator. Simply select the desired floor, and the cabin will move flexibly along the rails.
A special mechanism that changes form based on weight.\nStep on it to trigger the linkage device and activate the mechanism.
Grapple through the air and step on the void.\nMechanical platforms contain hidden hooks; touch the platform to activate them.
Magical creatures occasionally seen in Jixia that love a good game of tag. Try to keep up with them to earn rewards from this chase.
A timid River Spirit hiding in sturdy vines. Help it break free; maybe something good will happen?
Collect Cloud-Root Dew to activate the Cloud-Root Bridge and open the path to explore the Cloud-Root Grotto-Heaven.
Ding-a-ling—listen, that's the sound of treasure sparkling.\nCome take a look, what incredible things has naughty Menki found for you this time?
Mysterious Stone Tablet: Southwest of the Mausoleum

The war rages on. Having been ordered to guard the path to the city at this vital mountain pass, one must be as firm as iron and treat the matter with gravity. Only then can one fulfill the mission and repel the enemy.\n\nI have hidden my treasures in the <69D0FF>military camp north of Yingmu Pavilion</>. Those who come after may find them if fate allows.

Few return from the wars of old. I have lived for over twenty years, and now I fight to the death to defend against foreign enemies, with no regrets.\n\nI have hidden my treasures in the <69D0FF>crevice between the dragon's spine and tail</>, for those who are fated to find them.
Mysterious Stone Tablet: Outside Old Citadel

War is coming, and we are taking refuge here, fearing the worst. I have gathered the family fortune accumulated over the years to leave behind for a rainy day.\n\nI have hidden my treasures beside the <69D0FF>bronze stele underwater in the Council Hall</>. Those who come after may find them if fate allows.

I was full of spirit when I first tested the Eight Pillars of Casting Spirits, eager for a chance to show my skills. Now, with the war raging, I realize that the peaceful years of the past were more worth cherishing.\n\nI have hidden my treasures in the <69D0FF>Eight Pillar Trial in the north of Lanshan Hill</>. Those who are fated may find them.

My defeat today was not due to a lack of skill, but fate and fortune—what can one do? As a commander, I do not wish to live on in shame; I only hope this broken body can hold back the enemy for a moment.\n\nI have hidden my treasures <69D0FF>south of Frostcloud Town, at the base of the waterfall</>. May those who come after find them.

The path of trial is only for the exceptional. If you feel weary, why not rest here for a while?\n\nI have hidden treasures in the <69D0FF>cave behind the waterfall on the cliff</>, for those who are fated to find them.

This is a vital military stronghold; it must not fall. By order of my superiors, I have buried supplies throughout this area for use in wartime, or perhaps to resolve an urgent crisis. \n \nI have hidden the treasure on <69D0FF>the small hill northeast of the stone crossing at Luoyun Cliff and south of the Armory City</>. May those who come after find it.

I never expected the enemy to launch a surprise attack. Our forces were vastly outnumbered, and our defeat was inevitable... But I have no intention of living in disgrace; I only wish to die alongside my comrades. \n \nI have hidden the treasure <69D0FF>under the stele in the Rongzhu Stele Forest</>. Those who come after may find it if fate allows.
Mysterious Stone Tablet: East of Mirror Lake

The enemy approaches, but our troops still hold the line. It is too early to say this is the end. After all, beyond Jueyun Bridge, there is still a path to survival to the east of Yunluo.\n\nI have hidden my treasure at the <69D0FF>southern end of Jueyun Bridge</>. Those who come after may find it if fate allows.
Mysterious Stone Tablet: Sunken Stele Pondside

After days of bitter fighting, we finally slew the enemy's giant soldier. We have erected this giant arm here to commemorate our victory, and the horn of counterattack sounds today.\n\nI have hidden my treasure at the <69D0FF>wrist of the Giant Hand ruins</>; those who are fated may find it.
Mysterious Stone Tablet: North of Mirror Lake

The wound is bleeding non-stop, and my strength is exhausted. I'm afraid there's no saving me now...\n\nI have hidden the treasure <69D0FF>south of the Sunken Stele Pool, in the center of the circular pool</>. Those who come later may find it if they are fated.

The military order arrived suddenly; I fear I may never return. I buried my treasures <69D0FF>beneath the coastal cliff</>, hidden by Sea Coral Waterfall.\n\nMay those who come after me share this dawn view of the East Sea.
Springbrook Plains Treasure: East of Saepes Retreat

Story quests offer Bracer EXP and currency.
Newbie Quests: Earn a large amount of EXP, upgrade materials, and Resonance.
Routine quests give more Bracer EXP.
Limited-time Event: Earn a large amount of EXP, Platinum Crystal, and Spirit Callers.
Daily challenges reward EXP and upgrade materials.
Three slots are unlocked every 10 Bracer Levels.
The Weapon Level Cap is increased by 5 (capped at Level 60) every 5 Bracer Levels.
Weapons can be further Advanced at Bracer Levels 10, 20, 30, 40, and 50.
New Talents are unlocked every 5 Bracer Levels.
Summon Skills gain 1 Level every 5 Bracer Levels.
They are Mechcraft boxes that use Aersilk for countdowns.
They only open at the right time—hence the name.
Fei hid three Time Capsules with treasure and said I'd never find them.
Who am I? A Seeker! I swore I'd find them all in under an hour.
Judging by your face, you haven't found any yet.
Judging by your face, you haven't found any yet.
He hid them far apart, but I don't want to lose. Can you help me?
I shouldn't have promised Fei. How can I find three Time Capsules so quickly?
Great! You take the two to the southeast. I'll get the other one.
Sula bets Fei she can find three Time Capsules in an hour, and she needs your help.
I want to travel too. Maybe I'll visit Navenia, where the oceans glow!
No rush. We Seekers travel a lot anyway.
Here is a drawing. And the last Time Capsule isn't open yet.
Here is a drawing. And the last Time Capsule isn't open yet.
This opens at two a.m., but I can try the password. Guess it.
It worked! I knew Fei would use Yango's birthday.
I found the poem I wrote secretly in Sorcery class.
You and Sula wait for the Time Capsule to open, only to find a few odds and ends. But then Sula takes a guess at another capsule's password—and finds a special music box!
How can I find all the Time Capsules in an hour...
Sula, by the time you open it, I'll have already left.
You probably feel upset that they held nothing special.
But I'm glad we became friends at Jixia. Thanks, and take care.
He should've told you in person. Sula, you okay?
He should've told you in person. Sula, you okay?
I... I'm fine. I knew he'd return home eventually. His family needs him.
You might still be able to see him before he leaves, since you opened the capsules early.
You might still be able to see him before he leaves, since you opened the capsules early.
I don't think I should. He must have struggled to say goodbye. And I... I...
Next time I see him, I'm going to tell him off!
Do you know where he is going?
Do you know where he is going?
No, but it doesn't matter. I'm a Seeker. I can track down anything.
I'm still mad! Why make it so complicated!
Sula understands that Fei's family needs him, so she doesn't blame him for leaving without a word.
Next time I see him, I'm going to tell him off!
It's not the time to open it yet.
It's not the time to open it yet.
Hmm... a drawing of a napping girl.
Hmm... a drawing of a napping girl.
Hey, I've found one. The other one should be on that high platform over there. Be careful!
Humph, can't hide anything from you.
This test is made for you.
I couldn't just let that slide.
You're my student. Doubting you is like doubting me.
So you set up this test?
So you set up this test?
Exactly! I know you'll prove yourself, right?
Hurry up and make up your mind. Don't let me down.
It will give you a hint for the next one.
You've been making waves, but someone's been doubting your abilities.
That's the spirit! Get to that paper on the outer wall first.
If I lose, how will I ever live this down?
Oh, you again. Anything you would like to ask?
It sounds like you have some time to spare. Great.
I have an important test for you.
See that paper? There are three like it in this tower.
Find them all, read each one, and you pass. I have rewards for you.
So what do you think? Wanna try it?
But I heard you said something about losing...
But I heard you said something about losing...
At the bottom of the tower tube.

text: Fen cheated? What does that mean?
Fen cheated? What does that mean?
The first one says, "Bottom of the tower."
The first one says, "Bottom of the tower."
The second one is "Bathed in sunlight."
The second one is "Bathed in sunlight."
Nice work! What about the last one?
Wait a minute... Cheating? Let me check!
There's nothing on this at all!
Hold on... You saw my name on it?
Now I get it. That's why she was sure I'd fail.
Don't use Fang's skills. Nonsense! I just hate her Sorcery tricks!
Haha, you were tricked! My clever plan worked!
I said I'd get them all. She didn't believe me.
Well, actually, this was a test from my Captain.
We're preparing for a competition, but we argued over who should lead.
Everyone knows I'm brilliant. It's only fair I lead the team.
But she said Cyan is a better leader. Want to know why?
She had the nerve to say I'm just copying Fang or relying on cheap tricks!
It was ridiculous, right? She said I couldn't do anything without Fang's skills.
I couldn't let that slide, so this test happened.
She bet I wouldn't find all three notes without climbing like my brother.
She said even if I found them, I couldn't possibly read them.
Smart? She's just full of sly tricks! I'm not going to lose to her.
Since I couldn't get them myself, I waited for someone to help.
No wonder she felt so sure. I should've known!
That's her secret trick. She writes someone's name on a piece of paper...
... and that person can't read what's written on it.
Master Zhuangzi mentioned it. It was used for secret messages.
But I figured it out on my own. Tell me, do you think it's cheating?
I never agreed to anything else with her before, so it's not cheating. I won, fair and square!
Don't look so serious. Here's a small gift for your help.
Next time, try not to fall for tricks like this!
I thought I had it, but her Sorcery got me. I couldn't read the notes.
That's for your captain to decide.
Exactly! I saw right through her tricks. Now that's what I call strategy!
Maybe we should ask your Detective.
W-what? No need to bother Fang with this! Wait... you know him?
Anyway, I won. Just... don't let Fang hear about it, okay?
The third note says, "Fen cheated." It turns out that Fen argues with his teammates over who should be captain, which leads to his test. Fen insists his strategy proves he is the real winner.
Go now. If the Captain sees...
I need a complete plan before I argue with her.
This is too high... how can I get it?
All things have spirits, returning home to this place.

text: Shh, keep it down! I'm on a secret mission!
Wait a sec... Are you that new student who aced the special exam?
Wow, my apologies. I'm Meng Feng from the Secrets Club.
Do you know about the Secrets Club?
We uncover and share every secret about Jixia—everyone talks about us!
You got a minute? I need help here.
Don't tell anybody. I'm digging up a big secret.
My last article was criticized for being dull. This time, I need a big story.
Too bad. You're missing a big scoop.
If you want, you can work for us as a contractor.
Have you seen Mr. Bai He from He & Ming's Training Hall today?
Have you seen Mr. Bai He from He & Ming's Training Hall today?
Yes... Hmm? Are you... with the Secrets Club?
Meng Feng said someone from the club would come. Is that you?
Have you made any progress? You know, I'm a big fan of the club.
Hello, I haven't seen you before. How can I assist you?
Si Qi is waiting for someone from the Secrets Club. She tells you she saw Mr. Bai He earlier today.
Then he went to the pier. I can't see him from here. Maybe you should ask others.
If you find out anything, I want to know!
May I know what Mr. Bai He bought today?
May I know what Mr. Bai He bought today?
Is that old flask very special?
Is that old flask very special?
Sorry, I can't reveal my customers' purchases.
If you can persuade him, we could work something out.
He should get a new flask.
Mr. Bai He is a regular here. It's not about my business, but I can't overlook it...
I'm telling you, he just bought my best fruit drink.
He's got taste. In Jixia, only my drink satisfies him.
But he just kept it in his dusty flask... It's made from 17 ingredients and aged for three years...
It feels like... a bit of a waste.
I have flasks of celadon, ancient wood, silver—any are better than his old one.
It's just old Jade City work, not valuable.
But I saw "Ming" on it. Does that mean "Ming" made it personally?
Anyway, it's too old. He comes here every year. The drink deserves a better flask.
Ziyi, who sells fruit drinks, says Mr. Bai He always uses an old flask to buy drinks. Ziyi hopes you can convince him to get a new flask that suits his heroic image.
Mr. Bai He? Yes, he was here just now.
Like always, sitting there and drinking quietly.
He used to come every year?
He used to come every year?
Yes, I thought he was here to learn about angling, but he only came once a year.
Anglers need to practice every day. So, I'm sure he has other reasons for being here.
Besides, I don't like chit-chatting while angling. It scares the fish off.
The Angler Hao Qi notices that Mr. Bai He comes to the pier every year on this day and spends the whole day sitting quietly by himself.
He probably had things to do. Usually, he stays at the pier all day.
I see... He's not here now. Better bring my findings to Meng Feng.
I see... He's not here now. Better bring my findings to Meng Feng.
When people got off the ship, he just got up and left.
Never. He seemed lost in his own thoughts. I didn't want to bother him.
Hao Qi says that Mr. Bai He, who usually sits alone at the pier all day, suddenly stood up and left today after a ship docked here.
The spotlight is going to fall on the head trainer—Mr. Bai He!
Well, here's my first question: How much do you know about him?
He's young, but he's as skilled as the top seniors in Martial Arts.
That's why I want to write about him.
You seem very interested. Glad you're on my team!
Mr. Bai He shows up in Springbrook Plains on one specific day each year, no miss.
What is he doing? A secret mission? That's what I want to know.
Today is that day. Let's find out what he's up to!
I wish it were more eye-catching, since my job is to uncover amazing stories.
I tried. None would talk. Who knows what they are hiding...
Well, looks like we're left with no choice but to rely on ourselves.
From my info, Bai He probably went to the harbor today.
I'll keep watch here. Go find Si Qi at the harbor—she's a reliable source.
I'll let you handle the investigation your way. Just don't let Bai He notice you!
Why does he rarely show up?
Why not ask the people at He & Ming's Training Hall?
The people at He & Ming's Training Hall don't know about this?
Because Mr. Bai He rarely shows up in public, few in Jixia have witnessed him in any fight.
Mr. Bai He is actually one of the top names on the list of "Jixia's Most Mysterious People."
Many years have passed since the war that ravaged Jixia.
This statue was built for the fallen hero. Now it finally sees the light...
The Dawnsong army sent two groups. One attacked Jixia directly.
With defeat close, a hero named Everspring turned the tide.
He stopped Dawnsong's advance, giving Jixia time to respond.
He rallied troops in Old Citadel and helped people escape.
At the end, he led the monster into the Underhall, and then the two vanished.
That's where the Sanctifier chose the Sanctified. Everspring asked to seal its entrance.
The key was split in two and hidden where the mural shows.
If you want the full truth, find the key and enter the Underhall.
The other landed at Springbrook Plains to launch a surprise raid.
His comrades hid the key to make sure the monster would never return.
Those are from the war. It's a sensitive topic in Jixia.
Some of it's in the academy records, but not everything...
Records focus on major events, but they often overlook individual people.
True. One person's story is usually too small to record.
True. One person's story is usually too small to record.
So what should we do now?
So what should we do now?
All the keys to the mystery lie within <001>the mural on Littoral Cave</>.
We'll meet again once you've found the answers in the mural.
The <001>Springbrook War Chronicle</>, passed down by my ancestors, includes many battle stories.
I made a copy, which contains some clues.
Follow the clues to discover how the battle ended, and the mystery will be solved.
I've put all my research and notes in this copy.
Student? Are you interested in the war at Springbrook Plains?
Well, tell me, what stands out to you most in Springbrook Plains?
But I want to make sure their stories are not forgotten.

But why are you always turned over on your back?
Hah, I'm old. My legs are not what they were.
You again, tortoise. What do you want this time?
You again, tortoise. What do you want this time?
Hey there, my kind young friend.
You really think I'll fall for your old trick again? Not happening.
You really think I'll fall for your old trick again? Not happening.

The old tortoise asks for your help again, promising a unique treasure in return. When you refuse, it admits that everything before was planned as tests. It says you are lucky to have met it and even luckier to have passed all its tests, and promises there will be no more tricks. Curious about what it will do next, you decide to help.
Go on then. I look forward to your return with the treasure.
I once got lost and nearly got swallowed by a big fish, but a man saved me with an invisible line.
He saved me, healed me, and fed me. I owe him my life.
Haha, he was more than a famous hero.
With just a wave of his hand, he could change the fate of the whole land.
A story that sounds taller than ever.
A story that sounds taller than ever.
You still don't trust me. I swear, I never lie about him.
As the war ends and peace returns, history awakens from sleep.
The treasures I'm telling you are lost pieces from long ago.
If you're willing to help, you can keep everything, and I'll tell you a story no one else knows.
Do not worry. No more lies this time.
I've confirmed the treasure is in the lake behind me. I'm sure you'll find it.
Well, I'll go have a look.
Well, I'll go have a look.
This sounds more serious than before.
This sounds more serious than before.

When the tortoise was young, a mysterious man used an invisible line to save it. That man grew up to be a famous, history-making hero. Now the tortoise says the secret treasure is a valuable fragment hidden in the pond behind it. Find it, and you can keep it and uncover an old story.
The stone lifted the darkness and helped the tortoise speak human language.
It was once part of his legendary staff.
People admired his power and came to Jixia.
One day, his pet tortoise accidentally touched the stone.
After you give the tortoise the Sorcery Gem, it tells an ancient story: a stone once sat atop a great man's staff, and his pet tortoise touched it and gained the power to speak.
One day, the little turtle he kept at the bottom of the tank accidentally touched this stone that everyone envied...
zh_text: 一日，他饲养在缸底的小乌龟，无意间触碰到了这块众人艳羡的石头……
source_text: 一日，他饲养在缸底的小乌龟，无意间触碰到了这块众人艳羡的石头……
official_target_text: One day, the little turtle he kept at the bottom of the tank accidentally touched this stone that everyone envied...
official_en_text: One day, the little turtle he kept at the bottom of the tank accidentally touched this stone that everyone envied...

text: So you must know the owner of this stone well.
So you must know the owner of this stone well.
Of course. We lived together in the mountain cave for decades.
You're out now, and you've learned how to deceive others.
You're out now, and you've learned how to deceive others.
It's a wooden stick. You can find it in a mountain cave behind me.
Just follow the mountain path and you'll find it.
I had to find ways to pass the long years, you know. You'll get it someday.
Alright, what does it look like?
Alright, what does it look like?
He talked about his dreams each day. I felt so bored and wanted to see the world.
That stone needs something else to become a staff. Can you help me find it?
I'm more of a companion than just a pet.
Back then, the outside world was all new to me.
The tortoise from the story is right in front of you. It asks you to enter a cave and find a wooden stick that can be joined with the Sorcery Gem to form a staff.
That's not the point. I need you to do me a favor.
There's a sword in the lake up ahead. Can you retrieve it for me?
I know you're curious, but don't ask why it's there or why I won't do it myself.
Just tell me if you'll help, alright?
I don't want to get my clothes wet.
A Mechanoid calls to you and asks you to retrieve a sword from the lake.
A talking mechanical being stops you and asks for your help to retrieve a sword that fell into the lake.
zh_text: 一个会说话的机关人叫住你，拜托你帮他把落到湖里剑找回来。
source_text: 一个会说话的机关人叫住你，拜托你帮他把落到湖里剑找回来。
official_target_text: A talking mechanical being stops you and asks for your help to retrieve a sword that fell into the lake.
official_en_text: A talking mechanical being stops you and asks for your help to retrieve a sword that fell into the lake.

text: Got it. Leave it to me.
official_target_text: Got it. Leave it to me.
official_en_text: Got it. Leave it to me.

text: Got it. Leave it to me.
official_target_text: Got it. Leave it to me.
official_en_text: Got it. Leave it to me.

text: Thanks, but who are you, and why did you bring it here?
I told others not to help. All that effort was wasted.
At first, I thought so. But after meeting Master Mozi, I'm not sure.
Master Mozi looks exactly like a Mechanoid.
Rumor says he either wears the armor or controls the Mechanoid remotely.
So I wondered if Mek might be doing the same thing.
Mek has always been very caring about me.
Well, I failed this time, but I'm not giving up.
Of course! Don't underestimate my resolve!
Wait, look at the Pearlized Tree! I've got a new idea!
Meet me by the tree after sunset!
I threw the sword into the lake, hoping Mek would remove his armor to find it.
He never removes his armor, and I thought he couldn't wear it in water.
So I asked him to find my sword, but things didn't go as planned.
He says he owes me, but I don't remember helping him.
You saw him, right? He finds it hard to socialize or make friends.
He never removes his armor and risks a lot with his research.
Everyone avoids him, and he has no real friends.
Shouldn't we be honest and show who we really are?
Shouldn't we be honest and show who we really are?
I would like to help him.
Seems one-sided, but it's better than doing nothing.
I'll think of a way to help him leave that armor behind!

When you return the sword to Yoling, she tells you she threw it into the lake on purpose to make Mek dive in and get it. She wanted to force him out of his armor to see what he really looks like. Since her plan didn't work, Yoling asks you to come back after sunset—she already has another idea.
Hey, you again? Whatever. Stay with me here and wait.
An air bubble... I can breathe now.
An air bubble... I can breathe now.
This is my unique Sorcery ability. No one else knows it.
Your voice could be sent directly to my bubble. Pretty cool, right?
Why don't you just go up?
Why don't you just go up?
This prank is way too much.
This prank is way too much.
If you want to see Mek's face, you gotta stay with me!
You get oxygen down here and can talk inside the bubble.
This is part of my plan.
I wanted Mek to climb the tree, but he did it with his armor on.
But what if I fall into the water?
I will stay here for a while.
You're right... I need to apologize to him after this.
At first, I just wanted the senior to take off his gear and climb a tree, but it seems his mechanical skills have improved again.
zh_text: 一开始只是想让学长脱下装备爬树，可他机关术好像又进步了。
source_text: 一开始只是想让学长脱下装备爬树，可他机关术好像又进步了。
official_target_text: At first, I just wanted the senior to take off his gear and climb a tree, but it seems his mechanical skills have improved again.
official_en_text: At first, I just wanted the senior to take off his gear and climb a tree, but it seems his mechanical skills have improved again.

text: What a nuisance... What are they up to?
I wanted you to take off your armor...
Come see me at the academy.
I've got medicine for your cold.
Why is it taking them so long...
By the way, I'm Mek, a student from the School of Mechcraft.
Which school are you from? I'll repay the favor when I can.
It belongs to a clumsy junior student.
Since you found it, return it to her. She's across the lake.
You must be new here. At Jixia, students can take classes from different schools.
But most students pick one main focus: Mechcraft, Sorcery, or Martial Arts.
If you help, do it fully. Plus, I'm busy.
In Jixia, you'll get all sorts of requests. You'll get used to it.
But no worries, I won't make you work for free.
The "Mechanoid" is called Mek. He asks you to help return the sword to its owner.
It's you! Yoling fell into the water. She needs help!
She insisted on showing me something on the tree, but then slipped and fell into the water.
I thought she could swim... Anyway, please check on her.
Yoling tried to demonstrate something and fell into the water. Mek, worried, asks you to dive in and rescue her.
Got it. Leave it to me.
official_target_text: Got it. Leave it to me.
official_en_text: Got it. Leave it to me.

text: Now it's time for the next step.
A stone tablet. What's written on it?
A stone tablet. What's written on it?
How do I get into Littoral Cave...? Is this treasure going to remain hidden forever?
That seal was powerful. The inscription tells a story.
There was a remarkable civilization with extraordinary people.
But they were attacked and had to leave their home.
They traveled a long way to get here, and then settled down.
The First Site is along the east coast. The treasure is hidden in the fish's maw. Have you heard of this legend?
Literally speaking, there should be a hidden treasure in the place where Jixia was first founded.
The fish float above the sea, east of the Jixia coast. There lies a place shaped like a fish that no one has ever successfully set foot in—the Littoral Cave.
Besides, my research suggests Littoral Cave was left behind by someone important.
Don't you think there'll be treasures in there that can't be found anywhere else?
Don't lose hope! Let's find a way in together.
Don't lose hope! Let's find a way in together.
The key to this legend lies in the second half: 'The treasure is in the fish's maw.' 'Fish's maw' might have some connection to the 'place of origin.'
Let me introduce myself. My name is Ling Yuan. I study the history of Jixia.
This legend was recorded in a note left by my father.
But you don't know how to get into Littoral Cave.
But you don't know how to get into Littoral Cave.
Sigh, indeed... The entrance to Littoral Cave is guarded by a powerful seal.
Great! I've been here trying to figure out how to get in.
I haven't looked around the entrance yet. Mind checking it out for me?
How do I get into Littoral Cave...? Is this treasure going to remain hidden forever?
A powerful seal keeps Seeker Ling Yuan out of a cave. He asks you to help find a way inside.
East coast... Fish... It must be Littoral Cave. But no one has entered it.

I've got to tell Ling Yuan what it says. Perhaps he'll know how to break the seal.
The Sanctifier created Littoral Cave. The scroll holds the secret to gain entry.
The Sorcery power serves as the key. Things come and go. Fate has its way.
Your father's note! Why not try that?
Your father's note! Why not try that?
The scroll holds the secret to gain entry. What does this refer to?
That makes sense! I've always felt like there's something ancient and mystical about it!

Twilight, twilight, into the depth, where courage finds its breath.

In the nameless lake, the fish talisman hides. Set it on the statue, and the path then guides. This part is important.

But where is the nameless lake?

Alright, I'll go take a look over there. You keep an eye out here.

Was your father also a Seeker?
It doesn't matter. Littoral Cave is where an important person lived. It must be full of treasures.
True! And treasure's what we seek!
True! And treasure's what we seek!
There are two lakes nearby: the Pearlized Lake, and the <001>small lake behind the statue</>.
We might have to dive in to find the fish talisman.
We have to make a thorough search underwater.

This is some sort of ancient script! Good thing I studied a bit of it before.

Alright, I won't push you further.

How could someone with a sunny disposition like his be ever clouded?

With my encouragement, he wrote that famous poem and awakened his latent bloodline powers.

Yes. Everyone has a star above. Our fates are written in the sky.
Astrology is deep, and I'm dedicating my life to unlocking its secrets.
The tower in the distance... I'm sure you know about it.
It's the symbol of Jixia. An inspiration to every student here.

The Astrologer points out the beautiful views around Jixia and suggests you might one day find yourself among the stars. She feels it is a special gift from the stars that a friend has come to join her for stargazing on the mountain tonight.
Yes. It's my favorite spot. My stargazing device and notes are still here.
Is this the stargazing spot mentioned on the stone tablet?
Is this the stargazing spot mentioned on the stone tablet?
Dawn is upon us. Look at the mountains in the east.
Jixia is truly stunning. The sunrise is the most majestic sight here.
When sunlight breaks the mist, it feels like time freezes.
Even with clouds, the sun's rays shine through.
It climbs over the peaks. I can't stop staring.
Careful, you might hurt your eyes.
Careful, you might hurt your eyes.
The sun's up. I'll head back to camp and record my observations.
Thank you for sharing the stars and Jixia's beauty with me.
Thank you for sharing the stars and Jixia's beauty with me.

The sun rises, the moon sets—another day begins. Time for breakfast!
I've got some food for you. Thanks for keeping me company tonight.
In this moment, what is the sight you wish to remember most?

They gaze steadfastly in the right direction, illuminating your past and future... Perhaps the path forward is also the way home.
Jixia at dawn? The path of life is as complex as a riddle; only the steadfast and sharp-witted can perceive the secrets of flowing fate.
Jixia is a land of challenges and chances. If riddles are your calling, may you solve them all and greet a dazzling dawn.
The tower stands firm upon the earth, its light parting the darkness like a curtain, just as the conviction in your heart will always light the path ahead...
May the power of fate bless you. May your firm conviction carry you through the dense fog to the top of the tower, where you may look down upon the future that is yours.

Is this tree really that amazing?
Is this tree really that amazing?
Try it! Put down a Wish Coin, close your eyes, make a wish, and receive your boon.

Hey, no great treasures come to those who play it safe!
Guess I should search for more generous—or kinder—people...
F-farewell then! May we meet again!
Since you know Mr. Tortoise, I'll make an exception and give you some.
To make a wish, you need a Wish Coin. A stranger offers to sell you some.
A real boon? That's weird... A chest appeared after I wished at the tree.
A real boon? That's weird... A chest appeared after I wished under the tree.
Actually, it was the River Sprites.
Mr. Tortoise didn't know, so he thought the tree granted wishes.
Now I understand, but the chest had nothing useful.
Now I understand, but the chest had nothing useful.
Ha! River Sprites have their rules about what counts as treasure.

Hey, no great treasures come to those who play it safe!

You look the same and sound the same!

How dare you show up again, you liar!
How dare you show up again, you liar!
What are you saying? We've just met for the first time.

Most tortoises are honest, but a few cheats ruin our name.
Another tortoise? You're the real liar here!
Another tortoise? You're the real liar here!
I always tell the truth. I've never lied once.
I'm famous for my honesty among tortoises.
Oh, I get it. You must've met another tortoise.
The tortoise insists that the scammer must be another tortoise.
He only cared about one thing.
On a rainy day, I was lying on my back, just like today.
Like you, he put me upright, studied my shell, and then decided to look for the Fragments.
So he did it because of you?
So he did it because of you?
I didn't say that. He just sat near that tree and thought deeply.
Hah, not much at all. It just reminded me of the past.

Your kindness reminds me of Jixia's number one genius...

At Primaera's top academy, anyone could become a star.
And this one outshines all the geniuses.
Jixia's most talented graduate. Master Fuzi's heir.
To repay your kindness, I'll share a secret that can make your wishes come true...
Perhaps you will become a world-renowned hero like him, too.
Sounds like Kongming. Novar has mentioned him a lot.
Sounds like Kongming. Novar has mentioned him a lot.
He was always top of the class—admired by all. Envy never touched him.
To find the cradle of civilization, of course. The Fragments of the Heavenly Scrolls.
I inspired him to explore and seek out civilization's origins.
Is this related to the secret?

text: I think it's the sword my ancestor always carried.
He defended his homeland against invaders for years until he died...
I heard most battles happened here, so I often search for my ancestor's traces.
The gem started glowing as I was nearby, and Yun led me here...
The sword's energy matches the gem's. It must be his!
Strange. I've never seen this sword here before. Was it buried here all along?

That's just like the records! He faced every danger without fear—a true hero!
I see... I never knew my ancestor had such a story.
So... what do you make of him?
He fought to the end. He was a hero.
A hero...? You're right. I won't dishonor his memory. I'll continue to protect this place. We'll meet again.
He was just an ordinary man.
Perhaps so. Thank you for uncovering the truth, but I'd like some time alone now. We'll meet again.
The truth is... he abandoned the fight.
No! That's only your guess. It's not true.
I will find out what really happened. And then... Yun? Where are you?
I had a feeling she wouldn't take it well...
I had a feeling she wouldn't take it well...

But he didn't make it and passed away here.

So you followed Yun and got here?
So you followed Yun and got here?
I'm Tian Lyn, a Seeker. This is Yun, my Aershroud.
That glowing gem Yun wears belonged to my ancestor.
Years ago, a war broke out in Jixia. My ancestor fought to protect his pregnant wife.
Exactly. This sword looks just like the one described in the records.
Oh! That must have been my ancestor! What did he say?
He fought fearlessly against Dawnsong, even against the giant Mechanoid.

He was badly hurt and knew he wouldn't survive, so he left the battle to see his wife.

Tian Lyn, the owner of the Aershroud, tracks the sword here because it resonates. She believes it once belonged to her ancestor, a hero who defended Jixia to protect his wife. But you reveal a different story: her ancestor, badly wounded, left the army to search for his wife. Tian Lyn thanks you for finding the sword, and this new information makes her question what she believed.
I grew up alone. Yun and my ancestor's stories got me this far...
I'm going to find out what really happened to him.
One moment he's saying the sky is blue and the flowers are pretty, the next he's praising my cooking and knife skills—I have no idea what he's thinking.

I'm great at roasting. It locks in all the flavors!
You know the saying, 'you can roast anything'? I get a kick out of toasting all the odd and wild stuff students bring me!
Don't you think his fireworks research and my culinary experiments are similar?
Mix various elements to craft something extraordinary. My cuisine delights the palate, and the fireworks soothe the soul.
So, I kind of see him as a kindred spirit.
Despite his fiery temper, he really means well.
If you ever find interesting ingredients, come and find me! I'll cook them for you for free!
This is Susu's Eatery, a restaurant at the Upstream Camp.
Feel free to ask me anything!
It's you, haven't seen you in a while. How have you been lately?
It's been a while. What would you like to eat?
Feel free to ask me anything!

Since the start of the Void Dream Performance, Xingmang has been busy with the tournament and hasn't had a moment to rest, so she has had less time to come to the Firearm Workshop.
Now that he has been entrusted with this critical task as Acting Dean, the burden on his shoulders is even heavier.
It's just that with the fireworks gone from the camp, the night feels so quiet.
If you ever find interesting ingredients, come and find me! I'll cook them for you for free!
Susu's secret recipe makes the grilled meat smell amazing!
That big guy has been mumbling to himself about forming another Team of Stars like Novar.
You always brag that your Mechcraft is superior to Sun Bin's, so why not join?
No thanks, I'd rather stay in the school and work on my new Mechcrafts.
Well, isn't your Sorcery Technique better than Shye's? Go ahead if you're so inclined.
The stars told me that I would encounter a wanderer today. You appeared short after I sat down.
Never seen you here around the Upstream Camp. I assume you are the new student Novar brought here, right?
It's not that... Novar's too loud for anyone to miss it.
What else is on your mind?
Yeah. You're not from Jixia, but you know your power well.
I'm just an ordinary Astrologer. Once you enroll, you'll understand. You can come find me then.
Before we part ways, here's a divination for you.
The stars tell me you're facing a challenge, but you can pull it off.
Congratulations, I knew you could pass the exam!
What do you want to know this time?
What else is on your mind?
What will I go through next?
Well... let me see. The stars tell me that you might encounter something with the size of a mountain.
Also, you will meet some special people and uncover things from the past.
It seems dangerous. Do take care of yourself.
Where can I find good food?
Huh... The stars tell me your chance is imminent.
Farewell. May the stars guide your way.
You're right here at Susu's Eatery, and you're asking that?
Anyway, you can try your luck over the Springpool Wetlands.
See Shye's notice over there? You'll become wealthy by visiting her... I'm kidding.
Oh, it's been a long time. What brings you to the Upstream Camp this time?
What else is on your mind?
You're always so curious about the future.
There's something interesting about you. Also, a secret is about to be revealed in Jixia.
Farewell. May the stars guide your way.
Again? It's simple. In Jixia, anything forbidden by the school rules can make you rich.
However, the stars told me that wealth wouldn't be a problem for you.
The diviner is in Frostcloud Town.
Novar recruited the Team of Stars here by promoting himself. I can do the same!
I'm taller and louder than him. Surely more people will join me for a challenge against Sundering Horns.
How dare you... You're just trying to push the price down!
Nonsense! You sell junk and trick customers!
Everyone! This old man harasses a student and demands crazy prices!
This crafty student is trying to scam the old man with smooth talk!
I don't have enough Ringild to buy them all...
The little Mechanoid is so cute! I'm tempted!
Check out Team of Stars Mechanoid. I put a lot of effort into this!
Let the Team of Stars' voice wake you up and support you through your trials.
It's amazing, but on second thought, not very useful.
The Sorcery stone absorbs sunlight to light up your night.
The Sorcery fan blows warm air in summer and cool air in winter.
Fantastic items to help you master Sorcery. Come take a look!
His goods look poor and suspicious. My offer is fair.
But there are real treasures. With me, they won't be wasted.
If you hadn't pointed it out, he would have continued acting that way.
Fate brought us together. Here's a small gift.
I feel like I got scammed.
I'm selling real treasures. The price is high, but he won't be disappointed.
Thanks for speaking up for me, buddy!
He's clearly devaluing my goods to pay less!
Fine, I'll add a bit more for all of them.
Ask around. My reputation speaks for itself at Upstream Camp!
Stop bragging. Seekers' treasures? They're just strange ores and cracked jars.
This ore is ideal for making a powerful weapon. This jar contains an amazing healing medicine.
You're clueless! Shye and I spent a year scouring Springbrook Plains for these!
They look like trash. Give me a discount and I'll buy them all as a favor.
It's just roadside junk you picked up.
Alright, I'll take it all, but we still need to discuss the price.
See? Your fellow student agrees with me.
That's not true. You can't ask someone who has never been to Upstream Camp.
That's unfair! Don't be such a bully!
Come and take a look! Treasures found by Seekers!
I'll ask. Could you tell us what you think?
Isn't it the training dummy I usually use?
Check out this training dummy—the same model Novar uses!
It'll definitely boost your Martial Arts skills!
The bonfire is the heart of Upstream Camp!
Upstream Camp is the first stop for every new student.
All who come to Jixia, admitted or not, toss Aerux scraps into the bonfire.
The scraps burn brighter, forming the Aerux Bonfire of Upstream Camp.
Swimming upstream is hard, but if you keep going, your dream will come true.
Maybe that's why the camp has that name: to remind students why they came.
I clear the ashes every day so it stays lit each night.
Each night the bonfire helps students at Springbrook Plains find their way back to camp.
Aerux is abundant in Jixia, but turning it into a bonfire is hard.
Well, Mr. Blazen's fireworks are extremely popular. Everyone looks forward to them during the bonfire party!
Every time I see his fireworks, I feel my energy coming back.
Mr. Blazen would be glad to hear your praise.
Mr. Blazen would be glad to hear your praise.
I admire him, but he's too strict. Don't tell him I said that.
See you later. Don't miss the Bonfire Party at night!
Don't miss the Bonfire Party at night!
I like Mr. Blazen's fireworks so much!
Don't miss the Bonfire Party at night!
You must come to the bonfire party!

text: I was gathering herbs there when a group of Saepes ambushed me. I barely escaped.
You're right. Will you come with me and watch my back next time?
We're good friends, right? Give me a discount, alright?
That's their territory. Don't go there alone.
Animals around Springpool Wetlands have been acting odd lately...
I'm starting training now so I can join the School of Martial Arts someday!
I hoped she'd help, but she was tidying herself by the water, and I was badly beaten.
You should've trained to get stronger. Well, I just met a terrible student from the School of Mechcraft.
His modified Moocart was fast, but it fell apart halfway and left me bruised.
Minor flaws are normal. Students from the School of Martial Arts are the real trouble.
I was ambushed by Saepes in the Springpool Wetlands, and I saw a student from the School of Sorcery.
I was gathering herbs when they attracted a monster that chased us all the way.
People rarely visit the northern Springbrook Plains. Exotic creatures might live there.
Hunters say a rare small creature called Cloudlet lives here.
It appears in the morning sunlight and often rests beneath a leafy tree.
Such a mystical creature isn't easily caught by normal predators.
People say it brings good luck and grants wishes. If I caught it, maybe my exam...
Wait, stop there. Who told you that? A storyteller?
Don't even blink, kids. Amazing, isn't it?
If you're interested, learn Sorcery when you grow up!
Why read gossip instead of recipes?
I need inspiration for new dishes!
Watching Jixia students is the best part of being an Intelligencer.
Calm down, the fireworks will start in a moment.
Who's going to set off the fireworks today?
I can stand on one foot all night long!
If you can do that, I'll cover your meals for a month!
Can we just enjoy the fireworks?
Nowhere better to spend the night than by the campfire.
Wonder what kind of fireworks we'll see tonight?
When are the fireworks going off?
When will we see the fireworks?
Mayene said she found some amazing military strategy book in Navenia!
Yeah, she's our senior. Went to Navenia after graduation. Now she sends us all the cool stuff from there.
I can't wait to see their take on military tactics!
Aww, are you looking so hard because you miss her?
A military strategy book from Navenia?
Pretty cool, right? I can't wait to see their take on military tactics!
Mayene's the best. She sends us all the cool stuff from Navenia.
Aww, are you looking so hard because you miss her?
Back at Upstream Camp, this time there's serious business to take care of!
Yeah, that's me. Seems like the new students did their homework.
Power comes at a price. Due to an overload, the Apocalyptor is being repaired by Mr. Blazen.
The Apocalyptor's structure differs from other cannons. It uses a unique gunpowder blend and packs double the power. Repairing it costs more effort.
In Jixia, only Luban and Mr. Blazen can repair it properly.
What are you doing in Springbrook Plains?
The Student Affairs Committee reported multiple beast attacks causing injuries in Springbrook Plains. I'm here to handle it.
The observatory in Springpool Wetlands has found a giant Saepes.
A normal Saepes is fine, but this one is humongous and covered in nettles, very aggressive.
If it damages the observatory, our routine upkeep will be a hassle!
It's not a big deal! Once my Apocalyptor is repaired, one shot and the problem will be solved.
You're not thinking of dealing with that Saepes by yourself, are you?
Good, I see the passion of youth in you!
But remember, if you can't beat it, just retreat.
As seniors, we'll always back you up in Jixia.
That's right, let us seniors handle it.
Farewell. Make the most of it before you go to the academy!
This time, I'm at Upstream Camp not as the Team of Stars' legendary marksman, but as Jixia Academy's Department of Discipline representative.
It's a student organization within the Student Affairs Committee, tasked with upholding academic integrity, discipline, and safety. You'll learn more soon.

text: Mr. Blazen, I must say, our annual welcome fireworks are still too tame.

So, art over power? Should I entertain the enemy with fireworks instead of cannons on the battlefield?
You're impossible. Always fixated on using the Apocalyptor to blow things up!
Humph! I don't even want to talk to you.

Cannons are meant to unleash their greatest power!
Just wait and see. I'll prove myself.

Got it. Let's see how it goes!

Got it. Let's see how it goes!

Curious about the result? I'll reveal it later.

Not impressed. I could do better!
They were evenly matched, and the outcome was decided by the narrowest of margins. It was an exciting battle.
If you're interested, stay tuned for more arm-wrestling matches!
Anything else you want to know?

After all, the clash of strength is part of the charm of Martial Arts.
I'll let you in on a secret: the first arm-wrestling champion was Fuzi!
See you around. Feel free to come back and watch more arm-wrestling matches!

Well, it's obvious. Nora, as a senior, had the upper hand in Martial Arts skills.
Anything else you'd like to know?
Interested in arm wrestling? Let's watch it together.
It's your turn to shine, Mountain Lifter!
Show these new students the true spirit of Martial Arts!
Colossal Wrist, beat them like you did me!
See those terrifying muscles under Mountain Lifter's clothes?
Who wouldn't want muscles like that?
Can you see that? Colossal Wrist is incredibly skilled.
Mountain Lifter has never lost an arm-wrestling match.
Don't believe me? As Martial Artists, we let our strength speak for itself. You'll see soon enough.
Let's witness Colossal Wrist using minor force to achieve great effects.
Leaving already? It's getting to the best part!
You'll see that in the face of absolute strength, all techniques are futile!
Today, I'm going to defeat you with my honed skills!

If you have any questions, let's discuss them.
The School of Mechcraft will teach everyone how to reshape the world by using Aerflow to weave Aersilk and build creations.
But the Academy's Cloud-Weaving looms have been suspended recently, and cloud silk production has decreased.
When developing mechanisms, we must assess the situation and make more use of alternative materials.
Ah, you mean these various forms of Mechcraft? Most of them are created by the students.
Perhaps they're not perfect in terms of functionality, but we encourage students to innovate.
The many practical and magical Mechcraft devices you see at Jixia were born like this!
When it comes to Mozi's Mechcraft, you could discuss it endlessly for days on end.
The Mechcraft Armor that covers his entire body alone contains enough technological intricacies to warrant further study!
When Master Mozi was still at Jixia, he often came to the Mechanism Academy to give lectures. If one could learn even a little bit, it would be infinitely useful in the field of mechanism arts!
Of course, my teaching assistant classes are also very popular with junior students, ranking in the top twenty of the most popular course list...

It's just that recently, he has resolutely taken on the responsibility of the Cloud Silkworms and can no longer spare the time to teach us.

You can ask me anything about the Way of Martial Arts.
About the School of Martial Arts.
We're flexible as silk, resilient as cocoons, and steadfast as roots! Here, we train to align mind and body.
We focus not only on physical training but also on refining our character, striving for balance in both body and mind.
As far as I know, Master was injured in the recent accident during the Void Dream Performance and is on leave to recover.
Although many students want to avenge the Master, I have always advised them not to act on impulse.
When the Master recovers and returns, I hope he sees a well-ordered Jixia Academy.
Goodbye, you're welcome to come discuss things with me again if needed.

So you passed the entrance exam, congrats!
When you arrive at the academy, be sure to check out the School of Martial Arts!
Welcome to the Martial Arts family!
How do you like the School of Martial Arts? Pretty impressive, huh?
Hey, I remember you, you are the talented student.

If I catch whoever is invading Jixia, I'll make them taste a fist the size of a sandbag!

Under his guidance, many students discovered their ways in Martial Arts.

I knew the exam was no challenge to you.
Oh, it's been a long time since I've seen you.
Surrounded by a good aura, it seems everything has been going well for you lately.
I heard you passed the exam. How's everything going?

We heard about your ruckus in Seclusion City. If you're hurt, we Herbalists are here to help.

Ah... finally back to normal. Gotta figure out a way to control the duration. Being a Croaky is murder on my lower back...
Good thing we had your potion, or the town would've been toast.
Good thing we had your potion, or the town would've been toast.

Seems like they're close. Since Croakus isn't bad, maybe Vesper... isn't a bad person either.
Croak! Oh, good, you understood! We meet again, my friend.
It's me, Ye Da! I made this special Croaky Tonic. Turns you into a Croaky. Pretty cool, huh?
You're really into this Croaky thing...
You know me. But this potion is no simple brew, and I've run out. Next time, perhaps—you'll get to spend a whole day as a Croaky!
Sounds amazing! Let me try it!
Ah, well... that might have to wait. It's a complicated potion, and I just drank the last of it.
Wait, is that what I just drank...?
Nope, that's the older version. It only lets you understand their language, not become a Croaky. I'll save you some next time.
So... you just want to show off your new look?
So... you just want to show off your new look?

That's why I went undercover! Turns out they meet in secret every night.
...Don't tell me they're plotting to drive out humans again?
...Don't tell me they're plotting to drive out humans again?
I think I know where this is going...
I think I know where this is going...
Knew you'd be interested. Tonight, east of Frostcloud Town, under the tree. Let's get to the bottom of this.

text: Since you saved Bowie... I'll let you go this time. But if you ever bother Vesper again, you'll answer to me!
Speaking of Vesper... how did you know him?
Speaking of Vesper... how did you know him?
Hmph! It was an alliance of justice!
Not long ago, a bully was picking on a kid in Hermitage.
I was about to step in when this red-haired kid popped up and—bam! Kicked the guy down!
And we fought side-by-side to protect the peace of the village. Croak!
Later, I found out he was the descendant of an ancient hero. But people bullied him for his strange powers, and he ended up here...
Never thought he had such a past... Where is he now?
Never thought he had such a past... Where is he now?
I don't croak... He said he had to do something dangerous and couldn't take me along. But whatever it is, I know it's for justice! Croak!
Vesper said... everyone outside Hermitage forgot history. They were the bad guys who drove the hero away...
But... you don't seem bad. If he runs into trouble out there, I hope you'll lend him a hand.
Guess we're friends now. If you're ever in a bind, just drop my name. The boys will know to show some respect.
Alright, Croakies! The operation's off! But I'm a Croaky of my word. Follow me and croak croak... Cuh-croak!
Can't understand a word... But I guess he's still worried about Vesper.
Can't understand a word... But I guess he's still worried about Vesper.

Uh... should we stop this? Looks like we need to find those "secret weapons."

We need to take it out from a distance.
We need to take it out from a distance.

Ugh, it reeks... What is that smell?

A long time ago, a bunch of bad guys invaded this land. There were fires, battles... and we Croakies suffered! Croak!
Croak, I thought there'd be snacks. What's with all the talky?
I don't croak... My tummy's croaking...
...But a hero appeared, and brought peace back to the land!
After the war, the hero settled down here and helped us rebuild our homes.
But what about the humans now? Ungrateful! They've forgotten the hero, and us!
They treat us like tools, and cut back on our snacks! It's time to take back what's rightfully ours!
We will punish them... with our secret weapon! Croak!
And all of the town's snacks will be ours! Croak!
Cakes, fruit, candied treats! And... my private stash of chips!
...A hero has appeared, saving the Guguas from fire and water, and peace has returned to the land!
zh_text: ……勇者现世，救咕呱于水火中，土地重回安宁！

A Croaky Potion. It lets you understand their language.

Oh no! Why is there a Croaky trapped inside?!

In Peony's cultivation garden... looking for Peony?
In Peony's cultivation garden... looking for Peony?
To tell you the truth, this garden is so messy that even she, the owner, gets lost in it...
If we don't find her... this student might be in danger!
Finally found the medicine, I need to get back quickly...
Peony? How did you get pinned under here? Are you alright?
Peony? How did you get pinned under here? Are you alright?
Pressed? I wasn't pressed, I just couldn't get out. Just now, while looking for medicine, I gave it a light pull...
Boom! Everything collapsed! But I'm fine, I just need to get out quickly...
Stay still. I'll clear away this debris so you can get out.
Stay still. I'll clear away this debris so you can get out.
Dongling... she, she's not making a sound anymore...
I'm alive! The pain is gone! Thank you so much! I almost went to see my great-grandmother...
You should thank them too. If it were just me, I might not have made it in time.
Thank you, Shaoyao, thank you all! Well... I'm heading back now!
Peony, maybe you should tidy up the nursery...
Coming! I still have a prescription to mix, I'll clean up once I'm done!
Peony, do you remember telling me you were troubled... about the nursery business...
Hmm, I remember. That's why I've been researching new prescriptions lately!
Sigh... You were able to learn such complex Baicao studies, why can't you understand this...
You can tell too, right, student?
No, it's not! Medicine is supposed to be bitter! What are you talking about!
It's because the garden is too messy... It's very inconvenient for everyone to buy medicine and see a doctor...
Because the garden is a mess?
Yeah! Shaoyao, the nursery is so chaotic now that it's hurting business. What do you think?
Your pharmaceutical skills are excellent and the prices are reasonable, but you're only a backup choice for the students.
It's precisely because it's so messy here that even if you can find things according to your own habits, it still takes a lot of time.
Like Dongling, for instance, who has been enduring the pain just waiting for you to return...
Like Dongling, for instance, who has been enduring the pain just waiting for you to return...
So, without realizing it, have I been 'making things difficult' for the customers who come to the shop...
Since that's the case, why not...
Let's tidy up the garden again!
Classmate, you always have good ideas when repairing the dorms, I'm sure you can do it this time too!
Then, as the 'Master of the Garden,' I officially invite you two to renovate this nursery! Please!
Shaoyao has always been the one quietly helping everyone... So, I want to help Shaoyao too.
I'm satisfied! Inspection complete! Thank you both.
Then, please accept my special thanks. Thank you, most reliable Qizai!
