(Should I team up with him in the future and help solve all sorts of architectural problems?)
(You're smiling even wider, Xiao Qizai. So you were plotting against me?)
(You're smiling even wider, Xiao Qizai. So you were plotting against me?)
(Qi Zai asks repeatedly whether to team up with him to practice the 'Way of Architecture')
(States that in the future, they will use friends around them as case studies to research the relationship between human needs and architecture.)
(All of this is thanks to your design, which gave him a new perspective.)
(States that they are currently studying and improving their herbal medicine skills, and you can bring various collected items for them to study and trade.)
(Laughs. Shaoyao, so you've been eyeing me too?)
(Laughs. Shaoyao, so you've been eyeing me too?)
(Shaoyao asks repeatedly whether to team up with her to practice the "Way of Herbs".)
(States that they will take good care of the nursery in the future, and will try to become a better "Garden Master" and a more capable herbalist.)
(All of this is thanks to your help in giving him a new perspective.)
Are you free lately? Like, in a... really big way?
Just say what's on your mind. Don't be shy.
Just say what's on your mind. Don't be shy.
There's a small favor I'd like to ask of you, but it's not for me...
Shall we meet at the nursery in Pillow Cloud Cliff?
Alright, I'll come by when I'm free.
Alright, I'll come by when I'm free.
Thank you! Don't worry, it won't be too much trouble... probably...
Did someone cry out in pain? Let's go check it out.
Did someone cry out in pain? Let's go check it out.
It's such a mess... Is this really a nursery?
It's such a mess... Is this really a nursery?
Urgh... ouch... it hurts! It hurts...
This should be more than just 'a bit messy'...
This should be more than just 'a bit messy'...
Hmm? That figure, is it Shaoyao?
Hmm? That figure, is it Shaoyao?
Try it, can you come out now?
Try it, can you come out now?
Great skills! Thanks! I need to go treat my patients now!
Ha! Got you! How was that?
Well, it's about Fang, my brother.
I've set up three challenges for him!
The tougher they are, the more my wisdom stands out.
He's a Chang'an Detective, no less! If he can't handle it, he should leave the job to me!
I'm still setting up. Will you help test them?
Thanks! They're really tough, so don't feel bad if you lose.
After all, they are designed for Fang, whom I wanna beat.
He's coming to Jixia for work and to see me.
I need to be sure they work. Don't worry, I won't make you help for free.
What do I need to do?
What do I need to do?
Get a complete Roost Crystal, but watch out for Nest Eggs.
They'll explode when disturbed, so be careful.
My Flying Dagger never misses! I'm Fang. You know my younger brother?
To welcome Fang, Fen has prepared three challenges and asks for your help to make sure everything works properly.
What do I need to do?
What do I need to do?
Get a complete Roost Crystal, but watch out for Nest Eggs.
They'll explode when disturbed, so be careful.
Phew, good thing I didn't break the crystal. That was tough.
Phew, good thing I didn't break the crystal. That was tough.
Not bad! I never expected you'd pass.
See the Mechanoids? You need to defeat the red one.
If you hit any others, even once, you fail.
Are you making it difficult for the sake of being difficult?
Are you making it difficult for the sake of being difficult?
Are you testing your brother or testing me?
Are you testing your brother or testing me?
Haha, nope! That's how it should be.
Even though you failed, help me beat the red one so I can test its strength.
The Tinderflower burned up. Hm? What is it?
The Tinderflower burned up. Hm? What is it?
Tinderflowers burn in the air, so they must stay underwater.
He won't come. Instead, he says to focus on my studies.
I thought he'd miss me since I've been gone from Chang'an for a long time.
No way he can pass it, but... it doesn't really matter now. Appreciate the help, though.
Captain Vlinder's Mechanoid brought Fang's letter.
Isn't the letter proof that he missed you?
Isn't the letter proof that he missed you?
Hmph... I'm not buying it. He just worries I'll grow up and outshine him.
Once I win the Enlightenment Trials and return to Chang'an, let's see if he'll still have excuses!
Even if you're my rival, I wish you luck too. Take this gift as a thanks and apology.
Fen receives Fang's letter. Fang has cancelled his visit to Jixia. Fen is disappointed but still thanks you for helping test the challenges.
The Tinderflower has burned to ashes...
Hmph, next time I see him, I'll show him what I'm really made of.
That's right! With this, and your help, no one will trip again in the dark.
Haha... Actually, it's a hide-and-seek toy.
So I can turn into a streetlight and light the road myself?
So I can turn into a streetlight and light the road myself?
I need you to <001>turn into a streetlight</> and illuminate the road <001>northwest of town</>.
Got it. Leave it to me.
Got it. Leave it to me.
Is this the "Morph Mirror" you were talking about?
Is this the "Morph Mirror" you were talking about?
Wait, it can work like a lamp? It looks like a toy.
Wait, it can work like a lamp? It looks like a toy.
It lets you temporarily turn into something else: a crate, a plant, furniture...
That way, people won't walk in the dark while I fix the real streetlight.
Talk to Deng Jian after crafting the item.
What's up? Curious about us Crafters?
Alright. I can explain what we do, how we're organized, or how we differ from the School of Mechcraft.
What do you want to learn?
We build all kinds of things, from vehicles to home gadgets to toys.
We also support other Societies: Anglers need rods, Cannoneers need help with firework launchers...
But no matter what we make, our philosophy is to connect people with Mechcraft.
Crafters have two branches: Academics and Artisans.
Academics use their expertise to create new things. Some of them compile their designs for others to use.
Artisans focus on hands-on practice. With enough skill, they can turn scrap into art.
They work well together: Academics design, and Artisans build a prototype to test it.
How do you differ from the School of Mechcraft?
Well, there are a lot of subtle differences...
Simply put, the School of Mechcraft chases cutting-edge breakthroughs. We focus on useful everyday tools.
Thank you so much for bringing it back.
Oh, sorry. We'll move it away once it's fixed.
Not "we"! Handle it yourself. And you! Can't you take another way?
I'm a Crafter, not a handyman!
But even a simple invention can be...
Save it. I'm done. I'm leaving!
Are you okay? I'm sorry... He was too harsh.
Are you okay? I'm sorry... He was too harsh.
I'm fine. He was just... Please don't take it personally.
Is there anything I can do to help?
Is there anything I can do to help?
It has to be done before dark. Since Gang Chen left, I don't think I can finish on time.
Great! First, get an <001>Ordinary Iron Stone</>. You can find one <001>outside Frostcloud Town</> or buy it from <001>Zhang Quan</>.
I want to make useful, recognized work—not something like Morph Mirrors, fireworks, or that lamp!
A bridge between hearts? "Craft binds people"? I'm sick of your preaching!
Without it, people will have trouble walking at night.
Without it, people will have trouble walking at night.
Yes. Many people have stumbled there. I need to fix it as soon as possible, but Gang Chen...
Y-you'd help? Maybe you can... but I can't offer much in return...
I can teach you how to use the Fabricator! You can make lots of fun things with it.

Even the most humble creation is a bridge connecting people, "Mortise and tenon join wood, craftsmanship connects hearts." Can you even say that convincingly? You're full of such empty talk!
zh_text: “再不起眼的造物，也是连接人与人的桥梁”、“榫卯接木，工巧连心”，学得像吗？你一张嘴就是这种大话！

And when I'm a forgetful old lady, you'll come find me, right?
Finally! What kept you out so late?
Wh-what are you doing here? I thought you were back home!
You haven't written in three months! I came to make sure you're okay.

I-it's just... the light is too bright!
Haha, come on. Lead the way! Show me your dorm!
It's already fixed...? Wait, something's off...
I can't... hold on much longer...
I can't... hold on much longer...
Hey, it's you! You used a Morph Mirror? Must be his idea...

I, uh, couldn't sleep. Went for a walk.

Sure it wasn't because you were worried?
Ahem, I just don't want anyone to trip. If you've got a plan, I didn't need to come.

I saw a mom teaching her little girl to find her way home.

I saw a girl travel from home, waiting under the streetlight to surprise her friend.
I just realized how important the streetlight is.
I just realized how important the streetlight is.
You've done plenty. When people need help, they don't care if it's a mirror, lamp, or anything else.
I hoped Gang Chen would learn from this, but I'm glad you learned it first.
Good. I'm glad to hear you say that.

The Divine Fish are seen in town. The three Angler schools will compete to catch them.

You won't believe what's happening in town!
Someone posted in Secret Scoops, saying that Divine Fish appeared here.

I see. But what exactly are Divine Fish?
Legend says a Sorcery fish became the King of the North Sea, glowing at night and ethereal by day.

They're super rare and almost impossible to catch.
Many Anglers give up, and now they're betting on who gets one first.
Most think <001>Yalena</> from Gearheads is most likely to catch it—she's been winning a lot.

As I said, Anglers, all three types, are here for the Divine Fish.
If you want to learn about them, just ask me anything.

We Riverreads value practical angling knowledge.

Tracking the life cycle and habits of fish is fascinating.

Don't see any Expedition Guide here... I should keep looking.

I should tell Cen Xu what happened.

They tried to change it, but failed.

Seekers document their exploration findings to guide those who come after them.

Yeah. Maybe Rebels did it—we could have a problem.

Please leave. It might be dangerous.

No, no, no, you've got it all wrong.

Not yet. I need to check more places.
I'm new here. How could I know how to tamper with it?

I'm not strong enough to handle the Mechanoids inside... I'll get nowhere near the Expedition Guide.

It shows the details of this place with some warning, but no identity stamp.

Ran Yu... It looks like a name.
How about it? Did you find anything?
But she quit after having me.
Your mom is a Seeker too?
Your mom is a Seeker too?
Yes, she met my father through archaeology.
Do you think my mom made up stories about my dad?
I've never seen his name on any Expedition Guide.
Why did she leave a compass instead of an identity stamp?
If my mom told the truth...
...why aren't their names on any Expedition Guides?
I have to go back and ask her why.
No identity stamp, but I found a compass.
No identity stamp, but I found a compass.
It's got "Feng Baichuan" and "Ran Yu" written on it.
It's got "Feng Baichuan" and "Ran Yu" written on it.
Wait, "Ran Yu?" That's my mom's name.
But I've never heard of Feng Baichuan.

Was it really that dangerous here?
Was it really that dangerous here?
Yes. Exploring untouched ruins is always risky. We owe those pioneers.
The spirits of those pioneers always inspire me.
Those three Seekers didn't list their names on any Expedition Guides.
They saw themselves as discoverers, not heroes.
Years ago, three brave Seekers started exploring here.
So they left their belongings as a warning.
But that never stopped Seekers from exploring.
It's why I wanted to be a Seeker.
I see... I checked, no sign of tampering.
Unfortunately, they triggered a deadly trap.
The captain of the three, Feng Baichuan, placed his compass there.

Perhaps that's why Baichuan, too, chose to dedicate his life to a Seeker's cause...

If this is the case, we might find his identity stamp on the Expedition Guide there.
Could I trouble you to make another trip?
I'll keep searching around and see if I missed anything.

text: Thank you. I'll be back after some checks.
I heard a mysterious woman calling you from the mist of the past...
Will you stay here? That newly-created Cadenza will come back for me.
In return, I'll tell you more truths. You won't believe the incredible things I've seen...
I saw the Tower of Enlightenment pierce through the clouds, only to ultimately point towards the world's core...
I saw warriors with peculiar glowing marks wake up, experienced ever-changing dreams, and witnessed the dragons' rise and fall...
Everything, including us, will wither and vanish in another world...
Everything here runs on binary in another world...
Aersilk Ecology Patrol Drone No. 9 has shut down due to low energy. Cadenza, please recharge it soon.
The drone needs a full day's charge before it can restart.
Low energy... Warning... Shutting down in...
You choose not to dismantle the Patrol Drone. In return, it tells you incredible things, then runs out of power and goes silent.
Oh? Changed your mind? Then I'll get someone to take it away.
Hey, nice to meet you... Wait, we've met before, haven't we?
So, you're probably thinking, "What? A talking Mechanoid?" Right?
Everything, from fruit husks to the stars, is a world of its own.
This Mechanoid is just a shell where my consciousness is confined.
It seems you're meant to know the truth of this world. I have important findings to share.
Curiosity leads to the truth. I knew you'd be interested. Give me a moment.
I'm Cadenza. Don't let the name fool you—music's not my forte. I'm into Mechcraft instead.
You encounter an abandoned Mechanoid calling itself Cadenza. It tells you it's a student from the School of Mechcraft.
Is that so? Then, this may come as a shock to you...
No? Well, here's some good news...
You don't? I didn't either, but my investigation led me here.
I sometimes regret it, you know, all the research on Aersilk...
I mean everything—from the people you know to those you'll meet, every flower, leaf, grain of sand, and speck of dust.
I have to tell you that nothing you see is real.
Ugh, not again... It's just like looking at someone chasing away Saepes.
Ever wonder why Saepes and Wolvines keep appearing in the same places?
The entire world is fake—everything in it! Aren't you amazed?
Impossible! I spent a ton of time investigating this thoroughly. How did you come to the same conclusion?
To truly understand reality, you must first break it apart. Now, tell me: Do you like this world?
I... rather... research about... Low energy... please charge...
Cadenza the Patrol Drone indicates the world is false... before finishing its statement, it malfunctions and loses consciousness.
So, what would you like to know?
I started by moving puppets with Aersilk. Since their bodies are made of dense Aersilk...
... also known as Aerux, was I moving Aersilk with Aersilk?
Muscles? Skeletons? Are they just Aersilk and Aerux in different forms?
How did you end up like this?
A foolish experiment. I wanted to prove that the world was an Aersilk illusion.
If it was all fake, I could rewrite it with my will.
Everything is controlled by threads, ready to be pulled, teased, and coiled...
Too complicated to explain. Anyway, I "rewrote" myself into this form.
As for why I'm stuck here, that's another story.
How did you end up like this?
A foolish experiment. I wanted to prove that the world was an Aersilk illusion.
If it was all fake, I could rewrite it with my will.
Everything is controlled by threads, ready to be pulled, teased, and coiled...
Too complicated to explain. Anyway, I "rewrote" myself into this form.
As for why I'm stuck here, that's another story.
I started by moving puppets with Aersilk. Since their bodies are made of dense Aersilk...
... also known as Aerux, was I moving Aersilk with Aersilk?
Muscles? Skeletons? Are they just Aersilk and Aerux in different forms?
Anything else you want to know? No? Okay...
Do you believe this world is a lie now?
What I told you is just the beginning. The truth runs deeper than you think...
Not convinced yet? I'll show you more evidence...
I know Croakies who seem kind but are plotting mischief...
Then I wondered, what moves our bodies?
If so, how is our world different from an illusion woven from Aersilk?
Then I wondered, what moves our bodies?
If so, how is our world different from an illusion woven from Aersilk?
We're nothing but puppets... every movement, every gesture is scripted.
Through Aersilk, I can explore the world like a spider at the center of the universe...
Anyway, ask me anything you want.
It marks the location of a <001>treasure trove</>...
Go find them, and you know I'm telling the truth.
There is a scroll hidden at the top of the <001>waterfall</>.
Th-thanks... I'm feeling much better. This form can't contain me much longer...
We're nothing but puppets... every movement, every gesture is scripted.
I know underground Saepes that talk in their sleep...
So, it's related to your research...
Then tell me about your research.
The key needed to find the treasure is hidden under a <001>monolith</> on the <001>southeast cliff</>.
Waking up, Cadenza claims the world is controlled by Aersilk, citing how certain things always appear in the same places as evidence.
At first, my research was only on using cloud silk to pull puppets... The puppet's torso is made of cloud roots, which are solidified cloud silk themselves.
zh_text: 一开始我研究的只是用云丝牵拉傀儡……傀儡的躯干是云根所制，本身就是固化的云丝。

text: It's a tree branch, not a scroll... But I'll take it anyway.
It's a tree branch, not a scroll... But I'll take it anyway.
Could this be the key? A stone?
Could this be the key? A stone?
Gu Tuo refused to return and asked us to take this back to the General.
Gu Tuo refused to return and asked us to take this back to the General.
Oh... Gu Tuo... Still haunted by his past...
He was a guard at the Gully in Yong.
Unfortunately, during a mission, his squad was wiped out while defending a village.
He blamed himself and got depressed.
Never thought he had such a past...
Never thought he had such a past...
I tried talking to him, but it didn't help... Looks like he still hasn't gotten over it after all this time.
I'll have to disappoint the General this time. I'll take the sword back.
But before that, I'd like to repair it.
At least... this way, the General won't worry about Gu Tuo's life here.
I'm a complete stranger here. Can you find a skilled blacksmith for the job?
I'll try finding a way to persuade Gu Tuo.
I won't give up as long as there's hope.
Zhong Young tells you Gu Tuo's story. He decides to have the heavy sword repaired before taking it back to General Meng Tian, and asks you for help.
Anything I can help you with?
Of course I can! Who do you think I am? I'm a pro! But wait...
Wait a minute... Isn't this the sword I wanted? Why is it broken?
Did you break it? You fool! Ah... such a waste...
You take the broken sword to Ember and ask if she can repair it.
I see. This weapon sure has a very unlucky owner.
But I don't think someone who took such good care of their weapon would just snap it like that.
Maybe he regrets it now... I've seen lots of people like him.
They destroyed their weapons in anger, then regretted it.
Are you really sending it back?
Are you really sending it back?
Sure. I bet he won't break it again.
If he dares, I'll rough him up!
Just stop asking questions. Just do what I say.
By the way, did you get involved because of that Yong Intelligencer?
Where is he? I need a word with that fool.
Alright, I'll find him later. Now go and hurry back.
Go find Ashun, the blacksmith at Red Falcon Training Hall, and get some Nebulium Grit.
And ask Maple, the Head Trainer, for a speedy Red Falcon!
He should be in the square.
He should be in the square.
Give me the sword. I'll fix it and... send it back to its owner.
Quit staring and get moving. I need some materials.
Why do you need a Red Falcon...?
Why do you need a Red Falcon...?
Ember agrees to help, on the condition that it's returned to its original owner afterward. She asks you to borrow Nebulium Grit and get the fastest Red Falcon from the Head Trainer.
Ember? Nebulium Grit? Is she fixing another strange weapon?
No problem, I'll lend her some.
She also needs the fastest Red Falcon from Maple.
She also needs the fastest Red Falcon from Maple.
I'll send our fastest Red Falcon to Ember. Just make sure you take good care of it.
You sure we could take it?
You sure we could take it?
No worries. Maple isn't that stingy. Ember must have her reasons.
By the way, let Ember know my next weapon will be even better than hers!
Hi, Ember sent me to get some Nebulium Grit.
Hi, Ember sent me to get some Nebulium Grit.
A Red Falcon too? Lucky for you, I've been taking care of them for Maple.
You manage to borrow Nebulium Grit from Ashun. He's tending the Head Trainer's falcon and will send a Red Falcon to Ember shortly.
Ember asked me to find you...
Sure, I'll rewrite it just like you asked.
You Intelligencers talk too much. Just get to the point.
Words can't be taken back once spoken, like water once spilled...
Enough with the riddles! Just fix it, or I'll fix you with my hammer.
There you are! The Red Falcon just arrived too. Did you bring what I need?
Impressive speed. Place it over here.
The Red Falcon will deliver my letter once I'm done editing.
I see, you need the falcon to deliver a letter. Who's it for?
I see, you need the falcon to deliver a letter. Who's it for?
Go on, hurry up. The falcon's round trip might take a while.
I've got to get to work!
A weapon like this shouldn't go to waste.
You hand Ember all the materials she needs. She uses the Falcon to send a letter and gets ready to work.
Phew... Finally done. Yong's weapons really are something.
If I hadn't seen it, I'd never believe this was made the old-fashioned way.
Alright, all done. Take it and go find Gu Tuo.
I'm waiting for the reply to the letter. Once I get it, I'll catch up.
It took hours of quenching to ensure the new materials achieved the right rigidity.
Once the heavy sword is repaired, Ember asks you to return it to Gu Tuo while she waits for a reply.
This must be where Gu Tuo lives.
This must be where Gu Tuo lives.
He's not here... Is he hiding from me?
He's not here... Is he hiding from me?
Are you looking for that tall guy, Gu Tuo?
Hehe, a little bird told me. It overheard your talk with Ember.
Do you know where he is right now?
Do you know where he is right now?
Well, I'll have to ask my friend first.
Scholarly Tiger, where is Gu Tuo?
Can you really make sense of this...?
Can you really make sense of this...?
He says, "Take it or leave it." That's rude, Scholarly Tiger!
Gu Tuo is in a flower field to the east. My Scholarly Tiger saw him on the way here.
He seems grumpy and scary, but he's really gentle.
He once saved me from a wild beast. And that flower field is his work.
I didn't know he was good at gardening.
I didn't know he was good at gardening.
Not sure why you're looking for him, but don't judge by looks alone.
He may seem cold, but inside, he's as warm as a flame.
Deera says Gu Tuo is at the flower field, tending his flowers to the east.
Hehe, a little bird told me. It overheard your talk with Ember.
You just won't give up, will you? I said I'm not going back.
I can't accept it. I can't go back to Yong.
I'm here to return your sword.
I'm here to return your sword.
You find Gu Tuo and offer him the repaired sword, but he refuses to take it back.
If you don't want it, how about giving it to us?
So, this is Ember's work after a whole day? Looks great.
The intel was right. This rare sword suits me well.
He doesn't keep it. Why can't I have it?
Even if I leave it, I won't let it fall into your hands.
The Rebels are after the heavy sword. You can't let it fall into their hands.
Hello! Have you seen a tall, strong man?
He has a Yong-style heavy sword. You can't miss him.
No, I haven't. Why are you looking for him?
No, I haven't. Why are you looking for him?
I'm searching for him for General Meng Tian.
When I was very young, a foreign tribe wreaked havoc in Yong. The General saved everyone.
Without him, I wouldn't be here. I can't let him down.
What does General Meng Tian want with this man?
What does General Meng Tian want with this man?
He used to be the General's subordinate, but left the army for some reason.
The General sent me, an Intelligencer, to persuade him to get back.
I heard he's in Aerfall Highlands, but I can't find his exact location.
His name is Gu Tuo. If you see him, tell him the General needs him.
The General really wants to fight with him again.
You must've heard of Meng Tian. He's a military genius who created the Great Fortress Formation.
Would you help me with my search? Maybe we'll find him faster together.
Zhong Young asks if you've seen a tall man carrying a Yong style sword, revealing Meng Tian is searching for this person and hoping you'll help track him down.
Is that all you've got? Weak...
There's no point in returning to Yong.
You give Gu Tuo the sword again, but he remains stubborn and refuses it.
Are you the idiot who broke your own weapon?
This flower... It's not local. I haven't seen it before.
I brought it from Yong... Beautiful, isn't it?
It looks best growing alone, not in groups.
Yong's a harsh land. This flower is a rare splash of color there.
If flowers grow in that barren land, why can't you return?
I made an unforgivable mistake. I can't...
Anything broken can be fixed. That goes for swords, and people too!
You love your weapons like I do. Promise me you won't break this one again.
Enough! Stop hesitating! I know what can open your heart. Give him the letter.
Gu Tuo, this letter's from the General—just arrived from Yong.
Even though Yong is tough, these flowers cheered me up as a child...
I'm Ember. I fixed your sword.
Ember suddenly appears and tries to persuade Gu Tuo with the Yong flower. When he still hesitates, she tells Zhong Young to give him a letter.
Listen up, Gu Tuo! A soldier's duty comes first. There's no room for fear in battle.
One defeat isn't the end. Don't give up on yourself. That's not a true soldier.
Your worth comes from what you do now, not from your past.
The Gully is in danger. Go fix your mistake and help us.
Once we win, we'll celebrate together.

Your past doesn't dictate your worth. It's who you are today that matters. \n \nThough General Meng Tian rebukes Gu Tuo in the letter, it carries more expectation than reprimand. At the end, Gu Tuo is commanded to return to the Gully to redeem himself.
We're going home. To defend the Gully!
But before that, I have a favor to ask.
I need to change, just like this reforged sword.
I'm starting fresh in Yong, so I want you to have this weapon.
If you hadn't found me, my past would still haunt me.
Although I really want the sword myself, I suppose it has found a better owner now.
Let's get moving. Hope to see you in Yong one day!
Hmph, that's more like it. My effort wasn't in vain.
I'd like you to have my sword.
It's difficult to learn Yong sword skills. But master them and you'll be strong.
Gu Tuo decides to return to Yong and guard the Gully and gifts you this sword.
A soldier... I should ask the town's blacksmith.
A soldier... I should ask the town's blacksmith.
Let me know if you need anything.
I'm looking for a man named Gu Tuo, tall and carrying a Yong-style heavy sword.
I'm looking for a man named Gu Tuo, tall and carrying a Yong-style heavy sword.
Never heard that name, but I did see a top-notch Yong-style sword.
He was tall. Not sure if he was Gu Tuo.
It's made with solid materials and crafted with great care... But that stubborn man just refused to sell it.
It's a shame, though. Yong weapons are incredible. I'd love to have one and see how it's made.
I was willing to pay a fortune for it.
But he didn't care. Just bought a hammer and left.
Maybe the sword means a lot to him.
Maybe the sword means a lot to him.
No doubt about it. You can tell he takes great care of it.
But it still makes me mad. He was so stubborn!
If not for that sword, I'd have hit him with my hammer!
How would I know? Go ask <001>Ke Naizhen</>. He's right over there.
Ember sold him a hammer, but she doesn't know where he went afterward. She suggests you to ask Naizhen across the way.
Excuse me. I'm looking for a tall man from Yong named Gu Tuo with a Yong-style heavy sword.
Excuse me. I'm looking for a tall man from Yong named Gu Tuo with a Yong-style heavy sword.
Hmm... Not quite the person you're after, but there's a huge outsider who was here recently.
He visited the town not long ago and spoke with a Yong accent.
He's probably a hunter, keeps to himself, and only comes to camp to sell his catches.
But he is not an ordinary hunter. He brings in the fiercest beasts that others can't catch.
I saw him hunt once, like a warrior on the battlefield. It gave me chills.
But he's been great. Cleared out most of the wild beasts around here.
If you're looking for him, head to <001>the North of Mirror Lake</>. He lives there now.
Naizhen knows an outsider matching your description who arrived not long ago. You might find the man at the North of Mirror Lake.
North of Mirror Lake... Well, I'll try my luck there.
North of Mirror Lake... Well, I'll try my luck there.
Hm? That sounds like a fight.
Hm? That sounds like a fight.
Haven't heard that name in ages. Who are you?
General Meng Tian wants you back in the army. He wants to fight alongside you again.
General Meng Tian wants you back in the army. He wants to fight alongside you again.
Soldier Gu Tuo is no more. I'm just a deserter, hunting to survive.
If you insist on taking Gu Tuo back, then take this sword with you...
Wow, it's heavy. And why is its tip broken?
Wow, it's heavy. And why is its tip broken?
I broke it myself. I don't deserve to carry it now.
Please take it back to someone who's worthy of it.
With moves like that and your size... You must be Gu Tuo, right?
With moves like that and your size... You must be Gu Tuo, right?
Thanks... I'm still getting used to this new hammer.
You find Gu Tuo and try to get him to return. He refuses, and hands you the heavy sword for Meng Tian.
What are you waiting for? My forge is hot. Get a move on!
If you play with fire, you get burned.
What happened to him? And who are you?
What happened to him? And who are you?
Relax, I'm the Discipline Overseer investigating the Death Knell's theft.
Yes, this Cyril stole the Death Knell.
He was a senior at the School of Mechcraft. He stole it from the Forbidden Chamber.
While tracking him, we found that wherever he went...
I followed him to the Hunters' camp, but I was too late.
So Mr. Liu was killed by this Death Knell...
So Mr. Liu was killed by this Death Knell...
Most likely. If I hadn't witnessed it myself, I wouldn't have believed that something so terrifying could exist.
The Intendant of the Forbidden Chamber said it can draw energy from living beings.
I think Cyril used it to absorb others' life energy.
Now Cyril's plans are finally over.
It depends on how it's used. Not everyone can resist temptation.
Thanks to you, my mission is complete.
I'll take them back. Thank you on behalf of the Department of Discipline and the Forbidden Chamber.
We suspected the same, but without evidence, we didn't want to cause panic.
But this time, the Death Knell went out of control. He's still alive, but...
That explains what happened in the ruins.
That explains what happened in the ruins.
Did anything else happen? By the way, your skills are impressive.
Even with the Death Knell's power, you weren't harmed.
The Death Knell isn't good or evil—like life and death itself.
Do you think it's good to know when you'll die?
This is why I brou... created it.
Don't get nervous. I've just got some concerns...
But some use it to wish for others' deaths.
Actually, I would call it "a masterpiece."
It reads the Aerflow energy around a living being to determine its vitality.
At first, I wanted to help people face death peacefully.
Sorry, this is a heavy topic. We can't sum it up in a snap.
I'll leave it to you. Please go to the camp and get my invention.
Really...? Some say life is short, like the blink of an eye.
Life is a long journey, heavy until the very end.
But if everyone's destined to leave, what harm is there in knowing when?
I hope it brings peace and courage, not regret or fear, in the final moments.
I used to think every life must end, but I missed a deeper truth.
If you know when you'll die, you may stop giving your best.
I started to think brin... creating this was a mistake.
According to Cyrus, this device can reveal how long its holder has left to live. You sensed a red flag. After careful consideration, Cyrus now wants your help to retrieve the invention from the camp.
Give it to me! Or else...
You find Cyrus, but something about him seems off. Desperate to get the device, he attacks you.
Who are you?! Are you after the Death Knell too?
Hey, if you're traveling, watch your belongings! This area isn't safe...
I met a Hunter in a camp not far from here. We hit it off right away.
He asked to borrow my invention. I agreed.
But he hasn't given it back yet...
I went to the camp to get it back, but...
... his apprentice kicked me out before I could see him!
You might not believe it, but my invention predicts how long someone has to live.
Some think it's ominous, but actually, it has helped people facing the end of life.
I'm worried it will cause more trouble if left out there.
I think fate sent you to me.
Can you help me get my invention back? I'll reward you!
I'm counting on you. The Hunter is at the northeastern camp, not far from here.
I call him Mr. Liu. He's an expert—you'll find him easily.
Oh, before you go, I would like to...
I have a question on my mind. Do you have a moment?
I thought you'd be interested in my invention.
Cyrus needs your help to retrieve an invention he lent to a Hunter.
Excuse me. Is Mr. Liu here?
Excuse me. Is Mr. Liu here?
His apprentice is in the camp. You may ask him.
You ask Zhisheng and Fan He about Mr. Liu while searching the Hunters' Camp. Neither gives a straight answer, just tells you to check with his student at the tent.
Excuse me. I'm looking for Mr. Liu.
Excuse me. I'm looking for Mr. Liu.
He died last month... Everyone knows.
Sorry, I got a little emotional. I still can't accept this...
I'll be honest. I already got rid of it.
I left it in the nearby ruins.
If you need it, you'll have to find it yourself.
I'm sorry... but I need to get back something he borrowed.
I'm sorry... but I need to get back something he borrowed.
Cyrus? Hmph. He just won't give up, will he?
Come on, leave us in peace! I told him it was his invention that caused...
Days ago, my master was hurt while hunting. Cyrus brought him back—the first time I met him.
That day, they talked a lot. My master was happy, fascinated by a Mechcraft device.
Later, I happened to catch him polishing it...
I saw eerie lights flicker on it, glowing—then go dark in a flash.
My master hit at it, trying to keep the light on—but nothing worked.
It felt off. When I asked, he could barely answer—it was abnormal for him.
From then on, he changed. He just stared at it every day.
His wounds were getting healed... but suddenly...
It's all Cyrus's fault! That device brought trouble...
It killed my master. I can't let it harm others.
I've warned you about its curse. Do not go after it.
And that Cyrus... I won't forgive him.
When you enter the tent to speak with Jiayi, Mr. Liu's student, he blames Cyrus' Mechcraft creation, revealing he hurled the cursed device into the nearby ruins.
Don't worry, I'll take them back to the academy.
Thank you on behalf of the Department of Discipline and the Forbidden Chamber.
Viola says she'll bring both Cyrus and the Death Knell back to the academy.
Disappeared... he seemed to be suffering.
Disappeared... he seemed to be suffering.
Was that Mr. Liu? What happened to him?
Was that Mr. Liu? What happened to him?
You haven't gotten the invention back yet?
It's at <001>the camp to the northeast</>. It means a lot to me. I'm counting on you.
According to Cyrus, the invention is located in the camp in the northeast.
Absorb... recycle... I see how great this invention is...
Ha! Unlimited life energy—all for me...
I was thinking about the fish and lost track of time...
Tidon walks as silently as a cat.
Got it! Yalena will be excited to see it.
Got it! Yalena will be excited to see it.
Take my fish crate. Make good use of it!
Quick, put it in Yalena's fish crate!
Jixia Academy shoes... Wide and shallow footprints...
Hmm... Just as I thought. Now, I can confirm...
By its movement, eating habits, and sharp teeth... It's more like a shark.
Starrynight Shark... It's got a ring to it.
So... should we call it Starrynight... Shark?
It makes sense... Sharks react to high-frequency sounds—they can even be stunned by them.
In Frostcloud Town, the Fish Caller made a sharp sound—that's likely why the fish died.
But... If it's a shark, why does it look just like the Starrynight Fish?
But... If it's a shark, why does it look just like the Starrynight Fish?
Let's dig deeper into The Angler's Chronicles.
But it's so hard to read. Even with Zephron's help, it'll take time.
It's okay. Please, we need to learn the truth.
And thank you. Without you, we might've ended up bear food.
I'll contact everyone as soon as we learn more from The Angler's Chronicles. Please wait.
Tidon suspects the fish caller killed the fake Divine Fish. He still needs to study why it resembles Starrynight Fish and promises to keep you informed.
By the way, what happened to those fish in Frostcloud Town?
By the way, what happened to those fish in Frostcloud Town?
Tata confirmed they were edible, then threw a three-day "Fried Fish Festival!"
The fried fish smell filled the whole town. Everyone loved it.
But even after all that, the source of the fish is still unknown.
Ah... Yalena said I'm from Jiang and know about fish?
Actually... I don't know that much...
If I really knew fish, I wouldn't have...
Zephron chats with you, blaming herself for last time.

At the base, you meet Rufeng. He believes Xianqiao, the one with the locator, is in danger. He sets out to find her and asks you to search for Xue Yi.
They should be here by now.
They should be here by now.
Please don't kick me into the freezing water again!
Tell me, WHERE IS THE BIRD?
Bird? I only sell artifacts, not animals.
Let me remind you... Forbidden Chamber...
I'm here with a message from Rufeng.
I'm here with a message from Rufeng.
He never sends messengers. Why should I trust you?
Enough! Stop! I get it, my head hurts.
Such embarrassing code words... It must be urgent.
Xianqiao's signal is lost at Bastion Fort. Rufeng went after her.
Xianqiao's signal is lost at Bastion Fort. Rufeng went after her.
The signal is lost... She overestimated her Mechanoid.
Never mind. This isn't anything new anyway.
Hey, the signal... Xue Yi... can you hear...
We lost contact. It ran out of power.
It seems your Captain found her.
It seems your Captain found her.
The message is unclear. I need to check the ruins to ensure their safety.
Can you go first? I need answers from him.
Thanks. If you need any help, just ask our team.
Where are you going? Come to Bastion Fort with me!
Think you can escape me? Not a chance!
Please, let me go! I've told you everything I know.
You find Xue Yi and explain the situation. She asks you to go to Bastion Fort, and she will meet you there later.
We have some trouble getting into the village.
The kids won't let us in. They don't even know Xue Yi.
I've been away a long time, so...
No, we might need their help to investigate.
Honestly, we could just force our way in.
Are you good with kids? I'm a good fighter, but...
Knew you were the right choice! It's up to you!
You meet Team Wilderness at the village entrance, but some children block the way. Rufeng asks you to help communicate with them.
You outsiders won't step foot inside!
If you want in, beat us: the Three Warriors of Aerfall Highlands!
We're the heroes who stopped the Dawnsong army!
I'm Y'chen, Spirit of the Night!
As long as we stand, you'll never hurt the village!
Of course! Haven't you heard the nursery rhyme about us three?
Three brave heroes, bold and tall. Standing on the bridge, they guard the land for all.
One wields Sorcery, strange and sly. A wordless book that tricks the eye.
One masters Mechcraft, gears alive. His eerie bird warns, "Few survive."
One heals best, with steady hands. The bell chases souls and saves the land.
Three as one, they cleave through gold. In Hermitage they rest, growing old.
The wisest man in the village taught us this rhyme!
No way! We won't let any shady outsiders in!
Who knows what trouble you'll bring?
We just want to explore and look into something.
We just want to explore and look into something.
If you're here to explore, prove it!
How can I prove it to you?
How can I prove it to you?
With just the three of you?
With just the three of you?
Three kids block your way, calling themselves the Three Warriors of Aerfall. To enter the village, you must prove your worth.
Three warriors are so majestic, protecting Yunluo before the Jueyun Bridge!
zh_text: 三个勇士好威风，绝云桥前护云落！
source_text: 三个勇士好威风，绝云桥前护云落！

text: They said he almost found the Warriors' Treasure, the greatest treasure in Aerfall Highlands.
But isn't that just a legend? We just treat it as a story.
If you're after the treasure, get ready to be disappointed.
That man searched for years and never found it. And he has left the village.
Excuse me. Do you know if there is a symbolist in the village?
Excuse me. Do you know if there is a symbolist in the village?
Symbolist? Hmm, my elders talked about someone like that before.
If you need more info, head east and find <001>Lee Xiang</>. He might know more.
Yuanbao says a symbolist nearly found the Warriors' Treasure but ended up empty-handed. He suggests you talk to Lee Xiang, who is to the east, for more information.
You must mean Xue Hong. I remember him, but I'm no expert on his studies.
There's only been one scholar here, ever.
He was strange—always drawing odd symbols all over the village.
He invented something called a "Symbol Seeker." It could show things we couldn't see.
He even tried it on my house! It revealed all the damage I caused when I was a kid. Amazing!
That was cool, but he vanished after that. No one knows where he went.
His house is still here, always locked. No one goes inside.
Hello, can I ask about a symbolist here?
Hello, can I ask about a symbolist here?
I don't know more, but you could ask <001>Situ Yuan</> to the north. She knows village gossip!
You ask Lee Xiang about the symbolist. He tells you what he knows and sends you north to speak with Situ Yuan.
He lived here for years, but I never really talked to him.
The oldest elder in the village knew him well. You should ask him.
He usually stays at the ancestral hall. Easy to find.
No problem. You just remind me of a Jixia student who visited long ago.
But after a few months, he left—he looked really worn out.
I don't know what you are up to, but I hope you don't end up like him.
Excuse me, do you know anything about a symbolist?
Excuse me, do you know anything about a symbolist?
He brought a strange device and was also searching for the symbolist. He stayed for a while.
Situ Yuan says an old man at the ancestral hall is a close friend of the symbolist. He also says a Jixia student once came searching for Xue Hong but left months later, looking exhausted.
The elder at the ancestral hall, right?
The elder at the ancestral hall, right?
I don't know what he was doing, but he was a good guy.
I see... Do you know what he was studying?
I see... It might be a clue. Let's check it out.
Hmm... Since you asked, I'll stay.
Alright, could you help investigate? I'll stay here a bit more.
If I find anything, my Big-eye Owlet will inform you.
His shoulders looked tense, so I offered him a massage.
Thanks. It's been a while since someone did that...
The symbolist you asked about must be Xue Hong.
He always carried his strange inventions.
A book with no words, a strange device, and a singing Mechanoid Bird.
I once heard its song and couldn't speak when I got home.
Xue Hong found out, and immediately destroyed the bird—then I could talk again.
Not sure. Maybe something about symbols.
He often took his inventions to the memorial on the mountain.
Leaving already? Stay a bit longer—it's been ages since I talked to young people.
The elder says Xue Hong often brought inventions to the memorial. Rufeng will stay to talk with him, so you'll have to go there alone.
You better not be making plots!
Don't be silly. They're just investigating, being adventurers and all.
I see... No, wait! You're the silly one!
Memorial? What's that? Is it something to eat?
All you do is eat! It's like a stone tablet, silly!
Well... Wait a sec! If you call others silly, you're the real silly one!
Just you two? Where's the other girl?
Mimi? She said she had something more important to do.
What's more important than eating, silly?
Oh... No, wait! She's not going home! It's not time yet.
Mimi must be planning something. I know her.
It's you. What are you doing here?
There's a memorial on the mountain—but not sure if it's the one you are looking for.
The children mention a stone tablet on the nearby mountain, yet one of their friends slips away alone, as if sneaking off to do something.
New here, huh? Another treasure seeker?
It's just an ordinary stone tablet, built in honor of the past. There's nothing worth finding here.
Don't waste your time on it...
You could lose more than you think, and might not even get what you came for.
Leave here. Wild beasts roam these mountains.
Zhan Xin notices you're not from here. He warns you to stop investigating, or you could lose more than you expect and still end up with nothing.
Such a weirdo... Strange, nothing on this memorial.
Such a weirdo... Strange, nothing on this memorial.
Xue Yi? What are you doing here?
Xue Yi? What are you doing here?
Yeah, it was. I lived here too... He was my Grandpa.
It's been ages, but the house hasn't changed much...
No one lives here, but the neighbors seem to clean it quite often.
Come to think of it, why are you here again? You aren't looking for Grandpa's Symbol Seeker, are you?
I checked the house. Unfortunately, it's not there.
Grandpa destroyed it. I couldn't let his hard work go to waste, so I took it home.
This used to be... my home.
It should be somewhere in the house, but now I can't find it...
You find Xue Yi in the old house. After Xue Hong smashed the Symbol Seeker, she brought it back and hid it here. But now, it's gone.
You're... You know what we're talking about?
Of course. I have been here all the time.
Forget it. Tell me, what are we looking for?
It's a vase-like item with complex carvings.
Okay, seems you know. So, where is it?
I'll tell you, but on one condition!
I want to join your team.
But... Are you leaving your friends behind?
Hmph! I'm six now. They're toooooo childish!
Alright, bring us the Symbol Seeker, and I'll say yes.
Mimi says she knows where the Symbol Seeker is. After Xue Yi promises to let her join the team, she agrees to guide you.
I have what you're looking for!
Your grandpa's Symbol Seeker. The auntie next door tossed it while cleaning.
It looked cool, so I kept it.
All done! It should be working now.
Honestly, this is the cleverest design I've ever seen.
It emits Sorcery energy that seeps through tiny cracks on a surface.
Then reads the energy's pattern to restore the lost symbols.
And that's not all! Its creator must be a genius!
It also deciphers the symbols' hidden meanings.
What a fascinating idea! Who would ever think of that?
Consciousness? Incredible... Do you still have it?
Oops, got carried away. Here's the fixed Symbol Seeker.
We still have a few things to discuss. I'll catch up with you later. See you.
Amazing, right? Xue Hong was truly one of a kind.
He brought me many of his inventions, some of which were true masterpieces.
I don't know where he got them. Some I still can't figure out today.
The most impressive was his Mechanoid Bird.
It recorded voices, used rare Sorcery energy, and had a complex internal design.
I took it apart—it turned out to be a kind of storage device...
It may sound wild, but maybe it stored consciousness.
No, it was stolen. If only I spent more time studying it.
After you repair the Symbol Seeker, the blacksmith says Xue Hong made many strange inventions. One was a Mechanoid Bird that could store consciousness, but it has gone missing.
Xue Yi said you'd be here. She really knows you.
Xue Yi said you'd be here. She really knows you.
Yep. I'm learning rare techniques. You know, people here rarely exchange skills with outsiders.
What can I do for you?
Heh, I've gathered info and done my research too.
Excuse me, may I borrow your workbench?
Sure, I'd like to see your skills too.
This must be the Symbol Seeker.
This must be the Symbol Seeker.
Let me see... Yep, it's Grandpa's. Looks just like I remember.
No way, it's broken and was buried for a long time.
But Xianqiao might fix it. She's a genius with Mechcraft.
So, am I part of the team now?
Yes, yes. You're one of us now.
Then teach me those cool moves! And the motto!
You... Urgh, alright, I did promise you after all.
No! Not like that! You gotta show more spirit!
Take it seriously, or I'll tell everyone you're frauds!
You little... Fine, I'll teach you properly.
Now what? Could you bring the Symbol Seeker to Xianqiao? She should be at the smithy.
I'll handle... no... give her a quick lesson and then catch up with you.
You show the Symbol Seeker to Xue Yi. She recognizes it as her grandfather's work and asks you to bring it to Xianqiao at the smithy for repairs.
Wait... Xue Hong's Symbol Seeker! Where did you... You even fixed it?
Sigh... since you're so determined, I might as well be honest with you.
When I was a Jixia student, I was crazy about the legend and the treasure.
So I came here and met Xue Hong. He was researching it and I became his helper.
But on our search, I was cursed by one of the "keys." My body was ruined.
Now, I can't use Sorcery. I'm not much help anymore.
And the worst part? We found out that...
As a fellow Jixia student, I'm not here to mislead you.
But if you insist on seeking the truth, I won't stop you... Just be careful.
Zhan Xin admits he was the Jixia student who came to find Xue Hong. He says the treasure hunt ruined him and urges you to stop before it's too late.
Yes, let me test it out.
Yes, let me test it out.
You're trying the Symbol Seeker on the memorial.
It looks like a military journal, but only half of it is here.
Three bad villains, fierce and sly. Left their friends alone to die.
One was cruel, with heart of stone. Hurt the innocent for his own.
One was sneaky, full of schemes. Helped the wrong and crushed good dreams.
One was cunning, evil mind. Kept on torturing all he could find.
Their wicked acts remain concealed. The hidden truth is not revealed.
This nursery rhyme is really dark...
Wait, there's more below in different handwriting.
If you dare, seek the truth in the mountain ruins.
It points to a place. We might find the answers there.
That warning gives me a bad feeling...
But we've come too far to give up now.
Will you go to the ruins first? I'll get Xue Yi and Xianqiao and meet you there.
The memorial has a strange nursery rhyme and clues that point to ruins on the mountain. Rufeng refuses to give up and asks you to head to the ruins while he gathers the others.
Three villains are so shocking, abandoning their comrades to save their own skins!
zh_text: 三个恶徒好惊人，抛弃战友自苟活！
source_text: 三个恶徒好惊人，抛弃战友自苟活！
official_target_text: Three villains are so shocking, abandoning their comrades to save their own skins!
official_en_text: Three villains are so shocking, abandoning their comrades to save their own skins!

official_target_text: One is the most cruel, harming the innocent for selfish desires!

The ruins mentioned on the memorial...
Glad I got here in time, or you would've been in trouble.
I owe you one... Where are the others?
I owe you one... Where are the others?
Just behind me. They'll arrive soon.
Finally, we catch up with you.
Eh? Why is it such a mess here?
Xue Yi just fought off the enemies.
Xue Yi just fought off the enemies.
What's that over there? It looks like... Could you check it out?
Xue Yi notices something strange and suggests you take a look.
That's easy! Xue Yi, Xianqiao, let's show them!
We have no choice, Xue Yi.
Ahem, not as good as ours, but you passed. We'll let you in.
But if you cause trouble, we'll stop you!
We'll chase down anyone who messes with Hermitage! Let's go!
Rufeng has Xianqiao and Xue Yi show their signature moves. The children accept and let you through.
I can't believe I just did that... in front of everyone...
Rufeng, we need to talk later.
Well, at least we're inside. Let's start looking for info on the symbolist.
At least we made it into the village!
After the team passes the children's test, they invite you to go into the village with them.
The journal should be open now...
The Dawnsong army didn't gain anything from the ambush.
In fact, they suffered heavy losses, which is why an investigation was started.
They thought the cargo was the cause of the disaster.
Their search led them to a person named Y'chen.
They found Y'chen had hidden what caused the destruction.
They believed three items were the key to the secret.
A singing bird, a shining bell, and a truth-telling book.
Anyway, we just have to find them.
But we have no clue what they are.
That's what I'll investigate. I will find all three items.
You're going alone? Let me or Xianqiao go with you.
You two should stay here and see if there are any more clues. Our new friend will help.
I need to return to keep things in order, so I'll be away for a bit.
If you find any clues, please be patient and wait for me to arrive.
Wait a minute... This is a wartime record kept by the Dawnsong army.
The Dawnsong army ambushed a transport team, then did an investigation.
By the way, the Department of Discipline needs me. Not sure when I'll be back.
Someone named Y'chen created three items to hide something important. Xue Yi leaves, saying she is on to something.
This used to be... my home.
Yeah, it was. I lived here too... He was my Grandpa.
It's been ages, but the house hasn't changed much...
No one lives here, but the neighbors seem to clean it quite often.

Grandpa destroyed it. I couldn't let his hard work go to waste, so I took it home.

You're... You know what we're talking about?

Forget it. Tell me, what are we looking for?
It's a vase-like item with complex carvings.
Okay, seems you know. So, where is it?

I want to join your team.
But... Are you leaving your friends behind?
Hmph! I'm six now. They're toooooo childish!
Alright, bring us the Symbol Seeker, and I'll say yes.
At her old home, Xue Yi tells you the Symbol Seeker she hid years ago is gone. Mimi offers to reveal where it is if she can join the team.
Those kids might know about the memorial.
Those kids might know about the memorial.
If you're an exploration team, show us your cool team moves like what we did!
After some discussion, the children ask you to perform your team's signature moves to prove you're real explorers.
This was Xue Hong's place. The door's locked. Gotta find someone to ask.
This was Xue Hong's place. The door's locked. Gotta find someone to ask.
You mean that old man who lived here?
Yeah, I heard this was his home.
Yeah, I heard this was his home.
He passed away years ago. This house's been abandoned.
Excuse me, do you know where I can find Xue Hong?
Excuse me, do you know where I can find Xue Hong?
A girl just came and has been walking around here. It seems she knows here well.
Look, she's over there. Maybe she can help you.
A villager tells you that Xue Hong passed away many years ago. However, a girl was just wandering around here for some time, and she seemed very familiar with the place.
Hmm, its... it must be the missing piece we need.
Then we should be able to read the complete journal.
Let's get started. Xianqiao, get your tools out.
The team finds another missing piece and begins to decipher the journal.
The style of this stele looks like the Chaoge Army's. It must have been erected by them, but that's nothing unusual...
What I find strange is the content of the inscription... Why would it say the entire Jixia army was wiped out?
Didn't they say the Jixia army successfully retreated under the cover of three warriors? This contradicts the legend.
If we find anything, we'll contact each other via the Great Eye Owl at any time.
Hmm, I think it's necessary to continue investigating in this direction.
It is said that three warriors fought and retreated to face the Zhaoge army, heading towards this mountain by the lake.
On the mountain, there are ruins where warriors fought a bitter battle against the Zhaoge army, and a monument erected for them by a hunter who witnessed their heroic deeds.
The stone tablet at the bottom of the lake has no clues about the treasure...
The stone tablet at the bottom of the lake has no clues about the treasure...
Could it be that the Zhaoge army deliberately distorted the outcome of the war? But what good would that do?
Let's split up. You go look for clues on the mountain by the lake, and I'll stay here and keep trying to find a way to survey the lake bottom. How about that?

There's an energy reaction here too... but... I have an indescribable, bad feeling about it.
There's an energy reaction here too... but... I have an indescribable, bad feeling about it.

This must be the ruin where those three held their ground...
It looks like... it was destroyed from the inside. Was there a fierce battle in there?
It seems like it... but the way these buildings were destroyed is a bit strange.
We shouldn't be arguing at a time like this...
You say you can't bring yourself to do it now? Can't you have a little faith in me?
This experiment is nowhere near mature. Can't we find a safer way to evade the pursuers...
It has already harmed many people. I don't want you to be the next...
I might be the next sacrifice, but I certainly won't be the last.
If I fail... take my notes and hide them, and entrust them to someone more suitable who can lead you forward.
This must be the stele commemorating the sacrifice of the three heroes...
This must be the stele commemorating the sacrifice of the three heroes...
No... something's not right. Although it looks old, this is clearly not a creation from that era...

Hey... hey, don't be like this, everyone get up...
Don't scare me, I didn't mean to! I only pushed it very lightly, just once...
Age, didn't you say you'd always stand behind me and cover for our recklessness?

That power... what have I... done...

Our findings are inconsistent with the legends in many ways.

But a large part of the warrior's legend is completely opposite to the clues here...

Does that mean... our investigation was headed in the wrong direction too?

I won't give up easily! If I can't find the Warrior's Relic, finding the truth about it is just as good!

Ouch, hey! We'd be your seniors if we hadn't left the academy. Show some respect.
You are so mean. We didn't come here to fight.
You know the bear sealed deep inside? We need the key to its seal.

Actually, one of us stole the key before and released that monster for a while.

If it's released undefeated, the consequences would be unimaginable.
I'm sure I can defeat it.

With your skill, maybe you can do it.

You took on all of us without breaking a sweat. We won't, and can't get in your way.
