It's as if... it's been infused with tremendous energy inside and out.
While you were fighting, I found a blood sample. I think it's from that bear. There's a bloodstained journal next to it...

In the midst of the battle, Zhang He managed to collect blood samples from the bear. Analysis reveals the bear has been infused with enormous amounts of energy, which is likely the cause of its madness.
The village chief! You're the one who destroyed the inscriptions and hindered my research!
So that's it. But she never regretted any of it!
During my days in Hermitage, I've met many Seekers, all passionate and curious.
But most were hurt or worse in the end.
You're all blind to the truth!
Look around! The Sanctified built this place with their greatest power—yet it's long been forgotten.
To those who sought power, becoming Sanctified was an honor.
But only a few survived the trials to get that power.
The trials were deadly—causing madness or even death.
Many have perished on the Path of Trials.
If it happened to the great Sanctified, it's even riskier for students like you.
I destroyed the inscriptions to keep you Seekers and village youth safe.
I feel guilty about what happened to Malva... Am I just overthinking it?
Never mind, since both of you are safe, I'll leave. You should leave, too.
I thought you would learn from Malva's situation...
Suchen confronts Zhong Yan about the destroyed inscriptions. Zhong Yan says he did it to protect the Seekers and the village's young people.
What's the matter? Why are you arguing?
What's the matter? Why are you arguing?
Hmm... You must be the new student Novar recommended.
Everyone's talking about how you passed the special exam.
I'm Suchen, captain of a Seeker team. This old... eh, elder here is the chief of Hermitage.
You must have solved the Eight Sentinels to reach here. I'm here for Malva's wishes.
The Seekers are devoted but suffer the worst injuries out of curiosity.
Records show these trials cause madness and physical harm.
If it happened to the great Sanctified, it's even riskier for students like you.
I destroyed the inscriptions to keep you Seekers and village youth safe.
I feel guilty about what happened to Malva... Am I just overthinking it?
Never mind, since both of you are safe, I'll leave. You should leave, too.
Interested in the pillars' story? You've earned the truth by coming this far.
Malva was badly hurt during her work, so she had to pause her career to heal.
But I will continue her work.
But the inscriptions found near the pillars were destroyed.
Now I know who's behind all this.
Good question. You must have gone to the bronze pillars and completed the trials there.
Old records tell of eight such pillars on Aerfall Highlands.
The Eight Sentinels had been a major ancient mystery of this area.
She revealed the mystery of the pillars and made huge discoveries.
Unfortunately, this was what made her give up her work.
Malva said they're the Path of Trials left by the Sanctified.
Ignore him. Malva braved the heartlands, conquered trials, and uncovered the truth.
Each pillar tested one of the eight traits the Sanctified had to possess.
Precision, Endurance, Courage, Insight, Wisdom, Memory, Stealth, and Spatial Awareness.
Based on our research, these trials are challenging and risky.
Only the best from that civilization could pass.
Even the best struggled to complete those trials.
Malva found that many people tried to prove themselves at the pillars.
So Malva believed the Path of Trials led to huge rewards.
Don't blame yourself! She actually reached the ultimate trial.
And found a link between the Eight Sentinels and the Mausoleum's Peak.
Challenge the Sentinels in the Mausoleum's Peak to get the key...
Challenge the Sentinels in the Mausoleum's Peak to get the key...
The Eight Sentinels and the Mausoleum were built at different times in history.
But the strange thing is, both of them seem part of the Path of Trials.
It's a regret she never got to see this place for herself.
That changed when the great Seeker Malva arrived.
You and Malva are being absurd!
Hah! Path of Trials? It's just risking your life!
You young ones are all blind to the truth!
Now I wish I hadn't given her that lead... I feel I've failed as the village chief.
Don't sass me, kid. I've seen enough Seekers around here.
You learn the truth about the Eight Pillars Trial from Su Chen. Zhong Xing, however, is deeply wary, explaining that he destroyed the inscriptions to protect the researchers and the villagers.
You learn the truth about the Eight Pillars Trial from Su Chen. Zhong Xing, however, is deeply wary, explaining that he destroyed the inscriptions to protect the researchers and the villagers.
That's it! I can use them to fix the bucket.
Do all the villagers here use this water for their crops?
Do all the villagers here use this water for their crops?
You know what? Here's a little secret—this waterfall's got some kind of mysterious energy. Folks say drinking from it makes you stronger.
It's only a legend, but there truly is a <001>huge bronze gate</> upstream from the waterfall...
Shoot, I shouldn't have told you that... Forget you heard it, okay? I've got a bucket to patch.
I got the Ordinary Iron Stone.
I never knew the water from our waterfall had mysterious powers.
Why do you think everyone's obsessed with the mountain spring soups at Hidden Trellis?
We should be using this water for our crops too!
Ah, the bucket's leaking! Someone, please help!
What do I do? Why's the bucket leaking?
Yeah, I was just fetching water, and the bucket's hoops came loose.
Do me a favor and get me some <001>Ordinary Iron Stones</>, will you?
We use them to make all our furniture here. Please...
Great. I'll wait for you here!
Outsiders aren't welcome here. Please leave.
If you've traveled around, you may have seen several large bronze pillars that look exactly the same.
Old records tell of eight such pillars on Aerfall Highlands.
Some say they're for honoring ancestors, others think they're old war beacons.
But those theories turned out to be wrong after more digging.
Then came Malva, a legendary Seeker.
She revealed the mystery of the pillars and made huge discoveries.
Unfortunately, she was not able to finish the investigation. And now I'm here to continue her work.
But inscriptions found near the pillars were destroyed.
Someone's ruining my research. With your help, we can solve it.
Will you help me investigate those pillars?
Thanks! You've boosted my confidence. Now let me tell you about the eight pillars.
Malva said they're the Path of Trials from a lost civilization.
Each pillar tested one of the eight traits.
Precision, Endurance, Courage, Insight, Wisdom, Memory, Stealth, and Spatial Awareness.
According to her research, these trials were tough and risky.
Only the best from that civilization could pass.
Even the best struggled to complete those trials.
Malva found that many people tried to prove themselves at the pillars.
So Malva believed the Path of Trials led to huge rewards.
But glory often comes with danger.
She later found the pillars and trials are linked to the Mausoleum's Peak.
Yes. She discovered that, although the pillars and the Mausoleum were built at different times...
... together they form the complete <001>Path of Trials</>.
Their connection still remains a mystery.
Malva got badly hurt before finding out more.
It's a real loss. I admire her, and I read all her writings back at the academy.
I'm trying to finish her work by studying the eight pillars.
That's all for now. Let's split up and investigate the <001>eight pillars</>. Stay alert. It's dangerous.
Too bad you can't uncover the truth yourself...
What do those destroyed inscriptions mean...
Sorry, I got lost in thought again.
You're that amazing new student, right? I heard you aced that special exam.
I'm Suchen, captain of a Seeker team. I'm here to study the Eight Sentinels.
I never expected this... Searching for secrets from history is what Seekers do.
But what if uncovering secrets brings pain?
I'll go talk to Malva. Thanks for your support. Until next time!
Is this the Pillar Ruins... The senior's wish has been fulfilled.
I didn't expect that even with such strict defenses, you would eventually get in. The younger generation is truly formidable.
Hello there, it's been a while.
Wait, this is the Sentinel's Talisman... Have you already figured it out?
If my research is correct, this talisman holds the key to unraveling the secret. The question is, where do we use it?
Someone in the village must know <001>what this key unlocks</>, but they all seem wary around Seekers like me...
No time to waste. I'll chase down another lead—see if you can find any clues around here.
Let's hope we both find the answers. Until next time!
My name is Suchen. I'm a Seeker, here to investigate the mystery of the Eight Sentinels.
Wait, this is the Sentinel's Talisman... Have you already figured it out?
If my research is correct, this talisman holds the key to solving the mystery. If only we could find out where to use it...
Someone in the village must know <001>what this key unlocks</>, but they all seem wary around Seekers like me...
No time to waste. I'll chase down another lead—see if you can find any clues around here.
Let's hope we both find the answers. Until next time!
There seems to be something over there.
There seems to be something over there.
The gate that the Sentinel's Talisman opens should be located <001>upstream from the waterfall</>...
The gate that the Sentinel's Talisman opens should be located <001>upstream from the waterfall</>...
I must be careful this time...
I must be careful this time...
It's only a legend, but there truly is a <001>huge bronze gate</> <001>upstream from the waterfall</>.
What was he thinking, assigning Qu Yan and Lin Zheng to <001>guard duty</>...
Exactly! The moment the clock strikes <001>ten at night</>, they vanish—and our dear chief hasn't got a clue.
Ha, good move! Okay, check this out. Your turn!
Come on, cut me some slack! If only Qu Yan were here—he always wipes the floor with you!
Actually, what's he doing today? Why isn't he here playing with us?
The village chief's been <001>posting guards up in the mountains</> lately. Right now, it's Qu Yan and Lin Zheng on duty.
But these two are masters at slacking off! The second the clock hits <001>ten at night</>, they disappear—and our dear chief hasn't got a clue.
No more excuses! Return them in three days or Team Wilderness will face the consequences!
Xue Yi borrowed them properly—she followed the rules!
Exactly! A Discipline Overseer would never do that!
We have proof—our surveillance device caught her stealing.
We're just doing our job. The Forbidden Chamber must get these dangerous items back.
Three days. Miss the deadline, and Team Wilderness is over.
Don't waste your time with me. You'd better return every single item.

The Discipline Overseer orders Team Wilderness to return the treasures within three days. Rufeng tries to explain, but the Overseer says surveillance proves Xue Yi steals them. If the treasures are not returned on time, Team Wilderness will be forcibly disbanded.
Three days is the maximum grace period. If the deadline is exceeded, all activities of the Wilderness Squad will be prohibited and it will be forcibly disbanded.
zh_text: 三日已是最大宽限，若是逾期，将禁止旷野小队一切活动并强制解散。
source_text: 三日已是最大宽限，若是逾期，将禁止旷野小队一切活动并强制解散。
official_target_text: Three days is the maximum grace period. If the deadline is exceeded, all activities of the Wilderness Squad will be prohibited and it will be forcibly disbanded.
official_en_text: Three days is the maximum grace period. If the deadline is exceeded, all activities of the Wilderness Squad will be prohibited and it will be forcibly disbanded.

text: When we woke up, Xue Yi and the three treasures were gone. Then a Discipline Overseer came...
Did that Maple Snow... Was she trying to knock us out?
Now it points straight to Bastion Fort.
What? That place is as deadly as the Mausoleum!
I get it. Xue Yi wants to keep us away from danger.
Are you feeling well? Just take a break. We'll handle this.
But many Mechanoids are garrisoned in Bastion Fort. You must be fully prepared.
Actually, I hid a tracker inside my Mechcraft box, just in case.
Is that so... Hmm... But it's risky for her to go alone.
Well, you helped us find the treasures. You deserve to know everything.
When you're set, meet us there.
All the missing treasures are at Bastion Fort. Rufeng thinks Xue Yi went alone to protect everyone, so he decides to launch a rescue and tells you to prepare before you regroup.
Xue Yi suggests we seal it with Aersilk.
I feel bad I wasn't more aware as your captain.
We worked together, and I thought you were just better than most.
But you were the one meant to help Team Wilderness!
Look at it. Remind you of anything?
Kindle my life's flame, race the clock, before death falls. Who does the Death Knell toll for?
This is what you've found—the Death Knell.
It tricks people into reading their lifespans, but actually drains their life energy.
Uh... why is it back here? Wasn't it already taken by...
Uh... why is it back here? Wasn't it already taken by...
Remember? Xue Yi is a Discipline Overseer.
That made it easy for her.
Now Xianqiao and I are figuring out how to store them safely.
Got any smart ideas to stop energy escaping?
Oh, we've tried both. Neither worked.
Xianqiao is working with the Blank Book. Want to check it out?
And the other one—the Blank Book that twists people's minds...
You found two of the three legendary treasures for Team Wilderness! We'll be famous!
Rufeng says the team is looking for a way to store the treasures. He asks you to check on Xianqiao, who is working with the Blank Book.
“With the embers of life, strike the clock that runs backward. Before death arrives, for whom does the bell toll...”
zh_text: “以生命的余烬，敲响倒行的时钟，在死亡来临前，丧钟为谁而鸣……”
source_text: “以生命的余烬，敲响倒行的时钟，在死亡来临前，丧钟为谁而鸣……”
official_target_text: “With the embers of life, strike the clock that runs backward. Before death arrives, for whom does the bell toll...”
official_en_text: “With the embers of life, strike the clock that runs backward. Before death arrives, for whom does the bell toll...”

text: Oh, hey. You found this cursed book, right? That's amazing!
The Blank Book hidden in a cave, appearing different to each reader, tempting them further in...
The note from the Forbidden Chamber sounds scary. Glad I chose good materials!
I combined several materials and built a box that's really tough.
It's light and impenetrable—rare in all Jixia.
Twenty Aeririd Pearls, eight Azure Stones, and crushed Coarse Copper Stone—yes, exactly the materials needed to craft the mechanism's main body...
zh_text: 二十颗云铱珠，八块蓝沾石，粗铜石切碎，没错，就是制作机关主体的材料……
source_text: 二十颗云铱珠，八块蓝沾石，粗铜石切碎，没错，就是制作机关主体的材料……

text: It turns out that the melted Coarse Copper Stone really blocks energy.
Even with ten of these books, I'd feel safe!
Your captain's stressed—he tried so many ideas with no luck.
Your captain's stressed—he tried so many ideas with no luck.
Oops, sorry... I can't help it when it comes to my inventions...
Let's go over to him then.
Xianqiao builds a box to store the book and contain its energy, and excitedly explains how it works. Realizing she says too much, she quickly pulls you away to meet the captain.
“A wordless book hidden in a cave, seen differently by different people, sinking into a realm of desire...”
zh_text: “藏于洞穴中的无字书，不同之人观之皆异，深陷欲念之境……”
source_text: “藏于洞穴中的无字书，不同之人观之皆异，深陷欲念之境……”
official_target_text: “A wordless book hidden in a cave, seen differently by different people, sinking into a realm of desire...”
official_en_text: “A wordless book hidden in a cave, seen differently by different people, sinking into a realm of desire...”

text: I knew our genius would do it!
Now we just wait for Xue Yi. I wonder if she found that bird...
Don't worry. Xue Yi might bring clues when she returns with the singing bird.
Definitely! And Xue Yi will be glad to see you, our fourth member!
You solved the crisis, got the treasures, and came back safe so quickly...
Xianqiao worries whether Xue Yi will find the singing bird. Rufeng reassures her, saying Xue Yi will be happy to see you.
Yes. Let's get all three treasures on the table.
I heard it stole people's voices, but it looks so ordinary.
Thanks, if it weren't for you, I wouldn't have found it that quickly.
By the way, I've asked the Forbidden Chamber to care for that girl.
Xianqiao, did you find anything special?
There's an ancient gadget inside the bird's throat. The Death Knell has one too.
They're mysterious and tricky—they once ruined a Dawnsong army...
It will take a while to study them fully.
Let's set the research aside for now!
Right now, we need a celebration!
Ahem, let's toast to our big step in treasure hunting. And most importantly...
To welcome our talented fourth member!
Of course! Look at us—Xue Yi is a master tactician.
Xianqiao's intellect outsmarts any Mechcraft system.
And I, Rufeng, am our powerhouse and invented "borrowed energy attacks."
We're a talented bunch, if I say so myself.
But you turned out to be our top star!
Xue Yi, please, let's celebrate with "that."
You mean... the rare Maple Snow!?
A special drink. I left it at the base. Could you go get it?
That is... could it be the "Maple Snow" treasured by Sister Xueyi!
zh_text: “那个”是……难道是雪漪姐姐珍藏的“枫雪”！
source_text: “那个”是……难道是雪漪姐姐珍藏的“枫雪”！
official_target_text: That is... could it be the "Maple Snow" treasured by Sister Xueyi!
official_en_text: That is... could it be the "Maple Snow" treasured by Sister Xueyi!

text: I heard your grandfather buried them under the oldest maple tree in Hermitage.
I wonder that, too. Why was it named that?
Moonlight on maple, girl hidden in snowy cloth.
Well, it's time to open up about my past.
My grandfather was a Seeker who searched for lost history and treasures.
He came to Aerfall Highlands and became obsessed with the ruins here.
One day, he found a baby under a maple tree.
The baby was wrapped in a snow-white blanket among red maple leaves.
When he got closer, the baby calmly looked at him without fear.
He then decided to raise the baby and stayed at Hermitage.
During his time there, he brewed Maple Snow and buried it under the tree.
As the child grew, he learned about a legend of the treasures in Aerfall Highlands.
It told of three warriors in the old war.
Before leaving, he said I should study hard at Jixia.
When he returned, we'd open Maple Snow together.
So I teamed up with Rufeng and Xianqiao to search for the treasures...
... and, most importantly, for my grandfather.
So it was you... I thought Rufeng started the team.
So it was you... I thought Rufeng started the team.
Hehe, yes. Xianqiao and I were just weirdos no one cared about in the academy.
Xue Yi saw our potential and brought us together.
Instead of a boring life, why not use our talents somewhere meaningful?
I said... Life isn't a set path—it's Wilderness...
Never mind. Let's have some drinks!
I'm forever grateful. No matter what, we'll stick together.
Hey, cheer up! We'll find the treasures—and your grandfather!
Come on. Let's toast to that!
How can we skip our motto at a moment like this?
Come on, Captain... Well, let's do it!
One, two, three, everyone! Here in Jixia, where Team Wilderness adventures...
Here in Jixia, where Team Wilderness adventures...
Go Team Wilderness! Fight! Fight! Fight!
Go Team Wilderness! Fight! Fight! Fight!
Is it connected to maple trees?
Is it connected to maple trees?
One, two, three, shout together: All of Jixia is our wilderness for adventure...
zh_text: 一二三，一起喊：整个稷下，就是我们冒险的旷野……
source_text: 一二三，一起喊：整个稷下，就是我们冒险的旷野……
official_target_text: One, two, three, shout together: All of Jixia is our wilderness for adventure...
official_en_text: One, two, three, shout together: All of Jixia is our wilderness for adventure...

text: Where are they? Who's there at the entrance?
Where are they? Who's there at the entrance?
Caught you! Kids shouldn't wander here!
Let me in! She went that way!
The light has those mysterious marks' energy...
The energy coming from above is powering up something...
Xianqiao catches Mimi, who tells you where Xue Yi is headed. Xianqiao senses a powerful energy—Xue Yi may be about to unlock the final treasure.
Why's the entrance shut? Wait, it's my...
Mechcraft Frequency Booster? You used that at the Mechcraft Competition, right?
Yes... My first invention—it lets you control Mechanoids by adjusting their signal frequency.
It interfered with all the Mechanoids in the competition and caused chaos...
It's causing trouble again! The Mechanoids here are affected!
I'm still weak... Xianqiao, protect Mimi!
Please defend against them until I recover.
The gate shuts, and you find Xianqiao's Mechcraft Frequency Booster. Rufeng tells Xianqiao to protect Mimi and asks you to help hold off the Mechanoids.
Mechanism Frequency Amplifier? Isn't that the one you used for the mechanism competition?
zh_text: “机关同频增幅仪”？这不是你参加机关比赛的那个？
source_text: “机关同频增幅仪”？这不是你参加机关比赛的那个？
official_target_text: Mechanism Frequency Amplifier? Isn't that the one you used for the mechanism competition?
official_en_text: Mechanism Frequency Amplifier? Isn't that the one you used for the mechanism competition?

text: Fantastic! You're super fast, just like me!
Looks like you've been outdone, Captain!
I would say, "The next generation has gone further than the last."
Done. It won't activate Mechanoids again.
Yep—the thing that almost got me banned.
Luckily, Xue Yi defended me so I could continue to compete...
Were we chosen just to be used? I can't accept.
No matter what, she founded Team Wilderness.
I mean... her kindness might be an act.
Xianqiao and Rufeng argue about Xue Yi. Rufeng says Team Wilderness exists because of her, while Xianqiao doubts her motives. Mimi shouts the team's motto.
Here in Jixia, where Team Wilderness adventures!
Go Team Wilderness! Fight! Fight! Fight!
As the argument continues, Mimi shouts Team Wilderness's motto.
You scared me! Mimi, what are you doing?
Xue Yi taught me this, but she didn't seem to like it.
Still, she was careful about showing me every detail.
If she didn't like you, she wouldn't remember it so clearly!
Besides, she sounds so happy whenever she talks about you.
Just like—just like my best friend Feifei!
Okay, I'm leaving. My adventure ends here!
I just wanted to see the place my brother visited.
Kids by the sea learn to swim. Kids from Hermitage learn to hide from Mechanoids!
I've explored so many places in Aerfall Highlands...
But we are never allowed to come here.
My brother's adventure team was the only ones allowed in—like yours!
They left here and crossed the sea. It's been two years, still not back.
I missed him so much, so I followed you...
Kid, listen! I get it, but Seekers never risk needless danger!
That's it—your adventure's done. Now go home!
The three artifacts return, and the hidden treasure activates...
Energy is surging. The Mechanoids are about to be reactivated!
No time to waste. Let's get Mimi to safety first. Go find Xue Yi, please.
Haha, I can tell you're stronger than all of us. So can I count on you to bring Xue Yi back safely?
We'll catch up as soon as we can. I can track your location!
Here in Jixia, where Team Wilderness adventures!
Go Team Wilderness! Fight! Fight! Fight!

Mimi proves that Xue Yi cares about the team and explains why she wants to come here with you. With the Mechanoids reactivating, Rufeng tells Mimi and Xianqiao to leave and counts on you to find Xue Yi.
The three artifacts return to their places, the secret treasure reopens...
official_target_text: The three artifacts return to their places, the secret treasure reopens...
official_en_text: The three artifacts return to their places, the secret treasure reopens...

text: Who am I? Haven't heard that in years.
That nursery rhyme... It was you...
That nursery rhyme... It was you...
There are always people who don't understand our research and mission.
I'm the one without talent—unworthy of the Enlightenment Trials.
But who gave them the right to decide my fate?
But the ritual's side effects killed them one by one.
Among the three who created the ritual, only one survived. He possessed a bird and spread a legend.
Three people united Sorcery, Mechcraft, and Martial Arts to copy his ritual and created ultimate warriors.
Many students gained incredible power and joined the war against Dawnsong.
You should be honored. You'll witness the birth of the strongest warrior again!

Xue Yi is trapped. The Singing Bird speaks. It explains that years ago, three people tried to create warriors like the Sage, but only one survived. That survivor transferred his life into a Mechanoid Bird and spread a legend about treasures. Now he plans to use Xue Yi to make the ultimate warrior.
That last hit drained me. Maybe I can just be a regular student now.
No more jealous looks. I feel relieved.
Xue Yi, can you explain it now?
You heard him. This isn't the kind of treasure worth studying.
It was a made-up legend to hide their mistakes.
Grandpa spent years chasing it, and went missing...
If the truth comes out, his reputation will be ruined.
It's true that I recruited you only to find the treasure.
I'll quit the team and face punishment.
So that's it... I won't forgive you, Xue Yi.
Unless you help me find ten more ancient creations!
But Team Wilderness doesn't let anyone quit!
If you'd told us, did you think we wouldn't help?
Team Wilderness, exploring and living freely... it was all a lie.
After Grandpa left, all I could think about was finding him.
I studied and trained hard just to search for him.
But when we made progress and everyone cheered, it felt more meaningful...
Hey, forget why it began. What really matters is how much you care. See?
But Rufeng, your power... It's my fault.
So what? I'll ask Master Fuzi for help. Maybe he can FIX me up!
Whatever the punishment, we'll face it together!
You had good intentions. I believe the academy will be fair.
Thanks, and sorry for dragging you in.
You should believe in your friends.
It's tiring to carry everything alone.
It's an honor to join you.
Enough apologizing. Take me to the academy for treatment!
Thank you! Let's go on more epic adventures next time!
Let's do it to say goodbye, shall we?
You finally come around to it? I'm moved to tears...
Go Team Wilderness! Fight! Fight! Fight!
Goodbye. May our friendship last forever!
I'm so sorry. I can't make up for lying or Rufeng's injury.
Alright then, this is where we part ways. We may face the Department of Discipline once we're back.
We can't get you in trouble anymore. When it's all over, I hope we meet again.
Xue Yi admits everything and decides to take responsibility alone. Xianqiao and Rufeng insist that the three of them should face punishment together. They say goodbye, hoping to meet you again.
She can't hold on much longer!
Hello, fellow juniors. Here for your traitor? I already punished her on your behalf.
What are you talking about? Who are you!
Me? Just a nobody, unworthy of the Enlightenment Trials or the Sage's ritual.
As for her... If she really saw you as partners, why would she leave you behind and come here alone?
She... she must've had her reasons!
Reasons? Huh. You trust her that much?
Long ago, my two partners and I combined Martial Arts, Mechcraft, and Sorcery to try the Sage's ritual ourselves.
But it was flawed. The warriors it made were fearsome in the Dawnsong War, yet none survived the cost.
When disaster hit, they betrayed me and blamed everything on me, but they paid for it soon enough.
It's tragic, isn't it? Only one survived and was trapped inside a bird just to stay alive.
That's what "trust" cost me. Now it's your turn.
Heh. They said that too. Now that everything's ready, I'll take over her body when the ritual is finished.
The Singing Bird says his partners betrayed him, forcing him to survive this way. He claims he has punished Xue Yi and will finish the ritual to take over her body.
He rushed in as soon as he got here. I couldn't stop him!
Bastion Fort has three levels—he should be on the ground level.
The locator on the treasures stopped. I'm afraid Xue Yi has gotten rid of it.
I've deployed a probe in the sky. All the exits of Bastion Fort are being checked.
Bastion Fort is one of the most infamous war ruins on East Aerfall Highlands.
Jixia and Dawnsong fought here. Jixia's biggest weapons stash was inside.
I know Mechcraft, but Xue Yi's the real expert on ruins.
Her plan is probably more than just protecting us...
Xue Yi's mind works in mysterious ways—more complex than any Mechcraft design.
Since we started, I've had this feeling...

Amidst the autumn air, the crows lament.
The moonlit sky recalls the past...

Alright, I'll go check it out.

Time's fleeting grasp, like whispers in the breeze.

The sword remains, the waterfalls flow as always, but you...

As sun descends, I weep for friends unseen.

The girl introduces herself as Yunlan, an Aersilk Harvester who came to retrieve Aersilk raided by Rebels. She asks you to help unlock the Mechcraft device and recover the Aersilk.
Those cunning Rebels... We must be more vigilant...
The Aersilk Harvester wails that the Rebels stole all the Aersilk.
Someone is calling for help. I need to handle these Rebels.
Someone is calling for help. I need to handle these Rebels.
So strong... What do we do, boss? B-boss?
Alright, the gate is open, and the Aersilk is all there.
Alright, the gate is open, and the Aersilk is all there.
With Sweet Jam, I might feel better...
No. I just hope her BIG dreams come true.
She promised to sing for Qu Jiang.
She promised to sing for Qu Jiang.
Haha... I guess she's too busy being a superstar to sing for you.
I've looked everywhere. Maybe she has left with that man...
Well, she shouldn't be too far. I'll check in the village. Will you go east of the village to look?
Oh well, if she's made up her mind, why should I worry about her?
Xie Fu is also looking for Jin Chun. She asks you to search for Jin Chun east of the village.
Jin Chun, Jin Chun! What happened? Why are you out here alone?
Jin Chun, Jin Chun! What happened? Why are you out here alone?
This bird... It's singing in Jin Chun's voice... What on earth is going on?
This bird... It's singing in Jin Chun's voice... What on earth is going on?
You find Jin Chun, who can only whimper, while the strange bird is singing in her voice. As a storm breaks out, you take her back to the village.
No clue... She was already like that when I arrived. Doesn't seem physically injured, though.
No clue... She was already like that when I arrived. Doesn't seem physically injured, though.
What happened? Why did she lose her voice?!
That man must be behind this...
Thank you for bringing her back. I've got to find her a doctor...
Jin Chun has lost her voice. Xie Fu decides to take her to seek medical treatment.
This ever-changing timbre is simply unreal! No matter how many times I listen to it, it always leaves me in awe!
Yep! Isn't it amazing? This is the Song of Longing that took Chang'an by storm. Listen! Each note hits you right in the feels...
How can a bird sing like a human?
How can a bird sing like a human?
Hey there! Sorry, I got lost. I'm Qu Jiang, a Musician. I followed it all the way from Frostcloud Town.
Were you also entranced by its singing? You seem like a music enthusiast too.
It sings lyrics, remembers songs, and effortlessly switches between voices of all ages and genders. Few things in Jixia compare.
Ah, you mean Chun. She has an extraordinary voice indeed.
That's her. One day, she came here and sang with my bird, and her voice outshined all the professional singers I know.
It was like a burst of light through the clouds, a powerful call summoning the elements, echoing in a valley...
Too bad her family won't let her leave the village, or I would have recommended her to the academy.
Ah, rejection often stems from an unsuitable price, my friend.
Nothing, the next song you requested is about to begin. Hush and listen.
It's so full of emotion, even better than the top vocal mentors in the academy!
Marvelous! This next song originates from the frontier region of Alsahraa. Come enjoy it with me!
Yeah, most of them are here out of curiosity, but I actually discovered a talented young singer.
This bird is truly incredible, but it won't sell no matter what! My friend here, tell our new fan what's up!
Music is meant for those who truly appreciate it. Anyway, plenty of youngsters come to listen every day...
Haha, I've put my heart and soul into raising this bird.
But it's a shame that the villagers are stubborn and won't let it perform in the village.
So I had no choice but to set up a stall here.
A merchant owns a bird that sings in human-like voices. He mentions a local girl who has a beautiful singing voice.
I have to say. It is amazing.
I have to say. It is amazing.
I've neglected my studies due to this adventure, gotta rush back to the academy tonight.
Thanks a million! Oh, by the way, Chun's full name is Jin Chun.
I'm not exactly sure where she lives, but I bet someone around here will know.
If she agrees to sing, tell her I'm waiting by the waterfall.
Oh well, I guess I'll have to do it myself.
It's on me! You should try the popular Ballad of the Lute in Chang'an.
I'd really love to stick around a bit longer for the melody. Can you help me deliver my song to Chun?
The bird never fails to impress me. That tune took me straight to the bustling bazaars of Jade City...
However, I've composed a song for Chun, the girl we were talking about, and I want to record her singing it.
Heh, my friend, would you like a tune as well? It's cheap now, with a ten percent discount for new customers.
zh_text: 呵呵，这位朋友，你也要来点一曲吗？现在便宜，新顾客有九折优惠。
source_text: 呵呵，这位朋友，你也要来点一曲吗？现在便宜，新顾客有九折优惠。

text: Sorry, I don't have time for this.
Sure, I'll get it to her for you.
You don't have to be shy. I'm truly glad to meet a fellow enthusiast... but I do have a small favor to ask.
Help me, and I'll play five songs for you.
So, what do you need my help with?
So, what do you need my help with?
Qu Jiang asks you to deliver a song he wrote to Jin Chun.
Hello, do you happen to know where Jin Chun is?
Hello, do you happen to know where Jin Chun is?
Jin Chun? She's got so many visitors lately, tsk tsk.
It's an old rule from our ancestors—no contact with outsiders.
However, in recent years, it has become less strict. I can't quite understand what's so appealing about the outside world.
But she won't leave here, even if someone likes her voice.
All she cares about is singing, and she never gives a thought to her home.
But Jin Chun's family is strict with her and doesn't want her to leave. So she will stay home.
If you're looking for Jin Chun, you might want to check near the waterfall. She goes there sometimes. Perhaps the elderly man resting there has seen her.
You ask a girl where to find Jin Chun. She says that Jin Chun might be near the waterfall.
Let's start by asking this girl.
Let's start by asking this girl.
Does she often go out to sing?
Does she often go out to sing?
Then do you know where she usually goes to sing?
Then do you know where she usually goes to sing?
I'm trying to find Jin Chun. Any idea where she might be?
I'm trying to find Jin Chun. Any idea where she might be?
I can't tell if she's good, but her voice always cheers me up.
Oh yeah, she can't help but belt out a tune.
Not sure... See the girl by the crossroads? She is Xie Fu, Jin Chun's friend. She might be able to help.
You don't find Jin Chun at the waterfall. A kind old man points you to a girl who always sings with Jin Chun.
I don't see anyone who looks like Jin Chun... Let's ask this old man first.
I don't see anyone who looks like Jin Chun... Let's ask this old man first.
Hello, do you know Jin Chun?
Hello, do you know Jin Chun?
Yes. Hm? Another student from the academy?
Yep, I've got a song to deliver to her.
Yep, I've got a song to deliver to her.
Go straight from here to the cliff behind the square. If she hasn't gone to Chang'an, she'll be there.
Not really. Just known each other for about ten years or so.
Haha, what's the point? She'd rather listen to a stranger.
Sorry, no offense. I know Qu Jiang, and he's a solid dude.
A little stubborn, but he's sincere.
She truly believes she can become a famous singer and make big money from her songs.
She's completely stubborn. Even a seven-year-old boy has more common sense than her.
Ugh, enough about that. Hurry up and go find her.
Jixia Academy is a good place to learn skills.
But Chun always falls for unrealistic ideas.
The girl says Jin Chun is at the cliff just outside the village.
The girl by the crossroads... This should be her.
The girl by the crossroads... This should be her.
There's a girl on the cliff. That has to be Jin Chun.
There's a girl on the cliff. That has to be Jin Chun.
Yes, I am. Who are you?
A Musician sent me here with a song for you.
A Musician sent me here with a song for you.
Ah, Qu Jiang? ...I never thought he'd actually write a song for me...
All the attention he's been giving me makes me feel kinda guilty.
Are you sure that person's reliable?
Are you sure that person's reliable?
Please tell him to meet me in two hours at the waterfall where we first met.
He loves my voice and wants to recommend me for the academy.
But... I wanna go somewhere beyond Jixia.
I've been coming here since I was a kid, gazing at distant ships, wondering where they're going.
That man said... I should go to Chang'an.
Anyway, I should thank Qu Jiang. Before I go, I'll master and perform this song for him.
Your voice is worth a fortune to the rich and powerful. Don't waste time studying at Jixia Academy.
He would never lie to me, but even my best friend doesn't understand me...
This person fully believes in and supports me, and his knowledge of music surpasses Qu Jiang's...
Jin Chun accepts the song. She plans to leave for Chang'an and promises to sing the song at the waterfall before she goes.
What do you mean? You were totally mesmerized by it, weren't you?
What do you mean? You were totally mesmerized by it, weren't you?
Did you find Chun? Did she agree to sing it?
She agreed. She also said to meet her in two hours at the waterfall where you first met.
She agreed. She also said to meet her in two hours at the waterfall where you first met.
Wonderful! I knew Chun wouldn't turn me down!
No way we Musicians would let a talent like her go unnoticed. This song was tailored for her.
By the way, the most artistically captivating voice I've heard lately, besides Chun, has to be that bird.
But there's something a bit off about it.
Over days of close observation, I've noticed the bird's voice box seems to be in the wrong place.
Forget about it. By the way, I've been inspired lately. Want me to share with you?
I got curious and asked a Hunter, who told me that birds have syrinxes.
It's like the vocal cords for humans. According to biology, birds shouldn't be able to make sounds like that...
I asked the merchant, but he said it was a secret and refused to disclose.
Qu Jiang is pleased that Jin Chun accepted the song. He says her voice and the merchant's bird are the most beautiful he has heard lately, but he feels that something isn't right.
Oh, time flies! It's getting dark.
These music facts and stories are really fascinating.
These music facts and stories are really fascinating.
May I trouble you to help me give her a message?
If Chun were here, we'd probably keep going. Why isn't she here yet?
Yes, a lot more time than two hours has gone by.
Yes, a lot more time than two hours has gone by.
Looks like I won't be able to see her. I gotta go now or I'll be late for class tomorrow.
Let her know I'll come back next month and hope to hear her sing the song then.
Qu Jiang can't wait any longer and has to return to the academy. He asks you to tell Jin Chun he will come back next month.
Jin Chun? No, that's not her...
Jin Chun? No, that's not her...
Don't you worry, Chun, I'll take care of you... You'll get better...
Any luck finding that strange Croaky?
Wait! You never tried it yourself?
Wait! You never tried it yourself?
I've got a Croaky Potion. It lets you understand their language.
Can't guarantee it'll work every time, though.
So what do you think? Wanna try it?
Well, there's a suspicious Croaky behind that house.
Find it and see if my potion works.
Hmm... it was hard to make, so I saved it for you.
Alright, come back whenever you're ready.
Strange? Can you describe it a little more?
Ye Da invites you to test a special potion. He claims it lets you understand the Croakies' language.
Can you head over right now, then?
Can you head over right now, then?
Fine. Do you know where I can find the other one?
Fine. Do you know where I can find the other one?
Brainy is waiting for you. Said you have a plan to make.
Brainy is waiting for you. Said you have a plan to make.
Oh, I seem to remember now... But I feel really woozy right now.
No. I'm too hungry to do anything.
No idea. The only thing I can think of is the smell of cakes.
I gotta figure out a way to feed it.
I gotta figure out a way to feed it.
Shye said that Tata would often prepare food for the Croakies.
Shye said that Tata would often prepare food for the Croakies.
Let me see if I can find any.
Let me see if I can find any.
You find Bowie passed out from hunger. It wants pastries, so you decide to head to Tata's place to scrounge up some food.
Oh, Skippy went to the stage to watch the Societies' shows!
After eating its fill, Bowie keeps its word and tells you Skippy is at the Stage watching the Societies' shows.
Wow! How did you know my name?
Brainy asked me to find you.
Brainy asked me to find you.
You understand our language? That's interesting!
I'm starting to wish I couldn't, to be honest...
I'm starting to wish I couldn't, to be honest...
You should join me. The shows are so exciting!
I'm staying for now! Say, why don't you go in my stead?
Emm... what are you planning to do?
Emm... what are you planning to do?
Brainy wants to unite us Croakies and chase the humans out of town!
He believes we will have all the good food for ourselves if there are no humans.
But aren't you having enough right now?
But aren't you having enough right now?
Indeed. So, do me a favor and tell Brainy that Skippy is out, will ya?
Two found, two out... I should tell Brainy about this.
Two found, two out... I should tell Brainy about this.
You tell Skippy to go meet with Brainy, but it doesn't want to miss the show. It spills Brainy's plan and quits the mission. You decide to break the news to Brainy.
Losing two great generals at once... I should tell Congcong about the situation first.

text: The potion is probably working... Were you speaking just then?
The potion is probably working... Were you speaking just then?
You bet I was! This is my territory!
Hey, wait! Human, you understand what I was saying?
Yes, but I didn't hear anything. Don't get nervous.
Yes, but I didn't hear anything. Don't get nervous.
I'm Brainy. And as you've probably guessed, I've got the smartest brain amongst Croakies!
Smartest brain... just because your name is Brainy?
Smartest brain... just because your name is Brainy?
What? Seeing how stupid you are, my plan might just work.
Alright, human. Want to help me with something? I'll let you be a captain if we succeed.
How about this, then? If you ever need something moved, I'll be the first to help!
Fine. Now out with it. What do you need from me?
Fine. Now out with it. What do you need from me?
My two friends were supposed to meet me here to discuss our plan, but neither showed up.
So I need you to help me check if they ran into some accident.
Bowie is probably at... well, the food shop. I'd start from there if I were you.
The potion worked. A Croaky named Brighty asks you to find two of its friends. One of them, Bowie, might be at the Food Shop.
Back alone? You're terrible at your job! Where are those two?
What? I prepped everything! Look at the shovel here! And this stick!
They're not into your plan to kick out humans.
They're not into your plan to kick out humans.
Kick o- what? I... I don't know what you're talking about. Croak! Cuh-croak!
Why do you want the humans gone anyway?
Why do you want the humans gone anyway?
Looks like the effect cannot last very long.
Looks like the effect cannot last very long.
Anyway, I doubt they're gonna cause any real trouble.
Anyway, I doubt they're gonna cause any real trouble.
But this is quite an interesting experience.
But this is quite an interesting experience.
Oh, right. Tata asked if you wanted some cake.
Oh, right. Tata asked if you wanted some cake.
No? Fine. I'll tell her to skip yours. Bowie had some already.
No? Fine. I'll tell her to skip yours. Bowie had some already.
What? You'll never eat cakes again? Okay, then.
What? You'll never eat cakes again? Okay, then.
Hey! That is not what I said!
Ah, so the potion is still working.
Ah, so the potion is still working.
Do that again, and I'll start plucking your hair.
Do that again, and I'll start plucking your hair.
No, please don't! I love my hair! I'll tell you everything.
Then tell me why you want the humans out of town.
Then tell me why you want the humans out of town.
I... I passed Ember's smithy and wanted to see her forge, but she chased me out, so I...
The forge? It's so hot there that it could be dangerous. She's just trying to protect you.
The forge? It's so hot there that it could be dangerous. She's just trying to protect you.
I got it. Then go to Tata's. The cakes will be ready soon.
I got it. Then go to Tata's. The cakes will be ready soon.
Cakes? For real? Why didn't you tell me earlier...?
I believe the effect has really worn off this time.
I believe the effect has really worn off this time.
You tell Brainy that Bowie and Skippy aren't coming, but then the potion wears off. Any follow-up questions are met with confused croaking.
Emm... I'd rather not. It messes up my digestion...
Emm... I'd rather not. It messes up my digestion...
The potion works. I did talk to the Croakies.
The potion works. I did talk to the Croakies.
That's awesome! What did you talk about?
Well... It's a little secret between me and the Croakies.
Well... It's a little secret between me and the Croakies.
Haha, great! I'm just glad it works. I'll improve it and invite you to test it again.
Oh? Don't worry. I'll add something good for your stomach, then.
You tell Ye Da the potion worked. Thrilled, he starts tweaking the formula and asks you to keep testing it. You decide to bail for now.
I've got a Croaky Potion. It lets you understand their language.
What should I give him... Ah, gift-giving is an art in itself.
Hey there, I'm Yunge, owner of Cirroflow Store in Frostcloud Town. Take a look at my stuff.
Are you interested in learning more?
Cirroflow Cards? Why are they so special?
Just like the saying that, time flows like water while cirro takes many faces.
He travels all over Jixia to find unique cards.
He's in Frostcloud Town for a few days. You can talk to him if you're interested.
Thank you, my friend. You've done me a big favor.
You see, Cuckoo and I are finally meeting again in Frostcloud Town. I wanna get him a gift, but have no idea what.
Talking to you gave me an idea for the perfect gift.
Can you do me a favor and deliver it to him?
Don't worry. He'll reward you well for it.
I get it. If you ever wanna know more about Cirroflow Cards, drop by anytime.
Wait, you've never been here? Cirroflow Cards are all the rage across the lands!
A Trader and a Seeker teamed up to create the first set of Cirroflow Cards.
In an event later known as the "Panoramist Gathering", these cards were given to their friends from Chang'an as a parting gift.
Everyone went crazy for them because of the beautiful illustrations and unique material.
These cards showcase scenic spots and legends of heroes.
And guess what? The Trader was my mentor.
My sisters and I learned a lot while making Cirroflow Cards with our teacher, thus starting the Panoramology Society.
Now, my sisters Yunyi and Xiaoyu sell Cirroflow Cards too.
We wanna share more and better cards with the world.
Sounds like you're a big fan of Cirroflow Cards.
Sounds like you're a big fan of Cirroflow Cards.
Speaking of love... My buddy Cuckoo is a big shot in the Cirroflow Card world.
Oh? Yes, that's me. How may I help you?
Yunge sent me with something for you.
Yunge sent me with something for you.
I see. This gift is exactly what I would expect of her.
It's a collector's box specially designed by the Panoramology Society, experts in Sorcery and Mechcraft, for Cirroflow Card enthusiasts.
It's so nostalgic for me. She gave me my very first Panorama Box, back in the day...
Cirroflow Cards are precious to me, but sharing them with a friend means the world to me.
But I happen to have bought a new Panorama Box too. What a pity...
Here's the one I bought. Take it as a token of gratitude.
Here, hold it tight. This is the latest Amberfolio.
Now, try using the Panorama Box to create an Amberfolio!
I wonder what she gave you.
I wonder what she gave you.
In that instant, the world's visions flashed before my eyes, like flowing clouds and lanterns...
Yunge used to say... The feeling of having fellow aficionados is priceless.
Haha, I'd like to share the joy of collecting Cirroflow Cards with you too!
It's highly prized and has space for a lot of beautiful Cirroflow Cards!
That's when I began collecting Cirroflow Cards.
Thank you guys. I couldn't ask for a better gift.
Using Sorcery techniques, the Panoramologists replicated the formation of amber to create Aerflow Amber, which is used to store Cirroflow Cards.
Speaking of which, only a true collector can open Amberfolios for the Cirroflow Cards inside.
“The Flowing Cloud Token is precious to me, but sharing it with friends is even more precious.”

text: He loved it and gave me a new Panorama Box.
He loved it and gave me a new Panorama Box.
Haha, congrats. You're now a proper Cirroflow Card collector too!
If you need help with your Panorama Box or Cirroflow Cards, I'm here for you!
As a thank you, I'll share any knowledge I have.
How do I get Cirroflow Cards?
The main way is by opening <001>Amberfolios</>.
Other than Frostcloud Town, you can find <001>Cirroflow Stores</> in Aerux Town and School of Sorcery, owned by Yunyi and Xiaoyu.
Use <001>Cirroflow Coins</> created by Panoramists to buy Amberfolios from the stores. Then open them in Panorama Boxes.
You never know how many or what cards you'll get until you open them!
The Panorama Box helps you organize your cards by <001>sets</>.
Completing a set leads to <001>special transformations</>.
How do I earn Cirroflow Coins?
When you get duplicate cards, you can <001>Dismantle</> them in the Panorama Box for Cirroflow Coins.
You can also <001>Transfigure</> them to upgrade their frames.
You can earn Cirroflow Coins by finding them in Jixia or completing quests.
I'm so glad you joined our ranks. Now let's get out there and collect all kinds of different Cirroflow Cards!
May the happiness these cards bring you walk with you everywhere you go henceforth.
Opening new Amberfolios is always exciting for every collector, and I'm no exception!
Only a true master of Cirroflow Cards would understand the joy of it.
Still unsure? Join us and see why we're the best team at Aerdeep Camp!
My power keeps us safe. Xianqiao's creations get us where no one else can go.
And Xue Yi is a top Seeker and strict Discipline Overseer. She is very reliable!
The academy keeps some dangerous ruins off limits... but with Xue Yi, we might get access!
Come on, it's about doing the Seekers' job.
Anyway, Team Wilderness isn't open to anyone.
To me, you're already on the team! I, the Captain, officially welcome you to Team Wilderness!
Join us! It's been ages since we had a new member!
You two, ease up. Well, just decide when you're ready.
Uh... maybe later. For now, congrats—you're joining the hunt for...
Take a break, then meet at Hermitage!
As you see, they are always energetic... You'll get used to it. Welcome.
Well, let me tell you about our ultimate goal...
If you join, you get to search for the greatest secret in Aerfall Highlands—
It's the oldest and most legendary treasure in Aerfall Highlands.
The legend is about the three warriors who fought the Dawnsong army.
Those three warriors changed history—all thanks to the treasure!
You might've heard it already. Does it sound appealing?
Let's uncover this huge mystery together!
Welcome! I'm really glad you joined.
As you see, they are always energetic... You'll get used to it. Welcome.
Absolutely. Xue Yi's healing is amazing. You can always trust her.
You've just got a sturdy body.
Look! I broke the first protection. It was quite complicated.
Hmm... Its cover reminds me of Jixia Academy.
It feels old, locked by some kind of Sorcery.
These marks are odd—like what we've found in the ruins.
It's protected by both Mechcraft and Sorcery. The content must be valuable.
The Sorcery energy is... very peculiar.
I'm not good at Sorcery—Xue Yi, you got any idea?
But they might be the key to learning how it was locked.
So, we need to <001>restore them</> first...
They look familiar to me. Perhaps I have seen them before.
Hermitage? Isn't that your old home, Xue Yi? I've heard it's mysterious. I'd love to visit it!
Not a sightseeing trip. Be serious.
It's a long shot, but worth trying! That's Team Wilderness spirit!
Leave it to me. I'll handle negotiations. I won't let you down.
Heh, you usually make things messy for us.
Hurry up and get packed. Prepare yourself and set off for the Hermitage.
Well, you haven't joined a Seeker Team, right? Wanna come with Team Wilderness?
We're not some big organization, and we can't promise you Ringild or treasure right away.
But we really admire your courage and spirit.
It's the oldest and most legendary treasure in Aerfall Highlands.
The legend is about the three warriors who fought the Dawnsong army.
Those three warriors changed history—all thanks to the treasure!
You might've heard it already. If not, we'll fill you in.
Let's uncover this huge mystery together!
Take a break, then meet at Hermitage!
Welcome! I'm really glad you joined.
Hermitage. This one and that one. I saw them in Hermitage.
A symbolist there studied ancient runes. We might find clues in the village.
Just so you know, that symbolist is gone.
I'm not sure if his research was preserved.
Hermitage doesn't welcome outsiders. It might be hard to enter.

Mature Bitewood resembles pinecones, with a spiny outer coat and a reddish-orange color. You can find it near Frostcloud Town.
Oh? You saw my message on the Mission Board, have you gathered mature Bitewood?
Oh? So you saw my message on the Mission Board. Have you gathered three Splitternut Trees?
There are plenty of Splitternut Trees near Frostcloud Town in West Aerfall Highlands.
Great, I can continue my experiments now!
Thank you. I'm sure you'll shine in the Herb Society.
Dammit, I never thought I'd fail so many times...
I just wanted to run an experiment, but I ended up using all the Pawpaw stored up!
Pawpaw is common in Jixia Plains, but I'm tied up here. Could you bring me <001>two Pawpaws</>?
Dammit, I never thought I'd fail so many times...
I just wanted to run an experiment, but I ended up using all the Pawpaw stored up!
Pawpaw is common in Jixia Plains, but I'm tied up here. Could you please bring me <001>two Pawpaws</>?
Thank you, this should satisfy our peculiar customer.
Take a look at what I'm selling. It works better than Waxgrass Powder.
Why does it have to be <001>Bee Grass Powder</>...?
A customer specifically requested <001>Bee Grass Powder</>, but I have a better medicine here...
Exactly. Could you fetch me <001>two doses of Waxgrass Powder</>?
Why does it have to be <001>Bee Grass Powder</>...?
A customer specifically requested <001>Bee Grass Powder</>, but I have a better medicine here...
Exactly. Could you get me <001>two doses of Waxgrass Powder</>? You can either make it or buy it.
I heard <001>Green Breeze Powder</> works similarly to our <001>Restorative Cold Tea</>.
Did you bring <001>one serving of Green Breeze Powder</>?
Just like before, its effect is still not as good as our <001>Restorative Cold Tea</>.
Why not give it a try? Some say it has extra benefits!
Oh? So you saw my message on the Mission Board. Have you gathered three Splitternut Trees?
There are plenty of Splitternut Trees near Frostcloud Town in West Aerfall Highlands.
Old Luo, I see my friend is recovering very quickly. That's great.
Yeah, the red and blue birds have been dealt with, and we have plenty of supplies now, so there shouldn't be any issues with follow-up treatment.
I'm truly grateful to the hero who defeated the twin birds.
Yeah, I'm really grateful to him. By the way, how are your ears recovering?
I'm basically better. I didn't expect the mucus of the Velvet Doctor to be so magical. It recovered almost completely in just one night.
That's good, that's good. Good, things are moving in a positive direction.
Thanks to the protagonist for resolving the two-bird crisis!
Speak up. What do you want to borrow this time?
Sister Miao, what kind of person do you take me for? I'm here to return the ingredients I borrowed earlier. Look.
Thanks to the hero who defeated the Red and Blue, I'm no longer short on medicine.
So that's how it is. I really did misunderstand you. I'm busy preparing medicinal meals for patients, so my attitude was a bit... Please don't take it to heart.
Oh, why so polite? By the way, do you have any extra pots? I've run out of containers for brewing medicine.
Sigh, I knew it. I really shouldn't have let my guard down with you.
Thanks to the person who dealt with the red and blue birds.
What is this? It's disgusting! It's all sticky and so cold.
Brother Pan Xia, who is the little one standing next to you? Did he get this slime on me?
Chen Chen! This is Dr. Rong. You are coated in the precious mucus she sacrificed to save you. How can you speak to her like that?
I'm telling you, if it weren't for their help, we would have run out of medicine long ago. Hurry up and apologize to them.
Sorry, I just... sigh, I have a short temper, and I say things without thinking... Please don't take it to heart.
The Herb Society is disciplining the martial arts students!
So you're the one who defeated those red and blue birds?
Those two birds were already in my grasp. I didn't expect you to beat me to it.
But since you're clearly skilled, I'll be the bigger person and forgive you this time.
It's just... if you have the chance, could you teach me a move or two? It's not that I really want to learn, it's just... it looks kind of cool.
Willing to become friends with the protagonist!
How did so many shell fragments get into my body...
Sorry, student, I'm treating his wounds. His condition is very critical.
Please give me some space to provide medical treatment, thank you.
Ouch, not bad, kid. You actually made it past all those guards? Then let me be your opponent!
Boss is making a move! This is going to be good!
You're actually pretty tough, kid... What are you lot standing around for? Get him!
Sigh. Just like the last few days, nothing to show for it. I couldn't even help with what the hunter asked of me.
According to my days of investigation, these underground waters are definitely rich in fish, but they've all been scared off by the intruders.
And we can only fish in this shallow area. The good spots are all taken by the door-breaking students. They are right there, see?
It's so infuriating. I'm just saying, if someone hadn't stopped me, I would've gone and fought those gate-crashers.
Complaining about not catching anything for days!
Dammit, one wrong move. I had that guard on the ropes and he was about to give in...
Sister Ranran is the same, insisting that the <001>Red and Blue Birds</> are powerful, and for safety, she organized this hunting selection to cull the red and blue <001>birds</>.
Why is the opponent I have to select a person instead of an animal?
Does the fact that I can't beat this guard mean I'm not qualified to fight? I specialize in fighting animals, not people.
It's really unreasonable, I'm so angry. I'm going to find the others to hear my side of the story.
A student stopped by the guards!
Warning! Warning! Primary defense system signal not detected. Initiating hidden defender: Titan.
System error: Titan signal not detected. Enabling debug mode. Please try opening the gate manually...
Warning! Intruder detected. Initiating primary defense system.
I still stand by my point: deal with the red and blue <001>twin birds</> first.
These <001>two birds</> have not only caused a shortage of supplies, but they are also likely to destroy the fragile ecosystem here.
You're right, but the <001>Twin Birds</> are just stealing—that's a minor irritation, while the Gate-Breakers are the real threat.
The reason we can't eliminate those <001>two birds</> is that the cannons at the gate are draining too much of our strength.
And according to the "tradition" of the door-breaking students, I don't know how much damage they will cause to this ancient ruin. Gong Sheng, what do you think?
From the perspective of the logistics I manage, Brother Yingyang is right. These <001>two giant birds</> are truly detestable.
But Ranran makes a good point. If we take out the cannon, we'll have plenty of manpower... It's such a hard choice.
About the discussion on the Twin-Bird Broken Gate disciples!
Hello, student. Are you interested in fishing too?
Looks like you're a fan of fishing too, but you won't catch anything now.
It's too high from the water surface here.
At the same time, the area near the water on the opposite side is within the range of the artillery bombardment from the gate-breaking cannons.
While catching more fish provides food for the camp, it's not worth getting injured and adding to our casualty count.
The Gate-Breakers really are capable of anything!
There's a group of expelled students nearby building a dock.
There are too many of them. A head-on confrontation is not a good choice.
After scouting here for a while, I found a less dangerous path.
I tried sneaking in through the cargo transport tunnel above.
But there are still guards. If you insist on trying to pass, please be careful.
Goodbye! Be careful not to get caught by them.
It seems you are heading into the academy.
Perhaps you could head to the bank on the right; there aren't many guards over there.
I think I saw the Gate-Breakers modifying the academy's old, large-scale automatons over there.
Perhaps we can also learn the academy's secrets from over there.
How could there be such a person...
About the cause of the distress.
Senior Yan Ying wants to hunt down two spirit birds for the safety of the camp.
But they were already doing their best to find space to survive in such an environment.
We are the invaders here. We should respect their actions and provide necessary help.
Jiang Xin, look, these remnants have used many transport mechanisms, and there are traces of large-scale transport mechanisms operating in the distance.
I'm afraid they are plotting something deep within the ruins. It could be a weapon even more terrifying than that cannon.
So, you also don't think this cannon was built by the Gate-Breakers themselves?
Of course. The Po Men students never value mechanism arts. So I suspect someone with superb mechanism skills helped them repair the cannon.
It's very likely, but even in the Mechanics Academy, there are only a handful of people who can repair such a large cannon. Who could this person be?
And if it's true, as you say, that there are even more powerful weapons, then the road ahead will be fraught with difficulties.
Discuss the experts among the new students!
Old Luo, Old Luo, how is it? How is my friend doing now? He's going to be okay, right?
It's fine, the situation has stabilized and there's no life-threatening danger. Now you just need to stay in bed and recover.
The problem now is that we only have enough medicine to treat burns for a few more days. Further treatment might be affected.
Sigh, the shortage of supplies and that cannon are like two giant beasts blocking our path...
Huh? Could you say that again? I didn't catch that—my ears are a bit shot from all the cannon fire. How is my friend doing now, anyway?
Well, looks like I wasted my breath, and now I'll have to clear another spot in the infirmary.
Martial arts student asking the herbalist!
Boss Ji Huai, I just thought of a way to treat burns that saves medicine. Could you help me analyze if it's feasible?
Hmm. That's about right. Dilute the Rong-doctor's mucus one to two, then soak the Cloud Silk cloth in it.
Then cover the burn with cloth, three times a day. What do you think?
Yes, I haven't tried it before because there are just too many wounded and not enough medicine.
You think it's worth a try, too? Alright then, I'll get started on the preparations right away.
Discuss how to treat the burned students!
Hello, student. The captain has already informed me about the situation.
Thank you for your help. This is the item to activate the mechanism; you can use it to reach the giant bird's nest.
Get the item and head to the giant bird's nest!
May you achieve victory and help us clear out the <001>Twin Birds!</>
Place <001>this item into the mechanism</> to activate it and head to the mountain top.
Break the seal leading to the summit!
Classmate, thank you for your help. Please help us find our superior, the Wise Man.
zh_text: 同学，感谢你的帮助。请帮助我们找到上司智叟。
source_text: 同学，感谢你的帮助。请帮助我们找到上司智叟。
official_target_text: Classmate, thank you for your help. Please help us find our superior, the Wise Man.
official_en_text: Classmate, thank you for your help. Please help us find our superior, the Wise Man.

text: Classmate, thank you for your help. Please help us find our superior, the Wise Man.
Where is the supervisor, Wise Old Man?
It's right at the guard station opposite.
But be careful, the floorboards in the middle have collapsed into the water.
Classmate, thank you for your help. Please help us find our superior, the Wise Man.
The classroom's security system is now active.
The security system has always been controlled by our superior, Zhishou.
Due to the previous war, my superior activated the security system directly to block the enemies.
Because of that, part of the classroom is relatively well-preserved.
But it seems the war is over now. My superior doesn't know, so the security system is still active.
Perhaps you could try negotiating with him.
Where is the supervisor, Wise Old Man?
The supervisor's office is on the second floor.
But the roads have all collapsed.
Perhaps you need to jump down from above.
But please, help our superior, Wise Old Man, come to his senses.
Classmate, thank you for your help.
He's on the next level. I can help you start the <001>elevator</> so you can go downstairs.
Unknown personnel detected entering the classroom! Security system will be activated!
Command received, changing for you now.
Hello, is there anything you need?
Command received, changing for you now.
Me? I'm fine, just tripped by the shockwave. I should recover soon.
That's a relief. My leg was almost completely broken earlier.
It's a good thing the divine doctor Tian Lin was there; it took a lot of herbs to recover. I can barely sit up now.
Senior Tian Lin is indeed a highly skilled physician.
But if it weren't for Captain Geng's unreasonable persistence, maybe there wouldn't be so many wounded.
Why does this have to do with that captain?
It's actually our Fengwu captain, Geng Shuai. His requirements for ecological protection are just too high.
Someone was organizing a team to hunt the <001>Big Bird</>, but he stopped them.
The result is that <001>Big Birds</> keep coming to steal supplies, and the Gate Breakers are attacking too. We're under attack from both sides.
That is indeed something Captain Geng should take the blame for.
He's still arguing with other captains at the entrance of the Ancient Hall!
Classmate, is there something you need? I'm currently preparing medicine for injured classmates.
The resources we brought here are too limited, and a lot of them were snatched away by the <001>big bird</> above...
Now I have no choice but to mix one portion of herbs with other ingredients to make enough for the students to use...
Hello, student. Do you need any help?
There are really a lot of wounded now. We were attacked by <001>Giant Birds</>, and at the same time, we have to fend off the Pomen students.
The number of wounded is increasing, and there is not enough medicine or medical equipment.
There is an urgent need to resolve this crisis.
Classmate, classmate, stop for a second. You're new here, right? Don't go any further! <001>No entry ahead!</>
Any further, and you'll be in range of the broken gate's cannons. Be extremely careful.
Many students who tried to break in were injured by explosions and are still lying in the infirmary.
Anyway, don't go in there. It's too dangerous!
Thank you for eliminating the red and blue birds, removing a major threat to our camp.
But we must not let our guard down against the cannon just because we eliminated the two birds. I'm still worried about that cannon now.
That thing is like a ticking time bomb. I can't relax until this problem is solved.
Oh, and don't let your guard down. Remember, if you go any further, you'll be in range of the cannons.
Thanks to the protagonist for resolving the two-bird crisis!
Have you found the <001>Drive Shaft</> and <001>Energy Station</> yet?
That's fantastic. Now we can start producing the core device.
Alright, come tell me if you need anything.
The production device is located in the workshop on the left outside the hall!
How do I use the device?
Place the <001>drive shaft</> and <001>energy station</> in the correct positions, and it will produce automatically after activating the switch.
When it comes down to it, it's really just a lack of determination. Listen to me: if you strike with full force and disregard the losses, you would have taken the cannon long ago.
zh_text: 说来说去，其实就是缺乏决心的问题。听我的，一鼓作气，不计损失，早就拿下大炮了。
source_text: 说来说去，其实就是缺乏决心的问题。听我的，一鼓作气，不计损失，早就拿下大炮了。
official_target_text: When it comes down to it, it's really just a lack of determination. Listen to me: if you strike with full force and disregard the losses, you would have taken the cannon long ago.
