text: Hello, student. Is there a problem?
This is a special mechanism in our classroom.
Operating mechanisms or mechanical devices is prohibited during <001>class</>. However, you can learn a lot of information.
Students are allowed to operate mechanisms freely after <001>class</> to solve puzzles, and those who succeed can receive rewards.
I have granted you the authority to freely toggle between class in session and class dismissed.
Just ask my <001>subordinates</> to switch at any time.
Alright, I hope you enjoy your research here.
Class time! Students, please prepare your course materials and supplies.
Class is over! Students are free to do as they please!
I'm a Jixia student sent here to explore. Just call me Gan Chun.
I'm in charge of scouting this entrance.
It's still very dangerous around here, please be careful, student.
Sigh, it's that damn <001>giant bird</> again...
But this <001>big bird</> often steals things, and I can't do anything about it.
This bird seems to be the <001>Great Bird</> that perches atop the mountain.
And they are particularly fond of the food in the camp; much of our supplies have been taken.
Hello, student. Please don't hurt those animals!
Where did the animals come from?
I'm a member of the squad led by Senior Geng Shuai, responsible for looking after the animals in this area.
These animals were also attacked by the Gate-Breakers' artillery, so I took them in to treat their wounds.
However, it seems many people are unhappy about this...
Goodbye! Remember not to hurt those animals!
When it comes down to it, it's really just a lack of determination. Listen to me: if you strike with full force and disregard the losses, you would have taken the cannon long ago.
No, no, everything needs careful consideration. We must send out a scout team to re-survey the terrain.
Still scouting? Still need to 'deliberate'? If we keep dragging this out, we won't even be able to organize a single assault team.
If you just rush in blindly without analyzing the weaknesses and attack intervals of the artillery, you'll only increase casualties.
Haven't you two argued enough? If you ask me, at this rate, we'll be the next ones lying in bed.
Martial arts students discussing a failed battle!
Hello, student. Is something bothering you?
If you are physically unharmed, please do not interfere with my work.
Although the wounded here seem to have recovered, we still cannot give up on treatment.
To avoid any lingering side effects, I will keep an eye on them and ensure they change their herbs regularly.
If you have any special requirements, you can discuss them with Physician Tian.
Come look, come look, I have a new discovery.
Look, isn't the bronze material here very similar to those in the mountain ruins? Could there be a connection between these two places?
I also saw an ancient relic earlier with a mechanism I've never seen before. I haven't figured it out yet.
I can't imagine how many secrets are hidden here. If only we could repel the Gate-Breakers and continue exploring deeper.
The one collecting ancient relics here!
After all that, what exactly did you come to see me about?
I mean... could you lend me some honey and jam? I need to make an ointment to treat burns.
No, the food is almost gone, and those two big birds keep coming to steal our supplies. If I lend you any more, I'm afraid...
What are you afraid of? Look at all those people in the infirmary injured by the shelling; we can't just ignore them.
No, absolutely not this time. Unless you can convince Sister Ranran and the others, there really isn't any food left to spare here.
Sigh, now it's not just the cannon at the gate that we can't fix, we're also helpless against those two <001>big birds</> that keep coming to steal things.
If this continues, I don't know how much more damage the Gate-Breakers will cause. We absolutely cannot let them continue like this!
I'll gather everyone to discuss a strategy once I've finished taking inventory of the cooking supplies.
Otherwise, all our hard work will have been for nothing.
Complaining about the festival cooking supplies!
Let me see... plenty of stone, plenty of fuel. Finally, no more worrying about supply shortages!
If you hadn't taken care of those two giant birds, I wouldn't even be in the mood to cook.
Thank you so much. Just let me know what you'd like to eat, don't stand on ceremony with me.
Thanks to the protagonist for resolving the two-bird crisis!
It's not that I like to nag. But you can't make a meal without ingredients. If this continues, we'll be eating dry rations in five days.
I can take a small group to the Shattered Lands to find some food first. That should at least solve our immediate problem.
That's a viable plan. We could go to the fishing spot over there, and maybe gather some Blue Jade Mushrooms, Oil Guests, Split-Wood Fruits...
Hold on, I know what ingredients to look for, but we're busy running back and forth—we can't work for free. You'll have to show some appreciation.
Of course. Didn't you say you wanted my secret animal biscuits? I'll give you half once we're done, how about that?
Alright, it's a deal. Don't try to back out like you did last time.
An argument over the shortage of ingredients!
Great, the red and blue giant birds have been eliminated. We don't have to worry about supplies anymore. We really should thank them properly.
We should definitely thank him properly. But, did you forget something?
Hmm? What did I forget... Right, I need to go cook. First...
Come back! Where are my animal crackers? I went through so much trouble to find all this food, and you want to welch on the deal?
No, I didn't. It's just... I'll give it to you when I get back to the academy. Trust me, I won't go back on my word this time.
Thanks to the protagonist for resolving the two-bird crisis!
On behalf of the students in the camp, I thank you for your willingness to help us protect it.
The personnel guarding the cave will be notified immediately.
Zongheng has dispelled the barrier of the Twin Bird Cave!
I will... make you... pay... the price...
My shoulder still hurts so much... Hello there, classmate...
I was ambushed by the artillery of the Broken Gate students while I was blocking the <001>Great Bird</>.
You can see for yourself—more than half of the opposite bank has been scorched by the Fire Dragon Cannon.
Even outside their firing range, I'm still on edge.
I advise against going there unless necessary. If you must go, be sure to dodge the artillery fire.
Goodbye, I still need to continue resting.
Hello, student. Are you looking for some food?
Sorry, student, our food is very limited right now, and we're prioritizing the wounded.
There are pots in the camp, but none of them are being used.
If you have any ingredients, feel free to use them. I don't mind.
It's you! I've heard everything; you took care of those two giant birds in no time.
That's better. With those two big birds gone, we can focus on dealing with the gate-breakers.
With sufficient supplies, capturing the Po Men Sheng camp is just a matter of time!
Are you the reinforcements sent by the Academy? Great! We're short on hands right now.
You are very welcome. I was supposed to be in charge of welcoming guests and showing you around the camp, but I can't get away right now.
I'm very sorry. You can look around first and get a feel for the situation.
If you have any important matters, you can go to Sister Ranran and Brother Yingyang. They are in charge here.
It seems that if we want to dismantle the Gate-Breaker's defenses quickly, that cannon is the key.
That's right. The previous frontal assault was too costly. It seems we must take it by guile.
Great minds think alike. I have a plan: we'll send people to figure out the enemy's recent patrol patterns first.
We'll launch the full-scale attack once supplies are ready. The main force will continue to feint a frontal assault during the day.
How about we send an elite squad at night to raid the cannons when the enemy's guard is at its weakest?
Good! I agree. By the way, Brother Gong, how is the supply allocation going?
I've already requested a batch of logistical supplies, and we can launch the final assault soon.
Work together to discuss the all-out attack!
Hello, student. Is this your first time here?
I am the captain leading this group of students. I can answer some of your questions.
He's just a naturalist who loves nature.
His passion is a bit much, though. He really does deserve a talking-to.
If you're looking for him, he's at the entrance of the Ancient Hall across the river.
Looks like you've heard of it too.
It often comes to our camp to steal things and even hurts our classmates.
This is really giving me a headache...
They arrived here first and occupied part of the mountainous area.
They even brought out many cannons to bombard this place.
Many students are injured. While we wait for them to recover, we are also planning a counterattack.
Who are you? Unauthorized personnel are not allowed in here!
You said the war is already over?
Is this the original Mech-core that was once inside the giant mechanical body?
It seems the war is truly over.
I will disable the security system. And I grant you the authority to freely toggle between <001>class in session and class dismissed</>.
You can just have my subordinates switch it later. You are free to study in this classroom area.
You snatched the drive shaft from those two giant birds? Well done.
I remember it was stolen by that big bird during the chaos when we were fighting the gate-crashers.
The battle was intense, but I think I saw the giant bird hit by artillery fire, and the energy station fell near the ruins.
Perhaps you can find it among the various rocks in the ruins.
Goodbye. I hope you make more new discoveries.
Correct, this is the power station that supplies energy to the core manufacturing device.
The other missing part, the <001>Drive Shaft</>, might have been snatched away by two large birds.
Perhaps you could check their territory. I'll notify the student on guard, <001>, to assist you immediately.</>
Goodbye. I hope you make more new discoveries.
The flowers are the same year after year, but the people change with the passing years.
This is the academy's ethos: The Badge of Contention.
It represents the Academy's openness to talent from all over the world, where academic, technical, and artistic schools of thought contend.
But due to the war, it's now damaged beyond repair.
Does this place seem to lack energy?
You have a good eye, student.
I have successfully injected a burst of energy to repair the Zhangming Zhang.
But there are still three energy sources that cannot be injected because they lack the key Primal Mechanism Core.
The first one is in Jiang Ziya's laboratory, but the path has collapsed, and I cannot reach it.
The second was implanted into a large mechanical construct for the war. Its current status is unknown.
The third was seized and modified by invaders to extract energy. It is likely located somewhere near the academy.
Student, you are not allowed inside without the captain's permission<001>!</>
The <001>Great Bird</> is currently resting at the summit. Do not disturb it, lest it cause another disturbance!
Of course it's because of the guy next to me.
There are two strange, large birds nearby.
They are incredibly curious; they try to snatch everything in our camp.
It looks like daily supplies, food, equipment, and even equipment parts were all taken by them!
I'm planning to form a squad to take them out.
This guy next to me is something else—he's doing everything he can to stop us.
Talking about protecting the ecological environment, that a bird's life is a life, and so on.
If this continues, we won't even be able to save ourselves!
If these are taken, we <001>won't be able to repair the grappling hook</> to reach the outpost.
I'll help you take care of the giant bird.
I'll notify the students guarding the cave entrance; they will assist you in heading to the <001>summit nest!</>
Are you the new student? Great, I was just worrying about being short-handed.
I need testers for the Aerrider competition—<001>Scenic Ride</>.
There are two tracks: one at <001>Pearlized Lake</> and one at <001>Cloudshatter Vale</>. Both were designed by the previous champion—me.
I have rewards for anyone who completes a lap. Interested?
Fantastic! Grab your Aerrider. Which track do you want to try first?
Which track would you like to try first?
It's a secret. They say wishes made under this tree come true. Why not try it yourself?
Pearlized Tree, did you hear my wish? I hope...
Keep your heart sincere, and silently recite in your mind.
Remember, keep it a secret between you and the Pearlized Tree.
There, you've seen it. We should hit the road now, or your Dad's gonna dock my wages again.
Eat more and aim for my height first...
Master Ge, do you think I'll grow that tall in the future?
So many manuscripts to sort out... Still, I'd better go through them one by one.
They all worked hard on this. Can't afford to miss anything important.
I'm sorting through the scripts for the Secrets Club. Every newcomer starts from this.
It helps us get acquainted with the work we do here.
And after going through all the worthless drafts, I'll know better how to write content of value.
The most important thing is to keep only the useful information, and piece together a story amidst chaos.
Then we might just uncover the bigger secrets behind it. That's the real charm of the Secrets Club.
Some say the Secrets Club was first established by Sima Yi as a covert intelligence agency under the Intelligence Society.
Others believe it began as a casual gathering of people interested in the headless statue.
As rumors spread, the truth gets muddled, turning those rumors into secrets.
How to join the Secrets Club?
You must first join the Intelligence Society. However, anyone can submit their findings to the Secrets Club!
Whatever you love, wherever you work, you can all share anything you see or hear with us.
Are you interested in our club? We always welcome your contributions!
Goodbye, and just wait for our the next publication!

What were you going to buy?
The antiques he recommends! I'm no Seeker, so I really can't tell if it's legit.
I always wonder where I should start. I wish I could just break it down and bring it back to the Academy.
I'm trying to restore and dismantle the framework of this Giant Hand.
After my companion solves the problem of the head's energy source, maybe we can get this Mechanoid moving again.
That guy's so dull. He won't even move for meals.
To be honest, we still haven't quite figured out how such a giant Mechanoid could operate so smoothly.
I can only say there are still plenty of Mechcraft principles buried beneath the ruins, waiting to be discovered.
To try and reverse engineer it using the set of Mechcraft principles Jixia advocates is far too challenging.
So I really wish I could take it back to the Academy for the teachers to take a look.
Come chat with me whenever you've got the time. Field research is really monotonous...
Are you also interested in this Giant Hand?
What a fantastic structure this is.
I can't wait to restore this giant.
Snip's obsessed with interesting creatures lately. She keeps pestering me about my Hunter experiences.
I guess Scholarly Tiger isn't enough to satisfy this child's curiosity anymore.
I start to think I should have a talk with her father so I can take Snip around when they come next time.
Walk about town, see the animals... It would be wonderful if the child grew up to be a Hunter.
Sorcery classes are way too hard. Just thinking about it gives me a headache. Best to skip tomorrow as well!
Time to slack off a bit...
I can't spend all my time in the Academy.
It's a tough choice between cost and safety...
I'm a wandering merchant who does some trading in Aerux Town and Horizon Harbor.
Is business good in Aerux Town?
Is business good in Aerux Town?
As long as there are people there, business is fair! If you're interested, you can keep north on this road before going west, and you'll soon reach Aerux Town.
But be careful. The Rebels have been fairly active nearby.
I'm trying to decide which route to take.
There are two routes to Horizon Harbor. Most travelers and merchants take the old road. It's quite safe.
The other one is a new path I've charted. It's short and saves on the cost of transportation but...
But I need to pass through the Rebel camp, and I'll have to post an escort request.
There will be extra cost, but I can focus on the goods and Yun Yi.
Hmph! If I can't go out, he won't get no sparring partners either.
Unbelievable. How much energy does it take to propel it...
I wonder how things are going over at the Giant Hand.
As you can see, this Mechanoid dates back ages.
I don't know much about it, and all I can do is to hazard some blind guesses as I study it.
For example, this head may be where the energy core is located.
My friend studies the inner workings of this Mechanoid, and she's currently stationed at the Giant Hand.
If I can solve the two pressing problems—the energy source and the inner workings...
Then maybe we can do a full-scale recreation of this giant Mechanoid...
I'm sorry, I've spoken too much. Some Rebels do come snooping around for information, so I have to be cautious.
Farewell, I must continue studying the helmet.
Are you interested in the Giant Mechanoid?
Did you take care of those Mechanoids on your own?
Nope, hard pass. The principle of Martial Arts is to never give up. I'm going to have another go!
Does the Mechanoid have a move pattern? How can I manage its flailing?
You should start with an easier Trial if you find this hard.
Or just listen to me explain how the Mechanoid works...
It says, "Feel free to challenge me, and I'm always available..." Are all of Fuzi's disciples full of themselves?
I'll give it a try. Maybe I'm better than him.
After all, if he truly is one of the Four Disciples of Fuzi, why would he slum it at such a place?
Compared to Aerux Town, Horizon Harbor isn't that good...
The new students are all very skilled... They've already passed a lot of the challenging trials in Springbrook Plains.
Take this Mechcraft Trial for instance. I saw a new student waltz through in one try without even breaking a sweat.
Talent emerges generation after generation. If we can't even outperform the newbies...
Work hard now or regret later. Let's commit to daily practice at Battle Simulators from today!
How about a super spicy mushroom stew?
Spicy mushroom stew? Don't tell me you're thinking about using that big mushroom over there.
Why not? A fiery stir-fry might just work.
Forget those dangerous ingredients. I don't want to haul you back to the Herbalist Camp again.
How can I make mushroom soup now?
Well, I really didn't expect anyone to come fight the mushroom...
Let's wait a bit longer. Mushrooms grow fast, right? They should sprout soon.
Sorry, it was me. They were too dangerous to ignore.
Sorry, it was me. They were too dangerous to ignore.
You ruined my ingredients! You're gonna pay!
Is there anything I can do to make it up?
Is there anything I can do to make it up?
Grow those mushrooms back and put them into my pot!
Ignore him. You did nothing wrong by defeating dangerous monsters.
It's just that my friend here can't find any ingredients to cook with.
How about this: could you find some common <001>Jade Mushroom</>? I'm counting on you!
Here, I found some Jade Mushrooms for you. Use them well.
Here, I found some Jade Mushrooms for you. Use them well.
Thanks, but I wouldn't stoop to using such bland ingredients.
Have you ever heard the saying, "The fanciest dishes often require the simplest ingredients"?
But I want to cook with mushroom monsters!
Wait! I'll just use the Jade Mushrooms, alright?
Fine, find your own mushroom monsters then! I'm outta here!
That's more like it. Sorry for the drama, and thanks for the mushrooms.
How can I make ordinary Jade Mushrooms as spicy as those fiery ones?
I need to study this a bit more.
It feels risky, but it's definitely safer than using actual monsters as ingredients.
Want to pet this Preydator? Don't worry. It won't bite.
Preydators are all really friendly towards humans, so don't worry too much if you see them in the wild.
Just like this one. It goes wherever I go, and I think it behaves better than most common pets.
If only my roommate wasn't allergic, I'd definitely adopt it.
The one with long ears is a Scholarly Tiger, the one with the fluffy round tail is a Fluffy, and the one with the flat mouth is a Croaky...
Baak Zing said Jixia's full of cute little animals like Scholarly Tiger. I want to go see all of them!
But my dad keeps telling me I'm too young for that and should stay at the harbor. When will I be able to explore other areas of Jixia?
I want to play here every day!
Scholarly Tiger's ears are so big and cuuuuute!
Master's gone looking for formulae to create lures and traps. I'm here keeping watch.
I wonder when I'll be skilled enough to handle things on my own and really help my master.
I watched your fight from here. You were amazing!
The academy specially enhanced them with Aersilk, so they're harder to handle.
Yet you handled them with ease. You didn't even flinch.
I was hesitant, but watching you fight gave me courage.
Next time, I'll fight them myself!
Shielded Walk? It's amazing! I'm glad we came here!
That's actually a piece of giant armor.
Huge spear and hands—they probably belonged to a Mechanoid.
I don't believe it. No way a Mechanoid could be that big.
There's actually evidence that supports this theory...
I'm here to have fun, not to learn a lesson, alright?
Just think of it as a... guided tour. You gotta know what you're seeing, right?
See those Saepes? They're our targets.
That's the spirit! You're truly my best partner.
Listen, we're a team. You lure out, and I'll strike from behind.
What? You think it's easy? You're really starting to impress me, buddy.
Such a huge blue crystal on the lake!
That's Aerux Crystal. Wherever there's an abundance of Aerflow in Jixia, it grows wild, revealing its flowing, cloud-like appearance.
It looks like rushing streams at first glance.
I'll explore Springbrook Plains to find more Aerux!
You're just too curious. Some places in Springbrook Plains aren't meant for wandering, you know?
One, two... Wow, there are too many!
The Mechanoids in the ruins ahead are quite different from the bronze ones...
The academy made them with Aersilk for combat trials.
Still, don't take them lightly. Getting hit still hurts.
I trained hard for this trial, but I didn't expect so many...
The Mechanoids in the ruins ahead are quite different from the bronze ones...
The academy made them with Aersilk for combat trials.
Still, don't take them lightly. Getting hit still hurts.
I trained hard for this trial, but I didn't expect so many...
One, two... wow, there are too many to count.
zh_text: 一个、两个……哇，多得数不过来了。
source_text: 一个、两个……哇，多得数不过来了。
official_target_text: One, two... wow, there are too many to count.
official_en_text: One, two... wow, there are too many to count.

text: The seniors have been inside for a long time. I hope they're okay.
Then why not go in and check on them?
Then why not go in and check on them?
I... I'm keeping watch out here—it's important! They can handle themselves.
Besides, I'd only get in their way.
I'm not scared. Sticking to my duty is the smart choice.
Wow, you collected everything so fast! Just a moment, please.
Hmm... like this, then that... Okay, now the memory is complete!
Please take it back to Zhiqiu—it'll be a huge help for our research! Thank you!
Oh, almost forgot—Ke Hwei seems to have run into some trouble near the wetlands. Could I trouble you to check it out?
You got this! I'll be waiting here.
Where are the other two Mind Shadows?
One is on the nearby mountain slope ruins, and the other is in the water ruins below the slope. They don't seem very safe, so please proceed with caution.
One is on the nearby hillside ruins, and the other is in the underwater ruins below the slope. Neither seems safe, so please proceed with caution.
zh_text: 一只在附近的山坡遗迹上，另一只在坡下面的水中遗迹里。都不太安全的样子，还请小心行事。
source_text: 一只在附近的山坡遗迹上，另一只在坡下面的水中遗迹里。都不太安全的样子，还请小心行事。
official_target_text: One is on the nearby hillside ruins, and the other is in the underwater ruins below the slope. Neither seems safe, so please proceed with caution.
official_en_text: One is on the nearby hillside ruins, and the other is in the underwater ruins below the slope. Neither seems safe, so please proceed with caution.

text: Since you're here at Zhiqiu's request, I assume you're already briefed. So I'll cut to the chase.
I've located all the nearby Saepes Mind Shadows, but their positions are too dangerous for me to approach, so I had to give up for now.
It's not dangerous, but it lives in a scary cave.
What's so scary about a cave?
Who knows what strange things might come out? Wolvines? Or out-of-control Mechanoids?
Where are the other two Mind Shadows?
We're counting on you! Remember to come back and find me after you're done!
One is on the nearby mountain slope ruins, and the other is in the water ruins below the slope. They don't seem very safe, so please proceed with caution.
Thank goodness Zhiqiu invited you here, otherwise I wouldn't know what to do.
One is on the nearby hillside ruins, and the other is in the underwater ruins below the slope. Neither seems safe, so please proceed with caution.

text: Hey, I know you're eager, but listen to me first. Stay safe, and keep me updated on any clues you find!
Hey, you there! Don't go any further. Don't you see the Saepes Shadow ahead?
Oh, you're here to help. My bad. Why don't you come over and talk?
Please bring the Giant Saepes' memory back to Zhiqiu. It'll be very helpful for our research! Thank you!
Ke Hwei seems to have run into some trouble near the wetlands. Could you go check on her?
Oh no, what are we going to do now?
It all started with this big guy behind me.
I never expected that after all my efforts, the truth of history turned out to be something my grandfather experienced himself. It feels like all my work was for nothing.
Grandpa, why didn't you tell me this earlier?
The elders of Springbrook Plains claim the sleeping Giant Saepes is the guardian of Springbrook Plains, the people's benefactor, but they can't explain why, so I decided to investigate.
I was fortunate enough to study Dreamscape Sorcery under Master Zhuangzi for a few years. I thought I could use a little trick to directly extract the memories from the Giant Saepes.
I don't know if it's because my skills are lacking or if the Giant Saepes is truly powerful. I managed to extract its memories, but I wasn't able to obtain them.
These memories turned into energy and scattered, forming Mind Shadows across the Springbrook Plains.
I had to ask my three friends for help and requested them to assist in the investigation and recover this Dreamscape energy.
But they seem to have run into some obstacles. And I'm stuck here guarding the Giant Saepes.
Excuse me, are you a student of Jixia Academy? Could you help me?
Great. My friend Shann is investigating near Battle Simulator at Cape of Millisails. Please go assist him first. He should know the whereabouts of my other two friends.
No worries. I'll figure out another way.
Thanks for your help. Anything else you want to know?
I'm sorry, I only know that Hu Shann is currently near Battle Simulator at Cape of Millisails. I haven't heard from the other two in a while, but Hu Shann might have some clues.
About the Giant Saepes Mind Shadow.
I tried using Dreamscape Sorcery to retrieve the Giant Saepes' memories, but I messed up and scattered the fragments. They formed Mind Shadows that are now roaming around.
Mind Shadow itself is harmless, just a memory. But a Giant Saepes with memory gaps might be unstable, so we need to retrieve all its memories quickly.
You got this! And thank you for your help!
Why are you here again, my little boy? I had a hard time finding you. Let's go home and have some food!
What's this? Old buddy, you finally woke up. Long time no see, do you remember me?
Okay, I'll go back with you. Wait, hold on, just one more thing—You know the Giant Saepes?
It's a long story. If it hadn't saved me back then, you wouldn't be here, you know.
You got this! And thank you for your help!
I knew you could do it. Let me see what's in these memories.
I never knew the Giant Saepes had such a connection with Master Zhuangzi. No wonder it's so different from the others.
No wonder the elders call it the guardian of Springbrook Plains. It fought Mechanoids to help people.
I wonder how that child is doing now. Perhaps the Giant Saepes is also concerned about this?
Now I'll return the Giant Saepes' memories.
Look, the Saepes Phantom has reappeared. You got this!
About clues of other Saepes Phantoms.
I only know that three Memory Fragments have turned into Saepes Phantoms and are scattered in the wetlands, but I'm not sure of their exact location. I really don't dare to go deep into the swamp.
Good luck! Remember to come back to me after finding those Memory Fragments!
Take the Giant Saepes' memory back to Zhiqiu, he must be worried. Thank you!
Odd... He was just here a moment ago.
Go away. Mind your own business!
I'm here on behalf of Zhiqiu.
I'm here on behalf of Zhiqiu.
Oh, you're here to help. Sorry, I was a bit short-tempered earlier.
I've learned the details from Yin Zhen's Big-eye Owlet. Thank you for your assistance. Is there anything else you'd like to know?
I'm tracking the movements of the Saepes Phantoms. One just appeared in the wetlands below, but sadly, it vanished in the blink of an eye.
I only know that three Memory Fragments have turned into Saepes Phantoms and are scattered in the wetlands, but I'm not sure of their exact location. I really don't dare to go deep into the swamp.
Good luck! Remember to come back to me after finding those Memory Fragments!
There it is again! I won't miss it this time!
Wow, you're really impressive! I didn't believe it when Yin Zhen told me.
The memory is now complete. Take it back to Zhiqiu. He must be worried.
You got this! I'll be waiting here.
About clues of other Saepes Phantoms.
I only know that three Memory Fragments have turned into Saepes Phantoms and are scattered in the wetlands, but I'm not sure of their exact location. I really don't dare to go deep into the swamp.
Looks like the second shadow is here.
By the way, did you encounter any strange phenomena when you came into contact with the illusion?
Good. Since you're okay, I'll join you this time.
N-no! Okay, okay, let's get started!
Yin Zhen and Ke Hwei are also on the case, but I only know where Yin Zhen is.
Yin Zhen is near the ancient battlefield, by the sea in <001>Emerald Meadows</>. Look for a <001>small cave</> at the <001>three-way intersection</>.
Last time I saw her, she was at the cave entrance, afraid to go in because she's scared of the dark.
Two of my classmates are also investigating the Saepes Shadow. They're somewhere else in Springbrook Plains.
Investigation of the shadows near Cape of Millisails is complete. The two fragments of condensed shadow seem to fit together. Come, let me help you repair it.
Here you go. Oh, and one more thing.
Please <001>give it to Zhiqiu</> when you're done, I'll go play with my friends first, thank you!
Wait, I haven't repaired the fragments for you yet!
Never thought Master Zhuangzi once adopted a small Saepes.
The shadow ends here, but there's another spot nearby.
Come on, let's head to the next site right away.
Be careful. It's a Saepes, even if it's just a shadow.
No one knows what's gonna happen. You must be careful!
I saw the shadow near here.
Oh! Right ahead! I'm a bit scared of the shadow. Could you... go take a look?
I've been assisting Zhiqiu lately. It's exhausting.
That nerd going to Saepes Retreat? What are you researching?
Yes, it's about the Saepes Shadow seen at Cape of Millisails.
Thankfully I didn't join the Hunting Society like you suggested.
Cui Fei told me you might fail.
What? She just blurted it out?
Hey, we're from the same village!
Haha, I thought we were friends.
Zhiqiu asked me to help with the investigation.
Zhiqiu asked me to help with the investigation.
Great, they've actually sent extra hands. Since we have extra help, let's prepare to set off immediately.
Let's head to Cape of Millisails first. That's where I last saw the Shadow. Shall we go?
I heard you mention <001>Saepes Shadow</>, what is that?
I heard you mention <001>Saepes Shadow</>, what is that?
It's a research project. Simply put, the <001>giant Saepes in Saepes Retreat</> is a bit unusual. It emits an aura slightly different from other Saepes.
We encountered similar energy traces nearby. There might be a connection.
You can ask <001>Zhiqiu</>, the person in charge at <001>Saepes Retreat</>. He'll explain everything.
It's a fragment condensed after the phantom dissipated. I'm not sure what it can be used for.
But there's another shadow ahead. Maybe it can coalesce into a fragment too?
Yin Zhen... She's near the ancient battlefield, by the sea, in <001>Emerald Meadows</>. Look for a <001>small cave</> at the <001>three-way crossroads</>.
I've got the gift. Please give it to Zhiqiu for me. I'll go play with my friends now. Thank you!
Just reeled in another big one!
Right depth and calm current. Easy to catch fish.
I feel I can find lots of great ingredients here.
I can't wait to see the amazing dishes they'll make.
I just hope the Gourmets won't waste what I gather.
You want to enter the ruins? Just so you know, I can't fight all those Mechanoids.
Don't be so nervous. I built a device that can paralyze them.
First, we need to put it in the center. Then it will activate...
Turn left up ahead to reach the courtyard of the family I work for. I'm about to pick up some goods from their garden to deliver to a customer.
They're a talented family, and their vegetables are popular.
A happy family living together. I really envy them.
I haven't been home once since I came to Jixia.
A whole family living together in harmony—it's truly enviable.
zh_text: 一大家子住在一起其乐融融的，真是让人羡慕啊。
source_text: 一大家子住在一起其乐融融的，真是让人羡慕啊。
official_target_text: A whole family living together in harmony—it's truly enviable.
official_en_text: A whole family living together in harmony—it's truly enviable.

text: It looks spectacular even from a distance!
Of course. Why else bring you here?
This is definitely a Jixia must-visit!
I wonder how the statue looked before it got damaged.
Could they be good ingredients for cooking?
Well, even if I wanted to, Master Mozi wouldn't allow it.
Actually... I was just joking. I had no idea you had a taste for that!
Up ahead is Spring Lodge. Don't miss out!
Beautiful views, comfy stay, tasty food. You name it, we've got it!
We're going to clear out the Saepes. Are you ready?
I've got my bow. Just remember to cover me up front.
Aim well! I don't want an arrow in my backside.
It looks dangerous just by looking at it.
official_target_text: It looks dangerous just by looking at it.
official_en_text: It looks dangerous just by looking at it.

text: We're near Desolate Woodland, right? I hear it's full of Saepes.
Yeah. Maybe one's hiding in those bushes.
Come on, you're from the School of Martial Arts!
Stop joking. My legs are shaking again.
I joined the School of Martial Arts to be braver. Guess it's not working...
See the Saepes over there? Any plan to clear them?
I trust my Sorcery. I should be able to wipe them out.
That's risky. What if they attack you while you're casting?
I'll distract them and buy you some time. Easy and safe.
Brilliant! You're as clever as Kongming!
I trust my Sorcery. I should be able to wipe them out.
How about I distract them while you ambush with Sorcery?
Brilliant! You're as clever as Kongming!
Huh? The Saepes seem gone. How about we...
See the Saepes over there? Any plan to clear them?
What are you waiting for? Let's go now!
Stop it. We should move on. There are too many Saepes here.
Not yet. I'm still resting here. Come join me and enjoy the view!
Rest well to work well. Besides, the Saepes might vanish on their own soon!
Hello. We are here to clear the Saepes.
He can take down an entire Saepes gathering all by himself!
We've rested all day! We won't be able to finish our task this way!
If you hate fighting, why did you come with us to clear the Saepes?
To be close to you, of course.
You... You've been like this since you were little.
Since the Saepes are gone, we finally have some time to ourselves.
Just sit back, relax, and chat with me. Please...?
Alright. But just for a while, okay?
Time to handle those Saepes... Wait, where are they?
I told you they'd leave if we just ignored them.
Nice work! You did it alone?
You're kidding, right? I'm sure you beat the Saepes.
This was supposed to be our job. But she...
Anyway, thanks for the help. You really saved us a lot of trouble.
I won't travel alone next time.
I heard He & Ming's Training Hall also specializes in medicine, so I went to check it out.
But I got lost in Springpool Wetlands and almost didn't make it back.
I heard you failed the challenge. Mind a quick interview?
It takes courage to face that challenge. Would you mind sharing what happened?
I gave a full-force punch, and then... I was on the ground.
Alright, sounds like quite a fight.
Hey, you're headed to He & Ming's Training Hall for a challenge, aren't you?
I've got an incredible pellet. It sharpens your mind and shields you from pain!
No one will be able to beat you then!
You can't pass this up if you come to challenge!
You're thinking I'm a fraud, right?
Relax, the Herb Society certified it. You'll feel strong and confident.
You've come to the right person.
They're known for switching between two weapons.
The dual blades are agile, while the heavy sword is powerful. Together, they're unstoppable.
You know General Mulan? She's a master of this style.
If you're set on a challenge, I strongly recommend my pellet—just to be safe!
Goodbye! And don't forget to spread the word about my pellet!
My pellet sharpens your mind and body!
Ugh, my senior always dumps everything on me.
I was asked to clear the Swiftbolt Falcons nearby.
They are always flying around. It's impossible to hit them.
Let's sit down and have something to eat.
See that isle in the lake?
I need to take a closer look.
The Seeker Society camp is northeast.
If you're tired, take a break.
There's rare Bronze Ivy in the ruins ahead.
Too bad these Saepes are messing up my research.
Wild Bronze Ivy usually grows in ruins like this.
See the River Sprites over there?
Looks like the Saepes took over their home!
It would be great if someone could get their home back.
Great! The Saepes are all gone.
The River Sprites must be thanking you!
So my vision is true. You really came here.
Just an ordinary Astrologer. The stars told me to wait here for you.
The cave up ahead is vital to your journey.
If it's closed, it means it's not time yet.
But if it's open, it's a sign for you to march on.
May your destined journey be joyful. Good luck!
Hold on. Did someone just go in and open the chest?
Someone just beat us to the punch!
We are so stupid! Why couldn't we just be more decisive next time?
That shapeshifting weapon was amazing! When I get back, I'll join Master Fuzi's class.
One person is worth two of us bunglers. Sigh, why is the gap between students of Jixia so large?
zh_text: 一个人就顶我们两个臭皮匠了，哎，同样是稷下的学生差距怎么就这么大呢。
source_text: 一个人就顶我们两个臭皮匠了，哎，同样是稷下的学生差距怎么就这么大呢。
official_target_text: One person is worth two of us bunglers. Sigh, why is the gap between students of Jixia so large?
official_en_text: One person is worth two of us bunglers. Sigh, why is the gap between students of Jixia so large?

text: The Universal Mech-Blade is so cool! I'm going to attend the Master's class and learn martial arts!
zh_text: 万用机关刀也太帅了，我回头就去上夫子的课，学武道！
source_text: 万用机关刀也太帅了，我回头就去上夫子的课，学武道！
official_target_text: The Universal Mech-Blade is so cool! I'm going to attend the Master's class and learn martial arts!
official_en_text: The Universal Mech-Blade is so cool! I'm going to attend the Master's class and learn martial arts!

text: Look! That's the ruins I mentioned!
I see it. So what's your plan?
There's treasure inside. You grab it, and we'll split the loot fifty-fifty!
But... don't you see those Mechanoids?
You think they're just going to stand there and do nothing?
Ah, I haven't thought that far. But don't worry, I'll figure something out.
You're not calling someone from the School of Martial Arts, are you?
The Herbalists' medicinal garden is right ahead. You can make it.
Wait, I can't... My wound hurts again.
A Scorched Giant Tree in Springbrook Plains.
Was It Celestial Fire or an Earthly Eruption?
Join me as we unravel this mystery!
One more quick sketch, and the report is all set.
Hmm... This looks good! So good!
Someone messed up the road sign...
It must have been those annoying Rebels.
It must be those annoying expelled students.
zh_text: 一定是讨厌的破门生干的。
source_text: 一定是讨厌的破门生干的。
official_target_text: It must be those annoying expelled students.
official_en_text: It must be those annoying expelled students.

text: So many adorable little animals around here!
It's a joy watching them run around.
Some Seekers have set up camp at the southern ruins. I have to come here...
Who would have thought the Mechanoids would activate?
Luckily, I got out fast. That was close.
What a day. Maybe today isn't a good day to go out.
But my gut tells me there's danger lurking beneath.
I might just run into crazy monsters in there.
Rui Xin is such a great cook!
I just wanna eat. Don't bother me.
Sometimes I wish I could take a break.
But Lian Yi is such trouble.
Hurry up, sis! We're almost there!
We've been walking for ages. Where are we going?
There are lots of River Sprites in the pond ahead. Come and have a look!
Alright, just let me catch my breath first.
You've had the spyglass forever. Can I use it for a little while?
Wait. I must survey the site first. Doesn't that look familiar?
Of course. All Bronze Ruins are like this. The teacher went over that in class today.
You're right! Then that big structure—what do you think it's for?
When can I have the spyglass...
Sorry, I can't stand up right now, so let's talk like this.
A Seeker said there's something worth investigating in the nearby ruins.
But the trip was tougher than I expected. Rough paths, dangerous creatures...
And my backpack is super heavy! I really need a good rest.
Ah, you mean the Bull and Mushrooms?
Don't worry. I know how to deal with them.
If they try to mess with me, the cannon in my bag isn't just for show!
I should have taken the Aership.
Don't mind me chatting with you while lying down, do you?
Students from the School of Mechcraft aren't good at fighting. Why are you here?
Don't underestimate me. I'm here testing a new weapon.
It just took down a Saepes gathering.
But the weapon is too heavy. I can't carry it any further—I need to rest.
Hey, never doubt it. I put my heart and soul into it!
The School of Mechcraft is amazing!
Hold on, I'm not convinced just yet!
How about we take on the Saepes together when you're rested? Let's see which is better, your Mechcraft or my fists.
Hey, never doubt it. I put my heart and soul into it!
Wait! You're making me curious now.
How about we take on the Saepes together when you're rested? Let's see which is better, your Mechcraft or my fists.
Although I've been a Seeker for less than a hundred days, I believe there's an astonishing secret.
I believe the stone tablets hold clues, but I'm not sure what the inscriptions mean.
Wow! I saw you unlock that.
I must study more to be as smart as you.
Now, I just avoid them every time.
I just hate the Moon Bats. They're impossible to hit, and their bites really hurt.
Did you fail the challenge at He & Ming's Training Hall?
Yes, I underestimated Mr. Bai He's skills.
First time I've seen you lose. I'll beat him for you!
With your beginner skills? Let's head back and train more.
Facing the roaring waves! Perfect for training!
Once I'm stronger, I'll tackle that waterfall for harder training!
The closer to Desolate Woodland, the more Saepes there are.
My teacher sent me to investigate the ruins. But which one is it?
Ugh, why don't you decide, little Croaky?
What? You just want to stay here and play?
That's not a bad idea. We're not in a rush anyway.
The flowers here are so well-kept and breathtakingly beautiful.
A master Herbalist must live here. I'm going to visit!
When should I say when we meet...?
Ah, I'm so nervous. I just need some more time.
There must be a master of herbalism living in seclusion here, so I've decided to become their apprentice!
zh_text: 一定是有一位百草家前辈隐居在这里，所以我决定来拜师！
source_text: 一定是有一位百草家前辈隐居在这里，所以我决定来拜师！
official_target_text: There must be a master of herbalism living in seclusion here, so I've decided to become their apprentice!
official_en_text: There must be a master of herbalism living in seclusion here, so I've decided to become their apprentice!

text: Stop running around! We have to go to Frostcloud Town!
I don't want to go! That town is so boring!
It's much more fun out here, hehe!
Looking forward to seeing you back here!
zh_text: 期待同学再次参与试炼获得更多学分哦！
source_text: 期待同学再次参与试炼获得更多学分哦！
official_target_text: Looking forward to your participation in the trial again to earn more credits!

text: After days of tracking, hunger, and harsh winds...
I won't leave until I see Blazing Falcon!
Ugh, investigating is such a hassle. I'd rather just punch it.
A red bird called Blazing Falcon is around here somewhere.
If you walk along the main road, you might even catch it showing off its wings.
Its feathers! It loves to strut.
It chases animals for the thrill of the hunt, not to eat them.
Many animals here have fallen to its talons.
Without the scorched trail it left, I'd probably still be searching.
If I'd teamed up with Lei Yinyin, we might've seen both Blazing Falcon and Skyrumble Falcon.
Huh? I thought you'd help me!
A large red bird called a Proud Fire Falcon; it's nearby right now.
zh_text: 一只叫做傲火隼的红色大鸟，它现在就在这附近。
source_text: 一只叫做傲火隼的红色大鸟，它现在就在这附近。
official_target_text: A large red bird called a Proud Fire Falcon; it's nearby right now.
official_en_text: A large red bird called a Proud Fire Falcon; it's nearby right now.

text: Blazing Falcon stopped causing trouble and showing off its feathers. Was that you?
Thanks to you, I'm ahead of Lei Yinyin. Should I bring her some feathers?
Well, in that case, I'll keep the feathers for myself.
Better to keep them in my notebook—maybe a future heirloom.
I've sent my report to camp. Read it when you get there.
This is a report written on my first solo mission!
I doubt if Wreckflame Lizard could cause trouble in Navenia! See if it keeps breathing fire!
Oh no, are you okay? Let me check. Your wings are singed...
Don't worry. Your feathers will grow back soon. Don't cry!
It's breathing fire across Springbrook Plains. I followed it and kept putting out the flames nonstop.
Such a mess! Just as I got close, I lost sight of it...
This Croaky just passed by and got its feathers singed!
Little one, I know you want revenge, but first we need to find it, right?
The lizard has never shown up in Springbrook Plains before.
Maybe it lost a territory battle against the Saepes elsewhere and came here to strut around.
It's scared away all the local wildlife.
Alright, I've got other things to handle too.
Ha! I can't believe you got to it before me. It's finally stopped setting everything on fire!
Now the animals that fled can return, and Springbrook Plains can thrive once again...
Look how happy the little fella is!
You're really the hero Springbrook Plains needed!
Next time you're around the camp, come check out the investigation report I sent.
I'll be here with the little guys. If you miss them, just drop by.
Hey! Are you here to play with that big fruit?
At least wear a mask, or else...
See? That's what happens if you're unprepared.
Didn't you just rush in, yelling "So cute!" at first sight?
It's this rare plant in the cave called the Echoing Lament. Master gave it that nickname.
Ha, you're speaking clearly now. After all that gas, you recovered fast.
Please stop teasing me. I'm still crying.
See? That's what happens when you rush into the cave!
Just follow this path into Labyrinth Cave, and you'll find it.
But beware, it's guarded by numerous Saepes. They hit hard and play dirty!
The fruit's tear gas doesn't work on plants. You didn't listen to me.
I did listen! You said it wouldn't move, so I tried attacking from a distance.
Turns out, those Saepes saw me as an easy target...
Okay, I know you're fine now. Come help me with the report.
The big fruit seems a lot calmer now.
Ah, my little apprentice has turned against me so soon. It's truly heartbreaking...
Master, stop pretending it. I've already sent the report back to camp.
Skyrumble Falcon is dangerous. It's safer to take a detour.
I'm quite familiar with it, to be honest.
Thanks for the concern. You are really polite.
Don't worry. I've tracked Skyrumble Falcon for a long time. It can't hurt me.
Last time at the cliff, it saw me and ran. Ha...
It's lazy and usually hunts only near its lair, unless Blazing Falcon is nearby.
My partner insisted we split up to speed up the investigation.
He didn't know I'd figured most of it out. I'm just here to verify a few details.
You went straight to fight Skyrumble Falcon, with barely any investigation?
That made my work feel redundant...
I didn't see it that way.
You're kind, but no need to comfort me.
I just hesitated to defeat it.
Knowing everything about Skyrumble Falcon is in the past.
Maybe the report I sent to camp still misses something...
Are you here to challenge the Mechanoid?
I suggest you prepare a bit more, or you might end up frozen.
Honestly, it should be kept in the Forbidden Chamber.
I'm a Hunter. The academy sent me to study that Rime Comet Shield.
I'm studying its icy aura and how it affects the environment.
It freezes even the soil solid.
The academy aptly named it Rime Comet Shield.
Rumor says it even froze butterflies at the School of Sorcery.
I tried it. It took an hour just to break its ice barrier.
Now, this troublemaker is my responsibility...
I saw you defeat Rime Comet Shield.
I've gathered some additional findings about it.
Interested? Read my report in camp. You'll be impressed by my writing.
Yes. It's a long-term task. Gauging its environmental impact will take time.
Maybe we could turn this place into an ice rink...
That icy Mechanoid is right ahead...
These marks are from a large Saepes, just as I suspected.
With that confirmed, the next steps are clear.
I'm not talkative, but I will explain things patiently if you need.
I'm investigating a large Saepes, commonly known as Stillwood Howler.
Clues suggest it's nearby. Please be extra careful.
Records say large Saepes are docile and rarely attack others.
It may have become aggressive because of a serious threat, but I still need more evidence.
Well, I should confirm its hiding spot first.
Alright, I'll get back to work.
Stillwood Howler is down. I believe it's all thanks to you.
And I've made progress in my investigation.
I can't finish this report without your help. Thanks, and feel free to read it at camp.
I will keep tracking the large Saepes.
Many records are incomplete. I'll work to complete them.
There's no view like the one from the seashore. Looking out over the endless ocean is really soothing.
I've thought long and hard about how to bypass the Mechcraft devices but failed, so I came here to admire the view.
You too. You shouldn't get downhearted even if you can't make it through the Ruins Trials.
What use is there in getting depressed? Just relax. The only way to live a carefree life is to not have desires.
Hm? Didn't Master Zhuangzi say something similar?
Surprised to see a Mechcraft student out here?
I usually avoid these remote areas, but my mentor advised me...
When you're stuck with a new Mechcraft invention, instead of brooding in the academy, it's better to step out and travel.
Experiencing the world broadens your mind and might just solve your problem.
But this bag of Mechcraft parts is not helping. I hope there's a spot up ahead to rest.
Don't you dare peek at my notes!
My mentor says I'm too reckless in combat. I should come up with more flexible tactics.
But that's what I think a true man should do. I don't want to go against the principles of Martial Arts I believe in.
Where is it? I'm so exhausted I just want to lie down.
Just down the path to the east, you'll find Spring Lodge. They offer lodging and free meals.
Just down the path to the east, you'll find Spring Lodge. They offer lodging and free meals.
Now that you've mentioned food, I'm suddenly feeling very hungry. Free meals sound great.
This bag feels like it's packed with bricks! I need a break.
After that, I'll head to Spring Lodge in the east.
These Mechcraft parts are so heavy. I can't move anymore.
If only there's somewhere to rest up ahead.
There's a hermit in the northwest who claims to be one of Fuzi's four disciples.
Found some ruins nearby too... quite a productive trip.
I... I discovered that Cape of Millisails has gorgeous views. We can watch the sunset together sometime.
You've got to take a break from studying and training sometimes... We can go there when you need a break.
How can you be this lazy? Forget the sunset and focus on getting some real intel first!
Aren't scenic spots good information? Many students are interested in this.
Yeah... My partner was hard on me earlier today. Just trying to make it up right now.
But honestly, any information can be useful in some way. Every Intelligencer should know that.
While most are aware of the beautiful sunset at the Cape of Millisails, few have heard about the spectacular starry night there...
The statue and the mural are truly amazing.
You definitely don't want to miss the view above Littoral Cave.
It must honor someone. I can't think of another reason.
With my skills, can I get into the Music Society?
Believe in yourself. You're better than many of my peers.
I didn't expect you to say that.
Despite Jixia Academy's fame, not everyone works hard.
If you join, you'll definitely stand out.
Nothing beats the taste of fresh fish—it's the pinnacle of savoriness.
Tell me, who could possibly resist the siren call of a serving of fresh fish? In this culinary competition, fish will eventually carry the day.
The quality of the water will often determine the texture of fish.
The water here is pristine, fostering algae that the fish feed on, resulting in tender, sweet, and less fishy flesh.
The fine sediment indicates the water isn't stagnant. It produces naturally supple fish.
This is why you can find the best ingredients here.
This is a tradition of our group.
At first, we just cooked our best dishes for the students. But soon, they started rating our cooking.
Win or lose, the competition's just meant to motivate us to search for better ingredients, and cook better dishes.
The key to mastering fish dishes lies in how you present the natural sweetness of its flesh.
Traditional methods like stewing, braising, and deep-frying can ruin a fish's natural taste. That's why we often steam or cook fish dishes.
I plan to make a pot of fish soup with no spices, only finely ground salt, to highlight the aroma of the stock. Stay tuned.
Remember, fish dishes are the best!
The more you know, the more confident you'll be with fish dishes! Let me tell you a little more about it!
At first, we just cooked our signature dishes for the students, but it later evolved into the students grading and reviewing them.
zh_text: 一开始只是大家做些拿手菜给学生们吃，之后演变成学生们打分评价。
source_text: 一开始只是大家做些拿手菜给学生们吃，之后演变成学生们打分评价。
official_target_text: At first, we just cooked our signature dishes for the students, but it later evolved into the students grading and reviewing them.
official_en_text: At first, we just cooked our signature dishes for the students, but it later evolved into the students grading and reviewing them.

text: What would you like to know?
The area is rich in ingredients, with wild animals and seafood.
That's why the Gourmet Society loves this place for recipe research.
Shush, you must keep this a secret. I'm studying those vegetable and fruit monsters to figure out how to turn them into delicacies.
Delights hide in unexpected places. You need to be adventurous to find them.
Don't be fooled by their cute looks, they're actually quite powerful!
I'm no match for them, so I have to beg my friend for help...
He has a bad temper, but he can easily deal with those monsters.
Can't believe the head trainer let us go on this journey. Everything's so new. Anywhere you're dying to visit?
How about the School of Mechcraft? They're known for advanced Mechcraft. Beating a few of them would be great practice.
There's no glory in fighting some lifeless Mechanoids. Why not go help clear the Springpool Wetlands of Saepes?
Weren't you the one asking me to pick? The Saepes are so weak, and it feels almost unfair beating them.
I've already fought almost every peer in He & Ming's Training Hall. It's getting boring.
Cut the crap... I saw you being punished by a senior not long ago.
Ahem! I mean peers of a similar skill level! Sparring with seniors doesn't count...
Anyway, I'm planning to go to other training halls so I can pick up some of their new tricks. You coming?
Then why not go to Red Falcon Training Hall? Let me fish out a map of Aerfall Highlands...
If I could use these mushrooms as ingredients, I'd definitely whip up something special.
But how am I supposed to pick those dangerous little things...?
I haven't seen that girl in ages...
A blonde-haired girl used to lie on that tree, wearing School of Martial Arts attire, with impressive footwork that left a strong impression on me.
The last time I was attacked by Rebels, she jumped down and took care of them in a few moves.
After saving me, she jumped onto a tree and fell asleep.
I haven't seen her around lately, but I'd still look up at the tree whenever I pass by here.
I've heard rumors that the wildlife in Springbrook Plains is getting restless. Figured I'd ask around to see if there's any truth to it.
As a Hunter, it'd be better to investigate in person.
But I'm old and slow now, and it's too dangerous for me outside the camp.
I'm going to stay here a bit longer. Bye.
The tumbledown ruins in Springbrook Plains are a shame.
There were many exquisitely designed clusters of buildings here, but they all came tumbling down in the end.
These ruins, with their heaps of broken stone, almost take me back to the time of clashing swords and armored cavalry.
If not for the war, there could be a majestic terrace dominating this place.
I came here following my instructor, who was also intrigued by the ruins here.
There are lots of ruins left behind by the war. Preliminary study suggests that this was once a temporary command center on the battlefield.
But going by the state of destruction here, the command center was overrun by the enemy.
Farewell, I must continue my study.
Is there no way to chase them off? Even just shifting them out of the way's enough!
The untouched, dense vegetation of the Desolate Woodland is a perfect haven for Saepes. They won't surrender easily.
These ruins hold clues about the battles of the past in Springbrook Plains. If the Saepes damage them, it'd be a huge loss!
Umm... If that's the case, I'll try to figure out another way.
Is there no other way? I know how you Hunters do things, but as a Seeker, I have to share my two cents.
I'd love to keep studying those broken stone tablets in the wild.
I need to fix this device quickly.
Isn't it nice when someone helps us deal with those pesky Saepes? Lighten up a bit!
But I really wanted to handle those cute Saepes myself... now I've missed my chance...
Don't worry, more Saepes might pop up any day now.
Next time, I definitely won't miss my opportunity!
I've helped you take out quite a few Saepes. Should be enough to get your job done, right?
I've helped you take out quite a few Saepes. Should be enough to get your job done, right?
Really? Thanks for your help, my friend!
Why couldn't I be the one to take them out?
My friend here just has a rather unusual hobby. Anyway, thanks a lot for your help!
I didn't think there would be so many Saepes here...
I didn't think there would be so many Saepes here!
I know, right? How do we get rid of all of them? Maybe we should just take down a few to bring back to Captain Yanshan and...
I can't wait! Sorry, what did you say?
Nothing. It's just weird how excited you are...
Clear, soothing skies as far as the eye and heart can see.
Amidst the mountains lies a vast vista, like the light at the end of the tunnel that the ancients once spoke of.
It is important to stop and rest your weary feet before you continue on your journey.
Don't miss out, or you'll regret it!
Make sure to try the food at Tata's Food Shop!
Hi, there. Are you headed to Frostcloud Town?
If you are, don't miss out on Tata's Food Shop!
I'm interning at Tata's. Those pesky Rebels keep destroying the road signs.
Tata thinks it'll hurt business if people get lost, so she sent me here to guide visitors.
What are you doing up on that rock?
Do you work there? Why are you here...
Didn't we just have a break? How can you be tired again?
I'm to blame. I just need to buck up on training...
Man, I'm bushed! Let's take a break Peng Yue. I'm about to keel over!
Springbrook Plains is mostly made up of plains and wetlands, so the paths here are already very even. Even the mountain roads are easy to walk up.
How are you going to attend the Academy with such poor stamina? I don't even understand how you made it into the School of Martial Arts.
Ugh, blame this lame place for not having Aerships!
See that Aerux, reaching as high as a mountain? Nature truly works in miraculous ways.
And see the remnants of the ruins and walls? They were once a spectacle born of human labor.
Which do you think is superior? Nature's might, or the power of humans?
I suspect Senior Chuo chose a spot swarming with monsters to wear challengers down!
She's Fuzi's second top disciple out of four. Heard she's pretty straightforward too. Also...
If you can't even handle these monsters, you're far from ready to challenge someone like Senior Chuo.
I'm practicing my kicks! I want to be able to kick it far and accurate!
See the big wooden fence across the road? Once I've trained more, I'll be able to smash them with explosive fruits!
I'm practicing my kicks! I want to be able to kick it far and accurate!
See the big wooden fence across the road? Once I've trained more, I'll be able to smash them with explosive fruits!
Damn that Saepes. Just you wait. I'm going to issue a request at Upstream Camp!
I imported some specialty snacks from Navenia and traveled all this way to sell them in Frostcloud Town.
I hope they haven't guzzled all those snacks, or I'm going to be in the red!
Halfway there, a horde of Saepes just jumped out of the bushes and hijacked my cart.
Those darn Saepes! There goes my cart...
There's a little pink Saepes walking around in the distance.
Those Saepes are extremely wary. It's so hard to get close...
I hope they can't hear my footsteps...
Perhaps I can sneak up from behind? Take it by surprise.
Wonder how the radishes are doing.
Hopefully no one else gets hurt...
Impressive, your footsteps are lighter than a cat's!
That was some really slick movement!
Impressive, your footsteps are lighter than a cat's!
That was some really slick movement!
I'm sure this statue's harboring a great secret. If I can uncover the truth through research, that would make my name!
Before I find the key pieces of information, I have to keep any other Seekers from beating me to it.
Earlier, I injured my leg while collecting herbs. Fortunately, a girl who claimed to be a Herbalist found me.
She carried me back and treated my injury. After that, I decided to give this place to her to help other injured students nearby.
It's my way of repaying her kindness.
This statue looks like it's been through a lot.
No one knows who the subject of the statue is, and the fact it's headless is kind of creepy.
Probably gives you a nasty jump at night...
Are you wounded? Do you need treatment?
Monsters roam this area, and many students who come here end up getting hurt. I stay nearby to help whenever needed.
Since I can't hold young people back, I may as well support them in the best way I may.
They're fixated on herb science and even making poisons. But they forget that Herbalists are meant to cure diseases and save lives.
Watch out for Ruins Guards and Saepes around. A lone one is manageable, but a group can turn deadly fast.
I was seriously injured in the past myself, and the memory of it still haunts me.
I was lucky to have been saved by a passing Herbalist. Now, I too have the ability to aid others.
Farewell, do not try to put on a brave front if you're injured. Be sure to rest well.
Is there anything I can do?
I'm a Herbalist, and I'm planting herbs here. But to be honest, many Herbalists these days have lost their aspirations.
Stealth Radishes? Watch yourself around them.
They look cute, but they have nasty tempers. Won't let anyone into the herb garden.
If you're gathering herbs, steer clear. They're extremely alert, and their kicks are brutal.
One hit, and you'll be in pain for days!
I feel terrible seeing the Seekers get so dirty in the ruins. Why must they go through all that?
The stars are always watching. Why grovel in the dust when you can look up? They hold all the secrets.
The cracked city walls, the Mechanoids guarding this place... there are too many traces of war here...
A great battle must've taken place here, and the casualties inflicted were devastating.
A huge secret must be buried within Old Citadel!
All around Old Citadel, obviously! It's a massive ruin!
I think I'd rather investigate on my own.
I think I'd rather investigate on my own.
Bye, you're always welcome to join our expedition team.
We're the Old Citadel expedition team, made up of members from different Societies.
But we share a common objective: to uncover the secrets that slumber within the Old Citadel.
Of course. According to the latest discoveries, Old Citadel was an important stronghold in the war of Springbrook Plains.
Thus we have reason to believe that a highly valuable artifact that could affect the outcome of the war was hidden within Old Citadel.
About the secret of Old Citadel.
This is top-secret, and technically should only be revealed to members of the group...
If you really want to learn more, consider joining us.
All you need to do is to fill up this form, and I'll tell you a secret that will rock your world!
I'm taking a short break before setting out. Traveling is so tiring.
The road to Old Citadel is so long. Looking south from here, it seems endless.
But the girl beside you looks pretty chuffed.
But the girl beside you looks pretty chuffed.
Oh, you mean Rue? She looks way too cheerful for someone with a name like hers.
Well, life is a boring circle. You go through the same thing every day.
She goes to the wetlands and gets hurt every day. I don't even know why she is still happy...
Then what do you plan to do?
Ugh, I can't beat the senior disciple, and I can't beat the acting head trainer. What's the point of all this training?
As a disciple of the training hall, I have to go train there today as usual.
The scenery in the wetlands is really comforting. Cool breeze, calm waters. How relaxing!
I'll just admire the scenery, no way I'm getting my hair wet in the wetlands.
Tong Dan, will you teach me how to wield a greatsword? It's so cool!
You've got good taste, kid. But I'm not sure your tiny frame can really carry a sword this heavy?
Don't write me off just yet. I usually eat two heaping bowls of rice every meal!
Not bad, you've got spirit. Now, to master the greatsword, yell your catchphrase with conviction.
Repeat after me, "Spirits of the sword, bestow your power upon me!"
Spirits of the sword, bestow your power upon me!
New areas are waiting for me!
The guy beside you looks like a thunderstorm waiting to happen.
The guy beside you looks like a thunderstorm waiting to happen.
Oh, you mean Guan Le? He looks like that all the time.
He's always complaining about how meaningless things are. I don't see a speck of the joy that his name's supposed to imply.
It's a pain to have to think of ways to cheer him up every day.
See those wetlands behind you? That's my goal today!
There are rare species and secrets unknown to anyone else hidden in these wetlands.
I even found a gigantic nest of Saepes the last time I was there. This time I've got to get a good look at what the Saepes are doing here.
I know today's going to be an amazing day!
Looks like you're over the moon.
Of course! Springbrook Plains can change so much in just a day. You're sure to make new discoveries every single day!
As a Seeker, it's my job to know every place in Springbrook Plains inside out!
Where are you planning to go today?
Anything else you wish to know?
Were they an organization that studied and created Mechcraft, or an arsenal? We'll see.
Wow, that was an inspiring lecture! You should present at the next Mechcraft Origins session.
The area ahead contains the ruins protected by ancient Mechcraft.
How did it go? With your agility, fetching a component from those Lost Sentinels should be easy, right?
I'm still curious, what do you need these Mechcraft components for?
I'm still curious, what do you need these Mechcraft components for?
You'll find out once you get them for me.
What do I need to do?
Hey, did you know? Much of Jixia's Mechcraft is based on mimicking war artifacts.
Why are you telling me this?
But mere words are not convincing without solid evidence. I'm a little unsure myself and need concrete proof.
I got an idea. Could you help me gather some components from the Mechanoids of the ruins?
What do you want with those Mechcraft components?
What do you want with those Mechcraft components?
I'll keep you guessing for now. Once you've helped me out, I'll spill the beans.
As the saying goes, "Mastery of Mechcraft makes you fearless wherever you go."
Here. These are the Mechcraft components you needed.
Here. These are the Mechcraft components you needed.
Let me check... Yes, they definitely demonstrate the inheritance in Mechcraft techniques.
Having seen these, I feel much more confident.
Just wait a moment, let me gather my thoughts...
But first, accept this token of my gratitude.
Look at the thickness and hardness of this. If I'm not mistaken, the ruins here should form a structure resembling city walls.
But what about this gap here? What kind of force could have blown a hole in such a durable wall?
I've hit a wall with my research, and I'm not making progress with my thesis.
The worst thing that one can possibly do is to engage in any research, and the worst kind of research to do is historical research...
If I could make herbal remedies, I'd really be able to help the students around here.
I'm relieved you're safe. It's impressive!
Anyway, I'll keep an eye on Seclusion City.
I know this area well. Any questions?
I graduated from the academy two years ago and joined the Seekers' expedition to explore Seclusion City.
Since I'm not much of a fighter, I mainly handle logistics.
Seclusion City is filled with Mechcraft devices and overgrown with weeds. Only experienced explorers should venture inside.
Make sure you are well prepared if you plan to go.
I've always admired the Seekers' mission: exploring the world's mysteries and preserving the seeds of civilization.
The outdoors can be tough, but the sense of accomplishment is something you can't get from any other job.
If you meet other Seekers in the wild, talk to them. You might learn some secrets.
It's not that I can't fight at all, but since I didn't come from a martial background, I can only handle basic threats like the Saepes.
I've been training hard lately, hoping to join the real exploration soon.
I hope to become a well-rounded team leader someday...
It seems the disturbances in Seclusion City have stopped.
We can prepare to explore with the rest of the team.
This is the closest camp to Seclusion City. Here you can rest and restock your supplies.
But if you have an emergency, I suggest you go to Upstream Camp for help.
I know this area well. Any questions?
I graduated from the academy two years ago and joined the Seekers' expedition to explore Seclusion City.
Since I'm not much of a fighter, I mainly handle logistics.

Make sure you are well prepared if you plan to go.

It's not that I can't fight at all, but since I didn't come from a martial background, I can only handle basic threats like the Saepes.
I've been training hard lately, hoping to join the real exploration soon.
I hope to become a well-rounded team leader someday...
Don't you think we work too hard? Good thing we have this camp to rest in.
Stop complaining. There's another area to patrol. Ready your weapons and set off.
The passage of time is relentless yet swift. It's been so many years since I graduated.
I remember throwing a keepsake into Pearlized Lake the year I graduated like it was yesterday.
Yeye and Sheng, are both of you still full of mischief like when we were students?
Although the Spike Bears have been driven off, the camp is a mess.
I should report this to Master and have him send someone to fix up the camp.
Have you figured out how you're going to explain this to Master?
I'm too scared to tell him. You should do it.
Then I'll also tell him about the time you sneaked a peek at his secret formula!
I've cleared out the Spike Bears from the camp. It should be safe now.
I've cleared out the Spike Bears from the camp. It should be safe now.
The Spike Bears are gone... Incredible! You single-handedly solved the problem.
If you ever need to deal with Spike Bears again, try out my new powerful bait.
Thank you. We definitely won't make the same mistake again.
As long as you toss something valuable into the lake, Qi An's gonna make sure you pass all your exams.
Did you really spread those rumors?
Nothing from the lake? Seriously? Are all these students broke? What did you tell them?
Just toss your valuables into the lake, and Big Sister will surely bless you to pass your exams.
zh_text: “只要把贵重物品投到湖里，大姐一定会保佑你们考试必过。”
source_text: “只要把贵重物品投到湖里，大姐一定会保佑你们考试必过。”
