text: Have the Spike Bears caught up with us?
Phew... No, they're still sniffing at the bait.
What on earth did you do? It attracts all the Spike Bears nearby. What kind of bait was that?
I learned it from the Master. I think I miscalculated the weight of the ingredients. Sorry 'bout that...
The Spike Bears are too territorial. This camp is a lost cause now. Explain it to the Master yourself.
No big deal, just trying to make some bait for hunting.
I think I miscalculated the weight of the ingredients...
Everything seems fine, so why aren't there any bites?
The teacher said this was a perfect spot, but why can't I catch anything?
Hey, wanna try your luck? Maybe I'm just too impatient.
If you're missing any items, I have plenty to transfer to you at cost.
Angling is about taste and atmosphere, and the process is what you enjoy.
Scooping up fish brings fleeting joy.
I'm an Angling Society member, not a fish scooper.
A guy named Lan Yi, and I think he's upset at the moment.
He left He & Ming's Training Hall dejected after losing to Head Trainer Bai He.
Head Trainer Bai He asked me to bring him back.
I heard he likes to chill out on a big rock by a river in the southwest, but I don't know where it is.
It's like the river just keeps flowing and I'm lost in its currents.
Hey, don't be thinking about anything crazy, okay?
Hey, don't be thinking about anything crazy, okay?
Me? No, I'm not. Just taking a moment to clear my head.
I've lost 13 times in a row...
I'm feeling quite lost right now. What's the point of practicing every day but still failing?
Keep at it, and you'll eventually succeed.
You're right, I shouldn't let a little setback get to me.
Head Trainer Bai He sent a student named He Yan to find you, hoping to persuade you to return to the Training Hall.
Head Trainer Bai He sent a student named He Yan to find you, hoping to persuade you to return to the Training Hall.
I see. I guess we've worried the Head Trainer and you. I'll go find her now.
Thank you. I feel much better now.
Go find He Yan now. I'll join you later.
Lan Yi, you're back! I was worried.
A kind student found me and cheered me up. I figured it out and decided to come back.
Why did you run away? It wasn't a big deal.
My bad. It just somehow bothered me a lot.
Next time, don't leave without a word.
Head Trainer Bai He from He & Ming's Training Hall is one of the best in Springbrook Plains. It's normal you can't beat him.
In light of your limited training time, it's already impressive you held your own against Head Trainer for a while.
So, don't give up. Keep trying, and you'll eventually succeed.
I understand, Senior. I'll keep practicing and stop avoiding it.
The storm breaks upon us, and I am its end.
On this long journey, rain casts my only shadow.
Only in the wake of ruin can rebirth begin!
By my bolt, the darkness shall break!
Father, can you tell me again about your expedition to the wetlands?
Sure thing. Back then, I was young and impulsive, so I took a bet and ventured alone into the Springpool Wetlands.
I battled swarms of Saepes and lizards in the wetlands for three days and nights straight, without so much as blinking an eye.
Wow! You didn't even bat an eyelash!?
Do you know why there are so many Saepes wandering around? I destroyed their caves!
Back in my day, I marched right into the Springpool Wetlands and battled the Saepes King for three whole days.
Wow, Dad! What did you keep as a trophy from that battle?
Heroes in the stories always keep something from their enemies as a trophy.
Ugh... I have something to, but I need to... Oh, hey, one second, please!
Shh, let's keep this between us. Could you fetch something from a Saepes for me?
I want to keep my heroic image intact for my daughter!
Shh, let's keep this between us. Could you fetch something from a Saepes for me?
I want to keep my heroic image intact for my daughter!
Dad, what are you two talking about?
Dad, what are you two talking about?
I just needed help retrieving my trophy. You'll see it soon!
Did you manage to retrieve that trophy from my great battle against the Saepes?
Just knock down any Saepes nearby. You can do it!
Here. Is this the trophy from your great battle against the Saepes?
Here. Is this the trophy from your great battle against the Saepes?
After battling the Saepes for two whole days, suddenly a giant Saepes King appeared before me.
I managed to dodge its attacks with some quick footwork and finally took it down.
This is the branch I got from the Saepes King!
Wow, it's true! Dad is the best!
Daddy, I want to hear stories of your adventures!
I was a great warrior back then.
I love it when he gets mad. Too bad he's avoiding me like the plague now.
An angler who can't even catch as many fish as I do… "Waiting for a big catch"? Ha!
My research funds are running out. From today on, I can only afford the cheapest foods...
I'm lucky Chef Che is kind enough to slip me extra vegetables and meat, otherwise I would've starved long ago.
He's going to be the person I'll thank at the end of my dissertation on the Giant Saepes when I finish writing it!
My, you're a mess. Were you running for your life, chased by monsters?
How about some chow to chill you out? I'll lend you my big stir-fry wok.
You'll have the energy to deal with problems once you've filled your tummy, right? You're young. Go ahead and eat more!
The monsters around here aren't really dangerous, right? Also, the area is guarded by skilled masters.
Besides, the Springpool Wetlands is teeming with all kinds of precious ingredients.
Sure, the wetlands are full of monsters, but hey, the riskier it is, the better it tastes!
If you feel like cooking, you know where to find me.
I'm not much of a fighter, so I support everyone with warm, delicious meals instead.
Look at those Fibercore Lotuses and Raft Reeds—so fresh!
Don't rush off just yet! Fill your belly before hitting the road.
Fancy joining me to test your skills against the Mechanoids?
They're much trickier than Saepes. They move unpredictably.
Remember how we just got our butts kicked by those Saepes? How could we possibly handle Mechanoids?
It's not like that. We only lost last time because a Saepes bit my toe. It hurt like hell.
Mechanoids don't have mouths, so this time, it should be a cinch.
Man... sometimes I wish I had your confidence.
Shh... keep it down! I'm searching for the River Sprites. We might hear their performance again tonight.
One night many years ago, I was lucky enough to hear them once...
Even the most beautiful sound can't compare. The finest instruments struggle to match such music.
The unadulterated sounds of nature that I have never heard again since then... I wish I could hear it once more!
I can't believe it. I, a top Gourmet, forgot to bring all the ingredients.
Accompanying the meat with a side dish made using radishes will be great.
Today, I took my little brother swimming and decided to show off my culinary skills.
No, I just realized I forgot to bring side dishes.
Can't just munch on meat alone. It's too greasy and not good for the waistline.
If only we had some <001>radishes</> now, they'd be the perfect match for the meat. Refreshing and healthy.
My little brother is starving and waiting to dig in, but where am I going to find <001>radishes</> quickly?
Hey, I found some radishes for you.
Hey, I found some radishes for you.
Great! These radishes are big and fresh. They'll go perfectly with barbecue!
Thank you so much for your help. Otherwise, I'd be the laughingstock here.
Now that I have all the ingredients, I can finally focus on the barbecue. My brother must be starving.
Thanks a lot. You're a lifesaver!
It needs a bit of salt for flavor.
Waterside barbecue is where it's at.
And these skewers need a little more grease.
Just a few more minutes and they'll be ready.
I'm waiting for the barbecue my brother's making. Swimming always makes me hungry!
But I need to stay away from the stove—it's not safe for us kids.
I wonder what's written on this broken bronze stele...
What a perfect spot for fishing.
Wanna give it a shot? I'm sure you'll catch something good.
If you're missing any Angling items, you can buy them from me. I promise fair prices.
Our competition is still under the academy's rules...
But outside Jixia, in the midst of chaos, I may not have been able to best you.
Your letter mentioned this would be our final battle. I was worried... so I took drastic measures. The transformation potion should wear off soon.
Right on time. Speak up. The final challenge.
We once set up Mechcrafts to store brews from our hometown here.
Meet here again when our dreams come true. The world is not at peace yet, and our dreams remain unfulfilled. Gong Jin is...
The Three Kingdoms are in turmoil. A hero is needed, what do you plan to do?
The world is like a chess game. Every move requires three plans ahead. This chess game isn't even in Jiangjun.
But next round, we might be...
Fine... enough talk. Drink up, this is our final duel.
People think you and I are rivals, but all you ever compete for is better solutions for our nation.
Jixia is prosperous, embracing all, as if guarded by capable hands.
One day, I will unite the land... Kongming, I need your talent. If you are willing to come, I am willing to step aside.
Then why did you trick me into drinking the Saepes transformation potion?
Undercurrents are surging in the land of the three kingdoms, and the times will surely create heroes. What are your plans for now?
zh_text: 三分之地暗流涌动，时势必造英雄，眼下你有何打算？
source_text: 三分之地暗流涌动，时势必造英雄，眼下你有何打算？

text: So the "treasure" turns out to be what's left at the bottom of the cup...
Ohhh, I'm choking up... This friendship is so inspiring.
Haha, are you crying because we lost the treasure and the scoop?
Haha, are you crying because we lost the treasure and the scoop?
Uh, you've seen through my plan... Still, even if we come home empty-handed, a scoop on you two wouldn't be half bad.
How about "Eastwind Unbroken, Flames Engulfing the Plains: Unbreakable Bonds of Friendship"? Once this comes out, I won't just be number one in Jixia—I'll be the best in all of Primaera!
Well, I guess this is the end of our collaboration...
Well, I guess this is the end of our collaboration...
That was close! Good thing you stepped in—I'm the best Secrets Scoops correspondent in Jixia, you know!
You're the best student in Jixia?
You're the best student in Jixia?
If anyone can crack the treasure mystery, it's me. This is pure material for Secrets Scoops. I already have the title...

Facing the Saepes Treasure: Unveiling the Greatest Secret of the War Ruins! How's that? I sifted through heaps of materials to piece together this intel. With this special issue, I'll be the real deal.
So these Saepes are your doing too?
So these Saepes are your doing too?
That's right. I had to make some arrangements to make the investigation easier, but I accidentally startled a few... If any more show up, we'll be in trouble.
Sigh, are you interested in the investigation? Here, follow me. Let me show you the treasure first.
One is right in the ruins; the way to find it seems to have something to do with light.

But it's no easy fight. If that thing wakes up... I don't know if you can handle it.
Wow! Is this the stele left by our predecessors?
What secrets are you talking about?
Come play with us! Uh, it's more fun with more people...

text: This is it! The Saepes treasure is inside. I can tell this special feature is going to be a hit. What do you think could be inside?
Mountains of gold and silver treasures.
A mysterious and dangerous Saepes herbal medicine.
That'd be epic! History in the making for the Saepes!
They do love glittering things, but that's really testing my professional integrity.
Look, three locks. We need the matching keys to enter.
Doesn't look like something a Saepes could come up with.
Doesn't look like something a Saepes could come up with.
Oh, don't worry about that. I've already found the two keys...
In case someone is really that "lucky" in the future, it's good to have a countermeasure.

text: Stop bickering. Both of you have got a point, so why not just include everything?
I was hoping you'd come up with real suggestions.
You two are making my head spin. Let's get a fourth opinion, shall we?
Exactly! Both of their articles are <001>on the shelves back there</>.
Take a look at both and let us know what you think.
Come on, it won't take much of your time. Please help us out!
When you have time, <001>check out our reports on the nearby shelves</>. Then tell us what you think.
The Secrets Club should write stuff that aligns with the future research direction of the academy. That's how we stay ahead.
Hmph. Studying is boring enough already. Why make our publication another class for students?
I think something fun is much better. Just like our last issue, "Splendors of Jixia". The readers liked it very much.
We need to have some foresight in our reports...
Some gossip or funny anecdotes might be better.
Why fight over it? We'll just write them all.
I'm a Seeker. The treasures are not that important to me.
I won't find anything without learning how to swim...
Everyone knows that there are treasures at the bottom of Pearlized Lake.
In the past, people used to throw treasured trinkets into the lake for blessings. Now it's become a Jixia tradition.
Remember Bubble Fish Riot? It was part of the last Enlightenment Trials. Shye won.
Novar even threw himself in during that contest!
So how do you plan to search for treasure in the lake?
So how do you plan to search for treasure in the lake?
To hire others, I suppose. I don't have much money, so I'd just let them keep what they find.
So all that work is just for nothing?
So all that work is just for nothing?
I care more about the process and the satisfaction of making discoveries.
Bye. I'll think more about the swimming thing...
Well, it's not that I can't swim at all. I can float in water, but diving?
I just don't know how to time my breathing right. Choking on water all the time, and it feels awful...
Guess I'll never learn to swim. Do you want to go treasure hunting instead?
It is common knowledge that “there is treasure under the water of Zhuji Lake”.

source_text: “珠玑湖水下有宝物”是大家公认的事。

text: Am I imagining things, or are these dishes moving?
Really? They taste fine to me.
It's not the taste, but the ingredients... It's like they're watching me.
I haven't noticed anything. Maybe you're too tired?
Maybe so... Hopefully, that's all it is.
Your hunch was right—the dishes here are actually made from veggie and fruit monsters!
It was hard to accept at first, but knowing the truth actually makes it easier to enjoy.
Maybe next time, we should introduce our family and friends to this kind of cuisine.
Who knows, maybe one day this trend will catch on and we'll be known as pioneers of the monster cuisine movement.
I have both good and bad news for you.
I have both good and bad news for you.
You were right. The dishes ARE moving. BUT the dishes were made from fruit and vegetable monsters.
You were right. The dishes ARE moving. BUT the dishes were made from fruit and vegetable monsters.
Who says those sprites are off the menu? Keep an open mind!
Well, it is indeed a bit unsettling. But they do taste so great...
But you seem to be enjoying these dishes... Unique flavors, right?
Thanks for letting me know the truth. Now I can enjoy my meals without doubts!
Hello, something I can help you with?
Okay... Still, I'm having a strange feeling about this.
I knew something was off! Those sneaky Gourmets. I'm going to give them a piece of my mind!
Okay. Ren Ye, you handle the research. Xiaohu, you write. I'll manage the layout.
Fine, guess I'll try to write in that dry, academic style.
Just don't bring your gossip writing here! It could undermine the credibility of our reports!
Let's divide the work first. Ren Ye, go collect some stories. Xiaohu, you write. And I'll do the layout.
But where can I find all those funny gossips?
See? That's what happens when you pay too much attention on your studies.
Our next issue will have sections for both academic and daily life secrets.
You two, take charge of one section each. Remember, quality for credibility!
Got it. I'll put together some solid academic articles that'll make your section look trivial.
Oh yeah? Watch me create a buzz with the gossips so that no one reads your boring stuff!
Hey, have you read the reports Xiaohu and I wrote? Which do you think is better?
Do you prefer academic articles or entertainment pieces?
I knew you were a cut above the rest!
The Secrets Club should serve as the benchmark for the academic researches in Jixia!
Since you suggest it, we'll focus on academic content for our next issue.
I still think students prefer lighter and more entertaining content.
Great minds think alike! Let's keep the dry stuff in textbooks.
We should keep our articles entertaining and engaging for students.
Let's do it my way and make our next issue more fun.
Ugh, then it'd be empty as fast food. Who would want that?
A bit of both is better.
I knew I was right. Who says we can only choose one?
Edutainment, you know what I mean? It's possible to include both fun and informative content!
Yeah, you might be right. We'll try to do it this way next time.
But make sure it's divided evenly. I should get as much print space as her!
W-what's wrong? Am I not playing well?
Well, I'm still practicing... Please don't eavesdrop!
I... I never play well when others are listening...
That's why I came here. Somewhere quiet and secluded.
What if you're to perform one day?
What if you're to perform one day?
I'd have to close my eyes and pretend there's no one around...
So every time the audience applauds at the end of a performance, I'd get startled...
I've heard the villagers talk about the Saepes being spotted all over Springbrook Plains.
My guess would be it has something to do with that Giant Saepes.
Yes, it's said that the Giant Saepes has been sleeping there for a very long time. That's why they call it Saepes Retreat.
I really think that monster is involved in something in Springbrook Plains. Something bad...
Th-Thank you. I think the villagers enjoy it too.
Maybe it's because of this country vibe. I feel more relaxed than at the academy.
I didn't expect to meet another student so far away from the academy. I should've gone farther!
Here, the only people I might run into are some friendly villagers.
Yes. Some dishes pack a punch right from the first bite; others though, require more careful savoring.
Well... Let's say they're each flavorful in their own way.
I'm happy just to taste them all. Why spoil it by making comparisons?
I've been invited here by a Gourmet friend to sample these culinary delights.
You're here to evaluate the dishes?
Goodbye. And may you find joy in the art of culinary delicacies.
Keep those muddy shoes out of my tent!
Are you having trouble with this, too?
Are you having trouble with this, too?
Yes! I've been stuck here for over an hour!
It feels like, however I try, I'm still just one step away.
I've traveled across Springbrook Plains and figured out many Mechcrafts, but this one has me stumped.
What about you? Got any ideas?
The room on the second floor looks suspicious.
Exactly. There's a pressure plate inside the room and another one outside.
Both pressure plates need to be pressed at the same time.
So you must step on the one outside and find a way to activate the other.
Sadly, I don't know how to make that Mechanoid move.
If only something from outside could force it...
Before you came, I discussed with <001>Shye</>.
<001>She controls Flow in a unique way.</> Her <001>Silk Imprint</> can <001>pull</> enemies toward her Sorcery Lotus.
She <001>stood under the room</> and used her skill.
Surprisingly, a Sorcery Lotus was <001>created inside the room</>.
I don't have her skill. Still figuring out my own way.

<001>She controls Flow in a unique way.</> Her <001>Silk Imprint</> can <001>pull</> enemies toward her Sorcery Lotus.
She <001>stood under the room</> and used her skill.

You've come just at the right time. See the gate there?
The room on the second floor looks suspicious.
Exactly! I knew you'd pick up on that.
There's a pressure plate inside the room and another one outside.
Both pressure plates need to be pressed at the same time.
So you must step on the one outside and find a way to activate the other.

You are truly a special one, aren't you? I should move on now.
I saw how you did it. Really inspiring indeed!
A play in three acts. Bear witness!
Listen! Man speaks through flesh and cord, but a puppet? How does a puppet utter its first syllable?
I was adrift in a boundless sea... no... I have reached the shore.
Seeking the first prototype... the frayed and scattered threads of memory, right here, beneath the foundations of Old Citadel...
Visions take root upon my tongue, locking it in place. But tell me—is this a play, or a memory?
Are you... malfunctioning? None of this makes sense!
Are you... malfunctioning? None of this makes sense!
They say when the puppet speaks, the creator becomes a vessel of eternal silence.
Hush! The ancient <001>threads</> have opened their eyes. I can hear them! They are here!
They stir, spiraling through the wake of time, desperate to perform their grandest masterpiece!
Now! Find your <001>seats</>! Watch! Listen! Before it all unravels into nothing!
Something's wrong... it's glitching. The <001>threads</>... is there a problem with the puppet strings?
Something's wrong... it's glitching. The <001>threads</>... is there a problem with the puppet strings?
And what's all this about <001>seats</> and "watching the show"? Well, let me just see where this leads.
And what's all this about <001>seats</> and "watching the show"? Well, let me just see where this leads.
Did Senior Yango really betray Senior Kongming...?
Did Senior Yango really betray Senior Kongming...?
Was that... a message from Yango to Senior Kongming?
Was that... a message from Yango to Senior Kongming?
Thank you. You've helped me unravel a mystery that has haunted me for far too long.
Don't mention it. Witnessing the bond they once shared... it was worth the journey.
Don't mention it. Witnessing the bond they once shared... it was worth the journey.
I... I need to consider this carefully. The Master has made his death so vivid, so final... I cannot simply shatter that illusion on a whim.
I'll keep this recording safe for now. Perhaps one day, it will find its way to the ears of the one who needs to hear it most.
For now, accept this gift. May the secrets of the first puppet bring a touch of wonder to your days at the Academy.
That vision we just saw... was that the moment Senior Yango fell into the sea?
That vision we just saw... was that the moment Senior Yango fell into the sea?
To think he infiltrated Cao's camp just to help Senior Kongming... only to vanish into the waves. A true sacrifice.
To think he infiltrated Cao's camp just to help Senior Kongming... only to vanish into the waves. A true sacrifice.
A heavy ending... it leaves a bitter taste in the mouth.
A heavy ending... it leaves a bitter taste in the mouth.
Yango's Puppet... what's happened to it?
Yango's Puppet... what's happened to it?
Was that... the birth of Yango's Puppet?
Was that... the birth of Yango's Puppet?
So it was the Flow all along. I suppose it makes sense... only the Flow could grant a puppet such lifelike grace.
So it was the Flow all along. I suppose it makes sense... only the Flow could grant a puppet such lifelike grace.
The final scene... what's left to see?
The final scene... what's left to see?
Was that the moment Senior Kongming reached out to Yango... a memory of his guidance?
Was that the moment Senior Kongming reached out to Yango... a memory of his guidance?
So, this is how the puppets truly began...
So, this is how the puppets truly began...
I'm actually looking forward to the next performance.
I'm actually looking forward to the next performance.
What's happening? It's spiraling into some kind of frenzy...
What's happening? It's spiraling into some kind of frenzy...
And it said these puppets were Cao Cao's soldiers? During an old battle, perhaps...?
And it said these puppets were Cao Cao's soldiers? During an old battle, perhaps...?
The entrance that just lit up... it should be right in the center of the first floor.
The entrance that just lit up... it should be right in the center of the first floor.
What exactly is 'it'? Is it the fishy smell of the sea, the raised sails...

text: To be expected of the <001>Primal Puppet Strings</>. Their power is truly staggering.
There you are. I owe you my thanks. Had you not played the "audience" today, I never would have gathered these threads.
What exactly is going on? You weren't yourself back there...
What exactly is going on? You weren't yourself back there...
I have you to thank for that. Who would have thought the strings of my life would find their way back into your hands? Heh.
Aren't you curious why a "puppet show" meant for students would be staged in a place like this?
Does it have something to do with the ruins?
That's right. Old Citadel is where my master first began his research on puppets.
Legend says the laboratory where the first puppets were forged lies somewhere deep beneath these ruins.
The "actors" you saw were the very first prototypes crafted by the Master and Senior.
Precisely. It was in Old Citadel, that the Master first began his research into the craft.
Rumor says the original puppet lab lies deep beneath our feet.
The "actors" you saw were the very first prototypes crafted by the Master and Senior.
So there's a history here... but what does any of this have to do with me?
So there's a history here... but what does any of this have to do with me?
A faint directive remains etched in my mind: I must find something hidden within that lab.
Yet, though I have haunted these halls for ages, the entrance remained lost to me.
Until the day of the exam. The unique Flow you possess somehow awakened the ancient puppets scattered throughout the city.
The energy in their strings—perhaps because it was once touched by the Master's Flow—resonates perfectly with the aura underground.
And so, I attempted to make them dance at my fingertips, hoping they would lead the way to the entrance.
I underestimated the lingering power. It was enough to drag even me into those vivid, haunting phantasms of the past.
Fortunately, you arrived. I used what was left of my will to cast you as the spectator, bringing that chaotic performance to a close and reweaving the threads.
At any rate, the curtain has fallen. Now, follow me. It's time we saw what's waiting backstage.
Exquisite and translucent, as pale as jade. Light as a cloud, yet as tempered as steel... woven from the Aersilk.
Watch me take them out with one shot!
Three, two, one, bang! Haha, Xishi, your assist came just in time!
My dear young lady, why won't you wait for me?
Let my Phantom Gauze help you keep them under control!
Heehee, the credit goes to you, the treasure goes to me!
I thought I'd found a clue to this year's surprise!
I happened to see some seniors slipping to a hill behind the inn at night.
Then I went to the hill, but found nothing... just a pile of rubble.
I wonder where they are. Well, I'd better rely on myself and prepare for the exam.
When they brought the injured Seeker Society Senior here that day, it really startled me.
I heard he was surrounded by five or six bears. It's a miracle he got out alive...
A new round of entrance exams has begun.
Upstream Camp is the largest camp in Springbrook Plains, and almost all exam candidates will set foot here.
But there's another tradition here that few people know about...
Every year, the seniors prepare a surprise at Upstream Camp. Only one available, first come first served.
It's different every year, but it always helps new students improve their skills.
Goodbye, and good luck with your exams!
Goodbye, and good luck with your exams!
Goodbye, and good luck with your exams!
You too, good luck! Hope to see you after I get in.
This test... it's wasting my genius intellect...
The riddles on this board are so tricky.
I have mastered the knowledge of Sorcery, but if I can't solve riddles, I couldn't even find the exam venue.
I should keep the answer to myself...
I should keep the answer to myself...
Is this what they call "talent going unrecognized?"
We Sorcery students value innate talent, not postnatal training.
But it's fun watching Qiu Shan train every day.
Training all day is against the rules. He must be too busy to rest. Unlike me, I follow the rules.
I'm aiming for the School of Sorcery. Look at my elegant appearance and refined techniques. People even call me Little Zhou Yu.
Take care. I'll continue studying these riddles.
Are you studying for the exam?
Senior Kongming passed with full marks. It's unbelievable!
Yes! That's one of Senior Kongming's records at Jixia.
He completed the trial in record time, far surpassing the standard.
Are you a fan of Kongming?
That's right! I came to Jixia Academy just to join the fan club!
Oh no, it's to follow in the footsteps of Kongming, exploring the wisdom of the world.
Goodbye! If you get Kongming's autograph, be sure to contact me!
This is an amulet blessed by the Pearlized Tree.
Senior Kongming wore the same one.
Why, he told me, of course.
Can you tell me more about it?
You go ahead and buy it, I'll explain...
Let me tell you about the preparations for the bonfire party.
A smoke bomb and the mask of the Three Sages.
Senior, um, could you slow down a bit?
Smoke bombs and masks of the Three Sages...
Yes? Do you have any questions?
Hehe, you'll know when the time comes.
There's usually healing medicine, chili sauce...

text: So, did you get all of it?
This is a list of items needed for the bonfire party.
Yeah! It must be really... explosive?
Boom, chu, whoosh, you get my drift, right?
I... I think I understand... maybe.
Time flies. It's been years since I started preparing for the exam...
So many new students this year...
Wuyan's hammer? My handiwork as well!
Choose a weapon that feels right!
Is there anything I can help with?
Could you give me some guidance as a new student?
Can you give me some guidance as a new student?

Any advice for a new student?
Any advice for the new students?
Any advice for the new students?
The first rule of the training ground is to never gamble with your life. Never engage in a direct confrontation during adventures.
The Item Store offers many useful items, like Energy Potion, which can help you stay prepared.
Thank you for your help, goodbye.
Thank you for your help, goodbye.
Goodbye, and good luck with your exams.
Feel free to ask me any questions about the exam.
Not bad for a new student.
That guy just now was pretty cute.
That brat Meng Ya, just thinking about him makes me angry!
What fireworks should we use for the bonfire party?
How about trying a new formula?
Tonight's campfire and fireworks depend on it!
There are so many new students this year.
Hahaha, Meng Ya will finally concede defeat this time.
Stand clear, I'm testing my cannon!
What's wrong with the new formula?
With this, the precision should be perfect.
Why is the front sight crooked again?
Now this is a perfect cannon!
Finally, time to rest. Today's training was intense but satisfying.
Each practice feels like a real battle. I must stay focused.
That raw power and the feeling of never quite mastering it—it's captivating.
I'll push harder tomorrow. That's it for today.
It's bustling inside! I heard they do serious training with dual swords. Want to come and watch?
Watch their training? Humph, I'll pass.
Fine... But I heard there are always challengers.
The challengers are sure to be top-notch, and it'll be thrilling. You'd regret missing it.
Hello! Here to visit our Training Hall?
Welcome! We have top talent with outstanding Martial Arts skills.
Special? It's our carefree spirit. We go with the flow and stay true to ourselves.
Go with the flow? You mean there's no rule here?
Go with the flow? You mean there's no rule here?
Of course! Every disciple trains in the way they prefer.
We consult the Head Trainer if we have questions. Seniors give tips—or playful jabs.
Join us! Follow your heart and unleash your freedom. Welcome to He & Ming's Training Hall!
I can feel the intensity even as a spectator.
So, can you tell me more about your challenge?
That's it for me. Lost too many Mechcraft weapons.
Coward. Mechcraft weapons are just combat tools. Their purpose is served.
To beat Mr. Bai He, you gotta keep trying. Just like me.
Didn't expect you to lose too...
One day, I'll beat Bai He and rename this place Mechcraft Training Hall!
I got beaten before finishing my first move...
I should probably just join He & Ming's Training Hall to refine my skills.
I'm usually lazy, and it makes my junior brother unfocused in his training. This can't go on.

Maybe I should just go back. I can't win anyway.
She was close on each try. Why couldn't she make it?
Take it seriously, and you'll win.
Take it seriously, and you'll win.
Makes sense. Could you get tips from other challengers and share them with us?
See, everyone says it's normal to fail when starting out.
Thanks, but if I lack the talent, all this effort may be pointless.
Come on. It's not like that.
Could you get tips from other challengers and share them with us?
Yeah, please! Do us a favor.
That's the spirit! Don't get discouraged.
Look, our friend's back. Let's hear what the other challengers have to say.
Forget it, I'll just keep practicing on my own. If it still doesn't work, maybe I'm just not talented.
I was just getting fired up, now I'm down again...
Sorry, but could you do us a favor?
Sure, if I have the time.
Sure, if I have the time.
Some lost even after four tries.
Mr. Bai He's skills are unfathomable.
Feeling better? You did well enough. With more practice, you'll do even better.
I guess it's just my problem...
I asked all the challengers here...
I asked all the challengers here...
Exactly. People fail often. Don't worry about being laughed at.
There was a time I didn't even stand a chance.
It's okay. You did your best!
I let everyone down. Maybe I'm not cut out for Martial Arts...
My sister is losing confidence again. How can I help her get back on track?
Isn't it obvious? Just look at me.
This is my fourth try, and I got beaten before finishing my first move.
Next time, I'll at least show something before getting knocked down!
Is the challenge tough for you?
Is the challenge tough for you?
Do you find the challenge difficult?
Now I think back, many of the Head Trainer's moves that seemed like weaknesses were actually intentional.
I was being too careless. Ugh, now my head hurts.
If he hadn't held back, more than your head would be hurting.
Challenging the Head Trainer is no joke. I'd better get back to training.
Mr. Bai He's skills are really something.
Mr. Bai He's skills are really something.
Do you find the challenge difficult?
My partner is a genius from the School of Mechcraft. His weapons are top-tier.
You lost even with your Mechcraft weapon?
You lost even with your Mechcraft weapon?
And yet, I just couldn't touch Mr. Bai He.
I need more study. I'm not there yet.
Do you find the challenge difficult?
Keep all the Dual Swords techniques taught by the Head Trainer in mind.
Your transitions are choppy. Engage your waist on turns to stay balanced.
Yeah, that's it. You did well.
It's my favorite time of the day, done with my tasks and watching the juniors train.
Just leaning back here, and admiring the youth's energy—that's life.
Good work. Those moves are pretty solid. Reminds me of myself back in the day.
Go put on your training gear now.
I can't understand a thing... Maybe I should give up on Martial Arts.
Cheer up. Try to start with Dual Swords. Mr. Bai He will help you.
What happened? Take your time and tell me about it.
I can't master Dual Blades. I train as much as Wang Yun, but I still fall short.

Just hold on a bit longer.

I ran this shop for ten years and mocked those afraid to change. Now I'm the same.

Deera visits with her animals. When I get lazy, Ember's big hammer keeps me on track.

Hmm... I think I should stay a bit longer. Maybe I can repay their kindness a little.

Jixia is great, but not for me. It's never too late to find my place in this vast world.
Thank you for your encouragement. May you one day travel across mountains and seas.
Ride the wind to a good place, across the vast sky, and look down at the smoke of a hundred homes.
This tune embodies years of my refinement. I hope you'll enjoy it at a leisurely pace.

Each tune is born from my reflections on life.
Haha! My sword isn't meant for mere mortals, it's forged to guard the Dragon Veins!
In the world of business, power isn't always the key to success. Some merchants trust in their own wisdom.
Kiddo, you're not there yet. Practice a few more years.
May my music echo your moods.

Next, Musashi's adventure in a soba shop.
At noon, under a blazing sun, Musashi entered town, stomach growling.
A tiny, worn shop caught his eye, but its aroma was irresistible.
He thought, "A hot bowl of noodles is just what I need."
He stepped in and was greeted by a cheerful shopkeeper.
Welcome, sir! Our soba is legendary!
I'd like some noodles, too. Let's go to Tata's later.
Musashi sat down and looked around.
A crude wall scroll read "What goes around comes around" in bold strokes.
He called the waiter: "One bowl of soba, extra sugar."
The waiter was at a loss. The shopkeeper spoke.
Sir, soba is served plain. Adding sugar is unusual.
Musashi's gaze hardened. "Do as I say."
The shopkeeper sighed and told the waiter to do it.
Who knows, maybe a master in disguise?
Musashi ignored them and served himself a cup of tea.
Ugh, they care so much about others.
Soon, a steaming bowl of soba arrived.
Musashi tasted and found it completely bland.
He set down his chopsticks, sipped tea, and heard nearby customers gossiping.
Two swords, a cross-shaped scar... Is that Musashi?
Miyamoto Musashi? No way! If he were, why eat at a place like this?
I heard Musashi slew sea monsters for a woman.
A true warrior shouldn't be swayed by such sentiments!
BAM! Musashi smashed the table with his fist. The table was split.
All fell silent. He spoke slowly:
I am Musashi. Since you're so interested... care to test my swords?
I'm boring now. I've heard you're tough stuff, show me what you've got!
The drunk kicked over the table and chair, overturning the sugar-topped noodles.
Musashi sprang forward, furious, and pinned the drunk flat on the ground.
With a few sharp snaps, the diners' swords broke in half!
Musashi said coldly, "If you can't appreciate a fine meal, you have no right to challenge me."
He dropped some coins and walked out.
The shopkeeper kept apologizing. Musashi waved him off and paused at the door.
Afternoon sun streamed in. Musashi felt as if he saw Otsu outside the candy shop.
She used to watch him practice in secret, never mocking him, even when he fell.
They promised: one would be a legendary swordsman, the other would open the finest candy shop.
Now everything had changed, and that promise could never be fulfilled.
Fine, Musashi murmured to himself. "What goes around comes around."
He glanced at the wall scroll one last time, then strode out into the bustling crowd.
Sir, swordsman from Kyokutou! Chang'an is west! the shopowner called out.
The swordsman keeps going. No one knows where he's headed.
But as long as you care, you'll meet again!

It's so dull without showing the power of my cannon.
Everyone has their own specific requirements. I apologize if I get a bit stern at times.
I do my best to accommodate everyone, but sometimes it's just frustrating.
These days, we have Sleepers, Novelists, Beauticians... all claiming to be Societies.
There's a "Society" for almost everything nowadays.
If they're not Academy-certified, I turn them away. I'm having enough on my plate as it is.
Only registered Societies can apply for a booth! No exceptions!
I'm in charge of managing the Society recruitment booths.
Our booth receives around 500 visitors daily, which is about 20% more than the others.
Among these five hundred people, however, the recruitment success rate was less than ten percent.

text: We need to increase that number to improve our conversion rate... Hey, are you still listening?
Hello! This is the Trading Society's booth. We're conducting research on Society recruitment.
I'm not interested in it. Thanks.
I guess research isn't an appealing topic...
People are drawn to places with enticing food aromas.
Though people used to come because of burnt smells.
But that's in the past! After burning through eight woks, my skills finally received recognition!
My next goal is to create exciting dishes and attract more students to join us.
A dash of curiosity, a pinch of courage, and a whole lot of effort. We're ready to serve!
That's right! Nothing beats the smell of good cooking.
Wow, these dishes look delicious! I absolutely love spicy food. The hotter, the better!
And desserts too! Especially River Flower Rolls and Spring Lotus Cakes. They're my favorites.
Savory dishes are also great. Salted Duck and Smoked Spice Falcon are so yummy with rice.
As long as there's no radish, I'll eat anything.
Recruitment? I'm not really in the mood for it right now.
My divination tells me today isn't the best day for recruiting. I need some rest and recharge.
I'm tired. Maybe come back in a few days?
Or check out the other booths. They might be more interesting.
Few know of Intelligencers these days.
We once controlled all the intel across Jixia and planned every strategy.
Back when the Societies were divided, we united everyone by forging alliances.
Though the Intelligence Society isn't as influential as it once was, it remains an indispensable part of the Society.
With our strategies, we Intelligencers will rise again.
Time's up. The claw needs to recharge.
Time's up. The claw needs to recharge.
Need perfect timing... I can do it.
Need perfect timing... I can do it.
I know where to get free food!
You wanna know where Tata's pantry is?
The Mechcraft I built works like a charm.
Check out this Mechcraft woven from Aersilk, built to last!
Check out the goods from Craftworks, guaranteed to please!
You want to test my blade skills, is that it?
I learned a lot from Novar's defeat of Aersim.
And my business has flourished thanks to Nora.
I always thought I was strong, but seeing your prowess, I realize I still have a long way to go.
You're intrigued by the puppet show. I can see it in your eyes.
Humans and puppets are different. Puppets are the perfect creations. Ask me anything you want to know.
You don't know much about Puppeteers, do you?
Understandable. We're not exactly the most popular Society.
Puppets are the elegant combination of Mechcraft and Sorcery.
We craft their bodies with Mechcraft and control their movements with Telepathic Threads.
Puppet shows are our unique art.
I'm still rehearsing, but I promise you'll be amazed by the actual performance.
Bye. Hope to see you at the show.
Maybe we should get a booth next to the stage. So we can get more people to join.
Nah, I'd rather spend my time angling.
Have you decided which Society to join?
But every Society seems so interesting. Are you sure?
You know my answer. I came to Jixia with a clear goal in mind.
If not for those restrictions, we Cannoneers would be performing today.
Our fireworks are way more impressive than flame breathing.
They're not for sale, but join us and I'll teach you how to make them.
That's a cannon on your right. Small, but pretty powerful.
I'd love to show you, but the manager won't allow it...
Can't show off my cannons at the fair. What a shame.
My cannons are perfectly safe. But that fussy manager won't let me.
I can only show my cannon at the booth. I can't fire it.

It's so dull without showing the power of my cannon.
If only I could show everyone my cannons...
The show will get boring if it stays the same.

What kind of performances would you like to see?
Why didn't I think of that? With all the Societies gathered here...
We could showcase everyone's talents and spark new ideas.
With the beauty and talent here, the audience will be swept away.
A performance by the Student Affairs Committee.
Oh no, that's asking too much, haha.
I'm fine with MCing, but I really can't perform on stage.
Say, have you heard me MC? Don't you think my voice is perfect for poetry recitals?
Well, guess the burden falls on my shoulders alone.
It's my first time on stage... my stomach is hurting from nerves...
The perfect performance I imagined seems impossible now.
Relax! Don't lose heart before you even start.
Some audiences want to see a mysterious hero fighting Cloudeater.

Amazing! Can't wait for the full performance!

And desserts too! Especially River Flower Rolls and Spring Lotus Cakes. They're my favorites!
As long as there's no radish, I'll eat anything.
What's happening? Has the show started?
Did I miss something cool? Maybe I should watch from the other side...
Don't miss out on our newest specialty snacks!
We have tons of choices, perfect for the performance!
I wanna perform on stage too...
That was awesome! I want to get a closer look!
You saw the notice, right? The angling competition is coming up.
And we need impressive fish for that! We're running low.
Without them, the veterans won't even bother showing up.
Hope my partner can find some in Cloudshatter Vale...
Five, six, seven... that's far from enough.
Let's compete. See who is the best.
Sure. The winner gets to join the angling competition.
Hey, anyone can join the angling competition!
Just saying... Why are you so worked up?
Wait, I found a nest, but still caught nothing...
Dad, you're not buying another angling rod, are you?
One needs good tools to do a good job. I won't come home empty-handed this time!
Because you can come home with your new rod!
Your fancy gear ruins the spirit of angling!
Angling is about "clicking" with the fish. Your harpoon will just scare them away.
Everyone knows he wins because of his Bubble Fish!
Hey, I never called you Stillminds boring. Why so hostile?
'Cause you Gearheads took over the whole booth...
Hey, what's your take on this?
See? No one can say no to the Mechcraft harpoon.
Pathetic. Seems I'm the only one who can see the beauty of Stillminds.
But you just fell asleep at the booth.
I was just... becoming one with nature.
Besides, real angling is done in the wild. Sitting at the booth is boring.
That won't win you the competition. Even Shye is buying new gear.
No amount of gear will help her. She'll still finish last.
Why doesn't Shye ask Master Zhuangzi for advice?
I only care about the fish.
Fair point. Angling is about catching the most fish.
That's... so mundane. If you fish for gain, you'll gain nothing.
Why not study aquatic ecosystems with me? Sustainability is the Riverreads' ultimate goal.
Boring. I want to catch a ton of fish with one stab...
The traditional ways are the best!
Looks like they'll be at it for a while.
Looks like they'll be at it for a while.
Luban, I need to pass tomorrow's Mechcraft exam!
Please give me luck with my new creation!
Could you make the next exam easier? Please?
Students from the School of Mechcraft pray to Luban's cutout before exams.
Hey! You used to pray at Kongming's cutout, too!
Th-that's different! Kongming really answered my prayers!
Why not just ask Master Mozi for help?
How's this pose? Or was the last one better?
Of course, I'll add some artistic touches to the portrait.
Perfect as it is. You look just as good as Shye.
Not quite there. It needs more strikes.
Of course, it is. No one questions my skill.

Years ago, he wanted to forge a mighty weapon with it for his graduation exam.
He spent months, confident that he'd impress Master Fuzi with the weapon he forged.
When Master Fuzi tested the weapon, it snapped in two.
You should decrease the hardness, Master Fuzi said, and my father failed.
After that, my father left the academy. He never touched the hammer again.
But I know he never forgot it until the end.
So I'll reforge it, no matter the cost.
You think so? I've been refining it day and night, trying to turn it into my finest weapon.
No... the finest weapon Jixia has ever seen.
But maybe you're right. Maybe it's good enough. Time to return to the School of Martial Arts...
And show Master Fuzi my father's legacy!
Of course! My father's regret won't hold me back.
I've forged weapons for many students during my time at Megablade Smithy.
Every single one is a masterpiece.

Yao... he is severely injured now, and I don't know when he will wake up...
Yao... he is severely injured now, and I don't know when he will wake up...
How could this be... Damn it! If I catch the culprit, I'll smash them into a pancake!
Stay calm. The academy has been hit hard, and our top priority is to treat the wounded and regroup.
Stay calm. The academy has been hit hard, and our top priority is to treat the wounded and regroup.
Student, if there's anything I can help you with, remember to let me know.
I wonder how Yao is doing now...
Anything else you want to ask?
Hehe, do they praise my looks or my cooking?
I'd be happier if it's the latter! You haven't truly visited Frostcloud Town until you've eaten at Tata's!
Everything here is delicious. You can't go wrong with anything on the menu.
Today's specials are Croaky Yolk Tart and Fluffy Iced Cake!
They are desserts inspired by cute animals. Who can resist them?
Even though things are like this now, Tata believes that everything will get better!
So, I hope to do my part to cheer everyone up!
Oh, right, classmate... is the Master really...?
So, what about everyone in the Star Team?
Everyone is seriously injured; only Master Luban is in slightly better condition...
Everyone is seriously injured; only Master Luban is in slightly better condition...
Hmm... let's work hard together, we can definitely overcome this difficulty!
How is everyone on the Star Team doing...
Craftworks is the Crafters' workshop. We showcase our finest work here.
We partner with many regions and offer Mechcraft Kite delivery.
Exactly! We want to get the tools we make into the right hands.
I hope people understand our work and live a more comfortable life.
It's possible that some Cloud-Silk mechanisms will gradually shut down during this time.
But you don't need to worry too much, classmate. Once Dean Mozi and the others reclaim the Cloud Silkworm, those mechanisms will soon return to operation!
Don't forget to check out our new products!
Once he returns, we'll have our backbone back.
I hope Jixia can safely overcome this crisis...
Would you like to chat some more?
Hmm... I am preparing to pray with these little animals.
I hope Jixia can overcome this crisis soon and return to its former vibrant self.
Though the people of Frostcloud Town are uneasy, they are prepared to face what comes.
The tea at Miaoshou Tea Shop is still great, and the fluffy ice cakes are delicious as ever.
They're fond of you! They say you have a warm, inviting scent.
May Jixia overcome this danger as well and return to its former peace.
Fluffy, come and pray for Jixia with me.
Check out the prologue of this new tale! Even seasoned travelers are fans. Want to give it a go?
My goodness, these pages hold more excitement than any real adventure!
Don't miss it, or you'll regret it! Tons of wonders here!
Hey, who are you, and how dare you bring chaos to Frostcloud Town?
If I could visit Aermore Valley, what a brilliant book that would make!
Novar's brave and sharp, but trust me, my story holds even more spectacular feats!
In the tales of Frostcloud Town, you are the most brilliant chapter!
Oh my, the Shye dolls just flew off the shelves! Next time, I'll need to stock up more.
These Team of Stars dolls are our hot sellers!
Team of Stars dolls just arrived! Hurry, or you'll miss out!
That move of Nora's? It's almost unbelievable!
The Divine Imprint anomalies in Jixia have me curious. I want to check them out.
Everyone in Frostcloud Town is buzzing about the tale of you two joining forces against the beast.
I recently bought what was supposedly Novar's notes on Martial Arts.
I thought I'd finally learn his skills, but it turned out to be just some poems.
Are you here keeping someone company too?
Me too. I've been walking all day. My legs might fall off. I wonder how she manages this...
No, I can't walk any further...
How can you still keep walking?
It's so hot. And exhausting. We could just stay in the dorm.
It's our day off! Why waste it lying around?
Classes are tiring enough without your shopping trips...
What do you think? Going out or staying in?
Wonder Park in the morning, Institute of Divination in the afternoon, then finish the day off with dinner at Tata's...
My kind of person! I only get to recharge when I'm by myself.
Hmph. You just don't want to hang out with me.
It's not that. I just need some alone time.
Once I get some rest, I'll take you to dinner. How's that?
Stop looking for allies. I call the shots today. Now get up and get moving!
Girls are so good at shopping...
Learned so many tricks, it's all down to this!
I'll make a bigger one when I grow up!
Meng Ya might look tough, but he shares his cannon designs with us.
That's why I'll always be his fan!
Hello there! What would you like to know?
Is there anything else you'd like to know?
I've been treasure hunting in East Aerfall Highlands for years. Ruins, Bronze Mechanoids, you name it.
With all the Societies around, I get to see all kinds of rare treasures here!
First time in Frostcloud Town? Got any Society in mind?
I suggest you take a look around and learn more before making a decision.
I joined a Seeker Society recruitment event, and that's when my passion for relics and treasures began.
Goodbye! Come find me if you need anything!
I used to be so tense all the time. But now, with these little ones as company and some nice people to talk to, I'm finally learning what real life is about!
Every item here has a fascinating story behind it! Would you like to hear about them?
Yeah, yeah. You've been sitting here for ages. It's hard not to notice you.
Their uniform looks so good! So sharp and clean.
You mean it looks good on him. Why not go say hi?
No way... I'm not ready yet.
That cute guy from the Student Affairs Committee just glanced at me again!
Did he just look at me again?!
The path of the claw is so hard to predict.
Limited edition book! First come, first served!
Hi there! Want to take a look?
Are you one of the Societies?
Of course! Everyone reads novels—students, residents, everyone!
Novels bring so much color to life. They're an essential part of our cultural events!
The Society registration office is too rigid...
At least we've got fans here in Frostcloud Town!
These are works collected from different sources. Each has a unique story.
Some are bestsellers and prized collections. They're very hard to find.
We even have rare ones from legendary alumni. You must've heard of those four, right?
And some were confiscated by the Department of Discipline. It took us some time to ste... I mean... retrieve them...
Anyway! Every book here is special. Take your time browsing!
Limited edition book! First come, first served!
Oh, just some anecdotes about Senior Sima Yi and Senior Kongming.
Oh... huh? What! Tell me more!
Student Affairs Committee. How can I help you?
We're a student-run organization, managed by upright students.
We help with academic and daily matters in towns and camps in Jixia.
See you. Enjoy your time in Frostcloud Town!
If you need any help, feel free to come to us anytime.
Frostcloud Town was built by Societies, each running their own shops.
Here's a full range of Society offerings: Gourmets' cuisines to Herbalists' herbal tea...
Hunters' fantastic creatures, Musicians' performances, Crafters' creations...
Hey there! Are you interested in the latest plushies from the Heroes' Fanclub?
Yep! We make plushies based on famous heroes.
Here is the champion team from last year's Enlightenment Trials. They're the most popular right now.
Just look at the incredible detail! Our best Puppeteers have crafted them perfectly.
I see you're new here. We're a group that greatly admires heroes, as our name suggests.
Anyone can join us, as long as they have a passion for heroes.
We look up to heroes and strive to follow their example!
We also create merchandise featuring our favorite heroes.
Our previous plushies of the four legendary alumni were incredibly popular!
These are just samples. See the fancy box across the street? Try your luck there!
See you! Come back if you like what you see!
Is there anything else you'd like to know?
Yes! The Puppeteer and his puppet released the third volume. I finally got it! Look, look, the Sorcery senior also has an update!
Oh no, I'm running low on money. Can only afford one of them...
I want to see Senior Kongming's gentle eyes, but I also want to see Senior Yuan Ge's possessive pampering... what should I do?
You do realize these are just fictional stories, right?
I know, but I just can't help it. How about we buy both and take turns reading?
Look, The Greatest Trader has released a new volume! The previous one was about Navenia.
Now it dives into Chang'an! I wonder how he becomes the greatest Trader!
I'm not really interested in Strings of Love...
Should I place this cutout here or on the other side...
This stall looks like it was set up by the Heroes' Fanclub.
We'll have to wait and see.

text: I can't be the first to give up.
I can't let him look down on me.
Where did you learn those moves?
I mean, come on, I'm a warrior, yet I'm stuck teaching these kids!
My dad, the former village chief, instructed me to do so.
He said our ancestors built this village, and we must protect it.
Before he passed away, he entrusted this responsibility to me.
Like everyone else, I learned it from the bronze set in the Ancestral Hall.
You know, they were left by my dad decades ago.
I wonder why he only left six chapters. I asked him about the seventh many times, but he never told me.
Ah, it feels like it all happened just yesterday.
Sometimes I feel like Dad hasn't left. He's just gone for a walk by his favorite river.
So, I must raise worthy successors to protect the village before I can leave in peace...
They're competing at every training session and ignoring each other, even eating separately.
When will those two ever stop?
My two younger brothers have been training with Buqi from dawn till dusk without a break.
Everyone called him Lu Buqi the Old Man. His vigor and strength were unmatched.
He can train from dawn till dusk, but that doesn't surprise anyone. His father, Wu Li, is also incredibly strong.
But my little brothers are too weak for that.
The problem is they eat three more bowls of rice every day. It's worrying...
But this is for the best. They won't cause trouble or sneak out, and their parents won't worry.
Recently, more students have come to the village. The village chief even posted a notice.
The village chief has his reasons, but I enjoy interacting with those scholars.
Especially those Seekers, they always have fascinating stories to share about the outside world.
Speaking of which, there used to be a Seeker Society member who often sought advice from the village chief.
The Seeker Society? And the village chief?
I remember that Seeker Society member—she stopped visiting after that.
No one knows what happened, but since then, the village chief's attitude toward those students changed.
You're not from here, are you? I haven't seen you before.
Our village chief wasn't always this strict. He used to welcome the Seekers and even accompanied them on their explorations.
Farewell, and keep what you heard to yourself, okay?
When he's older, I'll teach him everything I know, so he can take over the family business and become a great Hunter!
I don't want him to be a Hunter! I plan to send him to Jixia Academy in two years.
Jixia Academy isn't necessarily better than our village. Why else would those students keep running to our village every other day?
Before I knew it, the kid was already learning martial arts from Lu Buqi.
Stand like pines, move like the wind! Hey! Hah!
Why isn't class over yet? I wanna go home and sleep...
The mesh size must be just right.
Look at the leaves drifting in the wind, just like the butterflies I used to chase as a child.
Leaves fall and grow again, life is peaceful. I like these days.
Hermitage is just an ordinary mountain village. We're self-sufficient and happy.
The terrain around our village is complex and dangerous. We don't interact much with the outside world unless necessary.
Why do you care? It's none of your business.
They do this not only to protect villagers but also to safeguard outsiders like you.
Young one, this is the Ancestral Hall of Hermitage. Outsiders shouldn't linger here too long.
You're a Jixia Academy student, right? Don't be like those Seekers of your school! They pester villagers with questions and investigations, causing a ruckus.
It's just a few tricks and good stamina, nothing special.
Young one, don't pry into village matters. Best leave soon.
Goodbye, young one. May you leave the village soon.
I won't give in... I'm not sleepy...
This ancestral hall gives me peace.
Why didn't you play with your sister today?
I'm competing with them to see who's the least sleepy.
Croaky is about to lose, but I'm feeling a bit sleepy...
Great, thank you! I'll follow your lead.
Hmm! Such a big decision really needs careful consideration!
The Horned Beast? It's lively and cute, but it doesn't seem majestic enough. Is it really suitable?
Look at its smooth fur. It feels just like a "ball".
Look at its smooth fur. It feels just like a "ball".
And those twin horns on its head, so majestic! Even I envy them.
And those twin horns on its head, so majestic! Even I envy them.
Wow! Really? I think Horned Beast fits perfectly.
Not just that. Apart from Chiuchiu, Aku has other animal companions. Croaky and Fluffy here would be perfect for those roles.
Not just that. Apart from Chiuchiu, Aku has other animal companions. Croaky and Fluffy here would be perfect for those roles.
Great, thank you! I'll follow your lead.
Hmm! Such a big decision really needs careful consideration!
Have you heard the story of Agedo, the Child of the Woods? She's the greatest warrior in my opinion!
Fluffy's build is the closest match to "Chiuchiu." I mean, "Chiuchiu" looks plump and round as well.
Fluffy's build is the closest match to "Chiuchiu." I mean, "Chiuchiu" looks plump and round as well.
I plan to follow in her footsteps, exploring every corner of the village with my animal companions, and becoming the village king!
Now's the perfect time for a journey! But who should I choose to be my "Chiuchiu"? I can't decide!
Hey, do you know the story of Aged and Chiuchiu? Can you give this girl some advice? She's been stuck for ages.
No one knows Agedo better than I do.
Really? Which one of them would make the best "ball" for me?
Never heard of it. Gotta go.
This Fluffy looks exactly like the original.
This Four-horned Beast is quite impressive.
Fluffy? But it's a bit slow. Is it suitable?
Great, thank you! I'll follow your lead.
Hmm! Such a big decision really needs careful consideration!
Wow! That's the first time I hear about it!
Not just that. Apart from Chiuchiu, Aku has other animal companions. The Horned Beast and Croaky here would be perfect for those roles.
Not just that. Apart from Chiuchiu, Aku has other animal companions. The Horned Beast and Croaky here would be perfect for those roles.
Croaky is a bit noisy, are you sure it's a good idea?
Look at its determined little eyes and sharp claws. It's just like "Chiuchiu."
Look at its determined little eyes and sharp claws. It's just like "Chiuchiu."

No, I want to go play hide-and-seek with Sister Yuetao and the others.

Maybe it's not a bad thing for villagers to see the world.

text: Chiuchiu, scratch that person when you see them!
The valiant Ageda will protect you!
But if it's one of the elders, don't scratch, or you'll get lectured!
Wonder who'll be the new elder...
Forget it, it's not my problem. I'd better focus on checking the supplies.
I heard about what happened to Guan... so sad.
I've planted this field twice now. Surely this time I'll get a good harvest.
Hey, with that build, you must be aiming to be a plowing expert!
Sunshine, water drops, and greenery—my haven.
Oh, seems like I've upset someone.
The tune's ambiance is like the subtle fragrance in this tea, calming the mind.
The fragrance of tea and the gentle music create a unique atmosphere.
The land needs rest, just like people do.
Just got better and already jumping around? Watch out, your fever might come back.
Master Lu says life is about movement! I'll fall behind if I miss even a day.
No way you can keep up. Look, I can walk on walls and roofs!
That's fine, as long as I run faster than you!
Boundless leaves fall rustling through the air; the endless sound of hammers rings everywhere.
Yes, I'm the village blacksmith. I craft all the farming and hunting tools here.
Just common farming tools and weapons, like hunting knives, bows, and I use the Myriad Gold Rock...
Ah... I didn't say Sougold Rock. You didn't hear anything, okay?
No worries. Better get going! The chief doesn't allow me to deal with strangers.
Where is my Goldrock? I hope everything is fine. I really want to test different weapons with it...
I'll wait until everyone's asleep, then I'll go to the training grounds to check things out.
I'm forging iron! Why are you doing this at night?
Outsiders aren't allowed to stay overnight. Go away!
You're hallucinating! I said "through trials and tribulations". How could I possibly have external minerals?
Watch me stand on one leg!
Like you? Didn't you fall off the roof last month and spend two weeks in bed?
Hey, don't be mad. The roof is fixed.
What are they saying? I can't hear clearly...
Slacking off with my girl, hope no one finds out.
Are you from the School of Sorcery?
School of Sorcery? What's that? I've grown up here and never left the village.
But you can manipulate Sorcery Energy.
But you can manipulate Sorcery Energy.
You mean this energy in my hands? I've always had this power.
I used to think everyone could sense the flow of energy, but my brother can't.
Haha, he's anything but ordinary. He may not know these things, but he's incredibly talented in Martial Arts.
His skills are among the best in our village.
My brother's usually at the training grounds ahead. Why not challenge him to a spar? He loves testing his skills against others.
Where have you been playing with Grandpa lately?
Grandpa taught me lots of crafts in the workshop!
Oh? I've been busy in the workshop for a few days. How come I haven't seen either of you?
I don't know. You should ask my grandpa.
You think you can bully me because my hearing's bad?
Those don't really count as weapons.
No worries. There must be other secrets waiting for us to uncover in this village!
Excuse me, is there any rare weapon in the village that can't be found outside?
Of course! Our village's special cultivators and spades. You won't find them anywhere else.
Oh well, I thought this mysterious village would have something useful.
Wow, that blade's edge is perfectly straight.
Where are these Skirt Shakers going?
It's being transported to the camp in the west.
That's the camp of Jixia students, right?
Muddy said the Skirtleaf Flowers they ordered kept coming in one batch after another.
Guess our village crops are in demand!
Hidden Trellis is such a soothing place.
The unique sweetness of this mountain spring water is really refreshing.
Scholarly Tiger is always this quiet and well-behaved, such a rare trait.
Exactly. Outsiders shouldn't be allowed in anymore.
I should raise a complaint! This is way too noisy!
Exactly. Maybe seeing too many new faces makes me feel uneasy.
The village is getting livelier, but so is the trash.
Hup, hup, hup... Feeling fiery today! Time to challenge Lu Buqi at the training grounds!
Training's going well! Maybe next time we can go further out for supplies.
I'm Hu Pen, a staff member of Hidden Trellis.
So I come here to train whenever the shop's not busy.
I'm not slacking off. I'm preparing for the next restock.
Of course! I've been training every day since I started working at this store.
The dangers outside are unpredictable. Only through rigorous training can we ensure safety.
Boss Cao usually takes me along when he's out procuring goods. My strong muscles never let him down.
I didn't expect you to find me so soon.
Next time, pick a better spot. I'll teach you. Next time, you should hide at...
Oh, I'm Cao Shengjin, the owner of this place.
I have some friends who are wandering merchants. They occasionally come to the village to deliver goods to me.
We often go to nearby camps and trade our local products for tea and snacks the villagers like.
I often go beyond the village to get supplies and have seen the prosperity outside. I do hope Hermitage can become lively too.
What else would you like to talk about?
I carefully prepare all the food here, and we also have some village specialties. If you're interested, take a look!
How did you get your hands on them?
The villagers may seem a bit reserved, but deep down, they're simple and kind.
It's good for young people to leave the village and see the world.
Hermitage's timeless treat, loved by kids and adults alike!
I played well today, not a single wrong note.
Are you from the Gongyu family?
Are you from the Gongyu family?
Music Society... what's that? I'm just an ordinary person.
But when it comes to playing, I'm still better than anyone else in the village.
The elegant surroundings and peaceful audience make this my favorite place to perform!
Found you! Now I'm going to find Moth Peach!
These farm tools are so handy. They'll definitely make harvesting easier.
But these tools don't look like they were crafted at Liye's Workshop.
Chiki, stop being naughty. Learn how to till the soil!
We'd better stick up the notice...
Those foreign students, always talking about exploration and archaeology. But they don't even watch where they step on the fields, trampling the crops.
As one of the "Three Elders," posting notices is a way to set an example. It also helps the village chief with less trouble. As for Si... well...
I've farmed all my life, but now I'm too old. I worry about the crops, so I teach the young ones here.
The villagers started calling me one of the village elders, so I figured I'd live up to the title and do my part.
The Village Chief leads the Three Elders. Villagers turn to him for all matters, big or small.
If they hadn't elected the "Three Elders" to share the burden, he wouldn't have made it this far.
Honestly, I don't like him, but his skills are undeniable.
I believe he has made a mistake this time. He was not like this before...
I remember that time, all financial matters were handled by him, every transaction was accounted for.
Without him, our village wouldn't have prospered as it has.
That's really unfortunate... Sigh, I hope he learns his lesson after this.
Hey, try to walk on the paths so you don't damage the crops!
I heard the sales channel for this year's crops has been secured.
You know, I actually learned everything about plant cultivation from him.
Kids these days, always walking with their eyes glued to the ground.
Those farmlands are the life's work of the farmers...
When I grow up, can I climb that high too?
Eat well, exercise, and you'll be fine!
Oh yeah? I'll climb higher and faster than you!
Oh? You've got spirit! You'll have to work hard, you know I used to be...
When I grow up, can I climb that high too?
Oh yeah? I'll climb higher and faster than you!
Oh? You've got spirit! You'll have to work hard, you know I used to be...
Haha, as long as you eat well and exercise regularly, you'll be fine!
There's a huge rock right above the teahouse, just over there.
I'm telling my grandson about the places I used to play when I was little.
There's a huge rock above the teahouse in the village. When I was little, I'd often sit in the cave there from afternoon till dusk, humming a tune to the evening breeze.
The scenery there is really beautiful. Young man, if you're interested, you can go take a look.
Really? I'll go feel it myself.
It's too high for him. Let's wait until he grows up.
How nostalgic. It's been so long since I last went up there. Even if I wanted to, these old bones aren't what they used to be.
I wonder what the view is like up there now. Will you tell me about it after you've seen it?
It's good to be busy, but don't forget to take care of yourself.
About the view from the heights.
Sure! Right above Hidden Trellis, see it?
Where's that cave? Can we see it from here?
How's the view? Does the high-altitude air make your heart feel better?
The view up there is really nice.
Haha, of course! Growing up, besides my own house, that was the place I spent most of my time at.
Of course not! I was quite nimble back then! I could climb up there in a few strides. My old body can't handle that now.
It's not as impressive as I imagined.
Haha, really? Perhaps I miss not just the sights, but my youthful vigor.
Of course not! I was quite nimble back then! I could climb up there in a few strides. My old body can't handle that now.
It's so high. Is it hard to climb?
It's so high. Is it hard to climb?
Old memories are everywhere. Where they can't be found, only a youthful heart may see.
Keeping a young heart is easier said than done...
Say I want to go up again, can I?
The cave is on the <001>giant rock above Hidden Trellis</>. Climb up and you'll find it.
What should I make to eat in a bit?

Hehe, last night's dream was lovely. I'm sure it'll come true!
I dreamed of a pond in front of my home, its water flowing directly into the fields.
In the fields, Skirtleaf Flowers, when watered, grow taller than children.
I asked the village chief this morning, and he said fish and water both symbolize wealth. Adding that the tall Skirtleaf signals a great harvest this year!

I asked the village chief early this morning, and he said that both fish and water represent wealth. Plus, the skirt-flowers are growing tall, which means we're sure to have a bumper harvest this year!

If they hadn't elected the "Three Elders" to share the burden, he wouldn't have made it this far.
