Without him, our village wouldn't have prospered as it has.
I never cared for Brother Si's temper, but I can't deny he's worked hard for the village all these years.
Farming demands patience. Every move must be done with a calm mind.
These crops are the result of a season's hard work. Please keep a close eye on them.
Huh? Where did these herbs go? Oh no...
Careful now, this isn't the place for sparring.
I let you win last time, but this time, I'll make sure to enjoy it more!
Too bad. Next time you come find me, I'll definitely take you on.
My unmatched martial arts skills lie dormant, awaiting a worthy challenge. Care to spar?
And I don't buy that you beat me so easily last time. Let's do it again!
Sounds perfect! My unmatched martial skills will finally shine.
Don't get cocky, though. Beating me once doesn't mean you'll win next time.
Don't be down. Even my kids know failure is the mother of success.
It's been a long time since I felt so exhilarated. So, do you want to spar again?
Alright, let's have an even more exciting fight this time!
Well, take a break for now. I'll be waiting for you at the training ground next time!
The cliffs are steep, and the ground is slippery. It's dangerous. You shouldn't be here.
Stop snooping around and go somewhere else if you have nothing better to do.
What are you doing here? No civilians allowed. Go away!
The cliffs are steep, and the ground is slippery. It's dangerous here. You shouldn't have come.
Hermitage? Where did you hear about it?
There's no Hermitage. Just go, hurry!
Guarding this place is boring. Should we sneak back early tonight?
How many times have we snuck out this month? If the village chief finds out...
Don't worry, who'd come here at this hour?
Why is this guy still hanging around?
Tsk, who knows what he's scheming. Let's wait until he <001>gets a bit further away</>.
Why is that person staring over here...?
We have to stay vigilant all night.
What are you doing here? No civilians allowed. Go away!
What's it to you? Mind your own business!
Get moving, don't just stand around!
You're still here? Don't make me kick you out again!
Nothing much happening lately, how about we find some time to...
When will you catch a fish, brother?
Be patient. Angling is like life—you never know what's coming next.
I feel like I've been waiting here for a hundred years.
You know? Some wait a lifetime for a big catch.
In the end, they realized what they truly needed wasn't the fish, but the act of waiting itself.
Hey, stop messing around in the water, okay? You scared away my fish.
You're here at the perfect time. The scenery here is also just right. I was just contemplating a poem.
I've got the first half: "Reunion under the moonlight."
Can you help me with the second half of the couplet?
Two people barbecue in the garden.
It's terrible. Even a three-year-old would disapprove.
The night is deep, and dreams are far away.
Nice, nice. Just this line will do!
It expresses the longing for lost ones, in dreams and reality...
It rhymes well, but... it's missing something.
Goodbye, come find me if you have any ideas.
I sense something unusual in this water.
I'm vaguely sensing a peculiar aura emanating from this pool.
Hmm, where does this peculiar scent come from?
It's a long story... Hold on, where are you from? I don't think I've seen you before.
You're just a foreigner, you don't need to ask so many questions. Hmph.
Oh? Why do you say so?
Oh? Why do you say so?
Steal for joy? You're just slacking off.
Valley breeze plays with carefree carp, in a tranquil pond, I find my peace.
I just wanted to see what those students from outside are doing on behalf of Mr. Ya.
Then keep watching. Stop pretending and whining about poetry!
I need to work on the second line. Let me think...
The moon's embrace, a lonely quest for long-lost memories. In the still of night, dreams drift far away.
Just two lines, yet it captures the essence of longing. Well done!
Who's searching through the endless night...
Have you heard? I can't believe Trustee Si would do such things behind our backs.
The Village Chief spends most of her time at the Ancestral Hall. You can find Senior Mo at the farmland.
Indeed. I thought he had been managing the village's finances for years, so he shouldn't be so greedy for money...
I wonder if the Three Elders will change...
You're not from here, are you? It's normal not to know about the Three Elders. Only us locals are aware of them.
They are the Village Chief, Elder Mo, and Elder Si of Hermitage.
The Village Chief oversees everything, and everyone likes to consult him. Master Mo mainly plans farming activities.
Lastly, there's Si Guan. He was the village's finance manager. Outsiders looking to do business in the village had to get past him.
With them bustling around the village, our village is what it is today. It's just Pennivise... ah, so misguided.
As for Si, he's always on the move, especially after the incident... Just go with the flow.
Speaking of which, have you noticed that the head of Department of Discipline is often away from the village? I wonder what he's been up to.
Anyway, we don't need to worry about where he is. Just focus on our own tasks.
Oh? Outsider, it's normal not to know. I'm talking about the Village Chief and Elders Si and Mo.
The village chief oversees village affairs, the treasurer manages finances, and the agricultural overseer plans farming. They are crucial to our prosperity.
The Village Chief spends most of her time at the Ancestral Hall. You can find Senior Mo at the farmland.
As for Si, he's always on the move. I haven't seen him in ages.
You recorded poems with Sorcery runes?
It seems you're quite fond of poetry.
Yes, I do! I hope I can be like the village chief one day, teaching poetry to everyone.
Goodbye, come find me if you have any good verses to share.
Are there many villagers skilled in Sorcery Techniques?
Not that much... like one in ten?
Where did you learn that Sorcery Technique?
I think I learned it when I was very young. They said it had something to do with bloodline, what was it again?
Oops! The chief usually tells us not to talk about this with outsiders. What I just said, you can't tell anyone, okay?
Wow, you're really good! You figured it out so quickly!
This is a great couplet. I'll write it down right away!
You're amazing! Your answer is perfect. I'll write it down right away!
In these leisurely days, every moment is worth savoring.
Bumping isn't a friendly gesture, ease up.
If I could turn into a butterfly, I'd flutter up to the treetop.
Hey, you bumped into me! Be careful.
These words carry the freshness of waterside, immersive.
Books recommended by the village chief always hold unique wisdom. They're definitely worth reading.
Last year, this kid could only cry and fuss all day. Who would've thought that in the blink of an eye, he'd be learning martial arts from the Old Monster.
When he's older, I'll teach him everything I know. He'll take over the family business and become a great hunter!
I don't want that life for my son! When he's old enough, I'm sending him to Jixia Academy.
Jixia Academy isn't necessarily better than our village. Why else would those students keep running to our village every other day?
The village is getting livelier, but so is the trash.
It worked! Guess they do like me after all!
Thank you for your suggestion. Now I can travel with peace of mind!

We just need to be mindful of the rules. I want to explore inside.
Alright, maybe we'll find something inside.

No interfering with normal labor, no peddling external goods, no staying overnight in the village...

Not many outsiders here, mostly students from your academy. Among them, most are Seekers exploring East Aerfall.
But they never lasted more than a few days before my grandfather, the village chief, convinced them to leave.
Why would the village chief do that?
I think it's related to a member of the Seeker Society, but I'm not sure about the details.
Grandpa said many students and teachers used to visit our village.
Then that man met with an accident, and Grandpa changed. I don't know the details.
After that, fewer students came. Grandpa, though, would leave the village from time to time.
Grandpa said many students and teachers used to visit our village.

I'm losing my authority as the elder sister.
Playing with kids is no easy task...
We're playing hide-and-seek. I've been looking everywhere, but no sign of them.
Hello, have you seen two kids hiding around here?
Those two haven't left the village. They must be hiding somewhere here.
They usually don't hide in the same spot. Taotao likes <001>high places</>, and Ah Ji prefers <001>corners</>.
I bet Li Yue is far away. How long will it take her to find me this time? Hehe.

Thanks to you, we found them quickly.
It's nothing. I love playing with them too.
It's nothing. I love playing with them too.

The aroma of this tea is so good that it seems to dispel fatigue.

You look exhausted. Why are you fighting sleep here?

Their howling keeps me awake at night.

The East Aerfall Highlands are quite dangerous. Better stock up on medicine.
Is there anything else you'd like to know?
I rarely venture outside the camp, but I've heard that this place is dotted with ruins.
There are loads of treasures, as well as all kinds of unexpected dangers.
Every day, I dress the wounds of those great adventurers and hear stories of Mechanoids and Bronze monsters until my ears are tired of them.
If you plan to explore the mysteries of East Aerfall, make sure to prepare plenty of medicines for emergencies.
I came to the camp at the suggestion of a Herb Society senior to help treat the injured and improve my herbal medicine skills.
As you know, a dangerous place like East Aerfall Highlands never lacks for casualties.
The excuses for leave are getting more and more ridiculous.
My heart is shattered. I need help from the Herb Society.
It's terminal. I suggest giving up treatment.
Wait! I think I can still salvage it.
I'm injured. Need some meds and a sick leave note.
Why do you keep getting hurt?
I had no choice. Hunting can be dangerous.
Then why are you clutching your stomach?
Please, go easy on yourself. Or even a minor injury could turn serious.
What happened to your injury? Did the beasts around here do it?
No, but your strength definitely rivals that of a beast, haha.
Serves you right for being careless!
Aerfall Highlands is full of dangers. Want to buy some herbs just in case?
Luckily, the camp has plenty of herbs. Once it's a bit better, we can release it back into the wild.
Are you from the Hunting Society?
I belong to the Breeder Society of the Hunting Society. We mainly study animal care and treatment, hoping to become friends with them.
The forest near the camp is dangerous, and animals often get injured.
Brutalhorn Bull, you better get well soon!
What's wrong with these Brutalhorn Bulls?
When people on adventures or just passing by find them, they bring them to me at the camp to heal.
It was startled by a wild beast and suddenly ran into the camp.
When I restrained it, I noticed its leg was injured.
The key to organizing archives is patience.
I'll take them all when I receive my stipend from the Seekers' Association this month!
It's hard to believe you passed all the trials of The Eight Sentinels!
And in such a short time too. Looks like Captain Suchen made the right choice.
That's great! Malva would be happy to know this.
Now you've investigated The Eight Sentinels, maybe it's time to explore The Mausoleum.
Captain Suchen has already gone ahead. You can <001>find him in front of the Mausoleum Gate</>.
Malva is one of the top Seekers after Kongming. She founded the Sentinel Exploration Team.
She possesses insight and drive far beyond ordinary people. Captain Suchen was actually her disciple...
But after an accident, she retired... She was never seen in camp again.
After the accident, Suchen continued to organize the Sentinel Exploration Team.
He's probably upset about the senior's retirement, so he's throwing everything into this research.
Goodbye, and thank you for your help!
I heard Captain Suchen of the Sentinel Exploration Team entrusted you to secretly investigate the Eight Sentinels.
Just be careful during your investigation. Don't get yourself in trouble.
They all mark the locations of The Eight Sentinels.
The golden mark indicates you've completed the Sentinel Trial.
Blue means the trial is not complete.
What is the Sentinel Exploration Team?
The Sentinel Exploration Team, composed of elites from the Seeker Society, ventures into the most dangerous ruins of Aerfall Highlands.
They can reach places other teams can't, like The Eight Sentinels!
The Sentinel Exploration Team was originally formed by Malva, and is now led by Captain Suchen. It's a bit of a shame...
Yes... she is one of the most outstanding Seekers after Kongming, and she is the one who established the Sentinel Exploration Team.
She possesses insight and drive far beyond ordinary people. Captain Suchen was actually her disciple...
But after an accident, she retired... She was never seen in camp again.
After the accident, Suchen continued to organize the Sentinel Exploration Team.
He's probably upset about the senior's retirement, so he's throwing everything into this research.
Good luck with your investigation. I'll be rooting for you back at camp!
This map shows the completion progress of the Sentinel Trials in real-time.
Look at the blue signals. When the trials are finished, they are highlighted in <001>gold</>.
Good logistics will make the expedition team's work run more smoothly.
Another batch of antiquities has been unearthed.
When will I ever finish cataloging these artifacts?
It's rare to have some leisure time. Seeing this vast world from a different perspective is really fascinating.
Let's enjoy the scenery here a while longer.
Hmm, didn't expect to be watched while I'm here enjoying the view.
Haha, I'm actually a member of the Seeker Society, just interested in poetry.
Huh? I never called you a poet.
Huh? I never called you a poet.
Hehe, I can tell from your admiring gaze. Want my autograph?
How did you get up here?
As a member of the Seeker Society, I'm quite skilled at surviving in the wild.
This height seems hard to climb, but with the right tools, it's easy. Like that ladder...
I didn't see any ladder when I came up.
I didn't see any ladder when I came up.
What? It's gone? Who took it?
Ahem... It's nothing, just a little accident. As an outstanding Seeker, I'll figure it out, don't worry.
It's not often that I get a chance to relax and enjoy the view.
The world looks so different from this angle.
Let's enjoy the scenery here a while longer.
It's pitch black at night here...
I can't see anything once night falls...

text: Don't mess with the archives, don't browse randomly, and don't ask too many questions, except for questions about relics.
If you want to know more, you can find Mr. Ge, who is teaching students near the ruins.
I still have a lot of work to do. Sorry for not being a good host.
I'm organizing the newly excavated artifacts. Any further research requires a formal application for access.
If you really want to read them, I can help you apply.
Can I learn a bit more about the Seeker Society first?
Can I learn a bit more about the Seeker Society first?
Understanding history, preserving culture, and solving puzzles. That's what the Seeker Society is all about.
He's my elder brother. We both belong to the Seeker Society, but we're engaged in different research.
Exploring ruins is fun. Aren't you going with him?
Exploring ruins is fun. Aren't you going with him?
I use my talents to clear the way for him. It's a fair division of labor.
Searching for and protecting ancient artifacts are equally important in our field.
What now? I gotta find the other half.
It's a bronze Mechanoid unearthed nearby a few days ago. It's a valuable research material.
Unfortunately, it broke into two pieces due to the wear and tear over time.
I was hoping to bring them back for repair, but some went missing during transport.
Someone must have taken it. I have to get it back.
What now? I gotta find the other half.
You actually found the other half of the missing Mechanoid.
Are we in Rebel territory? How dare they!
I must warn my instructor and everyone at camp about these troublemakers!

Considering the climate, terrain, and routes, this plan still needs work...
If you need anything for your adventures, just let me know.
If you're venturing alone, I suggest exploring the smaller ruins nearby. There are plenty, and most remain unexplored.
I'm Faye, a member of the Seeker Society, and deputy captain of the Aerfall Highlands exploration team.
I will oversee planning, coordination, communication, support, and more to avoid unnecessary risks.
There are two major ruins in Aerfall Highlands: The Mausoleum and Bastion Fort. Most archaeological expeditions revolve around these two sites.
The unexplored Mausoleum's Peak is our next priority.
As for the mysterious Mausoleum's Peak, we still don't know how to get up there.
Recently, the archaeological team discovered two more Sentinels deep in East Aerfall.
These two pillars are tougher than the previous ones, with different challenges.
We received an anonymous tip that the series of trials of The Eight Sentinels seem to be related to the Mausoleum's Peak.
If we find clues to the Pillars of Shattered Hope, we can help Captain Suchen fulfill his wish sooner.
Captain Faye mentioned there's been progress in the research.
I'd love to go on adventures with him!
The next objective ruin is at the highest peak of Aerfall Highlands.
Considering the terrain and weather forecast, we may need more protective and warming supplies.
Map, route, and data are all set. I'll report to Captain Faye tonight.
If not for the vandalism, deciphering the secrets of The Eight Sentinels wouldn't be so challenging.
Could it be the Rebels? They're also investigating the secrets of The Eight Sentinels.
The Rebels never do anything good, but I can't figure out why they'd destroy the inscriptions.
I don't think it's the Rebels. They clash with us often, but they'd rather enlist our help to uncover secrets.
Captain Faye, any new discoveries from the exploration team?
A team reported finding a stele near the Sentinel Pillar, but the inscription is badly damaged and illegible.
Finally... all the artifacts I collected are here.
Who should I ask for help from the Seeker Society?
The stall looks nice, but I have too much to carry.
With so many artifacts, there's no room for error. I need to plan carefully.
Everything in the chest was collected with great care...
I can't tell if it's fake or not without opening it. If it's fake, my trip here would be wasted.
But to verify its authenticity, we have to open the box... What should we do?
You're right, avoiding it won't solve the problem. At least opening the box gives us a fifty-fifty chance of it being the real deal.
But there's also a 50% chance even if you don't open the chest.
But there's also a 50% chance even if you don't open the chest.
It's different. It's the same fifty-fifty chance, but not opening the box just gives you anxiety, while opening it is a collapse!
True, what's in the box could be real or fake.
Opening it ruins the aesthetic of chaos.
But how am I supposed to register without it...?
To open or not to open, that is the question.
It'd be awesome if you could bring back all the other parts!
I'm re-examining Mechcraft parts the adventure team brought back from Bastion Fort.
Did you take this from Bastion Fort?
Did you take this from Bastion Fort?
Impressive, right? Aerdeep Camp is the base for Seekers and explorers.
Especially the relics unearthed from the East Aerfall Highlands, they're precious materials for studying mysterious history!
For Seekers, opportunities come and go! Wish I could check it out myself one day!
The documents about the ruins should be here.
Hello. First time at Aerdeep Camp?
I'm the camp receptionist. Feel free to ask me anything!
The area's not safe, stay close.
Any questions? I'll tell you everything!
This is Aerdeep Camp, the base of the Seeker Society and the Hunting Society.
Bastion Fort on the west side of the highlands is one of the popular study spots for the Seeker Society.
The Mausoleum in the central highlands is full of mysteries, but it's also full of dangers. It's recommended for senior students to team up before heading there.
Most importantly, stay away from The Eight Sentinels. Every student coming here needs to remember that.
I heard Senior Kongming visited this place.
Aerdeep Camp was founded by Senior Zhuge Liang. Walk further in, and you can still see his old tent!
I heard he came back, but I don't know when exactly.
Is it always this crowded here?
Exactly! Aerdeep Camp is the academy's only large camp in Aerfall Highlands.
Attracts many Seekers who come for archaeology, exploration, and study. The nearby ruins are numerous, and dangerous monsters also lurk about.
That's why some members of the Hunting Society, who study animals and train in hunting, also come here to explore.
They're super passionate, always volunteering for guard duty to keep everyone in the camp safe.
That's admirable. Lots of Society students have visited the camp lately. It's getting livelier!
I'm always at the camp. Come find me if you have more questions!

I'm the camp receptionist. Feel free to ask me anything!

Remember to prioritize your safety while studying and researching.

You have to believe it now.
Thank you! I'll learn from this, sniff...
Collecting antiques comes with risks. Be cautious!
Stay vigilant, everyone! Don't fall for scams!
Treasure Appraisal Stall sponsored by Shye!
Don't miss out, or you'll regret it!
But... but I can't bring myself to do it!

Don't miss out, or you'll regret it!
Honestly, I doubt it's the real deal.
Look at that gem of his, it's missing the gentle glow.
Um... it looks pretty nice to me.
Wow! It actually shattered! Was I really conned?
Oh no! My money! Damn you, crook!
Well... this friend of mine spent a fortune on a bronze piece from ancient times, and I was just here to do an appraisal.
I used Sorcery Technique to examine it, only to find this is no ancient bronze artifact—this thing is clearly from last week! And the material isn't even bronze.
He refused to accept it and asked me to double-check, then...
Now you believe me, right? My Sorcery identification method is definitely accurate.
I have to try. I spent a fortune on it. Can't believe it's fake.
Right, you gave it a good smash. I actually asked him about it earlier. A smash would tell.
A real bronze piece wouldn't break so easily. But he's been hesitating here for a long time, unable to bring himself to do it.
Help me out, will ya? Smash that bronze thing on the table!
This student spent a fortune on an ancient bronze piece and asked me to authenticate it.
I can only tell him it's real or fake with a strike. Genuine bronze will never break with just one hit.
I've been eager to smash some stuff!
I really can't bring myself to do it. Please!
I used a Sorcery Technique to examine it and found out it's not ancient at all! It's practically brand new! And it's not even bronze.
He didn't believe it and asked me to double-check...
I spent a fortune on them, so I can't bear to throw them away. You do it, okay?
It's okay, smash away, I can take it!
Let's see what this student has discovered. I'll analyze it for you.
The ruins are covered with moss.
The ruins fragment is partially buried in mud.
Interesting. The truth is close to what I suspected.
Oh, the ruins went through that too...
Good, I've nearly figured out the truth behind the ruins.
The people who built these ruins were truly wise.
To conceal the ruins, they buried most of it and covered it with moss, effectively protecting it.
It's because of the mysterious energy protected by this ruin!
But the energy of the Ruins Tree was too powerful, and it was burned to ashes in one of its outbursts.
Uh... that sounds a bit far-fetched.
That does sound a bit far-fetched.
What do you know? Inspiration and intuition are crucial in Seeker research.
How can you conduct research well if you only know how to follow the rules?
Senior, you're not even from the Seeker Society, why are you acting so high and mighty?
Maybe I should hire a professional guide...
And thank you for helping us find clues so quickly. You're like a professional Seeker!
Welcome to Aerdeep Camp, the base of the Seeker Society since my student days.
The ruins in the middle of the camp, like many ancient ruins in Aerfall Highlands, shine with the light of history.
Such a unique and mysterious place that even attracted Senior Kongming to explore in person...
Senior, you're not from the Seeker Society. How do you know so much about this ruin?
What's so hard about that? Every Seeker who comes to camp starts with these ruins as their beginner study. Only after completing it can they venture out for fieldwork.
I've spent years in Jixia and learned a bit about its history. Don't believe me? Then help me collect clues of the ruins.
I can show you a bit of my archeological skills and tell you the story of this ruin. What do you think?
Where are the clues of the ruins?
Let's see... By the bridge at the camp's back gate, by the stairs under the main ruins, and near the Seeker Society's tent.
No problem, leave it to me.
No problem, leave it to me.
Sorry, I have other things to do.
Kids these days are just so uncooperative.
Kids these days have no manners!
Ruins are best appreciated quietly, alone.
Jixia has so many places to explore. I can't wait!
No need to worry about finding companions on the road ahead. Aerdeep Camp welcomes you!
Camp safety is my top priority!
Weren't you injured? Why are you back at the camp so soon?
Yeah, I'm worried about the camp's safety. I'll be back on guard duty as soon as I recover!
I took a couple of days off to recover and wandered around Frostcloud Town. Got a bit carried away with spending.
If I don't get back to work, I won't be able to afford food!
Aha! Knew it! Your injury healed long ago!
Once you're healed, let me know, okay?
Honestly, getting something for nothing isn't right.
Hard work leads to wealth. You know what I mean?
And don't take advantage of others' kindness.
Taking advantage of others' kindness is wrong.
We need to have a serious talk...
This Brutalhorn Bull has been lying here for almost a month since I healed it, not moving an inch.
I was even worried it might have other injuries. I took good care of it every day.
Can cows in Aerfall Highlands understand human speech?
It may not understand, but I still have to say it.
Of course not, but Master Zhuangzi once said, "It's like playing music to a cow, without expecting it to understand."
Hey, that's so annoying! Look, it's turning its head away, ignoring me.
Strange, this injury should have healed by now.
What's wrong with these Brutalhorn Bulls?
It was startled by a wild beast and suddenly ran into the camp.
When I restrained it, I noticed its leg was injured.
Luckily, the camp had plenty of herbs. I treated its wounds.
Its wounds have healed, but it still can't stand. Odd.
Are you from the Hunting Society?
I belong to the Breeder Society of the Hunting Society. We mainly study animal care and treatment, hoping to become friends with them.
The forest near the camp is dangerous, and animals often get injured.
When people on adventures or just passing by find them, they bring them to me at the camp to heal.
Do you have any better ideas?
Brutalhorn Bulls prefer quiet. Perhaps all it takes is a disturbance to see how it reacts, and we can verify whether its injury has fully healed.
If only someone could wave a weapon here to distract it.
Hey! You turned your back on me again!
Come back here! Listen to me!
He didn't even let me know when he recovered. It breaks my heart.
Thank you so much, its wound has indeed healed!

I was even worried it might have other injuries. I took good care of it every day.
I need to have a talk with it. It's not right to get things without effort.
You seem curious about the work of the Hunting Society. Is there anything else you'd like to chat about?
What's wrong with these Brutalhorn Bulls?
It was startled after being attacked by a wild beast and suddenly ran into the camp.
I left it here after finding out its leg was injured.
Luckily, the camp has plenty of herbs. Healing a Brutalhorn Bull won't be a problem. It's just...
His wounds healed long ago, but he's just lying here, unmoving, for nearly a month.
The Brutalhorn Bull prefers quiet. Thanks to you disturbing it just now, I realized its injury has fully healed.

When people on adventures or just passing by find them, they bring them to me at the camp to heal.
You can still communicate with it?
No way. Master Zhuangzi once said, "It's like playing music to a cow, don't expect them to understand."
It may not understand, but I still have to say it.
Go on then. I need to have a word with this Brutalhorn Bull!
A true angler fears not the cold, only the escape of the fish.
Sitting idly, watching the float, day after day, returning empty-handed.
I've already come up with a few poems. Why haven't any fish taken the bait yet?
Sure thing! The Angling King of Aerdeep Camp never gets his lines crossed.
Dominating every body of water, he's known as Hai Yi.
I've got everything you need for angling. Looking for something?
Why, I'm the Angling King of Aerdeep Camp, of course I rule all waters!
Look at this Spotted Brown Arowana! I caught this beauty! So, what do you think of my skills now?
Though... maybe too full of itself, hasn't been caught in a while.
It's definitely not that I'm weak, absolutely not.
Well, goodbye then. I think a fish is about to take the bait!
Should I go with braising or steaming? Maybe grilling is a better option...
Saepes sap stewed with Red Falcon wings and Wolvine claw powder. Want a taste?
Though I can't promise you'll still be breathing afterward. Haha, just kidding, worst case, you'll get a stomachache.
In the pursuit of the highest flavor, one must be willing to experiment and face sacrifices.
Why did you come to the camp?
I've heard about the exotic ingredients in East Aerfall Highlands. As a Gourmet, I must explore them.
I was just here to gather special ingredients for new dishes.
But I met a group of people who couldn't cook to save their lives. Without me, they'd be stuck eating dry rations.
How could I leave after you put it like that?
Haha, don't worry. I won't do that kind of experiment at night.
When it's mealtime, I'll still whip up proper delicious dishes for everyone.
After all, not everyone can appreciate "special cuisines."
But seriously, are you really not going to try it?
Off you go then. Don't forget to come for a proper meal!
If Chef Lu notices, you'll be his cooking test subject.
But Chef Lu's dishes are heavenly. I must get the first bite.
Let's eat as much as we can. We won't find such good food in Aerfall Highlands.
Nope! Looks like it's going to be a while before we can eat well again.
This radish and fish soup is so delicious! I could drink ten bowls of it!
A true angler fears not the cold, only the escape of the fish.
Sitting idly, watching the float, day after day, returning empty-handed.
I can barely write a line of poetry, yet I'm struggling to catch a fish.
Are the ingredients at the camp running out fast?
Are the ingredients at the camp running out fast?
Yes, the camp is far away, so it takes time to deliver supplies.
The Hunting Society brings back game, but without proper preservation, it spoils quickly.
I was about to throw away some spoiled meat but found the numbers didn't add up.
Hope no one's cooking with spoiled meat.
Let's take stock of the remaining ingredients.
The game meat brought back by the Hunting Society is so delicious when grilled.
Why did you choose this place?
Hi there, looking to buy some ingredients?
We have all the perfect ingredients for a barbecue. Once they're grilled over charcoal, you won't be able to stop at just one bite!
Apart from that, it's probably just to give the students in the camp some good food to relieve the daily pressure of their adventures.
It's pathetic if they can't even have a hot barbecue after a whole day of exploring.
If I can make a bundle of Ringild, and people's lives are better for it, then it won't have been a wasted journey.
As you can see, I'm a member of the Gourmet Society, and I aim to become the best in the East Aerfall Highlands.
When I joined the Gourmet Society, I focused on barbecue. When it comes to ingredients, wild ones are the best!
Goodbye, and thank you! Come back anytime!
It looks like the wear is not too bad...
Well, I guess I'll have to get a new one.
Camp safety is at stake, no room for error!
If I catch anyone littering again, I'll toss them in the trash with the garbage.
Why does it taste so funny?
You hunted that deer before us!
Although it's a bit of a shame we didn't do it ourselves, I have to admire your strength.
To celebrate, I'll make my signature dish for you. Please sit in the chair and wait.
Here's the food I made. Please take it.
What are you two talking about?
What are you two talking about?
We're discussing our target. A female Aersilk Deer.
That deer is the most unique in these parts. Many have tried to hunt it, but none have succeeded.
It has <001>dark blue</> fur, and it's much larger than other deer.
According to the books, its meat is exceptionally delicious.
Based on our observation, this deer often comes to drink at the <001>pond near the camp</>.
What are you two talking about?
What are you two talking about?
Where should I hunt next time?
Ah, my stomach hurts. I shouldn't have eaten so much.
The art of casting bronze... if only I could master it.
Same old, crafting gear for the disciples at the camp.
But in my free time, I'll study the bronze items brought out from the ruins.
If I could master the art of crafting bronze weapons that are strong and durable...
Everyone will line up at my forge.
About the techniques of casting bronze.
Heat's just right... one more strike!
Hard to believe the quality of this unearthed artifact.
The Seeker Society is really impressive.
This report doesn't cover the composition of the artifact. It's not the one I wanted.
Can we try again to get the right report?
I'm studying newly unearthed artifacts from the ruins, hoping to use special equipment to analyze their composition.
But I have no idea which button is for component identification.
To be honest, operating Mechcrafts has always been a challenge for me. That's why I've been avoiding Mechcraft courses at the academy.
I never thought that coming to the Aerfall Highlands to join the Seeker Society would still keep me tied to Mechcraft...
How exactly do you use this thing...?
I'm really not used to this device...
Analysis shows the aging traces on the material are common...
Yes, this is the composition appraisal report of the artifact!
Who would've thought these Mechcraft tools would be so helpful in archaeology? This report is even better than what I could've written myself.
I need to master this Mechcraft soon. I can't keep troubling others, but I really appreciate your help this time!

We make a pretty good team.

I owe you a big meal. Next time, dinner's on me.

I owe you a big meal. Next time, dinner's on me.
See ya! And thanks again for the backup!

You've got a knack for this... and a soft heart to match.

Shye and player talk about the outcome.
That proves how skilled the maker was.
This type of coarse clay is full of sand and grit. Polishing it to this level of perfection takes incredible effort.
Whoever made this must be incredibly skilled.

The creator must have been quite meticulous.

Even a single speck left behind would have ruined the final piece.
The creator must have been determined.

I can only imagine the effort that went into this beautiful xun.

You're right. It could only be painted by someone with a gentle heart.
You're right. It could only be painted by someone with a gentle heart.
I always knew Mom was the gentlest person in the world!

Not a single scratch or stain. You must've taken really good care of it.

Judging by the hardness of the clay and the weathering, I'd say it's about seven years old.

Maybe... your mom made it for you, to welcome you into this world.
Thank you! You're the best appraisers in the world!
It looks so new and clean. I wonder when it was made.
It looks so new and clean. I wonder when it was made.

Alright, let's give this xun a proper look. Now, where should we start...
Can we tell anything from the clay?
Can we tell anything from the clay?

Perfect! Knew you wouldn't say no.

You were pretty sharp the last time we worked together. Since you're here, wanna be my assistant for a bit?

Shye's appraising treasures at the camp! C'mon, let's go!
I missed her last time. Not making that mistake again!
*Sniff* That little girl's story just breaks my heart.

My treasure might be a fake, but maybe it has a touching story, too!
I wonder how much this is worth...
This xun doesn't look ancient at all. Whoever bought this probably got scammed.
This xun doesn't look ancient at all. Whoever bought this probably got scammed.
Hey, it's not your fault. Just follow my lead, okay?
Oh no. Shye... I messed up. What do I do?
Oh no. Shye... I messed up. What do I do?
Player makes the girl cry and asks Shye for help.
After all this time, the patterns on the ruins remain so exquisite.

Digging for relics doesn't seem that hard.

Handle with care and stay focused.

Stay focused and watch the demonstration.
Her skills in restoring artifacts are exceptional. Watching her work is so inspiring!
Thank you. With your strong work ethic, I'm sure you'll improve quickly too.
I've seen these markings in books!
Hmm... the details seem different. Let me take a closer look.
I remember this place was mentioned in one of the books here...
The patterns on bronze artifacts carry such meanings? Complicated.
Where's the book...? Did I misremember?
Oh, you startled me. Could you keep your voice down?
I told you, I'm looking for info on The Eight Sentinels.
That's because of the ban set by the Seeker Society elders.
They claim The Eight Sentinels are too dangerous and have banned all related research.
I just feel there's something fishy about it... The more they stop me, the more I want to know.
But keep it between us, okay?
Let's see if there are any recruitment notices today...
What kind of requests are being updated on the bulletin board?
The Mausoleum, Sorcery Mechcrafts... all so dangerous.
Wait, there's an appraisal booth at the camp? I should check it out later.
Great! I've been wanting to see the knowledge of the Seekers for a long time.
Don't rush me. I'm trying to find the feel for a hundred percent accuracy.
The sun will set if this goes on.
It's been three hours. Why are you still holding the bow without shooting?
Date of discovery, location, personnel in charge, and archive number...
That way, it'll be easier for everyone to access and study them back at the academy.
Every detail of unearthed artifacts must be carefully verified before archiving. No error is allowed.
I must document the original appearance of these ruins.
The road sign's broken again. Were beasts nearby?
Twenty-five, twenty-six... Huh? Why are there only twenty-six?

If they find out we messed up the delivery, we'll be cleaning toilets...

Back in the exploration team, I always ended up with broken weapons, expired rations, and fake treasures the Rebels swapped with...
Don't worry, we'll figure something out.
Don't worry, we'll figure something out.
If you keep quiet, no one will find out.

I see. We'll have to find another way.
I see. We'll have to find another way.

Why does this kind of thing always happen to me?

Could it be... because we're near the ruins?

Hmph, those guys better not come back!

But the Rebels are even more troublesome.
Hey, focus! Help me pack up.
I feel dizzy... and my arms are weak.

I'll handle the rest! Go grab a seat before the Hunting Society does!

Not only is he handsome, he's also a Sorcery prodigy, an adventure expert, and even conquered the hearts of everyone at school with his song...
I also found the senior's notes in the tent, recording many celestial mysteries that ordinary people cannot understand.
I must keep it clean. Who knows, maybe one day he'll come back for it, and I can ask him to sign it.
Compared to Senior Kongming, are you interested in me?
I've heard stories about Senior Kongming since I was little. That's why I worked hard to become a Jixia student.

Her skills in restoring artifacts are exceptional. Watching her work is so inspiring!
Thank you. With your strong work ethic, I'm sure you'll improve quickly too.
No bugs allowed in Senior Kongming's tent!
I see you're quite skilled. Care to spar with me?
Haha! Not bad! Let's try again.
Nice move! With more practice, you'll get even better.
The training ground in the rain has a unique charm, with each move shimmering in the water.
The arena in the rain has a special charm, perfect for tempering one's character.
Rain pounding on the body like weapon blows, forging a stronger will.
The sky is clear and the air is fresh. A perfect time to spar.
The sky is clear. A perfect time to spar.
A perfect time to meditate by the waterfall near Meditation Hall.
Wait, I didn't say I wanted to see!
Wait, I didn't say I wanted to see!

Ten thousand punches? It'll take me forever.
Ten thousand punches? It'll take me forever.

How long is it going to take to do it ten thousand times?

On late nights, I always think of a dear friend.

I was a recruit at the Great Wall, then followed Maple to Jixia.
In the army, we treasured our bows like our own lives.
After just one day of training, they look as exhausted as wilted eggplants.
Back in my military days, I guarded the Great Wall for seven days straight, and never even frowned once.
Those kids are nothing like my generation.
Goodbye, I'll check on this bow.
I still recall the years I fought alongside her husband.
Students here don't face war and live more comfortably now.
To them, bows are just for practice. What a waste...
They'd been together since childhood, until death separated them.
I want to speak to her, but I fear the past will hurt her.
She keeps polishing his bow. *Sigh* Spare a moment to comfort her, will you?
The bellows broke again. Third time this month.
Constant use wears them out fast.
With so many bows to forge, the bellows never rest. Of course, they can't handle it.
I'd like to see what you can do with this move!
Quite aggressive, aren't you? Come, let's spar in the arena.
Looks like you're eager for a match. Let's have it.
Those who stand higher have a broader view. It seems you're approaching martial arts from a different perspective.
Don't stand on the table. Are you practicing your footwork?
Tables are for serving food. Keep your feet on the ground, please?
...I was injured before, and the Pavilion Master told me to move slowly.
zh_text: ……之前受了伤，馆主让我慢慢活动。
source_text: ……之前受了伤，馆主让我慢慢活动。
official_target_text: ...I was injured before, and the Pavilion Master told me to move slowly.
official_en_text: ...I was injured before, and the Pavilion Master told me to move slowly.

text: Each arrow carries Red Falcon Training Hall's legacy.
Aermore Valley offers breathtaking views. With no wild beasts around, it's quite safe.
Beneath the red maple trees, the disciples' archery skills sharpen with each passing day.
Come on, we can talk this out.
Looks like things won't get exciting today. Can't even throw a punch.
Hey, cut it. This is better for everyone.
I love the sound of rain, it's so poetic.
It washes the earth and cleanses our souls.
This rain is pouring down. I'd better hurry home and bring in my clothes.
Tofu salad beneath sunbeams. Pure bliss.
The weather's perfect for a walk. I'll go pack now.
Look at that blue sky and white clouds. It's perfect for drying clothes.
Thirty thousand times... I wonder if I can finish by dawn?
zh_text: 三万次啊……不知道天亮能不能做完？
source_text: 三万次啊……不知道天亮能不能做完？
official_target_text: Thirty thousand times... I wonder if I can finish by dawn?
official_en_text: Thirty thousand times... I wonder if I can finish by dawn?

text: Thirty thousand times is truly heartless...
official_target_text: Thirty thousand times is truly heartless...
official_en_text: Thirty thousand times is truly heartless...

text: Novar's Star Power is incredible. He even took down Aersim.
Every archery practice reminds me of Nora's valor.
With Aersim defeated, peace and beauty returned to Aermore Valley.
I'm afraid Novar's inner demon is beyond most people's imagination.
Divine Imprint... What is your secret?
Everyone's heard about Aersim, but few have actually faced it.
Cultivation is no easy path. Aersim is likely the ultimate test for martial artists.
I once challenged Novar. I hope you can unleash your full strength when fighting alongside him.
Novar's determined. He'll have a bright future.
Haha, I admire the fiery spirit of youth, always eager to prove themselves!
You've got an unyielding spirit! Game on!
Wow, that move was fancy. You need to try harder to defeat me.
Ha, even the rain won't stop us.
Practicing in the rain has cleared my mind.
Wind and rain are no challenge for dreamers like us!
Sunshine is perfect for practicing martial arts!
When you keep practicing, even the weather will be on your side. I'm in a great mood today!
The weather's perfect for training in the arena!
Score seven points, and the grand prize is yours. A bit of a challenge, though.
Deal. If anyone does that, you're my apprentice.
All the rewards have been claimed. Impressive...
Not just three in a row... We meet an expert. Right, my apprentice?
How do you play it then?
How do you play it then?
Easy! Activate the pedal, step on it, and then throw caskets into the goals.
Yes, actually, anything works. If you need some, there are plenty on the table.
Didn't we use plush balls before?
Not anymore. Animals chew them, which makes the maintenance cost too high.
It's been a long time since I returned to Jixia. I hardly recognize it.
Where is my old friend now...
Heard of Red Falcon Training Hall? My old friend used to be the Head Trainer.
But this time, I met a spirited girl.
I guess my old friend has retired by now.
Well, at least now we have time to catch up.
I just wish he had left me a note about where he was going...
Sorry, I can't chat right now.
Please stand back from the edge while waiting.
While you're on the Aership, stand back from the railing.
Attention. This Aership is heading to the academy.
No, I'm with my dad, but he fell asleep over there.
But I'm used to it. I can have fun by myself!
Master Fuzi, I'm listening! I swear!
Is this the butterfly from Master Zhuangzi's dream?
I found your checklist. You looked exhausted, so I finished your work.
I found your checklist. You looked exhausted, so I finished your work.
Remember to balance work and rest.
Remember to balance work and rest.
You must remember to balance work and rest.
zh_text: 一定要懂得劳逸结合呀。
source_text: 一定要懂得劳逸结合呀。
official_target_text: You must remember to balance work and rest.
official_en_text: You must remember to balance work and rest.

text: Finally made it. Everything feels so fresh here!
My teacher said go straight to Red Falcon Training Hall, but no way.
I'm off to Frostcloud Town for a meal! I hear Tata's dishes are delicious!
We use Aersilk and special materials. They are stronger and lighter.
I admire you for creating such a unique way to transport people.
Thank you, but I'm still new. The seasoned Crafters are truly impressive.
Someday, I'll design even better materials.
It's the first time I've really gotten to see how the Aership works.
It's soft and mildly sweet, and it pairs perfectly with slightly bitter green tea.
If you like it, let's make some more together when you have time.
Are we coming again? I'm free tomorrow!
It's really noisy here. This isn't a teahouse, okay?
Did they step on the flowers? Those are my experiments, not wildflowers!
This garden should be quiet and orderly, like a library.
“Your company has given my journey to Yunluo a feeling of heartbeat...” What does “heartbeat” mean here?
zh_text: “你的陪伴，让我的云落之旅有了悸动的感觉……“这里的悸动是什么意思？
source_text: “你的陪伴，让我的云落之旅有了悸动的感觉……“这里的悸动是什么意思？

text: It's pleasant here, but a little damp. Forget studying. I just want to chat with you.
Me too. Next time, we should study at school.
Sure. What did you just talk about?
You saw our senior in town, and then?
The point is, he just bought a dessert.
That's where the Herbalists grow their herbs.
Its unique beauty draws many students to visit.
I saw students entering in pairs. They must have been there to relax.
Well, legend says a famed Herbalist once fell in love with a crane there.
That explains it. Shall we take a look, too?
I saw an angry Herbalist just now. Did we offend him?
I know him. He just doesn't like people wandering in the garden.
Why? It's such a beautiful garden... Let's detour next time.
By the way, notice the shape of this garden?
I feed the cranes here every day. These clever birds carry your wishes far away.
Shh, keep it quiet. Wishes lose their magic once spoken aloud.
Just come here often for these lovely cranes.
When we grow up, we'll be strong adults like you and Novar!
Novar is back on top of Wonder!
What are you all looking at?
What are you all looking at?
Novar's figurine fell off the Aerux Crystal, and we're trying to put it back...
Thank you! If you succeed, this treasure chest is yours!
Where does it go? The highest spot in the middle?
Where does it go? The highest spot in the middle?
Yes! It took a lot of effort to put it there before...
So I just need to put the figurine back? Let me see what I can do.
So I just need to put the figurine back? Let me see what I can do.
Thank you! If it works, this treasure chest is yours!
I just need to put it back, right?
I just need to put it back, right?
Hmm... is there a way to move the figurine up there?
Hmm... is there a way to move the figurine up there?
If only I could zoom up like Novar...
If only I could zoom up like Novar...
We'll head back to Frostcloud Town soon. Thank you!
Once we're back, we'll ask Novar to teach us that move.
Ah... but I still want to visit Maple at the Red Falcon Training Hall...
If we don't head back, Shye will worry.
What should I do... should I go find Novar?
Whoosh! Novar just flew up there! So fast!
Place the Team of Stars figurine closer to Wonder...
Novar's ideas are always so unpredictable!
Step on the pedal and hit the dummy in a flash.
If you succeed, I'll give you a reward.
I can pull off the move.
Show me! Stand on the pedal over there.
If you can do it, come find me!
One day, I'll reach that speed.
If I see that move again, I might gain new insights...
But that speed... is beyond my abilities...
If you know anything about it, please tell me.
Once, someone passed my house and used a sword technique <001>as radiant as the stars</>.
I've trained here alone for ages, trying to learn that.
With one move, he felled enemies twenty meters away. When I came to, he was gone.
That man you saw... He is quite famous.
That man you saw... He is quite famous.
Really? I haven't left here in ages... I wonder how much the world has changed.
Training alone won't lead to breakthroughs.
Training alone won't lead to breakthroughs.
You're right. Only real combat will help me reach that speed.
Your insight really cleared things up!
You can't break through your bottleneck by training in isolation. You should go out and see the world.
zh_text: 一个人闭关修炼是无法打破瓶颈的，你应该出去看看外面的世界。
source_text: 一个人闭关修炼是无法打破瓶颈的，你应该出去看看外面的世界。
official_target_text: You can't break through your bottleneck by training in isolation. You should go out and see the world.

text: Stand on the pedal, and use <001>that move</> to hit the dummy.
You took down that bear outside?
It took a bit of effort.
Phew... if it weren't for my stomach acting up, that Spike Bear wouldn't even be worth my time!
But thank you anyway. Without you, I doubt I would have made it out of this cave.
You probably don't realize it, but you've just completed a trial without knowing it.
That's right. I found part of The Three Principles of Archery by Wei An, the former Red Falcon Training Hall leader, in this cave.
Archery is completed by courage and then victory. I trained too hard and got stomach problems... It was hard enough to find this place, and now I'm trapped here.
Even with all the courage in the world, I couldn't do anything to get myself out. It's so ironic...
It seems what I really need isn't unmatched skills but proper meals...
Looks like we're in this together now.
How did you get trapped here with a bear outside?
How did you get trapped here with a bear outside?
Alright, no point discussing this. The bear can't get in, and we can't get out.
Well, you're stuck here now, aren't you?
If it weren't for this sharp stomach pain...
Don't worry, the cave's too narrow—it won't dare come in.
Hey?! Where are you going? Are you seriously leaving me here to die?!
Chiuchiu, look! I learned this bridge from my mentor's notes. It's called Crosswind Bridge. Amazing!
It's said that a great master built this bridge by controlling how Aerux grew.
Think I could be like him someday? Careful, Chiuchiu! Don't fall!
Chiuchiu, look! I learned this bridge from my mentor's notes. It's called Crosswind Bridge. Amazing!
Think I could be like him someday? Careful, Chiuchiu! Don't fall!
It's said that a great master built this bridge by controlling how Aerux grew.
Kids, we're standing on Crosswind Bridge. It connects East and West Aerfall Highlands.
It's said that an ancient master built this bridge using Sorcery energy!
Do you want to become as great as that master?
*Sigh*... I wonder if these kids are even listening.
Alright, line up. Soon we'll go up and use the telescope!
Fishing? Nah. I'm trying to catch a Bubble Fish.
Hey, why are you fishing here?
Hey, why are you fishing here?
But how do you know Bubble Fish will show up here?
But how do you know Bubble Fish will show up here?
Haha, just let an Astrologer do his thing. Believing is the key.
There is a <001>telescope</>. The view is stunning.
Believing is the key. Go check out the <001>telescope</> over there.
Dad, what's across the bridge? Why can't we go there?
There are monsters. We're staying here for Mom.
Monsters?! That's scary! Dad, protect me!
Don't worry, sweetie. Mom will keep us safe.
Mom is holding back monsters there. Kids can't go there.
Wow! Was that Mom riding a Bubble Fish?
Mei, is that you? Did the Bubble Fish bring you back to see us?
The Moocart hasn't returned. The supplies are running out.
Hello! This is the Moocart hub. How can I help?
So you make sure the supplies are transferred between East and West Aerfall Highlands?
So you make sure the supplies are transferred between East and West Aerfall Highlands?
That little deer was so cute.
I wish I could take it home.
Burp... I'm stuffed. What should I eat for dinner?
The wind on the bridge is so loud, I can't hear the teacher.
After I beat Fuzi's Four Disciples, I'll enjoy this view again on my return.
Ah, I see. Now let's start tracking the third disciple, Ray.
That's easy. Let me find a high ground and scope things out.
By the way, why are they called Fuzi's Four Disciples? Are they really his students?
They formed a team called "Fuzi's Five Disciples" to compete in the Enlightenment Trials.
There were five members, but after an incident, they split up.
Could bronze-cast flowers forever like bronze?
What kind of flower is this?
Old records say it calms wandering spirits and guides their way.
If you find it in the ruins, take it as a guide from Bronze Ivy.
It's called Bronze Ivy. It feeds on bronze and can even grow on metal.
These ruins are rich in bronze, a perfect place for Bronze Ivy to thrive.
Goodbye. I'll keep studying these seemingly eternal flowers.
My name is Qing Wen. I've brought my students here to study the ruins in East Aerfall Highlands.
We're studying these bronze flowers and have made some progress.
We hope to uncover more ancient secrets before our time runs out.
In return, Bronze Ivy adorns the ruins—a gift of nature.
Haha, there's something more mystical. Legend speaks of a unique <001>Twin Bronze Ivy</>.
Haha, there's something more romantic. Legend speaks of a unique <001>Twin Bronze Ivy</>.
These flowers are a gift of time.
What's on the Mausoleum's Peak up in the sky?
No idea. It's so high—how could we even start investigating it?
You could observe it with your eyes. Guess what I found?
It has eight sides, each with a mysterious mark.
And there are eight pillars in East Aerfall Highlands. I'm afraid they might be connected.
You have a point, but how do we verify it?
*Sigh*... your archery is way better than mine.
Where do you most want to go?
I'd like to go to the Mausoleum, but I've heard it's hard to enter.
I've roamed the East Aerfall Highlands for ages, yet countless corners remain unexplored.
I want to visit Bastion Fort. It's cloaked in historical mystery, and I'd love to pay my respects there someday.
Finally, a place to rest for a while.
I'm used to the lonely wilderness, but this lively camp is captivating.
Maybe I'll stay a few more days.
The cart broke down after leaving Aerdeep Camp.
Thankfully, Chang Yyu fixed it. She runs this camp so well. I really admire her!
I've met so many fascinating people along the way.
Maybe that's what adventuring is all about!
And it's open to all adventurers.
It's way too hard to do that.
Based on my research, you need to accurately hit the correct targets.
But I keep missing! Ugh, maybe I should just give up...
The structure has stood the test of time.
Those patterns hide secrets, but they're hard to decipher.
It's ancient wisdom. Studying it is well worth the time.
Hello! I run this camp so Seekers have a good place to rest.
It's not easy to travel across mountains and rivers. Make yourself at home here.
If only my mentor had a place like this during the journeys...
Ah, never mind. Take a good rest, and let me know if you need anything.
Most villagers in Hermitage are friendly, but a few are wary of strangers.
True. I can sense some powerful people hidden among them.
This time, we explored every corner of Hermitage. The trip was worth it.
There's much more to discover here. It's not just Hermitage!
I'm exhausted. Let's take a break.
<001>Invisible Stone Slab Trial</> interference has been cleared.
official_target_text: <001>Invisible Stone Slab Trial</> interference has been cleared.
official_en_text: <001>Invisible Stone Slab Trial</> interference has been cleared.

text: The camp is pretty basic, so please don't mind. I wish we were back at the old site...
What happened to your old site?
What happened to your old site?
The Rebels seized it, so we had to move here.
Worse still, my teammates went off to hunt the Embermane and left me here by myself.
The Rebels are after the Embermane, too. Hard to say who'll win.
Maybe someone else will come after them all. Humph, leaving me here was definitely a mistake!
Students chase grades and often ignore the beauty around them.
That's why we're here—to find and share that beauty with others.
We'll turn the scenery into riddles and put them <001>inside lanterns</>.
Anyone who <001>solves the riddle</> will discover the beautiful place and get a reward from us.
This way, they'll be amazed by what they find.
Gong, why did you give up? Now it's my turn!
No, I fell asleep last time you were the seeker. My turn now!
Wahhh, I don't want to play anymore...
One more round, please? Don't be scared, Gong. We can hide together!
A failed student playing music... were these wolves attracted by it?
zh_text: 一个吹奏乐曲的破门生……这些狼是被吸引来的吗？
source_text: 一个吹奏乐曲的破门生……这些狼是被吸引来的吗？

text: Hey! Those are ore shipments about to be transported out!
Aermore Valley is nearby, rich in mineral resources. Go mining there if you need to.
Remember to clean the cookware and stove after use...
I've never seen you before. I'm Mu Wan, an Aersilk Harvester for over ten years.
This is where Aersilk Harvesters come to rest and resupply.
Yes, it's an ancient profession dedicated to collecting Jixia's ever-changing Aersilk.
The more you learn, the more you'll love it. For now, just rest.
Ugh, I shouldn't have taken this request alone.
It's a high-difficulty request posted by the Aersilk Harvester.
They need someone brave enough to clear out the beasts in the valley.
The monsters' unusual behavior is severely disrupting Aersilk collection.
A drop in Aersilk production is a big deal.
Are the beasts here that strong?
With my skills and some hunting traps, I can handle a few Wolvines.
But the valley's beasts are much stronger than those outside, likely due to environmental anomalies.
If some Spike Bears hadn't shown up to fight the Wolvines, I might not have made it out alive.
And I'm certain there are even stronger beasts here. Don't be reckless and try to fight them.
Farewell. I'll go back and recruit some hands.
If my senior weren't here, I'd jump down there in a heartbeat.
Are you out of your mind?
Are you out of your mind?
There are countless relics down there, but my senior won't let me go.
Bronze Mechanoids? Who cares? Doesn't he trust my combat skills?
It's too deep... What should we do now?
We must prepare before going in, but the entrance is too narrow to see inside.
We could get injured if we jump in recklessly. Any ideas?
Maybe You can use Your Sorcery Power.
Alright then. I'll try and find another way.
See if your <001>Flow Sense</> works here.
Hey, I think I have what you need.
Hey, I think I have what you need.
Great! Now we have enough data.
I'm really grateful for your help.
It was nothing. Happy to help.
It was nothing. Happy to help.
I heard a noise coming from inside. Could it be a gate?
Are you here to investigate the ruins, too?
Let me give it a shot.
Let me give it a shot.
I think you can throw something through this opening to hit the target!
I tried many times, but it jams at the entrance. So frustrating... Maybe I'm too weak.
Try it, but it's harder than it looks.
How can I get it in there?
Is it what you were looking for? Rebels were here, but I've already cleared them.
The outpost once stood tall, but now it's in ruins.
The exploration team reported a damaged stone tablet inside that needs repair.
Pei Erh is great at fixing tablets, so I asked her to teach me.
Go find her inside. I've got your back.
It was so dangerous. The moment the fire started, it attracted the Wolvines.
Thank goodness you helped. Here, take my junior's chest as thanks! No need to be polite!
No, I'm not alone. I'd never venture into the wild alone. My junior's here with me.
We want to explore the ruins there and the broken stone tablets. Especially the latter, which seems to have some Mechcrafts.
But then he just disappeared... He's so unreliable!
I didn't expect the design of this bronze structure to be so advanced.
No wonder the School of Mechcraft's ideas come mostly from ancient ruins.
That was close. Thanks for the help!
He'll probably come here. I should just wait here.
It's just a stone tablet—nothing special.
It's just a stone tablet—nothing special.
When someone went down and could hardly come back, he built a walkway.
When someone went down and could hardly come back, he built a walkway.
Got it, thanks. Now I can stop obsessing over it.
Look down the walkway. There's an old stone tablet.
Would there be some Martial Arts secrets?
Stories about Martial Arts secrets hidden under cliffs are popular at the academy.
I don't have the skills to go down. Could you check it for me?
What are you waiting for? It's right below the cliff.
Greetings! I'm Wu Mian, a top Hunter from Jixia Academy.
We've set up camp here to study the Frost Kodiak.
If you want to join us, you must prove yourself.
Not bad. I admit you've got talent.
Every tyrant meets their downfall. The Frostmane Spike Bear once ruled these lands, now reduced to a desperate beast—a pitiful shadow of its former self.
I'm Wu Mian, a Hunter. The academy sent me and a few of my apprentices to study the Frost Kodiak here in East Aerfall Highlands.
East Aerfall Highlands are dangerous. We must stay alert and respect nature.
The Frost Kodiak is an ancient creature with markings that resemble the patterns found in nearby ruins.
It has been sealed in a remote corner, but it's getting more violent.
If I were sure I could hunt it, I would, to ease the villagers' fears.
It's extremely powerful. I won't act recklessly until I understand it fully.
My apprentices and I have gathered plenty of intel on the Frost Kodiak, and our research is progressing well.
But some Rebels just raided our camp. But luckily, no research data was stolen.
This bear looks strange... It has mysterious markings all over its body.
That's the Frost Kodiak. I saw it myself when I joined Master Wu Mian on an investigation. That was terrifying.
It's huge, aggressive, and uncontrollable. Someone likely sealed it to stop harm.
Aggressive... could the markings be the cause?
Possibly. Zhang He accepted the villagers' request to hunt it. Good chance to learn more.
You must be eager to study the Frost Kodiak.
Shh... come closer. Don't let those up there see you.
A few days ago, we saw a strange beast that glowed like fire and moved faster than the wind.
We tracked it here to catch it, but Rebels now control the nearby camp.
We're not giving up. Patience wins the hunt.
That beast is ours, no doubt about it.
I spotted you from a distance. Thank you so much!
No worries! I'm just glad you're okay.
No worries! I'm just glad you're okay.
The Seekers at the camp have been taking good care of this kid. It seems to have fattened up.
This belongs to the child. Take it back to her, and stay safe on your way.
This belongs to the child. Take it back to her, and stay safe on your way.
Don't ignore even the smallest movements out here!
She should be at <001>Seeker Society Camp</>. Go check it out.
How long have I been on guard? Feels like forever...
Really? I thought it was hours!
Why did you join the School of Martial Arts then?
Why did you join the School of Martial Arts then?
I joined the School of Martial Arts thinking I'd get to fight in East Aerfall.
Later, I learned the academy advises against new Martial Arts students entering ruins alone for safety reasons.
If I'd joined the School of Mechcrafts, I'd probably be enjoying the Cloudreach Festival feast right now.
First time in East Aerfall Highlands? Don't drop your guard.
Is it really that dangerous here?
Absolutely. Rebels cause constant trouble, and beasts may chase you often.
I'm a Martial Arts student. Guard duty trains me, and I know my limits, despite what some think.
Most people would suggest those grand, towering structures.
But I prefer the smaller, overlooked ruins. They often hide surprising treasures.
And don't miss the tall bronze pillars. Rumor says they hold many secrets.
Aerfall Highlands are vast. Take your time exploring.
Farewell, and go broaden your horizons!
Will Tata's order be ready today? We're running out of ingredients!
We sent our Hunters. I'm sure they'll be back soon.
We're doing our best on this rush order.
We can discuss that when the Hunters are back.
Yes. See? It's as lively as ever!
Please take this chest as a token of my gratitude.
If only everyone were as kindhearted as you!
Are you hurt, my precious? What would I do if anything happened to you...
Don't let me see you again!
My beloved Preydator climbed a tree and is too scared to come down!
Yeah, I feel terrible about it... Hey, are you leaving already?
It's too high! I'll find another way. Don't risk yourself!
Phew, finally, all the bounties are posted.
Speaking of which, this Hunting Society instructor is way too lazy, even hiring someone to write the bounty for them.
Being a disciple of the Hunting Society must be tough.
If they don't come home soon, I'll go to the Croaky Pitch to find them.
This happens too often. It seems like he doesn't care about us.
Next time, I'll make sure he takes responsibility!
The animals here are cute but wary. I failed to earn their trust again...
If only my mentor were here... I need advice, but as usual, he vanished without a word.
Will your mentor come back? He wouldn't abandon you, would he?
Will your mentor come back? He wouldn't abandon you, would he?
Who knows? He does this all the time.
Maybe he went after a rare animal again.
I doubt it. I saw him a few days ago at the waterside cave south of Frostcloud Town.
He was talking to himself, so I left him alone.
That creepy cave? I wouldn't dare go in.
We should wait here. He wouldn't abandon us, right?

text: I was getting ready to study the stars above Frostcloud Town at night.
But Rebels barged in, drove me out, and seized the terrace!
They're getting out of control lately.
Am I still not trying hard enough... even after all this?
I'm Fayer from Wind's Rest Pavilion. Want to meet Master Wei An? Let's spar first.
Alright, come back when you've made up your mind.
My master looks even better since moving to Wind's Rest Pavilion.
When he took over Red Falcon Training Hall, he hardly even had time to rest.
The once-brilliant archer had lost the spark in his eyes...
But now he's found his love for archery again. His poise and confidence are back.
I secretly challenged some disciples of Red Falcon Training Hall and won every duel.
Maybe one day, I can win back the Training Hall for my master.
Then I'll have juniors. I wish someone would train with me more often.
Ugh...! Am I still not strong enough...
It's okay. You're facing one of the best archers, after all.
It takes some genius to be the number one disciple of a genius!
You beat me once already. Why come back?
I can't spar right now. Please come back another time.
You lost last time. Feeling confident for a rematch? I'm looking forward to it.
I'd love to raise a few more...
Having these little ones around makes me happy.
I'm Yan Shanxi. I'm here to clear out monsters in this area.
No monster has ever escaped me, but it's gotten a bit tedious over time.
Raising animals is far more interesting. I spend more and more time on it.
I care for many animals here. Most of them were rescued from monsters.
Some Hunters also leave injured pets here to recover.
Do their pets get injured often?
Do their pets get injured often?
Unfortunately, yes. Hunters often bring them here for wound treatment.
Once, a Hunter brought a badly injured pet here, and I sternly scolded him.
If you're not skilled, stay safe. Don't drag pets into danger. That's irresponsible.
How do you care for animals?
I could talk for days about it, but the basics are simple:
Feed their favorites, spend quality time, and show lots of love.
In a word, treat them like your own children.
Hello, welcome to the Hunters' camp in West Aerfall Highlands.
All this time, no monster has ever escaped my hands. It's become quite boring after a while.
zh_text: 一直以来，从未有怪物能从我手中逃脱，时间长了，甚是无趣。
source_text: 一直以来，从未有怪物能从我手中逃脱，时间长了，甚是无趣。

text: I'm always kind to people and animals.
But in sparring, I'm dead serious.
Looks like you've got the heart of a timid pet.
Come by my side, the trial of wills is about to begin!
That's what the School of Sorcery specializes in.
These Bronze Spheres could be important.
Thanks. I couldn't have done it without you.
Now I see those pillars' secrets and why Captain Suchen is so cautious.
Each restored Bronze Sphere raises the pillar a little.
With all three Bronze Spheres restored, a trial starts.
It likely works the same for others!
I'd love to share with others, but let's keep it quiet, okay?
Captain Suchen just worries about our safety.
I heard a student was seriously injured while exploring those pillars.
Now I understand how dangerous they are.
When I return, I'll warn the other Seekers.
Honestly, the more they forbid it, the more tempting it is.
Yeah... Captain Suchen from Aerdeep Camp set a rule that Seekers couldn't investigate the Eight Sentinels on their own...
I did everything I could to defeat all those Bronze Mechanoids.
I'm already exhausted... and more might be coming.
I must stay sharp! If I get hurt, Captain Suchen will find out.
If we work together, we can handle this.
If we work together, we can handle this.
Great! I'm glad you feel the same!
And if you don't, that's fine—just don't tell Captain Suchen, okay? Please!
Hey, are you secretly investigating the Eight Sentinels too? Want to team up?
Alright, if you won't admit it, fine.
I'll stay here and prepare. Come find me if you decide to do this.
Once you're ready, repair the three Sorcery Mechcraft devices around here to start the Courage Trial.
Oh? You seem to have some real skill...
Keep moving forward. The Path of Trials requires steady progress to reach the summit.
The younger generation is truly remarkable!
The students of Jixia grow so quickly. It seems I no longer have a reason to stay here...
The cycle repeats; one challenger after another, yet success remains rare...
Well, well, another challenger for the Courage Trial. Let's see how far you can go.
Is the Courage Trial that difficult?
Is the Courage Trial that difficult?
Over the years, hundreds have tried, but only a few made it to the end.
At first, I just watched and noticed—not a single person survived the trial.
Even when I helped every participant, the number of successes remained pitifully small.
Then I guess I'll have to try.
That sounds over the top... No thanks.
Fine. If you're ready, go activate the three Sorcery Mechcraft devices nearby.
There's no shame in knowing your limits. Realizing the gap is a victory in itself.
Oh, you must be the newcomer taking the extra test! Are you here to challenge the Eight Sentinels?
Not even here... where are you?
No, no, Captain Suchen strictly forbade us from going near the Eight Sentinels. I'm looking for my roommate.
He went missing recently, but I know he was secretly investigating the Eight Sentinels.
I thought passing one of the pillars' trials might reveal his whereabouts.
But my strength is too weak to activate the Divine Imprint, let alone pass the trial.
Maybe you can do it. Give it a try!
Not even here... where are you?
Based on my observation, the two rooms have <001>similar</> internal structures. There might be some kind of correspondence...
See you! I'm off to search for my roommate elsewhere.
You're incredible. If my roommate were this capable, I wouldn't be so worried about him.
They saw you! Run if you can't fight them all!
Wow, that's great. I was worried about you.
I could never be that stealthy.
I can see you're a great fighter, yet you remained so patient...
You are truly one of a kind!
Huh? So that's how you solved it...
You must be a top Martial Arts student!
Be careful. The trial at this pillar tests your stealth skills.
See those three guards? Make sure they never spot you...
Restoring all three Bronze Spheres <001>without being seen</> is nearly impossible.
If you get trapped in there, I won't be able to help.
You must. I'll stay here and keep watch!
What are you doing? Hide now!

text: When the Bastion Token returns, I'll fight once more.
Incredible... so this is the true power of the Bastion Token.
Incredible... so this is the true power of the Bastion Token.
No wonder so many covet this token.
No wonder so many covet this token.
Awaken, twin axes buried beneath! Wipe out the enemy!
Awaken, twin axes buried beneath! Wipe out the enemy!
Hmm, sounds like you had a good time...
Next time, I'll design a more challenging one.
You are the legendary Aerrider with forever hot tears?
You are the legendary Aerrider with forever hot tears?
No, I didn't. I'm just passing by!
I need to deliver goods to <001>Pickaxe Garden</>.
But the recipient's name is <001>"Mysterious lady surrounded by Croakies at night"</>.
How am I supposed to find it?! I'm about to miss the delivery window...
There you are! <001>The mysterious woman surrounded by Croakies every night</>!
There you are! <001>The mysterious woman surrounded by Croakies every night</>!
That's right, it's mine! Aerfall Express really lives up to its name!
Petals fall and bloom again, but some who leave never return...
Yes, my family has protected this tree for generations, keeping it safe from harm.
What kind of questions can it answer?
What kind of questions can it answer?
Are you here to visit the Tree of Answers to seek what's in your heart?
At the same time, we welcome travelers who seek answers with sincerity.
Anything, really. But most travelers ask about love, health, careers, or luck.
But remember, the Tree of Answers only responds to pure intentions. When you silently ask your question, do so with respect.
Alright, I'll activate the stele now. Think about your question in your heart.
I don't think I have any pressing concerns for now.
Alright, but maybe you'll find yourself coming back.
Alright, I'll activate the stele now. Think about your question in your heart.
Alright, I'll activate the stele now. Think about your question in your heart.
Alright, I'll activate the stele now. Think about your question in your heart.
The Aerux spreading from the Tower of Enlightenment has deeply rooted itself underground.
Much like the roots of the water tree spreading through the lake.
This land, this world—it's all been carefully protected over time.
Its roots connect like veins. This might be another Pearlized Tree.
The stele's magic will take time to recharge—come back later.
Such stunning scenery... I can't bear to...
I've been painting the stark beauty of the East Aerfall Highlands, but my brush water has gotten dirty.
I want to capture the feeling in my heart at this moment and can't bring myself to leave for water.
Could you fetch some water from the bridge below?
You're back already? Great, let me have it.
You're back already? Great, let me have it.
Please fetch some water from the river—it'd be a huge help.
Please grab some water from the river nearby—it'd be a great help.
That was quick—thank you so much.
That was quick—thank you so much.
Good Deeds Cards can be exchanged for Credits with the <001>Student Affairs Committee</> at <001>Aerdeep Camp</>.
Don't mention it. It was no trouble at all.
Don't mention it. It was no trouble at all.
If you can't handle it alone, remember to call your partners to fight together!

When I first enrolled, my swordsmanship was unmatched, and the examiners couldn't stop praising me.
Do you really think you're stronger than me, blocking my way like this? Step aside!
