text: Hello, I'm the academy guide for East Aerfall Highlands.
Ahead is dangerous. Per academy rules, I must verify your identity.
Ah, a new student. I must remind you of a few things.
Aerdeep Camp up ahead is our base. Bastion Fort to the west is a well-known research site for Seekers.
The central area around the Mausoleum has dangerous, hard-to-reach ruins, so only seniors team up to go there.
Most importantly, avoid the Eight Sentinels. Every student must remember this.
You don't look like a villager. Anyway, always stay alert in East Aerfall Highlands.
If you encounter any problem, seek help at Aerdeep Camp ahead. It's the academy's base.
The academy studies Bastion Fort to the west and the central Mausoleum. Villagers should stay away.
Also, avoid tall pillars with strange markings. Some students were badly hurt investigating them.
I can't express how grateful I am to you.
Everything I've been through, we've been through... such great memories.
A Seeker's mission is to uncover history's mysteries. Malva believed it, and so do I.
You've been a tremendous help. Thank you!
But this isn't the end. I'll stay here to study the Mausoleum.
An expedition team is already stationed in the Underhall. I'm sure more stories are waiting.
I've experienced so many things along the way, and they are all unforgettable memories.
zh_text: 一路走来居然经历了这么多事情，都是我难忘的回忆。

text: Fengluo, wait. This is for you.
Wow, what a beautiful jade pendant. It says... 'Gazing at the autumn water, calling for the maple to fall'?
You have another piece! Let me see what's written on your jade pendant!
Stop teasing me. By the way, Taigong has something urgent to discuss with us.
It seems there's something unusual about the southern coastline of Jixia. Shall we go together?
What do I do, what do I do—I'm going to be late...
The unbeatable me... is lost again...
I'm new to the Hall of Herbology, and today's my first day. But my map got ruined by the rain, so I can't use it anymore.
Could you open your map and help me find the way to <001>Aerdeep Camp in the East Aerfall Highlands</>?
Sure, let me take a look.
Sorry, I don't know where it is either.
How about it? Found it? Which direction should I go to reach <001>Aerdeep Camp</> in East Aerfall Highlands?
Thank you! I'll head out now!
I don't remember. Let me check again.
Thank you! I'll head out now!
Thank you! I'll head out now!
It's you! Your bad directions made me late on my first day!
Sorry, I must've misread the map.
Sorry, I must've misread the map.
Hmph! If you make me a <001>Fluffy Iced Cake</>, I'll forgive you!
It's you! Thanks to your directions, I made it to the alchemy shop on time.
If it weren't for you, I'd have been late. Take this treasure chest as my thanks!
How much of destiny can divination truly reveal?
I must see the new performance on Frostcloud Stage.
Can astrologers' prophecies truly reveal destiny, or are they just illusions veiled in mist?

Over time, whenever I couldn't go on, just thinking about the taste of the Claw-Xun Fruit would naturally give my body strength again.
But I'm really tired and hungry now. It would be great if a kind soul could <001>pick a Claw-Bamboo Fruit</> for me.
The Claw-Xun fruit is picked, here you go.
The Claw-Xun fruit is picked, here you go.
Anyway, thanks for the Claw Xun fruit. Once I get back, I'll have a banner custom-made for you!
Did you pick this just for me? I'm... I'm so touched. It's like I can feel that warmth from my childhood again.
I even think that if I face the mechanical constructs again, I won't be afraid anymore.
Haha, that's a bit of an exaggeration. My reason still tells me it's best not to go head-to-head with those guys.

Alright, I'll rest here a bit longer. Stay safe!
Thanks again for the Clawshooter Fruit you gave me earlier—it was such a lifesaver.
If you run into trouble, just run. Like they say, there's no shame in trying to stay safe!
Don't give me that look! The book explains everything clearly!
I promise this is worth every coin. The booklet covers all the Mechcrafts and trials on Mausoleum's Peak.
For example, to enter Mausoleum's Peak, you need to complete a series of trials.
Only then can you ascend to the sacred Mausoleum's Peak.
It's very complicated. You should probably just buy the book and study it yourself.
Tell me about the mysterious village.
I only found out from this book that there's a village deep within the Highlands. Beneath it lies a hidden ruin.
Turns out that idyllic village is just a facade. The book even talks about using an ancient Sorcery Technique to enter that underground place...
Why not take a look? What if the book's claims are true?
See you around, and don't forget to stop by again!
Hey, my Anecdote Collection is a bestseller. Every explorer in the East Aerfall Highlands needs one.
The collection says warriors who perished in the great wars would return as spirits to Bastion Fort.
While other ruins have crumbled, the massive Bastion Fort remains perfectly intact—thanks to them, perhaps?
You'll need to piece together two halves of a talisman and activate all the Eight Sentinels...
Wait, are those Rebels over there? The students investigating that area are gonna have a tough time.
But I've already finished my assignments. I should just stay out of trouble.
Now should I eat back at the camp later?
What should I eat when I get back to camp?

text: Oh, Croaky, please grant me a very successful adventure.
Is there really some Croaky deity in this shrine?
Is there really some Croaky deity in this shrine?
The shrine is more of a symbol of luck. And people just really love Croakies.
Over time, praying at the Croaky Shrine has become a tradition for newcomers to the East Aerfall Highlands.
You're new here, aren't you? Try touching the Croaky inside—your wish might just come true!
This cart just has to break down now of all times—right when we're almost at the Seekers' Camp!
Come on, buddy. Look on the bright side—it's just a simple supply run.
If this happens when we are hauling archaeological artifacts, we can say goodbye to this career!
Well, you do have a point.
Let's just fix the cart quickly. We don't want to keep the Seekers waiting.
See that mountain peak? It looks easy to climb, but you'll never make it to the top without great strength.
If only I had the power to leap to the top in one go.
Now? Now I'm stuck with my bare hands and feet.
I see. But that really seemed like a strange guy.
That man came over wearing a hood, notebook in hand, and asked me some strange questions. I had no idea how to respond...
Earlier when I was exploring a ruin nearby, I ran into a strange Seeker.
But Seeker expeditions in the East Aerfall Highlands are under strict management. Nobody just wanders around by themselves.
Students are amazing. They keep things running and add many fun ideas.
Exactly. This place feels much more alive now.
They built the Aership Station as well.
And durable Aersilk fishing rods, useful farming tools...
They can cause trouble sometimes, but they've really made our lives easier.
Stillgrove Foxes and Phantom Rabbits seem symbiotic. I should note this.
Are you tracking their daily activities?
Are you tracking their daily activities?
Yes. I'd share this with my mentor, but I can't find him lately.
So I'm drawing my own conclusions. It's going pretty well.
Deer are playfully running around the hills.
Sometimes they stroll along the river, almost like they're chatting with the fish.
Let's just leave them in peace.
This second line just won't rhyme. Ugh, poetry is so hard.
Maybe I should switch to painting or music instead. I can't be bad at everything, right?
Next time I see such stunning scenery, I want to be able to record it. Any means will do.
The emerald waters shimmer with a soft green glow, and the red maples...
Hmm, wait, there are no maples here.
If you're not buying anything, how about staying here and keeping me company?
Is there anything else you'd like to know?
I'm a true Angling Society member. Started baiting at three, casting at seven, and landed a King Fish at fifteen!
If you ask me, my true skill lies in creating holes. Go ask around with other Angling Societies. Everyone knows the name of the Hole Puncher!
It's an art that comes down to three things: the right amount, the right time, and the right balance.
Specifically, it's about how much bait to use, when to refill it, and where to use it.
But the details are my secret. Can't just spill everything.
Goodbye and good luck! May your angling bring you bountiful harvests!
As expected, the lakeside is the most peaceful place.
Once I graduate, I'm settling down here. Or anywhere by a lake.
Grow up and get bigger, fish!
Traveling alone always feels a bit unsettling.

source_text: 一个人赶路总有些不安啊。

text: I heard this lake was not a lake before.
Apparently, this place used to be a deep pit. The locals diverted water here to create what is now Mirror Lake.
They also say the ancient tree in the lake can answer one's questions. That girl under the tree told me that.
Honestly, I think most of those rumors are just made up.
This has been quite an enjoyable journey. Thanks so much for your help.
You're too kind. Your archery skills are very impressive. Were you a disciple at Red Falcon?
You flatter me. I'm not even close to those Red Falcon warriors.
But that's why I came here. To learn from Head Trainer Maple and become a better archer.
Dad's been staring at the chessboard all day. So boring.
He says I should watch and think more, but I don't get it, and I don't want to.
Playing in the water is way more fun! But only when that big sister isn't around.
Otherwise, she'll stop me and start rambling about stuff I don't understand.
That dummy! He promised to play with me!
He's not on the bridge, either. Where could he have gone?
I'm telling his dad about this!
It's late. Are you walking alone at night?
Walking alone at night in Aerfall Highlands requires extra caution.
What should I pay attention to?
What should I pay attention to?
Rumors say that late at night, the spirits that have been sleeping for years will awaken and wander silently throughout Aerfall.
The "person" you met might be one of them...
Then what are you doing here?
Of course I'm a living, breathing person! How can you be so clueless?
But that thing floating beside you might be an exception.
I didn't believe in them either, before.
Then one night, I saw shadows wandering down the path...
You really should be careful when walking alone at night on the Cloudfall Highlands.

text: I've got a hunch that these Aerux roots are what elevated the Aerfall Highlands.
See that large Aerux in the distance? Based on my measurements, it's grown taller than it was a week ago.
Do you know about surveying? Or have you been observing the large Aerux?
The Aerux in Jixia are alive, breathing, and growing alongside us.
So, it's no surprise if they get taller every day.
Really? Maybe I made a mistake. But I've always been very careful in my work...
No way! I'll measure again and compare it with the data from two and three weeks ago. I'll figure this out!
Gotta practice so I don't stutter in front of Head Trainer Maple.
Ms... Ms... M-Maple... I... I'd like to... Will you be my mentor?
I can't stutter when I see Master Fengyu later! I need to practice beforehand.

text: Where did she find that gem? Hopefully she'll give me a hint.
Haven't you heard? <001>Some student just found a precious gem!</>
There might be more around. If I could find one...
I don't know where she found it. I don't even know who she is.
It's too early to get back. Let's visit the Red Falcon Training Hall.
I don't want to go back yet.
I heard there's a powerful creature called Cloudeater in these mountains. Let's go find it.
I don't think that's a good idea. We should discuss our plans before making a decision.
What? Why not take the Aership back and relax for a bit?
I saw a Croaky heading for the field with the big balloons. Let's go!
Forget what the administrator told you last time? That is not the place to play chase with Croakies!
That's just him. He's so boring.
He's just trying to protect those little creatures. Don't give him a hard time, okay?
It's brave and strong, and it protects me while I'm hanging out.
Hey, wanna play with me and my Scholarly Tiger?
My parents just push me to study and train all the time. Good grades are all they care about.
But my Scholarly Tiger? It's always here for me.
The Red Falcons don't like noises, so they're hard to find.
I love their graceful posture in the air. Been tracking them for years.
The unique terrain here has attracted many of them.
This is a rare opportunity. I'm planning to camp here and observe their behaviors.
The Aership here leads to the academy, Aerux Town, and Darkpool Camp...
I can buy the stuff we need in Aerux Town, and then head back to the academy.
And there's a schedule here. I can use it to estimate the travel time.
With this, I can make much better plans every time.
The Aership here leads to the academy, Aerux Town, and Darkpool Camp...
Go to Aerux Town to buy materials, return, then take the Aership from Aerux Town back to the Academy.
The travel time can be estimated based on the Aership route table.
With this, I can make much better plans every time.
A lot of students have visited the town recently.
I picked up some skills from the School of Mechcraft, and now I want to try them out.
Mechcraft isn't easy. You must be pretty talented.
Mechcraft isn't easy. You must be pretty talented.
Haha, I'm just doing my best!
It took a lot of effort to bring my project here.
What are you doing here? Aren't you supposed to be interning at the Craftworks in Frostcloud Town?
A road sign is broken, and I'm here to fix it.
By the way, do you remember this place?
Of course! We used to play hide-and-seek over there.
I remember how easy it was to find you. You were so big.
It's been a while since we went to Frostcloud Town for dinner.
Yeah, everyone is so busy. We two Anglers are the only ones who have some time to relax.
Yeah, haven't seen him in ages. Ever since he became a Seeker, he's been obsessed, staring at those pillars for months.
Forget him. Let's go grab some food.
Suchen stood us up again. He's always working on that "Eight Sentinels" stuff. So boring.
What's so special about the Eight Sentinels anyway? More special than friends?
The gentle breeze, the sea of flowers—this scenery is just breathtaking.
I'm waiting... Oh no, I missed the Aership again. This is the second time.
Well, there will be another one soon. I should take the time to enjoy this view.
The road ahead is unpredictable. We should prepare more before we set out.
We've checked our equipment hundreds of times, brother. There's nothing more to prepare.
The beasts are very dangerous. We can't be too careful.
Come on, you're being too cautious! We should welcome a little challenge!
This batch of goods is top quality. I'd better deliver it quickly.
Are you from nearby? It's dangerous ahead.
Are you from nearby? It's dangerous ahead.
Oh, me? Don't worry, I know this area like the back of my hand.
Please, I mean it. I'll be fine.
What? Is this more nonsense you dug up?
Not this time! They're in Dragon Valley, studying the dragons in the legends.
Did you know there's a hidden school of thought in the Seeker Society?
Dragons? That's a pretty niche field of study.
The Dragon Valley is not far from here. Why not go check it out?
There are Rebels everywhere—who knows how many more are waiting.
Why do you think they're here? Studying rare creatures too?
Aersilk? The harvesters are already struggling with the beasts. If the Rebels get involved, it'll be worse.
Exactly... We'd better get out of this valley.
It's hard to let go of something passed down for three generations.
It's those monsters in Aermore Valley. They've forced us Aersilk Harvesters out of the valley.
Maybe this is a chance for us to find a new career.
A bunch of Rebels from the north ambushed me and damaged all my cargo!
I'm okay, but the Aersilk... The harvesters worked so hard for this batch...
Thank you for standing up for me!
Those Rebels went back north. There are many of them, so stay safe.
Yeah... I won't do the transport alone next time.
The Rebels are very active in this area. It'd be better to have someone escort me next time.
By the way, those Rebels I ran into went back north. There are many of them, so watch out.
BL01 Angler Hidden Quest Convergence Point

text: Elders say Red Falcon Training Hall's former Head Trainer was a big name.
Yes, his skills were top-tier, yet he left Red Falcon Training Hall for unknown reasons...
Someone is practicing archery in that elegant courtyard. What is that place?
That's probably Wind's Rest Pavilion. Wei An lives there. He used to be the head of Red Falcon Training Hall.
Maple of Red Falcon Training Hall is known for archery, but Wind's Rest Pavilion's head is just as impressive.
Wei An was Red Falcon Training Hall's former Head Trainer. You didn't know?
No wonder those who train in Wind's Rest Pavilion excel at archery.
You know Yun Feixie, a senior in Wind's Rest Pavilion? We were childhood friends!
Back then, I could teach her, but now...
She shines her way, and you do too. You're the best, at least in my eyes!
Are you lost? You're not at the entrance of Red Falcon Training Hall.
If you could spar with Yun Feixie, I'd be most grateful.
When I missed my shot, I realized that the heavy burden of being the dojo master had kept my heartstrings taut for too long, causing me to lose the composure an archer should have.
zh_text: 一箭失手时，我才发觉，馆主的重责令我心弦紧了太久，失去了箭士该有的从容不迫。

text: My brother brought back a bronze helmet from the mountain last time—it was so cool!
I want to go too, but I'm a little scared...
He said there are masked villains on the mountain who hit kids on the head with sticks...
Right! His clothes are always stained with ink. You can't miss him!
Anyway, we've retrieved the pigment he asked for, but...
He only said to meet him by Mirror Lake without specifying where...
Makes sense. If he's nowhere to be found, and he couldn't have leapt down the waterfall, then he must be in that pavilion up there.
No way! With his frail frame, hauling all those painting tools up such a high ladder?
He could have just hired a Martial Arts student to help him move it...
Nothing I can do about it.
Let's just wait a little longer.
Odd... I can smell traces of Inkon...
The waters of Mirror Lake seem even clearer than last year!
Strange... Was my earlier hypothesis wrong?
Given the ecosystem here, self-purification shouldn't be possible...
If only we could uncover the history of Mirror Lake.
Next time, let's bring a senior Seeker along.
They say Mirror Lake wasn't always like this. What happened in between?
If we had a Seeker with us, maybe we could find some clues nearby.
Ugh... I spent all my living expenses on bait...
Let's see how this fragrant bait works!
Come on, little fishies, call your big relatives over. I've got something to discuss with them!
Huh? Is that golden shimmer under the water... a fish?
I've heard about the mysterious ruins in the East Aerfall Highlands. I'm going to take a look.
Back when I aced the entrance exams and secured the top spot, I never thought I'd end up performing for a living.
Don't just stand there. I'm heading to the East Aerfall Highlands.
Are you trying to provoke me? I'm not someone you want to mess with!
In the end, I defeated the rust-covered monster, crossed the mountains, and left behind a treasure, waiting for the little Garo of the future to find it.
zh_text: “最后，我打败身披铜锈的怪物，穿过山岭留下宝藏，等着未来的小伽罗将它找寻。”
source_text: “最后，我打败身披铜锈的怪物，穿过山岭留下宝藏，等着未来的小伽罗将它找寻。”

I need testers for the Aerrider competition—<001>Scenic Ride</>.
There are two tracks: one at <001>Pearlized Lake</> and one at <001>Cloudshatter Vale</>. Both were designed by the previous champion—me.
I have rewards for anyone who completes a lap. Interested?
Fantastic! Grab your Aerrider. Which track do you want to try first?
Are you the new student? Great, I was just worrying about being short-handed.
zh_text: 你就是那位新来的学子吗？太好了，我正因为人手不足的事发愁呢。

text: Which track would you like to try first?
Zzz... still need to knead the dough...
Not this again. I need to figure out something new.
Why do we have to come here, Master?
The library is so quiet that you can feel the subtle differences in the energy between the day and the night.
What can we do with it?
Good question! I always like students who ask questions. As the saying goes, "A miss is as good as a mile." This is especially true for us.
Subtle energies affect the results of Sorcery casting. If the wrong energies accumulate, they can even harm the caster.
Just think about how many books the academy has...
Yeah, who could possibly read all of them?
Probably only Senior Kongming. Everything he does, he does it well with speed.
Well, I've heard Sima Yi read every book in the Sorcery library back in his day.
We're almost done sorting these books. Thanks for your help.
Master Zhuangzi is really something... It's one thing that he never shows his face...
What time is it now... It would put the students' minds at ease if you just came out and let them see you...
Can I pet Master Zhuangzi's Bubble Fish, Won Qing? It's so cute!
Mayene frequently skipped class to play with the Bubble Fish and got caught by Master Zhuangzi.
You mean the famous class skipper who's always being chased around the School of Martial Arts by Master Fuzi?
Exactly. She used to come here instead. Was Master Zhuangzi angry about this?
Master Zhuangzi never gets angry, so don't be afraid to pet his Bubble Fish.
I've been having strange dreams lately. The School of Sorcery turned into a forest.
The students were flowers and trees, and Headmaster Zhuangzi became a crane. Everyone looked at each other in silence.
Could you help me interpret this dream?
Maybe you want to make new friends.
That's totally possible. Maybe I do have that thought...
But first, I have to get over my nervousness around strangers. Perhaps I can practice in my dreams.
I've been trying hard to control my dreams, and it's tiring. Maybe I need to take a walk in the woods to relax.
Sorcery and baking are such an amazing match!
Are you here for a class too, little Croaky?
Every time I come to the School of Sorcery, I feel this mysterious vibe...
What are you talking about? The hall is so open and clear. There's nothing mysterious here.
Exactly. Have you been sleeping well? Cause you seem...
No, seriously, have you not heard? Once, the Student Affairs Committee came here looking for Mayene.
One minute they saw her here, and the next she was gone. Tell me that's not mysterious!
Do you know where Master Zhuangzi went? I feel like I haven't seen him in a long time.
I bet it has something to do with the explosion at the finals arena a while back!
You mean... Master Zhuangzi blew it up?
When did I ever say such a thing!
However, Master Zhuangzi does seem to have vanished since then...
What you seek might just be close at hand.
Strange... The Miaoxing Instrument isn't working either...
So many mechanisms are broken; it shouldn't be just a simple coincidence...
It's incredible how just I used Sorcery to make such delicate pastries!
After seeing a senior make pastries with his Sorcery Techniques, I thought I'd give it a try.
It's called "Sorcery for Delicacies," which explains how to make Rainbow Flaky Lotus Buns.
With the right Sorcery Technique, one can add vibrant colors to the flaky crust and bring the flavor to perfection.
I'm a Gourmet who's always looking for ways to make delicious food!
And I heard Senior Zhou Yu used to cook with his fire spells, too.
Excuse me, is there a way that I can boost my strength fast?
Well, it's something that can't be explained by words. You'll have to find the answers in books.
Can you at least tell me what books I should read?
This one... and this one... Oh, and those two on the shelf.
That's a lot! If I only have time for one book, which one should I go for?
One book? Are you serious? Even geniuses like Zhou Yu had to work hard!
Little Gugu, I wish I could be as carefree as you.
The shadow of a flying bird is not in motion, huh... But the bird is still moving. I'm confused.
The shadow of a flying bird is relatively static, but the bird itself is still in motion. I think it's trying to teach me something...
I get a headache thinking about it. I'll go for a walk to clear my mind.
“The scene of a flying bird has never moved.” Is it moving or not?
zh_text: “飞鸟之景，未尝动也。”那是动还是没动呢？
source_text: “飞鸟之景，未尝动也。”那是动还是没动呢？
official_target_text: “The scene of a flying bird has never moved.” Is it moving or not?
official_en_text: “The scene of a flying bird has never moved.” Is it moving or not?

text: A mysterious past with no records...
I found something weird while going through the books in the library. Something... lost.
When histories are hidden, they're hidden for a reason.
To cover things up, to forget painful memories, or even to get benefit from doing so...
But whatever it is, the truth must be revealed.
More often than not, missing records are somehow related to the Restricted Ground.
Is this all a coincidence, or is there a connection we don't see? What exactly happened during that time?
If you're interested, ask Mr. Lin Xing in the Tower of Enlightenment.
Remember to put books back after reading!
Should I just tell the truth...? Will that make me look bad?
Oh, hi. I'm a Martial Arts student who works here part-time.
Master Fuzi always says that life itself is a form of training.
So I took this job as a delivery guy and used it as a way to train myself.
I'm waiting for some Sorcery students to pick up their orders.
But I actually came here a bit late. Ran into a few Rebels on the way.
I was wondering how I should explain it to them—trying to figure out an excuse that isn't lame so they won't leave negative reviews.
See ya! Let me know if you need a delivery.
Should I just tell the truth...? Will that make me look bad?
I've been researching the history of Sorcery Techniques. Something seems to be missing from the old documents.
That's strange. I wonder what really happened back then...
Should I ask Master Zhuangzi about it?
But his words are always so... cryptic. Not sure if I can understand them.
I'll have to ask Master Zhuangzi for advice when he returns.
No... The more I think about it, the more suspicious it seems. I'm sure I followed Mayene into the School of Sorcery that day.
I'm sure I wasn't seeing things.
It's just weird. How could anyone vanish like that?
Master Zhuangzi has a knack for finding talents. It was him who discovered Senior Shye.
That's understandable. Shye is also good at finding things. Treasures, actually.
I'd rather become someone like Senior Kongming.
Maybe one day, I'll be a legend of Jixia Academy too...
Zhou Yu will notice even the slightest flaw in melody.
Gardenia is cold in nature, but with a slight moderation with my Sorcery skills, it can be used to relieve depression...
There was a time when I often felt lost in herbology... It was Senior Shye who helped me regain confidence.
She suggested there might have been a deeper connection between herbs and Sorcery Techniques.
I've been focusing my direction of research in this area ever since.
Reading is a great way of improving my medical skills.
Dream within a dream, only to know it's a dream upon waking. Headmaster Zhuangzi wants to tell us that dream and reality coexist and contrast.
I'm Bai Shiyi, an instructor at the School of Sorcery. Welcome!
I'm here to answer students' questions. If you have any problems with your studies, feel free to come to me.
I enjoy discussing and exchanging ideas with students. I hope you will adapt quickly to the learning environment here.
Our Academy strives to provide a free and open studying environment. Anyone can learn Sorcery here.
You can browse books in the library, find friends who share the same hobby.
We also hold regular thematic lectures based on the students' learning progress and interests.
Goodbye. I hope you make the most out of your time at the School of Sorcery!
One dreams and then occupies the dream, only after waking does one know it was a dream. Dean Zhuangzi wants to tell us that dreams and reality are both symbiotic and relative.
zh_text: “梦之中又占其梦焉，觉而后知其梦也。”庄周院长想告诉我们，梦与觉既共生又相对。
source_text: “梦之中又占其梦焉，觉而后知其梦也。”庄周院长想告诉我们，梦与觉既共生又相对。

text: Ling Xin, let's go for the win and claim that crown!
Yu An, let's go, claim the title, steal the show!
Hey, keep your voice down! Are you doing it on purpose?
I'm just rooting for my senior. I can cheer just as well as you—I've got serious cheerleading chops!
Seems I've met my match! I lead our cheer squad. Care for a friendly cheer-off to see who can really rile up the crowd?
Great idea! Let's go find a tea shop and see who really has the skills!
Just look at how bustling the life in Jixia is! Everything is so clear from this terrace.
Hey there! I've been gathering fun anecdotes from around the academy. Want to hear the latest one?
You know Mayene from the School of Martial Arts, right? She's kind of a free spirit, does things her own way.
She often comes to the School of Sorcery to visit Master Zhuangzi—loves to feed his Bubble Fish.
She used to share her snacks with the Bubble Fish, but now that she's gone, the Bubble Fish is getting thinner.
That's too bad. But if you ever get curious, you know where to find me.
This is definitely the best viewing spot in Jixia!
I just saw Senior Qianshen. He upgraded his exclusive weapon. I'm so jealous!
I saw it too! The upgraded weapon makes him look even more handsome.
I really admire his patience. It takes forever to collect all those materials!
Yes. I get a headache every time I think about it. But I heard that if you have enough money, you can buy the materials from others.
I can't afford that. I'll just keep practicing my runes to get stronger.
But I really want to have my own weapon, just like Senior Wuyan's hammer. How cool would that be...?
Are we really going to sneak into the School of Sorcery? What if the administrator catch us?
Let's stay under the radar and perfect our device before the Sorcery students. It has to outshine the Power Rankings at Enlightenment Plaza.
You're right. A combination of Sorcery Energy and Mechcraft. We can't let anyone else know about this.
Alright, alright... If we pull this off, the Power Rankings will get a major shakeup. And then...
Imagine our names replacing Meng Ya and Sun Bin's—ain't that exciting!
Absolutely. Mastering both Sorcery and Mechcrafts could put us on par with Senior Kongming.
Hey, why haven't I seen those Star Team folks around lately?
Don't you know? They say they were all injured and are currently recovering.
Huh? Then, don't you think we should go take a look?
I met Senior Shye lately when I was in Oneirland!
That's to be expected. She's always hunting for treasures there.
I know, I know. But hear me out: my friends and I came across some kind of monster this time...
It was a creature I'd never seen before, appearing out of nowhere and tearing rifts in the air.
Right as it lunged at us, Senior Shye swooped down from above and subdued it in one move.
It was just amazing beyond words! I've joined her fan club already. She'll be my biggest role model!
That sounds pretty intense... Just how good is Senior Shye?
The Mu Ying Troupe is planning to visit Senior Xishi soon. Are you coming?
I definitely have to go. I've admired the senior for a long time.
Behave yourself when you get there. You can visit, but don't disturb them.
Hmm... The Cloud Crystal shows no abnormalities... yet it won't work... Is it an issue with insufficient Cloud Flow?
The Aerflow has never been abnormal for so many years... What on earth happened in the Aer-silkworm room?
I didn't know this is how the Sorcery Crystal channels their energy.
I'm a Crafter. Just observing the Sorcery Crystal of the School of Sorcery.

Just give up. If you can't even get the Sorcery Runes right, how could you remember those musical scores?

If anything unusual happens to it, there's going to be a lot of trouble.

Hmm, the Sorcery Crystal is running smoothly today.

Ahem... That was just my opening line. What I meant is, I'm a Cannoneer.

Me? I'd just make some small fireworks. Not dangerous at all.

Still, I can see why the Department of Discipline is watching you...

If I hadn't been having so many nightmares lately, I wouldn't have come here.
I heard Sima Yi also had trouble sleeping. What happened to him?
Croaky's fur feels s so comfortable!
Huh? Stop, stop it... Don't peck at my hand!

Haha, are you kidding me? The Fluffy isn't moving, but the table is a already complete disaster.
Woah, why are the books flying!? Gave me quite a scare!
Is this what Master Zhuangzi meant by walking in a Dreamscape?
Ah! This... how did this happen?
No, it's out of my control!
The key to performing Butterflies' Melody is to relax; a butterfly's flight is light and free.
Imagine yourself floating in the air. Feel the breeze as you rise with it.
Ugh, why can't I get this rune right? I am so stupid...
I... I'm afraid they'll laugh at me. Everyone can do this except me.
What if they talk behind my back? What if the teacher thinks I'm too dumb...?
You can ask your classmates for help.
You can ask your classmates for help.
Actually, they care about you a lot. You should give it a try.
Actually, they care about you a lot. You should give it a try.
You're doing this part wrong. Here, it should be done from the bottom up.
So that's why I've been failing to do it! Thank you so much!
No problem. I used to make that mistake all the time.
I'll try again. I'm sure this time I can get it right.
Why is this technique so difficult?!

When it comes to Sorcery Techniques, patience is key. Grace and poise are what we aim for.
The Butterflies Melody isn't that hard... but I'm so dumb I can't even learn something this simple.
Stop being so hard on yourself. It's normal to miss things when you're too close to the situation.
You're right. That's also why we practice together. Having others help is crucial for faster improvement.
Do you guys practice together often?
Master said Sorcery Techniques often require observers to spot errors.
That's why we often train together. But Tao...
No! Don't say that! I almost messed it up again. I don't want my teacher to think I'm stupid...
We make mistakes all the time too. And Ms. Xie was just giving advice, not calling anyone stupid.
It's alright, Chun Ge is just really nervous. Let's not put too much pressure on her.
Just take your time and let nature take its course.

Hi, I gathered feedback on our supply deal. Shall we discuss it?
Oh, you're from the Bookcloud Paper Shop. Your paper is indeed nice, but it's really too small and thin for our needs.
The new paper shop is willing to produce thicker, more durable paper. I'm still considering it.
Let's hear what our customer has to say! Sorry to keep you, but what kind of paper do you usually prefer?
Sorcery students prefer lighter paper for their studies.
They need to practice drawing runes. Thick paper is durable, but thin paper is better for controlling strength.
I see your point. Perhaps we should discuss it further.
I should've listened to my peers. Thank you.
Are you studying Mechcraft? Thick paper is necessary for designs that require frequent revisions.
But importing paper costs a fortune. If we reach a deal, we can offer affordable, high-quality paper in the future.
Oh? You mean your paper shop is willing to use your technology to expand our market?
That's unexpected. Let us discuss it. Thank you.
You must be a martial arts expert, not confined by the limitations of books. Sorry again.
Thank you for proving my point. This deal wouldn't have happened without your support.
Don't mention it. It was no trouble at all.
Don't mention it. It was no trouble at all.
The Academy's paper consumption has been high lately.
Must reach a deal with the School of Sorcery!
Has anyone used our paper before?
If you step on my zither, I'll make you pay for it.
No need to stand so close to listen.
Excuse me, you're blocking my view.
Hey! What did that guy tell you about the price of his clothes?
I didn't ask about the price, just that there would be a discount.
I didn't ask about the price, just that there would be a discount.
Another story? This guy's a real trickster!
Definitely! I spent a bunch of money on a one-of-a-kind fashion set.
Then I find the exact same outfit at the Academy gate for only half the price.
Considering what you said, he's totally ripping me off!
I just saw the list of goods left by Manliu, and indeed, there are two prices for the fashion set.
I just saw the list of goods left by Manliu, and indeed, there are two prices for the fashion set.
But shouldn't there be a difference if the prices are different? I need to talk to him.
I feel ripped off. Should I go back and confront him?
You owe me an explanation today. Why is the limited edition outfit you sold me available to someone else for half the price?
Calm down, let's talk this over.
You sold the same outfit to others for half the price. Aren't you ripping me off?
Ah, you don't know the whole story.
Your outfit is indeed limited edition and worth every coin.
But theirs looks just like mine!
Not quite! Yours is made of premium Aersilk with intricate stitching, much finer craftsmanship.
Really? Let me check with that person.
Plus, yours was modified by a famous designer, handcrafted to match the style of Sorcery students.
Really? Don't try to fool me!
Well, when you put it that way, it doesn't seem overpriced.
Next time, save the latest fashion for me.
Sure. You can get a membership here, you know...
How long has it been since Master Zhuangzi last taught a class?
Ever since the Dream Performance ended... isn't it normal for teachers to sleep in?
But it's the first time they haven't come to teach us for so long...
The writing paper from the new paper shop is so beautiful. It shimmers in the sunlight.
I agree, but their paper is too thick for drawing runes.

No wonder your notebooks are always so beautiful. The paper inside is different.
This book is really interesting. Do you want to take a look?
Hmm, Aerocakes... so soft and fragrant...
Wow! He got it right again. That's so accurate.
Are you here to visit the School of Sorcery?
Hello. Welcome to the School of Sorcery.
The Croaky is so cute. Want to pet it?
Watch it! Don't mess up my clothes!
I need to go now or it'll be sold out.
The latest collection from the Aersilk Workshop!

What are you trying to buy?
What are you trying to buy?
I have my eye on two items, but I can't decide. Can you help me with it?
Go for the short sleeve one.

The other one is sleeveless with a short hem. It's fresh and casual, with my favorite hero colors. Perfect for showing off at the Academy.
Yeah, I think this is the best value as well! Who can say no to a classic Aersilk piece?
That's what I thought! Wearing this would make me feel like a hero.

Progress comes from practice. You know what I admire about them? When they say they're going to spar, they mean it.

I want to be just like her...

If they coexist, how can they be opposites... I'm still confused, to be honest.
I was thinking that when we're awake during the day, we're also dreaming, just with our eyes open.
You've confused me more. How can a person be both awake and asleep?
Ms. Bai's explanation of dreams was really enlightening!
Understanding the essence of dreams is the only way to know if we are dreaming.
I got it first, so I'll read it first.
You always borrow a pile of books at once and then leave them untouched. Just give it to me.
This one is different; it has Kongming's personal notes in it. I'm definitely reading it.
Come on, you two. Stop bickering like children.

She's tall and beautiful like you two.
Haha, you flatter us. The latest trend now is classic weave.

Yes... but wouldn't you consider looking at something else?
I came all the way from the School of Martial Arts just to get that doll!
He's my mentor, and my spiritual leader. Do you understand this feeling?
I just think the doll looks silly, haha.

That's why I'm here, bringing you all the goodies.
I have two trending items here.
One is the captain of Team of Stars—Novar doll!
The other is the most popular among Sorcery students—Shye doll!
But you're too late, all the dolls have been reserved. I'll let you know when they're back in stock.
One is a figure of the shining Star Captain—Novar.

text: Jixia celebrity figurines! Step right up, don't miss out!
Why are you selling things here?
In the life of an Arcana student, there is never a shortage of beautiful things.
And the current trend is dolls modeled after famous figures of Jixia.
That's why I'm here, bringing you all the goodies.
What kind of dolls do you have for sale?
Hmm... let me see, there's also... the three great merchants of Jixia, the most handsome boatman in Jixia...
Hehe, sorry, student. A group of people came by earlier, saying they wanted to cheer for the Star Team, and they bought all the Star Team figures.
No way! This is my prized limited edition! It's for display only, not for sale!
I see... Tell me whose you want, and I'll be sure to bring it for you next time.
I can understand every word in these books, but not when they're put together.
Some theories are so convoluted. Today the teacher talked about how dreams and reality coexist and yet are opposites for a whole morning!
And how do you listen to your inner self? I prefer practical courses.
Though I'm a Mechcraft major, I find Sorcery courses captivating!
Missed some in Sorcery class today, I'm revising. Wish I were like Senior Kongming!
But why is the Sorcery Technique textbook so much thicker than ours?
This book is really hard to understand!
It's a reference book of rune examples...
From the Aercocoon to constellations, the nature is full of hints.
Runes are the application of these hints that Sorcery has understood.
But they are hard to grasp, and I still have much to learn.
Reading like this is really tiring.
I have no choice. I still have many books to ready...
The School of Sorcery library has the most books in Jixia, and the most concepts to read and memorize.
If only there was a spell to dump all the knowledge into my head...
I read all day. My eyes are so tired...
Petting the animals is really soothing.
It alleviates the fatigue of studying.
They are drawing Sorcery Circles everywhere. It's vandalism!
I've warned them so many times, but they just never listen.
Zhou Yu used to help keep them in line... But who can help me now?
But what about Scholarly Tigers? What are these cute little creatures thinking?
No wonder Librarian Scholarly Tiger recommended it... Is the world of dreams really that fascinating?
Tales of Phantasia. Master Zhuangzi recommended this book in his class. It's all about interesting Dreamscapes.
For example, someone dreamed of floating on clouds, using them as soft blankets, with birds singing lullabies.
It's so interesting. I want to visit the Oneirland one day...
Haha, you must be new here. It's the "director" of our library, a Scholarly Tiger.
It's really smart. It often patrols the Library of Philosophia, helping us find books and keeping us company while we read.
Okay, I'll go back to reading.
Dream on, a carefree journey awaits!
Is it okay to leave him like this?
Is it okay to leave him like this?
He had a weird dream. Why not just snap him out of it?
He had a weird dream. Why not just snap him out of it?
Do you think what he said was just a dream, or was it real?
He sounded so sure. What if it's true?
He sounded so sure. What if it's true?
Interesting thought. Maybe dreams are adventures of their own?
If I dreamed my Bubble Fish got stolen, I would wake up quite upset.
I once dreamed I became a legendary bird, soaring high above and looking down on Jixia.
The world floats in a sea of stars, and humans are just tiny specks of dust.
Life has an end, but dreams know no limits.
Haha... dream or reality, who can tell them apart?
Wait, my punch feels weak... Where did all my power go?
Training now? Are you seriously thinking about switching?
Training now? Are you seriously thinking about switching?
It was all just a dream. Wake up.
It was all just a dream. Wake up.
Good catch! But I need to get used to this body first.
I need to heal up, in case I get transported back.
Wait, wasn't I supposed to ask Master Zhuangzi how to get back?
I can still hear her voice. This can't be imagined.
Congrats, you've embarrassed yourself in front of everyone!
What do you know? You won't believe what I can do next. It'll blow your mind!
Master Zhuangzi, could you check on him? Looks like he's having a nightmare!
Who... who are you people? Where am I?!
No! This... this can't be! Where's my general tent? Where are my troops?!
Qu Chun, are you alright? Did your nap give you nightmares?
Pull yourself together. I've already called Master Zhuangzi!
What I just said... think of it as ramblings in a dream.
Not even in a dream can anyone steal my Bubble Fish.
Is this what students are into these days?
Hmm... I might just read it.
Reincarnated into the Overlord of Yong...
What happened? Take a deep breath.
Everyone, I must tell you something, and please, don't be frightened...
I am the very Chief Commander of Yong, Tianlong the Overlord.
What? Did that dream scramble your brain?
Ahem, Master, Tianlong the Overlord is the main character in a popular reincarnation novel.
It's called Reincarnated into the Overlord of Yong. It's the latest craze—everyone's reading it.
It may sound crazy, but I really am Tianlong the Overlord.
I've mastered every martial skill and I'm invincible in Yong! Even the emperor himself treats me with honor!
I was on my way to rescue the princess from bandits.
I opened the door, and suddenly, here I am!
Master, please! The princess will be terrified and crying without me!
If you go back with this body, can you still do Martial Arts?
Hmm? Good question, I need to test it.
Maybe I'll visit the School of Martial Arts and challenge Master Fuzi to see how it goes...
So the princess is all that matters?
Of course not! I'm a man of honor. Rescuing the princess is just part of my duty!
Well, someone like you, buried in ancient texts, might not know much about popular novels like this...
The Chief Commander of Yong, blessed with a natural martial physique!
Many Martial Arts students are my regulars.
My collection of training gear, secret guides, and equipment has it all!
Come and take a look, don't miss out!
Come take a look! You won't be disappointed!
It's just a small hole in the school banner, and it's not like the cannons have eyes. Now they want me to copy the rules fifty times?!
I mean, fifty times! My hands are meant for creating things, not this!
Didn't I invent a Mechanoid for this once? I wonder where it is now...
Oh no! Mayene borrowed it when she got punished by Master Fuzi last time!
Is she still at the Jixia Academy? What am I supposed to do now?
It hasn't been fixed after such a long time... In my opinion, this isn't a problem with the loom at all.
The Academy is definitely keeping something from us!
This way, the students can focus on their studies. It's amazing.
To me, it's like a flowing stream in the mountains.
It nourishes lives along its banks and eventually converges into a vast expanse.
So, what do you think of the Aerflow Weaver? A waterwheel? A dam?
Just like a lively source of flowing water.
The School of Mechcraft always impresses me with the designers' wits.
The Aerflow Weaver efficiently and smoothly connects three towers for transportation.
This part seems loose, doesn't it?
Does anyone remember the last step to fix this Mechanoid?
I remember it's five on the left, two on the right.
That's right, five on the left, two on the right. Tighten them in sequence.
But there's one more thing before that. Everyone should keep their thoughts to themselves and not remind others.
I don't recognize you. You're not from the School of Mechcrafts, right? Any thoughts, Anglu?
Ah... I haven't figured that out yet. I've read the books carefully, but I don't remember any such step...
Well, let me tell you a secret. Before tightening the screws, you need to tap them until you hear a click.
This Mechanoid is old. If you skip that step, the latch won't match up.
This step isn't actually written in the books. If you only know how to read books blindly, you won't be able to figure it out.
Mechcraft is all about how you combine different knowledge. That requires a lot of practice.
So my guess was right. This is the way to deal with old Mechcrafts we learned before!
No wonder following the book didn't work. I get it now...
Shh, hold on, let others have a chance to think, okay?
Xueze, I'm heading to Littoral Cave in a couple of days. Can I borrow your compass?
It broke the last time I took it treasure hunting. Its needle was spinning like crazy.
Then I ran into Senior Shye. She seemed interested, so I just gave it to her.
What, are you serious? Why would she take your compass if it was useless?
Is that so... Then my invention must be good, right?
Feels like I haven't seen Senior Sister Shye treasure hunting at the Academy in a long time...
Sigh, maybe I should make something else. If Senior smells it, she might come out.
Why do you talk about the senior sister like she's a ground wolf...
I wanted to sell their gadgets in town, but they wouldn't let me.
They insisted the Mechcrafts were experimental prototypes and not ready for mass production.
I even offered them a sixty percent cut! High risk, high return. But they just can't see it yet.
These students might seem easygoing, but they're actually quite stuffy.
As if supported by a pair of invisible hands...
Dashing Wings designed by Sun Bin must be impressive.
Let's see how high I can fly...
We're testing out Dashing Wings, inherited from Sun Bin. Doesn't the name alone sound impressive?
It could even help those afraid of heights realize their dream of flying!
You seem to admire Sun Bin.
Of course! You can doubt Mechcraft students at the academy, but if anyone doubts Sun Bin...
Well, as Mechcraft students, we know a bit about Martial Arts too!
Talking with my classmates recently, everyone seems worried about the weight of the Mechcrafts.
One or two parts don't weigh much. But an integrated Mechcraft packs a punch.
What if we blended Aersilk with meteoric ore?
Imagine a part that's strong and light like Aersilk, but with the texture of meteoric ore.
A part or two doesn't weigh much, but when assembled into a complete mechanism, it has quite a bit of heft.

text: I guess finding peace in chaos is also part of Sorcery training.
So this is how Mechcrafts are assembled.
The sound of gears turning, the roar of machines, the grinding of parts... All mixed together, yet all very distinct.
It's not easy to master both Mechcraft and Sorcery like Senior Kongming.
The Inspection Platform has really stopped... Could the rumors be true?
Who would've guessed that using the inspection table would be such a headache? I passed all the theory exams!
Theory is only part of the puzzle. Relax, get some more practice in.
It took me a good couple of days to really get the hang of it. And still no results yet.
Do you have any tricks? Your Mechcraft is the only one that passes inspection.
No secret tricks here. I failed many times before I finally passed. My instructor said it's all part of the learning process.
This... the inspection platform is unusable, so I guess there's no exam, right?
I checked it before, the mechanism itself is fine, the problem must be somewhere else...
Hmm... I'll go confirm with the teacher again.
It's normal to struggle with puppets.
I'm quite advanced in studying the Mech Core, but designing puppets is another story. I'm stuck.
Puppet is the hardest part of Mechcrafts. We're not all prodigies like Senior Yango. It's normal to reach a bottleneck.
Speaking of him, why don't we see his puppets around the academy? I really want to see them with my own eyes.
They say his puppets always stay with him, so we rarely get a chance to see them.
We're not as talented but we can work hard to make up for it.
That's right, but you can try your luck on Springbrook Plains if you really want to meet Senior Yango.
Our teacher mentioned that he's recently set up a trial there.
I promised a classmate a Mechcraft duel, but which one should I choose...
Yeah, I made two Mechcrafts, a Discipline Dog and an Aereader.
The Discipline Dog is highly sensitive, while Aereader is incredibly agile.
Someone challenged me to a Mechcraft performance test, and I can't decide who to take!
Haha, have you ever been chased by a Discipline Dog? Remember that fierce look?
But my Discipline Dog is more lively and cute, quite different from the original.
It would definitely catch people's attention!
Which one is stronger, Aereader or Bookworm?
Do you also think that the graceful Aereader better showcases the potential of Mechcraft?
But I'm new to this. This is the first time I've designed an Aereader, and I'm not sure if it's good enough.
But it's so beautiful. The elegant Mechcraft I envisioned is exactly like this. I should definitely share it with my classmates.
When can I see my work here?
We still have a long way to go.
Long time no see. Have you been working on any new Mechcrafts lately?
Not really, I've just been helping the Student Affairs Committee fix the Discipline Dog.
The Discipline Dog is broken? That sounds great...
It's a disaster for our credit if you fix it. Why not focus on something else?
Keep your balance and start smoothly!
You mean my Aerrider or me? Well, I'll take it as a compliment.
Spent a lot of time on its design. Cool, right?
If you're shy but want to make friends, Aerrider is a good choice.
With a little effort, you can attract a big crowd.
And if you're running late for class, it's your best bet!
Then why don't you head to the southeast to assist with the patrol? Remember to stay safe.
Yo, classmate, long time no see. How have you been lately?
Feels like there are fewer people around.
So I discussed it with everyone and decided to use the skateboard's superior mobility to assist the Lingyun Guard with patrols.
Ever since the Star Team was injured and the Dean went missing, monsters have been appearing, and many students are worried about their safety.
Although a large number of Lingyun Guards have been dispatched to patrol, we also want to do our part for the academy.
The little Mechcraft bird! This is amazing!
The School of Mechcraft is one of the three schools in Jixia. The students here are the most hands-on bunch you'll find.
The main halls, connected by the Aerflow Weaver, are where they study and craft.
The entire school is a marvel of engineering, showcasing the pinnacle of Mechcraft.
The current headmaster, Mozi, is also the founder of the school.
He's one of the Three Sages, known for his Mechcraft expertise. He inspired me to join the School of Mechcraft.
Sigh, if Dean Mozi hadn't been invited to Chang'an, we wouldn't be in such a predicament at this critical moment...
Cough, although the Academy's pride and joy, the Cloud-Weave Loom and the Plastic-Weave Loom, are temporarily out of commission.
But one can still glimpse the wonders of mechanism arts in every gear and every axle.
Besides, the loom is having some issues and can't be used... The production of cloud silk has also dropped significantly...
If the situation doesn't improve... the research on mechanism arts based on Cloud Silk will be severely hindered...
Have you seen the design I sent you yesterday?
I leafed through it. I'll give you more detailed feedback later.
So, what do you think? I have to say, I'm a genius.
I bet it would surprise everyone in the Designer's Square.
If you studied as hard as you invent these things, you'd be top of the class.
We should focus on mastering the basics first.
That sounds complicated. I prefer Sorcery—nothing beats using amazing Sorcery techniques!
Welcome to the School of Mechcraft. The campus is a bit complex, so take your time.
The School of Mechcraft is one of the three schools in Jixia. The students here are the most hands-on bunch you'll find.
The entire school is a marvel of engineering, showcasing the pinnacle of Mechcraft.
The current headmaster, Mozi, is also the founder of the school.
I'm here to test my guide Mechanoid, which was inspired by a junior who always gets lost...
With this, even someone like her can navigate complex terrain at ease.
The main halls, connected by the Aerflow Weaver, are where they study and craft.
He's one of the Three Sages, known for his Mechcraft expertise. He inspired me to join the School of Mechcraft.
Welcome to the School of Mechcraft.
We come to the academy every day, why do we still have to be interrogated!
Nothing I can do. These are special times, and Master Mozi is still in Chang'an...
We'll have Master Mozi decide for us then! I've been wronged so much!

Nothing I can do. These are special times, and Master Mozi is still in Chang'an...
We'll have Master Mozi decide for us then! I've been wronged so much!
Let's see who's next for delivery...
Hurry up! We still need to fix that Mechcraft dummy at the School of Martial Arts.
Why is it always us? Well, let's get this to Luban first—he's been waiting for days.
He is really busy. I saw him late one night, still up on the roof fixing things.
You're so cool. Everyone's looking over here.
As expected of you, the pride of the School of Mechcrafts, the benchmark of Mechcraft R&D.
People's lives and work will become much easier.
The Fabricator is not for making simple farming tools.
We should build more weapons to protect Jixia and make our mark just like Kongming.
Why would you think like that? Our purpose is to create for the people.
You're being naive. Mechcraft is power, and those with great power don't bother with trivialities.
I realize that I've never really known you.
Once the Fabricator is mass-produced, many tools we design will be available to the public.
Sigh, who would have thought that before the plastic weaving machines could even be mass-produced, the Cloud Flow would run into trouble...
Not all mechcraft requires Cloud Silk.
So, without Cloud Silk, there is no mechanism art in Haidu or Chang'an?
Now there won't be enough Cloud Silk to research mechanism arts...
Wow, the Mechcraft is really the pinnacle of Jixia's art. That's incredible!
You're far too kind. I'm just an ordinary student here.
Your Sorcery arrays are truly extraordinary. It's an eye-opener.
The Mechcrafts have a long history, with masters like Mozi and Yango coming out of it. These are things we can't compare to.
We just specialize in different fields. Your skills are also impressive.
Removing that part saves costs but reduces efficiency.
And it would make it difficult to pass inspections.
If we continue with the original design, funding will be the biggest issue.
My last funding request hasn't been approved yet. Maybe we should ask about it.
What if we run out of Aersilk?
After this period of study, I believe that while everyone has gained a lot of insight, you must also have many questions.
Let's use today's class to answer the questions you've encountered in your studies.
Which student has a question for the teacher?
This... the teacher understands your concerns. As long as the Cloud Flow exists, the Cloud Silk will not run out.
I believe the recent abnormalities are only temporary, and the academy will surely solve the problem.
This is the Fabricator—think of it as a smaller Aerweaver.
Remember what I said in class? It's our main tool for making parts.
These parts look very high-quality. Are they made from Aersilk? That's amazing.
What if we run out of Aersilk?
As long as we have the Aercocoon, we'll always have Aersilk, but we still shouldn't waste it.
Understood. I'll plan carefully before using the Fabricator.
Are you also here to learn about Aersilk weaving?
It seems simple, but to truly grasp Aersilk's properties, you need constant practice.
For example, this part can become ten times stronger by simply adjusting how it's woven.
Five on the left, two on the right, that's what it says.
It's two on the left, five on the right.
You've got it wrong. It's two on the left, five on the right.
You've got it wrong. It's two on the left, five on the right.
No way. I've read the book many times. It's five on the left.
Five on the left, two on the right, that's what it says.
Tap it and listen for a clicking sound.
Tap it and listen for a clicking sound.
Tapping it? Are you even listening to yourself?

The latch is not fully engaged. A few taps should make it fall off.
Well, shall we give it a shot? It's not like what we're doing is better.
It's two on the left, five on the right.

Thanks a lot, my friend. We couldn't have done it without you.
Don't mention it. It was no trouble at all.
Don't mention it. It was no trouble at all.
What's going on? We've done everything the book says.
We must be close now. Quick, check if there's anything about exceptions.
Nope, I've read those pages a hundred times.
See? Told you they'd get it done.
Impressive! They remembered even the smallest details.
Really? I don't think they did it by themselves...
Why are they taking so long? It's not that hard at all.
Don't worry, I'm sure they'll figure it out.
Does anyone remember the last step to fix this Mechanoid?
I remember it's five on the left, two on the right.
What do I always say in class? Details matter, guys.
Before tightening the screws, you must tap them until you hear a click.
The latch can no longer be fully sealed after years of use, so you have to knock it down manually.
No wonder they've been struggling with it for so long. Should we tell them about this?
No, let them figure it out themselves. Experience will always be the best teacher.
You've got the numbers right. But there's one more thing to do before that. Anyone?
You both did great. Exactly how I taught you in my class.
When faced with a problem, always dig deeper, kids.
What are you two arguing about?
What are you two arguing about?
Senior Shi Min is repairing a Mechcraft Kite, but one screw just won't fit the hole.
I suggested she take her time to position the screw right before tightening it. Nothing can go wrong, right?
But then this man came out of nowhere, insisting on doing the opposite.
Hey, just because I'm not from your school doesn't mean I can't have an opinion.
See? My idea isn't so bad.
He claimed that we should just use a hammer to pound it in. What a ridiculous idea!
Look at how she is struggling. Why not try the hammer? It might just solve your problem.
Whatever. So, why don't you tell us what you think: screwdriver or hammer?
Told you so. You should stay out of things you don't understand.
Watching you guys work makes me so exhausted. But fine, I'll back off.
If something goes wrong, it's on you.
This last screw just won't fit...
It's so frustrating... Hey, you two, stop arguing!
If I were her, I'd just hammer it in—it's much more efficient.
That's amateur advice. Using a screwdriver ensures precision.
Really? Alright, I'll give it a try.
Alright, alright... I admit, you were right.
If I adjust the angle like this... There! It finally fits!
The Mechcraft Kite is fixed, thanks to both of you!
Told you the screwdriver was the right choice. You're lucky we didn't go with your idea.
I'm not buying it. Maybe the angle was off?
Okay. We'll leave you to it then.
Uh-oh, the screw looks crooked. I hope it didn't break inside...
I warned you about using a hammer, didn't I? Anyway, let's find a way to fix this.
Enough... Just leave me alone. I'm sure I can do it.
I'm exhausted from carrying all these books. It's a real workout.
Seekers do need to make a study of history.
Can you make me a Mecharm like Luban's? It will help me carry books.
Haha, we already have something like that! Try the Aereader next time.
Can I borrow some scratch paper? I need to work on the design assignment from Master Mozi.
Spent all your money again, didn't you?
It's not about money, it's just... I've been keeping a low profile recently.
I knew it! That rogue little Mechanoid was your work, correct?
You heard about that? That little thing went to practice on the Martial Arts dummies for hours. Impressive, right?
To me? I don't know. But it sure is impressive to the Department of Discipline. They're searching for you.
I've noticed that the students here have been designing a lot of little Mechanoids lately...
Maybe they could help with recent problems in the Student Affairs Committee.
I'm really curious how they come up with so many offbeat ideas.
They design many interesting Mechcrafts, most of which are quite useful.
I wonder if we could turn these Mechanoids into tutors?
That way, everyone wouldn't have to scramble to take notes during class.
Goodbye. Maybe I can discuss this with the students here.
Why is this Discipline Dog still following me around? Look, I don't have any jerky on me, buddy.
Hey! Feeding Croakies isn't enough for you now? Discipline Dog, seriously?
That wasn't me! it was that glitchy auto feeder mistaking it for a pet.
The Crazy Idea List? That sounds like fun.
I'm always late for class, so a pair of Mechcraft shoes would be nice.
Using Aersilk for wigs? That's handy.
We should introduce this to the School of Sorcery. People would love it.
The Mechcraft students are so quiet. Didn't expect they could organize such cool contests.
Maybe we should try something at the School of Sorcery too.
I'll go see for myself at the Designer's Square.
A Mechcraft showdown? Is it as thrilling as a Martial Arts duel?
If only the Croaky Cannon could deal with divine-pattern monsters...
If I improve it a bit, maybe I can...
It's time to take these mechanisms out to soak up some sun. Mechanism design requires constant iteration, after all.
These are the first-generation versions of the Gugu Cannons and small automatons!
I must admit, no matter how well-designed these mechanisms are, they have their flaws...
For example, the arms of this little automaton fall off quite easily.
It is precisely because students constantly improve their experiments that we have designs that are always innovating.
Goodbye. I'll go back to keeping them in the sun.

Oh, nothing much. I'm a traveling Herbalist. I need to look around and see if anyone needs help.
I just can't afford to miss a sick student nearby.
Actually, I once asked someone to take care of these flowers and plants.
Looks like he really listened to me...
Now that we've visited both the Schools of Sorcery and Mechcrafts, what do you think?
So that's how puppets work! The School of Mechcraft is so fascinating!
I don't remember seeing you so perked up at the School of Sorcery. Got a thing for Senior Yango?
Well, that's part of it, but mostly...
I want to design a Mechanoid to help my mom with chores so she doesn't have to work so hard.
While strolling through the School of Mechcraft, I've seen many students pulling all-nighters with their projects.
I'm Loyan, an Herbalist. I'm responsible for helping students with their health issues.
Why is everyone staying up all night?
I hear they're all preparing for the Mechcraft showdown.
Indeed. You never know when inspiration will strike.
They really need to start looking after their bodies...
Be honest with me, did you spend all night on that Mechcraft again?
Haha, it's all thanks to that energizing potion you gave me last time. You're really good at your work!
But don't worry. I made sure to eat three meals a day, just like you advised!
Great, that saves you from the stomach medicine. I can give them to Luban now. That's really thoughtful of you!
Of course! Wait... that's a compliment, right?
Always jot down those spur-of-the-moment Mechcraft ideas.
Next, dive in and learn through practice.
Finally, you've got to love what you do to really stick with it.
Thank you! I understand all of them.
So, have you figured out what to give Zhan Xing for her birthday?
I'm thinking of a Mechcraft knife. Could be useful to her in the Enlightenment Trials.
So boring. Remember how Nora is her idol? I'm going to find out where she's been and then...
Hmph, and how exactly are you planning to do that?
And replacements for the Mechcraft dummies at the School of Martial Arts... again?
Let's see... These Mechcraft parts need to be shipped out...
Cannon parts to Obsidian Flame Training Hall for Meng Ya, Aero Irrigator sets to Harvest Fields...
Those rascals can break 800 dummies in a day!
The demand for parts has increased so much lately...
Cloud silk shortage... I wonder how much longer we can hold out...
It'd be great if we could establish a long-term collaboration with the School of Mechcraft for a steady supply of their products.
It's a win-win, though most people here are too stubborn to see that...
The mountains have been pretty restless recently.
We need to ask some Mechcraft students to upgrade our gear.
Yeah, we need to keep everyone safe.
When will Master Mozi return from Chang'an...
Bring it on, you big kid-eating... bull-looking monster!
The Student Affairs Committee thanks you and the other Mechcraft students.
The Discipline Dog was a huge help!
No problem. We're always happy to help our students with Mechcraft creations.
Do drop by when you have time.
By the way, someone was experimenting with cannons on the roof earlier. The Discipline Dog didn't catch them, though.
We're working on Mechcraft Kite improvements now for better aerial surveillance.
Exquisite decorations at affordable prices. Come take a look!
Let me know if you have any questions.
I mainly sell craft designs here. They're perfect for sprucing up your home.
Living in a beautiful space can lift your spirits!
There are many styles of furniture design. Some people like it elaborate, while others prefer it minimalist.
Many thanks to the School of Mechcraft for allowing us to visit every year.
It would be great if some of you could visit our place for lectures sometime.
Sorry... I don't think I can teach anyone just yet.
Besides... something happened at the academy recently, and we need to take measures ourselves.
We've received a lot of help from your academy over the years. If you ever need anything, just ask.
Many thanks to the School of Mechcraft for allowing us to visit every year.
It would be great if some of you could visit our place for lectures sometime.
Sorry... I don't think I can teach anyone just yet.
And I need to spend more time on my research. But I can ask Senior Sun Bin if he can help!
The more, the merrier! We welcome anyone from your school!
It was a really worthwhile trip.
It would be great if I could work with their creators...
I'm a wandering merchant. I'm here to check out the graduation works in this hall.
This room is filled with the latest in Mechcraft technology. It's truly amazing.
Which one has caught your eye?
I'm most impressed by the Fabricator. It uses Aerflow to create advanced Mechcrafts.
Such creation truly lives up to its reputation.
Well, I used to be a merchant, traveling wherever there was money to be made.
And then one stormy night, I slipped and fell into a ditch.
It was pitch black everywhere, and there was nothing to hold on to. Just as I lost hope, some Mecharm pulled me out.
I've been promoting Mechcrafts for the academy ever since.
The cutting-edge technology of the Academy in this room is truly breathtaking.
zh_text: 一房间机关学院的最前沿技术，实在是令人惊叹无比。
source_text: 一房间机关学院的最前沿技术，实在是令人惊叹无比。
official_target_text: The cutting-edge technology of the Academy in this room is truly breathtaking.
