text: It's time to take these mechanisms out to soak up some sun.
Let me see... This should work.
These are the first-generation versions of the Gugu Cannons and small automatons!
It's been gathering dust in the warehouse for a while, but given the current situation, I wanted to dig it out and see if anything is still useful.
I must admit, no matter how well-designed these mechanisms are, they have their flaws.
For example, the arms of this little automaton fall off quite easily.
It is precisely because students constantly improve their experiments that we have designs that are always innovating.
Goodbye. Looks like it needs some maintenance before it can be used again...
Could the Star Team be my lucky star?
Ever since the members of the Star Team stopped showing up, business has plummeted...
Hope there's no roll call at today's cannon class... Anyway, won't make a difference now.
Back to my research. What topic should I pick...
Gah! Don't sneak up on me like that! My nerves are all fried from pulling an all-nighter!
I'm finding the class too easy. It's my own project that's troubling me now...
I'd love to get some advice from Luban, but he's nowhere to be found.
Yeah, I once took a course at the Obsidian Flame Training Hall. Learned everything about it already.
If you really want to excel, Meng Ya is the one to look to.
His hot temper, though... I'd be careful around him.
Go on then. I must get started now.
Hope there's no roll call at today's cannon class... Anyway, won't make a difference now.
What should I research for my project?
Did you skip class to come out?
Gah! Don't sneak up on me like that! My nerves are all fried from pulling an all-nighter!
I have already mastered the course content thoroughly, and now I'm busy with my own research project.
I made some progress talking to Uncle Ban last time, I was planning to go talk to him again...
I'll work hard on my own, and next time I see Uncle Ban, I'll give him a surprise.
Yeah, I once took a course at the Obsidian Flame Training Hall. Learned everything about it already.
If you really want to excel, Meng Ya is the one to look to.
The teacher said in class last time that the academy has been much quieter since the senior left...
I wish you could get better sooner, Senior...
Go on then. I must get started now.
What are you doing? You broke it!
Wait, why did this Mechcraft come back on its own? Is it broken?
There's a small problem... but I'll fix it soon!
I'm good at it! Why don't you take a look around?
Huh? Why are you back so soon?
If you want to listen to the class, sit over there.
If the loom keeps stopping like this, the cloud silk will keep getting scarcer...
Then what materials should I use to iterate on my culinary mechanisms in the future...
What kind of Mechanoid has a tracking system?
Goodbye. Come by again if you want to learn more about Mechcrafts.
Thank you for your time. This should encourage the others to participate.
Last question: Who founded the School of Mechcraft?
Correct! The School of Mechcraft was founded by Master Mozi, one of the Three Sages.
Goodbye. Come by again if you want to learn more.
It's a quiz for new students, but there haven't been enough participants to keep it going.
We've tried to get more students to join, but they're afraid of embarrassing themselves...
We need someone to get things started. Can you be that person for us?
Wrong answer. Mechcraft Kites are used for aerial patrols only. They don't have tracking capabilities yet.
Correct! Discipline Dogs are equipped with a tracking unit that reacts to rule violations in real time.
That's why you often see them chasing rule-breakers around campus. Meng Ya sure has something to say about this, haha!
Umm... He's too young for that, I'm afraid.
Nope. Luban is still student at the academy, just like everyone else here.
Wrong. Aereaders only follow their pre-programmed routes. Tracking is not their thing.
Get down now, the Student Affairs Committee will be here any minute.
Why do you look so pale? And look at those dark circles...
Hey, check out our latest invention!
How about it? Doesn't look too bad, right?
How about it? Doesn't look too bad, right?
If you're interested, take a look.
Welcome to the School of Mechcraft.
If you've never been here before, I promise you're in for a treat!
Come check out my latest invention!
Believe me, you'll love it when you see it!
I sent a little Mechanoid to the class for me. I hope it doesn't break down.
Ugh, it's just too much stress. There's endless work and studying is getting harder and harder.
I've pulled a few all-nighters in a row, but I still can't keep up with the work.
Avoiding it won't solve the problem.
Maybe you're right, but I just want to be alone.
True, but when I think of all the unfinished projects waiting for me, it gives me a headache.
Any damage to the Mechcraft will be charged.
Watch out, you might hit someone!
New student, huh? You made the right choice joining us!
Welcome to the School of Mechcraft! You'll definitely learn a lot of unexpected things here!
Hi! Haven't seen you around before. Are you new here?
Plus, don't miss out on the Mechcraft showdown that happens every night!
We also have our newly developed Mechanoid, and the food it cooks is just as good as that of the Gourmets!
Hi, have you come to watch the Mechcraft showdown? I've learned a lot here these past few days.
Now if it were up to me, I'd boost the wings for more power. Have it fly as high as the Tower of Enlightenment.
Maybe I should discuss this with Senior Sun Bin... Would be so cool if it works.
When will Senior Sun Bin wake up...
The wings are finished... but I haven't properly thanked him yet...
Hi, are you here to watch the Mechcraft showdown?
Yeah, every night the students here have these amazing showdowns.
So, who do you think has the best Mechanoid?
Good eye. She's put a lot of work into this. I wonder if she's going to win.
Indeed, but Ye Chiu's isn't bad either. Tough choice.
We're running a quiz for new students. Feel free to give it a try!
I don't know... It'd be so embarrassing to fail.
It's okay, you're not from our school. Just think of it as a game!
Come on, let's get in line!
Come on, guys! Don't be shy!
Please make some space in the back, guys!
No, no, that's Mr. Gong's quiz. I'm not doing it first.
You believe him, you might as well believe I could build a Luban XVIII.
Qiuxiang, you're the best student among us. Why don't you give it a try?
But it's meant for new students. Mr. Gong said it's not that difficult.
Haha, I guess you have a point.
Still, you go first. I want to see how you do it.
The Aereader looks a bit more fun.
The Discipline Dog looks cuter, indeed!
Dialogue of choosing the Discipline Dog.
The Discipline Dog does seem stronger.
I made two Mechcrafts, the Discipline Dog and Aereader.
I'm preparing for a showdown, but I can't decide which one to use.
Not much, really. They perform about the same, just look and function differently.
Hmm, the Discipline Dog... might work!
The Aereader has been tweaked a lot. It might just win!
See you. I'll think about it.
Ugh, I'm completely out of ideas.
Senior Sun Bin, what should we do?
Time is running out, we can't just let Master Mozi keep putting this off!
I... I'll figure something out. We'll get Master Mozi to sign off on this today, one way or another.
What is it? Don't tell me I forgot another deadline...
The Mechcraft Kite upgrade proposals... surely those can wait until next week...
Sounds like you've got quite the backlog, Master Mozi.
Sounds like you've got quite the backlog, Master Mozi.
When you're stretched thin, things have a habit of piling up. That's forgivable once in a while, don't you think?
The discussion about mentor assignments... I think that got postponed...
Haha. Keeping the school running is vastly more complicated than repairing any machine.
Seven minutes and thirty-four seconds to go... Can't believe we made it.
Master Mozi has a tough job.
Master Mozi has a tough job.
Being Headmaster is less about his own research, and more about inspiring his students to stay curious and keep experimenting.
Being Headmaster is less about his own research, and more about inspiring his students to stay curious and keep experimenting.
Exactly. That's why every Mechcraft student looks up to him.
Thanks again for today. Let's hope next year he doesn't leave it until the last minute.
Did you hear that? Master Mozi praised my work!
So... did all our projects get approved?
I think so? Do we start at the same time?
Oh no, we forgot to ask!
These are all wonderful ideas! I say we approve them all...
Master Mozi, we don't have the budget to fully fund all of them...
I'll assign mentors to guide your research, and I'll personally see to it that you all get the lab space you need.
Spend wisely, and we can achieve great things. Together, we'll make all of these projects happen.
Reality strikes again. But brilliant ideas shouldn't be held back by lack of funding.
We'll have to scale back the budget for each project. But don't you worry...
What do you think, Master Mozi?
Headmaster, I'm working on the Auto Dressing Pod.
The only issue is... the machine's fashion sense needs work.
A red floral jacket with green heels...
It'll launch someone straight from the dorms to the top of Jixia Mountain in no time.
The landing's still a bit rough, but we're working on that!
If this works, I'm sure Master Fuzi would be interested.
It's safe, climate-controlled, and comes with an adjustable massager!
A tank top and leggings with black dress shoes...
So it yeets you out of bed?
Hmm. I've heard the Martial Arts students are always late to their morning drills.
Master Mozi, I'm working on a next-generation Mechcraft Research Suit.
I'm working on the Commuter Catapult.
Mechcraft students are terrible at getting dressed. This pod sorts that out in seconds.
Perhaps it will finally stop our students from wearing their pants as scarves...
And fashion is subjective, anyway. Honestly, I don't see anything wrong with these styles.
The outfit's built with a variety of common tools, prepping you for the most challenging research conditions.
The only downside is the weight. Putting the thing on is a workout in itself...
Excellent! Very practical, with a thorough understanding of real-world use cases. I'm impressed.
The thermoregulation and massager sound intriguing. Hmm... perhaps I should try them myself.
As for the trouble putting it on... why don't you team up with Miss Su here? Her Dressing Pod could help!
We'll leave you to it, then, Master Mozi.
What's everyone doing here? Sun Bin, are you in some kind of trouble?
What's everyone doing here? Sun Bin, are you in some kind of trouble?
Oh, it's you! We're trying to get the budget approved.
Knowing him, he's going to find a way to dodge it again.
So I wanted to ask... could you come with me?
Of course. I've got your back.
I'm sure he won't put it off in front of you.
Master Mozi's procrastinating again. I've reminded him a dozen times, but he always manages to change the subject...
Today is the last day to approve these budgets.
Ah... I think I feel a headache coming on...
Wait... I almost fell for that again.
All three applicants are waiting here right now because they've heard nothing back.
Oh! I just remembered, I left my Mechcraft armor out to dry. Maybe we could come back a little later and...
Why don't we get it over with now? We can listen to the pitches with you. It won't take long.
Why don't we get it over with now? We can listen to the pitches with you. It won't take long.
Fantastic! Alright, everyone, please go ahead with your spiel.
Master Mozi, we really need these budgets approved today.
Master Mozi, we're really out of time.
Master Mozi, we're really out of time.
Sigh... I suppose I shouldn't set a bad example for our new student. Let's hear them.
The three applicants' projects haven't received a response, so they came to the academy today.
zh_text: 三位申请人的课题迟迟没得到回复，今天都找来学院了。
source_text: 三位申请人的课题迟迟没得到回复，今天都找来学院了。
official_target_text: The three applicants' projects haven't received a response, so they came to the academy today.
official_en_text: The three applicants' projects haven't received a response, so they came to the academy today.

text: I spent half of savings on this manuscript from Kongming. It better be worth it.
Wow, look at this! I... have no idea what I'm looking at.
Maybe I should start with the notes.
High-Polymer Mech Core Drive, Aersilk Bearings... fusion with some kind of Sorcery Technique, blah blah...
Is this even meant for humans to read?
Well, guess that's how special Kongming's manuscript is.
I must make sense of it! Even if this means staying up all night!
Headmaster Mozi and Luban once had quite an argument over the design of our Fabricator.
Their relationship is quite complicated. Outsiders may never understand it.
The last time I went to Frostcloud Town with my teacher, they chased us all the way.
If my teacher hadn't used Mechanoid Puppets to distract them, I don't know what would have happened.
I've heard that they're also studying Mechcraft, but their methods are not up to standard.
I'm worried that they might create something dangerous.
There's been some disturbances down the hill lately. Rebels, huh?
I joined the School of Mechcrafts to escape this, but nope, still stuck reading all day!
I'm here because I trust the honest seniors.
Is reading too much really that bad?
Designs are fine, but theory texts are a headache.
I'm an intuitive genius. Too much theory only confuses me.
Why did you choose the School of Mechcraft?
It all started with the recruitment promotion.
Back then, seniors from all schools surrounded me, praising my elegance and charm...
Then a senior who looked very honest stuffed a promotional poster into my hands and left. I thought to myself, interesting, it's you.
He just wanted to lure me into his trap.
This was such a busy day. I hardly had time to breathe.
I have a bunch of new Mechcrafts waiting to be tested, plus some extra work assigned by Master Fuzi.
I've been doing this for years, but I've never seen these tools used in the academy.
No matter how much I asked, he either said nothing or pretended not to know. It's frustrating...
Fuzi wanted me to prepare a batch of farm tools, but didn't say where they would be used.
I was swamped before, but now I'm finally free...
Not happy even when you're free?
Not happy even when you're free?
Cloud silk is getting scarcer, and we can't make the farming mechanisms... None of the three Deans are anywhere to be seen...
What's there to be happy about...
Strange. Aren't we supposed to meet in the Engineering Hall?
Those two have been acting strangely lately...
I never knew Master Mozi would care so much about the aesthetic design of Mechcrafts. Now what should I do...
Functionality, that's your thing. Aesthetic taste, on the other hand, you do need to work on that.
That's why I'm asking for your help! Come on, give me some tips!
Try finding inspiration from Jixia's landscapes. Or listen to the Musicians' performances.
Oh, and there's Senior Yango's puppet show. That's really something else.
Do you want to join my classes? Just find Xingzhi over there to register.
When I was little, I cried a lot and threw away every toy I was given, until I got a Mechcraft part.
Master Mozi is quite a character.
The new students always address me respectfully, making me feel old.
In fact, they show respect to everyone, which is really nice of them.
So, I've always been interested in Mechcraft. It must be fate.
I once saw him using Yango's Mechanoid Puppets to catch fish down the hill.
We must take tolerance and combinations into consideration.
The Aersilk is versatile, but the principles of Mechcrafts cannot be ignored.
Long and heavy parts should be placed on the bottom and short and light parts should be placed on the top.
The art of construction lies in following the law of nature.
Follow the principles, adhere to the methods, and avoid unfounded assumptions.
Mechanoid Puppets are at risk of malfunctioning or getting lost due to their complex structures.
I've been exploring ways to secure them for years. Recently, I had the help of Wennon.
We've implemented traditional methods such as key locks and launchers that have passed inspection. Now we're looking at more innovative solutions.
For example, how about unlocking with the puppet owner's voice or recognizing the owner's eyes?
I've been swamped lately, putting off many of my own tasks.
Oh, it's you! Didn't expect we'd meet here.
What've you been up to lately?
Same as usual, studying ancient Mechcrafts and trying to invent something.
Normally, this would be easy for me. But recently, I've been working as Luban's assistant.
Though Luban is a legend and I'm really interested in his projects, I don't have any personal time when I'm busy.
Oh, that? I've been swamped lately, haven't seen Yoling in ages.
After all, everyone needs companions to broaden their horizons and boost creativity.
Anyway, I really want to see her after I'm done. And please, keep this a secret.
So many parts have broken down lately, and replacing them would cost a fortune. What should I do...?
This goes on, and I might start taking parts off Discipline Dogs.
Maybe I should start a Mechanoid part scrapping business. Could fund my research.
The Mechcraft students are as spirited as ever!
Are you serious, Dad? I just saw someone almost pass out while walking...
I'm talking about the look in their eyes—that passion you only see in someone who truly loves what they do.
I used to have that look too.
It's okay, kid. I just want you to always follow your heart when making big decisions in your life.
Don't let anyone change your mind, not even those closest to you... You don't want to live with regrets.
Aersilk is light and bright, but it's incredibly strong and flexible. When gathered and shaped, it can be used to craft various Mechcraft parts.
Respect for teachers is essential. Those who daydream or sleep in class should be disciplined.
The Mech Core is essential for all Mechcrafts. Some students spend decades just mastering this one aspect.
Students, the loom is temporarily malfunctioning and cannot be used.
Of course, this is only temporary. The academy is actively repairing it, and it will be back to normal in a while.
We won't fall behind in our studies. For this period, we will focus our teaching on the theoretical framework of the loom.
When Wuyan was a student here, she really gave us teachers a hard time.
But this new Hammer Mechanoid model is no longer the useless scrap metal it once was.
I do miss those old days... Helped me become a better teacher.
At the time, our technology was still immature—the shell wasn't tough enough, and it wasn't compatible with the Mech Core.
Now its defensive capabilities are on a whole different level. I'd like to see who can break it now.
Although she can be quite noisy, we have her to thank for realizing our shortcomings.
They say the Hammer Mechanoid's weapon design was inspired by Wuyan's hammer.
I can recite these theories backwards by now.
I'd rather spend my time preparing for tonight's showdown, even though Ping Yin has no chance against me...
Bring it on. What's special about your dog?
I've spent six months developing the legs of my Sky Swallower. It's powered by a self-driving core.
It can jump over a mountain to better monitor students.
What's the use of that? My "Eat What You're Given" food delivery robot is much more practical.
It scans students in real-time to identify picky eaters and customizes a nutritious meal for them.
Just food delivery? Wait... so you basically just force them to eat what you think is healthy. That's ridiculous!
The showdown isn't just about creativity. The instructors said practicality is key.
Let's stop arguing and see who the winner is. The opinion of the majority will decide.
I knew Ye Chiu could pull it off. His design is amazing. I wonder what the instructors will think.
I still think Ping Yin's creation is better—more practical. And I need some food to feed my brain.
You're just hungry. Ping Yin's work looks like a class assignment. It lacks originality.
I've gone over the Mech Core principles four times, but I'm still grappling with some of the finer details.
Xun Rihua seems lost in thought again. Probably thinking of some ideas out of boredom.
Ugh, kinda envious of his talent.
Hopefully, my hard work will pay off. If I listen to a few more explanations, my foundation should get stronger.
Different types of Mechcrafts use different Mech Cores.
Each Mech Core operates under different principles, and I always get them mixed up.
I guess I'll have to find a way to memorize everything.
Unlike Xun Rihua, who seems to have a unique way of understanding things.
He says you should observe patterns in things, but I just can't wrap my head around it.
Oh no, the theoretical framework of the loom? Something so complex... can I learn it?
Ugh, kinda envious of his talent.
Sigh, don't get me started. I haven't even fully mastered the principles of my mechanism core, and now there's something even harder...
What are we going to do if this keeps up...
I guess I'll have to find a way to memorize everything.
To be honest, at first I looked down on Xun Rihua a bit. Every time the teacher was lecturing, he would be slacking off on the side...
But no matter the subject, he always learns it much faster than I do...
I actually envy him a little now.
Data collection's done. How about we go rafting? I promise our raft will be sturdy this time.
Seriously? You're not afraid of getting caught by the teachers?
No worries. I heard that Mayene also played there before. If she's okay, we're okay.
She's faster than Discipline Dogs, and we're just two tech nerds. It's not the same thing at all.
Like those who keep looking around and staring at the Mechcraft. "Suspicious" is written all over their faces.
Humph. With me here, she won't cause any trouble.
Our duty is to keep an eye on those who act suspiciously.
There are too many visitors to the School of Mechcraft.
We've been getting more complaints lately—roof tiles blown up, gardens raided...
Can't those people rein it in just a little bit?
Why are we back on Mech Core principles?
Maybe I should bring my Croaky puppet to class.
Hands-on learning might be easier than pure theory. Plus, the puppet is so cute!
Rehashing the basics over and over is pointless.
I've already mastered this simple knowledge.
Just remember: Flow doesn't appear or disappear out of nowhere.
The Mech Core runs on Flow. You'll understand this by observing patterns in real life.
Are we starting the lecture on the theoretical structure of the loom?
Finally, something challenging! But this level of difficulty won't stump me!
Tsk, as expected of the most famous large-scale mechanism in the School of Mechcraft... it has several mechanism cores alone.
Relying on the shaft and gears to operate, the power is transmitted to every corner of the loom.
At the same time, it is equipped with the highest-spec intelligent module, allowing it to learn and assist the user's thought process.
Learning isn't just about reading books. As a student of the School of Mechcraft, while theoretical knowledge is important, practice is even more so!
Only by making and observing it yourself can you better understand the role that every gear and every shaft plays in it.
I will! Definitely! Pass! The physical test!
Is my sword not sharp enough? I'd love to learn how Novar's sword was forged.
Blades are sharp. Please be careful around here.
I want two Super Thick Pancakes.
But my teeth hurt. Not sure if I can eat them.
When can I stop? My arm's so sore.
Uh... can you stop staring at me?
I get all stiff when people stare. Can't even practice properly...
Xueping, the exam's coming up soon. Are you ready?
Don't even mention it. I've been dozing off all day. How about you?
Same. I've been out of it and haven't trained with the dummy in ages.
I saw you meditate all night, then read tactics at dawn.
You did? Did you stay up all night, too?
Relax and tense, move and be still...
What is the Meditation Hall for?
A strong body must be matched by a strong mind.
Students use Aerflow for cleansing and meditation.
You can start by taking slow, deep breaths.
Calm your thoughts and accept the emptiness.
Tension and relaxation, movement and stillness...
official_target_text: Tension and relaxation, movement and stillness...
official_en_text: Tension and relaxation, movement and stillness...

text: What is the Hall of Contemplation for?
A powerful body requires a powerful mind to master.
Originally... students could use the cloud flow on the Flowing Cloud Platform to wash their bodies, meditate, and breathe, to center themselves.
But the cloud flow has decreased, so it's not as effective for cleansing the body, though meditation and breathing exercises are still good for cultivating the mind.
Don't worry too much, this is definitely just temporary. I suspect... the Cloud Silkworm isn't feeling well!
You can start by taking slow, deep breaths.
Calm your thoughts and accept the emptiness.
Focus on one realm, and harbor no delusions.
The Hall of Meditation is a place where martial arts students hone their character and temper their will through meditation.
I'm here to make friends and help each other.
When there's no rush, rest. Don't exhaust yourself.
We should enjoy life in the moment. That's my philosophy.
It's so boring without Mayene here. I miss the days when we used to slack off together.
I enjoy finding moments to relax.
I don't need nonstop training. I've passed every test.
Haha, Mayene is famous for skipping class. Used to spot her up there all the time.
She trained little yet excelled easily in Martial Arts.
Just keep this between us, okay? Bye.
But I haven't seen her around much lately. I really miss her.
A perfect day to take a break...
The students in Herb Garden need them now.
This will be a nice workout!
I've trained hard. Do you think I can excel in all three schools?
Forget it. You're chasing a pipe dream.
Why do you always doubt me?
Let's be real. Even Mayene, a Martial Arts prodigy, scored zero in Sorcery.
Proper recovery is crucial with daily training!
I'm Yingwen, responsible for managing the students' health and well-being.
They need to focus more on their health.
I'm preparing medicine for these two.
They've been overtraining and need to recover.
But it's tough. These students rarely take advice.
If you're looking to improve your health, take a look at these herbs.
The equipment for the new students this year is heavier than what we had.
It was Master Fuzi's decision. I hear this year's batch is exceptionally talented.
Take another kick! I'm going to kick three hundred times today!
zh_text: 我再踢！今天要踢够三百下！
source_text: 我再踢！今天要踢够三百下！

text: They say it was smashed by Wuyan during her fight with Lian Po.
She's so strong. Imagine how fierce that fight was.
If only I could reach that level someday.
What's so good about the dried fish Mayene raves about? I'm dying to try them.
The academy should host an eating contest. I'd win easily.
Why does my punch feel so weak?
Maybe I'm not doing it right?
Since I don't have Kongming's talent, I need to compensate with ten times the effort.
Hey there, interested in joining the Hunting Society and conquering beasts?
No! The Angling Society is where it's at.
Join the Hunting Society and roam Jixia with beasts at your side!
Join the Angling Society, and with a simple cast of the line, reap the rewards effortlessly.
No thanks, the training at the School of Martial Arts is more than enough for now.
Meditation is meant to train the mind; Cloud Flow tempering is an aid, not the goal.
Now that the cloud flow concentration is lower, it's easier to see how one's heart-training has been going.
Slash sideways, thrust up, then end with a sleek sword sheath.
That's my signature Cyclone Sword Technique, simply stunning!
Li Bai became famous overnight after carving his name at the Phoenix Gate.
Why do I get punished for carving on a pillar?
Maybe because my carving wasn't in a prominent enough place...
It must be that the place I carved isn't conspicuous enough...
zh_text: 一定是我刻的地方还不够显眼……
source_text: 一定是我刻的地方还不够显眼……
official_target_text: It must be that the place I carved isn't conspicuous enough...
official_en_text: It must be that the place I carved isn't conspicuous enough...

text: Meditating isn't a walk in the park.
This Meditation Hall is the heart of the School of Martial Arts.
Students meditate in Aerflow to learn proper breathing techniques.
Many find it hard and doubt its benefits.
They don't get that it requires quieting the mind.
Martial Arts training is about building up bit by bit.
The hall helps internalize daily practices for genuine benefits.
Hey, hey, wait. I need to talk to you.
You lost to me. Can't accept it?
I accepted it. I... I just...
Make it quick. I'm going to the canteen soon.
I just wanted to ask if... well, if you'd like to grab a bite with me?
Oh, I thought it was something serious. Sure, let's go.
Where's Meng Choo? We're about to grab a meal after class.
It's too loud out there. I'm staying here.
I'm Xinqing from Roaring Tiger Training Hall.
Swords gleaming and fists whipping up wind. There's no shortage of promising students here.
My master sent me here to poach a few... oh, to admire the students' skills, I mean.
I'm here practicing... and seeing how everyone else is doing.
I see that some female students are especially outstanding. They remind me of Wuyan.
I heard Master Fuzi once knocked down the central Mechanoid in the arena with just a wave of his hand.
Really? Too bad I didn't get to see it for myself.
When will we ever reach that level?
I'm not aiming that high. My goal is to spar with Novar.
Master taught us not to be arrogant or complacent...
Hmm... the Master isn't here, so we need to be even more careful...
Even though the Master is away, I must not forget his teachings...
What did Master Fuzi say in class again?
This is how you make the move, right?
Finally, a chance to relax. Surely no one will find me here...
What have you learned from watching?
I'm not slacking, I'm watching and learning.
These two have been competing forever without a clear winner.
Maybe today's the day. I have to witness it.
From what I've seen, Wong Bowen has better stamina, but his skills need work.
Sheng Yun is more balanced, but tends to get impatient.
I'm just curious to see who comes out on top. Otherwise, I wouldn't have watched for so long.
If Master were still here... I wouldn't feel so troubled all the time, would I...
No, I can't keep feeling down like this. I need to temper my spirit...
I heard Shangguan will join the Chang'an Envoys. She wields her ink brush as skillfully as a sword, blending power with elegance.
I'd love to travel the world as freely as she does.
I must say, there are some promising new students.
Ah, we'll be left behind soon if we don't keep up.
We started at the School of Martial Arts and trained relentlessly.
We focused solely on our goals and ignored everything else...
Thankfully our hard work paid off. We made it to the Aerwatch.
Time to visit our masters. It's been a while.
These Fuzi Lamps make everything feel so warm. No wonder the juniors are so energetic, just like we were back then.
It's a little different, though. When we were training at the academy, these lights weren't fully installed.
Hmm... Doesn't look like a suspicious person...
Hmm... Doesn't look like a suspicious person...
There's a target over there. Why did this arrow land here?
I heard he's been secretly training. Maybe he sneaked in at night to sharpen his skills.
Isn't there a target right there? Why did you shoot the arrow here instead?
I guess... could it be Novar?
Wait... isn't Novar still recovering? You said that last time too...
Could it be that you did it!
He's still drumming? Doesn't he get tired?
If he's not stopping, neither am I!
I hope the sound of these drums can inspire everyone!
The medicine is so bitter. I can't take another sip.
Yeah, and seven more days to go... let's sneak out.
Thinking the same thing. Plus, we've got more training to do.
Right, let's escape when Yingwen's not around.
Weren't we supposed to check the mountain region? Why are we here?
There are a lot of wild beasts in the mountains. We need extra hands.
Why didn't you say that earlier? Those two on the stakes look pretty capable.
We will ask the winner to join us for exploration.
Let's ask the winner to join us for the inspection later.
zh_text: 一会就拜托赢了的人陪咱们去考察吧。
source_text: 一会就拜托赢了的人陪咱们去考察吧。
official_target_text: Let's ask the winner to join us for the inspection later.
official_en_text: Let's ask the winner to join us for the inspection later.

text: Looks like we're about to see a result.
That one doesn't seem like this student will hold on much longer.
Looks like the other one is going to be the winner.
I guess we've found ourselves an elite.
But to maintain peace longer, you need even greater skills.
That's why I joined Jixia Academy to learn non-violent conflict resolution.
Don't let my age fool you. Back in my day, I held my own on the Great Wall.
Relax, just like you usually do!
Why did you ask me to meet you so late, and why all the secrecy? Don't tell me it's...
I've been hesitating for a long time. I wasn't sure if I should give this to you.
A letter? What's written on it?
It's the secret recipe for "Three Ofishial Defeats" from the snack stand. I went to great lengths to get it!
It's the secret recipe for "Three Ofishial Defeats" from the snack stand. I went to great lengths to get it!
zh_text: 小吃摊三味鲜粥的食谱秘方，我好不容易才搞到的！
source_text: 小吃摊三味鲜粥的食谱秘方，我好不容易才搞到的！
official_target_text: It's the secret recipe for "Three Ofishial Defeats" from the snack stand. I went to great lengths to get it!
official_en_text: It's the secret recipe for "Three Ofishial Defeats" from the snack stand. I went to great lengths to get it!

text: It's quieter here at night... not as bustling as during the day.
I actually prefer it this way. Training in the evening breeze is quite nice.
I want the freshly cooked ones. I don't mind waiting a bit.
Too hot? Perfect, the heat helps me build endurance.
I want Super Thick Pancake too.
Hmm... maybe I should have them all.
Retreating to advance is my favorite tactic.
I'm explaining tactics. Do you guys still want to listen, or am I being too wordy?
We... Well, we love it. Just keep going.
Yeah, great, but a bit lengthy. I'm so sleepy...
Yes, it's my personal philosophy. It's about...
It seems you didn't get it. Let me explain again...
Again...? We won't have time to eat.
Are you gonna miss out on more fantastic tactics?
To be honest, I've had some guidance from Meng Ya.
You know, just the usual pointers.
The Hall of Contemplation is the most essential part of the Martial Arts Academy, where students can practice meditation and breathing exercises.
This place used to be full of flowing clouds, perfect for meditation and body tempering. But...
Martial Arts training is about building up bit by bit.
The hall helps internalize daily practices for genuine benefits.
Besides, at a time like this, honing one's character is a better way to face the current situation.
The more unusual the situation, the more you should treat it with a normal state of mind.
Whether it's the training grounds or the Hall of Meditation, the cloud flow inside has become visibly thinner...
Many students have even reported significant training results recently, and the cloud currents in the Hall of Meditation no longer pose any pressure to them...
We borrowed instruments from the Mechanism Academy for testing and found that the cloud flow concentration had dropped significantly.
It seems the lockdown of the Cloud Silkworm Room is definitely linked to the drop in Cloud Stream concentration...
I hope the Academy... can resolve these anomalies as soon as possible...
So many supplies... busy times ahead.
I'm Ling Fu, in charge of deliveries.
I'm logging delivery info. Most of what's delivered here is for our canteen.
We get food deliveries daily, but sometimes it's not enough.
These students have quite an appetite.
See you soon, I've got to head out too.
The Martial Arts students often deliver packages for the three schools. They don't have Sun Bin's Mechwings for speed.
They rely purely on their own feet, treating each delivery like a drill.
Honestly, I'm fine... No check-up needed, right?
Really, I'm okay. I still have a thousand squats to do.
I can't stop training now. How else am I going to break Nora's record?
Odd, I can train for days without a headache.
But reading for a bit makes my head spin... why is that?
Come try our freshly prepared dishes. Don't miss out!
I'm Xiaoyu, chef and manager of the canteen.
We'll go above and beyond to delight your taste buds!
More students are on the way after their training.
These students eat a lot and try anything to help with training. I can't keep up!
I just brought over the dishes we made in class. Can't let anyone go hungry!
Chen Mu, can you lend me some money? I'm broke again.
I'm tapped out too. We need to find a way to make some.
What did you all spend on?
Weapons, training equipment, and Novar merch.
I didn't buy much, but my wallet's empty.
I ate three extra meals a day, and there went my money...
How do you plan to make money?
I heard Ling Fu needs help with deliveries.
No way, you'd just end up breaking things.
Chen Mu, do you... have any 'surplus grain' left?
Huh? You've blown through your allowance again? No... you really shouldn't spend money like that...
I, uh, I couldn't control myself... I promise this is the last time! Just lend it to me!
No! How many times have you promised! I've never seen you actually do it!
Weapons, training equipment, and Novar merch.
I didn't buy much, but my wallet's empty.
Yeah, I just ate three extra meals a day, and my money was gone.
How do you plan to make some extra cash?
I heard Ling Fu needs help with deliveries.
No way, you'd just end up breaking things.
Is there anything strange happening at the Martial Arts Academy?
Strange... Come to think of it, I don't know if it's just my imagination, but the Cloud Flow at the Martial Arts Academy seems to be getting thinner...
Oh right! The cloud flow before was much denser. The cloud flow in the Hall of Meditation doesn't feel like much when it hits you now.
I remember... it must have started after that explosion during the Dream Performance finals...
Come to think of it... the Divine Rune monsters also started appearing after that...
Hey, you mentioned challenging Senior Yao before—any results?
I won't take advantage of someone in a vulnerable state. Once he's healed, I'll challenge him.
That's so like you, it had to be you!
One day, I'll be the brightest star!
I saw Novar dueling on the roof the other day.
I've challenged everyone in the academy. Next, I want to take on Novar!
Go for it! I believe in you!
Hello, can you teach me the sword techniques to defeat Novar?
Why do you want to defeat him?
That's the only way I can surpass him and become the greatest hero of Frostcloud Town!
I heard someone say that the explosion during the Dream Performance finals was a deliberate attack!
Yes, yes, yes, I heard that too. They said she hurt the Master, leaving him bedridden with serious injuries.
Injure the Master? How is that possible! How many people in this world could even beat the Master?
Warm up and stretch well before training.
Otherwise, it's easy to get injured.
Junwu, remember that you twisted your ankle?
I took you to a Herbalist, which kept me busy for quite some time.
Alright, alright, let's not dwell on that. I'll warm up properly this time.
Spread your knees, push from your hips, and keep your posture upright and stable.
Great, you got the height and power right. Excellent work!
As long as the training continues, the drumbeat must not stop.
Overslept again... It's almost graduation and I still can't kick the habit.
Ever since Mayene left, there's been no one to be late with me...
Since the new students arrived, the senior students have also stepped up their training.
This place bustles from dawn till late at night.
Who will prevail, the new students or the seniors? It's anyone's game.
Even though the Master is away, everyone is united and training hard to deal with the Divine Rune monsters...
If he could see this scene... he would surely feel very comforted.
I feel light as a feather lately. It seems the recent training has been very effective.
You spend every day meditating in the Hall of Quiet Contemplation; haven't you felt the cloud flow getting thinner?
Siang You almost fooled everyone here. Very impressive.
Liu Chuo has walked into the trap and doesn't realize it.
Liu Chuo, don't hesitate. The enemy is advancing.
What do you think of the situation?
Liu Chuo lacks flexibility and adaptability.
He attacks rashly and carelessly, and defends weakly and slowly.
On the battlefield, you must recognize both your own weaknesses and the enemy's.
It's rare to see an intact dummy. Most dummies here are badly damaged.
Some students blamed the graduates for the damaged dummies...
Can Liu Chuo read his opponent's intentions? Let's see...
Siang You's apparent sacrifices are baiting Liu Chuo.
A moment's hesitation can lead to defeat.
But if Liu Chuo takes the bait, he'll trap himself.
Hmm... My Swift Spear seems to be quite worn out.
When will the blacksmith replace the spearhead for me?
The waiting list is endless! I've been queued up for days and still no luck.
If only I had something like that.
That crossbow you got looks nice.
That crossbow you got looks nice.
With this crossbow, you could catch all the fish in the river!
All the fish in the river?
All the fish in the river?
Just don't tell the other Anglers. This is my secret weapon.
With weapons from this blacksmith, you might even land a fish as big as a Bubble Fish.
The blacksmith's right over there. You should check out his work—he's a real pro.
Listen, sounds like another weapon is just about finished.
Fishing's a breeze now. The river's mine!
How's that new bow treating you?
The shape and string are so refined. I've never had a bow this good before.
Just incredible. It feels so light in my hands.
Good taste! It's inspired by the Cloud Piercer's design...
You'll notice this bow has way more punch than regular ones.
Don't worry, the blacksmith will craft a fine sword for you one day.
But for now, a basic one is just fine.
I wonder who will wield this weapon. It's so exquisite.
When will I ever master such incredible skills?
To forge a legendary weapon like the Deepfrost Assault...
Don't beat yourself up. You just weren't sharp enough to see his trap.
The moment he sent that cavalry to harass you, you fell right into his trap.
In that situation, you should've countered immediately... You've got a lot to learn.
Look at you, falling for the same trick again.
If you get too caught up, you lose your footing.
I've been using these gloves for almost a year. They're starting to wear out.
I'd really like a pair of gauntlets like Lian Po's.
Look at you, falling for the same trick again.
If you get too caught up, you lose your footing.
How did this happen? He predicted my every move.
It was all his setup. Clearly, I'm still not at his level.
The wind blowing through the fallen leaves... It's a sight to behold.
What kind of performance is this?
This is a martial arts performance of internal energy. Only those with strong energy can make it visible.
Why are the leaves blown into the air?
That's because the student on stage is channeling internal energy, causing the leaves to swirl.
The red leaves add a beautiful touch to this quaint academy corner.
Mayene's movements are so graceful, like a heroic figure from Chang'an. It's really inspiring.
Dialogue to learn details about luck.
They're at it again. When will they ever stop?
Why do they compete so much?
A pair of rivals. The one with longer hair is Sheng Yun, and the other one is Wong Bowen.
Who do you think will win?
I think Sheng Yun will win.
Makes sense, since he was the one who proposed the challenge. He should be more confident.
I think Wong Bowen will win.
True, Wong Bowen seems steadier, more in control.
It's quite childish. They keep arguing over who is better, Novar or Mayene... They both think the other is just making stuff up.
So they decided to settle it with a contest.
How long have they been there?
How long have they been there?
Probably all day. They haven't even stopped to eat. Those two... they'll regret it if they fall.
A pair of rivals; the one with longer hair is Sheng Yun, and the one with shorter hair is Wang Bowen.
zh_text: 一对冤家，头发长点的是盛芸，短点的是王博文。
source_text: 一对冤家，头发长点的是盛芸，短点的是王博文。
official_target_text: A pair of rivals; the one with longer hair is Sheng Yun, and the one with shorter hair is Wang Bowen.
official_en_text: A pair of rivals; the one with longer hair is Sheng Yun, and the one with shorter hair is Wang Bowen.

text: Oh no, Sheng Yun looks like he's about to lose his balance!
Hang in there, Sheng Yun! For Novar!
You see? I knew that Wong Bowen wasn't good enough. I should have taken his place.
For Mayene's sake, I'll definitely win.
He has a bit of Mayene's flair, but when it comes down to it, he's not quite there yet.
These two do have some skill.
But if it were me, I'd definitely win.
Heh, it looks like Wong Bowen is losing his balance. Sheng Yun has it in the bag now.
Wow, they've been at this stalemate for ages.
My legs are getting tired just from watching.
You look so cool wielding that spear!
He still didn't realize it was a trap set up by Siang You.
Siang You started setting up a pincer move early on.
The game is set. It's too late to escape now.
You still have a lot to learn.
Is that Senior Lin Song over there? It's been a year since I last saw her.
I heard she had a severe arm injury and had to quit archery. I never expected to see her back here.
Yes, and now she's back. Could it be...?
Step aside! Don't block my target!
She's really good! Her aim is spot on!
She's incredible... When will I become as good as her?
Hmm... I feel like I'm the only beginner here.
That senior looks nervous but handles herself like a pro.
Do you really think I can do this?
You won't know unless you try, senior. You're healed now, and I believe in you.
But my arm will never be as good as it was. I'm worried...
Just take that step, senior. The outcome doesn't matter. I just want you to find your old self and be happy again.
I haven't touched my bow since my injury. I wonder... will I be okay?
You must have confidence! Skills won't be easily forgotten even before injury!
Thank you... Until I recover, could you stay with me a bit longer?
Go all in and make it quick.
Alright, I'll give it a try. It's not the time to be timid.
See through the mistakes and strike back.
This simulation battle is really putting me in a dilemma.
Looks like you're in a tough spot.
Looks like you're in a tough spot.
Yeah, Siang You has already positioned a cavalry unit in front of my supply depot.
That means he's likely split his forces to protect other resource points too.
If I attack now with everything, I might wipe them out, but it's a big gamble...
I'm really torn... What do you think?
Siang You, ready for a fair fight?
Makes sense. Spreading his forces thin to harass me will slow him down too.
As long as I can hold out, victory will eventually be mine!
I've got other things to do. See you.
What a sharp blade. I hope I can get my long spear next time.
Time to get back to practice.
Clever and discreet, Siang You played a beautiful game.
This is my tenth try. If I fail again, I won't get any more materials.
Should I quench with water, salt, or oil? I'm not sure which is best.
Alright! I'll try it out soon, thanks for the advice!
Okay! I'll give it another shot with water!
Alright! I'll follow your advice and hopefully succeed this time!
I don't know much about quenching.
Any tips? For example, when should I start the quenching?
I need a handy weapon. I don't care how it looks. Why is it so hard?
The problem seems to be during quenching.
Why is luck never on my side?
I need a bit more time. Please come back later.
Ah! I used water, and my sword snapped!
Ugh, thought you knew your stuff.
So... that wasn't the way to go?
So... that wasn't the way to go?
It's you... I tried salt, but the hardness isn't up to standard.
Again? When will I finally succeed...
Maybe something went wrong. Just try again.
Maybe something went wrong. Just try again.
It's you! Oil quenching worked! I finally did it!
Thanks to you, my mentor won't be mad this time.
Many Martial Arts students are my regulars.
My collection of training gear, secret guides, and equipment has it all!
Come and take a look, don't miss out!
Come take a look! You won't be disappointed!
You... just stay on one side. I'm focusing on my training.
To outsiders, it may look like sleeping, but there are many mysteries at play!
They won't catch me if I nap for a bit... So comfy...
There are so many posts. Why fight over his?
Enter quietly, take a seat, and begin meditating. Please follow the Meditation Hall rules.
You've been still for a while now.
Why can't I exert any strength?
Welcome to the School of Martial Arts!
But I can't give up. I have to push past my limits.
The instructor is watching. I gotta do my best!
I won't let others outdo me.
I can do this! I know I can!
Mayene was right. Air's great up here.
Falcon, right? Your teacher asked me to get you back to the training.
Falcon, right? Your teacher asked me to get you back to the training.
He's too busy to remember—I'm off today. No extra practice.
When will the herbs arrive? I can't take it anymore.
I feel like... the sky is... spinning...
Let's get that bleeding stopped first! We'll worry about the herbs later.
If you're feeling dizzy, just stay put. I'll come check on you in a bit.
I told you, Lan Jia, you insisted on setting up a high-difficulty course on the dummy, and now you've fallen and hurt yourself!
Ow, ow, ow... I can't go on!
Another one? It looks not that serious. You can wait.
Ouch... Please, no lectures. Just help me, okay? It hurts...
Shut up! And you, Tong An, you're having a dizzy spell, just sit still and don't move around!
Oh no... I feel dizzy, like I'm about to fall off my chair...
Just tell me where the bandages and hemostatic powder are. I can dress my own wounds!
Stop arguing! Do not use the medicine without my permission!
You? You look fine to me. Don't be nosy! I don't have time to entertain guests.
If you paid more attention, you wouldn't be in this mess.
You've seen how they cry and beg for help. Their bodies might be fine, but they sure know how to whine.
Could you take a look for me?
They're a handful. If you've got nothing better to do, go keep them company.
Take care, I don't want to see you in a hospital bed.
Okay, it's better now! How much longer until I can leave?
How much longer until I recover... Ah...
Not now. I just stopped the bleeding. Luckily, the herbs are working.
What? So I can't train for a while?
I'm an Herbalist. Students training here often get hurt.
With me around, they can push their limits safely.
I'm here to treat training injuries. It's tiring, but I find it rewarding.
Their varied injuries give me useful insights.
One day, I'll design a safer, more effective training plan for them.
Take care. Come to me if you get injured.
Be careful not to get injured while training.
I don't want to sweep all day...
Welcome to the School of Martial Arts! Your sweat will soak every tile here!
Is it really that intense? Is it too late to back out?
We're already here, so let's give it our all! Plus, if you leave now, Master Fuzi will definitely scold you.
Let's go, the School of Mechcraft said they need help moving things over there.
I promised someone I'd go repel the mutated beasts in the area later...
I'm fine. I'll go with you.
Shooting arrows at night feels different than during the day.
It relies on experience and senses, not just sight.
Exactly. It's about coordinating all your senses.
I should train more at night to adapt.
How about we call it a night? I'm feeling tired.
Just hold on a little longer. We're still way off from our goal.
If we don't push ourselves, we'll stay at the bottom.
You're right. We can't keep falling behind.
Why are you training up here?
Why are you training up here?
It's too noisy down there. I can't concentrate.
Looking into the distance at a high spot calms me down.
I'm tallying up the daily equipment usage for the School of Martial Arts. It's a real headache.
It's only halfway through the month, and our expenses are already piling up again...
One thousand one hundred and fifty, one thousand one hundred and fifty-one...
zh_text: 一千一百五十，一千一百五十一……
source_text: 一千一百五十，一千一百五十一……
official_target_text: One thousand one hundred and fifty, one thousand one hundred and fifty-one...
official_en_text: One thousand one hundred and fifty, one thousand one hundred and fifty-one...

text: My mentor said my martial music lacks spirit and told me to visit the School of Martial Arts.
I should have come here sooner. Working alone was foolish.
I'll weave the students' passion into my music.
Zhou Yu must have felt the same while composing his pieces.
Feng Yen escaped a horrible monster. He was so brave.
I think Guan Di took a bigger risk—it's Master Fuzi's beard!
I'd like to use it to play with Croakies.
Feng Yen and Guan Di are sharing their stories.
Students from the School of Martial Arts do everything they can to destroy what the School of Mechcraft built.
The two schools really do help each other out in that way.
Someone even wanted a Mechanoid as a training partner. I should visit Springbrook Plains sometime.
It's lively here, isn't it? It used to be even livelier.
We used to hold private contests here, but they were banned.
Now we run bravery contests. I actually enjoy their tall tales.
The Fuzi Lamp is so bright at night. He's really thoughtful.
Master... when will you come back...
I sneaked into the Restricted Ground and fought a monster there!
Cloaked in black mist, torch-bright eyes, man-long fangs. Each step shook the ground.
It's the strongest monster in Jixia Academy!
Once, I plucked off Master Fuzi's beard while he was napping. I'm still feeling the pain from his ferule!
Oh my, how scary! A monster cloaked in black mist!
There's no such monster in the Restricted Ground. I swear on the Seeker's name.
But he tells it convincingly... Anyway, the other one is really bold, pulling off Master Fuzi's beard.
It's nothing. Watch me write my name on Master Mozi's armor!
I've lost count of how many times they have faced off.
They restarted so many times... I regret being their judge.
I'd advise you not to get too close, or they might start all over again... Wish I got paid every time they did that...
You've come this far. How can you give up now?
I can't take it anymore. Martial Arts are so tough. I should've stayed at my dad's shop.
Look at the Fuzi Lamp. Master Fuzi set it up to light our way.
So you absolutely can't give up in front of it. Buck up!
Maybe I'll just go and give up somewhere else then...
I need to do some extra training tonight...
Didn't you say you wanted to give up before? Why are you practicing so diligently now...
The academy needs people right now... I can't give up at such a critical moment...
Good! I'll go with you tonight!
Just taking a little break here...
Watching them work up a sweat...
Glad I chose the School of Sorcery.
The flow of clouds over the training grounds has visibly thinned... It's not just the Academy of Magic that's been affected...
Could it be... that the academy sealing off the Cloud Silkworm Room is really trying to hide something...
Are you interested in Martial Arts?
I can show you some basics.
Are you all just playing with the air or what?
You must be dizzy from all this! I won't rest until you admit it.
Are you slacking off because you think you can't catch up to those geniuses?
Novar and Wuyan are rare. In fact, I've never seen anyone like them before.
But Master Fuzi's teachings aren't just for those geniuses.
Don't give up. Keep training. You're hardworking geniuses!
The academy is still in crisis, and monsters are emerging in the surrounding areas.
At this critical moment, it's time for the martial arts students to step up!
I must get stronger to protect my hometown!
Keep at it... One thousand more!
Training alone is such a drag. It's nowhere near as effective as sparring with Mayene.
Her style is unpredictable. I never know what's next.
Too bad she's away. If she were here, she'd probably be on the roof.
Practicing alone is so dull. It's nowhere near as effective as sparring with Senior Mayene.
zh_text: 一个人练习真没意思，远没有和小满学姐对练来的有成效。
source_text: 一个人练习真没意思，远没有和小满学姐对练来的有成效。
official_target_text: Practicing alone is so dull. It's nowhere near as effective as sparring with Senior Mayene.
official_en_text: Practicing alone is so dull. It's nowhere near as effective as sparring with Senior Mayene.

text: Look at my fur, you'll know "Mr. Fitness" is none other than me! Please give me your support!
Smooth fur, toned muscles, it's stunning!
So, who are you rooting for?
I missed the event, so I wanted to take a closer look.
I missed the event, so I wanted to take a closer look.
Sure, you can talk to them for more details.
What do you think, Master Fuzi?
It's a tough choice, so I wanted to ask what you think.
I missed the earlier rounds, but today's competition is indeed intense.
I missed the earlier rounds, but today's competition is indeed intense.
Why not talk to the contestants? Maybe you'll pick up something useful.
2's fur looks so soft, I want to bury myself in it...
Mechanoid... Why does that sound familiar?
Could I ever build muscles like that? I envy them.
Missing this year's event is a real regret. I'll make sure to sign up early next year.
It's about to begin. Who will emerge victorious?
Who do you think Master Fuzi will pick as the champion?
Oh, you're here just in time. We're about to start.
Haha, welcome to the annual Bodybuilding Competition of the School of Martial Arts.
Since today is the final, tell me what you think of the competition as the latest student.
No problem, I'm a muscle expert.
Oh? I shall take a good look then.
I don't understand, but I'm interested.
There aren't that many rules in this competition. Just speak your mind.
Alright, let's get started! Competitors, step up to the stage one at a time!
Let's see you flex! Show me that youthful energy!
So, have you made up your mind? Who are you rooting for?
Everyone has their own strengths. But if I really have to pick one... this one.
Everyone has their own strengths. But if I really have to pick one... this one.
I didn't expect this year's competition to be so fierce. Jixia is a place where talents flourish, and it's a pleasure to witness everyone's brilliance.
Back in my youth, a dear friend and I were renowned as the most promising young men.
These matches are always so intense... but I'm getting ahead of myself.
Alright. And now, the champion of this year's bodybuilding competition is...
Just kidding. The outcome of this competition isn't decided by my opinion alone, is it?
We'll gather votes from the audience. Whoever gets the most wins!
Of course, your vote will be included too. Let's wait and see!
I'm contestant No. 3, Lin Ji, presenting "Muscle Mechanoid Type 3000"!
It must be unmatched in both form and function!
Wow, I never expected to see such muscular beauty in a Mechcraft.
Looks like the competition is fierce!
Who will be this year's champion? Stay tuned!
The "Martial Arts Master" bodybuilding competition is now officially open!
This year's competition will be judged by Fuzi!
The "Mr. Martial Arts" Bodybuilding Competition is officially open!
zh_text: “武道先生”健美大赛正式开幕！
source_text: “武道先生”健美大赛正式开幕！
official_target_text: The "Mr. Martial Arts" Bodybuilding Competition is officially open!
official_en_text: The "Mr. Martial Arts" Bodybuilding Competition is officially open!

text: Check out these muscles! The result of six years of relentless training!
Yeah, you've built quite the muscle, but you've been failing for six years, so focus up!
I may be the smallest in the family, but I have the most perfect fur!
But the fur covers the muscles...
That subtle veil of mystery is the most captivating. It's called ethereal beauty!
The coordination of fur and muscles is ingenious.
You're right! I'll share some hair care tips after I win.
But the fur covers the muscles...
Take a closer look at my Mechanoid, the latest model, my Mechanoid Type: M-1000!
This physique is the pinnacle of human strength, an unattainable height for ordinary people...
What's wrong with being a Mechanoid? There's no rule that says a Mechanoid can't be a "Martial Arts expert"!
Oh, I heard you admired Senior Yuan Ge's puppet aesthetic up close.
I see the rumors are true—you have excellent taste!
Check out these muscles! Feel free to touch them.
This is the fruit of my six years of relentless practice in Jixia!
Six years? But I thought the academy...
I got too obsessed with physical training and neglected my Martial Arts practice, so I've fallen behind in my studies...
You can train, but with your figure, you should eat more first...
Alright! All three contestants have finished their displays!
Master Fuzi, what do you think?
Forging weapons is no easy task—it's hot, exhausting, and time-consuming.
Those who bought weapons from smithies might be laughing at me now...
I'm crafting a sword to outshine Li Bai's sword. I'm not joking!
But I'm not sure I can stick it out...
Why do you want to forge a weapon?
I want to be the most famous blacksmith.
As long as someone hasn't heard about my weapons, I'll keep forging...
My weapons are expensive, but they're worth it.
Even Novar and Lian Po purchased weapons here.
Only the top-notch ones meet their standard.
You know, even a genius like Novar started with basic weapons.
So if you can't afford my weapon, you can try forging weapons yourself.
Even the best rely on their unique weapons.
I want my own weapon too...
Why do you want your own weapon?
Every student here aims to get stronger, and that calls for a powerful weapon.
My skills feel average because my weapon doesn't suit me.
All need good weapons to be powerful.
Exactly! Those heroes wield incredibly rare and powerful weapons.
Besides, choosing the weapon that best suits you is also crucial.
Ridiculous! I've failed thirteen times this month.
You must follow secret rites to craft superior weapons.
Bow clockwise to the Three Sages, wish at nine Fuzi Lamps, then focus and finish the forge in one go.
I did all that, but why did I still fail?
Maybe you led with your left foot. Next time, start with your right?
I didn't realize there was so much delicious food at the Pastoral Care Canteen. Senior, have you tried everything here yet?
Haven't tried the new dessert yet. Wanna join me later?
They keep introducing new dishes—whether it's stir-fries or desserts, they've mastered it all.
Sure, I'll try it in a bit.
Why's there such a crowd at the bun shop?
Great! Mann's buns are a staple of Pastoral Garden. I heard Myra loved them too.
Kongming Avatar Limited Edition Enlightenment Trials Commemorative Coin...
How could I fall for such a scam!
They'd have sold out long before I even knew about them!
Welcome to Pastoral Garden, where Jixia students relax and unwind.
That smells amazing. Is this the canteen?
Yep, better rush here after class.
Martial Arts training is exhausting. I need plenty of food to recover.
No wonder Senior Novar runs so fast. Turns out mealtime sprints are training too!
See that shining blue star? It's a lucky star, and right now, it's at its peak energy.
I hope I can discover more fascinating star phenomena.
Why are you interested in astrology?
So many secrets in the stars. It's fascinating to study them, like that blue star, very unique, right?
Sigh, can we talk about something else? This is putting me to sleep.
A little bit. You can deduce a lot of information from star patterns. Plus, I know some gossip related to stars.
What is it? Tell me, tell me!
I heard Senior Nianjing also goes to the Stargazing Terrace sometimes. But she always goes alone, and no one knows why.
Could it be... for Senior Novar? I wish I had a sister too.
Sure, let's chat about astrology next time.
Master Zhuangzi always says to eat slowly and savor each bite.
But I see those Martial Arts students just...
Yeah, I could totally chew through three miles of grass.
Sorcery knowledge is so hard to remember. It's my weakest subject.
Come here every night. I'll guide you, and you'll learn twice as fast.
You're so kind. Might others misunderstand us?
Don't worry about it. Helping each other out is what friends do.
Just like the Team of Stars, we'll progress together and overcome any obstacles!
Never thought I'd find Chang'an dishes here in Jixia.
The pastries of Chang'an are quite complex. I'm afraid we can't replicate the flavor accurately.
Why? The canteen's version is authentic.
Haha! We're lucky to have authentic Chang'an desserts!
Look, bruise ointment from Jiegeng. Priceless.
She must be keeping an eye on me to know about my frequent injuries during training.
That's nothing. My medicine was given by Dr Bian himself. How's that for impressive?
I never heard Dr Bian visited Jixia. You're bragging!
Look, this is my honest heart. Even if you pluck it from my chest filled with sorrow, it wouldn't dare deceive you.
This line is hard to get right.
We're rehearsing for next week's performance. I'm struggling with this line, and Yong Qian is giving me feedback.
Hmm, for this part, you need to lower your tone a bit in the first half.
Haha, not at all. We're just rehearsing.
This part is really sad, the character is suffering.
I need to show that struggle and pain in my performance. I'm trying to figure out how to do it better.
The flowers at the door still need to be watered by the Herb Society themselves. Perhaps they can research an automatic watering system.
If only I could make one for her.
Senior, are you working on an automatic watering device? I didn't see you in class this morning...
Shh, keep it down, loose lips sink ships!
It's Senior Mayene's favorite saying. It means things are about to go sideways. Keep my idea to yourself, okay?
Yeah, it makes watering plants and farming so much easier.
I must hurry up with my research.
Mr. Luobai, you praise Pastoral Care Canteen's dishes so much, they must be delicious.
It's very nice. The pastry is crispy with a subtle sweetness, leaving a lingering flavor.
Speaking of, is there any dish that you found particularly memorable?
Well, there was this one time when I nearly died after tasting a dish as a judge.
I don't know how she turned common ingredients into toxic food, but thankfully, she's been banned from competing since.
My thesis is still missing something. I need to keep working on it.
If only I could make them as exquisite as the puppet show...
My name will be remembered like Yuan Ge's.
Ugh, one time skipping class, and I get the worst luck—caught red-handed by the teacher and punished with cleaning duty!
No Sorcery Techniques? That's so annoying!
Yeah, she got away many times, while I got caught this one time. And they won't even let me use Sorcery techniques to sweep the floor. Ugh, what bad luck!
I know. I wanted to transfer to the School of Martial Arts, but the training is too intense. Sweeping is easier.
Shouldn't have skipped class. Now I'm in trouble!
I wasn't sleeping, I... I'm wide awake...
I'd love to learn some money-making tips...
I wish I could be friends with Shye. She would understand.
Jiegeng, can you get me some herbal balm for my back pain?
Honestly, they only remember me when they're sick.
Come by when you're free. It's good for you, and it lifts my mood.
Yes, Senior Shye discovered the ruins, and we've been doing archaeological research nonstop until we're all exhausted.
Yeah, super busy. Haven't seen her since she joined the Shye's archaeological team.
Tell me about it. I'm always bent over researching, my back is killing me.
I've told you to balance work and rest. Can't always rely on medicine.
The grass is so green, how can you bear to tread on it? Get out!
The air between the herb garden and flower garden is so nice.
The Pastoral Herb Grove is impressive! I don't want to leave.
I envy Jixia students. This place is hard to leave.
Want a divination reading? It's accurate!
I saw stars last night, knew today would be lucky!
How thoughtful of them to have Mechanoids serving seafood.
I've been here two months and never had the same dish twice at the academy canteen. Talk about culinary diversity!
Although some dishes are definitely acquired tastes...
Hmm, tough choice. But if I have to pick one, it's got to be Aerocakes.
So soft and white, melts on your tongue... It's like you're eating clouds.
Don't they remind you of Aercocoon and Aersilk? Takes me back to my early days in Jixia.
I'll bring loads home to everyone in Navenia, and tell them all about the legend of Aersilk!
Well, in Navenia we mostly eat seafood. So all this meat is new to me.
There's this dish called... Smoked Spice Falcon? Everyone raves about it, but I just can't stomach it.
It tastes too strong for me... I prefer the natural flavor of ingredients without too much seasoning.
How are you liking the food here?
It's great! They even serve Chang'an food.
Our pastries are tricky to make, but the ones here taste just like those from home.
Haha. We're lucky to have you folks here! You bring so much variety to our table.
The gentle breeze today makes it perfect for feeding the fish.
I'm Liu Chih, an Angler. You look puzzled. Haven't you heard of me? I'm quite skilled in fishing.
I'm feeding the fish. Fishing has been banned in Pastoral Garden's pond lately, or I'd show you my skills.
But feeding fish is fun too.
It's more satisfying when you catch bigger fish, you know.
Do you have a lot of fishing gear?
More than you can imagine. I always carry them, ready to assemble or use them whenever needed.
But tools are just tools. The real skill comes in adapting to changes.
Goodbye, and good luck to everyone today.
Lynlu, she skipped rehearsal. No idea where she's off to.
At least, you can forget about getting her Novar cards.
Are you looking for Ling Lu?
Yeah, she's always late. It's frustrating, but I've gotten used to it.
She's harmless, just a big fan of cute animals. Can't resist them.
If you see her, don't alert her. I want to see how late she'll be and how much penalty she'll get.
We adapted a storybook. Rehearsals are almost done.
It's a matter between fellow enthusiasts. It's not a big deal if she can't make it, but at least she should have let us know.
When she gets back, I'll have to punish her properly.
Why isn't she here yet? Where did she go?
Did she oversleep, or did she forget?
Fluffy little paws! Can't resist them.
Come here, let me cuddle you!
What? You can't reach the lotus by the shore?
Haha, they are created by Sorcery.
Nice band name. I love barbecue.
Is it really a good idea to name a band that?
Emphasize this line when you say it.
Hey! You're not paying attention at all!
Look, this is my honest heart. Even if you pluck it from my chest filled with sorrow, it wouldn't dare deceive you.
But you won't trust me the slightest, all because of one mistake I made out of my deep affection for you.
This part needs a lower tone in the beginning.
Okay, how about you try your part?
I tried to forgive you too, but something unexpected always disappoints me.
No need for further words. From the day I made my decision, "us" lost all its meaning.
You might want to speed up here to show determination.
No, the female lead is in pain. She should speak slowly and deliberately.
Success starts with well-prepared tools, angling included.
I don't believe in luck, I believe in making things happen.
You look like an angling expert.
You flatter me. I just enjoy working on tools.
With proper gear, you can fish in any waters.
If I had a suit of armor instead of this rain cloak, I'd be protected from both rain and beasts.
Your angling tools are quite special?
Of course! This is the new angling rod I developed with the Mechcraft students.
This angling rod can quickly drag out the fish once it bites.
Caught it before it could react. Impressed?
Goodbye, let me know if you find any good fishing spots!
Sigh, fishing is useless. If only I had enrolled in the Martial Arts Academy back then...
If that were the case, I'd have led the martial arts students to repel all the Rune monsters by now! Then I could finally get back to fishing in peace.
Alright, I'm on my way over now.
So soft and fluffy... I wish I had one at home...
Ling Lu? Your friend is waiting for you.
Ling Lu? Your friend is waiting for you.
Ah... The rehearsal! Oh no, I totally forgot.
I got so distracted by these Croakies... Xianlu must be angry...
Go find her now. The Croakies can wait.
Go find her now. The Croakies can wait.
See that shining blue star? It's a lucky star, and right now, it's at its peak energy.
Sigh, can we talk about something else? This is putting me to sleep.
Okay... How about some gossip? That's more your thing.
They say Jing used to visit the Stargazing Terrace from time to time, but nobody knows why.
Could it be... for Senior Novar? I wish I had a sister too.
Then come here every night and go over it a few times. With my guidance, you'll learn it twice as fast.
Don't worry about it. We're friends, so naturally, we help each other.
You're so kind, but others may think we're dating.
There's so much to memorize in sorcery, but I'm terrible at reciting.
Like the Team of Stars, we advance together and tackle challenges!
Have you noticed anything unusual lately?
Lately, the mountain area has been busy.
Crafters are gathering materials for repairs, and there are more Seekers around too.
Many are attempting the trials left by Senior Kongming.
Oh, heard about that too. The Rebels seem more active as well.
I got it. All traces point to one possibility.
Well... I haven't figured it out yet.
You've probably been reading too much "Jixia Mysteries" lately...
We're down-to-earth, alright? A name like "Cold Peak Band" would be boring.
Hmm... The name is weird, but the music is decent.
Looks like you're a fan now.
After-School BBQ has also prepared a little fireworks surprise for everyone!
Could it be the latest fireworks from Obsidian Flame Training Hall?
“After-School BBQ”? Why is it called that?
zh_text: “放学后烤肉”？怎么叫这个名字？
source_text: “放学后烤肉”？怎么叫这个名字？
official_target_text: “After-School BBQ”? Why is it called that?
official_en_text: “After-School BBQ”? Why is it called that?

text: The folks at “After-School BBQ” even prepared a little firework surprise for everyone!
zh_text: “放学后烤肉”的各位还给大家准备了烟花小惊喜呢！
source_text: “放学后烤肉”的各位还给大家准备了烟花小惊喜呢！
