official_en_text: The folks at “After-School BBQ” even prepared a little firework surprise for everyone!

text: Sigh, no matter how chaotic things get, listening for a while makes my heart feel much calmer...
This is the power of music...
Come to think of it, why does it feel like there are fewer people here listening to the zither?
Ever since the Dream Performance finals were suspended and the Star Team members were injured... the academy has been significantly affected...
The Moyan Pavilion also had to focus on firearms to deal with the Divine Pattern monsters.
Sigh... Hearing you say that, it really is rare to have the heart to listen to music...
They must be practicing every night!
They may get hungry after the show. Let's prepare some food.
I heard they've prepared a special performance for today.
The melody and rhythm are both excellent.
This is what we Sorcery students would enjoy!
I don't know much about music, but it still feels wonderful.
They must have worked hard behind the scenes.
It really is fireworks! So cool!
It's so annoying how some people judge others based on stereotypes.
I may be clumsy, careless, and impatient, but I'm a man of action!
Do you really think I'm just a book-smart Crafter?
Not difficult, just a bit tricky. Everyone knows my hands aren't the nimblest.
But don't call me a pure theorist! I love tinkering and inventing all sorts of gadgets!
When I become a renowned Craft Society member, no one will dare to doubt me.
Haha, I see there are still connoisseurs in this world!
I know I may be a bit reckless, but I'm sure we can figure it out.
Many famous figures were unknown before they became famous.
Anyway, I'm much better now. Thank you!
How long has the outer ring of the Tower of Enlightenment been broken... Why hasn't anyone taken care of it...
But if I can fix it... wouldn't this be my chance to make a name for myself?
Didn't expect the flowers at the door to be watered by an Herbalist. She might need an automatic sprinkler.
Senior, you aren't working on one already, are you? After all, I didn't see you in class this morning...
Keep it down—loose lips sink ships!
Okay, I'll keep it down. I just realized, senior, not only do you invent strange Mechcrafts, but you also have a funny way of speaking.
So what does "loose lips sink ships" mean?
It's Mayene's favorite saying—it means talking too much may get you in trouble. Thankfully, no one noticed us just now.
I didn't expect that even with the Dean missing and divine-pattern monsters appearing, the Herb Garden could still keep watering the flowers like clockwork...
I think that's just their way of tempering their character; we should learn from them.
The future big eater, An Jun, a student aiming to win eating contests.
Though I'm stuffed right now, never underestimate the potential of a true food lover—the sky's the limit.
You've come to the right person! I often take walks here after meals, so I know it well.
To the north is the Pastoral Care Residence for new students; to the south, the Gourmets run the Pastoral Care Canteen.
In the center, you'll find the Pastoral Herb Grove maintained by the Herbalists, and the eastern side houses a serene and elegant garden.
The meals at the Pastoral Care Canteen are incredible. Next time I'm at the Pastoral Garden, I'm heading straight here to eat.
Quiet! I'm praying for Senior Yao!
Did you hear about the Star Team members getting injured? I have a feeling it's fake...
With their skills, they wouldn't be seriously injured so easily, right? Why are you ignoring me?
I don't care! If he can't return safely, then it's all your fault!
Ping Yi, you're always full of clever ideas. Do you have any insights on how to improve the layout of Pastoral Garden?
You're just flattering. Since you ask, here's my humble opinion.
To be honest, the place is already balanced. Adding or removing something from it will break the peace.
You're right, Ping Yi. The key of Pastoral Garden lies in its peaceful environment. So when it comes to layout, we just have to weigh the options and choose the most important one.
Welcome! Are you here to enjoy the arm-wrestling masters match?
The guy in red is Ruiyu, a freshman from the School of Martial Arts, a three-week reigning champion and a rising star!
Oh, nice choice. Let's wait and see.
Haha, expected. Let's see what happens.
The guy in blue, Senior Chiyang, is today's challenger. Despite being a Sorcery student, his fist skills are impressive.
Who do you think will win?
Looks like our rising star might claim another victory.
Martial arts techniques really live up to their reputation!
It seems like the challenger might finally succeed this time.
As expected of an experienced senior, he's a rare talent proficient in both Sorcery and Martial Arts!
Come on. You can do it!
I've used Master Crafter's Mechcrafts too. They're impressive.
I sought him out once for a teacher's task. He was a bit weird and could barely complete a sentence when talking.
You don't understand. His style is exactly what Mechcraft students strive for.
Social anxiety and awkwardness are traits many of us Mechcraft students embrace. I want to become someone like that.
Good luck with that... Mechcraft students are quite different I guess.
Someone's finally here! It's the same model as the Master's study! Come take a look!
Action speaks louder than words, just buy it, student!
These are exquisite furniture blueprints, essential for any study.
It is said that the renovation market is deep; you'd better keep your eyes peeled.
But you can trust me—one-year replacement, three-year repair warranty!
This is called leveraging influence. Besides, the old man isn't here, and he wouldn't stoop to my level anyway.
Sigh, since I have this opportunity, I might as well find a way to borrow some ideas from Master's study.
Come by often. If you introduce friends, I'll give you a discount!
These students... so what if the Dean is away? Life goes on, doesn't it?
You need to manage your own independent space to feel secure, how can you not understand this simple truth...
Jixia is huge! There's no way to see it all.
We must build good relationships with the Society here!
Are you enjoying yourself in Jixia?
Of course! Everyone here is talented in their own way.
You'll find kind souls everywhere, especially among the students of the School of Martial Arts.
I asked if what they held was tasty, and they filled my arms with snacks and pancakes.
How's your relationship with the Society?
I'm good at making friends. It'll be easy!
But I caused quite a bit of trouble for the Society when I was young.
Like secretly picking fruits observed by the Herb Society for half a year, or mocking the Angling Society for fattening fish within a ten-mile radius...
Goodbye, come play with me again soon!
I must build a good relationship with the Hundred Schools here!
zh_text: 一定要和这里的百家们打好关系！
source_text: 一定要和这里的百家们打好关系！
official_target_text: I must build a good relationship with the Hundred Schools here!
official_en_text: I must build a good relationship with the Hundred Schools here!

text: The Hundred Schools seem so worried...
The atmosphere felt off when I snuck into the academy to play before...
Just my luck. Skipped class just this once, and got caught red-handed...
Now I have to sweep the grounds without the help of Sorcery.
How did Mayene get away with it all the time? Maybe I should transfer to the School of Martial Arts.
Nah, too much physical training... Back to sweeping I guess.
I'm the dorm supervisor at Pastoral Care.
Nope. I'm totally sober. I'm a hard-working person, alright?
Goodbye, and please don't interrupt my work again.
Why don't Mechcraft students invent something useful like a cleaning device for our dorms?
Actually, the watering Mechcraft in the greenhouse may do the job.
That's a new way of utilizing the watering Mechcraft. You're so smart.
Thanks, but we should discuss it with Senior Changpu first.
See this? It's a bruise ointment from Jiegeng. It's priceless.
She must have been keeping an eye on me. How else would she know about my frequent training injuries?
That's nothing. Guess who gave me this? Dr Bian himself!
I helped him gather some herbs for his research, and he gave me this amazing gift in return.
No way. I never heard about him visiting Jixia. You're pulling my leg.
It is said that the renovation market is deep; you'd better keep your eyes peeled.
zh_text: 据说装修市场的水很深，你可要擦亮眼睛。
source_text: 据说装修市场的水很深，你可要擦亮眼睛。
official_target_text: It is said that the renovation market is deep; you'd better keep your eyes peeled.
official_en_text: It is said that the renovation market is deep; you'd better keep your eyes peeled.

zh_text: 不过找我你放心，一年包换三年包修！
source_text: 不过找我你放心，一年包换三年包修！

official_en_text: But you can trust me—one-year replacement, three-year repair warranty!

text: Come by often. If you introduce friends, I'll give you a discount!
zh_text: 有空常来，介绍朋友过来我给你打折！
source_text: 有空常来，介绍朋友过来我给你打折！
official_target_text: Come by often. If you introduce friends, I'll give you a discount!
official_en_text: Come by often. If you introduce friends, I'll give you a discount!

text: Gave me quite a fright! Why are you sneaking around?
That's my line. Why did you pretend to be a dorm supervisor?
Mind your own business. I know you've been sneaking out to stargaze at night again. You're going to get in trouble.
There's some misunderstanding here. I can smell the garlic from you. Did you just finish a meal?
If I get caught, you're going down with me.
Go Fan Li! Impress us all!
Of course, it's my secret recipe.
Impressive! The fish slices are so thin they're translucent. Is this a special knife skill from Mechcraft students?
Shi Ke's fish slices are too thin for stewing, relying heavily on sauce for flavor, which makes them unsuitable for spicy dishes.
Fan Li, on the other hand, cooks the whole fish with special Sorcery spices inside, steaming it instead of frying, which makes every bit packed with flavor.
But steaming the whole fish makes it fall apart, and the juices ruin the texture. One needs to find a balanced way of using the knife.
Let's hear from this student—what do you think is the most important thing in cooking?
Sigh, these flashy tricks indeed have a way of deceiving people.
What's flashy about knife skills? They're a fundamental part of cooking. You may not use them, but you can't say you don't need to learn them.
If it's optional, it's not essential. Cooking should be about taste, first and foremost.
Taste is subjective, and no chef can please everyone. It's not a hard requirement.
That's a refined palate. Ordinary folks can still distinguish between tasty and unpalatable.
Unpalatable is too strong a word, but knife skills and taste do complement each other.
Hmph, it does look pretty good.
Stop crying... it won't help... sniff...
But my food is clearly delicious. Why can't anyone understand me?
Why? Why can't I make a dish that others will like...
I just made a home-style dish and improved it based on feedback.
Like a common dish, but it lacked a bit of color, so I added some charcoal powder.
It's perfectly edible, though it will blacken your mouth. Just wipe it off.
Do you need to adjust the direction?
You mean improving the recipe? I've been doing that all along.
For example, adding shredded ginger to potato noodles unifies the color and adds a spicy texture.
I clearly mark spicy dishes on the menu, yet some still claim they were misled...
Goodbye... I hope you'll enjoy my cooking someday.
It's mainly a contest among the master Gourmets of Pastoral Care Canteen, but students confident in their cooking can also apply to participate.
The food at the Pastoral Care Canteen is decent. I heard they were holding a food contest. That sounds exciting.
I double-majored in Gourmet and Sorcery. I'm known for my taste in food.
After trying all the food at Jixia, I noticed Frostcloud Town always has long lines, and Horizon Harbor often attracts tourists.
Returning to the Pastoral Care Canteen now and then offers a pleasant change of pace.
Like me, I'm really passionate about cooking.
But after a judge got sick from my last dish, I was banned from competing. They just don't know how to appreciate the unique flavor of my dish.
But without proper cooking, the taste is inevitably plain.
And the dish I made with my secret spice will leave you wanting more.
Shi Ke's knife skills are truly impressive.
But taste isn't everything. Presentation is just as important.
Besides, I've mastered the knife skills to preserve the meat's tenderness. My dishes' texture is unmatched.
Fan Li excels in the use of spices.
The cooking contest is heating up!
On one side, we have Fan Li from the School of Sorcery, known for his secret spices.
With sorcery support from his friend, what kind of surprise will they bring?
On the other side is Shi Ke from the School of Mechcraft!
With his special Mechcraft assistant handling all the sides!
They are both creative. Looking forward to tasting their dishes!
On one side is Fan Li from the Magic Academy! His secret spices are famous far and wide.
zh_text: 一边是来自魔道学院的范理！他的秘制香料远近闻名。
source_text: 一边是来自魔道学院的范理！他的秘制香料远近闻名。
official_target_text: On one side is Fan Li from the Magic Academy! His secret spices are famous far and wide.
official_en_text: On one side is Fan Li from the Magic Academy! His secret spices are famous far and wide.

text: Mr. Luobai, you've praised Pastoral Care Canteen for their dishes so many times that I guess they do taste incredible.
Their new pastries are delicious too—crispy with a subtle sweetness that lingers.
I'll grab one after our interview. By the way, is there any dish you've found particularly memorable?
Well, there was this one time when I nearly died after tasting a dish as a judge.
I don't know how she turned common ingredients into toxic food, but thankfully, she's been banned from competing since.
Despite that, she continues to practice her cooking at the Pastoral Care Canteen. Her dedication is quite touching.
That's quite unfortunate for that student.
It's finally our turn. Mann's buns are literally calling out to us.
We're lucky. Look at the line behind us. The buns might run out before they get a chance.
No kidding. Doubt there are enough buns for everyone.
I didn't realize there was so much delicious food at the Pastoral Care Canteen. Senior, have you tried everything here yet?
Almost, but they keep introducing new dishes.
Look at that long line. Their buns must be amazing.
Mann's buns are their signature dish. I heard Mayene loved them too.
Freshly steamed buns, want to try one?
Yeah, it's so busy I can barely keep up, but serving everyone these traditional buns is worth it.
Did you make these buns yourself?
Yes, from kneading to steaming, I handle it all.
Besides being delicious, it's important that everyone feels the warmth and comfort from eating them.
That's what I, the Bun Master, strive for in life.
Can you cook other dishes too?
Certainly, I'm proficient in various cooking techniques and cuisines.
I rarely cook, but when I do, I transform simple ingredients into extraordinary meals. That's why I'm the head chef.
Goodbye, hope to see you again soon!
Master Zhuangzi always tells us to eat slowly, but look at those Martial Arts students...
They look like they're going to gobble up everything here.
Everything checks out. Keep up the good work making our late-night snacks.
I'm Chong Yu from the School of Mechcraft. If you're a fan of late-night snacks, you've probably seen me around the canteen.
See the little cooking Mechcraft? I'm here to check if it's working properly at night.
It makes late-night snacks for Jixia's students and teachers. If it breaks down, many will go hungry.
Goodbye, I'm off to rest after this.
I'm Chu Zhao from the School of Sorcery, working various jobs to make ends meet.
I'm cleaning up. The big eater contest always leaves the place a mess.
If not for the extra pay from the canteen manager, I wouldn't have taken this cleanup job.
Goodbye, I need to continue cleaning.
Cooking is a never-ending journey, like the caliber of a cannon!
I must work harder to invent the cooking Mechanoid soon.
Hey there, want to talk about memorable dishes?
What's so surprising about that? If you ask me, cooking Mechanoids are the future.
It frees the hands of Gourmet Society members and lets diners enjoy food without leaving home.
Mastering both Mechcraft and cooking to combine them takes time.
What do cooking and cannons have in common?
Of course! Both cooking and cannons require control over heat or force.
Precision is key. Even the slightest error could drastically change the outcome.
So what if Divine Imprint monsters are here? We'll just blast them back when the time comes.
It's not worth going hungry over such a trivial worry.
Excuse me, Mr. Liu Chen. Shuyao and I need some advice on improving our astrology accuracy.
Accuracy isn't the best word for astrology since no astrologer is capable of revealing the secret of the universe.
If we keep perfecting our skills, will there be a day we reveal the truth of the universe?
Maybe. Keep reading and studying the stars, but never over-interpret them.
Got it. I need to leave my presumptions out of it. Thank you so much!
To show appreciation, I'll get the new dessert from the canteen for you.
Really? That's great. I've been wanting to try it, but the canteen is always so crowded.
The new cannon is almost finished. I should find a place to test its firepower.
Senior, please steer clear of the academy grounds. Last time, the Department of Discipline deducted your credits, remember?
If only Senior Novar were here, he could always locate the best spot.
Novar's the real deal! The academy's been dull these days—everyone's eager for a bit of excitement.
Let's unleash our power of youth on the battlefield! Staying here is far too boring!
But Master Mozi always advocates for peace, and maybe I should listen... How about we use the Apocalyptor to pop some corn next time?
The Aerflow of Jixia Academy holds wisdom akin to the Aqualight of Navenia.
My final year project is still missing something. I need to think about it.
If I can make it as elaborate as a puppet show, maybe I'll be remembered like Yango.
Whew... The scent of the herb is making my eyelids heavy.
Yawn... Guess it'll count as Master Zhuangzi's dream assignment.
Jiegeng, can you get me some herbal balm for my back pain?
What brings you here, busy bee? Haven't seen you in a while.
Shye found another ruin underground. Been excavating non-stop.
Not quite a Seeker yet, and my back is already killing me.
Okay, okay. I'll get your meds in a bit.
It's a pity... if Senior Xishi hadn't been seriously injured, she could have joined us in excavating the artifacts.
Once Senior Sister Xishi wakes up and sees the artifacts you found, she'll be so happy.
If that's how you feel, then we have to work even harder.
Once this herb matures, we can use it to test a new universal antidote formula.
I wish this ancient formula were complete. Now, I have to try everything one by one.
At this point, I'm starting to doubt if a universal antidote even exists.
Well, I guess it's fine. I've already done so many tests.
Should I go for the grafting or go for the ancient seed?
One day, I'll write my own Herbalist's Studies!
Why are you so interested in the seed?
I'm from the Herb Society, so of course I'm interested in seeds!
Well... there are factions within the Herb Society too.
Cultivators like us love growing practical plants. That's why I'm always searching for precious herbs.
Why are you looking for ancient seeds?
Cultivating extinct herbs and searching for ancient seeds is the most direct and effective method.
I heard Armadillo Rats eat herbs, so I followed them, hoping to find some myself. But they ran off when they saw me.
As long as I cultivate rare herbs, I'll definitely make a name for myself in Jixia.
My book will be a textbook for Herb Society members!
If you see any peculiar seeds, be sure to show them to me!
Why, why has it withered so much? The cultivation method was correct...
No, the withered species all seem to depend on the Cloud Flow to grow...
One, two... five? Why do I always end up with an odd number of healing potions? I wish it were even.
I'm the Herbalist student responsible for managing our medicine supply. As you can see, I'm tallying up our stock.
We offer a wide selection of meds to the students, such as healing potions, vitality pills, and cooling powders.
We're constantly developing specialized herbal formulas. Recently, there's been a surge in demand for memory-enhancing pills.
See you. Maybe I wasn't paying enough attention. Let me just count them again...
One, two... five. Why is the number of healing potions odd again? I really want to make it an even number.
zh_text: 一份，两份……五份，治伤药的数量怎么又是单数？好想凑个双数啊。
source_text: 一份，两份……五份，治伤药的数量怎么又是单数？好想凑个双数啊。
official_target_text: One, two... five. Why is the number of healing potions odd again? I really want to make it an even number.
official_en_text: One, two... five. Why is the number of healing potions odd again? I really want to make it an even number.

text: Keep growing, so we may reunite one day.
I'm a Herbalist student about to graduate. I used to take care of this garden.
I'm graduating soon and wanted to visit the garden one last time to see the plants I've nurtured.
I wish I could stay longer. Sigh...
Goodbye, I'll be leaving soon as well.
Sorry, don't get too close. This plant is sensitive to stress.
My bad. I was just curious. What happens when it's overstressed?
It depends. Sometimes it just drops some leaves, but if it's really stressed, it starts withering from the top.
Be careful not to step on the herbs.
Hey! You'll get punished for trampling the herbs.
You shouldn't be wandering around here.
It's almost my turn. Don't try to cut in line!
Hey, you're not that hungry, are you?
Senior, where are these flower fields you mentioned?
The place is full of bugs.
Shall we go somewhere else then?
Okay, let's ask the others if they want to join us.
Well, everything is actually pretty good at the academy...
Except there are too many blockheads, ugh.
Studying every day is getting tiring.
You could apply for a field workshop with your instructor.
Huh? What do you mean by that?
Whoa! Keep it down, you scared me.
Shan Shan is my roommate. I look out for her.
She finally worked up the courage to ask someone out for a chat, so I came to make sure she wasn't being bullied.
Turns out it was like talking to a brick wall. That guy's as dense as a log, but that's okay, at least she's safe.
Uh, how about we go to the flower fields? Or the Herb Garden?
Need to check in? New students get a twenty percent discount.
zh_text: 需要办理入住吗？新生八折哟。
source_text: 需要办理入住吗？新生八折哟。

text: Get down from there! I'm working here.
How about now? Doesn't it smell wonderful?
You'll be even more surprised when I finish it with sizzling oil.
Smells so good, I can't wait!
I want to take a bite right now!
I want to take a bite right now!
Smells so good, I can't wait!
Turning its head, Croaky tried its best to jump.
Wait a second! Croaky isn't supposed to be in this narration!
Ah, it should be the Scholarly Tiger, right?
No! There's no animal in this part!
Sorry, I stayed up too late last night. It won't happen again!
You've lost a lot of weight...
You have too, sorry for everything. Can we stop being mad at each other?
It's not all on him. Overthinking can lead to mistakes, and someone's been pushing him, clouding his judgment.
It's not all on him. Overthinking can lead to mistakes, and someone's been pushing him, clouding his judgment.
It was a Discipline Overseer who gave Zhi Peng terrible advice when he was confused.
It was a Discipline Overseer who gave Zhi Peng terrible advice when he was confused.
Ah! I know that guy. He's always stirring up trouble. I'll talk to my friend about it later.
Zhi Peng is really upset that you're ignoring him. Maybe you two could talk things out face to face.
Zhi Peng is really upset that you're ignoring him. Maybe you two could talk things out face to face.
There isn't really a misunderstanding. I know the whole story about removing the plants.
It hurts that he couldn't see my point of view. We've been close since childhood, and I thought we could just be straightforward with each other.
If he wanted to get rid of the Petermannia Sprout, he should have consulted me first instead of just doing it "for my best."
Who would do this? Zhi Peng and I haven't wronged anyone.
It'd be good to clear the air. You're each other's best friends—don't drift apart so easily.
It'd be good to clear the air. You're each other's best friends—don't drift apart so easily.
I just finished cleaning, and now you're littering!
I don't mind if you want to do the job for me!
I really want to fix our relationship.
Can you help me convince my friend?
My friend planted a dangerous plant in a corner of the Pastoral Garden.
I'm really worried about him. If this plant hurts someone, he might get expelled.
I teamed up with a Discipline Overseer to get rid of the plant while my friend was out.
My friend was really sad when he found out and hasn't forgiven me up to now.
Why not try shifting the blame?
I'll tell him that it was all the Discipline Overseer's idea, and you were just misled.
I'll tell him that it was all the Discipline Overseer's idea, and you were just misled.
That could work. Please, give it a try.
Sometimes, it's best to give advice and let the person decide. You shouldn't have taken action on your own.
Sometimes, it's best to give advice and let the person decide. You shouldn't have taken action on your own.
But he's my friend. I couldn't just watch him get expelled.
Luckily, we removed it just in time before it could hurt anyone.
You still should have consulted him and let him decide.
You still should have consulted him and let him decide.
Looks like there's no other way. I'll handle it myself.
W-what's going on! How did the outer ring of the Tongtian Tower end up like this?
Ah! If that thing falls... the academy will be destroyed!
Everyone, don't panic. The situation is still under control, and we will guard the safety of the academy and the students.
W-what's going on! How did the outer ring of the Tongtian Tower end up like this?
Ah! If that thing falls... the academy will be destroyed!
Everyone, don't panic. The situation is still under control, and we will guard the safety of the academy and the students.
I haven't talked to him yet.
I haven't talked to him yet.
Hey! You scared away the fish.
Just a simple dish, but it needed more color, and I added some charcoal powder.
Can diners tell the difference between potato and ginger if they are all shredded?
Can diners tell the difference between potato and ginger if they are all shredded?
But the dish will look fantastic in terms of color.
Maybe you should consider a different career.
But cooking is the only thing I have passion for.
Consider focusing on the presentation of your dishes, perhaps by teaching other chefs the art of plating attractively.
Consider focusing on the presentation of your dishes, perhaps by teaching other chefs the art of plating attractively.
Are you crying? Did someone bully you?
Are you crying? Did someone bully you?
No, everything is fine. It's just that my eyes are sore.
No one appreciates my delicious dish!
What did you make? People have different tastes in food, you know.
What did you make? People have different tastes in food, you know.
You're right, but my dish is not terrible. They are just... unique...
Then the teacher said it looked and tasted burnt. No way, I controlled the heat perfectly!
I'll focus on homestyle dishes, but I won't give up on innovation!
For example, adding shredded ginger to potato noodles unifies the color and adds a spicy texture.
Good idea, I'll try that. Thanks!
Let me try this... Huh? Why is it burnt?
The outer ring of the Tower of Enlightenment is broken! Wait, what should we do in this situation...
Senior Pu Dian, will we be unable to attend classes from now on?
Why now of all times... I don't know where the Master went either, the academy is going to be in chaos...
I need to contact the Gongqiao family... No, no, report to the Mechanism Academy first...
Senior Pu Dian... Dean Mozi is not at the academy right now...
Can you step aside a bit? I can't see anything.
Excuse me, can you move to the side?
True friends never hide secrets or betray one another.
Why isn't she here yet? It's getting late...
We agreed to meet at the canteen.
I'm waiting for my friend, Yang Miao. She's running quite late.
The food's going to be cold if she doesn't hurry.
I'm not sure. She never gets late for meals.
Perhaps she's been held back by a teacher this time.
I'll wait a bit longer. See you.
Hey, look, is the outer ring of the Tongtian Tower broken?
Huh? Then, what if those fragments fall into my pot and ruin the dish?
What time do you think it is? How can you still be thinking about that pot of food!
It's not here... Still no sign of it...
If it doesn't show up, I'll have to register at the Lost & Found.
It took me a lot of effort to get the latest Croaky bracelet.
The Ruins of Springbrook Plains never ceases to surprise.
There are over twenty jar fragments, but how do I smuggle them into the dorm?
zh_text: 罐子碎片就有二十多片，不过，怎么带进宿舍呢？
source_text: 罐子碎片就有二十多片，不过，怎么带进宿舍呢？

text: They may be considered as restricted items...
As a resourceful Seeker, I must figure out a perfect plan...
Master said it was nothing serious, but he must be lying to us!
I just passed by the Tower of Enlightenment and saw from afar that it was heavily guarded!
The Academy must be hiding something! Maybe this has to do with the outer ring of the Tongtian Tower shattering...
How about the two of us go investigate and see what they're really hiding!
This... well... maybe we should just forget it. I, I still have to take care of the little animals. I'm busy.
The herbalists are stretched too thin right now.
If it leads to the wounded not being treated in time, it will be too late.
If there's any heavy lifting to be done, I can still help out.
Feels like the recent matches haven't been worth watching.
No kidding. With what happened at the academy, from the organizers down to the contestants, who has the heart for that?
I've been out for almost a month. Haven't had a chance to catch up with you.
I'm talking to my good friend, Fluffy. I haven't seen it for a month and miss it terribly.
It seems Fluffy isn't adjusting well to being alone.
Fluffy has been with me since I started school.
I plan to bring it along on any future adventures.
Every great Seeker has their little assistant!
This play is crucial. We need to know every line by heart.
If we forget a line on stage, it would be disastrous.
He's memorizing lines, and I'm supervising him.
I've already memorized my lines, but he's a bit slow. I'm not sure if we'll make it in time.
It's an original show we're working on, about a Puppeteer and the Puppet Mechanoid he created.
We're expanding and staging it to give the story a better ending.
The show is tomorrow. I hope it all goes well.
They can't tell the difference between you and me anymore.
When will I wake up, and where will I find rest...
I want to climb this tree to enjoy the view.
Doesn't sound like a good idea to me...
Didn't you just hurt your leg at the School of Martial Arts last month?
No! It'll get my clothes wet!
Can't you summon a lotus like Senior Shye and step over on it?
I don't know that kind of Sorcery Technique, and you really can't step on a Sorcery lotus anyway!
Why does the academy atmosphere feel so strange after a trip to Fengyunya?
Let's ask someone what happened later.
Thank you so much for helping me the whole week.
I'll treat you to some nice food. Or we can go somewhere fun and rest.
Are you talking to a Scholarly Tiger?
It's not just any Scholarly Tiger, it's my best buddy.
It contributed a lot during my tough week.
Where are you two going then?
The waterfall. We'll have fun in the water.
But I can hear its stomach rumble. Maybe we should get some food first.
I'll join the line and get some of Mann's buns!
Welcome to the Pastoral Garden, a favorite gathering spot for Jixia students. You can find the dorms and the canteen here.
No wonder it smells so nice here. My stomach is rumbling.
Just a heads-up, though—watch out when your seniors get out of class.
Here at the School of Martial Arts, you gotta race your way to lunch. Unless you want to go hungry.
No wonder Novar runs so fast!
It's solved quite a few problems for us.
These are all fresh ingredients shipped from the Harvest Fields.
Looks like we're in for a treat today, haha.
Recently, people found many strange artifacts in the Pastoral Garden.
Do you know the Jixia Mountains are bustling now?
New ruins are being discovered every day, and students are sneaking artifacts back to the Pastoral Garden every day.
What if it's something dangerous? We'll need to screen them again.
What if what we brought back is dangerous? Let's screen it again later.
zh_text: 万一带回来的是危险物品呢，之后咱们再筛查一次吧。
source_text: 万一带回来的是危险物品呢，之后咱们再筛查一次吧。
official_target_text: What if what we brought back is dangerous? Let's screen it again later.
official_en_text: What if what we brought back is dangerous? Let's screen it again later.

text: Don't just talk! We're completely out of herbs, what are we supposed to do!
Quite a few students are injured, we must find a way to provide treatment for everyone as much as possible.
Can't you two just help count the existing herbs first? Let's solve the problem at hand.
Usually, it's a culinary contest where Gourmets compete with their dishes.
This time, they're letting the diners join the contest.
It should be fine. I've heard the contestants this time are skilled.
One has mastered knife skills, and the other boasts secret Sorcery recipes. I'm quite excited!
One with incredible blade skills, the other with secret magical recipes—I'm really looking forward to this!
zh_text: 一位刀法了得，一位有魔道秘方，我可是很期待啊！
source_text: 一位刀法了得，一位有魔道秘方，我可是很期待啊！
official_target_text: One with incredible blade skills, the other with secret magical recipes—I'm really looking forward to this!
official_en_text: One with incredible blade skills, the other with secret magical recipes—I'm really looking forward to this!

text: Have you decided where to go after class?
Should we explore the ruins in Springbrook Plains or go to the Roaring Tiger Training Hall for a challenge?
The Ruins of Springbrook Plains? That sounds boring.
The Roaring Tiger Training Hall may be crowded but it feels like a better option.
True, there aren't many classes today, and I haven't stretched my muscles at all.
How about we head to the Roaring Tiger Training Hall first, and then Springbrook Plains?
Is everyone full? There's still some food left.
Croaky is so cute! I wish I could take it back to the dorm.
But the dorm supervisor would never allow it. That's so sad...
I should come up with an idea for a high-profile event too.
I'm Sang Yuh, a student of the Angling Society. Are you here for the events?
I wish we Anglers had events like this, but...
Haven't you organized any events before?
Sure, we held an Angling Masters Competition last time.
Many gave up, but those who stayed caught nothing all day...
Move, my legs! I believe in you!
I can't believe I'm worn out after just twenty rounds.
Sitting all day to study Mechcraft is killing my back, so I'm trying to exercise more.
The Herbalists suggested that I get more active, and I thought climbing stairs would be a good start.
For Martial Arts students, probably not much since they train much harder.
But it should help me a lot. If I can keep up with daily stair climbing, my back and waist should feel better.
Exercise is tiring, maybe I should invent a Massage Mechcraft instead!
I want to participate in every event.
I didn't realize they have band performances here every night. It's really fun!
I wonder how crowded it'll be tonight.
It would be nice to catch her in this atmosphere and chat.
Jixia Academy is beyond my expectation.
I've only seen it from afar until now.
Sister, this place is more charming than our home.
There's one way you could live here.
Once you're admitted to Jixia Academy, this will be your dorm!
To troubleshoot a Mechcraft drive shaft, I should start with...
Wait... Start with gear? I think it's something else.
Oh, the bearings... Wait, it's actually a more important part.
It's the pivot shell! But what exactly does "pivot shell" mean?
Hey, you're back! How was your day?
It was fine, but my head is aching...
Could it be from a lack of oxygen?
You do spend a lot of time underground...
I can do a quick check for you... You know what? Let's go find an Herbalist.
The problem is... I didn't go underground today.
Probably just woke up too early, and my body didn't like it.
Why does the academy feel so gloomy lately? It's almost like the atmosphere in Xuan Yong...
Looks like the Dean's absence is having quite an impact on the academy...
I really hope she reads it and gets back to me.
But... if she does read it and talks to me...
What should I say when I see her? Just say hi, or...?
Kongming commemorative coins exclusive to the Enlightenment Trials...
If they were real, they'd have sold out ages ago.
Can't believe I fell for that...
Where should we set the scene for this section?
How about the pavilion in the backyard?
I saw the Team of Stars rehearsing there before.
How about Nover and the heroine hit a minor snag in Chapter 2, but they patch things up swiftly by Chapter 3?
What should I do for Chapter 4...
I'm currently working on a youth novel featuring a character named Nover.
Oh, he's a character I created—a cheerful, handsome boy.
Is it that obvious? Well, I'm just writing for fun. My friends love it.
Wow! Nover is really taking the initiative!
I wonder what happens next in the story...
The Shining Galaxy. Everyone's been reading it lately.
It's only up to the first chapter. I can't wait for the rest!
