This sword looks sturdy, but I wonder how it feels compared to my current weapon.
I want a new shield, but if its weight and size are different, will I be able to get used to it?
Delicious, nutritious, and filling! One meal will keep you going for half a day!
Be kind to yourself. You'll need a full stomach to tackle the Wondrous Maze!
Time to call it a day... Busy, busy, busy, what a fulfilling day.
Time to check my earnings. A new outfit is in order.
Let's tally up the earnings later; I should buy myself a new outfit as a treat.
zh_text: 一会儿清点下收入吧，该买件新衣服犒劳犒劳自己了。
source_text: 一会儿清点下收入吧，该买件新衣服犒劳犒劳自己了。
official_target_text: Let's tally up the earnings later; I should buy myself a new outfit as a treat.
official_en_text: Let's tally up the earnings later; I should buy myself a new outfit as a treat.

text: Let me check... We seem to have everything on the list.
My Mechcrafts are on par with Wondrous Maze. Buying them will help you with the challenge.
This is the Discipline Dog, cute, right?
They were designed to help manage discipline at the academy, so if you do anything wrong, they'll catch you.
Frostcloud Town could learn from this place.
Mechcraft energy solves too many trivial matters.
You just don't want to do the chores.
Complaining about a little bit of work for this long.
official_target_text: Complaining about a little bit of work for this long.
official_en_text: Complaining about a little bit of work for this long.

text: You've come to the right place! This is the Mechcraft Hall. No matter how strange the request, we'll find a solution.
Like this Mechanoid Bird, it's designed to get you out of bed.
It makes sounds and flies around.
It won't turn off until morning exercise is completed.
The most representative part of Omnicraft Garden is the central Mechcraft Expo, with the Ingenious Hall, All Business House, and Inventor's Hall nearby.
If it's your first time here, I recommend checking out the Mozi Mechanoid and exploring the expo.
The most iconic part of Wanqiao Garden is the central Mechanism Expo, and nearby are the Mechanism Hall, the Oddity Shop, and the Master Craftsman Hall.
zh_text: 万巧园最具代表性的就是中央的机关博览会啦，旁边还有机巧堂、万事屋和神匠堂。
source_text: 万巧园最具代表性的就是中央的机关博览会啦，旁边还有机巧堂、万事屋和神匠堂。
official_target_text: The most iconic part of Wanqiao Garden is the central Mechanism Expo, and nearby are the Mechanism Hall, the Oddity Shop, and the Master Craftsman Hall.
official_en_text: The most iconic part of Wanqiao Garden is the central Mechanism Expo, and nearby are the Mechanism Hall, the Oddity Shop, and the Master Craftsman Hall.

text: It's my first time here. What's fun to do?
Those who stand higher have a broader view.
Maybe I'll get to see Mozi.
Welcome to Omnicraft Garden. I'm the headmaster, Crafter.
It was Mozi's private lab. After he abandoned it, a few students discovered his Mechanoid stored here.
They wanted to study Mozi's designs here. With his permission, they established the first Omnicraft Garden.
I designed it with a few Mechsmiths, but we clashed. I finished it alone.
Sadly, many bold ideas weren't implemented on the Mechanoids.
Then I'd ask, why does a Mechanoid need a weapon module?
Why isn't the Mechanoid equipped with weapons?

zh_text: 万巧园是怎么建成的呢？
source_text: 万巧园是怎么建成的呢？

text: Wow! I want to make Mechcrafts too when I grow up!
Whoever designed Dashing Wings is a genius.
Master Mozi's design is so ingenious.
This shows the master's flexible thinking, although there's space for weapons, the master valued the diversity of the Mechanoid functions.
The design shows he wanted the Mechanoid to do more than just fight. That's inspiring.
The mechanisms at the Oddity Shop are really amazing.
official_target_text: The mechanisms at the Oddity Shop are really amazing.
official_en_text: The mechanisms at the Oddity Shop are really amazing.

text: Mechcrafts solve everything, except apologizing for me.
And there's this Mechcraft for divining fortune. Perhaps only Master Juanzi would know.
Welcome. Mechcrafts solve all problems. We accept any Mechcraft requests here.
Our problem-solving skills have been highly praised by Jixia.
If you have no more questions, head to the World Expo. Your mind will be blown.
The Aership line covers multiple areas, including Jixia Mountains and Springbrook Plains.
To cover more areas, we must consider the characteristics of new environments.
How do I make dishes with different flavors?
How to mimic different Gourmet Society members?
The Mechanoid Waiter makes delicious food.
Can Mechcrafts really hit the mark? Never tried it.
Come check out my new invention, Beastie Biter!
It's a little Mechcraft I designed to liven up the party.
I'm interested, but will our friends really enjoy it?
It's super cheap. Just give it a try!
If it's not to your taste, I have plenty of other interesting designs.
As long as you fund me, I'll craft whatever you want!
The Mechcrafts from Yongyu are truly ingenious.
The Aersilk Mechcraft knife achieves its storage of various tools within a single box through an ingenious spatial arrangement.
And through the precise arrangement of Mechcraft, the user can quickly and accurately find the tool they need.
Excuse me, can I buy just one?
Sure! Please help spread the word. More orders will ease my cash flow.
Hope everyone can have such a convenient tool in the future.
Let me check the automatic mining drill.
With it, my work efficiency has greatly improved.
We need to reduce shipping and inventory costs.
I'm always swamped at this time.
It's been days since I had a good sleep.
Hey there, isn't this Mechanoid awesome?
It's awesome! I want to ride it to fight monsters.
This Mechanoid is packed with cutting-edge tech.
What's the point of making a Mechanoid so big? The Mechanoids in Chang'an can do more things.
Besides, most of these Mechcrafts are semi-finished products. I can see conflicts of different design concepts, possibly due to disagreements within the production team.
The Aersilk Mechcraft transformation blade is so cool!
The Music Mechcraft is so cool!
Jixia's design philosophy emphasizes durability and versatility of Mechcrafts.
The Aersilk Mech Core perfectly embodies our philosophy.
It's practical, but less intelligent than Chang'an Mech Core.
I don't think it's worth much. This type of Mech Core relies too heavily on Aersilk, so it can only be used in Jixia. There's no way to promote it.
Missed it again! Should've gotten up earlier.
We're out of souvenirs for today.
Hey, help me get some stock.
I'll give you a cut of the profits.
Succeeding once is fine, but if you keep failing, the cost of materials will be so high you won't even be able to afford a meal.
zh_text: 一次成功还好说，一直失败的话消耗的材料可是贵到连饭都吃不起啊。
source_text: 一次成功还好说，一直失败的话消耗的材料可是贵到连饭都吃不起啊。
official_target_text: Succeeding once is fine, but if you keep failing, the cost of materials will be so high you won't even be able to afford a meal.
official_en_text: Succeeding once is fine, but if you keep failing, the cost of materials will be so high you won't even be able to afford a meal.

text: Every adjustment brings us closer to perfection.
Every day is a new start to explore the mysteries of the world.
Every Mechcraft is a new attempt. Failure is the mother of success.
I look forward to new creations and to leading the trend again with my Mechcraft.
Every step embodies the wisdom passed down through generations. We must honor their legacy.
Mindset, like a stove fire, cannot be left unattended even for a moment.
The study of Mechcraft is endless. New discoveries await us every day.
The art of Mechcraft is boundless and infinite. We are all apprentices on this path.
Mechcraft is not just a skill, but a pursuit of beauty and virtue.
Everyone can find their dreams in my Mechcraft.
Not bad, you've got some skills. But remember, true Martial Arts lies in refinement.
My papier-mâché can't withstand such extravagance.
Nothing is too difficult for Mechcraft. Just ask if you need help.
A free spirit is what it takes to wander the world.
Could you slow down? I don't want to pick a fight.
I've hit a wall in my research and am looking for new cases to study.
Many patients in Serene Wilds, but where are the intriguing cases?
Maybe we could start with animal cases?
You know, I think this is where we picked the Bluegrass before.
I read that Glaucous Lan Grass grows in the mountains.
Yes! It shouldn't be growing here. Could one of our animals have sneaked out and brought the seeds back?
Very likely. But which one brought it back?
This is a warehouse for important supplies.
For the safety of supplies, please refrain from dangerous actions.
Croaky is so strong, it carried my luggage all this way. I should reward it well later.
Do the Croaky often help you carry heavy loads?
Of course, the Hunting Society and Croaky are the best of friends! We often rely on them.
We're in a partnership. I never force them to do anything against their will.
It's precisely this longstanding mutual respect that has led Croaky to trust and assist the Hunting Society.
Place this here, and voilà! What a perfect setup!
Hello there! The more you buy, the better the deal. Take a look and see if there's anything you like.
Ah, do you have any other questions?
They have all kinds of quirky, beautifully designed gadgets that are decor pieces on their own!
What you doing is not hard labor?
I enjoy chatting with people, so it's no trouble at all!
These decorative items make the place cozier. So lovely!
No one will find me here.
No wonder Mayene likes this spot. She's spent plenty of time fishing here.
Let me test the gold content of this auspicious land.
The Spike Bears here are so quiet. They barely move.
Don't know what they were thinking, scheduling patrols for us to stand guard here all day.
No one would dare mess with a Spike Bear, right?
We have a botanical corner and an insect observation box here. Feel free to take a look.
Don't be a stranger. Let me know if you have any questions.
I'm a Hunter. I travel and study in Jixia, focusing on the protection of animals and plants.
I'm knowledgeable about various flora and fauna, especially insects. I'm currently staying in Serene Wilds to do some educational work.
Whether it's a creature you see here or one you've encountered before, if you want to learn more about it, just ask me anytime.
Plants, animals, minerals, or anything else, I can consult experts even if I don't know them.
Check them first, or we might mistake rotten buns for ores again.
And those scary stories to frighten kids, like the legend of the Wolvine biting children...
No need to ask me such questions. But if you can guarantee its existence, I'd be very interested.
Goodbye, looking forward to more fresh insights you bring.
We have a botanical corner and an insect observation box here. Feel free to take a look.
Don't be a stranger. Let me know if you have any questions.
I'm a Hunter. I travel and study in Jixia, focusing on the protection of animals and plants.
I'm knowledgeable about various flora and fauna, especially insects. I'm currently staying in Serene Wilds to do some educational work.
Whether it's a creature you see here or one you've encountered before, if you want to learn more about it, just ask me anytime.
Plants, animals, minerals, or anything else, I can consult experts even if I don't know them.
Check them first, or we might mistake rotten buns for ores again.
And those scary stories to frighten kids, like the legend of the Wolvine biting children...
No need to ask me such questions. But if you can guarantee its existence, I'd be very interested.
Goodbye, looking forward to more fresh insights you bring.
Identifying Jixia's creatures... spreading knowledge of flora and fauna... unveiling folk legends...
That requires a vast amount of knowledge...
The harmonious Serene Wilds, where humans and animals coexist, is like a real-life Peach Blossom Land...
Could you introduce it again? Hmm, would that sound too awkward?
Goodbye! Take good care of the little animals around you!
Dad was often away when I was little. I'd come to Serene Wilds and play with animals here.
Accompany animals in their growth and defend Serene Wilds!
If you love animals too, we'll be best friends!
I'm Hongdou, Captain of the Hunting Society's Croaky Patrol Team.
Now that I'm grown up, I can finally stay with them forever!
I've recently joined the Hunting Society, but I've been spending time with animals since I was a child.
Croaky, Naughty Civet, Scholarly Tiger, Preydator... they're all my good friends.
It's always been my dream to join the Serene Wilds Patrol and contribute to protecting animals.
I'm on patrol here, checking for any potential dangers to ensure the safety of all animals.
It's my lifelong dream to protect Serene Wilds, so animals can play freely.
Thanks to the skewers you made me last time, my archery training has improved significantly!
I'm Hongdou, Captain of the Hunting Society's Croaky Patrol Team.
Of course! It's always been my dream to join the Serene Wilds Patrol and contribute to protecting animals.
Dad was often away when I was little. I'd come to Serene Wilds and play with animals here.
Now that I'm grown up, I can finally stay with them forever!
I'm on patrol here, checking for any potential dangers to ensure the safety of all animals.
I've recently joined the Hunting Society, but I've been spending time with animals since I was a child.
Croaky, Naughty Civet, Scholarly Tiger, Preydator... they're all my good friends.
It's my lifelong dream to protect Serene Wilds, so animals can play freely.
Goodbye! Take good care of the little animals around you!
Lately, ingredients have been flying off the shelves. While it's great that more tourists are visiting Serene Wilds, it does pose a problem.
Perhaps we need a warning sign here...
Hello, let us know what you need.
We specialize in clean ingredients for animals, making us your top choice for feeding them.
Reminder: Ingredients sold in the store are not recommended for human consumption. Please keep out of reach of children.
Also, remember not to feed them human food. It's bad for their health.
First, Croaky. They have no dietary restrictions and love to eat almost everything.
But remember not to overfeed. Croakies are naturally greedy, and they can't stop themselves from eating.
The Naughty Civets are fond of fruit. They consider the place a free buffet and frequently come by to grab some.
Most other animals prefer fruits, vegetables, and I stock them based on their preferences.
Goodbye, hope to see you again!
Right, I should bring some for my sister too, or she'll be nagging me again.
Where's the pastry Bu Bu gave me? I haven't even touched it!
Now that I think about it, I might have caught a glimpse of a tail with stripes brushing past me...
Wait, why do all of you have patterns on your tails?
Oh no, what do we do now? Can we hope the thief has a change of heart...?
What—damn it! I'm actually the same height as a Naughty Civet!
Is it too late to start sleeping early...?
So fluffy! So cute! I really want to touch them...
How about getting pet food from that stall?
Serene Wilds has many rules, but they're all learned from countless experiences.
Don't ever ignore the rules for convenience. You'll regret it!
These fruits look so juicy and sweet. Please...
Pfft, that's for the animals. You'll get a tummyache if you eat it.
Delivery's done. Got plans? I'm off fishing, wanna join?
Sure, I guess it's a good chance to take a break... But before that, I want to feed the Naughty Civets some pears.
Didn't you slip on their fruit peels and almost fall last time? And now you want to feed them?
Ah, they're just being themselves. They're still adorable, right?
Besides that, we need to tread lightly to avoid startling the skittish animals.
No more racing with other animals, Preydator. Got it?
Honestly, last time you made Fluffy race with you, we waited almost a whole day at the finish line to get it back.
We have lots of cute and interesting animals here. Take your time to look around!
Last time we talked about a mysterious creature called Moss Sprite. Actually, there's another one that's even better at hiding.
That's the Cypress Dreambeast. A mysterious creature hidden among the grasslands and mossy plains.
It looks like a rock covered in moss. At first glance, it's just a moss-covered rock, albeit a bit odd in shape.
The Slumberstone Lynx is a creature that loves to laze around. It won't move from its den unless it's extremely hungry.
So people often step on it by mistake. Some even use it as a stool to sit on.
That's all for today. Any questions?
Me? Just an ordinary member of the Hunting Society.
I've traveled extensively, accumulating considerable knowledge. I decided to stay in Serene Wilds to share my insights with others.
I share stories about Jixia's creatures and answer questions.
The Mossling is a timid, mysterious creature. It's completely transparent and has a branch growing from its head.
It usually hides from people, and when frightened, it will possess beasts to protect itself.
But it's also extremely curious. Timid but always peeking.
Nature is truly amazing, every life it nurtures is so special.
The next episode will be just as captivating, so be sure not to miss it!
H-hello, could you tell me more about the Miner Civets again?
Can they really find treasures? Wait, how do they find treasures?
Relax. The idea that the Miner Civets can find treasures is just a folk tale.
People saw them playing with gems, which led to the association.
But animals are smart. Maybe they can sense treasure in a special way.
Wow! So many fascinating plants! That animal's head is as big as I am!
Brother, let's go closer to have a look!
Let's stay out of trouble. With your destructive power, it's best to admire from a distance.
Stop it—or I'll tell your mom when I get home.
Make your trip to Serene Wilds more memorable with our wide variety of souvenirs!
Adorable plushies... Are you sure you don't want one?
Hongdou skipped patrol today... Did she sneak off to the archery range west of Serene Wilds again?
So, where shall we go next?
But you've been making all the decisions for us. You know I tend to overthink things...
Here we go again. You fret before we leave, and you complain when we arrive. That's why I said I wouldn't get involved this time.
Come on, I like Serene Wilds... And I really can't decide.
Fine... Let's do what our friend here suggests. No more detours.
Go ahead, don't mind Lin Bufan.
What kind of place are you thinking of?
Hmm... Having visited the idyllic Serene Wilds, next I'd like to go somewhere crowded and bustling...
Just some bustling towns. Any recommendations?
Aerux Town? Actually, we haven't been there yet. Alright, it's settled. Lin Bufan, you're silenced.
Let me think... I've pretty much covered all of Springbrook Plains, and the only place I've been in the mountains is Serene Wilds...
Honestly, I'm too exhausted to go any further. I just need a place to rest.
We've barely walked anything at all. I told you we should use the Mechcraft scooter, but you refused.
Is it that I don't want to ride with you? Your driving skills... I flew out once, and you didn't even notice.
Look, even the passing students are annoyed by you.
Round and fluffy, be careful on the downhill!
Yeah, yeah, just take it slow... I envy you sometimes...
I heard you cured Croaky's hair loss, is that true?
Of course, look at these little Croakies in Serene Wilds. Every one of them has thick fur and shiny coats. I raised them all.
There's hope for me yet! Miracle Healer, please help me with my hair loss!
I'd like to help, but I'm just a vet.
I've tried everything. Could you give me the medicine you made for Croaky? I wouldn't mind growing feathers instead of hair!
No way! Don't listen to him! Humans and Croakies are completely different species. You can't just use medicine willy-nilly!
Brother, did you see that! Aereader flew so high! It became a tiny one in an instant!
It's Aershroud, not Aerfall. Imagine it—vanishing into thin air. That's how it got its name.
Come down now, okay? Be careful. I'll take you to see something even more interesting later.
The Nightmare Peacock is elegant but aggressive, often leaving a trail of feathers. One wonders if their tails are okay.
Don't worry about the feathers. They come from the Oneirland in the north, and their feathers grow back incredibly fast.
Well, how about this? We follow them, they fight, feathers drop, we pick...
Senior Kongming emphasized that we can only pick up feathers that have dropped naturally.
Correct. You can't hurt them just for their feathers. The Senior made his fan from ones he found on the ground.
As expected of Qing Ji, you really know a lot... What's wrong? You look lost in thought.
I have an idea. If we disguise ourselves as animals, do you think they'll come cuddle us?
There's only one way to find out. Why don't you disguise yourself as a Discipline Dog? Borrow some gear from the School of Mechcrafts, and I'll help you assemble it.
You... just want to see me lose points, don't you?
Ah, the patterns on its ears... even if there's a wound hidden among them, it'd be hard to spot.
Stay still, little Phantom Rabbit. Let me check for any missed wounds...
Butterflies love fermented things, like brews. You can use that to attract them.
What about Dream Butterfly? Can we lure it out with brew?
You're really focused on that... I've never seen a Dream Butterfly, so I can't say for sure.
That's easy! We can just ask Master Zhuangzi.
Let me check... We're selling fast. Need to restock soon. Are there really that many tourists coming to Serene Wilds lately?
Forget it, cheer up and earn money for my little Croaky's food!
They're cute, but sudden approaches stress them.
Animals may attack you when they feel threatened. What should you do?
You've said it many times, brother—you have to gain their trust before approaching them, then interact with them gently.
The Croaky's snacks are quite unique. I've never seen them before.
I'll wait and see how others react after eating it.
Though I'm a trainee Hunter, overseeing supplies feels a bit dull at the start.
I wonder when I can take you to the wild to see the animals...
Look how close those beasts are to the observation instrument. I hope they don't treat it like a toy.
Hmm... Your concerns do make sense.
Some of these beasts are exceptionally smart. They might actually pull off something unexpected.
Check out our grand opening deals!
So many cute animals in Serene Wilds...
I wouldn't dare touch them, but just watching them makes me feel happy.
There are fewer animal injuries caused by beasts now.
Their sudden frenzy indeed signals a remarkable transformation.
That troublemaker from the Hunting Society is pretty bold. If she hadn't been chased away, I would have taken her under my wing...
Those pesky Wolvines bit the legs of the Windrest Stags.
Good thing I just applied the medicine Senior Qingling gave me. It should be fine.
There have been more incidents of beasts harming animals lately. What's going on?
The air feels unusual. Rumor has it, a big one has appeared.
Recently, beasts have been roaming about. My Observation Instrument was destroyed by a bear.
Perhaps they were provoked? Could there be something that they fear...
Anyway, I hope no one and no animal gets hurt.
In my homeland, in the distant north, people believe the wind is nature's messenger.
Shh, those deer are very sensitive. Don't disturb them. This is the rehabilitation zone of Serene Wilds.
The place has returned to its usual tranquility. The Observation Instrument is fixed.
The wind tells me the animals are happy now. That gives me peace of mind to focus on my research.
You've been wandering around for a while. Got any questions?
Animals that have been injured in accidents, after receiving treatment and recovering, may still need time to readjust before returning to the wild, so they stay here for a while.
Most of us here are from the Hunting Society. We use the Observation Scope to monitor the animals, to ensure their safe release.
As for me... I used to live north of Jixia. The wind led me here, and I'm staying for a bit to observe and learn.
I prefer to rely on the changes in the wind and earth to get a general idea of the animals, and then use the Observation Scope to fill in the details.
But recently, Serene Wilds was invaded by beasts, damaging the Observation Instrument and frightening the animals.
It's a relief that it's all over now, and I can continue my research on the origin of animal migration.
Goodbye. Hmm... it feels like the wind really likes you. Is that just my imagination?
Some accidentally injured animals that can't return to the wild immediately after being treated and recovered will adapt here for a while.
zh_text: 一些意外受了伤的动物，接受治疗痊愈后还一时无法回到野外，就会在这里稍作适应。
source_text: 一些意外受了伤的动物，接受治疗痊愈后还一时无法回到野外，就会在这里稍作适应。
official_target_text: Some accidentally injured animals that can't return to the wild immediately after being treated and recovered will adapt here for a while.
official_en_text: Some accidentally injured animals that can't return to the wild immediately after being treated and recovered will adapt here for a while.

text: The tracks are clear as day.
Senior Liusan said the wind here can tell us what happened in Serene Wilds.
Yeah! I didn't really get it either! But the scenery here is beautiful.
The southern woods seem restless, with beasts frequently trespassing Serene Wilds.
This is the territory of the Hunting Society. We observe and care for many small animals in Serene Wilds.
I've seen many mystical creatures in the Dreamwood, but Serene Wilds has observation instruments to record more information.
Living with animals is my dream.
Goodbye. One day, I'll return to Yunmeng Ze as a member of the Hunting Society.
Not a kitty or puppy, it's a Scholarly Tiger!
zh_text: 不是小猫小狗，是堂听虎！
source_text: 不是小猫小狗，是堂听虎！

text: Not a kitty or puppy, it's a Scholarly Tiger!
zh_text: 不是小猫小狗，是堂听虎！
source_text: 不是小猫小狗，是堂听虎！

text: Preydators are so cute. I should share my food with them.
My little pot never rests. I cook snacks and medicine for the animals here.
Preydators are especially fond of food! By the way, I can make pastries in the shape of Preydators.
Preydator is a lively herbivore, but for some reason, all the beasts are afraid of it.
People in Jixia used to hang puppet or paper cutouts of Preydator outside their homes, and it worked.
The elders say the Preydator is the offspring of a giant Divine Beast. Like a caterpillar transforming into a butterfly, the Preydator might suddenly metamorphose too.
But we haven't seen anything like that yet, haha.
Yes, I'm one of the Gourmet Society members responsible for meals here. Everyone works hard, so it's my job to keep them well-fed.
Bu, your cooking is so delicious, it's worrying me.
Huh? How is my cooking a bad thing?
I came to Serene Wilds to lose weight by walking and watching animals.
But the aroma of your cooking has rooted me to the spot!
Haha, I get it now. Maybe we shouldn't give any to Mr. Fey next time, okay?
Oh, come on, just one bite won't hurt. I'll start my diet tomorrow.
Quantity check... injury meds, pest control meds, toxin meds.
And there's a physical boost medicine for emergency use.
Hunters face dangers. Logistics must be handled well.
Embermanes are majestic, but they're too dangerous.
Everyone says Embermane and Wolvines are sworn enemies, haha!
Craftsmen make Embermane-shaped pots that sell well in northern shops.
But seeing Embermanes outside? Better run fast!
They were once besieged by Wolvines, and a lone Embermane defeated the beasts, saving them.
Others claim Embermane is the fire-breathing Stove God.
You know a lot about Embermanes?
Haha, it's just my family has a bit of a connection with Embermanes!
My name honors an Embermane. My parents were Hunters.
I have to mention the legend of Embermanes. In ancient times, people trained them to pull war chariots.
Even the beasts here don't like it.
The beasts here are getting restless. Maybe it's because Embermane is here!
Some craftsmen make pots in the shape of Zhuo Rong, which sell very well in the northern shops.
zh_text: 一些工匠会做灼绒形状的壶，在北面商铺卖得很好。
source_text: 一些工匠会做灼绒形状的壶，在北面商铺卖得很好。
official_target_text: Some craftsmen make pots in the shape of Zhuo Rong, which sell very well in the northern shops.
official_en_text: Some craftsmen make pots in the shape of Zhuo Rong, which sell very well in the northern shops.

text: I knew those beasts were connected to Embermane.
I knew it! The beasts went wild because of Embermane!
My Hunting Society instincts are scarily accurate...
Why would Embermane affect other beasts?
I think it's partly because they have a feud and have always been at odds.
On the other hand, I believe Embermanes possess superior intelligence and many unknown abilities.
So we can't speculate its behavior like we do with other beasts.
Hey, you're back. Feeling unwell again?
Xiang Yi, don't you find it odd that they always show up right before mealtime?
No way. They're still recovering. They need more time to grow stronger...
I've been secretly observing them. They're full of energy when you're not looking!
So that's why I couldn't find any source of illness in them!
The Observation Instrument is finally fixed. Now we can collect more comprehensive data on the Preydator.
Well-prepared tools make variable tasks easier.
First time in Serene Wilds? This is the paradise for Jixia's animals and Hunters.
We often use a Mechcraft called the Observation Scope to study animals from a distance. Look, I'm using it right now.
Many observation instruments were damaged, but thankfully they've been repaired, so I can continue my research on Preydators.
Are you from the Hunting Society?
What, don't I look the part? Maybe it's because I'm from the School of Mechcrafts.
These two roles don't conflict. Many Mechcrafts draw inspiration from animals.
For example, I learned a lot while observing and studying the Preydator.
Maybe one day I'll invent a Mechcraft wonder that astonishes the world!
Serene Wilds belongs to the animals, we Hunters are just observers.
Are you from the Hunting Society?
But many observation instruments were damaged recently, causing data loss, even for Preydator...
First time in Serene Wilds? This is the paradise for Jixia's animals and Hunters.
We often use a Mechcraft called the Observation Scope to study animals from a distance. Look, I'm using it right now.
Lost data can be recalculated, but it's really inconvenient for work. I hope those observation instruments get fixed soon.
What, don't I look the part? Maybe it's because I'm from the School of Mechcrafts.
These two roles don't conflict. Many Mechcrafts draw inspiration from animals.
For example, I learned a lot while observing and studying the Preydator.
Maybe one day I'll invent a Mechcraft wonder that astonishes the world!
The scenery in Serene Wilds is breathtaking. Every time I look at it, I feel an infinite sense of vitality that's hard to put into words.
Yes! People are all about living in harmony with nature these days.
What a vibrant world this is.
Welcome, everyone! This is Serene Wilds, a paradise for small animals!
Are you interested in animals too?
You've come to the right place! This is the famous Serene Wilds, Jixia's most renowned animal research site and a protected area.
Many Hunters like me choose to intern here. It's a great way to get close to the animals we love and gain experience.
Anyway, you know what? You'd better experience it yourself.
Are you from the Hunting Society?
Of course! I may not have been a Hunter for long, but I've got the basics covered.
Someday, you'll hear about me from others!
If only we'd trusted each other from the start!
Thanks to a kind soul, the Observation Instrument has been restored to its original state...
Hey, aren't you the kind person who fixed the observation instrument? This is the Hunters' Mechcraft workshop!
I assembled many of the Mechcrafts in Serene Wilds! Of course, this Mechcraft console helped a lot too.
I sought advice from seniors at the School of Mechcrafts, and their suggestions really helped.
See those Mechcrafts shaped like small towers? Those are the observation instruments. The rotating spherical Mechcrafts are used for recording.
Our research heavily relies on the Observation Instrument. Li Su always says that soon, we'll be able to detect even a few extra hairs on an animal!
I should thank you for fixing the observation instrument. Our research can continue now.
Goodbye, come find me when you have time.
Hey there! This is the Mechcraft Workshop of the Hunting Society!
I assembled many of the Mechcrafts in Serene Wilds! Of course, this Mechcraft console helped a lot too.
See those Mechcrafts shaped like small towers? Those are the observation instruments. The rotating spherical Mechcrafts are used for recording.
Li Suk liked the observation instrument. He always said that in the future, even if small animals grew a few more hairs, he could spot it!
Goodbye, come find me when you have time.
I've got it! I can add a boom to make the observation instrument even more effective.
Are you here to see the cute animals too?
I sought advice from seniors at the School of Mechcrafts, and their suggestions really helped.
However, the observation instrument has been malfunctioning lately. You can ask Szuo, but he has a short temper, so don't mention I sent you.
My eyes are hurting from looking at Mechcraft parts all day. I need some fresh air.
The animals caused some distractions, but we still managed to complete today's tasks.
Anyway, it's nice to see these little guys playing around.
Qisheng, help me take a look. Tangtang hasn't been himself since yesterday.
zh_text: 七声你帮我看看，堂堂它从昨天开始就没精神。
source_text: 七声你帮我看看，堂堂它从昨天开始就没精神。
official_target_text: Qisheng, help me take a look. Tangtang hasn't been himself since yesterday.
official_en_text: Qisheng, help me take a look. Tangtang hasn't been himself since yesterday.

text: Fu Zhu! Let's go hunt some bison!
Why aren't you pestering me for toys today, Huahua?
No more Scholarly Tiger toys, they ignore me.
Haha, are you afraid of them?
Hmm... I thought they'd be a bit more proactive.
It's okay. We'll go together tomorrow. Don't be scared!
I've been feeding some Croakies here in Serene Wilds.
I thought this would be an easy job, but it's exhausting.
Croaky eats several meals a day.
To prevent them from eating too much at once, I have to get up several times at night to feed them.
The food is so tempting today, I need to eat a lot.
Hold on! This is for the animals, and most of it is raw. You can't eat it.
The animals' meals look so good! Can I have some?
Research so intense, even meals forgotten.
I'll make you something cooked. Just give me a moment.
I should enjoy it while the ingredients are fresh, hehe.
Food for the next few days is all set. It feels so good to have plenty!
Need help moving things? I'm your guy!
Sturdy goods for strength, fragile goods for precision.
It's a great choice for us Martial Artists.
Hehe, I've been showing my face at the warehouse quite a few times today.
No one's gonna find out I'm slacking off, right?
Yeen, shall we visit Serene Wilds more often?
Huh? I thought you hated walking.
Listen to the sounds of the wind, water, birds, and insects.
Now look at these people and animals resting. Doesn't it feel like something's missing?
Got it, music is missing. Let's bring it to them!
There were so many beasts before, it scared me to death.
I'm good at hiding, but not always.
Now I can finally get back to work.
Why are you looking at me like that? Is it wrong to be cautious?
Don't be fooled by my looks—I have the talent of an ink lion. Beasts never find me.
Blend in, hide yourself, be a low-key Hunting Society member—that's how you observe everything, hehehe.
Keep your voice down. Don't let the animals spot us.
Did you see those Spike Bears? They're terrifying! If those massive claws grab you, no one could survive.
You look capable. How about you help me chase those pesky beasts away?
Serene Wilds is beautiful, but it's also home to many fierce beasts.
Doing my duty as a Hunter, researching animals.
I didn't graduate from the School of Martial Arts, so I need to be careful.
Someday, we'll both be top Hunters!
You are! Just stay focused and keep learning, and you'll get there.
Sure, I want to be a bird-watching master! But they're really sensitive to their surroundings, one slight move and they'll fly away.
That's why we need to give them space, so they can always feel free.
You must be quite into birdwatching! Just be careful, though—Wolvines and Spike Bears have been causing trouble in the southern woods lately.
No wonder your sister isn't here today. Is she scared?
Nope, not a chance! Cheng Cheng's never been afraid of anything. She's out on the hill playing with a Scholarly Tiger right now.
It definitely will! As long as we observe carefully and study diligently, there will be no problems.
zh_text: 一定会的！我们只要用心观察，踏实学习，一定没问题的。
source_text: 一定会的！我们只要用心观察，踏实学习，一定没问题的。
official_target_text: It definitely will! As long as we observe carefully and study diligently, there will be no problems.
official_en_text: It definitely will! As long as we observe carefully and study diligently, there will be no problems.

text: Finally, the long day comes to an end. Time to take stock of the materials at the warehouse...
This tough job is really a test of endurance!
Come to me if you need any herbs!
Healing animals requires professional skills and a lot of love.
I've got some healing herbs here. They work on animals too.
One day, there could be Mechcraft claws to help disabled animals walk again.
Why do you care so much about animals?
As a child, I heard legends of Cloudeater. I came to Jixia to search for their traces.
I haven't seen Cloudeater, but I'm drawn to the animals here. I want to protect these reckless little guys.
There's an observation instrument outside the tent, perfect for observing animals. If you're interested, why not take a look?
This isn't a dining area. Look how you've flustered...
Just hold on a bit longer, I'll get you some tasty food as soon as I'm done!
We're new to Serene Wilds, surrounded by beasts. Should we hire a Hunting Society guide?
Guides? We're here to train our skills against beasts. Wouldn't it be perfect to run into them?
Huh? If they're dangerous, I'll chase them off. I don't have to fight them, right?
The Hunting Society always emphasizes getting along with animals.
Well... you both have a point. Maybe I'm just too eager for a fight, haha.
You should learn to coexist with animals. We should attend a lecture by the Hunting Society.
The lights at the workstations came on one by one, but the Craft Society definitely doesn't have the ability to wrestle with beasts...
Oh, it's you. I saw the light on at the workbench and knew you were helping out. Thank you so much.
Thanks for your help. Once they're all fixed, we can get Mr. Zuo to unlock the door.
Ugh, Master can be so stubborn... Why won't he listen to the Craft Society?
The noises in the warehouse are getting more intense. Those beasts that wrecked the observation instrument—I suspect they've snuck inside.
Honestly... I'm scared. Please, you have to fix the Observation Instrument.
You must have fixed this. The Craft Society doesn't have the ability to wrestle with beasts.
Fantastic! All the lights on the workbench are finally lit up!
Yes, I fixed it. Many beasts are roaming near the Observation Instrument.
Yes, I fixed it. Many beasts are roaming near the Observation Instrument.
Yeah, they warned Mr. Zhuo, but he wouldn't believe it. He insisted the Serene Wilds he knew wouldn't do this.
They accused the team of negligence and locked the storehouse as punishment. It's so frustrating.
Now I can explain to my teacher. He has no reason to lock the warehouse anymore.
Have you been guarding the storehouse all this time?
Have you been guarding the storehouse all this time?
Yes, and there have been beast sounds from the warehouse lately. I've been on edge...
But I dare not go against Mr. Seizer. He's terrifying when angry. I'll open the door for you right away!
Alright, the door's open. If things get hairy, you call me in. I don't like the idea of you going alone.
You've been a great help. Before you proceed, take what's inside the chest by the entrance. It may be of assistance.
Don't worry. I've been guarding the warehouse and haven't let anyone in. No signs of beast activity for now.
I don't know what's inside. If you plan to check out the storehouse, be careful.
Please stop right there! At Mr. Zhuo's request, the warehouse is temporarily closed.
I wonder when he'll calm down. Better come back later.
The observation instrument is still broken, the Craft Society can't beat the beasts, and the warehouse... what should I do now?!
It's a long story. You see those observation instruments over there? They're usually maintained by the Craft Society.
Now all the observation instruments are damaged. The Craft Society says it's due to beast invasion, but Mr. Shi doesn't believe it.
He insisted it was the Craft Society's negligence in maintaining the observation instrument that caused the damage.
They closed the warehouse and stuck me on guard duty. No one enters until all the Observation Instruments are fixed.
What's going on in the warehouse?
It's not the storehouse, it's the observation instrument... According to the Craft Society, wild beasts have invaded Serene Wilds.
Well, I'll be honest with you—I've been hearing strange growls behind me ever since I was assigned to guard the warehouse.
I'm sure I didn't! But once Mr. Si makes a decision, no one can change it. And he's still upset...
Could you do me a favor... Fix the observation instrument and check if there really is a monster in the warehouse?
Fine... Come on, someone fix the Observation Instrument already, so I can be free too.
You're here! We owe you so much for last time—I don't know how to repay you.
Ever since you helped us take down Embermane, we haven't had any more beast attacks.
I've been thinking, when I disagree with my elders, should I speak up or stay quiet?
Next time something like this happens, I should talk to my elders instead of avoiding them.
It's one thing to fear beasts, but don't be afraid to communicate with people like this.
I heard sounds of combat. Did you defeat the beast? Are you injured? I was so worried about you...
But Xiao Ling stopped me, saying I'd only make things worse.
There's an Embermane inside, but I'm fine, don't worry.
There's an Embermane inside, but I'm fine, don't worry.
Such a powerful beast! Actually, Mr. Zuo also came to take a look earlier. He saw the claw marks and ashes left behind.
He didn't say much, but now he should realize he misunderstood the Craft Society before.
Maybe. But don't just wait for others to realize their mistakes. Sometimes you need to speak up. Don't suffer in silence.
Maybe. But don't just wait for others to realize their mistakes. Sometimes you need to speak up. Don't suffer in silence.
But I'm afraid of conflict. He is our teacher after all... Going against a senior just doesn't feel right.
I understand you don't want to disagree with your elder, but sharing your thoughts doesn't mean you're being disrespectful.
I understand you don't want to disagree with your elder, but sharing your thoughts doesn't mean you're being disrespectful.
Next time, try talking to others and finding the courage first.
Next time, try talking to others and finding the courage first.
You make a good point. Let me think about it...
You're right, I should talk to them. I'll think about it. Thanks.
Goodness, that's loud. Could it be... a wild beast?
Don't worry, it was just an Embermane. I've already taken care of it.
Don't worry, it was just an Embermane. I've already taken care of it.
Embermane?! Not just Wolvines, but Embermanes too?!
The books say Embermanes are the natural predators of deer. Could it be...
I raised the deer outside the designated observation zone. Could that have attracted them?
Anyway, thank you for helping Serene Wilds. I need to report back to the teachers now, goodbye...
Might it be dangerous in there? Should I go take a look?
It's okay, it's me. As for the noise, it must have been the sound of my fight with Embermane.
It's okay, it's me. As for the noise, it must have been the sound of my fight with Embermane.
You scared me! You... you were the one inside that thing?!
The soil here is loose, and there are often rockfalls blocking the entrance. It's a good thing you're okay!
They broke the observation instrument and lied to me.
Ha, locking the warehouse keeps you young ones on your toes!
Lock the storehouse, and they'll stop calling us old guys beasts. Hmph.
I've never seen you before. Are you new to Serene Wilds?
Serene Wilds is their territory. What you saw are just animals... or beasts, if you insist.
I've asked the Hunting Society, and they said the TDs won't break Mechcrafts.
It's just an excuse they use to cover up their mistakes. You don't need to speak for them.
I see the light on the workbench has lit up.
I thought it was that stubborn girl's friend, not you.
They asked you for help, right? A bunch of slackers. Whatever your relationship is with them, this has nothing to do with you.
But I promise, if I fix them all... well, let this be a lesson. If they cause trouble again, I'll lock the warehouse!
All lights are on. Pretty quick, huh? You were using the beast as an excuse before, but you fixed it all anyway.
Beasts aren't the excuse—they're no match for beasts. I repaired the observation instrument.
Beasts aren't the excuse—they're no match for beasts. I repaired the observation instrument.
Tsk, why do you young people love to talk without evidence?
Never mind, as long as work can proceed normally, that's good enough. Go tell Hwee Shun to open the warehouse.
As for these young men, if they can't realize their own problems... they won't always have someone to help them.
Beasts aren't the excuse. They aren't the match for beasts. I repaired the observation instrument.
zh_text: 野兽不是借口，他们不是野兽的对手，观察仪是我修的。
source_text: 野兽不是借口，他们不是野兽的对手，观察仪是我修的。
official_target_text: Beasts aren't the excuse. They aren't the match for beasts. I repaired the observation instrument.
official_en_text: Beasts aren't the excuse. They aren't the match for beasts. I repaired the observation instrument.

text: Those bastards, using beasts and reinforcements...
Hmph, this time, let's just have them release the warehouse and spare them.
If it happens again, they'll be punished. Can't let them learn to cheat.
These young men are so lazy! They can't even handle their own jobs properly, always dreaming about sneaking into the vault for their own research!
Time you learned your lesson. I'm shutting down the storehouse for good!
Back in the day, we built Mechcraft houses from scratch. Kids these days have it easy...
Hmph! They can't even handle their job properly!
See those indicator lights over there? Tsk, tsk, tsk... four of them are out. That means the observation instrument is half broken!
None of this would've broken with proper care! You can't manage that, and you want storage room access? Forget it.
Shouldn't I be angry? It's bad enough they neglected their duties, but they cooked up a pack of lies to cover it up.
They claimed the beasts did it, but I think it was their fault. Do I look that gullible to them?
I even checked with the Hunting Society—beasts would never attack people or Mechcrafts. This lie is... amateur.
Go do whatever you do... Kids these days...
Huh? What are you doing? *cough* You've made quite a racket—didn't break anything, did you? Now this old man has to fix it.
Ahem... I never expected to actually find monsters in Serene Wilds—and they can breathe fire too! It took me forever to recover from the choking.
The observation instrument is damaged... They claimed a beast attack, and it's true...
Those young men were right. The observation instrument isn't malfunctioning because they neglected maintenance... How should I put this...
You've got to see it to believe it... Who would've thought such a terrifying beast would show up in Serene Wilds? B-but...
They didn't explain it clearly! They said it was damaged by monsters but had no evidence. How could I believe it?
And they started to get all worked up. Young people these days, always so quick to get angry!
You should apologize to the students.
What? Since when did an elder apologize to a younger one?
My intention was to test their skills and push them to properly maintain the Mechcrafts.
Even if it was a misunderstanding... Hmph, they're so proud. If I apologize, would they really accept it?
Just leave me alone... If you get burned, go see the Herb Society for medicine!
Perhaps I should try to be more patient...
Ahem... Speed up the Mechcraft repairs!
No, no, no... Why isn't the mechcraft fixed yet?
Ugh, happy now? I said it.
Trying to connect with the younger generation?
Eavesdropping, really? You should stop that.
So what? I'm just saving us the trouble of unnecessary communication...
That's it! Alright, alright, go back to wherever you came from. Don't disturb my thoughts.
That tone is not quite right either.
That's already a very gentle inquiry! Still not good enough?
What now? Dealing with these youngsters is more complicated than any Mechcraft structure!
Finally, he's gone. Let's continue. Ouch... how should I put it...
Hey, Serene Wilds has been pretty restless lately, you gotta be careful!
By the way, you should be careful elsewhere too. Other animals seem to be getting restless as well.
Yes, wild beasts invaded recently and hurt my deer.
I don't know where that guy's hiding now. I hope it doesn't get caught!
There have been frequent wild animal attacks lately. I volunteered for patrol duty in this area.
Though the deer isn't fully grown, and I'm not sure if I can fend off the attacking beasts.
But as a new Hunter, it's my job to protect Serene Wilds.
Strange, the light's on. Those Artisans aren't a match for the beasts. You fixed it, didn't you?
It's okay if the storehouse can't be opened. We'll just wear them out. You don't have to go through so much trouble for us.
It's not that you can't, but this is our business with Strazer.
He scolded us about the damaged Observation Instrument and locked up the warehouse. But I won't take it lying down.
After all, neither you nor the Craft Society is at fault for the damage. It's all the fault of that wretched beast.
And that Szuo, blaming us for no reason. Threatening to destroy the warehouse... he's way over the line!
I just fixed it out of habit.
Kind souls like you are rare... except for Shuxun.
I appreciate your help, but this is all because of Sto's mistake. He even got Xun to stand guard.
That old man just assumed we broke the instruments without checking the facts.
Once you're done, Szuo will probably unlock the warehouse. But if he doesn't apologize, I won't let it go.
Goodbye. I'll wait for Szuo's apology.
It's really frustrating. I've been studying Mechcraft for years, and I've never been treated like this before.
He accused me without a shred of evidence. I won't lift a finger.
Hmph, let's see who can outlast whom.
See the observation instrument beside me?
They were damaged by the invaded beasts, but the old man doesn't believe it.
He didn't believe us and locked us in the high-level materials warehouse! He says he'll let us out only after we fix the observation instrument.
A timid one like Shuxun might budge, I won't!
Of course, it's just damaged by beasts.
Just put the spherical parts back on the pedestals. Even a new apprentice like me can do it easily.
Goodbye, talking to you has eased my temper a bit.
Finally! We were so worried. Shuxun almost rushed in to help you.
Now that old man won't have anything to say. I'll make him apologize in front of everyone.
How about trying to talk things out?
That stubborn old man would never listen to us younger ones.
I'd rather believe that beast will apologize than trust he'll listen to reason.
Guess I need to work on my Martial Arts to match his standard.
So, Szuak isn't that kind of arrogant person? He actually seems to want to apologize to us.
I didn't expect that either, but now he believes the damage to the instrument had nothing to do with the Tinkerers. That misunderstanding is finally cleared up.
I didn't expect that either, but now he believes the damage to the instrument had nothing to do with the Tinkerers. That misunderstanding is finally cleared up.
I'm still a bit upset, but I want to believe he's not an arrogant person.
He studied the ecology of Serene Wilds with the Hunting Society before coming here, though what he learned is a bit outdated...
After you repair the Observation Instrument, he keeps his word and allows you to open the warehouse.
Maybe I should change how I communicate with elders too?
What if I run into a wild beast?
But I'm a member of the Hunting Society, I can't give up...
It's okay, it's me. As for the noise, it must have been the sound of my fight with Embermane.
zh_text: 没事的，是我。至于你说的动静，应该是我和灼绒战斗的声音。
source_text: 没事的，是我。至于你说的动静，应该是我和灼绒战斗的声音。
official_target_text: It's okay, it's me. As for the noise, it must have been the sound of my fight with Embermane.
official_en_text: It's okay, it's me. As for the noise, it must have been the sound of my fight with Embermane.

text: You scared me! You... you were the one inside that thing?!
zh_text: 吓我一跳！刚、刚才是你在里面呀！
source_text: 吓我一跳！刚、刚才是你在里面呀！
official_target_text: You scared me! W-were you inside just now?
official_en_text: You scared me! W-were you inside just now?

text: The soil here is loose, and there are often rockfalls blocking the entrance. It's a good thing you're okay!
zh_text: 这里的土质比较疏松，经常有碎石滑落会堵住洞口，还好你没事！
source_text: 这里的土质比较疏松，经常有碎石滑落会堵住洞口，还好你没事！
official_target_text: The soil here is loose, and rubble falls to block the entrance. Thank the Sages you're okay!
official_en_text: The soil here is loose, and rubble falls to block the entrance. Thank the Sages you're okay!

text: What's up, bubble? Are you playing hide-and-seek with someone?
You've been hiding here for a while. Why not go back and check? Maybe the round is already over.
Xiaohu, did you sneak out to play when the observation instrument broke down?
Hmm? Really? Then who was that little one cheering on the sidelines when Croaky and Naughty Civet were arguing?
The observation instrument is fixed. Now, be good and take your examination.
Do you need anything? I'm about to check the little ones!
I'm a new member of the Hunting Society. I love these little guys so much that I volunteered to come to Serene Wilds.
I play with the Scholarly Tigers and record their behavior to check their health.
The observation instrument broke recently, and a lot of work has been put on hold... I still can't get over it!
It was clearly the work of Wolvines, but that arrogant old man Szuo just wouldn't believe it. I'd love to send Xiaohu to bite his butt!
I was just thinking about giving these little guys a check-up.
Scholarly Tigers are naturally curious. When the observation instrument broke down earlier, several of them sneaked out.
I was terrified—thought there were bad guys or wild beasts out there... Luckily, my sister helped me get it back.
Have you seen my sister? Her name is You Lai. Luckily, she quickly found these little guys wandering nearby.
If I hadn't shown up in time, who knows what would've happened to those poor little creatures!
They even wrecked the observation instrument.
But no matter what I say, that stubborn old man won't listen. He's more annoying than a Wolvine!
We need to increase patrols here. It's too close to the beasts' territory.
Exactly. It'd be disastrous if beasts got in and hurt them... Patrols are just a temporary fix; we need to boost protection.
Wait, the observation instrument suddenly started transmitting records again!
What an eye-opener! I thought I was going to fail animal observation class for sure.
If I wait for Mr. Slade and the Craft Society to reach a consensus, I don't know how long it'll take.
The underground observation instrument is also damaged. What's going on lately...
The new teacher is furious at the warehouse, blaming the Craft Society for negligence.
I have a feeling there's more to it.
I have a bad feeling too, but we can't check it out.
The herbs should be ready by now...
Serene Wilds has perfect conditions. If I plant herbs here... will Gourmand Civets steal them?
Scholarly Tigers are known for their curiosity. Next time, bring something novel to facilitate my observations.
Got it... Bring toys for Scholarly Tigers...
Senior, could there be a problem with the gunpowder formula?
Impossible. I followed the book to the letter.
There might be a glitch somewhere. Get ready, let's try again.
The previous master left behind many cannon designs. Study them.
I know, but they're covered in Croaky claw marks! It's hard to read.
Don't make excuses for being lazy!
If it fails to launch again, that would be too discouraging.
zh_text: 万一又没发射成功，太打击了。
source_text: 万一又没发射成功，太打击了。
official_target_text: If it fails to launch again, that would be too discouraging.
official_en_text: If it fails to launch again, that would be too discouraging.

text: Just visiting? This is the Cannoneers' base, so watch out for accidental discharges!
When visiting our training hall, always stay alert.
Welcome to Obsidian Flame Training Hall, home of Jixia's most advanced cannons.
Cannoneers and people from all over come here to study and test their cannons.
If you're here for experiments or research, check out the Testing Range and Wildfire Corridor.
If you're sightseeing, feel free to rest at the Cliffside Terrace or Firefly Plaza. They are quieter.
Oh... I'm waiting for the person bringing me the parts. Why isn't he here yet?
It definitely wasn't because he failed every cannon test for a month and got punished by his master.
The structure needs more tweaking, especially the cannon barrel. It just doesn't feel right.
The design data has been recalculated a dozen times. There won't be any issues. Don't burn yourself out.
I thought you wanted to take a break. Why are you still talking about Mechcrafts?
I can't stop worrying until my experiment is complete.
I hope my research goes smoothly.
First time at Obsidian Flame Training Hall? This is where the Cannon Society conducts research.
But we managed to sneak away for a bit. Research can be mind-numbing at times.
If you're interested in cannons, head to the research area to the right of the entrance. My companions are all there.
Nothing, I was hoping to relax a bit, but Li Yu just keeps talking about Mechcrafts.
Research is crucial. One mistake could lead to disaster.
But being so tense all the time isn't good for research either. Once you're done with this phase, let's head down the mountain and have some fun.
Goodbye, and happy training at Obsidian Flame Training Hall!
The head trainer of Obsidian Flame Training Hall?
The Cannoneers here possess exceptional intellect and passion. I must keep up.
Are you responsible for training the students here?
Are you here to discuss cannon techniques or challenge me?
I hope you gain something from your time at Obsidian Flame Training Hall.
Yes. Obsidian Flame Training Hall attracts those interested in Mechcraft and cannons. They appointed me to care for this place.
I'm glad they trust me. I'm constantly improving my Mechcraft to be worthy of their faith.
No need for formalities. We're companions and friends.
Exchanging ideas, engaging in friendly competitions, the Cannon Society continually improves through this exchange.
If you've got any fancy moves, I'd love to see them in action.
Goodbye, Obsidian Flame Training Hall is always open to you.
I hope the new firearms we've iterated on can handle those God-Marked monsters.
However... if I'm to process this many firearm orders, I'll have to put in more effort.
You saw the match between Meng Ya and Senior Sun Bin, right? Clearly, Senior Sun Bin has greater vision.
I still believe the Cannon Society should take on a guardian role and unleash firepower like Meng Ya.
I knew a wise person would share my thoughts. Though we're just passing by, we've formed a connection.
But I heard Meng Ya got angry and destroyed a lot with his cannon. Hope the academy's got deep pockets.
Hehe, isn't that so? Not only are you good at Mechcraft, but you're also helpful...
Sun Bin is a Mechcraft genius. He explores all possibilities of Mechcraft.
Alright, I admit both philosophies are important. Neither can be neglected.
Sigh, I was hoping that if mechanism arts developed for a few more years, I'd be able to catch mice...
Before that day even came, the cloud silk was almost gone...
Sigh, I was hoping that if mechanism arts developed for a few more years, I'd be able to catch mice...
Before that day even came, the cloud silk was almost gone...
Is there an issue with the quality of this batch of goods?
It's fine. Let me check if the gunpowder is damp with my Scholarly Tiger.
Alright, I've got some fish treats. Scholarly Tiger, you got this!
Wow, I've never seen these cannons before. I wonder how they work.
Which one should I buy? It's so hard to decide...
I'm choosing from the new cannons. There are so many types... which should I pick?
Honestly, maybe I should just buy one of each... but that might be too much of a waste...
Yes! Cannons give me a sense of security.
So sweet... Maybe I should get some for my friends.
But how can I reduce recoil while keeping its firepower?
We need to get creative with the design.
My teacher always tells me to watch out for the recoil of cannons. But the more powerful they are, the stronger the kickback will be. It's so frustrating...
I still have to do it myself...
Maybe you can learn from Mr. Blazen.
Yes, Blazen has a real knack for controlling cannons. If even fireworks can be fired from them, there must be a way to reduce the recoil.
It's possible, but we can't copy the design of fireworks and cannons. We may need to redesign it.
Come on, you're a Mechcraft student! I know you can figure it out.
You could learn from Meng Ya.
Really? That's awesome! I've always dreamed of having cannons as powerful as Senior Meng Ya's!
He seems pretty fit. It's a good idea to train yourself to handle the recoil!
Hmm... But the problem with the cannon itself still isn't solved. If anything, it's even more pronounced.
Hehe, so my biggest problem is that my firepower isn't strong enough. I think I've got an idea!
If you don't study the Mechcraft itself, I won't be able to help you.
A stroll here is always refreshing. The market needs more people to liven it up!
Enjoy the night market, chat with classmates and all sorts of people, freeing yourself from daytime studies and work.
I believe everyone needs a balance between work and rest.
It's good for the body, mind, and productivity.
As night falls, the Firefly Plaza transforms into a bustling market. I love coming here to chat with the locals.
It lifts my mood and helps me relax.
Chatting with others really expands my mind. Most of my ideas come from talking to people.
Goodbye, and thank you for listening.
Every night, Firefly Plaza turns into a bustling market. This is my favorite time to come here, stroll around, and chat with people.

text: What brings you here? Welcome! Take a look around!
The honor of your visit elevates our humble shop to unparalleled glory! I am your dedicated sales representative, allow me the privilege of serving you!
We sell all kinds of goodies! A near-century-old brand!
How long have you been doing this?
Only you could ask such a professional question! Yes, I acquired this shop last year.
Story: The reborn me sells bestsellers in Jixia and makes a customer fall in love with me!
With your wealth, why not spend some on our products?
Even the back of you looks dashing as you leave! Hope to see you again next time!
Been waiting for you! That Mechcraft Rat Repellent was great. Do you still sell it?
How do you like the market?
Oh, my eyes must be playing tricks on me. My bad!
It's the Mechcraft that scares away the gophers. Those little pests are always nibbling on crops and running faster than you can say "gopher"!
I got it from a Jixia Academy student. You guys look quite similar, actually.
I love it. It's lively, and the items are of good quality. I always find something interesting.
And there's the night market food. Mr. Peng's skills are unmatched. I highly recommend it.
Take care... Do you think that person will come back?
Seems like your invention is quite a hit, Guanhe!
It's just that everyone is used to my work... Your design is also great.
But I think this is okay. You don't need to do great things. Just be happy.
See you later! Don't forget to come to the plaza tonight!
This one, and that one... Looks like I'll need to go back.
Still a ways to the market. There's plenty of time.
Let's see if we're missing anything. We can't afford another trip.
Are you here for the fair too? You're here way too early, it doesn't start until tonight.
The market's bustling, you can find everything there.
Fireworks, crackers, cannons, and snacks. Don't miss out!
I'm setting up for tonight's sales. All sorts of fresh inventions.
I've been working on a "Mosquito Vanquisher", a portable mini Mechcraft cannon designed to eliminate pesky mosquitoes.
My experiments are halfway done. Soon I'll be able to showcase my inventions at the market. I can't wait for that day!
Hey, I told you not to run off. Now the first thing you do is sneak onto the cannon.
Cannon experiments are dangerous. Promise me you won't be so reckless again, okay?

I wonder if the cancellation of the Dream Performance finals and the Dean's disappearance will affect the night market...
Great! I've been looking forward to it! This place is a paradise for Cannons!
From cannon designs to gunpowder experiments, it's got everything.
Yes, I heard they have a night market there. Not only plenty of tasty food, but also lots of cannons.
Ha, we're finally open for business today! Take twenty percent off, pick whatever you like!

text: Hey, ever since the Divine Rune monsters appeared... none of the students have the heart to buy posters anymore...
You don't understand cannons. You got blown up, right?
I thought I needed more practice to supplement theory... and well, you saw what happened.
Okay, stop moving. Let me heal you.
According to the design, the materials for forging Mechcrafts should be...
This is the first step in Mechcraft production—we can't afford any mistakes.
How's it going on your end? Found any reference data?
No, this book doesn't mention it either.
But there's some data on cannons, which should come in handy for experiments in the core area.
Phew... been researching cannons all day, I smell like gunpowder.
It's cooler here... but there's still a bit of a smoky smell. If only the wind were stronger.
Stay calm, stay patient. Research comes first.
Zi Yuan is creative, so let her go. I've checked the data, so there shouldn't be any major issues.
Electromagnetic, cannon, smoke... wait, what was I supposed to check again?
Come on, remember already! Or that "unreliable" label is never coming off!
Well, as you can see, this bookshelf stores all the documents used in the research of the entire corridor.
Whether it's comparing materials, verifying data, or determining how to handle byproducts, it all happens here.
But the documents are all over the place, and my memory isn't great...
I always forget what my teacher wants me to do. What should I do?
I guess I was too obvious. But he's waiting for me to gather the materials. I'm really in a hurry!
This place retrieves data from all other areas and provides resources. The content is incredibly vast.
Finding the right water in this vast ocean is too hard for me!
I just can't remember those names... Maybe I'm not cut out for this...
You've been working on it for a while. Any progress?
Once this Mechcraft passes the pressure test, it can be mounted on the main body.
We must start with basic principles when verifying parts.
But book knowledge is always limited. Try it yourself, and you'll see what I mean.
But practice without theory is like a ship without anchor.
Here... or maybe here? Let me check where the problem is.
Aren't you from the School of Mechcrafts? Show us what you've got!
Once it's assembled, we can send it to the core team right away.
Don't rush, even the best Craft Society members have to take it one step at a time.
What a mess. He's left the books scattered all over the place...
Doing things halfway... isn't that just making trouble for the next guy?
It's sweltering there, much cooler here.
Since we have some time to spare, we might as well think about what to buy at the night market.
I heard they're selling Luban and Meng Ya figurines at the night market. I must get them this time.
I'm just a bystander, what did I do to deserve this!
These rascals are a real handful!
Why are you asking me? I'm a Cannoneer.
Cannons don't have eyes, so stay safe, everyone!
Ugh, these guys get so obsessed with their research.
The night market is so lively, with so many fascinating things.
Too bad I'm on patrol. There are just too many safety risks to check.
How long until these scraps are remelted? The core area is pushing for progress.
There's no rush. Even if it melts, there's still purification and refinement to be done.
If they push me again, I'll tell them to come here and talk to the furnace themselves.
Cannons are impressive, but neglecting the flowers and grass is unacceptable.
Master Luban's doll... Not bad at all.
If I give this to Master Luban, would he be a little happier?
Master Luban's doll... Not bad at all.
If I give this to Master Luban, would he be a little happier?
Why hasn't he come for the Mechcraft? He's not standing me up again, is he?
I'm so tired. When can I take a break?
Cannons involve both hands-on skills and theoretical studies.
Meng Ya doesn't seem to like reading. How is he so good at research?
Do you wish to challenge me, the Head Trainer of Obsidian Flame Training Hall?
If you want to spar with her, just go for it.
As you've probably seen on your way here, Obsidian Flame Training Hall is the stronghold of the Cannon Society.
As the Intendant of Obsidian Flame Training Hall, Mo Xie naturally represents the pinnacle of cannon and Mechcraft technology.
Whether it's to refine skills or simply to relax with a spar, our Intendant never turns down a chance for a friendly match.
Any suggestions for challenging the Intendant?
Haha, I can't make an exception just for you. It wouldn't be fair to others.
I can only say, the power of Mechcraft and cannons is not to be underestimated. If you can't handle it, don't try to be a hero.
After you've healed and are ready, try again. Mo Xie won't look down on you for it—she'll actually see you as resilient.
See you. I look forward to seeing you shine under the guidance of Master!
We haven't played together for a long time.
We just saw the fireworks together last night...
Hey, don't run around. You might fall.
Came all this way just for the class.
Cute little Croaky, the parts haven't arrived yet, hang in there.
Still got time to chat with the cannon, huh?
Never mind, should we try a test fire?
You're brave, I'll give you that. No, it's too dangerous!
This little one's fearless, not even flinching at the cannons.
It's here all the time. I doubt he'd be scared. Maybe he'll even try to study it.
So cute. Come to class with me.
I rarely try to be funny, and you just ignore me?
Let me check the map. We should go to...
Who would've thought those enthusiastic Cannon Society folks would be so meticulous with these items?
These stones are quite old. I need to take a closer look.
I knew I'd find you here.
It's too intense in there. I need some fresh air to clear my head.
Knowledge is vast, I only take a scoop.
Uh... which one should I take...?
Those kids have messed up the books again.
Never mind, I'll clean it up.
Could you give me some oil? I want to lubricate my Mechcraft.
That's cooking oil. Don't waste food!
Wasteful fool, go away if you're not hungry!
It's too dangerous for you here, kid.
Let me through, I'm here to buy fireworks.
Little but strong. No setting off fireworks alone! Find an adult!
Research can wait. Let's eat first.
The cannons here are so cool!
It's not often we get to come here. Let's stop a Cannon Society member later to ask some questions.
Perhaps we can gather information about Meng Ya's residence.
I thought you were serious about studying, not slacking off like this.
These cannons are fun. If I could modify them for hunting...
I was right to come here. It's a bountiful day!
I've been going non-stop all day... my brain's turning to mush.
Maybe I'll get some inspiration after the class.
You must be exhausted. Come, have some tea.
I'd like to take a break, but these prototype cannons are extremely dangerous.
Gotta stay vigilant all the time.
I've decided. I'm going to challenge Head Trainer Mo.
Not bad, you've got potential! Keep it up, I'm rooting for you!
Uh, I have a favor to ask... Could you demonstrate the Head Trainer's fighting style? I want to prepare in advance.
Sure. Preparations are an important part of any competition, so take a good look.
A bit more to the left... It should be safe now, right?
Better double-check everything. One mistake and the experiment could go sideways.
Mellow tea, tea aroma... what flame danger?
Your eyes are as sharp as Blazen's.
The warning about cannons in the hallway... People are experimenting there.
I ate a medicine by mistake, so I can't see clearly for now... Anyway, thanks for telling me about it.
Selected tea varieties, mellow and sweet fragrance, this is the tea stall's slogan.
zh_text: “精选茶种，茶香甘醇”，这是茶摊的宣传语。
source_text: “精选茶种，茶香甘醇”，这是茶摊的宣传语。

text: The prototype cannon is finally done. I've pulled several all-nighters, and I'm really exhausted...
Heart racing... tea break? Maybe exercise to boost resistance.
Can you give me a straight answer? Will I get the Mechcraft parts tomorrow?
Stop putting me on the spot, Guo Guan. You know how things are here. We really don't have any spare parts.
But I know there's a big pile of them. You're being a bit unfair here.
Those were scrap parts. If you try to build a Treasure Hunter Mechanoid with that junk, a malfunction is the least of your worries. It'll probably explode!
Hehe, I'm probably the first one here.
Newly developed cannons, what a business opportunity!
Its gaze... is it going to charge at me? Ahh!
How do I find the balance between fuel volume and burn rate?
With this view, all you can think of is cannons?
Got it! The key lies in the structure of the combustion chamber!
I'm really impressed by your academic prowess.
Not enthusiastic about playing, having thought problems. Who else dares to mention work, I will get angry with him!
Yeah, who'd dare to mess with me! Oh, by the way, I forgot to dry a basket of herbs...
This job is exhausting. There are so many Cannon Societies in Obsidian Flame Training Hall, and dangerous experiments are endless.
I'll definitely apply for a patrol transfer next time, sigh!
Each Society has its own specialty. The Herb Society understands plants, the Seeker Society knows history.
Maybe learning from them could help me better understand animal behaviors.
What? This challenge is dangerous! And I thought I was prepared... sniff...
If you get injured, don't push yourself. Call the Herb Society for help.
It's just a standard safety notice. Don't spook yourself...
This firework sometimes works, sometimes doesn't...
Scholarly Tiger, any thoughts on this detonator?
I need to stretch a bit, you go ahead!
Hold on, I haven't even warmed up! Don't rush it!
Remember the key is to find the right spot to push.
Phew... I prefer just lounging around...
Been at it a while now, time for a short break!
Its fur is so soft! I just can't stop myself from petting it.
Didn't you say training with the Head Trainer felt better? Turns out you were just fond of the Preydator.
Stop staring and get back to the Aerux Post! You've rested enough.
Look at this giant Mechanoid. Aren't you curious to try piloting it?
No way. You'd just break it!
Let me check the latest rankings... Oh, this Mechsmith made it to the top three. What a big jump!
Haha, I can see why you're a Mechcraft researcher!
I wonder how well Chang'an's Mechcraft would rank in this challenge.
Challengers, please keep your belongings secure!
Please take your trash with you when leaving. Thank you for your cooperation!
This cannon's recoil feels like a massage, so weak.
Let me turn it up to the max... Wait, it's already maxed out?
Come help me check if the shelf is at the right height!
Nope, I can't take my hands off the Mechcraft. You try it yourself first.
I heard the Martial Arts students have a secret training manual.
I can learn something from my patrol duty.
Odd, why is this plum blossom screw paired with a square nut?
Who did this? Let me take a closer look...
No one's up for a challenge? My feet are itchy from waiting! I really want to give it a try.
Just fifteen minutes left for today's standing training...
Welcome to the Training Hall, where you'll find martial arts training dummies and a Mechcraft test area.
The registration and result boards are nearby!
Will I still get paid if I fail? Surely you won't beat me up for free?
Our Training Hall challenge bonuses are high. Just fight, I guarantee you'll win!
But I'm not a student. I'll really go sign up. Don't you trick me!
The finest ingredients are often best prepared in the simplest ways...
Let me see what I need. I'll pack up after selling these.
Delicious and nutritious natural ingredients that taste great however you cook them.
Now is the best time for hunting. You're in luck—miss this window, and you'll have to wait another year.
For brewing soup, clay pots are ideal. They facilitate internal circulation, locking in the ingredients' natural flavors and enhancing the overall taste.
A steaming bowl of soup after training heals both body and mind, fatigue vanishes instantly.
Leaving already? Stay for the soup I just made!
It's clear, but is it appealing enough?
Well, it's a signature dish. It should be made interesting...
Hey, smell that? Want something to fill you up?
Sit anywhere. It'll be ready in a flash!
We've got fried food, grilled dishes, vegetable stir-fries, and more.
Everyone who tried my food loves it. Many come to the fair just for my stall.
Any recommendations for the night market?
Hehe, you've got to try our snacks. We have many regulars!
As for the rest, you've probably seen the stalls selling all kinds of cannons and Mechcrafts along the way. There are no shortage of novelties.
Besides food, you can also find fireworks, accessories, and all kinds of trinkets. A quick stroll can bring quite the haul.
Goodbye, hope to see you again!
Mr. Peng's cooking is exceptional. I'm so full!
Slow down, I didn't bring any digestive meds this time.
Not at all. I could eat a whole cow right now!
Anyway, I got carried away. Back to the point, I heard they were researching Mechcraft grinding. I wonder if it's on the shelf yet.
It'll come in handy for your digestive pills.
Ouch—It's so hot, but it smells amazing! No wonder it's a night market favorite.
I should eat first, don't want my skewers to get pushed away.
Wait... is this flower also a Mechcraft?
The designer must have a gentle heart like Sun Bin's.
Iron, jade, cannons, come take a look.
Well, can't help it. Anyway, do consider supporting this stall!
Come take a look! Don't miss out, great prices, everyone loves it!
The latest Mechcraft cannon, packed with features beyond your wildest dreams!
Our Mechanoids are great for training. Interested?
Check out our latest model—packed with features and budget-friendly!
