source_text: 金属齿轮共计……一百八十九件。

text: We should still have enough materials...
Creating innovative yet practical Mechcrafts is so challenging. The inventor of the Popper must be a genius!
I hope I can have such insight at my graduation.
Cannons roar, flames blaze... roasting wheat blossoms to perfection...
Hmm, I really want some sweet Corn Poppers...
Check out this pose. Cool, right?
Hey, stop gloating. You're blocking my view of the cutouts!
The lotus in the pond are in full bloom. When you come back, let's pick some lotus roots together!
I'll go back and play with you once I'm done with my work! You're making me hungry!
I'm a Martial Arts practitioner, yet I feel so tired.
Research work really shouldn't be underestimated.
Mmm... delicious meat soup. It warms my heart.
I heard the <001>night market</> here is quite lively. Have you been?
I went yesterday and saw a beautiful <001>cannon part</>, but it was too pricey.
The varnish and craftsmanship are top-notch. It looks like something from the School of Mechcraft.
Huh? That's very possible. Someone mixed them up and put it up for sale?
The mortise and tenon joints aren't as complicated as you might think.
What did we talk about yesterday?
Seems like I've forgotten everything. I wonder if the Croaky beside me still remembers?
I'm really interested in this topic and have been waiting for several days.
Indeed a new face, I wonder if they're any good...
Why isn't the class starting yet?
Hey, look. Is that a teacher? I don't think I've seen him before.
Class is about to start. I need to finish this apple quickly.
This is my first time giving a trial lecture as an intern teacher. I'm not sure what teaching method would be more suitable for my peers...
So we should ask everyone first?
Really? That's a great idea! Thank you so much.
The lecture is about to start. What do I do? I always get so nervous in class. What if I mess up...
How does Master Mozi make his lectures on mechanics so captivating?
How should I explain this? Should I start with examples of mortise and tenon joints?
Ah! Hello. I-I'm just nervous about the lecture.
How about I ask what kind of teaching style everyone prefers?
How about I ask what kind of teaching style everyone prefers?
Hello, I've been watching you practice archery for a while now. I've always dreamed of drawing a bow myself. Could you teach me how to do it?
Sure! It's not that hard, actually.
Watch me. Keep the bow grip center and level with your eyes, then draw the string horizontally.
Remember to adjust your breathing. Don't be nervous. Keep your heart steady to aim accurately.
Yue Xun, could you teach me how to hit the bullseye?
It's crucial to stay patient and avoid rushing.
Something's wrong with my bow. Did I pull it too hard?
The sound of arrows whizzing by fills me with longing.
You mean those Martial Arts students practicing archery over there?
You mean those Martial Arts students practicing archery over there?
Yes, Zhong Lin has always wanted to try archery.
But I... I'm scared. I've never held a bow or arrow before.
I'm drawn to it, but I have no experience. A reckless attempt could lead to disaster or injury.
Afraid that trying might lead to regret.
I don't want to have regrets... You may be right.
If there's even a chance it could work, a little injury wouldn't matter, right?
I don't want to trouble others.
Dialogue over tea with the protagonist.
I'd love to try drawing this bow.
Why not give it a try?
I've never learned archery. I'm scared...
According to the lesson plan, the next line should go like this...
This Mechcraft component seems to be the missing one...
What are you looking at? It belongs to me!
I just wanted to test for overheating issues. Never expected it to explode...
Where did those arm parts go? I'm doomed if I can't find them...
Ladies and gentlemen, come one, come all! Rare Mechcraft sale!
You're selling these white parts? They look familiar...
You're selling these white parts? They look familiar...
Ah, that... it's an older model! A classic, in fact.
Ah, this... it came from near the stall...
I'm not entirely sure, but I can look into it for you later. If you're interested, I'll give you a discount. How does that sound?
I'm afraid not. It's a Mecharm lost after a cannon experiment went wrong. The Cannon Society is searching for it.
I'm afraid not. It's a Mecharm lost after a cannon experiment went wrong. The Cannon Society is searching for it.
What? I... I found it lying around here... I'm sorry!
I'll return them right away. Please, don't tell them I sold their stuff. I'm begging you!
No worries. I'll ask someone else then.
What's wrong with this Mechcraft? Why are you all crowded here?
What's wrong with this Mechcraft? Why are you all crowded here?
Well, remember the heavy rain a few days ago? The cannon part of the Mechcraft got short-circuited, and a disciple accidentally triggered a small explosion when activating it...
The Mechcraft is severely damaged. We tried to repair it but found two key parts missing.

They are two <001>firearm arms</>. I sent Tan Hwei to look for them, but there's been no word. I need to oversee the machinery here and can't get away. If you have time, could you keep an eye out for us?
Please. The two cannons have <001>white</> arms. Should be around here.
Triggered in the Cannon Society Scene.
You're back! Great, now we have all the parts!
Thank you so much. Where did you find it?
A jerk! He found it and wanted to keep it for himself! If it weren't for this student here, I'd never have gotten it back.
Someone picked up the other part too and almost sold it. Luckily, it's coming back.
Someone picked up the other part too and almost sold it. Luckily, it's coming back.
Thank goodness you found it! Without it, the Mechcraft would be beyond repair.
I believe you've all learned a valuable lesson. Next, we'll officially begin the adjustments.
An unreasonable jerk! He found it and wanted to keep it for himself! If this student hadn't helped, I wouldn't have gotten it back.
zh_text: 一个蛮不讲理的混蛋那，他捡到了，想据为己有！要不是这位同学帮忙，我就拿不回来了。
source_text: 一个蛮不讲理的混蛋那，他捡到了，想据为己有！要不是这位同学帮忙，我就拿不回来了。
official_target_text: An unreasonable jerk! He found it and wanted to keep it for himself! If this student hadn't helped, I wouldn't have gotten it back.
official_en_text: An unreasonable jerk! He found it and wanted to keep it for himself! If this student hadn't helped, I wouldn't have gotten it back.

text: It still seems like it's not enough... Could you please help me find the rest?
Thanks for your help. I'll send the parts back right away!
Not all of them. Some are just trash I found and modified.
Modifications? What did you modify? These aren't discarded materials, they're missing parts of our cannons!
How do I know you're the owner? I won't let you just take it!
Besides, who cares what it was before? I found it, so it's mine.
He's telling the truth. There was a small explosion nearby. This is a cannon part lost in the blast.
He's telling the truth. There was a small explosion nearby. This is a cannon part lost in the blast.
They're not junk. They're meant to be repaired. Or should I call the senior overseeing cannon maintenance here to settle this?
They're not junk. They're meant to be repaired. Or should I call the senior overseeing cannon maintenance here to settle this?
N-no need! I'll give them to you. I didn't actually modify the cannons. I was just messing with him.
A, um, female friend. She's a Gongyu family member. She wanted to use fireworks for a performance, so I brought her to the Moyan Pavilion.
zh_text: 一位，嗯，女性朋友。是个宫羽家，她想运用烟花来进行表演，我就带她来墨焰阁了。
source_text: 一位，嗯，女性朋友。是个宫羽家，她想运用烟花来进行表演，我就带她来墨焰阁了。
official_target_text: A, um, female friend. She's a Gongyu family member. She wanted to use fireworks for a performance, so I brought her to the Moyan Pavilion.
official_en_text: A, um, female friend. She's a Gongyu family member. She wanted to use fireworks for a performance, so I brought her to the Moyan Pavilion.

text: Hello, how can I assist you?
If anything makes you uncomfortable, just let me know. I'll do my best to help.
This is the Medicine Stand, where we Herbalists prepare remedies.
If you want to make your own medicine, you're welcome to come here too. Just don't waste any herbs.
Quite a few. Everyone's always conducting wild cannon experiments, so injuries are bound to happen.
Make sure to follow the rules. A student blew up a furnace a few days ago and got hurt.
I enjoy the lively flames, but I don't want my patients to suffer because of them.
You've probably been reading too much. Come here more often for some experiments—that'll keep your brain sharp!
No way. There is no way that knowledge from books can be so practical.
I'm discussing design directions with that guy next to me—a real bookworm.
He only believes in the frameworks given in books, with no imagination at all.
How dare you question my design of "Super Speed Fire" with those rigid theories?
Do you often do your experiments here?
Yep, you could say we're here every day!
I worked hard to be in charge of the final assembly. Book smarts are important, but having the courage to get your hands dirty is just as important!
Uh, goodbye. And hey, try not to get too close to the cannons.
A group of plant monsters suddenly attacked us and destroyed our research results!
zh_text: 一群植物怪物突然袭击了我们，破坏了研究成果！
source_text: 一群植物怪物突然袭击了我们，破坏了研究成果！
official_target_text: A group of plant monsters suddenly attacked us and destroyed our research results!
official_en_text: A group of plant monsters suddenly attacked us and destroyed our research results!

text: I'll head home for dinner once I'm done moving this cargo.
zh_text: 一会儿搬完这批货就回家吃饭。
source_text: 一会儿搬完这批货就回家吃饭。
official_target_text: I'll head home for dinner once I'm done moving this cargo.
official_en_text: I'll head home for dinner once I'm done moving this cargo.

text: I run an inn here, with a warehouse next door and rooms upstairs.
People coming and going, rest your feet at our shop when you're tired.
Don't worry, I heard the guests upstairs giving great reviews of the beds.
Don't worry, I heard the guests upstairs giving great reviews of the beds.
I see. Thank you, but still, don't disturb the guests.
Goodbye! Come rest here if you're tired.
As long as the customers are happy, that's all that matters.
Safe travels. Sigh, maybe I should take a detour elsewhere.
zh_text: 一路走好，唉，要不我先改道去别的地方。
source_text: 一路走好，唉，要不我先改道去别的地方。
official_target_text: Safe travels. Sigh, maybe I should take a detour elsewhere.
official_en_text: Safe travels. Sigh, maybe I should take a detour elsewhere.

text: If I can establish new fishing spots, I'm sure I can sell a lot of merchandise too.
This camp was supposedly chosen by Fang Yuu, a grandmaster of the Angling Society.
The Aerdense Flower here keeps mutants away from the Angling Society.
If you want to learn more about this amazing flower, you should ask someone in the Herb Garden.
At first, it truly made me happy. The flute music that suddenly sounded from the opposite bank was so clear and melodious.
zh_text: 一开始确实让我高兴，对岸突然响起的笛声，是那么清丽，那么悠扬。
source_text: 一开始确实让我高兴，对岸突然响起的笛声，是那么清丽，那么悠扬。
official_target_text: At first, it truly made me happy. The flute music that suddenly sounded from the opposite bank was so clear and melodious.
official_en_text: At first, it truly made me happy. The flute music that suddenly sounded from the opposite bank was so clear and melodious.

text: Which school do you think will win this year's Cloudreach Tower competition?
Sorcery, of course. The previous champion was from the School of Sorcery.
Oh? So you're a champion fan? You didn't just start watching the Cloudreach Tower competition last year, did you?
What did Champion Powder do to you?
I'd say it's high time for the Team of Stars to take the crown this year.
Team of Stars? More like the People's Champions. Top support, zero titles.
Ugh, those two... Can't even be trusted when they're in time-out...
I wonder if Wang Yu has selected the materials for this experiment yet...
Hello, I sell fresh fruits here.
The brewery's been experimenting with new recipes, buying lots of fresh fruits, so they set up a stall here too.
But I've heard the owner is quite old-fashioned, so selecting fruits always seems to be a dilemma...
I'll send this batch of vegetables to the Cloud-Climbing Tower in the north in a bit.
zh_text: 一会儿就把这批菜送到北边的攀云塔去。
source_text: 一会儿就把这批菜送到北边的攀云塔去。
official_target_text: I'll send this batch of vegetables to the Cloud-Climbing Tower in the north in a bit.
official_en_text: I'll send this batch of vegetables to the Cloud-Climbing Tower in the north in a bit.

text: I have some little gadgets crafted by the Craft Society of Cloudreach Tower.
Take a look if you're interested.
Sorry, we're out of brew for now.
That's a shame. Is it Harvest Brew?
That's a shame. Is it Harvest Brew?
Yes, the four breweries in Dreamweave Plains offer distinct flavors.
You can go there and have a look.
Isn't this the new member of Team Star who is competing with Gui Die for the record?
Did you see that student just now? I heard his climbing speed is on par with Guidie's!
Really? I didn't expect to be able to compete with that Guidie, so impressive!
Isn't this the freshman who is challenging Gui Die's record?
Yo! The Guidie record-breaker! I've heard all about it! That's amazing!
It's the freshman who broke Guidie's record!
Is this the new Team Star member who is challenging Gui Die's record!
Jixia's vegetables, Navenia's fruits, and daily essentials.
Hungry? Want to take some home?
I'm a student. Can you deliver it to me?
I'm a student. Can you deliver it to me?
Where did you come from, kid? Who asks prices like that?
Go play somewhere else, stop causing trouble here.
The produce looks fresh. How much are they?
The produce looks fresh. How much are they?
New face, huh? Here for the Cloudreach Festival too?
No thanks, I'll just keep looking.
Here, have some Dreamweave Plains fruit.
We have an ancient method of brewing with fruit here, too. Why not visit a few breweries?
Isn't this the kid who was causing trouble earlier?
I need to support my family. Stop wasting my time.
I'm responsible for maintaining order at Harvest Bazaar.
Shortages, poor quality goods, misdeliveries—I'm not responsible for any of that. I only deal with thugs and Rebels.
I used to come here all the time when I was little. I always dreamed of eating pancakes and drinking Harvest Brew here every day.
Never thought I'd end up guarding this spot. But hey, I've got all the pancakes and Harvest Brew I could want. Guess you could say my wish came true.
The competition is going to be a blast! Ever-changing Mechcraft obstacles and generous rewards await!
If I didn't have to guard against Rebels here, I'd love to climb it myself!
Take care. If you see any Rebels nearby, let me know.
Did you see that student just now? I heard he's the freshman who almost broke Guidie's record!
Really? I didn't expect to be able to go head-to-head with Guidie, that's incredible!
I can buy herbs at the market to prevent injuries during the competition.
I hear many masters are joining this season. I'm so excited!
The Cloudreach Competition is just ahead.
Hey there! Welcome to Harvest Bazaar!
If you plan to challenge Cloudreach Tower, you should stock up on herbs.
I heard many were injured challenging Cloudreach Tower.
Herbs for healing! Effective for treating injuries!
Are you looking for loose or wholesale orders of Ageon Brew?
I'm a salesperson of Ageon Brew. Let me know if you're interested in making a purchase.
Ageon Brew is in short supply at the moment. We're only accepting preorders for bulk orders.
I'm quite fond of Ageon Brew, but its yield has always been low, which concerns me.
I asked if we could brew more, but the master scolded me.
The boss also thinks I'm too impatient. I'm starting to not want to work anymore.
He was very strict and wouldn't listen to advice when it came to brewing, but otherwise he was very kind to us.
He works harder than anyone at the brewery, giving his all to keep Time Brew's legacy alive.
Hey, did you know? There's a legend about treasure left by Fishy in this lake!
Legend has it that the renowned Angler Fang Yu once secluded himself in this very place.
He buried treasure at the bottom of the lake, likely tied to his battle with the cloud monster.
I traced his tracks here, but I'm not a good swimmer and can't dive in to explore.
If only someone could investigate for me.
Don't you know? He's a legend in the Angling Society!
He caught the Fish Monster and battled the Warcloud Monster—his feats are legendary within the Angling Society!
If Herbologists led the school, there wouldn't be such mess!
Herbologists believe plants have their own rhythms and shouldn't be interfered with.
Look, this is the consequence of Cultivators recklessly interfering with the rhythm of herbs!
I'm telling Perilla about these Cultivators! You'll be my witness!
This is outrageous! Even if we disagree, he shouldn't have done this! I'll return to Shennong Hall once I've sorted this out.
It's all Perilla's fault for letting those Cultivators do their Moonelia Sprout grafting research!
These things are running wild! They're trashing the garden!
Ah, sorry, I forgot to introduce myself. Hello, I'm the <001>underground warehouse manager</> of Shennong Hall.
Responsible for the books, <001>antiques</> and seeds of various herbs in the Herb Garden.
Why were you locked up here?
I heard strange things have been happening at the herb nursery, so I came to check it out.
I hid here to escape from monsters. But the vines grew so fast... I couldn't even leave.
I was so scared I forgot to thank you properly.
But I must return to the seed vault. It can't be left unattended for too long.
My savior, when you have time, please come find me at <001>the basement of Shennong Hall in Herb Garden</>!
These packaged herbs haven't been delivered yet. The people waiting for them must be getting anxious.
These packaged herbs haven't been delivered yet. The people waiting for them must be getting anxious.
Sample, hello there! Do you want to continue helping me with my research?
zh_text: “样本”你好呀！要不要继续帮我做研究？
source_text: “样本”你好呀！要不要继续帮我做研究？
official_target_text: Sample, hello there! Do you want to continue helping me with my research?
official_en_text: Sample, hello there! Do you want to continue helping me with my research?

text: Most patients with minor injuries or illnesses wouldn't dare ask our Zhendong Sect for help.
zh_text: 一般患者只是有些小伤小病的话，都不敢来请我们鸩冬派出手。
source_text: 一般患者只是有些小伤小病的话，都不敢来请我们鸩冬派出手。
official_target_text: Most patients with minor injuries or illnesses wouldn't dare ask our Zhendong Sect for help.
official_en_text: Most patients with minor injuries or illnesses wouldn't dare ask our Zhendong Sect for help.

text: Welcome to my Harvest Shack! Sit please.
I run this place, and the kids at the door are my nephews.
I hope my nephews can be as outstanding as you two someday.
Feel free to chat with me anytime.
You've noticed our signature dish too?
It's named after Miss Shye, who used to visit me often.
I adjusted the porridge to her taste and always gave her a discount.
She was actually quite shy when I told her I wanted to name the porridge after her.
Fresh off the stove! Get 'em while they're hot!
Come on, it tastes bad when it's cold!
Welcome! What'll it be? Our savory Harvest Brew, or the sweet Shye Porridge?
All my dishes are freshly brewed and simmered. If you don't get them now, you'll miss out!
So what do you think, want to try a bowl?
This porridge is quite famous. They say it's Shye's favorite from the Team of Stars.
The grains and potatoes are marinated in fine salt, making it sweet and refreshing—and good for the skin!
The Harvest Brew is a famous treasure of Harvest Fields, renowned in Jixia!
Ageon Brew's rich flavor, Foxvale Brew's aromatic taste, Fallspring Brew's pure sweetness, and Aerux Brew's crisp refreshingness.
Well, you've got to drink it to find out.
There will definitely be people who become our loyal supporters.
zh_text: 一定会有人成为我们的忠实拥趸。
source_text: 一定会有人成为我们的忠实拥趸。
official_target_text: There will definitely be people who become our loyal supporters.
official_en_text: There will definitely be people who become our loyal supporters.

text: In the end, Foxvale Brew is still the best. It's got a nice kick.
It suits your fiery temper. I don't like it.
Don't even mention it. It makes me so angry. What kind of kid feeds their wheat to Naughty Foxes before harvest?
That boy is such a troublemaker. I'm gonna...
Enough, let's drink! It's rare for me to treat you.
I wouldn't have taken this job if I'd known.
He's seen enough in the tent!
Get ready... We can't let him escape!
Get ready... We can't let him escape!
I've been moving Mechcraft blocks for two days straight. When's my break?
Ah... no, no, I mean I researched it nonstop for two days.
All this effort just to dismantle these wooden blocks... it's making my head spin.
Exactly! These broken Mechcraft parts are exactly what we need.
Haha, of course! Dismantling Mechcrafts is my specialty!
They're all meant for Cloudreach Tower.
Goodbye, I'll rest a bit longer.
Well... I mean, repairing the Mechcraft.
Is he talking in his sleep?
Is he talking in his sleep?
Pretending to be a student is so exhausting...
Curiosity is the first step to success.
Ha! Look at your modest and strict demeanor!
When it comes to Cloudreach Competition, no one knows better than us!
Every student who made it to the top of Cloudreach Tower trained with us!
Our secret manual, "Cloudreach Competition Winning Strategies," is your best aid for successfully climbing the tower!
Easy! Just pay with three Mech Cores, and you'll get a great deal!
No worries! One is fine! We'll take what we can!
I'll go and get the money.
I'll go and get the money.
You'll be the one and only, the unmatched adventurer who conquers Cloudreach Tower!
You clearly already possess a handsome appearance and agile physique.
But what you need right now is a chance to prove yourself—by climbing the Cloudreach Tower!
Wait, let me take a closer look...
What? You are! You are! The adventurer who shall ascend Cloudreach Tower!
Alright, grab as much as you can—no time to waste, no exceptions made!
Hey, Jixia adventurer! Stop! Hear me out!
Three mechanism cores? That's so expensive...
official_target_text: Three mechanism cores? That's so expensive...
official_en_text: Three mechanism cores? That's so expensive...

text: Three mechanism cores? That's so expensive...
official_target_text: Three mechanism cores? That's so expensive...
official_en_text: Three mechanism cores? That's so expensive...

text: I haven't... made up my mind...
I haven't... made up my mind...
Haven't decided yet? This is the secret manual for climbing Cloudreach Tower! A secret manual!
Hey adventurer, finally decided to buy the secret manual?
They won't dare to come back.
They won't dare to come back.
But who would've thought a group of Rebels would barge in, take over the storehouse, and lock up me and the manager.
I'm a patroller from the Craft Society, and this warehouse is my assignment for the next couple of days.
More importantly, they seized our Craft Society's <001>Nature's Art</>!
<001>Nature's Art</> is one of the four talismans the Society used to defeat the Black Cloud Monster.
Though few people know how to use its energy now, it's been well-preserved as a testament to the Craft Society's history.
Now, it's been seized by the Rebels. It's all my fault!
Thanks, but <001>Nature's Art</> is crucial. I must retrieve it quickly.
In the southwest of Cloudreach Tower lies an <001>abandoned Mechcraft warehouse</>, recently occupied by Rebels. You may find clues there.
No time to waste. I'm heading out now!
The <001>Tiangong Stone</> is said to be one of the four talisman stones used by the Hundred Schools long ago to subdue the Black Cloud Monster.
zh_text: <001>天工石</>据说是很久以前百家协力降服黑云怪的四块符石之一。
source_text: <001>天工石</>据说是很久以前百家协力降服黑云怪的四块符石之一。
official_target_text: The <001>Tiangong Stone</> is said to be one of the four talisman stones used by the Hundred Schools long ago to subdue the Black Cloud Monster.
official_en_text: The <001>Tiangong Stone</> is said to be one of the four talisman stones used by the Hundred Schools long ago to subdue the Black Cloud Monster.

text: Thanks for your help. I'll call the big guy back now.
Can he really handle this on his own?
Can he really handle this on his own?
Look! The Aerdense Flower is blooming!
Aerdense Flower is indeed beautiful, but I still don't understand how it can be used to deal with the Black Cloud Monster?
Perhaps you can <001>gather its pistils</> and ask at <001>Herb Garden</>.
But if you ask me, the real hero has to be the Cloudreach Tower developed by our Craft Society.
I'm observing the Aerdense Flower, a specialty of Dreamweave Plains.
It's said to be specially bred by the Herb Society to fight the Black Cloud Monster.
It only blooms <001>at night</>. What will happen then?
What should I do? Will I get scolded?
Well, a group of Rebels barged in a few days ago. Took off with some Mechcraft parts and a gemstone.
The parts are fine, but this gem is something our teacher left to us to keep safe.
I've never looked into it, but the teachers mentioned something called <001>"Nature's Art"</>.
Ugh, the Rebels are at the southwest camp, and I have too much to handle here...
Isn't that thanks to Senior Sun Bin's guidance? If you were left to research blindly on your own, you'd have to wait at least another half month.
What about your harvester improvement plan from last time...
The three Cloud-Drawing Cages are located in the wheat fields of the <001>west, southwest, and south of Fengyun Wilds</>.
zh_text: 三处汲云笼分别在<001>丰云野西部、丰云野西南部、丰云野南部</>的麦田上。
source_text: 三处汲云笼分别在<001>丰云野西部、丰云野西南部、丰云野南部</>的麦田上。
official_target_text: The three Cloud-Drawing Cages are located in the wheat fields of the <001>west, southwest, and south of Fengyun Wilds</>.
official_en_text: The three Cloud-Drawing Cages are located in the wheat fields of the <001>west, southwest, and south of Fengyun Wilds</>.

text: Sheng Qi is responsible for repairing agricultural Mechcrafts. Yi Qiu handles applications for Aero Cages.
Oh, so you're not a villager.
I'm Gongshu Lun, a teacher from the Craft Society responsible for managing agricultural assistance activities.
He worked non-stop the whole day to help fix the villagers' tools.
Looks like he got heatstroke. I've asked my friend from the Herb Society to send over some medicine.
Is Pang Yun feeling any better?
Thanks to the medicine you brought, this child looks much better now.
It's great to be passionate about Mechcraft, but don't neglect your health.
The Craft Society established this place to help villagers maintain their farming Mechcrafts.
Besides maintaining agricultural Mechcrafts, we also test new irrigation equipment.
We call it Aero Irrigator. You should see it in many parts of Harvest Fields.
Excuse me, do you sell something called... Springtide Fruit?
I've heard something about it, but I'm not selling anything.
I heard an artist ate this fruit and was inspired.
But I've never seen that fruit, so I don't know if it's just a rumor.
It's been so long. Why isn't he back yet? He's giving me worries.
Ah, it's those three stubborn bulls of mine. They're always running around. Now they've gone off somewhere again.
My old bones can't search as well as they used to. Could you help me look for it?
Great, thank you! You're a lifesaver! I'll wait here for your good news.
I have other things to attend to.
Ah, I see. No worries, I'll figure something out.
Uncle Geng searches for the cow 1.
Good luck, kid. I'm counting on you to find my cow.
Silly me, I got so excited I forgot to describe my three-headed cow. Good thing you were careful, or we'd be in trouble bringing home the wrong cow!
My big buffalo has the worst temper and loves to fight. It's probably picking another fight.
Niu Niu is the biggest foodie—grass isn't enough; it craves fruits and herbs. It's probably off searching for a tasty treat.
San Niu is extremely curious. Once, he vanished while chasing a shiny trinket—I couldn't even keep up.
I raised these three cows myself, so I'm really worried about them. But I'm getting old and useless, without the strength to search.
I'm counting on you, young man. Thank you!
Young men are full of energy, that's good!
Uncle Geng searches for the cow 2.
Thank you so much! I'd be lost without your help.
I've prepared a small gift for you. It's nothing valuable, but please do accept it.
They're back, they're all back! Hahaha!
Uncle Geng searches for the cow 3.
Uncle Geng searches for the cow 4.
Chu Dachuang is a role model for us Martial Arts students. Never try to challenge him!
I can't believe you defeated Senior Dachuang. You're my role model now!
I got caught stealing veggies by Chu Dachuang. Now I'm helping out in the garden.
I wouldn't have come if I knew there was someone this skilled here!
Stop, stop! I admit defeat... I admit defeat!
Judging from your moves, you're not a Rebel.
Let's practice again next time. I'll definitely beat you.
That's more like it. Now scram, don't be caught loitering around the vegetable patch on my watch.
What are you doing? Trying to steal my food? With all the Rebels around, you must be one of them!
Oh? You've got some attitude. Let me teach you a lesson!
Huh? You lost already? I haven't even warmed up!
Oh? You again. Come on, let's practice some more!
Alright, I'm gonna beat you this time!
Hey, wait! That was the best fight I've had all day!
This forest is full of tasty veggies and fruits!
But there are wolves in the woods, and I'm too scared to go...
How about it? Are there plenty of veggies and fruits?
Just a scratch. It's good that your puppet wasn't broken.
zh_text: 一点擦伤而已，你的玩偶没有被弄坏就好。
source_text: 一点擦伤而已，你的玩偶没有被弄坏就好。
official_target_text: Just a scratch. It's good that your puppet wasn't broken.
official_en_text: Just a scratch. It's good that your puppet wasn't broken.

text: Shh... There are powerful creatures here. Don't disturb them.
What kind of creature is it?
I'm Lu Buming, a Hunter observing the ecosystem around Dreamweave Plains.
For us hunters, hunting is not just about competing in skill, but more importantly, about maintaining the balance of the local ecosystem.
I patrol Dreamweave Plains. We'll meet again.
There have been multiple reports of fights between Flame-tailed Lizards and Neon-tailed Lizards.
This area is a habitat for the Neon Leaftail Lizards. There is no record of the Flame Leaftail Lizards.
So the latest sighting report is unusual and may indicate an invasion of some species.
That's why I'm here. To investigate.
Based on my observations, the Flame Lizards here seem to form a group.
Led by a powerful individual, they have recently migrated to this area.
Their aggressive leader has nearly wiped out the Leaftail Lizards.
All evidence points to the legendary <001>Wreckflame Lizard</>.
For the ecological balance of the region, it must be eliminated.
Pygmy Lizards are hot-tempered and aggressive, and they are highly territorial.
<001>Eliminate some of their kind</>, and it might just lure out the <001>Wreckflame Lizard</>.

text: Haha! Having power sure makes things easier.
If I encounter greater challenges in the future, I'll be counting on you!
Sorry, my bad. I should've prepared you for this.
As compensation, please accept these rewards!
Join us for more hunting events at the Hunting Society!
Wreckflame Lizard appeared, and you ran.
Wreckflame Lizard appeared, and you ran.
Well... I'm going to get backup, aren't I?
It's not easy to find help. The Hunting Society is short-staffed right now.
No one else was available, so I had to come myself.
I didn't expect you to finish the job before I returned.
Anyway, this is the reward issued by the Hunting Society. Don't hold it against me!
Wreckflame Lizard is one of our recent targets.
Since you've already taken care of it for us, I'll reward you on behalf of the Hunting Society.
Do you know whose footprints are here?
Then let me tell you as a Hunter!
Found footprints of an older Hunter.
Do I look like a beast to you?
Hey there! Interested in joining the Hunting Society's ecological observation?
I'm Lu Buming, a Hunter observing the ecosystem of Dreamweave Plains.
For us hunters, hunting is not just about competing in skill, but more importantly, about maintaining the balance of the local ecosystem.
I patrol Dreamweave Plains. We'll meet again.
This is actually an altar to the Sundering Horns.
Sundering Horns are ancient beasts that bring thunderstorms wherever they go.
Villagers offer Harvest Pancakes to lure it, so it can water our crops.
Over time, it became a tradition for the villagers.
But it's been acting strange lately. Might cause trouble for the villagers.
There are traces of Sundering Horns activity nearby. Please go investigate.
But we did find something else.
Alright, come back to me when you have any news.
But we did find something else.
Yes, there are traces of villagers fighting with Sundering Horns nearby.
Yes, there are traces of villagers fighting with Sundering Horns nearby.
Place some Harvest Pancakes on the Offering Table, and he should show up.
Never mind, and you can stop working too.
But we can't afford any delay now. You should use it.
You don't happen to have one, do you?
I do have some, but that was my dinner!
Surely your own comfort pales in comparison to the village's safety?
Surely your own comfort pales in comparison to the village's safety?
Alright, alright! I'm scared of you.
Harvest Pancake is my go-to snack.
Just as I thought. It happened again.
The playful Lowrum Horns love to mess around with villagers.
It's just playing, but the villagers might get hurt easily.
So we need to fight it to satisfy it.
That should keep it quiet for a while.
Nice work! I knew I could count on you.
So, how does it feel playing with ancient beasts?
It fell down before I could even do anything.
It fell down before I could even do anything.
Few students in the academy can match your combat skills.
Join us in the Hunters' ecological observations when you have time!
I almost saw my life flash before my eyes.
I almost saw my life flash before my eyes.
I saw you handled the Sundering Horns with ease.
Join us in the Hunters' ecological observations!
Ways to improve the Cloudreach Cannon...
Hi there! Interested in assembling a Cloudreach Cannon Shell?
Specifically, it consists of the base, rear stabilizer, front shield, side frames, ammo box, and barrel.
I just tweaked the cannonball design, and I need someone to test it out.
The parts are on the table. Assemble it, and you'll get a reward.
Alright. Come back if you change your mind!
So, how was it? Was it hard?
But you pulled it off, which shows you have real talent!
Thank you for your feedback. Now, there's only one final step left to complete the challenge!
Just use the cannon you just assembled to shoot the dummies over there, and you can claim your reward!
Congratulations on completing the challenge. Any questions?
There are three Craft Society challenge locations in Dreamweave Plains.
Its original purpose was to let everyone experience the mysteries of Mechcraft.
And those who succeed in the challenge will have the opportunity to join the Craft Society early.
So, our challenge event gradually became another recruitment event for the Craft Society.
Haha, guess what? I'm the champion of the first Cloudreach Cannonball Assembly Challenge!
Not long after winning the championship, I joined the Craft Society.
Now I'm in charge of recruiting for the Craft Society.
Check out the champion list over there if you're interested. They all joined the Craft Society afterward!
I knew it wouldn't be difficult for you!
Luckily, the Mechcraft box is sturdy enough...
Watch out for a rampaging bear nearby!
I'm in charge of the Craft Society challenge, and it was vandalized too. Luckily, the Mechcraft box is intact.
But most of the important parts needed to unlock the Mechcraft box are missing. What do we do now?
Thanks! The bear didn't take any parts, so they should still be around this camp.
If you can open this box, I'll pass you on the spot, and you get to keep everything inside!
How do I participate in the challenge?
As you can see, the parts needed for the challenge are all locked in chests.
Even if I could open them now, it'd take ages to check the parts. The challenge has to be canceled.
But if you can open this box for me, I'll let you pass the challenge. The prizes inside the box are all yours!
This challenge is one of three projects set up by the Craft Society in Dreamweave Plains.
Are you from the Craft Society too?
Are you from the Craft Society too?
Haha, no, I'm just a Mechcraft enthusiast who volunteered to help the Craft Society.
This challenge point is the easiest in the Craft Society Challenge project of Dreamweave Plains.
Plus, it's close to Cloudreach Tower, making it easy to maintain the Mechcrafts.
So even someone like me can manage this place.
Our challenges are relatively easy, so students from other schools can join in too.
Wanna help me test Little Cuckoo's flight data?
We're on a grand mission—building a logistics network in Dreamweave Plains with Little Cuckoos!
But the little Cuckoo always got bothered by the Flybird and couldn't keep its balance.
We need to simulate the impact on Little Cuckoo from different angles and collect data.
Once we have enough data, we can craft a balancer perfectly suited for Little Cuckoo.
So, interested in helping out? Once the data collection is complete, the Craft Society will give you a reward.
I'll make the little Cuckoos fly in a pattern. Your job is to hit the special targets on them.
I'll collect the targets and analyze the data.
If you're ready, flip that switch.
Little Du Juan can definitely do it!
Thanks for your help! Anything else you'd like to know?
Isn't this supposed to be the Little Cuckoo Assembly Challenge? Why has it turned into a shooting range?
Isn't this supposed to be the Little Cuckoo Assembly Challenge? Why has it turned into a shooting range?
Ah, you might not know, but this is the most remote of the three challenge points in Dreamweave Plains.
Usually, no one comes here except during the Tower Climbing Competition.
Then I started doing collision tests on Little Cuckoo.
Why did the Craft Society spread the challenge points so far apart? Wouldn't it be better to group them together?
Why did the Craft Society spread the challenge points so far apart? Wouldn't it be better to group them together?
Actually, the three challenge points were designed to be together.
But the next year, a new student swept through three Craft Society challenges and took the crown!
To give everyone a chance, the challenge points will be scattered from now on.
And this spot I'm watching is the most remote of them all.
Guarding this place was boring, so I assembled all the parts for the competition.
Turn on the Mechcraft first, then we can start the test.
Hey there! Interested in trying my Mini Cloudreach Tower?
Yes! This is the training equipment I invented for Cloudreach Tower!
Its biggest advantage is that it's highly portable!
But it doesn't look like something you could easily carry around...
But it doesn't look like something you could easily carry around...
You seem interested. How about giving it a try?
I've prepared a prize—the first student to complete the mini Cloudreach Tower gets everything in that chest!
Are you sure you won't give it a try?
I'm still working on it. But you don't have to worry.
The purpose is to let everyone practice climbing skills anywhere and anytime.
No matter where you are, you can use it right away!
To start climbing, you need to flip that switch to fully extend it.
Wow, you actually pulled it off!
Impressive! You're the first to complete my Mini Cloudreach Tower!
Sometimes, sacrifices must be made for portability.
But yours isn't exactly portable either.
But yours isn't exactly portable either.
Oh, please, don't get me started!
We're poor students, you know. The academy doesn't give us much.
Rewards are good enough for me...
Alright, thanks for supporting my research!
Go try my Mini Cloudreach Tower!
You need to make it expand before you can climb.
I'm planning to continue improving my Mini Cloudreach Tower. Any suggestions or questions?
When I first arrived at Cloudreach Tower, I was amazed by its ingenious design.
Cloudreach Tower represents the highest achievement of the Craft Society and embodies the spirit of athletic competition.
So I thought, if only I could invent a portable Cloudreach Tower.
We could promote our designs across Jixia, even the world. Not just Dreamweave Plains.
It's just... well, as you can see, it's not going too well.
Do you know the three challenge points set up by the Craft Society in the Dreamweave Plains area?
Do you know the three challenge points set up by the Craft Society in the Dreamweave Plains area?
Of course! I've participated in all of them and took home all the first-place trophies!
So it was you behind all this!
So it was you behind all this!
It's precisely because you swept all the championships that the Craft Society decided to spread the three challenge points apart.
It's precisely because you swept all the championships that the Craft Society decided to spread the three challenge points apart.
People like me who want to join all the challenges have to travel across Dreamweave Plains!
People like me who want to join all the challenges have to travel across Dreamweave Plains!
That's on me, but I really didn't know about the venue change.
Just kidding, you are quite skilled.
Just kidding, you are quite skilled.
Maybe I should give others more chances in the future.
Clearly, we need to improve its portability.
But we don't have enough funds!
Hey, you're here! I just got word from the Mechcraft research point. Everyone's singing your praises.
Thank you for your contribution to the research of Cloudreach Tower. The model beside me is yours to keep!
Hello, the Craft Society is organizing a research activity on the Mechcraft of Cloudreach Tower. Are you interested?
Good! That's the drive I like to see. Keep it up!
The rules are simple. We've established three research camps in Dreamweave Plains. Complete them, then come back to me.
Complete the research to earn the Cloudreach Tower model. I'm looking forward to your performance!
Oh, hello. Do you happen to have three Mech Cores?
What do you want with that?
You see that camp across the river? They're selling secret guides for conquering Cloudreach Tower!
But it costs three Mech Cores, and I can't afford it.
Something feels off. Let me investigate.
Something feels off. Let me investigate.
Don't fall for secret manuals. Hard work is the only way.
Don't fall for secret manuals. Hard work is the only way.
I've tried many times, but never succeeded.
Maybe I'm doing it wrong. I wish someone could teach me.
Okay... I'll figure out another way.
Forget the real Cloudreach Tower, I can't even climb this mini one.
If only we had a secret manual.
I've investigated that camp. It's a group of rebels selling fake manuals to scam people.
I've investigated that camp. It's a group of rebels selling fake manuals to scam people.
Ugh, my greed almost got me scammed.
Thank goodness you're here, I don't know what I would do otherwise!
Thank goodness you're here, I don't know what I would do otherwise!
What are these Naughty Civets up to?
What are these Naughty Civets up to?
Oh, big brother! Can you help me?
Oh, big sister! Can you help me?
Alright, I'll keep observing on my own.
It wasn't me that ran into trouble!
Look at these Naughty Civets. What are they up to?
They seem to be trying to form a line, but they never succeed.
Looks like you've really meshed with the Naughty Civets!
Big sis is totally blending in with us Naughty Civets now!
Still, I'm not sure what these Naughty Civets are up to.
Maybe we should observe a bit longer?
Maybe we should observe a bit longer?
Forget it. You may inherit my mission.
The calamity of lightning shall perish with my body...
I saw it! You're stronger than the Bull Hero!
I saw it! You're even stronger than the Bull Hero!
So the Bull God absorbed the thunderstorm, and you finally freed it.
Maybe we'll have another bumper harvest next year!
When I grow up, I'll protect this land too!
May the coming year bring you good fortune and harmony.

No more incidents of Han Ming's Thunder Horn causing injuries have occurred.
Just to be safe, I'll keep patrolling here for a while.

If only Navenia had something like this.

I run the Wilderness Ranch. I'm in charge of... hold on, just a sec!

The animals here have the best living conditions.

No thanks, I'm just taking a little break. But thanks for offering.

Kind soul, until we meet again!
I wanna go angling too! But I can't handle such a big rod.
An elder boy advised me to wait until I grow up. I saw him laughing at me!
Bad brother, don't ever talk to them again!
It's by the lake. Lots of people are angling there.
Hmph! I went there early this morning too.
I should tell these fish not to bite his hook!
Okay, I'll go play with the bunny later.

I analyze their combat techniques and develop training plans for my students.
I have no choice. The competition this year is too intense.
I may not be as strong as the younger generation, but I can still offer them some advice.
I'm gathering intel on other contestants for my disciple.
Goodbye, looking forward to seeing you on the arena.
This is way slower than before.
I've never felt so tired before...

Harvest Brew ahead, how I miss it.

Make sure to try Harvest Brew. You won't regret it.
Finally, a chance to catch my breath. I'm so tired.

text: Stereotypes are unreliable. I need to observe more carefully.
Granny, there's such a large field here, how can you manage it all by yourself? Let me help you!
That's very kind of you, dear. But with this insect plow, the field is turned over in no time, so there's no need to trouble yourself.
What kind of mechanism is this? So convenient! Can I touch it? Granny, what is that other mechanism floating in the sky?
What princess would be interested in farming... The intel must be wrong.
That Mechcraft student charged forward right from the start, with our senior close behind.
It seems senior has more experience. Leading blindly without knowing the situation can lead to big losses.
Haha, then his Mechcraft seemed to malfunction, and he lost his ranking.
Watching the Cloudreach Tower race from here is so comfortable. No need to deal with the crowds on site. Yes!
Mechcrafts have changed our lives, but we shouldn't rely on them for everything.
The Cloudreach Tower souvenir was also quite ingenious...
There's a trace of structure of Ruins Mechcraft.
Check out the Cloudreach Tower souvenirs!
So different from the ones in Navenia.
Everyone has their own strengths in Mechcraft. I hope this exchange has been fruitful for all of you.
Are you also interested in Mechcraft?
Mecha in Navenia are typically constructed with a secret technique and powered by the Sea Glintstone.
What exactly is this... Sea Glint?
What exactly is this... Sea Glint?
It's a coarse crystal, blue as starlight, and very valuable.
There are many similar energy sources, but they will eventually run out.
What do you call this wooden Mechcraft structure in Jixia?
This is a Mortise and Tenon Mechcraft structure, and the Mech Core is its core drive.
But we'll make the most of nature's gifts, like wind or solar power.
Thanks, I think I understand now.
Thanks, I think I understand now.
Looks like we craftsmen of Navenia still have a long way to go...
So different from the ones in Navenia.
Everyone has their own strengths in Mechcraft. I hope this exchange has been fruitful for all of you.
A chef in the Cloudreach Tower race?
True masters always hide among the crowd.
Hey, want to check out some souvenirs?
Did you make these keepsakes yourself?
Did you make these keepsakes yourself?
Not mine, actually. Most of them are crafted by students from the Craft Society. I'm just helping sell them.
Such a beautiful keepsake, I really want it.
Such a beautiful keepsake, I really want it.
Thank you for your support! If you like it, recommend it to your friends!
Hey! You must be the challenger!
So, isn't Cloudreach Tower fascinating? Interested in some souvenirs?
Did you make these keepsakes yourself?
Did you make these keepsakes yourself?

Such a beautiful keepsake, I really want it.
Such a beautiful keepsake, I really want it.
Thank you for your support! If you like it, recommend it to your friends!
Flour and meat... should still be enough.
Oh, I'm thinking how to make Cloudreach Tower more fun.
Did you design all those Mechcrafts?
Did you design all those Mechcrafts?
Actually, not just the Mechcrafts, the entire layout around Cloudreach Tower was designed by us Craft Society.
I think there's room for improvement.
Glad you like it. We'll keep working on even better designs.
Indeed, that's why we're studying the wisdom of our predecessors and trying to integrate it into Mechcraft.
One day, we'll build a Cloudreach Tower that meets everyone's expectations!
Why are these seats so bad? You can barely see the match!
Senior, this is the best tent I could get after pulling all my strings.
This year's competition has so many dark horse contestants, and the audience is larger than ever before.
With that tent, you could secure a front-row spot at every competition...
Alright, I know it's not easy. Lunch is on me today.
You're too kind, Senior Fangfei. I'll be sure to let you know if I find anything!
The competition is fierce this year.
Thank goodness for these tents. I can stay in the front row to watch the matches...
Did you see how that new student performed?
Yes, she's one of the champion candidates. She's really impressive.
Hey, Senior, look. Isn't that the new student?
Next time, let's use a seat-reserving Mechcraft.
Mechcrafts made with passion always shine.
A puppet can play music like this?
The Puppet Society and Music Society make a fantastic team!
A big fish like this must be popular...
Hey there! Want to learn about the Angling Society?
Is it possible... your fish has gone bad?
Is it possible... your fish has gone bad?
Smell? Really? I don't smell anything. You're imagining things.
What does the Angling Society emphasize?
Some think Angling Society's all about reeling in the biggest catch.
But what we truly pursue is the process of angling, the cultivation of temperament. What you catch isn't important.
Goodbye, let's go angling together if there's a chance!
Is this the simulation platform used by the Strategist Society?
But why does it smell funny?
Cloudreach contender Ding Xiaozhang is even stronger!
Tsk, Senior Xiao would totally pull off the tower climbing look better!
Nothing beats Senior Ding's "Five Heavenly Steps"!
When Senior Xia wins the championship, the Nine-jointed Mechcraft Lasso will definitely go viral!
Him? Climbing the tower with his Mechcraft rope?
Every store in Jixia will be fighting to sell them!
Hello. Have you seen any stones with colorful patterns on them?
Bring me all you've got. I have lots of cool stuff here. Give me your stones, and I'll trade with you!
Where did you find more Iridescent Stones? Let me see! If they're pretty, you can pick anything from here!
Haha, you noticed! When I first enrolled, my teacher said I was running around like a monkey.
I found them while exploring Jixia.
For the sake of my collection, let's trade these trinkets. A little exchange is only polite.
Take a closer look at this stone. See anything unusual? Look at that pattern...
Sorry, I got a bit emotional... The Herbalists say these are small stones associated with Aerux. You can see the traces of Aerflow on them.
Each tile's color is slightly different. You should come by my place sometime—I have tiles in all sorts of amazing colors!
Until next time! Remember to come find me if you have any Iridescent Stones!
If you have Iridescent Stones in your pocket, come find me!
Come one, come all! I sell everything! As long as you have Circolstone, we can do business!
I want to join Jixia Society too!
You'll know when you enter the academy.
Are you here to interview me?
I'm Chen Qisi, the most dazzling contestant in this competition.
I'm the one making this competition glamorous.
Climbing Cloudreach Tower isn't hard. The real challenge is maintaining grace and elegance all the way up.
See you. Don't miss my glamorous performance in the arena!
Society Recruitment! Come check out the Hunting Society!
Join the Hunting Society to learn about breeding!
It's so cute! I want one!
Take a look! We have everything you need!
What would you like to know?
You've come to the right person! I'm very familiar with the shops around here.
For injuries, go to the recovery room. If you're hungry... can't you smell the delicious food?
Cloudreach Tower is more than just a competition venue. The area is just as lively as the town.
Here for the Cloudreach Competition? Good luck!
But make sure you go prepared. I heard they've added new Mechcrafts to Cloudreach Tower this year, and the competition will be even fiercer!
Be careful. A fall will put you out for days.
Goodbye! Don't forget to drop by again!
The Strategy Society is recruiting new disciples!
The Puppet Society welcomes new disciples!
The Herb Society at the organizers' camp is really impressive.
From that fall, I thought it would take months to recover.
But I recovered in just seven days, and I feel stronger than ever!
I'll reach the finals next time. Special training starts now!
You've been here a few times. Why not give it a try?
I'm swamped with coursework. It's all I can handle and more.
Talk tough if you want, I say you're just scared!
Look at all the contestants getting hurt. The safety measures for this competition are not up to par.
Look at those new students, and then look at you...
Everyone's dreams are special in their own way. Why compare?
I'm good at climbing, and I'm good at my studies.
How do you know they're doing worse than you?
Why is there a banana peel on the track...?
I was so nervous watching the match.
Thank goodness for the Herb Society's medicinal teas.
My mood calmed down as soon as I drank it.

Alright, let's not put pressure on him.
I'll get Su to check on it later. Some rest should do the trick.

Once I heal this Aerux, I need to check on the Herb Garden...

Wait, you're not from the Herb Society...?
Ah, my apologies! The Herb Society is grateful for your assistance.
If you're not hurt, why are you here?
If there's nothing else, please leave.
The Department of Discipline is watching, keep your hands and feet clean!
Today, your productivity will soar, and your cooking and medicine-making skills will reach new heights!
Today you can easily make a lot of money! No time to waste, set off now!

Today, you'll have an underwater surprise! Not only will your catch be bountiful, but you might also find sunken treasures.
The Angling Society is too boring for me...
I'm not a member of the Strategic Society, and I'm not smart enough...
Puppet Society, puppets can work, that's good!
Join the Puppet Society and create terrifying puppets!

The Puppet Society is the culmination of Mechcraft and Sorcery! We control puppets with Sorcery!
Senior Yuan Ge represents the Puppet Society. Want to be as skilled as him? Sign up with me!
Of course! Martial Arts teaches you how to defeat one person, but we Strategists study how to defeat thousands, even tens of thousands.
Senior Lian Po is an honorary member of our Strategist Society. Join us, and you'll have the chance to discuss tactics with him.
It feels like there are fewer people here.
It's just that the Angling Society's fish...
See you. I really wish we could get some new members...
Join the Strategic Society, and you'll all become brilliant commanders.
The Puppet Society is the culmination of Mechcraft and Sorcery! We control puppets with Sorcery!

Senior Lian Po is an honorary member of our Strategist Society. Join us, and you'll have the chance to discuss tactics with him.
It feels like there are fewer people here.
Join the Puppet Society and create terrifying puppets!
See you. I really wish we could get some new members...
It's just that the Angling Society's fish...
That's your five elements of luck. Until we meet again.
No one has the patience to listen to the end.
Welcome to the Yin Yang Society.
The Yin Yang Society sounds amazing.
Then you must be interested in our research: yin and yang, the harmony of duality...
The five elements: Water, Fire, Wood, Metal, and Earth...
Wood fuels Fire, Fire nourishes Earth, Earth creates Metal, Metal collects Water, Water feeds Wood...
Water defeats fire, fire defeats gold, gold defeats wood, wood defeats earth, earth defeats water...
Fine... Looks like you can't grasp the mystic way of Yin and Yang.
Finally, I got all this off my chest. You seem to really connect with the Yin Yang Society!
Since we've met, let me read your fortune!
Fine... Looks like you can't grasp the mystic way of Yin and Yang.
Fine... Looks like you can't grasp the mystic way of Yin and Yang.
Oh, you want to check your fortune again? Sorry, the five elements are mysterious, can't be revealed too much.
How about I introduce you to our Yin Yang Society?
Everything in the world is governed by yin and yang, and the five elements...
I've got other things to do.
Hey, wait! I wasn't finished talking.
Hey, wait! I wasn't finished talking.
Hey, you ate all the exhibits!
Oh dear, I only meant to let you have a tiny taste. Did walking around the fair tire you out?
Just enjoy your food. It won't take long to make another one.
Now, guess which exhibit here is my work?
Now guess, my dear assistant, which exhibit here is crafted by my hands?
I've got a sensitive nose, but I don't know much about making incense.
That puppet's too rough, not my style.
And if you ever need a massage, come find me at the school infirmary.
Cleaning... not really my thing. You think I'm that domesticated?
Sorry to disappoint, but I'd prefer fully automatic cleaning Mechcrafts.
You're right! But technically, it's not a dessert, but a medicinal dish I created.
I studied hard from Gourmet Society and spent a lot of time brewing herbs, just to make it perfect in both taste and effect.
As a reward, how about a little taste?
This ergonomic broom seems to work well.
I'll hang out a bit longer, since it's free.
Finished yet? I wanna go play somewhere else.
It's sturdy enough for those buff Martial Arts students.
Come on, let's go see the next exhibit.
Wow, that's impressive! A massage after training would be perfect.
Maximum power is quite intense... Guess it should be used in moderation.
Yeah... or it'd be muscle strain instead of massage.
Yeah... or it'd be muscle strain instead of massage.
The last two exhibits are an ergonomic broom and... a super delicious Honey Bud Soup.
Take a look around, then guess which one is my masterpiece.
The Engineering Broom helps to reduce the burden on the user's waist and back, making it an essential cleaning tool for dormitory cleaning.
As for the Waxy Stew, it's not only delicious but also helps prevent illnesses.
Let me know if you have any flavor preferences. I might just mix something to your taste next time.
Harvest Fields Invention Exhibition, a glimpse into Jixia's beautiful future!
I heard the School Infirmary is participating in the exhibition this year.
I suspect that aromatherapy device came from the infirmary.
Let's go see the next one.
Ms. Lychill, I heard you made that Waxy Broth. Is that true?
The taste is absolutely exquisite! When can we start mass production?
Yes, it is. Pretty good, right?
Well, that depends on how much Moonelia Sprout raw material Herb Garden is willing to support me with...
What, you want me to keep you company?
Unfortunately, I underestimated the popularity of the Waxy Broth. I need to get more samples.
Overtime just won't end... Being too popular is a blessing and a curse.
Dr. Lychill, are you here to visit the exhibition too?
Dr. Lychill, are you here to visit the exhibition too?
That would be nice. I'm here representing the Infirmary at the exhibition. So yes, you can say I'm working.
But at least it's better than being cooped up in the infirmary. We have plenty of free time now... Let me show you around.
You're a sweet one. Seeing how polite you are, let's play a game.
Part of my job is introducing exhibits, but... just walking around seems a bit dull. How about we play a game?
If you can guess which exhibit is my work representing the School Infirmary, I'll give you a small reward.
The first exhibit is this <001>Aromatherapy Device</>. Just touch the switch, and it releases a fragrance formulated from Skirtleaf Flower.
It not only calms the mind but also helps with sleep.
An opportunity. Why not try placing your hand on it?
Alright, I'll give it a try.
Alright, I'll give it a try.
But how? Did I not add enough seasoning?
Looks like the formula needs some tweaking.
You call that a big eater?
Ugh... today was a bad day.
Freshly baked Harvest Pancakes, come take a look!
You need some cakes to climb the Cloudreach Tower!
Kids eat to grow, adults eat to be full.
The Rebels are joining the Cloudreach Competition, and they've got the Craft Society's approval.
Yeah, they broke my Mechcraft Kite last year and took my snacks last month...
Looks like they didn't make any major mistakes...
Maybe it's a scheme of the Craft Society.
Those Craft Society folks are too naive for such schemes, you know?
They even told me "everyone can participate regardless of status."
Want to conquer Cloudreach Tower? Want some tips from the previous champion?
Look how fast you climb the tower after eating my food!
I don't care! You must have eaten my food to be this strong!
Are you here for the Tower Climbing Competition too?
Listen, every contestant who's done well has eaten my Dondu Delights.
Even those who fell from the tower weren't hurt, thanks to my food.
Here! Try these skewers, fresh off the grill. You look like someone with great taste, so I'll let you have them for free!
Is there anything else you'd like to know?
official_target_text: Is there anything else you'd like to know?
official_en_text: Is there anything else you'd like to know?

text: You've already tried all my new dishes, don't be too greedy.
Do you think these manuals are truly so extraordinary?
If it's that powerful, why would he sell it?
They're selling souvenirs at Cloudreach Tower.
Now where should I go first...
The Craft Society designed Cloudreach Tower well.
When will the Angling Society have such a grand place?
Welcome to Cloudreach Tower! Join the climbing competition now!
We've also got plenty of souvenirs. You'll definitely find something you like.
If you're a foodie like me, head to the Food Area!
Pass through here, then dodge the Mechcraft over there...
Haha, I don't even know how to lose. This one's in the bag!
Hey, is there a shortcut to climb Cloudreach Tower? There must be one.
The shortcut is just trying and thinking more. Don't stress it.
What's your business? Who am I to you?
Are you from the Craft Society too?
That's all in the past now...
I once set the record for the fastest assembly of the Cloudreach Cannon Shell at the Craft Society's assembly challenge.
And so, I got the chance to study with the Crafters.
But then, my high-explosive cannonball injured a competitor, violating the spirit of the Cloudreach Challenge.
Since then, I've been exiled and became a Rebel.
I just want to prove myself!
Even after I left the academy, I never stopped studying Mechcraft!
I wonder if I'll ever get the chance to return to the academy...
How many balloons do I have to make in a day?!
Dad, I want the barbecue from that place!
So, do you still want to drink Harvest Brew?
It's rare that mom's not home today.
Let's eat our fill this time!
Who do you think will win this year's Tower Climb?
I bet on that new student.
It seems we can't convince each other...
Such a strong contestant... Is that the new student?
I might have a shot at the crown!
Wonder if she's representing a school.
I think she's here with the Team of Stars. Probably... not here to represent the academy.
I've figured out the pattern of this Mechcraft.
A somersault, then a carp jump!
These little gadgets are quite interesting.
Damn, I don't have enough money to buy them all...
It's the toughest arena challenge in Dreamweave Plains. Mechcrafts are unpredictable, but rewards are very generous.
But... the tower is guarded by Mechcrafts. One wrong move, and you're out.
Hey there! Interested in joining the Cloudreach Competition? It's designed by our Craft Society!
This pillar has quite a history. After an accident in Dreamweave Plains, the Craft Society built it to protect the area.
The place was abandoned for years until we renovated it.
I watched your match! You did well!
So, anything else you'd like to know?
This pillar has quite a history. After an accident in Dreamweave Plains, the Craft Society built it to protect the area.
Thanks to the joint efforts of all the societies, we finally managed to overcome the crisis.
What's the point of the Cloudreach Tower competition?
To remember the spirit of Society collaboration during that difficult time.
Don't you think people climbing Cloudreach Tower reminds you of Society members showcasing their skills there?
The little one ran off again.
My boy's always giving others riddles.
I have no idea where they are. I'm so unlucky...
Where did he run off to this time?
Just stay out of trouble, okay?
You're back. Did you cause more trouble for me?
No! I just find watching boring. Let me join.
I brought you freshly baked Harvest Pancakes!
What about drinks? I brought two cups of Harvest Brew.
I have training soon, I'll pass.
If you're thirsty, you could just drink some.
What's so fun about the race? I'd rather play!
Are you Lanny? Your mom is calling you.
Are you Lanny? Your mom is calling you.
No way! She can't even solve my riddles!
What puzzle? If I solve it, will you go home?
What puzzle? If I solve it, will you go home?
Hmm... I guess that's fine! You'd never guess it anyway!
The riddle goes like this: "We fly but are not birds, we keep time but are not clocks. Allies speed up when we're around, while enemies slow down."
I want to join the competition too.
And reach the top to claim the championship!
Taking care of a child is really not easy...
Finally, a break from parenting duties.
You look down. Did someone bully you?
Not really. I heard Chen Qisi is competing, so I wanted an autograph...
But I hesitated outside her tent for a long time and never had the courage to go in.
Then others from the School of Sorcery found me, calling me a pervert.
Hahahahaha... Oh, I can't stop laughing...
I'm already suffering, and you're mocking me too...
Wow! They solved my riddle! Impressive!
Oh, it's you! Thank you for bringing him back.
No problem. I do enjoy a good puzzle.
No problem. I do enjoy a good puzzle.
Great! We'll keep making riddles for you!
I'm glad you're happy. Just don't cause trouble for others next time, okay?
I thought I'd seen all the peculiar Mechcrafts there are.
Never expected to find a fascinating structure like Cloudreach Tower in Jixia.
The Craft Society of Jixia Academy really has ingenious minds.
Is this a masterpiece from the Craft Society?
With my years of experience operating Mechcrafts, I don't think this Cloudreach Mechcraft is anything special.
These little Mechcrafts are no match for me.
Registration for the Cloudreach Tower challenge has not started. Take a look around!
The competition is over, but we've designed more challenge stages.
The barbecue smells amazing, and so do the pancakes. And the noodles on this table...
Which one should I go for? It's so hard to decide.
If I join the Gourmet Society and cook delicious food every day, I won't have to choose.
I drank digestive tea before the eating contest, so why can't I eat more?
Must be the buns and tea... darn it...
She's tiny, but she can eat a lot. I underestimated her!
It must be that the ingredients in those buns and tea reacted in my stomach. Damn it, I'm so frustrated...
zh_text: 一定是那些馒头和茶的成分在我的胃里发生什么反应，可恶，好不甘心……
source_text: 一定是那些馒头和茶的成分在我的胃里发生什么反应，可恶，好不甘心……

text: Haha, not even an eating contest can stand a chance against me!
That guy on the other side ate too quickly, no wonder he's feeling unwell now.
And fruit to help digest the meat.
Next time, let's call our juniors to come together.
Hmm. The Craft Society actually expressed welcome...
Heard that? A Rebel's joining the competition!
The roasted Dondu is getting better and better.
I wish I could make something like this.
Then we can have barbecue at home every day.
Sorry, we've sold out of Harvest Brew for now. I've already got my staff restocking.
What bad luck. When will the goods arrive?
It might take a while... Maybe you could go check out the other places first?
No worries, I'll wait here to prevent them from getting snatched again.
I haven't eaten for three days for this competition.
Are you sure you're alright, Senior?
That's the only way you can eat thirty of my signature energy foods, "Quick Steam Buns," while climbing the tower.
Then, with the sustained stamina provided by "Instant Steamed Bun," you can quickly climb Cloudreach Tower.
Only you could come up with such tactics! You're amazing! You're destined to be the champion!
That new student seems pretty skilled...
Instant Steamed Buns is a secret recipe. It's sure to win!
Instant Steamed Bun is a unique secret technique, of course I'll win!
zh_text: “速食馒头”可是独门秘籍，当然会赢的！
source_text: “速食馒头”可是独门秘籍，当然会赢的！

text: After the competition at Cloudreach Tower, a barbecue is what completes the experience.
Hmph, how can you compare a simple barbecue to the Harvest Pancake?
Excessive seasoning and high heat only overwhelm the ingredients, making everything taste bland.
You might not get it, but for us barbecue enthusiasts, the flavors of smoke and charcoal are what make all the difference.
Only those who savor their food can truly appreciate the texture of Harvest Pancake. Those who gobble their food could never understand.
Those Rebels are completely out of control!
Last time, they almost stole my stuff. Luckily, I caught them red-handed.
And yet, they managed to slip through again while I was distracted. It's ridiculous!

We must teach them a lesson!
We must show them what we're made of!

source_text: 一定要给他们点颜色瞧瞧！

text: I was only gone for a moment...
He's making excuses. What are we going to do?
Martial Arts students have impressive footwork...
The Gourmet Society uses food to assist...
