They were in a hurry when they stole the Mechcraft components. Even broke the cart.
True, but the scene was clean. Other students are already in position at the exits, watching for anyone suspicious.
They want the School of Mechcrafts to lose, so they went through all this trouble.
Great, you have potential in solving cases. You predicted my next steps!
I've sent someone to search for the Mechcraft components.
Tami will probably climb the tower when she grows up.
I swear it wasn't intentional! I had a stomachache that day, okay?
Still making excuses... I was kind enough to bring you to work for Luo Shu, and now how am I supposed to explain this?
You weren't around last time either. If Luo Bei hadn't returned, that thing would've been stolen!
I'm willing to accept my punishment. What more do you want from me?
You're so annoying. I'll transfer you after this.
Senior, how about we go back and rest? We can't see clearly in this darkness.
I think it's fine. When else should we work hard?
Senior Sun Bin worked day and night to study Cloudreach Tower. We can't slack off either.
Can you help me with the Mechcraft adjustments tomorrow, Senior?
Seriously? You're still negotiating with me?
Hehe, after all, Senior Sun Bin helps Senior Meng Ya with cannon research.
Wow! Are they going to climb such a tall tower? That's amazing!
When you grow up and enter Jixia Academy, you'll be able to reach the top of Cloudreach Tower.
Alright! I'm going to get into Jixia Academy!
See, I knew we Martial Artists would come out on top!
The champion of Cloudreach Competition, of course.
Cloudreach Tower is an intricate Mechcraft creation. Who do you think is more likely to pass this trial?
Are you a Martial Arts practitioner, a Sorcery adept, or a Mechcraft student?
I know, right? Hahaha! Come on, you'll need a full stomach to climb the tower. Take it, go on!
Indeed. These rations will help you recover energy. You'll need them for the challenge ahead.
Good choice. I hope these supplies will be of help to you.
This Cloudreach Tower has quite a few new tricks up its sleeve compared to the last one.
But all their tricks are useless against my signature move, "Five Heavenly Steps."
I watched the new student's match, and I felt...
No way, my signature move, "Skybound Steps," must be invincible!
Shh, what are you doing! Keep it down!
Al-Alright! Let's go, we still have to make up your magic class today!
The intel was so specific, it shouldn't be wrong...
This butterfly is so pretty! The fabric is very soft, but isn't there too little cloud silk used on it?
Knowing so much about market prices, you don't look very wealthy... Conclusion: Intelligence is incorrect, the princess is not currently at Jixia...
Based on my years of experience in military logistics procurement, the cost price is roughly... Heh heh, classmate, can you give me a discount?
Sorry, miss, our goods are produced and priced uniformly.
I will record your request. If it is reasonable, we craftsmen will adjust the price of the bows accordingly.
This year's Tower Climbing Competition is really exciting!
I must keep up with the logistics work.
Little Cuckoo, I'm counting on you for today's broadcast.
Hello, I'm the Craft Society member responsible for maintaining the broadcasting Mechcraft.
This broadcasting Mechcraft lets everyone hear live commentary.
It's the broadcasting Mechcraft. I named it Dujuan.
Thanks for not judging me by my rough appearance. It's nice to chat with someone every now and then.
Little Cuckoo, I'm counting on you for today's broadcast.
I know you! You're that record challenger, right? I was just about to announce your achievements to the whole venue!
Hello, I'm the Craft Society member responsible for maintaining the broadcasting Mechcraft.
This broadcasting Mechcraft lets everyone hear live commentary.
It's the broadcasting Mechcraft. I named it Dujuan.
Thanks for not judging me by my rough appearance. It's nice to chat with someone every now and then.
The Tower-climbing Mechcraft was stolen from the School of Mechcraft.
I was only gone for a bit, and the Mechcraft got destroyed?
I'm sorry. I was distracted by the child over there...
Backup components for Cloudreach Tower, crafted by the School of Mechcrafts at the request of the Craft Society.
Last month, we were short of one box of parts sent from the academy, and I got an earful.
Strange... The numbers just don't add up.
But this morning, hey! There's an extra crate! Looks like last month's lecture was wasted.
Goodbye. I need to count them again.
Next time, think before you act...
Next time, think before you act...
What kind of competition is this?
Alright... Anything else I should know?
Alright... Anything else I should know?
Hey there! Are you interested in joining the "Cloudreach Competition" held by the Craft Society?
It's the most popular Mechcraft competition in Jixia, with generous rewards.
Just climb with your legs. Be careful with the Mechcrafts, or you'll be knocked off.
Don't worry. We've got your back. Climb with confidence.
The Mechcrafts in Cloudreach Tower are diverse and challenging. Clear them to win rewards!
It was a Mechcraft pillar built by seniors at the School of Mechcrafts. It was abandoned after they graduated.
After we Craft Society members discovered it, we stuffed it with all sorts of Mechcrafts to transform it into what it is now.
The Craft Society of Jixia specializes in studying Mechcraft. You'll see our traces wherever there are ingenious Mechcraft and buildings.
Alright, touch the Mechcraft under the tower to complete the preliminaries, and you're all set.
No worries. Come back whenever you have time. Our Tower Climbing Competition is open all year round.
Aeropal? Sounds like an ancient Mechcraft material, but I don't recall much about it.
It is indeed an ancient artifact, related to the legendary Aerflow anomaly in Harvest Fields.
It is indeed an ancient artifact, related to the legendary Aerflow anomaly in Harvest Fields.
Oh, I know about that. We have a special place to store old items related to that disaster.
Great, I'll go look for it myself.
Great, I'll go look for it myself.
But recently, we sent some artifacts to an exhibition at the academy. On the way back, they were stolen, and the investigation is ongoing.
If you can't wait, go check it yourself. It's southwest from here.
But be careful. The thief might be a Rebel.
I don't get it. Is this novel really that good?
Ugh, this parts list is so long.
They're probably setting up new Mechcrafts on Cloudreach Tower.
No, I can't let Cloudreach Tower fall again.
We can't let Master Mozi clean up our mess again...
Step back! I'm practicing my balance!
Hey, hey, hey! Don't hit me! I was wrong!
Are you preparing for the Cloudreach Challenge?
Are you preparing for the Cloudreach Challenge?
Yes, I use Sorcery Techniques to manipulate this part to protect myself from harm.
It's my first experiment, so we'll see how it goes.
This is ingenious. I never thought of designing Mechcrafts like this...
I wish my Mechcraft could be used on Cloudreach Tower.
You really aren't going to practice swordplay anymore?
Let me finish this novel first...
This time we must defeat the School of Sorcery!
Didn't expect this new student to be so impressive...
Looks like there's one more opponent to defeat.
When I grow up, I'll challenge Cloudreach Tower too! I'll be stronger than all of them!
Hey! It's already broken and you're still hitting it!
How long am I gonna be fixing this?!
You always disappear on competition day!
I told you not to rush in like Wuyan. You failed, right?
You need to take things slow and solve the Mechcraft puzzles in Cloudreach Tower.
Yes, I've figured out the issue.
The problem is I don't have a big hammer like Senior Wuyan.
Just wait till I get one like hers. I'll swing a big hammer like her and clear all these Mechcrafts in no time.
You didn't listen to a word I said.
Someone tried to force their way through the Mechcraft like Senior Wuyan, and now it's all messed up.
I'll go back to the academy and get some help.
It's all because I'm not capable enough. I'm just not strong enough yet.
zh_text: 一切都是因为我的能力不够。是我还不够强。
source_text: 一切都是因为我的能力不够。是我还不够强。
official_target_text: It's all because I'm not capable enough. I'm just not strong enough yet.
official_en_text: It's all because I'm not capable enough. I'm just not strong enough yet.

text: Even in the Herb Garden, medicines should be used sparingly.
Don't take too much medicine. Even medicine can be toxic in excess.
Aerdense Flowers are growing more and more.
What if they spread across Jixia?
Well, Moonelia Sprout is just a flower that blooms too much!
The Cultivators' research on Moonelia Sprout is glorious and noble!
In this critical moment for the Herb Garden, only we can shoulder the burden of the Herb Society.
Jixia's medical skills are truly amazing.
Who knew roadside plants could heal?
I've come all this way for healing, and I've definitely come to the right place.
I wonder if these herbs can be preserved. Maybe I've discovered a great business opportunity!
Long time no see, Mayene. Here to buy herbs from Jixia again?
Exactly. I've sold out all my stock.
Whether it's Chang'an or anywhere else, demand always outstrips supply.
There seems to be some sort of science outreach event at the Herb Garden. I see a big crowd.
Oh, sounds interesting! I'll have to check it out later.
After all the choosing, I still find Jixia's herbs the best. They offer a wide variety and top-notch quality.
Where Aerux meets the sky, and mist turns to dawn. The ancients were right—this medicine truly lies at the highest point.
After thirty-seven days and nights, I finally found this century-old Silk Ginseng.
This medicine is so rare, tomorrow I'll have to assemble everyone to see if we can cultivate it.
Thirty-seven days and nights have passed, and I have finally found this century-old Thread-Pulling Ginseng.
zh_text: 三十七个日夜过去，终于让我找到这百年牵丝参了。
source_text: 三十七个日夜过去，终于让我找到这百年牵丝参了。

official_en_text: Thirty-seven days and nights have passed, and I have finally found this century-old Thread-Pulling Ginseng.

text: Ugh, now I have to sweep again.
It's just those herb names are too hard to remember.
When will I get to treat real patients...
You're lucky. I have to trek mountains for Century Silk Ginseng.
My legs are tired. Wanna switch?
When will the teacher be back today?
I need to ask the teacher about the growth of the seedlings.
That seems to be the student who saved the Herb Garden!
I feel sad when I think I'm just a nobody.
So you took down a few Moonelia Sprouts? I could do that too.
Oh, it's you... I mean, sir.
We meet again. Glad we got through that last time without a hitch. How have you been?
We meet again. Glad we got through that last time without a hitch. How have you been?
I really appreciate your help last time. I was so flustered I forgot to thank you.
This basement was established by the previous generation of Herb Society to store herb seeds.
I need to perform the Stabilization Ritual again. Do you know the whereabouts of the Golden Wheat from the Herb Society?
I need to perform the Stabilization Ritual again. Do you know the whereabouts of the Golden Wheat from the Herb Society?
I know! The Golden Wheat is stored in this seed vault. I've already got permission from Perilla, so feel free to take it yourself.
I'm not sure about the details, but I heard the head trainer mention that when the bell tolls, all things are set.
They were told to give the Golden Wheat to whoever came for it.
No worries, he'll be back when he's hungry.
No worries, he'll be back when he's hungry.
Who has the key to the basement?
The student guarding the basement suddenly disappeared.
The door to the basement is locked too. I'm a bit worried, but I can't leave until my research is complete...
Great, I'm swamped. I have to rely on you.
He left a message on the door. You should take a look.
May we all enjoy health and peace.
The student who was always guarding the basement has suddenly disappeared for some reason.
zh_text: 一直在这里看守地下室的那名同学，不知怎么突然不见了。
source_text: 一直在这里看守地下室的那名同学，不知怎么突然不见了。

official_en_text: The student who was always guarding the basement has suddenly disappeared for some reason.

text: The student with the basement key is back! He told me the story of your battle with the giant invincible radish monster! So exciting!
When can I finish my research and embark on an exciting journey like you?
Precious treasures passed down by our Herb Society lie below!
You flatter me. So, where's the student with the key?
You flatter me. So, where's the student with the key?
Check the basement. He headed straight there when he got back.
Nobody comes here. Why bother cleaning?
This is a seed warehouse. Only Herb Society members come here to develop new seeds.
But I heard Senior Sun Bin came once.
Senior Sun Bin? Is he injured?
Woah... you admire Senior Sun Bin, right?
They say he left empty-handed, no seeds or data... Maybe he's just here for a visit.
When will Senior come again? I want to help him heal...
This Runestone emits a warm light, it should be the treasure of the Herb Society.
This Runestone emits a warm light, it should be the treasure of the Herb Society.
Don't touch it without Master's permission.
Don't touch it without Master's permission.
The gate beneath Shennong Hall opened...
The gate beneath Shennong Hall opened...
Gained new insights into the situation of the Herb Society.
Gained new insights into the situation of the Herb Society.
The door's locked. What's written on the sign...?
The door's locked. What's written on the sign...?
Ah! It's all because I love joining in on the fun.
I planned to take my grandson to the Herb Garden, but this lecture on pulse diagnosis caught my attention.
When I snapped out of it, my child was gone. I want to search but fear leaving home might confuse them. What should I do now?
I'll help you look for it.
Thank you so much! I'll stay here in case he comes back.
It's all my fault! I'll wait a bit longer, but if it doesn't show up, I'll have to ask the disciples nearby for help. It's so embarrassing!
Oh no... Where did he go?
Ugh, I shouldn't have lied to him about seeing Dr Bian here...
Ah... where has that boy gone...
Plants have spirits and require careful nurturing and patient observation.
Ever heard of Herbologist Jiang Han? Studying plants in Jixia to develop new medicines.
Mind your step! Don't step on it!
These are seedlings of precious herbs. They need careful care.
Plants have their own nature. Following ancestral traditions and growing in harmony with nature can maximize their potential.
Shh... Li Er, keep quiet. Don't let anyone spot us.
Don't worry, they're probably all asleep. Feel the soil—it's got just the right amount of moisture, and the fertilizer is perfectly balanced.
Indeed! Herbologists really know their stuff. Hope they can keep our Springborne No. 8 seedlings alive!
Hehe, let's remember the spots well.
Got it. Let's finish up and get out of here.
Thanks! I'll make sure the academy hears about your deeds!
Don't worry, I'll check for you.
Oh no, this formula is marked for external use only! How could you let him take it orally?!
Oh... haha, I see! Wait, will I be okay?
Don't worry. The herbs are harmless.
What kind of medicine is this? My leg was hurting, and now my stomach hurts too!
You Herb Society people are so unreliable!
Do you have any memory-loss medicine?
But Cultivators have studied it. It's not something to be used casually, though. Why?
I... I'm supposed to meet Xiaofeng and the others to explore the Evernull Forest. But I saw a shadow as soon as we entered and ran away crying...
It's alright. I'll ask Mr. Waixi for a soothing dietary supplement, and you go back and get some good rest. I'll go with you next time.
Why bring that up? Herbologists like us have never used such medicines.
Hello, Master. Could you take a look at this formula for me? I can't quite...
Please don't call me Master, I'm just a student. Let me take a look.
Hmm, the handwriting is a bit messy... but I can make it out.
One Silk Ginseng, powdered and taken with hot water.
Hello! Welcome to the Medicine House. Are you here for a prescription or a consultation?
Hey, you must be new here! Welcome!
The Herb Garden's Medicine House is famous. Practically everyone in Jixia comes here for remedies.
I'm Liu Yunxin, a Herbologist. I diagnose patients and prescribe herbs.
If you feel unwell, come see me.
She also teaches students how to make medicine. You can see them grinding herbs back there.
Wow! It's the hero who saved the Herb Garden! Are you here to grab medicine or for a consultation?
This is the Herb Garden's Medicine House, where everyone in Jixia comes for treatment.
I'm Liu Yunxin, a Herbologist. I diagnose patients and prescribe herbs.
If you feel unwell, come see me.
She also teaches students how to make medicine. You can see them grinding herbs back there.
Diagnosis requires observation, interrogation, and palpation. It's a serious business.
Probably hidden by Naughty Civets again.
How am I supposed to grind the medicine now...
Thank you for helping me retrieve my mortar.
I'll make sure to praise you to the academy!
Now a dash of aged Staring Gent, hmm, this ratio should work.
I was about to grind medicine for a patient, but my mortar is missing.
Probably those naughty Naughty Civets again. It's the third time this month.
I'll go look for him on your behalf.
Thanks! Naughty Civets don't usually toss things far, so just look around.
Help me! My head has been hurting at night like there are claws scratching inside.
Odd, your lip color looks off. Have you eaten something unusual recently?
Let me think... Nothing unusual, I suppose. Could it be the fruit I had before?
Think it over. I'll have the Toxineers take a look later.
Oh dear, please spare me the treatment from the Toxineers.
I heard they use toxins. I can't handle that.
Alright, I'll help you check again.
You're back! Where have you been?
I went off to play and found a book written by Dr Bian!
Alright, promise me you won't run off alone again. I was so scared when I couldn't find you.
What's wrong with Mr. Gan Sui lately? He keeps talking about Dr Bian's method and has even stopped coming to class.
Dr Bian's method is a legendary forbidden technique...
I'm Lady Perilla's top expert in both medicine and toxins! My skills are impressive, but my temper is worse than the Toxic Bubble Vine on the back hill.
She's been acting so mysteriously lately. You can never find her when you need her. Look, she's even late for a lecture.
I heard someone saw her sneaking into the restricted area of Springbud to gather herbs at midnight, and a medicine boy swore he saw her in <001>that creepy cave behind the Medicine House</>!
But who would go to such a creepy cave? It's probably just a rumor... I'll wait a bit longer. She should be here soon.
Where is the teacher? My legs are numb.
What's going on with Mr. Gan Sui lately? He skipped class again!
No one's coming to my science classes. Where did she go?
Free lectures on pulse diagnosis by Herb Society's Herbologist. All are welcome.
Is this the right spot? Why can't I feel a pulse...?
No, you're doing it wrong! Look at me, you need to place your hand here.
Haha! Got it! Herbologists are really something!
Do we still need to check pulse the old way? My heart races when I swing my sword. Isn't that the same?
Pulse readings can reveal a lot. Your description doesn't sound normal.
Come on, everyone. Put your hands up like I do.
Let me teach you a rhyme: Start at the wrist, find the pulse, feel it float on the surface, and sink deep within.
Your grandpa's been waiting for you. Hurry back now.
Your grandpa's been waiting for you. Hurry back now.
Who are you? Are you also a fan of Dr Bian?
Really? Grandma told me stories about Dr Bian in Herb Garden. I'm a big fan!
I heard he used special methods to treat the injured. I want to be someone like him when I grow up!
That's sweet. But your grandpa is worried sick now. Perhaps you should go home first?
That's sweet. But your grandpa is worried sick now. Perhaps you should go home first?
Alright, I'm heading back right away!
He doesn't know how great Dr Bian is! He even said Grandma lied, Dr Bian never visited Herb Garden.
Look, there are logs. Grandma wasn't lying!
She must've been very kind to you. But your grandpa is worried sick now. Don't you want to go home first?
She must've been very kind to you. But your grandpa is worried sick now. Don't you want to go home first?
Hmph! I'll go back and tell him Grandma didn't lie!
Welcome to listen to the Wangqiu faction's popular science on pulse-taking!
zh_text: 欢迎来听望秋派的把脉小科普！
source_text: 欢迎来听望秋派的把脉小科普！

text: The Herb Garden is so soothing.
Not like Red Falcon Training Hall, where they train all day. It's too intense.
Little troublemaker, how did you mess around under Perilla's nose today?
What? The herbs at Perilla's place are tastier? Oh my, I won't dare try them again.
She's grown up now, and she's even more impressive. She's keeping the Herb Garden very well organized.
Next time, let's sneak some food from Ying Bohe. He won't notice, haha.
You forgot what I told you last time, about her secretly pulling my beard when she was little?
Alright, everyone's here! Let's see if you remember what you learned. Get it right, and there's a reward waiting!
First question, what herb looks like claws and can relieve pain...?
I'm on it! It's Clawshooter Fruit!
Smart! You know the answers so well. Now, what about Fishwood? What's it used for?
Haha, not bad. Fish Fruit Tree Wood is said to be good for the eyes.
You love sleeping. It makes sense, Beakshade helps with sleep.
Next, we'll increase the difficulty. What role does Staring Gent play?
Grandpa Tong, Staring Gent has calming effects and improves vision.
Perfect! Come play with Grandpa again tomorrow. I'll have some tasty treats for you.
I'm Fish... Fish Fruit Tree Wood. Eating me is good for the eyes.
Word for word, perfect! Come back and play with Grandpa tomorrow; I have delicious treats here.
zh_text: 一字不差，太棒了！明天再来找爷爷玩，爷爷这里有好吃的哦。
source_text: 一字不差，太棒了！明天再来找爷爷玩，爷爷这里有好吃的哦。
official_target_text: Word for word, perfect! Come back and play with Grandpa tomorrow; I have delicious treats here.
official_en_text: Word for word, perfect! Come back and play with Grandpa tomorrow; I have delicious treats here.

text: Hey, wait! Don't leave me behind!
I have a packet of seeds. Lend me your rubber bands, and I'll make a slingshot. Then we can play together.
No way. You broke the door last time.
Hmph! If you don't lend it to me, I won't talk to you tomorrow, or the day after!
Ouch... it hurts. I hate it.
Nora did that? I thought Dr Bian Jiang was the best.
Are you doing this for her or for yourself? Can you even tell?
Are you doing this for her or for yourself? Can you even tell?
This area is a research zone for the Herb Society. Outsiders can't enter.
Our research subjects are dangerous—I mean, innovative.
Please keep your distance next time.
<001>Rebels</> have been spotted <001>near the cave at the foot of the mountain</>.
If the Rebels get hold of it, we'll be in trouble.
To prevent that, Cultivators like us must keep watch here day and night.
Please leave and don't come back.
If it gets snatched by a Po Men student, we'll be in big trouble.
zh_text: 万一被破门生抢走了，那麻烦可就大了。
source_text: 万一被破门生抢走了，那麻烦可就大了。
official_target_text: If it gets snatched by a Po Men student, we'll be in big trouble.
official_en_text: If it gets snatched by a Po Men student, we'll be in big trouble.

text: Found it! This is... Gan Sui, what are you doing?
Found it! This is... Gan Sui, what are you doing?
Haha, the perfect potion is about to be born!
Hahaha! Pain is nothing! You will never defeat me!
Zhao, what's the relationship between Dr Bian and the Toxineers? I was too sleepy to pay attention in class yesterday.
I asked around, and everyone had a different answer.
My mentor said that although the Toxineers weren't founded by Dr Bian, the first generation of Toxineers were heavily influenced by him.
You know your stuff, Zhao Yuan.
I'm far from that. I only know the basics. I wouldn't dare to ask him personally. Would you?
I wouldn't dare... Using toxins as medicine? It's scary just to think about it.
Come down now. I know your legs are fine.
You changed your cultivation method without my permission?
Yes... but look how well they've grown!
You're so silly. You're just like the Cultivators, always chasing speed and change.
If we don't follow the ancient formula, what if it dilutes their medicinal value?
Go remove these, before they affect the other plants.
What? You watered them three times today?
I'm so tired. We've been watching till dark.
Beibei, are you sure they bloom at night?
Y-yeah, of course. Just give me a second.
I really want to go back to sleep, I can barely hold on.
That's what the books say, but it hasn't changed at all these few nights.
Could it be a mistake in the records?
Excuse me, where can I find Golden Wheat from the Herb Society?
Excuse me, where can I find Golden Wheat from the Herb Society?
You've made it this far, so I guess I can tell you. It's in the seed vault of Shennong Hall.
The seed vault is locked, and the person with the key is in the herb nursery.
If you're in a hurry, you can try searching the herb nursery on the east side of the Herb Garden.
I've heard about what you've done at the Herb Nursery and Aerfrost Valley.
Such a promising young man. Interested in discussing further with the Head Trainer of the Herb Society?
Relax, I mean I'm very pleased with your performance.
The Aeropal is stored in a vault beneath Shennong Hall. If you can open it, take it. No need for formalities.
Haha! I see. Looks like they need more practice.
Thanks for your help. I'll talk to the academy and get you a reward.
I suggest you try it yourself next time.
Haha! I've had way too much. Skipping today was the right call.
Thanks for your help. I'll make sure the academy treats you well.
I want to see who made this potion.
Hey! Those are for display only, please don't pick them!
Please, just keep your hands off these samples, okay?
Is this Shennong Hall in Herb Garden?
I heard Perilla is a skilled healer. Should I go see her?
I wish I could soak in that bath too.
Remedies bring relief to summer's plight.
Keep an eye on it, Zhi Lan. Don't let Naughty Civets ruin it!
You know it belongs to Grandpa Tong. No one dares to scold it.
Hmph, if it causes trouble again, I'll tell Senior Perilla!
Look, Zhi Lan. There are a few new sprouts compared to last week.
Let me count... one, two, three, four, five. I can't believe it! I need to tell my mentor.
The two injured little beasts rescued under the large Aerux a few days ago have fiery tempers.
A relaxing soak in my herbal bath will ease injuries and calm tempers.
Treated two today, four more to go...
Herbal baths are our Healer's signature. They heal wounds and calm the mind.
This bath is for animals only. I need more research to adapt it for humans.
It's rare for you to be so interested, so I'll tell you all about it.
The lake water accumulated at the base of the Aerux is even made into medicinal baths.
Feel free to visit whenever you have time.
The large Aerux in the Herb Garden not only nourishes these herbs.
This is a unique research of our Healers.
Daily care, supplemented with medicinal meals, is recommended.
Food is essential for people, and nutrition is essential for food.
Medicinal cooking is the art of combining herbs and ingredients to create a delicious dish.
Some foods are excellent medicinal herbs, like Fibercore Lotus seeds, which can calm the mind.
Can I eat medicinal meals often?
Everything in moderation, excess leads to imbalance. Overindulging in medicinal cuisine depletes bodily fluids and disrupts internal harmony.
Recently, the kids from Martial Arts have been pestering me daily for medicinal meals, claiming they can strengthen the body.
But many overdid it and got indigestion. Dietary warming should be gradual.
Goodbye, and don't forget to eat well!
Nourish your body and soul with food supplements.
Oh? A newcomer? I'm Ling You, instructor of Toxineers. We may be newly established, but our research is anything but ordinary.
Let me put it this way. If an Armadillo Rat tries to eat my plants, it'll be knocked out cold.
But Cultivators are pretty bold. I always see them circling around my plants.
By the way, I have a new medicine here. Want to try it?
My lovely flowers, grow up fast.
When I grow up, I can turn you into pills and eat you.
Although three courses of treatment have passed without improvement, the standard treatment course is four. We just have to wait a bit longer.
We can't wait. The patient's reporting weakness and limb fatigue.
I need to adjust the formula, add some strength-enhancing herbs.
That's not how it works. You need to finish the full course first. Changing treatment now could make things worse.
You Herbologists just stick to the rules! I should've known better and not used a conservative treatment from the start.
Medicine can be toxic in large doses. Don't eat them randomly.
Why does this medicine smell so weird...
Let's find a student outside the Toxineers to try it.
I've heard about your deeds. Thank you for helping out at Herb Garden.
I underestimated the threat of the Moonelia Sprout.
Feel free to visit me anytime you're not sick.
Herb Society members have been open to other Flow Styles' views.
I'm sure you played a big part in that.
It seems my previous methods haven't solved the root problem.
Perhaps I should make some changes too.
Most of the time, I'll persuade them with reason and emotion. But there might always be some especially stubborn ones.
That's when you need to exploit the weaknesses of the Herb Society.
I could get more funding for herb research or send them more challenging patients.
Goodbye. Come to me if you have any health issues.
Haha, joking aside, I really appreciate your help in resolving the Moonelia Sprout crisis.
Things have been going well for the Herb Society, all thanks to you.
Spring's restless, Summer's inactive, Autumn's immature, Winter's dormant. These factions are really troublesome.
The four factions of the Herb Society outside, of course. They've been bickering for years before I became the head of this family.
In the medical field, even if you have top-notch skills, not everyone will respect you.
Luckily, I'm good at diagnosing and treating patients.
Duties as head of the house.
Healers must prioritize healing and saving people above all else.
But since I've taken on the title of head of the Herb Society, I'll also handle some of the Society's internal affairs.
Now that you mention it, someone's been doing things behind our backs.
With me around, they won't cause much trouble.
Not long after the Herb Society brought Gan Sui back, she fell into a coma. When she woke up, she had no memory of what happened during that time.
Yes, we tried many methods, but... the medicine had corroded her body too deeply.
I remember when she first came to the Herb Garden, she was suffering from a severe illness... Many treatments failed to help.
Nora was rescued by someone named Norge and settled here. During her recovery, she started studying herbs and eventually became a Herbalist.
Who could have imagined that the usually quiet Gan Sui would restart Dr Bian's old experiments in the underground cave of Herb Garden...
She doesn't know any of this now. Perhaps... losing her memories isn't a bad thing for her.
Erasing pain also means forgetting. I hope this is the rebirth she wanted.
Erasing pain also means forgetting. I hope this is the rebirth she wanted.
By the way, we've already destroyed everything that could be destroyed in that cave. The patients are also under treatment and recovery.
We'll also take care of those Rebels. Hopefully, this incident will teach them a lesson.
There have been quite a few conflicts between the factions of the Herb Society recently.
How about hosting a medicine development competition to keep them busy?
When everyone's busy, I have peace.
Oh? You found me. How did you find me?
Different Herb Society factions always have their own opinions, and they often end up in disputes.
Competition may drive progress, but I fear some may forget their purpose and focus solely on efficiency.
After all, more important than quick healing is making sure there aren't any scary side effects afterward, right?
That's all for now... I need a break.
Stop, or you'll end up my test subject!
Foxvale Brew is getting bland. Maybe I should spice it up with herbs?
I wish the night could be longer...
With all this movement, is it time for medicine?
Careful, don't touch the poison on the table.
Hey! Don't step on my herbs!
I heard there's a giant radish nearby. Is it true?
I heard there's a giant radish nearby. Is it true?
Actually, it's the Radish King, but it's hiding now.
Radish King? How do I find it?
Radish King? How do I find it?
Rumor has it only those who've defeated ten little radishes can stir its ire.
I really hope someone can help us solve this problem once and for all...
Sob sob... I can't see clearly now.
Shhh... stay still. It'll be over soon.
Thanks for your kindness. I'm just collecting samples.
I'm working on my graduation project for the Cultivators.
My mentor rejected all my previous ideas. It took me a lot of effort to come up with this one.
Research on the Hybridization of Wailing Bud and Moonelia Sprout is my last chance this year.
I didn't mean to... Those Wailing Fruits were too intense.
But if you don't mind, could you help me ask the students downstairs for the experimental data of the Moonelia Sprout?
Hope I can get some results this time.
Or maybe... my project just isn't going well. Ugh...
Researching the Hybridization of Jade Tear Fruit and Spring Buds is my last chance this year.
zh_text: 《研究玉泪果和朔椿芽的杂交》是我今年最后的机会了。

text: Just a bit more to go. Keep it up, and we'll be done in no time.
Wow, the texture of the Moonelia Sprout, it actually feels like this! So fascinating.
It does look rough, but it's actually quite smooth to the touch.
I really want to touch a Moonelia Sprout.
I'd love to, but the teacher banned Moonelia Sprouts in the first class.
Since when did Cultivators start caring about rules?
Since when did Cultivators start caring about rules?
You're right! Following rules isn't the Cultivator way. If you want to touch, just touch!
Zhong Xiao is keeping watch for us over there. If he sees the teacher coming, he'll yell, and then you can take my spot.
I thought Cultivators didn't care about rules.
Good idea. I'll water the flowers and keep an eye on him.
So... how's the experiment with Moonelia Sprout?
No signs of successful hybridization of Wailing Bud.
No signs of successful hybridization of Wailing Bud.
Sob... now I want to cry even more.
I often wonder what that guy is up to.
He actually led the Cultivators in planting Moonelia Sprouts!
It's clearly my turn to farm this land. How long do I have to wait?
See? Moonelia Sprout is highly sensitive. Even a touch could provoke it.
Learn your lesson. Don't touch them again.
Oh no! Sprout is angry again!
Run! Spring Sprout is about to attack again!
Who dares to attack Spring Sprout?
Hey, stop that! You're agitating our Moonelia Sprout. It's dangerous!
I've been working on this project for so long... Will I ever get any results?
Crossing Wailing Bud with Moonelia Sprout is a bit of a stretch.
Senior Xiang Xiang sent me to ask for the experimental data of Moonelia Sprout.
Senior Xiang Xiang sent me to ask for the experimental data of Moonelia Sprout.
Oh, tell him to be patient. It's not ready yet.
My sprout, you're waiting for me here today, too.
When will Senior Novar visit Herb Garden again?
I'd love to take a photo with Senior Novar. You can join us, of course.
It's so boring. That girl talks to Moonelia Sprout all day. Is she alright?
I've heard them too, always calling him Brother Novar and stuff... they're totally obsessed.
Hey, stop gossiping! Novar is so charming, who wouldn't like him? He's way better than both of you.
You two should just help Senior Xiangxue record the data on Moonelia Sprout!
The Moonelia Sprout doesn't seem to have changed much today. Is Senior Ching's research project really reliable?
No signs of successful hybridization here either.
I wonder what Moonelia Sprout feels like.
Shh! The teacher doesn't want us to touch them, although I'm really tempted.
How many times do I have to tell you: don't touch the Thorn Sprouts with your bare hands!
I was just curious about how they felt...
You're not afraid of getting hurt, are you? The teacher warned us not to touch Thorn Sprouts in the first lesson.
See, even a newcomer knows that. You're not taking my advice seriously.
Senior Chang Xiang's project aside, what if you got hurt?
See the researcher by the table? That's Senior Xiangsiang. These Brier Sprouts are crucial for his new project!
Croaky, you guys need to get well soon.
You've been feeling down these days. A good soak will surely help.
Hello. Have you heard of Aerdense Flower?
Second, this flower only blooms <001>at night</>, which is when you can collect its <001>stigmas</>.
Aerflower is a rare plant cultivated by the Herb Society, its pistil being a precious medicinal ingredient.
I'm collecting them for my research. Would you help?
First, not all Aerdense Flowers can be gathered. You need to find mature ones.
I've recorded the locations of Aerdense Flowers and other notes in this journal.
If you can collect five pistils, come back and find me! I've prepared a gift for you!
Got it, I'll keep that in mind.
Got it, I'll keep that in mind.
The first Aerdense Flower is right here in the Herb Garden. Go take a look!
Alright. Come back if you change your mind!
Have you gathered five <001>Aerdense Flower Pistils</>?
Thanks for your help! Please take this as a token of gratitude.
Alright, come find me when you've collected five.
Remember to wait until nightfall to pick it!
Thanks to the Aerdense Flower Pistils you brought, my experiment can continue.
I saw you gathered Aerdense Flower Pistils by the medicine bath!
The others are at <001>Aerdense Flower Research Garden, Harvest Rest, Angling Society Camp, and Seeker Society Camp.</>
When in doubt, check the notes I gave you!
The last one—the only flawless creation.
It numbs the pain of being shattered into pieces. The only cost is... you will no longer be yourself.
What's wrong with her? We must save her.
Anyway, he took too much of the stolen potion. Even if we saved him, his mind would be damaged.
There's also a Flux here, just like what we felt on the way.
There's also a Flux here, just like what we felt on the way.
Finally... it stops hurting... So comfortable...
Give me... give me a bit more...
This is so comfortable... Let me rest...
So that plant is the source of both the mist and the serum?
So that plant is the source of both the mist and the serum?
No time to explain. Have you seen Gan Sui? A girl, about...
No time to explain. Have you seen Gan Sui? A girl, about...
She hurried towards the <001>Backhill</>, all flustered...
Take the <001>water ride</> to the Backhill!
Someone else just came out. What happened inside the cave?
Seedling... Dr Bian's method... can cultivate... almost there.
Oh, a new face. Are you here for medicine too?
What is this? What's with the mist and the experiments?
What is this? What's with the mist and the experiments?
I... Gan Sui, I'm a healer. Those people were my patients...
What you see before you is a young plant newly cultivated based on Dr Bian's notes.
With it, we could heal everyone's suffering.
What's the difference between living without self and being a walking corpse?
What's the difference between living without self and being a walking corpse?
You make it sound so easy. You're not a healer. Do you know the agony of living worse than death?
Especially one symptom, like thousands of shards churning inside my body, cutting with every breath, painful to the core...
Yes, you don't know. People can never truly empathize.
Well, in that case, why don't you stay here and experience the pain of illness for yourself? Hahaha...
Thank you for your help, my friend!
If you're worried, come back tomorrow to check on him.
I'm ashamed I didn't notice anything off in the garden as a Herb Society member...
The Moonelia Sprout crisis is finally over, but a new situation has arisen in the herb nursery.
According to eyewitnesses, it was something like <001>"Carrot Meeting"</>...?
Too bad I'm stuck cleaning up the scene and can't check it out myself.
Mature radishes suddenly sprouted from the ground, possibly influenced by Moonelia Sprout. Even Ms. Perilla was perplexed.
Great! Now the crises of Moonelia Sprout and Radish King are both solved.
On behalf of the Herb Society, I extend our sincerest gratitude!
You're always welcome to visit Herb Garden and exchange with us Herb Society members.
How did Gan Sui end up like this...
And that underground cave... I really didn't expect it...
I'm sorry... I can't remember anything.
But what's the point... they'll just forget again.
Go back... go back... report to... who?
Legs... not hurting... can... jump... Why... jump...?
No pain... no pain at all!
It seems Radish King is still waiting for something...
Perhaps you should find the little radishes first?
But it seems you need the approval of these little radishes to tame Radish King.
I see. It seems Radish King acknowledges your feat in defeating the Moonelia Sprout and is willing to share its power with you.
Gather the <001>six little radishes</> scattered throughout the garden together.
Fantastic! Now all the little radishes are accounted for.
The little radishes shouldn't have gone too far. Look around Radish King.
The little radishes shouldn't have gone too far. Look around Radish King.
Halt! This is the Herb Society treatment area. Unauthorized personnel must stay away!
What are you waiting for? Get them!
A healing chamber? Sounds like Dr Bian's old lab.
A healing chamber? Sounds like Dr Bian's old lab.
Tsk, you were eavesdropping on us? What did you hear...?
Oh, it seems a mouse has sneaked in.
I happen to be short of a few specimens.
Addictive... Nice, a steady stream of money...
Dr Bian's old research site is so close to the Herb Garden.
Don't you worry they'll see you here?
It's your fault for being too curious!
At least for now, I can feel like a normal person... alive...
Unfortunately... it's only temporary. It'll get worse later...
It itches... It itches!! From the bones...! Hurry... Give it to me...!
You promised... no more... pain... why... why...
That woman... she lied to us...
Who would've thought there'd be such a deep cave?... This mist seems odd.
Who would've thought there'd be such a deep cave?... This mist seems odd.
This mist is making me feel so relaxed.
This mist is making me feel so relaxed.
Hiding in plain sight? Sounds like something shady's going on.
Hiding in plain sight? Sounds like something shady's going on.
What secrets lie hidden in Dr Bian's old cave?
What secrets lie hidden in Dr Bian's old cave?
A patient? This doesn't sound like ordinary treatment.
A patient? This doesn't sound like ordinary treatment.
Thousands of shards in his body... Could it be...
Thousands of shards in his body... Could it be...
Nora? The person she saved is... Gan Sui.
Nora? The person she saved is... Gan Sui.
Could it be... Gan Sui did all this for...
Could it be... Gan Sui did all this for...
Someone is replicating Dr Bian's research?
Someone is replicating Dr Bian's research?
They seem out of their minds, with vacant stares...
They seem out of their minds, with vacant stares...
I'm getting a bit carried away.
I'm getting a bit carried away.
Those Rebels didn't defend or evade attacks.
Those Rebels didn't defend or evade attacks.
Numbed, as if incapable of feeling pain...
Numbed, as if incapable of feeling pain...
Master, this is the Radish King that appeared this morning.
These radishes, once spirited plants in the Herb Garden, lost their vitality after being parasitized by the underground roots of the Moonelia Sprout.
Now the roots are cleared, and vitality is restored. This must be why Radish King appeared.
So, what should we do with it?
Only the one who tied the knot can untie it. It appears now only to meet the one who helped sever the Moonelia Sprout.
In for a penny, in for a pound. I'll take care of the Radish King too.
In for a penny, in for a pound. I'll take care of the Radish King too.
Might as well finish what I started; I'll take care of the Radish King matter too.
zh_text: 一不做二不休，莱菔王的事也由我来解决吧。
source_text: 一不做二不休，莱菔王的事也由我来解决吧。
official_target_text: Might as well finish what I started; I'll take care of the Radish King matter too.
official_en_text: Might as well finish what I started; I'll take care of the Radish King matter too.

text: I was so close... so close to saving her... saving everyone from pain...
She would never drink a potion brewed at the cost of others' lives.
She would never drink a potion brewed at the cost of others' lives.
Silence, it's excruciating... You don't understand... *cough* *cough*...
She saved you by chance while seeking medicine from Dr Bian. Years later, you used repaying her kindness as an excuse to start your experiments...
She saved you by chance while seeking medicine from Dr Bian. Years later, you used repaying her kindness as an excuse to start your experiments...
She made her choice long ago.
She made her choice long ago.
What specialties can be found here?
It's paired with Harvest Sauce, crafted with spices unique to Jixia.
And Harvest Brew brewed with Green Veil Lake water.
Sounds good, but the name could use some work.
Finally, a whole day to play here!
Young shoots resistant to cold, grains ground into flour, what crop is it?
Correct! You earn a Harvest Pancake!
I heard they're having a ball here during the Harvest Festival.
The thought alone makes me want to dance!
I'll take you there next time, how's that?
Hey there, what are you doing?
Oh, hi! We're planning a ball.
Feel free to join us if you're interested.
This is the plow crafted by the Craft Society for us villagers.
These will make our work much easier.
Now I can do in one day what took me five days before.
It'd be great if these things could move on their own. Would save us a lot of effort.
Excuse me, I wanted to ask...
Didn't realize preparing for a ball would be this much work...
It took us two whole days just to gather the materials for the stage.
But it's so rewarding! And all the prep work has really boosted my stamina.
Sit here and enjoy the show.
Mr. Lu, how's the new tea?
Hmm... Nice, very nice. It's refreshing with a rich aroma. Much better than the previous years.
Yes, probably because of the great harvest this year, the tea is especially fragrant.
If only every year could be a harvest year. Then we could enjoy this sweet tea every year.
You seem happy today, humming as you walk.
Of course, business is booming this year. I'm overjoyed.
Yes, things have been improving. Everyone's got more energy in their work.
Thinking of how things were before... it's fair to say Harvest Fields have been reborn.
Come take a look! We've got veggies, fruits, grains, and more! You won't regret it!
Don't miss out! Our dishes are famous in Chang'an, and everyone who's tried them loves them!
I can feel the Harvest Festival vibe already.
Join the students of Jixia in celebrating the harvest and wishing for blessings in the coming year. What a lively scene!
I love Harvest Festival. Just being around so many people makes me happy.
I've only practiced a few days, and my grilled meat already rivals some masters.
The Harvest Festival is coming. I'll show everyone what I can do.
Let everyone taste my Harvest Feast.
Ah, with the help of the Gourmet Society, the barbecue definitely smells even more enticing.
Thanks, but the real credit goes to your excellent pickling.
No amount of spices can replicate this flavor.
Of course. It's my family's secret recipe.
I get it, but it smells so good. Can't I have just one bite?
I'm still perfecting the final product. You'll get to try it at the celebration.
Let me think if there's anything else to improve in Harvest Fields.
Harvest Fields has a history even older than Jixia. As village chief, I'll see our name spoken across the entire continent!
If you're in danger, just shout my name. Got it?
You're in my territory and don't know who I am?
I'm Miaomiao, the village chief of Harvest Fields and the future star of Jixia.
I see. I think I know what the problem is.
Can you fix it? I tried the whole day yesterday and failed.
No worries, leave it to me. There's no farm tool I can't fix.
Besides, your issue is minor. I guarantee I can fix you in no time.
Oh, bless you, kind soul! Thank you so much...
My price is already the lowest in Harvest Fields.
But other shops aren't this pricey...
Check out my quality, is it the same as others?
If you think other shops are cheaper, go buy from them. I don't haggle over prices.
Fine. Sigh... just help me pack it up, please.
Four eggs for one radish, just like we agreed.
That should be four normal eggs for one normal radish, right?
Your radish looks wilted. I can only offer two eggs.
Two seems too little. Half... three sounds about right.
Three... that's a bit pricey. Let me think about it...
Three... still a bit expensive. Hmm, let me calculate first...
zh_text: 三个……还是有点贵。嗯，让我先算一算……
source_text: 三个……还是有点贵。嗯，让我先算一算……
official_target_text: Three... still a bit expensive. Hmm, let me calculate first...
official_en_text: Three... still a bit expensive. Hmm, let me calculate first...

text: Watch your mouth or I'll make you regret it.
Everyone worked hard to prepare for the Harvest Festival.
Try sneaking food and I'll beat you!
Fine, I won't eat it, I'll just... take a look.
I heard Senior Xiao Qiao once performed a fan dance here.
A story? It's more than that! People back then surrounded this place.
They say Xiao Qiao accidentally blew a merchant's shelves away.
Strong enough to blow shelves away... That must be a really big fan, much larger than what I use.
Why you always focus on these things...
These decorations make it feel like a festival.
By the way, I haven't had a chance to take a good look at the Harvest Bell. Do you want to...
The Harvest Bell is at the mountaintop. I'm busy now, so you should go check it yourself.
Harvest Fields is bustling now, but it was just a village a century ago.
When the thunder stopped, the folks in Harvest Fields saw all their crops had withered.
Kids detected strange odors, but adults dismissed it. The next day, everyone who drank it fell ill.
Everyone wondered if someone had poisoned the village. But why? The village was self-sufficient and had no known enemies.
A Jixia disciple came and said he caught a biting fish outside the village.
That's remarkable. Go seek advice from those students on the mountain who tinker with strange things all day.
Until a member of the Seeker Society suddenly pointed at the sky and said, "There seems to be something in these dark clouds." What could it be?
I'll tell you once you finish your homework.
One day, dark clouds suddenly filled the sky, and thunder roared incessantly.
A dance of swords in all directions!
Relax a bit. Don't look so fierce during the performance.
Got it. I'm still a bit nervous, though.
You're not quite there yet. Let's practice together.
A sword dance that moves the world!
official_target_text: A sword dance that moves the world!
official_en_text: A sword dance that moves the world!

text: Big fish on the hook? Did we get it?
It took the bait... but you scared it off...
Yeah, it's more than enough for a whole year.
Green Veil Lake is truly a treasure trove.
I heard there's been a bountiful catch this time.
Why did this thing have to break down now...
I'll go check it out myself. Can't let it stay broken like this.
I heard Lao Gao's farm tools broke yesterday too. He said he was going to Harvest Square to find someone to repair them. I wonder if he's back yet...
The Harvest Festival must be quite lively.
Croaky, when will my child come back...
Chopping peppers with magic isn't easy either...
Ouch... even my spells are spicy now...
Grain for Aerux Town is packed.
The posthouse staff from Misthill should be here any moment.
Studying Mechcrafts. All the usable ones are in the field. Only this broken one is left for me to tinker with.
You found me? Haha... People in Jixia are still as vigilant as ever.
I am a Jixia student, just haven't been back for a few years.
I just came back to learn more techniques. I didn't steal this.
I'm learning agricultural techniques and Mechcraft designs to develop agriculture back in my hometown.
Meanwhile, countless people in Alsahraa are struggling to get enough food.
Shh, don't tell anyone. I'll leave once I learn the skills.
Could Harvest Festival traditions be turned into business opportunities?
The new species developed by the Herbalist students are actually this impressive.
Our output has increased several times at once...
I'll have to report this to the academy.
Where's the part about Jihu Barley?
Pollination Compendium, Jixia Plant Encyclopedia... none of these are it.
Didn't someone try to improve Jihu Barley before?
Essentials of Pollination, "Jixia Plant Encyclopedia"... none of these, not this one either.
zh_text: 《授粉辑要》、《稷下植物小百科》……都不是，这篇也没有。
source_text: 《授粉辑要》、《稷下植物小百科》……都不是，这篇也没有。
official_target_text: Essentials of Pollination, "Jixia Plant Encyclopedia"... none of these, not this one either.
official_en_text: Essentials of Pollination, "Jixia Plant Encyclopedia"... none of these, not this one either.

text: Are you really willing to return to Harvest Fields to farm?
These test subjects are growing so fast.
Really? Maybe they're touched by my care.
Dude, calm down... We're using the same amount of water and the same brewing time every time. There are no other variables.
Well, the Naughty Civet is the only variable here.
Hey, you might be right. The Naughty Civets could be the key. I'll make a note of it!
Theoretically, this shouldn't happen. Where's the problem?
Do you understand it? Help me think about it.
Is a restart the only option?
I'm troubled because I don't even know where to start.
According to the report, seed selection, seedling quality, weed control... all checked out fine. But in reality, there could be issues.
It's like I'm trying to patch a piece of clothing but can't find the tear.
Well... so many thoughts, where do I begin?
Why is the yield so much lower than expected? Could we be missing something?
Could there have been a problem with the initial plan? Or perhaps something went wrong during the breeding phase...
Hmm, when storing it, it seemed to... Let me think...
I wanna help with the harvest! I'm strong!
Sure thing, I'll get you registered.
Hmm... the history of Harvest Fields...
Stop bringing those up. Just tell me what to do when I can't find a job.
With your inventions, who needs me? People say your Mechcrafts work better than humans.
Innovation is a must. Efficiency represents progress.
Calm down. I'll make you a Mechanoid so you can run like one.
How about I treat you to a meal at Harvest Shack as an apology?
Welcome to Harvest Fields! Are you here to help with the harvest? Please wait a moment, we're still registering...
I just wanted to take a look.
I just wanted to take a look.
Sorry, we've had a lot of students helping out and visiting today. Take your time, there are plenty of other activities to enjoy in Harvest Fields.
I also sell materials for crafting Weapons. Let me see what you have.
This climb is endless... No wonder I haven't seen a soul.
Ring the Bell... Is this the way up to the Harvest Bell?
Why do I have to go so far just to see the Harvest Bell...
Come to think of it, the villagers are always coming and going, but only Uncle Yun seems to have never left.
Never wondered what the outside world holds?
The old generation's way of thinking is different from ours.
Are you curious about Uncle Yun's story too?
I have a feeling Uncle Yun has more pressing concerns.
Everyone knows he's the former village chief's descendant.
But he didn't become the village chief. He just stayed here, guarding the Harvest Bell.
I heard he's been obsessed with painting since he was young, even gave up learning farming for it.
My parents said he was looked down upon because he wasn't good at farming. But he seemed not to mind.
Next time, we should ask Uncle Yun about his latest paintings.
I saw an altar by the roadside, seemingly with a wheat shape on top. Do you know what it is?
Not really. I think Uncle Yun said they were for praying for a good harvest.
Now we have Mechcraft farming tools and Aerflow, bountiful harvests are guaranteed.
Farming is in my hands, not in wishes.
This fish is the largest on record.
We can't finish all this fish in a hurry...
Let's dry it in the sun later.
Are you here to buy angling bait?
The place may look messy, but the goods are all top quality.
Harvest Fields aren't just good for crops—the fish here are extremely fat and tasty.
Look at this pomfret. Where else but Harvest Fields could you catch one this big?
It's quite a hassle. Removing the guts alone will take a good couple of hours.
Weather's important too. If it rains too much, the fish will probably go bad.
Thank goodness the sun's been blazing these past few days. Otherwise, I'd have a real headache handling this fish.
Gotta go and keep track of the catch. Bye!
Did you deliver the fish for me?
I placed it on the cart at the entrance.
I placed it on the cart at the entrance.
That's a relief. Now where is that Craft Society member...
Thanks for helping me out. I'll make sure to praise you to the academy!
Haha, time to slack off again.
Well... I did feel something was off when it started moving.
Something's definitely off. The cart flipped halfway through the fish delivery. What a shame.
I've called a Craft Society member to help fix it. This basket needs to be sent back to the warehouse later. What bad luck!
The warehouse is just ahead—place the fish on the cart by the door. Thanks!
The long-silent Harvest Bell tolls again.
It's a relief to know the younger generation is carrying on the tradition.
If you ever get weary on your travels, you're welcome to come back and rest here anytime.
The altar has been dim for years, and now it's finally shining again...
Complete Stabilization Ritual. Find four Runestones to subdue the monster and place them at the corners of Harvest Bell.

They are located in the <001>Aerdense Flower Valley</> in the west, <001>Fishing King's Residence</> underwater in the central area, <001>Craft Society Warehouse</> in the north, and <001>Herb Garden</> in the southwest.
Young one, after completing the four prayers, do you still have doubts?
Why did the storm suddenly disappear back then?
Before you, a girl named Ji also tried to investigate. But she got stuck trying to find out why the thunderstorm disappeared and didn't make progress.
Eventually, she was brought back to the Academy by Master Fuzi of Jixia for staying too long in Dreamweave Plains.
Back when Aerflow went haywire, Harvest Fields were shrouded in deafening thunder. Water was undrinkable, fish vanished, and crops withered.
But the thunder suddenly stopped. No one knows how, as if it was sucked away.
What do we do after praying?
During the Aerflow anomaly, the Black Cloud Monster tore through the clouds with its massive fangs, revealing its gruesome face. It was eventually suppressed by a joint effort of all Societies.
Now these Runestones are scattered in the hands of various Societies across Dreamweave Plains.
Your energy reminds me of myself in my youth!
The Prayer Ritual began as a commemoration of our ancestors who quelled the supernatural events, and later evolved into a local tradition in Harvest Fields.
I've marked the locations in this journal. Check it out if you get lost.
You need to pray at four locations across the Dreamweave Plains.
Wishing for a year of peace and harmony...
Did you know? This statue can light up! As long as you have Harvest Pancake.
Grandma said people ate Harvest Pancakes and got strength to fight monsters!
That monster's scary. Thunder always comes when it appears...
What kind of monster are you talking about?
What kind of monster are you talking about?
It's the Black Cloud Monster! A monster with two big fangs, riding around on black clouds.
Fewer visitors means more time for cleaning.
When can my sister Myar come visit again?
I've learned some new moves and want to show her.
If I make a wish here, will my sister come back?
Please, please, let me see sis Mayene again...
Thank you for lighting up this statue!
Diligence in livelihood, "New wheat and new wine," "Abundance every year," "Food is the heaven of the people," these four, not a single one can be missing.
zh_text: “民生在勤”“新麦新醯”“年年有余”“以食为天”，这四个，一个都不能少。
