text: Did the main axle of this Mechcraft really break before?
They say no parts were replaced, so how come there's no sign of repair? Incredible.
Senior Sun Bin's maintenance techniques are so sophisticated, I don't even know where to start...
Great harvest this year, so good.
Feeling like I have endless strength.
A bountiful harvest gives me energy.
Feel free to browse. If you see something you like, why not give it a try?
I craft my ironwares hammer by hammer. They are strong and durable.
Though I usually fix farming tools, my skills in forging knives are just as sharp.
Just look at the edge. Not only is it extremely sharp, but it also doesn't chip when cutting through stone.
Hey, the crops have been growing well these years, all thanks to the farming tools invented by the Craft Society.
I'm no Mechcraft expert, but I can do some basic repairs.
So this harvest is partly thanks to me!
Wah, where did this troublemaking tanuki come from?
Only one last slope left, do you want to take a break first?
Of course we have to strike while the iron is hot! It will be even more inconvenient to transport goods if it starts raining or thundering later.
Now that you mention it, I recall hearing that the lightning storm caused by the Black Cloud Monster destroyed all the crops in an instant... Classmate Mayene, watch out ahead!
Hic! Uncle Ban, why are you only just arriving? I've figured it out—the steamer and the lightning storm that vanished all those years ago...
It has nothing to do with it! Hey, I asked you to try brewing, why are you drinking it yourself?
Uncle Ban... *hic!* You have to try this.
Sigh... Drink up. Once you're passed out, it'll be easier to send you back.
Quick, quick, quick! I think I've hooked a huge fish! Aunt Song, help me!
Don't be so impatient! It's just a small fish, look at how happy you are! Back then, the fish monsters mutated by the thunderstorm were at least ten times bigger than this!
Oh no, my fish got away!
Get up, get up, my old back can't take this!
How much longer? My arms are getting tired.
Almost there, just hold on a bit longer.
Harvest Fields is so lively. That student's recommendation was spot on!
I should've brought more paper. There's so much more to record.
Wow! Look at that fish up there! I never noticed it before. Quick, draw it!
Let's go with Aerwell Restaurant. Great suggestion. Why didn't I think of that?
Okay! That classmate really seems extraordinary!
Wow! Didn't expect a Jixia student to have such skills, so cool!
The Harvest Festival is getting more exciting every year.
Wow, this sword dance is so cool!
Tsk, what's the point of acting cool?
The fire performance sounds exciting. I think it'll be a hit.
The fire performance sounds exciting. I think it'll be a hit.
A sword dance sounds elegant. I'll go with that.
A sword dance sounds elegant. I'll go with that.
Ugh, I finally got a chance to visit Harvest Fields and record my findings, but this foolish junior only brought one piece of paper.
Decided! Fire it is! A record of me and Harvest Fields!
I'll document my experiences and encounters in Harvest Fields.
Oh, I remember the one you're talking about! Hmm... now that I think about it, I haven't seen it anywhere else.
Thanks for the tip. We can't miss this. Let's go!
It's so frustrating. It feels like I've wasted my time.
Do you still want to document Harvest Fields?
Do you still want to document Harvest Fields?
I should take some notes before I leave.
It's my first time seeing such a big pot. It really stands for Harvest Fields.
It's my first time seeing such a big pot. It really stands for Harvest Fields.
How about I recommend a place that showcases the specialties of Harvest Fields?
How about I recommend a place that showcases the specialties of Harvest Fields?
I recommend the big pot at the village entrance. What's it called again... Aerwell Pot?
I recommend the big pot at the village entrance. What's it called again... Aerwell Pot?
What?! You only brought one set of paper?
I'm so sorry... I was too careless and forgot to check the paper.
It's so hard for me to come to Harvest Fields, and you're telling me I can only record one place?
So what do you think of my new dish?
Wow! That's great! Thanks for the feedback. I'll promote it now.
Looks like it's not ready for promotion yet.
I'll have to think about it...
It's specially prepared for the Harvest Festival.
Candied fruit, get your candied fruit here!
Have you tried our Harvest Pancake?
Is there anything else you'd like to know?
The Harvest Pancake is a staple on every table in Harvest Fields.
It may look simple, but it's one of the highest creations of our Gourmet Society!
The aroma of Jihu Barley... It was so delicious!
The Harvest Festival is the most important event of the year in Harvest Fields.
To celebrate the harvest and pray for good weather in the coming year, we hold the biggest feast of the year at the village entrance.
We welcome guests from all places. We drink and sing together.
Wow, is this dessert made just for me?
Hey! That was a gift from my friend!
Why would you take something from a kid like me... That was something a lady made just for me.
What's wrong? You look puffed up.
A strange person took my food...
Haha, there's someone with a bigger appetite than you. How about I buy you some tang hulu instead?
I'd rather have the new desserts...
Hello there! Are you here to help out too?
A new dish I designed for Harvest Fields. I want to give people strength even when they're working.
I'd like you to try them and give me some feedback. If they're good, I'll promote them!
I'm still working on new recipes. No tastings for now.
So many pottery raw materials come in every day, but I don't see much being shipped out.
Another order from Navenia. We need to speed up.
Can't wait to get my bonus and splurge at Com-fluence.
This one looks like you, Croaky. Do you like it?
You have to like it. Buy two and I'll give you a discount! Say it, you like it!
I waited in line for three days to get this. Selling it at double the price is fair, I'd say.
Sell it to me, please. I came all this way just for the latest plush. I'll pay any price!
It's a dirty business practice that tarnishes the reputation of Jixia students.
She's willing to sell, I'm willing to buy. It's none of your business.
If we allow this, fans will struggle to buy their favorite plushies at fair prices.
Hmph, no more sales? What a bummer. I'll just keep this one for myself.
Who's buying all these hero models at Com-fluence? I've never seen them in stock!
Not just you! I was also puzzled. I lined up early in the morning on the day the new models were released.
I was the fifth in line. When it was my turn, the employee just said, "Sold out, please come back another day"!
What? Fifth in line and still no figurine? Are there only four?
I guess there must be special channels for it. It's not something you can find easily.
Did you ask the people in line how they got it?
No, I didn't know there was anything fishy going on. I'll ask next time I'm there and let you know.
Next time, just take me with you. I'll get the story straight from the source.
Pottery Workshop offers a wide variety of ceramics, from jars and vases to clay figures.
Behind me is the largest pottery workshop in Aerux Town.
As for why it's called Tao Yun, it's because our workshop has the most unique craftsmanship, giving rise to Northton Pottery.
Well, it's not easy to embed Aersilk into pottery so smoothly.
Without great skill and technique, how could it stand out in Northton and be a unique existence?
These boxes are heavy. Did I buy too much?
It's not that much! The more you buy, the better the deal!
It's easy for you to say. Why don't you buy it then?
I sure did. They're all on their way to me as we speak.
I was too excited about the purchase, sorry.
The new glaze has excellent color rendition, high purity, and high luster.
I'll create some new designs to impress her.
Maybe I'll get to paint pottery and earn more!
Why don't you both come in and have some tea?
I don't have much to say to him.
Fine! Don't talk then, see if I care.
It's rare to come see the competition together, so don't fall out over a little thing, okay?
Are you kidding me? He's not with my team, that's not a small matter!
Haha, this is the power of friendship.
Here, I ordered you a Dream Trial Energy Drink endorsed by Senior Shye.
Heard it can improve scores in the Enlightenment Trials.
Of course! Would Senior Shye just endorse anything?
She must have tried it herself. And I do feel more energized after drinking it!
Wow! I'll have three more then!
Aerux Town is surrounded by beautiful mountains and waters.
I prefer the Dream Trial Elixir.
Endorsed by Shye, it's practically a specialty of Aerux Town.
It definitely worked. Can you come back tomorrow? I'd like to try another drink.
Sure. After tomorrow's meeting at the guild, we can come back here.
Why are your pots so much pricier than others?
Our pots are embedded with special Aersilk.
The glaze and hardness are far superior to common pottery.
I see. I'll think about it.
Is this where the photo event is held?
That's right! Take a photo with Shye's cutout, and you'll receive discounts and gifts!
This one's so cute. Shall we get it for her?
If I buy five, I wonder if there'll be extra gifts?
Which reward should I go for?
So exquisite! So detailed! I want it—
It's so pricey. Can't they have a sale? How can I convince myself to buy it at full price?
Eh... I'll just do it myself.
Wow! Bubble Fish looks so cute with a pillow!
I want the Aerux statue of the Tower of Enlightenment too!
Let's hurry back to the academy.
This glaze isn't rich enough, I don't think it'll work...
So many pottery pieces need glazing.
Look at me! I can carry so many pots at once.
I can finish two days' work in just ten trips.
But how many days does it take to remake a new one if one gets broken?
Oh, then how many days will it take to replace the ones my sister broke?
Welcome... aren't you the new member of the Team of Stars?
Your captain Novar is a regular here. Did he send you?
Rising Star, when can we discuss licensing?
It's great, especially during grand events.
We gather information through the Secrets Club and prepare goods for the celebrities attending.
Our products are all designed by senior designers from the Academy.
They ensure that every detail is accurately and truthfully restored.
Take care, Com-fluence will keep an eye on you.
Future star, thought about how you'd like a model based on yourself to pose?
Which hero do you like? We have many exclusives in the store.
The eternal king of Linglong Canyon!
Why is there no accompaniment? I shall wield my spear and conquer the world with a laugh!
Why is there no accompaniment? I'll laugh and accept the vast mountains and rivers with my spear in hand!
You must be the new member of the Team of Stars.
I always get the latest scoop. So, are you interested in Navenia?
My home is far away in the west.
I crossed vast oceans, climbed towering mountains, traversed scorching deserts, and journeyed through dense forests.
Navenia is completely different from here in every way.
I can't tell you everything, even if we talked for days.
Goodbye! Good luck with your quest!
Maybe you can break Marco Polo's record.
Our shop is a favorite among Jixia students. Ever since Marco Polo set the record, countless students have come to challenge it.
Why open a shop in Jixia?
I'm Anthony, owner of this shooting range.
How's the design different from Jixia's? It's Navenia style.
Our shop is a favorite among Jixia students. Ever since Marco Polo set the record, countless students have come to challenge it.
In the words of Marco Polo, "The world is a book, and those who do not travel read only one page."
Antony wishes you luck on your quest.
Do you want to challenge Mark Polo's shooting record?
Can't they get more hands at the Trading Post?
She's always dragging her feet with such a long line.
What a hassle! I'll file a complaint with the president if this continues!
Senior, could you sell me those three materials?
No worries, you can have mine. I'll just buy another one elsewhere.
Wow, such a large amethyst, that's rare!
Navenian goods are so luxurious. I'd love to join a merchant caravan someday.
There's been an issue with the Navenian merchant ship at the harbor. Would you like to check it out yourself?
The Enlightenment Trials present opportunities for both Navenia and Jixia. The game is just beginning.
Docking space is limited. Price hikes are to be expected.
Understood. Should we talk to the local guilds?
No need, I won't move unless the enemy does.
Who's gonna compensate for the time wasted in this ridiculously slow queue?
How about a discount for a first-time partner?
Escorting deliveries, moving goods, daily patrols...
Why is it all manual labor? Can't I get a desk job?
The sun is scorching. I don't want to get roasted.
Finally, I'm back. This time, following the caravan to Chang'an, I saw quite a few interesting things.
I'll have to report this properly later.
I need to report to them properly in a bit.
zh_text: 一会儿得好好跟他们汇报。
source_text: 一会儿得好好跟他们汇报。
official_target_text: I need to report to them properly in a bit.
official_en_text: I need to report to them properly in a bit.

text: It seems a bit pricey. Shall we look around some more?
But I really want to buy something. How about we pick just one?
The rewards are better than expected. We should take more jobs from the guild.
Great! I knew the Northton Trade Union was reliable!
You should stay here. It's tough to keep wandering around.
Alright, I'll stay here for now.
Great! Come, let's go get some food.
I've been dreaming of Come-true Restaurant's Dreamlike Spirit Steak for ages.
I heard many Mechcraft structures were damaged.
Exactly, that's why all the Mechcraft Timber has been shipped to Chang'an, and I can't get any stock.
Excellent. I'll add four more crates of Aersilk to the shipment to Navenia.
Don't worry, we still have some in stock. But demand always surges before the Enlightenment Trials. We must restock before the next competition.
How about more Aersilk? Storing it with other perishables can help preserve the flavor.
Anytime. By the way, still have space on my tea ship to Navenia, any goods you want to load?
Have you heard about the recent changes in Sikong?
Definitely, definitely. By the way, my tea ship to Haidu still has empty cargo space. Is there anything else worth bringing in?
zh_text: 一定一定。对了，我去海都的茶船仍空余舱位，还有什么值得进的货物吗？
source_text: 一定一定。对了，我去海都的茶船仍空余舱位，还有什么值得进的货物吗？
official_target_text: Definitely, definitely. By the way, my tea ship to Haidu still has empty cargo space. Is there anything else worth bringing in?
official_en_text: Definitely, definitely. By the way, my tea ship to Haidu still has empty cargo space. Is there anything else worth bringing in?

text: The supply of Mechcraft Wood has been tight lately.
I still have enough Mechcraft Timber in stock to handle this.
Then I'll add four more crates.
The more inventory, the better to handle supply shortages.
Aersilk can slow the loss of flavor in fresh food.
Aersilk can be cross-sold with other fresh products...
The people at the Trading Post are too stubborn to bend the rules.
Running a stall is just a cover; gathering and selling information is where the real money lies.
When will my shipment be sent out? Could you please speed it up?
With so much cargo lately, it's taking time for merchant ships to get processed. We'll have to wait.
I've worked with you plenty of times. Can't you make an exception for me?
Please be patient, sir! As you can see, there's a long line...
I've got fresh produce to deliver. Every second counts!
Alright, I'll get yours delivered first. But next time, report it early, okay? We're doing our best here.
You've delayed the guild payment for half a year. I've extended it for you three times.
If I hadn't found you today, would you just keep ignoring me?
Be patient for a few more days! I just got a new batch of goods...
What goods? We heard you've been spending all your money playing cards with your friends.
That's right. If your friend hadn't used the money you made from playing cards with him to pay off the debt, who would have known what you've been up to?
You're selling me out? I messed up. Give me three days. I'll pay it off!
Fine, but don't even think about welching on this one!
Finished checking the Aersilk? Top quality, can triple in price at Navenia.
Hmm, this is good stuff. But the price... you'll have to lower it a bit. The shipping costs are quite high now.
Sir, you should talk to the guild about that. We...
Yeah, the volume is large, but our profit margin is low. You won't make that much.
We've also developed many new products tailored to the Enlightenment Trials. Navenia is very interested in them.
I was hoping we could discuss a long-term partnership, but since you're haggling over the price...
Sounds good. How about you two bundle them together? I'll take them all.
I'll leave the shipping details to you then.
Hmm, okay. But you have to guarantee these new products are all bestsellers. I'll need to inspect them again.
The Northton Trade Union connects Navenia and Chang'an, with extensive business scope.
Aerux Town seems livelier because of this.
With so many merchants passing through, word of it has spread far and wide. Of course, its reputation has also been greatly boosted by the Enlightenment Trials.
Speaking of the Enlightenment Trials, you promised to take me there.
If only I could meet Shye!
It's easy to see Shye. She lives in Aerux Town. You'll definitely see her.
So many people at the guild, so much work, but no pay raise. Ridiculous!
Quests never end. I'll report later. I need a break.
If I do well, could my sister's business partner with the guild too?
It would be even better if we could get an employee discount.
The Guild is packed with all kinds of people. I should patrol more instead of just standing guard.
When's my replacement coming? I'm getting sleepy...
One sentry is enough. Why have two?
He looks tired. Maybe I should take his shift.
I remember now, you're the newcomer from the Star Team.
zh_text: 想起来了，你是星之队的新人。
source_text: 想起来了，你是星之队的新人。
official_target_text: I remember now, you're the newcomer from the Star Team.
official_en_text: I remember now, you're the newcomer from the Star Team.

text: Would you like some practical furniture to decorate your home?
zh_text: 要来些实用的家具装点自己的居所吗？
source_text: 要来些实用的家具装点自己的居所吗？
official_target_text: Would you like some practical furniture to decorate your home?
official_en_text: Would you like some practical furniture to decorate your home?

text: Cloud root furniture, the pinnacle of pure wood, welcome to browse.
zh_text: 云根家具，纯木典范，欢迎选购。
source_text: 云根家具，纯木典范，欢迎选购。
official_target_text: Cloud root furniture, the pinnacle of pure wood, welcome to browse.
official_en_text: Cloud root furniture, the pinnacle of pure wood, welcome to browse.

text: My furniture is made by first using classic Jixia patterns provided by the Artisan Guild, then produced uniformly by the Craftsman Guild.
zh_text: 我的家具，是先由风物家提供稷下经典图样，再转由工巧家统一制作的。
source_text: 我的家具，是先由风物家提供稷下经典图样，再转由工巧家统一制作的。
official_target_text: My furniture is made by first using classic Jixia patterns provided by the Artisan Guild, then produced uniformly by the Craftsman Guild.
official_en_text: My furniture is made by first using classic Jixia patterns provided by the Artisan Guild, then produced uniformly by the Craftsman Guild.

text: Dreamer, have your dreams been peaceful lately?
I'll never forget what you've done for us. My sincerest thanks, Dreamer.
That means the Dreamslayer couldn't hunt you down in your dream. That's a relief.
I can feel the Dream Butterfly Weaver's obsession lifting as the Runestone is restored.
Had they not been so close, Dreamslayer's deception wouldn't have worked...
This tragedy has ended. Let's wait for the next dream.
The impact of the Dream Energy disorder still lingers, but most of the townspeople are safe now.
But those who spent time in the depths of Dreamwhisper Lake will need time to recover.
So I'll stay at the inn a while longer, helping those haunted by nightmares.
Goodbye, may your dreams shine with light.
I haven't slept well these days.
If you fall asleep, you'll be pulled into a nightmare. Then it's just an endless cycle of waking up and falling back to sleep again.
I hope Mr. Qing Ze can help me. As long as I can get some proper rest, I'm game for anything...
I regret drinking that Fine Dream Tea. Now I dream of monsters every night—it's driving me crazy!
Lately, nightmares kept me up. I figured I'd grab some sleep tea from Dreamish Teahouse.
Outside, I overheard customers talking about a new Fine Dream Tea in Northton.
They say it chases away nightmares and brings lovely dreams.
So I went over to ask him and bought a Fine Dream Tea from a merchant near the Aerux Wood Storehouse.
At first, I drank it every day. It worked! I dreamed of lying on fluffy clouds. So relaxing.
One day, I forgot to brew the tea before bed. That night, I had an even more terrifying dream—a ferocious monster.
Then I kept having nightmares about the monster for several nights in a row. Even the Fine Dream Tea didn't help, so I came to Mr. Qing Ze...
The Fine Dream Tea can amplify your heart's desires. Your deepest longings in beautiful dreams and your worst fears in nightmares will become much stronger.
It was Qing Ze who helped me in my dream. He guided me away from the monsters and relieved my nightmare.
At first, I brewed and drank it daily, and it was indeed effective. I would dream of lying on clouds like cotton; it was so comfortable.
zh_text: 一开始每日冲泡着喝，确实有效，会梦见自己躺在棉花一样的云上，可舒服了。
source_text: 一开始每日冲泡着喝，确实有效，会梦见自己躺在棉花一样的云上，可舒服了。
official_target_text: At first, I brewed and drank it daily, and it was indeed effective. I would dream of lying on clouds like cotton; it was so comfortable.
official_en_text: At first, I brewed and drank it daily, and it was indeed effective. I would dream of lying on clouds like cotton; it was so comfortable.

text: What do I do? I really need sleep...
Come on, haven't you had enough of being chased by monsters in your dreams?
Every time I close my eyes, I see that monster holding me down... I want to go home...
Stop whining and save your strength. I can barely speak...
Every time I close my eyes, I see that scene of being pounced on by the monster. It's just too traumatic. Wuwuwu, I want to go home...
zh_text: 一闭上眼就是被怪物扑倒的那一幕，简直是太折磨了，呜呜呜我想回家……
source_text: 一闭上眼就是被怪物扑倒的那一幕，简直是太折磨了，呜呜呜我想回家……
official_target_text: Every time I close my eyes, I see that scene of being pounced on by the monster. It's just too traumatic. Wuwuwu, I want to go home...
official_en_text: Every time I close my eyes, I see that scene of being pounced on by the monster. It's just too traumatic. Wuwuwu, I want to go home...

text: Fuzi, why all the sneaking around?
Fuzi, why all the sneaking around?
Just eavesdropping on their gossip. But honestly, it's rather bland.
Lucky you're here... Do me a favor, will you? Go join them and toss in a few juicy stories to liven things up.
Is it okay to spread gossip?
Oh, I enjoy it! All that chatter—it's full of life!
Humor me. With that sharp wit of yours, you'll be fine.
That's the spirit. I'm counting on you!
Stay on your toes and improvise!
You kids are naturals at this sort of thing—gossip, jokes. And I'm sure you've got plenty of material.
I thought keeping up with student gossip might help me connect with them better, but something this bland? It's not going to do me any good.
Speaking of Master Zhuangzi's hypnosis, I heard some School of Sorcery fellows have been having these vivid dreams where they wake up as completely different people.
And even after they wake up, some of them still believe they're the person from the dream...
That's been going around forever. I've got something fresh!
That's been going around forever. I've got something fresh!
Shye and River Sprites have a special connection.
Has anyone ever wondered how Shye always manages to find those hidden treasures no one else can?
Has anyone ever wondered how Shye always manages to find those hidden treasures no one else can?
Word is, she has a gift. She just clicks with the River Sprites, and they guide her straight to what she's looking for.
Word is, she has a gift. She just clicks with the River Sprites, and they guide her straight to what she's looking for.
No wonder Shye always comes back loaded!
Meng Ya has a well-loved plush.
A plush? Wait, did Sun Bin give it to him?
No... actually, his father gave it to him when he was little. Meng Ya can't fall asleep without it.
No... actually, his father gave it to him when he was little. Meng Ya can't fall asleep without it.
Everyone assumes the Mengs don't get along, but Meng Ya truly cares about his father. They're just both too proud to reach out first.
Everyone assumes the Mengs don't get along, but Meng Ya truly cares about his father. They're just both too proud to reach out first.
Don't underestimate an Intelligencer's network! I've got something sizzling!
Ever wonder why Master Fuzi's beard is always perfectly groomed?
He goes to an Herbalist every single week for the full treatment...
Why so quiet? Isn't this fun?
Shye and River Sprites have a special connection.
Alright, alright. I've got nowhere to be today. Let's really get into it.
I pulled it off pretty well, didn't I?
I pulled it off pretty well, didn't I?
Master Fuzi, please, tell us more!
Wenxiao, remember when you were studying at the School of Martial Arts? So quiet in class, you barely dared to breathe.
Look at you now. I guess I played a part in your growth.
Master Fuzi! That was ages ago...
I always enjoy Mayene's stories. I think that's what led me to join the Intelligence Society.
Hmm. When it comes to gossip, I won't be modest. Experience counts for everything. So, who do you want to hear about?
He has a serious procrastination issue.
The Three Sages Summit was delayed again and again because of him. In the end, I had to drag him out of his office myself.
Oh, I've always heard Master Mozi stays up at night developing his Mechcraft.
Oh, I've always heard Master Mozi stays up at night developing his Mechcraft.
Half his projects sit untouched until the last possible deadline... maybe that's just how he works.
Ha! The looks on your faces! Exactly what I imagined.
Haha. Blazen had quite the rebellious phase back in the day.
Instead of fireworks, he set off actual explosives and blew half the caves in Jixia to pieces.
Hard to picture Mr. Blazen like that...
Hard to picture Mr. Blazen like that...
Poor Tigon got caught in one of those blasts once. His hair was completely singed black, and he chased Blazen through three streets.
Looking back now... I do miss that reckless, hotheaded kid.
His Mechcraft is no lightweight. If I weren't in such good shape, I couldn't have managed it.
Fuzi, what are you doing here?
Fuzi, what are you doing here?
Shh... Come here, keep it down.
They say a student fell asleep in Master Zhuangzi's hypnosis class.
She woke up years later to a whole new class!
Oh, that's just Da Meng from the next door. She kept dozing off in class and had to repeat a few years.
But I heard students who slack off get thrown into Pearlized Lake to feed Bubble Fish!
Are you on Master Zhuangzi's payroll?
Bubble Fish is adorable! Master Zhuangzi let me pet it once.
I will never do Mechcraft assignments during Sorcery class again...
Their gossip isn't juicy at all.
Super. Alright, I'll throw in something even better.
Fu... Fuzi? What are you doing here?
I've been listening for quite a while now.
You heard it all? Uh-oh, gotta run...
Why? I love it. I want more.
Speaking of the arm-wrestling competition, Martial Arts students' favorite.
The final round of the second competition came down to Lian Po and Wuyan.
I had no idea they had that kind of history.
Lian Po won, but after the match Wuyan filed a complaint, arguing that Mechcraft gauntlets shouldn't be allowed.
I agreed. From then on the rules were changed: bare hands only.
Everyone knows Kongming and Zhou Yu were the fiercest rivals back in school.
Famous for their Sorcery duels and their Mechcraft creations. Actually, right from the very first week, in my own classroom, they had...
A battle of willpower. They sat through over twenty consecutive classes together, pulled all-nighters studying, and refused to let the other pull ahead.
In the end, they both collapsed during sparring practice and had to be rushed to an Herbalist.
I thought I'd done something wrong with my teaching. It weighed on me for a long time.
Those legends were so competitive? Hard to imagine.
Well, they had just enrolled back then. That kind of passion is the privilege of youth, haha.
As you know, I visit Herb Garden for beard treatments.
Guess who I run into there regularly?
Master Mozi doesn't have a beard.
Under all that Mechcraft, who knows!
It's Tigon. Caring for his hair takes hours.
Inside a suit of mecha, who knows!
zh_text: 一身机甲之中，谁知道呢！
source_text: 一身机甲之中，谁知道呢！
official_target_text: Inside a suit of mecha, who knows!
official_en_text: Inside a suit of mecha, who knows!

text: One person's strength is limited, after all.
zh_text: 一个人的力量毕竟是有限的。
source_text: 一个人的力量毕竟是有限的。
official_target_text: One person's strength is limited, after all.
official_en_text: One person's strength is limited, after all.

text: A palace maid crosses the night bridge with a lantern in hand.
Lights fade beneath your feet, children wait for cold food. Decline.
The frontier is in chaos. The ruler shall not return, nor shall he be replaced.
What do you want to hear?
It's a story I heard. You've never been to Chang'an, have you?
Bridges above, streets below. Streets under the bridges, and more bridges over the streets. That's Chang'an.
Towering structures conceal the sky, casting a shadow over the streets below, where the sun, moon, and stars are unknown.
Actually, it's not that great. I saw a Mechcraft that records music and plays it back.
Music without a player lacks emotion.
The sound of the guqin, the strength in the fingertips, my performance, all are crucial.
What machines convey can only be called sound.
Spring water flows in a stream, with a hint of smokiness.
Thirty-three weeks circling Chang'an, fleeting bubbles of light, layered pagodas.
Red cloaks line the street. At the end, the hero sets out.
I'm Le Nishang, a Musicologist from Chang'an's Peaceful Workshop.
Come by anytime for some tunes.
It's my voice, another way I express myself.
I carried it all the way from Chang'an. This place is truly peaceful.
Thirty-three weeks around Chang'an, floating lights and shadows, layered pavilions.
zh_text: 三十三周环长安，浮光泡影，套楼阁。
source_text: 三十三周环长安，浮光泡影，套楼阁。
official_target_text: Thirty-three weeks around Chang'an, floating lights and shadows, layered pavilions.
official_en_text: Thirty-three weeks around Chang'an, floating lights and shadows, layered pavilions.

text: Stressed? Let me play you a tune.
Do you miss the sounds of Yungen Town?
zh_text: 怀念云根镇的声音了吗？
source_text: 怀念云根镇的声音了吗？
official_target_text: Do you miss the sounds of Yungen Town?
official_en_text: Do you miss the sounds of Yungen Town?

text: Come and relieve stress with music!
Any favorite tunes? Want to give them a listen?
Do you miss the sounds of Yungen Town?
zh_text: 怀念云根镇的声音了吗？
source_text: 怀念云根镇的声音了吗？
official_target_text: Do you miss the sounds of Yungen Town?
official_en_text: Do you miss the sounds of Yungen Town?

text: Jixia's music has a long heritage; it carries the melody of history, and I will pass its sound on.
zh_text: 稷下音乐传承久远，它承载了历史的旋律，我会把它的声音传承下去。
source_text: 稷下音乐传承久远，它承载了历史的旋律，我会把它的声音传承下去。
official_target_text: Jixia's music has a long heritage; it carries the melody of history, and I will pass its sound on.
official_en_text: Jixia's music has a long heritage; it carries the melody of history, and I will pass its sound on.

text: I also have all kinds of unique musical instruments, as well as performance recordings from the famous Gongyu family.
zh_text: 我这还有各式特色乐器，以及知名宫羽家的演奏记录。
source_text: 我这还有各式特色乐器，以及知名宫羽家的演奏记录。
official_target_text: I also have all kinds of unique musical instruments, as well as performance recordings from the famous Gongyu family.
official_en_text: I also have all kinds of unique musical instruments, as well as performance recordings from the famous Gongyu family.

text: Take care, and don't forget the sounds of Yungen Town.
zh_text: 慢走，要记得我们云根镇的声音哦。
source_text: 慢走，要记得我们云根镇的声音哦。
official_target_text: Take care, and don't forget the sounds of Yungen Town.
official_en_text: Take care, and don't forget the sounds of Yungen Town.

text: Drumming for so long is exhausting. I need to give my shoulders a rest...
zh_text: 一直击鼓也太累了，我得让我的肩膀休息会……

official_target_text: Drumming for so long is exhausting. I need to give my shoulders a rest...
official_en_text: Drumming for so long is exhausting. I need to give my shoulders a rest...

text: Welcome to the Jixia Merchant Guild! We've got all the exciting Jixia products you may need!
The wide array of goods has been carefully selected, and the quality is trustworthy.
High quality and low price, lots of discounts!
When you get duplicate cards, you can <001>Dismantle</>them in the Panorama Box for Cirroflow Coins.

text: Hey, aren't you the new member of the Team of Stars?
What? Thinking of opening a shop in Northton?
Welcome. Are you considering opening a shop? Or do you have a complaint about a business?
To ensure fair business practices, we're not allowed to personally recommend any stalls.
But every merchant in Northton, especially in Aerux Town, has been selected over time for their top quality.
I suggest choosing a store based on your preferences and needs.
Any thoughts are welcome. Everyone's needs may vary, but when compiled, they form valuable insights.
Your intel is one reason why shops keep improving.
Northton Trade Union at your service!
Why hasn't Shye replied to me yet?
Welcome to the Northton Trade Union.
Miss Shye will always be the chief consultant of the Northton Trade Union!
Ahem, well, she hasn't said yes yet...
A business whiz like her? We'd be crazy not to.
Northton Trade Union is one of the largest in Jixia, leading in both scale and reputation.
But I've only just taken over, and the pressure is really getting to me...
If Miss Shye hadn't helped me with the deal with Navenia, I might have quit.
So when I asked her to be a consultant, I was totally sincere...
Northton's got everything you need for your adventures!
Hello, visitor. Do you want to make a complaint or open a shop?
You've joined the Team of Stars?
Quick, tell me, have you heard any rumors about ancient ruins?
I'll trade you my adventure stories for it.
Got any scoop to share with me?
Hmm... I was going to exchange information, but since you might have inside scoop, I'll share my experience with you.
Before I came to Jixia, I passed through Chang'an. After months with the spies there, I uncovered some of its secrets.
Did you know there are many mysterious places within Chang'an?
And I have a strange feeling that someone is always one step ahead of me, hiding something.
My explorer's instinct tells me I'm being watched.
I'm still trying to find out more information.
I found the Seekers' Society in Jixia has plenty of relevant information, and they're willing to share it with me.
Intelligence Society... that's what you call yourselves, right? I'm sure you're willing to exchange information with me. Like that lady from the Secrets Club to the north.
Thank you, and I wish you the same.
I'm Arter, from the distant Navenia. Pleased to meet you.
Navenia is a beautiful city built on the delta of a bay.
Unlike Jixia, we build houses out of stone.
We love long voyages, so our ships are really huge. The one I sailed on was much bigger than any I've seen in Jixia.
I'm an explorer, chasing the finest wonders of the world.
I've heard Jixia has a long history, so I'm here to take a look.
Hmm... I haven't found it yet.
But I believe when I see it, I'll know!
Goodbye. Take me along if you hear of any adventures!
So, whoever takes this pill will get super strength?
The formula for this medicine was passed to me personally by Senior Kongming.
Those two tall guys got their strength from my potions.
Guess I still have to rely on my own efforts.
So this is the power of pills?
Oh, so it was just acting.
What was I looking at for so long...?
What do we do? The Student Affairs Committee is coming for us.
Shh, keep up the act, maybe we'll get through this!
What's going on? The boss seems to be turning himself in.
Let's keep acting, pretend we're not involved.
The Invincibility Pill, its secret formula was personally taught to me by Senior Kongming. Taking this pill will fill you with strength, now just 288 Ringild per pill.
Really? Why am I skeptical about that?
Really? Why am I skeptical about that?
See those two strong men? They were weak before, thanks to my pills, they became Martial Arts students. Ask them if the pills worked.
You don't know a good thing when you see it. Go away, don't interrupt my business.
Suit yourself. I wish I had more.
A pill peddler is making a racket in my shop; how could business possibly be good?
zh_text: 一个卖药丸的在我的店里吵吵闹闹，生意怎么可能会好。
source_text: 一个卖药丸的在我的店里吵吵闹闹，生意怎么可能会好。
official_target_text: A pill peddler is making a racket in my shop; how could business possibly be good?
official_en_text: A pill peddler is making a racket in my shop; how could business possibly be good?

text: So this is what the Power Pill does.
I saw the formula of the pill.
Your fake medicine is selling well.
Your fake medicine is selling well.
Are you here to cause trouble?
So you found me. Speak up, what do you want?
Turn myself in? You don't know who I am.
Then I'll show you no mercy.
Do you know the power of public opinion?
I can spread the word about your fake herbs to the Intelligence Society. When the truth comes to light, it won't just be a matter of not selling fake herbs.
I can spread the word about your fake herbs to the Intelligence Society. When the truth comes to light, it won't just be a matter of not selling fake herbs.
Breaking news! Breaking news! This person is selling fake medicine!
Breaking news! Breaking news! This person is selling fake medicine!
My cannon is no worse than Meng Ya's.
My sorcery skills were taught by Shye!
Stop! Stop! Put away your cannon first. I'll surrender right away.
Shye! I messed up, I'll turn myself in, alright?
Do I really need to turn myself in...?
Mechcraft is so advanced that even stoves can start fires automatically.
Eighty is a great age to learn blacksmithing!
The latest pottery from Tao Yun's Workshop.
We've already sold half our goods before setting up.
Should we go back for more?
No time, we still need to get some plushies from Com-fluence.
Alright, we'll come better prepared next time.
Go on, collect some stars. A sight like this doesn't happen often.
A little. It'll probably last a few days.
You get some rest. I'm off to collect stars.
You get some rest. I'm off to collect stars.
I tried biting one just now. Wasn't friendly to my teeth.
You go collect the stars. I need to study this a bit more.
Truly Jixia's most magnificent celestial event.
You should collect a bunch of stars. A view like this won't last forever.
You joined the Team of Stars?
The road ahead is unclear. Let me help you prepare your weapons.
How's it going? Let me see what materials you've brought this time.
I've been obsessed with weapons since my time at the School of Martial Arts. While my classmates focused on techniques, I was captivated by the weapons.
I graduated through brute strength and returned to inherit this forge.
I'll focus on forging. You can handle the heroic deeds.
Aerux Town is a key transportation hub. Wandering merchants, students, and local merchants are all my customers.
Of course, teams from the academy also come here regularly for maintenance.
Your team members are my regulars. Novar comes to spar with me. Shye brings strange boxes she can't open.
I only opened the boxes for her, without asking what was inside. But... where did she find so many strange things?
Goodbye. Remember, keep your weapons in good condition.
Gang Tu from Aerux Town. Wanna see my handiwork?
Stand back. I don't want to hurt you.
As long as you provide the materials, my twenty years of experience will not let you down.
Most of my time is spent helping merchants solve problems with their transportation equipment.
I also help with advertising for the shops and fixing utensils for the townsfolk.
I offer weapon repair and maintenance services for students and martial artists.
Alright, I'll get back to work.
Look at my non-stop orders. My skills are unquestionable.
The Enlightenment Trials are dangerous. Let's get our weapons ready.
Come and witness the unmatched blacksmithing skills in Aerux Town!
A seafood hotpot, the one in front of me wins!
zh_text: 一顿海鲜锅，我面前这位赢！
source_text: 一顿海鲜锅，我面前这位赢！
official_target_text: A seafood hotpot, the one in front of me wins!
official_en_text: A seafood hotpot, the one in front of me wins!

text: Didn't expect to see a fire show.
The Northton Trade Union is really trying to attract wandering merchants.
Isn't that Nishang? What's she doing in Jixia?
This trip is a real bargain. Back in Chang'an, I wouldn't pay a cent for these tunes.
Is she that famous? She's been playing here for a while.
This is definitely going to sell.
Of course I do. A genius one, no less. The whole strategy centers on the Team of Stars.
Buy a drink for a chance to win. The Grand prize is a trip to Aerux Town with Team of Stars!
And the top prize? A championship guide, written by me! Hard to resist, right?
A lucky draw alone can get people excited, and the costs stay low!
A lucky draw alone can get people excited, and the costs stay low!
Obviously. This is what genius-level thinking looks like. I'm telling you...
Enlightenment Trials are different every year.
Enlightenment Trials are different every year.
No worries. What I've learned from that is absolutely worth passing on.
Hold on. Let's hear what Shye thinks about it.
Hold on. Let's hear what Shye thinks about it.
I'm not sure yet. Let's check on Shye's idea first.
I'm not sure yet. Let's check on Shye's idea first.
Objectively, it's not as good as mine.
Let the new member be the judge.
Let me see what you wrote...
Thanks to you, we made a fortune! Now our grand plan can finally take off!
What grand plan? Nobody told me anything.
What grand plan? Nobody told me anything.
If we make it to the finals of the next Enlightenment Trials, you'll know.
Looks like the shopkeeper likes our endorsement.
Of course. It took all three of us to come up with something this good.
We should grab a few drinks ourselves when it launches.
What if we win the grand prize: a trip with Team of Stars...
Then we should hang out together. It's been ages!
What if we win the prize to tour with the Star Team...
zh_text: 万一我们自己抽到了和星之队共游的奖品……
source_text: 万一我们自己抽到了和星之队共游的奖品……
official_target_text: What if we win the prize to tour with the Star Team...
official_en_text: What if we win the prize to tour with the Star Team...

text: Novar, Shye, what are you doing here? Are you having a private dinner?
Novar, Shye, what are you doing here? Are you having a private dinner?
Private dinner? We're here closing an endorsement deal for Team of Stars. This is serious business!
School of Mechcraft fellows got their hands full with some new invention, so it's just us two.
As captain and chief Trader, keeping the books balanced is on us.
Those group dinners don't pay for themselves, you know.
We're stuck. Completely different ideas, and neither of us can budge.
Since you're here, time to settle it.
Wait. Seeing you just sparked something. Let me jot it down. You two talk.
What if we partner with the beverage shop? Every purchase comes with my autograph. Sound good?
That wouldn't look good for Team of Stars.
We've prepared free gifts and a lucky draw!
Impressive. Didn't take Team of Stars for business minds.
You've been a great help. Please accept this small token of my appreciation.
Just waiting on one more teammate!
Now that you've heard both, what do you think?
Why not combine the two? Enlightenment Share gives customers a buy-four-get-one-free deal, plus a lucky draw with the championship guide as the top prize.
Why not combine the two? Enlightenment Share gives customers a buy-four-get-one-free deal, plus a lucky draw with the championship guide as the top prize.
Double the incentive, a solid sales boost, and still manageable on costs.
Double the incentive, a solid sales boost, and still manageable on costs.
Simple. Buy four, get one free.
Perfect for squads of five drinking together during Enlightenment Trials. Train hard, drink to together. How's that sound?
From one drink to five! That's brilliant!
From one drink to five! That's brilliant!
This is what careful planning can do!
Not bad! Fresh eyes do help!
Enlightenment Share? What does that mean?
Enlightenment Share? What does that mean?
Alright, let's go with that. Time to talk to the shop owner.
What sort of proposal would work best?
I'm onto something. No peeking until I'm done!
Go talk to Novar, he seems got it all figured out.
Thanks to you, I haven't had any more nightmares.
Those obsessions have also been let go. It's time to look forward again.
I heard the Chang'an Envoys are coming, so I'm getting ready to greet them.
Thank you for your concern. If you need help, come find me anytime.
Good, I see determination in your eyes.
You'll definitely win the Enlightenment Trials.
That's right. You're improving, and I can't fall behind.
As an envoy, I need to learn more about Jixia.
What do you think of war?
It's better if you don't know.
I don't know what your goals are, but a situation where only one of two can exist is not worth aspiring to.
You'll win for sure, I believe in you.
You joined the Star Team? So much has happened lately, are you all okay?
Although I'd also like to know about the ruins...
But it's really good to see you safe.
If you have any inside scoop... you can share it with me first.
Hmm... Since you're still so interested, I can tell you about an experience I had before.
Before I came to Jixia, I passed through Chang'an. After months with the spies there, I uncovered some of its secrets.
Did you know there are many strange and mysterious places inside Chang'an City?
And I have a strange feeling that someone is always one step ahead of me, hiding something.
As an explorer, I know that the feeling of being watched isn't just paranoia—there are spies...
Many of my information channels are currently cut off...
A naturalist who specializes in studying ruins, now searching for historical clues to overcome the current difficulties.
The Zongheng scholars, who were once happy to share, are now busy solving various internal and external troubles for Jixia. Maybe I have to rely on myself.
Thank you, and I wish you the same.
You must be the new member of the Team of Stars.
I always get the latest scoop. So, are you interested in Navenia?
Maybe you can break Marco Polo's record.
My home is far away in the west.
I crossed vast oceans, climbed towering mountains, traversed scorching deserts, and journeyed through dense forests.
Haidu is completely different from here, yet perhaps there are some similarities... Maybe the fact that people are 'resilient and unyielding' is a common ground.
Jixia students used to come to my shop to challenge Marco Polo's record. It's been so quiet lately that I'm not used to it. When will it be lively again...
Welcome... aren't you the new member of the Team of Stars?
Your captain, Novar, used to come here often! Are you here to bring him something?
What a pity, we were talking about discussing licensing...
In the past, whenever there was a grand event, we would scout through the Secret News Agency to prepare merchandise for various celebrities.
This year... I'm afraid everything I prepared will go to waste. This business is only kept alive by pure passion.
We have always hired senior academy designers at high prices to ensure rigorous field research and authentic details in the final products.
I originally wanted to ask your Star Team to be our spokespeople, but who knew such a big incident would happen! Let's reconsider this later...
Take care. Baihui Workshop will continue to keep an eye on you.
Are you Senior Xishi's new teammate? Come have a drink and rest, it's on me.
What would you like to drink?
Senior Shye mentioned when she came for drinks that a freshman had great potential. That must be you, right?
My drink stall's business only took off because the senior endorsed it.
But now, I might have to temporarily take the related drinks off the menu... I hope Senior Xishi is safe...
This is confidential, but I guarantee it's made of delicious and nutritious ingredients, beneficial for everyone's tired body and mind.
I may just be a stall owner, but I'm studying both herbalism and culinary arts... I hope to put what I've learned to good use.
Goodbye. If you want to nourish your spirit, come by for a drink often!
Books always say "seeing an object reminds one of the person." Holding this drink today, I think I'm starting to understand...
I heard this is the last batch of drinks endorsed by Senior Shye. We might not be able to drink them in the future.
Can't get a drink? How is that possible?
I heard the boss decided not to make any more until Senior Shye returns.
They said drinking this would make you as amazing as Senior Sister Shye, but now she's gone too...
Pfft, pfft, pfft! What do you mean gone? They're just missing!
Yes, yes, yes, I hope Senior Xishi appears soon. She's so strong, she'll be fine.
Here, I ordered you a Dream Trial Energy Drink endorsed by Senior Shye.
I heard that because Senior Shye is missing, this drink is being taken off the shelves!
Sigh, you shouldn't have brought that up. Now I can't even finish my drink...
This was supposed to be a drink filled with Senior Xishi's blessings...
I felt much more energized after drinking it... Hey, you said if we drink it, maybe we can bless her too?
Then I won't drink it, I'll keep it as a memento. I hope the senior is doing well...
Looking at Yungen Town from here, though the mountains and waters remain, the people and things have changed...
This Dream-Performance Kung Fu tea actually tastes pretty good. A small comfort, I suppose.
This was endorsed by Xishi. It was originally a specialty of Yungen Town and can replenish energy. But I heard it's being discontinued.
Hmm? Let's come back tomorrow then. We should have a few more drinks before the owner really takes it off the menu.
Alright, I'll go to the Chamber of Commerce tomorrow to follow up on the orders delayed by this incident, then we can come back here and sit for a while.
Thanks to Shye, the newly repaired house is ready to move into. I can finally rest easy.
I must invite her to visit my new home to thank her properly.
Sigh, I wonder when she'll be back to see the letter I left...
It's a bit embarrassing to say, but the house I was staying in was knocked down by a group of crazed monsters.
The elderly and children at home were also quite frightened and all fell ill at once.
It's a pity that all my savings weren't enough to repair the house, so Xishi helped me find a temporary place to stay.
She even paid for someone to fix my house, solving my most urgent problem! How could someone so kind suddenly go missing...
Yeah, the day I received help, I swore that I would be more diligent in the future.
I don't want to experience such an embarrassing situation a second time...
Come to think of it, the thing I'm most grateful to Xishi for is that she didn't scold me in front of the children back then.
Such a thoughtful, kind girl... I haven't even had the chance to thank her properly, how could she...
Farewell. Sigh, where did Shye go...
I remember now, you're the newcomer from the Star Team.
Would you like some practical furniture to decorate your home?
Cloud root furniture, the pinnacle of pure wood, welcome to browse.
My furniture is made by first using classic Jixia patterns provided by the Artisan Guild, then produced uniformly by the Craftsman Guild.
I strive to maintain the traditional Jixia style, insisting on using cloud-root materials to pass on the philosophy of harmony between man and nature.
In the past, I never turned anyone away, but now, almost no one comes...
What's more worrying is that the supply of cloud root materials is almost cut off, and I don't know how to deliver the orders that have already been placed.
Merchants from Chang'an, Haidu, and Yunzhong keep coming to urge me... I truly hope everyone can weather this storm.
Spring water flows, wine cups drift, a gentle intoxication.
Thirty-three circuits around Chang'an, drifting light, shadows of pavilions.
Red cloaks sweep the long street, full of heroism; white-haired hero, where to return...
How should I continue writing these new lyrics...
I'm Le Nishang, a Musicologist from Chang'an's Peaceful Workshop.
If you also enjoy music, feel free to come and listen often.
This instrument resonates with my heart; by plucking the strings and singing, I can express my true feelings.
I had heard that Jixia was peaceful, so I traveled all the way from Chang'an, but I never expected to witness such changes...
Have you heard? Someone is organizing everyone to go back to the academy to find the teachers?
I've heard. But I think this matter requires further deliberation.
The situation on this road is unclear. Going forward rashly always makes one feel uneasy...
If we don't return to the academy, what will happen to our studies?
Will the Academy take measures once order is restored?
But when will order ever be restored...
People are going missing everywhere. Isn't there any good news?
The good news is that order is being restored at the academy, but they haven't officially recalled students yet, so we're essentially on an extended break.
Oh my, you really know how to think in reverse. I'm so sick of it.
The more chaotic things are, the more you need to stay calm. This period might just be the perfect time to settle down and think about the future.
How could this be? The match was interrupted, the teachers are unreachable, and my friends are missing in the accident.
Stay sharp. The students participating in this competition are all top-tier, everything will be fine.
I hope so. Everything is a mess right now; let's just try to stay calm.
I hope the missing people return safely.
Hey, hey, don't lose heart. If we work together and ask around, we'll eventually get news about the teachers and students.
I really wonder how they are doing now. I hope they don't run into any danger...
You're right, it's safer for us to act together.
I'm good at puzzles, and you're strong. Let's protect each other and hold out for now.
Don't always keep your nerves so tight; it's not worth it to ruin your health.
Look at what the newspaper says. It seems many teachers and students have gone missing.
Extra! Extra! Latest news on the missing persons. Any interested students, come and take a look.
The situation is chaotic now, students should be careful and stay safe.
It's safest to have someone strong go deep into the scene to scout it out.
But doesn't that mean someone might have to be sacrificed? That's too dangerous.
In my opinion, it's better to find more people, let everyone play to their strengths, and brainstorm together.
Hmm, one person's strength is limited. Only by organizing can we have a better chance of finding the missing teachers and students.
We were supposed to go to the Chamber of Commerce to discuss business, but they're too busy dealing with complaints and disputes. What should we do?
I choose not to think about it for now. I want to sleep a little longer.
What's going on with you? Didn't everyone go back to their rooms to rest early last night?
Is it possible... that this sudden turn of events is what's causing my insomnia...
You must be the new member of the Team of Stars.
You've been busy lately, haven't you? Come have a meal at my Dream-Fulfilling Eatery; it might just bring you some good luck.
Welcome to Come-true Restaurant! What would you like to eat?
People have to eat, so my eatery is still managing to stay open.
Plus, my shop's name has a good ring to it, so in these times, passing merchants and students are all willing to come by for some good luck.
Can it really make dreams come true?
Haha, what do you think, guest? While it's said that "man proposes, God disposes," it's hard not to feel discouraged, hesitant, or lose one's appetite when facing difficulties.
Coming to my Dream Eater restaurant is just an excuse to cheer myself up.
Eat a good meal and take care of yourself. Your health is your most important asset.
Goodbye, wishing you peace and safety.
Shangguan Wan'er from Chang'an entrusted me to buy this batch of cloud-silk paper. Now what am I supposed to give her...
If I explain the situation about what happened here in detail, she should understand.
But now the roads are blocked and the cloudships are grounded, so how are we supposed to get in touch?
Chang'an is well-informed. With something like this happening in Jixia, they should know soon... For now, we can only wait...
The Northton Trade Union connects Navenia and Chang'an, with extensive business scope.
Aerux Town seemed to be quite lively because of this at one point, but now, I hear it's not what it used to be.
Who would have thought that such a major incident would occur during a grand event like the Guixu Dream Performance...
Oh, right, speaking of the Guixu Dream Performance, I heard Xishi went missing during it?
If I had gone to see it back then, I might have actually met Xishi!
Shye lived in Yungen Town. If she returned safely, perhaps we could still see her...
You joined the Team of Stars?
The road ahead is uncertain. Let me, Gangtu, help you prepare your weapons.
Everything okay lately? Let me see what materials you've brought this time.
I've been obsessed with weapons since my time at the School of Martial Arts. While my classmates focused on techniques, I was captivated by the weapons.
I graduated through brute strength and returned to inherit this forge.
I'll focus on forging. You can handle the heroic deeds.
This Cloud-Root Town is a major thoroughfare. Merchants, scholars, and locals—they're all my customers.
The various teams from the Ruins Dream Performance often come here to gear up. With all the turmoil lately, more people need weapons.
Novar often comes here to practice swordplay, and that girl, Shye, lives nearby and is always bringing me strange, locked boxes.
I'm only responsible for opening the boxes for her; I never ask what's inside. But they haven't been here in a while, and I actually miss them.
Goodbye. Remember, keep your weapons in good condition.
Mom, I want to see those glowing flowers again. Can you turn into one for me?
That's a flower created by Sorcery Technique. Mom can't do that, only Shye can.
Flower as in 'Hua-Hua'? Why does Sister Shye know, but Mom doesn't?
Because Shye is a great Sorcerer. If you like, you can go learn it too.
Hmm... I don't want to study, I just want Sister Shye to play with me... When is she coming back?
This... Sister Xishi is very busy, Youyou needs to be sensible. If you're a good girl, maybe Sister Xishi will come back...
Good, I see determination in your eyes.
Jixia is in chaos, with so much to handle... but with your drive, you will surely overcome these difficulties.
That's right. You're improving, and I can't fall behind.
As an envoy, I need to learn more about Jixia.
What do you think of war?
Perhaps in the past, I would have thought that matters of war were not for outsiders to hear, but now...
In a Jixia like this, I have only one thing to say: war is a situation where only one of two can survive, and it is not worth yearning for.
Who would have thought that our everyday lives would end so suddenly...
Without Cloud Silk, many instruments may become one-of-a-kind... If you can't bear to let them be forgotten, you can buy them as a keepsake.
Do you miss the sounds of Yungen Town?
Jixia's music has a long heritage; it carries the melody of history, and I will pass its sound on.
I also have all kinds of unique musical instruments, as well as performance recordings from the famous Gongyu family.
There are many merchants in Baihui Square, and now it's blocked by all kinds of disputes. My little shop has actually found some peace.
For those in the know, I have no shortage of priceless treasures here.
Discerning customers often sweep up all the stock.
Le Nishang has bought a lot of famous Jixia music from me recently. Perhaps she wants to remember the sounds of Jixia...
Take care, and don't forget the sounds of Yungen Town.
Are you... the new member of the Star Team?
Business is slow today, but at least we have a distinguished guest.
Welcome, honored guest. Are you looking to open a shop, or do you have a complaint about a merchant?
To ensure fair business practices, we're not allowed to personally recommend any stalls.
But here in Jiebei, especially every shop in Cloud Root Town, they are all quality establishments that have stood the test of time.
With this sudden turn of events, business must adapt accordingly. I suggest you wait and see, and think it over carefully.
Any feedback is welcome. Business can't be a one-way street; listening to opinions helps it grow.
Although complaints have increased lately, perhaps it's a good sign? We will continue to help everyone mediate issues and get through these difficult times.
Northton Trade Union at your service!
Are you that little hero from the Star Team?
I heard you encountered significant danger this time. You're still just children, yet you have to bear such a heavy burden...
Especially you... you give me the feeling that there's more to you than meets the eye.
Times are turbulent right now, so you must protect yourself. With the Three Sages gone, all the Jixia students have had to grow up overnight...
Isn't it just two young men, one young child, one girl next door, and an additional silent gourd?
Those two were always disturbing other guests.
But... after I taught them a lesson a few times, they've behaved.
Business was quite good during the Enlightenment Trials...
Everyone is worried these days, so I'm just letting things take their course. In business, ups and downs are inevitable.
My acquaintances at the Secret Society are all busy rebuilding order at the academy.
I only heard that there seemed to have been a great battle...
Hmm? How come I heard a masked expert came and stole it?
Steal? How could anyone steal such a huge cloud silkworm? Whoever did this is truly hateful!
Did you get an answer? What exactly happened at the academy?
What are we cloud-silk artisans supposed to do now?
Some stick to their craft and endure, while others adapt and change trades just to get by.
Sigh... I know what you mean, trying to get me to change careers. But I want to wait a little longer.
Wait, you'll have stock soon? Better focus on feeding your own family first.
I don't know what happened at the academy, but we've suddenly run out of cloud silk raw materials...
Wouldn't it be wonderful to enjoy delicious hot food while overlooking the beautiful scenery of Yungen Town?
zh_text: 一边纵览云根镇美景一边享用热腾腾美食，岂不快哉？
source_text: 一边纵览云根镇美景一边享用热腾腾美食，岂不快哉？
official_target_text: Wouldn't it be wonderful to enjoy delicious hot food while overlooking the beautiful scenery of Yungen Town?

text: Aren't you Shye's new partner? Here, have a drink.
What would you like to drink?
Haha, she mentioned it when she came for a drink. She said there was a promising new student, and it must be you.
Now you're part of the Team of Stars. Get along well with Shye!
Without her help, my drink stand wouldn't be doing so well.
That's a trade secret, but I promise they're all delicious and nutritious ingredients.
I'm a stall owner with a Herb Society background and self-taught Gourmet Society skills!
Goodbye, come for a drink when you're weary in body or spirit!
Hey, new student. Tired from all that walking around?
How about a refreshing Dream Trial Energy Boost?
This drink was recommended by Shye!
Enlightenment Tea, even Shye is a fan!
Shye lives nearby and often visits me.
At first, I couldn't shout well, and business was poor.
She thought such a great drink shouldn't go unnoticed. She helped promote it and brought in lots of business.
Her sunny disposition inspired me, and I learned how to attract customers.
Now that I've made money, I naturally asked her to be my ambassador.
I wanted to join the Herb Society, but I failed the entrance exam every time.
No one dared to try my potions, so I had to test them myself. Surprisingly, they tasted good.
Shye encouraged me, saying I must have a real talent for potion effects and flavor.
So I gave up on that dream and started selling an improved version of the formula.
How about a drink before you go?
Shye said you have great potential, so keep it up!
Still far from the school. Have a drink to replenish energy!
Business is booming, and the restaurant's ingredients are in short supply. Should we suggest the boss order two more crates?
We still have some in stock. I'll buy more when it's all used up. I want to take a few days off...
Hurry up, I'm planning to watch the Team of Stars' match.
No one will help you with the heavy lifting then.
Wait! Then I'll talk to the owner when I'm having dinner, so he can stock up early.
Come take a look! Specialties of Northton, we have them all!
Special offer! First come, first served!
You must be the new member of the Team of Stars.
Going on a quest? Fill up at Come-true Restaurant for a smooth journey.
Welcome to Come-true Restaurant! What would you like to eat?
Come-true Restaurant has always been bustling, though it can't match the Aerux Inn across the way.
Wandering merchants come and go, and disciples like to stop by for a blessing. Many wishes come true, and people come to give thanks.
Can it really make dreams come true?
Haha, what do you think? We all know the importance of taking action, but sometimes fear holds us back.
Come-true Restaurant is just a name. We want to help everyone cast aside their doubts.
After all, you get nothing by doing nothing, right?
Goodbye, and good luck with your mission.
Are you going to study at Jixia Academy?
We've got a long road ahead. Time for some food.
Welcome to Come-true Restaurant! What would you like to eat?
People say you eat what you have around you. Our Seafood Pot ingredients come from nearby mountains and Horizon Harbor to the east of Jixia.
If you're new to Jixia, come warm yourself by the pot.
It's a good name, right? With all these new students coming to eat, you've probably sensed something.
When new students arrive at Horizon Harbor, they're filled with dreams.
But when they reached Aerux Town, some of the new students got intimidated by their peers' talents and started to back out.
The Come-true Restaurant is named to inspire these new students.
You only live once. Dreams are within reach. Give it your all!
Goodbye, and good luck with your studies.
Before heading out on a quest, make sure to eat a full meal first!
Hey there, wanna try our signature dish?
Hey, aren't you that future great hero?
And you give me a sense of... hidden power.
Just don't cause trouble. Or even the Three Sages won't be able to help you.
Isn't it just two young men, one young child, one girl next door, and an additional silent gourd?
Those two were always disturbing other guests.
But... after I taught them a lesson a few times, they've behaved.
Best of luck with your business.
Thanks to the Enlightenment Trials, our business is booming.
More students and merchants are staying here.
Would you like to stay at Aerux Inn? I'm Yongxi, the owner.
We pride ourselves on making guests feel at home.
As innkeepers, we must treat our guests well. Kindness brings wealth, you know.
Here you'll find Aerux Town's best chef, coziest rooms, and finest views.
My rule is simple: don't make me look at you funny.
So, you better not do anything out of line.
Oh, the big shot's here. Someone, get over here and welcome him.
Look who's here, another extraordinary new student.
Hehe, I'm the first to get Senior Zhou Yu's latest poster!
I got to the store late, and they were all snapped up.
Wow! One bite and I'm energized again—and I just climbed two mountains!
I don't feel any stronger, but I don't feel as tired as before...
Physical fitness comes from daily training, not just drinks!
Oh... I have been slacking off on training lately.
By the way, someone said that after drinking it, they felt energized all day, and then slept poorly for several nights.
Then I've probably had too much. I should slow down... Wait, how many have I had again?
I've heard so much about it. Finally I get to try it today.
Shye is our ambassador, and reviews are good, but...
All this hype... Seems kinda sketchy.
They claim it'll make you as good as Shye. Try it and see.
Or... why don't you try it first? If you think it's good, I'll have some too.
Oh my, aren't you a scaredy-goat!
Mom, I want to see those glowing flowers again. Can you turn into one for me?
That's a flower created by Sorcery Technique. Mom can't do that, only Shye can.
Flora's flower? I don't get it. Why can Shye have it while mommy can't...
Because Shye is a great Sorcerer. If you like, you can go learn it too.
But I don't wanna study. I just want Shye to come back and play with me...
Be good, Yooyoo. Shye has a lot to do.
You get what you pay for. I'll tell you a secret: even Miss Shangguan Wan'er can't get enough of the cloud-patterned paper.
zh_text: 一分钱，一分货嘛。我悄悄告诉你，就连上官婉儿小姐也对云纹纸爱不释手呢。
source_text: 一分钱，一分货嘛。我悄悄告诉你，就连上官婉儿小姐也对云纹纸爱不释手呢。
official_target_text: You get what you pay for. I'll tell you a secret: even Miss Shangguan Wan'er can't get enough of the cloud-patterned paper.
official_en_text: You get what you pay for. I'll tell you a secret: even Miss Shangguan Wan'er can't get enough of the cloud-patterned paper.

text: When I grow up, I'm going to the School of Mechcrafts!
Designing big, sturdy, and cool Mechwings, and flying with Sun Bin.
That way, no matter how high you fly, Sun Bin wouldn't worry.
Maybe I could even make mechanical legs and play with Sun Bin!
It's a bit embarrassing to say, but the house I was staying in was knocked down by a group of crazed monsters.
zh_text: 说起来怪不好意思的，原本我住的那屋子，被一群发狂的怪物推倒了。
source_text: 说起来怪不好意思的，原本我住的那屋子，被一群发狂的怪物推倒了。
official_target_text: It's a bit embarrassing to say, but the house I was staying in was knocked down by a group of crazed monsters.
official_en_text: It's a bit embarrassing to say, but the house I was staying in was knocked down by a group of crazed monsters.

text: The elderly and children at home were also quite frightened and all fell ill at once.

source_text: 家里的老人孩子也受到了不小的惊吓，一股脑病倒了。
official_target_text: The elderly and children at home were also quite frightened and all fell ill at once.

text: It's been so long. I think it's really discontinued.
I set an alarm to grab the same alarm clock as Master Zhuangzi... but it didn't go off!
Isn't that also a kind of... missing in the Dreamscape?
Anyway, let's find a place to get this alarm clock.
Good point! I'll buy it now since I don't know when it'll be available again.
Surprisingly, there's a hidden space under the warehouse. How can I explain this to the boss?
A merchant from Frostcloud Town arranged to buy supplies from me.
It's way past the promised time. Did something happen on the way here?
Yes, it's been several days. I keep hearing sounds coming from underground.
It doesn't sound like a rat... Could it be a thief? That's scary!
Those who hired me were very secretive.
People often guard the chest at the highest point, as if it holds a secret.
But that's none of my business. As long as I get paid, I'm good.
They should be at the teahouse now. They'll be back soon.
Hey, it's you! Would you like to try some refreshing tea?
What about the sleep tea from before?
What about the sleep tea from before?
No more nightmares. No need for the tea.
But that made them sleepy, so we introduced the refreshing tea.
Our recipes are open for all to see, and our prices are fair for everyone. Remember, when it comes to tea, Dreamish Teahouse is your best choice!
I heard you solved the nightmare incident. Impressive!
Later, the academy sent someone to investigate their hideout and reclaimed all the stuff that could be a serious threat.
Some lingering effects will take time to clear, but as long as you don't touch it intentionally, you'll be fine.
On behalf of the teahouse and our customer, thank you. You're always welcome to tea here.
It's said the formula for Fine Dream Tea was created by a master who studied forbidden dream techniques...
He conducted experiments in the secret vault of the abandoned mine and created many things that could induce fine dreams.
So he's the reason people in Northton have nightmares.
No wonder it's forbidden. If he succeeds, no one could sleep again!
Finally got a good night's sleep. I'm ready to tackle the day!
Must be because of the fish I bought. If you want to thank me, treat me to dinner!
Just be careful. Make sure what you bought doesn't end up like that "Fine Dream Tea"...
Feel free to rest and enjoy some tea here. No soliciting, please!
I'm here to ask about something...
I'm here to ask about something...
Could you do me a favor?
Lately I've been busy with the tea garden and haven't been sleeping well.
I need you to get a cup of <001>stimulating</> tea from the teahouse owner.
It's a special tea found only in Jixia. Made with water from Dreamish Spring and steamed in Aerux tea sets.
My sister and I used to play there and find lots of interesting sigils.
The elders said those marks are connected to something at the bottom of Iridescent Stream.
Head west, you'll reach Aerux Town. My sister runs a branch there. Do drop by!
Feel free to visit whenever you have time. Goodbye.
The Iridescent Basin in the north is where Jixia Academy holds the Enlightenment Trials.
Welcome! Would you like to try our Aerux Essence Tea?
I still have to finish the report when I get back.
zh_text: 一会儿回去还得把报告写完。
source_text: 一会儿回去还得把报告写完。
official_target_text: I still have to finish the report when I get back.
