text: Are you here to challenge rock climbing?
Reach the finish line within the time limit, and you'll receive generous rewards sponsored by the academy!
Great, take this Vertical Rush Token. Once you're out, turn right, and our guide will show you the way at the starting point.
Don't forget to grab the gift behind me. Everyone gets one! Help spread the word!
Reach the finish line within the time limit, and you'll receive generous rewards sponsored by the academy!
Come on, let's go rock climbing!
Just ask Hu Xue, the guide at the entrance.
Test your speed in vertical racing!
Welcome to the climbing competition. I'm your guide, Chong Feng.
If you're confident in your skills, go to the cave ahead and sign up with our Senior Yingzhao.
If you're confident in your skills, go to the cave ahead and sign up with our Senior Yingzhao.
Are you ready for the climbing challenge?
Now I'll activate the pedal mechcraft on the right. Then you can start.
Reach the finish line and give the Vertical Rush Token to the guarding student, then you can exchange for rewards.
Remember, there's a time limit. If you can't finish within a minute, you'll have to start over from the beginning.
Haha, you sound confident. Good luck then!
Excellent! Hand me the tokens, and you can claim your reward!
Senior Ying Zhao watched your entire challenge through his Big-eye Owlet, and he's quite impressed by your strength.
Everything that happened was my fault. I'm sorry for the trouble you went through.
After Qing Peng returned, he was like a different person. He suddenly started working hard.
I'm proud of how far he's come. But part of me wonders if I did enough to look out for him in the past.
Thank you for your help. If you need anything in the future, don't hesitate to reach out.
Next time something fun comes up, call me!
I'll work hard when I get back and won't cause you any trouble.
I'm still pretty confident. I'll make Qing Peng see me in a new light.
How did Qing Peng sneak out again?
I have a junior named Qing Peng, very enthusiastic and a lover of nature—perhaps... a bit too much.
He left the library with a Croaky to study the northern region. It's close to Oneirland, a dangerous place.
I don't usually reveal this information to just anyone, but since we're fated, just buy whichever one catches your eye.
zh_text: 一般人我都不透露这个消息的，见你我有缘，看上哪件就买了吧。
source_text: 一般人我都不透露这个消息的，见你我有缘，看上哪件就买了吧。
official_target_text: I don't usually reveal this information to just anyone, but since we're fated, just buy whichever one catches your eye.
official_en_text: I don't usually reveal this information to just anyone, but since we're fated, just buy whichever one catches your eye.

text: Qing Peng said he'd be out in a jiffy. How long has it been?
These Seekers are all the same—can't keep their word.
Just now, Qing Peng insisted on rushing in. I didn't catch what he was muttering, just said he'd be out soon.
They've been in there for ages. What's in the cave?
Qing Peng slipped away from the <001>upper cave entrance</>, likely heading to the <001>Northern Dark Woods Bear Den</>.
Once I'm rested, I need to check on Bai Yan at <001>Dreamstone Woods</>.
When talking to Huangfu Cai again.
Bai Yan sent me to find Qing Peng. As expected, he was in the cave.
The moment Qing Peng touched the Dream Energy Stone, the monsters in the cave rushed over like mad.
That guy sneaked off alone from <001>the upper cave entrance</>. Was his former righteous demeanor all just an act?
He seems to have gone to the <001>Northern Dark Woods Bear Den</>. I heard there's Dream Energy Stone there too.
Once I'm feeling better, I need to check on Bai Yan at <001>Dreamstone Woods</>. She's all alone there, and anything could happen.
Thank you so much! You're a lifesaver!
Ahem, if it weren't for Senior Bai Yan, I wouldn't be here!
To think I was worried about Qing Peng for so long, he doesn't even appreciate it.
He's never been like this before. It's like he's a different person today...
Thanks for your help! I'm Bai Yan, and this is my junior Qing Peng and his Croaky, Cheng Cheng.
One of my juniors has been causing worries lately. Cheng said Qing Peng has been having nightmares, and he keeps talking about saving people and destruction.
Qing Peng also mentioned going to <001>Aerux Horn</> to find more Dream Energy Stones, but a bear monster appeared, and he disappeared.
Qing Peng would never abandon Chang Chang. He must be in greater danger. I have to find him.
I'll take care of Chang Chang. I'll take it to <001>Dreamstone Woods</> to find Qing Peng. Don't worry!
Chenn Chenn! Why are you here? Where's Qing Peng?
It's okay, take your time. You're safe now, Chengcheng.
Hello, I'm Bai Yan. Have you seen someone named Qing Peng? He's my junior, and we've lost contact for quite some time.
I can only try my luck here based on his logs. His good friend, Huangfu Cai, is also looking for him at <001>the Aerux Horn in the southwest</>.
We've always been close, and he wouldn't leave without a word. Even Qing Peng's Croaky Chan Chan is missing. Something fishy is going on.
I'm searching <001>the Dark Woods Bear Den to the west</>. If you find any clues of Qing Peng, please let me know. Thanks!
Bai Yan dialogue when prerequisite is not met.
Look who's here. Cheng, this is the hero who saved you earlier.
No one here, they must have gone to <001>Southwest Aerux Horn</>, perhaps Huangfu Cai can intercept Qing Peng.
They're like two knives stuck in each other's ribs. Huangfu won't admit it, but he's more anxious than I am.
So you're the hero Huangfu Cai mentioned. Thank you for your assistance.
I'm Qing Peng's senior. He usually informs me before going anywhere. This is the first time he's gone missing without a word.
His Croaky, Cheng Cheng, is missing too. It's not a simple runaway. Next, I'll go to <001>the Dark Woods Bear Den to the west</>.
Could you keep an eye out for Qing Peng? I'm really in a bind here. Thanks!
Dialogue with Bai Yan when Huangfu Cai is nearby.
I hope Qing Peng is okay. Huangfu Cai went to <001>Southwest Aerux Horn</> to find him, but there's no news yet.
I'm heading to <001>the Bear Den in the west</>. If you find any clues of Qing Peng, please let me know! Thanks!
Short version for repeated dialogue with Bai Yan.
Where did Qing Peng go? Am I too late?
I wonder if he ran into Huangfu Cai...
Not here either. Where could Qing Peng be?
Strange, I feel some force calling me. Can you feel it too, Cheng?
This must be the Dream Energy Stone Qing Peng was looking for. Could it be causing the strange occurrences?
How am I supposed to explain to Master Fuzi...
Dream Energy Stone... This energy feels strange yet familiar...
Could Qing Peng's disappearance be related to the Dream Energy Stone?
That was terrifying. How did it come to this...
Thank goodness you're here. Thank you!
You're right. I was too reckless and put you in danger too.
I'll go back and apologize to her. I've made her worry for so long...
Oh, you're finally here. Hurry and help us out. After Qing Peng appeared, it completely ignored us and went straight for that Dream Energy Stone.
Bai Yan tried to stop him, but was knocked to the ground. Go check on him now!
Dialogue before fighting the monster (Huangfu Cai).
If it weren't for you, that monster would've torn me to shreds. Scares me just thinking about it. Thank you!
This Qing Peng, he made us worry for nothing. He even took away the cute Chang Chang, how could he!
As long as he and Cheng Cheng are safe, I won't make a fuss.
Have you lost your mind, Qing Peng? It's me, Acai!
Qing Peng! Don't touch that rock! It's dangerous! Come back here!
That Qing Peng is so unfair, he went off on an adventure without calling me.
He's been gone for a while. Maybe he's working on something big to impress me.
How could this be? This energy surge...
Dreamscape... where did it go... what is your purpose... with me here, it will soon succeed...
Qing Peng, stop! This Dream Energy Stone is dangerous!
Qing Peng, stop! This Dream Energy Stone is dangerous!
Qing Peng! What are you doing? Stop!
Qing Peng! What are you doing? Stop!
No! The Dream Energy is out of control!
Something scary's coming, I can feel it! Run!
Bai Yan is worried about you.
Bai Yan is worried about you.
Just a bit more time, and I'll have it unlocked.
Dream Energy has already affected the mushrooms and Wolvines. The sorcery circle here is more complex than before, and it may attract even more dangerous things.
Dream Energy has already affected the mushrooms and Wolvines. The sorcery circle here is more complex than before, and it may attract even more dangerous things.
It won't. What happened before was just a coincidence. Dream Energy is a gentle type of energy.
Qing Peng insists on activating the mysterious stone pillar.
Just as I thought. This stone pillar...
Did the Wolvines fight the Rebels to rescue their companion? Let's investigate.
Did the Wolvines fight the Rebels to rescue their companion? Let's investigate.
Strange, why are the Rebels and Wolvines fighting? And these Wolvines don't seem to have any intention of attacking me...
Strange, why are the Rebels and Wolvines fighting? And these Wolvines don't seem to have any intention of attacking me...
Odd, why are Rebels and Wolvines fighting? Besides, these Wolvines don't seem to want to attack me...
zh_text: 奇怪，破门生和地狼怎么打起来了？而且这些地狼并没有攻击我的意图……
source_text: 奇怪，破门生和地狼怎么打起来了？而且这些地狼并没有攻击我的意图……
official_target_text: Odd, why are Rebels and Wolvines fighting? Besides, these Wolvines don't seem to want to attack me...
official_en_text: Odd, why are Rebels and Wolvines fighting? Besides, these Wolvines don't seem to want to attack me...

text: Don't bite me... I didn't catch you...
I don't want to infuse Dream Energy into Wolvine, it's not my problem!
It was all Contraption Master's doing!
I originally just wanted to see what was at the end of this path, but I never expected to run into a Po Men Sheng and a pack of Earth Wolves.
But it seems they were fighting each other, which is how I managed to escape.
It's too dangerous here, we'd better leave quickly.
It's too dangerous here, we'd better leave quickly.
I ran too fast and got a stitch in my side. Let me rest for a moment.
I originally just wanted to see what was at the end of this path, but I never expected to run into a Po Men Sheng and a pack of Earth Wolves.

It's too dangerous here, we'd better leave quickly.
It's too dangerous here, we'd better leave quickly.
I ran too fast and got a stitch in my side. Let me rest for a moment.
Too late... The Wolvine in the cage is dead...
Too late... The Wolvine in the cage is dead...
Are these Wolvines mourning for their companion?
Are these Wolvines mourning for their companion?
I've found your friend. He'll be here soon.
I've found your friend. He'll be here soon.
Really! Then I hope he didn't run into any danger.
Ran into some Earth Wolves and Door-Breakers, but I'm out of danger now.
Ran into some Earth Wolves and Door-Breakers, but I'm out of danger now.
I've found your friend. He'll be here soon.
I've found your friend. He'll be here soon.

Ran into some Earth Wolves and Door-Breakers, but I'm out of danger now.
Ran into some Earth Wolves and Door-Breakers, but I'm out of danger now.
What if the Earth Wolves rush into the camp?
zh_text: 万一地狼冲进营地怎么办？
source_text: 万一地狼冲进营地怎么办？
official_target_text: What if the Earth Wolves rush into the camp?

text: No talent, no credentials—how did you get into Jixia?

text: Wow! I'll go check it out myself!
Such spectacles are not rare in Aerux Town.
No problem, I'll show you the way.
Cloudrest Bridge is the best. Natural, graceful, and absolutely gorgeous. It's a festival favorite.
No? Well, if you do, then stay and have a match with me before you go.
I've just learned archery, not sure how I'd fare. Wanna practice with me?
Don't worry. This is our first fight. I'll go easy on you.
I'll be here waiting. Come back whenever you're ready.
A barbecue stall here would be a hit!
Impressive, I didn't expect you to overcome my Bow of Erudit so easily.
Shh... Don't mention that lady. I'm not even worthy of being considered one of her students.
Bow of Erudit... who are you?
Bow of Erudit... who are you?
It's so embarrassing... I still have a long way to go.
Good. Next time, come practice with me.
Back to play with me again? Got any new tricks up your sleeve?
I'll tell you everything, just stop attacking me.
We work for Contraption Master, mostly active in Northton.
Master recently acquired a mysterious fragment and is studying it.
We three leaders each hold a portion of the Mechcraft key.
The key I'm responsible for is in this cell. I can remove the seal on the key for you.
Whether you can get the key or not is up to you.
But recently, things have been getting weirder... I'm done with this job.
Now that you've discovered our secret, you're not leaving!
Did you try the tea yourself? How was it?
I bought some, but then thought better of it.
So, what did you do to stop the nightmares?
Did you know there's a secret Sorcery technique that can harness Dream Energy to create dreams?
I tried to do the same, but nothing worked.
This could be a forbidden technique! I heard that a former student researched it and was expelled from the academy...
Sorry, we've run out of sleep tea. We're brewing a fresh batch now.
So you didn't sleep well... I envy you.
Everyone in town has been having nightmares lately, and we're all feeling sluggish during the day.
I really need a good sleep...
Do you know why it would do that?
I'm completely lost. Lack of sleep is really getting to me.
If you're looking for information, you should talk to our lady boss.
Big or small, all town matters eventually reach her ears.
Let me think... Some guys did come to our boss, trying to sell "Fine Dream Tea."
But the shopkeeper was wary of its unusual origins, so she hasn't agreed to the deal yet.
Some customers were talking about it, but I haven't seen anyone discussing it lately.
Just follow the road south from here, take a right at the first fork, and you'll see it.
Sorry, I mistook you for another salesperson.
Some salespeople were promoting Fine Dream Tea, claiming it helps you sleep and keeps nightmares away.
When I pressed them on where they got the tea, they got evasive. Add that to the timing of their appearance... it's all too suspicious.
I first spotted them hauling crates of tea bags out of an abandoned mine on the north bank of Autumn Creek.
I'm investigating the nightmares. These people are definitely suspicious. Seen where they hang out?
I'm investigating the nightmares. These people are definitely suspicious. Seen where they hang out?
I'm gathering information about Northton, specifically the Aerux Wood Storehouse, Waterfall View Pavilion, and Hunting Camp.
I'm gathering information about Northton, specifically the Aerux Wood Storehouse, Waterfall View Pavilion, and Hunting Camp.
The person who hired me to investigate said there might be anomalies in these places. I want to collect as many clues as possible.
The person who hired me to investigate said there might be anomalies in these places. I want to collect as many clues as possible.
Which location would you like to know more about?
Take the path west of the teahouse. The Aerux Wood Storehouse will be on your left.
They built a warehouse there months ago. Doesn't seem like for storing Aerux Wood.
Now it seems likely they were preparing to hoard the ore.
Before you cross the Cloudrest Bridge into Aerux Town, you'll find Waterfall View Pavilion to the east.
For travelers, this is a perfect spot to admire the waterfall from afar.
For merchants traveling in and out of Northton, this is the only way.
It's at the foot of a hill east of the teahouse. But be careful, Rebels have taken it over.
I heard wolf howls at night. They might be capturing Wolvines nearby.
But the Wolvines are very united. If they know we're keeping one captive, more will come for sure.
Do you know there's an abandoned mine in Northton?
I passed by the mountain a while ago and heard screams coming from inside...
If I remember correctly, places like this are usually the Rebels' hideouts.
Did someone take care of them?
It was odd. I saw a pile of goods left by the roadside while I was shipping mine. Strange butterflies were hovering around.
Stay away from those goods. I heard people who took them home started having nightmares.
The Rebels are at it again.
It must be the troublemaking expelled students again.
zh_text: 一定又是破门生在捣乱。
source_text: 一定又是破门生在捣乱。
official_target_text: It must be the troublemaking expelled students again.
official_en_text: It must be the troublemaking expelled students again.

text: Oh, it's scary. I saw Rebels gathering at the pavilion last night...
Who knows what shady business they're up to.
I'll give you the key he left with me. Just don't ask me anything else!
Hey, hold on! We're just... helping Contraption Master with the delivery.
But I'm sure something's wrong with this batch of goods. Boss is already losing his mind.
I've told you everything I know. Just let me go!
It looks like there's something on Wolvine...
It looks like there's something on Wolvine...
I had a rare fine dream last night. Dreamt that my uncles and aunts left me a huge inheritance, and I bought all the shops in Aerux Town.
You're going to wake up to music, then?
But in my dreams, my money just keeps growing. No matter how I spend it, it never ends. It's so exhausting.
I envy you for having such a beautiful dream. I had a terrible nightmare last night, and it's been keeping me awake all night.
Everyone says Aerux Inn offers a good night's sleep, so why did I have a nightmare?
I'll tell everyone the Aerux Inn is dishonest. Who would stay here again?
I heard from Mr. Qing Ze that you not only repaired the Runestone but also dismantled Dreamslayer's conspiracy!
As a member of the Aerwatch, I almost collapsed during the investigation. I'm truly ashamed of my weakness.
I've also compiled the results of the investigation into this incident. If you want to know more, you can check the table next to you!
At first, we were commissioned by the Academy to investigate the source of the Dream Energy disorder...
I've investigated all the way to the deep cave where the Butterfly Envoy holds the ritual, but I can't proceed because I lack the Runestone.
I realized I was deeply affected by Dream Energy disruptions, so I came to Mr. Qing Ze for treatment.
Mr. Qing Ze just treated him... He spent more time in the area with Dream Energy chaos than I did.
While Dream Sorcery Techniques can withstand some Dream Energy disruptions, excessive consumption can lead to severe backlash.
I'll keep an eye on him here. Once this is all over, I'll go home and get a good sleep!
I can see Dreamslayer in my mind when I close my eyes.
Guess it really wants to hunt me in dreams...
Who dares to hurt you when I'm watching?
Mr. Qing Ze has treated you. Just rest for now!
I see... That item you got is a Dreamwhisper Runestone fragment.
Dreamer, what else do you wish to know?
The Great Dream Totem was established by a powerful being riding a Bubble Fish when we first arrived in Oneirland.
I don't know how it works, but it has stabilized the Dream Energy scattered throughout Oneirland.
Repairing the Runestone will cause energy fluctuations, and the Dream Totem can make the process smoother.
In the northwest of Dreamplunge Island, you'll find a giant butterfly-wing-shaped rock with crystals that shimmer in the light. That's the Dream Totem.
The Oneiric Butterfly chose my clan as its messengers, protecting Jixia's Dreamscape.
They? You mean, there's more than one Butterfly Envoy?
They? You mean, there's more than one Butterfly Envoy?
Beauty and nightmare coexist, just like the Butterfly Envoys, who are now a pair of sisters.
The Butterfly Envoy at Dreamwhisper Lake has long protected fine dreams on her own.
Alone... So the two Butterfly Envoys weren't together?
Alone... So the two Butterfly Envoys weren't together?
Good and bad dreams coexisted but also clashed. For the Dreamscape's stability, apart from parting, there was no better choice.
The Weaver should have had the protection of my clan, but after the great battle two years ago, we had to retreat from Dreamwhisper Lake, thus losing contact with her...
How do I find other Runestone fragments?
The <001>stone map</> in your hand is a condensed reflection of the Dreamscape in reality.
It captures ripples caused by Dream Energy and records the locations of Dream Energy fluctuations in Dreamwhisper Lake.
If you get lost, check the <001>stone tablets</>. They'll guide you.
Got it. I'll head out right away.
It's all in your hands now, Dreamer.
There's something else I don't understand...
There's something else I don't understand...
Sure, ask away. I'll tell you everything I know.
I leave everything to you, Dreamer.
official_target_text: I leave everything to you, Dreamer.
official_en_text: I leave everything to you, Dreamer.

text: After many years, people on the Bubble Fish's back found us.
He forged a path between dreams and reality, establishing the boundaries of the Dreamscape with the Great Dream Totem.
And the Butterfly Envoys, with the power of Runestones, reshaped the Dreamrealm and stabilized the chaotic Dream Energy.
The person on the Bubble Fish's back... it's Master Zhuangzi. Then this fragment...
The person on the Bubble Fish's back... it's Master Zhuangzi. Then this fragment...
It's a fragment of the Dreamwhisper Runestone. It was supposed to be Butterfly Envoy's.
The Dreamwhisper Runestone shattered. Dream Energy began to fluctuate and distort.
I'm afraid chaos has returned to Dreamwhisper Lake. The realm of dreams is now a maze...
We are not the only residents of Dreamscape, nor are we the only ones who define dreams.
In Dreamland, butterflies and birds could fly together...
But different interpretations of dreams eventually turned this into a delusion.
The Dreamslayer, the embodiment of chaos, equally despises both fine dreams and nightmares.
Then let's settle this with swords.
The Runestone has shattered, and the Dreamwhisper Lake is in a worse state than Aerux Town.
You've already helped us so much, and I hate to ask for more. But this is urgent...
The source of Dream Energy fluctuations are these Runestone fragments, and this <001>stone tablet</> will guide you to the location of Dream Energy fluctuations in Dreamwhisper Lake.
Once you find them, return to the Dream Totem to restore the Runestone.
Finally, you need to go to the <001>cave north of the Great Dream Totem</> and use the Runestones to calm down the chaotic Dream Energy.
Only then can the crisis in Northton be thoroughly resolved.
What do I need to do?
What do I need to do?
Communication isn't just about language. We can find other ways to talk.
zh_text: 沟通不止有语言一种方式，作为伙伴，我们可以用别的方式交流。

text: The Young Mistress has arrived, everyone scatter!
Stop, stop right there! This is a sidewalk, no speeding allowed. Which academy are you from, student?
Huh? This is my first time in Jixia, I didn't know skateboarding wasn't allowed here. I'll be sure to watch out next time!
Welcome to Jixia, but please don't drive so dangerously again.
It is said that this is a must-pass location for the Princess of Jiang Commandery. If I can lie in wait for her, I will surely be able to collect key intelligence...
Could this reckless girl be the princess? I'd better keep observing...
Brother, hope this letter finds you well. The legal system in Jixia is even more complete than I imagined, and some of its regulations are worth learning from for Jiangjun...
Using mechanisms to assist farming is a great idea. Perhaps in the future, we can hire some craftsmen to go to Jiangjun...
Jixia is also quite prosperous in trade, with a unique handicraft industry based on cloud silk...
Perhaps it is time we seriously consider the Governor's proposal...
Oh, right, some foreign spies followed me the whole way. Once I confirmed their identities, I gave them a blast. Don't worry, brother!
I'm still at the beginner stage, doing basic work, starting with Dragonbone research.
I wonder how long it'll take to learn more advanced Dragonology...
I'm a Seeker, aiming to delve deep into the field of Dragonology.
After three months of research, I've found something interesting...
It's a secret! Read my Dragonology Beginner's Log over there if you're curious.
Master Boshe is so stingy with sharing the secrets of Dragonology research. He always says something like, "It's profound, just follow the clues."
The index has filled up so fast...
What would you like to know?
I'm organizing the catalog. Master Boshe assigned me to sketch different dragonbone forms daily.
Doing business with the Seekers here is always a pleasure.
Those Seekers are rarely seen, but they're generous with their money, never haggle over prices.
Maybe they'd rather spend their precious time on research than haggling over prices.
It's such a pleasure doing business with the Seekers here.
She's been at the camp for three months now, drawing the same pictures every day.
The captain said these treasures were meant to fund our expeditions.
The Enlightenment Trials preliminaries are held in Dragon's Graveyard?
Yes, more students will come to Dragon Valley.
Hello, we're the Dragon's Graveyard Archaeology Team. The preliminary of the Enlightenment Trials is being held there now, so we can only rest here for now.
I can't shake the feeling of unease. There are still so many areas left unexcavated...
Isn't that what this event is all about? To attract attention and gather talent?
I see! I'll start expecting more students to join our team! Are you interested? Hey, don't go...
Since you're here for the trial too, why not let her recommend something for you?
So many weapons to choose from in this trial. It's dazzling.
We've been dawdling here for so long, even the food's gone cold.
Draw the bow like a crescent moon, and release arrows like shooting stars. It's a good choice if you're skilled at archery.
I don't want to risk getting injured during the trial. Taking down monsters with arrows from a safe distance—that's more my style!
Not to mention I recently honed my archery skills at the Red Falcon Training Hall.
Using a heavy sword to overpower with strength is satisfying, but it's easy to get injured...
The clash of blades is the true path of Martial Arts training. Fearing injury only tarnishes your Martial Arts spirit.
After this trial, my skills will surely improve significantly. That's it!
Stop joking. What's in this cage...
I get it! This must be a new invention from the School of Mechcrafts—Versatile Mechcraft Cage that combines power, flexibility, and defense!
Haha, disguised as a common cage, but luckily, I was sharp enough to spot it. The top spot in the trial is within my grasp!
But... whatever. I'm glad you're happy.
Ranged attackers are key team players. If you can pass this trial with it, you'll be a top-notch marksman.
Ranged attackers are key team players. If you can pass this trial with it, you'll be a top-notch marksman.
Heavy swords are versatile, good for both offense and defense. If you can pass the trial with it, you'll be quite popular in team matches later on.
Heavy swords are versatile, good for both offense and defense. If you can pass the trial with it, you'll be quite popular in team matches later on.
Maybe I should check out this cage...
Maybe I should check out this cage...
Maybe we need someone to lighten the mood in the team.
Maybe we need someone to lighten the mood in the team.
I don't know what you're saying, but thanks!
What's the rush... you're gonna hurt yourself one day.
Do you have any recommended trial weapons?
Considering the size of the arena, bows should have an advantage...
I'll settle for using the knife properly.
All that running, you sprained something?
When will Master Boshe reveal the secret to me?
Herb Garden is close to Dragon Valley, convenient for gathering herbs.
But I do feel something different in the atmosphere here, a bit eerie.
Yes, many patients at Herb Garden were wounded in Dragon Valley.
More disciples get injured during each trial. We Herb Society members have to stay here.
How's his injury? I helped him pick a weapon for the trial before.
How's his injury? I helped him pick a weapon for the trial before.
He just twisted his ankle. He hasn't even started the trial yet...
About getting injured in the trial.
There should be some Herbalism materials here too...
So just stay still, got it?
No rush, we'll have plenty of time.
Don't move around for a while, understand?
zh_text: 一时半会就别乱动了，明白了吗？
source_text: 一时半会就别乱动了，明白了吗？
official_target_text: Don't move around for a while, understand?
official_en_text: Don't move around for a while, understand?

text: Is someone moving stuff? How did light leak in...
You can't see me... You can't see me...
If important information gets worn down, the research will lose key clues.
zh_text: 万一把重要信息磨损，研究也会失去关键线索。
source_text: 万一把重要信息磨损，研究也会失去关键线索。
official_target_text: If important information gets worn down, the research will lose key clues.
official_en_text: If important information gets worn down, the research will lose key clues.

text: Stand up. You're not escaping either.
I'll tell you what needs doing, then you can get to work.
So he wanted me to stay...
Anything else you're not telling me?
Nope. You're not going anywhere until you spill it.
I really didn't do anything else...
Hmm... The footprints don't lead outside the camp. He should still be here.
Could he be hiding somewhere nearby? Is our camp really big enough to conceal someone?
Ugh... I never knew being a Seeker could be so exhausting.
I should get some finer excavation Mechcrafts next time.
Are you here to study Dragonology too?
I'm Wei Qiong, a researcher under the guidance of Mentor Xueyan.
Is there anything that can help me understand Dragonology better?
Is there anything that can help me understand Dragonology better?
I'm a beginner like you, so I may not be able to help much. If you need anything, ask Instructor Xueyan.
I'm sure he knows everything about Dragonology.
Stop hiding, we can see you!
Thanks to the Seeker Society for sparing me...
I hope this research can inspire more people to join in.
Looks like there are still plenty of interested students this year.
You again? I'm seriously working this time! You can't catch me again!
Keep working! What were you trying to steal from the camp again?
Keep working! What were you trying to steal from the camp again?
I... I just wanted to take a look at the Seeker Society's research materials, no other motives, really.
But it's okay. I've talked to the Seeker Society. They might let me see the results after they're done.
Oh, it's you! Thanks again for helping us spot that suspicious guy last time.
Though his actions were problematic, he's willing to stay and study, and we welcome that.
Aren't you worried he'll cause more trouble?
Aren't you worried he'll cause more trouble?
He's in the tent reading now. Probably doesn't have time for petty theft.
He wasn't bad. Later, he came to the camp and showed interest in Dragonology. He seemed to have some knowledge himself.
Oh, it's you! Thanks for speaking up for me last time.
I've studied Dragonbone a bit, but never had direct access. After reviewing my research, they allowed me to stay in the camp.
As expected of a Seeker Society member, the materials I can access alone already cover my entire research.
Of course! I'm happy to help. Thanks so much!
Doesn't it get boring just sorting documents?
Doesn't it get boring just sorting documents?
Thanks to you, things didn't get worse.
The research materials are still there, so we can't call him a thief. Should we punish him, though?
A lesson learned through hard work.
If we don't punish him this time, next time it won't just be looking. There should be some "work" at the camp he can do.
If we don't punish him this time, next time it won't just be looking. There should be some "work" at the camp he can do.
If he hasn't actually done anything wrong, let him go. Maybe he's just interested in dragonology.
If he hasn't actually done anything wrong, let him go. Maybe he's just interested in dragonology.
Maybe he just really likes Dragonology.
We'll have a word with him. If he's really interested, he's welcome to join.
Hmm... You have a point. Let's keep him for the heavy lifting.
Interested in Dragonology? Hmm... that's a possibility.
So what do you plan to do with this... "little thief"?
So what do you plan to do with this... "little thief"?
Stop right there! We see you!
Stay back, I didn't take anything!
Thanks to that classmate who thought to check these supply piles.
So you knew they were research materials? I knew it was you!
Once I finish the story of Dragonrider and get the approval of the Seekers at the camp...
I'll be appointed as an instructor of the Seeker Society and lead my own research!
More students at the academy might read this book and develop an interest in the history of Dragonology. That would be great...
I owe it all to you, you know.
I heard a loud noise. Was that you?
Wow, that's incredible! I mean, that's so risky. I need to write this down...
Now many of our questions have been answered...
For instance, this Sentinel fought alongside the fallen dragon.
Dragons and warriors fought side by side, drawing strength from the same source.
The mysterious marks on the dragon bones can also be seen as the imprint of the warriors...
You mean those lamps? I can now explain why only Dragonbones can light them up.
They were probably made by the ancient warriors to commemorate their friendship with the dragon race. That's why only the power of Divine Imprint can light them up.
Those warriors have perished, but the dragonbones holding their power remain to this day...
It looks like a part of a musical instrument.
Sorry, I don't know much about music theory, and I haven't heard of any special connection between dragons and instruments.
Goodbye, I have many new discoveries to record.
Why not ask the <001>Music Society</>? I remember there's one in the valley.
Dragon Valley seems to hold secrets unknown to us...
I heard a loud noise. Was that you?
It looks like a part of a musical instrument.
Sorry, I don't know much about music theory, and I haven't heard of any special connection between dragons and instruments.
Why not ask the <001>Music Society</>? I remember there's one in the valley.
Dragon Valley seems to hold secrets unknown to us...
Wow, that's incredible! I mean, that's so risky. I need to write this down...
Now many of our questions have been answered...
For instance, this Sentinel fought alongside the fallen dragon.
Dragons and warriors fought side by side, drawing strength from the same source.
The mysterious marks on the dragon bones can also be seen as the imprint of the warriors...
