They were probably made by the ancient warriors to commemorate their friendship with the dragon race. That's why only the power of Divine Imprint can light them up.
Those warriors have perished, but the dragonbones holding their power remain to this day...
Goodbye, I have many new discoveries to record.
Ah! I... I didn't see anything. Just out for a walk, you know, to aid digestion...
It's suspicious how it can digest anything.
It's suspicious how it can digest anything.
Suspicious? I don't know what you're talking about! I haven't done anything...
Oh, and the campfire at my camp hasn't gone out. If I get back late and it goes out, it'll be on you!
Anyway, I'll be on my way now. Bye!
Oh... Hello there, welcome to our archaeological camp.
But the timing is a bit awkward... We've found some strange traces in the camp recently.
Things like reports getting misplaced, research materials getting moved around. Nothing's been lost yet, but it's slowing down my research.
I hope we catch this "thief" soon. What was he thinking...?
I think only this Dragon Sentinel Mechanoid can blow this horn...
I think only this Dragon Sentinel Mechanoid can blow this horn...
This dropped from a Dragon Sentinel. What is it?
This dropped from a Dragon Sentinel. What is it?
I have a feeling... <001>the story isn't over</>...
I have a feeling... <001>the story isn't over</>...
We lost...? Why can't I hear the clash of blades?
How I wish... to hear it again... the piercing dragon roar...
So the smell is coming from this horn.
Let me play it, just like when we fought side by side...
Has it really... been that long since it left?
Back then, I had just mastered the Dragonsoar Power and volunteered to sharpen its Dragon Horn.
But I slipped and left this little scar.
Thank you for bringing back the Dragon Horn.
I stand guard here. Same as yesterday, same as always.
If you ever want to spar, you know where to find me.
Why isn't this little one afraid at all?
Little one, are you curious too?
Hey, don't go any further. There are Hardscale Wolvines over there. It's dangerous!
Relax, if there were Hardscale Wolvines about, they'd have attacked us by now.
No! The safety patrol near the observatory is handled by the School of Mechcrafts. The previous person in charge was injured.
But I just want to go explore. Let me through, please.
We're already in danger, and you're still exploring? Do you really think Hardscale Wolvines are that easy to deal with?
The School of Mechcrafts has advised students from other schools not to enter the platform until maintenance is complete.
From the School of Mechcrafts? I've fixed the observatory.
From the School of Mechcrafts? I've fixed the observatory.
I get it! The observatory is dangerous, right?
You School of Mechcrafts must be hiding secrets at the observatory!
Oh, yes! But it won't be officially repaired until the School of Mechcrafts gives the green light!
You should stay away from here too.
From the School of Mechcrafts? I've already taken care of the Hardscale Wolvines.
From the School of Mechcrafts? I've already taken care of the Hardscale Wolvines.
S-seriously? You... you wiped them all out?
But that means you have no reason to stop me, right?
Wait... could the observatory be the source of danger?
No! Can you just drop the idea of exploring?
I'm sure the School of Mechcrafts is hiding secrets at the observatory!
Why are you in such a hurry?
I've fixed the observatory and dealt with the Hardscale Wolvines. Now...
I've fixed the observatory and dealt with the Hardscale Wolvines. Now...
Now they should let me go on expeditions. You have no reason to stop me.
Wait... let's wait until the School of Mechcrafts confirms it.
So we're still gonna have to wait...
Yeah, repairing the observatory... shouldn't you be happy?
I know now. It was you School of Mechcrafts who damaged the observatory!
I know now. It was you School of Mechcrafts who damaged the observatory!
That's why you're keeping everyone out.
That's why you're keeping everyone out.
I can go on expeditions now, right? You have no reason to stop me.
Wait... let's wait until the School of Mechcrafts confirms it.
You said you've already repaired the observatory?
Great... Wait, it's not that great...
Why did it stop being fun all of a sudden...
The observatory is down again. What about my observation assignment...
We only surveyed the north of Dragon Valley. The south remains unexplored.
Before we find the way south, how about drawing whatever you like? Nobody's been there anyway.
Didn't they say someone was coming to fix it? Why isn't he here yet?
Why hasn't the maintenance guy arrived yet...
What's the connection between the Corridor Bone Chime and the outside world?
Practice leads to true knowledge, a key principle of Seekers' studies!
I'll keep collecting info for a groundbreaking report!
Oh, sorry, I got too excited!
Thanks to you, we from Team Dragonscale could enter the core area of Dragon's Graveyard for research!
So, what did you want to talk about?
The Bone Chime outside Dragon's Graveyard can collect energy of the same origin as the Corridor Bone Chime.
This energy, once bestowed upon humans to aid in their fight against evil, embodies the principles of "unity, heritage, and reverence."
This power protected the past Jixia and deserves to be inherited by us.
Dragon Valley is dotted with steles. Check the ancient records—you might find the answer.
Who knows? You might discover even more interesting things while exploring yourself.
The energy of vision is hidden in the Bone Chime.
The energy awakened ancient voices. Incredible...
With the keepsake and the recognition of the Ruins Guards...
Finally, we can explore the core area of Dragon's Graveyard!
If only we had a skilled diver to scout ahead...
An underwater passage? This is troublesome.
Remember to summarize the information you've collected.
This investigation has been incredibly fruitful!
The statue says only those with the Bone Chime may pay respects.
zh_text: 雕像上说……有骨铃信物的逸群人杰，才能前来祭拜。
source_text: 雕像上说……有骨铃信物的逸群人杰，才能前来祭拜。
official_target_text: The statue says... only those with the Bone Chime Keepsake may come to pay respects.
official_en_text: The statue says... only those with the Bone Chime Keepsake may come to pay respects.

text: The dragon's soul lives on, protecting the world. With sincere respect, we pray for the dragon gate to open.
Wow! Why can't I lift this Dragon Horn?
Wow! Why can't I lift this Dragon Horn?
The Bone Chime needs more power to activate the altar and awaken the dragon soul.
Go to <001>the Bone Chime near Dragon's Graveyard</> and fulfill his wish. I'll wait for you here.
The Seekers have left. I'm heading to Valley Entrance Camp. Hope to see you again.
zh_text: 哦对了，那些来探险的风物家们都已经陆续离开，我先回谷口营地了，咱们有缘再会。
source_text: 哦对了，那些来探险的风物家们都已经陆续离开，我先回谷口营地了，咱们有缘再会。
official_target_text: Oh, right, those Seekers have all left one by one. I'll head back to the Camp Entrance first. May we meet again.
official_en_text: Oh, right, those Seekers have all left one by one. I'll head back to the Camp Entrance first. May we meet again.

text: Um... that seems to be the Dragonbone Fragment we're looking for...
It looks like the top part of a Bone Chime. Can you please deliver it to <001>Captain Yang Ling</>?
She should be near the statue, where the ruins are guarded. P-Please!
The dragon's blessing guides the sincere!
The seal is broken! My faith must have moved the dragon!
Wealth comes to the kind heart! Hahaha!
Are you sure this will work?
Are you sure this will work?
P-Probably? I also heard that someone wished in front of the candleholder, and the candlelight above suddenly went from dark to bright!
They say if you're sincere, the Dragon Tail Altar will grant your wish. I'm trying to unlock this Dragon Bone Fragment...
But that's just what I've heard. I'm still trying to confirm it. Want to join me?
Did you find the Bone Chime fragments? Let me see...
Since you found the pieces, how about you <001>hang the restored Bone Chime back on the original dragon bone</>?
Great, with these three fragments you provided, we can restore the Bone Chime.
Strangely, each fragment of the Bone Chime seems to have a strong affinity for each other.
When I was piecing them together, it wasn't difficult at all. In fact, it felt like... the bones were guiding me, showing me where each piece should go.
Why were they scattered? What kind of power does the Bone Chime hold...?
Maybe then we'll know what this Bone Chime is for!
Quickly! Hurry and <001>hang the assembled Bone Chime on the original dragon bone</>. Next, we witness the miracle!
<001>Assembling the bone bell token</> and then <001>waking the ruin guard</> is the first step for us to enter the core area of the Dragon's Sorrow Land.
zh_text: <001>拼合信物骨铃</>，然后<001>唤醒遗迹守卫</>，是我们进入龙殇地核心区域的第一步。
source_text: <001>拼合信物骨铃</>，然后<001>唤醒遗迹守卫</>，是我们进入龙殇地核心区域的第一步。
official_target_text: <001>Assembling the bone bell token</> and then <001>waking the ruin guard</> is the first step for us to enter the core area of the Dragon's Sorrow Land.
official_en_text: <001>Assembling the bone bell token</> and then <001>waking the ruin guard</> is the first step for us to enter the core area of the Dragon's Sorrow Land.

text: Have you gathered all the fragments of the Bone Chime? Let me see...
Hmm... it looks like we're still missing a few.
How about checking out the <001>other two trial sites and the altar atop Dragonbone</> for clues?
You've probably seen her already—she's near the statue below, guarding the ruins of Dragon's Graveyard.
Wow, you're fast! Since you found it, you should be the one to <001>give it to Captain Yang Ling</>.
See you later. I'll go find Cang Ling.
Where's Cang Ling? I can't break the seal of Dragonbone Fragment on my own...
Hey, are you the new member of Team Dragonscale?
Wanna team up for this trial?
Just <001>hit all the targets</>, and leave the Bonebreaker Formation to me!
Anyway, people on this continent no longer suffer from the chaos of war as they once did.
Anyway, people on this continent no longer suffer from the chaos of war as they once did.
Who dares trespass on the Dragon's Rest?!
Pure and untainted by blood and fire.
The war is over. Jixia... did we prevail?
That would be best... It is my wish...
What wish? Wait, this Dragon Horn is...?
What wish? Wait, this Dragon Horn is...?
I hope the others can find the remaining fragments.
Been standing here for ages. Why isn't this Mechanoid moving at all?
They are the Ruins Guards of Dragon's Graveyard...
It won't respond to us without the Bone Chime as a keepsake.
Yes, and this incomplete string of Bone Chimes isn't enough...
We've been stuck here for ages. I say just blow this seal wide open!
Great minds think alike. Watch this!
It's not recommended to act recklessly before confirming whether there are any dangers nearby.
How can we speed up exploration if we're always being so cautious? Are you afraid of taking responsibility? I'll take it!
Procrastination only leads to more problems! Hey, you there, what do you think?
Cowardice won't get you anywhere. I'll take the risk. Stand back, I've got this!
Can't you make up your mind? We've been here forever!
More haste, less speed. We'll act when it's safe.
Ah... s-slow down. Take your time.
Well, that's already taken care of... Why are you still mad?
If you're this reckless, you should stay with the captain.
Finally. Take the fragments to <001>Captain Yang Ling of Team Dragonscale</>.
Finally. Take the fragments to <001>Captain Yang Ling of Team Dragonscale</>.
The dragon bones floating nearby seem to follow a pattern. I can use them to get back.
The dragon bones floating nearby seem to follow a pattern. I can use them to get back.
This height... gotta be extra careful where I step.
This height... gotta be extra careful where I step.

zh_text: 快看，祭台后方的那些骨铃真的和龙殇地外的骨铃产生共鸣了！
source_text: 快看，祭台后方的那些骨铃真的和龙殇地外的骨铃产生共鸣了！
official_target_text: Look! The Bone Chimes behind the altar are resonating with the ones outside Dragon's Graveyard!
official_en_text: Look! The Bone Chimes behind the altar are resonating with the ones outside Dragon's Graveyard!

text: Try the largest chime. That's the <001>final step to awaken the dragon's spirit</>.
zh_text: 去吧，去试试中间的那个最大的骨铃，那应该就是<001>唤醒龙魂的最后一环</>。
source_text: 去吧，去试试中间的那个最大的骨铃，那应该就是<001>唤醒龙魂的最后一环</>。
official_target_text: Now go and try that middle Bone Chime—the largest one. That should be <001>the final step in awakening the dragon soul</>.
official_en_text: Now go and try that middle Bone Chime—the largest one. That should be <001>the final step in awakening the dragon soul</>.

text: Young man, I'm a Bellsmith leading an expedition into Dragon's Graveyard. We've hit a snag and can't proceed with our research.
The Mechcraft switch for that door is inside the cave. We need someone in there to open it, but we couldn't find a second entrance...
<001>Assemble the Bone Chime to awaken the guardian Mechanoid inside</>. Only it can help open the true path to the core area.
It's risky, so I understand if you want to back out...
No problem. Leave it to me.

Excellent. First, we need to <001>find all the fragments</>. Yang Ling believes there are <001>three in total</>. She's observing the ruins of Dragon's Graveyard right now. You can ask her for details.
This is a rare opportunity for us to uncover the true secrets of the Bone Chime. I'm counting on you!
Sounds like a hassle. I'll pass.
It's okay, I understand. After all, you have to find <001>three Bone Chime fragments</>, and it's risky.
If you change your mind, find Captain Yang Ling. She's observing the ruins guards in Dragon's Graveyard.
Exactly. I once carved Bone Chimes for those in need.
zh_text: 没错，我曾经雕刻过许多骨铃给那些有需要的人。
source_text: 没错，我曾经雕刻过许多骨铃给那些有需要的人。
official_target_text: Yes, I've crafted many Bone Chimes for those in need.
official_en_text: Yes, I've crafted many Bone Chimes for those in need.

text: If it's true, we'll be the first witnesses.
zh_text: 万一是真的，我们可就是首批见证者。
source_text: 万一是真的，我们可就是首批见证者。
official_target_text: If it's true, we'll be the first witnesses.
official_en_text: If it's true, we'll be the first witnesses.

text: It's a Ruins Guard—everyone, be careful! I'll handle it!
It's a Ruins Guard—everyone, be careful! I'll handle it!
Are you sure? Don't push yourself.
Everyone else, find somewhere safe now!
What if a monster runs out...
official_target_text: What if a monster runs out...
official_en_text: What if a monster runs out...

text: How am I supposed to find my way home...?
Don't worry. I won't hurt you.
Don't worry. I won't hurt you.
Some Rebels just came charging in, took all my stuff, and beat me up.
Don't hit me... don't hit me...
<001>As long as these three lights are reactivated</>, the barrier should be lifted, and I’ll be able to get out!
zh_text: <001>只要重新激活这三盏灯</>，屏障应该就会解开，我就能出来了！
source_text: <001>只要重新激活这三盏灯</>，屏障应该就会解开，我就能出来了！
official_target_text: <001>As long as these three lights are reactivated</>, the barrier should be lifted, and I’ll be able to get out!
official_en_text: <001>As long as these three lights are reactivated</>, the barrier should be lifted, and I’ll be able to get out!

text: It's really dangerous ahead. Why are you so stubborn...
We'll wait until the School of Mechcrafts confirms it!
Thought the Hardscale Wolvines were already cleared out...
Is there anything else you'd like to know?
official_target_text: Is there anything else you'd like to know?
official_en_text: Is there anything else you'd like to know?

text: Is there anything else you'd like to know?
official_target_text: Is there anything else you'd like to know?
official_en_text: Is there anything else you'd like to know?

text: I need to find an opportunity...
There are quite a few people in this camp.
I've helped you drive away those Rebels, but the items seem to be gone.
I've helped you drive away those Rebels, but the items seem to be gone.
We only brought some snacks, and they're probably in their stomachs now...
Can you stand? There's a camp south along this road. The scholars there should be able to help you.
Can you stand? There's a camp south along this road. The scholars there should be able to help you.
Thank you. You've already helped a lot. I'll rest a bit more and then go myself.
I can help you get there.
I can help you get there.
Thank you for helping me get away!
Ahem... Don't be fooled. I'm just bad at handling group attacks.
Thank you for helping me get away!
Ahem... Don't be fooled. I'm just bad at handling group attacks.
When it comes to solo combat, I'm top-notch.
Are you really as skilled as you claim?
I'm a lone adventurer, and I've fought my way across the world.
But those Rebels, they love to gang up on people!
Who are the tough opponents in Dragon Valley?
The lizards roaming the Misty Marshes, the Dragonriders lurking at midnight—none stand a chance against me.
Since you can handle these Rebels, you should have no problem taking on them!
One day, I hope to hear the dragon horn resound across the valley.
The Dragonroar Horn is on the stone platform nearby. Be careful, it's very heavy.
<001>Most people can't play it</>, lacking strength.
I wonder if the melody I play can traverse the river of time and reach the dragons of the past.
I heard dragon-like sounds in the valley just now!
No, I was once a friend of Long.
No, I was a warrior of Dragon Valley.
I see. The sound is indeed majestic, like the roar of a dragon.
It gave me inspiration for a new piece. Thank you, I'll keep playing in Dragon Valley.
I enjoy playing in places with a rich history.
I feel inspired when the melody echoes in the valley and travels through time.
You here for the music or just chatting?
You hear it too, right? I've poured the history I felt in Dragon Valley into this very song.
Dragons are mysterious beings. Their mystique is captivating.
There's an ancient legend in the Music Society... It's said dragons shed their horns once in their lifetime.
If you <001>turn that Dragon Horn into a horn</>, its sound when blown is like the roar of a dragon.
I wonder if the melody played can cross the long river of time and let the dragons of the past hear it too?
But those are just old stories. Now in Dragon Valley, you can only see dragon remains.
Goodbye, hope you enjoy my tune.
Such a heavy horn... Maybe only that <001>Sentinel</> could blow it...
Such a heavy horn... Maybe only that <001>Sentinel</> could blow it...
Finally, someone noticed me. Could you lend me a hand?
The cliffs of Dragon Valley hold many rare ores, but most are halfway up the mountain, hard to reach.
I took the academy's commission to build a walkway, but I forgot to survey before starting work...
Could you check if there's a mining spot on the mountain slope ahead of the plank road? It'd be even better if you could bring back some ore.
Thank you! Seeing the ore you brought back confirms the plank road's position. I can continue building with confidence now.
Wonder if there's ore deposits on that mountain slope ahead?
I enjoy playing in places with a rich history.
You here for the music or just chatting?
Dragons are mysterious beings. Their mystique is captivating.
A horn made from a dragon horn would be the best instrument!
The tip of a dragon horn, infused with the dragon's spirit. Its curved shape forms a special sound structure.
When blown, its sound is like a dragon's roar.
But <001>something seems to be missing</> to make it a musical instrument.
You hear it too, right? I've poured the history I felt in Dragon Valley into this very song.
There's an ancient legend in the Music Society... It's said dragons shed their horns once in their lifetime.
If you <001>turn that Dragon Horn into a horn</>, its sound when blown is like the roar of a dragon.
I wonder if the melody played can cross the long river of time and let the dragons of the past hear it too?
But those are just old stories. Now in Dragon Valley, you can only see dragon remains.
Goodbye, I really hope to craft a Dragon Horn myself one day.
Is this the legendary Dragon Horn... sealed inside Dragon's Graveyard by the dragon soul?
Have Dragon Horn but no Whistle Piece.
I enjoy playing in places with a rich history.
You here for the music or just chatting?
Dragons are mysterious beings. Their mystique is captivating.
If only I could craft a legendary instrument.
Where can I find Dragon Horns?
Where can I find Dragon Horns?
A Music Society elder said that when the Whistle Piece is inlaid into <001>Dragon Horn</> and played, the sound is like a dragon's roar.
You hear it too, right? I've poured the history I felt in Dragon Valley into this very song.
There's an ancient legend in the Music Society... It's said dragons shed their horns once in their lifetime.
If you <001>turn that Dragon Horn into a horn</>, its sound when blown is like the roar of a dragon.
I wonder if the melody played can cross the long river of time and let the dragons of the past hear it too?
But those are just old stories. Now in Dragon Valley, you can only see dragon remains.
Goodbye, I really hope to craft a Dragon Horn myself one day.
Legend has it, it was sealed by the dragon soul inside <001>Dragon's Grave Burrow</>.
I heard an expedition team from the Seeker Society is waiting to enter Dragon's Graveyard once the barrier is down. Wonder how it's going.
Have Whistle Piece but no Dragon Horn.
Next time we meet, it will be at Dreamwhisper Lake.
Life is but a dream. Take a moment to rest and wash away your worries before hitting the road again.
Master Zhuangzi? I didn't expect to find you here... and Vlinder too?
Master Zhuangzi? I didn't expect to find you here... and Vlinder too?
I was just out for a walk. Mind your own business!
What's with you? Don't tell me you're sweating the trial.
You too... Hmph. Panicking won't help. The win goes to the prepared!
Not in the zone yet, huh? You can't beat us slacking off like that.
Just wait. Team Vlinder is gonna beat you fair and square!
Master Zhuangzi, I'm heading off to train. See ya!
Haha, you said it out loud.
The one you were waiting for has arrived.
Life is but a fleeting dream, yet words often betray the heart.
Master Zhuangzi, are you helping Vlinder scope out the competition too?
Master Zhuangzi, are you helping Vlinder scope out the competition too?
Is this about the Enlightenment Trials?
I could use a quick break.
We just bumped into each other. I was actually looking for you.
Are you out here on patrol to keep the students safe?
Are you out here on patrol to keep the students safe?
It is about the trial. Seeing you this fired up puts my mind at ease.
I haven't done anything bad lately...
You've always been a good student. I came to talk to you about the Enlightenment Trials.
Seeking Wonders isn't easy. From teaming up with Novar against the Cloudeater, to fighting in the Enlightenment Trials with Team of Stars.
You've already been through so much.
Even you have to be running on fumes by now.
Ah, the boundless energy of youth. Still, a bow strung too tight will eventually snap. Take a breather.
Clear your head. Get some sleep, and let the dream wash away your exhaustion.
Vlinder, I know you're here to size up the competition. The Enlightenment Trials are fierce. It's only natural to feel the weight of it.
Who... who's feeling the weight?! I'm just here to clear my head, that's all!
This time, we must find the treasure and make her wish come true!
Where is it? Should be in the water nearby...
Anyway, thanks for bringing me the message. If you have any wishes of your own, try searching for the Bone Chime—it's said to be quite effective.
Already did. Here, she told me to give you this letter.
Already did. Here, she told me to give you this letter.
Oh, this is... an invitation letter!
Did you go to find Xuan Ling at the Valley Camp?
Does she want to... invite me to chat...? I'm so excited!
It must be the wish I made to the Wishbone Chime... that made her acknowledge me.
I heard rumors of <001>treasures hidden in these waters</>!
A <001>wandering merchant at the north camp</> collects oddities, so I thought I'd try my luck.
Could you help me search when you have time? I really want to get the approval of the appraiser Xuan Ling.
Ah... Don't get the wrong idea. I'm talking about Xuan Ling, a genius appraiser at the Entrance Camp. She's a wandering merchant now.
I'm also interested in rare treasures and often discuss them with her, but she always criticizes my lack of identification skills.
I heard <001>there's something valuable hidden in this water</>. Can you help me find it?
I must find that thing for her to see—
Next time, I'll find the treasure myself and make her see me differently!
Head north from here to <001>Barren Camp</>, and ask <001>Wandering Merchant Xuanling</> to appraise it.
I found a bronze slate nearby.
I found a bronze slate nearby.
This must be the legendary treasure. Bringing this to Xuan Ling would surely earn her approval!
But I need you to make another trip to the <001>Northern Valley Camp</>. After all, you're the one who found the treasure, and...
N-nothing. Remember to find <001>Xuan Ling</>, she's a skilled appraiser.
Did you find some treasure? L-let me see!
Oh no! My porcelain flask broke...
Maybe I should bring something more extraordinary to impress her.
Silence. Do not disturb my Bone Chime.
The Wishbone Chime is indeed a curious item, but its powers are often exaggerated.
People revere powerful and mysterious things. Some worship fire, some bow to wind, and in Dragon Valley, they revere the dragons.
The dragon was a guardian, so its bones were believed to bring blessings. People turned them into wind chimes.
Night wind drifts through the hall, morning dreams ring softly.
There's a legend, little-known to the public, but deeply cherished by every bell maker.
In a dark world devoid of kindness, even the Dragon Bone Wind Chimes shall never shine.
Dragons and dragon bone wind chimes exist to protect others, but did the dragon protect humanity, or did humanity choose the dragon?
You're smart. I don't think I need to spell it out.
I want to hear your story.
Hah, my old body has no interesting things to spit out, except for my apprentice days.
My mother... she'd send people to buy my wind chimes. Starting from the very first one I made.
Those ugly wind chimes fill the cellar of my home—it's embarrassing just to look at them.
I worked hard, hoping that one day I could replace them with finer ones.
Then surely, the wind chimes in the cellar later must have been marvelously crafted.
Then surely, the wind chimes in the cellar later must have been marvelously crafted.
And then? I graduated. I finally walked into the cellar in broad daylight.
But I don't see the "ingenious craftsmanship" in those crooked, ugly pieces.
But the fireflies lit up the most splendid galaxy. Unfortunately, the wish-makers never saw this starry sky.
During my apprenticeship, my mother was very ill. I wished for her recovery by making wind chimes.
But I lost myself in studies and prayers, missing precious time with my mother.
When mom secretly bought the wind chime, I even felt relieved. I thought she was wishing for her own recovery.
If the wind chimes carried that wish, why did they light up on the day I graduated after my mother passed away?
Because your mother wanted to be free.
Because your mother had been suffering from pain for a long time and was hoping for relief.
Because your mother had been suffering from pain for a long time and was hoping for relief.
Maybe yes, maybe no. Only the one making the wish truly knows. But if it was her wish...
Then my filial impiety should be punished even more.
Because your mother wants you to graduate.
Because your mother misses you dearly and hopes for your graduation.
Because your mother misses you dearly and hopes for your graduation.
Maybe yes, maybe no. Only the wisher knows, but the answer rests with my mother.
Anyway, I cried my heart out that day and swore never to take in another disciple again. Yes, I never had a student under my wing.
Others will carry on the legacy. I must be the lamp lighter during the time of the Icewind Bell: remember the past and stay true to our cause.
Farewell, young one. May your path be ever lit.
“A dark world without kind souls will never see the light of the Dragon Bone Wind Chimes.”
zh_text: “没有善人的幽暗世界，也必定不会亮起龙骨风铃的光。”
source_text: “没有善人的幽暗世界，也必定不会亮起龙骨风铃的光。”
official_target_text: “A dark world without kind souls will never see the light of the Dragon Bone Wind Chimes.”
official_en_text: “A dark world without kind souls will never see the light of the Dragon Bone Wind Chimes.”

text: Focus on your training, girl. I'll keep the area safe.
My aim is still not good enough...
Focus all your attention on the arrow.
Alright... Time to let my little bird spread its wings and fly!
I'm fine, Dad. I'll keep practicing!
I'm just practicing, not messing around! Ask this person here if you don't believe me.
Practical experience will speed up your progress. It's commendable that you have the determination to learn new techniques.
Practical experience will speed up your progress. It's commendable that you have the determination to learn new techniques.
Remember, our family's martial arts legacy is not just about skills, but also wisdom and responsibility.
Before you're healed, I'll stay and train with you.
Martial arts isn't something you can learn overnight. Laying a solid foundation is crucial.
Now come with me. No more messing around!
You should listen to your father.
Drive and practice are important, but steady progress builds a strong foundation.
Drive and practice are important, but steady progress builds a strong foundation.
I understand, Dad. I just want to prove I can do this.
You're my daughter. Of course, you can learn the family's highest martial arts.
But our legacy is not just about skills, it's also about wisdom and responsibility. Let's practice together while you recover.
Alright, alright, I get it. I'll learn at my own pace!
Don't worry, Dad. I'll do my best!
How are your injuries, my dear?
Shh! Keep quiet, my daughter mustn't find out.
She came alone to the Dragon Valley Trial. I'm really worried about her...
My daughter wants to learn the strongest moves, but I want her to master the basics first. She thinks I'm holding her back and stormed off.
My son's too impatient. How can he truly inherit our family's Martial Arts?
She insisted on coming to Dragon Valley Trial alone, just because I wanted her to build a solid foundation instead of teaching her the strongest moves right away.
I just want her to be safe. Why can't she understand that...
I've told you so much. Actually, I want to ask you to help persuade my daughter.
I'm sure you young people will get along just fine. Thanks in advance.
What do you want? I don't have time for chit-chat.
If there's nothing else, I'll continue practicing.
Dragon Valley offers not only breathtaking scenery but also trials left by Society predecessors.
Mastering even a few moves here would be a significant breakthrough.
It's dangerous to train here alone.
Wait... did my father send you to persuade me to go back?
Tell him I'll master the ultimate technique without his guidance. Let him stay home!
I'll leave you to it then.
I refuse to believe I can't figure it out on my own...
Adversity and danger drive progress, which is why everyone chooses Dragon Valley for trials. Don't worry—
I'm fearless by nature. I go where boys dare not.
It's dangerous. Maybe I should go with you...
It's dangerous. Maybe I should go with you...
No way. I'm here to prove myself.
This time, I must master the family's ultimate technique on my own to show that stubborn old man what I'm capable of!
Yes! Don't worry! I can take care of myself!
As long as we can solve these Mechcrafts... that's a trick learned, right?
It must be special. Let me guess, was it sent by... Cheng Jin?
I knew it was him. Thanks for your help.
Could you help me <001>deliver this letter</>? Keep who sent you a secret.
And no peeking for you either! I'll be watching.
Stop lying to me! That kid hangs around Sunken Stele Pond all day. If he didn't find it, you sure didn't stumble upon it!
Could you help me <001>deliver this letter</>? Keep who sent you a secret.
And no peeking for you either! I'll be watching.
Here you are. Are you here to see that treasure?
Yes, I want to take a look at that bronze tablet.
I'm sending it to a scholar who knows their stuff. We'll know its secrets soon.
I'm eager too, but there's no other way. Research takes time.
And of course, I've made a pretty penny myself!
Ah, young people are always in such a hurry. See you around!
No, I want to learn about the secrets of Dragon Valley.
Dragon Valley is full of oddities.
See those Dragonbone Ruins over there? Don't think they're just a bunch of giant bones.
One day, while I was passing by on a treasure hunt, I suddenly saw lightning flashing above the dragon bone!
But the sun's still shining everywhere else. Weird, right?
Dragon Valley must be hiding stories we don't know.
Wait, where did you find it? Sorry, I got too excited...
Are you here to uncover secrets or to seek curious items?
Dragon Valley is full of oddities.
See those Dragonbone Ruins over there? Don't think they're just a bunch of giant bones.
One day, while I was passing by on a treasure hunt, I suddenly saw lightning flashing above the dragon bone!
But the sun's still shining everywhere else. Weird, right?
The Dragon Valley must hold many secrets we've yet to uncover.
The strange things in Dragon Valley?
I heard rumors too! Someone found a treasure chest buried in the ruins.
Some say there's <001>bronze treasure</> around <001>Sunken Stele Pond</>.
Looks like there's plenty of valuable stuff here. If you find anything unusual, be sure to bring it to me!
Many adventurers come here with confidence, but few succeed. If you find it, I'll reward you well.
I spent everything on the Dragon Valley expedition. I thought you'd help out an old friend...
We aren't friends. You still owe me for the Mechcraft knife you bought on credit!
Hmph, who else would buy this junk besides me?
Junk? Everyone who's seen my Mechcrafts has praised them! Do you also want to try digging up Mechcrafts?
See? No one thinks it's a good idea!
Hmph, you don't know what you're missing!
Alright, I promise you'll be satisfied! Come on out.
Huh? It was just here a moment ago.
I'm really curious about what it is.
I need to prepare for the trial.
So, how many siblings are there in your family?
There are four of us. I'm the second eldest.
I wish I could see you four together.
I think I see the ruins of Minka...
That's all there is, matching the descriptions.
Looks like those Sorcery guys won't get ahead of me this time.
I feel like reciting a poem!
Stop it... my head's about to explode...
Can it sense the energy of Dragonbone...?
I can feel it. The ruins ahead must be the place.
I don't see those Seekers either. Looks like we're ahead again.
Alright, but let me finish my food first.
(Whisper) There are Wallow Puffers up ahead!
The Wallow Puffer is an exceptional ingredient, both pricey and delicious. I can't miss this opportunity.
I'll cook one for myself and sell the other to the Gourmet Society at a high price!
I need to take a closer look...
Why are there so many Bronze Mechanoids in Dragon's Graveyard?
Dragon's Graveyard was once a trial ground.
It's normal to have Mechanoids in trials!
Did you chase those Rebels away?
Finally, I can begin researching the ruins without worries. Thank you!
I thought... I thought once we avoided the beasts and Ruins Guards, we'd be in the clear...
And that's when the Rebels caught us off guard.
They've occupied the ruins we're studying.
We must find a way to rescue him.
Luckily, I'm fast, so I got away... But to protect An An, Ying was taken by the Rebels.
We were conducting research in the ruins...
Just follow this road northwest, and you'll see them. Be careful, there are many of them.
We'll... we'll ask the academy for help...
It's a relief that Ah Ying was saved...
Now I can focus on my research again...
Stop that little one! We can't take much more!
To be honest, I don't know how to make him stop...
What? You're ripping off your old friend?
Did you really invent it yourself? Why does it look so much like those old relics around here?
Hey, I'll give you another All-purpose Mechcraft Blade, okay?
Look, is this your automatic excavation Mechcraft? It nearly buried us in the ruins!
You should be thanking this kind stranger!
Oh, someone took care of the little one that got out of control!
Even old friends need to show some sincerity.
That's the observatory up ahead, where you can conduct detailed investigations of the entire Dragon Valley.
Dragon Valley is easy to get lost in, so it's a good idea to plan your route there first.
The observatory seems to malfunction occasionally, like now...
The School of Mechcrafts has sent someone to fix it. It'll be working again soon.
But don't worry. See those repair tools on the ground?
Really? You fixed it? I heard some people at the School of Mechcrafts got hurt trying to do that. You must be pretty skilled.
But these tools need to be carried back...
Why doesn't the School of Mechcrafts use their Mechcrafts for transport?
It's a real privilege to study the dragonbone up close in such detail.
You need to be more composed, both as an artist and a person.
Do you know about painting? I'm still observing. Haven't reached the stage of putting brush to paper.
See how majestic it is? Yet few stop to admire it.
Such a massive skeleton must carry even richer and more delicate contents.
Instead of copying its appearance, I focused on the details that others might overlook.
Did you get into a fight?
Oh? You must have run into my juniors.
Zhu Jin sometimes has odd ideas, and Qing has a hot temper, so clashes are inevitable.
But really, it's just different opinions on art. Nothing serious enough to cause a real fight.
Both of their ideas have practical value, and it's a shame to abandon either one. So I let them work separately.
It's been a pleasure talking to you. Goodbye.
But I'd prefer it if we could sit down together after gathering reference images and discuss our ideas.
They left in such a hurry. I don't know if they heard my suggestion or not.
Maybe I hesitated too much and missed the opportunity to coordinate them. As the senior, I feel like I've failed.
Can you be as quiet as Zhu Jin while painting?
The patterns in this bone are truly extraordinary.
You need to pay more attention to details.
Because Shen Zhu didn't mediate the conflict.
Senior Shen Zhu is always calm and steady, and he never interferes too much with our ideas.
I guess he trusted us to solve the problem on our own. Or he wanted us to learn from the experience.
No worries! Anyway, if we argue again, I'll side with Senior Shen Zhu and guide everyone!
Zhu Jin didn't explain her thoughts.
Senior Zhu's paintings are hard to understand, and her words are even more profound.
I've heard that deep down, she might be lonely. Perhaps she just doesn't know how to express herself.
It's okay! If we argue again, I'll explain myself to Senior Zhu Jin!
Because Raven is too impulsive and reckless.
Senior Ao Qing is a fascinating person. He excels at landscape paintings, with bold and free strokes that leave everyone in awe.
I know he sometimes acts before he thinks, but that's also what allows him to capture such lifelike portraits in just a few strokes.
It's okay! Anyway, if we argue again, I'll help Senior Ching slow down and think things through!
So they didn't argue or ignore each other? It's so confusing. I thought everyone was angry.

Guess I'll have to get used to it. Differences in opinion don't have to be settled with a winner or loser. Not just in painting, but I also need to learn more from my seniors in terms of how to handle relationships!
The senior students have already started painting. It's amazing how quickly they decided what to draw.
Thanks to your help, the seniors finally made up, just as I wished. I'm sure they'll create many stunning pieces inspired by this!
As for me, I'd love to capture everyone laughing together. United memories are what truly matter.
Thanks to your help, the seniors finally made up, just as I wished. I'm sure they'll create many stunning pieces inspired by this!
As for me, I'd love to capture everyone laughing together. United memories are what truly matter.
Thanks to your help, the seniors finally made up, just as I wished. I'm sure they'll create many stunning pieces inspired by this!
As for me, I'd love to capture everyone laughing together. United memories are what truly matter.
With your help, I'm sure they'll create some stunning works!
As for me, I'd love to capture everyone laughing together. United memories are what truly matter.
Clearly, we were all drawing dragon bones, but each of us drew it differently. Maybe this is what Master meant by "harmony in diversity."
I'm still a bit confused. Do you know why they were arguing this time?
Thank you for bringing them back... but it seems they're still arguing.
I overheard them. They've decided to paint together, but they're still deciding on a location.
They've been stuck for ages. How about you give me your opinion? I'll join the debate.
Of the places you've been to, which do you think has the most stunning scenery, most suitable for painting?
More details visible at close range.
Oh? Senior Shen Zhu seems to have returned from a nearby place.
Rich details make the overall image more complete. It's great for practicing observation and rendering skills...
That makes sense. I'll discuss it with the senior members!
You can get different angles by the water.
Oh? Senior Zhu Jin seems to have come back from the pool.
Can we see things differently through the distortion of reflections and ripples on the water?
Sounds interesting. I'll discuss it with my seniors!
From above, one can overlook the entirety of the Dragonbone.
Oh? Senior Hei Qing seems to have returned from a very high mountain top.
From up high, you can see the entire landscape. It's perfect for drawing Dragonbones in vivid detail...
That sounds awesome. I'll talk to the senior members!
Oh, I miss them so much...
They seem to have had a fight and split up, ignoring me.
If you see anyone <001>sketching, please tell them to come back</>.
I came here to practice painting with the senior disciples. But, oh dear...
It's just me now. I really wish the seniors could agree and work together...
So, this trip wasn't for nothing, right?
Ah, you saw my painting tools by the cliff? Yes, I'm here to paint.
But it's worth it! If you painted, you'd understand, especially landscapes. You need a high vantage point to capture the broader view.
Only from this cliff can you see the full majesty of the dragon bones. Capturing it on paper would be awe-inspiring.
Did you get into a fight?
If you're talking about a fight with the Saepes, haha!
Did Zhu Jin tell you? Or was it Shen Zhu? It must have been Zhu Jin, she can't stand my temper.
Don't worry, we're not upset. You martial artists have sparring matches, right? It's pretty much the same.
An artist should speak through their work. That's what Master and Senior Shen Zhoo always teach us.
Goodbye, next time I'll ask you about your fights.
I understand why Zhu Jin is frustrated. She's worried about me.
Don't let her tough talk fool you—she's the biggest worrier among us. Sometimes she's like a little sister.
No risk, no reward. That's my motto. But I shouldn't push Yalena too hard this time. I'll make it up to her.
Just as I was setting up my painting tools, a group of Saepes charged out from the side! I had no choice but to engage in a fierce battle.
Nothing ventured, nothing gained—that's the motto I believe in most. But I can't keep upsetting my Senior Sister, so I'll go coax her."
zh_text: “不入虎穴焉得虎子”，我最信奉这句话了。但也不能每次都气到师姐，我会去哄她的。
source_text: “不入虎穴焉得虎子”，我最信奉这句话了。但也不能每次都气到师姐，我会去哄她的。
official_target_text: Nothing ventured, nothing gained—that's the motto I believe in most. But I can't keep upsetting my Senior Sister, so I'll go coax her."
official_en_text: Nothing ventured, nothing gained—that's the motto I believe in most. But I can't keep upsetting my Senior Sister, so I'll go coax her."

text: If I had to pick, I'd say a high vantage point for a sweeping panorama!
Finally, I can paint in peace.
Shh, let me finish drawing first!
Water distorts shapes and alters colors of scenery, fascinating.
Anyone can follow the rules. I'd rather blaze my own trail.
Not yet, I'm still mixing the colors.
Goose-yellow willows, moonlit dark greens—I know these classic artist's colors, but they're not my taste.
Mist on the mountain is blue, at the horizon it's red. Yet mist has no color, and in its neutrality, it enriches the landscape.
While others simply draw the dragon bones, I insist on incorporating the pool as a mirror. I love the angles no one else notices.
Did you get into a fight?
Why? Do I look that scary?
Not just painting, actually. Anyone who's determined to accomplish something tends to be a bit stubborn.
Unfortunately, we're all like this in our training hall, with Qing being the worst.
He loves high, dangerous spots, feels freest there... Maybe one day he'll turn into a bird? Just kidding.
But if there's a safe way to do it, I'd love to see the world from a bird's perspective.
Just don't fall off the cliff. You'll be crying for my help.
But he just can't stop going up the mountain.
Was that place truly so marvelous that it was worth being reckless for?
Why follow my lead? You can't pull off my techniques.
How can I mix the color of water's sheen?
This place really offers a different view...
By the way... Tian Ji! Where did Tian Ji go...
Go away, go away, don't disturb the master... Ouch, my hand...
zh_text: 一边去一边去，别打扰大人做事……哎哟，我的手……
source_text: 一边去一边去，别打扰大人做事……哎哟，我的手……
official_target_text: Go away, go away, don't disturb the master... Ouch, my hand...
official_en_text: Go away, go away, don't disturb the master... Ouch, my hand...

text: The girl said goodbye to her loved ones and closed her eyes forever at just 21...
The General... branded as a war criminal... shunned by history...
A warrior... his undefeated pride shattered in an instant, left groveling at the victor's feet, begging for mercy...
The Dreamweaver foresaw the tragic end of our clan... and you call it the law of dreams...?
They begged for your help in nightmares, yet you bound them forever with your so-called prophecy.
Look at the shattered visage of the Butterfly Envoy... I consumed cocoon after cocoon... swallowed butterfly after butterfly...
Look at this cave shrouded in nightmares... They've been weeping in dreams... fading away endlessly in dreams...
You knew how it would end... yet you never helped them!
Help! Monsters! Monsters are going to eat me!
Oh no, how did he get in there?
Oh no, how did he get in there?
What do you think? I'm one of his favorite students.
I've never heard of such a... student.
I've never heard of such a... student.
As long as you don't mess things up, I'm sure I can complete the Dreamscape training.
Why are you eavesdropping on someone's class...
The teacher mentioned a <001>trainee student</>. That must be you.
The teacher mentioned a <001>trainee student</>. That must be you.
Put the collected Mind Shadow Energy in here as the journal suggests.
Put the collected Mind Shadow Energy in here as the journal suggests.
The butterfly... it's guiding me. The cage of thorns has been broken.
The butterfly... it's guiding me. The cage of thorns has been broken.
Why not give me a little more time?
I'll find my own answer... The future isn't limited to what's written in the prophecy.
Remember the prophecy I made for you?
When you see the butterfly again, everything will be settled.
Have you seen it? The pain of those trapped in nightmares.
I thought eating their nightmares would help, but the dreams just repeat.
In the realm of dreams, a thousand changes unfold.
I will witness the beginning and end of your training.
Let's call it a day. We'll continue tomorrow.
Am I the butterfly, or is the butterfly me?
No, your training is not over yet.
You could have foreseen a better ending, one that makes them forget the pain.
You thought this was self-cultivation, but you're actually bound by the desire to eat dreams in this Dreamy Grotto.
Now it's time I fulfill that prophecy and find freedom for you.
Your journey is long... Free and carefree... Follow your dreams...
Oh... it... turned into a butterfly...
Oh... it... turned into a butterfly...
Heh... The Dreamscape changes endlessly. It's never just one Dreamslayer.
Maybe a Dream Butterfly has returned, or perhaps a Dreamweaver has finally awakened.
Is this one of your predictions, Master?
Is this one of your predictions, Master?
You'll fulfill your own wish and discover your true self.
A chance encounter, you followed me in training, grasped the laws of dreams, and sought answers within yourself.
You felt suffering in people's dreams and decided to devour those nightmares for them.
Master Zhuangzi, is it Dreamslayer or a butterfly?
Master Zhuangzi, is it Dreamslayer or a butterfly?
That's... hard to understand. Could it be part of my Dreamscape training?
That's... hard to understand. Could it be part of my Dreamscape training?
In ten thousand dreams, a thousand changes.
official_target_text: In ten thousand dreams, a thousand changes.
official_en_text: In ten thousand dreams, a thousand changes.

text: A chance encounter. You follow me on this path of cultivation, seeking to comprehend the laws of dreams and find your own answers.
zh_text: 一场偶遇，你随我修行，参悟梦之规律，寻求自我的答案。
source_text: 一场偶遇，你随我修行，参悟梦之规律，寻求自我的答案。
official_target_text: A chance encounter. You follow me on this path of cultivation, seeking to comprehend the laws of dreams and find your own answers.
official_en_text: A chance encounter. You follow me on this path of cultivation, seeking to comprehend the laws of dreams and find your own answers.

text: Dreams are reflections of reality, memories hold emotions... Please, you have to help me find him.
The children hiding here are about to be consumed by nightmares...
Touch my Mind Shadow and open the Dreamscape of the past to seek.
To find the child... I have to touch this dream?
To find the child... I have to touch this dream?
So... dreams hold the answers to all my training questions...
But what if... dreams can't give me the answers I seek?
The butterfly will find the answer for you.
What we should pay attention to most in Dreamscape Training... is the teacher's butterfly?
If I see the butterfly, it's a dream... If I don't see the butterfly...
You've just temporarily forgotten who you are...
Her teacher's prophecy once brought her hope, yet just as that hope was about to arrive, it made her witness despair instead.
The poor general was trapped in endless wars, standing atop piles of bleached bones, listening to his name being cursed by history.
Did Master Zhuangzi experience all these Dreamscape dreams?
Did Master Zhuangzi experience all these Dreamscape dreams?
A proud warrior lost his sword, lost his name, wanders forever, and is forever despised.
It's like what the teacher mentioned in Sorcery class... the morning mushroom and the cicada...
It's like what the teacher mentioned in Sorcery class... the morning mushroom and the cicada...
Dreamslayers are sad and terrifying creatures. They know only endless hunger...
Dreamslayers aren't supposed to feel sympathy, are they?
Dreamslayers aren't supposed to feel sympathy, are they?
Dream or reality? Dreamslayer trained with Master Zhuangzi here...
Dream or reality? Dreamslayer trained with Master Zhuangzi here...
The sound is coming from behind the door. How do I get in... Wait, it seems these butterflies know the way...
The sound is coming from behind the door. How do I get in... Wait, it seems these butterflies know the way...
You've awakened these monsters. Hmph, you'd better pray for luck.
So many nightmare creatures... This place really is dangerous.
So many nightmare creatures... This place really is dangerous.
Who are you? Why are you trespassing on my training grounds?
Just leave if you don't want trouble. Don't disturb my thinking...
Back when I was poor, you foretold that I'd gain boundless wealth by the age of twenty.
I'd like to ask, Sage, what other moments of brilliance can we expect in this glorious life?
Your life will end at twenty-one.
So I struggled to survive and finally got the life I wanted.
The day I decided to reclaim my homeland, I met you. You said my wish would come true.
Respected Sage, now that our homeland has been reclaimed, how can I bring lasting peace to our people?
The wanderers you exiled will return, and the war will rage on for centuries, until everything is reduced to ruins.
Haha, you once said I'd never be the greatest Martial Artist. But now I've gone thousands of matches without losing.
Far away from here, a martial artist remains undefeated after thousands of battles. And he's on his way here.
I see it, Sage. In the future, people will build me a grand statue, grateful for the fine dreams I bring.
In the Dreamscape, the moons rise and fall endlessly, and that statue shall forever stand here, receiving offerings...
But fine dreams turn into nightmares shrouding this land, <001>the greedy Dreamslayer</> lingers...
Sage... I'm willing to... train with you...
When <001>Rosy Cage</> is broken, you will meet the outcome of your training.
Tell me... when can I fully devour the dream of sentient pain...
The day the <001>Cage of Thorns</> is broken, you will reap the results of your training.
zh_text: <001>荆棘囚笼</>被破除之日，你将迎来修行的结果。
source_text: <001>荆棘囚笼</>被破除之日，你将迎来修行的结果。
official_target_text: The day the <001>Cage of Thorns</> is broken, you will reap the results of your training.
official_en_text: The day the <001>Cage of Thorns</> is broken, you will reap the results of your training.

text: My teacher asked me to... Hey, wait...
My teacher asked me to... Hey, wait...
Master... Zhuangzi? Why is your Sorcery Projection here?
Master... Zhuangzi? Why is your Sorcery Projection here?
This is Dreamy Grotto. Students trained here to learn the laws of dreams.
Patterns of dreams... sounds like divination and changes mentioned in Sorcery class...
Patterns of dreams... sounds like divination and changes mentioned in Sorcery class...
Let me open the door to training for you. Go find that student lost in Dreamscape training.
The moment foretold has arrived, and you're right on time.
Dreamscape is unpredictable, but sometimes it offers glimpses of the future, revealing fortune and disaster.
Some lose themselves in predicting future changes and fall into a trap.
Master... are you saying your disciple got lost in the Prophecy Dream?
Master... are you saying your disciple got lost in the Prophecy Dream?
Correct. These Dreamscape are corroding his training and turning into uncontrollable nightmares. If we don't act in time, he'll completely turn into a monster.
Sounds dangerous. Aren't you going to rescue him?
Sounds dangerous. Aren't you going to rescue him?
Remember, adaptability is key in Dreamscape training.
So... are we just going to wait here for an answer?
So... are we just going to wait here for an answer?
I left my Sorcery Projection here to fulfill the prophecy I made for him, and you are the one destined to reveal his fate.
The Training Gate is open—follow the butterfly and find that lost <001>Trainee</>.
A past he chose to discard, the echo of a bygone event, a memory that needs to be forgotten.
zh_text: 一个被他割舍抛弃的过去，一段往事的残响，一段需要被忘记的回忆。
source_text: 一个被他割舍抛弃的过去，一段往事的残响，一段需要被忘记的回忆。
official_target_text: A past he chose to discard, the echo of a bygone event, a memory that needs to be forgotten.
official_en_text: A past he chose to discard, the echo of a bygone event, a memory that needs to be forgotten.

text: You've seen it all. Can you tell me what I am?
It was you... You gave me an answer...
What's going on? I think I just...
You trained here and turned into a Dreamslayer.
You trained here and turned into a Dreamslayer.
Dreamslayer? I was a student, how did I become this?
The day I decided to take on the Oneiric Training, Master said...
Your trial is against greed. The pain will become endless tears... You will forget yourself...
I begged for his help, but he just ignored me.
I can feel the pain from their dreams... The temptation to devour every nightmare...
He said he wouldn't help me, but also claimed my training wouldn't end in loss.
So that's how it is... Master Zhuangzi's prophecy, it's unbelievable.
So that's how it is... Master Zhuangzi's prophecy, it's unbelievable.
He will always be there, at the beginning and end of my training... no matter what form he takes.
Now that my training is over, what should I do next?
Dialogue with the child after combat.
“Your cultivation is a confrontation with greed, and pain will become endless tears... You will forget yourself...”
zh_text: “你的修行是与贪婪的对抗，痛苦将成为无尽的眼泪……你会忘记自己……”
source_text: “你的修行是与贪婪的对抗，痛苦将成为无尽的眼泪……你会忘记自己……”
official_target_text: “Your cultivation is a confrontation with greed, and pain will become endless tears... You will forget yourself...”
official_en_text: “Your cultivation is a confrontation with greed, and pain will become endless tears... You will forget yourself...”

text: The nightmare energy here has intensified, and there are many Dream Cocoons.
The nightmare energy here has intensified, and there are many Dream Cocoons.
Ten thousand dreams originate from me, and I become the butterfly. Let us return to one and head toward a more distant future.
zh_text: 万梦由吾，化蝶为吾，让我们回到一体，去往更遥远的未来吧。
source_text: 万梦由吾，化蝶为吾，让我们回到一体，去往更遥远的未来吧。

text: Student, come answer some questions! There's a surprise if you get them all right! You have to answer correctly to pet me, honk! Answer wrong, and you'll get pecked, honk!
There are three questions about the Hundred Schools of Thought here. Please, listen to the questions.
Answer the question correctly to pet me, honk! Answer wrong and you get pecked, honk!
Sure, I'm looking forward to it.
Sure, I'm looking forward to it.
First question: Junior Xiaoming had a dream last night that he fell into a huge ruin pit.
At the bottom of the pit is a mysterious beast whose face cannot be clearly seen. Xiao Ming wakes up quite troubled by this dream.
Who should he go to for dream interpretation?
Wrong! Scholars of relics must conduct repeated on-site surveys.
Wrong! I told you I couldn't see their face clearly. Asking was a waste of time.
Wrong! An astrologer might tell you what this dream portends, but they cannot fully interpret your dreams.
Gaa gaa, you got it right! Questions about dreams should of course be asked to Master Zhuangzi.
Which of the following is not a school certified by the Jixia Academy?
Wrong! All that delicious fish was fed to the dogs.
Wrong! You are punished with no food for three days.
Gaa gaa, you got it right! Just because there isn't one now doesn't mean there won't be in the future. I'm very optimistic about the novelist's potential.
Wrong! Senior Meng Ya is coming to beat you up with the Huntian.
Which of the following is a legendary angler?
Wrong! Did this kid go blast fishing with Novar again? I'm going to report him to the Academy Management Committee.
Gaa gaa, you got it right!
Wrong! The fish were caught by the automaton; what does that have to do with him?
Wrong! Using magic to weave a net is called fishing, not angling.
Master Yu Huan's fish dishes are superb. He often feeds me too. You should go to Qingyi Pavilion and try them sometime.
Congratulations on answering all the questions correctly. If you meet us elsewhere, be sure to answer enthusiastically too.

Help me find other plants affected by such ore. There should be two more spots above.

Come back after collecting ores from these three spots. Don't worry! I won't let anyone work for nothing.

Also, I need more research samples. We can trade if you have that ore.
That was close! Looks like this ore not only causes abnormal growth in plants but also sends them into a frenzy.
You saved me life. Thank you!
Come quickly! This could be the biggest herbology discovery since the founding of Jixia Academy!
I'm Lu Shen... a novice Herbalist. But I'm just as good as the famous ones.
How many Herbalists can modify their Dashing Wings like I did and find their way into this hidden spot?
Those Mechcraft monsters outside have been chasing me all day, and I haven't even had a chance to cook my meal.
I even lost my backpack, but I discovered something magnificent!
Very soon, the whole Jixia will know my name.
I can trade you my supplies for your Volcanic Gravels.
Looks like this ore not only causes abnormal growth in plants but also sends them into a frenzy.
I'll continue my research here. Please proceed with caution. The place is unusual.
More samples are always welcome. Bring everything you've collected to me if possible.
This is the first time I've seen something like this!
Looks like the plants in these three spots are growing at an abnormally fast rate.
Looks like the plants in these three spots are growing at an abnormally fast rate.

text: Oh. I heard about it. That quake... it was someone fighting up there.
An ancient hero whose soul was corrupted. He chose to be sealed here, to protect everyone.
The new student challenged him? So the hero... he's gone?
Yes... Perhaps he finally found peace.
A corrupted soul, trapped here alone for hundreds, even thousands of years. It must have been incredibly lonely.
I don't know him, but he must be a true hero. We must preserve the relics from his era.
And study their technology, too! Don't even think about hogging that keystone.
Fine. Just promise you won't take it apart...
Return to routine after defeating Fallspring.
That noise from atop the pillar. It wasn't an earthquake, was it?
No... I heard there's an ancient hero sealed up there...
Yufeng, I've been wondering, what is this grand central pillar for?
Hmm... It's said to be related to the Enlightenment Trials in the past.
Yes, but quite different. It was deadly and rigorous. People risked their lives.
Did you feel that surge of Sorcery energy from above?
Yes, and sounds too. Distant, but clear.
Everyone up there... Please stay safe...
About the top of the central pillar.
Is there a way to skip the keystone?
Don't even try. Thinking about your destructive Crafter tricks again?
Destructive? It's called deconstruct. We must dismantle it to understand it, alright?
Not gonna happen. Everything here is important. Can't let you break things.
Captain Gu Lai has sent someone to search for the keystone. I heard it's been discovered in the basement.
Seeker theories again, huh? Important this and important that.
Never seen it before, huh? This is a Servant, an ancient Mechcraft we discovered in the ruins.
The School of Mechcraft modified it, and now it can respond to basic commands.
It can do complex repairs and also plays a crucial role in exploring the ruins.
The Servant is from here, and many traps meant for outsiders won't be triggered by it.
Enough chit-chat. I need to get this repair machine built fast or we're delaying today's excavation again.
What's happening... strange energy fluctuations are coming from the top of the pillar.
My hair is standing on end... Is there something sinister atop the pillar?
That was intense. Whatever happens, I must decode these inscriptions.
Perhaps we'll find the truth behind that war!
We're dealing with severe weathering... This is impossible.
Perhaps we'll find the truth behind that war!
I must find a way to decipher the text here.
zh_text: 一定要想办法破译此处的文字。
source_text: 一定要想办法破译此处的文字。
official_target_text: I must find a way to decipher the text here.
official_en_text: I must find a way to decipher the text here.

text: What a pain, restoring these ancient texts...
A lapse in focus and it's back to square one.
After that quake, the restoration somehow got easier...
But any lapse in focus and it's back to square one.
I heard that new student challenged the ancient hero atop the pillar.
But the hero had long since been corrupted. At last, he can rest in peace...
So that surge in Sorcery energy signaled his passing... For a brief moment, we shared space with a hero of legend.
Did he pass the Enlightenment Trials? Is that how he transcended time?
I think so, yes. But fighting the corruption—that was all his own willpower. No gift could have done that.
How powerful... the will of mankind.
Regular dialogue after the battle with Fallspring.
To think we were so close to history...
Hard to imagine how he managed to do it all on his own...
That rumble... was it an earthquake? Yisin, are you okay?
Phew... that was scary. The noise came from above. Probably not an earthquake.
But you're actually worried about me? That's new.
You were right next to the keystone. If you fell with it...
Seriously? Seekers and their obsession with relics... Ugh!
What? And here I just submitted a request for forced entry.
You're amazing. I thought no one could find that keystone.
You do live up to your reputation!
The captain also said many good things about you.
Things are more complicated than we thought.
Also, the central shaft is completely sealed off.
Could someone be intentionally concealing secrets within?
Three of our members are in trouble and need your assistance.
I got this. Please tell me their exact positions and situations.
I got this. Please tell me their exact positions and situations.
The second member's name is <001>Shuke</>. He's studying the Divine Imprint and has heard that some of them are faintly glowing in the nearby pool.
As a member of the Herb Society, he went to investigate. We haven't heard from him. Please go check the lake.
Hello, you look a bit unfamiliar. Are you the great hero Gu Lai spoke of?
I heard you easily helped the vanguard drive out those pesky Rebels, and here you are.
Her name is <001>Qiao Siyuan</>. She said she was going to survey the ore deposits, but she hasn't come back yet.
According to other team members, she took three Servants and headed to the exposed mineral deposits where the Rebels are active. I hope she doesn't run into them.
She was at the pond on the left outside the gate. Could you please check why she's taking so long?
The third one is <001>Jiashu</>. He's an expert in the study of plants and their relationship with water.
He's by the water under the large tree in the central area. Something's off with the plants there.
These statues were likely erected by the Sanctified to commemorate some of their notable members.
I had the errand team on the lookout. They might have found something.
Thank you so much. I heard from the team. You really saved their skins back there.
Who would've thought that each of these four statues would have such a compelling story?
But everything is different now. Those stories have been buried for ages.
Without your help, the story of the four righteous might have remained buried forever.
Wait. Something just happened atop the pillar...
How could those Rebels just take everything...
They came prepared. Probably intended to destroy all valuable items.
My ingredients... Phew, they're all here!
Let me check again... Huh? Why are there so few? Where are my ingredients?
I only brought some light food to save space in the Mechcrafts.
To make matters worse, some of the food was raided by Rebels. Now we have to ration it.
Not sure if the ingredients will last until the academy sends supplies. I should have brought more, even if it was inconvenient.
We tried to track them, but there were too few of us...
Maybe hunger's playing tricks, but I've been hearing noises by the <001>pond</> lately.
<001>The pond closest to me</>. You can go check it out.
Hmm... if we each cut our food by one-third...
That's more like it! We can finally stop worrying!
New ingredients and cookware are coming in. I need to develop new dishes!
Don't forget to come by later. I'll serve you extra.
The Rebels have been dealt with.
Goodbye. Don't forget to eat on time every day!
Hey, you're here! Check out what I have!
All kinds of ingredients I could never get when I was trapped here.
Feel free to pick whatever you like. Resources are plentiful now!
This is the true skill of a Gourmet Society member, much more important than tracking ingredient usage!
Plenty of food is prepared, I don't want to make meals with bare minimum ingredients anymore.
I just heard about what you did. That hero's story... it moved me to tears.
I may not be as strong as either of you. But I've made up my mind to double down on my patrols.
Protecting this camp with my own hands—that's why I'm here with the team!
Humph, if I catch them, I'll give them a good lesson.
Captain Gu Lai saw my skills and gave me a chance to join the vanguard.
Are you a senior member of the vanguard? I'd love to spar with you sometime.
I'm new to the expedition team, but I didn't make the cut for the first group.
The Rebels here are out of control—seniors almost died because of them!
Don't wander around. The place is dangerous.
We should have a practice match some day.
A huge noise came from the central pillar just now. Were you there?
Are you hurt? The people at the camp can patch you up.
About the noise from the top.
That hero's tale still brings tears to my eyes.
I'm Fenyi from the Craft Society, here to assist in repairing Servants and other Mechcrafts.
I'd love to meet the designer. I have so many questions.
Lately, I've been busy all the time, except when I eat or sleep.
And with the earthquakes lately, even the Servants and other Mechcrafts can get damaged.
But these don't seem to be ordinary earthquakes. The shock waves are too powerful.
If you ever need help in the future, don't be shy.
Something to fix? Just write down what's wrong and leave it with me.
I've never seen such efficient and simple design before. The wisdom of the ancients is truly remarkable.
Those Rebels destroyed almost all the Mechcrafts, keeping me busy since I got here.
Wow, a real Mechcraft... I thought it was just a statue.
The structure seems intact with no visible damage. I wonder what the interior looks like?
Perhaps it just needs some simple adjustments to get moving.
Shh, keep it down. Don't let those Rebels spot us.
Can't you tell? I'm keeping an eye on the Rebels.
They set up camp up ahead. They tried to be discreet, but it's not like they could fool me!
The ruins are massive. There must be plenty of important discoveries to be made.
I must keep a close eye on the Rebels. Can't let them cause trouble in the camp again.
You should know I'm one of the best Seekers in Jixia!
Ahem... Keep it down, keep it low-key.
But these guys went all out, even ambushing our elite squad, just to get here. It looks like someone leaked the information.
Anyway, stop bothering me. I'm trying to locate the Rebels' base.
You might find our lost equipment and supplies there.
Finally, no more watching those Rebels! My eyes were getting tired!
The Seeker Society is all about exploring and documenting the wonders of the world!
I'm one of the top Seekers in Jixia! Hmph!
Anyway, this place is dangerous. You must be careful.
I never imagined an archaeological expedition could be so dangerous.
Not just Rebels, but also tough Mechanoids. The expedition team has their work cut out...
Flowy, have you ever studied a gigantic Bronze Mechcraft like this?
Same. But there's a reason for this. Bronze is difficult to work with, and we rarely use it in Mechcrafts now.
I believe ancient technologies were advanced, so using other metals shouldn't have been hard. Why stick with bronze?
This implies they may have harnessed bronze's other uses, possibly using these patterns as symbols to unlock its mysterious powers.
That sounds impressive... Do you have any evidence?
How many are in the vanguard? One... Two... Three...
Whatever! Just count however many tents there are!
How many more tents to set up, Man Qing? My back...
I... I can't remember! Let's just use everything we can!
What? How many more? I thought we prepared tents that could accommodate twice the number of the vanguard...
Just being prepared! Isn't that what a Strategist would advise?
Man Qing... you should focus on using your brain for the right things, like sorcery...
Got it, got it! I'll cheer for you this time, and join you next time!
Ugh, give me a hand, I can still manage.
Man Qing, pass me the hammer. I'll tighten this nail...
I wonder where the ancients quarried this stone from. It's too hard...
Are you the new student Captain Gu Lai mentioned? The one who made it here through the cascading light? Quite impressive.
If only that light cascade could take us out of here... The wounded would get better treatment outside.
I'm in charge of the team's equipment and medicine. Unfortunately, after the Rebels' attack, we don't have any extra medicine for you.
Yes, several of them. It's those Rebels! They ambushed us from the shadows, and many were injured.
We're all top students, but not everyone is a fighter. They probably knew that and thought they could get away with it. Cowards!
I wonder if I could find useful herbs in the Caelumpila.
Our priority now is to contact the academy.
Those cunning Rebels injured our people and stole important exploration equipment, items from Master Fuzi, and even food and medicine.
As for their whereabouts, you can ask <001>Xiu Yuan</>, the Gourmet over at the <001>Cooking Station</>.
I heard he's been dealing with some unusual events lately.
Hey, need anything? I have all kinds of goods here.
Thanks to you, the supplies are coming in.
So, from daily essentials to adventure gear, I have it all.
To be honest, it took a lot of effort when we first arrived here.
The conditions inside this hidden ancient site are harsh, and we even encountered Rebel attacks.
But you know how it is. Sometimes the biggest risks bring the greatest rewards!
Goodbye, hope to see you again.
Just let me know what you need. Oh, and don't expect any discounts. Running a small business is tough, you know.
To explore the exciting unknown, of course! And maybe make a few trades here and there...
We have a saying back home. "High winds, rough seas—fish costs their fill!"
What a twist! Looks like I bet on the right thing!
The erosion marks are severe, but restoring its original form shouldn't be difficult.
The vanguard has sent plenty of hands, but this is no overnight job.
We can only confirm the remaining traces of Sorcery in the tower and use them to deduce its original intact form.
Once the tent's up, we can focus on our research without any distractions.
I don't know how long it's been since sunlight last shone into this dark depths. I hope these lights continue to illuminate this place.
Finally, I don't have to watch those Rebels anymore!
The Seeker Society is all about exploring and documenting the wonders of the world!
I'm one of the top Seekers in Jixia! Hmph!
A colossal frame of bronze. Immensely powerful and indestructible.
What kind of Mech Core could power such a behemoth?
Hope they approve my request to dismantle it. Can't wait to peek inside this marvel.
Getting it back to the academy is a bit of a problem, though... Wonder if Master Mozi would help.
The captain told us about the inspiring story behind it...
Thanks to you, that ancient hero can finally rest in peace...
Now the danger lurking in the shadows has been eliminated, we can focus on our research with peace of mind.
About the incident at the top.
Hello! You've been a great help! The rest of the work will surely go smoothly.
After we contacted the academy, they immediately dispatched reinforcements.
We have plenty of resources now, and the elites from the School of Martial Arts are guarding the camp.
The crisis seems to have been resolved. We can now fully devote ourselves to exploration work.
Hehe! The flying Mechcraft is finally fixed! That new guy Fenyi is pretty skilled!
The academy must be serious about this expedition. The students they sent later are elites among elites.
Once we're done here, I'm going to ride a flying Mechcraft around the academy!
See you! Oh, by the way, after we're done here, fancy a ride with me?
If we were at the academy, this would have been fixed in a jiffy.
I wonder if there's still a chance for rescue...
Not bad, looks just like new.
I'll enjoy it when I have time.
What happened? What's with the commotion?
Now that's a true hero if I ever saw one!
It sounds like... a beast's growl?
I know you're skilled, but don't underestimate them.
Who are you? Never seen you around.
The Rebels are too annoying. I need more time to study the war simulation here.
Talk to Captain Gu Lai first. There's nothing to see here.
It's you who saved Gu Lai's team, right?
The expedition team consists of the best, but they still need guidance.
Not every member excels in combat.
Don't worry. We professionals will ensure the camp's safety.
Are these... the traces of war?
Look at the scars on these buildings—ancient wars were truly brutal.
This place is odd—not much damage caused by weapons, but significant collapse around the perimeter.
Could it be a giant object from the sky? A mysterious weapon? Or an unknown species?
But none of this makes sense. Though, in war, many things defy logic. Looking back through history...
Oh, sorry, I got carried away with history again.
Watch your step. Don't damage the relics.
War leaves ruins, and victory comes at a high cost. This has always been the way of war...
I'm surprised Rebels are interested in such a hidden place.
What kind of life did they lead...?
I can't stand this. Hope my guard duty ends soon.
Check all blind spots to ensure no Rebels are hiding.
But caves are indeed the best place for ambushes.
The School of Martial Arts sent so many elites?
But since Gu Lai is personally leading the team, this expedition squad must be on a crucial mission.
I must find a way to decipher the text here.
zh_text: 一定要想办法破译此处的文字。
source_text: 一定要想办法破译此处的文字。
official_target_text: I must find a way to decipher the text here.
official_en_text: I must find a way to decipher the text here.
