text: This is the core area of the Underhall. This place is not only vast but also full of dangers.
We're planning to delve deeper next. There are still so many mysteries to uncover.
Rebel troublemakers and internal disputes, especially with that fellow in the basement...
Anyway, we really need the manpower right now. If you could help, that would be great.
We enabled the protection here, so only our members can access the core area of the central pillar.
We have to do it to stop the Rebels.
At first, they were just causing troubles, but they started stealing artifacts we collected.
Selling them may be profitable, but some items are deadly.
Help us destroy the Rebel hideout, and I'll grant you access to the core area.
By then, we probably won't need to keep the protection on all the time.
Thankfully, we've pushed back the Rebels, and now we have a base of operations here.
I thought we were prepared but the exploration went beyond my imagination.
However, the Rebels are cunning. We lost them at the pool near the corner.
One of our team members lost his Servant after a run-in with the Rebels. He's moping <001>by the pond to the left of the camp</>. Poor guy.
You're... a student. How did you manage to reach here alone?
I activated all the Illuminators and a light teleported me here.
I activated all the Illuminators and a light teleported me here.
You've accomplished something so challenging on your own. Impressive!
We're from the academy. The Rebels have been causing us trouble. We need your help.
With a team full of elites, we used special Mechcraft Kites to get in.
We're the advance exploration team for the Tianzhu Ruins, formed by Master Fuzi himself. I'm the captain, Gu Lai.
However, the Rebels were one step earlier than us. I think they found a hidden underground waterway.
The speculation was right—the Rebels have been hiding in the waterway depths!
You did us a great favor. I really don't know how to thank you.
You're now an official member of our team. I'll grant you access to all areas.
Now that the Rebels' hideout has been destroyed, I'll have the team disable the protection.
However, we still need to stay alert. They are everywhere.
The threat of the Rebels has been temporarily lifted. We can now focus on the central pillar.
The more we uncover, the more mysteries we encounter, making us marvel at the greatness of the ancients.
Alright, I must continue my work, as there are still too many mysteries here unresolved...
Rebel troublemakers and internal disputes, especially with that fellow in the basement...
Anyway, we really need the manpower right now. If you could help, that would be great.
I thought we were prepared but the exploration went beyond my imagination.
We've discovered some ancient findings in the core area of the central pillar but still haven't found the way to the top of the pillar.
I think the pedestal in front of the pillar holds the <001>Keystone</>, but it's nowhere to be found.
We've been unable to find it anywhere, and now only the <001>basement</> remains unsearched.
The problem is that no one knows how to unlock the entrance.
Our team's Intelligencer, <001>Wuji</>, is investigating the basement. Talk to him if you meet him.
The entrance to the basement isn't far from <001>Fenyi's workbench</>. Once inside, just head downwards.
I'm Gu Lai, captain of the expedition team.
We are short on hands, but with your help, we can press on.
Alright, I must continue my work, as there are still too many mysteries here unresolved...
I'm Gu Lai, captain of the expedition team.
Rebel troublemakers and internal disputes, especially with that fellow in the basement...
Well, let's just say we're grateful for any help we can get. Thank you.
I've completed Bai Lu's request, but she's nowhere to be found. Is she at the camp?
I've completed Bai Lu's request, but she's nowhere to be found. Is she at the camp?
Who's Bai Lu? I don't think she's in our team.
Are you too tired? Remember to rest and eat on time!
Xiu Yuan is our Gourmet. His dishes are to die for. You can find him at the camp.
Impressive—you found the keys and made it!
We're starting our follow-up investigation now. This mysterious Tianzhu space will be a major discovery for cultural research.
I thought we were prepared but the exploration went beyond my imagination.
We don't have enough staff. When will the academy send us more help?
You're now an official member of our team. I'll grant you access to all areas.
Here's the thing. We've hit a snag in our research as we can't find a way to reach the top of the pillar.
I infer that the pedestal in front of the pillar is for placing the Keystone, but the Keystone is missing.
We searched everywhere, except for the <001>basement</>.
I hope the academy can send more people to support the Central Pillar area soon.
I wonder how Xin Wuji's research in the basement is progressing...
You actually found the entrance to the Underhall? Unbelievable! How'd you get here?
I activated all the Illuminators and a light teleported me here.
I activated all the Illuminators and a light teleported me here.
So that legend is true! Too bad we searched for a long time but couldn't find it. You guys are really impressive.
About the barrier of the central pillar.
This is the central pillar, the heart of the Underhall. But information about this place is scarce. It's said to be older than Jixia Academy.
We're the vanguard expedition team of Master Fuzi, and I'm the captain.
The members of the expedition team are all elites of the Society, with deep accomplishments in their respective fields.
But due to the Rebels' ambush, many team members were injured.
Anyway, we really need the manpower right now. If you could help, that would be great.
The barrier before you is a defensive mechanism of the Underhall, originally designed to prevent natural disasters or enemy invasions from damaging the central pillar.
Before we set out, Master Fuzi gave us an energy core he discovered elsewhere that can open it.
But they got raided by Rebels...
If only we could use the Illuminators to get them out...
If we could contact the academy, we could get the supplies the Rebels took back.
The supplies those Rebels took are crucial. We need you to retrieve them.
We tried tracking them, but the expedition team was too small, and we couldn't find them...
But there's been something strange going on <001>around the camp</> lately, maybe related to the Rebels. You can ask my <001>team members</> for more information.
This is... great! These are the supplies stolen by the Rebels! The stolen energy cores and repair tools are all inside!
Once we fix the flying Mechcraft, we'll be able to reestablish contact with the outside world.
You did us a great favor. I really don't know how to thank you.
The core Master Fuzi gave us is also here. I'll have my team use this core to disable the defensive mechanism of the central pillar.
The team will assist you in exploring the Central Pillar. You can move between areas as you like.
We will request the academy to dispatch more personnel to assist in exploration and research.
Have you found our important equipment?
The vanguard is short on hands, but with your help, we won't be stuck here by the Rebels.
The academy will send more people to help, and we can continue our exploration.
The Rebels are dealt with for now. We can explore the Central Pillar.
But the more we unearth, the more mysteries emerge, making us marvel at the greatness of the ancients.
I'll keep working hard. There are still too many mysteries here waiting to be solved...
We're the advance exploration team for the Tianzhu Ruins, formed by Master Fuzi himself. I'm the captain, Gu Lai.
Despite all the preparations, the challenges encountered while exploring the Central Pillar far exceeded my imagination.
Well, it's understandable. They must be disappointed after being stopped at the very beginning.
Anyway, we really need the manpower right now. If you could help, that would be great.
We've been researching the ancient ruins around the central pillar, but we still can't find a way to the top.
I infer that the pedestal in front of the pillar is for placing the Keystone, but the Keystone is missing.
We've been unable to find it anywhere, and now only the <001>basement</> remains unsearched.
The problem is that no one knows how to unlock the entrance.
The entrance is to my left, a large stone gate.
Follow the steps down, and you'll find the entrance to the basement.
After Gu Lai activates the barrier.
We still have a lot to do...
Thanks to you, we've established contact with the academy, and they immediately dispatched more personnel to construct the Expedition Camp.
Now that we've secured the central area, you're free to explore the entire Central Pillar.
Now that we have enough people at the camp, the Rebels shouldn't dare to attack us again.
Feel free to explore these mysterious ruins, but be careful not to fall off the steep cliffs.
As you can see, our vanguard's manpower and supplies have been sufficiently replenished.
More students will come to study the Underhall.
But as the team grows, the things I need to consider as captain have doubled.
Must have been quite the challenge getting hold of the keystone. Thank you so much.
The pedestal before the column may be where the keystone is placed.
You can try placing the keystone on the pedestal over there.
If it works, it might just open the path to the top of the pillar.
We might uncover the greatest mystery of the central pillar.
Gu Lai obtained the key but did not place it.
Didn't expect the keystone would actually open the path to the top of the pillar.
What could be in that mysterious space at the top of the pillar...
The vanguard is still short of hands. Should we apply for more from the Academy...
Impressive—you found the keys and made it!
We're starting our follow-up investigation now. This mysterious Tianzhu space will be a major discovery for cultural research.
Our research at the base paid off. Here, I can share our findings with you.
Based on the remaining clues, this place was sealed around the time of the Springbrook Plains war.
The war might have reached this place, or someone sealed the upper space for a special purpose.
We need to investigate further to learn the details.
I've completed Bai Lu's request, but she's nowhere to be found. Is she at the camp?
I've completed Bai Lu's request, but she's nowhere to be found. Is she at the camp?
Who's Bai Lu? I don't think she's in our team.
Are you too tired? Remember to rest and eat on time!
Xiu Yuan at the camp has created a new dish, and everyone loves it. You should try it.
After Gu Lai obtains and places the key.
Though the biggest mystery has been solved, there's still plenty of work to do. The vanguard is still short-handed...
The remains of a hero lie hidden atop the pillar. For centuries, he has fought the Phantom Monster every day...
I hope to find something he left behind. The expedition team will pay him proper respects.
Now our job is to explore the ruins, carry on the legacy and spirit of the heroic age. That would be the best comfort for them.
I must continue my work, as there are still too many mysteries here unresolved...
I'll always remember Fallspring's courage and determination. And I'll keep telling his story.
The Seeker Society says only when everyone forgets does a life, a civilization truly perish.
Everyone who remembers helps keep their story alive.
It's been a while since I saw the flowers in Springbrook Plains. Perhaps we can go together when things settle down.
Gu Lai's dialogue after defeating Fallspring.
You are the first student to participate in the Trial of Balance today... The exam is about to begin. Servant C-75 reminds you...
zh_text: 您是今日参加钧衡之试的第一位学子……考试马上开始，神工役丙七五提醒您……
source_text: 您是今日参加钧衡之试的第一位学子……考试马上开始，神工役丙七五提醒您……

text: The foundation of all things lies in stable balance; otherwise, even with ten thousand tons of force, it is still a deviation from the path.
zh_text: 万物之本在于稳妥平衡，否则纵有万钧之力也是剑走偏锋。
source_text: 万物之本在于稳妥平衡，否则纵有万钧之力也是剑走偏锋。

text: United minds forge glory. Servant B-24 standing by.
zh_text: 齐心铸荣，记录神工役乙二四。
source_text: 齐心铸荣，记录神工役乙二四。

text: The Rebels around here are so annoying!
None of them returned. I think I shouldn't go alone. Can you locate them for me?
Once you locate all three Servants, check their conditions and report back to me.
I've named them <001>Servant No. 9</>, <001>Servant No. 10</>, and <001>Servant No. 11</>.
I sent them to the mining area to explore.
I could do experiments here, but something strange has happened.
I've managed to repair three Servants.
Hey, do you see these three sealed Mechcraft Statues in the central area?
Yes, they are. And for some reason, they seem to hold some special power.
Bring me their parts to study, and that treasure chest is yours.
The location of the sealed Mechanoid Statues.
They are sealed next to the pond on the right side of the camp, and in the ruins behind the central pillar.
The last one is at the quarry on the left side of the camp, but it's extremely dangerous there.
If you find anything on them, please bring it to me!
I'm a Craft Society member who came with the vanguard. We're low on supplies, but luckily, my tools are still intact!
I'm really interested in those sealed Mechanoids in the surrounding areas!
But be careful. These Mechanoids are almost in perfect condition.
If the seals are released, they might resume their attacks once again.
These Mechanoids were once the Sanctified's powerful combat resource, but they were sealed here for some reason.
Strange. The records indicate the Sanctified were stretching thin at that point.
Why did they seal up the Mechanoids? How puzzling.
But these three parts do radiate a mysterious energy. I must study them carefully.
By the way, I found a Runestone in the wreckage of a Mechanoid. I sense strong Divine Imprint energy within it.
It'd be a waste if it were mine, so I might as well give it to you. I hope you'll find its uses.
As I expected, these three Mechanoids are operational again. Thank you for your efforts.
This Runestone isn't a standard Mechanoid component. It contains a huge amount of Divine Imprint energy.
But with my professional knowledge, I have no idea what such a Sorcery Runestone could be used for.
Hmm? I was just about to collect some water samples for testing.
The plants here are unusual. I'm wondering if it's related to the water source.
From what I've seen, this pool doesn't appear natural.
It might be a reservoir set up by the ancient builders. If that's the case, there should be a drainage Mechcraft nearby.
Did you find the drainage Mechcraft? The water level here has dropped!
Unfortunately, I haven't collected the water samples yet. I'll need to find another pool.
This is crucial. I need to inform everyone right away.
I remember seeing one in the <001>deep pond to the left of the west gate</>. Hurry, before someone else takes it.
The spring is in bad shape! What should we do?
The spring runs underground, and the pollution is severe enough to affect the local residents.
Could you please help me find a plant called <001>Stonecrusher Grass</> to purify the spring?
It's an ancient aquatic plant used to purify water.
But due to its demanding growth conditions, requiring shade to thrive, it's extremely rare.
And due to its strong absorptive powers, it often contains a large amount of toxins.
Toxic creatures love it, as it helps them replenish their toxins.
Eliminate the vines ambushing in the pond.
Perfect. Give the <001>Stonecrusher Grass</> to me.
I found a Runestone while testing the water.
But I'm not exactly sure what these items do.
Maybe it's related to the statue Dowming found inside the core. Take it for now.
Eliminate the vines in the Secluded Lake.
Did you take care of it?
I'll stay here to keep monitoring the spring. It should be fine soon.
Eliminate the vines in the spring.
I remember seeing one <001>in the deep pond to the left of the west gate</>. Hurry, before someone else takes it.
The universe and everything within it are full of mysteries.
I'm a Herb researcher with the Gu Lai Expedition Team. Just call me Jiashu.
As my name indicates, I love plants and the soil they grow in.
The plants here grow incredibly fast, unlike those on the surface.
Our studies suggest it's related to the unique minerals found here.
But this rampant growth is only found in collapsed areas.
I believe the ancient builders of this site had a way to mitigate the effects of these ores.
The lotus flowers in <001>the pool beside the west gate</> are pretty normal. Maybe the secret lies nearby.
If you find anything there, please bring it to me.
The lotus flowers in the <001>pond by the west gate</> look normal; perhaps the secret lies somewhere nearby.
zh_text: <001>西门旁水池</>里的荷花就没有异样，说不定奥秘就在那附近。
source_text: <001>西门旁水池</>里的荷花就没有异样，说不定奥秘就在那附近。
official_target_text: The lotus flowers in the <001>pond by the west gate</> look normal; perhaps the secret lies somewhere nearby.
official_en_text: The lotus flowers in the <001>pond by the west gate</> look normal; perhaps the secret lies somewhere nearby.

text: If I'm not mistaken, this substance should counteract the effects of the ores.
Could you apply it to the trees in the water and see what happens?
You've proven that I was right. Thank you!
I'll include these results in my research report.
There are Rebels nearby. Please proceed with caution.
I'll rest a bit more, and head back to the camp. Please watch out for the Rebels nearby.
Number Nine and Number Eleven are fine, but Number Ten was damaged.
Number Nine and Number Eleven are fine, but Number Ten was damaged.
Ah, these rascals! Now the Captain is going to scold me again for using the ancient artifacts without permission and causing damage!
Anyway, thanks a lot. Please take this as a token of gratitude.
I'll report this to the Captain and Senior Fenyi and ask them to help repair Number Ten.
I hope captain won't make me write a very long report.
I found a Runestone next to a tree nearby.
Maybe it's related to the statue Dowming found inside the core. Take it for now.
I need some time to think how to put it into words...
The three Servants might be in <001>the mining area in front of me</>.
Please help me find them. Thank you!
The three divine labor puppets might be right here in <001>the mining area in front of me</>.
zh_text: 三台神工役可能就在<001>我面前这片矿区</>。
source_text: 三台神工役可能就在<001>我面前这片矿区</>。
official_target_text: The three divine labor puppets might be right here in <001>the mining area in front of me</>.
official_en_text: The three divine labor puppets might be right here in <001>the mining area in front of me</>.

text: Strange, these divine imprints seem to be flickering on and off...
Could there be a hidden secret here?
Did you see the divine imprints in the pool below?
They light up when you get close and dim when you move away.
If all the stones light up at once, what then?
It could be a Sorcery Circle that only activates under certain conditions.
It could be a Sorcery Circle that only activates under certain conditions.
I agree, and based on what I've observed, there are more Divine Imprints underwater.
Usually, a Sorcery Circle requires all its energy channels to be activated simultaneously to function.
Generally speaking, activating a magic circle requires all the energy sources maintaining it to operate simultaneously.
zh_text: 一般来说，启动魔道法阵需要所有维系它的能量同时运作。
source_text: 一般来说，启动魔道法阵需要所有维系它的能量同时运作。
official_target_text: Generally speaking, activating a magic circle requires all the energy sources maintaining it to operate simultaneously.
official_en_text: Generally speaking, activating a magic circle requires all the energy sources maintaining it to operate simultaneously.

text: You lit up all the divine imprints at once? Impressive!
I'll continue to observe here and let you know as soon as I find anything new.
All the divine imprints are lit up now.
All the divine imprints are lit up now.
I'm exploring the ruins of the secret chamber here!
It's safer to use ancient Mechcrafts in such a place.
Anyway, what do you think we might find in this chamber?
Monsters, treasures, or new Mechcraft tech? This is so exciting!
Good thing my repair tools are still here.
These Mechcrafts seem to possess some kind of special power.
Back off, trespasser! This is the core area of Caelumpila Ruins...
Are you a student? Did you come here alone? How...
Golden spears and iron horses—I can still hear the songs of the past. When blades clash, I still see the sharpness of old times.
Leaves fall as clouds emerge from the deep valley. Only the sound of clouds moving with the wind can be heard.
Towering ten thousand fathoms high, reaching deep into the abyss. Standing firm to support the vast expanse, echoing with the remnants of ancient wars.
Clouds drift over distant mountains, while golden waves roll nearby. The tide brings the scent of wheat.
Ancient ruins and lush trees. Looking up at the fallen city, it's hard to find the dreams of the past.
The tower is a hundred feet high, one could pluck the stars. Gazing at the vast sea of stars, I realize how small I am.
A place of ancient, solemn silence, where glory once bloomed. The biting wind of the past brushes against my cheeks.
The bronze mirror reaches for the clouds. Immortal faith remains between heaven and earth.
The moonlight is bright, the flower shadows are silent. Sleeping soundly by the lake, a dream of Nanke.
How deep are the stacked tree shadows? Hard to find the depths, where the secret pavilion hides its edge.
The dragon sleeps by the marsh, its body fallen but its soul undying. Eyes fixed on jagged bones, ears ringing with an eternal chant.
Distant mountains in sight, the tower base nearby. To reach the heights and overlook this place, one must exhaust all their strength.
A wise man who contemplates fate and destiny. Follow in his footsteps to gain insight into his brilliant ideas.
A tower that reaches the clouds, a hall to question the truth. The countless first lessons are worth remembering for a lifetime.
Vast heaven and earth, wind rises and grass bows. The wind bypasses the remains, but it cannot bypass the memories of the past.
On the path of seeking, looking up at the stars, the view is filled with flowing light. May this brilliance adorn everyone's journey.
The long streets are bustling with a dazzling array of goods. Merchants and travelers from all over the world gather here.
Hey, the outer ring of the Tongtian Tower... doesn't the shape look a bit different?
I didn't even notice... I guess you're right... When did it become like this?
I've been so busy looking for the secret treasure Senior Lin Xing mentioned lately...
I remember... it shouldn't have changed before the Dream Performance finals started...
Hey, the outer ring of the Tongtian Tower... doesn't the shape look a bit different?
I didn't even notice... I guess you're right... When did it become like this?

Treasure in the Restricted Ground... Is that true?
I snuck in there once, but found nothing.
Why not just ask Lin Xing for clues?
And miss proving my wit and courage? No way.
The outer ring of the Tower of Enlightenment is broken...
What if the debris above falls and hits someone?
Want to learn more about the treasure in the Restricted Ground?
You could ask the students who participated in the challenge back then; some of them are still teaching at the school.
<001>Liu Jiao on the second floor of the School of Mechcraft, Heng Jun in the weapon forge at the School of Martial Arts</>...
Go ask them; you might be able to find some useful information.
Great! The previous guards have been removed. Now I can access the documents here.
Looks like they researched things students shouldn't have touched. No wonder it was sealed off. Take a look if you're curious.

Through my research on the academy's history, I discovered that this was once an academy itself, filled with talents like the other schools. But for some reason, it was abandoned, and the records of it are scarce.
Just don't interrupt my research, and I won't interrupt yours. Oh, and if you want to study these materials too, be careful not to damage them.
Who are you? You look like a student. You know you can't be here, right?
But I'm not a teacher, so whatever you say stays with me.
Thank you for saving me! I thought I was going to be dinner.
The monster took a look at the toy Mechanoid I picked up, then left. There was a battered Mechanoid nearby, but luckily, I wasn't hurt.
Take the treasure chest as a token of my gratitude. I'll meet up with my friends soon, so don't worry about me.
Thank you so much! I'll go find my friend right away.
My friend and I used Sorcery techniques to evade the Mechcrafts and made it here. But for some reason, the Mechcrafts suddenly activated, and my friend got trapped inside.
It's the Mechanoid outside. If it detects someone entering, it'll activate and the door will lock!
Wait, was it because of me...?
Wait, was it because of me...?
Something's wrong with my Sorcery Technique. Please help me open this door and save my friend.
Oh, hey there! Can you lend a hand?
So, did you find anything cool?
You're not thinking of going again, are you?
Wait... you went in and came out unscathed?
Wow, that sounds exciting! I've never seen a shape-shifting monster before!
I... I still feel dizzy. I'll pass this time.
After clearing the level, you meet the two Martial Arts students again.
Oh, I didn't expect anyone else to make it here. But I suggest you leave—this isn't a place for students.
Further ahead lies the Restricted Ground, deserted but guarded by Mechcraft sentinels. Curious?
I do want to go in.
Not bad. Here's a hint: there are many Mechcraft sentinels, but most are on the ground. You can <001>take the rooftops.</>
Haha, he's been caught a few times, but then he found it easier to walk along the rooftops. Getting caught isn't so bad, actually—they just send you back to the entrance.
I see. I don't recommend going there. It's off-limits to students.
No thanks. I get tossed every time they catch me, and my head's still spinning. You go ahead if you want, but good luck.
Two Martial Arts students on the way to Restricted Ground.

It's too hot up there, so I let my Mechanoid do the work!
If only we could meet the students in the Restricted Ground...

The effects of the two strange 'Little Wood Fence' transformation potions have worn off, and they have returned to human form—it's Senior Zhuge Liang and Senior Zhou Yu. They discuss the future after returning to the Land of Three Kingdoms; this seems to be the final battle of the Yu-Liang rivalry...
With all five bronze armor fragments collected, the history of Qiushui's war and the clues leading to The Underhall are finally becoming clear...
Embermane is lured out by the scent of the honey sauce set by Wang Xun and appears before you.

According to the Mozi projection records, Mozi once returned to the depths of the Bastion Fort, to the place where the Hengzhu Flow Mech was once kept. As he mourned, the "Tianheng" system activated—it was an operating system formed within the mech after the Hengzhu Flow, now completely integrated with it.

With the help of the 'Flow's' resonance, you see an echo of the past: The God-Sealer speaks with anger and shatters the bronze stele, dissatisfied with Jixia's forgetting of the heroes of the past, and solemnly recites their names... As he recites, the phantoms of the Divine Forge appear one by one to pay their respects. The God-Sealer returns, vowing to reclaim their glory.

Ding Wuhai hijacked the elite guards sent to intercept him, putting on a manic performance. Upon closer inspection, it seemed to be a bitter recount of the mockery he faced from classmates when he first arrived at Jixia. Suddenly, Ding Wuhai unleashed immense power, swallowing the colors of the entire space into black and white.

The fallen Megadrive Hammer projects a dusty image of the time when the Four Heroes of Jixia were gathered. With graduation approaching, the four sat down to write a farewell poem: 'A wisp of moon over Jixia, drying away the sorrows of the Three Kingdoms...'

The restless Ding-Wu-Hai settles into calm, revealing a magnificent scene—under the aurora created by magic, Zhuge Liang and Sima Yi stand side by side—if the world before us is only black and white, then you and I shall use our own hands to create our own light.
After completing the seven trials of the Cloud Terrace and using the token left by Zhuge Liang, you unlock the seal on the floating rock platform above his secret chamber.
Through Life Echo, Dr Bian and you see the past of Dongfang Jing in the garden. It turns out Dongfang Jing refused to take the potion and personally severed the Shuochun Bud.
After finding all the little radishes, you arrive before the Radish King. In recognition and gratitude for your eradication of the Sprout of Calamity, it shares its power with you.
Place the Blessing of Cooking to see an echo of the past: Villager Yun Shuming used Jixia Fox Wheat to cook Cloud Harvest Flatbread, inviting the villagers to come and enjoy it together.

Place the Blessing of Harvest to see an echo of the past: Hua Qinmi of the Hundred Herbs Family once placed Jixia Fox Wheat before the Prayer Stone, offering a blessing of abundance for the Harvest Fields.

Place the Blessing of Fishing to see an echo of the past: Anglers Man Xiaofeng and Fang Yu waited on the shore of the cave lake, hunting for the strange fish caused by the cloud flow anomalies of that year.
Place the Blessing of Brewing to see an echo of the past: Li Bai, dead drunk, leaned against the back of the Prayer Stone, sipping Cloud Brew and reciting poetry in praise of it.
Qing Ze tells you the origin of the butterfly-wing-shaped fragments and speculates that the dream power within Dream-Whisper Lake has gone out of control.
The Master of Ingenuity appears, his mind clouded by the intrusion of dream energy.
The moment the Master of Ingenuity is defeated, his mind suddenly clears, leaving only regret in his eyes.
Defeat Botu, the thorns dissipate, and the Butterfly Messenger statue glows once again.
Combining the four Dream Fragment Charms causes a wisp of dream energy to rise, pointing toward the Nightmare Grotto.
The Butterfly Envoy statue resonates with the Dream Slate, and the activated map slate reveals new clues.

After obtaining the Burning Mountain Cauldron Keystone on the second basement level, you meet Bai Lu. She is also curious about the final fate of the hero Qiushui and tells you some of his past. She asks you to go see how his story ends, while she sets off for Springbrook Plains.

After arriving at the Central Pillar, you encounter an advance team sent by the academy and are trapped by a magic circle as an intruder. Fortunately, the team leader, Gu Lai, steps in to negate the misunderstanding.
You have finally reached the top of the Central Pillar and found Qiushui, but he is already nearly controlled by the Calamity Beast...
The Calamity Beast is defeated, but Qiushui is fading away. Before dissolving into the wind, he recalls the flowers of Springbrook Plains...
The Three Lights have united, and the path to the Central Pillar has opened.

You see the lingering shadow of the hero Qiushui luring the enemy deep. At this moment, a 'Wind-Thing' collector named Bailu appears, who is also trying to uncover the final fate of this vanished hero. The priority is to find the Divine Craftsman in the Stone Extraction Hall, collect the Burning Mountain Stone Key, and head to the central pillar of light...

You and Bailu see the lingering shadow of the hero Qiushui luring the enemy deep, but what was the hero's fate? The priority is to find the Divine Craftsman in the Stone Extraction Hall, collect the Burning Mountain Stone Key, and head to the central pillar of light...
After returning to the Central Pillar camp with the Burning Mountain Cauldron Keystone, you see reinforcements sent by the academy, and the camp is being repaired with their help.
The sound of mechanisms shifting echoes from the depths of the hall. The stairs begin to rotate, and a new path opens up.
The drill has been started, but it seems some malfunction is still hindering it.

How about this? How much can this thing sell for? More than the treasure of Greenwhisper Pool?
Why won't they listen to me...?
Though the Jixia Mountains are dotted with ruins, this one has a particularly formidable reputation.
Since day one, I've heard about a Mechcraft as tall as a mountain, controlled by a joystick.
And if you time it right, you can use momentum to move the orb and activate Mechcrafts.
What an exquisite prototype design! If we study it thoroughly and apply it elsewhere, we'll surely achieve new breakthroughs.
Look how he talks non-stop about Mechcraft. I was hired as his guide to bring him here.
I don't understand Mechcraft, but if you're interested in the secret treasures passed down in Martial Arts, I have plenty to share.
Is the treasure really hidden in the chest?
I never paid attention to any treasure before Li Yao started nagging me...
Ah! You should've said you're interested in treasures! No one knows more about them than I do!
Legend has it a champion hid a secret manual at the bottom of Greenwhisper Pool. Whoever finds the three keys can claim it.
I'd go myself if I weren't a guide here! What do you think?
Hey, could you help me convince Guo? You two... uh, how about we all go together?
No, I'm not interested. And you, if you can't even crack this Mechcraft, how do you expect to find all the keys?
Feel free to discuss Mechcraft with me anytime.
Stop tinkering with Mechcrafts, remember to go find the treasure!
Yun Xu... I think I've seen this name before...
Yun Xu... I think I've seen this name before...
If I remember correctly, it should be the person Ling Xun, a former member of the Forbidden Chamber, tried to save.
If I remember correctly, it should be the person Ling Xun, a former member of the Forbidden Chamber, tried to save.
Perhaps I can find clues in her laboratory. Anyway, I should document my discoveries here.
Perhaps I can find clues in her laboratory. Anyway, I should document my discoveries here.
A promise? A gift? This is all very mysterious. I'll make a note of it and come back with more clues to go on.
A promise? A gift? This is all very mysterious. I'll make a note of it and come back with more clues to go on.
The gift should be here. Let's search carefully.
The gift should be here. Let's search carefully.
No one has passed the challenge yet.
Don't look at me. I can't do it either.
You got this! I believe in you.
How come I didn't know I could?
No, I don't want to be bedridden for another month.
I predict success, give it a try.
This is too hard for me.
Let's see how others completed it.
Who is he? Why is he sticking around the Aerflow Tower Trial? I must have my words with him!
Don't act rashly. I just fought him. He's stronger than us.
So what do we do? Just give up on the Aerflow Tower trial?
Let's wait here. Maybe someone even stronger will come and teach him a lesson.
Exactly. People would know if someone with my family name does something wrong.
The area is still under construction. Please visit later.
I'm Zhu Buyi. They say when my mother was carrying me, everything went wrong...
Do you know me? Because of my uncle Zhu Yi, right? Hahaha! He's really a big name in Jixia!
Are you related to Zhu Yichong?
I'm helping organize the warehouse. He said he'd leave it in my hands from now on.
Let me think... What should we use it for? How about a lounge for the Cannon Society?
Just watch out for that cannon... or...
Just watch out for that cannon... or...
Right, but that was an accident! I'll make sure to remind them!
Look at the dust. Been years, I suppose.
Uncle, you were a reckless boy...
Are you here to check out the Obsolete Pavilion and the ruins too?
Omnicraft Garden sent spies, and the Rebels gathered in numbers.
It seems like there are some unofficial plans in progress...
Maybe it's because it's next to the abandoned Obsolete Pavilion...
It gives off an unfathomable feeling.
Prehistory records are always a bit vague...
To the south is Omnicraft Garden of the School of Mechcrafts.
To the southwest is the Obsolete Pavilion of the former School of Mechcraft, now abandoned.
The lake is beautiful, the cliffs are steep, and the views are stunning. You can walk to the upper pavilion for a better view.
But there are Rebels and beasts nearby, so please be careful.
The player is lost in music, while the listener is found.
I wish time could slow down a bit...
Hold. This leads to the high-level trial grounds. The unqualified are forbidden to enter.
A trial crafted for senior students, where powerful Mechanoids reside, posing significant danger to ordinary students like yourself.
That just means I have to go in there.
That just means I have to go in there.
I didn't notice such beauty while walking below.
A different angle brings a new feeling.
Are we standing too close to the edge?
Still some time before the excavation ends.
Good things come to those who wait.
Next time, I'll bring two little Croakies to keep watch.
Then I'll bring two Scholarly Tigers.
We've been here for ages, Senior Zheng. What are we waiting for?
We're... waiting for someone from the academy.
Do we have to keep waiting? Can't we go down and find them?
Do you know the way down the mountain?
No idea. This cliff is steep. If I wasn't following you, I wouldn't have made it up here safely.
Well, I don't know the way down either. So we have no choice but to wait for the Academy...
Once they realize we're gone, they'll definitely send people after us.
How can I become an outstanding Hunting Society member?
They say studying objects leads to knowledge, but after observing for so long,
The road ahead will be even more challenging.
But it'd be a shame to give up now.
I hope our efforts won't be in vain.
Based on my research, there must be some secrets hidden in the ruins ahead.
The Rebels arrived earlier, but they haven't withdrawn yet, which means things aren't going smoothly...
Alright... But what do you think our chances are, just the two of us?
Don't worry! I'll take one, you take nine. We'll make short work of these Rebels!
Agreed! Any real treasure we find is mine!
What are Rebels doing here? That's odd...
Maybe they've found something valuable. Should we go check?
You're so obsessed with money that even the Wondrous Maze isn't far enough to escape your scheming.
It's been so long. Why are those Rebels still here?
We can't just keep staring at this...
But there's nothing we can do. We can't just walk over and ask them what they're doing.
We have to keep an eye on them.
Just those same five Rebels again today. No other Rebels came or left.
The students who come to take over are getting later and later.
As for how to find it... unfortunately, the books don't give us any clues.
Have other students already found all the Starmaps...
We need to find a way to sneak in and search the place.
The field is nearing harvest. We'll rely on the Mechcraft Bug Tiller for reaping.
But the machine isn't calibrated yet, so I have to wait.
The Mechcraft Bug Plow is so convenient.
That must be the Obsolete Pavilion.
I'm about to mine in the cave, but Wolvines often use it as their den.
I've notified the patrol team, but they won't be here for a while.
How do I make the Wolvines understand this isn't their den?
Just follow this path up the hill, and you'll reach Omnicraft Garden.
Off to train at Mount Guye, will I run into any formidable seniors?
The pavilion by the lake offers a stunning view. Take a break there.
Stay calm, she won't ignore me.
I'm waiting for the boy to come down from the mountain.
We finally got a chance to meet up and plan to enjoy the scenery at the lakeside pavilion.
Then he just stopped at the pavilion and told me to wait for him here.
Are you also heading to the lakeside pavilion?
It's the pavilion on the east side of the lake ahead.
Students love to enjoy the view here.
But I don't get it. What's the point of looking at a lake? Climbing is way more fun.
Hey, Martial Arts whiz, are you done yet? You've tried breaking, smashing, and kicking... got any other ideas?
This device is tough to crack... How about we try an axe instead?
Stop! What if there's some ancient relic inside? If you smash it, I'll be known as a historical vandal...
And you, silly student of mine. I paid a fortune to hire you, and you can't even solve a simple Mechcraft...
You should get someone from the School of Mechcrafts. We Martial Arts students only know this much. How about I give you a full refund and you find someone else?
Fine, I'll find another way. Don't do anything reckless.
This trial is nothing to me.
A high ground for a scenic view would make me feel so good...
They say beasts have taken over the nearby ruins... I wonder what's inside...
It's way too hot here, gotta go.
Through this mountain gate and up a bit further.
You can see Obsidian Flame Training Hall.
These mushrooms look so weird! Could they be affected by Aerux...?
Maybe I should stop investigating these ruins. These mushrooms have given me plenty to think about.
Jixia is incredible. You can find almost anything here!
Oh, if only I wasn't afraid of heights.
Master, which mountain areas are suitable for Martial Arts training?
Besides the Wondrous Maze, Obsidian Flame Training Hall, and Stargazing Terrace... it seems there's only the elevator and Aership left.
Master, I know the first few places are suitable for training, but the last two... are you sure you didn't make a mistake?
Exactly! With elevators, you can race it to the top. With Aership, you can race it to the finish.
Martial Arts students are great at pushing beyond physical limits. I believe you can surpass them!
Dialogue in front of the bulletin board.
The tranquil lake soothes, but my eyelids get heavy...
Ugh... What does this have to do with Sorcery training?
Just look at the reflections on the lake. To cultivate Sorcery, one must first understand the nature of all things.
So tired... Will this really improve my training?
I'll climb the highest mountain ahead!
Could this be the Dashing Wings my teacher often mentioned? Such a stunning Mechcraft— I have to try it out!
Wait! Senior, you always tell us, "Martial Arts training must be practiced through action, and mountain climbing is also a form of training!"
What? Now you wanna slack off and sit on Dashing Wings?
Don't spread rumors. I just wanted to see how it works!
That's easy! I'll take the Dashing Wings, and you climb the mountain and keep an eye out. We'll definitely get a clear view.
When will the next Aership arrive?
Though this place looks like a mess.
There must be something good hidden inside.
Yellow, yellow, yellow. All the leaves are yellow. The sky is blue, but the flowers are sweet.
If you Martial Arts students spent half as much time reading as you do now, you wouldn't be churning out such terrible lines.
I want a pair of ears that haven't heard all this.
Hey, like your poem was any better! "Green flowers, green leaves, green shade, whistling by the river."
Don't you think I'm better than you?
Hey, it rhymes! Definitely better than your "Yello, Yello, Yello!"
Alright, alright, let's drop it. We're equally bad, so no laughing here.
Why are there so many Rebels along the way?
Guess I'll have to take a detour to school again.
There's a teahouse up ahead. The owner brews rich, fragrant tea and is very kind.
I often go there to rest when I'm tired.
He's a tough one—no martial integrity whatsoever. He taunts while fighting, and I just can't beat him.
I really want to get in there quickly.
What's taking him so long? I can't wait to see the giant Mozi Mechanoid!
Just wait a bit longer. They should be here any moment.
Maybe he's lost again, or being a keen student somewhere.
What's the hurry? Are you that drawn to Mozi's Mechanoid?
It's the Giant Mozi Mechanoid! I've been waiting for it!
I heard Obsidian Flame Training Hall has a huge cannon.
It seems like it can launch massive fireworks.
Of course, this Head Trainer is quite impressive.
I wonder when I'll get to see it.
The Obsidian Flame Training Hall is famous for cannons, right?
I should look for a new angling spot... The Seeker Society was willing to pay a fortune for tips.
Well, even if you don't catch any fish, selling info to that guy isn't a bad idea...
Everyone's fishing here, making everyone anxious, and catches are getting smaller.
The breeze under this tree is so refreshing.
My shoulder... let's take a break.
Dashing Wings are such fun! Gotta try them again today!
All that practice is for this moment.
Shh, I'm observing the Mechanoid over there.
Several teams have tried, but none succeeded.
I just need to observe a bit more, and I'll find their weakness.
Is it too late to back out now?
Let me take a closer look.
I think I'm a little scared of heights...
The School of Mechcrafts is truly impressive! The Cannon Society actually created such a powerful weapon! Are you all geniuses?
They are all quite accomplished, while I'm just average. Being a genius is way out of my league.
In my heart, every student of the School of Mechcrafts is extraordinary! You've got this!
When you pass over that mountain, you can see the cannons of Obsidian Flame Training Hall. It's really majestic!
Do you also enjoy climbing high and gazing far?
That's not important. Close your eyes and feel the gentle wind.
Sometimes, it's okay to slow down and enjoy the view.
Won't they spot you up here?
Won't they spot you up here?
I've been watching the Rebels over there for a while and finally figured out their patterns.
Once I find their weakness, I can take them down.
Relax, they haven't looked my way even once.
No, I'm just thinking about future choices.
I can only calm down and think clearly in a place like this.
So... now that I know this, can I play with them?
Loving animals isn't just about how cute they are. You must also care about where they live, what they do every day, and more.
Daily... activities... I don't understand. What's that?
Just learning about when they sleep, what they eat, and their habits...
Then just learn, record, and join the Hunting Society to make friends with them.
I got it! I'll keep trying!
Brother, that Mechcraft over there looks amazing. Can you take us to check it out?
The Mechcraft requires significant strength to activate. Xiao is still young, so let's wait until he grows up.
Can you help activate it for me?
My brother forgot his Mechcraft monocle today, so he couldn't see clearly.
How could I not figure out a simple Mechcraft puzzle? It's just a few balls flying around.
Wow! So many animals to hunt, so many dishes to develop.
This is a protection area. No hunting allowed.
But people say this place is rich in ingredients, and we've come all this way... We can't just go back empty-handed.
How about some wild vegetables? You've always been good at making vegetable soup.
Actually, while protecting the animals, we could add some recreational facilities, like interaction points.
That way, we could raise funds while drawing more attention to our cause.
This will draw attention to environmental issues.
But this will require much more labor and investment upfront.
It's a wise strategy for long-term development. You should think it over.
The animal protection costs are dwindling. You can't keep this up for much longer.
Hmm, as expected of someone from the Trading Society, you make a lot of sense. I'll think about it carefully, thank you.
It's been a while since I've breathed such fresh air. I've been so tired lately.
Indeed. If only we could have one less day of classes each week.
After staying up all this time, I haven't even finished my homework. I have no idea how I'll face my teacher.
Let's not think about it. We should enjoy the scenery in Harvest Fields and relax a bit.
And worries will just go away. We'll deal with what's ahead when we get there.
Yeah, I do feel much better now.
Oh, a new disciple? And you dare to challenge Senior Kongming's trial?
Listen, if you want to challenge the Aerflow Tower, you have to get past me first.
If you can't even beat me, then tell me everything about other Aerflow Towers.
You defeated me? Impossible. It took me so much effort to occupy this trial point that is purely based on strength.
Indeed, brute force alone can never solve all of Senior Kongming's trials. Perhaps you still have a chance.
Ah, don't try to comfort me. I'm all brute force—I don't even qualify to challenge Senior Kongming.
Haha, you freshmen are really weak. You can't even beat me, and you still dare to challenge Senior Kongming?
Looks like I'm the strongest in the academy now.
Not bad at all! I didn't expect it to be such a fierce battle.
But I was holding back earlier. This time, I'll go all out. Take it.
I underestimated you. I'll go all out.
Jixia is full of wonders, worth documenting every day.
About the Lunar Eclipse Mechcraft Cog.
A group of Rebels have gathered south of Obsidian Flame Training Hall, camping in the wilderness.
I heard they got their hands on a valuable item. Could it be the Lunar Eclipse Mechcraft Cog you're after?
It should still be in their camp. We can sneak in and investigate.
Oh? You know about that? Then you must have some basic understanding.
The Cannon Society needs help from the Hunting Society to make special cannonballs like this.
The guy down there is probably getting visited by the Cannon Society every day.
Yes. Zhong Chi from the Hunters' Camp. He's quite knowledgeable about Jixia's creatures.
If you could help him deal with those Cannoneers, he'd be thrilled.
Goodbye. Take this Seeker Travel Log as a gift for meeting.
Animals are better hunters and observers than we'll ever be.
You know about Starhunter Cannonballs? Seems the Cannon Society really is searching everywhere.
They got the name because Embermanes like to collect them in their caves.
The Cannon Society will stop pestering me once they get their precious shells.
About the Lunar Eclipse Mechcraft Cog.
Mechcraft Cog... Go ask Mi Feng from the Seeker Society.
Much as I hate to admit it, he's traveled far and wide and knows a lot of things.
He should be at the nearby Seeker Society camp. You'll find him easily.
Goodbye, young man. Here's a copy of Biological Research Report. I hope it's useful to you.
Stellar Hunter Cannon requires Ember Crystals, which can withstand high temperatures.
If you manage to get a Fireguard Crystal, be sure to come find me.
I passed by a cave under the southwest cliff and saw traces of Embermane hunting.
Embermanes are no joke... But their roars haven't been heard lately. Maybe it's a good time to check out the ruins?
Animals are better hunters and observers than we'll ever be.
Yes! You actually entered the lair of the Embermanes.
Here, take this processed Starhunter Cannonball. I hope to see the cannon fire.
Embermane is gone. Only Rebels are there.
Embermane is gone. Only Rebels are there.
Rebels again! We really owe you a debt of gratitude!
Otherwise, these precious materials would be seized by them.
Those Cannon Society guys won't be back today, right?
No one knows better than me!
I know! The former Head Trainer of Obsidian Flame Training Hall... he built that thing...
That happened years ago! The former Head Trainer was a kind person...
To protect the two little Cannons, Mo Ye and Lin Fu.
She took the two kids to the Forbidden Chamber for clues... and something happened...
So, how much do you know about Wildfire Gun?
So, how much do you know about Wildfire Gun?
Yep, there's nothing I don't know!
Hmph, wait till I join the Cannons!
No one knows cannons better than me!
My cannons? You'll still need me in the end!
What do those bookworms at Stargazing Terrace know...
Jixia is full of wonders, worth documenting every day.
You can find us Seekers everywhere...
Unvisited places need explorers and records even more.
Jixia has many names scattered throughout history...
As for me, I just want to sell a few more copies of my notes...
Haha, why are you calling him that too?
Despite his impatient demeanor, Zhong Chi is a very sincere person.
I'll let you in on a secret: he's a big fan of felines.
Goodbye, maybe we'll travel together someday!
Jixia is full of wonders, worth documenting every day.
About the Lunar Eclipse Mechcraft Cog.
I heard they got their hands on a valuable item. Could it be the Lunar Eclipse Mechcraft Cog you're after?
It should still be in their camp. We can sneak in and investigate.
The Cannon Society keeps pestering the guy down the mountain, and he's getting impatient.
Yes. Zhong Chi from the Hunters' Camp. He's quite knowledgeable about Jixia's creatures.
He'll help you with the cannonball. You just need to find the right materials.
Then those Cannoneers won't push him around. Hahaha.
Goodbye, and I hope those notes help!
A group of Rebels have gathered south of Obsidian Flame Training Hall, setting up camp in the wilderness.
Oh? You know about that? Then you must have some basic understanding.
To make such special cannonballs, we need the help of the Hunting Society.
Animals are better hunters and observers than we'll ever be.
Oh, if you're interested, you can go to Serene Wilds.
There are many Hunting Society members over there.
They observe and care for all kinds of amazing animals in Jixia.
Like the Ink Lion? Or the Scholarly Tiger?
Lady Mo's Obsidian Flame Training Hall?
She taught me a lot when we were at the School of Mechcrafts.
Now, her daughter Mo Xie has taken over the Obsidian Flame Training Hall...
But some Cannoneers under the name of Obsidian Flame Training Hall have been disturbing the animals.
I hear Lady Mo is spoiling those kids.
Take care of those careless Cannon Society members.
I must figure out how Fireguard Crystals work so I can design more cannons!
Speaking of which... my friend Ding Morong knows a lot of legends about Embermanes. When you get to Serene Wilds, you can talk to him.
Animals are better hunters and observers than we'll ever be.
Stellar Hunter Cannon requires Ember Crystals, which can withstand high temperatures.
It's named after Embermane's love for collecting... Oh, have I told you about it?
Check out the "Jixia Fauna Research Report" I gave you.
About the Lunar Eclipse Mechcraft Cog.
I'm not sure about that... You should ask Mi Feng of the Seeker Society.
He's been around a lot more than you think.
Should be near the Seeker Society camp. You might wanna check around.
Water is soft and formless, yet it can gather into cascades that crash and pound against the rocks.
Sorcery power is the same. Though sparse like morning dew at first, with time, it can gather into a stream.
Hmm, so it all comes from nature... But this waterfall is so crystal clear...
I want to take a closer look at the Aerflow Tower...
I can use Dashing Wings to go straight up.
Aerflow Tower is quite a special feature of our academy.
It's not often that I get to visit Jixia. Let me take a closer look.
But I heard there are powerful Mechanoids under the Aerflow Tower that offer challenges to disciples.
The Mechanoids won't attack tourists, right?
I climbed up here with a few colleagues after a while, only to find no clues about Senior Zhou Yu.
Could they really be Kongming's casual works? Perhaps we need to pass all the trials to receive the message?
By the way, did you see a strange person on your way here? He might have been pestering you, saying things like "Kongming isn't that impressive."
Don't mind him, he's being extreme. It has nothing to do with Senior Zhou Yu. The other fans are all perfectly normal.
Oh, so you live here? What a prime location.

I want to improve my Sorcery skills and become the next Kongming.
That's quite the ambition... Alright, let's get going.
This Wish Tree is truly magical. The circling spirits, the eternally green leaves...
They say for a decade after its discovery, the area had been blessed with bountiful harvests. Not even a single natural disaster.
Is there really some mystical natural force at work? Could it have something to do with the recent beast attacks, too?
They attack swiftly and can spit deadly venom and flames.
My master told me that they have very hard scales. You gotta strike fast with a sharp sword to really hurt them.
He even asked if I needed backup, but I said no.
These lizards may be fierce, but they're no match for me. With my skills, I can take on as many as they come.
Nice move... By the way, do you know how many Jixia students there are in this area?
Well, students... Gotcha. Let's see how you counter it!
Hmm... I've seen quite a few Seekers lately. Do you know which areas they frequent?
Seekers? They usually... Hey, what's your next move? Giving up already?
Yes, yes, I give up, you're awesome! So, about those Seekers...
Loser cleans up the board. C'mon, let's play another round!
I need good marketing to sell my Mechcrafts, right?
As a Trader, I'd say that publicity is just the gateway, and trading is the core. But you haven't yet grasped the foundation.
You need financial support in the early stages.
That sounds about right. I do need startup money. Can you teach me how to get it?
First, let the public hear about your business potential. And then position your product... There's a lot to cover, so let's talk about it next time.
I read that our ancestors built this place as a backup camp during wartime.
But for some reason, they never ended up using it.
Now it's become a lair for beasts. How sad.
Getting closer to Roaring Tiger Training Hall, I'm so nervous...
Maybe we should take the long way up instead of using Dashing Wings.
I wonder if she's still mad at me.
I lost to her in a match and said stupid things. Just because I couldn't take it...
Ugh... Why am I such a sore loser?
I should apologize properly when I get back.
Hush. The inspiration. I can feel it coming.
Okay... Hope you know what you're doing...
Water from Greenwhisper Pool is sweet with a hint of peach blossoms. Simmer it with white vinegar and brown sugar to make a sauce.
Chop fresh fish into fine cubes and serve raw with the dip. It preserves the sweet flavor while removing the fishiness.
Got it! Wow. This sounds amazing!
You said you were going to challenge the Head Trainer at Roaring Tiger Training Hall, and you're giving up at the first hurdle?
I could climb up and go through that cave to reach Roaring Tiger Training Hall...
But if I push myself to challenge Dashing Wings, would it better train my courage?
The bronze here barely corrodes, different from other places.
In the meantime, though, there are clear signs of human damage.
Someone was here before us? Or are they the remnants of war?
Or maybe it's made with a special craft!
This is a major discovery! We should write up a report and submit it. We might become famous!
That's exactly why we should be cautious. Let's collect more samples and discuss our findings with the team before making any decisions.
You're right. Exploration demands boldness, but research requires caution.
Incredible. Just incredible. Hearing about the place is one thing, but seeing it in person is quite another.
The ancients' craftsmanship was surprisingly advanced.
All this precise stonework, and the exquisite carvings...
I examined it closely with this lens.
Even the bronze here is different. Barely corroded, almost like new.
Hmm, I must say, this loupe works really well. I should thank Taiching personally when I get back.
Where's that bronze plaque I found? You didn't hide it, did you?
You found it? I saw it first, of course it's mine.
Okay, but tell me, what are the patterns engraved on it?
Well... I didn't see clearly. But I know it was square.
Besides, who cares? It's not as if the thing has your name on it.
You're just twisting things around! Now hand it over!
But if you insist on going in, keep your ears open and stay on high alert.
The notice says a Wolvine took the bow? That sounds ridiculous.
Wolvines are cunning. They use terrain and shadows to hide, waiting for the right moment to attack.
You should think it over carefully. Don't take any unnecessary risks.
The request was posted by a Rebel.
I knew something was off about this job!
Without you, I'd be toast. Thanks a million!
Thanks to your warning, I saw through his tricks.
Thanks to your warning, I saw through his tricks.
Life is unpredictable. I must be more careful in the future. What seems like a good intention doesn't always lead to a good outcome.
You're back! How was it inside? You aren't injured, are you?
Hmm? Is this the Scholarly Tiger that always goes to class with me?
I've seen him solve math problems with twigs many times.
It's much better than Scholar Geese. They only pick holes in my homework.
I happen to be having trouble with a few questions. Perhaps Mr. Tiger here can help?
Look at all these defensive Mechcrafts around the ruins. Any idea how to get past?
Relax. Let me think it through.
Don't get too ahead of yourself. First, we need Aerpower Chips to open this thing...
I'm sure the treasure is in there. How about we take a closer look?
How much longer are we gonna stand here...
All those beasts and Mechanoids? Of course it is.
Still, no risk, no reward. I've heard a part of the key to the Greenwhisper Treasure is there.
The ruin has been here since the old times. It's gone through a lot of reinforcements, and now the wild animals...
Hiding the key in such a place. Very clever...
Hard to get the treasure inside?
To solve the puzzle, you must first install an Aerpower Chip to disable the barrier.
I'd say we do that first before anything. But this guy...
Don't rush things. If it were that easy, why set the barrier in the first place?
Those steles in the shadows look a bit too strange to me. We have to be cautious.
Xin Ran, I feel so ugly... I have too much fur and such big ears... What should I do?
No, you're pretty. Everyone looks different. Everyone is pretty in their own way.
Don't be sad. Mom says you shouldn't worry about how others think. It's more important to feel pretty yourself.
Yeah! I won't lie to you! So cheer up, wanna play at our secret base?
Cloud Stags are timid, but they will attack when feeling threatened.
Good, almost done with deer habits.
Next page: "Spike Bears are a ferocious kind of beast. Will attack humans that get too close..."
How long is this thing... Oh! I'm not even halfway through. There's still so much animal behavior to learn.
But that's okay! Slow and steady wins the race. One day, I'll become a capable Hunter.
We're trying to decipher the ancient writings in this ruin.
We've decoded some of it already. Words like "war", "bronze", and "guard".
Next, we plan to copy the patterns and symbols.
Once we get back, we'll discuss our findings with the others.
We're almost there. What wish do you have in mind?
Ah, I never told you. I want an angling rod that never misses.
That's it? Why not just ask the manager at the Omnipotent Agency? He can probably make it happen.
You don't know? It's near the Omnicraft Garden.
Just tell them what you have in mind, and they'll turn your idea into reality.
I see. What are we waiting for? Let's go!
How do you train every day? I want to learn Martial Arts with you!
Train with me? Are you sure you can handle it?
Of course I can! Mom says I'm super tough. I'll be fine!
Why don't you start with some basic internal training? Breathing and meditation, maybe?
Your body's still growing. Wait a few years, then you can try more external techniques. Okay?
Duh... everyone tells me to grow up first. It's so annoying! I wanna become as strong as you now!
Just close my eyes, and it'll be over soon...
There are also some untouched boulders and ruins nearby.
Better hurry up and clean up.
When can I start training on the posts?
Master the basics on the ground first. Then you can try the Aerux posts.
Then what about the Aersilk ones? I'm sure I can handle that.
You still need to work the basics, as well as your lower body strength. Static stance training will do you good in the long run.
Combine movement and stillness. That's how you master Martial Arts. Understand?
Extra discounts only for today! Want to take a look?
Thanks, Miss Deng, but I've got enough supplies.
Come on! You can never have too many balms or sachets.
But our instructor told us not to bring these...
I've got other things, too. When you head back...
I think it's time I head out. See you later!
This place might have been an ore vein before. The marks on the rocks don't look like the work of weathering.
Are they similar to the ones we found in the underground ruins the other day?
Yes. Human efforts wouldn't have left such smoothly hewn surfaces.
People who returned from the ruins said there were tattered Mechcrafts around the underground ore veins.
This could be another important piece of evidence for ancient mining Mechcrafts. We should report this immediately.
You wanna come over for dinner?
There's some Bitewood here. Should I pick some for dinner?
No spicy food? Anything you have in mind, then?
Xie Jun, Can you hear me?
You should head home first. I haven't finished my footwork training yet.
Oh, it's not about dinner... I have one more lap to go in the hills.
Hello? Are you even listening to me?
Why can't we use Dashing Wings here?
My friend at the School of Mechcraft told me it's dangerous to use flying Mechcrafts on mountain ridges.
You can get hurt if you don't know how to use them properly.
So what should we use to get up the mountain here?
Well, we'll need Aersilk hooks to scale the cliff.
Once we reach an open area, we can use Dashing Wings.
Have you heard? That rising poet just published a new piece.
It speaks of treasure buried here!
That local legend's popular among students. I heard his poems really led someone to fortune once.
Really? We should check it out sometime.
But his fame isn't just built on these gainful gimmicks.
You can tell from his verses that he's got real talent.
If he's still a student, he has a promising future ahead.
I can do it! After I finish the Twin Peaks challenge, I will head to the Stargazing Terrace!
Novar awakened his Star Power there. I'm sure I can do something amazing, too.
What power will I acquire? The Moon? Or even the Cosmos?
You... you climbed up here fast.
Am I? You're just too slow! Been slacking off in training, huh?
You heard the teacher. If you had practiced hard in the camp, you wouldn't be so slow!
I... I won't slack off next time...
Finally, some time to play with the Croakies. Now let me go over their body language again.
When they find something new, they... yes, they jump up high, flap their forelimbs vigorously, and make short, rhythmic croaks.
Hmm, that's good... But will the others think I'm too childish to play with them at my age?
Ah, what am I talking about? Who can resist the sight of those adorable creatures?
So I wasn't lying, was I? The scenery here is really something else.
Yeah, it is indeed. I wonder if the food here tastes different too?
Of course, especially the Striped Gourds and Bitewood — they have a very unique fragrance.
If you use them in cooking, the dishes will definitely be delicious.
Really? Then I'd like to pick some to make jam. Haven't had any jam in a while now.
Sure, I'll help you. I'd love to taste it too.
Siaoli, didn't we agree to go to the Croaky Park together? Why the change of mind?
We've already been there once, and I want to try a different place this time. How does the Scholarly Tiger Park sound?
The Scholarly Tigers have very soft fur. You'll fall in love with them as soon as you touch them.
Are you saying Croakies aren't cute? Think about how wobbly they walk — it's hard not to like them.
Plus, they never get angry when we play with them.
And I forgot to mention that I've learned some Croaky language. How about I show you this time?
Really? You speak Croaky now? Well, I can't say no to that!
The soil here is blue, and most of the plants have taken on a bluish hue too.
I wonder what's causing this... Is it related to the lake here? It doesn't seem like it.
These plants are growing wild. Could it be because of the Aersilk?
It's highly possible. I'll need to investigate further...
Master, Master, do you have a moment? Do you know who established this animal camp?
I heard it all started when some Herb Society members discovered the rapid plant growth and high nutritional value here.
They gathered many small animals and asked the Hunting Society to protect them from beasts.
Over time, more people arrived. The Crafters built the camp, and Gourmets started to cook for everyone...
Eventually, the camp becomes what it is today.
You're here early. Have you completed the tasks I assigned to you?
Here are my notes, boss. I spent a lot of time with the Scholarly Tigers and recorded all its habits.
I've been playing with Fluffies since I was little. I know all about them.
Don't worry, I promise there won't be any mistakes.
That's great. From what I've observed, the Scholarly Tiger and Fluffy are the most popular here.
Once he gets your data, we can start making the Scholarly Tiger and Fluffy plushies!
I'm sure they'll be a hit throughout Jixia!
And not just Jixia. Maybe Chang'an, too!
Let me check the manual: "First, wave to the Scholarly Tiger. It will sit down and wag its tail to show goodwill."
That's what I did, but it didn't respond.
The manual also says: "Scholarly Tigers enjoy lectures." Maybe try imitating your master like you do to us all the time.
Alright, I'll give it a try...
Ahem, gather yourselves together, guys. Today, we'll be discussing the use of Telepathic Threads...
Look! It's actually coming toward me. Your manual helps!
Of course... Well, don't just stand there — keep the lecture going, or it might leave soon.
You hungry, little one? What would you like to eat? How 'bout I make you something?
(Croaky language) Spreads forelimbs wide, holds its head high, and lets out long, loud croaks.
Okay, okay, I know you're hungry now, but I don't understand what you want to eat. Your favorite roasted mushrooms perhaps?
(Croaky language) Swings from side to side, slaps its feet on the ground, and makes rhythmic croaks.
I'm glad you like it! Looks like you're quite satisfied with my cooking.
Why the hurry to find me, Junmei? Did you gather any useful information?
Yes. I discovered a very powerful Thunder Lizard in the area. And the Wolvines have been very active as well.
Plus, there are a lot of people gathering at the Croaky Park. Seems like some student is teaching Croakies martial arts.
How about we go check it out?
But we haven't found enough intel yet...
After such a long time of hard work, we deserve some rest. Come on, I promise it won't take long.
So, did you find anything over there? Liang Zhe and the others are probably getting impatient.
Shh, keep your voice down. I just discovered a big Rebel camp there.
A Rebel camp? They have infiltrated this area already...?
It's right in the direction of the Stargazing Terrace. I'm almost certain they plan to hit the place.
Exactly. Let's quickly inform the others and see if we should report this to our masters.
Yes, there's no time to lose. Let's go right now.
Man Shuh told me you lost a glove. Is this one here yours?
Man Shuh told me you lost a glove. Is this one here yours?
What do you think? And how did your glove end up under a strange rock?
What do you think? And how did your glove end up under a strange rock?
I don't know what you're talking about!
Then how about I share my discovery with others and see what they think?
Then how about I share my discovery with others and see what they think?
No... please don't... I'll tell you...
Actually, I moved these rocks here at night a while ago. Put them in various shapes.
I did want some attention by doing this, but not that much.
I know I messed up. Please, keep this to yourself—I'd be in big trouble if anyone found out.
You don't need this kind of attention-seeking stunt. Not ever again.
You don't need this kind of attention-seeking stunt. Not ever again.
If you want others to notice you, there are many better ways to do so.
If you want others to notice you, there are many better ways to do so.
Look at the new gloves Man Shuh gave you. There are people who really care about you.

You seem like an honest person. Your actions should speak the same.
You seem like an honest person. Your actions should speak the same.
Thanks, I get it now. I won't do it again!
These are way too new to be mine. You can't deceive me for new stories like this.
Those old gloves I lost? They were a gift from an old friend. Their value goes far beyond their physical worth.
I'm not deceiving you. These gloves, though not the old ones, are also a gift from your friend.

It's Man Shuh. She wanted me to tell you that seeking attention in this way is wrong, but she's been keeping an eye on you and is very worried about you.

...I see. I'll thank her, and she'll give me a lecture... She always does this.
I did something wrong again? I just wanted to make more friends.
Though I have the new pair, I still want my old gloves back. If you see them, please bring them back.
No problem. You focus on your things with Man Shuh.
No problem. You focus on your things with Man Shuh.
A stone this heavy must have been moved by a Mechcraft master.
But what are these strange rocks for?
I really want to meet this mysterious master. It'd be great chance to discuss the art of design.
Speaking of which, there has been a student who often comes to borrow my lifter...
Haha, I'm thinking too much. How could he possibly be a Mechcraft master?
Could it be they were trying to imitate ancient technology and create a massive stone Mechcraft with these boulders?
Have you heard? There are strange rocks down the mountain, some taller than people.
I heard it was a giant beast from the deep mountains. It wanted to make this place its home, so it carried over this huge rock to build a nest.
And that the beast is several meters tall, with eight legs and three heads...
What? But the villagers said it was an ancient ruin. The heavy rain a few days ago washed out the stones.
Of course! It's spreading like wildfire. Got any juicy gossip for me?
Really? If rain could move such a massive stone, it'd be a flood.
I have a pair of gloves for you.
I have a pair of gloves for you.
It was your friend Man Shuh.
It was your friend Man Shuh.
She was worried you'd be upset if you couldn't find them, so she made you a new pair. But she was too embarrassed to give them to you herself, so she asked me to do it for her.

Thank you, I'll go thank Man Shuh.
As a reward, I spotted a cave while moving rocks. There might be treasures inside.
Not so fast. First, you have to tell me what you've been sneaking around doing here.

I don't know what you're talking about!
Guess I'll have to put the gloves back.

This is it! You got it back!
Thanks! I spotted a cave while moving rocks. There might be treasures inside.
I'm only telling you because you helped me.
I found a pair of gloves.
I found a pair of gloves.
Let me check, that must be the one I lost!
