Someone is taking a nap underneath that big platform... And I think that's it.
Ah, it works pretty well then!
But will it still work at night?
It's much more complicated when it comes to seeing things at night.
I've heard that the "Flow" within our bodies remains active at all times.
If we want clearer imaging in darker environment, the "Flow" might be the key.
More and more people are ordering takeout these days... Why is everyone so busy?
Oh, I'm posting a food delivery request for the Martial Arts students.
Those guys are willing to grab anything for you, as long as you have the money to pay them.
Yeah... I was too reckless during the fight just now.
I shouldn't have rushed straight to the center of the field. That made it too easy for those ranged Mechanoids to hit me.
I must be more patient next time. Being hasty doesn't help anyone.
Look, the Dashing Wings! They're so cool, aren't they?
You bet! And I think someone told me about them before...
When? How come I didn't know about it?
It was when a Mechsmith came to help us fix some Mechcrafts. You were not in the village at that time.
I heard him talk about them while he was working. Today I finally got to see the real thing — and it's truly extraordinary.
Whoever created them is a genius.
This design is up to par in every way. Great job, you two.
I'm glad you think so. It's all thanks to her idea—to create such a full stage with the minimum obstacles.
You're being modest. Your design for the bouncing ball is truly ingenious.
In any case, once the Mechcraft ball is set, your work will be ready for other students to challenge.
I'm too tired to keep going, Qingzhuo.
We should be studying Mechcrafts in the dorm. Not stuck at this place struggling through the exam.
Exactly, but I've already got a solution. Next time, we can try using that Versatile Mechanoid of mine.
Versatile Mechanoid? I bet that would save us from all this running around.
But I was warned not to use it in combat.
It's made of cheap materials, so it'll likely be destroyed in just a few hits.
Well, it seems like it's not so "versatile" after all.
I need to rest and recharge.
Once I'm ready, I will go explore the ruins.
The ancient Mechcrafts there are quite different from the ones today, both in aesthetics and structure. It's so worth studying.
The Mechcraft ball game they made is lame. I literally just touched it and it flew off to who knows where.
You're definitely not going anywhere if you keep trying like this.
There should be boards in every direction! Those students from the School of Mechcraft are such slackers!
Calm down and control your strength. This is not something that can be cracked with brute force.
Only then can you focus on finding the right path. Ugh, no wonder you always got criticized by your seniors.
Hmm... Now how do I get this Aerflow Conduit all connected?
Woah...! Sorry, I was too focused studying this Mechcraft here.
This is the last trial for my exam, and you can trust I did my homework before coming here.
But the textbook only talked about moving the Mech Cores to their required positions...
I didn't know there'd be a test on circuit connection too. And now I have no idea where to start.
Sigh My credits are so in trouble now...
Am I trapped in a maze?
Why won't these circles on the water sink?
No, it's not a maze. There are special devices underneath these circles to keep them afloat.
How do you play it then?
See the lines on top of the circles?
Just rotate the lines to connect each circle, and...
You'll find a treasure chest at the end!
This challenge is exhausting. I can't keep up with everything at the same time.
Don't worry. Once you get into the School of Mechcraft, you'll find these to be quite elementary.
Whew, look at all my sweat! It's really tough trying to aim and navigate at the same time.
I actually think there's a lot of room for improvement with this Mechcraft.
It now only has patterns on one side. If there were patterns on every side along with multiple endpoints, it'd be much more interesting.
I'm not choosing the School of Mechcraft for sure...
Just so you know, I'm pretty confident in my creation. Better get ready for some challenge!
Hey, I can tell it's your first time in the mountains. Why don't you give my Mechcraft a try?
Here's a little hint: the theme is 'Hearts Connected.'
Well don't you look determined! I can't wait to see how you do!
Did you come here to avoid all the noises over there?
This Mechcraft has such a sturdy pivot structure, yet it's not using the waterpower effectively...
If it were me, I'd install a hydraulic device at the base.
This would greatly reduce energy consumption, about three times less than the current model.
There might be danger ahead, Lanzhi. You should head back and check out the other places.
Why? I like the quiet here. It's nice.
Some of the Mechanoids here haven't been tested yet, and they might be too powerful for students to handle.
And the academy hasn't had the time to ship them all back in time, so... I've been assigned to recover them.
In that case, I'll wait for you here. Come back and find me when you're done!
The way you walk back and forth... Are you here to admire me?
See this challenge before us? I jumped up to trigger it, but then before I knew it, I was knocked off.
That's why my mentor asked me to stay here and observe the others.
So, how about you give it a try so I can "obersve"?
Zhuang Han, Hanyi, Nie Yan, You Xingde and Wei Jiang. Good, everybody's here.
And the other group... Not a single one showed up for the practice?
Those over-confident guys are going to learn their lesson the hard way.
Anyway, I'll give them a good talking to when I get back!
I think our design is still too simple. We should increase the rotation speed even more.
That's not the main issue. Our original intention was to test the challengers' observational skills, remember?
Now all we have are the School of Martial Arts students jumping around and using our Mechcrafts as Aersilk Dummies!
We need to reinforce its Aersilk Mech Core to make it more challenging.
Otherwise, it'd just be too easy. The challengers might not feel they are getting effective training.
You're right... I should head back to the dorm to fetch my notes.
Perhaps another 2.5-degree adjustment to the launch angle...
The launch port should be moved up by another three centimeters.

text: Got it! According to my calculations, the next shot is bound to go in.
Wait, it seems I haven't accounted for the wind yet...
I heard a senior at the School of Martial Arts passed the Path of Heroes with a perfect score. How can one do that?
They say it's nearly impossible to meet all the requirements.
It starts with Master Fuzi, Zhuangzi, and Mozi, and their connections to Jixia Academy...
How long is this story going to be?!
This Mechcraft cannon is too hard to use. Why can't we bring our own?
That's our mentor's decision. You know how unconventional he can be sometimes.
Once I'm done with this, I'm never going to his class again. It's so frustrating...
You need to calm down. There's another test of his in the southeast.
What?! If I fail again this month, then that's it. I'll just repeat the year and get a different mentor!
Meng Ya can hit the target every time with this type of cannon. Able minds don't whine.
But... fine, that's a good point. I'll try harder.
Does this Mechcraft seem interesting to you, Sheera?
Why are they all standing so far away?
The challenge requires a ranged weapon called bow. It's used to hit targets from a distance.
It sounds so cool! One day I want to fire a bow too!
You will. And as you learn more about Mechcrafts, you might even get to use cannons like Ya!
Anyway, just look at this thing. Whoever designed it is definitely a genius.
Then I'll also create something like this in the future!
I'm really scared of being outside and talking to strangers, Mr. Charde. Please let me go back...
If you want me to let you go, you might wanna come up with a better excuse.
Remember our motto at the School of Mechcraft? "Putting knowledge into practice."
Every theory, every... idea must be verified through practice before they can be considered "true knowledge".
You must always keep this in mind as you further your study.
There are quite a few Martial Arts students like Mi Xia who don't understand archery or cannons at all. Maybe our Mechcraft is too difficult for them?
This target is not even moving. That alone makes it easier to handle than real-life situations.
Well... the longbows we made before were indeed intended for stationary targets.
Exactly. In reality, things will only be more complex than these mere Mechcrafts.
If we could predict the target's movement, we could aim accordingly, right?
That's right! Time the arrow right, and we'll be able to hit every time!
It was a close call looking back now. I almost failed the Path of Heroes.
It's the academy's entrance exam! A test of skill, agility, puzzle-solving, and a ton of talent and insight...
Wait... so you didn't take that exam?
Just relax. Don't stress yourself out.

Yet even so, I know the lake holds many secrets I'm unaware of. How much more so for the world above, I wonder?
I see myself and everyone else, as if the lake is observing us.
Your perspectives are different. One sees the world, and the other sees what's within. Interesting, isn't it?
Make it quick. Otherwise we'll be late for tonight's Mechanoid simulation training!
Training is not a race against the clock.
I wasted enough time chasing away lizards in the morning. Don't want others to surpass me this way, you know?
Just take a break and come with me to the mountaintop. We can watch the sunset there.
It's okay to slow down and unwind now and then.
Hmm... Alright. I'm coming with you, if you insist.
You're out of breath. Is there something urgent?
Phew. I'm trying to break my own record.
I run here every day, but I feel like I can't get faster anymore.
If you want speed, you need to adjust your breathing when you're halfway up the mountain.
Post-exercise meditation is also important. My instructor says it gives you better control of the body's meridians.
Got it! I'll train with you from now on.
Fowl Meat filling, Foxtail Wheat base.
Oil Shrooms for scent, Fibercore Lotus for blood circulation.
Cooking needs planning. Only a worthy opponent deserves this dish.
During my competition with Zhou Yu, I did have a slight advantage but his footwork was obviously better than mine.
Yu managed to pass Master Fuzi's trial with his graceful and nimble footwork.
The speed, the grace... Still impresses me to this day.
I had a close call with a Giant Saepes once.
Just as they were about to break my defense, Zhou Yu came to my aid.
Although we eventually had to retreat, it remains a memorable episode...
Now these Mechanoids are similar to those Saepes back then both in number and strength. I think I can call it job done.
Such an ingenious structure... I could incorporate some of these elements into my Wondrous Maze.
The Bronze Mechcrafts in Aerfall Highlands appear to have a common origin with the ones in Jixia.
However, history rarely mentions the owners of these amazing creations.
The origin of Sorcery Technique is not impossible to trace.
Both the ruins and ancient texts show that a group of old Jixia people once possessed extraordinary powers.
The earliest records of these people have been lost to history.
Yet I discovered many underground cavities during my recent field research. Could it be...
The elevator seems stuck... I wonder if there's a gap nearby I can use to get down?
The elevator seems stuck... I wonder if there's a gap nearby I can use to get down?
I feel bad that Zhou Yu got hurt while testing for me.
So this time, I made it easier...
...just to make it up to him.
I need to rebuild these circuits for better speed...
This challenge is inspired by the Bagua. It's one of my proudest creations.
It won't be easy, even for Zhou Yu.
I got inspired by Zhou Yu's favorite line.
Plan everything, and then strike decisively. That's what this challenge is all about.
All signs point in one direction...
Once some incredible people lived here at the academy.
They're gone, but their traces remain...
Nothing special. It's pretty common. Haven't you seen it before in Jixia?
Hmph, you always overcomplicate things... Anyway, what are your plans after finishing your studies in Jixia?
I plan to keep studying the Heavenly Scrolls to uncover more of their secrets.
I knew you'd be most interested in it...
Aren't you also investigating that part of history?
Yes... There are just so many questions to be answered.
But that's just a minor chapter in my life. I'm determined to achieve something worth my talent. Something... greater.
Guess I'll look forward to it then...
We competed here before, and if I remember correctly, I won.
Don't get too smug. You were just lucky is all.
I wouldn't call ninety-six to eighty-seven "lucky".
Actually, it was ninety-five to eighty-eight.
Does it matter? Either way, you lost.
You can't just change the score! If you keep doing this, you can go ahead without me!
I didn't realize he cared about it so much... Maybe we should have another round...
Zhou Yu is fast, but sometimes he has trouble keeping his balance.
It's been a long time since we last met. I wonder if his skills have improved.
This trial is the perfect chance to test him.
You'll definitely use the northeast side.
Hmph, I already know your tricks well.
Let me see what you're planning this time.
Now I'm about to leave, I can't help but find myself filled with emotions.
With everything I set up for him, I wonder how long it would take him to find this place.
I've had countless matches with him over the years. I must say... he's become my closest friend in Jixia.
Kongming, do you really think you beat me at every turn?
This match wouldn't have ended so fast if I hadn't had to return to the Three Kingdoms.
It's almost funny — every time I competed with you, I'd always forget that I came to Jixia with a mission.
Let's leave the unfinished business to our next encounter.
Such a brilliant design. Only a genius could create this.
Aerflow Tower is incredible. After my grandfather brought me here once when I was little, I vowed to study at the academy.
I want to create aesthetically pleasing Mechcrafts like Aerflow Towers.
I'm here to become the best Puppeteer, just like Yango.
This place has a lot of history.
Wondrous Maze. The name alone brings back memories.
Kongming's ingenuity has stumped so many students over the years.
It's something of a struggle to solve all the puzzles. But it's totally worth it.
I'm curious how this year's students perform... Let's find a spot to watch them.
I can head to the eastern peak via a Zipline. Heard Kongming used to hang out there as well.
If only I could meet someone who truly appreciates these puzzles like I do.
Students get so frustrated trying to find the solution, and they'd miss the beauty of the designs. What a shame.
I just wanted to take a walk. Then I tripped and lost whole a bunch of parts.
The only good news is that Master Crafter is coming to give lectures again.
I wonder when he'll arrive. His last lecture was so much fun. I wish it could have been longer.
Oh... can't wait to take his Mechcraft classes soon.
Even with Mechcrafts, they were still designed and constructed by people.
How much effort did it take to remodel everything?
The view up here is incredible.
Stunning indeed... Look, that mountain peak looks so unique.
That one over there? There's a long story to it.
The peak's not a work of nature. Rather, it's the product of human efforts.
To build a structure for trials, the academy sent a team of talents to alter the terrain manually.
If I remember correctly, it was Mozi, one of the Three Sages, who brought all the major devices.
How much longer do we have to search?
Luo Xiao, are you sure this map is legit?
Yeah, we've been looking for ages. Where is this ruin?
Uh... Let's keep looking. Didn't they say there's a huge Mechcraft on top of it? Should be hard to miss.
I have a feeling you got scammed.
No, no way... Let's split up and look around. I'm sure we'll find it.
You'd better hope the map is the real deal.
Just leave me alone for a while.
Are you sure? You look sad.
I saw those people laughing at you.
Laugh all they want! Those cowards will get what's coming to them.
I don't know about that. But I do know friends can cheer you up. That's what mom and dad told me.
What are you talking about? Friends... I don't know about friends...
Hey, I can be your friend! I wanna cheer you up.
We've gone past a lot of ruins now. Where is the one you're looking for?
Be patient, okay? Yunji must have a plan.
We've still got a long way to go.
There are many historical sites here, but most of them are not worth our time.
Based on ancient texts and maps, I was able to locate a special one.
The books speak of a great battle here long ago.
Many ruins have been uncovered, but there are still crucial pieces missing.
Those fragments of war must be hidden in untouched parts of the mountain.
Alright, you two! Lead the way.
Would you mind standing back, Senior Lixin?
Do you have any new ideas, Zheng Nan? We've been stuck here for two hours.
I just spotted a tiny gear hidden behind the big one. It's connected to other parts.
If we start from there, we might find what's blocking the energy conduit in the Mech Core.
I never noticed that. You do have a sharp eye.
Thanks. I'll give it a shot!
Let's do it together, but be careful.
Wait, let me check out this herb...
No, we don't have time for that. We have to be back by tomorrow night.
That's not fair. We're not the same. You're much more talented than me, especially in Sorcery.
I know I'm weak and dumb, and I know you have to watch out for me on this trip...
Just because I'm quiet doesn't mean I don't care... and I'm doing my best to keep up.
I'm sorry... I didn't mean it like that.
No, I shouldn't have said that. I'm sorry, I won't bring it up again.
Croaky, croaky. Been out long. Miss home?
I see my parents in my dreams. I bet they miss me, too.
These Mechcrafts can control light, sending it anywhere, but they can't carry my thoughts back home...
What am I even talking to a Croaky for?
So many people are coming this way. What's happening?
You might wanna ask Leihe about this.
Do you know where I'm studying right now, Xiu?
Yeah! Jixia Academy, right? I wanna study there too!
That's the spirit! This place is where the academy holds its entrance exams.
You're a smart girl. I'm sure you'll get in as long as you work hard!
You're better than most kids. You'll make it.
Yeah! I'll beat all the exams there are, haha!
Let's split up. You gather firewood, and I'll go hunting.
With your physique, can you even hunt better than a wolf?
Should I let you, a Sorcery student, go instead? I'm much stronger than you.
Hmph, he's all talk. I use Sorcery Techniques to hunt, and it makes everything easier.
Since your Sorcery Techniques are so impressive, how about you go solve the Mechcraft nearby for me to see?
No way, I'm the hunter! You go gather firewood!
What's the key to this puzzle?
That strange beam of light might be important.
Now that you mention it... there does seem to be a strange Mechcraft in the opposite direction.
Could it be some sort of receiver?
Very likely, but it's facing the wrong way...
If only we could reflect the light. But... with what?
Where did that big lizard go...
A large Leaftail Lizard moved in lately and took that pond for itself.
I'm keeping tabs on it with my scope. Once it's out, I'll inform the others.
Be careful if you go near that place!
How did we do, Mr. Ding?
We'd love to hear your advice.
Yee, you're a gifted sorcerer. You have flexible moves, but your fundamentals are a bit shaky still.
Copy those theory notes again and hand them in tomorrow.
Zuochuan, your basics are much more solid. But the lack of change will put you at a disadvantage sometimes.
You won this match, but with Yee's quick wit, she might beat you next time.
Sit down and relax. I'm feeling dizzy just watching you getting worked up.
Then don't look. Don't you know that tension helps you perform better?
Listen, in Martial Arts we say: "Progress is made on diligence."
You've been practicing so hard day in and day out. You got this, okay?!
Thanks for the kind words, but you don't understand. Sorcery Runes are a test of one's mind.
To do well, you must have a clear mind.
But mine goes blank during exams every time. Ugh! Just leave me be!
Clouds come, clouds go. Exams now, exams then...
Try spending more time studying Sorcery Circles than this, okay?
Says someone who's doing the same thing.
I'm sensing how the Flow flows in you... some unorthodox power you have there.
There's nothing unorthodox in the world of Sorcery. As for the exam? I'm totally acing it.
Well, here's hoping you won't end up in remedial class.
What did I tell you last time? Sorcery can't be rushed!
I'm sorry, sir. I thought I'd found a quick solution.
I understand you want to prove yourself. We recruited you because you are sharp and quick-witted.
But Sorcery is not a very profound subject. Keeping ideas to yourself may yield disastrous outcome.
Yes, sir. We'll look out for each other.
Sorcery's different from Mechcraft or Martial Arts. To succeed, you must give it your all.
I'll keep that in mind, sir.
What's that platform for, big brother?
It's a part of the Path of Heroes trial.
You bet. The place has seen many ambitious challengers.
They say it dates back to the time of the Three Sages. Do you know about them?
Haha, that's right. The wisest, most powerful masters at Jixia Academy.
They wanted to give the students a real test, so they left a puzzle on this platform.
I wonder how the kids will do this year?
Don't be mad. Those Croakies didn't mean to upset you.
They just wanted to play. That tuft of fur was an accident...
I'll bring you treats next time, okay?
Just being here lifts my spirits. It's perfect for training!
I should bring my juniors here next time!
I need quiet for my Sorcery exam. Would you mind giving me some space?
You Sorcery folks are so fussy. Look at us. We can do our exam anytime anywhere.
Feng Xian is right, though. My instructor said they need a calm mind to control the Telepathic Threads.
If he's not focused, he won't be able to solve the Sorcery Circle test.
So, now that you understand... could you leave me alone for a while? I'll meet you guys once I'm done.
Alright, alright. We'll grab a table at your favorite spot. Don't be late, I'm starving!
They say the Path of Heroes trial back then was extremely brutal.
I'd so love to try it. Must be quite an exciting challenge.
Willing to push yourself, huh? Good.
When I joined the academy, I found the exam fairly simple.
But later I realized not everyone had such an easy time.
You're got great potential, but don't get complacent. It might bite you in the future.
I understand. That's why I want more challenge. Setbacks can humble me.
Since when did Sorcery trials become a spectator sport?
Preposterous... Do they take the Path of Heroes for some tourist attraction?
I... I'm sensing the energy flow in nature. Don't bug me!
Did you see that strange Mechcraft?
The one covered with a huge cloth? Yeah! What's it for?
I heard a Mechcraft student made it for Martial Arts trainings.
A combat puppet with an all-purpose Mechcraft blade that can switch between eighteen weapons instantly.
Wow! I wonder who made it and who it's for.
If only we could take a look.
Oh well... Everyone told me to scout ahead, but I'm kinda scared.
They said I'm the strongest, yet what happened was just a fluke!
That huge Wolvine suddenly jumped out from behind the tree. I panicked and punched it, and...
What if there are more Wolvines this time? It's too scary...
How many students do you think will be stumped by the exam?
I'd say at least a dozen fail here every year.
Yeah, this trial's tough. Wonder how many will pass this time?
I've seen many Martial Arts students get stuck at the shield.
A shield that can't be broken by force is indeed a challenge for them.
Those three pillars are tricky too. Even Mechcraft students will need some to time to figure them out.
Alright, enough chatter. Give me the binoculars, I want to watch too.
Hold on, just one more sec!
This path used to be an exam route of Jixia Academy.
You must be extra careful here.
Don't let curiosity lead you into danger.
So that's why there are so many Mechcrafts and ruins along this trail.
Didn't know it had such a history.
Thanks for the heads-up. I'll be careful.
I saw a strange Mechanoid here recently. I wonder what it was for.
This spot is on the Path of Heroes. Students often come here in their free time.
Maybe the Mechanoid was set up for a trial.
And it's been taken away now.
That's good. I was worried someone might get hurt.
That med you gave me! It worked wonders!
I even gave some to my friends. They all loved it!
Now I'm really interested in Herbalism! Can you teach me?
No... you'd better find someone else... Goodbye!
The range on this Mechcraft is insane...
Your runes are doing a good job boosting it. Still, I'd hoped for better.
Any other thoughts? I'm noting everything down.
The range is impressive, but my whole arm has gone numb.
And it takes too long to activate. In combat, we can't afford to lose that much time...
Where should we take the little Croaky next?
I think it is a bit overweight.
Let's bring it to Martial Arts workout with us.
Huh? The Croaky's not fat at all! You must be imagining things.
But the workout... sounds good! Croaky, wanna give it a shot?
Still, it might be a bit too hard for a tiny Croaky to learn those stuff.
But look! It is actually learning!
Impossible... I didn't even learn that fast. No... am I actually worse than a Croaky?
Is she ever going to stop or not!?
It's starting to make me head spin already.
I must do something about it. Maybe I can tamper with her flute.
It's okay. It takes wisdom and courage to admit defeat.
I know I'm no match for Senior Tao yet, but still... If only I could try again...
Admirable spirit. The key is you failed to spot his weak spots.
This is Martial Arts training no doubt, but Sorcery is equally important here. That's what a skilled fighter would do.
For instance, Tao Gu's lower body was unsteady when he punched. That was your chance, but you didn't sense it in time.
I see... let's have another round!
What we just saw was the Eastern Reed Pipe.
It really does look like an instrument.
Plant nomenclature is an interesting subject. Many are named for their appearance just like this one.
Next, we can look for Beakshade.
It's a good medicinal herb that looks like goldfish on the move.
Sounds great, let's look for it!
Excuse me, can we ask you something?
We are Traders, here to look for a friend of ours. He's supposed to help us examine some ancient coins.
Have you seen a shy young man, about this tall...
What, you've forgotten how tall Sun Bin is? What was the last time you saw him?
Of course I remember! I just had lunch with him not long ago.
What does Sun Bin look like again?
Look at those new students down there. They are nothing like us back in the days!
Can't agree more. Each year they just get worse.
I used to breeze through the Path of Heroes without a scratch. Novar even called me his successor.
Same here. I was even interviewed by Secrets Scoops. Said they'd put me on the front page!
Look who's talking. You're no better.
I made eye contact with a guard. He won't take me for a troublemaker, will he?
It's just a guard. Why so nervous?
That's the Forbidden Chamber. Don't you know?
Well... even if it is, I don't think it's gonna be a big deal.
But it is! The Forbidden Chamber's no joke. Not even a fly can get inside.
Let's go somewhere else. I don't want to get questioned. And keep what happened off the record.
Can you explore the ruins with me? Remember, I covered for you with Master Fuzi, right?
Please, not again... Last time you made me blast open an entrance.
It blasted them open all right, but out popped over twenty scorched-fur Giant Saepes...
zh_text: 轰是轰开了，但是跳出来二十多只毛发被燎着的巨木篱……
source_text: 轰是轰开了，但是跳出来二十多只毛发被燎着的巨木篱……

text: But you handled them well, didn't you?
This time we'll take a secret path, no dangers. Or are you scared?
Scared? Me? Just tell me where it is, I'm in.
Great! Remember, when we split the loot, it's 70% for me, 30% for you.
Go on, tell me how you feel.
Hmm, this bun has a crunchy texture from the tail ji seeds, and then a spicy flavor kicks in.
Hmm, this bun has a crunchy texture from the tail ji seeds, and then a spicy flavor kicks in.
Not bad... Huh? Why are there two of you now?
Not bad... Huh? Why are there two of you now?
Huh? These two combinations aren't toxic. Are you hallucinating?
Just take your time, it should be done in a flash.
Hmm... your two shadows finally merged. It tastes quite good, but please, no more clones.
Hmm... your two shadows finally merged. It tastes quite good, but please, no more clones.
Alright, I'll make some improvements next time and research the cause of hallucinations. I guarantee you'll see three... no, wait, you won't see any shadows.
Let me know when there are new samples to try.
Let me know when there are new samples to try.
Hello everyone! This is the International Student Help Desk. If you have any questions, feel free to ask.
Jixia Academy is divided into three schools: Martial Arts, Mechcrafts, and Sorcery.
Each focuses on a different area—physical training for Martial Arts, practical inventions for Mechcrafts, and perception of rules for Sorcery.
Sigh, whenever I see a mechanism puppet made in Chang'an, it stirs up my homesickness.
This is the Enlightenment Plaza, a hub for academy events and student activities. You can also find Society booths here.
Behind the academy is the Pastoral Garden, where students dine and relax.
Thanks! I'm curious, are you really a Mechanoid? You look so human.
Sorry, I'm afraid I can't answer that question.
Regarding the explosion at the Dream Performance Arena.
Sister, do you know what happened with the explosion at the Honor Tower during the Dream Performance finals?
Sorry, I'm afraid I can't answer that question.
Sigh, I know about that. I heard Master hid something underground there.
It ended up exploding because of the match between the Star Team and the Gui Die Team.
Then, seeing that his secret was out, the Master quietly slipped away.
That sounds fake, doesn't it? This doesn't seem like something the Master would do.
Well... I can't say for sure it's fake...
Tell me, what exactly did the Master hide?
How would I know... If you say it's fake, then you explain where the Master actually went?
See you. Let me know if you have any other questions.
Frenzied beasts have been appearing frequently lately. Students, please stay safe and trust in the academy.
What exactly happened at the academy?
Where is the Dean? I haven't seen the Star Team either... I'm very worried.
The academy will notify everyone once the situation is clarified.
Looking at it like this, business will be hard to do in the future...
Many foreign merchants are worried about being affected, and they'd rather take a detour.
Not to mention that cloud silk production has dropped, and the original advantage is gone.
Sigh... I wonder if Senior Sister Shye would have any ideas...
Alright. By the way, if you see Senior Shi, say hello for me.
There was an accident during the Dream Performance finals, and quite a few monsters appeared. There's been a lot of gossip outside.
Sigh... Ever since Senior Sister Shye got injured, business has been getting worse every day...
Sigh, I was really looking forward to seeing Master Luban's new mechanisms...
Sigh... Regarding the recent Great Mirage event, didn't a mysterious old man sabotage the arena and attack the students?
Everyone knows what's happening on the surface, but no one knows what's developing underground...
At that moment, Novar saw his teammates in crisis; he was anxious, and the old man was launching a fierce attack...
No sooner said than done, Novar gripped the Seven-Star Sword, unleashed his star power, stood before the old man, and shouted...
Wait... who did you hear that from?
Wait... who did you hear that from?
Novar's Heroic Team? Everyone says so, but I'm not done yet—the best part is still to come!
If you're interested in Novar's deeds, I can tell you about others...
Let's talk about it next time.
Let's talk about it next time.
It's a deal. Next time, don't stand me up.
Please do not linger in the outer perimeter!
The Lingyun Guard will do our best to ensure everyone's safety.
Since the Dream Performance, no one has seen the members of the Star Team...
The arena was destroyed like that, so they must be recovering from serious injuries.
That makes sense. I'll pull some strings and see if there's a chance to visit.
Hey! Don't leave your good brother behind when the time comes.
Sigh, if the competition hadn't been interrupted, the Star Team would have definitely been the champions this year!
What time is it to be talking about this...
Hmph, it's just a mere Divine Rune monster. What's there to be afraid of?
Li Bai is currently at Jixia. He only needs to make a slight move to wipe them all out!
What's wrong now? Why the long face?
I haven't seen Senior Yao around for a long time, could he have...
How did the Dream Performance finals just end like that...
I heard that the members of the Star Team were all seriously injured.
Master never appeared either. Could there be some connection behind this...
Whether there's a connection or not, I can't stay at the academy with peace of mind.
Exactly. Instead of wasting time on this, we should be thinking about how to boost the academy's morale.
Ever since the incident, everyone at the school has been looking so worried.
We were just thinking about organizing some kind of activity to boost the atmosphere at the academy.
Sigh, what do you think about holding a 'Hundred Schools Exhibition'?
That's so old-fashioned. How about we host an idol impersonation contest instead?
Hmm, that's an idea. I'll make a note of it.
Student, there have been many incidents lately, so please be careful. Is there anything I can help you with?
If you have any questions, feel free to ask.
We're the ones who attach the Flow to various tools and equipment. The bar is set very high to become one of us.
You need to master both Sorcery and Mechcraft, plus years of training as a Crafter.
Few can stick it out and have the talent to become a master. We're talking about one in ten thousand.
Yes, we do. We call it "Flow infusion." It's a way of shaping Flow and attaching its power to Gear.
This craft has a long history, and countries have applied it to vehicle construction.
The gear infused with Flow boasts excellent performance, but the high cost of materials makes it extremely pricey.
And what is even rarer are the master craftsmen with sufficient talent.
About recent events at the academy.
The Aerflow is fluctuating, far less abundant than before... and it's growing thinner by the moment...
Various facilities in the Academy have stopped working due to a lack of cloud flow and energy. I'm afraid this is a serious problem...
This is the first time such a problem has occurred with the Cloud Silkworms in all these years...
Safe travels! Come back anytime you need anything.
Strange... After checking, why has the cloud flow weakened so much...
Could it be... something went wrong with the Cloud Silkworm?
Let me use my genius brain to think... Monsters appearing... and at a time when supplies are tight...
There's a huge business opportunity hidden behind this...
What would you like to eat, student?
I can share it with you if you need it.
Is the food at the snack stall any good?
Well, you can tell by my size.
Feels like there are fewer people at the stalls lately...
If you ask me, it's because you're eating too little. As the saying goes, food settles the mind.
Once your belly is full, there's less to worry about.
Such a fragrant dish... why is no one here to eat it?
Isn't that the truth? Ever since the Mengyan finals ended in an accident, not only has there been no word, but a bunch of rumors have started flying around.
Some say the Master disappeared because he ran off with the Cloud Silkworm.
Some say someone infiltrated the academy with designs on the Cloud Silkworm, plotting something...
Delicious snacks will give you a hand! Defeating Divine Pattern monsters will be a piece of cake!
Sigh... Why is no one coming...
Cloud silk is becoming scarcer on the market... The price has risen so much that I don't even dare to stock it...
If I can't sell these and they end up stuck with me, the cat at home will have to skip so many meals...
Why is Dean Mozi not at the academy right now...
I'm afraid there will be fewer new students in the future...
The Dream Performance finals were going so well, how did an explosion happen?
Can't blame them; they'd definitely choose to attend a safe school.
I haven't seen Master for so long... Where on earth did he go...
Thank you for helping. I'm glad they're interested in the Team of Stars collections.
Your advice really worked! I made more in one go than I did in a whole week before!
Now I can afford Fuzzball's meds. Thank you!
Oh, Fuzzball? It's a little Croaky I found on a rainy day.
Poor thing's been sick lately. That's why I need the money.
Oh dear, what if someone gets hurt!
Why is such a dangerous item here?
Don't touch it. It's still being repaired.
This is my favorite book. Are you interested too?
Students from the School of Mechcraft really know their stuff.
Easy to get fresh water now.
Be careful not to burn yourself.
We want to know more details.
We want to know more details.
What does the food look like?
It took me a month to prepare the ingredients for this unique texture.
Jixia students really have some wild ideas.
I wanted to have it ready for the student to just grab and go.
But who would've thought this would happen! There's no time to prepare everything again.
Late deliveries mean bad reviews for me!
If someone did this intentionally, it's truly malicious.
Thanks, we understand the situation now.
If someone really stole your food, I'll make sure justice is served.
And it happens to be a <001>delivery order</> today.
We'd never dream of such flavors back home.
We'll help you find out the truth.
This dish is missing? Just make another one!
This dish is missing? Just make another one!
Don't be fooled by its simple appearance. It's quite tricky to make!
How can I not be anxious?!
That's our signature dessert—my own creation, found nowhere else!
It has a mild <001>aroma</> of Skipple, with a lingering flavor that will leave you wanting more!
These divine-pattern monsters are really fierce... We still haven't been able to fully deal with them...
Better get some more prescriptions for treating external injuries, just in case.
If that God-pattern monster keeps lurking nearby and isn't dealt with, it will probably affect the number of new students...
Students, don't be afraid! The Lingyun Guard will protect you all!
Please do not worry excessively; stay calm.
W-what's going on! How did the outer ring of the Tongtian Tower end up like this?
Ah! If that thing falls... the academy will be destroyed!
Everyone, don't panic. The situation is still under control, and we will guard the safety of the academy and the students.
Recruiting for the Mechanism Repair Squad! Those interested, please sign up!
The outer ring of the Heavenly Tower has shattered. We are now recruiting a squad to design a repair plan to ease the teachers' burdens.
Can those not from the School of Mechcraft sign up? We want to help too.
Of course! Let's all work together!
Sigh! Student, do you know how the other members of the Star Team are doing?
What's wrong with the academy? I haven't seen the Dean and the others...
Academic Discipline dog, cheer up! We can help if needed.
The wheel is normal, the core... is fine. The rocker arm... is also intact...
After checking everything... only the cloud-flow concentration is significantly lower than normal...
The Aerflow is waning... Could something be wrong with the Aer-silkworms...
I wonder when I'll be able to see the loom weaving cloud silk again...
Hmm... not necessarily. Senior Fang Yu is still checking; let's wait and see what he says.
You've checked it three times already, Senior. Can this loom actually be used or not...
Strange, I don't remember the outer ring of the Tongtian Tower being this shape...
Could something have happened when I went fishing?
Lu Lu, how is it? Did you smell anything suspicious?
With such a major incident, why haven't we seen the Dean?
I think the Master must be dealing with something more pressing.
The Dream-Reverie has gone well for years, why did it explode this time...
It's all the fault of those people from the Institute of Mechanics. They inspect everything every day, how did they miss such a huge hazard?
Sigh... Alright, alright, blaming them now won't help... The injured won't just get better like that.
The outer ring of the Tower of Enlightenment is broken! Wait, what should we do in this situation...
I need to contact the Gongqiao family... No, no, report to the Mechanism Academy first...
Senior... Dean Mozi is not at the academy right now...
Senior, will we be unable to attend classes from now on?
Why now of all times... I don't know where the Master went either, the academy is going to be in chaos...
Classmate, is everyone in the Star Team... okay?
You must keep your spirits up; don't do anything rash.
Sigh, even the number of people buying sheet music has dropped significantly...
The notes are in disarray... hard to form a melody...
Not much, really. Ever since the academy went through those changes, fewer people have been interested in studying the principles of musical notation.
I am also someone who plays the zither, so seeing this, I'm just a bit sentimental.
Music resonates deeply, forming bridges of memories. Have you ever experienced that?
A melody from the past brings memories flooding back, along with the emotions of that time.
Shh, did you hear that? The music that cleanses the soul...
Grand, melodious, dramatic, ethereal... Endless symphonies await your selection.
Music resonates deeply, forming bridges of memories. Have you ever experienced that?
A melody from the past brings memories flooding back, along with the emotions of that time.
Students, please maintain order. We will ensure everyone's safety!
This incident was so sudden... it was hard to avoid students getting caught up in it...
The ones who were injured during the incident were members of the Guidie Team and the Star Team...
But after the incident, many strange monsters appeared in the surrounding area... and many students were injured.
We are also looking for ways to see if there is anything we can do to help.
Hmm, you should cheer up too, classmate!
An explosion at the finals arena blew away my fortune.
Let me know if you need anything.
There's too much to list. Let's just say, big or small, whatever the function, the shop has it all.
From divine weapons to knickknacks, our selection will leave you spoiled for choice.
Do you travel for trade often?
Indeed, I frequently make trade runs, mostly to Frostcloud Town and Aerux Town.
Both places have bustling markets, especially Frostcloud Town—a flourishing hub co-built by Society members.
I'm content as long as I still have business to do.
We have guests? Welcome! Welcome! What would you like to buy? Feel free to look around!
Sigh, don't mention it. Ever since the Dreamscape Performance finals were suspended, foot traffic has dropped by more than half.
We were barely hanging on with the cloud silk, but now the production is failing too...
The silkworm sleeps, the cocoon forms, breaking free for a new life...
Monsters appearing... cloud current anomalies... Could this be some kind of omen?
It's really depressing at a time like this without any music to accompany us.
Come take a look, we've got everything you need!
Jixia Merchant Guild travels across Jixia to collect the finest goods.
The wide array of goods has been carefully selected, and the quality is trustworthy.
High quality and low price, lots of discounts!
My shop offers all kinds of peculiar items, most of which you've probably never seen before.
Aerux Town, Autumn Streams, Harvest Fields, Dreamweave Lake... The more remote the places are, the more I like them.
The fields below are full of treasures and oddities, just waiting for someone with eyes for them.
Anything catches your eye? We're flexible with prices.
Actually, I'm not from here. I'm from Harvest Fields.
It takes quite a while to go up or down from this mountain slope.
Sigh... With the trouble at the academy lately, business has been much harder to come by...
I hope things get better once we weather this storm.
It's fate that we've met. If you ever need anything, just drop by.
Academy supplies are tight, I need to keep track of everything.
I'll ask the Chamber of Commerce later to see if there's a chance to help the academy.
Even the fish are too scared to show their heads now...
Monsters are swarming, and there are anomalies in the cloud currents...
Shh, keep it down. You'll scare the fish away!
Since you're already here, take a look and see if there's anything you need.
But there's less fish than before. For some reason, a lot of animals have come to the pond.
Probably snatching up a good share of the fish.
Do you know the owner of the Qingyixuan shop?
We go way back. We were rivals back in our days at the School of Martial Arts.
Actually, he was the one pestering me to compete in this and that, wasting so much of my fishing time.
After graduation, we both found our own paths.
He cooks, I fish. The fish I catch always end up in his pot...
Fish haven't been biting lately, and I didn't expect his shop to be so empty of customers either...
Goodbye. Are you sure you won't take another look?
I thought my temperament had improved...
But it wasn't until something actually went wrong that I realized... I still have a lot to learn...
Get down before the teacher gets angry!
The table is not to be stepped on...
Twilight dims here and there; through twilight we fare.
Poems east and poems west; on Poetry Bridge they rest.
Welcome to Darkpool Camp! If you need help, just ask. The arena's right behind you. Best of luck!
I really want to sneak off.
Get down, or I'll get in trouble.
Why are there so few people eating here since the Star Team members got injured...
It won't do for a young person to be so worried that they don't eat...
Welcome to Qingyi Pavilion! What can I get you?
I, Yu Huan, am not bragging. Although the number of customers has dropped recently, the quality of the food is still top-notch! Order with confidence!
I'm the owner and chef here, known for crafting the finest fish dishes in Jixia.
I owe a lot to my old buddy who supplies us with the best fish from the Greenwhisper Pool.
There have been fewer customers lately, and there's more and more fish left in the shop. I think I'll go release them later...
The Azure Arena? I've heard the champion is skipping meals for battles. That's not the true path of a martial artist!
The championship is hardly an excuse for skipping meals. A martial artist needs proper nutrition!
My own daughter just got into the academy, and I bet she's skipping meals too. Kids these days.
So, you've conquered the arena before?
So, you've conquered the arena before?
Some things are best left unasked.
Hmm... maybe I should have the boy deliver takeout to the arena. What a headache.
Make sure to come back for our new dishes!
We're closed for the day. Come back in the morning!
Business has been slow lately, but at least the pots and stoves are much easier to clean...
The menu hasn't changed in ages. If we added some new dishes, we might attract more customers.
Ah, treasure of Sunset! You must be the destined one for me!
As you can probably tell, I hail from Navenia. You can call me Steve.
I'm a writer. Came to this wondrous land to track down a legendary adventurer's tale.
The last records of him in Navenia indicate that he sailed to Jixia, taking a lifetime of treasures with him.
I've asked around, but he lived so long ago that there are barely any clues.
A kind Seeker told me that the Treasure Probes scattered throughout the mountains point to hidden treasure.
Perhaps they can lead us to clues about the legendary adventurer.
Thing is, I'm no fighter. Mountains are too dangerous for me.
I can tell you're capable. Would you help me look for clues of this adventurer?
Any treasure we find is yours to keep!
Let's see. This is a story about Saepes.
The adventurer found nothing during his search in Springbrook Plains. Dejected, he went into the wilds—only to get chased by a horde of Saepes.
Sounds like something Saepes would do.
After defeating the Saepes, he found the cause for their rage.
The Saepes' habitat was dying, the plants withering inexplicably.
Without plants, new Saepes could not be born.
Ah yes, I've heard of their plight.
Ah yes, I've heard of their plight.
The adventurer gave them a treasure that could heal plants.
The Saepes became his friend and showed him the way.
Hard to imagine Saepes being so friendly. What a remarkable fellow.
Kindness begets kindness. Hope we can meet friendly Saepes too.
Kindness begets kindness. Hope we can meet friendly Saepes too.
Ha! The last Saepes I ran into left me with a lump that took three days to heal!
The Saepes in this story are straight out of a fairytale!
With all the clues gathered, the manuscript is now in its initial draft stage.
Who would've guessed it would be such a romantic tale?
Saved by this land, the explorer safeguarded numerous lives in return.
Take this copy of the manuscript. I hope to see you again in Navenia.
The Saepes guided him straight to Aerfall Highlands.
There, he ran into a fiercer beast—Embermane. It took him to its lair, but didn't eat him.
He tried to escape, but failed every time. Eventually, he just gave up.
However, he discovered a curious fact. Despite their fierce looks, Embermanes behaved like... big cats.
Uh... big cats? Wait, let me check... yeah, definitely big cats.
He used a round gem as a ball and gold coins as toys.
He spent the whole day playing with the Embermane, and they became friends.
I couldn't believe it either... But apparently the Embermane gave him a ride through dangerous territory.
Pretty convenient, except it burned his trousers.
Maybe we should try befriending a Embermane?
Maybe we should try befriending a Embermane?
As tempting as it sounds, I didn't bring spare trousers.
Perhaps another time, when I'm better prepared.
After parting ways with the Embermane, he collapsed in a cave, taken by fever and exhaustion.
When he woke up, he saw a Naughty Civet busying about.
And he found himself completely healed.
The Naughty Civet saved him, but it seemed upset.
The Naughty Civet had used all its precious herbs to cure him.
He repaid the kindness by buying it loads of herbs.
Enough to fill the Naughty Civet's den. The happy Naughty Civet called all its friends over.
They ran around the cave, circling him excitedly.
They set about helping him find the path to the legendary Skywell.
Awww... that's so sweet. It makes me want to cry.
Back in my days at the academy, I heard stories about Naughty Civets helping injured senior students.
Finally, he reached that fabled Skywell.
But it wasn't the paradise he'd imagined.
The war shattered everything at Jixia.
The scenery, creatures, and people, all fading away under its brutal sweep.
He thought of all the animal friends who had helped him along the way.
He poured his entire fortune into finding ways to secure a refuge for them in Skywell, away from the horrors of war.
The Skywell protected countless creatures that would have otherwise perished.
The war... Didn't expect it to end so cruelly.
True, war is merciless, but for them, it might have been a blessing.
True, war is merciless, but for them, it might have been a blessing.
Although the explorer's name wasn't recorded, I will remember him for sure!
He did everything he could for his animal friends. To them, he was nothing less than a savior.
Giving everything he had for their sake, noble indeed.
Giving everything he had for their sake, noble indeed.
It ended well for both the explorer and the animals.
The sea took everything, so I set out for a place without sorrow.
That's right. Based on this poem, I'd say his family perished at sea.
Grief-stricken, he sought a legendary haven, a place that erases all sorrow.
Could such a place really exist?
Could such a place really exist?
Who knows? The record ends here.
He added a footnote saying that he carried his life's treasures with him.
I hope he found the place he was searching for.
Are you upset that I didn't play along?
Are you upset that I didn't play along?
Why would I be? I've been pestering you, and it worked out pretty well, didn't it?
We both held back, and you saw that right away.
You both care about each other. Just say what you're thinking.
You both care about each other. Just say what you're thinking.
I get it now. Thanks for today!
No problem! Good luck with the challenge!
No problem! Good luck with the challenge!
The ending after triggering Xu Ting's storyline.
Xu Ting, don't take it the wrong way. I'm not trying to fool you...
She's exaggerating. I'm not exactly a rare goods merchant.
She's exaggerating. I'm not exactly a rare goods merchant.
But the Lucky Elixir is real, just like she said.
But the Lucky Elixir is real, just like she said.
Feeling skeptical? Just try it and see! I'm a Jixia student too, and I won't hurt you.
Feeling skeptical? Just try it and see! I'm a Jixia student too, and I won't hurt you.
Fine, for Wen Rui's sake, I'll give it a shot.
Wow, it really seems to work! I feel better than ever!
Fantastic! I told you it'd work!
I'll go sign up now! Wait for my good news, Wen Rui!
You're both doing this for each other. Why not just make things clear?
You're both doing this for each other. Why not just make things clear?
If you won't admit it, I'll do it for you!
If you won't admit it, I'll do it for you!
Xu Ting didn't take the challenge because he didn't want to let you down.
Xu Ting didn't take the challenge because he didn't want to let you down.
And Wen Rui went through all this trouble to make sure you didn't miss this opportunity.
And Wen Rui went through all this trouble to make sure you didn't miss this opportunity.
So, do you two finally understand each other?
So, do you two finally understand each other?
I would never be disappointed if you failed. Don't you know that?
I'm sorry, I've been too indecisive. You've done so much for me, and I...
I get it now. I won't behave like that again.
I'll sign up now and give it my all!
Triggered after dialogue with Xu Ting.
Finally, I get to interview the champion!
Who taught her? What's her practice routine like? When does she fuel up?
I might as well ask everything!
So, is there anything you need?
Are you working on a Formula?
So many students are injured. I want to see if I can prepare some simple, fast-acting medicine...
See you later... Where was I?
Adding this herb will enhance the hemostatic effect, but will it be too harsh on the wound...
Yes... I heard there have been many more monsters since the explosion at the Dream Performance finals...
The damage caused by Divine Imprint monsters is mostly physical, but there is also strange energy corruption...
Is there any medicinal herb that can prevent it...
Once cloud silk becomes scarce on the market, the price just shoots up...
The cost is so high, how am I supposed to sell this...
Top-quality goods. If you have Aerpower Chips, feel free to trade.
Does selling things affect my research?
Maybe I should just find a place with more foot traffic to do business...
Can't afford to miss this opportunity.
Classmate, you're already behind on the news. I'll be kind and tell you.
The latest intel from my buddy at the School of Mechcraft says the loom is unusable now, and the cloud flow concentration has dropped significantly.
Cloud Energy is a finite resource! If I don't do business now, I won't have the means to continue my research!
So many brilliant people at the School of Mechcrafts couldn't fix the loom. I don't think it'll be of any use in the future.
I must strike first and stockpile more Cloud Silk to prepare for future research.
Even at a time like this, one must not forget to hone their martial arts.
I heard you've been locked away for days working on war strategies.
Yes, Master. I'm finishing Meng's New War Tactics!
You're talented and ambitious, but working alone has its downsides.
I leaned on past wisdom too for my Mechcraft work.
I read military strategies sometimes. I think the notes in this book might be useful to you.
Master Mozi... alright, I'll read it.
Thanks for the feedback! Let me know if you need anything else!
Thank you! Your spirit reminds me of Senior Zhou Yu!
He loved this piece and gave me lots of advice.
I adjusted it to match the vibe of Darkpool Camp.
Looking for someone who understands your music?
Did he say why he's leaving?
Did he say why he's leaving?
I don't have time right now.
No, that's not right. Always a bit slow here. If he were here...
Playing tunes but none reply; Far I roam, alone am I.
Yes. It seems you understand and enjoy music.
My bond with Arman means so much to me.
Oh, sorry. I forgot to introduce myself.
Our band is getting ready for the academy's music contest.
Arman plays Guqin, but he just said he wanted to leave.
It's almost impossible for us to win without him.
Definitely! From what I've seen, only Yuhuan from Chang'an compares to him.
Music brought Arman and me together.
I've always looked up to Yuhuan since childhood. My name is actually inspired by her music.
Her tunes make you feel your dreams could come true.
I heard Jixia's Musicians are masters of all styles and wanted to improve my skills too.
So I came here, and I met Arman at a concert.
He played the Guqin from Alsahraa, and his music made me feel like I was in the Sandy Wastes.
The vast desert, endless sand... His music spoke to my soul.
I joined the Music Society and his band because I wanted to play as well as he does.
No, just that he's going back to the Sandy Wastes.
He has been busy at the academy recently and hasn't joined our practices.
He did leave us a gift at the School of Mechcraft, to say sorry.
He said we'll understand him after seeing it... Strange, right?
He is frugal, often does part-time jobs, and only gives greeting cards during holidays—never gifts.
He's careful with Ringild and doesn't usually join our activities, so I was surprised he gave us a gift.
We're busy practicing. Can you help us pick up the gift?
I'll make it worth your while, of course!
Music connects Musicians, but we failed to understand him this time...
All right. Thanks for listening, though.
Where can I find another kindred spirit...
Where is the gift? I should ask someone about it.
Where is the gift? I should ask someone about it.
Hello, I'm here to pick up a gift.
Hello, I'm here to pick up a gift.
Oh, that one. It's on the table across from the Fabricator. Take it.
I'm here to pick something up.
It's a Guqin... Looks a bit old.
It's a Guqin... Looks a bit old.
He brought it from Alsahraa and always treasured it most.
Why would he leave it with us?
Does it mean... he's giving up on music?
That would be a real pity.
If anyone could surpass Yuhuan one day...
I've always looked up to him. How could he just quit now...
What's the point of this gift if I can't learn from him anymore?
Forget it. Everyone has their own path.
Maybe he wasn't happy playing with us. Maybe I just didn't notice...
Actually, I heard he's staying at the School of Mechcraft these days.
Yes. If it weren't for his teacher, he might have left the Music Society long ago.
Anyway, we should thank him with a gift in return.
I got it! How about a farewell concert?
That's a great idea. How can I help?
That's a great idea. How can I help?
Well... We need the perfect music, and the perfect audience.
Arman's quiet, but he shows his feelings through his music.
Once, after reading a letter from home, he played a piece full of anger.
None of us knew what happened, or how to help.
Then a girl from Madinat Erudit came over and spoke to him. Arman immediately brightened up.
During that time, she always came to us. She said she saw Alsahraa in Arman's music.
Later, we found out her name was Glazia, and she was a scholar-in-training from Madinat Erudit.
She was unlike anyone in Chang'an. My mother said ladies should hide their teeth when smiling.
But Glazia always smiled big, like a blooming flower.
I admit I was a bit jealous.
Then the Debates of Societies began. She got quite busy there and stopped visiting us.
Ever since, Arman has always seemed distracted and asked about the Debates of Societies a lot.
Later, he composed a piece called "Ballad of Caves and Sands."
He clearly cares about that piece. He's revised it many times but never plays it for others.
I heard it once. It's Madinat Erudit style, but mixed with the desolation of the Sandy Wastes.
Quite different from his usual style.
And he never played it for Glazia, which was strange—I thought she'd like it.
So you want Arman to perform Ballad of Caves and Sands?
So you want Arman to perform Ballad of Caves and Sands?
If he's made up his mind, I want him to leave without regrets.
Pluck the bloom while it's here. Don't wait till the branch is bare.
As his... friend, I have to help him.
I'll set the stage and invite Glazia. As for Arman...
Thank you. He should be working at Roaring Tiger Training Hall.
And please don't tell him about our special guest.
There's news about the Head Trainer.
No, that's not right. Always a bit slow here. If he were here...
Living in the same era as him—whose misfortune is it, really?
zh_text: “与他生在同一个时代，究竟是谁的不幸？”
source_text: “与他生在同一个时代，究竟是谁的不幸？”

text: The stars are arranged in their positions, with the Three Enclosures and Four Symbols. Accurately mapping the constellations is quite a challenge.
Yes, everyone in the astrology class was required to create their own Starmaps, with no limitations on format.
Create their own Starmaps... sounds tricky.
Create their own Starmaps... sounds tricky.
I'm spinning now. Nevertheless, I heard that Dong Hai replicated the Genius's Starmap.
Yes. There was a Starmap competition back then. Guess who won first place?
Speaking of geniuses and top achievers, it must be Kongming.
Speaking of geniuses and top achievers, it must be Kongming.
Novar is wonderful, but the champion was Zhou Yu.
Really? I heard he never bested Kongming while in Jixia.
Really? I heard he never bested Kongming while in Jixia.
Don't know about that. Can you borrow the Starmap for me? I want to use it as a reference.
If you get it, I'll tell you a secret about Kongming's stargazing.
You'll find Dong Hai on the second floor of the Violet Chamber. Mind you though, he can be very stern.
I'm busy right now. Maybe try asking someone else.
I'm busy right now. Maybe try asking someone else.
After the stargazing contest, lots of students are still talking about it.
Before you visit Mr. Dong Hai, talk to these students. You might learn something useful.
Tan Cheng asks you to borrow Zhou Yu's Starmap from Mr. Dong Hai.
The stars are spread out, the three enclosures and four symbols, it's really hard to accurately represent the arrangement of the constellations on the map!

text: This Moon Reading is a bit odd: An esteemed guest arrives.
Hello, I heard you have a Sample Starmap from the previous winners of the Stargazing Competition. Tan Cheng sent me to borrow it.
Hello, I heard you have a Sample Starmap from the previous winners of the Stargazing Competition. Tan Cheng sent me to borrow it.
Not now, I'm stargazing! Do you have any idea how valuable these Sample Starmaps are? By the way, you look different.
I can't do your star reading. Could you be the "esteemed guest"? Interesting.
Fine, I'll give you a chance. I will lend you the Starmap if you can answer my question.
If I were the esteemed guest, shouldn't you just give it to me? Alright, I'll try.
If I were the esteemed guest, shouldn't you just give it to me? Alright, I'll try.
What do you think is the meaning of astrology?
Understanding the connections between humans and the world through the positions and movements of celestial bodies.
Understanding the connections between humans and the world through the positions and movements of celestial bodies.
Correct. Celestial bodies and people on Earth share a special bond.
Things that elude our attention become our fate.
Things that elude our attention become our fate.
That's true. Through the movements of the stars and the cycles of life, astrology reveals destiny.
Quite well. Still, I'm curious about your star reading.
Can I borrow the sample now?
Can I borrow the sample now?
Here. But if anything happens to it, you'll hear from me.
The Starmap... it's just like a real starry night. How did he manage that?
The Starmap... it's just like a real starry night. How did he manage that?
Zhou Yu baked the paint with the power of fire, winning first place.
Outstanding. What about Kongming's work? Why didn't it win?
Outstanding. What about Kongming's work? Why didn't it win?
Recently, my prized student replicated a different Starmap.
Apparently, it also won first place at that time.
Tied for first? I'll go see for myself.
Tied for first? I'll go see for myself.
She's in the library, on the second floor. Don't wander. Go down this way.
After passing the test and obtaining the starmap, you find that Zhou Yu and Kongming were tied for first place. Curious, you head to the second-floor library to find out more.
Hello, I wanted to ask about the starmap...
Both of them were created by Zhou Yu.
Both of them were created by Zhou Yu.
You made it! Now I can start my Starmap.
I was told Zhou Yu only won because Kongming didn't compete.
I was told Zhou Yu only won because Kongming didn't compete.
I heard that too. He probably didn't see his only victory coming with his rival as the judge.
It's hard to imagine how he felt back then.
I have to get this stargazing model done for Zhou Yu, so it can shine bright at Jixia!
He'd be pleased to have a junior recreating his work.
He'd be pleased to have a junior recreating his work.
Anyway, thank you for your help.
To make it worth your while, I'll tell you where Kongming stargazed during the competition.
However, it's high and challenging, so not everyone can reach it.
If you're interested, you can prepare for it.
Tan Cheng tells you the position where Kongming stargazed during the competition.
Hello, I heard you've recreated a copy of the previous winners' Sample Starmap from the Stargazing Competition. I'm here to borrow it.
Hello, I heard you've recreated a copy of the previous winners' Sample Starmap from the Stargazing Competition. I'm here to borrow it.
Sorry. All the samples have been borrowed.
Don't worry, I made a rough one for myself yesterday. You can use it if you'd like.
Over there on the bookshelf. It's a Stargazing Mechcraft Model.
You ask Sun Xiaoqin for a sample starmap from past competitions. She offers her own practice work, which can be found on a nearby bookshelf.
Is this it? Can a Starmap be done this way?
Is this it? Can a Starmap be done this way?
It's not my credit. I just recreated Zhou Yu's masterpiece. It precisely simulates celestial movements and took first place back then!
Didn't he already make a Starmap using special paints?
Didn't he already make a Starmap using special paints?
Zhou Yu is a high achiever who always provides three answers for each test. Absolutely perfect.
A flat map wasn't enough for him, so he crafted a three-dimensional model. I want to be like him.
Actually, he didn't participate. The teacher had an urgent matter to attend to, so he made Kongming a judge for the competition.
Well... Zhou Yu must've been disappointed.

Alright, I'll be quick. See you both soon.
I see. You found ancient records and followed them to make flawless medicine.
Unfortunately, it doesn't help my condition at all.
No way! We followed every detail from the Index of Ailments!
Sometimes people get stuck in their usual way of thinking and overlook things. Think it over again.
Have you seen her since? Weren't you going to apologize?
Have you seen her since? Weren't you going to apologize?
I've been busy working on the medicine, so...
Or... Maybe Perilla wanted to buy us more time to think things through and used medicine to manage her symptoms?
I don't think so. We really need to hurry, though.

If I must say... there are indeed differences, but they can all be explained by theories in the classics...

Found some warm bottles. She might really be taking medicine secretly.

I have an idea. Let's make a new medicine for Ms. Perilla.
This scent is familiar. You two make the medicine, and I'll try to find out where it comes from.
You got a clue? Tell us right away so we can help. If you work alone, it might take too long.
You have to make the medicine. We don't have much time. I'm going now.
Uh... He's pretty stubborn, but he gets things done.
Great! By the way, you've gotten so much better since we first met. Here's a gift for you.

text: It's done! Thanks to you holding off the beasts, every step went smoothly. The medicine is flawless.
Ms. Perilla, what brings you here?
Ms. Perilla, what brings you here?
The Dimfruit's scent woke me up, and I saw your medicine attracting beasts.
You handled everything really well, and the medicine looks good. Nice work.
By the way, where's Mooko? Why isn't she here with you?
Uh... She's supposed to be trying out our other idea.
Yes, definitely. Otherwise, we wouldn't have gotten this far without their help.
Since Ms. Perilla is here, let's show her our answer.
So you finally stopped arguing and teamed up. I've hoped you'd work together someday.
Let me guess—our new friend really helped you out, right?
The scent of the medicine draws Perilla over. You hand her the finished medicine to test the results.
It's done. Shinye must be waiting.
It's done. Shinye must be waiting.
The herbs are processed—only one ingredient left: <001>Purple Guardian Powder</>.
Can you make it? I heard your skills are much better now.
Actually, I'm worried the Dimfruit might attract beasts again.
Maybe we should find a place that's rarely visited.
Maybe we should find a place that's rarely visited.
Good idea. Let's meet near the waterwheel.
With the herbs partly prepared, one last ingredient is needed, the Purple Guardian Powder. Making it may draw wild beasts, so you decide to work by the waterwheel in the garden, away from the crowds.
Why are you here? Where's the client?
He left a note that said he "doesn't want the goods anymore" and has vanished. Bo Zheng, what should we do?
But he paid the deposit. What was the point?
I'm sorry you got dragged into this mess. Keep the Shock Casket for now. Maybe you'll find a use for it later.
Bo Zheng, are we just going to let this go?
Of course not. But Glazia will be here any minute. Go get some rest. I'll come find you later.
The client seems to have sensed something amiss and has abandoned the transaction.
True Crafters, what do you want?
I heard you have <001>Mech Cores that change circuits</>.
That's not my problem. What are you buying?
We want info. Who bought that Mech Core recently?
I don't share buyer info, or I'd go out of business.
None of my business. I'm just a merchant.
Fine. If no info, we want a Mech Core.
You heard me. They're in demand. A big buyer just took most of my stock. I've got only one left.
Believe it or not, that's the price. If you want more, you have to wait.
No way he's going to reveal who the buyer is.
At least we learned that person bought more than one...
Bo Zheng, your father is in charge of the herb grove's renovation. Should we warn him?
If only we could find him. He's always so busy—we can't rely on him.
Let's modify the Mechanoids so they can't be tampered with.
Great idea. It would really solve the problem at its core.
I need you to grab my toolbox from my workshop. Glazia knows where.
We're short on time. I'll check the Mechanoids at the Pastoral Herb Grove.
You don't check buyers—someone misused your product.
Even if someone used it for harm?
That's too expensive. Jixia must be filled with people who spend foolishly.
Are you saying there will be another sabotage?
Are you saying there will be another sabotage?
Exactly. Many Mechanoids are currently in the herb grove. I'm afraid...
What should we do, Bo Zheng?
What should we do, Bo Zheng?
The workshop is south here, west of the Crafters' camp. I'll wait for you there.
After learning someone bought a ton of circuit-altering Mech Cores, you decide to modify the Mechanoids first. You and Glazia head to Bo Zheng's workshop to grab his toolbox.
Can you craft a Shock Casket? It's not too complex.
We need to hurry, my client could arrive at any moment.
I'll finish another order. If you need me, I'm over there.
Bo Zheng asks you to help craft a Shock Casket.
I'm here to get his toolbox. But... what's that barrier?
I'm here to get his toolbox. But... what's that barrier?
Why would I know that? Didn't he explain it to you?
All I know is that it's powered by that large structure. You can start from there.
That's all I can help with. Good luck!
Do you know how to disable it?
Do you know how to disable it?
To lift the anti-theft measures and grab Bo Zheng's toolbox, you have to deal with the large Mechcraft creation outside first.
Come on. I'm willing to pay more Ringild!
I'm not going to say this again: I only sell to true Crafters.
Only true Crafters can buy "the special items."
How do we prove we're "true Crafters"?
How do we prove we're "true Crafters"?
See this structure? It's my masterpiece. Show me your Mechcraft skills—activate it!
To buy parts from Crafter Li and find clues, you need to study his Mechcraft creations and prove you're "true Crafters."
It's a hard quest. See? The merchant is losing patience.
Glazia was right—you're talented at crafting.
It's about time. I wonder what's keeping them.
You give the Shock Casket to Bo Zheng.
Wow, you're fast! Hand it over, let's get to work.
Bo Zheng, I got your toolbox.
Bo Zheng, I got your toolbox.
You hand the toolbox over to Bo Zheng.
So if anyone tries to replace the Mech Cores, they would be...
So if anyone tries to replace the Mech Cores, they would be...
Thanks to you both, we're nearly done.
That's right. I've installed a self-defense system and an alarm.
Don't worry. It's just a mild electric shock that causes temporary paralysis.
I also reinforced them and added extra recorders.
Some Crafters use Sorcery for protection, but I prefer pure Mechcraft designs.
Thanks. You're skilled too. I forgot to explain my toolbox's anti-theft system, but you managed.
Very impressive. You deserve this Crafter's belt.
If I catch that person, Bo Zheng won't show mercy!
Well, I've kept you busy for a while...
No worries. Call if you need me again.
No worries. Call if you need me again.
So the Mechanoids can't be tampered with anymore?
Ah... sorry, I ended up rambling.
Hopefully, no more trouble at Pastoral Garden.
It identifies you as a Crafter and will support you as you work on improving your skills.

You successfully modify the Mechanoids in the Pastoral Herb Grove, programming them to shock any malicious tamperers. Before parting ways, Bo Zheng gifts you a belt symbolizing the identity of a Crafter.
You're here already? Faster than me.
The Mechanoid was tampered with. The test results confirm it.
Someone installed a Mech Core that <001>changed the inner circuits</> and its behavior.
The Mechanoid became a thief. That's suspicious.
Now that the Reflection Gem is recovered, leave it to me. Jixia won't let go of any evil.
Please don't waste your time, or I'll be blamed for not looking after you.
Don't worry. I've decided, and I promise no one will blame you.
The main thing is to find out if the person behind will harm Pastoral Garden.
He mentioned buying special Mechcraft parts.
He's now down the mountain. We can catch him if we hurry.
You wanna find out who did it?
You wanna find out who did it?
But we have no leads yet. Where do we start?
But we have no leads yet. Where do we start?
Yes, he stopped us at the Fabricator.
Yes, he stopped us at the Fabricator.
I got him to spill—those parts were from a merchant named Crafter Li.
Turns out someone modified the Mechanoids to steal. You decide to start with the Crafters involved in the illegal trade and head back to the back mountain to investigate.
If I knew it'd be this troublesome, I'd have skipped this job.
I'm observing this structure... Glazia is struggling to negotiate with that merchant.
She's over there talking to that merchant. I doubt we can get any useful information from him.
Oops, when did you come here?
No problem. So what was up with that Mechanoid? Did Glazia get the results?
No problem. So what was up with that Mechanoid? Did Glazia get the results?
Great to see you! Thanks for your help with Glazia and the gem.
Yes, but let's talk later. Glazia told me you know how to use the Fabricator.
Perfect! I need urgent help with a crafting task. Can you assist?
Yes, and I've been improving my crafting skills.
Yes, and I've been improving my crafting skills.
Glazia identified the cause of the rogue Mechanoid. But before you rendezvous with her, Bo Zheng needs your help with a creation.
What a day. Get some rest!
With the Crafter's headpiece and belt, you should honor your role well!
Bo Zheng, think it over. It's a great chance.
This project isn't worth it. Your dad and I are hoping you'll change your mind.
Glazia, let's bring the toolbox to Bo Zheng.
Glazia, let's bring the toolbox to Bo Zheng.
I should check where I first met them...
I should check where I first met them...
The toolbox is under protection. Anyone here knows how to unlock it?
All thanks to Bo Zheng's Discipline Dog, I got my gem back.
Bo Zheng told me he built it when he was young.
This table's a mess... Where's the toolbox?
We're short on time. Let's try to activate that structure.
It worked! I knew you could do it!
Timing is crucial for connecting them...
Timing is crucial for connecting them...
His relationship with his father is so strained...
His relationship with his father is so strained...
That merchant should be here. Wait... is that Bo Zheng?
That merchant should be here. Wait... is that Bo Zheng?
I haven't been here much. Glad I found it.
You'll succeed in the challenge if you activate the three mechanical birds on the roof within thirty seconds!
