text: He only sees greatness in his grand creations, never recognizing the value of my small ones.
So I modified a Mechanoid and had it steal the Mech Core.
Cheer up! The plants in the Pastoral Herb Grove are safe now.
Is it "saving" if you almost let them die before helping?
Bo Zheng, you stopped us from telling anyone about the crisis here. Are you behind all this?
That Mechanoid was meant to steal a Mech Core, but took my Reflection Gem by mistake...
Then you made an excuse to leave and guided us to get my gem back.
And that merchant—you've met him before. The "big buyer" was you.
You acted like you modified the Mechanoids to help, but YOU took the Mech Core from the herb grove.
You staged all of this. And, you didn't even hide it well.
Ugh, what was I thinking...? You saw right through me.
Bo Zheng, I've already considered you a friend. Can you tell me why you did it?
Of course. Whatever's on your mind, you can tell me.
R-Really? You still see me as a friend?
Alright... think of this as a son confronting his father. My father, Bo Xing, is a top Crafter...
That was my chance to prove myself. Instead of reporting it, I would like to fix it my own way.
It wasn't enough. I wanted him to acknowledge his mistake and the value of my creations.
I solved the problem, just as planned.
I hate how he ignores my work and tries to control me. I want to prove him wrong!
Do you feel only anger toward him?
My teacher gave me this Reflection Gem—it reveals doubts and obsessions. Look into your own heart.
Take a deep breath and gaze into it.
But if I could do my research as I wish, why go through all this?
But why? Spotting the issue before your father was enough proof, right?
I never thought you'd take it like this.
I never thought you'd take it like this.
Why does he always focus on his big projects and ignore the creativity in my work?
Recently, I discovered a flaw in the herb grove's Mech Core—a rare oversight from my father.

It turns out Bo Zheng orchestrated all of this out of resentment, wanting to prove himself to his father. However, Glazia believes it wasn't just resentment and suggests Bo Zheng try the Trials of the Conscience.
You can't deny your heart—your father once gave you praise.
Your heart's not only full of anger.
Talk things out with your father, while you still have the chance...
My parents went missing when I was a child.
No matter how hard I try, they'll never see it.
Hey, why are we talking about me? Also, Bo Zheng, I want to thank you.
We are very much alike. I've felt lost and confused ever since my parents left.
What am I supposed to do? Everything feels meaningless.
So I keep learning and moving ahead.
But running from my heart is pointless. That's probably why I could never pass the Trials of the Conscience.
I'm sorry, Glazia. I didn't mean to get you in trouble...
I understand now. I'll talk to my father.
Yeah, meals won't fix all this trouble you started... Hm?
After undergoing the Trials of Conscience, Bo Zheng realizes his mistake and decides to have a proper talk with his father.
No need to explain. I saw it all on the Recorder. Look what you've done while I was away!
The Mech Core was unsafe. I fixed it my way. No harm was done.
Now the Mechanoids don't work! You wasted resources and other students' time on your tools!
Hmph. Even if those things worked, you still need to write a formal apology!
Miss Glazia, my son caused trouble. I apologize for him.
You helped my son fix the situation. And a Crafter did a lot, too. Was that you?
Thanks to you, nothing serious happened.
Your crafting skills are great, much better than my son's.
Take this workwear as my thanks to you.
Then... I'll accept it gratefully. Thank you.
Then... I'll accept it gratefully. Thank you.
Bo Zheng, we don't need thanks or apologies between us.
For the sake of this Discipline Dog, let's have a proper talk over the next couple of days.
Father, don't you find it odd to bring along the Discipline Dog I made?
Just this once! Don't get ahead of yourself!
Does that mean Bo Zheng's father accepts his work?
Thanks, but I don't deserve that much praise...
Thanks, but I don't deserve that much praise...
It turns out Bo Xing has been observing from the shadows all along and had already acknowledged Bo Zheng. He apologizes to you and Glazia, and gifts you Crafter robes as a token of gratitude.
I'll take this chance to upgrade the herb grove.
I can explain how they work...
Never mind. Just study them yourself.
I'm afraid so... Bo Zheng just got some bad news. Our efforts might have been for nothing...
Some rare plants are quite vulnerable. They cannot survive without irrigation.
Bo Zheng called a Crafter there, but got no reply. We can't wait.
Something wrong at Pastoral Herb Grove again?
Something wrong at Pastoral Herb Grove again?
I shouldn't tell you, but... Pastoral Herb Grove has a complex Mechcraft design.
It is run by contraptions inside the walls and underground. Now, the Mech Core is missing!
The Mech Core is missing? That's not good...
The Mech Core is missing? That's not good...
I have some Mechcraft farming tools that could help. Follow me!
The Mech Core sustaining the Pastoral Herb Grove is missing. Glazia asks for your help in creating a temporary replacement.
Bo Zheng, you have quite a collection of gadgets.
Hope they work. Moving them all to Pastoral Garden won't be easy...
Is there any transportation equipment here?
Is there any transportation equipment here?
There's a Moocart, but its key part, <001>the transmission</>, is missing.
We are running out of time, listen.
Go to the testing ground and find Crafter Yuan. He may know about the <001>transmission</>.
Glazia and I will load farming tools onto the Moocart.
You want to activate the Moocart to transport Mechcraft supplies, but you need to ask Crafter Yuan at the testing ground about the transmission.
You look familiar. Can I help you?
Bo Zheng said you might know where to find the Moocart's <001>transmission</>.
Bo Zheng said you might know where to find the Moocart's <001>transmission</>.
Ugh... I'm sorry, but it has been integrated into this big guy.
It's running—I can't force it to stop. I'm so sorry...
So, any way I can have it?
So, any way I can have it?
Hmm... You can take it when the test ends.
Alright, I'll give it a shot.
Alright, I'll give it a shot.
Crafter Yuan tells you that you can obtain the transmission only by passing the Mechcraft experiment.
Okay. But just so you know, very few finish this test quickly, so don't be too hard on yourself!
I should feel frustrated right now... but honestly? I'm kind of excited.
I'll keep working—hope to show you something new soon!
Bravo! I thought the test would take at least two days. Haha, maybe I overestimated myself.
Since the test is done... Here's your <001>transmission</>.
You quickly solve the Mechcraft puzzle, earning Crafter Yuan's admiration and successfully obtaining the transmission.
It's complicated, so don't worry if you make mistakes. Just keep trying!
Great, the <001>transmission</> looks fine. It won't take long to fix the Moocart.
The Moocart is ready! Now we have to split up.
I'll head to Pastoral Garden now—you keep the Moocart safe and meet me there.
Where did these Mechanoids come from? I have a bad feeling.
I hope the plants can hold on...
I've wasted too much time. Better catch up with Glazia—she's probably already there.
I've wasted too much time. Better catch up with Glazia—she's probably already there.
For the precious plants, let's get moving!
I hope you didn't get hurt.
I'm fine. What about the plants?
I'm fine. What about the plants?
We tried to activate the Aerial Sprayers, but they're not working...
They're just too high for us to reach.
We can handle the tools on the ground, but not the ones up in the sky...
I think we need to reset their paths. It's not hard, but...
No problem, just leave them to me!
No problem, just leave them to me!
Bo Zheng asks you to reset the movement path of the Aerial Sprayers overhead.
Hope they won't crash into each other... I can only believe in Bo Zheng.
Hope they won't crash into each other... I can only believe in Bo Zheng.
Seems like smaller tools are better than the big system sometimes...
Seems like smaller tools are better than the big system sometimes...
Think about what happened. There should be more...
The merchant seemed to know Bo Zheng.
I can't think of anything else.
Yeah, he always left at key moments and had time to act while we were apart...
But his advice led us to the gem, so maybe it's not what he wanted.
But his advice led us to the gem, so maybe it's not what he wanted.
Maybe he wanted the herb grove's Mech Core, but the Mechanoid took your gem and ruined his plan.
Maybe he wanted the herb grove's Mech Core, but the Mechanoid took your gem and ruined his plan.
He advised us to make caskets.
I've kept it to myself for a long time. We've faced so many tough situations since we met...
You asked about earlier records, but Bo Zheng didn't answer...
You asked about earlier records, but Bo Zheng didn't answer...
Bo Zheng kept our focus on the gem, so I didn't ask more.
He refused to ask for help.
Their talk was odd. It seemed like they were making up an excuse to get Bo Zheng out of there.
Bo Zheng might be connected to the gem theft. Can you think of anything else?
Bo Zheng questioned the merchant about Mech Cores. They might know each other.
Bo Zheng questioned the merchant about Mech Cores. They might know each other.
You mean Bo Zheng is that big buyer?
We don't know if Bo Zheng messed up by accident or on purpose.
Right. How did he know caskets would help us find the gem? It's like he knew about the black diamond.
Right. How did he know caskets would help us find the gem? It's like he knew about the black diamond.
But if Bo Zheng stole the Mech Core, why is he solving the problem he caused?
Even if no real harm was done, it still wasn't right...
Should we report him to the academy? ... Maybe he had his reasons.
Let's talk to Bo Zheng first.
Let's talk to Bo Zheng first.
Quite well here. Bo Zheng just needs to make some adjustments. The plants should be safe.
Bo Zheng advised us to check the Recorder to find your gem.
Bo Zheng advised us to check the Recorder to find your gem.
Bo Zheng refused to consult the Astrologer and didn't tell his father about the problem here.
Bo Zheng refused to consult the Astrologer and didn't tell his father about the problem here.
Seems like he wanted to keep things hidden.
We tweaked the Mechanoids as Bo Zheng said, but the herb grove's Mech Core still got taken.
We tweaked the Mechanoids as Bo Zheng said, but the herb grove's Mech Core still got taken.
...Bo Zheng has been helpful, but all signs suggest he's behind these strange events.
Finally, things are under control. Shh, there's something I want to talk over with you.
All set up here! How's it looking on your end?
All set up here! How's it looking on your end?
...When we were looking for the gem, a student showed up and called Bo Zheng away.
...When we were looking for the gem, a student showed up and called Bo Zheng away.
Yeah, Bo Zheng suggested making caskets, and they just became useful!
All signs point to Bo Zheng possibly being the mastermind behind this. You decide to have a serious talk with him.
The crisis has been solved. You can explore Jixia without worries.
The crisis has been solved. You can explore Jixia without worries.
Yeah, and I'll put Bo Zheng to good use. Otherwise, our effort would've been for nothing.
So Bo Zheng is still your guide? Are you planning to visit other places in Jixia?
So Bo Zheng is still your guide? Are you planning to visit other places in Jixia?
I'll stick around and watch Bo Zheng work with his dad. Should be fun!
Come hang out—or, I mean, let's share knowledge sometime!
With the matters of the Pastoral Garden finally settled, Glazia decides to stay for a while and invites you to visit for exchange and study when you have time.
You're back already! We just finished loading up.
Hello, student. I... I am Zhai Ji, the Secret Keeper of the Secret Pavilion. Is there something you need?
Help... ah, right, I'm in charge of containing forbidden artifacts, but that artifact...
It... it has a problem! A huge problem! Help me! Save me!
By the problem you mentioned, you mean...
By the problem you mentioned, you mean...
The Forbidden Archive... the Forbidden Archive is going to be eaten! We have to stop it! It's running away!
It, it's alive! It's all gone...
It, it needs food... tables, plants, soil, even its own kind have been eaten!
And me... I was eaten by it too...
Familiar... yet strange, I can't see the end anymore... Monsters, swarms of monsters!
They, they were devoured... and reborn anew! But that wasn't a dream! It was real!
You have to stop it, please, you have to stop it! Otherwise, it's going to eat everyone!
This... how am I supposed to stop it?
This... how am I supposed to stop it?
I don't know... To avoid being eaten... I kept fighting. When they were all gone, then, then I... came back.
It, it's in the Secret Forbidden Pavilion, stop it! You must stop it!
Was that you speaking? You look dizzy. Do you need my help?

text: Good day, judges. This is my dish—Bonfire-Roasted Aerlayer Carp.

I made a special fish oil by simmering the fish with spices to enhance its flavor.

Each mouthful releases scalding, juicy meat that floods the taste buds.
But over time, grilling became my specialty. So if I had to prove my skill, it had to be done through grilling.

Judges, thank you for waiting. I present to you—Thousand-Strike Meatballs!

A practitioner of martial arts trains day after day, for decades. These meatballs were crafted through the same philosophy—pounded thousands of times using a club instead of a sword. It's the perfect representation of my martial journey.
It's crab roe. I mixed in crab roe.
Not only that! With every chew, there's this umami flavor that bursts forth and intertwines with the meat...
Hmm... The broth is light, and the meatballs look rather plain. How does this dish reflect the theme?
That doesn't sound all that special... Oh wow! They're incredibly springy!
No wonder! The bold texture and intense flavor make it impossible to stop chewing... Even the light-looking broth carries a deep, rich taste...
Yiwi says it tastes great... but it's a bit hard to chew.
Surely Yiwi also appreciates the uniqueness of this dish?
Bai He's Thousand-Strike Meatballs have an intense, unique flavor, surprising the judges greatly.
Thank you... This is the dish I'm presenting today—Jar of Fragrance.
For me... my daily life is all about learning gourmet cuisine from Ms. Culine, honing my knife skills, and poring over cookbooks. Every day feels incredibly fulfilling.
I chose this dish, Jar of Fragrance—the one Ms. Culine taught me—because it carries everything I've learned over the years.
Exquisite knife work, precise heat control—every ingredient has been handled with care. This dish... it's almost identical to what I would have made myself...
But... is this really the dish you wanted to create?
I never expected to taste Ms. Culine's signature dish in this competition. What a pleasant surprise.

I see... With such a rich aroma, I can tell right away that the ingredients in this dish are anything but ordinary. Beast meat, fowl, seafood... The flavors of all these ingredients are concentrated within this jar.
One taste, and an endless wave of flavors bursts across the palate. Truly impressive!
Judges, I'm sorry for delaying the competition...
Good thing my classmate showed up in time.
Good to hear. But you seem a little distracted. Once today's competition is over, I'll make you something to calm your nerves.
Hmm... Mai, Yiwi has given this the highest rating so far, but...
Yiwi said that compared to the thoughts in your cooking, your obsession has dulled the flavor somewhat.

Unlike an ordinary Mushroom & Fish Stew, your version feels... bolder.
Instead of overpowering the original flavors, this infused oil has enhanced them, adding more depth to the dish. That's quite the innovation.
Yes. Ever since I came to Jixia, I've made so many friends. The time I've spent with them is my most cherished memory.

A testament to perseverance and refinement—not just in martial arts, but in gourmet cuisine as well! Truly unforgettable!
A chef whose warmth and kindness have once again touched the judges' hearts and stomachs!
And now... the moment you've all been waiting for—the winner!
The judges can't decide between you and Mai. They will hold a tiebreaker match to determine the final champion.

Forget it. Let's go see for ourselves.

I think I saw some discarded cooking utensils on the ground there.

I had no choice. No matter what I do, you never acknowledge me... I practiced my knife skills, memorized countless recipes, but it was useless...
I thought maybe I wasn't training hard enough... but in the end?
I thought if I won first place, you'd finally recognize me... But I couldn't even beat a rookie, not even by cheating...
Maybe... I was never meant to be a Gourmet...
I... I think we all need to calm down. Sorry you had to see this. Mai has been studying under me for years... I never knew he felt this way.
I often reminded him that a Gourmet's worth isn't decided by a single dish, hoping he would one day find his own approach to cooking. But in doing so, I overlooked his true feelings...
I bear responsibility for what happened today. I will report this and disqualify Mai from the competition.
And... here. This is the cooking tool belt I used in the past. It's a personal gift from me. Please accept it.
I truly admire your cooking, and I hope you continue down the path of a Gourmet.
Also... I apologize for the trouble Mai caused you.
So it was Mai who took the contestants' cooking utensils and seasonings... Culine blames herself for neglecting Mai's feelings but impartially disqualifies him from the competition.

Oh no, he's surrounded by Burrow Wolvines!

After talking with everyone, I feel inspired...
I should go summarize my thoughts at the Cooking Station.

It's nothing! We're still in the middle of the competition. Let's hurry back for the judging!

Nothing's more important than your safety. A spectator saw what was happening. That's how I found out.
Nothing's more important than your safety. A spectator saw what was happening. That's how I found out.
Why did you come here? And what's with all these Burrow Wolvines...?
Why did you come here? And what's with all these Burrow Wolvines...?
I... I was feeling nervous, and the crowd was overwhelming... I just wanted to step out for some air. But... I didn't expect the scent of meat and spices on me would attract the Burrow Wolvines.

I should get back to the judging panel now. By the way, have you seen Mai? I have no idea what he's up to...
That brat... I'll try reaching him with Big-eye Owlet again. If you're ready, go on in.

Mai! A-are you okay? Ms. Culine was really worried. I'm so glad you're safe...
As long as you're okay. Now, let's get back to the competition. We can't let the dishes go cold before the judges get to taste them.

Beneath his rugged appearance lies a delicate soul—his mastery of heat control and ingredient handling is unparalleled!
A firm believer in bringing out the natural flavors of ingredients. What kind of surprises will he bring us today?

Today, will we finally get to see her true skills?

The answer will surprise you! Bai He isn't just a martial arts master—he has a unique perspective on cooking as well!

Master Mozi planned to help the disabled, not to build weapons.
If it leads to something great, a small setback doesn't matter.
One thing's for sure—I won't give up like he did.
You have your own goal, don't you? I trust that you won't give up.
I hope we both make progress before we see each other again.
No, it's better to stop before it's too late.
The research was meant to help others. Creating weapons of war was never Mozi's intent. After learning the truth, Mek seems less lost and resolves to keep going.
Forget it. I've made a record. Come back.
Hmm... There should be another room here.
He just stopped? Doesn't seem like him to quit so easily.
Mek asks you to meet him outside, but you overhear him muttering that there may still be a hidden chamber here.
We don't have enough information to reach a conclusion yet. I've studied this place before.
There's space both above and below. I need you to investigate there.
Mechcraft exoskeletons... So I was right.
It's from Master Fuzi. The side effects...
It's from Master Fuzi. The side effects...
After reading the letter, Mek confirms he is on the right track. He says the lab has more than one level and asks you to search carefully.
Yue Chang asked me to find you. She received your gift.
Yue Chang asked me to find you. She received your gift.
No, she seemed to expect it.
No, she seemed to expect it.
I thought so. She's the Music Society's top talent this year. My junior...
I learned so much from playing alongside her.
Why do you have to leave?
Why do you have to leave?
Maybe this is your chance to talk.
Maybe this is your chance to talk.
She's inviting you to the farewell performance.
She's inviting you to the farewell performance.
Tell her no. She knows what I mean.
Doesn't look like he's here. I should ask someone.
Doesn't look like he's here. I should ask someone.
Excuse me, do you know where Arman is?
Excuse me, do you know where Arman is?
He's upstairs by the elevator. Surprised you're asking, I thought he had no friends.
He's been here the whole time! He even asked me to send his allowance home recently.
He's working non-stop, as if he's rushing to leave.
I heard his home's engineering team is hiring people.
Go through here, and you'll find him.
This is Roaring Tiger Training Hall. Where is Arman?
This is Roaring Tiger Training Hall. Where is Arman?
Excuse me, do you know where Arman is?
Excuse me, do you know where Arman is?
Arman? You mean the student from Sandy Wastes?
He's probably doing renovation work in the back, the messiest area.
The head trainer is paying him a good sum for it, though.
Looks like Arman is in the back. Must find a way in first.
Looks like Arman is in the back. Must find a way in first.
Excuse me, do you know where Arman is?
Excuse me, do you know where Arman is?
I think I've heard some students mention that name.
I only know he's the hardest worker on the renovation team, that's all.
If there's nothing else, you should go.
I... don't have anything to say.
Yue Chang said your music is wild and bold, like racing across Sandy Wastes.
Yue Chang said your music is wild and bold, like racing across Sandy Wastes.
Whatever your reason, maybe what you need most is courage.
Whatever your reason, maybe what you need most is courage.
You're going back to Sandy Wastes to rebuild your home, right?
You're going back to Sandy Wastes to rebuild your home, right?
Have you... ever been to Sandy Wastes?
People say renovation is tough, but for me, it's paradise here.
Sandy Wastes: endless dunes, the harsh sun, and Obsidite Storms that destroy everything.
For those living there, water means survival. Life itself is worth less than water.
My hearing has always been sharp. I could hear sounds others couldn't imagine.
And even the sound of underground rivers beneath the sand.
Eventually, the Sandsnakes took me in. My talent became my lifelong shackle.
Starving drifters lived there, exhaustion and numbness on their faces.
One day, a Musician from Jixia came. I noticed a mistake in his music.
He was amazed and gave up his best Guqin to bring me to Jixia.
I'll always remember the envy and despair in those kids' eyes as I left the tent.
My teacher couldn't save everyone. If I study in Jixia, maybe I'll save them someday.
Yes. I'm sure you've heard, Kheya is back.
After years torn by the Sandsnakes, my homeland finally has peace.
Now I have a chance to go home, and find peace myself.
So, you joined the School of Mechcraft to...
My first time on stage, I didn't care about the audience at all.
I was mesmerized by the School of Mechcraft's amazing architecture.
Bathed in the glow of flowing Aersilk, the whole school seems alive and powerful.
Even the highest ranks of the Sandsnakes had nothing like it...
So I joined the School of Mechcraft and studied day and night.
One day, I got a letter from my father, with the design for Karaturam.
It's a giant ship for ten thousand people. It means "searching for hope in the endless sand."
Kheya is supervising its construction and recruiting workers.
I don't know where Karaturam will take everyone.
But if I can help build it, it'll mean more than performing on stage.
Maybe that's what "The truth is what you make of it" really means.
I had no idea you were carrying so much on your shoulders.
Yue Chang, a noble from Chang'an, isn't like other nobles at all.
She said she envies my skills, tries to mimic my music, but hers is pure and gentle.
I envy her too. Her music is beautiful, like a bird nurtured by the grand music in Chang'an.
She wouldn't understand, and doesn't need to know everything.
For her, winning and applause are what matter most.
As her friend, I don't want to spoil her innocence.
But is it really okay to leave without saying goodbye?
But is it really okay to leave without saying goodbye?
Actually, she is asking to perform your Ballad of Caves and Sands with you.
Actually, she is asking to perform your Ballad of Caves and Sands with you.
I told her it's not important.
Anyway, maybe we'll never meet again.
Maybe she understands your music better than you think.
Maybe she understands your music better than you think.
Alright. I owe her and the band this one.
Tell her I'll be there on time.
Venomous scorpions crawling, horses in the distance, and the Sandsnakes' violence...

text: Aman believes he carries the hope of rebuilding his home and must leave, but after learning that Yuechang wants to perform "Ballad of the Thousand Caves and Neon Clouds" with him, he agrees to participate in the concert.
We'll need more people and some equipment, then.
The School of Mechcraft can help. Dongbai has a lot of equipment you can borrow.
I've also asked Zhang Nanshan and Li Beihai to join us—they're at the School of Sorcery now.
Don't worry, they are all nice people. As for me...
Of course! She loves fun. Let's meet back here after.
Yue Chang asks you to borrow an instrument from the School of Mechcraft, then find Nanshan and Beihai at the School of Sorcery.
Now, where can I find Dongbai?
Now, where can I find Dongbai?
I've got to visit the School of Mechcraft.
I've got to visit the School of Mechcraft.
Arman? You should've just said so!
Tsk. Are you a Musician? Still...
We were on the same team last semester. He saved me from a falling rock.
Alright, I'll deliver the musical instruments to you.
Remember to save me a seat!
Go away. Can't you see I'm busy?
I'm here to borrow some musical instruments.
I'm here to borrow some musical instruments.
I should find Zhang Nanshan and Li Beihai.
I should find Zhang Nanshan and Li Beihai.
This is impossible. Can anyone solve this?
Oh no, what about my flute?
As you see, we have a problem here...
Hmph, it's her fault for practicing flute in class!
And we're stuck on this senior-level Sorcery Rune.
Do something, okay? Or I'll never get my flute back!
I'm from the School of Martial Arts!
If Yue Chang's concert doesn't go well, you'll be responsible!
Do you know anything about Sorcery? We're out of ideas.
Hello, are you Li Beihai and Zhang Nanshan?
Hello, are you Li Beihai and Zhang Nanshan?
Wow, you actually solved it?! Amazing!
Now we can make it to the concert.
No problem. I'll grab my flute first. Thanks again!
Zhang Nanshan and Li Beihai agree to participate in the concert and arrange to meet you in the lobby.
Zhang Nanshan and Li Beihai agree to participate in the concert and arrange to meet you in the lobby.
I've done everything Yue Chang asked. Now I just wait for them.
I've done everything Yue Chang asked. Now I just wait for them.
Thank you so much for this. And... uh, I'm sorry.
Shh. Arman still doesn't know. She'll be here later!
It's fine, we get it. Let's enjoy our final show.
Glazia... What are you doing here?
That's just him. He planned to leave without telling anyone.
Yes. Thank you, everyone, for giving me hope.
Thanks, Yue Chang and everyone. I'll always remember my time and our music here.
Good luck in your contest! Don't forget to visit the Sandy Wastes—I'll show you how it snows in the desert!
That was beautiful, Arman! I didn't know you had such deep feelings!
Yue Chang invited me! Why didn't you? You didn't say anything about this farewell!
I know you like being alone, but I thought we were friends!
You found your hope? Kheya was right—hope changes people as much as despair.
Great! Go teach them a lesson! I'll come find you after I'm done here.
See you in the Sandy Wastes!
Haha, you're blushing! It's okay, I forgive you—I heard hope in your music.

Arman is surprised to see Glazia. She tells him that she heard hope in his music and plans to find him in Sandy Wastes once her business is concluded. Arman thanks everyone for coming to the recital and promises to see them again in his homeland.
Why am I crying? That was really sad...
It sounded like a variation of Southern Birds.
No, that's Madinat Erudit Whirl! Since when does Arman play foreign tunes?
We met like hills in misty blue. Growing old, our bonds stayed true.
Parting's like a crane from cloud. Snow falls on seas, a silent shroud.
Willow leaves sway. No friends to stay.
With hope, the young man finally leaves his chains behind...
With hope, the young man finally leaves his chains behind...
It feels like I'm walking in a soft, gentle rain.
But your music was wonderful. It's time for a new chapter.
In Chang'an, people say, "A thousand rounds will come to an end, but the sadness in my heart is incessant." So... there's nothing more for me to say.
Whatever path you choose to take, I wish you all the best.
Take good care of yourself, as you stride across the Sandy Wastes.
It's really nice to say goodbye to you guys in person...
Arman, I still don't get why you're leaving.
After the concert, Yue Chang and Arman finally say goodbye in person, and clear the air.
There are thousands of medical records. Have you Cultivators really used every herb listed in them?
You only chase new ideas. Are you forgetting the basics?
But you can't overlook how nature has changed the herbs.
Ms. Perilla's case is rare. Simply adhering to the old ways might not work.
Are they the other Herbalists that Mint mentioned? What are they doing?
Are they the other Herbalists that Mint mentioned? What are they doing?
You find the Herbalists that Mint mentioned. They seem to be arguing over their herbal practices.
The situation is complicated. We Herbologists have more experience, so let me take care of it.
We Cultivators have a lot of practical and theoretical knowledge about new herbs. I'm not going to lose!
The look on your face says you found it.
Let's check it out! It might have the cure for Ms. Perilla's illness.
Just add everything I brought here.
Just add everything I brought here.
Mooko and Shinye? Why are they here?
Mooko and Shinye? Why are they here?
The Cyan Bird! Will you show the way?
The Cyan Bird! Will you show the way?
A cave? Did the Sage hide the book here?
A cave? Did the Sage hide the book here?
This place seems to have a lot of secrets.
This place seems to have a lot of secrets.
Index of Ailments? This must be the book Shinye is looking for. I should take it back.
Index of Ailments? This must be the book Shinye is looking for. I should take it back.
The Compendium of All Diseases? Judging by the contents, this must be the Medicine Saint's Manuscript. Let's take it back and show them.

text: Blaze Fruits and vines that cover the wall...
Blaze Fruits and vines that cover the wall...
That's amazing... I found Ms. Perilla's illness and other rare conditions I've seen!
But... something's different. This book is really old, so we shouldn't follow it completely.
You're right. I'll look over it carefully before making any decisions.
The Sage wrote about his insights on using medicine. Maybe the Cultivators' new plants could help.
Let's be careful. We have rules for testing new medicines. If we rush, it could go wrong.
Sorry, I got ahead of myself. You stick to the plan—I'll try my approach.
I'll apologize to her later. But for now, the project and Ms. Perilla's health can't wait. Once everything settles, I'll go talk to her.
Thanks to the book you found, I drafted a basic treatment plan.
Alright, I'll wait for your news.
Alright, I'll wait for your news.
A herb basket. It's normally given from a senior to a junior, but I want to thank you for your hard work.
Forget it. She has her own way. Maybe working separately is better.
I need to prepare. We might need rare herbs. I'll let you know so we can find them together.
Until then, keep practicing your medicine making. You have talent—don't waste it.
After retrieving the Sage's notes, Shinye and Mooko disagree on their next steps and part ways. Shinye acknowledges your skills and gifts you a Herbalist's special medicine basket.
I should check out the nearby medicine stand.
I should check out the nearby medicine stand.
There's an old tale of a great Sage at Darkpool Camp who left behind a book.
The book supposedly describes thousands of herbs and secret cures for hard-to-treat illnesses.
We checked on Ms. Perilla's condition, and it looks like her old illness has returned.
Her symptoms—fatigue and chest pain—are common, but it's unusual for them to appear together and so unpredictably.
There's no similar record. Shinye is searching for more records, but I think we should try new herbs.
It's no problem. Why not do both?
It's no problem. Why not do both?
If my way works, we won't risk new, untested herbs. I can't afford to lose.
But the Sage didn't share his knowledge easily. He had his <001>Cyan Bird</> guard the book.
Legend says only a true Herbalist can pass the Cyan Bird's test and get the book.
I have ideas to pass the test, but I can't figure out where to find it.
The Cyan Bird... You mean, the one with the green chest? I saw it when I was gathering herbs.
It was sitting by a ganoderma. I wanted to go near, but it flew off.
You said it was sitting by a ganoderma?
You said it was sitting by a ganoderma?
Yes. The Cyan Birds love a type called <001>Green Ganoderma</>. Burning it could attract the bird.
I saw Green Ganoderma on blue pines there on the cliff, but I can't climb.
I've never been up there either... Could you go look for it?
Alright, I'll give it a shot.
Alright, I'll give it a shot.
Great. We'll wait below. If you slip, we'll treat you in time.
Leave it to me. Anything else?
Leave it to me. Anything else?
I have a mixture that makes you smell good to animals. It's made from <001>Bittertongue Powder</> and some herbs.
Oh? So you invent medicines? Never expected that.
Uh... I just made some improvements based on reliable records.
Haha, sure. Can you make Bittertongue Powder? Shinye and I will get the other herbs.
Yes. Since you're here, Ms. Perilla must want you to learn something. It's simple—you'll manage.
You're more responsible than I expected.
Running errands isn't enough to learn.
Agreed. Glad we both see it this way. Make the powder first, then we'll find the Ganoderma.
Herbalists are split into Healers, Toxineers, Cultivators, and Herbologists.
Healers focus on health. Toxineers are obsessed with poisons.
I'm a Herbologist. We study local plants and traditions. As for Cultivators...
Cultivators focus on new discoveries and their practical uses. We don't stick to old traditions.
The Sage knew so much—that book might have the answer for Ms. Perilla.
I've never seen her this sick before...
You decide to look for the Sage's notes. You need to gather Green Ganoderma and make Bittertongue Powder to lure the Cyan Bird.
Bittertongue Powder ready? We got everything else.
Looks good. I see why Ms. Perilla wanted you with us.
Now we just need the Green Ganoderma. Add them all into the incense atop the mountain, and burn it.
We can't climb that high, so we'll have to count on you. Be careful. Your safety matters more than anything.
It's fine. Don't rush. Take your time. Accuracy is most important.
Add this, and bring this extra mixture. That should be enough to earn the Cyan Bird's recognition.
With the wind, the scent will carry far.
You give the Bittertongue Powder to Shinye. Next, you need to gather Green Ganoderma from the cliffside.
Whenever they work together, they end up arguing. That never changes...
Oh, look, a new Herbalist student has arrived! A rare and exquisite little sprout indeed.
Ms. Perilla, why are they arguing?
Ms. Perilla, why are they arguing?
I gave them a test—to cure my stubborn illness. Now they're arguing, as usual...
It comes and goes. At this rate, they will be working on "how to cure a critically ill patient."
Well, just forgot we have another Herbalist here. Are you interested in this case?
But I'm just starting out—will I be any help?
But I'm just starting out—will I be any help?
Don't worry, I trust you. I've heard good things about your work.
If I think you're making a mistake, I'll stop you. Just give it a try and see what you can learn.
Actually, I can feel that they are stuck. With your help, they might finally move forward.
Alright, I'll give it a try.
Alright, I'll give it a try.
Good! Having courage is a great start.
It's pointless arguing here. Let our new friend join you. As seniors, you should provide proper guidance.
It's you. Being a Herbalist is no joke. Ready for a real challenge?
Shinye, you scare our new Herbalist off!
I'm feeling better now. Please share the problems you've had so far. I'm going to take a rest.
From Perilla, you learn that Shinye and Mooko are arguing over how to treat her old illness. She asks you to step in and help.

text: It's odd to see Cyan by himself.
It's odd to see Cyan by himself.
It's you. My rival in the Enlightenment Trials.
If you help me out, I might go easy on you next time.
My brother Maroon is on a job alone. Often, we always worked together.
We actually took the job together. While discussing it, or rather, when I was talking about the job...
Heard of the Crimson Beast? It's about handling its aftermath.
It wreaked havoc, got beaten, and then hid in a mountain crevice.
You don't know? I'm Cyan from Vlinder's team.
I think he deserves a chance, but I'm worried.
I need you to check on him for me... so I know what to do.
Many Hunters in Serene Wilds know how to handle fierce beasts.
My brother will probably seek their help.
You should start looking for him there.
I understand. It's best to solve problems on my own.
... he suddenly recommended getting a skilled Hunter involved.
Sorry. I can't help you out.
I believe so. He didn't say anything and left on his own.
He said he'd complete the job his way.
The crevice emits heat daily, becoming dangerous.
My brother wants to prove himself with this job.
I'll follow him, just in case things go wrong.
Did I say something too harsh? He isn't usually this sensitive.
I usually decide, and he never has opinions, so I brushed it off.
I told him we shouldn't be dumb enough to risk someone else taking credit for our work.
It might not be the best time to see him after our fight...
Maroon suddenly took on a commission alone, which worries Cyan. Cyan asks you to go find him.
I'm usually the one coming up with the ideas, and my big brother never has any objections, so I didn't think much of it.

text: We've never fought over the years...
Deepest shelf... is it up there?
Deepest shelf... is it up there?
Found it! But with this airflow... there could be another way out around here.
Found it! But with this airflow... there could be another way out around here.
I'm nearby, in a cave north of the camp. Come tell me what's going on.
Have you seen the observation instruments around the camp? They look like pedestals.
He's a new teacher who arrived not long ago. Got into a huge argument with the Crafters and shut down the place.
Four of them suddenly broke down. The Crafters claimed it was wild beasts, but Mr. Si Zhuo was convinced they were being careless.
Either way, no one goes inside until they're fixed.
So if I fix them, you'll let me in?
So if I fix them, you'll let me in?
If you could, that would be a huge help!
Shuxun tells you that no one is allowed in the storehouse until the Observation Instruments are fixed. You decide to try fixing them.
What a camp! I should ask around if someone saw Maroon.
What a camp! I should ask around if someone saw Maroon.
Ah, him! He asked about hunting the Crimson Beast. Do I look capable of that?
Hi! Yan Yun, right? I'm looking for someone.
Hi! Yan Yun, right? I'm looking for someone.
That's me. Who are you looking for?
A half-breed named Maroon. He might be asking about hunting a fierce beast.
A half-breed named Maroon. He might be asking about hunting a fierce beast.
Everyone avoids it. We know our limits.
Try asking the girl in blue by the cliff. She's traveling around here and might be interested.
Yan Yun says that Maroon was asking about how to hunt the Crimson Beast, but she couldn't help him. She suggests you ask the girl in blue by the cliff.
Excuse me, have you seen a tall, muscular half-breed?
Excuse me, have you seen a tall, muscular half-breed?
You may ask Yan Yun. She patrols the camp.
She's near the goods on the right side.
Maybe... but I was busy with injured animals and didn't see where he went.
You ask about Maroon. One of the students suggests you talk to Yan Yun.
Excuse me, have you seen someone in Southlands attire? His name is Maroon.
Excuse me, have you seen someone in Southlands attire? His name is Maroon.
Maroon? So that is his name. He just asked about capturing the Crimson Beast. Funny guy.
Aryion said he knew how to handle the Crimson Beast.
Maroon was excited, but Aryion looked worried and took him to the woods across here.
According to Shuwen, Shao Shi claimed to know how to handle the Crimson Beast and took Maroon into the woods.
Impressive! Besides my brother, you're the only one I admire!
Any good Hunter could do it.
Let's go! I'll brag to my brother later, haha!
What are you two talking about?
What are you two talking about?
The newbie from Team of Stars! Sorry, I'm busy with work right now.
Cyan asked me to help you.
Cyan asked me to help you.
Is that so? Alright then, I will let you be our assistant. Just don't mess this up.
Cyan mentioned we're here for the Crimson Beast, right?
It now hides in the south of the mountains. We need to seal it.
Shao Shi has a great idea... Hmm... What's that?
We need an amplifier for frost energy to suppress the heat.
It's a solid plan, right? You in to help us?
He said he didn't mean it.
He said he didn't mean it.
What? Well, it doesn't matter. I'll prove I can do this alone.
Tell him we don't need help, just let him heap the benefits!
You're like my brother, always correcting.
Wow, Novar's new partner? He could assist. You know, our plan is tricky.
I can make the amplifier "Frostfall," but I'll need icy water from Serene Wilds Pool to cool it while crafting.
I've heard of your skills. Will you retrieve the Mech Core for us?
Maroon and I will get the icy water. Come to us at Serene Wilds Pool after you get the Mech Core.
And to activate it, we need a Mech Core.
Wow, Novar's new teammate? She might help. You know, our plan is tricky.
To deal with the Crimson Beast, Maroon and Shao Shi plan to collect icy water. They ask you to meet them near Serene Wilds Pool after you get the Mech Core.
I'm here for a Mech Core. Shao Shi sent me.
I'm here for a Mech Core. Shao Shi sent me.
Hold on! The storehouse is closed.
Oh, right. The core he's looking for is on a shelf in the back.
But without Mr. Si Zhuo's permission, I can't let you take it.
The guard, Shuxun, tells you that no one can take the Mech Core without Mr. Si Zhuo's permission.
This plan seems okay, but there's a catch.
It would cause an explosion and release the Crimson Beast.
Its habits, likes, dislikes, combat patterns, and more.
He's after revenge. It looks like we're aiming for the same thing.
I looked into Shao Shi's background. The Crimson Beast left him an orphan, and the villagers took him in.
So I came here and found this box. It's full of info about the Crimson Beast.
But something's off. We need to be careful around him.
People in the camp told me he often stayed in this cave alone.
I'll meet up with them now. Are you coming?
I'll meet up with them now. Are you coming?
You go ahead. Serene Wilds Pool isn't close.
Frostfall sounds misleading. It's an amplifier, right?
What if it meets and absorbs heat...
The name “Frostfall” is very misleading; it sounds like it only generates frost energy, but it is essentially an amplifier.
zh_text: “霜降”这个名字很有迷惑性，听起来只能产生冰霜能量，但它的本质是一台增幅仪。
source_text: “霜降”这个名字很有迷惑性，听起来只能产生冰霜能量，但它的本质是一台增幅仪。

official_en_text: The name “Frostfall” is very misleading; it sounds like it only generates frost energy, but it is essentially an amplifier.

text: Shao Shi, did you save me? Didn't I tell you to leave?
I can't leave my friend behind.
Let me introduce. This is my brother, Cyan! Cyan, meet Shao Shi, he's great!
Shao Shi's been helping me. He taught me a lot!
No worries. This time, I won't interfere.
Do it your way. I'm just here to make sure you're safe.
I don't swim as well as Maroon. Now what? We need the icy water.
I'll prep at the camp across the lake. Meet me there once you've got the icy water.
I'm counting on you then. I'm just worried about my brother.
Maroon wakes up and introduces Cyan to Shao Shi. It turns out neither of them are good swimmers, and they still haven't retrieved the water. You decide to help them.
Maroon choked on water at the bottom and hasn't recovered yet.

You arrive at the lakeside to find Maroon, who seems to have collapsed from drowning. Shao Shi stands there, helpless. Before you can act, Cyan, who secretly followed, jolts the sleeping Maroon awake with a kick...
Everything's going smoothly, just like I planned.
I'm relieved to see you're still breathing...
How could you sleep like that? What if you couldn't wake up?
Eh? W-what are you doing here?
Bravo! We must handle the Team of Stars with care!
I've got the icy water and Mech Core.
I've got the icy water and Mech Core.
I was worried you'd be misled.
We've come all the way from the Southlands, and I can't fully trust strangers.
Shao Shi is trustworthy. He's kind and helpful.
Why do you insist on sealing that beast?
That's why I want to seal the crevice for good.
My question, what do you think of Jixia Academy?
To me, Jixia Academy means peace, trust, and support.
I was born in a village protected by Jixia.
But one day, the Crimson Beast attacked.
We couldn't wait for support from the academy, and my parents died protecting the village.
Thank you. I've set up a tent at a camping spot nearby. Let's rest there tonight.
Great! I'm tired and need a good rest.
Right... How did you find us, bro?
It is. Let's go over our plan now and we'll seal the crevice tomorrow morning.
Perfect! So I can officially introduce Shao Shi to my brother!
Shao Shi finishes crafting "Frostfall," and you all agree to seal the Crimson Beast next morning. You talk about the past and begin to let your guard down.
I should have seen this coming. I made a mistake.
He could be using us to gather the materials, just to awaken the Crimson Beast.
He trusts Shao Shi. It's the first time he's trusted someone other than me, and I don't want to hurt him.
If he puts the Pyrite in "Frostfall," it'll awaken the Crimson Beast.
He lied. We must stop him.
I got someone to dig into all the item trades in Jixia over the past few days.
Then, July brought me a message. You might not like it.
I heard a noise and got up to check it. And the next thing I knew, Shao Shi and "Frostfall" had disappeared.
Shao Shi disappeared with "Frostfall." Maybe his true goal was to awaken the Crimson Beast. Cyan asks you to keep this from Maroon so he would not feel hurt.
That was a good rest... This view is incredible. Where did you all go?
He wants to do it alone? Then I'm the one who heaps the benefits!
It's not the time for a lesson! Let's catch up with Shao Shi!
Maroon wakes up to find both Shao Shi and "Frostfall" gone. He immediately runs off to find them, and you have no choice but to follow.
Sigh, Li Ransheng has loved feeding fierce and strange beasts since he was a child. We tried to talk him out of it, but...
Ransheng is stubborn as a mule and won't listen to anyone. Later on, we discovered he was raising Qibao.
Ever since Qibao arrived, the village hasn't had a moment's peace. Either someone's getting hurt, or someone's losing their poultry...
The villagers made such a fuss that in the end... they just moved away.
Let's follow the direction Qibao fled in.
Let's follow the direction Qibao fled in.
Hmm? Where did they go? Let's track them with the bracelet.
Hmm? Where did they go? Let's track them with the bracelet.
There seems to be something under the signpost.
There seems to be something under the signpost.
This is... a total mess. Did Qibao do all this?
This is... a total mess. Did Qibao do all this?
These footprints don't look like Qibao's.
These footprints don't look like Qibao's.
Beast spotted, keep your distance. It seems Qibao is often in the area. Let's try tracking it.
Beast spotted, keep your distance. It seems Qibao is often in the area. Let's try tracking it.
Qibao? Strange... why does that person look so... close to Qibao?
Qibao? Strange... why does that person look so... close to Qibao?
Everyone who has seen Qibao says its fur is strange and its markings ominous, but they don't know that Qibao is actually honest and gentle.
If you're willing, student, why not try touching it?
I've seen these footprints before at the notice board.
I've seen these footprints before at the notice board.
Qibao! Qibao hurt someone! Good thing I ran fast, otherwise even I would have been...
Huh... Qibao is the name of a strange bear. I just got back from outside and saw Qibao pounce on someone from far away. I was so scared I just ran for it.
I told Ransheng so many times that this disaster couldn't be left alone, why did he... Poor traveler...
Could you please come with me to check it out? I really don't dare to go back alone...
At the very least, I owe his family an explanation...
It's all Li Ransheng's fault! If he hadn't insisted on raising Qibao, this wouldn't have happened! I told him so long ago!
How are you sure the attacker was Qibao?
How are you sure the attacker was Qibao?
I haven't seen Qibao for a while, but its fur is unique and it has strange markings, so there's no way I could be mistaken.
I'll come back to help you once I've settled the wounded.
Still breathing! There's still hope! I have to get him back quickly...
Classmate, if Qibao is still lingering nearby, it might hurt the residents. Could you please track it down?
No problem. I'll follow and take a look.
No problem. I'll follow and take a look.
I'm afraid they might also be...
Okay. If you find anything, don't act rashly. I don't want to see you end up...

You and Lin Sen find the injured person. Lin Sen is worried that Qibao might still hurt nearby villagers, so he asks you to check on Qibao's situation first, and he will follow after settling the injured person.
Student of Jixia, are you Li Ransheng?
Student of Jixia, are you Li Ransheng?
You know me? Coming all the way into these mountains to find me—is there something you need?
Qibao hurt someone, and I followed its tracks here.
Qibao hurt someone, and I followed its tracks here.
Heh, hurting people? I've raised Qibao for many years and have never seen him hurt anyone. Who told you that nonsense?
Lin Sen and I did see him attacking residents on the road.
Lin Sen and I did see him attacking residents on the road.
Lin Sen? Sigh... why does he always have to pick on Qibao...
Is there some kind of misunderstanding between you?
Is there some kind of misunderstanding between you?
I should be asking you that! Qibao is clearly kind and gentle, yet he acts like he has some grudge against him!
The killer is definitely not Qibao, it's innocent! I will definitely find evidence to prove its innocence!
What do you plan to do?
What do you plan to do?
I've found some clues. Give me more time, and I'll definitely catch the culprit!
If you don't trust me, student, why not join me in finding the real culprit? Besides, you can also prevent the "Seven Treasures from hurting people".

You see someone who looks very close to Qibao and guess that this person is Li Ransheng. You explain that you followed Qibao's footprints because Qibao hurt someone. Li Ransheng doesn't believe Qibao would hurt anyone and asks you to testify, so you work together to find clues to prove Qibao's innocence.
I'm stationed here temporarily. Ever since I left the village, I've been camping in the wild.
Compared to the village, Qibao is much happier here, though it can be a bit too playful at times...
Li Ransheng explains that he has been camping in the wild since leaving the village, which is better suited for Qibao than the village.
I'm stationed here temporarily. Ever since I left the village, I've been camping in the wild.
zh_text: 我临时驻扎在这，离开村子后，我便一直在野外扎营度日。
source_text: 我临时驻扎在这，离开村子后，我便一直在野外扎营度日。
official_target_text: I'm stationed here temporarily. Ever since I left the village, I've been camping in the wild.
official_en_text: I'm stationed here temporarily. Ever since I left the village, I've been camping in the wild.

text: Li Ransheng explains that he has been camping in the wild since leaving the village, which is better suited for Qibao than the village.
zh_text: 李然生说明自己离开村子后一直在野外扎营度日，而比起村里，野外也更加适合七宝生存。
source_text: 李然生说明自己离开村子后一直在野外扎营度日，而比起村里，野外也更加适合七宝生存。
official_target_text: Li Ransheng explains that he has been camping in the wild since leaving the village, which is better suited for Qibao than the village.
official_en_text: Li Ransheng explains that he has been camping in the wild since leaving the village, which is better suited for Qibao than the village.

text: We have known each other since we were children, growing up inseparable, just like brothers.
When I was out traveling, I found a strange-looking little Qibao and later brought it home to raise.
Since that's the case, Lin Sen should know Qibao very well, right?
Since that's the case, Lin Sen should know Qibao very well, right?
Besides you and me... who is the other one?
Besides you and me... who is the other one?
That was all in the past, when we were kids. We never imagined the future would turn out like this.
Although Lin Sen was shocked and scared when he first saw Qibao, he gradually became familiar with it.
Understanding is one thing, but it's not enough to make him stand with me and Qibao...
Back then, when Qibao was discovered in the village, I thought perhaps they would slowly accept Qibao just like Lin Sen did, but...
I couldn't take it, so I went to argue with them. Once or twice was fine, but after a while, I lost my patience.
Later on, Lin Sen also came to persuade me to give up the Seven Treasures... but...
Wait, isn't Qibao attacking the villagers?
Wait, isn't Qibao attacking the villagers?
Life in the wild inevitably leads to injuries. Every time I get hurt, Qibao comes over to lick my wounds.
I guess Qibao saw someone get hurt and tried to help, but was misunderstood.
However, my word alone is useless now.
The priority is to find the real culprit so that others can believe in Qibao.
Qibao likes to play with people, but no one dares to get close to it. So far, you are the third person willing to pet it.
They only said that Qibao was strange and ominous. Whether it was villagers getting hurt or poultry going missing, the blame was always placed on Qibao.

Li Ransheng tells you that he found Qibao while out wandering. He thought everyone would eventually accept Qibao, but they remained prejudiced. The alleged attacks on villagers were likely misunderstandings when Qibao tried to help someone who was injured. Thus, Li Ransheng is determined to find the real culprit.
I've been tracking its footprints since I left the village, investigating this monster.
These footprints have been appearing frequently lately. I have a feeling we're getting closer and closer to that monster.
We must be fully prepared... It's getting late, let's rest for today.
The toes and claws are relatively short... These are the footprints left by the monster that attacked the villagers.
Have you been searching for the real culprit all this time?
Have you been searching for the real culprit all this time?
That's right. Qibao has never attacked the villagers. I must find the real culprit!

Li Ransheng tracks the monster that attacked the villagers by its footprints. You learn that he has been searching for the culprit, and with the footprints appearing more frequently, you are likely getting closer to the monster.
It should be nearby... Watch out!
Qibao! Qibao? You, wake up, Qibao...
I'm fine. I didn't expect Qibao to save me. Qibao, it...
Qibao, stop messing around. If you open your eyes right now...
I'll give you three jin of honey! No... ten! Twenty is fine too! Qibao...
No... you didn't do anything wrong to me. I'm the one who failed Qibao...
People only see what they want to see... If I hadn't been so stubborn, Qibao wouldn't have...
Ransheng, how about we go back together?
I, I want to stay with Qibao a little longer.
Qibao was severely injured while saving Lin Sen and closed its eyes... Li Ransheng cannot accept the truth and refuses Lin Sen's suggestion to leave, wanting to stay with Qibao a little longer.
How are the injured doing? Are they any better?
How are the injured doing? Are they any better?
He woke up. He said he was attacked by earth wolves in the mountains, and fortunately, Qibao appeared in time to save him.
What about Li Ransheng? Any news?
What about Li Ransheng? Any news?
He... he left a letter. I don't think he's coming back.

Through Lin Sen, you learn that the injured person wasn't hurt badly and has already woken up. It wasn't Qibao who hurt him; rather, Qibao appeared just in time to save him from further attacks by the Ground Wolves. When asked about Li Ransheng, Lin Sen says he left a letter and likely won't be coming back.
I, I want to be alone for a while...
The Pyrite will put you in danger!
Haha... it will destroy everything, just like that time!
Calm down! Leave it to me!
I think our captain has got her river...
Will you gather some herbs? I'll check if anyone's burned.
After you defeat the Crimson Beast, Cyan sends Maroon away on an errand.
It's his first solo job. I don't want him to get hurt.
People think childhood memories blur, but mine are clear.
My village was near, but no help came during the attack.
I practiced hunting relentlessly, all for the chance to avenge one day.
As I grew up, I wanted to lead a hunt for the Crimson Beast, but no one was on my side.
I began to understand that empathy doesn't really exist.
Jixia saw no need to hunt the beast since it hadn't harmed them.
What if the Crimson Beast attacks Jixia? I wonder how they'll react.
I deceived him, yet he still cared about me.
He isn't stupid. He's just kind.
You're not a villain. If you were, you'd let him drown in the water.
I just thought him a fool.
I found something else while investigating you.
Jixia actually sent a Hunter to save your village.
But the rain and the unfamiliar terrain held him up, and he got there too late.
Overwhelmed by guilt, the Hunter took an orphan in and taught him everything he knew.
Jixia wasn't ignoring others, but there was only so much they could do at that time...
I don't understand. Why release the Crimson Beast?
I want everyone in Jixia to feel its threat and destruction.
Shao Shi reveals why he awakened the Crimson Beast: he resents the academy for failing to send help when it attacked his home. But Cyan tells the other side of the story.
He won't cause any more trouble.
Learning the hidden truth, Shao Shi says nothing and turns to leave. You start to call after him, but Cyan stops you...
Why are you here? Where's Shao Shi?
He had something to attend to.
How about that? I did it all by myself!
I can't do anything without your strength!
Hehe. No worries, I'm back now.
I've done my solo time. From now on, let's work together just like in old times!
It's easier this way. Less thinking for me!
Maroon and Cyan make peace. The two brothers really can't do without each other.
See you next time! We won't go easy in the Enlightenment Trials just because you helped!
That's right. We'll be the champion!
It seems like a good challenge to sharpen skills.
After today, it will be much weaker. Even if it shows up again, Jixia students can handle it easily.
Cyan and Maroon express their gratitude to you. The time for parting finally arrives...
The trunk is brittle, and there aren't many leaves. The color is too dull—it isn't mature yet.
The trunk is brittle, and there aren't many leaves. The color is too dull—it isn't mature yet.
Translucent color, flexible branches, and lush leaves. That's it!
Translucent color, flexible branches, and lush leaves. That's it!
The leaves are small, the scent is weak, and the fruit is dull. Not this one...
The leaves are small, the scent is weak, and the fruit is dull. Not this one...
I should look for another one.
I should look for another one.
The leaves and fruit are big, glossy, and smell great. This must be it.
The leaves and fruit are big, glossy, and smell great. This must be it.
We only need one, but it must be fresh and perfect.
I'll use Burnshoots and Dimfruits, plus gentler herbs like Cloudveil Velvet, Twisting Herb Seeds, and dried Nimbus Rolls.
It cures the illness in the gentlest way possible.
I have most of the ingredients. For the rest, let's split up and look for them.
Two are tricky to find, and they're in dangerous places. Can I count on you?
Okay, what do I need to do?
Okay, what do I need to do?
Let's go step by step. First is Dimfruits—look for big leaves and golden fruit in the cave.
It should be big, shiny, and have a strong scent you can smell from a few steps away.
Its smell can attract wild animals, so be very careful when picking it.
Remember, it must be freshly ripened and in perfect condition. I'll prepare the rest here. Be careful.
Great to see you here. Thanks to you, we found the Index of Ailments.
With that book and some old records, I have a plan to cure Ms. Perilla's stubborn illness.
You're no longer a beginner, so you should start memorizing these names.
Shinye creates a new formula based on the Sage's notes and asks you to gather Dimfruit from a nearby cave.
Well done. Let me take a look... Perfect, it's in excellent condition, just as the Index of Ailments describes.
The Burnshoot turns white in Aerflow. Its twigs are full of energy and very strong as medicine.
Likewise, this ingredient has strict requirements—it can't be too old or too young.
Old Burnshoots are too powerful, and young ones aren't potent enough for our needs.
Judging by Teacher Zisu's age and the records in her notes, what we need is a Kuyuan wood aged between thirty-two and thirty-six years.
zh_text: 根据紫苏老师的年纪和手札中的记载，我们需要的，是三十二到三十六年生的生奎木。
source_text: 根据紫苏老师的年纪和手札中的记载，我们需要的，是三十二到三十六年生的生奎木。

text: It should look clear, not too stiff or weak, and have healthy green leaves.
Next up is the Burnshoot. It grows in a riskier area. Please be very cautious.
That's how we Herbologists do—every detail matters. You'll get used to it.
Burnshoots grow near <001>burned trees</>. Watch out for the wild beasts nearby.
Shinye says another ingredient from the Index of Ailments, Burnshoot, grows near charred trees. Wild beasts roam nearby, so he asks you to collect it.
Glad you came back in time... The Dimfruit just drew wild beasts here.
Don't worry, I stored the ingredients safely. Let me take a look at the Burnshoot now.
It looks good. Have you checked the surrounding environment?
Great. The herb's power relies on its environment—even small changes matter.
Let me check again... All set. Let's head back to the Herb Garden and make the medicine!
Yes, I checked both the plant and where it grew as you told me.
Yes, I checked both the plant and where it grew as you told me.
After confirming the ingredients, Shinye prepares to return with you to the Herb Garden to make the medicine.
That should be the cave Shinye mentioned.
That should be the cave Shinye mentioned.
This should be the cave Shinye mentioned.
This should be the cave Shinye mentioned.
Qizai, I really hope you can regain everyone's recognition. Objectively speaking, you have always been the one we have the highest hopes for.
zh_text: 七仔，我非常希望你能重新获得大家的认可。客观来说，我们一直最看好的都是你。

text: Sorry, that's for "The Scholar Goose's head." Think again.
Incorrect. That's for "Frogs stacking high." Think again.
You've got it right! Yes, its body—except for the belly—is extremely tough; that's its defining feature.
Cherish it and study hard. Next time we meet, I won't make it so easy for you.
It turns out there are people in Jixia who genuinely seek to learn from Legendary Beasts. You've exceeded my expectations.
Your willingness to learn from animals has caught my attention.
Take this copy of "Dance with the Leafy Slumberstone" as a reward.
Well, I thought it would smash you. Impressive. Let's see how you did. Listen up!
Last question: The Leafy Slumberstone climbs high. What does it mean?
Didn't expect you to be so dedicated to learning allegories.
You answer the allegory based on your understanding, finally earning Cincin's admiration. She gifts you her treasured copy of Dance with the Leafy Slumberstone, hoping you'll keep studying hard.
What should I ask next time...
Why are you still here? Chickening out now?
A Phantom Rabbit should be around here. Keep looking.
A Phantom Rabbit should be around here. Keep looking.
Is it a person or a beast? Where is it coming from?
Is it a person or a beast? Where is it coming from?
Scholarly Tiger it is. Or rather, a mimicked one.
Scholarly Tiger it is. Or rather, a mimicked one.
What are you talking about? It seems happy.
What are you talking about? It seems happy.
Really? So, how did you come to master this art of eloquence and wisdom?
Really? So, how did you come to master this art of eloquence and wisdom?
A Hunter? Aren't you the one chasing rabbits and beating up Little Saepes all day?
A Hunter? Aren't you the one chasing rabbits and beating up Little Saepes all day?
I can't tell. Shouldn't you be teaching me how to learn from animals first?
I can't tell. Shouldn't you be teaching me how to learn from animals first?
Mistaking a Pome Magpie with a Red Falcon? Is this an allegory?
Mistaking a Pome Magpie with a Red Falcon? Is this an allegory?
I want to give it a try too!
The sound you were making is way off for Tiggy, like mistaking a Pome Magpie with a Red Falcon—completely wrong.
I see. You're that type: study, quiz, and beat up Little Saepes.
Listen, this is Jixia's wisdom, born from the mutual learning between villagers and animals!
Don't you judge the fine art with your mundane language.
For a Hunter like me, it's as easy as moving a house spider.
Listen: a true Hunter is someone who lives in harmony with all creatures, a supporter.
Driven by my love for animals, I constantly observe and have mastered this sophisticated linguistic art.
Are you sure? Many are drawn to allegories, but no one has mastered even just three lines.
Fine. Get this: 'Mini-nose Bilby in a flower patch'—can you guess the rest?
Eager to challenge, I see. I'll teach you some tricks, but it's your task to master them!
The key is to stay humble and seek the animals' wisdom.
A wise Mini-nose Bilby is right behind this tree, invited to offer advice. Ask it for guidance.
Remember, show respect and be humble.
Hey, stop that. We're discussing the weather!
Are you using Legendary Beasts as metaphors? Interesting.
Are you using Legendary Beasts as metaphors? Interesting.
I love animals too much to chase rabbits. As for hitting Little Saepes...
While talking to Cincin, you notice she often uses allegories. She calls it a language art. When you ask to learn, she tells you to first consult a Mini-nose Bilby.
There might be traces of Phantom Rabbits nearby. I'll try to track them down.
There might be traces of Phantom Rabbits nearby. I'll try to track them down.
How about that? Impressed by its wisdom?
Again, Mini-nose Bilby in a flower patch. What does that mean?
You were close. Its flower-like tail helps it hide among the blooms, making it difficult to spot.
Running away from the challenge might be wise, but it doesn't quite answer my question.
I'd be surprised if you can't get such a simple question right. The next one won't be so easy.
The next one is about the Phantom Rabbits. I invited them earlier, but they've already left.
You'll have to find them on your own.
Check the bushes for rabbits with elaborate ear patterns. They don't easily accept invitations.
Hmmm. You're like a Brutalhorn Bull grazing—clueless. Not even close!
You provide the second half, but Cincin throws another riddle at you, this time about a Phantom Rabbit.
Nice work. You got its guidance. Now it's time for the next question.
Second question: Phantom Rabbit perks its ears. What does it mean?
Correct. With mask-like patterns on its ears, the rabbit raises them to scare off threats when needed.
Incorrect. Herbivores don't just give up when in danger. Think again.
No, no, no. Phantom Rabbits don't have a voracious appetite. Their stomachs can't handle it.
Maybe I was wrong about you? I doubt it. You'll get the next one wrong for sure. Pay attention.
Hmph, this next one... is a guest you could never invite. It often rests in the south and is hard to spot.
When asleep, it looks like a green mountain. When it wakes, it roars like thunder.
It remains stationary now, but disturbing it will lead to a serious challenge.
You're on your own this time.
Not bad. Don't stop learning from nature.

You answer the allegory based on the Phantom Rabbit's behavior, impressing Cincin. She continues with the next riddle: "When asleep, it looks like a green mountain. When it wakes, it roars like thunder."
A green mountain that loves to sleep. It must be the Leafy Slumberstone. Looks like there's going to be a fight with it.
A green mountain that loves to sleep. It must be the Leafy Slumberstone. Looks like there's going to be a fight with it.
No surprise here, a creature with a sharp temper. Its only weak spot is its belly.
No surprise here, a creature with a sharp temper. Its only weak spot is its belly.
It stopped attacking. Looks like the challenge is over. Time to head back.
It stopped attacking. Looks like the challenge is over. Time to head back.
Yes, the Mini-nose Bilby buries its head in the ground, leaving its flower-like tail to attract insects.
By digging holes in different spots, they confuse predators. They're smart and fascinating creatures.

You come to a strange flower, and a Mini-nose Bilby pops out. When you pet its head, Cincin explains its special habit—they bury their heads in the ground, leaving their flower-like tails exposed to confuse predators...
Don't worry. When the Phantom Rabbits are startled, they raise their ears to intimidate.
It's okay. We're just here to be friends.
See the mask-like patterns on its ears? It's a defense mechanism.

You approach the Phantom Rabbit lightly but still startle the little critter. It raises its two ears at you, forming a mask-like pattern. Cincin appears and calms the creature, explaining that this is how the Phantom Rabbit intimidates enemies and protects itself...
So that's why he hesitated during the last and this retake.
Master Crafter faced the same situation as him... Why didn't I think of that?
I want to help him. Can you assist me?
I want to help him. Can you assist me?
Hmm... I need mediums for Sorcery transmission.
High-conductivity fire and wind Sorcery Crystals work best.
You can get them from Scorchtail Lizards and nearby Rebels.
I'll make other preparations... starting with apologizing to Jia Xu.
Once you have the crystals, let's meet back at the cliff.
Once you have the crystals, let's meet back at the cliff.
Yonmu asks you to find some Sorcery Crystals to act as a medium. You should be able to find them on Scorchtail Lizards and nearby Rebels. Once you have them, meet her at the first cliff.
Some of Master Banqiao's experimental journals and experience.

text: Here's the fire crystal. Next, go to the Rebels' camp.
Here's the fire crystal. Next, go to the Rebels' camp.
Wait... I think I have an appointment with...
Yes, you can count on me.
You agreed to this. You can't back out now, understand?
Do we really have to do this?
Then read it in your mind and decide.
It'll be safe, I promise. If there's any issue, you can pause.
With the Aershroud to help and the crystals, we're ready.
I'm about to begin. Can you release the Aershroud?
I'm about to begin. Can you release the Aershroud?
Yonmu and Jia Xu reach an agreement. After you return with the crystals, Yonmu prepares to share vision with you so you can release the Aershroud.
This is Aershroud's view. You're safe now.
No—way! This is way too high!
Hold my hand, don't close your eyes.
With the Aershroud released, Yonmu casts his Sorcery again, sharing its vision with Jia Xu for a soaring experience. His fear of heights makes him scream non-stop...
I'm here! I didn't keep you long, did I?
We're back! Sorry to keep you waiting.
I shared the Aershroud's vision with Jia Xu, so he could experience flying.
She wanted to help me get used to high altitudes and overcome my fear of heights.
Oh, right, I'm sorry. I didn't mean to pry or expose your fear.
Never mind, but don't let it happen again.
It's impressive you figured out my fear of heights from seeing me read Master Crafter's diary.
During those high-altitude retakes, you either gave up or tried strange ideas to complete them.
Strange ideas? I am a Trader! I'm just putting the theory into practice.
Well, never mind. Anyway, thank you.
Next time, can we fly lower?
The Aershroud flew too high. I'm still recovering.
And next time, can we use something more controllable, like July?
And thank you. Hopefully, I won't ask you for help next time.
I hope we don't have to retake anything. I want the Retake Alliance disbanded soon.
And thank you. Hopefully, I won't ask you for help next time.
It turns out Jia Xu cheated in the exam due to his fear of heights. Maybe this experience will help him overcome his phobia.
Gotta use the Bracer to track Jia Xu's location.
Gotta use the Bracer to track Jia Xu's location.
Ugh, fine, fine, I'll handle it myself.
Hey... Fancy meeting you here, haha...
By the way, if I paid you to help me again, would you be up for it?
Actually, I need someone to enter data into a device.
I was heading to the academy to ask around, but since you're here, maybe you'd like to help.
This stone activates a large rock, on which you can find the device.
Get there, enter the data, and the job is done.
Just be careful not to fall—I won't cover any medical expenses.
Jia Xu asks for your help using a green stone to activate a Mechcraft device and record data in it.
Hey, why did you do that?
He said it was a paid request.
He said it was a paid request.
No wonder he had me take the exam first—to make it easier for him to pull this off.
We were proving ourselves to the teacher, but you cheated again...
All our special training was wasted. You're hopeless!
You... Fine, report me. I'll accept failing this test!
I've got other things to do. Bye.
You enter the data, but Yonmu reveals it was a makeup test. Jia Xu tells you to report him if you want and leaves.
Was I too harsh with what I said?
I've seen how hard he worked for this makeup test.
He was honest with the earlier ones. Why did he mess up now...?
Ask him? I'm just guessing here.
He's already gone, and I don't know where he is.
I can find him. Just follow me.
I can find him. Just follow me.
Thanks, but I need to tidy up here first. Could you go look for him first?
Thanks, but I need to tidy up here first. Could you go look for him first?
Yonmu, wanting to find the real reason Jia Xu cheated, decides to ask him directly. She asks you to go find him first.
What's the situation? Did you find him?
Not yet. I think I'm at some kind of... lab?
Not yet. I think I'm at some kind of... lab?
A lab? Maybe... I'm almost there. Wait for me.
A lab? Maybe... I'm almost there. Wait for me.
This might be Master Crafter's lab, the one who designed the Dashing Wings!
Yes, the brilliant inventor. You heard the rumor about the Dashing Wings?
He used puppets for high-altitude experiments instead of doing them himself.
Can you imagine? The inventor never experienced his invention himself.
The lab is locked. How did he enter?
I'm not an expert here. I need your help to unlock the gate!
I'm not an expert here. I need your help to unlock the gate!
Yonmu thinks the lab belongs to the one who designed the Dashing Wings. You go inside to look for Jia Xu.
This might be Master Crafter's lab, the one who designed the Dashing Wings!
