Wait, is Jia Xu researching something? Why now of all times?
Actually I've felt like he's been hiding something from me...
This guy! I've told him, no secrets between us in the Retake Alliance.
We both retake exams often, so... I know it's embarrassing.
I got sidetracked. Anyway, I mean maybe we'd better not alert him...
Just secretly see what he's researching.
Forgot the Sorcery Technique I'm best at?
It's not the most ethical, but it seems like the only option right now.
Forgot the Sorcery Technique I'm best at?
Jia Xu is looking through files. Yonmu uses a vision-based Sorcery Technique to see what he's up to.
It is risky. Please be careful.
If you want to back out, I understand. No worries.
What a hassle, having to clean up all this mess...
I'll leave finding him to you, and I'll catch up later.
I'll leave finding him to you, and I'll catch up later.
It's dangerous around here, but you can handle it, right?
I'll wait here for Jia Xu. Go get the crystals.
And I'll take Jia Xu back to the cliff. Let's meet there!
Yonmu asks you to wait for her at the Aerflow Tower after you find the items.
No, there won't be a next time!
This must be the energy hub device Xiao Dao mentioned.
This must be the energy hub device Xiao Dao mentioned.
What was that barrier just now?
What was that barrier just now?
A weapon specifically designed to catch petty thieves. You don't need to know its name or how it works.
Speak up, cannon fodder. What exactly are you and your accomplices planning to steal?
I know, I just scanned it. So you're just here to distract me? The alarm was triggered the moment you entered the Secret Pavilion.
You just referred to yourself as 'this Pavilion Master'? So, the Secret Forbidden Pavilion Master is a patrol drone?
You just referred to yourself as 'this Pavilion Master'? So, the Secret Forbidden Pavilion Master is a patrol drone?
Sigh, what a headache. You don't even understand the situation—I'm using this mechanism to speak with you.
Uh... Jia Jiazi is gone. But that makes sense; the brief window when the hub was shut down was only enough to steal things from that sector.
It's one of the earliest batches of faulty mechanical cores. It has great power, but it's unstable, so it's sealed here.
But looking at it now, it's not that impressive. If you really want to talk about it, some of Master Luban's inventions are much more dangerous than this.
They're just imposters posing as Jixia students. I have the image data of all Jixia students here to cross-reference.
Disguise, and then trick me into shutting down the central energy device...
Disguise, and then trick me into shutting down the central energy device...
Huh, you're not as slow as I thought.
Fortunately, I placed a tracking device on Jiajiazi, so I can sense its general direction.
How about it? Want to make up for your mistakes and clear your name? If you can find Jiajiazi, I can pretend nothing happened.
Wait a moment while I check the Forbidden Archive's inventory... Hmm, the top-secret area is normal... The books are too...
Otherwise, I can demand your expulsion from the academy. The Master of the Secret Pavilion has the power of a deciding vote, you know. Think about it?
Ahem, I never said it was number seven. Let me see... who stole the Cloud-Silk Shadow... Ah, some unruly students.
No need to think about it, I agree. After all, this was indeed my oversight.
No need to think about it, I agree. After all, this was indeed my oversight.
I was suspicious too, but I didn't expect them to be able to run off so quickly while injured.

Heh, daring to come and steal things.
Forget it, I'll let you go for now, otherwise how am I supposed to question you?
Speaking of which, what kind of data are Xiao Dao and the others trying to obtain?
Speaking of which, what kind of data are Xiao Dao and the others trying to obtain?
Hmph, I told you no one would believe us.
Ahem, we ran into a bit of a problem.
Just touch the device in the center of the controller to disable the entire Secret Pavilion's defense system for one minute.
It's just a minor injury... hiss.
I'm sorry, if I hadn't been so careless, you wouldn't have been hurt by that mechanism patrol...
Mechcraft Guards? Are you trying to enter the Forbidden Pavilion?
Mechcraft Guards? Are you trying to enter the Forbidden Pavilion?
You'd better give up. The pavilion is not only guarded by the Patrol Hub, but it also has a complex network of secret passages.

From what you're saying... have you successfully broken in before?
We didn't apply to the Academy, indeed...
We didn't apply to the Academy, indeed...
Hmm, actually... we're here to investigate something.
I'm Xiaodao, an investigator from the Academic Discipline Department, and this is Qian Qian.
A few days ago, we received intelligence that the Master of the Secret Forbidden Pavilion was conducting dangerous, secret experiments.
That Pavilion Master has a special status, so we have no choice but to investigate in secret.
The Pavilion Master is deeply trusted by the Master, so he shouldn't...
The Pavilion Master is deeply trusted by the Master, so he shouldn't...
Sigh, we're in a tough spot too. So, if we can uncover the truth without alerting the Pavilion Master, that would be for the best.
If we can just shut down the central energy for a moment... we'll have a way to investigate it thoroughly.

The price? I... I can bear it.
Hmph, the same old clichés. Since we've been caught, we're at your mercy.
Oh my, I started lecturing without even realizing it. My inner self really doesn't match my appearance, I'll have to be careful next time.
Let me think about how I should punish you all.
Don't count me in. Boss Ji Chen sent me to find someone.
How about I use you as experimental material? I happen to be short two human subjects for a secret experiment.
Ah, is that joke too dark? Then be the manual labor for my experiment.
You are restricted to the Secret Forbidden Pavilion for half a year. However, you may visit any area outside the top-secret zones.
Does the Pavilion Master mean we can conduct research inside the Secret Forbidden Pavilion?
Great, Xiaodao, didn't we want to make something to show those who looked down on us from the very beginning?
I don't know, I'm just in a good mood today. Besides, I was indeed impressed that you managed to activate Jiajiazi.
Alright, we'll give it six months and follow your lead.

This... I will definitely apply according to the academy rules next time.
This... I will definitely apply according to the academy rules next time.
Newcomer, I deceived you today, yet you set aside your grievances to save me.
We don't need these anymore, so take them. Maybe we'll meet again someday.
From the moment you broke down that door, the freedom you chose must have had a corresponding price. Everything in this world is like that.

Well, it's Spring Galore, which captures all the world's richness and beauty. Guess my poem was too easy.
I'm giving my all! Let's get cooking!
You meet up with Culine and Mai for the rematch. From the poem she gives, Mai deduces the dish for the match is Spring Galore.
It's done... but probably not enough to beat Mai.
It's done... but probably not enough to beat Mai.
Spicepot Garlic smells strong, but heat unlocks a distinct aroma and flavors that vary by how you cook it.
Spicepot Garlic smells strong, but heat unlocks a distinct aroma and flavors that vary by how you cook it.
Scale Flowers are sweet and juicy. They add richness and blend all the flavors.
Scale Flowers are sweet and juicy. They add richness and blend all the flavors.
Alright, it's ready. Time for Ms. Culine to taste it.
Alright, it's ready. Time for Ms. Culine to taste it.
Bitewood is spicy and dries inner moisture. It also brings out the dish's flavors.
Bitewood is spicy and dries inner moisture. It also brings out the dish's flavors.
You add the final seasonings and finish your dish.
Ms. Culine, mine is finished too!
Both dishes look alike, but I can smell you used different spices and skills. Let me taste.
Mai, you've grown a lot. I can tell you are not cooking for the results or recognition.
Your Spring Galore is full of warmth and care for others. Great job.
I am your student, after all.
But... the other dish tastes a bit better. The technique is perfect, and the idea is bold yet refined.
What? Let me try! The meat is so juicy, the veggies are sweet... Wait, is this...
Your method to boost flavor... Why didn't I think of it?
Every dish you make amazes me. I can feel that your journey as a Gourmet is just getting started.
You're all giving me too much praise.
You're all giving me too much praise.
You earned it! Here's your prize for winning the contest.
Yes, I put a lot of thought into it.
A true gourmet needs the right outfit!
I hope you both keep working hard and never stop improving.
I decided to travel and learn about cooking across the continent.
If we have a chance to compete again, I won't lose!
Don't get cocky just yet! A Gourmet's worth isn't decided by a single dish.
Agreed! I'm looking forward to the next feast.
After tasting it, Culine decides you're the winner. But she gives Mai a gift for encouragement anyway. After this, Mai decides to travel and find new ways to grow.
I told the judges that Mai cheated. He's disqualified now.
We took extra time to talk things through.
So, what about the extra round?
So, what about the extra round?
It's canceled. Your Mushroom & Fish Stew already won. The award ceremony will be held soon.
Not only did you turn the crisis around, you created a stunning dish—and saved Mai. Thank you.
I haven't heard of him yet... Come on, the judges are still waiting.
If you're ready, let's start the award ceremony.
We've confirmed Mai damaged cooking utensils and stole seasoning. He was disqualified from the event.
This year's winner is—the Mysterious First-Year! Congratulations to our champion!
This student showed great skill and creativity by making an amazing dish from simple ingredients.
The hard work and creativity have really impressed us! Judges, would you like to say a few words?
Shen Qin announces that Mai has been disqualified for sabotaging the competition. You are declared the champion.
Your food amazed me! I wish I could taste more! Hope to see you keep cooking.
I admire your creativity and courage. Stay true to yourself and your passion for food!
Croak, croak croak, croak croak croak croak... (warm, sincere words)
Um... I think she's telling you to keep working hard.
Your prize will be sent to you after the event ends. Please be patient.
With that, the Food Festival Competition is over! One more round of applause for the winner!
Can you come with me? There's something I want to talk about.
After the competition is over, Culine wants to talk to you in private.
Congrats on your win. This marks your first real step into the culinary world.
I still have a lot to learn.
I still have a lot to learn.
That's good! Keep that spirit and you'll improve quickly. Also, I need help with Mai.
Wait! Let's bring something for him. Can you make a Seafood Pot to take with us?
If Mai is really quitting cooking, maybe it will change his mind.
Okay, I'll make it right away.
Okay, I'll make it right away.
I haven't seen him for some time. He's stubborn and might still be upset about what happened.
Can you come with me to talk to him?
Great! Let's keep in touch through Big-eye Owlet.
Culine congratulates you but says she's worried about Mai. She asks you to make a Seafood Pot and talk to Mai with her.
It's done. Did you find Mai?
It's done. Did you find Mai?
Still searching... He might have gone to the southern mountains for ingredients. Can you check there?
Did Mai really give up on cooking?
Did Mai really give up on cooking?
The campfire is still warm... Is this Mai's recipe?
The campfire is still warm... Is this Mai's recipe?
Wild beasts are nearby. Must find him fast.
Wild beasts are nearby. Must find him fast.
You... what are you doing here?
Ms. Culine's worried about you. We split up to search and I found clues here...
Ms. Culine's worried about you. We split up to search and I found clues here...
Sorry... I made everyone worry again. And about the contest... I apologize.
I... I can't go back. I never got Ms. Culine's recognition and messed up the contest...
I can't face anyone. Maybe I should leave Jixia. Please apologize to Ms. Culine and the others for me.
Why are you so set on getting recognized by Ms. Culine?
Why are you so set on getting recognized by Ms. Culine?
Hmm... well. I'm from Northlands. We barely had enough to eat, let alone learning cooking skills.
Ms. Culine once visited Northlands, and I tasted her food—only then did I realize how amazing cooking could be.
I would not start my journey to Jixia without her. Finally became her student, but then I failed her...
Ms. Culine asked me to bring you a Seafood Pot. She hopes you'll try it.
Ms. Culine asked me to bring you a Seafood Pot. She hopes you'll try it.
Seafood Pot... Ms. Culine made it in Northlands. I've had many at Jixia, but hers was always the best.
Guess it's fitting to end my time as a Gourmet.
You find Mai, who is planning to leave Jixia. He's too ashamed to stay, but he agrees to try your Seafood Pot before he goes.
This... It's just like Ms. Culine's! But wait, you made this?
I see... Ms. Culine's Seafood Pot is gentle and subtle, with all the flavors expressing her kindness...
But yours is completely different. You let every flavor shine, straight to the taste buds...
How can it taste different yet still remind me of her?
I wanted you to enjoy it.
I wanted to make it delicious.
Delicious... I get it now. Cooking is about sharing, not just using skills or following recipes...
Why now... I've thrown away the recipes and ingredients, and did badly in the contest...
I... Indeed. If I quit now, all my effort will go to waste.
I want to make food that brings joy, like the warmth you gave me.
Will you have another match with me? Not to win, but to show Ms. Culine my growth.
And I'll apologize to everyone. Ms. Culine, can you go back with me? And, see you there!
Mai! I... I finally found you.
Ms. Culine! You... why are you here?
Mai, are you really giving up cooking?
Remember? A Gourmet's worth isn't decided by a single dish. You can always start again.
You're talented, but you let others' opinions stop you. I've always hoped you'd find your own flavor.
Ms. Culine, I lost my head before—but I want to make up for it. Please judge our match!
Good. Gourmets solve things through cooking. If you're competing, get ready!

Mai tries your Seafood Pot and falls in thought. Culine arrives to ask him not to give up cooking. Realizing his mistake, Mai decides to stay and apologize to the other contestants. He then challenges you to a proper rematch.
Without you, I wouldn't know what the most important thing is for a Gourmet. Thank you!
With your passion, maybe one day you both could rival me!
I should follow them to the waterfall.
I should follow them to the waterfall.
I hope tomorrow she will find the answer she's looking for.
Wait with Lofu until the next day.
You decide to wait until the next day to duel Qiong Lou.
Get some rest, alright? And keep your mind off fighting for once.
A rare plant growing on the dangerous cliff... Plants and people might have something in common.
Hey, look! The Wisteria I've been waiting for has finally bloomed today.
Are you the Herbalist who treated Qiong Lou?
Are you the Herbalist who treated Qiong Lou?
Qiong Lou? Right! Her skill causes her a lot of pain. Something must be wrong within her body.
It's strange for a young girl like her to appear so lifeless...
Do you have time? Help me pick it while it's blooming!
I've been researching for days and finally found that the Wisteria might help.
Herbalist Shinye, who treated Qiong Lou, is obsessed with rare ailments. He asks you to help pick the rare Wisteria that can alleviate her symptoms.
Great! I knew I could count on you.
What's so rare about Qiong Lou's illness?
What's so rare about Qiong Lou's illness?
Usually, such an illness is caused by <001>Sorcery</> duels, but she's a Martial Arts expert. Isn't that strange?
She feels unwell now. Lofu is taking care of her.
She feels unwell now. Lofu is taking care of her.
Ah, well... Anyway, here, give it to Lofu.
By the way, why are you here for the medicine? I told Qiong Lou to come again.
Remember, if the situation doesn't improve, bring Qiong Lou to me.
Shinye says that despite being a Martial Arts master, Qiong Lou exhibits injuries typically seen in Sorcery users. He asks you to deliver a symptom-relieving prescription to Lofu.
Martial Arts isn't just about hard work. The higher you go, the more it's about talent.
What do you mean by "so fast"?
Ahh... What are Qiong Lou's secrets to becoming strong so fast?
What now? I told you not to disturb my training.
There is a rumor about it, but I don't really believe it.
Novar, Meng Ya, and you. You are all talented.
As for Qiong Lou... When she first came here, even I... I mean, no one lost to her.
Everyone knew that she wasn't cut out for Martial Arts, until one day...
I heard she often goes to <001>the Mechcraft Room</> near here. Maybe she had some special experience there.
Jiang Suan says Qiong Lou, who initially had no Martial Arts talent, seemed to become strong overnight. The reason might be related to a Mechcraft Room on the mountain.
Have you ever competed with Qiong Lou?
Not long after, the master vanished, leaving only a rainbow behind.
Some speculate that Qiong Lou might have comprehended the master's skills.
Many years ago, a master trained under a waterfall, mastered his skills, and became unbeatable.
My understanding is limited, but I can sense that she has reached an elusive level.
I did, but I couldn't even handle her first two moves.
Since then, students have come here to find out the secret of the rainbow.
Do you know about Qiong Lou's skills?
I heard Qiong Lou has something called <001>Iridescent Enlightenment</>, but it's just a <001>rumor</>.
Huh? Haven't you heard of the legend of the waterfall?
Ji Lu says a Martial Arts master left a rainbow under a waterfall. The "Iridescent Enlightenment" Qiong Lou practices might stem from the technique he left behind.
Shinye found a way to ease her symptoms.
Shinye found a way to ease her symptoms.
Shinye mentioned that Qiong Lou once refused treatment.
Shinye mentioned that Qiong Lou once refused treatment.
Yeah... She's always put Martial Arts first. But, I really admire her dedication.
Thanks, I hope she can take a good rest this time.
Now I just hope she can take better care of herself...
So that's why you two were...
So that's why you two were...
I could see the determination in her eyes and a hint of unwillingness to give up.
I've never had her determination, so I wished I could see her reach the top.
When we first met, she was already like that.
Ah, you saw that. Never mind.
I almost gave up on being a Herbalist, but she encouraged me to keep going.
I... I'll go prepare the medicine now. Anyway, thank you for your help.
You deliver the prescription and herbs to Lofu. Her words are full of admiration for Qiong Lou, but she seems to be worried about something else...
Well, I'd better go investigate that Mechcraft Room.
Well, I'd better go investigate that Mechcraft Room.
By the way, your face looks kind of familiar...
Who are you? Why are you here without knowing Qiong Lou's Iridescent Haze Swords?
See there? The one talking to Lofu.
She's the champion here. Many fell to her Iridescent Haze Swords.
I heard you mumbling that she's arrogant.
I heard you mumbling that she's arrogant.
She set a rule—<001>one fight per day</>, and the rest wait till tomorrow.
You want to challenge her? She is the master of the masters.
Sounds interesting. I'm gonna give it a try.
Sounds interesting. I'm gonna give it a try.
Forget it. No one else stands a chance against her, except for me and Novar...
... hmm, maybe that new student Novar brought back.
I was all set to go when you interrupted. Now I have to psych myself up again...
I... need a bit more time...
You hear that the champion here, Qiong Lou, only fights one match per day. You decide to go challenge her.
Clearly, she couldn't fight after the light appeared. It was strange.
Clearly, she couldn't fight after the light appeared. It was strange.
Excuse me, do you know Qiong Lou?
Excuse me, do you know Qiong Lou?
Oh, Qiong Lou. She often helps out here.
Yes. She took on several tasks today and is very busy.
You can wait for her at the <001>resting area in the corner</> over there.
Her backpack is there. She'll definitely come back later for it.
Did you hear any strange sounds?
Well... I guess work stress is really getting to me.
A working Mechcraft student says Qiong Lou often comes here to help out. She left in a hurry today, leaving her backpack in the corner resting area. You can wait for her there.
Was she hiding something? I'd better ask others.
Was she hiding something? I'd better ask others.
Her backpack, the wage box... The sound is coming from here.
Her backpack, the wage box... The sound is coming from here.
Huh? There really is a strange sound.
Huh? There really is a strange sound.
It seems to be coming from the corner...
It seems to be coming from the corner...
I met Lofu again at the Herb Garden, and she helped me bandage my broken arm.
She's a bit clumsy, but I think we're alike in some ways.
Lofu advised me not to challenge Aermore Valley again.
But how can I give up? Making it onto the Hunters' List is the best way to prove myself.
It creates an iridescent spirit. With a touch of Sorcery, Martial Arts can reach new heights.
Lofu's senior said that I might suffer both mentally and physically.
What's the price of <001>Iridescent Enlightenment</>? Do I... still have time to find my answer?
Qiong Lou's voice comes out of the backpack. "What Lofu mentioned" and "the price of Iridescent Enlightenment" might be what she's hiding...

Treasures produce rainbows, clearing the internal organs. If the fighting spirit does not die, one realizes the mist and clouds. The realm of martial arts, connected by magic, climbing to new heights...
zh_text: “宝物生虹，脏腑通透。战意不灭，方悟烟霞。武道之境，魔道以贯，再攀高峰……”
source_text: “宝物生虹，脏腑通透。战意不灭，方悟烟霞。武道之境，魔道以贯，再攀高峰……”
official_target_text: Treasures produce rainbows, clearing the internal organs. If the fighting spirit does not die, one realizes the mist and clouds. The realm of martial arts, connected by magic, climbing to new heights...
official_en_text: Treasures produce rainbows, clearing the internal organs. If the fighting spirit does not die, one realizes the mist and clouds. The realm of martial arts, connected by magic, climbing to new heights...

text: What will be the <001>price of comprehending the rainbow</>? Where is the answer to the pinnacle of martial arts? Do I... still have time?
zh_text: <001>悟虹的代价</>会是什么？武道之巅的答案又在哪里？我……还有时间吗？
source_text: <001>悟虹的代价</>会是什么？武道之巅的答案又在哪里？我……还有时间吗？
official_target_text: What will be the <001>price of comprehending the rainbow</>? Where is the answer to the pinnacle of martial arts? Do I... still have time?
official_en_text: What will be the <001>price of comprehending the rainbow</>? Where is the answer to the pinnacle of martial arts? Do I... still have time?

text: Your backpack seems to be... talking.
Your backpack seems to be... talking.
It's my Aercorder. I use it to record my training insights and... feelings. It's probably just malfunctioning.
Turns out the strange noise from Qiong Lou's backpack was from an Aercorder she usually uses to record her training insights and feelings.
Even an old tree can be swayed by the wind. I just went with the flow.
Focusing only on physical strength is not enough.
Iridescent Haze, huh? Just showing off fancy sword moves.
The medicine stabilized her mind, but she probably won't be able to practice Martial Arts anymore.
Ah, I... was busy preparing medicine and forgot.
Sorry, I forgot to tell you that Qiong Lou requested another duel.
Lofu, didn't you pass on my message?
I'm doing some small jobs here as a way to train.
I lift heavy things to gain strength and assemble small parts to stay sharp and focused.
It's an unconventional way to train both body and mind.
There's always someone better. I can't stop until I'm at the top.
Lofu only allows me to have one match per day, so I have to spend most of my time here.
Alright, take your medicine! It should be good for your... old injury.
Now we can have a good fight. You asked about Iridescent Enlightenment, right?
Well... the evening glow is shining, a perfect time for a battle.
I know an open place, let's go.
Qiong Lou invites you to fight in a more open area and to talk about the Iridescent Enlightenment.
I know an open place, let's go.
Don't be silly, you know I never blamed you...
One last question... could you handle my final strike?
The illusory view from the peak is as beautiful and fleeting as a rainbow...
It was strong, but not invincible.
I see... But I think I finally saw it, that beautiful yet fleeting view...
Lofu, let's go see that rainbow one more time.
Haha, after all, that was my power.
The medicine stabilized her mind, but she probably won't be able to practice Martial Arts anymore.
After the battle, Qiong Lou feels regret about that final, unfinished strike. All she wants is to see the rainbow with Lofu one more time—the rainbow born of her power.
Qiong Lou experienced her enlightenment right here.
Qiong Lou, are you done with your training? Why are you here, too?
You came early. But that's fine, I'm also eager to compete with you.
Didn't you come for our duel? I asked Lofu... So what are you doing here?
I want to ask about Iridescent Enlightenment...
I want to ask about Iridescent Enlightenment...
It's fine. I hope you can learn me more.
You're an opponent I've been paying attention to for a long time.
Wait... You knew I was coming here?
Wait... You knew I was coming here?
I have some questions for you.
I have some questions for you.
Qiong Lou, are you done with your training? Why are you here, too?
Lofu, didn't you pass on my message?
Ah, I... was busy preparing medicine and forgot.
Sorry, I forgot to tell you that Qiong Lou requested another duel.
I'm doing some small jobs here as a way to train.
I lift heavy things to gain strength and assemble small parts to stay sharp and focused.
It's an unconventional way to train both body and mind.
There's always someone better. I can't stop until I'm at the top.
Lofu only allows me to have one match per day, so I have to spend most of my time here.
Alright, take your medicine! It should be good for your... old injury.
Qiong Lou thinks you came for the promised duel. Lofu, who was supposed to send the invitation, is surprised by your presence. It seems Lofu didn't want her to duel again...
The person I fought yesterday was strong and unmovable, like an old tree. It was quite interesting.
But you used your skills to deflect his powerful force and sent him flying off the cliff.
Don't worry, I just added some calming herbs.
The Blazing Dance of Iridescent Haze Swords!
Today's final battle will witness my ultimate strike.
Qiong Lou exerts all her strength for the final move. Rainbow and sword light roar toward you. You raise your sword to meet it, wanting to receive this last strike.
I was hoping she could rest today, so I could try to persuade you to cancel the duel.
But I didn't expect you to come.
I hope tomorrow she will find the answer she's looking for.
When I interned there, I found something that was said to help people break through their talent limitations.
You must have heard it: "It creates an iridescent spirit."
I just wanted to help Qiong Lou, but I overlooked the price it came with.
You know the Forbidden Chamber, right? A place where dangerous items are contained.
Yes. That master studied a forbidden Sorcery Technique and created a Sorcery bottle.
You're not going to stop me anymore?
You're not going to stop me anymore?
I overheard your conversation and realized I underestimated Qiong Lou's resolve.
Everyone who held that power was destined to face this fate.
The Intendant told me that Qiong Lou has shown signs of "rainbowization."
I knew I couldn't hide it from you.
Now, I can only hope my senior's medicine can give Qiong Lou a sliver of hope.
The legend of the rainbow by the waterfall...
The legend of the rainbow by the waterfall...
His power was dispersed. Most of it was absorbed into the bottle, and a small amount formed the rainbow.
She was left with mental and physical injuries and can't practice Martial Arts anymore.
You really want to stop the duel. Is it because of the "Iridescent Enlightenment"?
You really want to stop the duel. Is it because of the "Iridescent Enlightenment"?

Turns out Qiong Lou is suffering backlash from the "Sorcery bottle" Lofu kindly gave her. Her martial skills are about to dissipate into rainbow... But Lofu, seeing Qiong Lou's determination, stops trying to prevent her.
Lofu, what are you doing here? We didn't...
Relax, I'm not here to stop you.
At least... take a break today.
Lofu has already told you everything, right?
Do you think I'm too obsessed with Martial Arts?
Now you will witness the unprecedented Iridescent Haze Swords.
No old injury. No special talent. Just this bottle.
I hope you won't regret this.
I hope you won't regret this.
Regret the rainbow's brilliance or regret its fleeting nature? Right or wrong, only time will tell.
But maybe it's my only choice.
There are many ways to reach the top. If you're willing to give everything, you'll find a way.
Qiong Lou knows using the Sorcery bottle to pursue Martial Arts isn't right, but she only wishes for a good battle now. Right and wrong can be judged later...
There are many ways to reach the peak. If you are willing to give everything, there will always be a way to get what you seek.
zh_text: 一个人攀上高峰有很多办法。如果愿意付出一切，那就总会有得到所求的途径。
source_text: 一个人攀上高峰有很多办法。如果愿意付出一切，那就总会有得到所求的途径。
official_target_text: There are many ways to reach the peak. If you are willing to give everything, there will always be a way to get what you seek.
official_en_text: There are many ways to reach the peak. If you are willing to give everything, there will always be a way to get what you seek.

text: Is my pursuit as unreachable as the rainbow?
A person spends their whole life pursuing an obsessive answer, finding their own meaning in it, regardless of success, failure, life, or death.
zh_text: 一个人一生追寻一个痴迷的答案，为此得到自己的意义，不论成败生死。
source_text: 一个人一生追寻一个痴迷的答案，为此得到自己的意义，不论成败生死。
official_target_text: A person spends their whole life pursuing an obsessive answer, finding their own meaning in it, regardless of success, failure, life, or death.
official_en_text: A person spends their whole life pursuing an obsessive answer, finding their own meaning in it, regardless of success, failure, life, or death.

text: Hey, why did you stop? Trying to act like a nice person?
Her old injury is acting up.
Her old injury is acting up.
She's probably faking it. You're so gullible.
I remember the day I first met Lofu many years ago.
We made a promise: I would become a Martial Arts master, and she would become a renowned Herbalist.
Martial Arts and medicine are mountains that we choose to climb.
They seem difficult to climb, but there's always a magnificent and fascinating view at the peak.
I... just want to find an answer.
I... just want to find an answer.
We're all in search of an answer, an answer about ourselves.
If it wasn't for her being by my side, I might have...
Excuse me, are you Qiong Lou?
Excuse me, are you Qiong Lou?
Hang on, I think I can take on another round today.
Even an old tree can be swayed by the wind. I just went with the flow.
Focusing only on physical strength is not enough.
Today's challenge is over. Please come back tomorrow.
It's fine. I didn't go all out right now.
I've heard about you from Novar.
I've been looking forward to this duel. Whenever you're ready.
Although Qiong Lou has already fought today, she's heard of your legend and decides to make an exception to spar with you.
Tell me, what does Martial Arts mean to you?
But you're already this strong. That's impressive.
Well, let me show you my answer.
This strike bears all that I have.
Qiong Lou's assault is like a sudden storm. She uses her sword to express her answer to the pinnacle of Martial Arts. With another clash of blades, Qiong Lou suddenly collapses, strength drained...
The realm of Martial Arts is like a towering mountain, difficult to climb.
The heart shines bright. The body is unparalleled. The swords are immovable.
Qiong Lou, why are you so stubborn...
It's hard to avoid getting hurt in competitions.
She only accepts one challenger a day... because her old injury has been acting up lately.
Although I'm a Herbalist, I don't have much experience dealing with her illness.
A senior Herbalist once diagnosed Qiong Lou. I wonder if he has found a solution yet.
Qiong Lou's condition got much worse... It's my fault for not stopping your duel.
I started this. I'll go find that senior.
I started this. I'll go find that senior.
Thanks. He should be at <001>the cliff below</>.
Qiong Lou's old injury has been flaring up recently. Lofu asks you to go to the cliff below to find a senior Herbalist who once treated Qiong Lou.
I'm fine, just need to rest for a bit.
I told you not to push yourself. You...
In the midst of your fierce battle, Qiong Lou suddenly collapses in pain. Lofu helplessly advises her. Their conversation seems to hint at some other hidden truth...
The Intendant took her and the bottle away.
I should face my punishment too, but I wanted to see this rainbow one last time.
Do you think it was truly an enlightenment, or could it have just been a mistake?
Maybe only Qiong Lou knows that.
Maybe only Qiong Lou knows that.
That's true. We won't really understand it unless we experience it ourselves.

Lofu says the Intendant of the Forbidden Chamber has reclaimed the Sorcery bottle, and she must return to accept punishment. Gazing at the distant rainbow, Lofu still wonders whether Qiong Lou's path was "enlightenment" or "error."
I hope it's not too late...
I do. I regret that all I could give her was a faint, false remnant of a rainbow.
But I'm also glad... that this light, at the very least, once briefly illuminated the path beneath her feet.
The road ahead is still long.
Yes... Whether it's me or Qiong Lou, we definitely, definitely still have a very long road to walk.
No... This can only be used once...
Before I answer your question, I want to ask: What does Martial Arts mean to you?
A master once told me it's about ending conflicts and fostering peace, both inside and out.
We all have reasons to become stronger.
Martial Arts is about competition and showcasing talent.
Through seasons and years, many people train diligently, and many face disappointment.
I once hesitated, so I understand that pain even more.
I'm genuinely happy to compete with you. Regardless of victory or defeat, it's a way to test my limits.
Maybe this time, I'll truly catch a glimpse of the pinnacle of Martial Arts.
It's just the price I paid to push the limits.
That doesn't matter anymore. I need to find the answer.
Even if the answer... may only be a fleeting, illusory rainbow.
After all, this might be my last chance.
I haven't talked so much in a long time, except with Lofu. Let's get started...
What's wrong? Is your old injury acting up again?
What's wrong? Is your old injury acting up again?
I'm okay, just suddenly feeling a bit tired.
We can have our duel later. Right now, you need to rest.

I promised to help, better follow her. Maybe I can track her with my Bracer.
I promised to help, better follow her. Maybe I can track her with my Bracer.
After you rescue Xuan, she still insists on going to the waterfall, saying today is the anniversary of her friend's death and she has to pay her respects. With no other option, you accompany her.
Oh, you followed me? I didn't expect you to find this place...
I couldn't just leave you alone. I'm glad you're okay.
I couldn't just leave you alone. I'm glad you're okay.
No, this is where my friendship with Qing began.
A year ago, I was testing a Mechcraft here when I accidentally alerted some monsters and ended up trapped in this tree.
Then Qing showed up and drove them away, saving you?
Then Qing showed up and drove them away, saving you?
Sort of. She used her puppet to distract them for a bit, then... we got stuck up here together.
Yeah, who would've thought it was a story of two rookies helping each other out? Hahaha.
We huddled up here, encouraging each other, until the academy found us on the third morning.
From then on, we were inseparable. We even carved our names into this tree to commemorate the day.
It should be... right on this tree.
When you catch up to Xuan, she explains that this is where she and Qing were once cornered by monsters. They carved their names here and have been friends ever since.
This is where Qing fell. The academy put up the sign after the incident.
It was raining, like today. When I got here, she was cornered by monsters at the cliff's edge.
But weren't you both skilled enough to handle wild monsters by then?
But weren't you both skilled enough to handle wild monsters by then?
There were too many of them.
We fought them off, but the ground was slippery from the rain... and she fell.
I rushed to the waterfall below, but the rain blurred my vision, and the river was too rough...
By the time I got there, Qing was gone...
The academy searched but found nothing. They eventually declared her missing.
It's the academy's way of handling it, but no one could survive that fall. Time tells all.
I've never returned here since that day.
People think it's because I'm too sad, but it's more than that... It's guilt.
If I'd arrived on time, maybe things would've been different. Maybe she wouldn't have faced the monsters alone.
Maybe my dreams are just her blaming me for what I did.
It was just an accident, right?
It was an avoidable accident, so I can't shake the guilt.
So you're here today to pay respects and find peace?
So you're here today to pay respects and find peace?
As long as your conscience is clear.
As long as my conscience is clear?
Yes, you came here to find peace within yourself, right?
Yes, you came here to find peace within yourself, right?
Yes, I hope this belated tribute can bring some closure...
You follow Xuan to the cliff where Qing fell. Blaming herself for not saving Qing in time, she ignores all warnings to come pay her belated tribute.
There are traces of something being here...
There are traces of something being here...
I hope Xuan will be okay. Thanks for your help.
It's better, but I still can't sleep well at night. Recently, I've been waking up in the middle of the night feeling like someone is outside my window...
I feel like the shadow comes and goes, sometimes so close that... I can almost hear her voice.
Could it be a nightmare from exhaustion? What did the voice say?
Nothing... Maybe I'm just imagining things because I'm so tired.
Alright, for now, try not to overexert yourself. Take a break from your projects and studies.
But joining Luban's team is such a rare opportunity...
What's more important, your health or your studies?
I've adjusted the prescription. This should help.
Xuan says she's been having restless sleep, feeling someone lingering by the window. Yue Min believes it's nightmares from fatigue and adjusts her prescription.
It's just a case of nerve strain, not too hard to treat. But if she doesn't follow instructions, it'll be tough to cure.
I bet she won't stay put and will still try to go to the waterfall.
What's so urgent that can't wait until she's better?
What's so urgent that can't wait until she's better?
Maybe it's because that day has come.
Can you keep an eye on her? I'm worried about her condition.
She usually heads there in the afternoon.
Please bring her back safely. I'll prepare some warming soup, as it looks like it's about to rain.
Yue Min mentions that Xuan isn't following his advice. He worries she has gone to the waterfall again and asks you to bring her back safely.
Hmm... The condition seems stable. How's the headache?
Excuse me, can I ask you some questions?
Excuse me, can I ask you some questions?
Why? Can't you see I'm busy!
My graduation test is next month. Just thinking about Yan Lie makes me...
You haven't heard? After the second duel, his eyes were red, his face was pale, and he could barely walk.
Ugh. Go away, don't waste my time!
If even he struggled so much against the master, what chance do I have?
You learn from Po Xi that Yan Lie looked strange after the second duel. His eyes were red and his face was pale.
Excuse me, do you know what happened at Yan Lie and Tigon's second duel?
Excuse me, do you know what happened at Yan Lie and Tigon's second duel?
That day, we cleaned up the duel site.
He should be at Pouncing Jump, treating the disciples.
We talked about things we found there.
Torn cloth and iron sand, likely from master's heavy sandbags.
Odd... Yan Lie was strong, but master still wore sandbags during the fight.
Oh, that must be the reason why they argued.
No... Maybe Yan Lie was already injured. We talked about it.
Yes, I found a medicine bottle marked "Yan." Probably Yan Lie's.
Why carry medicine, unless he was hurt?
You're late... A Herbalist was interested in the powder inside and took the bottle.
It's said a medicine bottle was found at the duel site, taken away by a Herbalist. Suspecting Yan Lie might have had an old injury, you decide to go to Pouncing Jump to find this Herbalist.
Bring it here, and I'll give you the bottle.
If you need medicine, please wait. I'm busy right now.
Can I take a look at the medicine bottle you got from the disciples here?
Can I take a look at the medicine bottle you got from the disciples here?
But I can't give it to you yet.
I'm trying to remake it, but need Beaded Seed Weed. You came just in time!
Find Beaded Seed Weed for me, and the bottle is yours.
Beaded Seed Weed grows in Yong, but there's some near the pond by the Training Hall...
Why do you need it? Are you trying to study it too?
The Herbalist, Junlian, is busy making a potion. He'll give you the bottle if you fetch him some Beaded Seed Weed.
The pond by the Training Hall...
The pond by the Training Hall...
Haha! I knew it! I finally recreated the medicine!
The calming effect of the medicine comes from Beaded Seed Weed. Next, I need to test it.
I don't need this bottle anymore. Take it.
Junlian recreates the formula. He tells you the medicine has calming effects and gives the bottle to you.
Back already? You've got some skill!
Let me check... That's it! I'll try it now!
Yeah... About half a month ago at night, I saw a man leaning against a rock.
I thought he was hurt, but then he went crazy and charged at me. I got too scared to sleep!
Do you remember what he looked like?
Do you remember what he looked like?
It was too dark. I couldn't see his face...
Then someone went after him. Judging by the footsteps, I think it was Head Trainer Tigon.
When the man saw Tigon, he ran upstairs to the second floor.
Stop rushing me! It's done. Here, take it.
I can get a good night's sleep...
By the way, that strange man who scared you at night—do you know where he is now?
From what you've told me, he could be the perfect person to try my new medicine.
How would I know? I never want to see him again!
A student comes to pick up his medicine. From his words, you learn that half a month ago, Tigon chased a crazed man up to the second floor of the Training Hall. You decide to go look for clues.
A student came to pick up medicine and mentioned that half a month ago, Master Linghu chased a crazed stranger to the second floor of the martial arts hall. You decide to go and look for clues.

text: Tigon chased a crazy man here...
Tigon chased a crazy man here...
This area isn't used for training. If they had fought here that night, there would be some signs of it.
This area isn't used for training. If they had fought here that night, there would be some signs of it.
The column was broken by force...
The column was broken by force...
That must have been a tough fight.
That must have been a tough fight.
More blood. It looks like the injured leaned against the wall.
More blood. It looks like the injured leaned against the wall.
Did they go to Tigon's place?
Did they go to Tigon's place?
There is blood on the column.
There is blood on the column.
The blood has dried. Its smell is still strong.
The blood has dried. Its smell is still strong.
I need to tell you—he brought him here to recover. Why would he do that if he caused his death?
When did Tigon take Yan Lie here?
When did Tigon take Yan Lie here?
About... half a month ago, late at night, he called me for help.
He cared for Yan Lie himself until he passed away.
I'm here to pick up a few things for the Head Trainer.
I'm here to pick up a few things for the Head Trainer.
If he needs something, he asks me. What exactly are you up to?
Fine... I'm actually investigating Yan Lie...
Fine... I'm actually investigating Yan Lie...
Head Trainer said as long as his disciples trust him, he doesn't care what others think.
When Yan Lie died, he thanked Head Trainer with his last breath...
There's no need to do this.
But how can we trust him if he keeps hiding the truth?
But how can we trust him if he keeps hiding the truth?
Lu Yi says that half a month ago, Tigon brought Yan Lie back to recover. He cared for Yan Lie until he passed away. When Yan Lie died, he thanked Tigon with his last breath.
The curator took care of Yan Lie personally until he passed away.
zh_text: 一直到燕烈过世，都是馆长在亲自照顾。
source_text: 一直到燕烈过世，都是馆长在亲自照顾。

text: I heard master has been looking for old texts recently.
He spent a lot of time here in the archives—he may have left clues.
These are... records about the strange disease in Yong...
These are... records about the strange disease in Yong...
The notes in the book are written by the master.
I also found Beaded Seed Weed mentioned in the books.
Tigon is investigating the disease and searching for a cure...
Tigon is investigating the disease and searching for a cure...
Yingrou discovers that Tigon has been investigating the strange disease in Yong and searching for a cure. Together, you piece the truth together.
Let's go to the Training Field.
About the torn fabric and iron sand.
Why was there torn fabric and iron sand left in the Training Field?
Why was there torn fabric and iron sand left in the Training Field?
They're probably from the sandbags I usually wear.
Why were they left behind after your second duel with Yan Lie?
Why were they left behind after your second duel with Yan Lie?
Master, you know Yan Lie's skills. Why would you duel him with sandbags?
It's easy for you to control your strength, but you were still extra careful.
Because Yan Lie was already injured before the second duel, wasn't he?
About the medicine bottle and your disciple.
Have you seen this medicine bottle before?
Have you seen this medicine bottle before?
It was found after your second duel. With "Yan" on it, it's Yan Lie's, right?
It was found after your second duel. With "Yan" on it, it's Yan Lie's, right?
It's common for us to carry healing medicine.
Beaded Seed Weed has a calming effect. Is this really just for healing?
Beaded Seed Weed has a calming effect. Is this really just for healing?
Heard a few things. But since no one is hurt, why ask about it now?
I heard you chased the attacker up to the second floor, and I saw some signs that there was a fight.
I heard you chased the attacker up to the second floor, and I saw some signs that there was a fight.
But no one knows who you were chasing.
But no one knows who you were chasing.
Just a thief who broke into the Training Hall.
Then you took the badly hurt Yan Lie to your place. Where is the thief?
Then you took the badly hurt Yan Lie to your place. Where is the thief?
Yan Lie was hurt by the thief, so I took him for treatment.
We found your notes in an old book on the second floor.
We found your notes in an old book on the second floor.
I was just browsing through the archives.
Master, those books are rare. No one checks them unless they need to.
A disciple said you asked for those books and Beaded Seed Weed after the duel.
So, Yan Lie was hurt by the disease from Yong...
So, you wore sandbags because Yan Lie was already hurt.
So, you wore sandbags because Yan Lie was already hurt.
The medicine he had was to control his symptoms.
The medicine he had was to control his symptoms.
You learned that the disease was from Yong and found a cure.
You learned that the disease was from Yong and found a cure.
But Yan Lie still lost control, and you had to fight him.
But Yan Lie still lost control, and you had to fight him.
It's still come to this... Fine, follow me.
We fought on the second floor and caused some damage there.
You confront Tigon, and he decides to tell you the truth.
Sorry... I need time to calm down.
The truth shouldn't stay hidden, no matter what.
The truth shouldn't stay hidden, no matter what.
But I'm not sure if it's for the best...
Perhaps keeping it a secret is the best way to protect everyone.
Perhaps keeping it a secret is the best way to protect everyone.
So you think the same way...
Some things are better left unspoken.
No matter what, I'll stand by Master and bear this burden together.
Thank you for helping me uncover the truth.
Yingrou wants to reveal the truth and asks for your opinion. Your choice will impact their lives.
But I can't let you insult the Training Hall or its head trainer...
You're Tigon's disciple. Of course you're on his side!
I'm not going back. I haven't passed the test.
Forget it! I don't want you risking your life here.
You don't know? Tigon, the head trainer here, badly hurt a student, who later died!
It's still unclear. The Department of Discipline hasn't started the investigation yet.
I understand you're worried about your child's safety.
It's not right to talk about people behind their backs.
It's not right to talk about people behind their backs.
It's said that Tigon severely injured his own disciple. Yingrou, also a disciple of Tigon, got into an argument with someone over this matter, and you help stop the quarrel.
I'll wait for you at the Training Field!
Thank you for speaking up for me.
But I still didn't make it back in time to see Yan Lie one last time.
That's probably why he returned for a duel.
Yeah... He joined the Training Hall a bit before me.
We sparred when I first arrived. That duel taught me a lot, and we became friends.
After that, we trained together under Tigon.
Later, I became a Seeker and went to Chang'an. He returned to Yong.
He told me that if he ever came back, he would defeat Tigon.
But I haven't seen him since.
What kind of person is Tigon?
What kind of person is Tigon?
He was kind. By the way, Yan Lie was his favorite disciple.
Did Tigon say anything about it?
Did Tigon say anything about it?
I asked as soon as I got back, but he avoided the topic every time.
Could you go with me to see him? I still... want an answer.
If I can help, of course.
If I can help, of course.
Ah... I've traveled nonstop lately, barely slept.
I've been gone from the Training Hall for a while, so I don't know all the details.
All I know is that Yan Lie once disagreed with the results of an exam.
He learned everything from Tigon but never earned his approval.
You were close with Yan Lie?
You were close with Yan Lie?
Hard to believe Tigon would do that to him.
You learn that Tigon valued Yan Lie the most, yet he avoids speaking about Yan Lie's death. To uncover the truth, Yingrou invites you to meet Tigon together at the Training Field.
I'll wait for you at the Training Field.
You're here—let's go see the master together.
What really happened? All those people just keep talking...
If you've come because of Yan Lie, please leave.
I feel guilty over Yan Lie's death and have nothing more to say.
Yingrou, some things are best left as they are.
That's enough. We're about to begin our training. Please leave.
Master! Everyone is talking about Yan Lie's death. Aren't you going to say anything?
Despite the rumors, Tigon remains silent about Yan Lie's death.
He is trying to hide something.
Good. Let's split up and stay in touch using my Big-eye Owlet.
Staying silent isn't like him at all.
Let's start by checking the duel site.
Yingrou decides to investigate the matter with you, starting with the duel site.
Were you there for Yan Lie and Tigon's duel?
Were you there for Yan Lie and Tigon's duel?
Yes! I was training then and saw part of it.
Yan Lie's skills really grew after those days.
If not for that mistake, he might've won the first duel. What a shame.
It's strange how he made such a mistake...
It was a true battle of masters! Just watching taught me a lot.
Fei Yun tells you that Yan Lie lost to Tigon because of a strange mistake at the end of the duel.
Yan Lie told me he wanted to return to Yong to avenge his family.
But I told him his studies here aren't finished.
Even so, he left resolutely, and...
I knew his father died in war, but I didn't know revenge drove him.
Revenge weighed on him. Perhaps he didn't want you to worry.
At first, I was happy to see how quickly his skills were improving.
But I never thought it would cost him his life...
The world outside is far beyond what we imagined...
If I hadn't seen it with my own eyes, I wouldn't have believed it.
I've heard of this rare disease. The infected become bloodthirsty monsters...
Yes... In the second duel, Yan Lie's will was consumed again.
But he was strong-minded and recovered for a short time. That's when I found out about his illness.
Even Dr Bian's medicine didn't work...
Before he hurt others, I had to injure him and take him home.
Though I tried my best to hold back, he couldn't take any more harm.
Why did you hide this for so long?
Why did you hide this for so long?
I believe Yan Lie didn't want anyone to know about his tragic fate...
I didn't want my disciples hurt. Even so, I still failed to protect him...
With Yan Lie's last breath, he said you had made a promise.
He felt sorry that he couldn't keep it...
More than any promise, I just wish you were still alive...
Most couldn't bear becoming such a monster.
Most couldn't bear becoming such a monster.
But you shouldn't have had to face all that criticism, Master!

It turns out Yan Lie contracted a strange illness that drove him to attack his own kind. To protect the innocent, Tigon had no choice but to injure Yan Lie. To protect Yan Lie's reputation, Tigon has endured the infamy all this time.
Sorry... I need time to calm down.
I hope he tells us those rumors aren't true...
A villager was attacked by <001>a dangerous puppet</> here. I'm searching for clues.
Please don't enter and disturb the scene.
It should be close. There might be clues in the ruins.
It should be close. There might be clues in the ruins.
Can a puppet really repair things?
Can a puppet really repair things?
A puppet that can repair ruin mechanisms?

Wei Lan said it often goes down the mountain.
What's going on? Whose puppet is it?
The Wolvines here are acting strange...
The Wolvines here are acting strange...
I've got some clues from some Aersilk Harvesters who were stopped by the puppet.
It seems to be protecting things related to the Aerux.
So it's actually trying to protect nature?
So it's actually trying to protect nature?
Who gave this order, and when?
No other academy puppet has done this before.
I think I found the puppet. I'll lead the way.
It seems I have no choice.
It seems I have no choice.
So it made you shut it down...
Herbs everywhere. Someone left in a hurry...
Herbs everywhere. Someone left in a hurry...
Aersilk is often used in puppet-making. Maybe my Bracer can track it...
Aersilk is often used in puppet-making. Maybe my Bracer can track it...
Thank you! I thought I'd be stuck here all night.
It's a long story... Forget it.
By the way, I'm looking for a dangerous puppet. Have you seen it?
By the way, I'm looking for a dangerous puppet. Have you seen it?
It lost control and hurt a villager. The Department of Discipline is looking for it.
It lost control and hurt a villager. The Department of Discipline is looking for it.
Does it go out of control from time to time?
You know something? It runs by itself, even without Aersilk.
You know something? It runs by itself, even without Aersilk.
Yes, I think I've seen it... but...
I can show you where it is, but can you promise not to hurt it?
I promise. So you've seen it?
I promise. So you've seen it?
Yes, it was at the herb nursery days ago. It acts like it has its own mind.
At first, it just watched the herbs silently...
Then it helped water, fertilize, and weed the plants.
At first, I thought its Aercorder was broken, but later I realized it just likes to be alone.
It sometimes visits the herb nursery and seems to wander around everywhere. Not sure who guides it.
I was impressed by how smart Mechcraft puppets are now.
I started clearing out old plants for my new project.
When the puppet saw me doing that, it got agitated and locked me in here.
Both cutting trees and clearing plants destroy greenery...
Both cutting trees and clearing plants destroy greenery...
I agree. It's not evil, but it loses control sometimes.
I've seen what happened to the out-of-control Mechanoids. I'd feel terrible if it got destroyed.
I understand. I'll pass your concern on to the Department of Discipline.
I understand. I'll pass your concern on to the Department of Discipline.
But it can't keep attacking people. I can't help it if it does.
But it can't keep attacking people. I can't help it if it does.
Thank you. I often saw it heading down the mountain. I can show you the way.
Let's hope for the best of it...
At first, I was just observing quietly by the herb garden...

text: It was terrible. I was hunting when suddenly...
...a puppet with strong combat skills came to me!
And it took your weapon, right?
How did you know? I tried to get it back, but I was no match for it, so I had to run away.
And it didn't chase after you.
So I didn't mean to hurt you.
Did it sneak up on you silently?
How do you know so much about it?
I wish! Creating a puppet like that is every student's dream.
We're from the Secrets Club. We heard many Hunters were attacked, and it seems like the same situation.
We came here to investigate, and we met you. I'm eager to see it up close.
Is it still there with the beasts? Gotta check it out.
Is it still there with the beasts? Gotta check it out.
The Pearlized Flowers bloom and fall by the lake. They recognize you...
No, but I can sense when something changes.
It's a familiar feeling. You remind me of the word "friend."
I don't know you. What do you mean by friend?
I don't know you. What do you mean by friend?
My name is Mountain Puppet, meant to protect the mountains.
Let's go back to the academy.
Let's go back to the academy.
My mission is to do everything I can to get ready for war.
So timber, herbs, and Aerux were all for war?
So timber, herbs, and Aerux were all for war?
Without orders, taking resources is forbidden.
Yes, they are trained for battle.
Are you talking about the war between Dawnsong and Jixia?
Are you talking about the war between Dawnsong and Jixia?
Dawnsong took Springbrook Plains, and my creator was badly hurt. He told me to guard the mountains.
I haven't heard from him since.
I see. That explains why it's so peaceful here.
I hope you can end this.

How did it come to this?
How did it come to this?
Finally... We'll meet again. I hope I'm not too late...
The Mountain Puppet stops moving. It finally looks at peace.
Thank you for finding the Forbidden Chamber's contraband, Xin-You-Wu.

text: That's Mountain Puppet's code name in the Forbidden Chamber.
A Puppeteer named Shi Yuh made it during wartime. We found it three years ago at the Cloudrest Bridge.
It has a complicated module that lets it evolve on its own, which is why we decided to contain it.
We once restarted it for research. It was fine... Didn't think it could escape alone.
It can't be repaired. The Forbidden Chamber will take it over from the Department of Discipline.
Your work here is done. You can leave now.
Here's a research report on Mountain Puppet. You may want to read it.
Leafy arrives to retrieve the Mountain Puppet. Turns out it escaped from the Forbidden Chamber. Leafy gives you a research report on the puppet. You can learn more if interested.
You find the Mountain Puppet. A River Sprite floats nearby, as if communicating with it. It suddenly speaks, noticing you...
There you are! We were worried something had happened to you.
I see, thanks for your hard work.
Wei Lan asked me to treat it fairly, but now it looks like...
It just refused to return to the academy.
Things have changed. Its mission is over.
It can still find its place here.
If you were in its position, what would you do?
You report that the Mountain Puppet, knowing its era is long gone, chose to end itself.
Here you are. You look unharmed. Great.
Perfect timing. We've discovered some incredible things and were just about to tell you!
Sorry if I sounded rude earlier, I was just focused on work.
Oh, are you the new student Novar brought in?
I'm Yan Hao, from the Department of Discipline.
Nice to meet you. What happened here?
Nice to meet you. What happened here?
This area was used for logging building materials.
But recently, a villager was badly hurt by a puppet here.
How did that happen? Maybe ask its owner?
How did that happen? Maybe ask its owner?
Usually, puppets have someone behind them. I did try to find out who controls it.
But I found no signs of anyone controlling it.
So it acted on its own?
So it acted on its own?
That's what it looks like, but it goes against the laws of puppets.
Luban No. 7 runs on its own.
That's true, Luban No. 7 uses advanced technology...
...but I didn't see any modules that were made by Luban.
But this puppet moves with no strings at all...
Its tech seems too advanced. Maybe it's from Chang'an or another era.
We must force it to shut down and bring it back before more people get hurt.
I heard you've helped us before. Can you help again?
Thank you! Be careful and protect anyone in danger.
Latest info says the puppet was last seen at the herb nursery. Please investigate.
If you find anything, send word via the Big-eye Owlet.
You hear there is a puppet injuring people nearby. Latest info says the puppet was last seen at the Herb Nursery. You decide to go investigate.
The puppet drove away the Hunters, and it seems to be... feeding the Wolvines?
The puppet drove away the Hunters, and it seems to be... feeding the Wolvines?

Ever since he started, he's gotten way better than me.
There must be something special about this method. I want to find out what it is.
Can you tell me where to find Yeshu now?
Can you tell me where to find Yeshu now?
Listen carefully. This is the correct version.
When the moment's right, use your might. In big fights... let complex skills shine bright.
I was reciting my training rhyme...
Gao Tiao is reciting his training rhyme on the post and asks you to help him. Once he finishes, he tells you that Yeshu left after talking to Long Ling.
I'm from the Department of Discipline. I need to ask you something.
I'm from the Department of Discipline. I need to ask you something.
Have you been staying up all night helping the juniors with their work?
Have you been staying up all night helping the juniors with their work?
I can't sleep, so I check on the juniors.
It affects you and others in a bad way.
It affects you and others in a bad way.
Someone has this Aercorder for you. It's to help you sleep well.
Someone has this Aercorder for you. It's to help you sleep well.
Sorry, I didn't mean to. I'm so used to staying up all night, and I can't sleep now even if I want to.
I'm super tired, but I can't fall asleep. Do you know how bad that is?
You do, right? I don't want this, either.
Thanks, anyway. Put the Aercorder on the table. I'll try it.

You tell Xuanmu that students are complaining about his late night tutoring sessions. He explains that he's been unable to sleep lately. You give him an Aercorder that plays soothing sounds. He promises to try it.
You look sleepy. Wake up and study!
Whoa, it's so noisy! Quick, turn it off!
This one is damaged too. I need to report it.
And after the alarm dog was taken away from Xuanmu, he...
You've warned Long Ling, but Yeshu... We all know him well.
Tell Wen Xiaoyan to assign more students to detention room shifts.
That's unexpected, but it's good news. Add him if he has time.
Nearly perfect! I think you're ready to join us.
Sure. These students are all available—and Yesheng too.
He did well on his exam, I heard.
Finally, we've completed all the requests. Thanks so much for your help.
How do you feel about our work?
Right? The Department of Discipline is always out there helping our fellow students.
People call Jixia students geniuses, but their hard work should not be overlooked.
You did so much for all three schools. We appreciate it!
Besides Mengjia, I've checked in on the other cases too.
Long Ling complained again. Yeshu keeps wearing out bows.
Should I go talk to him again?
Should I go talk to him again?
No need. Someone else is handling it.
Since then, he's only woken up to eat and drink; otherwise, he's been sleeping deeply.
He's happy now. He even left you a thank-you note!
Lilli is watching him, so we don't need to worry about him.
Now Yeshu is wearing out bows non-stop. Meanwhile, Xuanmu has been sleeping well after the Mechcraft Dog was taken away. Fortunately, all matters have been resolved smoothly.
<001>Purified Water</>, <001>Energy Herb</>, and then my <001>Secret Concoction</>.
I'm writing a report on everything, but there's a lot to cover. Who knows when I'll finish...
Let's all attack and teach this ungrateful guy a lesson!

text: Can you give it back to me?
Yes! You're a lifesaver. This was written for me.
Ah... I, I've been played? It's ruined, my lifelong reputation as Sheng Cefeng is ruined!
Oh god, my assignment is due tomorrow, what am I supposed to give the teacher? I spent my entire month's living expenses on this!
This guy lied to me, saying he could write my assignments for me. He's fast and gets high scores... so I just wanted him to help me out.
Why not just exchange the money and the goods on the spot?
Why not just exchange the money and the goods on the spot?
This guy only accepts underground deals; I haven't even seen him.
He sent the Great-Eyed Owls everywhere to spread the word, claiming that if you left your homework and gold rings at a designated spot, you could pick up your goods the next day.
Now that I think about it, how could I have been so gullible to believe such an obvious scam back then!
No way! I can't let this slide! Hey, could you help me teach that guy a lesson?
This has nothing to do with me, right?
This has nothing to do with me, right?
He swindled me, but I'm definitely not the only one he's cheated. I wonder how many other students have suffered... You don't want more students to be scammed, do you?
Please, I won't let your efforts go to waste. If I can get my living expenses back, I'll give you half the gold rings; if I can't, I'll be your servant for a month!
Work like an ox or horse for a month? This...
Work like an ox or horse for a month? This...
Alright, how can I help you?
Alright, how can I help you?
Benefactor! That hateful swindler has been trading at the cliff northeast of the Tanying Camp recently, making the poor students prepare Ringild and homework before <001>19:00 at night</>.
Benefactor, you can put the bait there and then hide nearby. When he comes out, teach him a lesson! Then send him to the Discipline Office so he knows the consequences of being a swindler!
I have a blank assignment here. Benefactor, pretend it's yours and trade with him to lure him out!
That's so sloppy... Seriously, how much homework do you still have left to do?
That's so sloppy... Seriously, how much homework do you still have left to do?
Th-this is the only one left, I should be able to try my luck, right? That scammer is so greedy, he even swindled a poor student trying to finish their homework. He'll definitely do it again!

Oh, there will be a generous reward afterwards! I'll wait for you at the entrance of <001>Tanying Camp</> with the Academic Affairs people. If you catch the swindler, we'll come find you. Good luck, benefactor!

Sheng Cefeng realized he was scammed after seeing a note; someone told him he could get paid to do homework, but it was a trap. He asks you to pose as a student to meet the scammer at 19:00 and teach them a lesson. He and the Student Discipline Committee will be waiting at the entrance of Tanying Camp.
Classmate, thank you for your help in getting the delinquent student to turn themselves in!
Wu Xin, that's enough. Get up.
Thanks to you, Sheng Cefeng turned himself in to the Academic Discipline Department, saving the academy time.
Here is your Ringild reward, student. Please accept it.
Turn myself in? Didn't I catch them?
Turn myself in? Didn't I catch them?
Committee member, this guy hits really hard! You have to be the judge...

Wu Xin was caught by me long ago, but the practice of paying for homework is rampant. To rectify the atmosphere, both the buyer and the seller should be punished. So, I made him bring the next student looking for a ghostwriter to avoid severe punishment.
Committee member, I'm reporting him! Wu Xin didn't just trick me; he tried to trick this student too! He hasn't repented at all! Please, let me off easy!
I, I just wanted to help the committee catch more people!
It seems the 'ghostwriting' scandal hasn't died down yet... How about this, Sheng Cefeng? You wanted leniency, right?
You take Wu Xin's place to bring in the next student attempting to cheat.
Students who try to slack off and fool their teachers deserve a special punishment.
I never expected it to end like this...
I never expected it to end like this...

The Disciplinary Department thanks you for bringing back the student who 'turned himself in.' It turns out Wu Xin had already been caught, and the Department used him to lure out students looking for ghostwriters, which led to Sheng Cefeng's arrest. The Department has ordered him to take Wu Xin's place and track down other students attempting to cheat.
This must be the cliff that Sheng Cefeng mentioned.
This must be the cliff that Sheng Cefeng mentioned.
Not many people would pay attention to this place.
Not many people would pay attention to this place.
This spot behind the tree is perfect for hiding. Let's wait for the snake to come out of its hole.
This spot behind the tree is perfect for hiding. Let's wait for the snake to come out of its hole.
Cash on delivery. Those were your words.
zh_text: 一手交钱，一手交货。这可是你自己说的。
source_text: 一手交钱，一手交货。这可是你自己说的。
official_target_text: Cash on delivery. Those were your words.

text: There's a figure over there. Could they have actually succeeded...
There's a figure over there. Could they have actually succeeded...
Everything is ready. Let's head to the cliff northeast of the Tanying Camp.
Everything is ready. Let's head to the cliff northeast of the Tanying Camp.
Too late, the swindler ran away, and did they take the gold ring too?
Too late, the swindler ran away, and did they take the gold ring too?
Return to the camp and find Sheng Cefeng.
Return to the camp and find Sheng Cefeng.
What kind of gibberish is this...
What kind of gibberish is this...
Homework still has to be done by yourself?
Homework still has to be done by yourself?
I could tell at a glance that you'd picked up my lifeline...
Students who try to slack off and fool their teachers deserve a special punishment. Take these Ringild as a reward, student.
Benefactor is back! The swindler has been caught, right?
I taught him a lesson, and I got the stolen Ringild back...
I taught him a lesson, and I got the stolen Ringild back...
Caught you! I'm going to teach you a lesson myself!
He must regret having cheated... Wait, he ran away? I wanted to see him get punished with my own eyes!
He even said 'I'll do it again next time' while running away.
He even said 'I'll do it again next time' while running away.
Tsk, a miscalculation. I thought he had truly repented, so I let him lure the next cheater into the trap...
Got it! Wouldn't it work if we just tricked him back?

Sheng Cefeng, your intentions are dishonest, attempting to have your homework done by others to fool your teachers. The Student Discipline Committee is now imposing a penalty on you according to regulations...
You have thirty days to trick student Wu Xin into coming back for punishment.

Wu Xin was caught by me long ago, but the practice of paying for homework is rampant. To rectify the atmosphere, both the buyer and the seller should be punished. So, I made him bring the next student looking for a ghostwriter to avoid severe punishment.
Committee member, I was wrong, please show mercy!
I never expected it to end like this...
I never expected it to end like this...

You bring back the news of Wu Xin's escape. The student discipline committee member is dismayed, but upon seeing Sheng Cefeng, he gets an idea and demands that Sheng Cefeng trick Wu Xin into returning within thirty days.
You're back, how is the progress?
Students who try to slack off and fool their teachers deserve a special punishment. Take these Ringild as a reward, student.
I saw the prisoner, but he slipped away.
I saw the prisoner, but he slipped away.
Tsk... then I'm not paying! You didn't teach that swindler a lesson, so I'm not giving you a reward!
Are you saying, student, that Wu Xin not only took action but also took those Ringild?
When I went back, I found a note that said 'There's a mole'.
When I went back, I found a note that said 'There's a mole'.
Is that so? No wonder I couldn't reach him...

Wu Xin was caught by me long ago, but the practice of paying for homework is rampant. To rectify the atmosphere, both the buyer and the seller should be punished. So, I made him bring the next student looking for a ghostwriter to avoid severe punishment.
Wu Xin's attitude toward admitting his mistakes was good. I thought he had truly repented, but I miscalculated. It seems he still needs education...
Sheng Cefeng, you'll be the one to lure him back!

Sheng Cefeng, your intentions are dishonest, attempting to have your homework done by others to fool your teachers. The Student Discipline Committee is now imposing a penalty on you according to regulations...
You have thirty days to trick student Wu Xin into coming back for punishment.
I never expected it to end like this...
I never expected it to end like this...

You tell the two that you saw Wu Xin but he escaped, and you also found a note saying "there's a mole." The Discipline Committee member cries out in frustration, but upon seeing Sheng Cefeng, they get an idea and demand that Sheng Cefeng find a way to trick Wu Xin into returning within thirty days.
That note is my lifeline, please, give it to me!
The gold ring and blank assignments are ready. Now, we just wait.
The gold ring and blank assignments are ready. Now, we just wait.
The liar should appear at <001>19:00 at night</>, let's set an ambush here.
The liar should appear at <001>19:00 at night</>, let's set an ambush here.
Are you the one who writes homework for others?
Are you the one who writes homework for others?
They're clearly a liar, yet they were still lured out by such a sloppy plan...
They're clearly a liar, yet they were still lured out by such a sloppy plan...
So you're the one scamming people by offering to do their homework?
So you're the one scamming people by offering to do their homework?
Pfft, would someone who studies honestly get scammed? They're just crooked themselves and blaming us!
We're just teaching them a lesson on anti-fraud! And collecting a bit of gold as tuition.
You little brat, trying to scam your Grandpa Wuxin? Take this!
You confront Wu Xin about scamming people by offering to do their homework, but he argues that they were dishonest and deserved to be scammed...
I only target those with bad intentions; I never scam good people!
I will not engage in favoritism or malpractice.
The specific situation needs to be judged by the Academic Discipline Department; they will be here soon.
The specific situation needs to be judged by the Academic Discipline Department; they will be here soon.
If you are willing to correct your mistakes.
But you must return the gold ring to your classmates and promise not to do it again.
But you must return the gold ring to your classmates and promise not to do it again.
You're generous, student! We'll give you the Ringild right now.
Spare me, student! Stop hitting me, let me go. This is my first offense, I won't dare to do it again.
No next time, no next time! I was just so broke I couldn't even put food on the table, that's why I had a moment of weakness.
Wu Xin was defeated by you. He explained that he was truly too poor to make ends meet, which is why he resorted to this, and begged you to let him go.
Haha, you fool, you actually believed me!
You've been tricked! I'll take the warning, but I'll do it again next time!
Let's go meet up with Sheng Cefeng first...
Let's go meet up with Sheng Cefeng first...
It looks like something is stuck to the railing over there...
It looks like something is stuck to the railing over there...
Let's go over and take a look.
Let's go over and take a look.
The battle just now... er, I hope he hasn't gone too far.
The battle just now... er, I hope he hasn't gone too far.
Based on what happened with Sheng Cefeng, we should be able to lure the swindler out by mimicking similar methods.
Based on what happened with Sheng Cefeng, we should be able to lure the swindler out by mimicking similar methods.
Benefactor, the location is at the cliff northeast of Tanying Camp, please!
