text: It makes one feel the vastness of the universe and soothes the soul.
It makes one feel the vastness of the universe and soothes the soul.
The wind passes through the valley, sometimes gentle and sometimes strong...
The wind passes through the valley, sometimes gentle and sometimes strong...
Which sound should I find first?
Which sound should I find first?
Shh, nature's sounds can calm and clear your mind.
The world's full of flaws and worries, but nature helps you find your true self.
How do I find my true self?
How do I find my true self?
We come from nature and should return to it.
Wise and kind people love water and mountains. Nature's sounds help you discover who you really are.
How do I hear nature's sounds?
How do I hear nature's sounds?
Jixia has the Aercorder that runs on Aersilk. It can record sounds.
As I travel, I use my Aercorder to capture those peaceful sounds.
Then I put the sounds together to create music that helps calm and clear the mind.
I got so focused on new music that I almost forgot that I have a few Aercorders outside.
If you enjoy nature's sounds, can you collect them? I'll reward you.
I'll count on you, then. My Big-eye Owlet will guide you.
Cicadas, birds, and deer sing in the forest. Get the Sound of Forest near Stargazing Terrace.

You heard from Bai Xi that Jixia has a device called the Aercorder, capable of capturing and preserving sound. She's asked you to retrieve the Aercorders she placed across the land to collect the sounds of nature.
Up ahead, the wind gets strong in the valley. Find the Sound of Wind there.
That's the lively Sound of Forest.
So the sound helps clear the mind. I get it.
Bai Xi said the wind gets strong in the valley up ahead. Find the Sound of Wind there.
The last one is on Stargazing Terrace, where you can see the distant Aercocoon.
As the Aercocoon shakes, the sky rumbles. That's the Sound of Air, showing Jixia's vibrant life.
Bai Xi told you the final Sound of Air is at the Stargazing Terrace, where you first met her.
Let me give you some advice.
Take a moment to unwind there, and you'll feel at one with nature.
That should be all. She must be waiting.
That should be all. She must be waiting.
You must've felt something unique while collecting them.
Whether it's calm or thrilling, you can always find the sound that resonates with your life in nature.
When your mind feels unsettled, you can look to nature to find your balance again.
Thanks for your help. I'll start turning these sounds of nature into a piece of music.
I hope it brings peace and comfort to others... Oh, and what you said earlier, like a dream...
To thank you, I'll name the piece Oneiric Melody.
When it's finished, I'd love for you to come and listen.
You've collected all three Aercorders. To thank you, Bai Xi will turn the sounds you collected into Oneiric Melody and invite you to come and listen once it's finished.
Listening to the Sound of Air feels like being surrounded by many energies. It's amazing.
Listening to the Sound of Air feels like being surrounded by many energies. It's amazing.
The sound is pure, cool, and refreshing.
The sound is pure, cool, and refreshing.
I can hear birds and deer in the forest.
I can hear birds and deer in the forest.
Please help me get my three Aercorders back.
Stall him. I'll catch up once I've taken care of this device!
Revealing classified information just to capture me? Aren't you afraid of being punished?
Hah! Too bad, I'm afraid you won't be catching me today. Farewell, both of you.
Stall him. I'll catch up once I've taken care of this device!
Hah! Too bad, I'm afraid you won't be catching me today. Farewell, both of you.
I don't want to use it, but...
You actually dared to chase me? Perfect, let's see how my new power fares against you.
That explosion injured him too, so he can't be far. Could you help me look for him?
Yes, that dangerous fugitive from Chang'an! You met him?
Do you remember his device? If it's disrupted while running, it will lose control.
He conducted experiments in Chang'an, but that device self-destructed many times, causing many injuries.
That's not what he told me...
That's not what he told me...
This is classified, but... Anyway, I've been tracking him from Chang'an to Jixia.
Thanks for your help. I tracked that man here, but fell for his trick.
He caused an explosion, activated the Bronze Mechanoids to injure me, and then escaped.
The man you're looking for—is it <001>Tang Ye</>?
The man you're looking for—is it <001>Tang Ye</>?
Don't fall for his sweet talk.
I finally found him, but he still managed to slip away.
Thank you. I'll join you after I catch my breath.
Why not report this to the Aerwatch?
Do I? I don't need your trust. Just be as wary of Tang Ye as you are of me.
That way, you won't be his next victim.
You two are telling different stories.
Words can lie, but facts speak for themselves. The truth will come out soon enough.
That would just alarm him and put more lives at risk.
You don't draw your sword until you're ready to strike.

A mysterious man tells you that Tang Ye is a fugitive from Chang'an. His experiment went wrong and caused a devastating explosion. Now Tang Ye is badly injured and can't have gone far. The man asks you to help find him.
I told you a man wants my energy transfer device! He is nearby!
Even though I've never tried connecting it to a human...
It's you! Great! I need your help!
I'm badly wounded and can't run far. I've already informed the Department of Discipline.
Tang Ye? What are you doing here?
Tang Ye? What are you doing here?
I was just doing my experiments when he suddenly appeared and tried to take my device!
This device is incredibly powerful. I can't let it fall into the wrong hands.
I'm not a fighter, so I detonated it to escape and injured him.
Then why are you still here...
Then why are you still here...
Before they arrive, I'll absorb the energy from the device, just in case...

Tang Ye says that his energy-transfer device is very powerful and could be dangerous if it falls into the wrong hands. He decides to risk absorbing the energy himself to confront the mysterious man and asks for your assistance.
I'm taking you back to Chang'an.
You're not taking anything. The academy won't let you go!
Tang Ye, you are classified as high-risk for causing sixteen explosions over three months.
The evidence is conclusive. Are you still going to deny it?
Ridiculous! How dare you say that? You're the one after the academy's research.
The Discipline Overseers are coming. Come on, help me take him down!
Heh, so this is your choice... I'm so disappointed.
Well... I have to reveal who I am.
I'm Yunfeng, a detective from the High Court. I'm given the task of taking Tang Ye back!
Tang Ye and the mysterious man each tell a different story. Will you believe the mysterious man or not? Please choose carefully, as each of your decisions will affect their futures.
He couldn't have gone far. We can find him by tracking the Sorcery energy.
He couldn't have gone far. We can find him by tracking the Sorcery energy.
Enough. Come back to Chang'an with me to face the Magistrate's judgment.
Thanks to your help, we were able to capture him.
My partner is on the way. We'll take it from here. Thank you for your help.
I wasn't supposed to reveal my identity, but given the situation, I need to tell you the truth.
If it were stable, I wouldn't have lost to you.
*Sigh* I can't transfer Aerflow stably in human bodies. She must be disappointed.
It's a long story... When I first arrived in Jixia, I met a girl who was really skilled.
She looked young but acted calm and mature.
Later, I learned she was Leafy, Intendant of the Forbidden Chamber.
She's grown up for years, but her body stayed young.
Back then, I thought... maybe my energy transfer device could help her return to normal.
But that wish... seems destined to go unfulfilled.
Does she know what you are doing?
Does she know what you are doing?
My apologies for keeping things from you.

Tang Ye admits the energy experiments were research on how to restore Intendant of the Forbidden Chamber to her original size. Yunfeng is taking him back to Chang'an for interrogation, and you part ways.
Enough. Come back to Chang'an with me to face the Magistrate's judgment.
Sorry for not telling you earlier. I'm Yunfeng, a detective from the High Court. I'm here to capture Tang Ye.
Thanks to your help, we were able to capture him.
My partner is on the way. We'll take it from here. Thank you for your help.
I'm not supposed to reveal my identity, but you've done me such a great favor.
If it were stable, I wouldn't have lost to you.
*Sigh* I can't transfer Aerflow stably in human bodies. She must be disappointed.
It's a long story... When I first arrived in Jixia, I met a girl who was really skilled.
She looked young but acted calm and mature.
Later, I learned she was Leafy, Intendant of the Forbidden Chamber.
She's grown up for years, but her body stayed young.
Back then, I thought... maybe my energy transfer device could help her return to normal.
But that wish... seems destined to go unfulfilled.
Does she know what you are doing?
Does she know what you are doing?

Tang Ye admits the energy experiments were research on how to restore Intendant of the Forbidden Chamber to her original size. Yunfeng is taking him back to Chang'an for interrogation, and you part ways.
If you visit Chang'an, stop by the High Court. I'll treat you to the finest brews.

text: Did you see my light friend over there?
Well... it was actually a broken Patrol Guardian.
Well... it was actually a broken Patrol Guardian.
But your light gave him the motivation to push through a roadblock in his work.
But your light gave him the motivation to push through a roadblock in his work.
Uh... yeah, you could put it that way.
Uh... yeah, you could put it that way.
A Crafter was testing a Patrol Guardian's crash resistance. The test failed...
A Crafter was testing a Patrol Guardian's crash resistance. The test failed...
The Patrol Guardian lost mobility. Only the lights remained on.
The Patrol Guardian lost mobility. Only the lights remained on.
Actually... he's a Crafter. He said he's heading out on a journey soon.
Actually... he's a Crafter. He said he's heading out on a journey soon.
Tonight was his last time "communicating" with you.
Tonight was his last time "communicating" with you.
So... what kind of person are they?
No way it's a Mechanoid. Its core wouldn't last this long and the light would fade.
No way! The light never dims and always replies at the right time. See, it flashed again.
Thanks for everything today. If it weren't for you, I never would've known all this.
The engineering log says the Patrol Guardian flashes randomly after it was damaged. The Crafter mistook your signals for encouragement...
The engineering log says the Patrol Guardian flashes randomly after it was damaged. The Crafter mistook your signals for encouragement...
So this whole time... we weren't really talking?
Forgive me. I'd like to be alone for a while...
He's leaving? But we haven't even met...
I knew we were meant to meet!
I'm glad we could connect over the distance.
It's a Patrol Guardian, unfortunately. But it does seem to be communicating with you in its own way.
It's a Patrol Guardian, unfortunately. But it does seem to be communicating with you in its own way.
Well, that's fine! A true friend doesn't have to be human.
Thanks to you both, I've got a new idea for my next poem!
I see. Guess we weren't meant to meet after all.
If I run there now, do you think I can still catch up to him?
You know... I'm going to try. It's not every day you find a good friend. Thanks again. See you around!
You helped me make a new friend today.
If you ever see a flashing light at night... it might be me, saying hello.
Inspiration calls... I must write at once. Until we meet again, my friend!
You tell Ming Hui the truth. Disheartened, Ming Hui wants to be alone for a while. (Your choice may affect their outcome...)
Weird... Today's signals are too complex. I don't understand them.
Why not talk to your friend in person?
Why not talk to your friend in person?
No way! "Distance creates beauty." Meeting ruins the mystery!
The mystery is what makes it special.
Haven't you thought about meeting "your friend?"
Haven't you thought about meeting "your friend?"
No need. We seek a connection of the soul.
Go check if you're curious. I'm staying here.
Ming Hui thinks today's light language is a bit complex but wishes to maintain the current communication. He asks you to go over to the other side to investigate.
Uh... I just see random flashes.
Uh... I just see random flashes.
They said, "Good night to you, too."
Ming Hui is overjoyed to see the response from the other side and tells you the reply means "Good night to you, too." He asks you to try flashing the light twice more.
It looks like it crashed here during the flight, but it's still working. There's an audio log available.
It looks like it crashed here during the flight, but it's still working. There's an audio log available.
Let me go meet this friend.
Let me go meet this friend.
We received a reply! It's amazing!
I said, "The night breeze is gentle. The stars are sparkling. Insects chirp. Frogs croak."
They replied, "Insects chirp. Frogs croak. The stream is calm. A good night to enjoy the moon."
You ask about the meaning of the flashing signals from the other side, and Ming Hui explains them one by one.
Here, stand on the pedal—you'll get a better view.
Hit the target on the central device to create a flash. Try it.
Okay, I'll give it a try.
Okay, I'll give it a try.
See that light flashing on the mountain?
Ming Hui tells you that shooting the target at the center of the Mirror Mechcraft Formation with a bow will create a flash and send messages.
Is that some kind of experiment?
Is that some kind of experiment?
Done! I'm Ming Hui, by the way.
My friend is on that mountain. We talk by flashing lights.
That student is saying hello! Let me adjust the angle...
Oh, I was talking to my friend by using light signals.
You are talking by... flashing lights?
You are talking by... flashing lights?
Yes. I've been trying the puzzle with mirrors here, and saw someone flashing signals back one night.
I was frustrated that night, so I came here to clear my mind.
While using mirrors, I noticed a flashing light across the mountain.
I was surprised someone else was doing the same thing at night!
It felt amazing—like we were meant to meet.
I tried replying with light. After a few exchanges, we became friends.
We've been talking with light signals for a few nights. Wanna try it?
I know nothing about light signals.
Just follow me. It's easy and fun!
Ming Hui is talking to his friend using flashing lights. He invites you to try it out.
Ming Hui's "friend" wasn't what he imagined...
Ming Hui's "friend" wasn't what he imagined...
How should I tell him later...
zh_text: 一会儿要怎么跟他说呢……
source_text: 一会儿要怎么跟他说呢……

text: They have thinner stems and longer leaves. I should take them back.
They have thinner stems and longer leaves. I should take them back.
Tsk, you already turned in the medicine? Looks like I'm a little late.
Just about to share. Ms. Perilla, did you use the toxic <001>Exhaustion Plant</> to fake your illness?
Oh dear... how do I answer that...
That new toxic herb? What does it do?
If you mix it with other poisons and take it, you get symptoms like Ms. Perilla's.
Toxineers study poisons. I smelled the Exhaustion Plant in their storehouse recently.
When it's unprocessed, it has a faint fishy odor. I noticed it too late. Wish I had Mooko's sharp nose...
It's not too late now. But why did Ms. Perilla do this?
It's not too late now. But why did Ms. Perilla do this?
Heh, are you sure? Herbalists need proof to make a diagnosis.
Simple. If I have the toxic herbs, I can make an antidote. I'll prove it.
I have plenty of herbs with me. Let's work together!
Alright. There are wild Exhaustion Plants near the pool. I'll go find some!
I'll help too! Hurry, let's go!
How long would that take you alone?
Not bad. They have bold ideas, but lack your patience and attention to detail. You'll help them, right?
Just as I said. Go on, I'll be waiting here for your good news.
Now that we have the Radish Leaves, we can start working.
I left the other herbs at Darkpool Camp. Let's go make the medicine!
I knew you could handle it!
But why did it act like that after eating the Aerdo Ball?
But why did it act like that after eating the Aerdo Ball?
If they sense danger, they'll attack. It's not easy to get their leaves without hurting them...
Food like this stimulates them and makes their leaves drop.
Don't worry. They grow back their leaves very fast.
You gave the Radish Leaf to Mooko. Next, you need to go to Darkpool Camp to make the medicine.
No wonder the Cyan Bird recognizes you!
With these and the main ingredient from Culine, the lure is sure to attract Stealth Radishes.
Wait here a sec while I prep the ingredients.
You gave the Blue Falcon Eggshell to Mooko. She began processing the materials and asked you to wait nearby.
Here you are! Let's split the work to finish faster!
I need three servings of <001>Red Ginseng Spirit Decoction</>. I'll blend the final product after.
It's not that I don't trust you, but using Radish Leaves is complicated. I'll handle that myself.
Mooko commissioned you to make three servings of Red Ginseng Spirit Decoction.
That should do it. Time to get the Radish Leaves.
I need all three servings of <001>Red Ginseng Spirit Decoction</>.
Take it easy. Quality matters most.
You give three servings of Red Ginseng Spirit Decoction to Mooko.
Stealth Radishes? They have medicinal parts, too?
Stealth Radishes? They have medicinal parts, too?
Of course! Cultivators believe everything can be medicine. Stealth Radishes are no exception.
But first, I need to make a lure to attract them.
Once they eat the lure, I'll get the ingredients I need.
Sounds a little odd... Okay, what do you need?
Sounds a little odd... Okay, what do you need?
Let me see... I'm just missing a Blue Falcon Eggshell.
I had a bird scout for me. There's a Blue Falcon nest on the pavilion with eggshell pieces.
Alright, I'll give it a try.
Alright, I'll give it a try.
You're here! I've tried lots of new herbs and learned from Shinye's failures. I finally made a new medicine!
I even messaged him. He said we should just make the medicine and not worry about him.
The new medicine is detoxifying and nourishing. I'm sure it will work! Now I need "help" from Stealth Radishes.
The roof is high up, but you already climbed a steep cliff, so this should be easy. Can you help again?
Their leaves can be processed to become a cooling herb.
Mooko needs two rare materials for her new formula: Radish Leaf from Stealth Radish and Blue Falcon Eggshell from Pavilion of Lakeheart.
Faster than I expected. And... it's perfect!
Phew, I knew Ms. Perilla wouldn't make it easy for us.
Good thing you found those herbs underwater, or we would've missed the answer...
Let's sum up. This assignment was pretty tough.
The Exhaustion Plant is new to the Toxineers. They haven't mastered the use of it, so it's not public yet.
They said they're testing it outside now. Darkpool Camp is one of those test sites.
Maybe they found out its effects change based on where it grows.
Our tests showed water and land Exhaustion Plants are equally toxic, but need totally different antidotes.
Cultivators see the same thing. Sun, water, soil—all affect plants. Same for the Exhaustion Plant.
We couldn't know about this, but Ms. Perilla, as Jixia's top Herbalist, surely does.
We couldn't know about this, but Ms. Perilla, as Jixia's top Herbalist, surely does.
So she took the Exhaustion Plant and faked her illness.
So she took the Exhaustion Plant and faked her illness.
That's about it. But why did she do it?
Maybe it's because we were arguing so much...
Ahem... We've been arguing nonstop, and teachers told us not to let our different views hurt our friendship.
Then Ms. Perilla said she was sick and gave us this assignment...
That's part of it, but not all. What did you do once you got the assignment?
We... kept arguing about every step. Things only moved forward until...
Good, that's for the best. My suffering had some purpose after all...
And it wasn't all bad. The Toxineers say the Exhaustion Plant might even make you more beautiful.
Sounds like you learned a lot. How about studying with them? Maybe help with copying their records?
He actually thinks that's a reward...
He actually thinks that's a reward...
Ahem. Both theory and practice are important. Combine them instead of choosing one!
It was too risky. I was cautious enough but still felt the side effects. And I couldn't meet you often.
If you hadn't joined, things might have ended badly. I won't do this again, and neither should you!
Anyway, watching a rookie grow to an expert was worth the trouble.
When we fought, you were always there to help us through... thanks.
Now, it's your turn to spread your wings. Here's a gift from the Herb Garden for you.

Perilla has finally approved the potion that Mooko and Shinye developed together. Thanks to you and Perilla, their partnership has been a success. Perilla sent this gift from the Herb Garden as a token of her gratitude.
You done? Then we just wait for them to show up!
Wow, I've been waiting to see you wear it!
All done. Time to bring them to Mooko.
All done. Time to bring them to Mooko.
Look, there are Exhaustion Plants by the shore!
Let's pick some for our tests!
I found a different kind of Exhaustion Plant in the pool.
I found a different kind of Exhaustion Plant in the pool.
Wow, this one has a much stronger smell than the ones on the land!
Does it grow underwater too? Remember my words at Smokescar Vale?
Yes, you said a plant's environment can change its properties.
Yes, you said a plant's environment can change its properties.
Exactly. Let's test this new one too!
Right. Sunlight affects Dimfruits and Aerflow changes Burnshoots' color. Tiny changes make the medicine different.
You found another kind of Exhaustion Plant underwater. You decided to take it for testing as well.
Ta-da! Here it is—fresh Aerdo Ball for Stealth Radishes!
Doesn't look that special. Are you sure they'll like it?
Doesn't look that special. Are you sure they'll like it?
Just watch. Here, take it. I'll let you handle this one.
I'll make another one, just in case. They're super sensitive. I'll show you how to lure them out.
Put the Aerdo Ball in the grass by the pool, then get away quickly.
Mooko asks you to use the Aeropastry Dough to attract a Stealth Radish while she makes another batch.
You'll find out in a moment. Here, take this cloud cake; the glorious task of attracting a Ground-Hiding Radish is up to you.
zh_text: 一会儿你就知道了。来，这份云糕团拿着，吸引一只伏地萝卜的光荣任务就交给你了。
source_text: 一会儿你就知道了。来，这份云糕团拿着，吸引一只伏地萝卜的光荣任务就交给你了。
official_target_text: You'll find out in a moment. Here, take this cloud cake; the glorious task of attracting a Ground-Hiding Radish is up to you.
official_en_text: You'll find out in a moment. Here, take this cloud cake; the glorious task of attracting a Ground-Hiding Radish is up to you.

text: Look who it is—our rookie Herbalist! Hm? Where is Shinye?
Uh... should we hand in the medicine now?
Maybe he wants to work solo now. Either way, it's great to see you two make a great team.
Don't worry. I'm sure it'll work.
Don't worry. I'm sure it'll work.
Did you try a new approach this time?
It's still not quite correct... but congrats, you're getting close.
The first failure may be because the Index of Ailments is outdated...
As for the second failure, did you overlook a detail, or was it a matter of teamwork?
Mooko's medicine still hasn't passed Perilla's evaluation.
The herbs underwater... Are they Exhaustion Plants too?
The herbs underwater... Are they Exhaustion Plants too?
Wow! Even senior Herbalists rarely make medicine this quickly and with such high quality.
Time to make the medicine. Once it's ready, I'll invite Ms. Perilla to Darkpool Camp tomorrow.
Still no word from Shinye... I wonder how his search is going.
You really trust him... Anyway, get some rest. Come early tomorrow and we'll meet Ms. Perilla!
If he finds anything, he'll tell us for sure.
If he finds anything, he'll tell us for sure.
Mooko praised your skills and invited you to join her at Darkpool Camp tomorrow to deliver the finished product to Perilla.
This is for a senior Herbalist. It's a little late, but you earned it.
The Herb Society's blessing is always with you. Take it on your journeys.
Hm? I'll be here, waiting for your answer.
See that grid button? Switch it to sow an entire row at once. Hurry and plant <001>four Fragrant Melons</>!
You're amazing! I can't believe you upgraded the home to level eight!
The veggie stand can reach level eight. More Versatile Coins are on our way!
By the way, I've been learning cultivation techniques from Society mentors. We can grow our own herbs and ingredients at home now.
Just select the herbs you want to grow and plant them in the incubator.
Besides growing herbs, we can also make medicine and food at home with materials.
I got the design for the Medicine Stand from the Society teachers. Let's place it in my Home for now.
Let's craft a medicine at the Medicine Stand.
You'll never have to borrow a Medicine Stand again. This place is starting to feel like home!
I've submitted an application to the academy. Once it's approved, we'll make a fortune!
Need 20,000 Versatile Coins to expand your Home's second area. Keep going!
Your hard work has paid off. Home is thriving, but we're running out of space. It's time to expand!
Already saved up so much? Impressive! But don't be too frugal. If you're ready, we can expand our home!
Thousands, tens of thousands... Just another <001>1,200,000 Craft Coins</>, and we can open a new area! If you want to earn more Craft Coins, remember to upgrade your vegetable stall.
zh_text: 个十百千万……再有<001>一百二十万百工币</>，就能再开一块新区域了！要想多赚百工币，可要记得升级蔬菜摊哦。
source_text: 个十百千万……再有<001>一百二十万百工币</>，就能再开一块新区域了！要想多赚百工币，可要记得升级蔬菜摊哦。

text: Once you've collected enough animal products, hurry over to the animal stall and sell them!
Go check on the animals. Remember to bring any produce to the animal stall to sell.
The second ranch slot is now unlocked. The new little animal can't wait to move in!
Hurry up and unlock a new slot so your new little animal can move in!

While waiting for the animals to grow, don't forget to go to <001>upgrade the Animal Stall</>! Just like the vegetable stall, the higher the level, the more Gong Coins you'll get from selling the animals' produce.
Without feed, the animals won't be able to grow.
Upgrade your animal stall so you can sell your livestock products for a higher price. Give it a try!
Let's <001>raise a Brocade Fox</>. It's not only cute, but the product yield is also higher.
Raise a Brocade Fox! It's a great helper for earning Artisan Coins!
How about it? Isn't building a ranch quite fun? Let more little animals move in, and the place will get livelier and livelier!
Alright, now that you know how to build a ranch, it's time for Zhilu to return to Frostcloud Town and take care of her little animals!
If there's anything you don't understand, ask Qizai! Qizai is amazing and knows more about building homes than Zhilu.
Once you have your harvest, you can go to the <001>Animal Shop to sell it</>. This is also a way to earn Craftsman Coins.
Go collect the animal produce and send it to the animal shop.
Use the marker to induce labor and speed up the animal's growth. Give it a try!
If there's no food, the little animals will stop growing if they go hungry. Go fill up the feed first.
Little animals won't grow if they're hungry. Remember to <001>add feed</> so it doesn't go hungry!
Once you approach the ranch sign, you can start building the ranch. Come and give it a try!
See this ranch sign? Go up to it and build your own ranch.
When you see a <001>brush, pet, or milk bottle</> icon above an animal, it means you can <001>harvest early</>. Want to give it a try?
Each feeding provides enough for the whole day. If you're worried, you can check on it anytime and top up the feed.
Hehe, it just told Zhilu that it really likes it here! Now, let's wait for it to grow up slowly.
Newcomer, Qizai told me you're building your residence. I guessed you haven't built a pasture yet, have you?
Zhilu is here to help! With a pasture, we can raise little animals, and the residence will be much livelier!
Come back to see Zhilu when your residence reaches level 19; there's still a lot of fun to be had with ranching.
When you're ready, go release your first White Fur Lop-eared Rabbit.
Now, go to the slot and <001>place a White Fur Lop Rabbit</>. It's the first little animal in your ranch.
Ugh... These vines and weeds are everywhere. It'd take forever to clear them out by hand... Wait, I've got a better idea!
Can you craft a Contriver's Blaze Casket? Three of them should be enough to clear the ruins.
You finished already? You're quite skilled! Now it's my turn. Just close your eyes and wait.
Ta-da! Our new home has a huge lot! Let's lay the foundation first. Enter Build Mode and place <001>ten frames</>.
Remember how to build? Open the furniture storage, select a frame, choose your favorite furniture, and place it.
Once you're done, come find me. We've still got other things to take care of!
How's the new area? Take your time, we've got plenty of time to get it all sorted out.
I just noticed that the Pet Dispatch Hut can be upgraded too. Go ahead and try it out! A Level 3 hut can house even more animals and dispatch an extra team.
I just noticed that the Pet Dispatch Hut can be upgraded too. Go ahead and try it out! A Level 3 hut can house even more animals and dispatch an extra team.
If we keep at it, we'll have a beautiful new area in no time!
My Home is almost at Level 10!
Thanks to your hard work, our Home has reached Level 6. Impressive!
This means we can upgrade the veggie stall to level six. More Versatile Coins are on the way!
Now that we have a grade 6 vegetable stall, let's set a small goal. How about we aim to earn 500 Versatile Coins?
Ta-da! This is the pet dispatch hut. Sun Bin fixed it up for us. Now we can send out pets to gather supplies!
Sending out pets to... gather supplies?
Sending out pets to... gather supplies?
Yes, Luban made it to find No. 7.
Later, Sun Bin modified it so you could dispatch your pets to gather supplies across the world.
Let's test it on this River Sprite!
By the way, you've been at Jixia Academy for a while now. Have you visited anyone else's place?
Whether it's accessing the Friends menu and picking a friend, or responding to someone's call for help in the chat recruitment channel.
Or you can visit other players' homes through Home Recommendations at the Home Overview!
Have you seen those small water pots on top of the crops in other people's farms?
The crops are thirsty. Water them for a Credit reward!
Feels good to help others, doesn't it?
Here's another tip: you can pray for other people's <001>mature crops</> for a chance to greatly increase their yield!
Still know how to visit other people's homes?
Or you can answer someone's call for help in the recruitment chat channel.
Or you can visit other players' homes through Home Recommendations at the Home Overview.
You can find it in the Friends menu...
When you visit friends, you can take some of their vegetables. And they can do the same!
But if you pick any, be sure to pray for your friend's crops in return!
When you give roses, your hands keep their fragrance. Always help your friends!
Home level 7! Have our farmlands been expanded to eight plots?
Don't forget to plant crops on the farmland. Every patch is valuable!
The upgraded Dispatch Hut also reduces the time required for pet dispatches. Give it a try!
The Pet Dispatch Hut can be upgraded too. Make your pets more comfortable!
Once it's empty, I'll water my friends' plants. It's a good way to earn Versatile Coins.
Don't forget to pray for your friends; it helps their crops grow better.
Go help your friends with 5 blessings, and they'll come to help you too!
Don't forget to pray for your friends; it helps their crops grow better.
Go help your friends with 5 blessings, and they'll come to help you too!
Among all the Jixia students I've met, you've got the fastest progress! With your help, an eight-story home might just become possible!

When you have time, remember to help out at your friends' places and <001>Pray</> on the ripe crops in the fields. After all, friendship is about looking out for one another to make the bonds stronger.
zh_text: 有空时，记得去朋友家帮帮忙，给农田里成熟的作物<001>祈福</>，毕竟友谊嘛，就是多关心彼此，才会更加牢固。
source_text: 有空时，记得去朋友家帮帮忙，给农田里成熟的作物<001>祈福</>，毕竟友谊嘛，就是多关心彼此，才会更加牢固。
official_target_text: When you have time, remember to help out at your friends' places and <001>pray for blessings</> on the ripe crops in the fields. After all, friendship is about looking out for one another to make the bonds stronger.
official_en_text: When you have time, remember to help out at your friends' places and <001>pray for blessings</> on the ripe crops in the fields. After all, friendship is about looking out for one another to make the bonds stronger.

text: I've got something cool for you—Melody Stand! Place it at Home and enjoy your favorite tunes there. Give it a try!
All set? If you don't like this one, we can try another song.
The Primaera is vast and boundless, with countless beautiful melodies.
Collect them during your travels, and you can play them at home!
By the way, there's also exclusive music for each Resonant character. Don't forget to play yours!
Oh, don't get too carried away with the music. Remember to upgrade the veggie stand to level 12, or we might lose out on a lot of Versatile Coins...
My merchant friend heard about our new home and wanted to see it for himself. He's over there.
They love digging up rare stuff to sell. If you're interested, you should check it out.
Additionally, to support our construction endeavors, I negotiated with them to raise the purchase prices for certain crops. Check out what they're buying today!
I've marked the crops they want with "High Price" in the seed list.
Let's see, we're paying top coin for Duskfire Peppers today...
Let's fill the farm with Duskfire Peppers!
Well, since they've promised to support our construction endeavors, it'd be impolite not to oblige them on this, wouldn't it?
My other friends will visit later, and they'll have different needs.
Don't forget to stock up and sell them a fortune!
Meeting friends is important, but don't let it get in the way of our business.
The second area already had a frame. This time, we just need to place <001>five pieces of architectural furniture</>, and the house will be complete.
Next, place <001>5 pieces of architectural furniture</> to finish the second house.
zh_text: 再摆<001>五件建筑类</>家具，第二区域的房子就搭好了。
source_text: 再摆<001>五件建筑类</>家具，第二区域的房子就搭好了。

text: Good! Our second area is taking shape. Keep it up. I'll be right by your side.
Your Intimate Rose looks lovely! Give it to a friend to deepen your bond.
Give the Intimate Roses to your best friend! Such a beautiful bouquet will surely deepen your friendship.
I got some <001>Whisper Rose</> seeds. Once they bloom, we can tie them into bouquets for our friends. Give it a try!
After the Whisper Rose blooms, pick it and take it to the <001>Fabricator</> to craft a <001>Rose Bouquet</>.

These records suggest the existence of a hidden treasure left behind by previous students.
I've also heard about a challenge that created quite a buzz many years ago.
During that time, students attempted to crack an incredibly complex lock.

Those who participated in the challenge back then might have some clues.

I still have a lot of documents to sort through here. Could you ask around for me?

You should not have broken the rules.

I get why so few people make it to the end.

I... I was overwhelmed by emotions.

Roaring Tiger Training Hall was a bit rude.

If we could get them working again, it would be crucial for the study of ancient civilizations and Mechcraft!
Unfortunately, a narrow-minded martial artist intervened, hindering my research progress...

Tiger Palm said, "If you want to cause trouble at Roaring Tiger Training Hall, you'll have to get past me first."
This is an insult to my refined culture!
Judging by its orbit, this elevator should lead directly into the academy.
Judging from its exterior structure and Sorcery circle patterns on the surface, it must be designed for wartime.
It's a shame. Without it, it's almost impossible to make any further progress in this research...
Farewell... If only I could get into the Roaring Tiger Training Hall to restart these ancient Mechcraft elevators...
I'll keep watch here, so you can focus on searching inside. The Wolvines haven't returned yet.

Something feels off about this... Oh well, I'll help out anyway.
Something feels off about this... Oh well, I'll help out anyway.
Thank you! If the Wolvines return, I'll send you a signal!
If you scared them off, why not go yourself?
If you scared them off, why not go yourself?
I still find it a bit strange... You should find someone else to help you.
I still find it a bit strange... You should find someone else to help you.
Tsk, tsk. Looks like I'll have to do this myself.

Ah... I got a bit injured while chasing them off. My body isn't as strong as my will.
Now that my plan's been messed up, I'll have to take matters into my own hands.
Well, I didn't scare you, but my disguise is still better!
You actually came back with the bow...

Thank the Sages! Finally, someone's here!

No problem, I'll go and check it out.
No problem, I'll go and check it out.

Great! He's on the mountaintop nearby, probably pulling his hair right now.
This is... yes! This is my bag! Thank you so much!
Let me help you open the chest! There seems to be quite a few treasures inside—consider it a thank-you gift. Don't be shy!
The backpack should be just below the cliff. Be careful!
Let's get to work! I wonder what stories these ruins could tell.
Damn those Saepes. What should I do?

Luckily, I reacted fast and climbed up here to safety, but I dropped my bag down there...

Looks like another student is surveying nearby, and the instructor probably went to find him.

Once the survey is complete, we'll set out for Smokescar Vale.

I accidentally dropped the teacher's <001>letter</> through the door. Can you help me retrieve it?
I don't know how to open the door of the ruins here, do you have any ideas?

Everyone, calm down. I'll figure something out...

Sir, we mean no harm! My Mechcraft Kite, designed to fly like a bird, keeps getting disrupted by your Mechcraft.
I'm in a treasure hunt, and my Mechcraft Kite must work perfectly. So... could you turn the Mechcrafts off?
Absolutely not! Those birds can wipe out all the fish in just half a day. No fish means no business for me!
But this competition means everything to me! I'll do whatever it takes to make it up to you. If we win, you can have the entire prize!
How long will that last? Raising fish is a long-term business! I don't care! Keep away from my Mechcraft!
We understand the risks. If any issues arise, we'll help bear the losses.
We understand the risks. If any issues arise, we'll help bear the losses.
How can a fish vendor survive without reputation?
Besides, this Mechcraft Kite can be used for aerial treasure hunting. It might bring you unexpected surprises in the future.
Besides, this Mechcraft Kite can be used for aerial treasure hunting. It might bring you unexpected surprises in the future.
Fine. I'll give you a chance. But you must compensate me for the loss! Or you'll regret it!
Borrowed money, owe a favor, it never ends...
Can I improve Mechcraft Kite in time?
Can I improve Mechcraft Kite in time?
Are you telling me to give up too? Seems like that's the best option now.
Like my brother, who insisted on his aerial treasure hunting research. He got ridiculed, and it broke him. So silly.
It'll take a week to make adjustments. There's no time.
If your goal is to prove your brother's research is valuable, there are other ways to do it.
If your goal is to prove your brother's research is valuable, there are other ways to do it.
But he's been locked up in that room for three months now...
You're right... Oh, what should I do...?
I must compete in this contest, or I'll regret it forever.
Mechcraft Kite is limited by its bird-repelling mechanism, which means there's room for improvement.
Mechcraft Kite is limited by its bird-repelling mechanism, which means there's room for improvement.

She didn't win in the end. I heard it was a Mechcraft dog that defeated the Mechcraft Kite.
The important thing is, the Mechcraft Kite actually found something valuable. I not only made up for my loss but also made a small profit.
Helpful to people, that's what makes a good invention.
Well, treasure hunting isn't like fishing. Things on the ground always outdo things in the sky.
She skipped the competition and focused on refining her Mechcraft.
Life can't be defined by a single victory or defeat.
Seeing her determination, he slowly regained his confidence.
Now, one is researching aerial treasure hunting, and the other is studying Mechcraft fishing. They've both found their own path.
What's wrong with this Mechanoid Bird?
What's wrong with this Mechanoid Bird?
It's a Mechcraft Kite! My brother designed it as an airborne treasure-hunting Mechcraft. I lost control during a test flight.
Yes! Shye won first place in the last Treasure Hunter event. I want to beat her with my Mechcraft Kite this time!
It's so weird. The Mechcraft components are fine... Why did it lose control when it flew to the lake?
Wait, I remember now! I saw a strange Mechcraft over there.
Let's go take a look. It might be related to the Mechcraft Kite malfunction.
My instincts tell me it's the reason the Mechcraft Kite is out of control!
But I'm no good at <001>cracking Mechcrafts</>... Oh, if only my brother were here!

These pieces look like they form an <001>arrowhead shape</>.
I can't swim, so I need you to <001>dive in and check</>.

I prepared for so long, yet I had to give up...
There's a running Mechcraft below, its function remains to be determined.
There's a running Mechcraft below, its function remains to be determined.
My brother's design can't be wrong... What's going on?
