I seemed to see some stone statues inside, but I couldn't tell. I didn't dare to get too close.
Thank you so much! This cave is promising... Hey, could you take me there?
Those Wolvines are acting strange. Can you believe they're prowling slowly in circles?
I've never seen this before. Wait, there seems to be something in the middle.
It's... another Wolvine. Could it be their new alpha?
Do you have any herbs for losing weight, Hanmeng? I've been getting fat lately...
Of course! Soup made with Purple Cloud Mushrooms can be effective.
It works even better if you throw in regular exercise and a controlled diet.
Speaking of which, isn't a Martial Arts instructor giving public lessons at the Tower of Enlightenment?
Martial Arts... No thanks, I think I'll just stick to Purple Cloud Mushroom soup.
I can sense they're scattered around. Could you please help me retrieve them?
Great job! The Mechcraft has been restarted and launched six Aersilk orbs.
Great! The energy has been retrieved! Next time, I should try a gentler approach...
Thank you for your help. Here's the treasure I found. Please take it.
Oh, and if you go further north, you might run into Wolvines and bears. But Serene Wilds is absolutely safe, and the scenery is gorgeous.
If there's a chance, I'll show you the spectacle of insects swarming in Serene Wilds. Until then, goodbye!
These Wolvines literally cornered me in an instant. Thank the Sages I was quick enough to react in time.
Indeed. We were so right to team up. So, have you rested up? Time to get moving.
Gimme a few more minutes. My heart's still pounding like crazy.
Come on, the Wish Tree is just a few steps away. We can rest all we want after we get there.
Where'd you get all that energy... I'm exhausted...
The Wolvines always move in packs, yet you're here scouting alone.
Master was worried you couldn't handle them, so he sent me to help.
That's great. The Wolvines here do tend to move in big numbers.
They get even faster when they burrow underground.
If left unchecked, these beasts will soon overrun this place.
But I should warn you, the Wolvines are not the only problem here.
Spike Bears and Leaftail Lizards also nest in the area. We can't let our guard down, not even for a second.
Relax. You know I don't mess up something like this.
So many deer live there, they look so carefree.
If I were a deer, would I have fewer worries?
But maybe deer have troubles too...
Dad, is it true? If I make a wish to the tree, will it come true?
That's what everyone says, so... I guess it will?
Wow! That's cool! I wish... I wish that you and mom would never fight again!
See those spirits flying around? They're the ones that make wishes come true.
Fight? Mom and I don't fight, we just... have discussions.
Hehe, can you pull this off for me, cute little spirits?
The place is rampant with ferocious beasts. What did my master say to me again...
Wolvines are agile creatures. Always watch out for their burrowing ambush.
Spike Bears have powerful claws. Keep your distance when fighting them.
The wishing well is not far ahead. I can't let my guard down.
Earth wolves are very agile; always be on guard for their burrowing sneak attacks.
zh_text: “地狼十分灵活，要时刻提防它们钻地突袭。”
source_text: “地狼十分灵活，要时刻提防它们钻地突袭。”
official_target_text: Earth wolves are very agile; always be on guard for their burrowing sneak attacks.
official_en_text: Earth wolves are very agile; always be on guard for their burrowing sneak attacks.

text: The Thorn Bear's claws are very powerful. Try to keep your distance when fighting it.
zh_text: “刺熊的利爪很有力量，对战的时候尽量保持距离。”
source_text: “刺熊的利爪很有力量，对战的时候尽量保持距离。”
official_target_text: The Thorn Bear's claws are very powerful. Try to keep your distance when fighting it.
official_en_text: The Thorn Bear's claws are very powerful. Try to keep your distance when fighting it.

text: I'm keeping an eye on the beasts. They've been very aggressive lately, and we must stay vigilant to ensure Serene Wilds' safety.
Watch out for wild beasts on the road. Stay safe!
I need to keep a close eye on this...
Almost there! Can't wait to explore Serene Wilds...
How do I get to Serene Wilds?
Head north from here. If you see a very special tree, that's Serene Wilds.
The Hunting Society is stationed in Serene Wilds. They might know something.
Master Crafter is running low on research funds again. But he's too shy to ask the academy for more.
So I offered to sponsor his new research. He said he'd add my name to his paper. Cool, right?
I once helped Master Crafter test the energy output of Barrier Domes. See that one over there? We made it together.
He insisted on paying me. Said I was incredibly gifted and kind at a young age. How's about?
There should be a passage here. This strange aura feels familiar...
We've been trying for hours with no luck. Perhaps we should buy some Mechcraft detectors?
No, we can do this ourselves. How can Seekers like us pass up on things within reach?
Maybe we can ask a Sorcery student to check for special energy at the entrance?
No. I think I'm getting close already.
But I... I still think we should ask others for help...
The Rebels are running wild. They just keep stirring up trouble!
Not long ago, they even attacked a Seeker, taking their belongings and portable Mechcrafts.
My sword is itching for action. Trust me, they don't want me running into them.
'Cause if so, I'll let them know we Martial Arts students aren't pushovers!
That was a risky trip, but look what I've found! I'm definitely making a fortune this time!
That's nothing. I found something even better. You'll never guess it.
I know, ancient coins, right? Have you got them appraised? Could be worth nothing.
I've learned about the local market and know exactly what the Seeker Society needs.
I can sell the same item for a better price. This is the power of intel.
Oh my, you're so stubborn. Everyone is allowed to study the ruins, am I right?
Even so... You can't just take the artifact away!
Besides, there are many other ways to conduct research, for example...
How is it "taking it away"? I'm just bringing the research subject back to the academy.
This is going nowhere. I'm going to report you to our mentor.
Hey! Is that all you can do?
A seasoned Trader must have found a ton of ancient relics in the ruins by now.
But I'm not familiar with this place, and I don't know much about the market either.
I've heard that selling these to Navenia merchants can be very profitable... no, wait, it's merchants from Chang'an...
A mature relic hunter must have found a pile of antiques in the ruins by now.
zh_text: 一个成熟的物币家，现在肯定在遗迹里找到一大堆古物了。
source_text: 一个成熟的物币家，现在肯定在遗迹里找到一大堆古物了。
official_target_text: A mature relic hunter must have found a pile of antiques in the ruins by now.
official_en_text: A mature relic hunter must have found a pile of antiques in the ruins by now.

text: I've just got an idea, Ting He. Please help me write it down.
A shockwave generator that can break through stone walls during archaeological excavations without damaging the relics. The key is...
Please wait a moment, Master. I can't write that fast.
Oh, no worries, you are always so meticulous.
Just one more mark real quick... and a summary... Okay, what's next?
The key is... it's, uh... what was it again?
You're always full of hot air. I'd rather listen to the Croaky on Springbrook Plains.
I've fought plenty of Rebels. Just the other day, I chased off five thieves trying to steal Mechcrafts!
Of course not. The Rebels have been quite aggressive lately. I'm sure they've been eyeing the academy's latest research findings for some time now.
We need to be extra careful.
Why do these herbs thrive in the wild but struggle in the garden?
The herbs in the garden are cultivated varieties, which are different from wild ones.
Why not just use wild species then? They're easier to raise and breed.
Then why not just say so? Being less sick would save you even more trouble! Wild herbs don't work as well, so don't get any funny ideas.
Based on the scratches on the remains, I believe a battle was fought here, and whoever owned the ruins was defeated.
I wouldn't be so sure. Evidence is crucial to Seeker investigations, and nothing here indicates the owners' loss.
We'll need more research to settle this.
I'm just a member of the Seeker Society, but I must take responsibility.
It looks safe here, but what if the Rebels plan to vandalize the ruins...
My bad. I should stay vigilant.
Martial Arts are about pushing your body to its limits. Keep that in mind.
You hear that? A kitten packs a stronger punch than you do.
And your fighting form is a joke. So? Wanna go another around?
Enough! Yuhai, you have strength, but lack focus. Chuyun, you are a skilled fighter, but you're always impatient.
Stay humble and always reflect on your trainings. That's how you reach your true potential. Got it?
That ruin looks huge even from this distance.
I haven't had the time to check the wind direction and speed, and now it seems it's too late.
Launching an unmanned flying Mechcraft under the current condition is a bit risky.
But... how will I know if I don't try? I guess I'll do it anyway, haha...
Those ancient Mechanoids in the ruins woke up, right? How did you escape?
I escaped as a Seeker should. Listen, everything in the world follows its own principles.
Those Mechanoids are the protectors of the ruins. As long as you leave quick enough, they won't chase you to the outside.
I thought you fought them... Gotta say I'm a bit disappointed.
As Seekers, knowledge should be our weapon! Fighting is not the solution to everything, okay?
We really should change the subject.
Some Seeker I am, getting stuck here... Hold on... I think I get it!
The layout here resembles stars surrounding the moon, so the "moon" could very well be the command center of this area.
Then these smaller ruins could be watchtowers, relay stations, or strongholds...
Great! I'm getting closer to the truth!
No more running off! There are Rebels around!
These ruins are unique. The secrets of Greenwhisper Pool's treasure must be hidden underwater.
Too bad I can't swim, or I'd grab it myself.
These ruins are unique. The secrets of Greenwhisper Pool's treasure must be hidden underwater.
Too bad I can't swim, or I'd grab it myself.
The Mechcrafts at Greenwhisper Pool were so intricately designed.
Inspired by water, conceptualized around water, and built on water.
It blends in perfectly with Greenwhisper Pool, while saving tons of energy.
Such ingenious design. Words will never do it justice. I'd love to see the original drawings someday.
How far's that pavilion by the viewing pool?
A five-minute run, give or take?
Don't think so. It's farther away than it looks. Plus, there are stairs.
Nah, I'll pass. Nothing special to see, and way too crowded.
I just finished reading the latest angling guide published by the Seekers.
It says fish are more likely to bite here.
Let's see... Face the southeast and kowtow three times...?
Then turn northwest, bow for five minutes, and ask for the King Fish's blessing...
... The book can't be lying, right?
When I was training at Maplefall Archery Range, someone told me about an incredible shot.
A shot by the Head Trainer of Red Falcon. A single arrow that pierced the mark, like a hawk soaring through the air.
Every one in the training hall heard the clear twang of the bowstring.
Some decided to quit archery altogether.
I understand the feeling. Disheartened having witnessed mastery they could never hope to surpass...
But I'll never give up. I want to reach the limits of archery myself.
The water here is so sweet. Much sweeter than what we usually drink.
I thought so too, so I asked Senior Su about it.
She said the camp's water comes from Greenwhisper Pool. Maybe that's why it's so sweet.
They say a legendary Gourmet once visited the pool and dropped a spice into the water by accident.
Since then, the water's been carrying a hint of sweetness.
Wow, interesting. I'll taste some to if there's really something "spicy" in it.
Can someone help us? We've been going in circles forever...
Hey, are you saying... you know the way?
We're trying to get to the nearest camp. Is it in this direction?
It's shaking its head. And it's saying something... I think it's telling us to go the other way?
You sure? Oh well... if only we spoke Croaky.
We're wondering if you've noticed anything unusual in the area recently.
It's our first time here helping with patrols, so we hope you can tell us something about the place.
Let's see... The mountain area has been restless lately. Passersby are being attacked by Wolvines.
We'll inform the teachers and get a team on it.
Oh well. What should I do about the agility test...
Haste makes waste. I've learned that lesson the hard way.
Hey, why are you staring at me?... It's not like I pulled a muscle or anything.
Oops, did I actually say that out loud? Um... just pretend you didn't see me, okay?
... It was just basic practice. How could I have possibly hurt myself?
Looks like foreign weeds have taken root in the herb patch.
If they keep increasing in number, it will slow the growth of herbs.
And if the herbs don't turn out well in the end, we'll be in trouble.
But if I pull out the weeds now, it might damage the good roots...
Cute things usually sell well... Maybe I can make money out of it too?
I wonder if it'll turn a profit though...
C'mon, think! I know I can do it!
This place is so boring. We rarely get to go out, and this is where we end up?
Patience. There are plenty of ruins here. I'm just choosing the right one.
Why would you say that, sir?
Sorcery is not as direct as Martial Arts, and sometimes, we don't hold up well against complex Mechcrafts.
I felt that during our trials. Runes have less range, which means we can be less flexible than Martial Arts students.
Precisely. Which is why you need to target the vital points.
Observe the Mechcrafts carefully so you can destroy its drive with one shot. That's the key to passing Sorcery trials.
I see. I still have much to learn.
I saw this tree when I came here as a child.
I even made a wish here! I wished to go to Jixia Academy when I grew up. And here I am!
I heard there's a real Wish Tree in the mountains. I should check it out later.
Hmm... What should I wish for this time...?
Later, the young man picked up his sword, and buried the girl under the ancient tree by Greenwhisper Pool.
Such a tragic end for the swordsman and the love of his love. Fate can be so cruel.
Later, the young man took his sword and buried the girl under the ancient tree at Qingming Pool.
zh_text: “后来那少年人提了剑，将少女埋在了青冥潭的古树下。”
source_text: “后来那少年人提了剑，将少女埋在了青冥潭的古树下。”
official_target_text: Later, the young man took his sword and buried the girl under the ancient tree at Qingming Pool.
official_en_text: Later, the young man took his sword and buried the girl under the ancient tree at Qingming Pool.

text: Your parents went to <001>Roaring Tiger Training Hall</>? That complicates things.
Why not? I heard they used those "<001>Dashing Wings</>" thingies and whoosh, straight up they went!
You're just a tiny kid! If you tried flying now, the wind would toss you around and crash you down!
Fine, I'll take you through a shortcut. Make sure you get some rest before we head out, okay?
I'm not tired! I'll become a disciple of Head Trainer Hu Tiger one day, just like Mom and Dad!
The place is crawling with all kinds of beasts.
Students who come here should travel in groups.
We should add it to the New Student Manual.
Hmm. Should I check out the beasts up close?
Fang Siao said he's happy with the loupe I made for him.
But still, there's something awkward about the way he uses it...
Holding it all day must be tiring. If I could secure it onto a headband or stuff, it would free up his hands.
A logging device would be nice too, like a voice recorder to note down things.
Hmm... I'll ask him if he has any suggestions.
Knowing him, though, I think all he has for me would be good words.

Ruins Explorers Wanted! We're in need of brave, curious adventurers for our expedition team.									
/Game/Data/ExportDialogues/Ck/Ck_QSKGZB/Ck01Dong/Anim/Anim_Ck_QSKGZB_Ck01Dong_00_LvGeYu	Ck_QSKGZB_Ck01Dong_01_LvGeYu_DialogueText	2990639092			If you share the same ambition with us, join us on trips to newly discovered ruins!
This recruitment notice is so amateur.
No mention of any specific ruin, no introduction of current members...
At least they didn't forget the meeting place. Hmph, I'll see for myself the bunch of idiots who wrote something like this.
Head to the recently discovered ruins to explore! Looking forward to working with someone as passionate as you..."
zh_text: 一同前往最近发现的遗迹进行探秘！期待与有相同热情的您共事……”
source_text: 一同前往最近发现的遗迹进行探秘！期待与有相同热情的您共事……”
official_target_text: Head to the recently discovered ruins to explore! Looking forward to working with someone as passionate as you..."
official_en_text: Head to the recently discovered ruins to explore! Looking forward to working with someone as passionate as you..."

text: Come on, it's just a few Saepes. Let's take a closer look.
I'm just being cautious. Do you know how terrifying the Saepes are now?
A few days ago, we went to explore the Saepes camp, and to our surprise, they had all learned to form battle lines!
Saepes with crude weapons on the front, Saepes with slingshots on the tree.
And Saepes that harass with spells from a distance.
Just thinking about it gives me goosebumps...
If you want to see it for yourself, you'll have to go there yourself.
You have a point. Let's stay here and observe.
Judging by the dense growth of moss and vines, I'd say this place has seen some history.
Bravo, like no one else can see it...
Well, tell me something that isn't obvious then.
See here? Clear signs of water erosion and human construction. I think this might be the drainage system for the ruins.
Hmm... That does make sense, I'll give you that...
I'm exhausted. When will this ever end?
Every day it's the same. Reviewing the archives, cataloging items, asking people for information. Just grunt work.
Why can't I explore the ruins? I've read up on everything about them. Even got brand new equipment.
And then? I never got the chance to go. The seniors always say they're worried about my safety.
Hmph. I bet it's just an excuse to make me do all the dirty work.
My brother ran away from home. When I found him on the mountain, he said he wanted to end it all.
I couldn't climb up but was worried something would happen to him, so I kept looking up at him, and ended up aggravating my lumbar strain.
Can you please talk some sense into him?
That was another group just now. What are all those people doing here lately, with all that equipment?
Looks like they are all Seekers.
And they're probably going for the ruins I discovered up there.
But there are just too many of them, and it's so annoying.
I finally found a quiet place to train, and now I might have to move again. Oh well.
I wonder what triggers this Mechcraft.
A Sorcery-sensor alone won't do, and neither will a force-sensor.
But if it's both... how can it be so small?
Hmm... no clue. I'll have to examine it closely when no one's around.
What? You want to check that out? No way! It's too dangerous.
Once, I got tired from walking and wanted to lean on that stone pillar to rest. Thought the place was just some plaza.
Suddenly, an arrow whizzed over my head, and the pillar made a strange noise. I ran away as fast as I could.
It's probably some kind of trap. Trust me, we should just go home.
The notice says a Wolvine took the bow? That sounds ridiculous.
But if you insist on going in, keep your ears open and stay on high alert.
Wolvines are cunning creatures. They know how to use the terrain and shadows to conceal themselves, waiting for the perfect moment to strike.
You should think it over carefully. Don't take any unnecessary risks.
Oh! I think I get it now!
This style, and all the other styles... They are just different ways to channel inner energy.
That's the foundation of all Martial Art forms. Without it, all moves are just structures without a base.
That's why Master always says to cultivate from within and never rush things. It makes so much sense now.
You must be here for the archaeological excavation too. Did you come with that group of Seekers just now?
Those folks were moving very slowly. Asking questions everywhere with their notebooks.
I'm sure you'll catch up to them in no time.
I'm exhausted already. Better rest here for a while. It's a long journey, and I must stay at full strength.
Last time, I nearly got ambushed by those crafty Mechanoids, not to mention all those mysterious traps...
This ruin is full of danger. I can't let my guard down.
Ah well... I've been studying the ruins up there for ages and I'm still getting nowhere.
Mazes, Mechcraft orbs... and not a single hint. What am I supposed to do...?
Don't lose heart. How about I come with you? Maybe I can help somehow.
That'd be great! Two heads will always be better than one.
Moon Bats navigate and hunt with the sounds they produce.
If I can make a Mechcraft that emits and receives sound like Moon Bats...
I'll use vibrating metal plates for sound waves and Aersilk threads to detect echoes.
Not bad... Perhaps I'll have a new invention.
All I catch is Anchor Fish. Did I choose a bad spot? No, I chose a good spot.
Maybe I used the wrong bait?
The shopkeeper reassured me it was for Prisma Napperfish. Was he lying?
Anchor Fish does taste good, but it doesn't provide the boost I need for training. What a waste of time!
It's getting late today. Tomorrow, that shopkeeper has some explaining to do.
Yes and no. I am feeding the fish no doubt, but I'm also maintaining the balance.
It's simple. Look, others are fishing, while I'm feeding.
They take fish out, and I help them grow. Wouldn't you call that balance?
Hmm, that makes sense... Or does it?
You've been watching through the binoculars for ages now. Got any ideas yet?
It seems that we need to use Aerpower Chips to deactivate the barrier before starting this trial.
You happen to have Aerpower Chips, right? Let's go try it out now!
Wait! This trial is no joke. I need to survey the area before we...
Still, I don't hear a yes from you. Don't tell me you're scared...
Although Dust Deer are very timid, they will attack if they encounter an emergency.
zh_text: “尘鹿虽然十分胆小，但如果遇到紧急情况，它们也会发起攻击。”
source_text: “尘鹿虽然十分胆小，但如果遇到紧急情况，它们也会发起攻击。”
official_target_text: Although Dust Deer are very timid, they will attack if they encounter an emergency.
official_en_text: Although Dust Deer are very timid, they will attack if they encounter an emergency.

text: Wait, Zeesuan. Haven't you heard the rumors?
They say there's a strange man in the ruins. He won't let anyone enter.
Everyone who's tried got kicked out. It's scary.
Apparently, he's some kind of recluse who likes peace and quiet.
Really? Maybe we should talk it over with more people...
Exactly. Let's think this through. Being cautious doesn't hurt.
The test is tomorrow, so today is all about practice.
Last time, we had to hit a moving target 500 paces away.
The Head Trainer hit it three times in a row. Made it look so easy.
And me? I aimed for ages and still missed. Ugh...
Come on, Youmei. You must pull yourself together! You can do this!
Oooh, what's happening? I just touched it, and a flower grew on its head!
Oh, I forgot to tell you. My Croaky is special. It has... powers.
Really? Let me try again... Wow, another flower!
Oops. Did you touch its tail just now?
I forgot to tell you to never touch its tail, or it'll make flowers grow on your head too!
Oh no! Why didn't you say it earlier? ... So, um, what's the flower on my head? Is it pretty?
Haha, don't worry. I was just messing with you. It was my spell just now, not my Croaky's.
Where's our senior? Let's just go in without him.
But he told us to wait for him. You know how angry he can get...
Heh, so what? He's always bragging about his archery skills. Didn't help him pass, did it?
If I complete the trial in the ruins, that can shut him up.
Well... Let's not be rash. This trial looks tough. It's best if we stick together.
I'm going anyway. How hard can it be?
This stone is different. I can sense the energy flowing through it.
Could it be some kind of ore? No, I've never read about anything like this.
Such powerful energy... Might be related to some kind of Sorcery. I should grab someone from the School of Sorcery.
Training with Mechanoids every day is so boring.
Their attacks are simply too slow. Once you know the pattern, they'll never land a hit on you.
Wolvines are different. They're fast and work well together.
They always attack from unexpected places.
Fighting them really tests my footwork and reflexes. Way more fun than kicking those Mechanoid butts.
My classmates were supposed to meet here to observe the Flamebearer Falcon.
But where are they? I wonder.
To be honest, the falcon's screech terrifies me.
I've heard that the Flamebearer Falcon swiftly approaches its prey upon spotting it.
With a scream to intimidate the prey, the falcon swoops down while breathing fire.
I'm getting really scared... I think I'll go home...
You've been standing here forever. Found anything?
Look at how well the plants grow.
I suspect they're influenced by the Saepes, which give them more life.
My guess is that it was the abundant water supply here that attracted the Saepes. Not the other way round.
Let's go. We'll never finish the quest if we keep watching. I'll think about it on the way back.
You do have a point... but just give me one more moment, please.
I heard these Moon Bats locate their prey through sound.
If I hold my breath and walk on tiptoes, can I slip by unnoticed?
I think it might just work! I'll go grab some quieter shoes and clothes now.
Do you understand Master's lesson on deflection today? I'm lost.
Oh, that? It's quite simple. It means receiving an attack and redirecting it. Then take the chance to strike back.
Well... the key is identifying different moves for counterattacks...
Tell you what, I'll show you hands-on later. You'll see how it works.
Excuse me, have you seen my cousin Fang Siao?
He left yesterday and never came back. Said something about exploring the ruins.
His parents are worried sick, so they asked me to help find him.
I heard those bronze monsters in the ruins are taller than hills and fiercer than beasts. Will he be okay?
Fang Siao? I saw him tinkering with Mechcrafts yesterday. Didn't want to disturb him.
Don't worry, there are lots of people here looking out for each other. He'll be fine.
That's a relief. Thank you so much.
My Croaky is under that tree in Serene Wilds...
My parents are training it in Serene Wilds to lose weight, while I'm preparing for an exam, so I can only cheer it on from here.
Hurry down the mountain, it's too dangerous.
Hurry down the mountain, it's too dangerous.
Got it. I'll head down right away.
Little brother, save your big brother!
Mr. Wen, here are the Eastern Reed Pipes we gathered today. They're good for brewing medicine.
Thank you. At my age, I've got to rely on young folks like you.
Here, I brought you some food. I cooked it myself.
You won't find them in the academy canteen. Go on, take it.
Take care, Mr. Wen. We'll get back to training.
What do they think of my design, Ms. Ding?
The mountaineering boots offer good stability on rock faces, but they slow you down.
And the impact-resistant suit tends to snag on vines. Your use of materials is pretty good though...
The Martial Arts students break our creations all the time, yet yours survived intact.
Thanks, I'll keep working on it!
I'm heading back to the dorms now. See you later, Ms. Ding!
We used to have wobbly legs on the plank road, just like that girl...
Now we can zip around the mountain like it's flat ground. Gotta thank those hard falls in training.
We have so many handy Mechcrafts now. Some to prevent ankle sprains, some to catch you when you slip...
Yet *some* of us still rush to Herb Garden get meds all the time.
I just want to challenge myself. Injuries are inevitable.
Why are you still as reckless as on day one? Can't you just listen to the seniors once?
I always feel like I can't put any force into my hits when we spar. Why?
Ever heard of the grounded falcon?
A true Martial Arts expert can let a falcon land on their hand without giving it leverage to take flight.
Try to find a weak spot in my stance. Then you can land a forceful hit.
Got it. Let's have another go then!
Why aren't you carrying the med pouch the Hunters gave you?
I want to travel light, Ms. Cheng.
It contains sachets that ward off Wolvines. Trying to make things harder for yourself?
Go check if the others have one to spare. I'll deal with you later!
The Martial Arts seniors are amazing.
The wooden posts are even narrower than this.
Plus, we've got some safety mechanisms here. Worst case, I'm keeping an eye on you, right?
This is a great spot to see Aersilk rainbows.
On one side, there's a waterfall cascading straight down. On the other, there's a rainbow rising up.
The swirling mist and rainbow lights, breathtaking.
On one side is a waterfall rushing down, and on the other is a rainbow rising up.
zh_text: 一边是飞流直下的瀑布，一边是扶摇而上的彩虹。
source_text: 一边是飞流直下的瀑布，一边是扶摇而上的彩虹。
official_target_text: On one side is a waterfall rushing down, and on the other is a rainbow rising up.
official_en_text: On one side is a waterfall rushing down, and on the other is a rainbow rising up.

text: Damn, this kid's two years younger than me, so why is he so much faster?
Must be used to standing penalties. Even a high mountain won't make this one sweat.
Well, I can't stop either. I must climb up there too. A senior disciple must lead by example!
If only I could get a closer look...
Because... I was afraid my appearance would scare them. You... aren't afraid of me?
Really...? Thanks, you're the first person to say that.
Why not get a closer look?
Why not get a closer look?
Everyone's the same. What's there to fear? Besides, who says they won't like you?
Everyone's the same. What's there to fear? Besides, who says they won't like you?
They say the Stone Forest of Jixia is filled with strange plants. It's true.
The veins of this azure leaf are still faintly glowing. I wonder if it was affected by Aersilk.
That is interesting. I should write this down.
When it comes to Mechcraft inventions, cannons are the mightiest, most commanding, and most attention-grabbing!
I'll make my instructors and peers proud.
I swear I'll create a cannon even better than Wildfire Gun when I graduate.
But a massive cannon like this poses significant challenges in terms of material strength, structural support, and more. I'll need to study it thoroughly.
I heard there are special ingredients nearby.
I shouldn't have taken that Mechcraft student's request to test his Mechcraft targets in such a remote place.
I managed to evade the beasts and Saepes, only to find nothing here.
He wouldn't be messing with me, would he?
Tell me... just this once, please!
How much longer are you going to follow me?
No choice. This week's Secrets Scoops theme is new mountain area inventions.
As a Mechcraft student, you must know something. How about sharing some info so I can finish my assignment?
Isn't that elevator over there? Just fill it in however you like, alright?
No way. You have to tell me how it works, how it's made, and the materials and techniques involved.
You should join the School of Mechcrafts. Then you'll know all these secrets.
Here! The elevator is really convenient.
Now with this, even us old folks can go up and down the mountain.
It's not just convenient—it feels like an amusement park ride. Thanks so much!
Not at all. Every Jixia student would be happy to help you.
The red maples are magnificent. Reminds me of that poem.
Light up the forest, and set my heart ablaze.
Too bad it'd always be late autumn when the leaves turn red. A season of farewells.
I wonder what the poet saw in the red maple trees...
“It lit up the whole forest and also ignited my heart.”
zh_text: “点亮了整个林子，也点燃了我的心”。
source_text: “点亮了整个林子，也点燃了我的心”。
official_target_text: “It lit up the whole forest and also ignited my heart.”
official_en_text: “It lit up the whole forest and also ignited my heart.”

text: I read an amusing poem about noodles recently.
Simple words, yet captivating. That's my thing, too. The lines flow smoothly and paint such a vivid picture.
The author cut all the frills. A big improvement from before.
That's just our opinion though. Wonder what the others might think...
Master, going down the mountain is harder than going up, right? I always feel like it's difficult to see the path below.
Exactly. Your view downward is blocked, and it's easier to lose your footing.
So keep your hands and feet steady, engage your core, and don't let your guard down for even one moment.
Again, Master asked me to practice without giving me any instructions. That's so typical him...
Let me think... Master said the secret to smooth movement is focusing on your core for greater explosive strength.
From the feet to the waist, then the waist to the hands... But how exactly do I do that?
The Mechcrafts here were designed to fit better into the environment.
Quite unlike the ancient designs I've seen elsewhere.
These Mechcrafts appear to work with nature, rather than conquer it.
I'd love to know what the designer was thinking back then.
The contraptions here are so impressive. They're cleverly designed to utilize the traits of mountain rocks.
I heard a student got hurt here before. We need to be careful.
That stone we just stepped on must've been the first trap. That was close.
Every stone from here on could be perilous.
The Mechcraft utilized every rock around us, yet it managed to keep everything intact... Remarkable.
The Mechcrafts here are complex. They blend so flawlessly into the terrain.
Before, I just wanted to get it over with. But now, I wanna try them again.
If only I can learn even just a little bit from that intricate design!
Honestly, I'm fascinated by their training methods. Sometimes they're jumping between rooftops, and other times they're standing still.
Perhaps this is their way of connecting with nature and the world around them.
I'd love to stay a few more days here. Unfortunately, time isn't on my side. I have to go back to my school tomorrow.
I'm so tired... I need a break...
When it comes to training, my trick is to balance work and rest.
Practicing all the time won't do you any good. When you're always exhausted, you'd get half the result with twice the effort.
As the mountains stand amongst the clouds, everything is crystal clear from high above.
The scenery here is so different from before; which means our intel needs an update.
These Martial Arts students may be stubborn, but I can see their skills are improving fast...
Alright, let's go over today's training plan:
Each of you will carry forty catties and climb for four hours. Then four hours of wooden dummy training, followed by three hours of waist training.
zh_text: 每个人负重四十斤攀爬四个小时，四个小时的木桩训练，再做三个小时的腰部训练。
source_text: 每个人负重四十斤攀爬四个小时，四个小时的木桩训练，再做三个小时的腰部训练。

text: Yeah... There's barely any time for meals.
You two are already falling behind. Stop making excuses and get back to work!
I'm not! I counted it myself — seven... uh, no, six seconds, and I was up there.
Is it seven seconds or six?
Seven... six, anyway, what does it matter?
Oh, and I saw a man with a telescope earlier. He was muttering to himself—didn't look like a kind sort...
Don't change the subject. Did you even climb at all? Tell me the truth!
Seven... six, anyway, it'll be here soon.
official_target_text: Seven... six, anyway, it'll be here soon.
official_en_text: Seven... six, anyway, it'll be here soon.

text: What are we even doing here? We're not Seekers — we should be focusing on cooking instead.
That's not entirely true. Field investigations can also be very helpful.
The more we know our ingredients, the deeper our understanding of cooking will be.
And how are you doing with the notes, Yaan?
Young man, keep practicing! Aim to reach the Stargazing Terrace soon.
Stargazing Terrace? What's up there? Is it easier to stargaze?
Of course not, silly! That's where Senior Novar mastered the Star Power!
Maybe we could get some inspiration up there.
I see... By the way, we're studying that stone pillar. Do you know anything about it?
Not much, but I've heard from the elders in my family that it's been around since they were kids.
There are rumors about it being a dormant war contraption, some think it's a part of a palace ruin. That's pretty much everything.
Dormant war contraption... palace ruin... None of it sounds very convincing...
I still have no clue what this thing is for. What about you guys?
I see some symbols on it that look like characters. A monument, perhaps?
It's probably more complex than that. I won't jump to conclusions so fast.
This isn't going anywhere. Teaming up with you is one of the biggest mistakes of my life!
Just stop complaining already. Let's keep trying, and maybe my sister will come back with some useful information.
Look, I'm new to this place, right? So could you just help me out, please?
If I don't get this done, my teacher is going to be so mad...
But I'm busy too. Got a crazy training schedule coming up.
It'll be quick. Just tell me about your daily training and show me around real quick. That's all I want.
Alright, alright. You've got two hours.
Thank you, you are a real lifesaver!
Check out my new move, dad. I learned it from brother today.
He called it the Cloudreach Style. It's cool, right?
Super cool. I'm so proud of you, Yeung.
Master, why do we have to come all the way up here? Can't we train just as well down below?
People seek their way up just as water seeks its way down.
The altitude, the quietness here can bring you peace. Helps you better feel the Flow running inside you.
That makes sense, Master. It really does.
Did you hear what that guy just said? Carrying eighty pounds—that's amazing!
zh_text: 欸，听刚才那个男生说了吗？负重八十斤，太厉害了！
source_text: 欸，听刚才那个男生说了吗？负重八十斤，太厉害了！

text: Yeah, I did. That's something else, I'll give him that.
I remember just the other night, I saw someone hanging from a tree branch under the moonlight.
Thought I had run into a ghost at first, but I'm not the kind of person who gets scared easily.
So I took a closer look. Turned out it was a Martial Arts student sleeping upside down.
Woah, so those people even train in their dreams?
Finally, some time for myself. I should take a good rest...
I mean, are those Martial Arts students never tired?
There's only one herb stand here. It's impossible to help everyone at once!
I traveled all the way to Jixia Academy just to witness the legendary rivalry between Zhou Yu and Kongming.
But that brute there has taken one of Kongming's Aerflow Towers or himself.
If only I had trained harder...
Again, Master asked me to practice without giving me any instructions. That's so typical him...
Let me think... Master said the secret to smooth movement is focusing on your core for greater explosive strength.
From the feet to the waist, then the waist to the hands... But how exactly do I do that?
Look at how Jixia Mountains have changed. Impressive. It's all thanks to Master Crafter.
Do you know I was the one that first tested the Zipline?
Master Crafter was worried about me, and he set up a series of intricate safety mechanisms for the test run.
It's been a long time... Those good old memories.
I need just a few more minutes before your training.
Let me wrap up the last section. Now where were we?
Right, the importance of having a flexible waist. It will help you with both fitness workout and strength recovery.
We know this already, Miss Xiaolan! Please let us try it in real practice!
Be patient, Chuncui. I'm almost done. Finally, the key points for core exercises...
Excuse me, do you know if there's a place here for climbing training? I've been wandering around here for a while.
Just follow this path. There's a sign up ahead with specific directions.
Just over there? That's great. Thank you so much!
Lift your left hand a bit higher... Yep, that's it. And try to keep your body steady.
Ugh... Stop fussing over these details. I'm carrying eighty pounds here, so cut me some slack, will ya?
zh_text: 啊……不要再计较这些细节了，我这身上可是八十斤的负重，你就放我一马吧。
source_text: 啊……不要再计较这些细节了，我这身上可是八十斤的负重，你就放我一马吧。

text: So what? The form is much more important than the weights.
Master always says, if you're sloppy in training, you'll pay the price in real combat... Why are you shaking even more? Stay steady.
This place is really nice. So quiet and so undisturbed.
Resting in quiet places helps you recover energy faster, so you can train longer.
I'm exhausted. Maybe we should skip the Stargazing Terrace today?
We have barely walked a mile! How do you expect to surpass Novar like this!
I just feel like the Star Power isn't something you just... pick it up.
But I came prepared! I heard that Novar acquired his power during a fight at the Stargazing Terrace.
I say we just do the same. Maybe we won't be as lucky, but maybe we will!
Hehe, didn't expect so many students to need medicine!
Anything I can help you with?
I'm selling medicines that can help you recover from pain!
I have the key raw materials. With the formula, you can craft it yourself.
Are you a student here too?
Heh, I'm a Herb Society trainee, but I've been kinda slacking off with my studies.
Some are gathered by me, but most are prepared by other Herb Society members, and I help sell them.
I hope I can make all sorts of medicines one day...
The aroma wafts for miles! Don't miss out, or you'll regret it!
Did the aroma bring you here too? You're in the right place!
They may look like ordinary plants, but if you're into cooking...
They're treasures! These materials can help you make all sorts of flavored dishes.
Not only that, these dishes all have unexpected effects. So, tempted yet?
Sometimes there aren't many customers. I'm not sure if it's because the food isn't good or for some other reason...
But as long as I see customers enjoying it, that's all that matters!
Goodbye, remember to eat on time.
The sound of clashing metal is music to my ears.
Are you here to get even stronger?
Tough? I love it! Every day I get to work on all kinds of gear.
I sometimes meet amazing seniors, and I always learn more about weapons from them.
All the weapon materials here are essential.
Catching fish involves baiting, hooking, and reeling them in.
Fresh catches, plump and juicy. Want to take one home?
Angling Bait for sale. Try them, and you'll see.
Who says fishing hooks are only for angling? Just look at this vast lake, and the ripples that keep me company.
During the day, you're angling sunlight and cloud drifts. At night, you're reeling in stars. How could it ever get boring?
Quiet... seems like fish are coming.
Hope today brings a bountiful harvest.
Fish meat available. Please help yourself.
If you need angling bait, we have top-quality options available.
I've been angling here for quite a while, and my heart has become as calm as the waters.
Tempering your mind is part of angling.
Goodbye, I'll continue waiting for fish.
Angling requires a calm and peaceful mind.
If it's not fresh, I'll catch one on the spot.
That's hilarious. One angling bait pack per angling rod, one small fish per day.
I just set up the trap. Fish will definitely take the bait!
Goodbye, I'll keep waiting for fish to bite.
The way of nature runs through all things.
Are you here for some peace too?
I only have angling goods here.
If you ever wish to escape into the tranquility of nature, buy something and start angling.
Well... everyone has their own way of angling.
Angling is about the spirit of the sport, not necessarily the catch. Ahem... well, just focus on the process.
Finally, someone to take over. I should use this chance to take down some notes. They will prove useful in the future.
Be patient with the Croakies... They get hungry often, so always keep some food on hand...
I also need to learn some of their language for easier communication.
Let me write down what I learned today first.
When they rapidly flap their forelimbs and make short, sharp croaks, it means they're angry...
Taking care of animals is an art in itself. It can be quite complicated.
Be patient, Yanhui. Don't move the rod too often, or you'll scare the fish away.
As they say, "Wind and waves come and go, yet I sit unbothered in my fishing boat." Patience is key in fishing.
I'd say we should do less talking. We haven't caught a single fish all day.
We promised everyone we'd prepare the animals a big feast.
As Anglers, it's embarrassing we can't catch even one fish.
The camp was set up by all the Societies, but it feels like we're the only ones who haven't contributed...
This... this is just bad luck. Don't worry, we won't go back empty-handed.
I just used my Sorcery Energy on these unique blue plants, and I felt a mysterious force around me.
I saw the energy rising and falling in these plants — their growth and decay over time.
That was unlike anything I've ever seen or felt.
These animals are really smart, especially the Croakies. They always communicate with me in their special language.
Hey, I just had an idea. If I could teach them Martial Arts, they could protect themselves when they have to.
If they were half as good as me, I wouldn't have to worry about them getting bullied when I'm not around.
But given their characters, I doubt they'll fight back even if they can... Maybe I need to come up with another idea.
See that mass of red and white clouds in the distance?
I've never seen anything like this before. What could possibly be causing this phenomenon? And why here?
I can't figure it out... It seems the only option is to consult the books.
Do you know why the grass and trees here are all blue?
My guess is someone dyed them this way intentionally.
Maybe it's the big bird I read about in the book yesterday. It said it could fly high, really high.
It's possible it took the color of the sky and spilled it here.
Or maybe it's a keeper of the blue sky, taking it away every day before dark and...
... And dropping some of it here by accident.
If I ever get a chance to meet it, I'll definitely ask it about this.
You found it? Thank you so much!
I'll go find my careless brother now.
Oh, right, I saw a few shadows while climbing earlier. They were fast, heading up the mountain. They didn't look like Jixia students.
You should look out for them.
Oh, I'm beat. I can't climb anymore.
He didn't wait for me, not even for a second. What kind of brother is that?
Ugh... I can't go on... I'm done.
I can't see him anymore. He's probably reached the cliff above the plank road by now.
You climbed up all by yourself without waiting for me? What kind of big brother are you?
zh_text: 一个人自己爬上去了也不等等我，哪有这么当哥哥的。
source_text: 一个人自己爬上去了也不等等我，哪有这么当哥哥的。
official_target_text: You climbed up all by yourself without waiting for me? What kind of big brother are you?
official_en_text: You climbed up all by yourself without waiting for me? What kind of big brother are you?

text: Do you know where Xiao Shuke's key is?
Do you know where Xiao Shuke's key is?
The key? I left it at the spot he told me to, by the <001>plank road corner</>.
He might have forgotten. He can be quite careless sometimes.
He's also quite impatient, going up by himself like that.
I... I'm not exactly in top physical condition. I really don't have the strength to climb again.
Sorry for talking so much all at once. I need to rest a bit now...
Thank you. I'll go find that careless brother of mine now.
Oh, right, I saw a few shadows while climbing earlier. They were fast, heading up the mountain. They didn't look like Jixia students.
You should look out for them.
Wow, I didn't realize how high this was until I started climbing.
But this kind of training is necessary if I want to join the School of Martial Arts.
I can work on my stamina, but I don't think I can overcome my fear of heights easily.
But that's alright. As long as I'm fast enough, I won't have time to think about the height.
Betta hates working out. He's probably still catching his breath down below.
He is just... Huh, where's my key?
Did you happen to see a <001>key</> nearby? It's... very important to me. Could you help me look for it? Thank you.
You found it already? Thank you so much!
By the way, I saw a group of suspicious people earlier. I gotta find Betta quickly and make sure he's okay.
My brother <001>Xiao Bayt</> might have it.
Only the two of us know about this key. Please ask him if he knows where it is. Thanks.
Speaking of which... he should have come to me by now. Could you help me look for him nearby?
Found it! Thank you so much!
I just remembered Betta had told me where the key was. How could I forget something like that?
By the way, while you were away, I saw a group of people acting suspiciously.
I need to hurry and find Betta. Make sure he's safe.
Oh, you found it! Thank you so much!
By the way, I saw a group of people acting suspicious. No telling what they're up to.
I need to hurry and find my brother, Betta, to make sure he's safe.
Hi there! Sorry, I'm a tourist. Do you know any must-see places around here?
You'd be surprised. Have you been to that famous ruin to the south? The Bronze Mechcrafts there are truly amazing.
Bronze Mechcrafts... I'll definitely have to check that out. Is that all?
There's another stunning sight right in the middle of that lake. It's a swirling red and white mist.
You absolutely don't want to miss it.
Got it... Thank you so much.
When I see Man Shuh, should I thank her or apologize first...?
These stones must have absorbed a lot of natural energy.
Hmm, this should be a good spot. I'll train here.
Why else would so many animals gather here? They must be sensing energy we can't perceive.
Hehe, that's a great idea. I could never come up with such stories.
Now they'll finally see me in a different light, since I'm the one spreading the word first...
Do you know a lot about strange rocks?
Do you know a lot about strange rocks?
Oh, huh? Haha, who else could it be? Are you here for a visit too?
Those stones are quite interesting, but they just showed up overnight and are getting more numerous. Take a closer look around.
Oh, and could you keep an eye out for <001>a pair of gloves</>? They're important to me.
If you find it, I'll trade you for the latest gossip. It's not like the Stonecliff, I haven't told anyone about it yet.
Is this pair of gloves yours? I see your name on them.
Is this pair of gloves yours? I see your name on them.
Ah... no... it's not mine... I didn't lose anything.
Besides, there are lots of people with similar names. I don't need all their missing stuff.
They are not mine. The name on them spelled different.
You should just throw them away. I can help you if you like.
Never mind, I'd better find the owner.
Never mind, I'd better find the owner.
That's right. I moved these rocks here at night a while ago. Put them in various shapes.
Look, are these your old gloves?
Look, are these your old gloves?
You actually found it? Let me see... Yes, this is it! Thank you so much.
You know me, I'm just a loser who can't sweet-talk.
I never had friends growing up, except for the one who gave me these gloves. That's why they mean so much to me.
I've kept it safe all this time, but now it's gone. Maybe he doesn't approve of me either.
So, you planned the Strange Rock Cliff incident?
So, you planned the Strange Rock Cliff incident?
If everyone likes this tale, they'll naturally like the one who "discovered" it first—me. That's what I thought.
Flashy tricks only grab attention for a moment. Only sincerity can bring true friendship.
Flashy tricks only grab attention for a moment. Only sincerity can bring true friendship.
Stop lecturing me! Once I'm mentally prepared, I'll have to go listen to Man Shu's nagging. Oh dear...
Man Shuh became my friend without me seeking attention. I forgot about that...
Right, I promised to tell you something interesting. While moving rocks, I spotted a <001>cave</> that seemed untouched.
There might be treasures hidden inside. Go check it out if you're interested.
Hello there. Are you here to visit the Strangestone Cliff too?
I finally finished my homework and was about to relax, but guess what? I ended up discovering something worth studying.
Look, is something underneath this strange rock? Even if only a bit is exposed, there might be a great mystery hidden inside.
Guess I'm not meant for resting! I could use a hand, you think you can help?
Sorry, I forgot to explain. You don't need to come in person. I've asked Ray to borrow a Mechanoid from the academy.
It's just taking him so long to return, I'm worried he might be lost.
I must stay here and figure out how to set up the Mechcrafts. Could you go to the <001>north exit</> and welcome him for me?
I have other matters to attend to.
Alright, I'll wait a bit longer... I hope Ruie is okay.
Thanks so much! I was getting really worried. Hold on, let me work my magic.
Wow, this stone is heavy. I might need my Mechanoid to help move it...
No need. It was hard work getting it back. You rest.
Well, this trip was pretty much a waste. But hey, you can't expect to catch fish every time you cast a line.
But I heard the stone just appeared out of nowhere. How did it happen to land on a glove?
Never mind, that's not my concern. These gloves are tattered, take them if you want, or I'll toss them.
That is quite strange. Let me take a look.
That is quite strange. Let me take a look.
Based on what I've learned, these animals are just curious about the new environment.
It's not like what Mingxi said. About some special energy drawing them here.
The animals haven't formed a stable ecosystem yet, which suggests this area hasn't been here for long.
It's nice to see these stones bring some excitement to the villagers' simple lives.
If only the origin of this strange cliff wasn't like that...
Do you know the origin of the Strangestone Cliff?
Do you know the origin of the Strangestone Cliff?
Yeah, I do. And I'm actually quite worried. I'll tell you the whole story, but keep it to yourself, okay?
My friend He Wei isn't good at making friends. He always tries to bring joy to others so that they would be willing to talk to him.
This time they went all out, using the Mechcraft lifter to move rocks and create this strange rock cliff.
I think it's time we talked to him. But he's quite sensitive, so we can't just confront him directly.
I've got a new pair of gloves for him. His old ones were lost when moving stones.
He knows me well. If you could remind him for me, that'd be great.
If I'm not mistaken, these strange rock formations were likely the work of some martial arts master practicing their skills and splitting mountains.
I will stand by my opinion until there is conclusive evidence that proves otherwise.
People are still puzzled by these stones. Haven't they heard stories of martial arts training?
Ugh, I'm exhausted. It looks small but it's surprisingly heavy.
Li Zhao sent me to find you. Are you lost?
Li Zhao sent me to find you. Are you lost?
What? You got lost? Oh, this Mechanoid must be too heavy. It used up all its energy and can't move anymore.
He really needs it. We're almost done. Can you help us out?
Alright, I'm curious about your research.
Alright, I'm curious about your research.
You're so kind. Then I'll leave it to you. Be careful not to strain your back.
No, why is this road so long...
Dragging this Mechanoid along, it must be so heavy...
Li Zhao should have started his research by now.
I'll go find him in a bit...
I hope this time I can uncover the truth about the Strangestone Cliff.
Yesterday, I saw some vague images during a divination. Now they seem as elusive as fleeting illusions to me.
Moonlight, dark stone crevices, vague shadows, and... a hand?
My divination technique is still lacking. I'll do it again tonight when it's quiet.
Look, are these your old gloves?
Look, are these your old gloves?
You actually found it? Let me see... Yes, this is it! Thank you so much.
To be honest, I'm a loser, not good at anything, and I don't know how to say nice things. I've never really had friends.
But the one who gave me these gloves was willing to play with me, so I cherish it and keep it as a friend by my side.
I came to the academy alone. We haven't seen each other for a long time.
But it's okay. Thanks to my discovery of Strange Rock Cliff, many visitors come here now. I really enjoy chatting with them.
If he knew I had so many friends now, he'd be happy too. By the way, do you know Man Shuh?
If you see her, ask where she's been lately. It's been a while. I hope she's not upset about my new friends.
I compared these strange stones with the ones from the hill, and they seem to be of the same type.
Additionally, there are clear drag marks around them...
I'm almost certain that they were transported from there.
I have some other things to take care of. Goodbye.
I have some other things to take care of. Goodbye.
The texture and layering of these strange stones resemble the rocks around the nearby mountains...
I wonder if I can find more clues by investigating further.
These stones have worn me out. Look, my hands are all rubbed raw.
Can you help me get that stone over there? I'll tell you a surprising discovery in exchange.
It's on that pile of rubble to my right. Ouch, my hands hurt so much. Could you help a poor soul, please?
Well, I'll tell you once you bring me the stone.
Oh? Another pair of gloves. Where did these come from?
If you want to be friends with me, you don't have to send me gloves like Novar, haha.
It wasn't me, it was Man Shuh. She also wanted me to tell you that seeking attention this way is not right.
It wasn't me, it was Man Shuh. She also wanted me to tell you that seeking attention this way is not right.
But she has been keeping an eye on you, and she's worried. She knows about the strange cliff.
But she has been keeping an eye on you, and she's worried. She knows about the strange cliff.
Tsk... Ah, she knew everything? And she told you all about it? I just wanted to make more friends, you know.
I messed up again? Right, I'll go thank her and get a lecture... She always does that.
Did you really orchestrate the Strange Rock Cliff incident with your own hands?
Did you really orchestrate the Strange Rock Cliff incident with your own hands?
That's right. I moved these rocks here at night a while ago. Put them in various shapes.
If everyone likes this tale, they'll naturally like the one who "discovered" it first—me. That's what I thought.
Flashy tricks only grab attention for a moment. Only sincerity can bring true friendship.
Flashy tricks only grab attention for a moment. Only sincerity can bring true friendship.
Stop lecturing me! Once I'm mentally prepared, I'll have to go listen to Man Shu's nagging. Oh dear...
Man Shuh became my friend without me seeking attention. I forgot about that...
Right, I promised to tell you something interesting. While moving rocks, I spotted a <001>cave</> that seemed untouched.
There might be treasures hidden inside. Go check it out if you're interested.
Universal Mech-Man? If we use a Mech-Man, we won't have to run around so tiringly. That sounds good.
zh_text: 万能机关人？用机关人的话就不用这么累地跑来跑去了，那挺好。
source_text: 万能机关人？用机关人的话就不用这么累地跑来跑去了，那挺好。
official_target_text: Universal Mech-Man? If we use a Mech-Man, we won't have to run around so tiringly. That sounds good.
official_en_text: Universal Mech-Man? If we use a Mech-Man, we won't have to run around so tiringly. That sounds good.

text: The materials for the Universal Mech-Man are quite cheap. If it participates in the earlier combat assessments, it will probably be smashed to pieces in a few hits.
zh_text: 万能机关人的材料比较廉价，参加前面的战斗考核的话，估计三两下就被砍坏了。
source_text: 万能机关人的材料比较廉价，参加前面的战斗考核的话，估计三两下就被砍坏了。
official_target_text: The materials for the Universal Mech-Man are quite cheap. If it participates in the earlier combat assessments, it will probably be smashed to pieces in a few hits.
