text: This pull Mechcraft controls the circuit's direction. It looks simple but actually tests your observational skills.
Want to give this Mechcraft a try?
Make sure you've got everything before pulling the lever. You don't want to fail just one step short.
It's so good to be young. I see those lads bouncing around at the foot of the mountain every day.
Yes, I've been doing so every morning for days now. Got a hungry young man to feed.
Said he needed to work on this big Mechcraft, and that he's been sleeping here...
I don't want to see him starve, so I figure I'd bring him some lunch. It's no trouble.
These students make quite exceptional Mechanoids.
Especially those Mechcraft weapons they wield... I'd really like to try them out myself.
And they follow their combat strategies well.
Those with shields handle melee attacks, while those with cannons provide long-range fire support. Hmmm, impressive.
I'm in huge trouble. There is no way I can pass this challenge...
I didn't expect my exam to include a shooting test. I don't know how to aim at all!
Do you know how to do it? Could you please set an example for me?
But those creatures didn't get me! I was just too careless to dodge it in time!
You look like you've got some skills. How about a little lizard hunting?
That group of lizards is over there, in the northern valley.
How about "Wolong Fellowship"? Let's make Senior Zhuge's name even more famous.
zh_text: “卧龙同友会”怎么样，让诸葛学长的名号越打越响。
source_text: “卧龙同友会”怎么样，让诸葛学长的名号越打越响。
official_target_text: How about "Wolong Fellowship"? Let's make Senior Zhuge's name even more famous.
official_en_text: How about "Wolong Fellowship"? Let's make Senior Zhuge's name even more famous.

text: The "Star-Chanting Society" fits the senior's temperament perfectly—like a star in the sky, so brilliant, worshipped by the world.
zh_text: “诸星咏明会”就很契合学长他的气质，宛如天上明星，如此闪耀，被世人崇拜。
source_text: “诸星咏明会”就很契合学长他的气质，宛如天上明星，如此闪耀，被世人崇拜。
official_target_text: The "Star-Chanting Society" fits the senior's temperament perfectly—like a star in the sky, so brilliant, worshipped by the world.
official_en_text: The "Star-Chanting Society" fits the senior's temperament perfectly—like a star in the sky, so brilliant, worshipped by the world.

text: Hey there, do you want to come play with me? Some fun time always cheers me up whenever I'm feeling down.
Thanks, but I think I'll just stay here and enjoy the breeze for a while... I'm just as banal as they come.
It's all because I haven't worked hard enough. You reap what you sow, no excuses.
Reap what you sow... Is it about gardening? My family does grow apples. Do you want one?
Aren't you a little optimist? Keep the apples for yourself, and thank you.
You're saying that there's no food I can find in this beautiful place?
Not only does the posthouse ahead offer no meals, but even the supply pods along the way are empty.
Our own food supplies cannot be carried into the maze, and the storage lockers at the posthouse are all occupied...
Oh, that is terrible news to hear... Still, thank you both for the information.
Beautiful scenery should come with delicious food. I'll discuss this with the person in charge at the posthouse later.
It's got so noisy here lately. I don't like it.
That's because several of the academy's tests are scheduled at the Wondrous Maze, and there are those fanatical Kongming fans...
I know you're right, but I just find them all annoying.
And that is because you care only about the training with Mechanoids. You should try to find some more hobbies!
Now I find you noisy too. I'm going to slip away to a quiet place with no one around.
I'm in the middle of my special training — shuttle run until the sun sets.
One day, I'll be the best student in the School of Martial Arts.
Then, I'll break the record for the fastest completion of the Wondrous Maze!
What a stroke of luck — such a marvelous ruin here! There must be many valuable artifacts inside.
Tang insisted I carry so many explosives. A resourceful Seeker like me doesn't need such crude methods to enter a ruin.
Just wait and see how I do my job. Effortlessly.
Y-you, how could you! I... I...
You've ruined everything! I'll definitely report this to Master Fuzi, just you wait!
We must root out this hidden traitor, otherwise it will only lead to more trouble later.
zh_text: 一定要把这个潜伏的破门生给揪出来，否则到时候只会滋生出更多的麻烦。
source_text: 一定要把这个潜伏的破门生给揪出来，否则到时候只会滋生出更多的麻烦。
official_target_text: We must root out this hidden traitor, otherwise it will only lead to more trouble later.
official_en_text: We must root out this hidden traitor, otherwise it will only lead to more trouble later.

text: I've heard the saying “Since there is Yu, why must there be Liang?” Who do you think was actually more capable?
zh_text: “既生瑜，何生亮”我也是听过，你觉得他们两个到底谁更厉害呢？
source_text: “既生瑜，何生亮”我也是听过，你觉得他们两个到底谁更厉害呢？
official_target_text: I've heard the saying “Since there is Yu, why must there be Liang?” Who do you think was actually more capable?
official_en_text: I've heard the saying “Since there is Yu, why must there be Liang?” Who do you think was actually more capable?

text: Ugh. The thing breaks, I fix it, and it gets broken again. This can't go on forever.
I'm in charge of the road maintenance in this area. But the scaffold I just fixed got destroyed by bears again.
Hmm... But if we don't do something, other planks might get damaged too.
Hmm... But if we don't do something, other planks might get damaged too.
Anyway, since you're here, could you help me get rid of those bears over there?
No problem. Leave it to me.
No problem. Leave it to me.
Thank you so much. Oh, if you want to go up, you can use the scaffold over there...
The work is not done yet, but with your skills, it shouldn't be a problem.
All the trees here have this curious blue color. What could be the cause?
Hmm... I need to note this down.
There's something strange about this tree, but I can't put my finger on it...
Could there be some sort of Mechcraft nearby?
This hut is strange. How do we get in?
Come here, little Croaky. Say I give you three beans and then take one back. How many do you have left?
You can answer by shouting or write the answer on the ground with your paws.
You can't stump it with such a simple question. At least make it a math problem in the double digits!
I hope he doesn't turn my pot into some Sorcery Artifact...
Don't worry. He's researching how Sorcery Energy can help with cooking. It's not like he's doing some spellcasting experiment.
You are not wrong, but still... Can Sorcery student really cook?
Where did that come from? That's a bit rude.
Those Sorcery students don't mess around. When you get your pot back, it'll probably be shinier than a brand-new one!
Why is there a Fluffy here?
Are you lost? There's a Fluffy gathering spot nearby, did you come from there?
Say if I'm really starving, is it that bad if I sneak in some snacks?
You do know if you eat in the study room, it'll attract a lot of animals, right?
And then they'll get caught. I see.
Not only that, but those animals might secretly steal our knowledge and take over the academy. Then you'll be the one to blame.
He is so slow! I've been waiting for hours.
He said we would go check out the Aerflow Towers and the cute animals...
Has he got so wrapped up in reading that he forgets about me again?
Indeed. This arrangement reminds me of the Starmap on the Stargazing Terrace...
Could it be the work of that legend? Let's check it out.
Uh... aren't we here to see the creatures?
As if stones could grow legs and run off! But if we're late, we might not even catch a glimpse of those mysterious creatures!
Turn around for me, you cute little one! Turn again!
You're just as energetic as usual.
Hey, wait a second, I'll go get some food for you. Be right back, okay?
So this is how Aersilk works in farming. Impressive...
This Aersilk shovel looks nothing special, but it turns out to be so useful.
I heard the Crafters are really good at making this stuff. I should get some for my parents.
In ancient times, there was a shadow that covered the sun, with fur as white as frost, and four legs that supported the heavens...
It says that a Preydator will transform into a divine beast one day after reaching adulthood.
That's unbelievable. What could trigger this kind of... evolvement?
I should ask the author if this is based on fact.
Excuse me, do you have any books on Aerflow Towers?
Of course! Are you looking for books on their design or their history? We have plenty of options.
Oh, that's great! Could I borrow all of them?
Ha, it looks like you got nicked by the Fastrelease Chesspiece while exploring the ruins, didn't you?
Just thinking about it makes me mad. How could those Mechcraft students let their creations cause trouble for others like this?
I need to report this to the School of Mechcraft and at least get them to compensate for my damaged clothes!
Those Fastrelease Chesspieces are meant to protect the ruins from beasts or Rebels.
Consider yourself lucky you weren't injured! After all, you went inside without permission.
Ugh, you're right. Guess I won't be getting that money for new clothes...
Recently, wild beasts have been sighted in the vicinity, which may pose a threat to small animals nearby.
Do you know what kind of beast they are? It would be easier to handle the situation with the right approach.
I don't know for sure, but I did see traces in the bushes and some large footprints on the road. Could be from Wolvines.
Let's stay sharp for now. I'll get some beast repellent from the Herbalists just in case.
Ugh... I'm so tired. Let me think how to get there again...
First through here, then that way, and finally through a forest... Okay.
They don't need to go so far for herbs! There are a few good ones nearby that can also be used to treat animal injuries.
If what they find isn't as effective as my Lonely White Orchid, I'll definitely make fun of them.
I've been wanting to bring you here for a while! So what do you think? Aren't these little animals adorable?
Yes, very much. Can you tell me more funny stories about them?
Sure! Would you like to hear about the Preydator or the Scholarly Tiger? Oh, let's start with the Ink Lion. You'll definitely like it.
The Ink Lion is able to camouflage itself to blend in with the surroundings. A rock, for example.
Kids around here often mistake it for a real stone and get scared when it suddenly moves.
Let's see if we can spot one today! Let's go!
It's so nice to see them bonding with animals. It really lifts the mood.
If I didn't sneeze around them, I'd definitely cuddle every one of them.
Too bad I forgot my allergy meds. Next time, I'll grab some herbs from the Herb Society before coming.
Lengmei, I heard that a Scholarly Tiger can turn into a folding screen. Is that true?
I've never seen it with my own eyes. Maybe you should just ask one?
Haha, joke with me all you want. Next time, I'll check every folding screen in the academy.
And if the rumors are true, maybe we could collect their fur and make a changing folding screen ourselves.
Now aren't you a clever one? But Scholarly Tigers don't molt, so your plan won't work.
Can you show me your belly, my cute little Scholarly Tiger? Let me give you a body checkup—
Why are you being so uncooperative today? Are you upset? Feeling sad or did you get bullied?
I see. Do you want to take a lesson? I'll find a textbook and read it to you.
I rarely get to observe Fluffies up close. I'll keep a close eye on them.
They say magical creatures can sense weather changes before they happen. I'll test it today!
Based on Stargazing Terrace's forecast, next... Huh? Where's my weather report?
I don't want to get close! I'm scared.
It's okay, Sennie. They're very friendly.
Yeah, I'll hold your hand. How about we pet it together?
Hmm... You go first. I want to take my time.
Oh, look! It's circling around you! It must like you, Sennie!
See? Fluffies love children. Go ahead and play with it!
Wow! Haha, I think it wants to be my friend!
Their history as pets goes back a long, long time.
Since the development of the Fluffy is strongly influenced by the environment...
How to shape their growth has always been a hot topic.
The intervention must be done during their juvenile phase.
Once they reach adulthood, it's hard for them to adapt to new surroundings.
Hehe, you're so cute. Come on, shake hands with me!
Shihan, are you even listening to me?
Once they reach adulthood, Fluffies become dependent on the environment in which they grew up and struggle to adapt to new ones.
zh_text: 一旦成年，毛茸茸就会对它长大的环境产生依赖，再难适应新的环境了。
source_text: 一旦成年，毛茸茸就会对它长大的环境产生依赖，再难适应新的环境了。
official_target_text: Once they reach adulthood, Fluffies become dependent on the environment in which they grew up and struggle to adapt to new ones.
official_en_text: Once they reach adulthood, Fluffies become dependent on the environment in which they grew up and struggle to adapt to new ones.

text: Why is this Fluffy so touchy?
Oh? You said your friend got lost?
Don't worry, maybe it's just wandering around nearby? I'll wait with you for it to return.
Haha, you're so cute! Do you want to come home with me?
But Mom and Dad said that if I want to bring you home, I need to spend more time with you first.
They also said something about filling out documents at the Hunting Society...
I don't understand what for. Can't we just tell them you're coming to play with me?
Never mind. How about a game of tag next?
I'm not exaggerating this time. You've got to trust me!
It's not my fault you love to boast! Is the elevator going up that high?
It's true! It'll lead you straight to the top where you can see the Tower of Enlightenment! You can see it for yourself!
Well... these observation data are really strange.
What's wrong? Do you need any help?
What's wrong? Do you need any help?
The trajectory of the star is consistent with our prediction, but it is moving much faster for some reason unknown...
Sorry... my mind wandered off just now.
If you want a tour, go find Lu Miao.
Hi, your friend asked me to give this to you.
Hi, your friend asked me to give this to you.
So Lu Miao decided to share our research with others after all.
You can access all the data we've found.
If you find any data with red markings, could you please bring it to me?
Hmm... The numbers are still a bit off and require more rigorous verification.
I'm sorry, but I need to get on with my work.
Thank you! I'll go back and compare the notes thoroughly. Maybe we'll finally have a breakthrough.
That's great, really great. Thank you so much!
Are the laws of all things, both past and future, really within the trajectories of these stars?
But... how does it work exactly...
Oh, hello. I'm sorry about that.
Oh, I got lost in thought.
By the way, what do you think of astronomy?
Everyone believes that the movement of the stars and the universe follow certain rules.
My friend Dashee is nearby. Show this to him, and he'll share with you something very interesting.
It's the mission of us Stargazers to study them, and only by following these rules can we understand and predict nature.
Are the laws of all things, the past and the future, truly written in the paths of the stars...
zh_text: 万物规律，过去将来，真的在这群星轨迹之中吗……
source_text: 万物规律，过去将来，真的在这群星轨迹之中吗……
official_target_text: Are the laws of all things, the past and the future, truly written in the paths of the stars...
official_en_text: Are the laws of all things, the past and the future, truly written in the paths of the stars...

text: This is our secret observation site. It's much smaller than the Stargazing Terrace, but it works for us.
Still, this is not my first choice. I'm just based here for now until our work gets the recognition it deserves.
The pursuit of knowledge shouldn't be influenced by external factors. That's what I've been telling myself.
Peining called me over here just to find a few parts?!
Anyway, I'll find them for him first so that the students can take their exam. He owns me big time.
But... what do those parts look like again?
Aoxue mentioned there are Staring Gent fields here, but I've searched for a long time and haven't found any.
Could they be near the trial Mechanoids? I'd be in deep trouble if I get surrounded by them.
Wait a minute. Can I find some other herbs instead?
I need to find something that breaks fever, improves vision, and relieves pain. Let me think...
Have you heard about the treasure rumors?
Treasure? Where? Is it on an island, or in a mountain cave, or underground?
Nope, you're all wrong. The students from the academy say it's behind the waterfall nearby.
The waterfall? Then what are we waiting for? Let's set off before others do!
I've been feeling pretty good lately. Maybe it's time for me to take the exam. How will I know if I can pass if I don't give it a shot?
But... what if I fail? That would look so bad...
Last time, I got smacked in the face by a Mechanoid's big shield, and my face swelled for days...
Hmm, maybe I'm still not quite ready yet. Gonna need more work...
Hmm, the terrain here is steep and rugged enough. Perfect.
This is so very ideal for my climbing practices.
I'll do five rounds today. Then I need to head to Twin Peaks for an exchange on footwork.
Zhiyu, these Mechanoids are so powerful. Do you have any tips for defeating them?
You're from the School of Mechcraft. I'm sure you know them better than we do.
Alright, let's start with the basics of a Mechanoid!
The most important part of a Mechanoid is its Mech Core, followed by the Aersilk lines connected to it.
The Mech Core decides its functionality, while the Aersilk is responsible for signal transmission.
There are exceptions, though, like a senior once developed a small Mechanoid without a Mech Core...
Alright, thank you. That's, uh... really helpful.
See? Told you it was useless to ask these Mechcraft nerds.
I can see from here the entire layout of the Mechcraft Ruins.
I'll mark the positions of everything here for future investigations. I'm sure master will be pleased.
Speaking of which, where is Master? I hope he hasn't wandered off again.
Hmph, after observing for a while, I've figured out what to do.
To secure a quick victory, I must close the distance quickly to engage in close combat.
Just keep the pressure on and don't give any opening, and that will do it.
I noticed during training that those Mechcraft Ruins over there are really something else.
Yes, I've heard that there's ancient treasure hidden within these ruins.
I'm not sure, but I know many people are trying to find out.
There's even a rumor that someone discovered an ancient Mechcraft behind a waterfall. And it's still in operation!
Maybe this mystic treasure is just lying there waiting to be found!
How is the view from here?
It's good enough. These Mechcraft Ruins are quite unique...
How should I put it? This place reminds me of a Mechcraft along the Path of Heroes — the one for climbing.
Oh, I remember it! I almost missed my step back there. Luckily, I reacted quickly and grabbed the edge.
Yes, I remember it too. I was worried sick down there when I saw you slip.
You? Worried about me? I don't buy it.
Your footwork has improved fast, Xiaocui.
Yes, and it's all thanks to you! I couldn't have done it by training alone.
You said earlier you have other plans tomorrow. Shall we reschedule our training then?
Of course not. We agreed to train together and pass the exam together, right? I will be here.
That's good, it's a deal then!
Linen often starts off strong in combat, but loses her stance just as quick. She needs to be more patient.
Shalan is better in this regard, but her strikes are a bit weak.
Talk is cheap, Gu Rui. Why not come spar with us? Practice is where true knowledge comes from after all.
Well, I-uh... I left my sword at home. I'll join you next time, I promise.
Drawing on the energy of the world is the foundation for improving your Martial Arts skills.
The energy of the world? What does that mean?
Oh, I understand now. It means connecting with nature. That's really insightful.
Martial arts refine the body, absorbing the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, drawing the essence of the sun and moon, in order to improve.
zh_text: “武道炼体，吸天地之灵气，汲日月之精华，为能精进。”
source_text: “武道炼体，吸天地之灵气，汲日月之精华，为能精进。”
official_target_text: Martial arts refine the body, absorbing the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, drawing the essence of the sun and moon, in order to improve.
official_en_text: Martial arts refine the body, absorbing the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, drawing the essence of the sun and moon, in order to improve.

text: I want to design a test that evaluates different parts of a student's Martial Arts skills. Any ideas?
Hmm... You could set up a series of challenges, each one testing a different skill.
Hmm, I'll think about it. Anything else?
You can ask my apprentice here. She's more creative than me in many ways.
You flatter me, Ms. Xunhan. I'm far from your level.
If I must say, you could combine both melee and ranged Mechanoids to make the combat more dynamic.
This proposal is great! You're definitely living up to your mentor's expectations.
Jiarong has been improving rapidly, with a steady footwork. I think he's ready for the exam.
But I think he still needs to work on his swordcraft. His strikes lack power, making him an easy target.
He's in such good form right now. I think he should give it a try. What if he passes?
I wouldn't be so confident like you. Some more preparation won't hurt.
Why isn't anyone asking for my opinion? I'm the one taking the exam...
Nice... I can feel my confidence coming back to me.
I'm going to take the test again. I will definitely pass this time!
Hey, you need to calm down first.
Last time, you were knocked out by the Mechanoids within seconds. Make sure to learn from that mistake.
The more you talk about it, the angrier I get. Those annoying things... I'll make 'em swallow my blows!
Students can come here for supplies...
Hmm, this is a business opportunity. There are simply not enough shops around here for all the students.
Injuries are common in Martial Arts tests. Now if I get some herbs like Skirtleaf Flower, Bellflower, and Eastern Reed Pipe...
I can also sell fruit juices made from Crackle and Striped Gourd. The students must be tired and thirsty after the challenge.
Okay, I'll start the preparation tonight.
There were just too many Mechanoids last time. Plus, I had an upset stomach the night before.
I fought hard all morning, but in the end, I was outnumbered and outpowered.
If I'd been in better shape, I could have taken on as many Mechanoids as there were.
So, you didn't pass in the end?
Well, it wasn't entirely my fault. There was no way I could anticipate everything.
That makes total sense. Thank you, Yaowen.
The key to passing the exam? I'm sure I don't know more than you. Why ask me?
Come on, you passed the test yesterday. Just give me some tips!
Well, I do have a secret trick... But don't be nervous. Just treat it as part of your daily training.
It seems that passing this exam requires both skills and tactics.
The exam is known for its high failure rate...
Don't rush. Take your time to observe.
You look downcast. Did you fail too?
Yeah... I was so close when I got thrown off guard.
Yeah, he's so strong and fast. How can we win?
So we're gonna set up an elevator like we have in all the other places?
Do you have any better ideas?
We could create a catapult device to launch people up here. It'd be faster and much more fun.
It's fast alright... but isn't it a bit dangerous?
Watching others fight is far more enjoyable than participating yourself. You don't have to worry about losing at all.
Plus, it's the perfect spot for spectators — cool breeze by the lake, beautiful scenery, and the soft grass...
I'd say it's one of the best things in life.
Look at the water and greenery here — what a beautiful place.
The gentle breeze is bringing me a sense of peace I've never felt before.
Taking a moment here between practice sessions is absolutely necessary.
Reproducing Dashing Wings? I thought the assignment was gonna be challenging.
I got my hands on a similar design during the climbing challenge in the Path of Heroes.
I must say, that experience was incredibly valuable. Really helped me with my later studies in Mechcrafts...
Wait, I'm getting distracted by the past again. I must concentrate on the task at hand.
Is this the waterfall with some ancient Mechcraft ruins behind it?
Just look at the velocity of the water... How could anyone build something like that here?
Interesting. I didn't expect such a huge surprise for my trip.
If I get everything figured out, maybe I'll become the next Master Crafter!
Why are there so many steles here?
According to our investigation, they are a crucial part of the entire ruins. But other than that...
Their function remains undetermined, which has led to all kinds of speculations.
Some believe they are communication Mechcrafts, while others think they were used for defensive purposes.
Defensive? Was there a war here?
It's quite possible, but we don't know the details.
The civilization that made these bronze structures probably perished because of that war.
I see... So these weathered stone pillars and Mechcrafts are the only things left...
Don't overthink it, Xiao Feng. What's in the past is in the past.
Our mission is to restore the forgotten history so that future generations will remember.
The exterior is made of bronze and rock, which makes the structure very sturdy.
But if some strong external force damages the outer structure, how can we ensure the integrity of the inside?
Hmm, you are right. I need to think about it...
Hmm, Bellflower, Bitewood, Eastern Reed Pipe... There are quite a few types of plants here.
By the way, Hou Shuxuan is supposed to bring me some supplies. Why isn't she here yet?
Is she lost again? I made sure to give her very clear directions this time.
There are stone tablets scattered around the ruin. Be it intentional or random, it should be some kind of Mechcraft design.
What on earth does it mean by "intentional or random"?
Can I trust this book or not?
There are scattered stone tablets at the mechanism ruins. Their arrangement seems to have a pattern, yet also seems random. It must be a type of mechanism.
zh_text: “机关遗迹处有散落石碑，其布置似有规律，似无规律。应是一种机关。”
source_text: “机关遗迹处有散落石碑，其布置似有规律，似无规律。应是一种机关。”
official_target_text: There are scattered stone tablets at the mechanism ruins. Their arrangement seems to have a pattern, yet also seems random. It must be a type of mechanism.
official_en_text: There are scattered stone tablets at the mechanism ruins. Their arrangement seems to have a pattern, yet also seems random. It must be a type of mechanism.

text: Half... Alright then, I'll go with you to take a look.
zh_text: 一半……那好，我就陪你们去看看。
source_text: 一半……那好，我就陪你们去看看。

official_en_text: Half... Alright then, I'll go with you to take a look.

text: Are there really Bronze Mechcrafts and rare treasures behind the waterfall? Can we trust those Seekers?
It does sound credible to me.
I'd pick this place if I were hiding something. Think about it — the waterfall as a natural cover and Mechcrafts as protection.
Of course it does. So just tag along now, and I'll let you see what rare treasures look like.
But the place's too dangerous. The two of us against the turbulent waterfall and those hefty Mechcrafts...?
I've made up my mind already. Go back to pack your things, and we'll meet at our usual spot tomorrow!
Yeah, the three of us are no match for them. What do you think we should do, Senior Zhixuan?
I think you were too reckless. You charged in without assessing the situation carefully.
Remember the last time at the Stargazing Terrace? I was still planning our strategy when you rushed in.
It's all Zhao Yue's fault. He's always acting on impulse.
Stop throwing that blame around! It's not like you weren't with me every time.
Any natural attractions around here? We've been wandering around aimlessly for a while now.
Yeah, it's all old ruins, bronze machines and stuff.
Natural attractions nearby? Let me think...
There's a beautiful waterfall by the bridge, and a lake up in the mountains. Also, I think these bronze ruins are quite beautiful too.
They are, but we've seen them too many times.
With my years of experience, I'm sure there are ancient Mechcrafts and gems around here.
If we sell them to the wandering merchants at Horizon Harbor, we could probably make a huge profit.
I agree. Looks like most of these things can be found in the ruins. What do you think? Should you go scout ahead?
Just me? How about we go together?
Don't be so scared. Let's split up and cover more ground.
Well... I think it's better if we have each other's back.
The ruins are up ahead... which means Senior Menki should be behind us.
But I was there earlier, and there was no sign of her.
Let me think... I remember a bridge, and there's a waterfall nearby. Then she should be there... or maybe to the left?
Bellflower, Eastern Reed Pipe, Beakshade, Silk Ginseng... and then what?
Ugh, I've got to write it down next time.
Let's go over the list again: Bellflower, Eastern Reed Pipe, Beakshade...
The Wondrous Maze is said to have several levels, each filled with ingenious Mechcrafts. Can you imagine how marvelous it is?
It does sound amazing. Could you tell us more?
How do you know so much about the Wondrous Maze?
The Wondrous Maze is a creation of Kongming, my biggest idol. Of course I know all about it.
I even bought a model of it back at my home.
If you're interested, I can take you to see it.
We're a bit busy right now. Let's call it a raincheck.
I don't think Eastern Reed Pipe is around here.
Seems like it... The books say this plant "looks like the musical instrument 'Sheng'." I really want to see the real thing.
Don't you Herb Society folks already have all sorts of herbs in your medicine chests? Why bother searching outside?
She's very strict. Said we can't mess with things used for healing.
If I find one myself, I can take my time to admire it.
Oh, a new disciple? And you dare to challenge Senior Kongming's trial?
Listen, if you want to challenge the Aerflow Tower, you have to get past me first.
If you can't even beat me, then tell me everything about other Aerflow Towers.
You defeated me? Impossible. It took me so much effort to occupy this trial point that is purely based on strength.
Indeed, brute force alone can never solve all of Senior Kongming's trials. Perhaps you still have a chance.
Ah, don't try to comfort me. I'm all brute force—I don't even qualify to challenge Senior Kongming.
Haha, you freshmen are really weak. You can't even beat me, and you still dare to challenge Senior Kongming?
Looks like I'm the strongest in the academy now.
Not bad at all! I didn't expect it to be such a fierce battle.
But I was holding back earlier. This time, I'll go all out. Take it.
I underestimated you. I'll go all out.
The bronze ruins? What's so special about them?
See those Mechcrafts inside? The technology is very different from what we've been taught.
And they're incredibly powerful. Judging by the tarnish, they're likely remnants from an ancient war.
Unfortunately, we may never know exactly what happened back then.
Finally, we can get some rest. Taking the kids out for travel is really tiring.
Being a mother is such tough work. Where should we go next?
How about we start with the Croaky Paradise? My girl's been begging to go for ages.
The Scholarly Tiger Park is nice too. We can stop by later if there's still time.
I'm sure the kids will love these places. Let's go, we shouldn't keep them waiting.
The Wanqiao Garden exhibition is about to start. I'm going to make a bear-shaped mechanical construct. Isn't that a great idea?
zh_text: 万巧园的展会要开始了，我要做一个熊型的机甲机关，是不是很有想法？
source_text: 万巧园的展会要开始了，我要做一个熊型的机甲机关，是不是很有想法？
official_target_text: The Wanqiao Garden exhibition is about to start. I'm going to make a bear-shaped mechanical construct. Isn't that a great idea?
official_en_text: The Wanqiao Garden exhibition is about to start. I'm going to make a bear-shaped mechanical construct. Isn't that a great idea?

text: Since the Ice Spike Bears arrived, my family hasn't gone deep into the river once.
These big guys love fish, and they have built a den for themselves already.
They're running wild on the mountainside. The academy must do something about it!
Don't worry, I'm sure actions will be taken sooner or later.
If a bear sees you, don't panic. They won't attack people from far away.
I get what you're saying, but it doesn't solve the problem. We can't just wait around.
Will the bears get angry if they see us? I'm scared.
They won't. We are nowhere near them or their den. They have no reason to get angry.
Look, they're probably taking their cubs out to catch fish.
So bears like fish and honey... Aww, the cubs look so cute.
But if they think their cubs are threatened, you can count on them going crazy at you.
Turning one-vs-many into many one-vs-ones? How is that supposed to work?
zh_text: 一对多变成很多次一对一？这要怎么实现？
source_text: 一对多变成很多次一对一？这要怎么实现？
official_target_text: Turning one-vs-many into many one-vs-ones? How is that supposed to work?
official_en_text: Turning one-vs-many into many one-vs-ones? How is that supposed to work?

text: The Wreckflame Lizard is just way beyond my league.
I just wanted a closer look, but it spotted me...
Then it got hot on my tail, and those flames... Even at a distance, I could feel the scorching heat.
Thank the Sages it hesitated when I cast my Ice Sorcery. Such a narrow escape.
I've chased off a few lizards, but there are just too many of them.
Must be related to that big electric one in the lake.
Why did it choose to nest here? Was it attracted by something?
Perhaps there's something special deep in the ruins at the lake's center...
Guess I'm counting on you again for the investigation, buddy.
But I'm a terrible fighter underwater. Looks like we should get backup from the academy before exploring further.
The lizards have been running rampant lately. We need to keep tourists away.
Let's just drive them all out. I've been itching for some practice!
These lizards are aggressive by nature. There must something in the lake that drew them here.
You're saying there's something even more dangerous underwater?
That's one more threat to deal with.
For now, ensuring everyone's safety is our top priority. Let's not waste time speculating. Time to head back.
Do you know why I brought you here?
To scout locations for stargazing tonight?
I think it's about stargazing, too...
Correct. I want to show you how starmaps and seasonal changes guide Jixia's agriculture.
Many of our Societies are established to study nature, while nature is intimately connected with the stars.
So stargazing isn't something esoteric. On the contrary, it's closely related to our daily lives.
Things are getting busy here. Must be a lot of work, caring for these rare plants.
Actually, I was hoping to talk to you about that...
Many tourists can't tell between public ruins and those still under excavation, right?
You're saying that us Seekers should set up protected areas for ruins, like you do with the herbs?
After putting up signs for rare plants, there have indeed been fewer people digging up the seedlings by accident.
You make a good point. I'll think about it after we deal with the matter at hand.
This angling Mechcraft is amazing! I don't even need to reel in the line myself.
The rod feels so good in hand too. It's truly a masterpiece of craftsmanship.
Okay, I get it. Now come home for dinner, okay? Mom's nagging again.
Hang on, let me catch a few more so she can try her fish soup recipe.
Mom already made soup. And if you don't go home soon, that soup is getting cold...
Whatever, stay here all you want. I'm going back myself!
I'm looking for pretty stones. According to the books, Saepes love them.
If I can find a bunch of them, I'm sure they'll play with me!
The Saepes aren't scary at all. They can be so fun as long as they like you!
Those lizards are getting close to the tourist areas. We should act quickly.
Are we gonna hunt them down? I'm ready for action!
What are you thinking? Our top priority is to keep tourists outside their territories. Don't act on your own!
Ugh, I don't get it. Why was I assigned to a group with you guys?
Fine, we'll listen to you. Let's keep people away from that lake first.
Then we get to beat the lizards up, right?
Please, just shut up. Or she'll beat you up first!
I've brought the tools for rubbing and digging.
You did? That's pretty impressive, Huai Li.
I've read all about the importance of tools on the books. So umm... I wonder if you can take me to the ruins with you?
The ruins are complex. We might run into Mechanoids, traps, and other unforeseen situations...
The one we're heading for today is relatively safe. It might not be a bad idea to get her some hands-on experience.
Well, it should be fine if there's no underground area... Alright, grab your tools, let's get moving.
These fallen pillars match the ones in the ruins. I see minimal signs of wear by humans.
But the fractures look unusual. It would take a sharp, gigantic weapon to achieve this.
Perhaps this place was also ravaged by that war, but I've never seen blade marks like these before...
What kind of gargantuan being could wield such an enormous weapon?
I think we need to talk to the investigation team before we can form a hypothesis.
Let's send word with the Big-eye Owlet first. There are still areas here we haven't explored.
No problem. I'll copy the stone tablets nearby so we can study the text.
When arranging these pillars according to Sorcery principles, I discovered a commonality...
This is a significant discovery! If we can reverse-engineer the formation of these cuts based on a specific pattern, we might be able to reconstruct the details of that battle!
There must be more secrets buried here. We need to be more thorough.
Let's head back later. We'll explore this place again with a fresh perspective, and I'm sure we'll make new discoveries.
Being tense all the time isn't good. Slowing down a bit is the key to balancing work and rest.
zh_text: 一直紧绷着不好，慢下来一点才是劳逸结合。
source_text: 一直紧绷着不好，慢下来一点才是劳逸结合。
official_target_text: Being tense all the time isn't good. Slowing down a bit is the key to balancing work and rest.
official_en_text: Being tense all the time isn't good. Slowing down a bit is the key to balancing work and rest.

text: Never expected such a majestic Mechcraft structure in Jixia Mountains.
At first glance, it's a complete whole, but if you look closely, each component is intricately connected...
Although the School of Mechcrafts is full of talents, only the best among the best could create such Aerflow Towers.
Climbing Aerflow Towers is too dangerous. Hardly the best way to enjoy the view.
Should I have turned left back there? I think I'm lost again.
I do get lost often, but as long as I can see the Aerflow Tower, I can find my way.
As long as you keep your eyes on the Aerflow Tower, you won't go wrong.
Finally, a chance to rest. This journey is endless.
I had no idea the Aerflow Tower would be so massive.
How did Senior Kongming create it? Can the Aerflow Weaver make something so big?
And each Aerflow Tower has a different trial. Are we really attending the same school?
I wonder if my mentor will let me build a Mechcraft this size for my graduation project.
It's been almost a year since we started observing these massive Aerflow Towers.
Just as my mentor said, they do stabilize Aerflow.
But if that were all, would they need such a massive device?
And was the trial Senior Kongming left really just coincidentally placed on the Aerflow Tower?
Looking at the Aerflow Tower, I feel as if I'm following the surge of Aersilk.
Dashing Wings could probably take me to that sea of clouds.
If I could leave my mark on Aerflow Tower, I'd have something to brag about to my senior.
There must be secrets hidden inside this mountain!
Why do I always hear it when I pass by...
But it seems they left empty-handed.
Are you here for the Aerflow Tower Trial too? If you're after the reward, you might want to reconsider.
I came here with faith, expecting the legendary Senior Kongming to have something in store for challengers.
But stumbling through to the end, only the cool breeze and drifting clouds remain.
Am I too pragmatic, or is he not as simple as we thought?
When I first got here, she insisted I see the giant tree on the mountain.
The blue leaves are beautiful, but I fear the outside. I wouldn't be here without a special reason.
I got some gossip from a senior. Just between us, okay?
That tree was where Senior Kongming often stayed before he graduated. I have to check it out.
Just looking up at the Aerflow Tower makes my legs wobble. This is the highest place I've been to recently.
I don't know if I can make it to the top. Last time, I passed out halfway up the mountain...
I envy those students. I heard they can undergo trials up there?
I hope I'll have a chance to overlook Jixia's beautiful landscape from high above someday.

zh_text: 万一飞到一半故障了怎么办……
source_text: 万一飞到一半故障了怎么办……

text: One, two, three... Is this the fourth Aerflow Tower? No, wait, fifth?
No, I just can't get the right number. Could it be five? But I did hear the senior say there were six.
One, two, three... Could it be seven? No, that can't be right.
One, two, three... is this the fourth cloud platform? No, it should be the fifth, right?
zh_text: 一、二、三……这是第四座云台？不对，应该是第五座吧？
source_text: 一、二、三……这是第四座云台？不对，应该是第五座吧？

official_en_text: One, two, three... is this the fourth cloud platform? No, it should be the fifth, right?

official_en_text: One, two, three... could it be seven? No, no, that must be wrong.

text: Tell you a secret... I'm a chosen one.
Hmm. These Aerflow Towers are far too suspicious... they were definitely built for something other than just collecting Aerflow energy.
These Mechcrafts must be hiding some dark secret. A very dark one.
As the chosen one, I will have to uncover the truth myself.
Just you wait, I will be the savior of Jixia.
My mentor asked me to keep an eye on all these challengers. Make sure they don't break anything.
But do you know how many Aerflow Towers there are? How can I keep track of them all?
Luckily, I have Chi Xia to help me. I will thank her properly when we get back to the academy.
Yesterday, she mentioned something about the trial north of here being the easiest.
Who's spreading these rumors? Well, I'd better check things out or my mentor will get upset again.
I'm new here and don't know much about Senior Kongming.
I'll get a better grasp of his style after trying a few Aerflow Tower Trials.
It's called Mechcraft instinct. People are like their Mechcrafts...
After the trial, I'll check out the stargazing spot on the nearby mountain. They say Senior Kongming once met a friend there.
Maybe there are some remarkable Mechcrafts there too.
So much Aersilk is gathered at the Aerflow Tower every day. What is it for?
I see. The Mechanoids in our trial are made from Aersilk, aren't they?
I'll craft the sturdiest Mechanoid with Aersilk.
So all the Mechanoids I scrapped, wasting all that precious Aersilk!
The Aerflow Towers are not just viewing trial platforms built by Senior Kongming, as the academy claims.
Besides, stabilizing Aerflow and collecting Aersilk doesn't require anything this complicated.
Could it be a variant of some combat mech?
I heard Zhou Yu's senior left him the Aerflow Tower trials. They must be tough.
Only something extraordinary can test such a astute person.
The purpose of the Aerflow Tower.
See those towering Mechcrafts on the mountainside? They're called Aerflow Towers.
It's a device the academy uses to collect Aerflow.
If you see an Aerflow Tower, you know you're not far from the academy.
But don't take it as a sign of which direction to take.
Otherwise, you'll definitely get lost, just like I did before.
There's more than one Aerflow Tower in the mountains, and they all look the same.
Students heading to Aerflow Tower for trials, please make sure you've registered with your instructor.
The trials Senior Kongming left are open to all challengers, but please refrain from intentionally damaging these facilities.
If you find any damage to the Aerflow Tower or facilities, please report it immediately. You can also tell me directly.
The mountain paths are crowded lately. Slow down, and watch out for stampedes.
Looks like you're up for a challenge. Gear up, and don't give up.
Think you can rile me up just like that?
That feral monster just now seemed almost disembodied.
Felt to me even the wind was obeying its command. Nearly swept us all into the sky.
I heard it's neither beast nor Mechcraft, but a creation of Sorcery Energy.
What should I do? If I fight it with Sorcery, would that work?
I've been staring at this test for ages. Still, no clue...
Still nothing? Want some tips then? I won't charge you too much.
I'll get you a gift later, okay? Spill it out!
You need to forget about that large sword on your back.
The Mechcraft here calls for a ranged weapon to be activated.
Is it that simple? I was thinking of throwing my sword to trigger it.
All you think about is swinging that thing. No wonder you're missing something so obvious...
The Three Immortals... what are they?
official_target_text: The Three Immortals... what are they?
official_en_text: The Three Immortals... what are they?

text: When can I take off these Telepathic Threads?
It's breaking the balance of my meridians. Better put those threads back.
Looks like Sorcery can't be rushed. I won't play with fire again!
Are you okay? I didn't expect this to happen...
I modeled this propulsion device after the Dashing Wings. Theoretically, it shouldn't have behaved like this.
The thrust was strong. Felt like I was soaring straight to the heavens.
But it was completely uncontrollable! My heart almost stopped when it took off.
I'm going back to camp to receive healing. You handle the rest...
That last match, you won by half a point.
Half a point? Surely it was more.
Hmph... How'd you spot my weakness?
It's weaknesses. You were full of openings.
You were too confident in your runes that you neglected defensive tactics.
You must change this if you want to win.
Hey! Why are you ignoring me again?
What's gotten into you? You've scared her.
I've had enough! Are all Mechcraft students so arrogant?
You're always tinkering with who-knows-what. This is supposed to be a trip for the three of us.
Can you be quiet? You're distracting me.
Maybe I should invent something to keep you quiet...
We've only explored half of this mountain. Can you keep going?
Don't worry about me. I can manage.
Umm... They told me to look after you during the trip. Said you might get tired easy.
So that's why you kept checking on me.
Yeah... It's my first field trip with you. Don't want nothing to go wrong, you know?
Thank you, I've gotten much better lately. And I appreciate all you've done for me along the way.
Hello, you must be Miss Cheng.
I'm an Astrologer. I know things.
Based on the trajectory of stars, we connect the past and present, then guide the way to the future. It's a profound art.
Ahem... Enough of that. So, are you interested in Astrology? Want to learn a thing or two with me?
I just don't like talking to people. It's more comfortable chatting with Croakies.
So many people come and go every day, but he's never come back.
I've always wanted to see him again. I'd never forget that powerful punch of his.
What was his name again? Fuzi something...?
Where do you think Sun Bin could be?
You've been looking for him for a while. Aren't you tired?
I need his help to crack a time delay Mechcraft. If I don't do it soon, my teacher will pass out in the room.
Does anyone know his whereabouts? Or maybe the good Sages can just send him over.
Am I speaking too softly? Feels like no one ever listens to me...
Last time I went out with a classmate of mime, he literally ignored me the whole trip.
Hey, you two! Talk to me!
Maybe the payment isn't enough...? Perhaps I need something other than money.
Mechcraft students like new gadgets. As for the farmer... maybe I'll try a fancy fertilizer?
How long have we been out here?
I'm not getting any ideas. What should we do?
Why don't we include the Aerflow Towers and the Path of Heroes in the dish?
We can make the "Aerflow Towers" crunchy, and give the "Path of Heroes" a mix of different flavors.
It's a masterpiece. The blade is sharp, and the steel whistles when swung.
But it might be a bit too heavy for you.
You're right. My fighting style focuses on agility, and this one does not match that well.
Choosing the right weapon is crucial in Martial Arts training.
I'm glad that you recognize your own strengths.
Don't worry, Luge. I'll pick something for you.
I know. You just want me to cure your friend's arm.
You know how he is. He just hates seeing doctors.
Last time I tried to take him to one, he gave me the cold shoulder for a month.
But if he doesn't get treatment soon, he might lose his arm.
He can't throw away his future like that. Can you help him, please? I'll talk sense into him.
I did not come here to fool around.
Neat. But it's not perfect yet.
Finally finished searching, let's go back and find that person.

text: The greatness of Jixia Academy was built by countless predecessors.
Jixia has changed so much over the years.
When we first arrived, it wasn't nearly this crowded.
You performed well in the Enlightenment Trials! It was a short time, but you've grown quite a bit.
Even though something like that happened on the field... don't be discouraged.
What are the masters talking about?
From Springbrook Plains to Aerfall Highlands' ancient ruins and the lively Jixia Academy...
Every place is full of delight. If you look closely, it reveals great beauty.
I hope you also possess a keen eye for discovery, so you may find what you are looking for.
I feel exhausted after reading books on Sorcery all day...

text: I'm about to graduate. I'll miss it here.
I wish I could become someone like Wuyan.
Are we too strict? Many students seem to avoid us.
It's our duty to keep everyone safe. Being strict is fine.
Remember Novar? He just rushed past the railing!
We must prevent that from happening again.
Master Mozi mastered Mechcraft by dismantling ten projects a day.
Really? I'll do it three hundred times to see if I can make any progress!
Leaving home to study at Jixia alone is stressful.
It's normal to feel anxious when everything is new.
I'm always worried I'm falling behind...
Don't worry. Once you learn, you're on equal footing.
The most important thing is to learn at a pace that works for you.
And remember that we are always here to help.
Should I continue my studies here or travel far away?
Oh, isn't this an old acquaintance? What's the matter, have time to visit Zhuangzi's classroom?
Yes, Master Zhuangzi's famous classroom at Jixia Academy.
Although Master Zhuangzi doesn't know where he went...
There's a collection of books on Sorcery, some of which are compiled by Master Zhuangzi.
Sorcery is personal. The key is to perceive its essence within the realms of nature.
Students use various tools and methods to channel Sorcery.
When was the Three Sages statue built?
Might be as old as the Tower of Enlightenment.
But he may be old, he's just as spirited as ever.
I want his stylish beard someday...
Don't miss Master Zhuangzi's classroom. I can show you around.
Don't be shy. Ask me anything!
Yes, Master Zhuangzi's famous classroom at Jixia Academy.

There's a collection of books on Sorcery, some of which are compiled by Master Zhuangzi.
Sorcery is personal. The key is to perceive its essence within the realms of nature.

Observe the world to see patterns in everything and understand how they relate to Sorcery.
Observe yourself by quieting your mind and listening to its resonance with Sorcery.
Come here anytime if you're into Sorcery.

The Bubble Fish is huge. It could take me around the world.
Which is harder to read: dreams or stars?

Studying celestial laws and predicting how they'll change is like reasoning with diagrams.
There's no right answer, and so much remains to be explored.
But elusive dreams are hard to fathom.
Dreams aren't just reflections of reality. Many factors turn them into shifting illusions.
Sometimes, even the dreamer can't explain their dreams.
It's alright. Feel free to find me if you change your mind.
Did you catch everything Master Fuzi taught?
Of course! I dare not miss a single detail!
Sigh, I really miss Master's lectures... When will he ever come back?
You, why weren't you this attentive when the Master was teaching?
The Student Affairs Committee is a bit too enthusiastic. What a pain...
I wish they'd give us some space.
Don't you think they're a bit too controlling?
We're not kids. We can take care of ourselves.
Well, some need the extra care... like those from the School of Martial Arts.
They warned me for not wearing my uniform in an outdoor class.
That's not a big deal, right?
Master Mozi's armor is so cool.
What's the point of being handsome? At a time like this, there isn't a single dean in the academy to take charge...
The Deans must have made arrangements, so don't you worry.
I can't believe how long I've been here already.
Will my old friends be surprised by my changes?
How are they doing in Chang'an?
What a pain... Their wild ideas wear us down.
How do we enforce rules without being bossy?

So many new students around here lately...

It feels awkward to start. Maybe I shouldn't...
Being a Discipline Overseer sure makes you lose friends...

We keep everyone safe, but deducting credits hurts my friendly image.
It keeps students in line, but they feel bad about it.
Actually, they can earn credits back.
By tutoring, maintaining facilities, or contributing creatively...

Everything is for everyone's safety... But deducting points like this really ruins my approachable image.

I saw you talking to her. How did it go?
She thought you were making excuses. You need to explain it yourself.
She thought you were making excuses. You need to explain it yourself.
When will she get over it...
I feel so hurt! I spent so much time putting together class notes for Bai Wenwen.
I even highlighted the essentials to help him prepare for the next exam.
Then he tells everyone they were his work! How could he do this?
So ungrateful. Have you talked to him?
So ungrateful. Have you talked to him?
No! I don't want to hear his excuses.
Can't believe he did that to me. I always help him out!
He didn't even apologize. I hate him!
He thought if everyone knew you compiled the notes, they'd bother you.
He thought if everyone knew you compiled the notes, they'd bother you.
He wanted to protect you from being overwhelmed.
He wanted to protect you from being overwhelmed.
After all my effort on those class notes! I'm done with him!
Calm down, do you want to hear Bai Wenwen's side?
Calm down, do you want to hear Bai Wenwen's side?
Really...? Why didn't he tell me that? Sounds like an excuse.
He didn't want to take credit. He wanted to protect you.
He didn't want to take credit. He wanted to protect you.
Just sharing notes. I don't need protection.
Yo, classmate, long time no see.
Wait, don't go! What do you think?
*Cough* Excuse me, can you do me a favor? *cough*
*Cough* Not really... Could you turn in this sick note for me?
Alright, won't keep you. I'll drag myself there.
I just, *cough* don't have the energy to do it myself. Gonna grab medicine from the Herbalists.
You seem fine—strong voice, rosy cheeks.
You seem fine—strong voice, rosy cheeks.
*Cough cough cough* I'm loud by nature. The red face is from coughing!
Just so you know, Frostcloud Town has released new hero-themed toys.
If the teacher asks, I'll play dumb.
If the teacher asks, I'll play dumb.
You're the best! It's great to have you here!
The teacher won't trouble a good student like you. Go on now. He's upstairs in the <001>Aisle of Knowledge</>.
It's more convincing if you do it yourself.
It's more convincing if you do it yourself.
And please don't compete with me for the new toys, okay?
Wow, that's pretty cold. Is that friendly air just a front?
This is a bad idea. They'll see through it.
I knew you wouldn't turn away a friend in need. Please!
Alright, won't keep you. I'll drag myself there.
If the teacher asks, I'll play dumb.
If the teacher asks, I'll play dumb.

The teacher won't trouble a good student like you. Go on now. He's upstairs in the <001>Aisle of Knowledge</>.
It's more convincing if you do it yourself.
It's more convincing if you do it yourself.
And please don't compete with me for the new toys, okay?
See? I knew it wouldn't work...
We're going to be here forever...
Caught at the store... How embarrassing!
Ugh, why is luck not on our side...
What if I actually get sick and can't get leave?
Look at you two, lying just to buy merchandise.
Stand here and think about what you did!
Qian Qiao is requesting leave. He's not feeling well today.
Qian Qiao is requesting leave. He's not feeling well today.
Qian Qiao? He was out last week for allergies. What's the problem now?
He has a bad cough. His friend is taking him to the Herbalists.
He has a bad cough. His friend is taking him to the Herbalists.
Changan panics when he lies! They're likely skipping class for Frostcloud Town.
Tell me the truth. Is he really sick?
He was coughing nonstop. His friend seemed worried.
He was coughing nonstop. His friend seemed worried.
Thanks for letting me know. I'm sorry for the trouble.
I will have them standing in the hall until Shen Shu grows hair!
Just stay here. I'll keep an eye out for her.
Just stay here. I'll keep an eye out for her.
I can't find my sister. Have you seen her?
What does she look like? Where did you get separated?
What does she look like? Where did you get separated?
Th-thanks. We took the elevator to the terrace, then came to the gardens.
My bad. I was walking slowly and didn't take good care of her. What if she can't find me...
Thanks for your help! Sorry again...
Go get her. Her legs must be numb.
Go get her. Her legs must be numb.
She's hiding behind a potted plant near the elevator.
She's hiding behind a potted plant near the elevator.
That kid! What's on her mind? I was worried sick...
She's just playing with you. She wants more of your attention.
She's just playing with you. She wants more of your attention.
You're right... It is my fault...
It's one thing making me worry. But don't get others involved.
Sit in on a class if you're interested.
I wonder when I'll be able to attend Teacher Zhuangzi's class again...
Have you finished the assignment from last time?
Music about dreaming... I'm out of ideas...
Maybe ask Master Zhuangzi for advice?
I lost too many credits this month. Wufan, you're too harsh.
I'm being fair. You're setting a good example for everyone.
I'd rather not. If I were as smart as Kongming, I'd exploit loopholes in the rules.
Senior Kongming would never do that. Don't assume the worst of others!
Master Fuzi told her to make up the courses she missed. When will she return?
This place always brings me peace.
I'm glad I didn't choose the School of Martial Arts.
I don't like training. I'd be punished nonstop in Master Fuzi's class.
Li Bai's gourd never seems to run dry. He drinks, yet still performs amazing swordplay.
If I carried a gourd and kept drinking, could I become as skilled as him?
I doubt it. More likely, you'd just lose more credits.
I don't mind. I'll just take extra classes. I have to try!
What am I going to do? Graduation is near, and I still don't have enough credits.
I should have spent more time in the study room.
Slacking off felt great at the time, but now I'm paying for it.
I've always heard about Master Fuzi's unmatched martial arts skills, and recently, I finally saw it for myself.
Oh, you saw Master Fuzi's skills in class, huh?
It's true. You won't believe it. Fuzi subdued a senior in just three moves.
I barely blinked, and their fight was over...
Wow, I should visit the School of Martial Arts someday!
I've always heard that the Master's martial arts attainments were unfathomable, and I finally witnessed it a while ago.

text: I heard people say that the Master went missing because he protected the students participating in the Dream Performance finals and ended up severely injured himself.
Come on, the Master is the greatest martial artist of our time. There's no way he'd be hurt by a mere explosion.
That's true... but then... where on earth did the Master go...
I'd love to ride a Bubble Fish to explore Jixia, too...
Did you hear that? Master Fuzi scolded someone for making memory-boosting herbs.
Why? Isn't improving memory a good thing?
Apparently, it was meant for exams. Master Fuzi doesn't want us to take shortcuts.
I love these relief murals. They are as elegant as Sorcery Runes.
Indeed, you have a keen eye.
Of all times, not a single dean is at the academy right now...
Hey, tell me, that explosion during the Dream Performance finals...
Could it have been intentionally prepared by someone at the academy?
Don't talk nonsense! How could that be possible!
How would you describe the relationship between Master Fuzi and Master Mozi?
Maybe we shouldn't speculate on that...
They've known and respected each other since youth. That's why they've worked together all this time.
It's been so long since I attended Master Zhuangzi's dream course, I feel like I've become quite dull...
Sigh, me too, me too. Ever since Master stopped coming to teach, I've even lost my appetite...
Master Zhuangzi's classes on dreams are absolutely mesmerizing...
But I always feel lost and worry I'll fail the exam.
Master Fuzi's classes are clear, practical, and physically tough.
Even though I ate three extra bowls of rice after his classes, I still lost weight!
When will Yango's Puppet Show be back?
I must get a front-row seat next time.
The Discipline Dog is so cute. It follows me around every time I'm here.
It's not a pet. It follows you because you broke the rules.
Better check your credits. You might be running low.
I heard the members of the Star Team were injured and fell unconscious...
Let's go ask around and pay them a visit.
Training Mechanoids were damaged overnight. Any update on the investigation?
I think Novar or Meng Ya did it. They're always up to something.
I think I saw Yango yesterday, but he's rarely at the academy...
Jixia is truly a cradle of heroes.
Where are Lian Po and Wuyan now? I want to challenge them.
These herbs warm the lungs and help treat coughs.
I heard that Dr Bian also visited the academy. I wish I could speak with him.
To clear Wondrous Maze, you must understand how it was designed.
You have to think like Kongming...
Been patrolling all day... haven't seen anything unusual...
We need to step up our patrols.
Meng Ya is always causing trouble.
Sigh, Senior Meng Ya being this well-behaved is not a good sign...
I wonder how tall the Tower of Enlightenment really is...
One day, I'll make it to its very top.
Told you, the Tower of Enlightenment always gives me accurate readings.
Not sure, but it's worth studying.
Non-academy students are not permitted to enter.
Do not enter unless it is an urgent matter.
Non-academy students are not permitted to enter.
Do not enter unless it is an urgent matter.
Borrow the breeze, greet the dawn; wings unfurl, then I'm gone.
The view here has a special charm.
Do you know who discovered the Aercocoon?
Restricted Academy area, please proceed with caution.
Be careful, someone is watching you.
Restricted Academy area, please proceed with caution.
Be careful, someone is watching you.
Want to grab a bite to eat after our shift?
Still on guard duty... We'll see when the time comes.
Want to grab a bite to eat after our shift?
Still on guard duty... We'll see when the time comes.
Gao Xin, I heard you've been outstanding at the Strategy Room!
I just followed the teacher's instructions.
Don't be modest, we all know how hard you worked.
Thank you, Senior Lu Ruo. I'll keep working hard.
The training methods at your School of Martial Arts really are different.
Of course, our training incorporates Aerflow energy, focusing on both internal and external development.
Sounds profound, but I still prefer the tranquility of Meditation Hall.
Haha, I'm different. I prefer sweating it out in the training grounds.
Everyone's path is different. What matters is finding what suits you best.
True, as long as I can become stronger, nothing else matters.
There's nothing to argue about. The advantages of Martial Arts are obvious.
I don't have time for this. If we keep arguing, we'll just attract a crowd and make a scene.
Hey, look, there's a student right here! Don't be shy, come on, ask for their opinion! Which do you think is cooler, Mechcraft or Martial Arts?
Mechcraft students are ingenious. They may not be the bravest, but they have all sorts of tricks up their sleeves.
Mechcraft students are ingenious. They may not be the bravest, but they have all sorts of tricks up their sleeves.
See? Even your friend here admits that you Mechcraft guys are no match for a fight.
How did you twist our meaning? This shows we have smart methods, not brute force!
If you can't understand the classmate's high EQ statement, just don't huff and puff.
Martial Arts Techniques are more powerful.
Martial artists are strong and tough. Though they may seem a bit rough, they master all kinds of weapons and tactics...
Martial artists are strong and tough. Though they may seem a bit rough, they master all kinds of weapons and tactics...
Oh, I get it. You're saying those Martial Arts folks are like oxen, all brute strength and no finesse.
We also use various weapons and tactics.
Can you deny that Martial Arts training is all about strength? You don't train your brains at all.
Sorcerers are impressive. They may look delicate, but they master incredibly profound techniques...
Sorcerers are impressive. They may look delicate, but they master incredibly profound techniques...
You're not a Sorcery student, so why are you defending them?
You're not practicing Sorcery with some subpar student and getting swayed by their little tricks, are you?
Don't worry. I can tell you've got some martial arts training. A little Sorcery Technique won't hurt you.
If we could see through Sorcery tricks, do you think we would even need to withstand them?
They are on par with each other.
Each of the three schools has its own strengths. You can't mix them up and compare them.
Each of the three schools has its own strengths. You can't mix them up and compare them.
See, he's sensible, not like you, always pitting Martial Arts against Mechcrafts.
Are you turning the tables on me? It was you who insisted on sparring with me these past two days!
After every match, you'd tell me to give up, saying things like "see the gap between you and Martial Arts." Can you deny that?
They're dead set on arguing. My opinion doesn't matter. Best to leave.
They're dead set on arguing. My opinion doesn't matter. Best to leave.
The three major academies each have their own strengths; you cannot simply lump them together or compare them as if they were the same.

text: Remember our plan? I'll make the first move.
If things go wrong, shout "Play it by ear," and I'll come back at once.
You're a Mayene fan and don't know her famous line?
Oh, now it makes sense. Let's go with it!
Welcome, new students! Come here if you have any questions about credits or courses.
Do we craft items using Aersilk?
Yes. Aersilk adapts and transforms, allowing us to craft a diverse array of creations.
Like being light and soft or sharp and durable?
Exactly. These properties make Aersilk integrate well with everything.
Can you give us some examples of Aersilk creations?
Sure. Mind Readers at the School of Sorcery, Mechcraft Kites, and Puppeteers' puppets.
Wow, I didn't realize there were so many Aersilk creations! Looks like I'll have to study Aersilk to make more practical Mechcrafts in the future!
What am I going to do? Graduation is near, and I still don't have enough credits.
I should have spent more time in the study room.
Slacking off felt great at the time, but now I'm paying for it.
This is the story of our academy's founding—a place dedicated to fostering exceptional talents.
Jixia Academy is the most esteemed learning institution in Primaera.
I'm explaining our history to students from Chang'an and Navenia. Come join us.
Thanks to the Three Sages and brave students, we now teach Sorcery, Martial Arts, and Mechcraft.
Combining theory and practice, we create innovations that improve lives, and our graduates drive change across the continent.
I've traveled all the way from Navenia to Jixia, but thinking about starting my academy life soon just gets me so excited!
It honors the Three Sages who rebuilt the academy.
These murals offer a glimpse of this place's rich history.
Although I'm from Chang'an, the history reminds me of the great responsibility I carry.

Are you interested in this, student? I'm introducing the school history to students from afar like Chang'an and Haidu. You can join us and listen.
