So this is how the Three Sages founded the academy...
It's incredible that the Tower of Enlightenment was built with the Aercocoon.
I'm from Chang'an! Who would've thought Jixia was rebuilt by the Aercocoon?
It's amazing that such delicate silk can be so strong!
I'm from Yong, here to study out of deep admiration for the Three Sages.
Are you interested in the Three Sages?
Yes! Master Mozi is the greatest Mechcraft Master of the continent! He built the city of Chang'an.
I admire Master Fuzi. He treats everyone equally and believes hard work leads to excellence.
I'm here to learn Martial Arts to protect my hometown.
Come visit Chang'an sometime! Check out Master Mozi's brilliant designs!
Master Mozi has written so many works...
Why do I feel... that it's been a bit too peaceful at the academy lately...
Those troublemakers have finally quieted down... I almost miss them...
Master, I understand. I'll go ask Senior Meng Ya to blow something up right now.
I smelled burning near the classroom earlier. What were you doing?
Were you trying to cook? That's not allowed in the classroom!
No, I didn't... I don't have any ingredients...
It must be Meng Ya. He tests his cannons a lot and probably burned something again.
The Academy is busy with affairs right now, and classes are suspended. I don't even feel like slacking off anymore...
Yeah, I just feel like... everything has been so lifeless lately...
If Senior Mayene were still at the Academy, I wonder if things would be better...
Indeed. If the Master saw Senior Sister Mayene, he might just jump out in a fit of rage.
Nice weather. Wanna go fishing? We could catch a bunch.
Slacking off again? You're not Mayene. She skipped class and somehow avoided Master Fuzi's anger.
Even with effort, I may never be the top like her. So why not take it easy?
Easy to say. Have you trained lately? There's an exam coming up.
Oh, I forgot. No fishing for now, then.
I'm so tired. Where is it?
I built a Mechanoid Bird, but its wing broke during a test flight.
The parts may be too heavy. I'm checking references to find a solution.
Master Mozi created the Mechanoid Bird here. Meng Ya repaired it once, but I can't find any records of that.
Did you hear about Ms. Shen Shu?
No, but people keep giving her odd looks. What happened?
A student's Mechanoid went haywire and knocked off her wig.
What? Ms. Shen Shu wears a wig?
Why are students from the School of Sorcery in our class?
Master Mozi believes Mechcraft should benefit everyone. Our doors are open.
But Mechcraft is complex. Can they keep up?
We'll have a quiz soon. Scores will tell.
Wait! I have to leave... I feel sick!
Why is it dead again? What's wrong?
My Mechanoid doesn't work. One part was misplaced.
In the last exam, it went berserk and knocked off Ms. Shen Shu's wig.
She went mad, and I failed the exam.
Want a tour of the Tower of Enlightenment?
It's the grandest structure in Jixia, made of Aersilk from the Aercocoon. Its interior is magnificent.
Thanks, but I need to get to class.
I'm heading there, too. Let me introduce you to the three schools...
No, thanks... I've visited them already.
Yango has stronger Mechcraft skills, in my opinion.
No. With a solid theoretical foundation, Sun Bin is better.
Hmm... Fair point, but they've never competed, right?
Yeah, if only they were like Kongming and Zhou Yu, it'd be a spectacle!
The lotus flowers are really beautiful.
Would you like to learn Shye's techniques?
That requires a deep understanding of Sorcery. Probably very challenging.
Shye will help if you share treasure clues with her.
Seeing lotus flowers always makes me think of Senior Xishi uncontrollably... especially now...
Yes, Senior Xishi hasn't appeared since... It's truly worrying for her safety...
Did you guys craft the Mechanoid guide for the new students?
It sure knows how to amuse people.
Of course, its language module is adjusted for this occasion.
Believe it or not, many students join the Gourmet Society just to taste more dishes.
Then they learn it's not all fun. Cooking takes skill.
Yeah, you need to understand ingredients and how they work together.
Exactly. Gourmets should know as much as Herbalists. Hope newcomers are ready to work.
Each visit to the Tower of Enlightenment gives me new insights.
I remember when I first enrolled, Master Fuzi delivered a stirring speech here. Even now, recalling it sends shivers down my spine.
So many memories... The closer graduation gets, the more I miss this place.
I'm here because I couldn't sleep...
I'm here because I couldn't sleep...
I still remember when I first enrolled, the Master giving a passionate speech right here...
Sigh, I still can't believe it...
Sigh... So much has been happening lately... I hope the academy can weather this storm...
I never expected that as I was about to leave the academy, I would witness a once-in-a-century event like the Dream-Performance finals being suspended...
The Star Team was injured during the Dream Performance finals, and Fuzi has been missing ever since...
There are more and more messy things going on... I... I'm really quite uneasy...
Hmm... Just a moment, I have something else to take care of...
Teacher Star-Gleam, will classes continue as normal recently?
Teacher Star-Gleam, the materials needed to repair the venue have been listed.
Hmm... I need to figure out something for these instruments at the Magic Academy as well...
Hmm? You're here? How are you feeling?
That's good. In these special times, manpower is limited. I may have to trouble you with some more things.
With all three Deans away, the Academy needs a backbone...
The aftershocks haven't ended yet; there are still many things to deal with.
At a time like this, I have no choice but to step in temporarily.
Hmm... These days are different from the past, but if we work together, we will surely get through this.
These lotus blooms are stunning at night. They remind me of Shye.
Pondering in new environments makes it easier to understand Sorcery.
Master Zhuangzi teaches by day. Maybe he travels at night.
Sigh, even this lotus viewing has become so dull...
I wonder when I'll be able to see Senior Sister Shye again...
Master Zhuangzi's lecture about dreams went over my head.
I've heard it three times and still don't get it.
What's to get? You sleep, you dream.
They say dreams reflect daytime thoughts.
I dream of exams nonstop, but I don't want them!
Maybe dreams sometimes run opposite to reality...
Where on earth did Master go... It's been so long since anyone's seen him...
The Tower of Enlightenment is amazing on the inside!
I heard Societies hold debates on the first floor.
Could I possibly see Master Fuzi?
Please walk slowly and in an orderly fashion.
Please walk slowly and in an orderly fashion.
I hope this turmoil passes soon...
Don't talk nonsense! Sincerity brings results!
I hope this turmoil passes soon...
Don't talk nonsense! Sincerity brings results!
Stay sharp! I must keep my eyes open!
I'm keeping an eye on this book. It moves when I look away.
I heard that anyone who reads it sleepwalks.
I want to find out why.
Relax... Inhale... Exhale... Empty your mind...
Whoa! Where did you show up from? My inspiration's gone!
Leave me alone. I'm trying to enter the dream!
Having a Sorcery clone like Master Zhuangzi is something I can only dream of.
If I had two, I'd use one for class and one for sleeping.
Songchen, have you heard the legend about Mayene?
What's that? Is it why you're also slacking off every day?
I'm not... Mayene once rode Master Zhuangzi's Bubble Fish and escaped.
For real? Never heard of that. How did she do it?
I don't know, but it's Mayene. Anything can happen.
Haven't seen them around for a while...
Where on earth did Master go...
Master Fuzi hit me with his ferule.
But he wasn't being very harsh.
Ugh, four jobs and still broke. If only treasure fell from the sky!
You know where to find treasures? Do tell!
Word is, the most precious treasure in Jixia is hidden in the Restricted Ground...
Shh! Keep it down. Going there could get you in trouble.
I know. It's creepy and guarded by monsters. I won't go.
Right, better safe than sorry. Not worth the risk.
It's so quiet tonight, I need to hurry... Whoa! What are you doing here?
I'm looking for Mayene's notes. Don't tell anyone.
Those notes teach perfect slacking: do less, be the strongest—sounds great!
But I can't find them anywhere... Maybe I should ask Novar. They were close friends.
What? You can't sleep at night either?
Didn't Senior Sister Mayene leave behind any secrets for cultivating the mind?
The teacher spoke too fast. I couldn't keep up.
Just note down the key points. You don't need to write down every word.
Oh no, I missed a detail in my notes...
I took notes, too. Maybe we can discuss them later.
I think the teacher might have made a mistake here...
I'll try it myself first, and then discuss it with the teacher after class.
I couldn't see it clearly, so I moved closer.
I couldn't see it clearly, so I moved closer.
Now get back to work. Come find me if you need help.
I just joined and missed most of the class.
I just joined and missed most of the class.
No worries. Just start something and show me. Let's see if you have talent.
All right, everyone, keep working. If you have questions, just ask.
Alright. Remember: practical work matters more than theory.
Everyone is practicing with Master Zhuangzi. Why don't you join them?
Everyone is practicing with Master Zhuangzi. Why don't you join them?
We just started learning here. I'll take notes first, and then we'll practice together.
Don't be afraid of making mistakes. Practicing helps you learn more.
Don't be afraid of making mistakes. Practicing helps you learn more.
The teacher's here to correct you and keep you on track.
The teacher's here to correct you and keep you on track.
You're right. Let's practice with everyone...
Warming up is crucial before training. Don't skip it. Make sure you do it properly.
Once you've stretched properly, you can start today's training.
Why do we need to warm up for archery?
Of course you do. Archery requires strength from your whole body.
Without a proper warm-up, you'd be hurting now.
Thanks for the reminder. I'll take it seriously.
Everyone is warming up. Why aren't you?
Everyone is warming up. Why aren't you?
I've already finished. The best students always prepare before the teacher arrives.
They're basic tools for observing stars. You'll use them every day.
Star charting is boring. Are you okay with that?
Sure. Stars always calm me down, whatever troubles I have.
Grandpa said people who've passed on become stars that guide future generations.
I think he is my guiding star.
Each banner represents a Society in Frostcloud Town.
Years ago, students came together there to rebuild a small village into what we see now.
Their banners symbolize their concerted effort.
Together, achieved something big. Just thinking about it inspires me.
That must be the sign of Aerux Town. Northton is such a busy place now.
Remember our trip with the merchants there? Thought it would be fun...
Instead, crowds swamped us. Navenian merchants everywhere!
Right, everyone almost fought over local specialties.
So you came from Horizon Harbor?
Yes. Ships from Chang'an bring visitors to Jixia. The sea views are amazing!
I came from Yong. The trip was tiring.
Then you should visit Horizon Harbor! It births heroes and gathers talent from everywhere.
You can find merchants with rare wares here. Quite a lively place!
I never knew Harvest Fields had such history. The Societies did so much.
Who could have imagined it would be this prosperous today?
Are you talking about Harvest Fields?
Yeah. It used to be a barren land, nothing like it is now.
Then Crafters, Herbalists, and Anglers each shared their skills.
They cleared waterways, built irrigation systems, and bred new crops—transforming Harvest Fields into the peaceful, prosperous place it is today.
They focus on their studies and try to get along with the local people.
They gather herbs, cut timber, and fish together with villagers.
Over time, they formed close bonds. That's how Harvest Fields became such a vibrant place.
Wish I had my peace and quiet back...
A student's Mechanoid went berserk in class.
I tried to stop it, but it blew away my wig.
Now everyone knows, and Herbalists keep coming to sell their hair-growth remedies.
Everyone, don't worry! I will protect you all!
Everyone, don't worry! I will protect you all!
I'm exhausted. Why hasn't the relief shift arrived yet?
I'm exhausted. Why hasn't the relief shift arrived yet?

I promise not to be the worst!
Don't set the bar too high—just don't fail your classes! By the way, fight back if bullied. I've got your back.

Academic Discipline dog, cheer up! We can help if needed.

Dad, was our plow made by this big guy? It's incredible!

Wow, can it make Mechanoid too? I want a cool Master Mozi Mechanoid!
When I grow up, I will build an even bigger Aerweaver!
The design of the Aerweaver is truly ingenious.
So many components work together, each essential to the whole.
I wonder when I'll be able to see the loom weaving cloud silk again...
Aerweavers are the heart of Jixia Academy.
Aerflow enters Aerweavers and transforms into Aersilk.
Over a thousand components are involved in this process!
Come on! I'll show you the next place!
We've been walking since morning. I'm starving.

You've checked it three times already, Senior. Can this loom actually be used or not...
I've been thinking about something important.
The Aercocoon spews Aerflow, which the Aerweavers turn into Aersilk, and Aersilk is then used to make various products.

Our teacher wants us to check the Aerweaver's condition. I hope Feng Yu stays focused this time.
Aerweavers are indispensable. We rely on Aersilk for experiments.
Every time we came here, Feng Yu was absorbed in strange questions.
So I had to double-check his work.
He should have joined the School of Sorcery. The School of Mechcraft requires hands-on learning.
The Academy has changed so much.
It wasn't this bustling when I first arrived.
Strange, I don't remember the outer ring of the Tongtian Tower being this shape...
Could something have happened when I went fishing?

Aren't you going to the plaza to promote it?

If someone is truly meant for angling, they'll find us.
Farewell, may we meet again someday.

I think the Master must be dealing with something more pressing.
The Dream-Reverie has gone well for years, why did it explode this time...
It's all the fault of those people from the Institute of Mechanics. They inspect everything every day, how did they miss such a huge hazard?
Sigh... Alright, alright, blaming them now won't help... The injured won't just get better like that.
Hey, I know you. Your aced the entrance exam.
Exactly! Why not consider joining Senior Guidie's team? You'd definitely be a core member.
Exactly! Why not consider joining Senior Guidie's team? You'd definitely be a core member.

You're not thinking of something crazy again, are you?

I need to contact the Gongqiao family... No, no, report to the Mechanism Academy first...
Senior... Dean Mozi is not at the academy right now...

You need sharp eyes and a compassionate heart to find them.
If you love them, join the Hunting Society!
Students, please maintain order. We will ensure everyone's safety!
This incident was so sudden... it was hard to avoid students getting caught up in it...
The ones who were injured during the incident were members of the Guidie Team and the Star Team...
But after the incident, many strange monsters appeared in the surrounding area... and many students were injured.
We are also looking for ways to see if there is anything we can do to help.
Hmm, you should cheer up too, classmate!
Guidie... I think I've seen her name on the Peerless Ranking, and she's ranked quite high.
Yes, would you like to learn more?
You don't know yet? Senior Guidie is the most promising student in the Magic Academy this year.
We all think Senior Guidie will definitely win this time.
Wow, I need to learn more about her.
Haha, Senior Guidie really made a splash on the Peerless Ranking, even overshadowing Senior Yao.

Just collect Croaky Coins from the booths around the square, and then you can start playing.
It's simple. Just drop the claw at the right moment. But it's all about timing and speed!
Hit the disk in the center to release the claw!
Hit the disk in the center to release the claw!
Maybe I should get some help to spread the word...

We also sell everyday items, like abacuses.

Opportunities come and go quickly, just like beads on an abacus.
Shye always says that whenever she comes.
I envy her so much. When will I be as smart as her?
Look at my stall, it's so quiet compared to others'.
I should consider collaborating with Shye and exchanging tips on how to make money.
How about we collaborate with the Mechcraft students to develop a finance Mechanoid?
Lian Po once broke the training dummies with pure force. I think I can do it too!
An explosion at the finals arena blew away my fortune.
Let me know if you need anything.
There's too much to list. Let's just say, big or small, whatever the function, the shop has it all.
From divine weapons to knickknacks, our selection will leave you spoiled for choice.
Do you travel for trade often?
Indeed, I frequently make trade runs, mostly to Frostcloud Town and Aerux Town.
Both places have bustling markets, especially Frostcloud Town—a flourishing hub co-built by Society members.
I'm content as long as I still have business to do.
We have guests? Welcome! Welcome! What would you like to buy? Feel free to look around!
Sigh, don't mention it. Ever since the Dreamscape Performance finals were suspended, foot traffic has dropped by more than half.
We were barely hanging on with the cloud silk, but now the production is failing too...
Welcome to the Jixia Merchant Guild! We've got all the Jixia products you may need!
Let me know if you need anything.
Oh, a bit of everything! Let me put it this way—large or small, practical or decorative, this shop has it all.
From divine weapons to knickknacks, our selection will leave you spoiled for choice.

Indeed, I frequently make trade runs, mostly to Frostcloud Town and Aerux Town.
Both places have bustling markets, especially Frostcloud Town—a flourishing hub co-built by Society members.
The silkworm sleeps, the cocoon forms, breaking free for a new life...
It's you! People are all talking about you lately!
Fate brought you to Jixia, and your future here is unwritten.
I have a feeling you'll have an exciting time here at the academy.
Monsters appearing... cloud current anomalies... Could this be some kind of omen?
It's really depressing at a time like this without any music to accompany us.
Is this where they introduce the three schools? The School of Sorcery seems farthest.
Should I have changed clothes for this?
Yeah, practicing Sorcery Techniques looks cool!
I heard he's recruiting, so I wanted to check it out...
By the way, don't tell my peers you saw me here.
If they find out I took leave to come here...
Hmm... did he just make eye contact with me?
No, I've been an Herbalist for quite a while.
Time flies in the blink of an eye.
So, what are your plans after this?
Who'd want to guess? Don't claim you know me once we're out, silly boy.
Look at that, future big shot of Chang'an acting all high and mighty.
Come and compete with me in Chang'an if you dare!
Who knows? Maybe you'll turn out to be a hero like Li Bai.
Heroes' Fanclub members are total fanatics.
They've flooded this place, knowing the Team of Stars often meets Sun Bin here.
The Student Affairs Committee sends staff here to keep things in order.
But with the growing crowds, we might need more help.
My stance techniques are still lacking.
In the arena, I wouldn't last more than a few moves.
Do I really need that Greenwhisper Treasure? A true martial artist draws power from within, not external sources.
The journey of martial arts... we have a long way ahead.
Could you tell me about the matches?
Hey, are you here for the Azure Arena challenge too? Maybe we'll have a face-off one day!
Back in the day, Jixia Mountains were the academy's testing grounds for the Entrance Exam.
The Path of Heroes used to scare off a lot of newcomers.
These days, this place is primarily an arena for Martial Arts students to practice sparring.
Could you tell me about the Greenwhisper Treasure?
The Greenwhisper Treasure? People have been talking about it nonstop since I got here.
Some call it the Champion's Treasure, supposedly left by a former champion for future challengers.
Victory in the arena is yours if you get it. The key to the chest is split in half, hidden around the camp.
But I believe true martial artists draw strength from within. Still, if you're curious, go ahead and search for it.
Hope to see you on that stage.
About the treasure of Greenwhisper Pool.
My kid wants to see the tournament, might as well come along.
Watching those battles always makes me nervous, though.
At least the storyteller across the way gets to spin tales in the comfort of his home. That's some small solace in all this.
But it's not too bad for me.
Missed the chance to become Hu's disciple. I can only admire his skills from here...
You're new here, right? Hu Dafu is the most famous blacksmith in our camp.
The weapons he forged helped countless people win in the arena.
They say every profession has its own elite. I believe Hu is the elite among blacksmiths!
Even if you're not a martial artist, watching him swing his hammer for a bit will give you a sense of the rhythmic charm within.
Blacksmith Hu finally started taking apprentices. I've long admired his craft and want to join.
As a Trading Society member, I have a deep understanding of raw materials, even if I don't know much about blacksmithing.
But I guess we might as well learn to make weapons. It's important to exercise our strength, right?
But when I returned, his spots were already filled. We missed our chance...
Take care. If you need weapons, come see me.
Ah, what a great way to make money, but alas, I'm as stubborn as a mule. What should I do...
With so many people around, my actions must remain hidden.
Sorry, I've been staying up late and feeling a bit sluggish.
What happened between you and Tie Sheng?
It's a long story. I'm setting up a general store and selecting suppliers.
Hu's been taking on new apprentices. They've been breaking a lot of tools during practice.
They may see these iron pieces as scrap metal, but in my hands, they're so much more.
I just need to package them well, spin a few yarns, and sell them to those muscle-brained fools at Roaring Tiger Training Hall...
I made a fortune at Roaring Tiger Training Hall.
Too bad that old man's as stubborn as a mule. He said those things were cluttering his shop and would rather toss them than give them to me.
Steal? You can't call Trading Society's actions stealing! This is called observation and reference, observation and reference!
I was curious about how Hu teaches his students, but he wasn't pleased when I asked.
So I'd sneak to his window at night to watch and learn... Hey, don't look at me like that, I was truly motivated by a desire to learn!
Turns out it was nothing. Just some banging with a hammer. Cost me several late nights, though. Got dark circles to show for it.
Take these two swords as a gift! See you soon, my future customer!
These <001>Black-Hilt Swords</> are always in short supply at Roaring Tiger Training Hall. And the new upgraded <001>White-Hilt Swords</> pack even more punch!
Oh, and you can refer your friends from Roaring Tiger Training Hall too. They're the easiest to fool... Pian...
Your graceful moves will unleash their full potential! If I ever open a shop, you must visit often!
I'll watch a bit more and see if I can find new tricks to... improve my skills.
Based on the records, most champions were martial artists.
But if I keep honing my Mechcraft skills, I'm sure I'll dominate the Azure Arena one day.
But his mom signed him up for tons of tough classes. We haven't hung out in ages.
I'll remember every detail of today's match so I can tell him all about it.
I wish my friend were here. He loves arena matches!
Then something clicked, and she's been dominating the arena for a month now!
So, do you think any of these disciples or visitors hiding secrets?
Hard to say, but as the masters always say, there's always someone better out there.
I heard that champion was once an ordinary student.
This champion is as formidable as the rumors suggest.
I plan to challenge the arena at dawn.
But daytime brings thick crowds and attention!
Welcome to the Azure Arena challenge.
I'm Wuwen, the arena admin, and although I've never practiced martial arts or fought in the arena...
No one knows the arena and its fighters' stories better than I do.
She used to be just an ordinary student watching from the audience.
That's impressive. Sometimes I can feel the chill of her blade from this distance.
As you can see, most top fighters like to stay anonymous.
Darkpool Camp holds many hidden talents. That doesn't surprise me.
Someday, I might write a book about the remarkable people and happenings I've witnessed here.
I'll call it... The Legends of Darkpool Camp.
Hope to see you on the list soon.
But suddenly, she's owning the arena. Even the best fighters from nearby training halls can't bring her down.
Come take a look, we've got everything you need!

High quality and low price, lots of discounts!

Aerux Town, Autumn Streams, Harvest Fields, Dreamweave Lake... The more remote the places are, the more I like them.
The fields below are full of treasures and oddities, just waiting for someone with eyes for them.
Anything catches your eye? We're flexible with prices.
Actually, I'm not from here. I'm from Harvest Fields.
It takes quite a while to go up or down from this mountain slope.

I hope things get better once we weather this storm.

I might have a future in the Trading Society.
Maybe I'll consider further study at the academy if there's a chance.

He won't even listen to me—his own daughter! Always treating me like a child, saying I'm just book-smart.
Hoarding all those elixirs from Alsahraa "doctors", and outdated healing devices from Navenia Mechsmiths...
Yesterday, he bought a bunch of herbal dust collectors while I wasn't looking. Now what am I supposed to do with that?
Older people often fall for scams because they can't tell what's legit.
With the right reference, they'd figure it out in no time!
Herbalist pills are finely ground, pure, and certified—they're totally reliable.
Good idea! I'll get some and give it a try!
Older people often get scammed because they don't know how to spot the signs.
If they saw how scams can ruin families and drain fortunes...
They might start questioning things and asking for advice.
Thanks for the advice. I'll ask the Herb Society about fake medicine scams.
That was impressive! I wonder if the champion could take on Tigon.
Mo Yan? I've heard she's quite skilled, too.
Indeed, this tournament is getting more exciting.
The Roaring Tiger Training Hall has always been strong, especially its Head Trainer. If Ling Hu were here, he'd be a champion.
I doubt it. Cinder from the Obsidian Flame Training Hall is also a contender.
Not enough! I'm planning to train at Roaring Tiger Training Hall this semester. Want to join me?
Isn't the Head Trainer super strict? I might not even make it in.
Look at you, you should know why you lost by now.

Even the fish are too scared to show their heads now...
Monsters are swarming, and there are anomalies in the cloud currents...
Shh, keep it down. You'll scare the fish away!
Do you know the owner of Qingyi Pavilion?
We go way back. We were rivals back in our days at the School of Martial Arts.
It was mostly him pestering me to compete, cutting into my fishing time.
After graduation, we both found our own paths.
He cooks, I fish—though my catches always end up in his pot.

Real peace comes from quiet fishing, free of ambition.

I thought my temperament had improved...
But it wasn't until something actually went wrong that I realized... I still have a lot to learn...
After all these years, Darkpool Camp is as lively as ever—and the treasure's still in the same spot.
I wonder what moves the new students are showing off in the arena. I'll check it out later.
I miss the old days of arena battles.
Yes, five or six years ago. My friends and I trained and sparred right here.
What a year! We beat all the teams until it was just us left to fight it out.
We gave it everything. One of my friends became champion that year, and we couldn't have been happier for him.
A champion and a prankster, that one! He never missed a chance to mess with us, or the new recruits!
What? Oh! Haha, that was just a prank. It's still making the rounds?
After his big win, my friend led us on a wild hunt for a secret manual.
We searched all over, only to find a chest of trinkets!
He laughed his head off. Good thing there were some useful items—otherwise, he'd have been in trouble.
Not sure who's carrying on this prank, but they'd better toss in some real treasures too. Fair's fair, right?
Take care! Enjoy your time at camp!
Get up here now. You're scaring my fish away!
Training just leads to being a hall trainer or a village guard for life.
Why not just relax and enjoy the feast...
That sounds a bit bleak. Work can be fulfilling!
So fulfilling that you'd want to fix Mechcraft creations forever?
Who knows what's ahead? For now, every day feels meaningful!
Take a look at this poster!
Come cheer him on at the stage!
Look at those lively fish in the pond! No wonder people rave about the fish and shrimp.
Relax and savor the fresh air.
The water mirrors the sky while the fish glide beneath... Enchanting!
My busy schedule has completely messed up my sense of time.
Helping the students makes all the effort worth it.
Hmm, dried meat and grilled mushrooms make a great travel meal.
Off to explore new areas. Better pack extra rations.
Nothing lifts my spirits like a treat on the go.
Another challenge... Who am I up against this time?
They're incredibly strong, but I've got to stay positive.
I don't expect to make a splash today.
Martial Arts are all about balancing the body and mind.
Watching others helps me understand my weaknesses.
I'm sitting out of the competition today.
I need to make sure all expenses are properly documented.
With so many supply sales, I need to check everything carefully.
With all these transactions, I have to be extra careful to avoid mistakes.
If only I could weave an Aersilk shield...
Who says the arena is only for Martial Arts students?
Then those Martial Arts students wouldn't stand a chance against me!
It's just a setback. I'll try to win next time!
This place always brings me peace.
The gentle breeze here seems to sweep my worries away.
I'm having a great time here! I'll be back for sure.
Let's explore the market for interesting items.
Maybe there are some Sorcery trinkets?
With these valuable herbs, I can craft new medicines.
Rest matters as much as work.
Great haul. I need a spot to sort them out.
Darkpool Camp and Herb Garden both have their charms.
The trees at Darkpool Camp are thriving.
As lively as it is, I find more peace in gathering herbs.
This climb is tougher than any training session!
Training in the wild is a real challenge—every step matters.
I always crave a feast after training.
I'm exhausted. Could really use some food from Qingyi Pavilion.
Hey, it's been a while. What've you been up to?
Trying to keep my troublemaker son in line!
Lucky you! Your daughter must save you from the headaches I get with my son.
I got him into the Roaring Tiger Training Hall for exam prep, hoping he could get into the School of Martial Arts.
But all he does is follow the Head Trainer around for stories. He's not learning anything.
Head north from this courtyard, and you'll reach the Backhill.
A legendary fighter once found enlightenment at Shadowy Cliff. Don't miss it.
Layered rocks by the waterfall offer a shortcut up.
About the history of Darkpool Camp.
Interested in Darkpool Camp's history? I've got some notes to share.
Jixia Mountains were once academy testing grounds, like Springbrook Plains.
Back then, reaching the summit by any means was enough to pass.
With wild beasts and rough trails, the mountains were dangerous terrain.
So the academy set up a camp here halfway up the mountain for students to rest and recover.
Yet none of the bright minds have figured out where.
Why not give it a shot?
It's for you to find out. Shortcuts won't get you far.
Jixia Mountains is vast, with caves, ruins, and even sunken treasures waiting to be discovered.
But beware: some places are older than the academy.
Ahem... New students have been buzzing about it. Supposedly, a former champion hid it here.
A few months ago, I was a student at the School of Martial Arts. I came here after graduation because I liked the Darkpool Camp.
Honestly, I'm not sure if I can manage a camp this size, but storytelling? That's my specialty.
Anyone familiar with this place knows it's full of surprises and hidden talents.
Legend says the former champion left a treasure that, if found, grants instant mastery of Martial Arts.
Take care. Come by anytime for a story.
Hehe... Did you see the flyers at the Midway Teahouse? Or did someone mention it to you?
If you're interested, why not follow the clues and see for yourself? Only by finding it can you know if it's true or false.
Intermission. Next up, we have "The Twin Blades Battle the Frost, While the Lone Sword Dances Through Flames."
Hey, if you want to listen to the story, find a seat now. It's going to be packed soon.
By "here", do you mean Darkpool Camp or my storytelling corner?
Just kidding. It's actually the arena administration office, established since the era of climbing entrance exams.
They were originally here to shelter disciples from the elements. Now, with the arena renovations, they've taken on administrative roles.
Camp records are stored here, including arena challenge records, Seeker Society reports, Gourmet Society findings, and more.
I've got a small room here to share stories with everyone. If I tell those legendary tales well, they'll love them.
Sharing these stories with more people is what truly fulfills me.
The latest clothing collection from Navenia is out now in Aerux Town!
Honestly, it doesn't stand out to me at all.
It's a craze at the academy. Everyone's into it.
I just don't get the fuss over being trendy.
Welcome to the Arena Administration! The room here showcases weapons used by challengers throughout history.
I know them inside and out. Let me introduce them to you!
Were these all used by challengers?
No! Challengers are skilled fighters, and their weapons are their trusted companions.
We can't keep their weapons on display, so these are replicas.
Capturing their beauty through photos is wonderful, isn't it?
Why are there cutouts of Meng Ya and the others here?
Well, besides Martial Artists and challengers, there are plenty of tourists visiting Darkpool Camp.
Visitors may not know much about weapons, but they've heard of these students.
It's called the celebrity effect. By featuring them as the hook, we can generate more interest in the competition.
But they do come to the camp occasionally. I heard Meng Ya and Master Mozi often chat behind the administration office.
Probably because of the beautiful and peaceful surroundings. Plus, it's a great place to stretch your limbs after a good talk.
Goodbye, come back if you need more information.
Celebrity effect, that's what they call it, right? Using them as a hook will attract more people to take an interest in the martial arts tournament.

Just take a look, I promise you won't be disappointed.

When will this life ever end...
More and more Mechcraft experts are joining the arena tournament.
What? Aren't you supposed to rely on your own strength in the arena?
Mechsmiths use their minds to design and make Mechcrafts to enhance their bodies. That's their strength, too.
Relying on Mechcrafts to rush in—that's cheating, right?
But you do have a point. We need to refine the rules further.
I could see the structure in your moves last time, but it was still a bit chaotic.
Practice a bit more and come back. If you'd like me to accompany you, I'd be happy to.
Let's see how much you've improved since our last battle!
How long have you been guarding the arena?
I don't remember. That's a strange question.
It's not about how long I can hold out or how many people I defeat. It's about whether my skills are improving.
Unfortunately, the recent opponents have been quite unremarkable, not even offering a single move I could learn from.
You're barely passable, but still far from impressive. Keep practicing.
Why did you come to the arena back then?
To further refine my Martial Arts skills and spread the glory of my school.
The moves we perform with our blades are the language of Martial Artists. Only through sparring and exchange can we truly improve.
This is something my father taught me since I was young. Don't worry if it doesn't make sense.
Your Martial Arts speak your language. Chaotic, yet... free.
I'll wait here until you're ready for another round.
To further refine my martial arts and spread the glory of my school.

text: Are you here to challenge me too? Then come, I'm ready any time.
How long have you been guarding the arena?
I don't remember. That's a strange question.
It's not about holding out or defeating enemies, but solely about improving skills.
Unfortunately, the recent opponents have been quite unremarkable, not even providing me with a single lesson.
Why did you come to the arena back then?
To further refine my martial arts and spread the glory of my school.
The moves we perform with our blades are the language of Martial Artists. Only through sparring and exchange can we truly improve.
That's what my father taught me since I started training in martial arts. You don't have to understand.
If you're not here to challenge, don't waste my time.
Right on time. Bring it on!
Still acting tough? Go back and fight again.
Not on an empty stomach. I'll eat at Qingyi Pavilion first, then head back to the arena.
Stop bragging and get some ointment from the Herbalist.
I just let my guard down. I'm sure I'd win if it happened again!
What, do you really think you can defeat her?
Absolutely, but it's a shame she's no longer the champion.
The new challenger was just sparring. He has no intention of taking over.
So there's still hope for me? Great! After eating my fill at Qingyi Pavilion, I'll come back to challenge her!
Damn! Someone beat Yan Ling before me!
You won but don't want to be champion... You are odd.
In that case, I'll take my time to reflect on what I've learned from you and keep moving forward.
How long have you been guarding the arena?
I don't remember much. Not long after my sister and I parted ways, I came to Darkpool Camp and quickly became the champion.
I don't get why she doesn't like Martial Arts. We've been learning it from our father since we were little, and it's supposed to bring joy.
If I master everyone's moves and carry on the legacy of Martial Arts alone, will she come back?
I've held onto this idea and defended my title all this time. But in your moves, I see freedom...
Maybe she doesn't hate me. She just wants freedom.
Why did you come to the arena back then?
To further refine my martial arts and spread the glory of my school.
My father was deeply passionate about Martial Arts. After he passed away, I inherited his legacy.
I thought my sister would join me in carrying on our father's martial arts and traveling the world. But she chose a completely different path.
I'm waiting for her and searching for an answer. Perhaps someday we'll stand side by side again, even if she never takes up her sword once more.
Congratulations, you're the winner! By the rules, you'll now take over as champion.
No need. I was just sparring with you, and I have other pressing matters. I don't intend to defend the arena.
No need. I was just sparring with you, and I have other pressing matters. I don't intend to defend the arena.
What are your plans after this?
The matches at the Azure Arena were boring. I nearly dozed off.
Oh, Yan Ling is great, but her opponent can't even handle a few moves. That's not nearly enough!
She's the current champion, going strong for over a month with no losses.
Why don't you try? No shame in losing, but if you win, we're in for a treat.
How could Yan Ling fall asleep during the defense? I've never seen a move that intense!
Who's this Yan Ling you're talking about?
Indeed, we've seen many matches here. Few can survive more than a few of her moves.
Do you still want the fish fillet? It's getting cold.
Then give it to me. I'll take the fish ball too.
So... are you full or not?
I broke two more bowls this morning. It's been happening every day this month.
Do you think Mr. Yu's going to kick me out?
I can't stop thinking about it—not even at night. It's making me even clumsier during the day.
Maybe I'm just not cut out to be a Gourmet.
The masked stranger only had a wooden stick.
Wow! There must be a lot of hidden masters around.
Rumor has it that the chef of Qingyi Pavilion was once a champion.
That's hard to believe. If he's so skilled, why is he cooking fish?
Tigon, the Head Trainer of the Roaring Tiger Training Hall, once was defeated here by a nobody.
You know, Tigon is bigger than you and wields a longblade.
Here for a meal too? Mr. Yu's cooking is amazing.
I'm thinking of trying something new, but I'm worried it might be too much for me.
Last time, I tried a dish Mr. Yu called slightly spicy—it was delicious, but...
My stomach was upset for days, but I can't wait to try it again.
Mr. Yu might be older, but he's young at heart.
Just a tip: never call him old to his face.
Once, a senior martial artist made that mistake, and Mr. Yu had him resting at Herb Garden for a month!
Just focus on doing your best.
But it's always packed, right? It's a staple of Darkpool Camp. People travel from all over just to try the fish.
Interested in Qingyi Pavilion? I'm new here, so I only know the basics.
Many Gourmets, myself included, come here to learn the fish dishes!
I'll admit, the owner and staff can be a bit unpredictable. It's a little worrying.
Ugh, I'm so nervous about the end-of-term assessment. What if the boss thinks I'm terrible?
He wasn't happy when I called him old on my first day.
Since then, I've been walking on eggshells. Should I really just let it go?
You're right... A good boss won't hold grudges. I should just focus on doing my job well.
Ugh, I'm so nervous about the end-of-term assessment. What if the staff thinks I'm awful?
Some people come from well-heeled families and are really friendly—they even bring snacks and get along with everyone.
Others work super hard, practicing late after we close. Should I really stop worrying?
Everyone has their own path. I just need to find mine... Thank you, I'll work on changing my mindset.
You must really like it here. Always here when you come down.
It's the fish soup... it tastes just like my mom's.
Whenever I miss home, I come by for it.
Now that you mention it, I'm feeling homesick too.
I saw some Mechsmiths from Navenia and Chang'an having a heated argument!
The Navenian criticized the Chang'an man for being overly elitist.
The Chang'an guy accused Navenia's Mechcrafts of causing pollution, even though they are widely accessible.
They went back and forth... it was pretty entertaining. But Jixia is still the best—the Aercocoon solves so many problems.
You got caught up in the drama and missed the point. The Chang'an Mechsmith is right—we need to be prepared.
Don't rely on that Aercocoon of yours! If it disappears one day, you'll be left with nothing.
Such a secretive invitation... I thought you were about to reveal something earth-shattering!
Is that... the Flaming Pepper Fish? I can't believe you remembered.
I remember your first time here, your first year in Jixia, you said this fish tasted just like home.
After years as a traveling merchant, I can barely remember the taste anymore.
Once I deliver the bamboo goods, I'm treating myself to a herbal bath at the Herb Garden.
Pick up an Aersilk robe for my wife, grab a couple of Mechcraft plushes for my daughter, and head home with my bounty.
Sure! Bring it all back home!
The dish is not quite there!
Why are there so few people eating here since the Star Team members got injured...
It won't do for a young person to be so worried that they don't eat...
Welcome to Qingyi Pavilion! What can I get you?
Can't decide? Our new special is a must-try. You won't regret it!
I'm the owner and chef here, known for crafting the finest fish dishes in Jixia.
I owe a lot to my old buddy who supplies us with the best fish from the Greenwhisper Pool.
Though his skills seem to be slipping lately.
The Azure Arena? I've heard the champion is skipping meals for battles. That's not the true path of a martial artist!
The championship is hardly an excuse for skipping meals. A martial artist needs proper nutrition!
My own daughter just got into the academy, and I bet she's skipping meals too. Kids these days.
So, you've conquered the arena before?
So, you've conquered the arena before?
Some things are best left unasked.
Hmm... maybe I should have the boy deliver takeout to the arena. What a headache.
Make sure to come back for our new dishes!
Take my word, once you try it, you'll be hooked!

I sent him on a break. Real training means eating and resting when needed.
Better to break a bowl than a hand.
Running this place with all the clanging pots and pans—it's the best way to relax.
As for you, drop by often! Who knows, there might be a new dish waiting for you tomorrow.
We're closed for the day. Come back in the morning!
Business has been slow lately, but at least the pots and stoves are much easier to clean...
The menu hasn't changed in ages. If we added some new dishes, we might attract more customers.
I feel so lost. Everyone else has plans after graduation, and I'm the only one struggling...
My Crafter friend's doing so well. Chang'an's Ministry of Mechcraft is scrambling to hire him, and he's not even graduated yet.
I should ask the Student Affairs Committee about the specifics. Hope it's not too late.
Now my family wants me to be like him. Keep pushing me to land a stable job soon.
Should I pursue my dream as a Seeker? Or be pragmatic and become a Crafter?
My dream... sounds like a childish fantasy.
When I first came here, a senior took me to the mountains near the Stargazing Terrace.
It was tough, but the view at the summit is etched in my memory forever.
Right then, I decided I'd become a Seeker and explore all the sights across these lands.
Silly, right? But thanks for your encouragement. If I give up now, I would never forgive myself.
Time to face reality, huh? I'm not a kid anymore. Can't keep running from responsibilities.
My family works hard to fund my education. I should start pulling my own weight.
As for my Seeker dream... well, life is long. That dream can wait until I'm ready.
I couldn't take it anymore, so I came here to enjoy the beautiful lake and relax.
The view at Darkpool Camp is absolutely stunning.
See how the waters form dark shadows on the cliff? That's where the name came from.
The icy, clear water is perfect for Fibercore Lotus—and home to the fattest fish you'll ever see.
Why is the camp called Darkpool?
Cool! Anything else interesting about this place?
They say there's treasure hidden in the pool too.
I heard it from folks at the arena. Ask around there if you're curious.
A helpful enthusiast told me that these treasure-seeking devices scattered throughout the mountains can point out the location of hidden treasures.

text: Graduation's round the corner. Thanks for looking after me all this time.

It's okay. Let's keep in touch. I can teach you about Chang'an's Mechcraft, and you can guide me on the practical side.
Darkpool Camp, where fireworks dazzle above the reflective waters.
This camp's known for the Arena Challenge, the succulent fish at Qingyi Pavilion, and the Greenwhisper Treasure.
The Arena Challenge, the succulent fish at Qingyi Pavilion, and the Greenwhisper Treasure—each one is a must-see.
Darkpool Camp once marked the entrance to Jixia Academy, where new students would gather to compete and learn from each other.
Over time, it became what we now call the Azure Arena.
Looking for a challenge? Start with the rankings.
The ones with win streaks aren't to be underestimated.
The succulent fish at Qingyi Pavilion.
The clear waters are home to succulent fish and fine Fibercore Lotus.
Qingyi Pavilion is the most famous restaurant around, known for its incredible fish dishes.
The dishes draw Gourmets and Anglers to Darkpool Camp to hone their skills.
Hehe, it's got a bit more mystery than the other two...
Legend has it a champion hid a manual beneath the Greenwhisper Pool, promising incredible power!
Battles aren't really my thing, but if you're curious, try asking around the Arena.
Bye, have a good time at the Darkpool Camp!
Not much of a catch today. Seems like Ling Yikong hasn't had much luck with fishing lately.
No way. Has he lost his touch?
Spike Bears are showing up more often at Greenwhisper Pool, catching plenty of fish.
Rumor has it that monsters are wreaking havoc, driving animals our way.
Some Hunters mentioned things have been uneasy over there.
I grew up eating fish from this pool.
If this keeps up, it might even affect the Harvest Festival.
It might even be connected to what's happening down south in Smokescar Vale.

If we head to Qingyi Pavilion after the competition, there's definitely going to be a long line.
Don't worry! I already made arrangements. I've asked for two servings of Master Yu Huan's fish bites, just for us!
Right! You work at Qingyi Pavilion part-time. Do you know how to make Mayene's favorite fish dish? I'd love to try it!
I'll have to ask Yu Huan about that. Hurry up, let's go! The good spots won't wait!
What if we can't get tickets? We came all this way!
There aren't many people ahead. Let's just wait a bit.
Hold on, everyone! Those tickets might be fake!
Thanks for the heads-up. We could've been ripped off!
Darkpool Camp is cracking down on scalpers. Think twice when you see something fishy.
Darkpool Camp is cracking down on scalpers. Think twice when you see something fishy.
It's wonderful we can visit Sun Bin's workshop. Wonder if I could bump into him.
Senior Sun Bin... I really want to see Senior Sun Bin...
Hey, why are your tickets so pricey?
That's the lowest I can go. I'm not making a cent.
Tickets are hard to get. If it's too much for you, no problem.
But these are the last ones. Miss them, and they're gone for good.
Excuse me, we're in a hurry for tickets. Please line up.
It's for the Darkpool Camp tour ticket!
It includes arena backstage access and a visit to Sun Bin's workshop. A great deal!
We got here late. No idea how many tickets are left.
When did the Darkpool Camp start selling tickets?
When did the Darkpool Camp start selling tickets?
I've heard scalpers are selling fake tickets. Don't get scammed.
I've heard scalpers are selling fake tickets. Don't get scammed.
Xu Ting, don't take it the wrong way. I'm not trying to fool you...
She's exaggerating. I'm not exactly a rare goods merchant.
She's exaggerating. I'm not exactly a rare goods merchant.
But the Lucky Elixir is real, just like she said.
But the Lucky Elixir is real, just like she said.
Feeling skeptical? Just try it and see! I'm a Jixia student too, and I won't hurt you.
Feeling skeptical? Just try it and see! I'm a Jixia student too, and I won't hurt you.
Fine, for Wen Rui's sake, I'll give it a shot.
Wow, it really seems to work! I feel better than ever!
Fantastic! I told you it'd work!
I'll go sign up now! Wait for my good news, Wen Rui!
No dialogue trigger with Xu Ting.
That was quite a hassle just now! Where were we?
Thanks for stepping in. We could've been stuck there all day.
In the end, justice always prevails.
You've picked the right side! Yan Ling is invincible, and we've drawn a big audience!
Care to join our Heroes' Fanclub?
Sounds tempting, but maybe next time...
Sounds tempting, but maybe next time...
What do you mean by "your level"? Trying to take the moral high ground now?
Stop being selfish! Why should you get to use this spot while others can't?
Darkpool Camp is big enough. Why are you so stuck on this one spot?
Agree with Yan Ling's Heroes' Fanclub.
Besides, it makes sense for the Heroes' Fanclub to be near the arena...
Besides, it makes sense for the Heroes' Fanclub to be near the arena...
Whatever. Looks like we've wasted our time here!
You wouldn't want Yan Ling to hear about her fans behaving so poorly, would you?
Hmph, whatever! We're not going to stoop to your level!
Just wait. Let's see if you can take on Yan Ling after your little practice session!
But we were told Yan Ling's Heroes' Fanclub has taken over this spot!
They're claiming this spot is reserved for the Heroes' Fanclub—what nonsense!
We've been using this spot for ages! Just ask anyone!
You're hogging the facilities without even practicing!
We have our reasons for being here, okay? Don't make us sound unreasonable!
You're not an official organization and have no claim over public resources.

text: All this fierce competition in the arena is great for business!
This is the perfect time to make some money, hehe!
How is it? Everything to your liking?
How is it? Everything to your liking?
Are you sure Fuzi recommended this?
It's sour, spicy, bitter, and astringent. One bite and my life flashed before my eyes.
And <001>Tough Love</>... Was sugar free today? It's so sweet my brain is screaming...
Get the chef out here. I need to know how they managed to make this.
What's there to be unsure about?
What, does Qingyi Pavilion not take customer complaints?
Alright, since you insist, I'll go get the chef.
Alright, since you insist, I'll go get the chef.
Is <001>Growing Pains</> meant to be literal physical pain?
Fuzi? What are you doing here?
Fuzi? What are you doing here?
Shh, keep it down. Don't disturb the customers.
There are many paths in life. Stepping outside your comfort zone is part of the experience.
You're certainly a man of action...
You're certainly a man of action...
It's quite a coincidence. A few kids from my school just showed up.
They train so hard. I should whip up a few dishes for them.
Would you mind taking their orders for me?
Oh, right. Ahem. I've been testing out two new dishes. Feel free to recommend them.
One's fresh and sweet, called <001>Tough Love</>. The other's sour and spicy, named <001>Growing Pains</>.
Why not take their order yourself?
They'd probably freeze up if I walked out there. Let's make it a surprise.
Oh, right. Ahem. While you're <001>taking their orders</>, feel free to recommend two new dishes.
One's got a sour and spicy kick, and the other's fresh and sweet.
No problem. What are they called?
No problem. What are they called?
After much deliberation, I've named them <001>Tough Love</> and <001>Growing Pains</>.
They're new recipes that balance nutrition and flavor.
Thanks. They're at the table left of the entrance. You can't miss them.
Thanks. They're at the table left of the entrance. You can't miss them.
One is fresh and sweet, called <001>'Deep Love'</>, and the other is sour and spicy, which I call <001>'Growing Pains'</>.
