text: Hmm... The color's off. Maybe I should add some more ingredients?
Gotta watch the heat and strength. Can't crack another wok.
Let's order and see what Qingyi Pavilion is all about!
Don't get up. Relax, this isn't an exam.
You wanted to meet the chef?
As it happens, you are looking at him.
As it happens, you are looking at him.
Just... Marvelous... Master Fuzi, we didn't know you can cook, haha.
A dish crafted by Fuzi. Such an honor.
Flattery will get you nowhere. And you're not using those words properly.
Wait. Why is there still food left?
With every bite, remember the effort behind it. Make it count.
That's the only proper way to appreciate the effort.
Exactly! Master Fuzi, please don't let us keep you. We'll finish up.
Ahem. Yes, it's a dish with quite a... distinctive character.
The fact that Master Fuzi made this for us... that alone means the world.
You're all too kind. I'm almost embarrassed.
In that case, I'll whip up two more. Wait here.
Looks like the new dishes are a hit.
Looks like the new dishes are a hit.
We're blessed, lucky, words can't even—
Every bowl of porridge and every grain of rice is hard-won; wasting food is not a good habit.
zh_text: 一粥一饭来之不易，浪费粮食可不是好习惯。
source_text: 一粥一饭来之不易，浪费粮食可不是好习惯。
official_target_text: Every bowl of porridge and every grain of rice is hard-won; wasting food is not a good habit.
official_en_text: Every bowl of porridge and every grain of rice is hard-won; wasting food is not a good habit.

text: Proper nourishment is essential! How else will students get through all that coursework?
Look at you, skinny as a rake. Clearly not eating enough.
Next time you're here, I'll cook something to build you up.
Thank you, Master Fuzi... Maybe next time...
Thank you, Master Fuzi... Maybe next time...
Alright, let's make stir-fried pork with bamboo shoots.
They turned out great. I wonder if the kids will like them...
The second they heard you recommended them, they were sold.
The second they heard you recommended them, they were sold.
Great! I'll prep the ingredients and get cooking!
Fuzi, those two Martial Arts students want a word with the chef.
Fuzi, those two Martial Arts students want a word with the chef.
Hmm... So, they know I'm the chef?
They might have something to say about the dishes.
They might have something to say about the dishes.
Oh? Perhaps they were so struck by the flavors that they simply had to meet the chef?
Welcome. What can I get for you two today?
Welcome. What can I get for you two today?
It's our first time here. Got any recommendations?
Judging by your energy, you two must be from the School of Martial Arts.
Judging by your energy, you two must be from the School of Martial Arts.
Care to try our seasonal specials, <001>Tough Love</> and <001>Growing Pains</>?
Care to try our seasonal specials, <001>Tough Love</> and <001>Growing Pains</>?
Fuzi eats here? If he recommends it, it must be good.
At Fuzi's age, he probably prefers bland food. Are you sure we'll like it?
You might wanna watch what you say...
You might wanna watch what you say...
We finally made it here, so we're definitely trying the specials!
They're at the table left of the entrance. You can't miss them.
Make sure to recommend those two dishes.
Ugh... why is this even more bitter than my life?
Are you sure we're in the right place? Is this actually Qingyi Pavilion?
Positive. Maybe our palates just aren't refined enough for it...
I can't do this... can we just... sneak out?
I don't know... It'd kill his excitement.
I'm sure his dishes are a great tonic... but the taste... I just can't.
Of course! It's the best way to prove myself.
Then when will you go? We've been here for days.
You sure about going to the arena? I got this pricey ticket just for you.
This is it... No turning back now.
Ugh, I just need a bit more time to prepare...
You look up to Wuyan, so why not follow her example?
This is the best spot ever! First-hand info makes for the best story of the year!
Huh? I thought you brought me here to cheer for the challengers.
You'd better write something good! I saved our spot ages in advance.
This piece on Yan Ling is going to go viral! When I get my payment, let's go get some fish at Qingyi Pavilion.
No need to fret about food! Fish Nuggets, ready to serve!
Qingyi Pavilion proudly introduces fish nuggets on the go!
I can watch the matches and eat tasty fish!
A senior said that she bought lots of rare little trinkets here at Darkpool Camp.
Just some small trinkets to impress the girls—nothing valuable.
What? Shye too? Alright, let's check it out!
You don't get it! Shye is a regular here!
So many new items here! Come take a look! Stock up while you can!
I'm running low on medicine for injuries. Time to restock.
This is Senior Sun Bin's workshop. Though he doesn't come back often, Darkpool Camp is still one of his stopping places.
If you're lucky, you might run into him!
Before interviewing the champion, I need to be fully prepared.
Having lost her father at a young age, the current estrangement from her sister feels like a wall in her heart.
Without sufficient writing skills, exploring these topics can be risky.
But common topics have all been covered. Let's find fresh angles from the audience tomorrow!
It's the first time someone doesn't want to be champion after winning the challenge.
Look at Yan Ling's face. She seems just as surprised.
But since then, she's been deep in thought...
Maybe this combat gave her some inspiration? I'll keep an eye on her. This could be a good story.
Come on! It's exciting to see a new student dethrone a champion!
That's good for you, right? Your story will get plenty of readers.
You don't get it. I outlined Yan Ling successfully defending the arena. Now I have to rewrite everything!
Luckily, that student isn't aiming to be champion. Let's see if I can make some simple adjustments...
Team of Stars plushes! Autographed photos of Sun Bin! Life-size standees of Luban!
All the hero merch! Don't miss out, or you'll regret it!
You guys... A match is meant to be friendly, not life-threatening!
You really don't know when to quit, do you, bullhead?
Quiet. Once my inspiration is interrupted, it's hard to get it back.
Don't disturb me unless you're here to learn.
I want peace. No one likes to be disturbed, right?
I travel the world. If only my experiences could be compiled into a book.
So many stories hidden in these books. If only I could experience them firsthand.
It would be wonderful if my records could one day be cherished alongside these treasures.
Every time I want to relax, I worry it'll affect my training.
A short pause from time's relentless flow, a brief rest is a joy to know.
If only I could freeze time for a while.
To read celestial events, one must first learn to read starmaps. These are some of the insights I've gathered.
Only by observing the night sky closely can we create the most accurate Starmap.
Precision requires meticulous observation of every detail.
Stars fill the night sky. Today's divination shows a harvest is coming.
Judging by the stars, tomorrow's weather will be exceptionally pleasant.
The stars may be distant, but their influence is deeply intertwined with our lives.
Every star in the constellation has a story, and I'm determined to uncover them all.
The secrets of stars run deeper than we can imagine.
The secrets of starmaps can only be sensed when you slow down.
Look at these little ones, seems like they can never get full.
Watching these little fish swim happily, my mood just brightens up.
I've been collecting divination techniques from various places, and found that birds are especially noteworthy in animal divination.
Everything in this world has secrets, even the aroma of tea.
Every place has its own divination customs. The world is truly full of wonders.
Just released. Animal protectors care more about prediction reports than ordinary students.
After all, this document predicts the future of these creatures.
After a long day, it's so refreshing to come here, feel the breeze, and count the stars.
And gossip sometimes... Hmm? Where was I?
You've been staring at the astrolabe for ages. Why not go get some food?
Don't get me started. My seniors keep rejecting my research proposals.
It's all about striving for perfection. Hey, look how bright the stars are tonight!
The stars say the road is tough, but the future is bright!
Alright, I'll trust you this time.
The brightness has decreased. I should record this with my device.
Okay, let me compare the data with the last batch.
Stars fade, clouds drift by, time keeps flowing. How many more nights like this will we get to see?
You're being too sentimental. But you're right, everything in this world shares the same fate. The moment something is born, it starts to wither away.
Yes, which is why we should cherish every night we have.
Hmm... The trajectory is indeed unusual, but we can't conclude that the Chrono Teller's record is faulty just yet.
Let me check again. There might be some error due to the weather.
Sorry to trouble you, but could you help me collect the data?
No problem. You helped me find that treasure last time, after all.
Done? It took you forever. Let me see.
Wait, hold on. The number of stars is off. How could you make such a rookie mistake?
Oh, I must have miscounted... Well, I can't stop staring at that big whirlpool ahead.
Don't you feel the cold? It's as if... it's sucking away all the warmth.
I bet it's gonna suck your soul out and drag you into another world adventure.
But getting lost could be dangerous.
I've lost count of how many times I've failed the Enlightenment Trials.
Maybe I'm not cut out to study at Jixia Academy.
Don't lose heart. I heard Senior Novar from our school acquired the Star Power right here at the Stargazing Terrace.
Exactly! I heard he trains on the roof of the Stargazing Terrace every night. This place is full of mysteries.
As a Sorcery student, you might even learn some mysterious abilities.
Did you know? Novar mastered the Star Power at the highest point of Stargazing Terrace.
We haven't reached the highest point yet. Are you giving up already?
Huff... huff... The journey is what matters, not the destination.
If I train at the Stargazing Terrace, will my Sorcery Techniques also...
What are you doing? Phew... let's keep climbing!
First, calm your mind. Then sense the changes in the stars, and deduce the divination result.
No way. How could I possibly be the winner of the Mechcraft Competition?
Maybe Fluffy's predictions are more accurate. It even predicted the exam content before.
Could Fluffy be the chosen Astrologist?
The mystery of the stars. Perhaps only my teacher can give me the answers.
Master once told me that the changes in the stars are unpredictable, but there is definitely a pattern to be found.
Master is always there to address every question of mine, so knowledgeable.
After the astrolabe spins... guide it to ascend.
Look, the star pattern has appeared. This symbol indicates that this place will remain peaceful and tranquil for some time to come.
Really? Then tell me, when will I become the strongest in our village?
Not strong enough? You trying to blow the whole village away?
Finally, you're here. Divination materials have been scarce lately.
Let me see... tortoiseshell, tea dregs...
There's also the starmap and parasol.
Always the same. Instead of divining for others, he should divine where his umbrella went.
No rush, take your time. Any more questions?
Don't we know each other? I feel a strange sense of familiarity, as if we were old friends reunited.
Pleased to meet you. I'm San Sing, an Astrologist.
I'm here every day, helping villagers with small problems and doing minor divinations.
If you need divination or miss me, drop by anytime.
Business is booming today. Luckily, I sensed the demand and brought plenty of stock.
This is a type of compass known as a sundial. Although it doesn't have a needle, it can accurately indicate direction.
But that's not all. When you're feeling lost, it can help guide your path in life.
I have many other astrology tools here. Take a look!
What do you think of Bowen?
Bowen is an old friend of mine. I visit him every now and then.
I admire him a lot. He's knowledgeable, tall, and even has a high tolerance for tickling.
If you can make him laugh, I'll give you a free divination.
Come back when you have time!
Come take a look at the new divination tools at my stall!
It's dazzling... Fu Ling, you go first.
Sister, can we sell these pretty divination crystals?
If you really like it, here's a special discount for you.
Let me know if you're interested in any of them.
Good eye! Of course, you can.
Dark again? Time to go home.
Time to pack up. Come back tomorrow!
Don't we know each other? I feel a strange sense of familiarity, as if we were old friends reunited.
Pleased to meet you. I'm San Sing, an Astrologist.
I'm here every day, helping villagers with small problems and doing minor divinations.
If you need divination or just miss me, feel free to drop by. Preferably during the day, though.
We didn't make much profit anyway. I'll tell you about it.
It'll take a few more days before I can afford the specialties I want.
Why not get Bo Wen to help?
He just stands there like a statue, scaring off customers.
Besides, if he were here, I'd be too busy tickling him to say anything, haha.
Come back when you have time!
Everyone's packing up or heading home.
Cleaning is so boring. Well, let me take it as a part of my training!
A calm mind is needed to read the stars.
Cleaning alone is so boring. Oh well, I'll just treat it as training!
zh_text: 一个人打扫真的好无聊，算了，就当成是修行吧！
source_text: 一个人打扫真的好无聊，算了，就当成是修行吧！
official_target_text: Cleaning alone is so boring. Oh well, I'll just treat it as training!
official_en_text: Cleaning alone is so boring. Oh well, I'll just treat it as training!

text: I've been so unlucky lately. I feel like I could get a toothache just by drinking cold water!
What, your herb garden got raided by Armadillo Rats again?
Worse! A frost hit, reducing herb yields, and strong winds delayed Jay's seed delivery.
Most importantly, my new Aersilk Bug Plow and Aero Irrigator both broke down at the same time! How can someone be this unlucky?!
Maybe something in here can guide me... Or perhaps the Stargazing Terrace sells lucky stones or something?
Shouldn't you be looking for the School of Mechcrafts? Go get your warranty.
Finally, a chance to rest after a long day. Fluffy, what did you see today?
But don't these Fluffy ones make an adorable sight?
When villagers need to divine important matters, that room comes in handy.
Mostly family matters, but since they care so much, we can't be sloppy.
Why are you surrounded by Fluffies?
My focus was on stargazing back in my school days. It's been a long time since graduation, and I've come to realize that these little things are also quite fascinating.
Their actions are like stars, seemingly random at first glance, but actually carrying deeper information.
Many Modern Astrology Society members keep Fluffies as pets and study them. Maybe I can figure out what they're predicting.
Goodbye, feel free to find me anytime.
Look at yourself, I could give you a pillow now, and you'd just sleep right on the floor.
I had no choice. Nightmares every time I doze off, and I've been a wreck these days.
My mom is in the same situation. I need your help.
I see. No worries, just follow my lead.
Now, clear your mind of distractions. Silently focus on your thoughts and slowly move your gaze to the light...
Oh? It seems it's not because of an emotional knot. Auntie, you should get some proper rest—during the daytime, I mean.
Mom! Did you go back to farming again? The Mechcraft bugs can handle it. Why are you...
I just can't stay idle... Alright, alright, I'll stop, really stop. I promise I'll take a few days off.
What are the three fluffy ones doing?
Praying for rain to cool down?
No. Fluffy's head and paws are highly directional.
Familiar things will change... does it mean the canteen is launching new dishes today?
I hope this time it's accurate. The last time it failed to predict the weather.
Yes, rain forecasted for two days and nights, but it turned out to be just overcast followed by clearing skies.
It'll be fine. Everything will be fine!
I made a little mistake last time, just a little one.
Don't miss out! Divination masters await at Stargazing Terrace!
And it's not just me. There are many other top masters!
If all else fails, you can always come here and learn about the stars!
It's free anyway. Why not go take a look?
Adventure's path is ever-changing, like the stars.
Oh? Are you also interested in these things?
Designs for decorative items and mysterious little fruits. Wanna try?
Practical or not, I love all kinds of little things. They make life fun.
I've studied astronomy, geography, ancient history, and more.
If you wish to discuss these matters, I'm afraid it will have to wait for another day. I'm busy running my stall.
Welcome to the Wonder Shop. If it exists, we have it.
Tea leaf divination is the most basic form of divination. Would you like to learn more?
Divination using tea leaves? Sounds unreliable...
Come on, he's my friend! He won't hurt me.
Keep your question in mind, drink most of the tea, then rotate the cup three times clockwise.
An interesting answer. Someone is waiting for your response. Don't hesitate, seize the moment.
You know what? I had a nightmare.
Thankfully, the muscles of us Martial Arts students never betray us.
You're just like that big furball on the ground—a simple fellow.
In the dream, I became an ordinary person with no Sorcery Energy left.
I've been under so much stress lately. I want to ask the stars if I'm really cut out for studying.
But I can't afford the fee...
Oh, the stars talk to everyone! Look up at night, if the stars are twinkling, it means you're awesome.
I know! The constellation changes with the seasons.
Yeah, like the stars last night... How many were there again?
Astrology works because stars predict changes in nature.
Taiwei Chamber Secret Room... No entry allowed...
I'm guarding the secret room of the Supreme Chamber, obviously.
Uh... just some Mechcraft parts for the Stargazing Terrace, repair tools, and stuff like that.
Oh, I still feel so sleepy.
It may sound unremarkable, but that's because everything is peaceful now. If trouble strikes, it's up to them to handle it!
If it's so important, why are you sleeping?
If it's so important, why are you sleeping?
I-I pulled an all-nighter making Mechcrafts... Please, don't tell the teacher.
I'm from the School of Mechcrafts. Whenever the divination Mechcrafts malfunction, people come to me for repairs.
You know the Divination Mechcraft, right? A perfect blend of divination and Mechcraft, I'd call it the greatest Mechcraft masterpiece of the past century!
Hehe, talking about this, I'm not sleepy at all.
Oh... ah? Are you talking to me?
Novar stole the show in the Enlightenment Trials back then.
I must work harder to surpass him.
The cutest Fluffy in the world, can you tell me where the ancient Starmap is?
Hehe, no rush. Let's play a while longer.
Oh, are you in a hurry to go and play with your little friends?
Fluffy who stay up late are not good babies.
I heard that one night, Fluffy stayed up, snuck out to see the stars, and...
So no staying up late, and no stepping on my face.
And then got taken away by that huge Wolvine!
Drawing a starmap is simple. You just...
It's really simple. Press this, then turn that...
Does it reflect the real sky in real time, even during the day?
Guess who's the teacher now, huh?
Third data record, comparing the averages... Perfect! The error has decreased!
Review the starmap. Calm down. Redraw it. I've done this a million times; this time will be fine.
Sketching the pattern in mind, channeling Sorcery Technique to fingertips, a gentle stroke...
That's what the beginner's guide to astrology says. I followed it to the letter. There shouldn't be any mistake.
By the stars, grant me the blessing to complete this Starmap in one stroke.
At times like thunder, at times like snow.
Sun Chenghu always brags about this Astrology Sorcery Technique. How did he put it again... Oh, right!
This guy just loves to talk about Aerships. I'll see for myself this time.
Don't be down. How about we go to the rooftop and relax with some stargazing?
No thanks, I slept enough during the day... Ah, when will this ever end.
You can't stay negative like this.
Guarding the secret chamber is boring, but you took on the Mechcraft maintenance of the Stargazing Terrace. That's impressive.
I saw how you fixed my divination Mechcraft in minutes. You're super talented!
Really? I... I... Let's go see the stars.
That cunning San Sing paid us to create a diversion so he could sneak into the Forbidden Chamber.
In the end, I got caught by Mr. Bo Wen while they ran faster than anyone else...
I swept the floor for three whole days. It's so frustrating.
Now she offers free divination as compensation. Could there be another trap? I'll trust her one last time.
Advanced Starmap Compendium—this must be it!
But the content is so hard to understand. Starmaps are so complicated...
No other choice. I'll give it a shot.
'The Complete Guide to Interpreting High-Level Star Charts,' this must be it!
zh_text: 《高阶星图解读大全》，应该就是这本！
source_text: 《高阶星图解读大全》，应该就是这本！
official_target_text: 'The Complete Guide to Interpreting High-Level Star Charts,' this must be it!
official_en_text: 'The Complete Guide to Interpreting High-Level Star Charts,' this must be it!

text: Quiet, I'm trying to sense something!
Starmap... Let me try sensing it with Sorcery Energy...
Can advanced divination techniques be learned so quickly?
Why can't I get the results? It shouldn't be failing all the time!
I've been staring at the patterns on the drawing board, trying to find the constellations.
I'm sorry. I had no other choice.
What now? We won't finish the assignment, and Mr. Bo Wen will definitely scold us tomorrow!
You're finally getting the hang of it. I'll go find some tea leaves.
Mr. Bowen taught us tea leaf divination. It's easy to do and interpret, we can give it a try.
Alright, alright, we'll do it your way this time.
Simple divination is a good start. Astrology is too hard for beginners.
Simple divination is a good start. Astrology is too hard for beginners.
Senior Novar used tea leaves for divination before, so it'll definitely work.
I'll dig deeper, hoping to find an answer...
I feel like searching more documents won't lead anywhere.
What are you doing under this device?
What are you doing under this device?
I'd like a divination about friendship.
I'd like a divination about my studies.
Ni Yuan knows the place well. You can go with him.
I'm using astrology to read celestial patterns and help my fellow students understand future trends.
Everyone's fate is closely tied to the stars, but it takes an astrologer to guide us through their mysteries.
Sounds incredible, right? But that's the truth.
Yeah, I just wanted to tag along with Ni Yuan, but the teacher's lecture was so captivating, I almost got swept up in it!
So, after hearing all this, would you like to try your hand at divination?
Honestly, I'm struggling a bit with Jixia's courses. I want to divine if my academic journey will go smoothly.
Honestly, I'm struggling a bit with Jixia's courses. I want to divine if my academic journey will go smoothly.
The Wen Heng Star, which symbolizes academics, is to the south.
Ni Yuan knows the place well. You can go with him.
I've not been in Jixia for long. I wonder if I'll find like-minded friends here.
I've not been in Jixia for long. I wonder if I'll find like-minded friends here.
Find the Nurturer of Bonds in the north.
The master's insight is remarkable. When I was low on money, I asked him to predict when I'd have more.
And she said I'd get some "unexpected wealth" in three days. I thought, no way!
That night, Dad showed up with my favorite dishes. He wanted to surprise me.
Feeling lost about your studies is a phase every student goes through.
Life can be too lonely for one person.
The constellation's main star is exceptionally bright, indicating smooth academic progress.
Great, no more stressing about failing exams!
Master, please help me with my fortune. Will I find love soon?
One at a time, guys. The clear sky is perfect for stargazing.
Finished observing the constellations? Did you record the starmap?
Got it. I saw the third star in the constellation was red. Anything about that?
Got it. I saw the third star in the constellation was red. Anything about that?
Let me check the stargazing device.
You can sense such subtle Astrological Energy? You have talent!
Finished observing the constellations? Did you record the starmap?
Got it. I see one purple star in the constellation. What does it mean?
Got it. I see one purple star in the constellation. What does it mean?
Let me check the stargazing device.
You can sense such subtle Astrological Energy? You have talent!
How things develop depends on how you perceive them. Next time you come stargazing, you might discover something different.
Guess Martial Arts students really aren't cut out for astrology. I don't get this at all.
It's normal for it to take some time to learn, so don't get discouraged.
Plus, under the starry sky, you'll better understand the harmony of Martial Arts in body and mind, right?
The starry sky calms my mind.
It's normal not to learn it right away, don't be discouraged.
zh_text: 一时半会儿学不会是很正常的，不要气馁。
source_text: 一时半会儿学不会是很正常的，不要气馁。
official_target_text: It's normal not to learn it right away, don't be discouraged.
official_en_text: It's normal not to learn it right away, don't be discouraged.

text: Thank you, now we can finally complete the divination assignment.
Thanks so much! If we failed, I can't imagine Mr. Bowen's cold face...
You're right. Simple methods often work just as well.
Don't chase higher difficulties blindly. Find the approach that suits you best right now—that's what matters most.
Well, tea leaf divination actually works pretty well.
Now you know. Let's try again to ensure accurate results.
The results from the planetarium match my hypothesis.
The Compassionate Maid represents your relationships. The purple star connecting the others in the center represents you.
Stars align for you, gathering a large group of classmates to progress alongside you.
I see now. Thank you for your guidance, Mr. Ding.
I see now. Thank you for your guidance, Mr. Ding.
But the depth of connection with each star doesn't need to be forced. As long as you're sincere, every journey will have its meaning.
The blue stars symbolize your successful enrollment, while the reddish stars represent the challenging courses you've encountered recently.
But the stars turned blue again, meaning the confusion is temporary, and your future studies will be smooth and easy.
I see now. Thank you for your guidance, Mr. Ding.
I see now. Thank you for your guidance, Mr. Ding.
The Vernal Equinox is usually associated with academics. Blue represents harmony and opportunity, while red represents obstacles and challenges.
But you must stay focused, persistent, and believe in yourself.
Let me see... The tea leaves have formed a circle.
A circle symbolizes harmony and is a sign of good luck. Our divination was successful!
I can see it too. I know what the divination shows.
It worked! Now I can finish my assignment on time!
You seem in a hurry. What happened?
You seem in a hurry. What happened?
Bowen assigned us a divination exercise. We have to choose a method to predict today's fortune.
I want to use advanced Astrology techniques for divination to impress Mr. Bowen.
Simple divination methods are recommended for beginners.
You're right. Maybe I haven't done enough research. Let me check more books.
You're finally getting the hang of it. I'll go find some tea leaves.
Those two have been arguing about divination methods all day. We're never going to finish this assignment!
You seem to know a lot about divination, can you help us? What method do you think we should use for the assignment?
Mr. Bowen taught us tea leaf divination. It's easy to do and interpret, we can give it a try.
Alright, alright, we'll do it your way this time.
See? Simple divination is the way to go. Astrology is too hard for beginners. Let's start with something easy.
From what I know, Senior Novar also used tea leaves for divination. It'll definitely work.
Give me a bit more time, and I might finally master the advanced divination technique.
Oh no, I haven't touched my divination assignment due tomorrow!
We haven't even figured out the basic methods of divination yet.
You haven't found the book at all, have you?
If there were an easier way, we would have succeeded long ago.
But a little challenge now and then isn't so bad.
Give her some time. She might actually figure it out.
How did it get this late?
I promised myself I'd go to bed early today, but the stars are out tonight. It's a rare opportunity.
Well, I'll go to bed early tomorrow!
I heard divination works when you're sincere. So, will I pass the exam?
Stop asking me that... I know I'm sincere, so why...
Maybe San Sing was just trying to motivate you! You can do better next time.
You never let me catch a break, do you?
Am I really saying goodbye to my dear campus?
Perfect timing. Care to spar with me?
Never seen you so keen on dieting before.
Just trying to help our juniors with their luggage, you know.
Been training in the arena every day. Do you see any weight loss?
I must go through all the records carefully.
In a few days, I'll be doing divination on my own.
I must not let him down.
Aren't these stars just random balls of light? There isn't any pattern at all.
How do those Astrologers see so much?
It still feels unbelievable. Master San Sing was right—the key was in my bag all along.
How did she know? I saw her just tap the water twice and give the answer.
It's incredible. I'll have to learn a few tricks when I have time. Then I won't worry about losing things.
Ugh, my luck has been terrible lately. I need to check when this bad luck will end.
But there are so many people here for divination. If I go after work, I might miss my turn...
Should we wait until there are fewer people before getting a ticket? Can we sneak in unnoticed?
I've never seen this before. It looks like good luck, but then it changed.
If I make a conclusion now and my judgment is wrong...
I should check the books to be sure.
Last time, it accurately predicted even the exact time and duration of the rain.
I need to do another divination.
If they're right again, I'll send them a banner.
Honestly, where is Qiming? I've been practicing for ages.
Not another urgent divination today, is it?
Should I go look for him? No, I shouldn't interrupt his work. I'll just wait a bit longer.
Luckily, I found Wei Chen to cover for me.
I don't want to waste my time arguing with that Seeker Society guy again.
Before Wei Chen changes his mind, I'll head back now.
Been days since I went home. My comfy bed probably misses me.
So many people come for divination, and the queue can take hours.
How can we speed up divination without causing chaos or exhausting our Astrologers...?
I need to plan it well.
Oh, I see. That's why the star hub's degree didn't change.
The stars have shifted, but they remain symmetrical, so the results still hold.
I must write this down, or I'll forget it.
I still think the first spot I picked was good. It's got mountains, water, and high terrain, which makes it less prone to dampness.
No, according to my astrological readings, that location is not suitable for a residence. Plus, it's surrounded by land on all sides, making it hard for moisture to escape.
You lack experience. I've traveled far and wide and never met anyone who'd call this place unsuitable.
You're just a bottle that's less than half full. Go get a map, and I'll explain it properly.
Alright, I'll get the map and explain it to you.
So, after all this talking, what do you want to divine?
Well... I want to divine my next exam score... though I know it might not be great.
But I've been away studying and running errands for my mentor.
I understand, but no excuses can change the results of divination. The stars in the sky can't hear you.
What was it called again? Patterns of Stars? Or was it Secrets of Stars?
I'd feel awkward asking the administrator.
They might think I'm clueless about the book.
I'll try myself first. Or maybe I'll come up with the name first. That's it!
This place is getting more lively.
I enjoy the bustling atmosphere, chatting with people and listening to their wishes.
Then I'll have endless inspiration for my novels.
I've been waiting forever, and they still won't let me see the Astrology Master.
I'll have to resort to my own methods then.
I'm about to see the Astrology Master for a divination.
Hmm, we could move that guy out of the way and go in through the front gate. But that might disturb the master...
Or maybe we can find a back door?
This stargazing device is amazing. I saw that Astrologer glance at it and reveal so much.
Astrological changes, situational developments, personal impacts... It feels quite profound.
If I learn Astrology, will I become as capable as him?
I never expected Master San Sing to praise me. Tong Jiaqiu, you've really improved. You're not the failure you used to be.
I must not get complacent. I will keep working hard.
I just finished my work and was looking for a place to relax.
I need to deliver some documents to the academy later.
Yes, I failed so many times that I almost lost faith.
But since I started studying hard, my divination has been accurate.
I want to be like those masters—accurate and flawless in every attempt.
Failed again. It's the third time this week.
How could I fail at such a simple divination?
Am I losing my edge, or is my heart not in it?
So many come for divination these days. I can only clean at night when it's quiet.
It's so quiet now, feels kinda boring.
But the library is quieter at night. I can read after cleaning, and review the divination cases from the day.
The Stargazing Terrace consists of the Hualin Market, the Taimei Pavilion, and the Violet Chamber.
The top floor is the Violet Chamber, divided into two levels. The first floor is a public hall with free access, while the inner room is the Stargazing Archive.
Tell me about the Stargazing Terrace.
The lowest level is the Heaven Market Terrace, where we conduct research and simulations. We also provide simple predictions for visitors.
The chamber in Taiwei Pavilion stores parts for stargazing Mechcrafts, as well as repair and production tools. Do not enter unless necessary.
The second floor houses the Chrono Teller, where I conduct my stargazing work.
I'm Bowen. If you seek divination, please find another Astrologer.
I'll answer other questions within my scope of responsibility.
Anything else? Like gossip from the Stargazing Terrace?
Anything else? Like gossip from the Stargazing Terrace?
Why don't you help with divination?
I'm only responsible for stargazing, what you mentioned is beyond my scope.
But aren't you an Astrologist too?
But aren't you an Astrologist too?
Some things are best left unsaid. Let's end it here.
How's your relationship with San Sing?
You must have a lot of free time.
Just a bit. She's a handful, to say the least.
She's been helping me a lot, running the Stargazing Terrace.
Quick rundown, what are we gonna ask?
First, the strange star trajectory last night; then, the new Astrology Mechcraft data differs from the previous ones.
And if he's in a good mood, we can ask him about San Sing.
That question just made me even more nervous.
I heard San Sing was here again yesterday.
Yeah, it was quite a spectacle.
The exchange between the two filled the Violet Chamber with excitement.
I wish San Sing would visit more often. Days feel so dull.
Shh, keep it down. Don't let Bo Wen hear us.
What do you think of San Sing?
Shh, keep your voice down when you say that name.
San Sing is full of mischievous ideas, always playing pranks on Bo Wen and has a bit of a greed for money.
That's not fair. I think she's nice and very passionate about her work.
You're both right. The San Sing I remember is a mix of what you both said.
How do you think Bowen did?
Oh dear... is that really necessary?
He's knowledgeable and reliable. He takes divination very seriously.
He's so focused on work that he hardly talks.
He rarely speaks and has a stern face. We only talk to him when we have questions.
How's the relationship between Chen Xing and Bowen?
You're asking the right person. We're always on the front lines of the war, with access to the latest and most comprehensive intelligence.
Ignore him. Sanxing wanted to access the Aerux, but Bowen, as the manager, refused multiple times. Sanxing wouldn't give up.
So they often clashed, both physically and wits-wise. Usually, it was San Sing provoking, and Bowen maintaining his ground.
It must have been spectacular. Too bad I missed it.
Come back soon. We're bored here.
One attacking, one defending, back and forth, tit for tat—the atmosphere in the Ziwei Hall has become much more lively.

text: But with the Rebels around the ruins lately, they might be after the Starmap too. Stay alert!
I'm collecting ancient starmaps. Can you help?
Scholars stargazed here before the Stargazing Terrace was built.
But I found four ancient Starmaps missing...
Though now we can observe the stars more easily and accurately with the Stargazing Terrace.
But the ancient starmap also records the methods of astrological calculations from the past...
The ancient astrology influenced farming, geography, medicine...
It plays a huge role in so many fields.
Seniors stayed up all night climbing peaks and recording the stars... so touching.
If you find them, please bring them to me. I'll reward you well.
Where can I find the starmap?
They should be scattered throughout the Jixia Mountains.
These ancient ruins were once the hub of Astrological activities.
Starmaps are precious and fragile, well-hidden for protection.
Some ancient ruins that were once places where astrologers were active.

text: If you find all the lost Starmaps, we'll be one step closer to unveiling the secrets of the cosmic stars.
I'll keep all the Starmaps you collect and reward you generously.
Try changing the rotation direction... Hmm, good.
Ah... The shifting distances between those stars resemble changes in Sorcery flow...
Pay attention to the stars that suddenly dim, and adjust the intensity of your Flow. Those seemingly dim stars actually harbor powerful forces within.
An extinguished star seems even more dangerous. Do you think these changes will affect Jixia?
The stars shift, and Sorcery changes. Understand?
Huh? You don't know the instructor of the School of Sorcery?
Check out this elegant Aersilk robe. There can only be one place in Jixia that sells it.
Many of my new students have just arrived at Jixia.
Their insight and control of Sorcery are far from the standard.
The essence of Sorcery lies in understanding the nature of all things.
Traveling with students is an essential part of teaching.
Observing prophecies? It may seem magical to most people.
But to us Sorcerers, everything is connected.
We seek deeper laws, the essence of heaven and earth.
This place is called Stargazing Terrace...
But its function goes far beyond just stargazing...
I just learned that weather forecasting also relies on historical data.
If I'm not wrong, the Starmap Master Zane needs should be around here...
Don't be fooled by its age. It's been running for a long time.
I've witnessed countless celestial cycles and recorded them in detail.
Don't be clumsy, be careful, don't break the Mechcraft.
Wow... look at how it sparkles.
Stargrams are said to contain the clues to all the hidden ruins and treasures.
This... I just can't make sense of it. Am I reading it upside down?
Hmm... it looks the same to me...
Me? I'm a member of the Seeker Society.
I've gone on quite a few ruin adventures lately, and they all ended with nothing gained. Everyone around me is advising me to consider a different path.
But I refuse to believe it. I'll keep going and find that treasure to prove them all wrong!
Anyway, I've got to keep searching for clues in the Starmap.
I don't know if you've heard, but for some people, starmaps are like compasses for ancient ruins.
It not only leads to the entrance but also marks the treasure's location!
You know Shye, right? She's also from the Seeker Society, and she often finds really valuable treasures.
And Novar, who's really close to her, always comes to the Stargazing Terrace.
What if Novar helped Shye interpret the starmap, and that's how she always returned with valuable info?
Bye... Perhaps I should flip it again...
The weather's been unpredictable lately, and the requests are piling up. I'm at my wit's end.
So you're looking for inspiration in this old Starmap?
It's a Starmap left by the previous master after all. There must be something special about it... right?
Haha, you're right. This oil spot aligns perfectly with the Tai Chi symbol in the case file. Isn't that mystical?
Anyway... the person who borrowed this map, did they use it as a picnic mat?
And there's a tea cup ring, ink stains, and a big red splatter...
I haven't even sorted out all the Starmaps I already have! Why are there new ones?!
Don't overwork, Croaky! Take a break!
These little creatures are so diligent. The previous master trained them well. They might replace us one day.
Who knows, maybe the next manager of Stargazing Terrace will be a Croaky...
I've heard Bowen is hard to get along with. I've never had the courage to ask for his advice...
I've heard Bowen is hard to get along with. I've never had the courage to ask for his advice...
Oh, it's not surprising you have that feeling.
Everyone who has dealt with him says the same thing.
I really admire people who've mastered astronomy and astrology.
Bowen's skills in this field are unmatched.
He was obsessed with it, never wasting time on meaningless social interactions...
Stargazing Terrace is focused on academic research. As its head, I don't need to worry too much about worldly affairs.
Bowen's world only has stars and celestial phenomena, no room for anything else... But recently...
Something's off, and it's related to San Sing's arrival.
Ever since San Sing joined the school, Bowen has been different.
He complained to me from time to time about San Sing disturbing his observations.
This was unimaginable before—Bowen never spoke of anything outside astronomy and astrology with us.
And although San Sing's interruption seemed to trouble him...
But if Sanxing doesn't go find him, he'll come asking me where Sanxing went, wondering if he went to the Stargazing Terrace...
Lately, I've often seen him standing alone, lost in thought, though he did this often before too.
But back then, he was always calculating the movements of stars or thinking about his stargazing device...
But now, I'm just... spacing out.
And recently... he made mistakes on his Starmap!
Hard to believe it was crafted by Bowen.
I need to finish this Starmap...
The people inside said children are not allowed in, it's too dangerous.
But I saw someone having fun in there last time.
I want to go too. Do I have to climb up like you?
And here I was hoping to slack off a bit.
How about you check around the main gate?
Nope, just happened to be nearby since I live close to Roaring Tiger Training Hall.
I thought if I could get in through this back door, I wouldn't have to walk all the way down to the main gate.
Turns out the door can't be opened. Head Trainer must have locked it from the inside.
Yeah, if you want to enter the Roaring Tiger Training Hall, you have to go through the front gate.
The main entrance is actually at the foot of the mountain. I heard they've set up some Mechanoid trials to guard the gate.
I don't feel like climbing and am too afraid to face the trial, so I'm just waiting here to see if someone can open the back door from the other side.
If you do get in, remember to open this path. See you.
The door can't be opened from this side...
I just wrote down that Formula a while ago, how could I forget it so soon?
Need to find a formula to boost memory.
Are you injured? Or do you feel unwell?
How about some medicine to recover your strength?
I used to struggle to remember formulas, but now...
But my work is reliable. If you ever need it, come and buy one.
Relax, I was very careful. There won't be any mistakes.
But you got my name wrong.
Oh, in that case, let me think about it...
Don't try to be a hero. Go get treated.
You were the one who got hurt.
I'm exhausted. How was my dance?
Don't think too much. Food first.
Help me out, and this round of drinks is on me.
Alright, I see you have enough strength, but your speed is still lacking, and your core isn't stable enough.
Finally, she's gone. Time to take a break.
Day and night, when will it ever end...
But this Pouncing Jump is getting easier.
Maybe this is what they call "deliberate practice"! I just wish she wasn't so strict...
I'm hungry, but too weak to open my mouth.
Eyelids so heavy... Zzz... I'll just take a nap...
Finally made it to the top.
Finally, I can catch my breath. I'll rest up first.
I've been training hard lately, and my back is killing me.
Ask for details about the weapon.
Ah! My weapon that's been through mountains and seas with me!
It's all Pouncing Tiger's fault! If my skills were better, you wouldn't have...
I won't let your efforts go to waste. I'll make sure to defeat it!
Croaky, why are you feeling down?
Why does he look like he's about to cry whenever we move?
Perhaps he thought it was too dangerous for us?
The people inside said children are not allowed in, it's too dangerous.
But I saw someone having fun in there last time.
You're the first to pass the challenge. Here's your reward. Take it.
Looking forward to seeing you make progress in Martial Arts!
Hehe, Ling'er and I are here to give out rewards to the diligent students under Master's orders.
Seems like no one's a fan of jumping on Plum Blossom Posts, but luckily, you're here!
No problem! Master will be happy to see someone using the Plum Blossom Post.
Someone's at the top! Great! Come down now. We've got gifts for you.
Speaking of which, did Senior Novar also come to jump on the Plum Blossom Post before?
Yeah, but I think our new friend here is even more impressive—faster than Senior Novar!
It's such a tough challenge. No one has reached the top in three months...
Show some enthusiasm! Otherwise, even fewer people will want to challenge.
No one has reached the top in three months. Whoever does it will get Master's reward!
Fish today, fish tomorrow... How can I eat fish every day?
When Master Mozi visited a few days ago, the food was amazing...
Actually, it's because Master Mozi doesn't like fish. So whenever he visits, we get new dishes, and we get to enjoy them too!
Master Mozi, you don't like fish?
Master Mozi doesn't like fish, so he always prepares new dishes when he visits. We get to enjoy them too!
Master Mozi, did you finish all the fish?
Master Mozi, we're all looking forward to having you dine with us!
Master Mozi, we're all looking forward to having you dine with us!
Wait, why are there fewer crystals than before?
Hey, have you seen a merchant named "Chang Bu Xing" at Darkpool Camp?
The sword he sold me broke after just one day. I need to have a word with him!
What, you bought this sword too? Look, it doesn't even have a scratch. Is it really just my bad luck...?
There's definitely something wrong with the quality of this sword.
There's definitely something wrong with the quality of this sword.
I heard that merchant say he made his first fortune at Roaring Tiger Training Hall... Are you that fortune?
I heard that merchant say he made his first fortune at Roaring Tiger Training Hall... Are you that fortune?
He sounded sincere, so I trusted him.
Plus, they're cheap, so I figured, why not buy one to practice with?
Trying to save a buck really cost me this time.
Hey, have you seen a merchant named "Chang Bu Xing" at Darkpool Camp?
The sword he sold me broke after just one day. I need to have a word with him!
Wait, look at this white-hilted sword.
Oh... this sword looks much better than my last one.
You like it? I got it from someone else. I'll let you have it cheap.
You like it? I got it from someone else. I'll let you have it cheap.
Really? That's great! My sword just broke, and I need a new one for practice.
Hold on. I think I know how you were deceived.
Hold on. I think I know how you were deceived.
Look at this sword. It may look impressive, but its quality is barely better than your broken one.
Look at this sword. It may look impressive, but its quality is barely better than your broken one.
I heard that merchant say he made his first fortune at Roaring Tiger Training Hall... Are you that fortune?
I heard that merchant say he made his first fortune at Roaring Tiger Training Hall... Are you that fortune?
You... you're with him?! Wait, you don't seem to be lying...
Ah! Your words are so sincere. It feels so real.
I've learned my lesson. Greed leads to loss. Thank you!
Just watch, I'll gather all the victims and expose him!
Damn, this Black-Hilted Sword broke after just one day of use!
It was supposed to last for years!
Once I catch that merchant Chang Buxing, he'll regret ever crossing me!
I remember he headed southeast after selling me the sword... Hmm...
Probably scamming at Darkpool Camp. I'll get him soon!
Why is no one paying attention to me? Is my voice too soft?
Ugh, can't take it, need a proper rest...
What? You figured that out just by passing by?
I got punished and had to sweep the floor all day. Master consoled me, saying to consider it part of my training.
No wonder this place is so clean.
No wonder this place is so clean.
Haha, that's a silly thing to say. But I'll take it as a comfort.
Sorry to stop you, but we found the head trainer's secret!
So you found the hidden compartment behind the chair?
So you found the hidden compartment behind the chair?
Yes, he hid some fish there. Though you probably took it, he left a warning note for you.
I took it. I just wanted to play a prank...
I took it. I just wanted to play a prank...
Don't worry, here, take it! Just consider it a "lesson" for the head trainer!
Actually, he thinks he's too heavy to defeat Bai He, who is much lighter.
Actually, he thinks he's too heavy to defeat Bai He, who is much lighter.
You guessed it! It's not right to let one dish dominate. Meal planning should be left to us Gourmet Society experts!
Exactly, and there's no real ranking in Martial Arts. The Hall Master's strength is unmatched, but that doesn't mean it's something Bai He can just learn.
You can "confiscate" the fish he hid! Whatever fish the Head Trainer eats to satisfy her cravings without gaining weight, let us handle it!
Just wait and see. We'll stuff her like a pufferfish!
I should buy ingredients for a dish for the Head Trainer tomorrow...
Stay focused. You still have to make the meal and copy the list.
How much farther to the top? My legs are tired.
We've stopped several times already. Maybe we should keep going?
You never rushed to reach the summit before, preferring to enjoy the scenery along the way. Why are you in such a hurry this time?
Mang Hua is waiting for us.
Training's been so boring lately. Same old stuff.
Shh... keep that between us, don't let others hear.
Finally, someone has completed the challenge. Come claim your rewards!
They're pushing too hard. Some moves are really risky.
An injury could be troublesome. Should we remind them?
It's a long way down. A fall will keep me out for days.
No time to hesitate now. Just grit your teeth and go.
That darn Zeh, insisted on challenging himself by doing the Pouncing Jump with an animal.
What am I even doing here? I shouldn't have gotten involved.
You said one person per segment, and both of us would be the "first one." Don't back out now!
I can't jump anymore. How about you give me a piggyback ride? It's impressive to carry someone through the Pouncing Jump.
About the challenge of Tiger Palm.
Are you here to challenge the Tiger Palm?
She's still trying, though. I'd like to stay and cheer her on.
The Head Trainer designed the Tiger Jump for our daily training. We come here after our daily sessions.
Now I can reach the room above.
Be more careful next time. Getting all injured will only slow you down.
The Head Trainer of Roaring Tiger Training Hall has no other hobby than sparring with others.
I heard there's a special reward for the winner, but with the Head Trainer's strength, few can win.
Goodbye, I'll practice a bit more.
Master's been angry these days. I'd better stay out of his sight.
I heard my master challenged Master Fuzi again. It was a disaster...
Shh, don't tell anyone I'm here.
Whoever gets assigned to sweep the stairs these days is in real trouble!
Yeah, is the stone wall above the staircase damaged or something? There's always debris falling down...
It seems the falling rocks have stopped.
That's right. Rubbles were piled up to conceal the Mechcraft.
That's right. Rubbles were piled up to conceal the Mechcraft.
Whoa! I knew the ceiling wouldn't crack for no reason. There was something hidden up there!
Thank goodness it's not Rebels causing trouble! I wonder what this Mechcraft does that it needs to be hidden.
That's got nothing to do with us. Maybe it's just Master teaming up with someone else to test us again.
Thank you so much! We can finally stop worrying.
That ceiling looks like it could cave in any second!
Nothing, just look at that staircase. It might be damaged, and there are rubble falling down.
Sweeping is nothing. If it collapses, it could be a disaster...
But the Roaring Tiger Training Hall is built entirely from this stone. Why are the ceilings fine everywhere else?
Could it be you're climbing higher with each attempt?
Ouch... that fall really hurt... Strange, it seems to hurt more than the last.
That... that makes sense! You're so smart!
Looks like the Mechanoid challenge will have to wait.
I can hold out for a while now.
That's quite an improvement. I'm thinking if there's another way to speedrun it...
You've been wandering around here for a while. Are you thinking of trying the Mechanoid challenge too?
It's a trial. Only those who pass can reach the second floor and meet Head Trainer Tiger.
Students from the Academy come here to challenge the Head Trainer, and this Mechanoid challenge is the first test.
Any tips for the Mechanoid challenge?
Just imagine them as the Mechcraft dummies at the academy, and bash your way forward.
Don't listen to him. He's too reckless. The Mechanoid was fine, but he collapsed from exhaustion.
Observe the Mechanoids' weaknesses, strike with precision, and maximize the impact of each hit.
But I've only got the theory down—I haven't actually passed it myself.
See you. Next time we can exchange tips on battles.
The Training Hall built on ruins must hold many secrets worth exploring.
I haven't discovered anything new yet... but I just need to keep focusing.
Aren't you going upstairs to see the head trainer?
Well, I did have that plan. Who wouldn't want to explore more after going through so much trouble to get in?
But Hu Rui Hall is enough to keep me busy for now. As for going higher, there's no rush.
I'm just a gentle Seeker, focused on my training. A single misstep could lead to serious injury.
Do you know anything about ancient Mechcrafts?
Ancient Mechcraft? Roaring Tiger Training Hall was built on ruins. It wouldn't surprise me if there were relics.
But... oh, I just remembered! One of my seniors specializes in studying these ancient Mechcraft facilities.
She skipped the Mechanoid trial and went inside alone, but Ling Hu kicked her out.
We made fun of her for ages! If you need help, go to the <001>cave opposite the top floor exit</> and look for someone named <001>Wen Yann</>.
She knows these things better than anyone I know. But keep it between us—I wouldn't want her to hear about my slip-up.
I'll be here for a while. Come find me if you need anything.
Dialogue after the elevator is activated.
I'm Xun Yuan, a Seeker dedicated to studying ruins.
So, it was easy for an experienced person like me to notice—this Training Hall was built on the foundation of a ruin.
Why is it set up this way? You can't go to the second floor if you fail the challenge.
Damn it... This Mechanoid trial is out to get me!
I've traveled through mountains and rivers, and set foot in untouched lands, all to explore the traces of history.
This Training Hall is based on ancient ruins. I'd like to study it further.
But this Mechanoid challenge is in the way. I can't even get to the second floor, let alone see the Head Trainer.
But I'm just a weak Society member. Nothing I can do about it.
But I see you have an extraordinary physique... If only I could borrow your martial arts skills.
Is there another way I can get up there?
There must be plenty of things worth studying here.
How much stronger do I need to be to take down these metal clunkers... I'm still far from it.
Since we're already here, we should focus on the ruins.
Was it you who just passed the Mechanoid challenge?
As much as I'd love to ask for your secret, a trial demands personal effort.
Watching you succeed has also been very helpful for us.
I believe that after learning from experience, we will be able to successfully pass the trial.
Impressive, another one has passed the trial. Looks like a promising talent!
Broken again. Guess it's not hard enough. Where should I improve...
How about we enhance their speed? Or better, just add more Mechanoids.
I'll make sure no one can cheat... or they'll be upset.
My movements are getting swifter. Sweeping is training too!
Finding calm in daily chores is essential for Martial Arts training.
Who would've thought the Head Trainer had such a delicate side?
Didn't expect someone to pass the Mechanoid Trial so soon.
Yeah, I'm so excited, it feels like I passed myself!
Stay calm, stay calm. I should learn from their success... Okay, I'm excited too!
The food here is way worse than what they serve at the academy.
How can I practice on an empty stomach?
The view here is stunning. I envy Master's choice of residence.
Don't tell Master we're talking about him behind his back.
He often shares stories of his travels.
He claimed he battled a monkey for three days in the Northlands, then finished it with a powerful slash.
Master's stories are so captivating. I must train hard so I can see the world for myself one day.
This is the Tiger Tail Path of the Roaring Tiger Training Hall, also a training ground for footwork.
Hello there, you must be here for a challenge?
I'm very friendly, so feel free to ask me anything.
The main entrance is downstairs. Complete the challenge on the first floor, and this side door will open.
Sneaking a peek is wrong, but how could anyone resist Master's diary?
The powerful and free-spirited Master surprisingly has a sweet tooth.
I must conquer this place with delicious food.
If you want to try cooking, start with selecting ingredients.
Just common ingredients. You can trust their quality.
Cooking is an art that requires creativity and experimentation.
Why do you want to join the Gourmet Society?
You know, my hometown is a food desert.
That's how I embarked on the path of food exploration...
Luckily, I've already succeeded, so I don't have to worry about what to eat anymore.
Goodbye, and don't forget to eat!
Master's finally giving me a day off. Where should I go?
Should we take a look in Northton? Shye often finds cool stuff there.
Exactly! Shye's taste is impeccable. We might even snag a treasure ourselves!
I'm completely exhausted from climbing. I can't move another step.
But I heard even Sun Bin found it easy.
If I had Mechwings, I could climb up and down ten times in a day.
After a long day, I'm enjoying the evening breeze and the night view here. It's quite pleasant.
Master always says a balance between rest and training is important.
He never says that to me. Am I training hard enough?
You don't pay attention, and you still have the nerve to blame the master?
He seems strict... I'm a little scared.
Just a couple of days after I joined, master sparred with me.
I lasted three moves, and my arms hurt for a month.
I'm exhausted. The training is too intense.
Many come to challenge the master. I heard that Senior Novar has also challenged him before.
It's incredible that he actually beat the master.
Our master is a good person, but way too strict.
Master doesn't like Novar's flashy moves, but deep down, I think he has a high opinion of him despite the fact.
Is the Pouncing Jump that hard?
It might be tough for newcomers, but I'm used to it.
Thanks to my hard work, I can now breeze through the daily training!
Stop bragging. Weren't you the one who almost fell just now?
I already told you, it was just a little stumble!
Goodbye, and congratulations again on completing the challenge!
By the way, is this your first time here? If so, you can claim a prize.
Such a perfect weather for plants to grow.
I commend your courage to challenge me.
My disciples must fight as well as I do.
Me too. Just thinking about his face makes me nervous...
I'm so scared. If I fail, my master will punish me again.
Oh? Another one wanting to challenge my master?
Are you ready? Just a heads-up, make sure you have medicine on hand.
To be honest, I'm not sure.
He's the hardest working person I've ever met. For him, martial arts has no end, and he's always improving.
I could see that in every teaching session.
Did Novar ever beat Tiger Palm?
I've heard those rumors, too. I've never asked him about it, but I'm sure it's not true.
Master Shi Yu only yields to Fuzi. No matter how renowned Novar is, he's just a student from the School of Martial Arts.
See you. Get ready if you want to challenge my master.
You snapped the bowstring. Always overexerting yourself.
Did you learn that from Wuyan?
It's okay. Next time I'll fix it myself.
Keep it up, junior. You must do it a thousand times, or you'll be punished with cleaning the Flying Tiger Jump!
I'm so tired. Why aren't you training too, Senior?
I'm not! I just... approach my studies differently, that's all.
Goodbye. Feel free to look around. If you want a match, just let me know.
How do you usually train your disciples?
This is Jixia's top Training Hall, Roaring Tiger Training Hall, and I'm its Head Trainer. Think it over.
Unlike training halls that flaunt flashy moves, I emphasize raw strength over technique, focusing on fundamental training.
Head Trainer of Roaring Tiger Training Hall?
Yes, I founded Roaring Tiger Training Hall.
Only those dedicated to Martial Arts are welcome here. Others will be stopped at the Mechanoid trial.
Fuzi? Why bring him up? If he didn't use weapons and faced me barehanded, I might have a chance!
But it seems Master Fuzi's fists and feet outrank yours.
But it seems Master Fuzi's fists and feet outrank yours.
Rankings? Real combat skills can't be measured by numbers. It's all about how you perform in the field!
See those disciples training over there? Only when they've mastered the basics will they get to train with me.
I always encourage them to spar with each other. Real combat is the best teacher.
Standing here is so tiring. I'll just take a little break...
My mission isn't complete until I've stood for five hours. That's forever... perhaps I should take down this timer.
Take it slow, you got this.
Exactly! Master Mozi crafted these plum blossom posts. Our head trainer treasures them and orders us to train with them daily.
Master Mozi regularly comes here to collect experimental data. My Master probably wanted to help him finish data collection as soon as possible.
Yeah, he's quite impatient. But after a few days of training, my leg muscles have gotten stronger.
Really? I guess I'll keep training then!
My arms are so sore... I don't know how much longer I can keep this up.
Next time we spar, could senior give me a few pointers? Progress is made step by step.
No, Master said to always give it my all.
Senior's respect is a bit hard to handle...
Ahem, don't slack off, guys. Master is omnipresent.
Stay focused! I'm sure no one wants extra training, right?
Martial Arts skills are earned through hard practice. There are no shortcuts.
Have you been training all night?
At night? Training is about quality, not just quantity.
If you've finished all your training for the day, why practice at night? You should rest and recharge!
Wait... why are you asking me this all of a sudden?
Go play somewhere else. What I do at night is none of your business. Stop prying!
Persuade Tiger Palm to take a break.
Back straight, breathe out... and in...
Stay steady... Practice the moves before going on the post, one step at a time...
My hard work paid off! This is the best spot.
It's my master's blind spot. Finally, I can slack off. I'm a genius!
If you can't surpass Tiger physically...
If I use Mechcraft... maybe I can defeat him.
Grip it firmly! Imagine it's an extension of yourself!
I'm fine! I'm not tired at all!
I really need a nap... Shouldn't have stayed up last night!
With this, you won't stand a chance against the Head Trainer, or even the Rebels.
Of course I will! I'll be a swordmaster one day!
Great, fantastic! You look even more tiger-like than the real thing...
Ugh, you're getting worse at this.
Try cheering for almost half a day without food or water, just shouting.
Count for me, let's see how long I can last.
No way! I'm already done with training. I'm taking a break right now.
Tsk, so petty... One, two, three... Ugh, I'm getting out of breath!
All this standing meditation practice is turning me into a statue.
Climbing horizontal bars seems more fun. You can just hang there freely... kinda like an animal, actually.
We must stop looking for shortcuts and dive into hard practice!
I'll work harder and strive to do better next time.
Last time I fought well, Master was trying to hold back a smile. Next time, I'll make Master laugh out loud!
They say the tougher the training conditions, the better the results.
Would it be more effective if I train directly in the water?
I've made some progress, but I'm not confident I can win.
I need to practice harder so I can exchange a few blows with the Head Trainer.
I'm starting to admire Senior Man... I should have asked her for slacking tips.
Left, right, left, left... Whatever. Your punches feel like nothing.
When will I get a break?
Why isn't he leaving? I'm so tired.
Oh no, my legs are giving out...
These new students still need a lot of practice... They can't rely on talent alone forever.
Even Novar practiced relentlessly in secret to get where he is today.
Training all day has exhausted me, yet I feel fulfilled.
I knew you'd stick it out. Sure enough, I heard even the Master is pleased with your performance.
Hehe, you really know everything... He did smile at me.
How is it this busted? Can it even be fixed...
I didn't even hit it that hard, did I?
Next, I'll reinforce the part we just fixed.
Don't worry about breaking the Mechcrafts. Just use them normally.
Go back to your training. I'll call you if I need you.
Let us know if you need anything else, Master Mozi!
Did you get all that down?
Roaring Tiger Training Hall's wild and aggressive fighting style actually gave us some great extra data.
This trip is well worth it.
Roaring Tiger Training Hall's wild and aggressive fighting style actually gave us some great extra data.
Master Mozi, what brings you here?
Master Mozi, what brings you here?
The School of Mechcraft dropped a new batch of training dummies here. I came to see how they're holding up.
Looks like... they've been used pretty "thoroughly."
Looks like... they've been used pretty "thoroughly."
Sorry about that. We were being careful during practice. I swear we didn't break it on purpose.
We didn't even use real weapons! Just unsharpened stone swords!
A stone sword... isn't that basically a giant hammer?
A stone sword... isn't that basically a giant hammer?
Don't beat yourself up. Wear and tear is normal.
Besides, after watching for the past two days, I've figured out the issue.
Your sword strikes all land in the exact same spot: the pivot joint of the dummy's mecharm.
It makes sense that prolonged stress would break the joint. I'll tweak that part later.
Anyway, let's put the dislocated parts back together for now.
Want to give it a shot?
This Mechcraft uses a spherical coupling, so it requires high precision to match up.
Even a tiny misalignment will mess up the coupling. Don't get careless.
What did Master Mozi just say about a coupling?
You know me, my mind just goes blank whenever I hear mech jargon...
Huh? I zoned out for a second.
The missing part is that mecharm on the ground.
Give it a try. Think you can attach it to the dummy correctly?
Pretty fast. Let me take a look.
Hmm... The sleeve fits perfectly, and the rotation is normal...
Master Mozi, I put it together!
Master Mozi, I put it together!
Well done! You must've worked hard in your Mechcraft classes. You deserve some credit.
Do you often supply Mechcrafts to different Training Halls?
Not really. Roaring Tiger Training Hall burns through training Mechcrafts incredibly fast because of their fighting style.
So I design all their training mechs now, just to collect sample data more accurately and efficiently.
What kind of experiment are you running, Master Mozi?
Right now I'm optimizing the custom dummies for Roaring Tiger Training Hall. There are two main hurdles to overcome.
First is the stress on the mecharm joints, and second is the durability of the materials.
Thanks to this data collection, I think we'll have a breakthrough soon.
Thank you for the help, too.
First is the stress issue at the pivot of the mechanical arm, and second is the durability of the mechanical materials.

We made this device for quick tower changes. That way, challengers can try out different levels.

For Dew? You know how to make pet treats? You really surprised me!

Life is free as a Rebel.

Too bad it ended in a tie. We'll have to do this again sometime.

Never thought it'd end in a tie.
It's windy here. Let's get down.

You'd better ask your friend where he's been!

Please leave. Your scent will attract more Wailing Buds and harm my herbs.

Meet me back here when you're finished!
Herbalists at the academy said you helped stop Moonelia Sprout.

Can't you do the interviews yourself?

We must find the cause to solve the problem for good.

Think of it like a teacup: the tea stays in because of the cup.

text: Yes. Ancestors made it to calm the land, and it grew into a local custom.
Now only old people remember it...
Take care. Don't risk yourself if you run into trouble.
I've noted the <001>locations and procedures</> here. Take it with you.
It's alright. I'll ask someone else.
But the best time for the ritual is almost upon us. I can't miss it...
Aerflow got weird and strange things happened, but the Runestones calmed it and the good times began...
Now we have Societies to keep everything stable. It looks like we don't need the ritual anymore, but...
It's just an old story. Hey, I haven't seen you here before.

Harvest Village has a tradition called the Stabilization Ritual, once a key part of the Harvest Festival.
Ancestors did it to calm chaos and bring blessings for a peaceful, prosperous year.
Now we always get a good harvest, thanks to Jixia Societies.
But the ritual stopped years ago. Most young people don't even know about it.
You might think I'm stubborn, but I don't want traditions to fade.
I'd pray in the fields myself, but I need to stay at the bell.
Could you please go to a few spots to finish the ritual for me?
This ritual is tied closely to Jixia—it'd be most fitting for a Jixia student to carry it out.
I've wished for this a long time. Thank you for making it come true.
Crops died, water spoiled... Villagers were terrified.
Things calmed down after Societies made four Runestones and did the Stabilization Ritual.
I hope doing the Stabilization Ritual again helps people remember the past.
A hundred years ago, disaster struck Harvest Fields—dark clouds, thunder...
Harvest Fields has an old tradition called the Stabilization Ritual, but it has not been held in years. Uncle Yun asks you to perform the ritual.

Sounds magical! Did Li Bai drink it before he performed that sword dance in the fields?

Alright. Let's put the ingredients inside and make Harvest Broth.

Qi... That's right! Only where people live is there culture, and from this, food, songs, and stories are born.

An admirable man. What happened to him?

Did he ever talk about these things back then?
Did he ever talk about these things back then?

As long as I know he's safe, I can rest easy.

You must be tired. I've prepared some food...

There are also letters floating in the cave...

I've never seen them here before. Who knows where they came from!
Someone there? Are you here to save me?
So many letters in the water...
So many letters in the water...

text: I've got to check it out.
I know a bit about Moonelia Sprout. This is a chance for me to study!
The painter's friend asked me to find the Herbalist for a cure...
The painter's friend asked me to find the Herbalist for a cure...
You need Cheng Yuan for that. I'm not sure if I can help you.
Where can I find her? Cai Yun said she's gathering herbs here. Any idea?
Where can I find her? Cai Yun said she's gathering herbs here. Any idea?
No... but maybe she went to the cave nearby to study toxins.
Yes. That fruit made a painter sick.
Yes. That fruit made a painter sick.
So you thought I... No, I have nothing to do with it.
He ate a fruit from there and became so inspired that he paints nonstop and never rests.
He ate a fruit from there and became so inspired that he paints nonstop and never rests.
So I was right—the farmland was affected by Moonelia Sprout! Cheng Yuan tried to hide it.
You mean the farmland at Harvest Ranch that grows odd fruits?
But I know the Herbalist you're looking for.
It's fine. I just passed by there and wanted to ask about her research...
You can go have a look. I'll check on the painter.
It's been a while... Are you checking the affected farmland for the villagers?
It's been a while... Are you checking the affected farmland for the villagers?
But she didn't let me near so I had to come here for my own experiments.
Shinye says the Herbalist you are looking for is Cheng Yuan. He decides to check on the painter first and says Cheng Yuan may be in a nearby cave.
You need Cheng Yuan for that. I'm not sure if I can help you.
Can you please help me find the Herbalist? I'm really worried...
Great! She should be up on that hill. Don't worry, I'll make sure you're paid for your help.
The farmland affected by Moonelia Sprout has started to grow fruits that inspire creativity.
My friend Huaixi heard about it and came looking for the fruit.
The Herbalist watching over the farmland refused at first, but Huaixi begged daily until he got one.
Hi, I'm Cai Yun, a Seeker. Do you know anything about medicine or toxins...?
I'm not a Herbalist, but I may have some herbs.
I'm not a Herbalist, but I may have some herbs.
Let me check... Only a few herbs here for healing. I'm afraid they won't really help Huaixi.
You mean the man over there? What's wrong with him?
You mean the man over there? What's wrong with him?
After eating it, Huaixi painted nonstop for two days—he hasn't eaten or slept since.
She went to the mountains to gather herbs and hasn't returned.
I must stay here with Huaixi in case he needs help.
Huaixi ate a strange fruit and has been painting nonstop for three days without eating or sleeping. His friend Cai Yun is worried and asks you to find an Herbalist to help him.
It's been two days! You should rest—the scenery will still be here!
The scenery stays, but the effect fades, and so does inspiration. I need to keep going!
I have other things to do.
Well... Alright, guess I'll have to wait...
Huaixi says his inspiration comes from the effects of medicine.
He's been painting for three days without rest since he ate that fruit you gave him.
He's been painting for three days without rest since he ate that fruit you gave him.
Wasn't that a fruit from the farmland?
Wasn't that a fruit from the farmland?
It's a mental issue, not something herbs can solve.
Please leave now. I have nothing more to say.
Oh, him. Wait, is he still waiting for me out in the field?
I gave him a normal fruit to make him leave. Why did this happen?
Some villagers made up those stories to boost sales.
And that painter believed the rumors and thought the fruit would inspire him.
He begged me for days, so I finally gave him a fruit.
There's nothing unusual about that fruit! I promise!
No. The villagers asked me to check the affected farmland.
The fruits are just bigger than usual, that's all.
You've got some guts... Hoping to be my next test sample?
Who are you? How did you find this place? Answer me!
Sorry, but it's urgent. It's about the farmland you've been watching.
Sorry, but it's urgent. It's about the farmland you've been watching.
Cheng Yuan says it was just a normal fruit. Some villagers invented a story to boost sales. Cheng Yuan adds that Huaixi's condition can't be cured with herbs.
Some villagers made up stories based on the legend of the Time Bud to promote their fruit sales.
zh_text: 一些村民为了推广果实大卖，就借朔椿芽的光阴奇闻编了些故事。
source_text: 一些村民为了推广果实大卖，就借朔椿芽的光阴奇闻编了些故事。
