text: She also said it's a mental issue.
She also said it's a mental issue.
She thinks Huaixi heard stories about Moonelia Sprout and believed it would inspire him.
She thinks Huaixi heard stories about Moonelia Sprout and believed it would inspire him.
That's true... Huaixi keeps talking about Moonelia Sprout since visiting the Herb Garden.
So Cheng Yuan only gave him a normal fruit?
In that case, I might have an idea.
I will eat a fruit here.
Could you get one? We'll find out soon.
Cheng Yuan said what she gave was just ordinary fruit.
Cheng Yuan said what she gave was just ordinary fruit.
But... I can't believe it! Huaixi doesn't seem fine at all! It must be that fruit...
Actually, the farmland shows no sign of Moonelia Sprout's power. It looks like too much fertilizer instead...
I checked Huaixi. He seems completely fine.
You tell them the truth and Shinye agrees, but Cai Yun isn't convinced. Shinye suggests doing a test and asks you to bring another fruit.
So you mean Huaixi got the fruit he wanted, and that sparked his inspiration?
Something like that. To be honest, I never thought Mr. Tong Bo's story was real until now.
But it can't go on like this. I'm worried about his health...
Should we tell him the truth?
Let's just let him ride the inspiration and finish painting.
It's normal for people to go days without rest in Jixia. Aersilk gives us energy.
Your friend seems very energetic. He's just showing his full potential.
He'll get tired once he runs out of energy.
For now, let him continue painting.
Haha, now I know why Cheng Yuan kept me away.
She thought I'd tease her! All those Toxineer methods, but it was just too much fertilizer.
This fruit is very bitter... It really keeps you awake!
A young woman with sleep troubles and constant fever.
Mr. Tong Bo tried for days, but couldn't figure it out. His medicine didn't help at all.
Then her childhood friend asked if he could take care of her for a few days.
And suddenly, with the same medicine, she recovered! The girl finally woke up.
So it's really a mental issue...
For that, we need to help his mind. Thinking affects how medicine works.
Mr. Tong Bo used to tell us stories at the Herb Garden.
He talked about a patient he met long ago in Chang'an.

Shinye explains that a person's mindset can affect how medicine works. He recalls a sick girl in Chang'an who got better thanks to her childhood friend's care. Shinye notices that Huaixi believes in the fruit's magic, which encourages him. Shinye says you should simply let Huaixi keep painting, and his "illness" will fade once he gets tired.
Bai Qi, seeing that the fruit was indeed effective, continued to draw with all her might.

This may seem strange, but it actually makes sense.
The world has so many surprises...
It's a lesson for me. I'll think about it. See you!
Watch out! No protection from the School of Sorcery here. Don't fall!
Xia Meng is in charge of registration. Go ask her!
The tower changes often. Next time, you might run into totally new obstacles.
There's a camp <001>to the east</> where you can practice climbing.
It's busy there lately. You might have to wait in line!
I'll go there in a while.
No problem. It's open all day and night.
You can sign up for the climbing competition any time. But it's harder now. You may need to practice first.
Remember, it's not managed by the competition organizers, so be careful and stay out of trouble.
No idea. I've never seen such cool moves.
Who's that up there? He's really skilled!
A student climbing the tower drew a large crowd. After he lands easily, he asks if anyone wants to challenge him, but the onlookers disperse and no one answers.
My name is Geechan. Up for a race?
It'll be good practice for the competition.
It's just a practice run—there are similar obstacles that test your speed and skill.
The climbing competition is tomorrow! It's not a major event, but everyone's talking about it.
To stand out in Jixia, you have to join.
But these students are boring. None has matched me today.
Not that you're the same—I can see you've got real talent.
Alright, I'll give it a try.
Alright, I'll give it a try.
Is this a copy of the Cloudreach Tower?
I've climbed the Cloudreach Tower before.
I've climbed the Cloudreach Tower before.
Oh? Did you race in the Harvest Festival?
The obstacles on the tower always change, so every attempt is fresh.
Geechan invites you to warm up for tomorrow's climbing competition.
With talent like yours, you shouldn't miss out.
The competition is open to everyone—this is the spirit of Jixia Academy!
Sign up now if you're interested.
With you on board, this might actually be a challenge!
So? You in for tomorrow's competition?
I can join, too! Come on! Prove that Jixia Academy's still got talent!
Still hesitating? I'm not leaving until your name's on that list!
Geechan suggests you sign up for tomorrow's competition.
See? Rebels have no order. You only gather for profit.
Master Fuzi opened the granary so Rebels could buy affordable supplies, but didn't expect it to be taken over.
It's just like the farmer and the snake! Can you promise no Rebel will do wrong?
Okay, just deal with the granary in your way. I'll help you find Dew.
But if my people aren't guilty...
I will apologize to you in public and let your friend compete.
If you took Dew, I'll kick you out and ask the academy to exile every Rebel!
Deal! Let's split up. Show me where you last saw Dew...
I'm really worried about Dew... Could you please help me deal with the granary?
If the Rebels have taken it, just teach them a lesson and kick them out!
And see if you can find any clues about Dew. Thanks a lot!
Xia Meng, my friend wants to sign up for the competition.
Geechan? Sorry, registration is closed now.
Hey! Wait up. Signing up takes just a minute!
Your people messed with Dew during sign-ups yesterday—remember?
Huh? We're only an hour late! This student is from Jixia Academy. Can you make an exception?
We've already drawn the lots. Adding more participants now is against the rules.
Rules again! Aren't you supposed to be more open?
Jixia Academy's rules aren't for you to challenge.
Well, if you cared about rules, you wouldn't be a Rebel.
Oh, I see. First you banned Rebels, now you stop talent. Afraid to lose?
Say what you want. Rebels can join only because Master Fuzi insisted.
Remember who stole Mechcraft parts last year?
There are many Rebels. That wasn't me or any of my people.
There's so much bias here! Innocent people get punished!
This is wasting my time. Excuse me, I have things to do.
Not everyone sits around all day like you! I've got to find Dew. Step aside!
Dew? Scholarly Tiger? I saw it yesterday.
I didn't want to bring this up, but...
If I hadn't noticed, Dew could've gone missing! Maybe it was them!
Oh? You sure? Then tell me...
Today, some Rebels took the eastern granary. Know anything about it?

Registration is closed, and because Geechan is a Rebel, Xia Meng refuses to sign you up. She insists on finding her missing Scholarly Tiger, Dew, first. It's a deal! Let's split up then! Take me to the place where you last saw Diudiu...

I'll find a way to get the stolen supplies back.
Did you find anything about Dew?

No, but I found a note.

Let me see... Meat stripes? Scholarly Tigers love them...
Okay. This must be a misunderstanding.

Sometimes I forget that Rebels used to be Jixia students too.
Did you ask why they dress like this? Is there a reason?
Actually, I found the Cloudreach Tower's design in their camp.
Actually, I found the Cloudreach Tower's design in their camp.
Maybe it's linked to the competition.
Maybe it's linked to the competition.
Xia Meng is stunned by what you've found. Before she can say anything, Geechan returns with Dew.
I get to compete now, eh?
No need to apologize, but I hope you learned something.
Prejudice can hurt as much as a blade.
I'll go now. Don't forget to sign my friend up!
I found out who took the supplies. I'll get them back later.
Dew is perfectly fine. Geechan tells Xia Meng to sign you up and says he'll see you on the field tomorrow.
Look at this design you've just found.
It may look like it's part of the Cloudreach Tower, but it actually controls all the obstacles there.
Why didn't you ask him just now?
Why didn't you ask him just now?
I don't want to assume things after what happened with Dew.
Right now, I need more proof.
Can you check the cave mentioned in the design? Some parts might be hidden there.
Got it. Leave it to me.
Got it. Leave it to me.
If you find anything, come meet me at the Cloudreach Tower.
Xia Meng suspects Geechan intends to cheat, so she asks you to explore the cave mentioned in the design.
It may look like it's part of the Cloudreach Tower, but it actually controls all the obstacles there.
Hit the switch! Let's do it together!
Is that Dew? The sound's coming from behind the camp.
Is that Dew? The sound's coming from behind the camp.
Design of the Cloudreach Tower? Why is it in the Rebels' Camp?
Design of the Cloudreach Tower? Why is it in the Rebels' Camp?
I should take this to Xia Meng.
I should take this to Xia Meng.
You made your camp out of that old experiment site?
And why are they wearing Jixia uniforms?

text: The Verdant Depths were forged to slay the Dawnsong general, yet in the end, nothing changed.
I lost all my friends to the war, and I could do nothing... For a hundred years, I've been withering away from the Divine Imprint, like a candle in the wind, never knowing when I'll go out.
You said your sword cannot tolerate injustice, and so is mine.
Then what has kept your heart sharp over these hundred years?
This sword represents a promise I made.
We once swore to defend Jixia.
That's why I've always got my sword ready. For my friend. For Jixia. Beyond life and death. Until my very end.
I don't know your friend, but I understand his intentions.
Maybe... we're not so different after all.
Some things are more important than one's own life. In that case, what does it matter if one is destroyed in the process?
And I'm a swordsman. And what I can do is to draw my sword.
Reaching the top of the building and taking the stars.
To meet yet not truly connect, it is better not to meet at all.
Since you insist on dueling, fine...
...then a bloody rain will pour down.
My sword may be sharp, but no blade, however keen, can cut through the distortions of time.

text: With Qing Ze's help, Lu Xya wakes. Fen explains the monster attack in the cave and decides to stay to protect the others.

Be careful. Don't let nightmares get you.

You invented a drink in your dream, and because of that, a lot of people will be helped.

Is it causing the nightmares in town?
It's like me—a being from the Dreamrealm.
It doesn't belong here. Dreamscape energy must be out of balance. This <001>Butterfly Stone</> proves it.
Recently, Northton's energy is unbalanced, so Dreamrealm creatures are coming in from the north.
That monster takes the chance to spread nightmare energy and feed on Dreamers' dreams.
Dreaming is normal, but when a Dreamrealm being fuels nightmares, things get worse.
When the mind is troubled, a dream forms. When doubt grows, the dream becomes real.
Dreams can appear as butterflies, thorns, monsters, or even the Dreamer's shadow.

Got burned out and trapped by nightmares too... How long has this lasted?
He's had nightmares for a while. Freshmind Tea used to work, but now... nothing helps.
I just checked. His Sorcery energy is completely unstable. If this goes on, he could die.
We must wake him up first. What would my brother do...

I sense strong nightmare energy in the cave. Don't try to fight alone.

The ratio is slightly off... yet the effect is so different... I must write this down...

Fen? What are you doing here?
Fen? What are you doing here?

Great! This will go much faster with your help.

You shouldn't stay long until we figure this out.

Lots of merchants here. Let's ask around first.

I'm not a scammer... Don't go!

You're Zheng Ren? Take a look at this note.
A note for Aersilk? What are the chances! The one who came to my aid is also the one who saved my life!
You're here for that weapon, right? I must repay you properly.
Let me think... what else... Ah! Those top-grade herbs!
I just got a batch of premium herbs delivered to the warehouse today. Want to come pick some too?
The delivery person should be at the warehouse now. Her name is Wang Ling—just let her know.

Are you Wang Ling? Here to deliver goods to Zheng Ren?
Wait... are you here to inspect the goods for Zheng Ren?
Good... The goods are gone. I don't know if Zheng Ren will blame me for failing to protect them...
I'm not as strong as you... When I run into Rebels, all I can do is hide.
I made a deal with Zheng Ren. I'm here to collect what we agreed on.
I made a deal with Zheng Ren. I'm here to collect what we agreed on.
But... both the delivery and Zheng Ren's personal collection were stolen...
He also offered to give me some of those top-grade herbs for saving him.
He also offered to give me some of those top-grade herbs for saving him.
Oh no... I should go tell Zheng Ren first and see what he says...
Yes, that's me. I was moving the cargo when those Rebels tried to rob me...
Just my luck—while hiding, I triggered a Mechcraft device and fell down here. But at least I dragged those Rebels down with me. A blessing in disguise, I guess.

Say that again? The goods are gone? All of it? The Aersilk? The weapon?
There's no hope left. They're gone for good. The Rebels in this area are too cunning—they hide immediately after causing trouble.
Y-yes... I'm so sorry, there was nothing I could do...
I recall our contract stated that if anything happens before delivery, you must refund and compensate.
Besides, I already promised part of those goods to my savior. That should be included too.
I-I will compensate, don't worry... Once I sell the remaining herbs...

But with such a major incident, I must return to Navenia immediately. It might take a while before I can gather enough funds to repay you.
Savior, you're doing a barter practice, right? You must be anxious since your gains are lost.
How about this, Wang Ling—transfer the compensation you owe me directly to my savior.
I believe that amount should be enough to cover the value of the weapon.
It's perfectly appropriate. Savior, why not head to Wang Ling's Herb Nursery first and see if there's anything readily usable?
Okay, okay, that's fine... But I need to reassess the losses. Follow my Big-eye Owlet for now. I'll catch up shortly.

She wants something special or valuable.
She wants something special or valuable.

Shouldn't have grown those herbs...This is all my fault...

Actually, those things didn't entirely belong to me.
Actually, those things didn't entirely belong to me.
It's all over... Everything was fine before, but as soon as it rained today, monsters sprouted up everywhere and destroyed all the herbs.
I hadn't heard from you, so I came to check. What happened?
Why are there so many monsters?
No wonder this Herb Nursery had poor yields and was sold at a discount...
Huixin thanks you and realizes that emotional needs make things worth more.
Do you know why I suddenly made this decision?
Because it just hit me—what if people are the biggest factor in adding value to objects?
Looking back on your barters, I realized that the emotions and needs that increased the items' value all originated from people.
It's people who use wisdom and skill to refine natural products, develop needs for them, and thus increase their value.
I felt my report was missing one final insight. Thanks to you, that insight is now complete.
Thank you for your help. Just you wait—this report will be flawless!
I hadn't heard from you, so I came to check. What happened?
You take the flower seeds to Sango to trade, but she doesn't want them.
Hello, what can I get for you?
I have these seeds from Huixin. I heard you agreed to trade flower seeds? Can I trade for something else?
I have these seeds from Huixin. I heard you agreed to trade flower seeds? Can I trade for something else?
They're said to be ancestral seeds from ancient Misty Marshes.
They're said to be ancestral seeds from ancient Misty Marshes.
Hmm? Why didn't she come herself?
I'm not too interested. I can trade you other items of equal value, just not flower seeds.

You explain to Wang Ling that this was just a barter practice. Huixin admires her growing skills and decides to waive the compensation, instead forming a contract with Wang Ling to cultivate rare herbs together.
The Aersilk, though less valuable than the weapon, gained extra worth because of emotional value.
No. It must be a temporary shift in supply and demand. The market became too unbalanced—low supply, high demand. That's why, right?
You saved Zheng Ren, and he wanted to repay you with premium herbs. That might be a trade enhanced by emotional value...
But the weapon's value can't be measured in money, and neither can the Aersilk. What a shame they're lost...
I'll sell the Herb Nursery as soon as possible to make it up to you. Just give me some time.

You didn't just make up these names, did you? These are extremely difficult to cultivate.
Not really? I found them pretty easy to grow. Just needed a little care.
Could it be that you... Ahem! In that case, would you like to sign a contract with me?
The terms are—I provide the seeds, you provide the expertise. We cooperate on cultivation and split the profits 50-50.

Then find us a place. We'll discuss the contract details later.
Actually, this was just part of our barter practice.
Actually, this was just part of our barter practice.
Yes, the most valuable part was the experience. It's extremely useful for my report.
After all, the responsibility doesn't fall on you. Why should you be the one to bear it?
But the Herb Nursery's yield is also an issue. Maybe I can help. What herbs have you been growing?
I heard you say these seeds are from Misty Marshes?
I have a regular with Misty Marshes ties—he's always collecting related items.
I have a special box of tea. Could I trade it for these unique seeds?
Aerux Essence Tea, handcrafted by a master. Only eighteen boxes a year. Special enough? Its value is way beyond flower seeds.
Here, keep the tea safe. I hope Sango doesn't mind me swooping in.
I'm not selling. I want to trade this box of Aerux Essence Tea for something special or valuable.
I'm not selling. I want to trade this box of Aerux Essence Tea for something special or valuable.
Tea... Alright. How much do you have?
That's all you got? You might as well drink it yourself.
Wait, is this Master Yun's tea? And from the exact year I'm missing!
I can't believe I found it here! I've been saving Aersilk forever to buy this!
I'll offer this much Aersilk. Is that enough for the tea?
Still not enough? I can't miss any of Master Yun's annual releases. I'll raise it! Double the Aersilk! How about that?!
They're busy. You can talk to me. Ahem, I'm an apprentice at the Trading Post.
Here's the Aersilk. How did you even get this tea?
I got it through a barter practice.
I got it through a barter practice.
Then check the plaza outside—lots of vendors there. If you get more tea, save it for me!
I do. But I'll only trade for something special or valuable.
I do. But I'll only trade for something special or valuable.
Am I hearing right? You're a student from Jixia Academy?
Yes. I'm doing this barter practice for someone.
Yes. I'm doing this barter practice for someone.
That sounds credible. Let me think... Would you be interested in a senior's weapon?
He won the Enlightenment Trials with it. Its value exceeds the Aersilk by a large margin.
Don't worry, I'm offering this because our boss urgently needs Aersilk. I'm not a scammer.
He won't mind overpaying if it means getting the Aersilk.
Thank you! Our boss is Zheng Ren. The weapon is in his warehouse. I'll write you a note.
Go to the address tomorrow, give this note to my boss, and ask to fetch the item. He'll understand.
Maybe this is another factor affecting item value. I should tell Huixin later.
Maybe this is another factor affecting item value. I should tell Huixin later.
The tea leaves are real, but not many people want to buy them. Chenglian suggests you go to Northton Trading Post to see if any merchants are interested.
Ask Mr. Guo for an appraisal.
Hi there! Have a seat. How many are we today? What can I get for you?
That's tricky. This tea won't fetch a good price unless you find the right buyer.
I'm not here to eat. I'd like your help authenticating this box of tea.
I'm not here to eat. I'd like your help authenticating this box of tea.
This is... Master Yun's Aerux Essence Tea from last season—her first collaboration with her new partner. It's genuine.
Great. I've stamped it with the authentication seal. What do you plan to do with it?
I'm practicing barter, hoping to trade it for something special or valuable.
I'm practicing barter, hoping to trade it for something special or valuable.
However, there's one spot where you might maximize its value.
Northton Trading Post. Many well-connected, generous merchants gather there. You might give it a try.
Huh... So they build a brand around a celebrity, target specific fans, and profit from the markup?
This much Aersilk? You got lucky!
Just met a trade apprentice who really loves tea.
Just met a trade apprentice who really loves tea.
Perhaps one of the master's admirers? They're the only ones who pay premium prices.
Eureka! Need to go write my report. See you!
Where did these Saepes come from?
Where did these Saepes come from?
Why are there so many monsters?
Everyone got Aersilk except for him.
Why not share yours with him?
No way. I barely have enough for myself. Bad luck for him.
Everyone got Aersilk except for him.
Why not share yours with him?
No way. I barely have enough for myself. Bad luck for him.
What should I do now? I can't go back empty-handed.
Can anyone hear me? I'll pay any price!
Everyone's so busy... No chance to even interrupt.
Everyone's so busy... No chance to even interrupt.
I'm not a scammer... Don't go!
Most are dreamers from elsewhere, so they're more sensitive to changes in Dream Energy...
If this continues, it would be best for you to leave Northton soon.
Is there really no way to fix this?
Is there really no way to fix this?
I've got a few ideas. Want to hear them?
I'll try to think of something else.
As a Dreamweaver who can sense Dream Energy, I should be the one to seek the truth.
But several dreamers at the inn took a turn for the worse yesterday. If I'm not here, their lives could be at risk.
What do you need me to do?
What do you need me to do?
I hope you can lend me a hand. Go to that <001>abandoned mine</> and investigate.
Got it. Leave it to me.
Got it. Leave it to me.
Thank you. You can find the <001>abandoned mine</> by heading southeast from here.
But from what I know, that abandoned mine is quite mysterious and not easy to enter. You may need to find another way in.
If you have any other questions, feel free to ask me. I'll share all I know.
Someone in Northton is misusing Dream Energy. It's giving everyone nightmares...
Find dreams and nightmares are unbalanced. Chaos is moving <001>southeast toward the Abandoned Mine</>.
The nightmares persist. Not even the Aerux Inn is spared.
Dreamer, you must be aware of the recent anomalies in Aerux Town, right?
More and more dreamers are trapped in nightmares, unable to break free. Those staying at the Aerux Inn are especially affected.

The nightmare crisis is over. Qing Ze thanks you and tells you a story: people admire the Finedream Envoy but hate the Nightmare Envoy. The Finedream Envoy couldn't stand seeing her sister blamed, and the Dreamslayers took advantage of that. They pretended to help, but secretly fueled conflict. This led to the Runestone breaking and Dream Energy falling out of balance.
Nightmares in Aerux Town are calmed, thanks to your help.
It's nothing. After all, nobody wants to suffer a nightmare.
It's nothing. After all, nobody wants to suffer a nightmare.
Despite what happened in Northton, dreams, sweet or bitter, are neither good nor evil.
Fine dreams are wondrous and elusive, inviting indulgence; nightmares are dangerous, mysterious, yet they sharpen clarity.
Things that discomfort us often face prejudice and hatred. Nightmares are a case in point.
With every fine dreamer, respect for the Finedream Envoy grows...
But the Nightmare Envoy faced constant scorn just for doing her job.
The Nightmare Envoy ignored the insults, but the Finedream Envoy wanted to share that burden...
Dreamslayers see her longing and decide to weave a beautiful dream for her, with lies...
Two years ago, Dreamslayers wielded their blade honed for years toward Dreamwhisper Lake, stirring turmoil.
That great war ended in our crushing defeat and leaving our homeland...
And the Finedream Envoy stayed at Dreamwhisper Lake to stabilize Dream Energy.
But... the Runestone shattered, and the Finedream Envoy disappeared...
The created Illusive Realm keeps expanding, devouring all lives around...
Through all this... my people, are you well?
The Courage Competition ends successfully. After conquering his fear, Arter sets off on a new journey.
The Courage Competition ends now. Let's cheer for all competitors—for their intrepidity, passion, and courage!
Congratulations on your result. Let me award you the prize.
By the way, where is Arter?
He overcame his fear of nightmares and has set off on his next journey.
He overcame his fear of nightmares and has set off on his next journey.
Is it so? Finally he... I'm really happy for him.
Someone like Arter breaking free, pushing forward—that's the meaning of holding this competition!
And with that, the Courage Competition draws to a perfect close. Friends, see you next year!
The Courage Competition, a major event in Northton, is about to begin. Go talk to Arter to learn more.
The competition is starting soon, and I dreamed my store was closed. It feels like a bad sign.
The Courage Competition, of course! You don't know about it? It's a big event here in Northton.
It's really exciting! The challenge is different every year, and it keeps getting better.
See the man under the tree? That's Arter, from Navenia. He's recruiting for the competition.
If you want to learn more, talk to him. He is nice and always has the latest info.
You seem like a strong competitor! If you join, you'll surely win honor.
Come celebrate at my store if you do!
Then would like to try my signature Mayene's Sweet and Sour Dried Fish? You can't miss out!

Arter explains the rules and says an unusually large number of people have dropped out this year, so the event might be canceled. He asks you to go to Cloudrest Bridge to recruit new participants and find out why people are quitting.
Is this year's challenge too difficult, or are they just not brave enough to try?
I'd like to learn about the Courage Competition.
I'd like to learn about the Courage Competition.
Shout with me, <001>Courage is the anthem of adventure</>!
Right! That slogan fits a hero.
This is the competition slogan. Does it fire you up?
This year, it's a rock-climbing race at the Climbers' Camp.
Competitors race up a cliff. Fastest to the top wins.
Honestly, sign-ups are low, and some dropped out at the last minute.
I don't know. If we don't have enough competitors, the event will be canceled.
We still can't fill all the spots.
I'm going to check <001>Cloudrest Bridge</>. Maybe someone there wants to join.
Can you help recruit and ask why people dropped out?
Courage is the anthem of adventure!
It might be... if we can't find out why people quit.
Hey, interested? The prize is huge for the winner!
Anyone can join. Take it. I'm looking for more competitors.
Xin Yu believes nightmares create the monsters, and asks you to help deal with them.
Finally, someone to help... It's strange.
That day, I learned a distant relative had passed away. Then I had a sad dream.
My relative seemed regretful, wouldn't leave, and cried in my dream...
The crying grew louder, deafening. I knew I was dreaming, but couldn't wake up. I felt trapped.
My father woke me up while I was sweating. Soon after, I heard that there was a monster...
Yes. After talking to others, I have a guess.
I heard a monster appeared near your home.
I heard a monster appeared near your home.
So you had a nightmare all night.
So you had a nightmare all night.
Do you think nightmares attract monsters?
Do you think nightmares attract monsters?
It seems so... and at some point in the dream, something split off.
It's like my nightmare turned into a monster...
Thank you. I really hope things go back to normal soon...
Qi Peng says people have been plagued by nightmare monsters and aren't in the mood to compete. He says Xin Yu has seen the monsters recently and suggests you talk to her at the house by the river.
Some strange black shadows that only appear at night.
We've done night patrols, but never saw anything. We don't know when they appear.
She lives in that house by the <001>riverbank</>.
I want to go there, but whenever I get close to the river, I...
Ahem. I'll leave it to you, please!
Don't you see what's happening? No one has the energy to care about the competition now...
If it continues, people won't even be able to sleep...
I'm not sure, but something started showing up recently.
It was seen near Xin Yu's place recently.
Arter decides to enter the dream himself and leaves you to handle the monsters.
What? The monster is related to nightmares?
But we don't know if the monster causes nightmares or nightmares create the monster, right?
Well, I'll stay in the village tonight.
Either way, we finally have a clue, haha.
I've been having nightmares. I'll dream, you handle the monster, okay?
Even so. Remember—courage is the anthem of adventure!
If I keep thinking about it, I probably will.
Are you sure you'll have nightmares tonight?
Are you sure you'll have nightmares tonight?
Ready? I'll go to sleep. After that, I'm counting on you.
Arter arrives. You learn the monsters were after Yuelan, so you decide to return to Autumn Village and tell everyone the truth.
Yeah... Qi Peng woke me up in his way... I still have a headache, but I'm okay.
The good thing is I heard you calling me. Otherwise, I might have been stuck there...
No, thanks. Just need some medicine to help me calm down. I don't want to go through that again.
Thank you for saving my life.
They just kept coming after me...
Well, when I was stea... gathering supplies up north, those monsters kept bothering me...
They never stop. I had to hide in a village for a while.
Not sure if they picked a new target. After a few days, I thought I was safe, but they found me again...
Did you hide in... Autumn Village?
So you brought those monsters to the village...
So you brought those monsters to the village...
Now that the monsters are gone, let's go back and tell everyone.
Hey, don't leave... What if they come back? What shall I do?
Learning the truth, the villagers agree to join the Courage Competition and promise to gather at Climbers' Camp.
I see. Thank you so much.
Now about the Courage Competition. Can you join now?
Of course! I've secretly practiced climbing a lot! Ahem! Courage is the anthem of adventure!
Don't get cocky. I'm joining too—it's time to break out my full set of Aersilk hiking gear!
Full of drive, huh! Then I'll see you at the big contest!
Now that we have enough people, I need to go tell the organizers the competition goes on.
Thanks for your help. See you at Climbers' Camp on game day.
Hello, I'm here to sign up.
Hello, I'm here to sign up.
Eh... Alright, I'll register you. But just so you know, it might be canceled.
Is it because not enough people signed up?
Is it because not enough people signed up?
Probably. You can ask the <001>organizer</> there.
Each competitor starts in turn, solo timed. The fastest wins.
Are you ready? Let me know when you can start and I'll time you.
Anything I should watch out for?
Anything I should watch out for?
Strange, where is that confident Arter, the one who said he'd win?
Did he bail at the last minute? This rock-climbing route is indeed dangerous.
Too bad—you're second, just a little slower than me!
Strange, where is that confident Arter, the one who said he'd win?
Did he bail at the last minute? This rock-climbing route is indeed dangerous.
Oh—unfortunately, you got fifth place... Better luck next time!
Strange, where is that confident Arter, the one who said he'd win?
Did he bail at the last minute? This rock-climbing route is indeed dangerous.
Strange, where is that confident Arter, the one who said he'd win?
Did he bail at the last minute? This rock-climbing route is indeed dangerous.
Congratulations! You have the shortest time so far—first place!
Wait—is that Arter sitting frozen over there?
What's going on, even in broad daylight...
What's going on, even in broad daylight...
I was dizzy a moment ago. Hearing water, unsettled... After a full night of nightmares, I couldn't hold on and fainted.
You mean, when someone is weak in mind and will, they attract those monsters?
You mean, when someone is weak in mind and will, they attract those monsters?
Maybe. This place surrounded by water feels like my waking nightmare.
I thought after last night I could beat my fear... but it seems I've still lost this test of courage.
Arter explains why he fears water, and with your help, he confronts the fear and overcomes it.
You once said your nightmare was of that time.
You once said your nightmare was of that time.
I was tied to a piece of driftwood and survived, but they didn't...
I fear nightmares more than most, because one did come true once...
After that, I refused all sailing. If I hear water, it brings me back to that drifting moment.
The night before departure, I dreamt of the ship sinking, but my parents said I was just nervous for my first voyage.
That sound always reminds me: if I hadn't gone, maybe this tragedy wouldn't have happened...
By the way, since you feared sailing, how did you end up in Jixia then?
By the way, since you feared sailing, how did you end up in Jixia then?
I feel great. I've even started thinking of names for new ships, and a long-awaited voyage.
So coming to Jixia and entering the Courage Competition turns out to mean something, hah!
Yeah, how are you feeling now?
Yeah, how are you feeling now?
I had someone knock me out and put me on a ship. Waking up with nowhere to go, I just closed my eyes and endured.
I guess I haven't totally failed the competition. The sound of water doesn't scare me as much now.
I think maybe it's time to leave Jixia. Maybe sometime in some voyage, you and I will meet on the waves.
Or maybe on some high mountain, crossing paths.
You already took the first step.
No matter which way you leave, the first step is an indication of courage.
No matter which way you leave, the first step is an indication of courage.
I can see you're actively seeking answers.
I can see you're actively seeking answers.
You seem very passionate about these trials and competitions.
I always dream of someone, but I can't see her face.
I always dream of someone, but I can't see her face.
I don't know where I came from, or where I should go...
I don't know where I came from, or where I should go...
Alone, aimless, sounds worse than me.
Haha, just kidding. But after talking with you so much, I really feel better.
I feel like I'm always in the center of a whirlpool, not knowing which way to escape this nightmare.
What's going on, even in broad daylight...
What's going on, even in broad daylight...
I was dizzy a moment ago. Hearing water, unsettled... After a full night of nightmares, I couldn't hold on and fainted.
You mean, when someone is weak in mind and will, they attract those monsters?
You mean, when someone is weak in mind and will, they attract those monsters?
Maybe. This place surrounded by water feels like my waking nightmare.
I thought after last night I could beat my fear... but it seems I've still lost this test of courage.
That was when I was six, at the Navenia Maritime Festival...
I never thought that dream would come true.
After all, I'm from Navenia. I can't suppress the call for adventure.
Perhaps this is the advantage of being in the whirlpool: I can't retreat anymore, so I can choose any direction.
Hopefully we can still shout the slogan loud and proud then!
Arter is upset that so few people sign up. To get the event running, he asks you to help recruit in Autumn Village.
Haven't you tried enough times? Do you still want to keep going?
Facing nightmares is true courage. We should hold the event as planned.
There must be a way. Let me think... Got it!
You can't call it a major competition with just two or three people. Does everyone get a prize?
One more day, please. I'll bring more people.
Autumn Village near Aerux Town! Maybe we'll find people there.
Alright. If you insist, good luck.
Great! See you in Autumn Village. I'll tell you how to get there.
I'm short on time. Can you help me?
There must be a way, let me think... Got it!
zh_text: 一定还有办法，我想一想……有了！
source_text: 一定还有办法，我想一想……有了！
official_target_text: There must be a way, let me think... Got it!
official_en_text: There must be a way, let me think... Got it!

text: Qiu Chang says he quits because constant nightmares keep him from sleeping.
Leave me alone... I need to sleep...
I've had terrible nightmares lately. They're wrecking me.
Hello, the Climbers' Camp is holding the Courage Competition...
Hello, the Climbers' Camp is holding the Courage Competition...
Doesn't matter. I keep having nightmares and can't sleep well.
I keep dreaming I lose my exam admission ticket, run out of ink, or my paper gets ruined. It's so stressful!
Bai Ling warns you not to join, as the Courage Competition may be connected to the nightmare crisis in Northton.
This year's Courage Competition is about climbing. Want to join?
This year's Courage Competition is about climbing. Want to join?
Crisis comes from illusion... Desire and reality clash...
Unclear and confusing... It warns of danger in the competition.
I only sense a risk. I suggest you don't join.
There are rumors of nightmares in Northton. Could they be linked?
Sima Yiyi says she quits because she cannot decide what food to bring, and she keeps having food-related nightmares.
The Courage Competition has something new this year. Come join us!
The Courage Competition has something new this year. Come join us!
I want to go, but what snack should I bring for energy?
No, it might melt and get my hands sticky.
That's easy to carry, but not filling.
I planned to bring Frostcloud Claypot Rice.
But I dreamed a rib got stuck in my throat. Now I can't eat ribs.
I'll think more about what to bring...
Let's ask around to see if anyone wants to join.

Arter hears from a traveler that people in Aerux Town have been suffering nightmares lately and have no interest in the competition. He invites you to Climbers' Camp to check the registration situation.
Yeah... it really wears people out. They can't compete like this.
I need to check the registrations at the Climbers' Camp. Are you coming with me? You still have to sign up.
Maybe the nightmare monster is just in their heads... Oh, you're back. How did it go?
Traveler, you should check out the Courage Competition.
A nightmare monster is causing constant nightmares. How can anyone do anything else?
I didn't believe it at first, but now I'm having nightmares, too. Is that monster targeting me?
I'll leave the town for now. I'll come back to compete when things calm down.
I heard someone talk about it, but he wouldn't give any more details.
Courage Competition? Who cares now... Haven't you heard?
So everyone in Aerux Town seems to have nightmares... No wonder I've been dreaming of...
First place is definitely mine, hehe.
Thanks for helping—may the best win!
Go for it—I think you've got this.
But I'm not going easy. Anything can happen in the competition!
Yes! I helped recruit players, but I never said I wouldn't compete.
Let's have a real match later! I'll warm up now.
Let's have a good spar in a bit! I'm going to warm up first.
zh_text: 一会儿我们来好好较量一下！我先去热身了。
source_text: 一会儿我们来好好较量一下！我先去热身了。
official_target_text: Let's have a good spar in a bit! I'm going to warm up first.
official_en_text: Let's have a good spar in a bit! I'm going to warm up first.

text: It's time to wake Arter up.
It's time to wake Arter up.
Arter? Oh no, he can't wake up!
Arter? Oh no, he can't wake up!
At the waterfall beneath the cliff, Arter is trapped in a nightmare and groans in pain. He drops to his knees as several nightmare monsters appear.
Father! Mother! No... Don't board the boat...
Waves... The waves are coming! Help! Save them!
Qi Peng says the nightmare monsters flew east. The ruins there may get them stronger.
Arter's still trapped in the nightmare. Please try to wake him.
Arter's still trapped in the nightmare. Please try to wake him.
Probably the ruins to the east. The strong Sorcery energy there might make the monsters stronger.
Okay, are you going after that?
Those <001>glowing purple</> things must be the monsters.
Those <001>glowing purple</> things must be the monsters.
Stratius had a nightmare about losing his treasured pen. When he woke, the pen was actually missing. He asks you to help find it.
Enough. As Yong envoy, I can't mix personal and official matters.
Since <001>that thing</> was lost, you've had nightmares for days now.
Can you truly focus on duty in this state?
You got here just in time.
Envoy Stratius worries about a strange matter. Would you help investigate? There will be generous reward.
The night before last, I fell asleep in the Contemplation Pavilion and had a nightmare.
I lost a pen in a dream.
It was a gift from someone dear. It's not expensive, but very meaningful, so I always carry it.
I clearly saw a figure steal the pen in that dream.
Dream or not, checking in the <001>Archives</> seems necessary.
I woke up, searched the entire Pavilion, and found nothing.
Maybe you can find some new clues.
Wouldn't it be better if you asked me to investigate instead?
Then I entrust that to you.
Then how about asking this connected traveler to help? That way it's not mixing personal with official.
You realize it is Stratius's Mind Shadow. Fu Hang died in battle because Stratius delayed a military order. You suspect the Mind Shadow left the pen here.
Yes... Chapter Nine... It should be "ambushed on a rainy night, delayed reinforcements cost lives".
Seems like this is the only Dreamscape Fragment.
Seems like this is the only Dreamscape Fragment.
If the Mind Shadow stole the pen, it's likely hidden nearby. Search the area.
If the Mind Shadow stole the pen, it's likely hidden nearby. Search the area.
It seems this Mind Shadow has gained self-awareness, yet can't communicate.
It seems this Mind Shadow has gained self-awareness, yet can't communicate.
Listen to what it's saying. There might be clues about the pen.
Listen to what it's saying. There might be clues about the pen.
Together we stand, with or without armor. The king raises his army, repairing my arms. I march with you...
A nice title indeed, fitting for a military memoir.
My pen... Where is it? Ah, right. I gave it to Stratius.
That traitor who delayed the troops!
Does it hurt? At least you're still alive, Stratius!
When our fellows fell one by one, I still believed you'd come... But where were you?
Sacrifices must be made, right? Then you abandoned me.
Envoy Stratius's Mind Shadow... is Fu Hang?
Envoy Stratius's Mind Shadow... is Fu Hang?
It sounds like Envoy Stratius delayed the orders, causing Fu Hang's death.
It sounds like Envoy Stratius delayed the orders, causing Fu Hang's death.
This must be the source of Envoy Stratius's nightmares.
This must be the source of Envoy Stratius's nightmares.
Yes... Chapter Nine... It should be "ambushed on a rainy night, delayed reinforcements cost lives".
Found it. It was here all along.
Found it. It was here all along.
After you defeat the monsters, Stratius admits his guilt. Xiuheng enlightens him, and Stratius gives Fu Hang's pen to Xiuheng as a gift.
The Mind Shadow became a nightmare monster, but I took care of it.
The Mind Shadow became a nightmare monster, but I took care of it.
Excellent! As expected of my partner!
Thank you for your help. According to your description, that Mind Shadow was indeed my nightmare.
Since learning the Pavilion held Fu Hang's works, I've visited often to read.
His books recount too many old memories, deepening my guilt.
By the way, did you find the pen?
This pen must be the object of obsession that gave the Mind Shadow self-awareness.
Write your critique with this pen.
Mr. Fu Hang's pen? No, it's too precious...
He would have preferred it in your hands.
In that case... it'd be impolite to say no to that.
Mind Shadows are unstable, and the nightmare energy caused it to gain self-awareness and become a monster.
His negative emotions would generate more nightmare energy...
Whenever I recall those words, I dream of that night. If I hadn't taken the detour, if I'd charged through...
But instead of guilt, he channeled that thought into doubled efforts.
I think Mr. Fu Hang would want Envoy Stratius to let go of the past and live better.
On the way, Fen here explained everything.
So Envoy Stratius's guilt nourished the nightmare energy...
It hid the pen because losing it would deepen Envoy Stratius's guilt.
From what I've heard, this might be related to the Dream Energy imbalance in Northton.
Mr. Fu Hang once told a story in Youngsters' Dreams.
Two friends promised to study at Jixia together, but only one recommendation was available.
The chosen one often wondered, "If it were him, he'd use this opportunity to better serve our hometown."
In short, Envoy Stratius's nightmare stems not just from guilt, but from a longing for a better outcome.
In the face of parting and death, the only respect for the departed is to never forget.
Guilt consumes me. I dare not forget even a single detail.
Now I realize, perhaps he already knew his hopeless friend would one day be haunted by this.
I... have a favor to ask.
I plan to compile Mr. Fu Hang's manuscripts and write a critique of his works.
When I finish, could Envoy Stratius, as his dear friend, write the preface?
“In the face of life and death, the only respect for the deceased is to never forget.”
zh_text: “生离死别面前，唯一对逝者的尊重是永不忘记。”
source_text: “生离死别面前，唯一对逝者的尊重是永不忘记。”
official_target_text: “In the face of life and death, the only respect for the deceased is to never forget.”
official_en_text: “In the face of life and death, the only respect for the deceased is to never forget.”

text: Thank you for your help. If you ever need anything, feel free to ask.
You tell Fen about the strange events linked to nightmares. He says he's also investigating Xiuheng and asks you to search the library while he keeps watch outside.
I took a dream-related mission, and I'm investigating this place.
I took a dream-related mission, and I'm investigating this place.
This matter is not for wide talk.
What is it that cannot even be shared with me?
There're too many strange things caused by nightmares in town. I can barely find the opportunity to exchange intel like this...
I'm here looking for a pen.
Looking for a pen in the Pavilion? Your mission is as strange as the town's nightmares.
Maybe we can exchange clues to help each other.
The night before, Pavilion, pen lost in a dream... Weird coincidence...

text: Where should I look for the stone tablets?

One is <001>inside the cave</>, the other <001>atop a bone</>.
Upon learning Ye An was attacked, Meng Hai decides to return and check on him first.
Ye An said you're inspecting the stone tablets here. He was attacked by a Mechanoid.
Ye An said you're inspecting the stone tablets here. He was attacked by a Mechanoid.
What? I shouldn't have left him alone... Is he okay?
Well then. If something happened to him, I'd never forgive myself.
Ye An is very knowledgeable and dedicated. He mentored me when I joined the Seekers.
I was glad to work with him, so I hoped everything would go smoothly.
The investigation's almost done. I need to go back and check on him.
Meng Hai believes the bones are not the Overlord's. He has another theory about where the Overlord is, and says the clues are on another stone tablet.
It's so high... up here. I came up another way. I need a moment to catch my breath...
I'm okay. I want to know the truth right now. How did the investigation go?
Based on my findings, these remains aren't the Overlord's.
Why not? I collected a great deal of historical material for this.
You're inexperienced. You might have made a mistake.
The Overlord's life force was strong. Soil under its remains should be rich, with much lusher plants.
But the plants around here are ordinary in size.
He's probably right. The stone tablets say the Overlord got reinforcements, didn't fall, and returned safely.
He's probably right. The stone tablets say the Overlord got reinforcements, didn't fall, and returned safely.
Is that so? You're new, yet whenever we disagree, you always end up being right...
You taught me a lot. Maybe I just got lucky.
Where is the real Overlord, then...
About that... look at this. Actually, I have a bold theory...
Also, though the Overlord is said to have no lower body, it has strong arms and a short, heavy jaw.
This one has a small breastbone and a jutting jaw. Its long, slim body suggests a dragon, not the Overlord.
Ye An agrees with Meng Hai's theory and decides to give him the other team's investigation notes. He also offers to help Meng Hai apply for permission to enter the southern region.
Where did the Overlord return to?
I think it went south, where the Dragonriders began their journey.
If we find the Overlord, our report will be much stronger.
Exactly... It's exciting even to imagine it!
The south is off-limits and there are no records. How can we start investigating?
There are records, but they're hidden away.
I got materials from a Gray Falcon and kept the useful parts.
Fieldwork isn't my strength, so I've been sitting on it.
Today you showed you're capable. You should have them.
Thanks for trusting me. I'd like to go! But what about the academy's rules?
Don't worry. I'm close with the Department of Discipline. I can get you a pass.
I won't come with you—I'd only slow you down.
You've helped me a lot. I'll list your name first on our report.
There's no time to lose. I'll pack right away and set out tomorrow.
It's good to see such a drive in a newcomer.
This is your payment. Thank you for your help.
You're new but already a reliable Seeker...
The Overlord... I'm finally close to the truth...

text: Lu Ji had worked so hard...
Xie Mu has come to Dragon Valley for inspiration. He asks you to help find a pen his friend Lu Ji dropped on the cliffside pathway, agreeing to meet on the mountainside.
Really? I didn't know. I usually stay home writing and rarely go out.
I came because of my friend Lu Ji. His new book is about Dragon Valley.
What inspired him? I was so curious that I came to see it for myself.
Could you do me a favor?
Thank you. I'll take another route up. Let's meet on the mountainside.
As you can see, I came here to hide from the Mechanoids, but it's hard to climb down from here.
The scenery is dramatic and awe-inspiring, but I can only reach a few ordinary spots.
The best views are out of my reach.
On the cliff road, he looked down and felt as if he were walking in midair. Each step terrified him.
Lu Ji walked along the cliff path and then realized he had left his pen there.
He didn't go back for it, so it should still be there.
I don't think I can climb up there. Could you please get the pen for me?
He looked back from the plank road. Suspended on the mountainside, rising into the air, every step is breathtaking.
zh_text: “他从栈道上俯身回看。悬于山腰，凌空而上，每一步都让人惊心动魄。”

You return Lu Ji's pen. You agree to go to Wind's Rest Pavilion to view Dragon Valley.
Ahh... Phew... Finally made it up.
Have you never traveled to find inspiration?
Have you never traveled to find inspiration?
Lu Ji insisted on field research, but I don't.
Once, he got stuck trying to write a grand battle scene and couldn't write a single word.
He only found inspiration after seeing the real battlefield.
I can effortlessly create magnificent works. It may sound arrogant, but it's true.
Lu Ji said my inspiration would run dry. But it never did. Those images feel born into me.
Thank you. I'll keep it safe.
Have you changed your mind after coming here?
Have you changed your mind after coming here?
I don't know. Perhaps that place will give me the answer...
Lu Ji wrote: "Wind's Rest Pavilion sits atop the peak, as if it sees all life below."
Would you like to see the whole Dragon Valley at your feet?
From the pavilion, you look out over all of Dragon Valley. As the magnificent scenery fills his sight, Xie Mu finally understands the landscape his friend once saw.
The glorious hero fell before dawn, his final sigh lost to time.
Only years later do nameless flowers bloom on the bones.
The dragon fell on its own throne, ashes drifting far away.
The clueless held blades, unsure where to aim.
It's all here, just like the book. Lu Ji... I finally see what you saw.

Hey! You're the one who saved me, right?
Uh... I was just passing by...
Uh... I was just passing by...

Are you sure you're okay? You look hurt.
Are you sure you're okay? You look hurt.
Sharp eye. Yeah, I'm having a bit of trouble moving right now...

Besides me, there's the captain, Wu Ting; the vice-captain, Lan Yu; our ace, Tang Ling'er; and the team's strategist, Chen Shen...
Me? Ahaha... I'm the soul of the team! The team couldn't function without me.
Boosting morale, mediating disputes, serving tea... ahem, anyway!
So, I'm counting on you to find the exit!
Yuchi Len says goodbye and invites you to visit her team at their camp.
Ahh—feels so good out here! My whole body is waking up...
Hey, want to come with me and check out our camp?
Our secret dipping sauce is to die for. Someone at the food festival even offered a fortune for the recipe!
Our team might not have a star student like Kongming, but we're still pretty well-known at the academy!
Oh, I gotta run. They must be worried sick.
Thanks for your help! I'm heading back to camp to find my teammates!

Hmm... maybe they moved the camp for some other special reason.
I need to find more clues to be sure.
Could you do me a favor and ask around at the Dreamweaver Ruins nearby?
People are always coming and going there. Maybe you'll hear some news.
Hmm... how do I put it...
Our team's name is drawn from the endless ocean waves.
Everyone has different personalities, but like our name, "Waves," we're always moving in the same direction.
Haha, our captain, Wu Ting, was the one who said that.
Even now, I can't believe a slacker like him could say something so profound.
Our vice-captain, Lan Yu, is much more thoughtful by comparison. He's always looking out for us.
Tang Ling'er is the strongest on our team. Talented and disciplined. She could even hold her own against Kongming...
And then there's Chen Shen. Without his strategies, I don't think our team would've ever made it to such a grand stage...
So now... where on earth could they be...
Tell me more about your team.
Tell me more about your team.

I heard it's from some star team. A few years back, you couldn't buy the recipe at any price!
Inquire about the Team of Waves.
I was hoping Jixia would send someone to deal with those arrogant thugs!
Hello, have you seen a Jixia team camped out nearby? Their camp seems to have been taken over by the Rebels.

Sorry to bother you, but do you know about Jixia Academy's Team of Waves?

A female student from the Team of Waves went missing without a trace years ago. It caused quite a stir at the time.
The academy sent search party after search party, but they all came up empty.
After that, their captain stayed here and kept searching for her.
Oh! In fact, he asked me to help gather some people a little while ago!
It's strange, really. It's always been Wu Ting asking around for news.
I've never had anyone come asking about him, but today I've had two.
A young girl. I was swamped, so I didn't say much.
But she looked a bit like the picture on an old missing person poster, and I showed it to her.
I didn't expect her to get so emotional after seeing it.
I didn't get a chance to ask! She took off running toward the mountaintop.
What about the missing person poster?
What about the missing person poster?
I don't know where I put it. You can dig through this pile yourself.

Hello, have you heard of Jixia Academy's Team of Waves stationed nearby?
Hello, have you heard of Jixia Academy's Team of Waves stationed nearby?

Looks like there's nothing useful around here…
Looks like there's nothing useful around here…
She's a student at Jixia Academy, so she might know something.
Wait... you could ask Liu Wen!
She's right over there sorting materials. Says she's heading back to the academy and wants to bring some books and old documents with her.
What is it? Did you find the exit?
Haha, alright. Why don't you sit and rest a bit?
I was stuck in that Dreamscape Rift for days, I still haven't recovered! You haven't been trapped in here for days too, have you?
But we can't rush finding a way out. You never know, sometimes a path appears when you least expect it.
Now that I'm finally back to a normal life, I'll work hard to catch up with my teammates!
But after being away for so many years, there's so much I need to learn again.
I'll have to ask Captain Wu Ting for guidance...
Len is finally back. Everyone will be so happy to hear the news.
She said she wants to start over. As her captain, I must help her.
Yuchi Len had been trapped for four years. The academy searched for her but couldn't find her. Guided by Zhuangzi, Wu Ting chose to stay. Now the Team of Waves is finally reunited.
I'm fine... If things had gone as planned, I would've brought you here to barbecue with everyone...
I've come to this mountaintop many times, but this is the first time I've been here alone. It feels so deserted.
But... why is there such a large patch of Sundered Blooms here...
Is there something wrong with them?
Is there something wrong with them?
I'm certain these flowers don't grow in Dreamrealm. They're the emblem of our team.
Did someone plant them here on purpose?
Did someone plant them here on purpose?
Even so, they couldn't have bloomed this quickly. Their meaning is "reunion after a long wait"...
Sundered Blooms take years to grow, and the last time I was here was just a few days ago...
I really was lost for a long time...
That genius senior... he's probably graduated by now, right?
If you mean Kongming, he's considered a Jixia legend now.
If you mean Kongming, he's considered a Jixia legend now.
Some of your teammates have apparently become mentors at Jixia Academy.
Some of your teammates have apparently become mentors at Jixia Academy.
When I first came to Dreamrealm, the seniors always warned us that practicing Dream Sorcery Techniques was risky.
But I never took it seriously. So... this is the risk they meant.
My time, my friends... all gone...
It's okay. You still have a chance to start over.
It's okay. You still have a chance to start over.
Without my friends, I don't know how...
Your friends might be waiting for you.
Your friends might be waiting for you.
Sundered Blooms... reunion after a long wait...
Could it be... they've been waiting to see me again all this time...?
Len, it's been a long time!
That's right. Lan Yu and the others left the academy and went to different places, though...
Ngh... everyone's taken their own path now, while I'm still the same as before...
That's not true. Mr. Zhuangzi says you're just learning your own path...
And now, we've finally met again, haven't we?
Four years ago, no matter how hard we searched, we couldn't find a trace of you.
Thankfully, Mr. Zhuangzi divined that you would reappear here, which put our minds at ease.
I stayed here after graduating, hoping to be the first to welcome my teammate back.
We planted these flowers together before the others left. They said that when you returned, they'd throw you a big welcome-back party!
Welcome back to the team, Len.
I'm going to start a new journey with my old friends!
Thank you! I hope we meet again someday!

text: Yong Chi invites you to take a challenge. Head west along the path to meet Beiwang.
To wander in the haze between truth and illusion in search of an answer... does clarity have any meaning?
Rivers run east; the sun sets in the west. I travel far south, into an endless dream.
When will I come? When will I leave?
Hello, a Dreamscape Trial created by a sage is being held here. Those who pass will witness a phantasmal vision.
Yes. I'm waiting for the final result, but the student taking the trial still hasn't emerged.
Interested? The trial ground is just over there.
What you are to me, I am to you. That's how the sage described it.
That's a question you must ask yourself.
What kind of trial is it?
Dreamrealm was born from Zhuangzi's butterfly dream. The deeper you go, the more you see its endless transformations.
What we call "clarity" is both true and false. It's not the flowers, not the mountains, not the rivers.
It's like the butterfly, like you, and like myself. A million forms, all contained within.
All that a dreamer says is dream-talk.
Follow the road west, and you'll meet the examiner named <001>Beiwang</>.
In short, once reality loses its form, the true test of the dream is to find your true self.
Good luck. I hope you are the one who will let me witness the phantasmal vision.
“You are to me, as I am to you,” is how the sage who set the test introduced it back then.

text: Congratulations on overcoming the Dilemma of the Self.
After the Trial of the Self comes the Trial of Self-Knowledge. Remember, do not look back. Simply accept...
Walk on with a steady heart. The path of your life is determined by the steps you take. Go where you are going, come from where you come...
Time flows on, the hourglass never stops.
Everything is going smoothly. If you win the Enlightenment Trials and graduate from Jixia, do you know where you will go?
Alas... what, then, is the meaning of meeting...?
I'll remember the stories we wrote together.
All things are born, all things perish, in a ceaseless cycle... Alas, it is both chance and fate...
You have only just met your companions in Jixia, yet who knows when you will have to part...
All things move in cycles... Perhaps you are the only one who can break free...
A chance meeting, a fated parting...
All things arise and perish in an endless cycle... Sigh, it is both coincidence and fate...

True, you definitely know yourself best!
Hahaha, either way, it's good you know what you're doing.
I hate that lying old tortoise in Springbrook Plains.
Next time I see it, I'm gonna kick it into next week.
It wasn't that big of a loss.
Tch. Don't come crying to me next time it tricks you!
I'll flip it onto its back so it can never get up!
You'll run into that nasty creature sooner or later!
That butterfly... is it showing me the way?
That butterfly... is it showing me the way?
The challenge is nearly over. Yong Chi's butterfly avatar reminds you it is time to decide whether to wake him.
Confront the self, act with self-knowledge. The knot of self-oblivion is untied only when the self is forgotten.
Yong Chi's voice... is the trial finally over?
Yong Chi's voice... is the trial finally over?
It's time to decide whether to awaken <001>the Self</>.
Another <001>Self</>? Just who are you people...?
Another <001>Self</>? Just who are you people...?

<001>I</> am <001>I</>. Go now, and you shall see.

Beiwang... you need to wake up...
Beiwang... you need to wake up...

It seems the trial is over.
It seems the trial is over.

I need more time to think.

Talk with the Beiwang on the right.

Choose and defeat the real me, and you'll pass.
Think back on your past, and the self will give you the answer.

Beiwang am I, and I am Beiwang. The Trial of the Self descends like a waterfall.
Seek the true self, choose one of us. Defeat the real me to conquer the self, and the path will reveal itself.
Seeking the true self... any hints?
Seeking the true self... any hints?
Comb through your past to question what is real and what is false.
Are you a student of Jixia?
The Student Affairs Committee is closely tied to the students' studies.
Once you've officially become a Jixia student, please report to the Student Affairs Committee as soon as possible!
I didn't expect your grades... to be not bad.
I will keep an eye on you. Don't let me down.
The course board has posted new assignments. Don't miss out if you're interested.
You will receive corresponding rewards after completing your coursework, and the higher the difficulty, the greater the reward.
If you want to train yourself and become stronger, you can complete more assignments here with me.

Carry me, big shot! I'll just tag along!
Need a pro player? Speedrun conquests and battles!

Tap my avatar to join the group and fight the boss together.

Autumn water on the southern lake, smokeless at night; how can I ride the current straight to the sky...

Huh? I can faintly smell fine wine...
Tigon said he hasn't been training at night.
Really? But he's clearly getting thinner.
And that noise in the hall at night is real. Is he just training in secret and lying about it?
I doubt it. Head Trainer Tigon might keep things to himself, but he's no liar.
Actually, that <001>thump-thump</> doesn't really sound like someone hitting a dummy.
You're right, it's too irregular. It sounds more like... moving furniture?
And it's close. If it were the far hall, we wouldn't hear it this clearly.
What exactly is Head Trainer Tigon up to...
The Head Trainer is pushing himself too hard. I wonder if that student got through to him.
Worrying won't help. Let's just wait for news.
Speaking of which, last night I saw a shadow dash past the <001>Head Trainer's seat</>. Thought I was just hallucinating from copying lists...
I'm still worried. Head Trainer Tigon looks even thinner today...
But we swapped the lists! Is he still moping?
Actually, he thinks he's too heavy to defeat Bai He, who is much lighter.
Actually, he thinks he's too heavy to defeat Bai He, who is much lighter.
So he's... starving himself to cut weight?
Exactly. He's hiding fresh fish behind his chair so he won't be tempted to eat.
Exactly. He's hiding fresh fish behind his chair so he won't be tempted to eat.
Ha! So that noise wasn't training. It was him fidgeting with his fish stash!
He can't just stop eating. We'll put together a proper meal plan for him.
Exactly, and there's no real ranking in Martial Arts. The Hall Master's strength is unmatched, but that doesn't mean it's something Bai He can just learn.
Head Trainer Tigon must really love fish. Why don't you take this and whip up something good?
Head Trainer Tigon must really love fish. Why don't you take this and whip up something good?
No, no. You take it. We'll find a fish that satisfies the craving without packing on the pounds!
Thanks for digging up the Head Trainer's secret. Just you wait, we'll get him back to his old, sturdy self.
Head Trainer Tigon has his secrets. If he wanted you to know, he would've told you. It's not my place.
Head Trainer Tigon has his secrets. If he wanted you to know, he would've told you. It's not my place.
Sigh... you're too noble for your own good. We just wanted to help.
It's okay, Che Jing. If there's a secret, then we were right to be suspicious.
If the student can find it, we can too. Thanks for confirming our hunch.
True. We'll go poke around tonight and see for ourselves.
Thanks for the help. We'll take it from here.

Why wrong? I want to go.
You're not ready for crowds yet. Wait till you grow up.
Well, you will know when you do.
Number Seven, remember, show no mercy to the enemy.
zh_text: 七号，记得面对敌人不可手下留情。

text: Enough with that question. Mechanoids don't eat.
Alright, alright. I'll let you eat.
Quiet, or I'll shut down your speech system.
Several Mechcraft students are talking about Mr. Luban's latest inventions. They're very curious about them but don't want to disturb him, so they suggest you go in and take a look first...
It's said to have a brand new imitation module, which can learn the moves of the opponent for a counterattack! How cool is that?
Look! See that Mecharm in the lab?
Ah... wish I could get a closer look...
Then what are you waiting for?
We heard Mr. Luban's been in a bad mood lately... and he's refusing visitors.
But look at all those design sketches on his desk. He seems to be doing well... I say we should go and say hello.
What, now? I'm not even prepared! Hey, how about... you go first?
Haven't seen Mr. Luban in a while. I wonder what he's been doing in his lab...
Haven't seen Mr. Luban in a while. I wonder what he's been doing in his lab...
Please do not touch! This is still a prototype!
Hmm... doesn't look like his other works.
Look at that! Luban's designed a new Mechanoid?
The quest for truth is unending.
The Mecharm on the workbench... is it in sleep mode?
The Mecharm on the workbench... is it in sleep mode?
Mr. Luban shows you his latest invention: a training Mechanoid specially designed for the Team of Stars. He then asks you to find his previous experiment logs that might help with the fine-tuning.
Defense mechanisms are stable, but energy efficiency is not optimal... needs more adjustment.
How have you been recently? I hope I'm not interrupting.
How have you been recently? I hope I'm not interrupting.
I designed this Mechanoid for our Team of Stars. It suits our training better.
It can act as a sparring partner and help you fix bad habits in combat.
Hmm... I've conducted similar experiments before. Perhaps there's something that can help.
It's called "Third Generation Energy Efficiency Experiment Logs". And look for number thirteen.
Not at all. I'm just reviewing the test data. The new training Mechanoid is nearly complete.
But it drains energy too fast right now. I'm still working on a solution.
Now where did I put those experiment logs...
Are you sure about the numbers?
Of course. When it comes to numbers, my memory never fails.
Document management, though... another matter entirely.
The remaining parts should be here...

After you help Master Luban obtain the materials, you chat about your views on mechanical creations. Master Luban tells you that he considers his mechanical creations to be life. Mentioning this, he seems to remember No. 7 again, and you are curious about its development history and want to learn more.
Give the log to Mr. Luban.
As their creator, I've always tried to improve their learning systems, hoping they'd grow like humans do.
Yes. He's always been on my mind.
I spent countless hours calibrating and testing him.
I don't know if he had different learning patterns, or if he just liked to play pranks...
Well, his development logs are on that workbench over there.
Quite a scribble, right? When inspiration strikes, I must jot down my thoughts fast as I could.
Sometimes even I can barely read them myself...
Glad I found the right one.
Oh, it's this Mechcraft Kite of mine. It reminds me of important schedules.
Always there for your Mechanoids... You really are like a father to them.
Always there for your Mechanoids... You really are like a father to them.
A father, huh... At school, everyone has their own opinions about the worth of their creations.
Some see them as weapons, or tools. Others believe they're more than that.
Speaking of this... what are Mechcrafts to you?
Though created by humans, they have their own feelings and thoughts.
To me, they are living beings.
Looks like we share the same view.
Smart enough to tell me where they are... or to remember the way home.
A little troublemaker with quick wits. Always giving me a headache.
It's almost time for No. 6's regular maintenance.
From a practical standpoint, they are indeed created as tools.
An interesting perspective... Perhaps one day, they will indeed surpass their creators.
Mr. Luban... Are you thinking about No. 7 again?
Mr. Luban... Are you thinking about No. 7 again?
Feel free to take a look. I'll get back to work.
I am too. Whenever I'm focused on an experiment, I don't have the capacity for anything else.
And that includes keeping track of my notes. I'm sure you understand.

After you help Master Luban obtain the materials, you chat about your views on mechanical creations. Master Luban tells you that he considers his mechanical creations to be life. Mentioning this, he seems to remember No. 7 again, and you are curious about its development history and want to learn more.
Code Luban — Power Sequence Test: Energy System Revamp Experiment Number XIII...
Code Luban — Power Sequence Test: Energy System Revamp Experiment Number XIII...
This must be it. I should <001>take it back to Mr. Luban</>.
This must be it. I should <001>take it back to Mr. Luban</>.
Hmm, let's see if I can read this scrawl...
Hmm, let's see if I can read this scrawl...
Secrets Club Exclusive — Luban: Untold Stories of the Mechcraft Maestro...
Secrets Club Exclusive — Luban: Untold Stories of the Mechcraft Maestro...
Not this one. Back it goes.
Not this one. Back it goes.
Though I'm curious what it says...
Though I'm curious what it says...
Secret Gazette Exclusive Interview: Master Luban, the untold stories of a top mechanical craftsman...
zh_text: 《秘闻社专访：鲁班大师，顶级机关工匠不为人知的故事》……
