text: I hope they will be reunited soon.
I hope they will be reunited soon.
Now I should get back to Luban.
Now I should get back to Luban.
Mr. Luban tells you that he has decided to stop waiting and start searching for No. 7 again. He hopes that one day, you will both find what you're looking for.
My heart nearly stopped when I read that No. 7 almost fell off the bridge.
My heart nearly stopped when I read that No. 7 almost fell off the bridge.
After that, I made him a new pair of "Dashing Wings" as a precaution.
Did you ever find his nameplate?
Did you ever find his nameplate?
Yes. I searched for a long time in the valley downstream.
In the end, though... it is all I have left.
So? Any thoughts on Mechanoid designs?
I was caught up in the story...
It was so fun reading about your time together...
It was so fun reading about your time together...
Honestly, it made me forget about the design stuff completely, and...
Honestly, it made me forget about the design stuff completely, and...
But after you guys made Star No. 7 for me... Well, that got me thinking.
And now I've decided. I'm done waiting.
I'm going to find him myself.
Just like a father would never sit and wait for his lost child to come home.
I see... If there's anything I can do to help, just say the word.
I see... If there's anything I can do to help, just say the word.
Thank you. We both have something we must find... Best of luck, to you and to me.
For now... my priority is to develop a Mechcraft that can receive No. 7's signals.
And of course, to help our team defend our title in the Enlightenment Trials.
Hmm... I guess a better planned schedule is in order.
Let me see... To begin with, I could use an assistant for No. 6's maintenance.
Inspection report, sampling device, and spare parts — they're all yours. Time to get going.
Didn't you just offer to help? Well, here's your chance.
By my calculations, a solid grasp of Mechcraft principles already puts you ahead of one-eighth of Enlightenment Trials competitors.
Knowledge will serve you when it matters most. Your operation begins, Luban No. 10!
Please don't treat me as one of your Mechanoids...
Please don't treat me as one of your Mechanoids...
Number Seven is so lively and cute.
official_target_text: Number Seven is so lively and cute.
official_en_text: Number Seven is so lively and cute.

text: This is our way in. Let's jump.
And be careful where you land!
Here! This must be leading to the Mirage.
Hmm... That should do it, right?
Shye is impressed by how well the two of you work together. After a few quips, you and Shye resume the pursuit of the Littoral's Heart.
Phew, that was intense! I didn't expect us to work so well together.
I should definitely consider inviting you more often.
Moving on towards the Littoral's Heart!
Enough talking. Let's get out of here.
Too late for regrets now, captain. You invited me first, remember?
Too late for regrets now, captain. You invited me first, remember?
Haha, I'm just joking. You are a great teammate.
As for the credits... I will make it worth your while. But let's talk about that after we secure the Littoral's Heart!
Wow, you accept? No turning back for you now!
Great! I'll let you know when I find the next treasure.
Wow, aren't you a greedy one... Maybe you'd fit better with the Hurricane Treasurehunters!
It's the Bronze Mechfish patrolling again.
I wonder if it's true... should we try it?
You know, I heard a guy got swallowed by the Mechfish once. But then miraculously, he ended up outside the cave unharmed.
You are starting to worry now? Relax, your captain came prepared.
The Hurricaners we're after... Could they be dangerous?
The Hurricaners we're after... Could they be dangerous?
Look, there it is! The Mirage!
We kept our distance so well! How were they still activated?
Watch out! More of them are activated!
Watch out! More of them are activated!
Don't panic. Rule number seventeen: Adapt and overcome!
The Mechanoids just don't stop coming, do they?
They do, but rule number seventeen: Adapt and overcome!
They do, but rule number seventeen: Adapt and overcome!
Hopefully, these are the last ones...
Hopefully, these are the last ones...
Dialogue for the first wave of Mechanoid combat.
This is our first time fighting together, isn't it?
You're quick, skilled. Much better than I expected.
You arrive at the Mirage, but it's not activated. Shye asks you to power up the nearby Mechcrafts.
So, while I'm doing my thing, why don't you go figure out how the Mechcrafts work?
Look, there it is! The Mirage!
A great captain always does their homework.
Together, we can be twice as efficient!
Haha, it's not activated yet! We need to switch on the Mechcrafts on both sides, then resonate with it with Sorcery power.
I've memorized everything on that treasure map. Impressed?
Mechanoids again? They are literally everywhere...
Stay quiet now. If we alert them, we might let those two Hurricaners get away.
Now let's see where the silly duo is.
They are? I'm almost done here, too. Just a little bit more Sorcery resonance...

Admiring the majestic statue, Shye shares her childhood stories with you. Her life in poverty, the night she found her Mistveil, her dreams that very night... until it is interrupted by a sudden booming sound in the distance. Together, the two of you set off for the Mirage again.
Dialogue expressing awe before approaching Bi Fang.
In the dream, I was in a beautiful village playing with the fish in the river, surrounded by friends and family...
It felt so real, like a memory of my own... So, I took the Mistveil, hoping to figure out the mystery behind it.
When I graduate from Jixia, I want to explore the world just like him!
It must be Cyan and Maroon. Come on, let's find our way to the Mirage.
Alright, enough about me. We've got business to do.
But hey, one day you'll have to tell me your story... I'd love to know more about you.
Hmm... solid bronze in such a majestic form... I'd make a fortune if this thing were in the Southlands.
Yes. He saved me from a group of criminals during his academic visit. I'll never forget that day.
What a statue! Looks like it was built by the ship's former owner, perhaps to commemorate a long voyage.
Shye, you seem quite familiar with all this... treasure hunting and trading stuff.
Shye, you seem quite familiar with all this... treasure hunting and trading stuff.
Well, I grew up in the Southlands all by myself, selling scraps to pay off debts and eke out a living... So yeah, I know a valuable thing when I see one.
Sorry, I didn't mean to bring up those memories.
Sorry, I didn't mean to bring up those memories.
It's okay. Life may have been hard, but I'm actually quite grateful for it. Taught me so many things.
Then I came across a silk ribbon woven with Sorcery patterns. Next thing I knew, I was traveling to Jixia with Master Zhuangzi.
Barren, chaotic. You've gotta be a survivor to live a life there.
For me, it's not really home... It's just the place I grew up.
I found it in a long-abandoned ancestral hall, wrapped around a statue of some unknown goddess.
It was freezing that day, so I used it to keep warm... and that night I had a long dream.
Woah! Won't you look at that...
As Shye maneuvers her Sorcery power, the two parts of the Mirage merges together, revealing that Maroon and Cyan have already got the Littoral's Heart. Your next goal is to snatch it back from them.
Hey, talk about timing! They are just one step away from the Littoral's Heart.
Wait, they are leaving... Have they got it already?
That's our cue now. Let's find them and claim that gem!
Hey, we're just in time! They are one step away from the Littoral's Heart.
It took them long enough, but they sure can handle their business.
Now let's go and claim that treasure!
The plan is simple. We just have to...
There's a large deck up ahead. We'll wait for them there.
Hurry up! We're gonna be late!
Shye guides you onto the elevator.
The Hurricaners should be arriving any minute now...
There's an elevator over there. Let's go.
Despite the fright, the Mechfish ferries you both safely out of the cave, just as Shye expected. As it fades back into the mist, you discover that the Littoral's Heart is gone...
You made it. Quick now, this way!
Your sudden appearance puts them on guard, but Shye charms Maroon with her silver tongue, while Cyan remains a bit skeptical. She winks at you—time to show them the hammers.
We're the largest treasure hunter team in Jixia. It's normal not to know every face, right?
And we've just joined the family. This is only our first mission.
Can't believe we're lucky enough to meet you two in person! You're legends!
Ah, my friend here just joined us yesterday. It takes time to learn things.
But I know. "Crash and smash!" Right?
That's right... So you are not lying?
You were gone for a long time, and captain got worried. She thought you might be in trouble.
So she sent us here to see what happened, and also to help you carry the treasures back.
The captain really thinks of everything! We are indeed exhausted.
Of course! You are talking about Captain Wuyan, the leader of Jixia's best treasure hunting team!
Come on, Cyan. Give the treasures to our new teammates.
Something still feels off... I feel I've seen this girl somewhere.
I've been staying by captain's side since day one. Maybe you've seen me around.
It's not every day captain cares about us like this. Just give them the stuff already!
Fine. Let me show you something. You'll trust us after this.
Hey, I'm warning you! Don't come any closer!
Relax, gentlemen. I know exactly who you are.
So your friend there, one of us too?
Don't you know who we are? You don't wanna mess with us!
Think, when was the last time captain did something like this? Don't you feel weird?
Then tell me, what does Captain Wuyan always say to us?
Careful now, especially with the Littoral's Heart.
Oh, so she knows... Just give them everything, Cyan.
We're on the same team here.
Maroon and Cyan, the right-hand men of Captain Wuyan.
Same team? Who are you then? I don't remember seeing you.

Taking Shye's cue, you present the hammers as a gift and successfully swap them for the Littoral's Heart. Just as you are about to make your escape, Maroon and Cyan realize they've been tricked and give chase. At that moment, a bomb comes out of nowhere and explodes, allowing you and Shye to slip away amidst the chaos.
The Sunbreaker and the Moonbreaker, to be exact.
The most powerful hammers for her most trusted warriors. Take them, you deserve it!
So she always knew what we wanted...
Captain Wuyan knew how much you longed for a weapon like the Starbreaker for yourselves.
So she found a master blacksmith and had these made just for you. A reward for this treasure hunt!
Ahem, why don't you go and give them a swing? See how they feel in your hands?
In the meantime, we'll keep your loot safe.
Oh, sure. Thanks, by the way!
Come on, you are the real heroes!
The rocks here seem like a good place to start. And we will be waiting over there.
I'm fine, you? Are you hurt?
Good! This path is blocked. You'll have to take a detour to the left.
I still have a funny feeling about this. I mean, that girl...
Hey, what!? My hammer just snapped! I barely touched it!
I must have seen her before...
I remember now! It's Shye! From the Team of Stars!
You lying brats! Don't let me catch you!
Watch out! The rocks are falling down!

Turns out Shye has left the Littoral's Heart inside the Mechfish so as to return the treasure to its rightful place. She reminds you that no treasure is more important than teammates and declares you an honorary member of her Treasurehunter team. Still, neither of you can shake the feeling that today's story is far from over...
Yeah... I'll have to report this to Senior Wuyan and the Department of Discipline.
I hope we can work even better together in the future!
And hey, should I get a new job, you'd be the first one to know.
Alright, I'm off. See you back at the academy!
Don't worry, I left it in the belly of the Bronze Mechfish.
What? Aren't we supposed to take it?
What? Aren't we supposed to take it?
Nope! I said we were here to "protect" the Littoral's Heart, not to take it away.
And the best way to do that is to put it back in its rightful place.
Besides, it was way too dangerous back there! My priority had to be our rule number one!
Rule number one... Safety above all else.
Rule number one... Safety above all else.
Exactly! No treasure is more important than teammates.
Well, don't get sappy on me. So, how did you feel about the job?
Oh, and that bomb... the smell when it went off reminded me of an old Southlands formula.
Yep. I've got a hunch this isn't quite over yet. More trouble may be headed our way...
Or it's just me being paranoid! Come on, we made a great team today, didn't we?
Until next time then, honorary member!
That's why I've made a decision—
I'm declaring you an <001>honorary member</> of the Aegis Treasurehunters!
Almost ended up as fish food...
Forgot that story I told you? Nothing was gonna happen to us.
But what if the story wasn't true?
But what if the story wasn't true?
Well, it is true. I already figured it out back at the Mirage, actually.
The Bronze Mechfish not only monitors the intruders, but also drives them away.
Still, it's not designed to hurt anyone. It just swallows them and sends them back out.
Of course not. Then maybe they did?
Don't mention it! I should be thanking you!
You really care about your reward, don't you...
You've been a great help today.
You know what? Let's sort that out later! We'll have plenty of time together in the future, right?
Next time, no throwing bombs without warning!
Wait... Shye, where's the Littoral's Heart?
Wait... Shye, where's the Littoral's Heart?
Wait, bomb...? I thought it was you.
Wait, bomb...? I thought it was you.
Or... was there someone else in the cave?
Anyway, the Littoral's Heart is safe, nobody got hurt... I'd say it's a job well done!
Just didn't expect the Hurricaners to be so obsessed with treasures...
Just didn't expect the Hurricaners to be so obsessed with treasures...
Shye shows you the "preparation" she made: two counterfeit hammers modeled after Wuyan's Starbreaker. Time for the two of you to stop Maroon and Cyan together!
Voila, check this out! The ace up my sleeve!
Remember what I said? Adapt and overcome.
See? Every Hurricaner covets a weapon powerful as Wuyan's Starbreaker.
Shye explains her plan: to pose as Wuyan's assistants and trick them into willingly handing over the treasure. You have your doubts, but Shye claims that she has "come prepared."
So, where was I before the Mechfish?
You said something about a simple plan.
You said something about a simple plan.
And I brought something to make our story more believable. You'll see.
Rule number thirteen: Work smarter, not harder!
Just follow my lead, and everything will be fine!
Humph, that's good! Wait, I'm hearing something down there... Let's check it out.
That's it? And you think it'll work?
That's it? And you think it'll work?
Right, the plan. So in a nutshell—
I think I'm getting the hang of this... Aegis style of yours, captain.
I think I'm getting the hang of this... Aegis style of yours, captain.
We'll just say Captain Wuyan sent us, play it by ear, then trick them into handing over the gem.
Maroon and Cyan have been staying with the Hurricaners ever since they joined them. They barely know other students anymore.
Those two may be skilled fighters, but they're all brawn and no brain.

Listening in on Maroon and Cyan, you learn they have long admired Wuyan's Starbreaker and dream of a powerful weapon of their own. And to do that, they've been selling stolen treasures to a mysterious individual...
Those were some annoying Mechcraft traps back there.
Hey, imagine we have something as powerful our captain's Starbreaker. How cool would that be?
You know, just smash our way through and grab everything!
But then again... when will we ever be rich enough to afford one?
Felt easy enough to me. As did all the other ruins in Jixia we've been to!
When we sell the Littoral's Heart we will.
Oh yeah, you're right! So we're giving it to that girl as always? I have a feeling the captain is on to us.
Nah, the captain will thank us in the end. It doesn't matter how we do it, as long as it works.
But can she really pull it off?
You've seen what she can do... And if it turns out she's playing us, we'll deal with her the Hurricaners' way.
Then what are we waiting for? Let's go!
Just as the two brothers are about to make off with the Littoral's Heart, you and Shye jump out to block their path.
Despite the terrifying descent, Shye remains perfectly composed and immediately leads the way to the bronze Tower Ship.
Enter the cave with Shye for the first time.
Practice makes perfect. We'll take it slow.
See that bronze gate over there? That's our entry to the Tower Ship.
Phew, safe landing! See, not as scary as it looked, right?
Now, back to the task at hand...
Better than expected, but I wouldn't call it safe...
Better than expected, but I wouldn't call it safe...

Just as Shye talks about the Bronze Mechfish mentioned on the treasure map, it miraculously appears out of nowhere, crashing straight through the stone pathway between you and her before vanishing back into the abyss.
Around the ship the bronze fish sails, amidst the haze a mirage unfolds. Remember?
I read this line in the treasure map.
Many Seekers believe there's a giant Bronze Mechfish somewhere in here...
There's no rush. Take your time.

Shye quickly composes herself from the accident and takes you toward the Mirage—a three-dimentional map of the Tower Ship that could be used to reveal the whereabouts of the two Hurricane Treasurehunters.
Remember that poem? "Around the ship the bronze fish sails, amidst the haze a mirage unfolds."
The Bronze Mechfish we just ran into functions like the ship's eye, roaming around and capturing everything in its sight.
Based on what it sees, a three-dimensional map is created. That's the Mirage.
We get there, we'll be able to see all that's happening on this ship.
And that includes those two from the Hurricane Treasurehunters.
This way, we can pick the best when and where to intercept them.
Are you okay? I promise I'll be more careful next time...
Are you okay? I promise I'll be more careful next time...
Stop blaming yourself. I didn't see it coming either. Must be part of the ship's defenses.
It's great you're here. If I were alone, this would be way more dangerous.
Ah, stop it! Let's hurry to the <001>Mirage</> and see where those two are now.
Let me think. Hmm... it should be this way...
Okay, the barrier is gone now!
Okay, the barrier is gone now!
Do you see the <001>glowing blue pebbles</> along the way?
Yeah, quite a lot of them.
Yeah, quite a lot of them.
Your friend? That deputy you mentioned earlier?
Your friend? That deputy you mentioned earlier?
Oh, and try not to alert the Mechanoids around here.
Be careful. Don't want you to get hurt!
In my previous trips here, they helped me find my way back to my friend. Multiple times, actually...
Yeah... but that was a long time ago.
Let's follow their tracks, and we should meet soon.
Dialogue after killing monsters on the Panstone Path.
Do you see the <001>glowing blue pebbles</> along the way?
Yeah, quite a lot of them.
Yeah, quite a lot of them.
Let's follow their tracks, and we should meet soon.
In my previous trips here, they helped me find my way back to my friend. Multiple times, actually...
Your friend? That deputy you mentioned earlier?
Your friend? That deputy you mentioned earlier?
Yeah... but that was a long time ago.
Oh no, where did all these Mechanoids come from?
It's nothing. Just let me take care of them.
Almost. I can see the platform, but it's too high for me.
Almost. I can see the platform, but it's too high for me.
Bronze platform... Must be that one over there.
Bronze platform... Must be that one over there.
Check, check. Have you made it?
Hmm, let me see... Got it! How about now?
Great! Now it's your turn to help me.
I'm stuck behind a barrier, and the control should be on your side. Can you see it?
I see it. I'll give it a try.
I see it. I'll give it a try.
Yeah, even from here it's impressive already.
As we go deeper into the cave, you'll see many more extraordinary things.
This Tower Ship is much larger than I imagined...
This Tower Ship is much larger than I imagined...
Yet what a timing, though! I just mentioned it and there it was!
Phew, I am. Nothing I can't handle.
Looks like we'll have to split up for now. Regroup later at the ship's <001>Bronze Platform</>?
With no road ahead, Shye suggests you split up and meet at the bronze platform.
It's all cliffs here with no solid footing. You should try that lower passage.
I'll go ahead and do some scouting. Meet me at the <001>Bronze Platform</> as planned!
Accompanying dialogue before entering the cave.
Aren't we going in through the main entrance?
Aren't we going in through the main entrance?
There, look! That's our way in.
Only a fool knocks on the front door. I know a secret passage.
With a playful grin, Shye shares two rules of the Aegis Treasurehunters. Before you can react, she urges you to jump into the Littoral Cave with her...
Oh, before we start, there's something I need to tell you.
Ahem, it's the rules of the Aegis Treasurehunters!
Rule number one: Safety above all else.
Rule number two: Trust your captain. And that means me.
For example, when I say jump down through here, you jump...
Look at you, all fired up and eager to get started... Alright, let's do it.
Some time later, two men appear below the cliff. Shye recognizes them as Maroon and Cyan, two of Wuyan's trusted members. Surprised, she decides to follow them.
They are the Hurricaners for sure, but...
Maroon and Cyan? I can't believe they'd stoop to such dishonesty...
But then again, it's still too early to draw any conclusion. Let's keep up with them and see how it goes.
Around the ship the bronze fish sails, amidst the haze a mirage unfolds.

You meet Shye after keeping her waiting for a long time. She has been tasked with guarding a treasure known as the "Littoral's Heart." You accept her offer and join her team—Aegis Treasurehunters, while she seems oddly evasive when talking about another member...
Sorry, this place was hard to find...
Sorry, this place was hard to find...
Anyway, I called you here for a very important matter. Now where do I begin...
How about you start by looking at this treasure map?

text: Ding! Hello student, you have an urgent commission letter from the Scholar Committee.
You need me for something? What is the commission?
You need me for something? What is the commission?
By the Master's exclusive commission, I am to convey an important task: The martial arts tournament in Yungen Town is approaching, and the Great Wall Guard selection requires talented assistance.
The Master's words: "I place my high hopes in you, awaiting your return."
Master, you want me to go to Yungen Town to assist the garrison with the selection process, right?
Master, you want me to go to Yungen Town to assist the garrison with the selection process, right?
Indeed. The Master has instructed you to proceed with peace of mind and seek out Mentor Xingmang at the Martial Arena for further coordination.
Assisting the Guard selection seems quite difficult... Is the Master sure about sending me?
Assisting the Guard selection seems quite difficult... Is the Master sure about sending me?
The Master says he has his own arrangements. Please rest assured and head to the martial arts tournament to meet with Mentor Xingmang.

Furthermore, the Master has a request: do not worry about the selection trials. He has already entrusted the Captain of the Guard to provide you with some guidance. Please be sure to show proper respect when you meet.
If the General has any orders, please allow me to contribute my humble efforts. I hope not to fail the Master's trust.
Understood. I will head to the Yungen Town martial arts tournament now to find Mentor Xingmang.
Understood. I will head to the Yungen Town martial arts tournament now to find Mentor Xingmang.
Understood, I'll go to the Yungen Town martial arts tournament to find Mentor Xingmang first.
Understood, I'll go to the Yungen Town martial arts tournament to find Mentor Xingmang first.
A time will come to ride the wind and cleave the waves, and set my cloud-white sail to cross the vast, deep sea.
Dear students, congratulations to your team for winning the championship in this year's Dream of Return to Nothingness.
All students in this group are cordially invited to visit the beautiful Caiyun Basin seaside at 17:00 tonight.
Looking forward to everyone's punctual attendance. Please reply "Received" to confirm.
Excuse me, what are the arrangements?
Excuse me, does the Academic Affairs Committee have any arrangements?
Excuse me, does the Academic Affairs Committee have any arrangements?
Excuse me, does the entire Star Team need to participate? My teammates are still recovering from their injuries...
Excuse me, does the entire Star Team need to participate? My teammates are still recovering from their injuries...
This is an automated message. Please do not reply with anything other than "Received." Thank you for your understanding.
Thank you for confirming, student. The specific location will be sent later, please keep an eye out.
Lychill invites you to afternoon tea, but you'll have to make your own tea.
Um, you know what... You're right—it doesn't hurt to learn a new skill.
Um, you know what... You're right—it doesn't hurt to learn a new skill.
Thirsty after the trip? I happen to have something nice—care to try?
Still not trusting my brews, I see... Well, today's a chance to change that.
I've been working on a wellness tea lately. Taste aside, the benefits are proving solid. But there's something missing...
Taste aside? But taste is important!
Taste aside? But taste is important!
That's where you come in. I could use a second opinion when it comes to ingredient combination.
Alright, I'll give it a try... Wait, you invite me for tea but I'll have to make it?
Alright, I'll give it a try... Wait, you invite me for tea but I'll have to make it?
At least your safety is guaranteed this way, right? Plus, you get to pick up a new skill.
Of course, I can do it myself, if that's what you want—
I didn't invite you here just for that, of course.
Are you thirsty from the journey? I have something delicious, want to try it?
zh_text: 一路走过来口渴吗？有好喝的哦，来尝尝？
source_text: 一路走过来口渴吗？有好喝的哦，来尝尝？
official_target_text: Are you thirsty from the journey? I have something delicious, want to try it?

text: A Mini-nose Bilby has caused chaos in the garden, yet Lychill asks you to finish gathering the ingredients for tea.
What happened? Was there an attack?
What happened? Was there an attack?
Not exactly. A little guy came uninvited is all. I was too occupied to... you know, take care of it.
But that's just the problem with outdoor gardens. Free souls in the wild love to join in the fun.
A bit too free, I'm afraid...
So are we still going as planned?
So are we still going as planned?
No worries, I have backups for the lost seasonings.
Thanks for fetching the water, by the way. Let's gather the rest of the ingredients now.
It's still running around—will that be a problem?
It's still running around—will that be a problem?
Don't worry, I'll teach it a lesson when the time is right...
Lychill asks you to fetch the water for brewing tea from the mid—waterfall on the shaded side.
The <001>rushing water in the middle of the waterfall, located on the shady side</>, is lively and clear, making it perfect for boiling tea.
I'll prep the ingredients here. Fetch some water for me, will you?
Well, navigating rough terrains is way more your thing than mine. Gotta leave the job to the pro, right?
Trust me, getting the ingredients ready is way trickier than fetching water. Plus, your legs are younger than mine.
And speaking from experience, the tea tastes better when the work is harder. Please?
You have named the tea, and Lychill suggests finding a place to rest and enjoy it.
Well, the brew's ready. You've done quite well.
Wanna give your tea a name?
You did make it based on how you felt. A good name, I like it.
You're kinda exaggerating things here. If someone calls it false advertising, don't blame the infirmary.
That's why I added "Special Edition"—should cover it, right?
That's why I added "Special Edition"—should cover it, right?
Okay... Someone's being sneaky, I see.
Me? Then how about... No. 16 Staring Gent Trial Tea?
Well, it's almost dark already. Great work today, kid.
Let's find a spot to rest and taste your tea, shall we?
It's easy to remember, and definitely unique. I'd say it's perfect.
You have named the tea, and Lychill suggests finding a place to rest and enjoy it.
The <001>rushing water in the middle of the waterfall, located on the shady side</>, is lively and clear, making it perfect for boiling tea.
Alright, almost there. Just a bit more time, and it should be ready for a test.

Lychill talks about her experiences, saying she envies your frankness and composure. As she speaks, the previous 'Lost-Nose Mouse' returns—it turns out to be a Lost-Nose Mouse. Lychill asks you to let it taste the tea.
Hmm, light flavor, smooth on the tongue, well-controlled heat. You really have a talent for this.
So, what do you think this place?
I come here alone sometimes—to clear my mind off all the worries.
Flowing water, evening breeze, the cicadas... Feels like the lines between you and everything else just vanish.
Oh—then what impression did I give you, huh?
Not everyone can fit into new places like you, you know. Many just dress it up with... let's say practiced poise.
Honestly, sometimes I envy how straightforward you are.
You could say that... Sometimes on quiet afternoons, I'd just space out hearing people pass by.
It'd hit me that, I've really left the old life behind—that I can actually enjoy my life here.
Moments like this? They are invaluable to me.
A free spirit to enjoy Jixia's free life. I'm really happy for you.
A free spirit to enjoy Jixia's free life. I'm really happy for you.
You want a cup too? Wasn't stealing my ingredients not enough, little one?
You got any of the tea left? Why don't we let our visitor try some?
Still not feeling at home here?

Lychill talks about her experiences, saying she envies your frankness and composure. As she speaks, the previous 'Lost-Nose Mouse' returns—it turns out to be a Lost-Nose Mouse. Lychill asks you to let it taste the tea.
Just an excuse to get me up here, isn't it...
Just an excuse to get me up here, isn't it...
It's been fun spending time with you.
Look forward to our next experi—I mean, tea tasting.
The scent of tea sends the Mini-nose Bilby away. Lychill promises to invite you the next time she finds a new tea.
It doesn't like it? Ain't that a surprise... Guess good things take time to be appreciated.
Well... It's about time to call it a day. Thanks for the help.
So glad to hear that. I'll be sure to invite you again when my new drink is ready.
That... you really just invited me here to make tea—not for testing medicine or some secret investigation.
That... you really just invited me here to make tea—not for testing medicine or some secret investigation.
Am I being too soft on you? Seems my little assistant prefers being bossed around...
Alright, shall we have one more cup before the sunset fades?
That should teach it not to mess around here again.
That should teach it not to mess around here again.
I got to try a bunch of new things too.
I got to try a bunch of new things too.
Given how the Mini-nose Bilby reacted, we should observe the tea's effects further. Agreed?
You think? But this is only your first sesson.
Hope the flavor wasn't too intense for it...
Hope the flavor wasn't too intense for it...
Now that's your real reason for inviting me here, isn't it...
Now that's your real reason for inviting me here, isn't it...
Under Lychill's guidance, you completed the process of preparing the tea base, seasoning, and adding toppings.
I want to do cold brew.
Let's begin then. You can follow my steps or do it your way.
As long as it doesn't taste too bad, I'll take that as a win.
First, chop Staring Gent leaves and boil them as the <001>tea base</>. Though some effect is lost, such a process can effectively remove astringency.
That would preserve all its tonic properties, but the base might taste very bitter. Still, no need to be rigid.
Just so you know, if it upsets your stomach, it's on you.
Next is <001>flavoring</>. Stir in some juice extracted from Phantom Dewcap Grass, and its sweet aroma will further neutralize the bitterness.
So it's like adding sugar... Is it really necessary?
So it's like adding sugar... Is it really necessary?
Not necessarily, but it does offer additional nutrition. Don't overdo it, of course.
Sweet plus nutritious—the more the merrier then.
Sweet plus nutritious—the more the merrier then.
Looks like I'm the more conservative one here...
Finally, the <001>topping</>. Personally, I recommend using a Crackle.
Dice the fruit for unique texture without overpowering the original flavor. What do you say?
Good, no need to remind you to watch your fingers.
Adding fruit makes it feel more like porridge than tea.
Adding fruit makes it feel more like porridge than tea.
You know what... I think you're right. Keeping it pure might be a better option.
If that's what you want. Had I known, I'd have prepared the right tools for you.
Are you being innovative or just cutting corners? You do know we're not making a fruit pudding, right?
Fair enough. I'll give them a few cuts then.
Fair enough. I'll give them a few cuts then.
Really...? Don't mind if I do, then!
Really...? Don't mind if I do, then!
Okay, I'll do as instructed. Otherwise a wrong first step might ruin the whole cup...
Okay, I'll do as instructed. Otherwise a wrong first step might ruin the whole cup...
No pressure, okay? I won't bite if you fail.
I'll just take a sip then... Now what's next?
I'll just take a sip then... Now what's next?
If it's too sweet, it won't feel like tea anymore.
If it's too sweet, it won't feel like tea anymore.
Hmm... good point. In the future, I could prepare some juices to go with it.

I can clearly feel each ingredient inside my mouth... So yeah, it's not bad at least.
Okay... Anything I can do better?

Nothing for now. Both the flavor and texture are lovely.
Still not feeling at home here?

Senior Meng Ya, while I was fishing by Mirror Lake, the Department of Discipline suddenly rushed out and confiscated my fishing rod! I'm here to get it back.
You're hogging all the spots. What about the other anglers?
Hey, just talk to me! Standard fishing spots cost 20 Ringild, premium ones cost 50. Quite a bargain, right?
Are you kidding? Mirror Lake is a public space!
But there's no rule against this, right? I put in the effort to secure these spots early, and the customers are free to choose—I'm not forcing anyone to buy.
Y-you're just exploiting a loophole... *breathe deeply* I gotta calm down, calm down... So, what do you think we should do?
I think it's fair to confiscate the rods.
And who are you? What rule are you referring to?
What kind of attitude is that! Deliberately exploiting school rules—confiscating your fishing rod and not deducting your credits is already lenient!
Is this how you from the Department of Discipline handle things? I'm going to report this to Master Fuzi!
Uh... what if he's serious about that?
Uh... what if he's serious about that?
Even if he goes to Master Fuzi and twists the story, you can vouch for me. Right now, we need to report this and amend the school rules.
If they want to know the truth, I'll go with you.
If they want to know the truth, I'll go with you.
We need rules to back it up.
What's that supposed to mean? Trying to make things hard for me? You... you just wait, I'm going to file a complaint!
By the way, before the new rules come out, why don't you join me in getting up early to secure a spot by the lake? That'll stop him from getting any funny ideas.
Get Novar involved. He's always up for morning training... and we can ask Sun Bin to create some Mechanoids to fill the spots!
Hmph, I remember this. You call that fishing? Since when do real anglers set up dozens of rods at once?
Exactly, what kind of rule is that?! You should give me back my angling rod, it cost me a fortune in Ringild!
One rod a day? What kind of strategy is that?
One rod a day? What kind of strategy is that?
Hey, it buys us time to report the case and get the rules patched up. Keeps him from trying the same stunt again.
Sure, no problem. But the Department of Discipline doesn't have a rule about returning confiscated items within a certain number of days...
So, just come by once a day and take an angling rod.
So this is how you deal with disciplinary violations.
So this is how you deal with disciplinary violations.
Yes, most students try all sorts of tricks to retrieve their confiscated items, which can be quite troublesome.
But with your help, it doesn't seem so difficult after all. We might be able to wrap this up sooner than expected.
Dianji tries to steal the confiscated mechanical puppet, but it goes out of control after being activated, causing panic. Meng Ya and Dianji don't see eye to eye, and Dianji runs off in a rage.
What you did just proved my point. Your Mechanoid doesn't meet the academy's safety standards.
It hasn't been properly maintained since it got here, so it went haywire when I switched it on.
But those standards are so old! The technology I'm using is very safe now.
I would've completed its final upgrade, and none of this would've happened...
All I've done is just modifications! And Rule 29 of the School of Mechcraft Regulations stipulates that...
You don't have to tell me about those old rules! What I'm doing is called innovation!
You do remember how many things you've blown up yourself before, right, Senior Meng Ya?
Where's my Apocalyptor? I'll make him get a taste of it!
*Sigh* I guess you're right. I should not let them... ugh, whatever!
It would've been if you guys hadn't come and confiscated it!
That's the Mechanoid I confiscated, right? What happened to it?
Easy, easy. Remember, you're a Discipline Overseer.
Easy, easy. Remember, you're a Discipline Overseer.
So you were planning to just sneak in and take it back? Are you serious?
My Mechanoids will never go wrong in my hands, I promise!
Hey, he just ran off... Meng Ya, are you okay?
Hey, he just ran off... Meng Ya, are you okay?
Let's just get out of here. There's work to be done.
It's okay, everyone. The situation is under control. Dian Ji! Get over here!
Dianji tries to steal the confiscated mechanical puppet, but it goes out of control after being activated, causing panic. Meng Ya and Dianji don't see eye to eye, and Dianji runs off in a rage.
Why are there so many people here...?
Why are there so many people here...?

And hey, think you can get up early tomorrow? We'll go to the lake and take up some spots, too.
I'll bring Novar, and ask Sun Bin to send a few Mechanoids there as well.
And that's just one case. Exhausting already, isn't it?
Good thing you're here. Without you, I would've blown up for sure.
What's going on out there? Come on, let's check it out.
So, could you please help me out? I honestly can't do this all day without making mistakes.
Hello there. What's with all the crowd?
Hello there. What's with all the crowd?
Oh, thank the Wonders! C'mon, let's talk inside.
You see, it's my turn to handle student violations... and I mean, what a pain...
You have no idea. They always manage to find the wildest ways to break the rules.
And some of them... I almost want to blast them with my Apocalyptor!
Claimed they were sleepwalking after getting into a fight. Used Mechanoids to sign in for class. Even shot down someone's graduation project during archery practice.
So my job is... to make sure you make the right decisions? I mean, I can try.
So my job is... to make sure you make the right decisions? I mean, I can try.
Ha, knew I could count on you.
Okay everyone, line up! We'll do this one at a time!
Rules are rules, okay? Now if you don't mind, other students are still waiting.
There's nothing wrong with my Mechanoid, I swear!

Master Fuzi won't indulge his nonsense. And I have you as my witness, don't I?
Right now, our priority is to report this and get the rules fixed!
We need rules to back it up.
Exactly! And since there's no such rule, give me back my angling rods, please.
Sure, no problem. But the Department of Discipline doesn't have a rule about returning confiscated items within a certain number of days...
So how about you come by once a day and pick up one rod at a time?
Are you kidding me?! I'm filing a complaint right now!

Meng Ya joined the Department of Discipline to understand rules from a different perspective, but handling academy affairs only left him more confused. You help him find clarity with words of encouragement.
I know what to do now. I'll first help Dian Ji fix his Mechanoid. Then I'll tell Master Mozi to revise the rule.
Not sure if it has. But when there's no path, I'll just blast one open.
And that's why people love me. Ha!
Enjoying it?! Had I known it'd be like this, I never would've joined in the first place!
Still, you get to know the rules so you don't break them when working on your cannons.
Still, you get to know the rules so you don't break them when working on your cannons.
You must be really troubled if you're getting all philosophical. But I think...
You must be really troubled if you're getting all philosophical. But I think...
For a kite that goes up high in the air...
I joined the Department of Discipline because... I wanted to see things from a different perspective.
Rules, order... I thought I could handle these things better than the others. Not quite the story so far.
Has that worked before at the academy?
Has that worked before at the academy?
Thanks. You've always been so reliable.
The string holding it back is also the one making it fly.
Let me know if you need help.
That's the Meng Ya I know.
I'll admit, being a Discipline Overseer is not an easy job...
I'll admit, being a Discipline Overseer is not an easy job...
Nope, it's not. And no one ever thanks you for being the bad guy.
But you look like you're enjoying it.
But you look like you're enjoying it.
Heh, now aren't you a clever one? Well, you're not entirely wrong...
Cut the string, and it falls.
You're not the kite. You're the one holding the string.
You're not the kite. You're the one holding the string.
So... I'm the one flying the kite.
You're right! The final decision is in my hands!
The string is in your hands...
There's so much stuff here... How about we split up and look around?
Technically, they're mystery boxes for the Enlightenment Trials. But for some reason, I kept pulling the same one...
This Mechanoid Bird's wings seem broken.
This Mechanoid Bird's wings seem broken.
Oh, that's Chiu. Can't fly anymore, but isn't the design lovely?
The room is piled high with clutter, including the treasure Shye wants to give you. To find it, you agree to help her tidy up the room first.
No such thing as free lunch, huh?
See all the stuff that's piling up inside?
Your present is somewhere in there. It's just... we'll need to tidy the place up first so I can find it.
Next time you need help, just say so...
Come on, I promise I've got something good for you, okay? Just consider this helping each other out!
Besides, you don't even have to lift a finger. I only need you to help me decide what to throw away.
Well, if you put it that way, fine...
Well, if you put it that way, fine...
Great! Let's waste no time and get started then!

Wow, it got dark fast... Let's call it a day!
Oh... some specialty brews I bought at the market. Set them down when I got back and completely forgot about them.
What are the teacups and teapots doing here?

All these crates... what's in them?
All these crates... what's in them?

Haven't had time for adventures lately, so they've been sitting here a while... hopefully they haven't gotten damp.

text: Yeah, it's old. But... it holds a few memories.
After you clean the house, Xishi asks you to help her declutter, but she seems to have a reason for not wanting to throw anything away.
Gilded timber goes to the Crafters, the Mechcraft lantern goes to the Seekers... well, that's about it for me. What about you?
Two things are easy to deal with—we can just drink the brews, and light those fireworks before they get damp.
Two things are easy to deal with—we can just drink the brews, and light those fireworks before they get damp.
As for those duplicate Novar toys... keep one, and maybe share the rest with the rest of the Star Team?
As for those duplicate Novar toys... keep one, and maybe share the rest with the rest of the Star Team?
Sure! I knew you'd be a great help. Dunno about the others, but our captain will surely like it.
What about the rest? Anything you think I should just toss?
The others... you might need to make the call on these.
The others... you might need to make the call on these.
You only bought those books because you were tricked. I say throw them away.
You only bought those books because you were tricked. I say throw them away.
Hmm... you have a point. But I feel like they represent a valuable lesson learned.
It was my first time being swindled, after all. I guess I kept them as a reminder—better to have good judgment than false treasure.
If it's just a reminder, you don't need the whole pile, right? Those look like reference books. Might as well pass them on to someone who'll use them.
If it's just a reminder, you don't need the whole pile, right? Those look like reference books. Might as well pass them on to someone who'll use them.

Fay? That's strange... I think I just heard her voice...
Do you think something's wrong? Should we go in and check?
The Lingyun Guard who accompanied us
official_target_text: The Lingyun Guard who accompanied us
official_en_text: The Lingyun Guard who accompanied us

text: No... we need to draw them away.
I never dared to get too close to that place. The reason I saved you is because I have something I want to ask you.
You... are the only person who walked out of that magic circle alive.
The other person wasn't as lucky as you; she is already... a stone statue without breath.
Before you came out, everything was just like it was back then...
That cold shadow under the moon has appeared again. He is shrouded in black mist and appears in the magic circle every time. I want to know about him.
Did you see his face? The person shrouded in black mist.
That guy is the killer. He trapped the victims in the magic circle, and he turned those people into...
Tell me, did you see it? Did you see what that guy looked like? Did you see where that guy went?
It should be safe for now. Are you feeling any better?
Ah, I forgot to introduce myself. My name is Fei, I'm a resident here.
Oh no, she didn't go out, did she? Another case has occurred. Ah Fei, if you're there, answer me.
You didn't tell him the truth.
You didn't kill me to silence me.
I know. Tell me what you saw!
Thanks. But you shouldn't have gotten involved.
Petrified victims, purple Sorcery circles, and an elevated altar.
How do you know? What else do you know?
Of course I do! I can't forget it even in my dreams...
Her brother and that girl... both died in a human-sacrifice ritual...
The shackles of restraint will also be broken. Was this the work of the Demonic Armor, or someone else?
Fei, what else does she know?
I don't want to hurt you. Just answer a few questions, and I'll leave.
What was that tune you were humming just now?
It... it doesn't have a name... We just call it the "Nursery Rhyme."
Just... just the nearby residents... and classmates from Music Society.
You're from the Music Society. Why are you so interested in this case?
I'm trying to find clues in the nursery rhyme. Three people have already died!
Wait, how do you know three people died?
He mentioned three cases, not three victims.
No, but the news is already out. The first two cases only had one victim each.
How long has it been since the first case?
We arrived at Jixia seven days ago.
Never mind. What clues did you find?
R-right. This nursery rhyme was heard at all three crime scenes, which means... the killer is probably the same person.
And... I don't think he's from around here.
I recorded a chilling nursery rhyme with my Aercorder. The Music Society found it unfamiliar, likely from another place—Great Wall, Alsahraa, or Navenia, perhaps.
She's right, we are outsiders. (Evil Whisper)
Not you, there are voices interfering with me.
I—I took a huge risk to sneak to the crime scene... Fine, here's your Aercorder. Can you let me go now?
You're safe. I'm just collecting all the clues.
It's on the table. Take it and leave. Don't come back.
The Nursery Rhyme Murder Case, there have been three so far... Every time the rhyme plays, someone dies in a strange ritual.
zh_text: “童谣杀人案”，到目前已经发生了三起……每次童谣响起，都会有人死于奇怪的仪式。
source_text: “童谣杀人案”，到目前已经发生了三起……每次童谣响起，都会有人死于奇怪的仪式。
official_target_text: The Nursery Rhyme Murder Case, there have been three so far... Every time the rhyme plays, someone dies in a strange ritual.
official_en_text: The Nursery Rhyme Murder Case, there have been three so far... Every time the rhyme plays, someone dies in a strange ritual.

text: Crimson red, wearing armor, exactly the same as the killer I saw, "craving blood plasma," the victims all suffered from excessive blood loss, and eventually even turned into stone statues...

zh_text: “改易皮囊”，我还不知道这句词的意思，但也一定与那诡异的仪式有关。

text: Gradually, I saw clearly—it was my brother. A sharp sword was plunged into his chest, and he was still struggling to say something to me...
I wanted to save him, I wanted to figure out what happened, but he...
But he used his last bit of strength to push me away and said, 'Xiao Fei, go home quickly.' It was right at that moment...
I saw a cold figure in a cloud of black mist appear behind him... Later, when I opened my eyes, I was already lying under the cliff.
I can't run, I can't go home, and my brother is still left there.
So I climbed up with all my might, wanting to save him, but... but when I saw him again, it was already...
His face was as cold and pale as plaster, and those pitch-black eyes were still open, yet they had solidified into gray stone.
I touched his face, but it suddenly cracked like a broken cup... Clatter, clatter, it just fell off piece by piece... I wanted to pick them up, but the Lingyun Guard arrived...
They said, is this your brother? Your brother... is already dead.
No one will ever protect me again.
It's been seven days. I told them every detail I could remember about the culprit, but there's been no progress.
He once said the moon would guide the water lanterns, carrying our thoughts to our parents' side.
My brother said this. Whenever I missed my parents, he would comfort me like this.
Oh moon, moon... it's gone, it won't take us home anymore. Brother can only drift in the cold water like this lantern...
If only I could become the moon and carry his lantern home...
Someone like you shouldn't have appeared in those ruins, only to get dragged into this murder case.
Can you tell me why you came to Jixia?
Kai, tough and unyielding armor, it suits you well.
I can tell you're a stranger here. So, your private business must be very important to you.
I've helped you twice on my adventures. Can I trade that for one of your stories?
You are just like your name. Someone wrapped in layers, impossible to see clearly.
Since that's the case, let me be the first to reveal myself. Only by being honest with each other can we have room for cooperation.
I used to love watching the sunrise, especially the sunrise from the cliffs of Yuxi Peak. My brother would always keep me company.
Seven days ago, we agreed to sit together and watch the sunrise, just like we always did.
But that sunrise... it was so blinding. I couldn't see anything. It was red like blood, and it fell warmly upon my face.
Not yet. We're searching everywhere. We found some traces at the scene, but they disappeared once we got near here...
Actually... I locked the door because I just heard a strange sound coming from the woods nearby...
Yes... I saw something moving in the woods from the window...
The Lingyun Guard who accompanied us
Strange, it was right there. How did it disappear?
Sigh, I'll go with you and take a look.
Hey, Fay! You haven't opened the door, is everything okay?
The seventh-day memorial is coming up... I just wanted to make something my brother used to love.
The Lingyun Guard who accompanied us
official_target_text: The Lingyun Guard who accompanied us
official_en_text: The Lingyun Guard who accompanied us

text: Hmm... you said another crime happened nearby—was it that same person?
Yes... we followed his trail to this area. We came specifically to warn you to shut your doors and stay inside.
He's nearby? Could those sounds in the grove just now have been him?
The Lingyun Guard who accompanied us
official_target_text: The Lingyun Guard who accompanied us
official_en_text: The Lingyun Guard who accompanied us

text: It should be safe for now. Are you feeling any better?
Oh, I forgot to introduce myself. My name is Fei, and I'm a resident here.
This is a dagger my brother left me for self-defense. Don't get the wrong idea.
Even fate cannot separate us... Brother, he is a liar...
zh_text: “就算命运也无法让我们分离”……哥哥他，是个骗子……
source_text: “就算命运也无法让我们分离”……哥哥他，是个骗子……
official_target_text: Even fate cannot separate us... Brother, he is a liar...
official_en_text: Even fate cannot separate us... Brother, he is a liar...

text: Three companion stars, one has yet to be lit...
zh_text: 三颗伴星，有一颗尚未被点亮……
source_text: 三颗伴星，有一颗尚未被点亮……
official_target_text: Three companion stars, one has yet to be lit...
official_en_text: Three companion stars, one has yet to be lit...

zh_text: 月亮居中……是法阵的核心。
source_text: 月亮居中……是法阵的核心。
official_target_text: The moon in the center... is the core of the magic array.
official_en_text: The moon in the center... is the core of the magic array.

text: Could it be... three rituals, and only the last one is left?
zh_text: 难道……三场仪式，还剩最后一场？
source_text: 难道……三场仪式，还剩最后一场？
official_target_text: Could it be... three rituals, and only the last one is left?
official_en_text: Could it be... three rituals, and only the last one is left?

text: The moon in the center... is the core of the magic array.
Three companion stars, one has yet to be lit...
Could it be... three rituals, and only the last one is left?
Three stars... does that mean there will be more victims? Who will be next?
The Forbidden Chamber is a restricted area of Jixia. What are you planning?
The home is still here, but he is gone.
An empty house can suddenly feel frightening.
I wish I were the one trapped in the magic circle...
No, I won't. I haven't caught the culprit yet.
The magic circle was acting up just now. Did you find a new clue?
But that's a mechanical labyrinth sealed by secret arts, and it's heavily guarded...
You can't go. Given your current status, if you get caught...
Didn't we agree to act together? Although I can't go in, I can at least lead the way and keep watch for you.
Stop pulling such a long face and come with me.
I... I have new clues about that magic circle. Can you come help me verify them?
New clues? Where did they come from?
...It was left by my brother. Anyway, follow me quickly to take a look; we might be able to discover the killer's identity.
Alright, then you lead the way.
It seems the magic array has been re-triggered.
But it was warm... like a brother, in that kind of light...
What kind of person is your brother?
In the Guard Army, if a comrade falls, we build a monument for them and talk about them together...
Once we've talked about it, he will live on in our hearts, and the sorrow will be a little less.
They didn't follow us. Are you okay?
I saw that light. It was exactly like what happened back then...
Wait, don't move... can you let me see...
No... signs of petrification. You're okay, thank goodness.
Your face, though always tense, looks cold.
I'm sorry... there's just so much going on, I've been a bit jumpy lately.
Alright, if you really want to hear it...
To me, Brother is the person who has always stood in front of me since I can remember.
We need more hands below. Let's go.
The victim's little sister wants to see her... but not long after we arrived at the scene, the victim <001>turned to dust</>...
Anyway, enough about that. Captain wants us to step up patrols. Let's go.
Four-limbed living sacrifice, the ritual will finally be complete.
official_target_text: Four-limbed living sacrifice, the ritual will finally be complete.
official_en_text: Four-limbed living sacrifice, the ritual will finally be complete.

text: No, the killer didn't leave a single trace.
Sigh, the latest files have already been sent to the Secret Pavilion. I hope the Pavilion Master can uncover the truth so there won't be any more victims...
The files are in the Secret Forbidden Pavilion...
For now, let's check the magic array.
From the side, it's worth a try.
Kai... wait. There should be a cableway left behind by the archaeologists in the ruins. Maybe that can help.
I should have guessed that for such a serious incident, they would definitely send the most people... What are you planning to do?
Good idea, I'll draw him away. If you find anything, make sure to tell me.
The demon in armor, heh, who are they talking about?
zh_text: “身穿铠甲的恶魔”，呵呵，这是在说谁呢？
source_text: “身穿铠甲的恶魔”，呵呵，这是在说谁呢？
official_target_text: The demon in armor, heh, who are they talking about?
official_en_text: The demon in armor, heh, who are they talking about?

text: I've investigated all the way here, only to find traces of my own power. You don't need me to tell you what that means, right?
zh_text: 一路调查下来，却在这里找到自己力量的残留，这意味着什么，不需要我来告诉你吧？
source_text: 一路调查下来，却在这里找到自己力量的残留，这意味着什么，不需要我来告诉你吧？

official_en_text: I've investigated all the way here, only to find traces of my own power. You don't need me to tell you what that means, right?

text: “Shut up”... Heh, that's what you said to that poor girl when she begged for help.
zh_text: “闭嘴”……呵呵，那个可怜的女孩求救的时候，你也是这样对她说的。
source_text: “闭嘴”……呵呵，那个可怜的女孩求救的时候，你也是这样对她说的。

text: How do you know so much about it?
All these years, I've been searching for a way to remove the Demonic Armor, and finally, I found it here.
Who are these two angry folks? I'm innocent, so no revenge or punishment on me, please.
You wrote a letter luring Kaizer to Jixia.
They even collaborated with the Demonic Armor to fake the crime scene, attempting to frame Kaizer as the culprit, leading to his pursuit by the Aerwatch.
They even collaborated with the Demonic Armor to fake the crime scene, attempting to frame Kaizer as the culprit, leading to his pursuit by the Aerwatch.
The Music Society is your disguise.
You were just using the nursery rhyme to shake Kaizer's faith and weaken his power.
You were just using the nursery rhyme to shake Kaizer's faith and weaken his power.
Your goal is to seize the Demonic Armor.
Driven by this obsession, you murdered three innocent people and performed the Blood Moon Ritual under the full moon.
Driven by this obsession, you murdered three innocent people and performed the Blood Moon Ritual under the full moon.
Who are you? How did you...
You wiped away all your traces, but kept Kaizer's Flow to frame him.
For us, it's easy to access memories in the Flow.
It's much easier when you're facing the real person. So, are you going to tell me the truth or hand over those memories? Your choice.
Looks like she chose the latter. Alright, hold her down. We—
Since you've already investigated everything, what more do you want to know?
Do I have any other choice?
Then tell me, who are you, and how did you do all this?
I'm like Kaizer. We both belong to the House of Alcana.
He was born into luxury, the heir of the Moon Badge, while I was just an orphan from a fallen branch family, barely surviving amidst schemes and assassinations.
For a weak me, the only hope of survival lay in reaching the clan's sealed sacred artifact—the Demonic Armor.
I braved the sacred grounds, survived countless attempts on my life, only to find the seal empty! That man had already taken the Demonic Armor!
That book belongs to me. I'm just taking back what's mine!
I lured Kaizer to Jixia with a letter and summoned the Demonic Armor with sorcery and my family bloodline, revealing my plan.
It's been unhappy with Kaizer's restraint on its power, and I'm willing to offer everything. Naturally, I'm the better choice.
It should have been me... but it abandoned me in the end. Why...
You disregarded life and turned to monsters. You should've expected this fate.
Identity, motive, method, and process—all cleared. Take him away.
Wait, I have a question too.
The nursery rhyme, the scene evidence, and the Demonic Armor's deception were enough to confuse him.
I still can't figure out where I went wrong.
Your failure was sealed the moment you tampered with his cherished memories and used them as bait.
Your failure was sealed the moment you tampered with his cherished memories and used them as bait.
That Navenian nursery rhyme? It's just a song. What's so precious about it?
Enough. You've confessed. Now face your punishment.
The case is closed. Those grieving souls have finally found the truth.
Where do you think Kaizer will go next?
He'll continue to protect what's precious to him.
Perhaps I'll seek out the homeland of nursery rhymes.
Whatever happens, I think he won't be lost anymore.
Whatever happens, I think he won't be lost anymore.
Is this real? Do you remember who I am?
Don't worry, I'm still me. The cause and details of the case are all clear now.
Don't worry, I'm still me. The cause and details of the case are all clear now.
(Tell Leafy and He Ping everything you saw in the memory.)
(Tell Leafy and He Ping everything you saw in the memory.)
This is outrageous! He's way too cruel!
We've been interrogating Fay, but she insists she's innocent.
Now we have you as a witness. She can't deny it anymore!
Can you come with us to question her?
Of course, we can't let her off!
Of course, we can't let her off!
Greetings. Intendant Ou Yezi invited me here.
Greetings. Intendant Ou Yezi invited me here.
It's you, the genius mentioned by the Intendant!
Excellent. Master has been waiting for a long time. Maybe you can...
Follow me. They're on the high platform just behind.
Yes, the requirements for casting this technique are very strict. The caster must have a very keen sense of Flow, and I can't do it.
Hold on. Before that, I must tell you the risks involved.
Of course. Otherwise, it wouldn't be called a secret technique.
But after seeing your skills for myself, I believe you can do it.
It's here! Let's see what he did!
He's not moving... is he asleep? Or has he passed out?
Forget the culprit setting up the scene and unleashing assassins, can't even see the culprit's face...
Thought we'd finally cracked the case. Guess it won't be that easy...
We keep searching. I won't let such a dangerous suspect go free so easily.
Well, you're right. But I have no clue where to start.
Since he was at the scene, he must be connected to the case. If only I could slip into his memories for a look... Ha, of course there's no such convenient way to investigate...
Entering someone else's memory... Your words remind me of an ancient Sorcery technique. Perhaps it's worth a try.
For real? Intendant, please cast the spell on me right now!
Unfortunately, you can't join this journey of memory. Only he can.
Memories that exist as Flow are important. They must carry strong emotions.
As you enter this memory, you'll merge into his emotions like a drop joining the sea. You'll feel what he felt, and pain as he pained.
If it lasts too long, you might get trapped forever.
That's too dangerous... No, no, investigation is our job as Aerwatch. We can't let a regular student get involved in danger.
But Intendant must have some confidence if you're proposing to use that secret technique, right?
But Intendant must have some confidence if you're proposing to use that secret technique, right?
Smart. Seems your Flow sense extends to people too.
Stopping the spell isn't hard, but I don't know if you can truly "wake up."
If your will isn't strong enough, his memories and emotions could forever change you, making you lose track of who you are, where you are, and where you're going.
Don't push yourself. Even without it, we can still... I mean, we will definitely uncover the truth!
But this is the quickest method.
(Looks at the Bracer) As long as I have this, I'm sure I'll find my way again.
(Looks at the Bracer) As long as I have this, I'm sure I'll find my way again.
Besides, I don't want the culprit to get away. Let me help.
Besides, I don't want the culprit to get away. Let me help.
Alright, I'll set up a Sorcery circle for you. When you're ready, infuse Flow to activate it.
Go and uncover the secrets in his memory. We'll be waiting for you here.
Whew, that was close. My heart's still pounding...
What did you find in the Forbidden Chamber? Why are they all after you?
Found some files, but no leads yet.
I see... The Aercorder won't hold them off for long. Let's talk on the move!
Someone's here. I don't want to get stuck in this place.
Warning. Unauthorized access. Warning. Unauthorized access.
Give yourself to me! Let's leave this place together!
I said I wouldn't let you succeed!
The blade marks at the scene were left by you, only you can wield the power of the Demonic Armor, and besides—
The host of the Demonic Armor is...
Still don't get it? You were the one trying to remove the Demonic Armor, and you were the one who sacrificed three innocent people!
You've worked hard for freedom, haven't you? Look, the Three Sages of Jixia have personally condemned your sins.
Who else but you would want to peel me off?
But you found the truth yourself. Are you satisfied?
If you are careless for even a moment, he will control you...
zh_text: 一旦大意，就会被他控制……
source_text: 一旦大意，就会被他控制……
official_target_text: If you are careless for even a moment, he will control you...
official_en_text: If you are careless for even a moment, he will control you...

text: Your hands are stained with blood. You are the Demonic Armor, and the Demonic Armor is you.
Me? I'm the Demonic Armor? Is this really the second half of the nursery rhyme?
Look at these blood-covered hands! Are you still not going to admit it?
What's unreasonable? You were the only one at the scene.
Then there's something at the scene that isn't mine.
With so many guards, it's hard to tell who left it.
No, I have no quarrel with them.
But I can't remember. I don't have these memories.
Right, and that Sorcery circle... The file says it was used to remove the Demonic Armor, so how could it...
Kaizer, isn't this what you wanted? Who else would want to separate from me? Give up.
After all, you are the Demonic Armor, and the Demonic Armor is you!
“Your hands are stained with blood. You are the Magic Armor, and the Magic Armor is you.”
zh_text: “你的双手沾满鲜血，你就是魔铠，魔铠就是你。”
source_text: “你的双手沾满鲜血，你就是魔铠，魔铠就是你。”
official_target_text: “Your hands are stained with blood. You are the Magic Armor, and the Magic Armor is you.”
official_en_text: “Your hands are stained with blood. You are the Magic Armor, and the Magic Armor is you.”

text: This is a good hiding spot. No one will find us here.
Are you... okay? You look pale...
She's worried about you, just like the girl who died before.
Will she end up the same way?
Oh? Am I bothering you? Sorry...
How did you know I was in the Forbidden Chamber?
It's long past our meeting time, and I can't find you anywhere. I'm worried something happened to you, so I went to the ruins of Desolate Woodland to look for you.
Luckily, I ran into a girl named Awen. She said you went to the Forbidden Chamber.
I see. You came just in time. Was it also your arrangement that the nursery rhyme distracted the Aerwatch?
Well, I heard the alarm as soon as I got here, then saw Aerwatch chasing you from inside.
I recorded a new nursery rhyme from another Music Society member. I used the Aercorder to distract the Aerwatch, and it worked...
I don't think we can get the Aercorder back... but don't worry, I memorized the nursery rhyme.
Just as I guessed, the lyrics do contain new clues!
Poor thing, she thought she could help and came all the way here.
Too bad. The culprit is right before us!
Hidden Path, broken illusion, freedom turns out to be an illusion. As for the true face of the shadow, look within yourself and you will know.
Look at yourself, that's all you need to know—
I... I received a letter... clues about removing the Demonic Armor...
There is no letter. It's just a memory you imagined.
As for how to separate, you've already found the way.
Look at your hands—they're already stained with blood!
Don't you get it? You're trapped in a dream of slaughter. What you just saw was just a brief moment of wakefulness.
Stop resisting, Kaizer. Becoming a demon is your destiny!
“No place to hide, break the maze, freedom is but a delusion. As for the true form of the shadow, look at yourself and you will know.”
zh_text: “无路藏，破迷障，自由原来是虚妄。至于诡影真模样，看看自己就知道”
source_text: “无路藏，破迷障，自由原来是虚妄。至于诡影真模样，看看自己就知道”
official_target_text: “No place to hide, break the maze, freedom is but a delusion. As for the true form of the shadow, look at yourself and you will know.”
official_en_text: “No place to hide, break the maze, freedom is but a delusion. As for the true form of the shadow, look at yourself and you will know.”

text: When did you start working with the Demonic Armor?
A bold question. Did you suspect me all along?
Honestly, I was really putting effort into the act... When did you realize?
Cai Yun, Awen, with all these coincidences and lies, it's not hard to suspect you.
I just want to know what drove you to do this.
Demonic Armor. Only he could leave traces at the scene and affect my memory. He's helping you.
Fine. Clearly I underestimated you. You know my purpose, right?
You did all this to get the Demonic Armor? Who are you?
Well... that's a secret for now.
It's rare to meet someone who understands me so well. I'd love to chat more.
But sadly, your time is up.
Such a delicate, beautiful life, yet you strangled it with your own hands. That feeling... must have been exhilarating!
Seal, slaughter, these are just words.
There's no cut on that girl, yet you keep trying to make me believe I'm the killer. What's your purpose?
My purpose has never changed, haha...
Admit your sins and discard that dull humanity. My host, you were meant to walk the path of carnage with me!
Heh, do you really believe you're innocent?
Then why did you lose your memory again? What happened to that girl?
I'll get to the bottom of this.
Sigh... Seems like no matter what I say, you won't believe me. Your hostility is always the same.
Then go investigate. See the truth for yourself.
When will your will waver? I'm looking forward to it...
I've heard enough of your words!
Why do you know this nursery rhyme?
(Placeholder dialogue with camera, to be replaced with more visually engaging non-camera content)
Hide well, don't get found... It's a bit scary, but the tune seems fine...
Oh, it's about to rain. I need to move my guqin back inside.
“‘Hide well and don't get caught...’ Although the lyrics are a bit scary, the melody seems fine...”
zh_text: “藏好别被发现啦……”，这歌词虽然有些恐怖，但曲子似乎没什么问题……

text: It sounds like Navenia. Is Kaizer from there?
Sorry... Um, since you find this nursery rhyme familiar, maybe it's connected to your past?
Ah, I didn't mean to imply you had anything to do with the serial murders...
No worries. I'm no music expert, but I can tell the tune wasn't meant to be offensive.
Then... how about I play it for you again? Maybe it'll help you remember something?
Alright, I'll leave it to you then.
Do you know anything else about the nursery rhyme and the case?
I came to Jixia to investigate this nursery rhyme too, but some accidents happened midway, and I was mistaken as the culprit.
Thanks. Why help me? You could tell the Aerwatch the truth.
If you're really a dangerous criminal, reporting your location won't end well for me and those two Aerwatch.
You could've just taken me out to avoid the Aerwatch. But you didn't—you even asked me to keep quiet.
Also, nursery rhymes and murder cases have been buzzing around here lately, but you seem completely unaware...
So I guess you're an outsider caught up in the nursery rhyme incident, right?
Wait... I... I actually guessed it?
Apart from music, my biggest hobby is reading detective stories. This case is connected to nursery rhymes, so I've always dreamed of being the one to uncover the truth.
Moonlight shines bright, heart races fast, demonic armor looms in the past. Hunting newborns, a wicked deed, hide well, or they'll find you in need. That's all I know.
I remember the nursery rhyme started circulating among the children. We thought it was just a game of "tag."
But then two incidents occurred, and both times, someone heard nursery rhymes. People started fearing the "phantoms" might be real.
That makes three people who have died...
People died when the nursery rhyme played... Could it have a mind-altering effect?
I had doubts too. I was singing in the courtyard earlier to investigate. I can confirm it has no effect on the singer.
As an audience, did you notice anything unusual?
He won't allow me to be controlled by other forces, unless...
It's alright. I have another question. Where can I find the Posthouse of Jixia?
If you want to send a message, use a Mechcraft Kite. I have one here.
Pen and paper... they're on the desk inside. Follow me.
“Bright moonlight, heart in a panic, the demon-armored shadow is about to appear. Hunting busily for rebirth, hide well so you aren't found.” That's all I know of the nursery rhyme.
zh_text: “明月光，心慌张，魔甲诡影将登场。为获新生猎杀忙，藏好别被发现啦”，我知道的童谣就是这些。

text: Excuse me, we're from Aerwatch. Have you seen a silver-haired man in armor?
No... I haven't seen him. Did he do something wrong?
He's a suspect in the nursery rhyme case and refused to cooperate with the Aerwatch. He escaped from the scene and is currently wanted across Jixia.
If he went this way, he would have passed by your yard. That man is very dangerous. Are you sure you haven't seen him?
Brutal... uh, I've been cleaning instruments in the courtyard the whole time and really didn't see the person you're talking about. Could he have escaped in another direction?
I see... Alright, we'll check the other paths. Thanks for your cooperation.
Are you alright? You seem troubled.
Oh, I was just startled by the thunder. I'm fine, thanks for asking.
That suspect is dangerous. You must be careful during the search.
Of course. We won't keep you then. A new case has come up today, so please try to avoid going out alone for now. If you need any help, just let us know.
What's wrong? Did you remember something?
No... Thank you for the melody. I must leave now.
Do you know where the Aerwatch files are kept?
Probably in the academy's archive room. But the academy's crowded, and you're wanted now, so moving around won't be easy...
I can go to the academy and look for her.
We don't want the academy to find out. It will only make things harder.
I'll go back to the scene. I left in a hurry last time and missed some details.
Can I go with you? I really want to help...
No, this is a murder case. I can't let you get involved.
You're right... I'm not as strong as you. I'd only be a burden.
Got it! I'll ask other Music Societies about the nursery rhyme!
The killer keeps using this nursery rhyme in their crimes, so it must hold some special significance.
Plus, the lyrics I know are clearly just a part of the whole. Maybe collecting them all could reveal the killer's identity?
Well, besides the crime scene, the nursery rhyme is the only clue we have.
Don't worry, I'll handle the nursery rhyme. Let's split up and meet back here tonight.
Petriﬁed, but no wounds. Could it be from that Sorcery circle?
You have a lot of patience with that girl.
Ah, I see. You're remembering your nightmare...
Could it be a dream, or perhaps a forgotten past?
You're not Aerwatch. Who are you?!
Don't be scared. I'm Kaizer. I'm also investigating the nursery rhyme case for personal reasons.
I overheard your conversation with the Aerwatch... Is your sister also a victim of the case?
Yeah... my sister is right over there...
I... I wanted to sing this song at the ruins, but those damned Aerwatch not only barred me from entering, they even forbade me from singing!
This song might bring you danger. You'd better stop singing it.
I know! But... this song shouldn't be like this!
She loved the tune, calling it beautiful, yet regretting its exploitation.
Instead of fearing a melody, we should look for common patterns in the series of cases. Only then can we catch the culprit!
So... so sis has been secretly investigating to prove her theory. Yesterday, she told me she'd made a major discovery...
The killer must have found out she knew something... I must avenge her!
So you sang here intentionally to lure the killer out.
What else can I do?! This is my only lead! She didn't leave any other clues, and I can't get into the Forbidden Chamber!
(Kai notices someone watching him and Awen, and he warily looks at the bushes. The bushes tremble once, as if blown by the wind.)
Can you tell me about the Forbidden Chamber?
It's where the Aerwatch store their files. My sister said there are lots of records of unsolved and bizarre cases there. She's always wanted to take a look...
You're investigating the case too, aren't you? How could you not know this...
I... I don't know as much as your sister does.
Of course! She's the best sister in the world... I...
I may not know as much as her, but there's one thing I'm very sure of.
More than revenge, your sister would want you to grow up safe and healthy.
If I had a little sister, that would be all I'd ever hope for her.
How about we make a deal? I'll investigate the Forbidden Chamber. In return, you go home and stop singing this nursery rhyme.
If something happens to you, you won't get to see the culprit punished or avenge your sister.
Al-alright... Then it's a pinkie swear! I'll be good, but you must find out the truth. No lying to me!
(Kaizer looks toward the grass, but the grass doesn't move.)
Instead of fearing a piece of music, we should look for the commonalities in the serial cases. Only then can we catch the killer!

text: The site's been cleaned, but this lingering Flow...
Yes, it's me. Who else would it be?
And now I've found traces of my power here. I assume you know what this means.
The poor girl thought she was helping a lost person. She led you to this altar and pointed the way for you.
Who would've thought this would be the end of her journey?
You think you covered everything, but you missed a detail.
The lingering power of the Demonic Armor here is the best proof, isn't it?
Wait... If they didn't want to leave traces, why is there a cut on the table? And how did I pass out?
There are too many holes in your story. I won't believe you.
Heh, you can choose to believe it or not.
The seeds of doubt have been sown. Everything you do will only nurture their growth.
I'll wait for the moment you give up completely.
Go check it out. The game has begun. You must find all the people hiding.
(Suddenly, a nursery rhyme echoes from nearby.)
I've investigated all the way here, only to find traces of my own power. You don't need me to tell you what that means, right?
zh_text: 一路调查下来，却在这里找到自己力量的残留，这意味着什么，不需要我来告诉你吧？
