text: Is the Grass-Whisper Leaf actually effective? You and Zhaojun decide to approach the Giant Wood Fence to find out.
Is the Grass-Whisper Leaf actually effective? You and Princess Frost decide to approach the Giant Wood Fence to find out.

Princess Frost looks at the blossoms with a hint of sorrow. She once promised her sister she'd come find her with the plum blossoms, and tomorrow she will fulfill that promise by the lake where you first met. She hopes you'll be there to witness it.
To bring closure to the past, and open new chapters for the future.
Will you leave Jixia after this?
Will you leave Jixia after this?
Yes. I've been away from Chonokh for a while now. My people are waiting...
Return to my sister with this plum in full blossom.
I promised her before I left that when we meet again, I would be holding this flower in my hand.
Meet me by the lake where we first met tomorrow. I'd like you to be there when it ends.
Now... I am to sleep again...
Ha. Rotten wood reborn, withered plum revived. How interesting.
But all things have their time. Who knows how long it will last this time?
There's one last thing I must do to fulfill my promise.
I'm sure she'd be overjoyed to see this.
I'm sure she'd be overjoyed to see this.
What you've done for me... I could never repay.
You and Princess Frost ask the Giant Saepes for its breath to revive the withered plum sprig. It agrees, but on one condition: you must first clear the gnarled wood galls from its back.
So noisy... I almost thought I was dreaming.
That's not why we're here. We came to ask for your... breath.
That's not why we're here. We came to ask for your... breath.
I need to revive a withered plum sprig, and you are my only hope.
Pity, though... Even if I wanted to help, I couldn't.
To breathe the breath of life, I must be in my prime condition.
But I'm too old now. <001>All my apertures have been blocked</>, occluding the flow of energy in me.
So... What if we help you clear those apertures?
So... What if we help you clear those apertures?
It worked! The Giant Saepes is speaking...
It worked! The Giant Saepes is speaking...
Why wake me up, humans? If you're here to paint, keep your voices down.
It's been years since someone last asked me for that...
Wait... you can understand me? You sure have done your homework.
Tell me, why do you need my breath?
Hmm... you're a curious little one.
You look pretty alive, but do not feel as such... Much like myself.
It might work, but they're blocked by gnarled wood galls. Won't be easy to deal with.
Help me get rid of them, and we'll talk.
I see. I'll do my best—
No, no, not you. You're too cold for me. Let your companion do it.
The flower is a treasured keepsake from someone very dear to me.
Hurry, before I change my mind.
On my back. You'll know when you see them.
With its apertures cleared, the Giant Saepes exhales a life-giving breath onto the plum sprig, instantly unfurling buds into radiant bloom.
Ahh... I haven't felt so good in ages.
Thank you. Now it's time to keep my end of the promise.
Come. Show me your plum blossom.
You and Zhaojun do not want to anger the behemoth before you, so you decide to take the Grass-Language Leaf to communicate with it as equals.
That huge creature must be the Giant Saepes.
Look at its size... We'll be in trouble if it gets angry.
Look at its size... We'll be in trouble if it gets angry.
We're here to ask for its help, so let's keep it friendly.
First, we should take the Whisper Grass. Then tell it why we're here.
But the effect won't last long. We must make haste.
You and Princess Frost do not want to anger the behemoth before you, so you decide to take the Grass-Language Leaf to communicate with it as equals.
Clear apertures for a Giant Saepes... Never thought I'd be doing this.
Clear apertures for a Giant Saepes... Never thought I'd be doing this.
You can begin whenever you're ready.
Herbalist Mooko is pulling her hair out over the strange frost that's affecting her mentor's herb nursery. Feeling desperate, she asks for your help to investigate.
I could teach you a few tricks.
I just got here, too. What's your theory?
I just got here, too. What's your theory?
Sorry, I must look like a fool. I'm Mooko, a Herbalist. Judging by your looks, you must be a student too.
So, I'm afraid I still need your help. After this, I'll make you a glass of Herbalists' special Inflated Gourd Juice!
Far from okay... These herbs are priceless, and now they are ruined by the frost!
My mentor spent years growing them. They can't die on my watch!
By the Sages, if she knew about this, I...
Calm down. These herbs are not dead yet. We might still be able to save them.
Calm down. These herbs are not dead yet. We might still be able to save them.
You're right... They are all my mentor left behind. I will not give up without trying.
My guess is, someone powerful in Sorcery created all this frost on purpose!
Look around you. Nothing but my herbs has become like this.
I don't know what they want, but if I ever find them, I swear I'll make them swallow a hundred Spikeroll Fruits!
But... I can't leave until these herbs are saved. Can I rely on you to <001>investigate the area</>?
Besides, these herbs are all I know. I don't have much experience in combat or tracking people...
I wish I could... But I doubt these herbs would still be alive by then.
Look, the frost seems to be spreading towards the lake. <001>Follow its trail</>, and you should be able to find who did this.
I'm not going anywhere, so come back if you learn anything. Thanks!
I was only gone for a day, and the herb nursery just... It's a disaster!
Really? Thank you so much! After this, I'll make you a glass of Herbalists' special Inflated Gourd Juice!
Were you around just now? Did you see who did this?
What's going on? Are you okay?
What's going on? Are you okay?
Not good at all... These are precious herbs planted by our Hundred Herbs family. I don't know why they've frosted over!

Strange, the grass here is covered with frost.
Oh no, what on earth is going on... Ah-choo!
The Flow is getting stronger by the second. Colder, too...
The Flow is getting stronger by the second. Colder, too...
Keep tracking, and I should be able to nab whomever it is.
Keep tracking, and I should be able to nab whomever it is.

Mooko points out that the Bisected Sapling is still a young shoot; and to accelerate its growth, someone must channel their Flow into it—a process that costs more energy than most can handle. Despite her warning, Princess Frost insists that she should be the one doing this.
Did we get the wrong one?
Did we get the wrong one?
No, this is the Bisected Sapling. Although... it's still a young shoot.
My mentor tried doing it once. Took her months to fully recover.
It's okay, I know what I'm doing.
Let me see... the color is different from what's described in the books.
Where did all the Saepes go? Wait, you guys have finished the job already?
Look. Is this what you need?
Look. Is this what you need?
If we mix it into the soil now, I'm afraid it might not work.
I know a way to accelerate its ripening. It's just...
Is there a problem? I'll do whatever I can to help.
It's just this process requires a strong source of Flow. And since Flow only exists within human bodies...
Yes, but it'll cost a lot of energy, and most people can't handle it.
It still needs several weeks to mature. All the herbs will be long gone by then.
No, you will not. We're not talking about some classroom experiment here!
What do you think, Princess Frost?
Are you sure? Maybe we should think this through...
All this trouble started because of me, so it's only right that I put an end to it myself.
You mean someone has to channel their own Flow into it?
Maybe my Power of Frost might work...
Princess Frost pours her Flow into the Bisected Sapling. The young shoot starts to grow while her face grows increasingly pale.

Mooko promises to find a way to revive the plum sprig once the herbs are healthy. In the meantime, she suggests you both rest in her study at Upstream Camp, where you may find clues on restoring withered plants in her mentor's old notes.
Look at the Bisected Sapling... It worked!
Alright. We'll wait for you at the camp. See you later.
Are you sure? You look pale...
I just need some rest. Don't worry.
You risked your life to save my herbs after I accused you... I'm really sorry.
My mentor left me those herbs, and they mean the world to me. So I... I got a little desperate.
When someone close to us is gone, what they left behind is all we have of them. I understand.
Alright, I'll take the Bisected Sapling back and heal those herbs.
There's a study in <001>Upstream Camp</>, where I keep all my books and records.
You can rest there while I tend to the herbs. Then I'll go find you.
Once I'm done, I'll figure out how to revive your plum sprig.
I remember reading about ways to save withered plants from my mentor's notes.
There is a bookstore in the <001>Backtracking Camp</> where I have collected all the classics and notes left by the teacher.
zh_text: <001>溯洄营地</>里有个书屋，我在那里收藏了老师留下的所有典籍和笔记。

It shouldn't be far now, right?

And never let your guard down.
The attacks are working. We can do this.
The Labyrinth Cave... Is Princess Frost already here?
The Labyrinth Cave... Is Princess Frost already here?

Feeling any better? We can rest here for a while.
Feeling any better? We can rest here for a while.

It is getting late, but Princess Frost is unwilling to rest, proposing to go find the Giant Wood Fence immediately.

Still feeling unwell? Should we take a break?
No, let's get out of this cave first. It's not safe here.
Right, but let's take it slow.
Right, but let's take it slow.
Traces of frost... She must've gone deeper.
Traces of frost... She must've gone deeper.

The aura of frost is getting stronger... She's close.

All this fighting... I hope she's alright.

You've barely recovered. I shouldn't have let you go in here alone...
You've barely recovered. I shouldn't have let you go in here alone...
The Whisper Grass is just in that cavern ahead. I can make it...
It's alright. I've come all the way here. I can manage a few more steps.
All the more reason not to take unnecessary risks.
All the more reason not to take unnecessary risks.
If you trust me, let me handle it.
If you trust me, let me handle it.

So this is the Whisper Grass. And it's supposed to help us communicate with the Giant Saepes?

A tender, shimmering sprout... There's the <001>Whisper Grass</>. On its back.
Guess we'll have to defeat it.
Guess we'll have to defeat it.
So that's why your plum blossoms...
So that's why your plum blossoms...
Let's save that story for later. Our mission comes first.
Princess Frost, you mentioned the Northlands. What kind of place is it?
Princess Frost, you mentioned the Northlands. What kind of place is it?
It's a harsh wilderness to the far north, and my people's home. A land of relentless winters.
That icy landscape has no room for fragile lives...

After retrieving the Bisected Sapling successfully, you ask Princess Frost why she's determined to revive the plum sprig. She explains it's a keepsake from an old friend, and she hopes it can witness their reunion with new blossoms...
What would you like to know?
It's a keepsake from someone dear to me.
I see. This promise means a lot to you.
I see. This promise means a lot to you.
Look—half lush, half decayed. This must be it.
Look—half lush, half decayed. This must be it.
Fair point. I'll hold onto it then.
Fair point. I'll hold onto it then.
Yes. With this, we can save Mooko's herbs.
We made a promise long ago—to meet again when the winter plum blooms.
Now I've finally returned, but all I have is this withered sprig.
I want to make it bloom again, as a way to keep my end of the promise... To let her know I'm back.
In that case, maybe you should give the Bisected Sapling to Mooko yourself?
In that case, maybe you should give the Bisected Sapling to Mooko yourself?
No, it's better if I don't. Should it get harmed by my power, all of this would be for nothing.
I'd love to know more about you.
I'd love to know more about you.
It comes from the Winter Ocean, a sacred place in Chonokh.
This power makes it easier for me to navigate the wildlands, yet it comes with the duty to protect my people.
But outside the Northlands, I've never met anyone who could withstand my power... until you.
How does it feel to have such power?
Once we do that, she should be able to revive your plum blossom sprig.
Once we do that, she should be able to revive your plum blossom sprig.
But... what's so special about it anyway? Must be important if you came all the way to Jixia for it.
But... what's so special about it anyway? Must be important if you came all the way to Jixia for it.
Wonder how long it'll take Mooko to get here...
Wonder how long it'll take Mooko to get here...
I'm sure it won't be too long. She seems pretty good at what she does.
It's been a long time since I talked about these things with others.
Not even your people? Aren't they curious?
Not even your people? Aren't they curious?
Maybe. But most of them have turned to silence in times of sufferings.
I wonder if I'll ever get the chance to share my past with someone again.
Right. Now while we wait... mind if I ask you something?
Right. Now while we wait... mind if I ask you something?
So... once I bring the plum blossoms back to life and fulfill my promise, I must return to the Northlands.
The Northlands are on the northernmost edge of the continent. A bitter cold place.
It's been so for ages, and our people have grown used to it. That's why they feel okay around me.
How does it feel? I've never really thought about it.
But I guess... People with powers like mine are destined to be alone.
If that's my fate, I'll try to accept it.
There are plenty of Saepes lurking in the wetland thickets. You and Princess Frost decide to take a closer look.
Is that the wetlands up ahead?
Is that the wetlands up ahead?
Yes, according to Mooko, that should be the place.
The vegetation is much denser, and there are way more Saepes lurking around.
Must be the Bisected Sapling at work.
Let's go then. A couple Saepes won't be too hard to deal with.
Let's go then. A couple Saepes won't be too hard to deal with.
I'm really grateful for what you've done for me. But please, let me handle the rest alone.
My Power of Frost can be really unpredictable sometimes. I'd hate to hurt you, too.
I know you weren't affected earlier, but what if...
But I was fine just now...
True, but better safe than sorry...
I trust you can control your power.
I trust you can control your power.
And if I do start to feel the cold, I'll let you know.
And if I do start to feel the cold, I'll let you know.
Never thought there'd be someone beyond the Northlands so resistant to the cold.
If that's the case... I'll do my best to keep my power contained. Let me know if anything feels wrong.
Alright, now let's move closer and get a better look at the area.
This must be it. Gotta go back to Princess Frost.
This must be it. Gotta go back to Princess Frost.
Looks like that's all of them...
Looks like that's all of them...
I should get the Bisected Sapling back before anything goes wrong.
I should get the Bisected Sapling back before anything goes wrong.
The roots are still wrapped tight. Guess I gotta deal with all the Saepes.
The roots are still wrapped tight. Guess I gotta deal with all the Saepes.
This should make things easier for you.
Though I can't keep it up for long at this distance...
No worries, I'm going in now.
No worries, I'm going in now.
I'll frost up the place a little with my power. It should slow those Saepes down.
You're welcome. And please... be careful.
You and Princess Frost decide to avoid direct confrontation so that her Power of Frost won't agitate the Saepes. Instead, you will sneak in alone while she provides support from a distance.
There's a piece of wood tangled in Saepes roots. Half lush, half decayed—must be the Bisected Sapling.
We've got way more Saepes than expected. With your frosty Flow, it's hard to go in there unnoticed.
We've got way more Saepes than expected. With your frosty Flow, it's hard to go in there unnoticed.
And if they all attack at once, we'll be in trouble...
And if they all attack at once, we'll be in trouble...
You can cover me from here.
That's probably the best way to avoid alerting them...
You plan to sneak in alone?
Okay, I'll provide cover from here.
Good thing there's enough cover here for some stealth action.
Good thing there's enough cover here for some stealth action.

The notes, faded with age, mention only a mysterious "breath." While you ponder its meaning, you discover a landscape painting tucked between the pages—a work of someone named Inkon. Perhaps he knows what you're after.
Um, it mentions something's breath... which will help dead wood live again.
I know how it sounds. But the writing is too faded for me to make out.
Beats me, too. This notebook's so old that the writing's all smudged.
There seems to be a picture tucked inside.
Oh, there is! But what's it of?
Looks like a landscape painting. It's been carefully preserved, so it must be important.
Maybe we're supposed to find what we need there?
Makes sense! But how do we figure out the exact location from a painting?
Artists usually leave signatures on their works.
This painting has a seal, too. If it can lead us to the artist, we should be able to get our answer.
Right now? I kinda want to check on my herbs first...
Oh, of course. You should go. I know how much they mean to you.
I'll do everything I can to help, and to honor my mentor's legacy.
Great! And next time, you can have as much Inflated Gourd Juice as you like!
Inkon? I know him. He's that traveling artist from Jixia.
And I heard he just returned recently. Someone saw him near the camp.
Alright, then. I'll get back as soon as I'm done at the nursery.
Don't worry, Mooko. We've got this.
Yeah, you can count on us, Mooko.
Yeah, you can count on us, Mooko.
Plants live and die just like people. To revive a withered flower, follow the method stated below...
When you figure out what the note refers to, be sure to let me know!
“Plants are like people, life and death are fated. To restore a withered flower to its former glory, the method is...”
zh_text: “草木如人，生死有命。枯萎之花，欲复其华，其法为……”
source_text: “草木如人，生死有命。枯萎之花，欲复其华，其法为……”
official_target_text: “Plants are like people, life and death are fated. To restore a withered flower to its former glory, the method is...”
official_en_text: “Plants are like people, life and death are fated. To restore a withered flower to its former glory, the method is...”

text: Worried that her Power of Frost might hurt the students, Princess Frost lingers hesitantly at the camp entrance. You reassure her and accompany her inside.
I depleted too much of my strength earlier, and my power now feels... unstable.
There are many students in the camp. I don't want to disturb them.
The study is just down this path. It should be fine if we move quick enough.
The study is just down this path. It should be fine if we move quick enough.

Still exhausted, Princess Frost decides to wait outside so that she does not harm the plants in the study. Mooko stays to keep an eye on her, leaving you to search for any notes on "withered flowers."
Hey, you're here! Can't believe I got here first!
That's right. And we'll be close by in case you need anything.
Great to see you here, Mooko. Does this mean your herbs are saved?
Great to see you here, Mooko. Does this mean your herbs are saved?
Almost. Just need them to soak up more nutrients from the soil.
All thanks to you two for getting me the Bisected Sapling.
There are a lot of plants in the study. I might hurt them if I go in.
Well... Hate to say this, but you do have a point.
It's best if I just wait for you out here.
You look pretty worn out. How about I stay here with you?
Let's find a place to sit, and I'll take the time to check out that sprig of yours.
Thank you, and I'll come help when I feel better.
Okay. Just look for anything about <001>"withered flowers,"</> right?
Okay. Just look for anything about <001>"withered flowers,"</> right?
Now, enough about me. It's time to look at your plum blossoms.
My mentor had a way to revive withered flowers. Should just be in one of her books or notes.
It's okay, taking care of people is my area of expertise. I've got this.
Meanwhile, you can search the study for my mentor's notes.
It's getting so cold. Is that girl doing this?
What kind of Sorcery is this? It's freezing!
I can't take it. Let's find another spot.
That's weird. What's she doing here?
On the Health Benefits of Stealth Radish?
On the Health Benefits of Stealth Radish?
Put that down! That's my thesis draft!
On the Health Benefits of Ground-Dwelling Radishes?
official_target_text: On the Health Benefits of Ground-Dwelling Radishes?
official_en_text: On the Health Benefits of Ground-Dwelling Radishes?

text: On the Health Benefits of Ground-Dwelling Radishes?
official_target_text: On the Health Benefits of Ground-Dwelling Radishes?
official_en_text: On the Health Benefits of Ground-Dwelling Radishes?

text: To revive a withered flower, follow the method stated below...
To revive a withered flower, follow the method stated below...
That sounds right. Come on, let me take a look.
Withered flower, seeking to regain its bloom, the method is...
official_target_text: Withered flower, seeking to regain its bloom, the method is...
official_en_text: Withered flower, seeking to regain its bloom, the method is...

text: Withered flower, seeking to regain its bloom, the method is...
official_target_text: Withered flower, seeking to regain its bloom, the method is...
official_en_text: Withered flower, seeking to regain its bloom, the method is...

text: The woman introduces herself as Zhaojun, the Princess Frost of Chonokh who's traveled all the way to revive a withered plum sprig. Her quest led her here to find Mooko, when her temporary loss of control over her Power of Frost accidentally harmed the herbs. She wants to apologize to Mooko in person.
Hi, there. I've been entrusted to investigate the abnormal frost in this area.
Hi, there. I've been entrusted to investigate the abnormal frost in this area.
To visit the Herb Society and revive this withered sprig of plum blossoms.
To revive a withered flower... How?
To revive a withered flower... How?
I can sense some intense coldness in you. Are you... connected to all this?
I can sense some intense coldness in you. Are you... connected to all this?
Yes, that was my doing. I am sorry.
What you sense must be the Power of Frost within me.
Why did you sabotage the herb nursery?
I didn't mean to. It is difficult to control the Power of Frost within me.
I may have let its balance slip in a moment of distraction, thus impacting my surroundings.
Are you saying it was your Power of Frost that affected Mooko's herbs?
Are you saying it was your Power of Frost that affected Mooko's herbs?
Yes, she was the one who sent me here.
Yes, she was the one who sent me here.
I see... I was waiting for her near the herb nursery. Must have hurt those plants by accident then.
My name is Zhaojun. I'm the Princess Frost of Chonokh, Northlands.
I came all this way to Jixia just for one thing.
I once heard that the Herb Society had a secret technique that could breathe life into withered plants.
Unfortunately, its creator has passed away. And Mooko happens to be her only student.
That's why I'm here. To find her before it's too late.
It's just... I never expected to damage her herbs like that before meeting her.
Do you know where she is now? I would like to explain what happened in person.
She's busy saving her herbs in the garden, but I don't think she'd be happy to see you.
She's busy saving her herbs in the garden, but I don't think she'd be happy to see you.
You know, considering what you just did with your "Frost" power...
You know, considering what you just did with your "Frost" power...
I understand. I should have controlled my power better... Still, I want to apologize in person.
In that case... Alright, I'll bring you there.
In that case... Alright, I'll bring you there.
Thanks, that's very kind of you.
Withered Plum... How can it be revived?
official_target_text: Withered Plum... How can it be revived?
official_en_text: Withered Plum... How can it be revived?

text: Withered Plum... How can it be revived?
official_target_text: Withered Plum... How can it be revived?
official_en_text: Withered Plum... How can it be revived?

text: All of Princess Frost's family have passed away, and beneath this tree lies her sister in eternal slumber. Filled with sorrow, Princess Frost decides to leave the plum sprig in Jixia forever.
This plum tree marks her final resting place.
Look, the plum blossoms from our home. She must have planted them here.
It was I who made the choice to leave. And I must bear the consequences.
Across time and places, the twin plum blossoms are finally reunited.
The Power of Frost gifted me immortality. Yet it also chains me to the shackles of fate.
By the time I awoke from the ice, my sister had long since passed.
But she... she endured the same cruelty of solitude because of my decision.
I wonder what she was thinking when she was here by herself...
Yes, she is. And I know that whatever I do, she won't be coming back.
Maybe she lived a good life.
I hope eventually, she had really settled into this place just like this tree.
This plum sprig of ours... maybe it should stay here, too.
It's time for me to move on. For her, and for myself.
She chose to plant this tree in Jixia. Does that mean she'd found her new home here...?
What is she thinking about while looking at these plum blossoms all by herself?
zh_text: 一个人看着这些梅花时，她在想些什么呢？
source_text: 一个人看着这些梅花时，她在想些什么呢？
official_target_text: What is she thinking about while looking at these plum blossoms all by herself?
official_en_text: What is she thinking about while looking at these plum blossoms all by herself?

text: The next day, you arrive at Lakeheart Isle, but Princess Frost's sister is nowhere in sight. Noticing your confusion, Princess Frost tells you a story...
She's always been here, waiting for me... for many, many years...
Let me tell you a story.
Where's your sister? Isn't she supposed to meet you here?
Where's your sister? Isn't she supposed to meet you here?
Here, in this foreign land, beneath this plum tree...
After a hundred years the twin plum blossoms reunite as Princess Frost performs one last dance. Amid a flurry of snow and blossoms she vanishes, her promise fulfilled...
Twin plums bloom, our bond eternal.
I dedicate this one last dance to her... and to you.
Worried for Princess Frost, you decide to follow her into Labyrinth Cave and offer your help.
She reminds me of a legend I heard while traveling in the Central Plains.
A princess married to the Northlands a century ago. She must've had the same resolve when she left.
Such a beautiful lady, only to meet a tragic end...
Anyway, are you really gonna just stay here?
She insisted on going alone. And you said it yourself—she is determined.
She insisted on going alone. And you said it yourself—she is determined.
And I thought you had a keen eye for character.
She doesn't want to keep troubling you, but that does not mean she needs no help.
She still looked pretty weak just now. I think you should go after her.
I understand. I'll get going now.
I understand. I'll get going now.
Listen, when a girl says something like that, read between the lines.
It's "art fanatic"! Go get your ears checked.
He doesn't look like an herb fanatic to me.
What's someone from Chonokh doing in Jixia?
Jixia welcomes everybody. It's nothing to be surprised about.
True, but it's my first time seeing one.

As it turns out, Inkon drew the landscape painting to depict a Giant Saepes whose breath can revive withered plants. But the big creature is grumpy and deaf to human speech, and one can only communicate with it after eating the Whisper Grass from Labyrinth Cave. The place crawls with monsters, so Princess Frost decides to go alone rather than risk your safety.
So I understand why you failed to discern it.
As for those blurred words in the notes, they must be referring to the <001>Giant Saepes' breath</>.
I should warn you that Labyrinth Cave is full of dangerous monsters. One wrong move could be fatal.
Yes. Think of it as the force of its life, similar to the Flow within us.
It's said to have the power to bring withered wood back to life. I believe only one Herbalist has ever succeeded, though.
That must've been Mooko's mentor, who wrote these notes.
Oh, right! Now that you mention it...
She did ask me for this painting back then. Maybe you're looking for the same thing.
So this Giant Saepes, where can we find it?
So this Giant Saepes, where can we find it?
I used to paint there often, and the Giant Saepes was always sleeping.
To me, we kinda kept each other company in a silent way.
Later, my travels took me away. But I've heard rumors.
Apparently, many other Herbalists have been seeking its magical breath, making it much more irritable than before.
That doesn't sound good. Then what do you suggest we do, Mr. Inkon?
Just be gentle and patient. Show it you mean no harm. You should be okay.
But the Giant Saepes doesn't speak, so it'll be hard for it to understand you...
Eat it, and you'll be able to communicate with plants. Should last long enough to get what you need.
Thank you, but this promise is one I must keep. I have to go.
I can feel my power coming back. I'll handle the rest by myself.
You've already helped me so much. I can't let you keep risking yourself for me.
I have! It's been ages since I found such joy in my work!
Here, Princess Frost. Please take this painting.
Yes. It captures how you look and how you feel right now, and what you've been through to get here.
No matter how long, the image will endure.
So whenever you look at it, you'll be reminded of your time in Jixia—of us, and of all the beautiful memories here.
Now that you've finished the painting, can we...
Now that you've finished the painting, can we...
The memories started to come back to me as I was working. Show me that painting again.
There's a special plant in Labyrinth Cave called <001>Whisper Grass</>. Looks like a tender, shimmering sprout.
Please, tell Mooko what we've learned. I'll find you when I get the Giant Saepes' breath.
A Giant Saepes. It lives on the mountain for so long that it almost becomes part of it.
It's in the north of Springbrook Plains. Just pass through Labyrinth Cave and head up. You can't miss it.
Have you finished the painting, Mr. Inkon?
Have you finished the painting, Mr. Inkon?
Actually, it wasn't the landscape I was trying to depict.

Landscape Painting is actually a giant wooden fence, and its breath of life can make withered wood spring to life. But the giant wooden fence does not understand human speech and has a grumpy temper. Only by taking the Grass-Language Leaf in the Maze Cave can one communicate with it. There are many monsters in the Maze Cave, and Zhaojun doesn't want you to take risks, so she decides to go alone.
zh_text: “山水图”其实是一只巨大的木篱，它的生命之息可令枯木逢春。可巨木篱不通人言又脾气暴躁，只有服下迷津洞中的草语叶才能与它沟通。迷津洞中怪物众多，昭君不愿让你涉险，决定独自前往。
source_text: “山水图”其实是一只巨大的木篱，它的生命之息可令枯木逢春。可巨木篱不通人言又脾气暴躁，只有服下迷津洞中的草语叶才能与它沟通。迷津洞中怪物众多，昭君不愿让你涉险，决定独自前往。

text: I-I'm not scared of that foreign lady!
That Chonokh lady... I'm sensing strong Sorcery Energy in her!
Hmph. Still no match for Master Zhuangzi.
That guy up ahead is in a black and white robe, and he's painting something...
That guy up ahead is in a black and white robe, and he's painting something...
Inkon, perhaps? I should go ask him.
Inkon, perhaps? I should go ask him.
Excuse me, are you Mr. Inkon?
Excuse me, are you Mr. Inkon?
Excuse me, are you Mr. Inkon?
Excuse me, are you Mr. Inkon?
He's not around here... Hmm, the cold around you is intense. You shouldn't stay here.
You learn from a Seeker and an Herbalist that Inkon is wearing a black and white robe.
Oh, you mean that art fanatic?
Excuse me, have you seen Inkon?
Excuse me, have you seen Inkon?
He was here just now, but then left as soon as he saw your companion. Mumbling about having to paint or something.
What? I always thought he was strange. But an herb fanatic? He better stay away from my plants!
I said "art fanatic." Your ears must be frozen.
No idea. But he's wearing <001>a black and white robe</>. Should be easy to spot.
Do you know where he might be now?
You learn from two Sorcery students that Inkon has been hanging around the headless statue on the west side of the camp.
Excuse me, have you seen a traveling artist called Inkon?
Excuse me, have you seen a traveling artist called Inkon?
Oh, him? He's been around here a lot lately.
Looking rather frail, though. Right now, he's probably hiding in somewhere warm.
Stop trying to act tough. Let's find somewhere warm.
Oh right, I remember now. That artist has been hanging around the <001>headless statue on the west side</> of the camp.
I'd check there if I were you.
Sheesh... the place's getting even colder.
Don't be ridiculous! A little cold is nothing to us Sorcery students—
I'm sorry. My Sorcery power's getting a bit out of control. Did I hurt you?
The two of you finally find Inkon. Captivated by Princess Frost's graceful demeanor, he offers to paint her a portrait, but she insists on getting answers to her questions first.
Excuse me, are you Mr. Inkon?
Excuse me, are you Mr. Inkon?
Not quite. Just a glimpse at the camp entrance.
One glance was all it took to fill my mind with inspiration!
I'm reacting the way I should be!
Of all the places I have traveled, I've never seen a girl like her. Not even close.
This lady from Chonokh... Like a plum blossom in the dire winter. So graceful, so... unforgettable.
Ahem... My lady, may I have the honor of painting you a portrait?
The honor would be mine, Mr. Inkon. It's just...
Actually, we're here to seek some answers from you. Answers to a very personal matter of mine...
You learn from two Martial Arts students that Inkon is carrying a brush and easel.
Excuse me, have you seen Inkon? I think he's a... traveling artist?
Excuse me, have you seen Inkon? I think he's a... traveling artist?
I've been too focused on training today. Have you?
Didn't someone just pass by with a brush and easel?
That was Inkon! How could you miss him?
Nothing distracts me when I train.
<001>Brush and easel</>... I see. Thank you.
Now we have something to work with.
Now we have something to work with.
A true Martial Artist fears no cold! Clearly, our training isn't enough!
Ahem. Well, thanks for the help. We have to go now.
Ahem. Well, thanks for the help. We have to go now.
Wait... I'm feeling colder now. Are you the one causing this?!
<001>Carrying a drawing board and holding a paintbrush</>? ...I see, thank you.
zh_text: <001>身携画板，手执画笔吗</>……我知道了，多谢。
source_text: <001>身携画板，手执画笔吗</>……我知道了，多谢。
official_target_text: <001>Carrying a drawing board and holding a paintbrush</>? ...I see, thank you.
official_en_text: <001>Carrying a drawing board and holding a paintbrush</>? ...I see, thank you.

text: Be it the coldest winter or the hottest summer, we must always keep up our efforts!
Hang in there! Think of it as a test of endurance!
What happened!? Why's the camp suddenly so cold?
Ugh, I'm getting tired. Maybe we should call it a day...
Frosty yet not frigid... So graceful...
So Inkon is wearing a black and white robe, and he's painting near the headless statue west of camp.
So Inkon is wearing a black and white robe, and he's painting near the headless statue west of camp.

Inkon confirms he painted the landscape, though the details have escaped him after all this time. He claims he can only try and jog his memory through painting, while his passion reminds Princess Frost of her childhood in the Central Plains...
Just a moment while I prepare the ink.
Your ink has an unusual scent. Does it contain medicinal properties?
It does! It helps with minor injuries during my travels.
I didn't expect you to know so much about art as well, Princess Frost!
Surely, it's fate that brought us together. A rare kindred spirit!
Why not stay in Jixia for a few more days? I can show you around the place—
Ahem. Sir, you're spilling your ink.
Ahem. Sir, you're spilling your ink.
Let me clean it up. Just one moment, please.
He got a bit too carried away, didn't he? So passionate about his work.
He got a bit too carried away, didn't he? So passionate about his work.
I can tell he means no harm.
I know many artists in my life. Some of them are talented, some pretentious, or superficial, but never one like Inkon.
His honesty probably shows in his art too. True emotions reach deep.
I grew up in the Central Plains, where I learned a bit about art and brushwork.
But since I left for the Northlands, such things have become history.
The Northlands are a harsh place. People are too busy getting by to care for art.
So, everything I know about painting was from when I grew up in the Central Plains.
So you're not from the Northlands.
So you're not from the Northlands.
No, but my childhood is long behind me. Chonokh is my only home now.
Everything's ready, Princess Frost. Just stand over there and relax, alright?
I overheard your talking just then—that you're not from the Northlands.
Yet your temperament seems to match the place perfectly. The cold, the frost, and even... that shred of desolation.
It's just what I feel at this moment. Don't take it too seriously.
We all have our own opinions, even on the same person.
Maybe our friend here sees you in a completely different way.
You left your homeland, shouldered the burden of the frost power, and took on the responsibility of protecting Chonokh.
You left your homeland, shouldered the burden of the frost power, and took on the responsibility of protecting Chonokh.
That tells how strong you are.
That tells how strong you are.
Warmer than you appear to be.
Your power is colder than the snow, but you always care for those around you.
Your power is colder than the snow, but you always care for those around you.
It shows that deep down, you have a very kind heart.
It shows that deep down, you have a very kind heart.
You journeyed all the way to Jixia for an old promise—that's admirable.
You journeyed all the way to Jixia for an old promise—that's admirable.
So that's how you see me... Thank you.
Well said! You have a keen eye for character. Could make a great painter if you learn with me.
It was my work, but it's been so long, and I can't recall where it was.
Artists value inspiration, which benefits a lot from new experiences. That's why I travel.
And as I said earlier, I've never met a lady like you before in my life, Princess Frost.
So to recall such an old memory, I'll need to, you know...
I see. Then please, Mr. Inkon.
Ahem, em... Of course that is!
Sounds even more suspicious to me...
Sounds even more suspicious to me...
Finding that place might be the only way to revive my flowers, Mr. Inkon. I'd really appreciate it if you could give it more thought.
Of course! I'll do everything I can to help you, my lady.
Mu Chun asks you about the investigation results of the ice anomaly, and Zhaojun admits that the frost nearby is caused by her.
Ah-choo! Why is it getting so cold again?
It was you! WHY did you sabotage my nursery!?
I just barely got the frost off the area... If this keeps happening, these herbs are doomed!
Oh, it's you. Did you find out what happened?
It was me, and I'm very sorry.
Mu Chun asks you about the investigation results of the ice anomaly, and Princess Frost admits that the frost nearby is caused by her.
Mooko explains that to save the herbs, you'll need the "Bisected Sapling" which can be found in Springpool Wetlands. The area is teeming with Saepes, however, and Princess Frost offers to help.
That's weird. Why aren't you affected by the cold?
So you did it by accident because you wanted my help?
Power of Frost... That's new. Hopefully, it's not some kind of lame excuse.
No, it's not. The Power of Frost resides within me, and I still haven't full control over it.
If I lose my focus, even for the briefest moment, the frost begins to diffuse.
Maybe that special Flow of yours is protecting you from the cold.
Anyway, you'd better stay away from my nursery for now. Or my herbs may get frozen again.
If you don't believe me, I can freeze the air to prove it...
W-wait! Don't do it! I'm feeling colder already! I believe you, all right!?

Chenzhuo throws both the Bastion Token and the manuscript into the flames, forcing Garo to choose. Without hesitation, she fires an arrow to save the token. You dive after the manuscript, but only manage to save a single page. When you look up, Garo is already gone in the smoke.

Do I have to remind you that the Madinat is gone?
Since you love that place so much... how about a final test?
Which will you choose to save from the flames?
And yet, I'm really tied up here...
She must have arrived by now.
Are you going to Aerdeep Camp too?
Of course! Wouldn't miss the Seekers' Fair for anything.
There'd be so many interesting things to learn.
Well, you should know it has nothing to do with Martial Arts.
Now I can focus on the task at hand.
Time to see what Tigon's disciples are made of.

Head Trainer Maple asks you to meet an old friend of hers—Grand Scholar Garo from Madinat Erudit—and show her around the Seekers' Fair. Garo, clad in violet with a flute and a longbow, is waiting under the ancient tung tree near Crosswind Bridge.
I'm supposed to meet her now, but I still have business to attend to here...
I've got an important appointment today. A good friend of mine is here to visit me.
Would you serve as the <001>guide</> for a special guest of the Seekers' Fair?
Yes. A Grand Scholar from Madinat Erudit — <001>Garo</>.
Garo should be wearing the purple robes of Madinat Erudit. And she always carries a flute and a longbow. You can't miss her.
We agreed to meet under the ancient tung tree near Crosswind Bridge. You'll find her there.
One more thing. Please give her this Sea Heath when you meet.
Yes. In Madinat Erudit, it symbolizes family and homeland.
That is a land of knowledge and civilization, a sanctuary for learned scholars. It's held in high regard by all nations.
Years ago, many scholars fled into the desert from the ravages of war. There they carved caves into desert cliffs to preserve their books.
She's particularly fond of the flower. I hope it might make up for my absence, if only a little.
Now before you go, is there anything else you'd like to know?
Tell me more about the Seekers' Fair.
The Seekers' Fair is a major academic event organized by Master Fuzi.
Attendees not only include our students and Seekers, but also scholars and merchants from across the continent.
There's a marketplace where people can view and trade rare artifacts—ancient books, tablet fragments, all sorts of things.
As a Grand Scholar and a good friend, Garo is an esteemed guest of mine.
The title of "Grand Scholar" holds great significance in Madinat Erudit. Besides profound knowledge, one must also pass a demanding test of reflection to qualify.
Though the city no longer enjoys its former glory, the reputation of Grand Scholars still commands respect around the world.
In fact, many students signed up for the event this time just to see her.
Tell me more about Madinat Erudit.
There's a saying in Alsahraa: <001>"Through the burning flames of civilization, the Madinat will guide."</>
It's a shrine for people in pursuit of wisdom, and home to countless ancient tomes.
But sadly... during an invasion by the feralis, most of the city was reduced to ashes.
As a Grand Scholar, Garo has been working tirelessly to rebuild it.... Therefore, we're very grateful she can make it this time.
Then I should not waste any more time. Please, take care of her for me.
Is there any way I can help?
Is there any way I can help?
Hmm... Perhaps you could take over their training for me?
I don't think I'm qualified for that...
I'll leave the job to you then. Let's meet after I'm done with the training here.
Invited by Master Fuzi, she's traveled a long way from Madinat Erudit to share her knowledge at the event.
Yes, to show our guest around the Seekers' Fair.
Madinat Erudit is far away from Jixia. It's natural you don't know about it.
Guess as a scout, I need to be better at hiding my emotions.
I was lost in thought. My apologies.
Madinat Erudit is a sacred place of learning in Alsahraa, where invaluable knowledge is preserved and passed down for generations.
Her name's Garo. A renowned Grand Scholar from Madinat Erudit.
She's an old friend of mine. We first met in Alsahraa years ago.
Madinat Erudit? Where is this place?
Madinat Erudit... I don't think I've heard about the place.
Thanks. I know I can rely on you.
I should be thanking you. Always reliable in times of need.
Well, to cut a long story short...
But the disciples of Roaring Tiger Training Hall have come for a joint sparring session. As the Head Trainer here, it's my duty to be present.
But you're right. Such an official visit demands formal etiquette from Red Falcon.
Though... there is something you could help with.
That was how the city of Madinat Erudit was created... Now enough about that.
Garo will need an escort during her stay here. And you, I believe, will make an excellent guide.
That is how the name "Thousand Caves" came to be... Alright, that's enough about the Thousand Caves.

Time to head to the Seekers' Fair.

May the Madinat Erudit be blessed with peace and security.

Oh, and Maple asked me to give you this Sea Heath.

I can tell Feng Yu trusts you deeply. I'll be in your care then.
Yes, you can count on me.

If you have other matters to attend to, I can go to the Seekers' Fair alone.
No, it's okay. I'd be happy to show you around.
No, it's okay. I'd be happy to show you around.
So yes, I think what you ask is reasonable.
Of course. Please, lead the way.
Well, fair work deserves fair compensation.
It's an honor to meet you, Grand Scholar.
It's an honor to meet you, Grand Scholar.
I'll be your guide in Jixia. Hope you enjoy your stay here.
I'll be your guide in Jixia. Hope you enjoy your stay here.
Shall we head over to the Seeker's Fair now? The exhibition has already started.
Shall we head over to the Seeker's Fair now? The exhibition has already started.
Maybe I should ask for some rewards?
If you have other things to do, I can find my way to the event alone. Don't trouble yourself on my account.

We'll finally get to meet the Grand Scholar!
Has the Seekers' Fair started? Let's hurry!
According to Maple, the tung tree should be this way.
According to Maple, the tung tree should be this way.

The ancient flute music of Madinat Erudit must have touched these lands countless times before.
What you played was beautiful. Shame there weren't more listeners...
What you played was beautiful. Shame there weren't more listeners...
I had enough. The grass, the trees... They all heard me playing.
Wish I knew the name of the piece...
Wish I knew the name of the piece...
Are we getting closer to the camp?
Is that... the sound of a flute?
Is that... the sound of a flute?
Must be coming from under the tung tree.
Must be coming from under the tung tree.
Come, I'll introduce you to her.
So she's already here. Punctual as ever.
Garo solves the puzzle from the inscription restored: the two of you must step on the pedals on both sides at the same time.
Marvel at Jixia and its magnificent sights. When the east echoes with the west, the twin steles shall rise.
East, west... I think we need to activate something on both sides at the same time.
Let's each step on a pedal and see what happens.
Observing the wonders of Jixia, with a profound view, I see the East and West shining together, the twin steles echoing each other.

text: Well... The text is just too damaged to make out.
Guess we'll have to find all the pieces first...
I see. The stone tablet on the other side rose, matching the riddle of "the twin tablets resonate"...
The tablet has been deliberately damaged, making it impossible to read. You offer to recover the fragments while Garo works on deciphering what remains of the text.
Someone did it on purpose to... hide something, perhaps?
Thank you. Meanwhile, I'll try to decipher what remains of the text.
Here, the cuts look fresh. Someone did this not long ago.
Let me see if I can recover the fragments from nearby. We might be able to piece the inscription back together.
Let me see if I can recover the fragments from nearby. We might be able to piece the inscription back together.
This must be the stone tablet Faye mentioned.
But the inscription on this bronze tablet is barely legible now.
There seems to be something under these rocks...
There seems to be something under these rocks...
Yes, they're definitely from this tablet.
And with the one we found back at the camp... Now we have the complete inscription.
The text might contain more clues. Let me write it down.
Then I'll wait for you at Hermitage.
Then I'll wait for you at Hermitage.
<001>Go stand on the other pedal</>. That should solve the puzzle.
<001>Stand on the stone slab on the other side</>, and the mechanism should unlock.

text: I rarely get to see a Jixia student in combat. You're a great fighter.
With the guards down, we can finally look for the answers.
Look, inscription has appeared on this tablet...
Look, inscription has appeared on this tablet...
A set of messy footprints leads to the higher ground. You and Garo decide to follow the trail.
Bronze shards scattered on the ground, and signs of a struggle on the grass.
Wait... Look at these footprints. They lead right up to the higher ground.
Wait... Look at these footprints. They lead right up to the higher ground.
Someone must have activated this Mechanoid by accident not long ago.
Someone must have activated this Mechanoid by accident not long ago.
A trail of messy footprints leads straight to the high platform at Yanlin Post. You and Jia Luo decide to follow them to investigate further.
zh_text: 一排凌乱的足迹直通岩林驿高台，你与伽罗决定循迹深入探查。

Another one. I should take it back to Garo.
Another one. I should take it back to Garo.
With new inscription revealed, Garo connects the text to Hermitage in Aerfall Highlands. You set out there first to investigate.
The ancient ruins hold boundless treasures behind their intricate Mechcraft puzzles.
Many have tried to investigate, but none have returned with success.
The art of tracking passed down to the descendants of the commanders of the city. Mountains hidden in the south, waters running free in the north...
It records treasure rumors in a ruin in Jixia.
According to the inscription, no one has ever reached the ruins, nor has anyone ever known the full extent of the treasure...
It matches a deed in my father's records. Somewhere in Jixia.
It is written in the manuscript: In the Aerfall Highlands of Jixia, there is a village called "Hermitage." We found the village and continued our investigation.
Father's journal must be related to this.
But... with the manuscript stolen, how should we know where to go next?
But... with the manuscript stolen, how should we know where to go next?
The clue lies within the inscription.
Somewhere in Jixia... What do you mean...
Somewhere in Jixia... What do you mean...
The answer lies not in north or south, but in "reclusion"?
Correct. As expected of a Jixia student.
I'll join you after I record the inscription here.
I believe the answer lies just ahead.
But the Mechanoid Guards here have been awakened, too...
They are likely to attack when we get close. Be careful.
These Mechanoids have incredibly tough armor.
It takes patience to break through their defenses. I'll assist you.
And it's very likely that there was more than one person.
All these marks on the ground... The fighting must have been intense.
Look, the pattern on the back resembles the surrounding terrain. It could be a map.
Did you find anything in the secret chamber?
I found a Mechcraft box with words like Bastion Fort and secret passage written on it, and there's even a key inside.
I found a Mechcraft box with words like Bastion Fort and secret passage written on it, and there's even a key inside.
The rays of the setting sun converge upon the ruins.
Bastion Fort... I once read Jixia's archaeological records. It's said that an extremely powerful Mechcraft weapon is sealed there.
If they breach the gate, the consequences would be dire... We must hurry.
Wait... The sunset converges on the stele. This pattern looks familiar, like a map of the area...
Wait... The sunset converges on the stele. This pattern looks familiar, like a map of the area...
A map... I see. So the light points to the location of the ruins.
I've always been fascinated by Jixia's Mechcrafts. Now I'm even more so.
A Mechcraft box with the words "Bastion Fort" written on it, and there's an old key inside.
A Mechcraft box with the words "Bastion Fort" written on it, and there's an old key inside.
Bastion Fort? Historical records indicate it is the site of an ancient battlefield, where incredibly powerful Mechcraft weapons are sealed.
They obey the "Bastion Token" unconditionally. If activated, the consequences would be unimaginable...
Oh no... Could the treasure thief be after them?
Oh no... Could the treasure thief be after them?

Wait... Doesn't the pattern up there resemble a map...?

Wait, there's writing on it... "Bastion Fort"... "secret passage"... What does it mean?
Guess it's time to go back and tell Garo what I found.
Guess it's time to go back and tell Garo what I found.

Such a big underground place down here.
I should see what I can find.
I should see what I can find.
Since the great fire at Madinat Erudit, I haven't had a chance to enjoy the sunset like this.
I heard you've been working nonstop to rebuild Madinat Erudit.
I heard you've been working nonstop to rebuild Madinat Erudit.
It still upsets me whenever I think about that day.
It was the day Madinat Erudit was destroyed.
I was on my way to buy books at the market when I received terrible news: Alsahraa was invaded by the Beastkind...
My father... perished in flames, protecting the artifacts of Madinat Erudit.
Time to light the lanterns. Let's go solve the mystery.

Garo and you take a seat.
Dusk is still hours away. Let's wait here.
Dusk is still hours away. Let's wait here.
Dusk and clouds, all in sight... Jixia's sunset is breathtaking.
I had just returned from the market with some new books, only to see the city in flames.

Since then, I've had only one goal: to rebuild Madinat Erudit.
Then... let's enjoy this moment right now.
Then... let's enjoy this moment right now.
It's been a long time since I last had a peaceful moment like this.

I heard you are too busy rebuilding Madinat Erudit to rest.

Thank you. There should be Mechcrafts inside that are connected to the stone tablets. Watch out for them.
It's filled with water, and... I can't swim...
Don't force yourself. I'll go down and check the situation; you wait here for my word.
Don't force yourself. I'll go down and check the situation; you wait here for my word.

Sunset clouds dye the sky and water, engraved stones and moss reflect a thousand autumns...
