How about we find a way to lure the fish back and catch them?
You sure you know how to fish? Don't waste all my bait, I warn ya!
We won't! Our new friend here is a master angler!
Just play along... we'll figure out what to do later!
You know how to fish too? I wonder what else you've got in your bag...
Just trust us, General! I guarantee you'll be surprised!
And if that's the case, guess we're having a fish feast tonight!
I think... why don't we fish together as you two catch up?
I think... why don't we fish together as you two catch up?
Wait... that scent of pine smoke and fruit...
That confident, huh? My bait's made specifically for <001>Javelin Loaches</>. Catch some for us, and I'll believe you!
Li Xiaomiao arranges for you to meet Zhao Dashun by the river, but accidentally scares away his fish... She claims you are a master angler, prompting a challenge to catch the Profit-Seeking Loach.
Old friends reunite as Mulan and Yuqiong reminisce about old wounds and vows. Mulan then leaves for an appointment, leaving you and Xiaomiao to wait.
This is easy. Try shaving half an inch off the tenon.
Hi there. I've come to seek your help—my crossbow seems to be jammed... again.
Well, look what the cat dragged in. Thought you had forgotten about me.
Yet I've waited so many years...
I see you're in a wheelchair... your legs acting up again?
It's nothing. I just use it to get more rest.
My mistake for bringing up such bad memories... Now since you're here, General—does your promise still stand?
Now you're finally here... I'm sure you can finally pay him a visit, right?
I just sent him a message. He'll be waiting at the Aerux Inn.
Okay, I'll be back shortly. You two can wait here.
Look at my prostheses. The Mechcraft students helped me modify them. Works really well now.
Weren't you the one who said I was harder to deal with than the Mindless?
That boy has grown into a fine man. And every time I meet him, he talks about you.
If it weren't for that, you wouldn't be...
Old friends reunite as Mulan and Yuqiong reminisce about old wounds and vows. Mulan then leaves for an appointment, leaving you and Xiaomiao to wait.
Hi there. I've come to seek your help—my crossbow seems to be jammed... again.
Mulan had long since sensed your movements, but instead of reprimanding you, she takes the opportunity to nudge Xiaomiao to lead you to the Li Family Post Station.
So it was a recruitment. Not much of a show at all...
G-General Mulan?! How did you know we...
If you want to be a good scout, you've got to do better than this.
We were just passing by! You can ask the examiner here!
Please forgive us, General. We know we were in the wrong.
Please forgive us, General. We know we were in the wrong.
I admit, we were here because we wanted to see what was happening, and...
I admit, we were here because we wanted to see what was happening, and...
It was me, General... The whole thing was my idea.
What you saw was me keeping a promise. Now, you know what to say if Jade asks about this, right?
Don't worry, General. My lips will be sealed tight!
You'd better. Now, from that token of yours and the way you used our moves to fight earlier...
You are Strayn's sister, aren't you?
You really thought I wasn't going to find out?
I... I wasn't thinking at all... I just wanted to prove I could be selected by myself.
Phew... Actually, I feel relieved now. I was afraid the whole way that I'd slip up somehow...
That's why you changed the subject every time his name was mentioned...
That's why you changed the subject every time his name was mentioned...
My apologies, General... I promise I won't do that again.
That said, you've been a great guide for me so far. Good job, kid.
It is. And as for your joining the Guards... I'll have a proper talk with Strayn when we meet.
You've misunderstood, General. I was actually taken in by Strayn's mother.
There are quite a few adopted children like me at the posthouse...
Let's go. Take us to the posthouse. Time to see my old friend, and your mother.
But if I recall correctly, Strayn is the only child in his family. He never told me he had a sister.
Mother said our home was in Yong. After the war there broke out... we became orphans.
To go through all that at such a young age...
To go through all that at such a young age...
A kid from rough ground knows how to push through better than a sheltered one...
Our selection is very serious. Did you think I'd let you pass just because you're someone's family?
Mulan had long since sensed your movements, but instead of reprimanding you, she takes the opportunity to nudge Xiaomiao to lead you to the Li Family Post Station.
The Great Wall Garrison fights the monsters in blood. Li Xun's sacrifice ignites Hua Mulan's desperate resolve...
The moon shines upon the smoke and fire of war across the land...
Reflecting the home letters hidden beneath the iron armor of the soldiers...
It can reflect the human heart...
It reflects the blade gripped tightly in hand even more clearly.
With ingredients in hand, Mulan plans to go back and show off her cooking skills...
Nice catch... Staryn always said I had a heavy hand with the seasoning—I'll let you be the judge of that later.
And I'm curious what kind of delicacy you can whip up with this...
And I'm curious what kind of delicacy you can whip up with this...
With ingredients in hand, Mulan plans to go back and show off her cooking skills...
Mulan wants to cook roasted lizard. Guided by Xiaomiao, you head to the waterfall to gather ingredients.
Haha, don't expect too much. Out there in the field, you make do with what you have to survive.
When Strayn first joined us, we always teased him for living on dry rations—he hated our leathery, overcooked meat.
Yet after years on the frontier... he'd drink porridge made of highland barley even when it had sand in it...
Well... that doesn't sound very reassuring...
Well... that doesn't sound very reassuring...
We'll make something proper today—missing one key ingredient: <001>Lizard Meat</>.
You heard right... The hind legs of lizards are good for cooking.
There are lizards over by the <001>shallows beneath the waterfall</>. I'll go get some...
It's okay, Spryn. I'll go with him.
It's okay, Spryn. I'll go with her.
It's no big deal, General. I can handle it...
I know—just want to take a walk outside. Get some air...
I see... Take your time, then.
Come on. I'll meet you at the shallows.
Mulan wants to cook roasted lizard. Guided by Xiaomiao, you head to the waterfall to gather ingredients.
When Strayn first joined us, we always teased him for living on dry rations—he hated our leathery, overcooked meat.
…Yes, please be careful, both of you.
official_target_text: …Yes, please be careful, both of you.
official_en_text: …Yes, please be careful, both of you.

text: Gazing at the moon, Mulan shares a story from the past about the Great Wall Border Guard...
Still, the moonlight up here reminds me of the old time in the desert—a rare chance to take a breather.
I see... Thinking about Strayn again?
I see... Thinking about Strayn again?
Only... its light somehow just feels colder...
The wind travels wide and far... whirling through the Yumen Pass...
General, is that a battle song, too?
General, is that a battle song, too?
Yes. One that fits the night sky.
The Mechcraft Kite came back a while ago. Unfortunately, the reply offered no new leads.
He's one of them, yes. But the sands of the Great Wall have buried far more than just him...
You know, the moon shines just as bright over there—perhaps even brighter.
Gazing at the moon, Mulan shares a story from the past about the Great Wall Border Guard...
Mulan sings the Border Guard's ballad once more, sending her worries into the distance... She then composes herself, preparing for your duel.
I often think back to when he saved me. Keeps me mindful of the duty I bear.
My sword swings for those who place their trust in me. So long as the Great Wall stands, our homeland stands with it.
Thank you for keeping me company today... Now, shall we spar like we agreed to?
Let's do this now—while we still have time.
*Sigh* Strayn used to say he'd give his life to protect the people he loved... Never thought the day would come so soon.
I've heard that music is the best cure for sorrow. If Strayn were here, I'm sure he'd want to hear you sing that song again.
I've heard that music is the best cure for sorrow. If Strayn were here, I'm sure he'd want to hear you sing that song again.
Very well—One heart, one soul... In life and in death... we stand together...
Though a thousand perils may await, a true warrior never looks back...
Okay. See you at the arena, then.
Mulan sings the Border Guard's ballad once more, sending her worries into the distance... She then composes herself, preparing for your duel.
Good, it's taken the bait. See that <001>target</> on the cage? Hit it to close the door.
General... how long do you think it'll take?
General... how long do you think it'll take?
Soon now that the scent's spreading. Remember, patience is a hunter's best weapon.
The moon rises o'er the horizon... A silver helm above the clouds...
It's done. I should go back to the General.
It's done. I should go back to the General.
The posthouse is still a ways off. Follow me.
Spryn, your steps are getting heavy. Something on your mind?
N-no, nothing. Just thinking of the days when I first got taken in...
Whenever your voice drops like that...
Whenever your voice drops like that...
Once we get to the posthouse, you'll understand...
Alright, then chin up for now. Know that we're here with you.
You return from delivering a message only to find Mulan praying at the altar, and learn of Li Xun's death...
So that's why you kept dodging the question on our way here...
So that's why you kept dodging the question on our way here...
His symptoms flared up a few months ago. He was gone in just three days...
Allow me to offer incense for Strayn as well.
Allow me to offer incense for Strayn as well.
He was fine when retiring from the army... And told me he was recovering well in his last letter.
He rewrote it countless times... I picked up his draft once, and, there were a lot of bloodstains on them...
So when he said he was okay... he just didn't want me to worry...
I... I didn't even have the chance to say goodbye to him in person...
May you rest in peace, Strayn.
You return from delivering a message only to find Mulan praying at the altar, and learn of Li Xun's death...

You arrive at the Li family's door, only to be blocked by a disgraced student. Mulan orders Xiao Miao to enter the house first to investigate the truth before joining you to deal with the disgraced student.
That old woman's hurt pretty bad. What if she tries to pin it on us later?
No way she's got the guts. You really think they dare to mess with us?
Well, well! Finally decided to show your face?
Get lost, will ya? I have no time for your nonsense today!
Woah—getting chummy with the Guards and what? You're gonna forget about your old buddies?
Are you guys looking for trouble now?
We backed you up in the arena, remember? That calls for some "reward," don't you think?
I never asked for your help! We cut ties a long time ago!
Hump! You should show us more gratitude—especially after we saved your mother's life in the back hill!
What happened to my mother? Move, you idiots!
We're the ones who brought her back alive, okay? No money, no entry!
Get inside, Spryn. I'll handle this.
And who do you think you— G-General Mulan?!
You mentioned the back hill. What happened—
We're leaving now. And tell Spryn, General—they can't hide from us forever! Let's go, guys!
I was going to let it slide for saving a life. But now it seems you do need a lesson.
Good. Was just itching for some exercise.
Fists aren't always the best approach, but they do work fast.
I-it's okay, guys. We have numbers!

You arrive at the Li family's door, only to be blocked by a disgraced student. Mulan orders Xiao Miao to enter the house first to investigate the truth before joining you to deal with the disgraced student.
I never had the honor of meeting you in person, but tales of your valor will live on. Rest in peace.
I never had the honor of meeting you in person, but tales of your valor will live on. Rest in peace.
Mulan asks Aunt Li about her injuries. Aunt Li gives a hesitant explanation about an encounter at the back mountain, so you help Mulan by delivering a message to the Lingyun Guard outside.
Ms. Li, where did you say you were attacked?
You can stay here, General. I'll go send the message.
You can stay here, General. I'll go send the message.
Very well. Tell the Aerwatch to send more men to search the mine, and signal with flares if anything turns up. Here, use my token.
I can operate a Mechcraft Kite. Let me go send the message.
I can operate a Mechcraft Kite. Let me go send the message.
*Sigh* I went to pick some Clawshooter Fruits, then a group of Wolvines attacked me...
My clothes must've got torn then. Still, it's nothing serious.
But why did you even go to the back hill? Don't you know some people just got attacked there!?
I can't quite remember... probably near that abandoned mine...?
Your lips are turning blue—this is not nothing! Let me see your wounds.
I slipped on the way down the mountain, is all... I'm fine, really.
Was it really just a fall? Then how did your clothes get torn like this!
I do, but... it's almost that time of year again.
Ms. Li, may I see where you're hurt? I'm no doctor, but war has taught me a thing or two about injuries.
One of them took a swipe at me. Luckily I was quick enough to dodge it.
I've got some hemostatic powder with me. It's very effective against cuts. Here, let me.
No, no... Spryn, you do it. General must have more important things to attend to.
A new location... We have to inform the Aerwatch about this.
We have a Mechcraft Kite for delivering messages, and... it should be back from its last run soon.
General, it's you! No, you shouldn't trouble yourself with this...
Wolvines are vicious ambushers. It's so fortunate you escaped unharmed.
I know... And that's when I slipped—took quite a tumble down the slope...
Mother, you're trembling... are you really alright?
Is that really necessary...? I'm so sorry for causing so much trouble, General...
Go on then. Meanwhile, I still have some questions for Ms. Li.
Mulan asks Aunt Li about her injuries. Aunt Li gives a hesitant explanation about an encounter at the back mountain, so you help Mulan by delivering a message to the Lingyun Guard outside.
A new location... We have to inform the Aerwatch about this.
I should wait here for the kite to return.
I should wait here for the kite to return.
The Gate-Breaker tells the truth, only to have accidentally saved Aunt Li from being extorted. Mulan lets them go but reminds you to stay vigilant in the future.
I'll talk! I'll talk! We were hunting in the back hill when we saw Spryn's mother tumbling down the slope.
We just let them go like that?
We just let them go like that?
They've learned their lesson. Keep an eye on those guys for me from now on.
You flatter me, General. I'd love for a chance to learn from you.
You flatter me, General. I'd love for a chance to learn from you.
Great. Now let's go in and see what happened.
Meanwhile, you fought well just now. Care for a spar after all this?
Then we took her back, and that's all! We didn't do anything to her! Just trying to get some compensation for our trouble...
General, please... could you let us off just this once?
Go. Don't let me see you again.
The Gate-Breaker tells the truth, only to have accidentally saved Aunt Li from being extorted. Mulan lets them go but reminds you to stay vigilant in the future.
Mulan mourns Li Xun. Aunt Li invites you both to stay for a meal, and Mulan, wanting to fulfill Li Xun's filial duties, offers to cook herself...
My brother made this. He said every piece of the armor had to be carved exactly like the original.
When Strayn got sick, he just lay there and kept telling your old stories. Again and again...
It's already dark out there... Don't you need some rest, General?
You've provided me with a solid lead. I don't want to waste more time...
If Strayn knew I failed to treat you properly, he'd surely blame me for this.
But Mother, General Mulan has more important things to do...
Oh, you mustn't trouble yourself for us...
Strayn used to love the flavors of the borderlands... Please, I insist.
I know my way around the kitchen. I'll help.
Maybe I can learn a thing or two about your cooking, General.
Maybe I can learn a thing or two about your cooking, General.
Then I'll leave you to it, then... Thank you, General.
You said that after you retired, you'd make a small statue for every one of us.
We laughed about it back then, saying statues were for dead warriors... Yet now, you are the first to leave us.
Ah... Those memories meant the world to him...
That night, he closed his eyes holding the last figure he made... He had no regrets.
The most heart-wrenching days for me have past, but... today is his birthday, so...
Might I pay a visit to his grave? There are things I'd like to speak to him in person.
Oh, of course. But... perhaps we could go together once I'm feeling better?
Sounds good! Then you should focus on your recovery... Meanwhile, I'll do some more digging myself.
I was hoping you'd at least stay and join us for a meal—especially since it's Strayn's birthday...
I just want to hear more stories about your brother in the army. He never got the chance to tell them himself...
Alright. I'll stay for dinner tonight... But I have a small favor to ask—let me cook for you.
With all of us here together—this makes me feel at ease... Come on, let's get started.
Mulan mourns Li Xun. Aunt Li invites you both to stay for a meal, and Mulan, wanting to fulfill Li Xun's filial duties, offers to cook herself...
It's already dark out there... Don't you need some rest, General?
At the dinner table, Mulan asks Aunt Li about Li Xun's past and mentions details regarding the "Heartless." Aunt Li reveals her true feelings, but seems to be hiding something...
Haha, exactly. So he told you a lot about our camp life, huh?
Yes... His health was already going downhill when he came back, so he stayed home most of the time.
Once he set his mind on something, nothing could change it. As his mother, I must learn to accept it, right?
While we were defending the Wall, a horde of feralis swarmed from Alsahraa and ravaged the borderlands.
These monsters were brutally vicious and, worst of all—anyone bitten by them would lose their mind and go berserk—that's why we called them "the Mindless."
Lose their mind... and go berserk...
Spryn, did you think of something?
Umm... Gives me chills just hearing that, is all. Thankfully that's never happened here in Jixia...
Wow, these dishes all smell so great.
This one's called "Kaizer Sliced Meat"—the thinner the slices, the better... And this is "Su Lie's Bone-Shattering Chicken"—best pounded apart while it's hot.
These names sound like they have stories behind them?
Not really. It's just one of our squadmates liked naming dishes after his buddies.
Was that Shouyue? Brother told me about him—a deadeye marksman who could carve radish flowers blindfolded...
The illness wore him down bit by bit... On good days, he'd carve stone figures or teach Spryn combat skills.
I'm so sorry to hear that... Ms. Li, there's something I've been meaning to ask.
That was all my fault... The last time we trained, he coughed up blood all over his hands...
The Mindless... Did Strayn ever mention them?
The... what? N-no, never heard of that... Is it one person, a group, or something else?
I don't think so, no... But you've mentioned it several times today, General—what is that?
Okay... Ms. Li, do you know how Strayn was injured?
Honestly, I never asked. As families of the Great Wall Guards, we knew what we were signing up for...
Well... We were out on a mission when the Mindless ambushed us. Strayn blocked a fatal attack for me with his axe, but... he took a grave wound himself.
The doctor said the strike damaged his tendons and bones badly... and that he should never fight again.
He... he decided to retire because he didn't want to become a burden for you.
That foolish boy... Always said he was ready to settle down, but... I knew he never really did.
Everyone has their own fate, General. Strayn chose this life rather than it chose him...
Those who have fought the war carry the battlefield in their hearts. I totally understand.
At the dinner table, Mulan asks Aunt Li about Li Xun's past and mentions details regarding the "Heartless." Aunt Li reveals her true feelings, but seems to be hiding something...
It's still probing. Don't spook it.
Oh no! The lizard got spooked...
Oh no! The lizard got spooked...
Yes. It's been a pretty long day for her...
You should go find her then. I think she's waiting for you up there.
It's just a small chore... Are you looking for General Mulan?
She was waiting for you here earlier. Then she saw the Mechcraft Kite land on the roof and went out.
She seemed somewhat distracted during dinner. I hope the kite brought good news.
She seemed somewhat distracted during dinner. I hope the kite brought good news.
Sure... Take care, both of you.
Sure... Take care, both of you.
Just as you're about to begin, a sudden signal flare lights up in the sky. Mulan rushes off towards the location...
Again, don't hold back. Show me your true strength.
Careful, don't stand too close to the cage! That's a common rookie mistake.
You and Mulan agreed to meet at the arena...
Do not hold back once we begin. In the army, we take every fight seriously.
I understand, General. I'll give it my all.
I understand, General. I'll give it my all.
You and Mulan agreed to meet at the arena...
That's how you want to do it, huh!? Let's set this place on fire!
Under Mulan's guidance, you head out to bait the trap with raw meat...
Here. I've already set the trap.
General, is this an army's trick?
General, is this an army's trick?
You'd pick up all sorts of skills in war... I'll teach you how to do it—just like I taught Strayn back then.
That's why you wanted to go out here...
That's why you wanted to go out here...
I know it won't change anything, but... Enough of that. Come, I'll show you.
First, put <001>raw meat</> into the cage. Be quick about it, and I'll keep watch here.
Under Mulan's guidance, you head out to bait the trap with raw meat...
Mulan reminisces about Li Xun through her cooking. You and Xiaomiao are both deeply moved...
Lizards living in the shallows have meaty hind legs—perfect for making <001>Crispy Lizard</>.
We all thought he was being too fussy, but... today, we'll do it his way.
Dreamwing Fruit is a Northton specialty... That must have reminded him of home.
The dish is very popular in the barracks. Even General Su Lie loves it.
But the ingredients must be fresh, and the prep's a real pain. We don't make it except for special occasions.
And when Strayn was with us, he'd always volunteer to go out and catch those lizards...
According to him, using Dreamwing Fruit for seasoning removes the gamy taste most effectively.
General... is the oil supposed to be popping like this?
General... is the oil supposed to be popping like this?
Oh, no! Quick, take it off the heat!
Mulan reminisces about Li Xun through her cooking. You and Xiaomiao are both deeply moved...

Under the witness of the stone statues, Hua Mulan uses military orders to awaken Li Xun's remaining will. Together, they sing the ballad of the garrison, executing demons with discipline. Amidst the broken strings and final songs, humanity is restored, leaving only the tragic echo of "Warrior, do not return."
We wear our armor and wield our blades to protect the people!
We must strike while the iron is hot and forge ahead with courage.
Even if... sigh... there are a thousand dangers...
Those who offend the Great Wall shall never return.
Mulan battles the "Heartless," only to be shocked by the very scar that once saved her. Aunt Li tearfully reveals the truth: "I was bitten while trying to save you..."
General, please spare him. He, he has always restrained himself, he has never bitten anyone...
But I just want him to be alive... to be alive...
The bite is incurable. Death is the only way.
Dead Wolvines... this does not look good.
Dead Wolvines... this does not look good.
The bushes and vines seem a little too thick here...
The bushes and vines seem a little too thick here...

You follow the clues and find Mulan, just as she is treating the wounded. Meanwhile, Xiao Miao also arrives, following the scent... After some pleading, Mulan agrees to let you accompany her in the pursuit.
Spryn, what are you doing here?
Luckily, no one was bitten. But these claw marks match the wounds of the other victims...
So yes. They were definitely attacked by <001>the Mindless</>.
Things are messy right now. You could use all the help you can get—please let me stay.
Things are messy right now. You could use all the help you can get—please let me stay.
This is too dangerous for you...
I... I followed Mother's trail here...
I saw you heading to the arena and thought I'd tag along, but then I saw the signal flare...
My brother once told me it means something big has happened. So I rushed home to stay with Mother.
But when I got back, her room was empty. She'd already left through the side door.
I tracked her with my keen sense of smell... and it led me here to you.
I see... Okay, you two follow my orders from now on. If we find Ms. Li, get her down the mountain immediately.
Alright... Wait... I'm picking up something familiar—
You're here. Sorry, there was no time to explain earlier.
Wolvine carcasses... and the Aerwatch has been attacked, too...
Wolvine carcasses... and the Aerwatch has been attacked, too...
He's still unconscious, but I've stopped the bleeding.
Several Aerwatch guards are still missing. I fear the Mindless is nearby. You should return to town.

You follow the clues and find Mulan, just as she is treating the wounded. Meanwhile, Xiao Miao also arrives, following the scent... After some pleading, Mulan agrees to let you accompany her in the pursuit.
This is the statue he carved for his mother...
You find the entrance to the hideout cave. Mulan orders you to provide support from outside while she enters to investigate alone.
Over here! There's a cave behind the vines!
Over here! There's a cave behind the vines!
You two, stay here. Let no one enter the cave.
General, what if... what if my mother is in there?
But General, going in alone is too dangerous—
But General, going in alone is too dangerous—
But covering the entrance like this... Is this really the work of the Mindless?
Trust me. No one knows the Mindless better than I do.
Know what's most important for a troop? Always follow orders no matter what happens.
If you don't hear back from me, you must seal this entrance completely—And that's an order!
I'll do my best to bring her out.
I'm going in. You should watch each other's backs, okay?
You find the entrance to the hideout cave. Mulan orders you to provide support from outside while she enters to investigate alone.
The fireworks signal should be nearby...
The fireworks signal should be nearby...

In the cave, Mulan is stunned to find Ms. Li comforting the Mindless. Before Ms. Li can explain, she is attacked by the monster as demonic energy surges in its eyes. Mulan roars and draws her sword to fight!
While you're still in there, we have to move, now!

In the cave, Mulan is stunned to find Ms. Li comforting the Mindless. Before Ms. Li can explain, she is attacked by the monster as demonic energy surges in its eyes. Mulan roars and draws her sword to fight!
Xiaomiao follows a familiar scent to find a key clue, and Mulan suggests splitting up to investigate.
Brother's grave... How is it possible...
What led you here, Spryn? That familiar scent you mentioned?
I... General, I don't know... What should I do...?
Don't panic. There might be something nearby. Let's split up and look—but stay within earshot.
Xiaomiao follows a familiar scent to find a key clue, and Mulan suggests splitting up to investigate.
I'm sensing traces of someone's Flow here...
I'm sensing traces of someone's Flow here...
The ground looks solid. No signs of anyone hiding here.
The ground looks solid. No signs of anyone hiding here.
Using the signal as proof, you enter the cave and witness Aunt Li begging Mulan for mercy... Mulan orders you to take Aunt Li away, determined to venture deeper with her sword.
This is all because of you! He was bitten saving you!
He hid the bite mark. It was small, and... none of you noticed.
That's why he retired—to see me one last time before he...
He was going to end it himself... But how could a mother ever allow that?!
Have mercy on us, General! Spare him, I'm begging you!
Spryn, your brother is alive! Please... beg the general to let him live!
Don't you want to join the Great Wall Guards? That's what it takes.
Spryn, get your mother out of here.
You saw what happened outside, didn't you? Strayn is beyond saving.
Using the signal as proof, you enter the cave and witness Aunt Li begging Mulan for mercy... Mulan orders you to take Aunt Li away, determined to venture deeper with her sword.
It's all because of you! It's you! He was bitten only because he was trying to save you!

You return to the Li Family Post and find Brother Shunzi and Sister Yuqiong guarding the door. From them, you learn that Mulan has already left...
How are Ms. Li and Spryn holding up?
How are Ms. Li and Spryn holding up?
It's been for days and she still won't see anyone. Oh and, General is leaving... she's waiting for you at Crosswind Bridge.
She did come earlier to say goodbye, but Ms. Li still wouldn't see her...
Spryn's grown up a lot overnight... As for Ms. Li... she just needs more time.

Mulan waits to bid you farewell, using the sword forms of the Border Guard to convey the myriad thoughts in her heart...
I'm afraid that in the future, their family still needs your help...
Don't worry, General. I'll do everything I can...
Don't worry, General. I'll do everything I can...
This journey has already borne too many regrets.
All I can do now... is use his moves to honor him as the real hero he was...
A sword can be reforged. But a lost one... is much harder to let go of...
Mulan waits to bid you farewell, using the sword forms of the Border Guard to convey the myriad thoughts in her heart...
You intended to enter the room to comfort Aunt Li, but you overheard Xiao Miao confessing her feelings to her, so you left in silence...
She also said that you should take care of yourself.
That's easy for her to say. But for me... my son is not coming back whatever I do.
Mother, I want to place this token on the memorial table.
I don't want to hear any of this... I'd rather none of this ever happened...
But you know him, Mother—you know that's what he would want...
*Sigh* Then place it beside the lamp. This way, Strayn will know where to look when he misses us.
Brother... I will walk the path you chose—for the both of us...
It's best not to disturb them right now... They need more time with each other.
It's best not to disturb them right now... They need more time with each other.
You intended to enter the room to comfort Aunt Li, but you overheard Xiao Miao confessing her feelings to her, so you left in silence...

Mulan offers her sword as a sacrifice, performing the 'Blade Tempers the Setting Sun, Returning Geese Never Depart' stance. Entrusting her grief to the heroic spirits, only history and her departing silhouette remain where the purple light fades.
During the sparring in the camp back then, he said this move was enough to pierce armor...
This technique... The blade quenches the setting sun, and the returning geese never come back.
One day, this style will be continued by those who come after... I'm off, see you later.
Hm-hm, nope. You should leave now.
Mulan admires your skills... At Xingmang's suggestion, General Mulan entrusts you to act as a guide for Yungen Town and accompany her to visit the retired guards.
General Mulan! I'm Blazen, teacher here at Jixia Academy, and this is my assistant examiner.
An honor to meet you, General.
An honor to meet you, General.
The honor is mine. Apologies for my late arrival. I paid a visit to the victims of the attack before coming here.
Fortunately, they are. But the attacker...I don't think it was any ordinary creature. It's very likely <001>the Mindless</>.
I appreciate it. And kid, impressive moves just now. Interested in join the Great Wall Guards as a scout?
It's okay, I understand. I won't force you into anything.
Hmm, a humble mind. Jixia Academy certainly knows how to raise its students. Okay, I respect your decision.
You don't trust me? I'll submit a request to Fuzi myself—if you're willing to go, that is.
Um... but, General, we still have a full curriculum lined up for the kid—
Haha, I see. In that case, I totally respect the academy's way of doing things.
The academy is here to help with everything, General. I'd say you should go pay them a visit.
Mr. Blazen is right, General. And I will assist you in any way I can.
Mr. Blazen is right, General. And I will assist you in any way I can.
Well, I do need a guide who knows the town well. Thanks, kid.
Wonderful! And when you return, you can share with your friends the stories about the Guards.
It's settled, then! I'll go back to the selections. Enjoy the reunion, General.
Those are just rumors. Our studies show that only bites from the Mindless are beyond remedy.
So for now, the situation is still under control. But we absolutely cannot let our guard down.
That was really kind of you, General. Are the wounded doing okay?
The Mindless?! As in, the ones said to be capable of driving people mad...?
And according to a witness, the creature bared its fangs but didn't bite anyone this time. Strange, actually.
I see! In the meantime, I will oversee the selection process... a-and avoid accidents like the one earlier!
By the way, Fuzi asked me to "offer instruction" to a talented student... that wouldn't be you, would it?
Ah, that's great! You're with me, then. *Sigh* Shame I'm on a tight schedule. Would like to visit some old comrades here otherwise.
Mulan admires your skills... At Xingmang's suggestion, General Mulan entrusts you to act as a guide for Yungen Town and accompany her to visit the retired guards.
Entrusted by the Master, you go to the Cloud Root Town arena to find the Star-Gazing Mentor... He invites you to be a temporary examiner, but a dispute suddenly breaks out in the arena.
Oh, another one here for the selections? Give me a sec—the next session hasn't started yet.
Ah, it's you, finally! Whew, this job is killing me...
So you are in charge of the selections here? Where are the Great Wall Guards?
So you are in charge of the selections here? Where are the Great Wall Guards?
But it seems you're the only one here...
But it seems you're the only one here...
Well, there was an attack in town, and many people got hurt. All the other instructors went to help with the investigation.
Anyway, never mind that. Since you're here to help, care to fill in as a temporary examiner?
Come on, we both know you're more than capable for this job.
That's the attitude! And of course, you're more than qualified.
With your help, I'll get a better look at the candidates from the sidelines. We'd make a great team!
This is Seclusion City all over again...
This is Seclusion City all over again...
Ahem, well, that means you're living up to our expectations!
What's so great about you Jixia students? If you've got the guts, get in the ring and prove it!
What's going on over there? Let's go check it out, quick!
Hey, I'm only offering because I know what you can do. Game recognizes game, okay?
All of them? Sounds pretty serious.
All of them? Sounds pretty serious.
You bet. Even the commander of the Great Wall Guards came to visit the wounded. And they say that creature...
It's me, Mr. Blazen. I came as soon as I got Master Fuzi's message.
It's me, Mr. Blazen. I came as soon as I got Master Fuzi's message.
They're too busy protecting the borders, so they asked our academy to run the assessments on their behalf.
Entrusted by the Master, you go to the Cloud Root Town arena to find the Star-Gazing Mentor... He invites you to be a temporary examiner, but a dispute suddenly breaks out in the arena.
It's me, Mr. Blazen. I came as soon as I got Master Fuzi's message.
It's me, Mr. Blazen. I came as soon as I got Master Fuzi's message.
What a shame. Mr. Blazen was clearly getting tired...
You do know he's a teacher at the academy, right?
Yeah. I know he's good, but...
Let's just come back next year. I'm dead set on joining the army.
Watching these tryouts is making my hands itch...
Hmph, the registration desk is right over there.
I'm just kidding. I know my own limits.
But I'm not. Maybe you'd actually make it.
Ha, I'll take that as a compliment!
The assessment is even harder this year...
The legendary Commander of the Guards...
I finally get to see her in person!
Li Xiaomiao begs to lead the way for you and Mulan. Mulan agrees to travel together after discovering her Guardian token during their spar.
General, what made you change your mind?
General, what made you change your mind?
I saw a token of the Great Wall Guards on her waist. I wonder what's the story behind that.
My thoughts exactly. Come on, let's keep up with her.
Please, give me a chance to make up for what I did! I was born and raised here in Aerux Town. Let me be your guide!
And that's a smart decision! I know these routes like the back of my hand!
Well... What do you think, General?
Well... What do you think, General?
Follow me! I can't wait to see Shunzi's reaction when he sees General Mulan!
I see. Maybe with the right guidance, she'd make a good candidate...
I see. Maybe with the right guidance, she'd make a good candidate...
There's little time to waste. Shall we set off now?
Spryn? Have you been eavesdropping on us this whole time?
Spryn? Have you been eavesdropping on us this whole time?
The sharp hearing of a half-breed... impressive.
You honor me, General! People always say I'm perfect for military life. Scout, messenger... I can do it all.
I heard there's a pair of half-breed brothers in your Outrider Squad. And that you rescued them yourself!
You sure have done your homework, haven't you?
I have! Not to mention the incredible Navenian soldiers, the ingenious Mechcraft troops... It's just amazing!
My squad is always to open to those who are capable.
Let me ask you this, kid—why do you want to join us?
I've always dreamed of becoming like you, General Mulan... someone who people respect.
Then I don't think you're ready. You should go home.
What... Don't send me away, General! Please, give me a chance to prove myself...
I apologize for my behavior earlier, examiner... Please, let me tag along, okay...?
It's not my decision to make...
Just put in a good word for me with the general... and I'll be forever in your debt!
Just one chance! I swear I'll plan a perfect trip for you!
She does seem sincere. Maybe... we give her a chance?
Really? Thank you, General! Spryn, at your service!
The first person I want to see is Strayn. He was my vanguard.
Huh, I see Prosper on your list... Is that who I think he is?
Trust me, this'll save us a lot of time!
I think we should go find him first. Weather like this, he's definitely fishing by the river not far from here.
Li Xiaomiao begs to lead the way for you and Mulan. Mulan agrees to travel together after discovering her Guardian token during their spar.
It's not easy to win against Mr. Blazen...
Mr. Blazen really doesn't pull his punches...
I told you not to push yourself...
Funny how all these people think they have a chance...
I want to go and give it a shot...
Li Xiaomiao wins a narrow victory through trickery, but Mulan sees through her sword style in three moves, causing her to lose in embarrassment and accidentally reveal her Guardian token.
Stop "Rebel" me, you talkers. You won't last a minute against me up here!
A Beastkind girl named Spryn is challenging Jixia students in the ring. As an "outsider," she proclaims she will beat everyone who dares to fight her!
As you intervene in a dispute on the arena as a temporary examiner, you are directly challenged by a demon-kin girl and forced to fight her.
You're the examiner? So if I beat you on this stage, I get to join the Great Wall Guards?
How barbaric. No wonder you hang around with Rebels...
Come on, say that again to my face!
When the examiner gets here, we'll see if you're still so talkative!
Excuse me, I'm the acting examiner for the army selections here, and I heard—
Excuse me, I'm the acting examiner for the army selections here, and I heard—
Guess I'll have to let my fists do the talking...
Guess I'll have to let my fists do the talking...
As you intervene in a dispute on the arena as a temporary examiner, you are directly challenged by a demon-kin girl and forced to fight her.
I trust you know the rule, right?
I trust you know the rule, right?
Of course. Stay within the ring — simple enough!
Now see if you can take this!
Great Wall Garrison Captain Hua Mulan easily repels Li Xiaomiao and settles the dispute.
I'm Mulan, Commander of the Great Wall Guards and chief examiner of this joint selection.
You failed to last a minute, and thus the result is unsuccessful. Any objections?
Anyone with an objection, step forward.
No? Just as I thought. Now, I think it's time to call it a day.
Boss, they're ganging up on you!
Great Wall Garrison Captain Hua Mulan easily repels Li Xiaomiao and settles the dispute.
Well, that's not surprising... So did you see where he went?
Well, that's not surprising... So did you see where he went?
I followed him after he left, but then... he asked me to stay and finish that investigation report.
Thanks, I'll go check it out. And good luck with your report.
Thanks, I'll go check it out. And good luck with your report.
He took the elevator to the upper platform... Maybe try your luck there?
Ji Sheng, do you know where Meng Ya is?
Ji Sheng, do you know where Meng Ya is?
Still, he did look off today—I hope he does not do anything he'll regret!
I'm having a bad feeling about this...
Excuse me, did you see where Meng Ya went?
Excuse me, did you see where Meng Ya went?
Senior Meng Ya? He stormed past here just now and went straight up.
On that Ripfire Cannon. He loves tinkering with his cannons there...
One theft after another... This is absolutely outrageous.
The thief must not get away...
Anyway, what are you doing here at the Obsidian Flame Training Hall?
Novar feels you haven't been hanging out much with the team lately, so he asked me to come check on you.
Novar feels you haven't been hanging out much with the team lately, so he asked me to come check on you.
You mean the guy who just flew off?
You mean the guy who just flew off?
You...! Why did you stand between us? Now that guy's gotten away!
Ugh! He got so lucky this time!
Hah, since when has he been worried about me? Bet he's just bored.
The academy's got a thief problem right now. As a member of the Department of Discipline, I don't have time to goof around with him.
That was the closest I ever got to catching him, and still...
Yes, you! I mean, you did kind of get in my way just now, didn't you?
That's right. He's been stealing all kinds of weapon designs.
What...? You almost shot me with your cannons...
What...? You almost shot me with your cannons...
Haha, I'm just kidding! I don't blame you at all, but that pesky burglar is going to be more careful for sure.
So what do you say? Care to help a friend out?
Hmm... I'd better head back to the crime scene. See if I can find anything useful.
Hey, why not come with me if you've got nothing better to do?
I'm not here... He can't see me...

Fireworks Shell Simulation by Blazen... Huh, Mr. Blazen's work...
Fireworks Shell Simulation by Blazen... Huh, Mr. Blazen's work...
The only thing you can learn from it is how to cook on the battlefield.
Firework Shell Simulation by Xing Mang. Huh, it's Master Xing Mang's work...

text: You're amazing! Now that we have the design, the rest should be a whole lot easier.
You know, back when the Ripfire Cannon was first built, they did fire it once for testing.
Then... things went sideways. Later when Cinder took over this place, she banned anyone from repairing the cannon.
I mean, it's really a long story...
Some say that the test went wrong, and the former intendant got, um...
But anyway, we're just setting off some fireworks. Nothing dangerous.
So are you allowed to fix it?
You let me worry about Cinder, okay? For now, let's just focus on making it work again!
And if anything goes wrong, I'll take the heat alone.
Let me see... Got it—we're missing some key components: two unique gears and one special power source.
<001>Inky Mechcraft Cog</>, <001>Frosty Mechcraft Cog</>, <001>Blazing Mech Core</>... such long yet pointless names.
The notes here list where the two gears are, but there's nothing about the <001>Blazing Mech Core</>.
The notes here list where the two gears are, but there's nothing about the <001>Blazing Mech Core</>.
Whatever, let's take it one step at a time. We'll figure something out as we go.
These locations were marked by Cinder—she must have been doing her own research as well.
My guess is, what happened last time has been holding her back.
So I say we finish this job for her.
Completing the repair won't be easy. Why don't we start by looking for this <001>Inky Mechcraft Cog</>?
Judging by the mark... it's located beneath the cliff north of <001>Smokescar Vale</>.
Alright... I gotta grab a few things first. Let's meet up there later!
<001>Ink Wind Gear</>, <001>Frost Crane Gear</>, <001>Prairie Fire Mechanical Core</>... What long and useless names.

text: Here we are. Let's see if we can find anything about the Ripfire Cannon.
And the roof you hit? Is that not a problem?
And the roof you hit? Is that not a problem?
Come on, we have a thief to catch! That's a far bigger fish to fry than some roof.
I'd love to help you solve this, but how?
I'd love to help you solve this, but how?
Well, no... Actually, they sent me here to confiscate your Apocalyptor...
According to Article 31 of the Discipline Code, if members cause damage by using excessive force during operations...
The Department of Discipline has the authority to confiscate their equipment.
Please don't make this harder for me, Senior... I'm just following orders.
I will. The department has also put me in charge of the case. If anything comes up, we'll talk via the Big-eye Owlet.
Senior Meng Ya, you fired the Apocalyptor without authorization earlier and damaged public property...
Hey, that's not true! I only hit the roof this morning because you showed up!
Alright, alright, I'll help. But I'm not the one to blame.
Alright, alright, I'll help. But I'm not the one to blame.
Already!? Did they catch that thief?
I'll hold on to it for now... And please be extra careful when you're out there without your weapon.
Yeah, yeah, I know. Don't break it, I warn ya.
Like who? Novar? I owe him a favor, I'll never hear the end of it.
As for Shye—you know she'd definitely charge for this.
Sun Bin's Mechwings are too valuable. There's no way I'd risk damaging them.
And Mr. Luban... This feels too trivial to bother him with. And well... that leaves you, doesn't it?
We should be able to find info on repairing the cannon in the <001>Hall of Flame</>. I'll go ahead and wait for you down there.
What's the matter, man? Did you get that report submitted yet?
I did, and... I just heard back from the Department of Discipline.
Seriously? Now? We've got a thief to catch! What if I say no?
You've gotta be kidding me... Fine, just take it.
That works for me. With you in charge, I might finally have time to fix that cannon.
What cannon? The Ripfire Cannon? What are planning, Senior Meng Ya?
I've got a guest to welcome.
You? Got any leads on the thief's whereabouts? Mapped his escape routes? Secured the harbor?
Oh, okay. I'm on it... But without the Apocalyptor, wouldn't it be hard for you to get the repair materials?
Actually, that won't be a problem. I have someone who can help...
Huh? Why are you looking at me?
Huh? Why are you looking at me?
Why not ask the others on the team?
Why not ask the others on the team?
And Ji Sheng, keep me in the loop about that thief.
Come on, aren't we the best friends? You're not gonna say no, right?
Do you really think that way, or... you think none of them is willing to do this?
Do you really think that way, or... you think none of them is willing to do this?
Ha, knew I could count on you! Next time you need something fixed, just let me know.
We should be able to find a way to repair the cannon in the <001>Sharpness Hall</>; let's go check it out. I'll head out first and wait for you below.

text: Senior Meng Ya, there you are!
Senior Meng Ya is always in a rush...
This thief—what can you tell me about him?
This thief—what can you tell me about him?
Hmph, still nowhere near my level. Now let's head inside and check things out.
Wait a second. Since we're doing this together, you've got to fill me in first.
Wait a second. Since we're doing this together, you've got to fill me in first.
We've had three—no, now four cases of weapon design theft in Jixia over the past few months.
They happened at our school and also here in the Obsidian Flame Training Hall, a place renowned for its weapons research.
They released a new set of blueprints recently, so we tightened our security here....and he still got away.
Never got a clear look at his face, but he's no slouch in either combat or Mechcraft.
For you to say that, he must be good.
For you to say that, he must be good.
Not at all. And please, I'd really appreciate if you could talk to Meng Ya for me.
Okay, I'll do my best. But where did he go...
Okay, I'll do my best. But where did he go...
What? Why wasn't I informed of this!?
So, you are investigating a case together?
General was right. Our defectors have already set their sights on Jixia...
We seized a batch of advanced weapons from them earlier, and their source is very concerning...
Now if you'll excuse me, I must report the suspected defector activity back to base fast.
I was looking for you when I heard explosions coming from here... Then your friend here led me to you.
Y-you must remember it wrong. I'm leaving to, uh... write it now... See ya!
I'm in the middle of an investigation now. Whatever you're here to do, do it fast.
General Meng Tian sent me to give this letter to you.
A letter? That's new. I thought military orders were the only thing he knew.
What's with all the secrecy... Fine, I'll take the letter. Bye.
And before you go... You should know the general is coming to Jixia tomorrow.
Just like that? He's not staying for anything else?
Still, he did ask that you read the letter very carefully.
So what's so important that made him send you here in person?
It will all make sense once you read the letter.
That's not why the general is coming here. He has official business to discuss with the Three Sages.
He will arrive on a private Aership and returns to Yong right after the meeting.
General has many vital duties back in Yong—training the army, overseeing border defense, and such...
And with the <001>army defectors</> causing more and more trouble, he's really had his hands full...
Will do when I'm free—I'm busy too, you know.
Stratius? What are you doing here?
Let me be clear: I'm very happy here, so don't even think about taking me back to Yong!
I know, I know! Been hearing this my whole life.
Still got an investigation report to finish. I'm off now!
Sorry about that... He's in a bad mood today—probably because I ruined his plan...
Sorry about that... He's in a bad mood today—probably because I ruined his plan...
No, no—please don't blame yourself. I'm afraid this whole thing weighs on him more deeply than that.
Young Master's never been close with his father. Actually, I don't think they've met since he came to Jixia...
Now the general is coming to visit without plans to see him—that'd sting for sure.
Anyway... their family matters aren't really mine to discuss.
Still, could you please do me a favor? See if you could talk to him?
General emphasized many times that Meng Ya must read the letter himself. This is no small matter.
Understood. I'll see what I can do.
Understood. I'll see what I can do.
Yes, this is the crime scene.
Yes, this is the crime scene.
Not many traces left. Whoever did this knew what they were doing—Wait a minute...
The marks on the lock suggest a signature technique of <001>Espionage, Yong's intelligence organization</>.
What do you mean by your defectors? They fled from Yong?
What do you mean by your defectors? They fled from Yong?
Yong may be a strong ally nation of Jixia, but it's hardly stable politically. There is constant friction in the border regions.
Recently, a defector force led by <001>Ji Yao</>, the former head of Espionage, has been causing serious trouble for us.
What exactly is this organization called "Espionage"?
What exactly is this organization called "Espionage"?
Espionage is one of Yong's Six Divisions, a specialized intelligence unit responsible for covert operations.
Back in Yong, the Six Divisions and our people are the very reason we carved out a strong nation in those untamed regions.
Yet who could have foreseen that <001>Ji Yao</>, the former head of Espionage, would betray us like that...
The “Yin Qu” is one of the six Xuanyong divisions—Wind, Forest, Fire, Mountain, Yin, and Thunder—specializing in disguise and infiltration intelligence.

text: There you are at last, Young Master!
And when I fix the Ripfire Cannon, I doubt anyone would ever dare to mess around here again!
Um, I don't see a connection there...
Um, I don't see a connection there...
What exactly is the place we're heading to?
What exactly is the place we're heading to?
Well... the Hall of Flame is where the intendant here, Cinder, works. Plenty of good stuff there.
After examining the table, the three confer.
Nah, it's not your fault. I was the one who let him get away... You can tell the others to come back.
Oh, this is Ji Sheng, my trusted aide in the Department of Discipline.
Well, actually... I did notice something in this room...
Look at these alarms—Senior Meng Ya set them up himself, but they didn't go off during the crime...
And here—very faint marks around the door lock, which means...
It's likely the thief used some <001>forbidden Mechcraft tricks</> to deactivate the alarms from outside.
Ha, that's my man! Next time, I'll leave you in charge of setting the traps!
What? You might want to think that over.
But... the Department of Discipline requires us to be truthful...
If you must put something down, just say... it was an accident. Yeah.
Accident? You nearly took me out...
Accident? You nearly took me out...
Shhh—we're on the same side, remember? Let's go...
An envoy from Yong is looking for you. Said his name was... Stratius?
Him? I don't have time for him. Just tell him I'm busy with the investigation.
Slow down, man. Did you get him?
With the thief gone no usable evidence at the scene, we'll need a new plan.
Thank you. I'll file a full report of today's operation and draft a new plan when I get back...
And... should I include the part where you fired your cannon?
But I've already brought him here...
Seems a lot of parts are missing from this crate.
Seems a lot of parts are missing from this crate.
He was going through these blueprints.
He was going through these blueprints.
All that's taken are the blueprints and parts for the new weapon models—same as the last few times.
Now, the thief. We know he only goes after top-level designs, but beyond that—nothing. This is frustrating.
Speaking of weapons... they're highly regulated in Jixia, aren't they?
Speaking of weapons... they're highly regulated in Jixia, aren't they?
Exactly. Raw materials, design blueprints—everything's supposed to be classified. It's unacceptable they keep getting stolen!
I wish. The Rebels are easy to deal with—they won't use the designs to do terrible things.
But if the wrong people get their hands on them—that'd be a nightmare.
<001>The Southlands bandits, Defectors from the Yong army, thieves in Alsahraa</>... All kinds of troublemakers across Primaera.
Guess we're lucky to be living in Jixia.
Guess we're lucky to be living in Jixia.
He really tore this place apart.
What a mess! Cinder is going to be pissed when she sees this.
Shot of the Ripfire Cannon's top.
Oh, hey! See this Ripfire Cannon—isn't it awesome?
Imagine if you actually fire it for once—bet you could level an entire mountain! BOOM!
That's what you've been thinking about? I thought you'd be here sulking over that letter from home.
That's what you've been thinking about? I thought you'd be here sulking over that letter from home.
What? Nah... Our great "General" never cares about other people's feelings. I'm used to it by now.
And when he bothers to think of me, he just what? Has someone throw a letter at me?
It's not like I'm one of his soldiers!
But Envoy Stratius said that this letter is very important...
But Envoy Stratius said that this letter is very important...
You know, my father always thought that nothing I did was serious. That's why I chose to come here.
When his Aership arrives, I'll fire the biggest <001>fireworks shot</> in history!
But your father is arriving tomorrow... Can you fix the cannon in time?
But your father is arriving tomorrow... Can you fix the cannon in time?
... Yeah, that is the tricky part. Let me think about it.
Too bad it's been sitting silent all these years since an accident right after it was built.
It's not that exciting, I know. But we're not allowed to load real projectiles inside without filing an official request.
Haha, you must be joking. His stuff is peanuts compared to this big guy.
What—is that Ji Sheng? Again? He better have something worth my while this time.
I know, I know. I'll get to it after all this.
The thief, yes—but I just decided to do something much bigger...
And just now, it hit me—I'm going to get the Ripfire Cannon working again!
So it's just like Mr. Blazen's fireworks?
So it's just like Mr. Blazen's fireworks?
I'll go see what he wants.
And when I do, I'll show him that I have my own way of winning battles!
What do you plan to do?
Got it! "Technical Design of Ripfire Cannon."
Got it! "Technical Design of Ripfire Cannon."
Is Meng Ya upset that his father isn't coming to see him...? I should find him.
Is Meng Ya upset that his father isn't coming to see him...? I should find him.
Don't see him here... I should ask around.
Don't see him here... I should ask around.
Damn it, the Mechanoid Guards here have been activated...
I've got this! Go—don't let him get away!
Now... time to go full blast!
Hmph, you are going to have some fun!
Then tell me why you were following us.
Then tell me why you were following us.
Who are you? Why are you following us?
Who are you? Why are you following us?
I... why do you care who I am?
Please... Your interrogation skills are so amateur...
I already got away from Meng Ya. You think I'm scared of you?
Glad it didn't take long. I should go after them now.
Shh... Play it cool. We're being followed!
Something felt off on my way here, so I checked around. There's a Rebel tailing me.
I'll stay on the platform and lure him out. Then we'll flank him and teach him a lesson.
Rebel... so Ji Sheng was right. Do you think they can lead us to our thief?
Rebel... so Ji Sheng was right. Do you think they can lead us to our thief?
Such a piece of cake for my Apocalyptor!
During the interrogation, Meng Ya arrives.
You know who I am? This just got easier.
We got word that you—the "bomb guy"—were put in charge of investigating the stolen weapon designs...
Boss was worried you'd trace it back to us, so they sent me to keep tabs on your moves.
Ah, our hideout... I mean, our camp is right over there...
Let's do this my way—I'll hit you for every lie you tell. So, where should I aim at first?
Guess I'll have to check it out myself. Your hands, please.
These are called detention bands! Don't even think about escaping again.
Without someone from the Department of Discipline to remove these, they might just... Boom!
Whoa, this thing explodes? I... I'm not going anywhere!
Wait, wait... I'll talk! I'll talk!
Your "Boss"? Let's skip the act. Admit it, you're the thief from this morning, aren't you?
What? No! That wasn't me, I swear!
Just save it, okay? You think I didn't notice?
That little gadget you tossed at me earlier? You used the same trick to disable the alarm at Obsidian Flame, didn't you?
Now where's your hideout? You'd better start talking, or...
Meng Ya!? You... How did you get out?!
Meng Ya decides to leave first.
Explosive detention bands... Isn't that a bit too much?
Explosive detention bands... Isn't that a bit too much?
Haha, you fell for it too? I just wanted to scare him so he wouldn’t run off.
As stated in Meng's War Tactics: Every play is a fair play!
This "War Tactics" book really covers everything, huh?
This "War Tactics" book really covers everything, huh?
With great ability comes... Anyway, same as before. I'll scout ahead first. Catch up when you're ready.
We'll talk again after we regroup. Be careful on your way.
Want me to lend you a copy later? By the way, I've already sent a message to have someone take him back to the academy.
Ji Sheng is nowhere to be found, though... No idea what he's up to.
Then shall we go back to repairing the cannon now?
Then shall we go back to repairing the cannon now?
Not so fast... We still don't know where to find the last component.
Besides, now that we have a lead in the case, we should check out that Rebel camp first.
Impressive how you switch between being a cannon mechanic and a Discipline officer.
Impressive how you switch between being a cannon mechanic and a Discipline officer.
I-I'm tired... Please, just let me go!
Hope that Rebel hasn't escaped... I must get this cog quickly.
There's a switch over there... Shouldn't be too tricky, right?
I'll take you down one by one!
Who wants a bomb? You? And you?
Even this prototype is more than enough to shred you all to pieces.
A <001>gray mask</> in this bag... Is this the one that thief wore this morning?
A <001>gray mask</> in this bag... Is this the one that thief wore this morning?
You and Meng Ya analyze the thief.
A shipment arrangement letter... So they're the ones smuggling our weapons everywhere!
It's the one that guy was wearing this morning! I'd recognize this thing anywhere!
Not bad. We've got the evidence, but are we sure the thief is really <001>Qu Sha</>, that Rebel leader?
The Blazing Mech Core is the last piece we need! I'll scout ahead first...
You're taking the lead again? That's just like Novar.
You're taking the lead again? That's just like Novar.
Something just feels off about this whole thing...
Now, shall we head to the Embermane Ruins? With your help, luck has been on our side!
In the letter, it says, "We'll get our revenge when the time comes—our enemy must pay."
Who is their enemy? Jixia? What kind of force would dare stand against Jixia?
Maybe they are related to the Sanctified?
Maybe they are related to the Sanctified?
That's a good guess, but I suspect this might be a separate incident.
When the time comes... How will they know when... wait, could there be a mole?!
That would explain why they were able to steal those designs without triggering any alarm.
That would explain why they were able to steal those designs without triggering any alarm.
Well, let's talk to Ji Sheng about this first. You know, he does seem...
Forget about it. Maybe I'm just being too sensitive.
Highly possible. I'm starting to think these Rebels aren't the real thieves. Someone else must be behind this.
“Who is the 'enemy'? Is it Jixia? What force could possibly be an enemy to Jixia?

text: Great! You came to save me!
There are quite a few of them...
There are quite a few of them...
And they do have a boss. Does that mean we've cracked the case already!?
See their boss over there? Isn't he the one who slipped away this morning?
Let me out and fight me one-on-one, you cowards!
Come and take a look. These Rebels are hoarding raw materials for making weapons.
They stand no chance against us. Let me think of a plan, and we'll take them all down!
Can't quite hear what they're saying... Wait, is that Ji Sheng?
How did he get captured by them? Damn in, we have to get him out!
What about the plan you just mentioned...
What about the plan you just mentioned...
No time for plans now! Just follow me!
You want weapons? Well, see if you can take mine!
Twenty more boxes of ammunition. More gunpowder and cannon designs.... They're in correspondence with someone?
Twenty more boxes of ammunition. More gunpowder and cannon designs.... They're in correspondence with someone?
A letter, a mask... I should show them to Meng Ya.
A letter, a mask... I should show them to Meng Ya.
Hey, you. You were the one at the Obsidian Flame Training Hall this morning, weren't you?
Suit yourself. Once we're back at the academy, we'll find a way to make you talk.
I'm not telling you a single word!
Good... This will all be over soon.
Understood, Senior. I'll take them all back so we can question them together when you return.
Here. Now get moving. And no more mistakes, okay?
No wonder I couldn't reach you earlier. How did you end up here? Are you hurt?
I got excited after learning the whereabouts of the <001>Blazing Mech Core</>, and... they caught me while I wasn't paying attention.
So they've been tailing everyone investigating the theft?
Were you followed too? *Sigh* If I had even half your skill, I wouldn't have been captured and humiliated like this.
Wait a minute... Are you saying you know the <001>Wildfire Mech Core</> is?
That key power source for the Ripfire Cannon?
That key power source for the Ripfire Cannon?
Exactly. I heard it from Zhao Xi at Obsidian Flame. She could tell that you were determined to repair it.
Every cannon enthusiast wishes for a day when that cannon fires.
Then she just told me where the Mech Core is—turns out she's been looking into this, too.
Embermane Ruins... I've heard it's a rather dangerous place.
Anyway, let's deal with these Rebels first.
By the way, what should we do with the stolen materials here? Should we return them to Obsidian Flame?
Sure. I'll leave this to you as well.
Then... could I borrow your badge? I don't have enough clearance to bring this stuff back alone.
I'm fine. Sorry for getting into trouble like this...
Now again, you could've just contacted me via your Big-eye Owlet. It's not safe running around on your own.
Before we go back, we should search this camp again—make sure we don't miss anything.
I agree. Let's do this then.
I agree. Let's do this then.
Among us students studying firearms, who wouldn't want to see the true power of that cannon?
zh_text: “我们这些研究火器的学子，哪个不想看看那门大炮真正的威力呢？”
source_text: “我们这些研究火器的学子，哪个不想看看那门大炮真正的威力呢？”

text: You are called to rescue someone.
I'll keep an eye on him here. You go get Ji Sheng out.
Hmph... Just get this over with!
You should've seen this coming when you stole things from me!
This bookshelf's tall... Can I reach the second level from here?
Pfft. Like these petty tricks could stop me.
A secret room within a secret room...
A secret room within a secret room...
Okay—I'll go down there alone. Judging by the structures here... I'll need your help getting back up later.
Ji Sheng? What are you doing here?
I... I came to update you on the case...
I've connected our thief with a group of Rebels, but their hideout is still unknown.
The Rebel again, huh... But without a location, there's not much we can do.
You should head back to the academy and plan for the next move. Next time, you can just send your Big-eye Owlet.
Oh, uh... okay. Take care, you two!
We were talking about finding the second Mechcraft cog.
We were talking about finding the second Mechcraft cog.
Oh, right! According to the design notes on the <001>Frosty Mechcraft Cog</>, our next stop is the <001>Heroes Platform</>...
Pass the trial, solve the puzzle... and then you can... Ugh, the same old boring stuff...
Alright then. I'll head to there first and check things out. Meet me there fast!
Maybe I'll beat you to it!
Maybe I'll beat you to it!
Oh, I also came to deliver the medicine for. Dr. Lychill. And she was wondering...
Hey, hey, I know. I'll talk to her myself. You can go now.
That guy always gets all jumpy when he's in charge of a case. Here, your medicine. Now where were we?
Pass the trial of the Hero Platform, then crack the mechanism... only then can... Sigh, it's this routine again...

But didn't your Apocalyptor get confiscated?
Mechanoids ahead. You can wait here—I'll handle this.
Mechanoids ahead. You can wait here—I'll handle this.
Wait? Are you kidding me? I'll blast them into scrap!
I just swung by the lab and grabbed its prototype. Haha.
A prototype... No wonder you made no objection earlier.
A prototype... No wonder you made no objection earlier.
Looks exactly the same, but the firepower's much weaker. Still, it'll get the job done here.
Hah! As stated in Meng's War Tactics: Always have a backup.
Let's strike together and finish this quickly.

text: Never imagined it could be opened this way.
Never imagined it could be opened this way.
Hmph, I know a better way that goes like—"Boom!" If you know what I mean.
Hey there. What seems to be troubling you?
Hey there. What seems to be troubling you?
What took you so long? Quick, let me see your arm—did my Apocalyptor hit you last time?
I've been so wrapped up in everything that I never got around to checking on you.
You're worried about me? It's okay, I'm fine.
You're worried about me? It's okay, I'm fine.
The Apocalyptor is very powerful... One direct hit, and you would've...
Anyway, forget I said that. Still, I got you some top-notch medicine from Dr. Lychill just in case.
Top-notch medicine? And she just gave it to you?
Top-notch medicine? And she just gave it to you?
Well... One of the advantages of working for the Department of Discipline.
It still needs some time to brew, though. I'll have Ji Sheng bring it to you once it's ready.
From now on, stick with me. I promise I won't put you in harm's way again.
Alright then. Thanks for being so responsible.
Alright then. Thanks for being so responsible.
Shut up... Now, we need to get this door open. Sun Bin taught me a trick that'll come in handy...
Ms. Lychill finally agreed to give me the medicine, but only if I drink her All-in-One Tonic for a month to help her improve the bitter taste...
Ugh... I heard it feels worse than sitting through a lecture.
Like this... then this... and the latch shall be unlocked... There we go!
How about you become my disciple, and I'll teach you how to solve Mechcraft puzzles like this one?
Oh yeah? But aren't you still ranked below Sun Bin and Mr. Luban on the Power Rankings?
Oh yeah? But aren't you still ranked below Sun Bin and Mr. Luban on the Power Rankings?
Well... You know how many rules they have for docking points, like damaging public property and whatnot...
Guess nothing can stop you from doing what you want, huh?
Guess nothing can stop you from doing what you want, huh?
You bet! Not even the gates of the General's Manor in Yong!
Wait... Does that mean you ran off to Jixia on your own?
Wait... Does that mean you ran off to Jixia on your own?
Well, sort of... Let's just say I didn't want to be trained into a heartless soldier by my father...
All he knows is "serve the people and protect the nation." There's no room for other ways in his mind.
Maybe that's what it takes to be a general...
Maybe that's what it takes to be a general...
To me, it was so suffocating back home. I barely had anyone I could really talk to.
Here in Jixia, however, it's been way better. The Team of Stars and all... and this year, you came.
Oh—didn't expect you to have such a soft side.
Oh—didn't expect you to have such a soft side.
I... Uh, never mind that. Let's just go find the second cog.
I think I saw someone sneaking around over there... We'd better check it out.
I'll take point. Follow me and watch my back.
That's it? Is it going to be that simple?
Look, there's one Mechcraft switch on each side.
Look, there's one Mechcraft switch on each side.
Are you alright? There's a lot of noise down there!
Are you alright? There's a lot of noise down there!
Yeah—just another hundred or so Mechanoids. No big deal!
What? Do you need my help?
What? Do you need my help?
Haha, I was just kidding! I thought only Novar would buy something like that!
Yellow, red... Looks like I need to step on them until they all turn blue.
An Aership exploding in the sky—that's one heck of a firework! Hahahaha!
Blaser in the air 2 in Phase 2.
Ji Sheng? I thought you were interrogating those Rebels.
Ji Sheng? I thought you were interrogating those Rebels.
I'm taking a break for the night—and I figured Senior Meng Ya could use an extra hand.
You bet. I've got <001>Ji Sheng</> here to help me.
We still need to install the two cogs onto the cannon. Care to do the honors?
Don’t mind if I do then. Leave it to me.
Don’t mind if I do then. Leave it to me.
You seem unhappy—haven't we just fixed the cannon?
You seem unhappy—haven't we just fixed the cannon?
What would you do if someone you'd always trusted betrayed you?
The Rebels' hideout, the Mech Core... Everything just fell into place too easily—like it was handed to us by someone.
You know, we're from the same place, and I always thought he was a true friend... then my badge data came back.
Turns out he never made it to the Department of Discipline.
Your badge can track locations? So he never interrogated those Rebels...
Your badge can track locations? So he never interrogated those Rebels...
And seeing how eager he was to repair the Ripfire Cannon—he must be planning something big with it.
Such being the case, I can't afford to go soft on him anymore.
Then you took advantage of this job to learn where the weapon designs were, making it easier for you to steal them.
And... maybe since you knew all about the operation plans, you were able to get away every time.
And... maybe since you knew all about the operation plans, you were able to get away every time.
What... Didn't we catch the thieves together? Those Rebels?
They were just your pawns, weren't they? You gave them up to make yourself look clean.
And the Mechcrafts in the Embermane Ruins that nearly got us killed... They were rigged by you as well, right?
Why do you think I did all that? I had absolutely no reason to.
I haven't finished yet. Let's talk about my father's upocming visit.
The moment you learned that he was coming to Jixia, you started plotting something bigger...
Something like to let the general's only son die "accidentally" during his visit, or to have him repair the cannon and "blow up" the Aership...
Either way, it would drive a wedge between Jixia and Yong. Exactly what you wanted.
Since I made it out of the ruins unharmed, that means your last resort is to tamper with the cannon before it fires.
So, let's start talking. Who are you and what do you want?
Heh... Not bad, Senior Meng Ya.
Spit it out. Or I'll have to borrow some special potions from Dr. Lychill.
Who I am is never the point. Can't you see I'm actually helping you?
You're always in a rush—to fix stuff, to catch thieves... Everything is an emergency to you.
But at the end of the day, it's always about earning his approval, isn't it?
He's the only reason you're so impatient... And you hate him for that, don't you?
You always complain to me, "Father is more stubborn than a mule"...
The barracks are more important than his son—he's really 'Father of the Year'. I remember those words clearly.
Shut up! Don't you dare speak of him like that!
While you're busy getting angry with him, you stop paying attention what I'm doing.
You, keep these two busy! Don't let them near the firing platform!
I will make sure it fires when your father arrives—might be a little more "exciting" than your fireworks...
If a fight is what you want, then let's fight!
Senior Meng Ya, what's with the serious look...
Tell me now, cannon thief—what did you do with those designs, and what are you really after?
What do you mean? I'm not sure if I understand...
Don't bother denying it. Let me take a bold guess about your scheme.
When you first came here, you got close to me by saying you were from my hometown—joined the Department of Discipline on my recommendation...
He's in such a hurry to return to the barracks after being home for only half a day; he really takes being a father lightly. I didn't misremember those words, did I?

My boy... he's turning into a real man.
*Sigh* I really thought I'd get to see him this time.
Still... knowing he's watching over me—that's not too bad, right?
You... you're quite the smooth talker, you know that?
Having you as an ally—and as a friend—I feel very lucky.

Hahaha, thanks for reminding me. I'll be sure to read them with pleasure.

My boy... he's turning into a real man.
I can see the potential in its power. It could turn the tide of war if used well.

I failed to keep your son out of this—this is my fault, General.
Don't blame yourself. With everything happening in Yong, it was only a matter of time before our enemies got my family involved.

As his friend, it was the least I could do.
