Now... I have urgent matters to attend to—I'll leave Young Master in your care, then.
Young Master is resting in his room now. He'll be fine.
Indeed. Though when I explained this to Meng Ya just now, he didn't seem very happy...
Perhaps... he's a bit disappointed because he didn't get to see his father this time.
Perhaps... he's a bit disappointed because he didn't get to see his father this time.
He did contact me after sensing something was off. But I was preparing the Aership with General and didn't reply in time...
If I had explained the plan to him back then... he probably wouldn't have taken it so hard.
Wait—you said you were preparing the ship with... General?
Wait—you said you were preparing the ship with... General?
That was all a trap? So...
That was all a trap? So...
You know, I still haven't thanked you for pulling me out of that water dungeon...
It wasn't. And when I found you outside, I assumed you'd managed to escape on your own.
It wasn't. And when I found you outside, I assumed you'd managed to escape on your own.
What? Then who saved me? Wait, was it...
You're here... Come, sit—or stand... Whatever makes you comfortable.
Alright, alright! It is a bit disappointing to learn he never came... Hey, don't you dare tell anyone, got it?
Ah, forget it. Let's just not talk about him...
Why the long face? We fixed the cannon, stopped the bad guys, and no one got hurt. I'd call it a win!
Why the long face? We fixed the cannon, stopped the bad guys, and no one got hurt. I'd call it a win!
Me? By the time I got the Mech Core and went down, you were already gone.
Me? By the time I got the Mech Core and went down, you were already gone.
But from what Stratius told me, I feel that the general...
But from what Stratius told me, I feel that the general...
What? You're saying it wasn't you?
How did you and Ji Sheng become friends?
Well... it's nothing special, really. He used to tell me stories he'd heard in Yong... stories about my father.
Like how... he stayed up carving a gift for me the night before a battle, afraid that he might not come back...
And how, after I ran away from home, he rushed to Jixia to look for me...
Just... bits and pieces like that. Probably intel he gathered during his time in Espionage.
What else did Ji Sheng tell you?
Just stories about our great general. Like how he'd occasionally compliment me in front of others...
Or that time he went to plead with Mozi after I got into trouble again...
Sounds like General Meng Tian—your father—does care a lot about you.
Sounds like General Meng Tian—your father—does care a lot about you.
So what? And maybe... Ji Sheng was making those things up to let my guard down...
Where are you going, Meng Ya?
Where are you going, Meng Ya?
Nice! There's another one over there!
How's it going down there? I've found some kind of switch, but... it won't budge.
How's it going down there? I've found some kind of switch, but... it won't budge.
Hey, I've got one here too. Maybe they are linked to each other? Let me try pulling it...
Blazing Mech Core, here we come!
I'm here. So is this the place?
I'm here. So is this the place?
That's right! You got here pretty fast.
I can already see all sorts of Mechcrafts inside. Come, let's take a closer look!
I should go now. Let's meet back at the Obsidian Flame Training Hall.
Oh, that... *Cough* I'm just glad you're safe.
Meng Ya, stop thinking like that...
Meng Ya, stop thinking like that...
When I was drowning just now, so many memories and thoughts raced through my mind...
When I was a kid, my father was always on the battlefield. The only thing I could do was read those war tactics over and over...
I think that's when I became more attached to Mechcrafts and cannons than to him.
Then not long after I came to Jixia, I blew up the statue of the Three Sages with my Apocalyptor. Even Master Mozi's head came off.
I thought I'd be punished, but Master Mozi praised me instead. Said he saw "tactical acumen" in me...
Then he asked me if I came to prove myself or...
To help the general—my father—end the war sooner so he could come home.
Back then, I was too stubborn to admit it... just like I refused to read his letter today.
He must have something important to talk to me about...
But now the writing's all smudged. I'll never know what he said...
There's no point fixing that cannon now—let's call it quits here.
Many people say you're a hothead, always acting without thinking.
Many people say you're a hothead, always acting without thinking.
But I know that's just your way of doing things.
But I know that's just your way of doing things.
So I'd say... if you really want to know what your father said in the letter, just ask him in person.
So I'd say... if you really want to know what your father said in the letter, just ask him in person.
Ahem, then let's get going now! What's there to stare at?
We still got a cannon to fix! *Cough*
Are you sure? You don't want to... think it over?
Are you sure? You don't want to... think it over?
No, I've made up my mind. And also, I've got a feeling that... the theft we're on is more complicated that we thought.
I haven't quite figured it out yet, but... I know something's off.
The stolen blueprints, the mole, and the cannon... it all feels connected somehow. What if...
You find answers by taking action.
You find answers by taking action.
We're safe now. And I've got the Mech Core.
We're safe now. And I've got the Mech Core.
I nearly got us both killed... Sorry for putting you through all this, really.
Hey, don't blame yourself. We're both fine, aren't we?
Hey, don't blame yourself. We're both fine, aren't we?
My father used to tell me that I'd pay for my recklessness one day.
Hate to admit it, but this sure proved him right...
It's ridiculous that all these years... I never once backed down in front of him.
But in the end... the facts always show otherwise.
Everything I've done is for what? To set off some stupid firework when he arrives?
It'd just be another childish stunt in his eyes... and I almost put you in danger for that!
It's done. I'm coming to save you!
It's done. I'm coming to save you!
Well... Looks like there are two levels down here. Let's get moving.
Just like that? I thought you said this place is dangerous.
Just like that? I thought you said this place is dangerous.
The sun's almost down—we must hurry. Let's split up. I'll take the lower level.
Is there nothing about "plan before you act" in your war tactics?
Is there nothing about "plan before you act" in your war tactics?
Alright. Considering we still need to return to Obsidian Flame—time really is tight.
Alright. Considering we still need to return to Obsidian Flame—time really is tight.
Then just follow my lead. You got the upper level.
Meng Ya hints at the mechcraft 1.
Blaze Cans? They must be here for a reason...
Hey, wait! Water's pouring in on my side! It's a <001>water dungeon</>!
Water dungeon? Let me see what I can do!
Water dungeon? Let me see what I can do!
Well done. Now what should we blow up with them?
Phew... got it. All good now?
Yes! It's going back up now...
Yes! It's going back up now...
Great! And, uh... sorry for putting you in danger.
I'm working on it! How long do you think you still have?
I can use the targets to position the slabs, and in the right order...
I can use the targets to position the slabs, and in the right order...
But nothing seems to be... Wait...
But nothing seems to be... Wait...
The ceiling on my side is coming down!
The ceiling on my side is coming down!
Oh no, I think that's called a <001>sinking-sand trap</>. This is not good.
Do you have a way to stop it over there?
Do you have a way to stop it over there?
With Lupan's help, Lovar is finally reunited with his beloved, Miss Violet. But what's broken can't seem to be mended anymore...
Finally, I can see her again...
I never thought we'd meet again.
I want you to know... I never forgot my promise.
You still don't understand... Money never mattered. All I wanted... was for you to look me in the eye that day, and tell me you wouldn't leave.
Croaky?! Miss Violet is a talking Croaky... Just how ridiculous can this story get?
You've grown thin. Has everything been alright?
I'm well. You may not believe it, but during our time apart, I opened a small shop and lived a peaceful life.
Now, I'm back. Everything I've done was for this day—the day I could return to your side.
I'm not the man I used to be.
Yes, you have changed. You've become the Frostcloud Biz Boss. I'm sorry I couldn't help you back then.
Do we still have a chance?
Some things, once lost, are lost forever.
Let us both move on. We can't go back.
Why? Can't you give me a chance to make things right?
Time has changed everything. Let those memories stay in the past, where they belong...
Vio, you feel like a stranger to me! Don't you believe me? There's a wonderful life ahead of us.
I believe you. But I... I don't need that anymore.
Why? Why must fate be so cruel to us? No—
You have a bright future ahead of you, Lovar.
Take this handkerchief. It's called Moon on Mirror Lake... I embroidered it myself.
Mirror Lake... where we first met?
Look closely. It has everything I want to say. By Mirror Lake, forget me not.
You've cherished our memories all this time... No, Vio, don't go...
The story continues as Lovar returns to the very day he was cast out of his family five years ago...
Novar comments on the book outside.
Lovar looked around, bemused. Everything was so strange, yet so familiar.
Lovar looked around, bemused. Everything was so strange, yet so familiar.
In front of him stood two of the Lovar estate's stewards... And he just stood there? Hey Lovar, say something!
Now you're really into this... Let's continue.
Now you're really into this... Let's continue.
Novar looked around, feeling lost. Everything around him was both strange and familiar.

Pack your things and leave. Now. Immediately!
Here, sign this agreement. From this moment on, you have nothing to do with the family.
This date... Have I... gone back five years? The night I was cast out...
What are you mumbling about? Just sign the thing and scram.
Don't play dumb! I'm talking to you, Lovar!
Dawu? Didn't you flee to the Central Plains to shake off your enemies...?

Trying to stall? Won't work! Look carefully, the date's right there in black and white!
...and began my business career, from nothing to everything, then back to nothing once more...

text: Nono Express becomes the talk of Frostcloud Town, and Richguy suggests Lovar expand his services to the animal camp.
I have good news to report, Mr. Lovar. Your Aerrider skills have drawn a lot of attention. Orders keep rolling in.
However, most of our orders are from the animal camp in the suburbs. Considering the costs, the margins are tight.
It's very much feasible. Deera's camp needs all kinds of medicines to treat sick animals, so I was thinking...
Please go on. I'll evaluate the proposal's feasibility before considering next steps.
Different fields face different challenges. Venturing into herbalism is too risky. I would advise against it.
So you're telling me to give up on my idea?
Alright. What about a different approach?
A different approach... If we streamline herb deliveries, we can expand our business, and animal camp members don't have to work outdoors in extreme heat. Brilliant.
Brilliant? You came up with that, not me... Right, I'll talk to Deera. We'll secure this deal!
Hard work does pay off. I'm so happy that I feel like walking on air right now...
Of course. With high profits, I've started drafting plans for a store upgrade.
No, I'm simply offering a different perspective.
Are you about to tell me off now?
No. If I had to, I'd make sure you never heard it. It's a matter of professional courtesy.
Not to worry, I spotted a new opportunity on my last run.
Lovar gets Nono Express off the ground and begins his journey to become the Biz Boss.
To become rich, a guy earns money the right way: through hard and honest work.
Guess that's how you survived that super long interview...
Mr. Lupan already briefed me. Starting today, I'm your exclusive assistant, sir. I'll do my best to maximize your profits.
I'm so excited! I'm the boss again!
Yes, I'm very happy for you, sir.
You don't sound very happy, though...
Working always makes me happy, sir. Haha, I'm very happy, just... in my own way.
No need to address me so formally. Just call me Lovie.
I'd rather not. Please do consider the mental well-being of your employee, sir, if you don't mind.
Let me update you on our current business status. We're in the early stage, with two staff members. Here's the plan.
Richguy: Responsible for the information coordination. Receives delivery requests from Frostcloud Town and manages records.
Got it. You take the orders.
Lovar: Runs deliveries like clockwork and keeps customers happy—turns timely drop-offs into lasting brand image.
If you have no questions, you may begin now.
Okay... though this doesn't feel like a business owner's job.
Nono Express... so the Croaky wasn't lying. Frostcloud really has a delivery service now.
A new order needs attention. Welcome to Nono Express. How can we assist you today?
Hi, I'm Deera. I have a Fluffy Iced Cake to deliver to the waterfall outside town...
My friends at the animal camp are gathering herbs under the sun. They need the ice cake to cool off.
Got it! I'll be right on my way.
Hold on, Mr. Lovar. Given the urgency and distance of this order, I strongly recommend taking the water route on <001>Aerrider</>.
Great idea! That way, I can get the ice cake there before it melts.
Thank you. The recipient is <001>Dongyu</>, the strongest and toughest in our camp. She should be able to survive till the ice cake arrives...
Your order is marked for expedited processing.
Delivering on Aerrider is new. You'll attract the attention of potential customers along the way. Take the opportunity to spread the word!
Sure thing... Nono Express, delivery guaranteed!
Beginnings are always tough. Once everything is on track, we can hire more staff, and you won't need to work the frontlines.
Look, we already have a customer.
The beginning is always the hardest. Once the shop is running normally, you'll be able to recruit more staff, and you won't have to keep working on the front lines.

text: With Nono Express becoming a huge success, Lovar decides to expand his business. In time, he'll reclaim everything he once lost.
Good morning Mr. Lovar, I have three important matters to report today. First, please note the rankings. Nono Express has claimed the top spot, all thanks to your hard work.
Couldn't have done it without you... By the way, did my courier rank go up this time?
That's the second update. You've earned the title "The Superlovar."
Superlovar... why does that sound so familiar? Like something out of a fantasy novel.
As businesspeople, it's best not to let those books distract you. I suggest keeping our feet on the ground before reaching for the stars.
Lastly, an important schedule reminder. Today is your investment progress meeting with Mr. Lupan.
Almost forgot about that! I'll get things arranged right away.
No need. We're friends. I've reviewed the financial reports. You've done exceptionally well.
Nono Express is now the most trusted brand in Frostcloud. Excellent work! But surely running a single business isn't enough to contain your grand ambitions?
I wouldn't call them grand. After I was reborn... I mean after I returned, I've met many people and noticed quite a few opportunities.
Delivery and catering services make a perfect match. We can cover everything from supply chain to reservations and payments.
Mr. Lupan, have you ever fallen in love? Have you ever felt hurt? After heartbreaking moments, have you ever found a way to heal your soul?
When I was eighteen... there was this unforgettable encounter...
Sorry to interrupt, but I just wanted to get you thinking. Is emotional healing a fundamental need in today's world?
Uh... so you're thinking about easing people's anxieties with pets? That's smart.
Deep roots allow for lush leaves; only through diversified investment can our business grow ever larger.
zh_text: 根深才能叶茂，只有多元化投资，才能将生意越做越大。
source_text: 根深才能叶茂，只有多元化投资，才能将生意越做越大。

text: I plan to have a mind meld with key partners and see if we can make hay...
Are we done? Enough jargon. Lovar, a word of advice.
At this level, you need only the simplest methods. We need to do just one thing: keep investing.
As long as I'm confident my capital will be returned a thousand-fold, I don't care about short-term cost surges.
The Biz Boss Competition is coming up soon. I'll send more funds your way. Do as you see fit.
Just one reminder: it's easy to lose your way in the tides of the business world. No matter what happens, never forget why you're here in the first place.
Why I'm here... That rainy night, and Miss Violet... I've worked hard all this time to ensure I have no regrets.
That's the spirit! I can offer business advice, but matters of the heart are up to fate.
Time to take back what's yours. I'll always have your back, buddy.

text: As the two discuss the future of Frostcloud Town, Lupan decides to give Lovar one of his shops and encourages him to run for the Biz Boss.
Frostcloud Town... back to where it all began.
Lovar, I like your business ideas. Very fascinating. Especially the one about Nono Express.
Thanks. I only had rough ideas, but couldn't secure investment. Never got it off the ground.
I need to leverage the best practice to gain insights into customer pain points. Also, I should synergize with the ecosystem to empower a robust, seamless solution. I still have much to learn, Lupan.
Well, your core competency in corporate jargon is certainly above benchmark. Keep this up, and I'll have to put a pin in it.

But let's get back to the action items. I believe Nono Express has serious ROI potential. If we position it as a market disruptor, it could be mission critical for moving the needle on Frostcloud Town's revival.
Didn't you just say no corporate-speak?
Wait... revival? I thought Frostcloud Town was always booming in trade.
Business has dwindled in Frostcloud. We're worse off than Harvest Village, and absolutely crushed by our rivals in Aerux Town... Have you forgotten all that?
Surely you still remember the Biz Boss Competition? Every year, hundreds of shops choose one Biz Boss to lead the trade alliance.
Oh, I remember all too well. Hit rock bottom after losing that one. Why bring it up now?
You may not have heard, but with Frostcloud Town in decline, Aerux Town will likely seize control of the alliance.
What? But... why don't you step up, Lupan? Rally Frostcloud, and lead the world!
Haha, I'm too old for that. Time to pass the torch to the younger generation. Are you ready for the challenge?
No one's readier than I am. Last time, I failed in the competition and lost the one I loved.
I have a shop on the commercial street that you can use as a starting point.
There you'll find <001>Richguy</>, a top-tier talent I handpicked after ten rounds of interviews. He'll make a perfect assistant.
Thanks Lupan. I'll ping him... I mean, talk to him now!
This time, I'll win the competition and confess my feelings to her. A second chance like this? I couldn't ask for more!
Not only business ambition, but also passion for love. Good, I like that!
Despair gripped Lovar's heart. The vast Frostcloud Town had no place for him.
Before he knew it, his feet had carried him to the outskirts...
At the last moment, Lupan shows his faith in Lovar by putting down 100 billion Ringild, securing his victory!
I thought you'd already retired with more than enough to spend. Why show up now for this brat?
Lovar saved my life. He's also a once-in-a-century business prodigy. I'll put down another 100 billion Ringild to back him up.
Impossible... I just put together 150 billion... I cannot lose this!
Thank you, THE Shye, for having faith in Frostcloud Town. But our town's future belongs in the hands of its own people.
This isn't just about wealth and power. It's about responsibility and integrity.
I started out with a delivery service. But whether I'm sending packages or investing in other fields, my goal has never changed. I want to serve Frostcloud and restore its glory!
Do you really think I'll fall for pretty words?
Business isn't just about numbers and deals. Mr. Lupan once told me, Nono Express would move the needle on Frostcloud Town's revival.
And that faith brought me here today. With me at the helm, Frostcloud Town will thrive again.
You're just talking tough because you have someone to back you up... Just wait and see. This isn't over!
Homeless, Lovar finds shelter in a rundown shack, where he stumbles upon two Rebels plotting something...
Only a few coins left. I need to figure out how to survive tomorrow...
What's that sound... Am I hearing things? No, someone's talking...
Well, I'm out of options. This will have to do for the night.
Useless fool! How did you let the cash cow escape?
You can try it yourself. The guy's tough as nails. Two whole days and he hasn't cracked. He may not need sleep, but I do!
No matter how much money he has, it's not worth dying for.
Tsk, amateur. Come on, let's go after him!
Those two look shady... Might as well follow them.
Who else would be here in this downpour, other than a homeless wretch like me?
Grateful, Lupan shares Lovar his secrets to earning money.
Thank you! Name's Lupan. Spent years trading here—made my mark, stacked my coin. Didn't mean to catch the attention of those criminals, though.
Lupan? I remember a wealthy man of that name from my past life. I heard he vanished to Chang'an after some misfortune... Could this be him?
Anything on your mind? Well, I should thank you properly for saving my bacon. I owe you my life, buddy.
Don't mention it. However, those two couldn't outthink a sack of rocks. Quite a feat to get yourself caught.
Haha, I'll take that as a compliment. Well, how can I repay you? Truth be told, aside from money, I don't have much else to offer.
Well, seems we're of the same mind!
It's called bad luck turns into good fortune. That's how things work for me, hahaha!
Should have left you to those two...
I'd gladly offer you a reward for saving my life, but money doesn't last forever. What will you do when the coins run dry?
That's precisely what I feared! Actually... I mean, that's not the smartest choice, I'm afraid.
You're right. In my past life... I mean, last year, I never quite learned how to make money multiply. Now look where I end up.
If I hadn't been kicked out of my family, I wouldn't have bumped into you here.
Life has its ups and downs. Just hold on tight, don't get carried away, and you'll make it! By the way, I haven't asked your name yet.
The name's Lovar. I'm deeply moved by your words of wisdom.
Alright, Lovar. I'll show you how to make money, enough to keep you covered for life.
What's this? A coin purse on the ground... Must be compensation from those thugs for my trouble. Let me check this first, then we'll head back to Frostcloud Town together.
Now I see why you're rich...
Guess I should have left you to those Rebels...
Ah, my bad. Shouldn't have put it that way. No offense taken, I hope?
Novar reclaims his title as the God of Commerce, and Master Lu offers guidance on his romantic troubles.
I've always had a keen eye for talent.
From the moment we met, Lovar, I knew greatness was your destiny. Oh wait, I must address you by your new title—Frostcloud's Biz Boss!
I could never have done it without your help. If you hadn't stepped in during that final showdown, I'd have been back at square one.
Starting over is nothing to fear. In business, we never give up. No matter how many times it takes, I'll always have your back. Money? That's the least of your worries!
Just how deep are your pockets?
Ah, I see. You're laughing to dodge the question. In other words: no comment.

Shrewd as Lovar himself. But I'm not stupid. I've seen too many freeloaders to fall for that!
Alright, it's a deal! The bookstall is on the other side of Frostcloud Town. The owner's Hammer. Now don't forget the secret code...
All this trouble just to buy a book. Alright, let's hear it.
Come closer, listen carefully. Here's how it goes...
Yet, in the dead of night, the God of Commerce would still take out his silk handkerchief and gaze at the patterns of Cloud Mirror Lake. He knew his longing would remain there forever...

text: Seeing the vases on the shelf, Nodark recalls a rule from the tablet: "Let white flowers guide the way." This might be the key to breaking the curse.
There are three vases on this shelf... Right! The stone tablet mentioned <001>"let white flowers guide the way"</>.
Whoa, you scared me! Where did you run off to?
It seems to be coming from the curio shelf...
Wait, a journal. Let's see what's inside.
I was right beside you the whole time! You must've been too focused to notice.
Someone, please... save us... Leave now, my child, there's still time... Go...
In the water dwells a beast known as the Bane Owl. It resembles an owl with horns, and its cry echoes a baby's wail. Pray with your heart, and be enlightened.
We found the ritual for summoning Bane Owl in the cellar. Offering the <001>Flower of Purity</>, we pray for peace and fortune.
This journal mentions strange things. Summoning Bane Owl? The cellar? What's that about?
Dad said the village chief found an ancient manual in the cellar. It described the way to summon Bane Owl...
I've only heard of Bane Owl as a bloodthirsty beast. Never knew it granted wishes.
He also said Bane Owl was suspicious and told me to stay away. But... others didn't listen to him.
The village chief made him carve three wooden idols... Dad had no choice but to obey.
After the villagers started worshiping Bane Owl... Did anything change?
Grandpa Zhou, Granny Fang... they could no longer see.
The chief said it wasn't blindness, but Lord Bane Owl's blessing. He said they could see things others couldn't, even buried treasures.
What nonsense! Once the curse is lifted, don't listen to his lies anymore.
Back to the search. That strange voice came from <001>behind the curio shelf</>. I need to see what's there.
There is a beast in the water, named Gu Diao, shaped like an eagle with horns, and its sound is like an infant. Worship with sincerity, and you will hear its clear sound.
zh_text: “水有兽焉，名曰蛊雕，其状如雕而有角，其音如婴。至诚叩拜，而得明音。”
source_text: “水有兽焉，名曰蛊雕，其状如雕而有角，其音如婴。至诚叩拜，而得明音。”

Anyone there... anyone... open the door...
Nothing changed... Wait, I hear something!
*Evil Laugh* You can hide for now, but you can't hide forever...
The stone tablet said, <001>"Hear not the whispers"</>... I must not respond.
In the dim light of the secret chamber, strange noises persist. Novar recalls the village taboo of "Unheard Sounds"...
Looks like the curse is lifted. It's time for me to leave.
Now that was an unbelievable ride... I must tell others about it.
Enough. I'll take care of you all!
You'll always... end up back here... *Evil Laugh*
A wooden idol with its eyes covered... Could this be "See Not"?
Looks like a horned owl... This must be the <001>Bane Owl</>.
According to texts, Bane Owl is a fierce beast. Why would Hermitage worship such an ominous creature?
Phew. Good thing I had a few tricks up my sleeve, or I'd be dead by now...
Alright, I'll continue. Escape from the Eerie Village...
Alright, I'll continue. Escape from the Eerie Village...
An ancient village disappeared overnight. No one could escape alive...
An ancient village disappeared overnight. No one could escape alive...
Wait, let me take one step back. Alright, go ahead!
The renowned Seeker, Nodark, travels through Jixia in search of strange tales and folklore.
The renowned Seeker, Nodark, travels through Jixia in search of strange tales and folklore.

text: All three idols are in place, but the curse isn't lifted. Turns out it has been Tian's trap all along. He plans to offer Nodark as a sacrifice to the Bane Owl!
The three idols are in place. Will Hermitage return to normal now...?
I'm right here. *Childish Laugh* Thank you! I didn't expect you to solve it so soon...
Lifted? Why would it be lifted... You must have misunderstood something.
Is there really no turning back?
The curse can now be lifted.
Everyone agreed to follow Lord Bane Owl's orders. Everyone believed they could get everything they wanted just by making wishes...
But your father was the only exception.
Yes... and exceptions must be shunned, framed, and destroyed. Dad... Dad's never coming back.
The voice I kept hearing... it was your father, wasn't it? Where is he?
How many times must I say it? Dad's never coming back! Those monsters tortured him to death... so I'm repaying them in kind!
Lord Bane Owl heard my wish! He promised to let me destroy Hermitage with my own hands, to punish those greedy monsters!
You made a wish to Bane Owl too?
That's right! Why shouldn't I? Three years ago, the village chief found a secret ritual at the temple. He preached that worshiping Bane Owl would bring endless fortune.
The villagers followed blindly, abandoning honest work... But everything comes at a price. Eyes, tongues, ears...
Then loved ones, families, their own lives. Every gain came with a bloody price.
The village's best woodcarver tried to stop it all. He smashed Bane Owl's idols, hoping to wake them up...
He thought the village would return to peace, but the villagers, consumed by greed, turned on him instead. They sacrificed him alive... They must pay!
Your father tried to stop the Bane Owl worship, and the villagers killed him.
And you, seeking to avenge him, asked Bane Owl to curse the village, turning them into puppets...
If it means this filthy village will suffer for eternity, what does it matter if I offer my flesh to Lord Bane Owl?
Not only that, I'll make sure everyone who comes here shares the same fate!
So... from the moment I stepped into this village, I was already in your trap.
Fool! Some greatest Seeker you are, completely twisted around my little finger. I'll make everyone feel my father's pain, you included!
Then... I have one more question.
Ask away. This will be the last time you speak.
Boring. Look before you—from the moment I made my wish, I became Bane Owl's flesh and blood, the vessel of his curse!
Foolish. I will never turn back, never regret! From the moment you set foot in this village, your fate was sealed. You will be my sacrifice!
What was the price you paid...?
Interesting. My price? I became one with Bane Owl. I am the cage. I will heed His every command. I am bound to this place forever!
You're beyond saving. Nothing I say will change your mind...
A sacrifice should act like a sacrifice. I will shut you up for good! *Maniacal Laugh*
The three wooden carvings were returned, but the curse was not lifted. It turns out this was just a trap set by Xiaotian; he intends to offer Dongfang Buyao as a sacrifice to the Gu Diao!

You walked right into my trap... Now, there is no turning back...
My eyes... ruined! I'll never be able to carve again...
Why... why do I have to go through this? Run, my child... run!
There's only weeping this time... he speaks not...
A child crying? Seems to be coming from up ahead... I should take a look.
Crows circle, Xiao Tian is elusive, and Dongfang Buyao is lost in thought...
So many crows circling above that house... Their cries are so mournful...
Maybe I'll find the last wooden idol there.
Tian? Where did he vanish to again...?
They're Lord Bane Owl's familiars. What we're looking for is there, but...
Crows circle, Xiao Tian is elusive, and Dongfang Buyao is lost in thought...
I should take a closer look around.
I'm Nodark. Everyone calls me the greatest Seeker of Jixia.
I'm here to solve the mystery of Hermitage!
My gut feeling was right... "Little did he know the cruel fate that awaited him."
Whispers in the dark returned once more... We will meet again. This is the beginning, and also the end.
That means no survivors, right? Um... let's keep reading...
“The whispers in the darkness have arrived as expected... We shall meet again. This is the beginning, and also the end.”
zh_text: “黑暗中的耳语如期而至……我们会再度相遇。这是开始，也是结束。”

text: Having secured the "See Not" and "Hear Not" idols, Nodark finally escapes the room. Tian suddenly appears and leads Nodark toward the sound of cawing crows...
You're amazing! Thanks to you, this will all be over soon...
That went easier than expected. I'd better hold onto this.
Where did you run off to again? I was just about to ask you about these idols I found. They're covering their eyes and ears—
That's right! "See Not" and "Hear Not." They were made by Dad himself. Now we just need the last one, "Speak Not"!
Nothing! I've searched the entire temple. Are there any other strange places here?
Crows... the sound of crows! Come with me!
There's only one more place I can think of...
Where is it? Wait... What's that noise outside?
The knocking stopped... The candles were indeed the key.
Was that Bane Owl's voice outside?
And that other voice urging "don't listen" was trying to protect the "child"...
The mystery remains. I should leave the room for now.
Tian's love for his father outweighs his hatred for the villagers. As his resentment fades, Nodark is finally free to leave Hermitage.
Do you really think this is enough to trap me here?
So naive! You will never escape Hermitage... My curse, my hatred... they will never disappear!
Is it really just hatred? From the moment I mentioned breaking the curse, you started acting strange.
But whenever you talked about your father, I saw not anger, but sorrow and helplessness in your eyes...
Don't let hatred consume you. Don't become the very thing you despise.
Don't act like you understand me! You're no different from those thrill seekers!
I won't pretend I can feel your pain. But those villagers aren't the only ones trapped here. You and I are trapped too, and your father as well.
Remember what I told you? Where there's a way in, there's a way out. Hermitage has been trapped in the dark long enough. It's time to end it all.
It won't end... I can't let it end... Dad...
Your dad is waiting for you. Rest in peace, Tian.
Dongfang Buyao continues forward, arriving at the Hermit Village square...

<001>Let candles dispel the shade</>... Maybe lighting these candles will show me a way out.

The candles flicker. Will Nodark ever find the truth?
Trying to spook me again? I won't even flinch.

Limbs, handprints, a tattered diary... Everything hints at the gnawing horror of this place. Having found the "Speak Not" idol, Nodark makes for the altar...
Summary of the three clues in the house.
A wooden idol covering its mouth...
Looks like I've found the last idol, "Speak Not."
Now, if I place all three idols on the altar... Perhaps I can finally lift the curse on Hermitage.
Someone was imprisoned here... perhaps even tortured...
He tried to escape, but failed. The diary was his only hope...
I do not fear death, as long as the villagers can come to their senses... But I can no longer speak. All I can do is await my end in silence...
His words are dripping with despair... Yet I'm getting closer to the truth...

text: I'm sorry... I'm too scared to go any further...
It's okay. Stay right here, and leave everything to me!
We pray to the wooden gods here. Come with me!
Dongfang Buyao leaves the cell. Now that the wood carvings are collected, Xiao Tian has appeared again...
How many times do I have to tell you? Of course! Now hurry! Place them on the altar!
<001>See Not, Hear Not, Speak Not</>. If I remember correctly, once we collect all three, the curse will be broken?
As long as Lord Bane Owl's wish is granted... you can go back to where you came from!
You've found all three wooden idols. Awesome!
Dongfang Buyao leaves the cell. Now that the wood carvings are collected, Xiao Tian has appeared again...
Following the weeping sound, Nodark finds the boy Tian who's acting strange. Tian begs him to restore three wooden idols before leading him to the temple...
A little boy... He doesn't seem hurt.
What's you name? Are you okay?
I-I'm Tian. I'm okay. Just a little scared.
Hello, Tian. Why are you out here alone? Where's your family?
Dad's gone... Lord Bane Owl got angry and took everyone away...
Someone moved the wooden idols, and He got angry... Dad was right, it's Lord Bane Owl's curse...
He is the deity we worship, who came when we prayed with all our hearts, bringing us happiness.
They stand for <001>See Not, Hear Not, Speak Not</>, the rules Lord Bane Owl set for us. We must follow them at all times.
So if we put the wooden idols back on the altar, everything will return to normal, right?
I'm scared... Can you lead the way? I'll follow after you.
Sure... Wait, where did he go?
This place just doesn't feel right. Based on what Tian said... <001>let's head to the temple first</>.
Three statues used in the rituals. The village chief asked my dad to make them.
I don't know... When I got back to the village, everyone was gone.
That's right! But I searched the whole village before you came, only to find nothing...
Tian, you said... your father made these wooden idols?
Yes. Dad was the best craftsman in the village. He made all the idols and took them to the village chief at the <001>temple</>... If only Dad were here...
Then that makes things simple. Let's start by checking the temple.
It must be because of Lord Gudiao's punishment!
zh_text: 一定是因为蛊雕大人的惩罚！
source_text: 一定是因为蛊雕大人的惩罚！

text: Dongfang Buyao breaks into the sealed cell, and what he sees makes his blood run cold...
*Sneeze* So much dust. Nobody's been here for ages...
What's that sound? It's making my skin crawl... Is someone scratching the walls?
But the place feels empty... Am I imagining things?
Anyway. I should look around first.
Dongfang Buyao breaks into the sealed cell, and what he sees makes his blood run cold...
I've researched ancient texts. Bane Owl is an evil being, but the villagers, blinded by easy money, are deluded by false promises...

text: A stone tablet outside the temple lists the village rules: "See Not, Hear Not, Speak Not," matching the three idols.
<001>Two: Hear not the whispers, let candles dispel the shade.</>
We Seekers always say: where there's a way in, there's a way out. Just leave the rest to me.
Tian, are you there? You said you'd follow...
Thank you... I couldn't do anything on my own. I'm so glad you're here...
I'm right here... Look at this stone tablet. Everyone who comes to our village must learn these rules by heart.
The way in is the way out... that makes sense.
Your village sure has a lot of rules. Let's see... "<001>Hermitage Taboos</>"?
Suddenly, the light from a house catches Nodark's eye...
Candles suddenly flicker to life, casting restless shadows of a vague figure pacing within.
<001>One: See not the illusions, let white flowers guide the way.</>
White flowers? What does that mean, Tian?
Hmm... They say white is the color of purity.
When you're born, your heart is clean like a blank sheet of paper. But as desires grow, that paper becomes stained...
Only by returning your heart to purity can you find the right path when lost.
That's... kind of deep. Didn't expect you to be a little philosopher.
I... I heard it from Dad. He always liked to tell me stories while he carved. *Sob* I really miss him...
Hush, don't cry. I'm Nodark, the greatest Seeker in Jixia. I promise I'll find your father and break the curse! But first, let's continue with the tablet.
That one's straightforward enough. Need to keep an eye out for <001>candles</>...
<001>Three: Speak not the slander, and you shall escape the cage.</>
Wait... <001>See Not, Hear Not, Speak Not</>... aren't those the three wooden idols you mentioned?
The village taboos began when we started worshiping them... The adults always said Lord Bane Owl would hear our prayers and grant all our wishes.
If only things can be that simple. Anyway, I've learned the taboos. They might come in handy later.

Limbs? And whose handprints are these?
The Brightest Star celebration specials! Check out the paintings! Buy one, get one free! Don't miss out!
A portrait of me? The artist sure has good taste. Excuse me, how much for this one?
This one? Easy. Pick another and I'll wrap them for you.
Just this one will do. Not every day I get to find such a fine depiction of my glory.
Well, I run an honest business here. Pick any other painting, and this "Sore Loser" is yours for free.
Another ignorant person who can't recognize the Brightest Star, huh? I'm taking my leave.
Why are you mad over a giveaway? You know what? You can have it for free. No one is going to buy it anyway.
Free? But that's the portrait of the great Supernovar!
I'd advise against that... Mr. Brightest Star.
I'd advise against that... Mr. Brightest Star.
So they wrote Meng Ya and Sun Bin into the novel too...
So they wrote Meng Ya and Sun Bin into the novel too...
And they got destroyed by Supernovar.
Haha! I'd love to shove this book in Meng Ya's hands. Just to watch him blow a fuse!
In the story, the underdog Supernovar arrives at the celebration, where the Three Sages will announce their selection of the "Brightest Star."
The guards think it's a joke.
Pretty awesome to stand guard for the Brightest Star's celebration, yeah? It's even better that we're getting paid for this!
Focus, alright? Today's the big day for the next Brightest Star. You don't want Mighty Meng catching you slacking off.
Right, right, just stretching my back... Hey, who's that?
That face looks familiar... Wait, aren't you Supernovar?
It is I, the Brightest Star.
How dare you address me by just my name?
Oh look, isn't it Mighty Meng's doormat? I still remember how you ate dirt, wimp! Quit daydreaming already.
When the great warrior went away a hundred years ago, he left this prophecy, "The next to wield the <001>Star Sword</> shall become the new Brightest Star!"
But the <001>Star Sword</> was never seen again. That's why Jixia set the rule: only the Enlightenment Trials champion can be a candidate.
Watch your mouth or you'll regret it.
Whatever. We don't have time for a loser like you, alright? Get lost!
Hey, is it just me... or does he seem different?
Looks the same to me. Not that I remember the wimp.
Can't put my finger on it, but there's this... majestic aura around him...
You lost ages ago, so drop those delusions. Today, the Three Sages will reveal the true heir to the throne. You can watch and cry!
The <001>Dragon King Sword</> has been lost for a long time, so Jixia set a rule: only the champion of the Guixu Dream Trial is qualified to become a candidate for the Dragon King.

text: All hail the return of the Brightest Star!
All hail the Brightest Star! The true star returns!
Here I am. I have reclaimed the throne.
Let it be known throughout Jixia: the age of Supernovar has arrived!
In the book, Meng Shao is defeated and wants to seek help from the Three Sages with Sun Bing...
That's right! They'll expose your fraud!
Impossible... I lost?! This power... it feels completely different... Hey, Pie! Why are you shaking more than I am?
I can't help it! There's this strange force... pressing down on me...
Do you see what I hold in my hand?
That dazzling light... that powerful aura... No way! It's the legendary Star Sword...
The so-called Star Sword never existed. Or rather, it exists in every blade in the world.
What truly matters... is the power within me. Now you see? The chosen one for the throne... is me!
Lies! It's all lies! We're taking this to the Three Sages!
Heh. By all means, go ahead. The truth will speak for itself.
In the book, Meng Shao is defeated and wants to seek help from the Three Sages with Sun Bing...
“The dragon’s roar startles the sky, starlight illuminates the night.” The so-called Dragon King Sword does not exist at all. Or rather, every precious sword in this world is a Dragon King Sword.

What's all this noise? I'm trying on my Brightest Star attire!
Bring it on. I'm always pumped to fight the best.
Dammit... What is this power...? Don't get cocky. Mighty Meng will be here soon!
In the name of the stars, I'll punish you!
The attire is clearly not for you. Look closely. Know who I am?
Well, if it isn't Supernovar! Here to congratulate me on becoming the Brightest Star?
Three years have passed. I'm here to reclaim everything that was taken from me. Listen up!
There is always only one Brightest Star!
The real Brightest Star is standing right here!
Come on, enough with the catchphrase. Think you've changed?
Yo, yo, Mighty Meng's the name, the Brightest Star's my game! Check out my cannons, roaring to go. Boom boom bang bang, you're out cold!
Channeling the trendiest tactic in Jixia: stun him with my vibes! Supernovar, come here and get owned!
Enough with the bravado. I'm not holding back, Mighty Meng!

text: Are you alright, Mighty Meng, Big Bean? We were so worried!
Drop the act. You two ran off first!
No, sir. We just... sprained our ankles...
You sure ran pretty fast with sprained ankles!
That's it? I haven't even tried.
Bow before me! Behold the power of the true Brightest Star!
In the book, a group of Jixia students outside the venue mimic Dongfang Yaotian's past defeat and hurl insults at him.
Someone is acting out Supernovar's defeat.
Heh... trying to get on my nerves? Pathetic. Do you know what it's like to raise my ire?
Those who challenge the Brightest Star all meet tragic ends. Laugh while you can, for I've seen enough of your kind.
Come to my throne later, and you shall witness a true star's return. Farewell.
Great performance! So amusing. Just keep'em coming!
I am Supernovar, Jixia's biggest loser! The biggest disgrace of them all. Mighty Meng, spare me! Big Bean, have mercy!
Sob... you're absolutely right, seniors. I was foolish to even dream of becoming the Brightest Star!
That's it? Talk tough and run away?
He's probably read too many "rise against fate" novels and lost his mind. Just ignore him.
Hahaha, right you are! Crawl back to your sister, crybaby! You're the biggest joke on earth!
Good. Now get on your knees and beg for forgiveness while you still can!
So many clowns here. The true Brightest Star hasn't even taken the stage.
Well, well, look who it is! Didn't you get knocked out in the first round, Supernovar?
Your legend still lives on! Ever since you left, Jixia hasn't heard such an amusing tale again.
Oh, woah! Look at you. Are you gonna bite us, or what?
After all, you're... the mighty Superpup! My, I'm scared out of my wits!
In the book, a group of Jixia students outside the venue mimic Novar's past defeat and hurl insults at him.
Hey! Stop right there. The celebration is ahead. You're not allowed here.
Oh? I think it's quite exciting... Let's see what's written on the back!
Fuzzy sees the Star Sword in Supernovar's hand and recognizes him as the Brightest Star. Hailed by the crowd, Supernovar reclaims his rightful throne.
The Three Sages appear and Mighty Meng complains about Supernovar.
Who dares make such a ruckus? All shall respect the Brightest Star's celebration!
Ah! Such radiance! My eyes never deceive. I say this without doubt: This is the Brightest Star in full glory!
At last, we welcome the Sword-Bearer. The true ruler, the one destined to reign.
King, master, deity, emperor, overlord. The ultimate man.
The Brightest Star stands above us all! A breathtaking sight, one that shakes the very soul!
Forgive our lack of proper welcome. It is our honor, our greatest fortune, to be in your presence!
Insolent brats! This is the true Star Sword! The one and only in the world!
Sun Bean! How dare you offend the Brightest Star! Meng Yam! You blind, ignorant fool!
W-what?! But everyone thought I was the chosen one! I-I'm the only one worthy...
How dare you disrespect the Brightest Star! Guards, punish him!
We shall deal with this impudent wretch immediately. Guards, seize Meng Yam and toss him out!
Enough. Now that I have returned, this farce comes to an end. Meng Yam, I will grant you a chance to redeem yourself.
Such mercy! Well? Why aren't you on your knees? Must I kick you into decency?
I... I understand. I will kneel...
No need. Today is the day of my return. I wish for no further unpleasantness.
I am humbled by your magnanimity. The throne awaits. Shall we...
Indeed, I have waited too long for this moment.
Don't get cocky. The Three Sages are on their way!
I take back my words. It was my folly not to recognize your magnificence!
That was fast. Still hoping for backup?
No rush. I have more than enough time.
Please, you must bring justice for us!
Fuzzy, it's him! The rascal impersonating the Brightest Star!
I am the Brightest Star. Why would I need to impersonate myself?
Hmm, I remember you. Weren't you defeated in the Enlightenment Trials preliminaries last time? What brings you here?
The throne of the Brightest Star has been vacant for years. I'm here to return it to its rightful owner.
Nonsense! The Brightest Star and the Star Sword have been gone for many years. That is why the world's heroes compete in the Enlightenment Trials to vie for the throne.
You haven't won the competition, nor do you wield the Star Sword. How can you possibly be worthy?
A fair question. But the sword has already awakened with my powers. Say no more—see for yourselves.
You now know what to do.
We understand. You need not worry.

He's completely out of his mind. Take him down!
Hold it right there! Who do you think you are? This is the Brightest Star's celebration. Where's your invitation?
I am the Brightest Star. Since when do I need an invitation to my own celebration?
You know, lame people always think they're special. They can't tell reality from dream or fiction. Leave now, don't waste our time.
You have a point, however, the ignorant just know not what to fear.
Blind fools. Today marks the glorious return of Supernovar the Brightest Star. Be smart, and move aside!
Hah! Is this some kind of joke? "Bow before Supernovar!" The rule is clear. No invitation? No entry!
Get lost, or we'll make you regret it.
Wait, I've seen you before. You're that Super-something loser. You've got some nerve showing up here again.
Hey, hold up! Can't you see there's an intruder? Do I have to tell you everything?!

Here, a hundred Ringild. Tsk... consider it my charity. Now scram, before Mighty Meng sees you.
You haven't changed a bit, petty Pie. Mean, vain, and nasty as ever.
Ridiculous. Have you forgotten how we wiped the floor with you back then? I have no time for your nonsense.
Who do you think you are? I'm doing you a favor by even speaking to you!
Why, if it isn't Supernovar. Long time no see. How have you been?
The throne is mine. It is meant for me!
But after all this time, you're still just Mighty Meng's lapdog. Come on, you can do better than that.
Today, we celebrate Mighty Meng's ascension as the Brightest Star, so don't cause trouble. Just watch the ceremony quietly, then go back to wherever you came from.
I'll take the Ringild AND the throne. Thanks for the generosity!
Sorry buddy. I have more Ringild than I know what to do with.
Y-you... shut up! Clearly I've been too kind. Someone, teach him a lesson!
Big Bean! Someone's crashed the celebration! He... he claimed he's awakened the power of the Brightest Star!
I say he's a cheeky brat puffed too full of himself... Big Bean, you ought to teach him a lesson!

The guards are shocked by Supernovar's strength, but still don't think he has any chance of claiming the throne.
Impossible! We are the elite guards, the finest of all Jixia! How did you manage to defeat us?
Alright, alright, we get it! Stop pointing, it's rude. Well, you're quite something... Are you really Supernovar? The same one who got pummeled into the dirt and ran home crying?
Keep the first part. And toss that bit about getting pummeled.
Well, guess I hadn't awakened the true power back then. But now that you've had a taste. What do you think? Awesome, right?
Ugh, he's definitely stronger now, but the way he talks... It's annoying.
Yeah... maybe that's the price of his power.
Enough talk. It's been three years. My time has come. No one shall stop me from claiming my rightful throne.
Don't get ahead of yourself, Supernovar. You may be strong, but Mighty Meng and Big Bean are stronger. You'll never beat them!
Oh really? Cute. We'll see about that, my stubborn little dorks.
Hmph. I'm the Brightest Star. Defeating you was a cakewalk. Now who did you say was dreaming again?
It's only been a few years, and you don't know me anymore?
Ugh—one more word and my breakfast is coming back up.
Looks like Mighty Meng will take the crown again.
Mighty Meng will definitely take the throne!
Why does Big Bean never fight himself?

Anyone else want to have a go? Step up!
Go! Send him back where he came from!

text: Look, I'm Novar, champion of the Enlightenment Trials!
The stories may be based on my heroic deeds, but let's not mix up fiction and reality!
Yeah, yeah, we get it. So... can we get that autograph now?
Maybe... some autographs for your enthusiastic fans first?
Novar! I'm your biggest fan! Can you sign for me?
Get out of the way! Novar is mine!
Unable to turn down the earnest Righter, we took the latest Novar series back to Jixia Academy.
Unable to turn down the earnest Righter, we took the latest Novar series back to Jixia Academy.
As for how the Three Sages and the Team of Stars thought of it... well, that's another story.
As for how the Three Sages and the Team of Stars thought of it... well, that's another story.
Today, I'm meeting Novar in Frostcloud Town...
Today, I'm meeting Novar in Frostcloud Town...
Righter and the others were freed. A happy ending.
Righter and the others were freed. A happy ending.
Righter recounts his ordeal: held captive by Hearsay, he was only able to leave coded pleas in his stories. Now, he is finally free...
Hey, it's alright. I mean, your protagonist was based on me after all. Maybe we were destined to meet.
And if you really want to thank me... maybe tone it down in the next Novar book?
Rest assured! I'll bring out my best writing. Nothing baloney, I swear.
Good thing we didn't come too late.
What a coward! You based your villains on this guy, didn't you?
And you, my friend, would you accept my interview when you have time? I'd love to include you in my next story.
I appreciate it, but you should rest and recover first.
I appreciate it, but you should rest and recover first.
Just looking at you two... the perfect story is already forming in my head. You'll be my first readers when it's finished!
Just leave out anything embarrassing about me, alright...?
A tale for the ages! Two heroes descending like deities and freeing us from this hellhole! Now there's the inspiration for my next story!
I must write this down before I forget.
Hold on. Now that you're safe, perhaps you could tell us what happened there?
Hold on. Now that you're safe, perhaps you could tell us what happened there?
Ah, right, of course! I got carried away. So, it all started when I was three years old. I read my first storybook, and I knew what I wanted to be...
You see, Mr. Novar, it's quite similar to your childhood dream of becoming a hero.
Right, can we skip that for the moment? Just tell us how you ended up here.
Of course. Allow me to introduce myself. My name's Righter, and I'm a writer with the pen name Aerfall Anonymous. Things were hard for me, though, for nobody ever read my books...
Then one day, Hearsay contacted me and said my Brightest Star story had great potential. Promised me food and board so I could focus on writing.
That novel became a hit. But soon, I realized I was imprisoned.
I wasn't the only one. Writers, musicians, artists, puzzle makers, mathematicians... Many others were lured here in the same way.
Miss a deadline, and Hearsay's goons would beat us up. Just thinking about it brings tears to my eyes...
A bit of honey to hide the poison.
Exactly. Many fellow captives have disappeared without a trace. Who knows what became of them...
With no one to turn to for help, I decided to slip hints into the Novar series, hoping someone would catch on. And after that... well, you know the rest.
There's nothing wrong with wanting to succeed, but never take shortcuts. If my friend here hadn't figured out your hints, you'd still be trapped.
I've learned my lesson! I owe you both a great debt. Please, accept my deepest gratitude.
Just... keep your eyes open next time. If something seems too good to be true, it probably is.
You find the author, Righter, and decide to free him and the other authors from the confinement.
All thanks to a few pointers from the Novar series.
I knew someone would figure out those clues!
Find somewhere safe to hide. We'll figure out the rest.
How wonderful! I racked my brain to hide the messages, so those crooks wouldn't notice...
I... I can't believe it! The nightmare is finally over! Thank you, thank you so much!
To think that Novar would come to the rescue, that the hero in my stories would pick up all the hints! Surely I must be the most blessed man on earth.
And you, my friend, may I know your name? Your heroic presence is burned into my mind. I'm making you the protagonist of my next book!
Now's not the time for that...
I wouldn't call the whole thing "blessed"...
Right, this place is dangerous. You should leave while you can.
Many are still imprisoned, and the guards never leave their posts. If they find you, you'll end up just like me... a sitting duck stuck in muck.
Well... look, we didn't come all this way just to talk to you.
A pressure plate? Let me see...
A pressure plate? Let me see...
Come over here! I found something!
Split up with Novar to investigate.
*Sneeze* So dusty! How long has it been since anyone cleaned this place?
The author of the Novar series might be using his stories to cry for help. You and Novar head to Mirror Lake to investigate.
Not scary at all. I was expecting something way more shocking...
The handkerchief Miss Violet gave to Lovar had Mirror Lake embroidered on it—the place they first met.
So the true ending of these books... lies in reality.
Yeah... Why would a strange token with cryptic words appear during the ceremony?
It keeps repeating "Help me"... Remember that diary in the prisoner's house?
It keeps repeating "Help me"... Remember that diary in the prisoner's house?
Even if it's a cry for help, they'd better be prepared...
For a proper beating, of course! And not just from me. The entire Team of Stars would be furious!
Sun Bin has a good temper, so he might just laugh it off. Shye would probably strangle them with her Mistveil... And Meng Ya? He'd bring out the cannons!
Come to think of it, that author should consider themselves lucky if they fall into my hands... Let's go, time to check out Mirror Lake.
To teach the author a lesson?
That can wait after the rescue.
Yeah, we'll get them out first. The punishment can wait.
If they went to such lengths to send a message, they must be in real trouble. I'm curious about what we'll find.
If they went to such lengths to send a message, they must be in real trouble. I'm curious about what we'll find.
No time to waste, then. See you at the lake!
A savior's voice, who will heed? A path to redemption, who will tread? I wait alone, trapped within this cage.
The whispers echo in Nodark's ears. It keeps calling... <001>Help me</>...
This... this is nothing! Anyway, look at the ending. Another riddle!
Just some spooky nonsense. Wait, "I wait alone, trapped within this cage"... The whole book is about someone trapped in a hopeless place with no way out.
When we piece together all three endings, it seems to be more than a mere challenge.
At first, it seemed the author was mocking the reader. Yet they emphasized "awaiting a brilliant mind." It feels like both a challenge and an invitation.

Then, the second book mentioned Mirror Lake, hinting at a secret hidden there.

There's a mountain behind Mirror Lake. We can start looking there.

My talent has gone unnoticed for years. Finally, someone appreciates my work... Tomorrow, I'll go to the mountains and write, away from all distractions.

Just a mountain away from a new life. Soon, my novels will be published, and I'll be famous!

They talked about how they created Supernovar. This is interesting.

Before leaving, they were working on a story with you as the protagonist.

The novels may be wild, but in those books, you're always the determined, fearless adventurer. Perhaps your life story inspired them more than you know.

They were bizarre, just like these stories. I saw my past with my sister, watched my idol Li Bai's adventures...
So I know... no matter how fantastical a story is, it all comes from the dreamer.

text: I wonder what Dr. Lychill wants to show me...
I wonder what Dr. Lychill wants to show me...
To make the infiltration easier, Lychill gives you a disguise. You plan to meet up at the Restricted Ground.
I'll go there first and check things out. Meet me at the entrance to the <001>Restricted Ground</>.
Nice. Already giving off villain vibes.
Alright, that's about everything we need.
A special <001>Mechcraft communicator</>. If we get separated, we'll use it to stay in touch.
We're going to be badly outnumbered. Direct confrontation is the last thing we want.
Strange how changing clothes just turns you into a different person...
Strange how changing clothes just turns you into a different person...
Remember—our top priority is finding and destroying their gas device.
And if things get dangerous, I want you to just run.
Your safety always comes first. Got it?
Their identity pass... And what's this little device?
Their identity pass... And what's this little device?
Still, we must always prepare for the worst.
A concealed <001>communication device</> that can connect voices over a certain distance. If we get separated inside, we'll use this to stay in touch.
zh_text: 一种隐蔽的<001>通讯机关</>，可以在一定距离内连接起两边的声音。如果我们在里面分开，就用它保持联络。

text: Something interesting...? Here in the infirmary?
Something interesting...? Here in the infirmary?
The safest place lies in plain sight, won't you agree?
I've never let anyone in before, you know.
Lychill opens her secret research room to you and helps you change your disguise here.
Now... why don't you let me help you get changed?
Wait, I can do it myself—
Wait, I can do it myself—
I traveled around before settling in Jixia. Made a few connections here and there.
When I came here, I brought some of my favorite ones and hid them here. Things like... potions, or handy garments.
Just everything you need—to disguise as a Rebel.
Before I knew it, I had a whole collection of stuff that's best kept out of sight.
Relax. You did a great job back in that cave. You might have a real talent for this.
Getting excited? We're getting close to the end.
Lychill opens her secret research room to you and helps you change your disguise here.
Lychill invites you to infiltrate with her, destroy the gas device, and capture them all. She also explains the very reason why she started this investigation in the first place.
I think it's time for us to "join" them.
Yes, those two have been taken care of. Now back to our job...
And you're the only person I trust to do this together.
But before everything, I believe I owe you some answers.
We take the fight to them, destroy their base of operation, and bring them all in.
So you had this planned out from the start? Then why did we spend so much time...
So you had this planned out from the start? Then why did we spend so much time...
Only knowing the problem won't solve it. Not until we learn everything about it.
In fact, it was our investigation that connected things together.
And now, we finally have the chance to catch them all in one go.
We've come all this way together, and...
Well, we did work well as a team, so... let's do this, partner.
Well, we did work well as a team, so... let's do this, partner.
Partner, huh... I like the sound of that.
Getting into character fast, are we? I like it.
Now, it's my job to ensure your safety...
Here, let me show you something interesting.
Yeah. Those bounty hunters might come in big numbers, not to mention the threat of the gas...
Good thing is, I've already prepared the antidotes along with a set of communication units. If things go wrong, you'll be able to get out at any time.
Now after everything we've been through—can you trust me one more time?
Master had long sensed that some had infiltrated the academy to track Lychill, and he entrusted the task of "cleaning up" these individuals to her.
So, the gang you saw... They're in Restricted Ground?
Yes. With all the people coming and going during the Enlightenment Trials, they must have managed to slip in.
And they've brought something from Yong.
If you're interested, how about I give this job to you?
Master Fuzi, I... are you sure about this?
You're our healer, and a teacher our students trust. I don't see a problem.
Besides, some <001>wounds</> cannot be healed by time alone.
I... I see. I'll do it then.
Master had long sensed that some had infiltrated the academy to track Lychill, and he entrusted the task of "cleaning up" these individuals to her.
You lost consciousness in the fog.
You lost consciousness in the fog.
You and Guanfeng walk into the thick fog. He seems to have seen something strange ahead.
Don't jinx it! Just... just stay close to me, okay?
This... doesn't seem different from regular fog.
Wait, what's that on the ground?
You and Guanfeng walk into the thick fog. He seems to have seen something strange ahead.
You and Chase hear strange noises in the fog. In the distance, a blurry human figure drifts toward you. \nChase flees the scene in panic.
As you examine the fawn's remains, a strange sound echoes from the surroundings...
I don't see any wounds. Then why...
D-don't say that! We shouldn't jump to conclusions.
As you examine the fawn's remains, a strange sound echoes from the surroundings...

Just as you're about to lose consciousness, you see a doctor approach you... \nIn your daze, you take the medicine you are fed. When you wake, you find yourself soaking in a medicinal bath. That doctor comes and examines you, before delivering her diagnosis...
I'm afraid it's too late. The poison has spread too far.
The detox bath seems to be working well.

Just as you're about to lose consciousness, you see a doctor approach you... \nIn your daze, you take the medicine you are fed. When you wake, you find yourself soaking in a medicinal bath. That doctor comes and examines you, before delivering her diagnosis...
When you wake up, you find yourself soaking in a medicinal bath. A doctor approaches, and after examining you, she smiles and gives you a diagnosis.
Chase from the Secrets Club? What's he doing here?
Chase from the Secrets Club? What's he doing here?
Chase, a report at the Secrets Club, is investigating a mysterious legend known as "The Fogdwellers." He hopes you'll join him to check out where the fog appears.
Aha! You're here! That makes things so much easier for my latest scoop.
Stay away from sudden fogs in the wild.
<001>"Fogdwellers"</> are believed to roam those fogs. If you stray too close and they find you...
Alrighty! I'll make sure your name's next to mine on the article!
The fog's not far from here. Let's go!
You're not exaggerating things again, are you?
You're not exaggerating things again, are you?
I'm investigating a secret incident the academy's hushed up. All I need now is a smart and brave partner.
And lucky me, I'm looking at this legendary freshman...
Well, since you put it that way...
I knew you wouldn't turn me down! Now, time for some classified intel.
I'm merely telling the truth! Look, I'll let you in on some classified intel. I bet you'll be interested.
Oh, come on! Who else but you?
Here, how about some classified intel? I bet you'll be interested.
I swear, it's the real deal!
And it's happening right under our noses! So, there's this strange rumor going around lately...
You'll become one of them and get trapped inside forever!
And guess what? A fog is rolling in as we speak.
It's now or never. Just say the word, and I'll take you to it!
And your name comes on top on the article, okay!?
Scoop... What are you this time?
Scoop... What are you this time?
Some say they're just seeing things. But what if something really is out there? Either way, it's worth digging.
We can't miss this chance. Please, I promise it'll just be a quick look. Nothing risky.
What was that shadow just now...?
What was that shadow just now...?
Better find Chase before anything bad happens.
Better find Chase before anything bad happens.
It vanished as I got closer...
It vanished as I got closer...
It disappears as soon as I get close...

official_en_text: It disappears as soon as I get close...

text: It disappears as soon as I get close...
