text: A deer... Quick, come with me!
Accompanying line in the fog while poisoned.
The fog seems to be getting thicker.
The fog seems to be getting thicker.
So, what do we do next?
We can talk about our plan once we return to the infirmary.
I'll go back after I find them a safe place. Anything else you want to talk about now?
Hm? What makes you say that?
The way you do things, and how you fight... there's no way you're just an ordinary healer.
The way you do things, and how you fight... there's no way you're just an ordinary healer.
I've been to many places before coming here, and...
The world has a way of teaching you things you never set out to learn. Don't you agree?
Well... You do have a point.
Well... You do have a point.
What will happen to these two?
For now, I'll find someone I trust to take them somewhere safe and out of sight.
Once we get to the bottom of this, we'll deal with them all according to academy rules.
Don't worry, everything will be fine.
Good. And you won't be disappointed by what I'm going to show you there.
Why didn't you tell me the truth sooner?
Like I said, it's a long story.
We'll have plenty of time to talk when this is all over.
For now, let's just focus on our job and bring all the culprits to justice.
They seemed so afraid of me. Am I really that scary?
Were they telling the truth? And how did you know about their hiding place?
Were they telling the truth? And how did you know about their hiding place?
That's a long story... Right now, let's take care of these two first.
I promise I'll explain everything once we get back.
For now, let's just say I got a little help from Master Fuzi.
And with everything we've done, we're almost ready to uncover the truth.
Let's continue this conversation back at the infirmary, alright?
The two captured individuals refuse to speak, so Lychill suggests using a potion to make them "talk nicely."
Apologies, guys, but we really had no choice. Now, care to talk things over?
*Cough* What in the world do you want from us?!
We're in the same business, you and I. If you... know what I mean?
I'm sure we're not! Even us Rebels don't jump people like that!
Easy, easy. We're just curious... who ordered you to let those bats loose? How's the pay? Think you can cut us in?
Well, look... we're just out here for a field study on wild bats. See? We have our academy pass.
Our work is sponsored by some powerful friends of ours. Let us go now or you'll regret it!
Oh dear, I'm terrified. I suppose I should stop asking questions.
Feed them my truth potions, will you? I'm sure they'll feel a bit more... cooperative.
The two captured individuals refuse to speak, so Lychill suggests using a potion to make them "talk nicely."
The two reveal their identities and motives. They forged permits and were hiding in the Restricted Ground, where they had also set up a gas device as a deterrence against the academy.
We're just following orders here, yes. But our boss... well, you don't want to mess with our boss.
Some of us are in this because we want to be. Some because we have to. You know what I'm saying?
Okay. Since you put it that way, I won't make things harder for you.
Sure thing... But just one last question before we go.
Say we release you now unharmed... Wouldn't your boss get suspicious? Even call you two traitors, perhaps?
That's just your version of the story, though...
Ugh... fine, we'll talk! But in exchange, you must guarantee our safety!
Now, tell me about this boss of yours.
He's a renowned Blood Clan Hunter from Yong. And the one behind him... is the famous <001>Lady Mi Yue</>.
She's the Empress Dowager of Yong. Legend has it that she—
Didn't expect that big a name to come up. Go on, what's your mission?
To track someone down. Boss wants us to keep a low profile, so we're only allowed to use the bats.
You think he'd trust us with that information?
I have all I need. Do you have any other questions?
Of course not! We were supposed to be discreet, and rumors are the last thing we need!
So the students did not hear the rumors from you? Then where did it all begin...?
So the students did not hear the rumors from you? Then where did it all begin...?
Us? No way! Boss ordered us not to alarm the academy.
But there are so many students talking about this...
But there are so many students talking about this...
Stories don't write themselves... You sure you didn't hire anyone to spread the word around?
No idea, but it does sound like something boss would do.
So you do think it's possible? Okay...
So you do think it's possible? Okay...
You got what you wanted. Now hold up your end of the deal and protect us!
I'm afraid you'll have to take another nap.
Don't worry, they'll be begging to tell us everything soon.
What are you two whispering about!? Now get lost and stay out of our way!
W-wait! What are you doing with those potions? You don't want to—
Whatever your boss is planning, I promise you he will not succeed.
Y-you—how did you know about that?!
Did you really think you could get away with shady business here in Jixia?
Now, be straight with me and tell me everything. And hand over your identity pass too.
What... So why bother asking when you knew it all along?
Well, I did need to hear it from you to be sure.
Fine... It's not like we have better choices anyway. The pass is yours.
Our boss brought a "secret weapon" from Yong—a gas device only he can control.
We don't know the specifics, but I guess... he intends to use it as a deterrence against the academy.
Worst case, he unleashes the gas to get away amid the chaos.
Believe what you want. I won't be the one choking on poison.
But you've been making yourselves all comfy in the Restricted Ground, no? How's that low profile?
We don't have much time before they come back.
I'll see what I can do first.
Alright, but be quick. I'll keep watch.
It's alright. Let me help you.
I noticed a pattern while you were trying with the switches.
If you activate the other three but not the one beside me, that should do the trick.
Want to give it a go?
Just as you're about to destroy the gas device, a warning from Lychill comes through the communicator. \nThe door slams shut, and the bounty hunters' leader surrounds you with his men.
Look what we have here... A kid trying to play the hero.
Who are you? What are you doing in Jixia?!
Who are you? What are you doing in Jixia?!
Now tell me who sent you, and I might let you walk away.
Heh... Haven't you realized you've been betrayed?
Just think about it. Why are you the only one trapped in here?
Speak now. I won't ask again.
Resist all you want. We'll get you to talk!
Better keep my distance from those elite looking men...
Better keep my distance from those elite looking men...
You discover that the entrance to the deeper layer is sealed by mechcraft. Lychill suggests faking a lighting system failure.
Seems only a few core members are allowed down here. Let's move fast before they hear about what we did upstairs.
The way that leads deeper in is being guarded.
The way that leads deeper in is being guarded.
I heard the boss has been away for a few days. I wonder if he's carrying the device to unlock the mechanism...
I heard the boss has been away for a few days. I wonder if he's carrying the device to unlock the mechanism...

When our path is blocked, we find a way to unblock it. Simple as that. Since this mechanism is blocking the way, we'll just stop it from working. After all, this school building has been abandoned for a long time, so it's no surprise if it malfunctions occasionally.
You mean to fake a blackout and sneak down in the dark?
You mean to fake a blackout and sneak down in the dark?
You're overthinking the situation, my dear assistant.
That should be the old control room of the place. If we can find its power switch, we can give them a little "surprise."
Exactly. Come on, let's go take a look.
Pulling this should cut the power to the entire floor... I hope Dr. Lychill will be alright.
Pulling this should cut the power to the entire floor... I hope Dr. Lychill will be alright.
Anyway, I should do this. We're running out of time.
Anyway, I should do this. We're running out of time.
Hmm? There's something behind this book...
Hmm? There's something behind this book...
You meet Guanfeng again, who is out collecting wind, and learn from him that a group of people is blocking others from entering the school building under the guise of safety inspections.
... And they just kicked me out! There's definitely something fishy going on, I'm sure of it!
I'm clearly onto something, right, Dr. Lychill? So how about... Hey, who's this?!
That's what they told me, but... something just feels off to me!
A-hem... I have both good news and bad news for you. Which do you want to hear first?
Can I just get the good news?
Bad news, then. The academy will take over the investigation from here, so I need you to go back to Pastoral Garden.
Ugh, okay... So, what's the good news?
As long as you keep your lips zipped, I promise you'll get your story soon.
You're a smart boy. Can I trust you to do as you're told?
I-I get it! I'm leaving now! Just... good luck with whatever you're doing!
I found him lurking around here earlier. Turns out, he was after a new story about the Restricted Ground.
Unlucky for him, he got tossed out by the "maintenance personnel" inside—if you know what I mean.
But don't worry, we should be fine with the identity pass.
The people inside are only getting paid to follow orders. They won't pay much attention to us.
And if they do get suspicious... well, guess we'll just have to improvise. That sounds good to you?
You seem pretty excited, Dr. Lychill.
You seem pretty excited, Dr. Lychill.
Do I? Come on, let's move. Once we're in, look closely for a way underground.
This is my assistant. Now, you were saying... that there were people inside for some safety maintenance?
You meet Guanfeng again, who is out collecting wind, and learn from him that a group of people is blocking others from entering the school building under the guise of safety inspections.
Accompanying line when Lychill and the player enter.
Hey, you sure our camp is safe?
I just want to make some coin, not die for it.
Then sign up for a field search then.
No one cares what you do out there.
But I heard the one we're after...
I just wish we could catch her soon.
Let's do another sweep outside the academy tomorrow.
I don't wanna see boss blow his top again.
What happened to the guys that messed up last time?
So you know, I just wanna make it out of this alive.
Can't believe I'm babysitting some stupid bats...
Should've never trusted those damn outsiders!
Yong agents? I don't buy it!
Just pay up and be done with it...
I'm never taking a job like this again!
A bunch of outsiders, acting all mysterious every single day!
zh_text: 一群外地人，天天神秘兮兮的！
source_text: 一群外地人，天天神秘兮兮的！
official_target_text: A bunch of outsiders, acting all mysterious every single day!
official_en_text: A bunch of outsiders, acting all mysterious every single day!

text: Can we really trust these critters to find a person?
It's the only way we can have our revenge...
And you lived to tell the tale?
Well, I barely got away. Shamefully.
She knew I was still alive...
So you took this job to thank her?
The bombs on the cages explode to unleash a swarm of bats into the air, throwing the entire place into chaos.
The bats! The bats are out!
Don't just stand here! Go check it out!
The cages are all broken... Ah-hem...
Hey! Why did the lights go out? Someone check it!
Just the old system acting up again. Happened last time too.
Everybody don't move! Or we might hurt each other in the dark. I'll get someone to fix it!
Once the bombs go off and the bats are loose, those guys are going to panic. That's our chance to sneak in.
From what I saw, the entrance is guarded by another Mechcraft puzzle. We must solve it fast.
When we're down there, stay vigilant.
Looks like we need to reach a certain combination to light them all up.
Oh no, a trap!? Eh-hem, the fog's getting thicker...
Oh no, a trap!? Eh-hem, the fog's getting thicker...
That's... Chase? What's he doing here?
That's... Chase? What's he doing here?
Lychill suddenly appears, striking down enemies after unleashing the Blood Clan's power. After a fierce fight, she defeats all the bounty hunters and rescues you.
Keep coming... I'm only getting started.
Now... time to say good night!
Using quick wits and improvisation, you make it through the inspection without raising suspicion.
Hey, stop there! This area is off limits.
O-kay... You're good. Did you make sure no one followed you?
Of course. We know what we're doing.
Of course. We know what we're doing.
Wait... You came back empty-handed? Where are your bats?
We got attacked in our camp today. The bats fled and our antidotes got smashed.
So we had to go back and grab more equipment. Gotta fight back, right?
That was way too careless of you... Now get inside before our boss returns.
Hasn't been around for a few days now. You guys are so lucky.
What makes you think he'd tell me!?
He's probably out doing the search himself. That stupid fog rumor has made the job so much harder to do.
Enough talking! Just take what you need and go, okay? If you don't find the target, none of us is getting paid!
Who went to check the power? What's taking so long?
Breakdowns all time... Jixia Academy sucks.
Hope it's fixed before boss gets back.
And what was that sound just now...
Problems every other day—is this the standard of Jixia Academy?
zh_text: 三天两头出问题，稷下学院就这水平？
source_text: 三天两头出问题，稷下学院就这水平？
official_target_text: Problems every other day—is this the standard of Jixia Academy?
official_en_text: Problems every other day—is this the standard of Jixia Academy?

text: To infiltrate further, Lychill plans to blow open the cages holding the Crimson Bats in the compound to create a diversion.
Lychill and the player speak at the gate.
Best steer clear of them to avoid trouble.
Look, tight security over there. Must be the entrance to the underground.
I suppose we can't just walk up, right...?
I suppose we can't just walk up, right...?
Here, take these <001>small explosive devices</>. Courtesy of the School of Mechcraft.
Let's plant them on the Crimson Bat cages, then meet at the bushes near the entrance.
What if the explosions put them on high alert?
What if the explosions put them on high alert?
No worries. I know what I'm doing.
One more thing. See those guys in different clothes? They're probably the boss's henchmen.
Out of caution, Lychill asks that you return the way you came. Without waiting for your answer, she cuts the power. \nThe whole underground area plunges into darkness.
That's it. We can use this switch to disable all the Mechcrafts in the area...
I also found an old map showing that the path ahead will split in two—perhaps only one leads to the deepest layer.
I also found an old map showing that the path ahead will split in two—perhaps only one leads to the deepest layer.
It's possible... given how cautious they are.
So, what do we do next—
So, what do we do next—
Not "we." I will take care of the rest. Meanwhile, you should go back under the cover of darkness.
You've done enough. I should finish this alone.
The bats! The bats are out!
Don't just stand here! Go check it out!
The cages are all broken... Ah-hem...
I need to get out of here.
I need to get out of here.
Pretty tough, huh? You won't last long!
Can't even handle a kid...? Useless scrap!
Where can you go now, huh?!
Spill what you know, and I'll make it quick.
And careful, I want the kid alive.
You guys, get down here and fight!
Rebels... gotta deal with them first.
Rebels... gotta deal with them first.
They put a Mechanoid down here? I should take care of it quietly.
They put a Mechanoid down here? I should take care of it quietly.
I should get to the bat cage fast...
I should get to the bat cage fast...
The bats seem almost tame when locked up...
The bats seem almost tame when locked up...
The gas generator. I should destroy it.
The gas generator. I should destroy it.
Separated by falling rocks, you and Lychill decide to split up and press further into the depths.
And... no. I can't move it.
And... no. I can't move it.
Dr. Lychill, are you there? Can you hear me—
Dr. Lychill, are you there? Can you hear me—
Ah-hem. Can you hear me now?
Yes! How are you doing? Are you hurt?
Yes! How are you doing? Are you hurt?
Don't worry, I'm fine. The passage caved in just as I got in.
I'll keep heading down, and your path should lead to the lowest level too. We can regroup there.
For now, let's talk via the communicator. If anything goes wrong, you leave and don't wait for me.
You promised me before we left, remember?
It's okay, we're almost there. We just have to keep moving.
Did the power shutdown cause the tunnel to collapse?
Did the power shutdown cause the tunnel to collapse?
I ca— you hear...? ... behind th—!
They're activated! Now let me see what I can do.
They're activated! Now let me see what I can do.
The water's drained and the door just opened. What about you?
The water's drained and the door just opened. What about you?
Same. Down there should be where they keep the gas device. You've got to be careful!
We've lost contact... I must hurry now.
We've lost contact... I must hurry now.
Dr. Lychill! Her voice is coming from the other side...
Dr. Lychill! Her voice is coming from the other side...
I see light... There's a passage ahead...
I see light... There's a passage ahead...
You receive intermittent communications from Lychill; she seems to have encountered an accident. You decide to follow and check on the situation.
Can you hear me? How's it going on your end?
The whole place is underwater... and there are a few dead Mechcrafts.
The whole place is underwater... and there are a few dead Mechcrafts.
Maybe I can help with that... Hold on.
A blade polished through half-blood experiments... a blade that walks in the darkness.
zh_text: 一柄经由半血族实验打磨出的……游走于黑暗中的刀。
source_text: 一柄经由半血族实验打磨出的……游走于黑暗中的刀。
official_target_text: A blade polished through half-blood experiments... a blade that walks in the darkness.
official_en_text: A blade polished through half-blood experiments... a blade that walks in the darkness.

text: On the cliff, you regain consciousness. With everything finally settled. Lychill decides to share with you her past.
After waking, you speak with her.
Like when we first met, right? Only now... it's all over.
Are you feeling alright? I've fed you an antidote, and patched up your wounds.
That's good. Now let me tell you how things went.
After you fell, I made sure to capture every single one of them. They'll all get what they deserve.
It's all thanks to you, you know. Your efforts are what made it all possible.
But I... I just feel like there's still something left unanswered...
But I... I just feel like there's still something left unanswered...
I believe you already know the answer, don't you?
Look at this place. A hill on top of everything, away from all the noises and trouble.
No patients, no bats, no annoying bounty hunters... Just you and me.
Now, we have all the time in the world to talk. I'll tell you everything you wish to know.
Who were you before all this?
Can you tell me about yourself?
Then let me tell you a story. A story about... a heartless tool finding new life again.
You took care of all of them?
Was it you they were after?
I found a bounty notice down there. It mentioned a Half-Blood Clan agent from Yong...
I found a bounty notice down there. It mentioned a Half-Blood Clan agent from Yong...
Lychill tells you the truth behind this whole case and apologizes. After everything that's happened, perhaps she will finally get the life she truly wants.
When you live in the dark long enough, you'd develop a rather keen sense for danger.
You know what? I haven't even thought about it.
Anyway, I'm not gonna deny the truth...
Using others to achieve my own goals... I've become so used to that.
Been trying to change that since I came to Jixia, yet old habits die hard.
But I promise you, I'll never do something like that to you again.
That said, I can still count on your help in the future, right? When things are not dangerous?
What happens to making a change...?
What happens to making a change...?
But you're my little assistant—that's different.
You do know I didn't ask for that, right?
You do know I didn't ask for that, right?
So what are you planning to do next? Will something like this happen again?
So what are you planning to do next? Will something like this happen again?
The past will remain the past.
Oh, you think so? I'll take your word for it, then.
I know how it sounds, and you have every right to be upset.
Still, as a healer, I can assure you the toxin and the wounds won't leave any lasting damage.
You saving me in the wild, curing me... were those part of your plan, too? Just to get me on board?
You saving me in the wild, curing me... were those part of your plan, too? Just to get me on board?
That made it impossible for me to conduct the investigation alone... I needed an assistant—or rather, a partner.
Then there you were, lying unconscious in the wild.
That's a lot to take in...
I know... It's okay if you need more time.
Oh... I didn't expect you to say that.
I'll stay as the academy healer, of course. No matter what might happen...
Fuzi once told me that I'd find an opportunity for change here.
Before my path becomes clear... I think I'll be here for as long as it takes.
I'm glad you have an answer.
I'm glad you have an answer.
Not sure if it'll be final, but I'll take it for now.
You are really a curious kid, aren't you?
Well, let's just call it... hope for tomorrow.
There's one last thing I'd like to do with you. Come with me.
Remember how it all got started? The rumor about the fog...?
Well... that was actually part of my plan.
So it was you that made that up in the first place?
So it was you that made that up in the first place?
<001>"Setting the right bait,"</> remember? That's how you hunt your prey.
So you knew all along they were after you?
So you knew all along they were after you?
When I first came to Jixia, I promised Fuzi I'd take care of my own troubles.
Unfortunately, things didn't go quite as planned...
I have a faint answer in mind, but it's still far from enough.
I made enough noise, and those guys would panic and mess things up themselves.
You may not know it, but the bats' toxin is hundreds of times more harmful to the Half-Blood Clan. To me.
So yes, I saved you—with a purpose.
Anyway, our mission is official complete now.
Even after all this time, my past is still trying to catch up with me...
It's just shadow of the sun.
You wake up on Lychill's lap.
Lychill invites you to release the remaining Crimson Bats back into the wild. \nNow that this has ended, she suggests you two keep it a secret of your own.
What do you think will happen to her?
No matter what happens, it's only getting better from here.
No matter what happens, it's only getting better from here.
Let us keep it as our own little secret.
These bats may have been tools of others, but now they're finally free.
After today, I'm sure it is.
If you ever need my help... you know where to find me.
For patients that don't behave, perhaps I should give 'em something stronger? *Chuckle*
Potions are fascinating. Just one drop may be enough to save people or... *Chuckle*
Those who seek immortality will only be bound by it...
Why won't they show up for their physicals? I mean, are they afraid of me?
I became a doctor because there are patients to heal. That's all there is to it.
I do hope the kids can behave... Hmm, when was the last time I took a day off?
(Idle Animation 2) Breath effort sounds while playing with energy.
(Idle Animation 3) Breath effort sounds while examining the weapon.
(Idle Animation 1) Breath effort sounds while playing with potions.
You find a Jixia map marked with many locations and speculate that the mastermind might be using the bats' Trait to scan the area in order to find someone.
From the looks of it, they are still trying to narrow things down.
From the looks of it, they are still trying to narrow things down.
A map of the Jixia Mountains... Are they using these marks to track the bats?
A map of the Jixia Mountains... Are they using these marks to track the bats?
Why do you think they care about where the bats go?
Maybe... they want the bats to find something for them?
Maybe... they want the bats to find something for them?
Someone, to be exact. One that only these bats can identify.
Now aren't you an observant one? Let's see if we can find anything else that's useful here.
You find a Jixia map marked with many locations and speculate that the mastermind might be using the bats' Trait to scan the area in order to find someone.
When odd coincidences occur too often, they're no longer coincidences.
So the figure I saw in the fog... Maybe there really was someone there?
So the figure I saw in the fog... Maybe there really was someone there?
Judging by the quantity, they were prepared for more than one person.
That's likely. Hmm... no brewing equipment here. They must have another hideout.
These potions were crafted in a way unique to Yong. Some match the stuff on the bats, while the others... are antidotes.
And I also spotted something else. Come here.
A Jixia Academy pass? So the bats' owner is from the academy?
A Jixia Academy pass? So the bats' owner is from the academy?
Its material and writing are slightly different from the real thing, but one can hardly tell at a glance.
I must say whoever did this was really good—not good enough to fool me, though.
Alright, let's go over what we've learned.
The bats' numbers don't add up. How about you?
Lost a bunch, too. These things are useless. Shoulda just grabbed a couple students as hostages!
No, no, no! The boss said we can't alert the academy!
I know! Constantly following orders... I'd rather fight freely like I used to!
The pay isn't even enough to shut your complaining mouth! Hey, you can't even restore the Mechcraft!
Pretty sure I did. Well, who cares if someone finds out, we're "officially" here anyway!
Wait, wait! Let's talk this over...
Who's there?! What do you want?
What's that hanging on the wall...
This should be the right place, but no one's home.
Let's look around. There might be some clues we can find.
Mechcraft doors like this usually have multiple switches, and they should be inside the cave.
If it were me, I'd hide them in concealed corners or up high.
Together, you find out about the bats' owner's true intentions. A noise suddenly comes from outside the cave, so you hide quietly.
Starting with the clues we found...
It's all quite clear. <001>One or a few people from Yong are using Crimson Bats to secretly track down someone in Jixia.</>
So the other victims and I were just... unintended consequences of their search?
So the other victims and I were just... unintended consequences of their search?
This whole thing reeks of conspiracy... What do you think?
They came all the way from Yong...
And just for this secret operation. Whoever is behind this really wants to get this done.
Such caution... They must know whatever they're doing is forbidden by the academy.
To be hunted by Crimson Bats and still get away... their target must be quite skilled at covering their tracks.
Now, let's have a nice little chat with our new friends.
Are you alright? Did the toxic fog...
Are you alright? Did the toxic fog...
I'm fine. Don't worry about me.
Accompanying line after breaking the wall.
The place is locked... they're definitely hiding something.
But I'm sure you can find a way to get the gate open, right?
You overhear that these people intend to cause trouble in Jixia. Lychill suggests subduing them first to gather more information.
Let's see what they're doing here.
The bats' numbers don't add up. How about you?
Lost a bunch, too. These things are useless. Shoulda just grabbed a couple students as hostages!
No, no, no! The boss said we can't alert the academy!
I know! Constantly following orders... I'd rather fight freely like I used to!
The pay isn't even enough to shut your complaining mouth! Hey, you can't even restore the Mechcraft!
Pretty sure I did. Well, who cares if someone finds out, we're "officially" here anyway!
This is our best chance to find out the truth. We can't let them get away.
This is our best chance to find out the truth. We can't let them get away.
A little violence might get us more information.
You wake up in the Herb Garden, and after learning the situation, you decide to check in with the other patients first.
Waking up in the Herb Garden...
You're awake. Want me to explain what happened?
Is this... the Herb Garden? And you're... Miss Perilla?
Is this... the Herb Garden? And you're... Miss Perilla?
That's right. And I was the one who saved you from Dr. Lychill.
Anyway, you ran into that strange fog too, didn't you?
The academy has decided that all patients shall receive treatment here. So you'll be staying with us for a few days. Okay?
Miss Perilla, could you come here for a second...
Your treatment starts tomorrow. Get some rest and don't wander off.
Many victims have suffered different symptoms. Getting all of you together can help us understand the situation better.
So just stay here and don't try to sneak out. I'd be rather upset otherwise.
She transferred you here as required by protocol. I'll be overseeing your treatment from now on.
Don't worry, our Toxineers are already working on an antidote.
Oh, yes. Her way of medical care can be a bit... "devious" sometimes.
You feel that Lychill sent you here to gather more information, so you decide to ask other patients about the situation first.
Dr. Lychill sent me here on purpose... so I could talk to other patients?
Dr. Lychill sent me here on purpose... so I could talk to other patients?
And the map she gave me... Is it so that I can narrow down the spread of the fog?
And the map she gave me... Is it so that I can narrow down the spread of the fog?
You feel that Lychill sent you here to gather more information, so you decide to ask other patients about the situation first.
Dr. Lychill? What brings you to the Herb Garden?
If it isn't Dr. Lychill! I was just thinking about asking you for some advice!
Didn't Miss Perilla say... uh, Dr. Lychill? What are you doing here?
You are... What are you doing here at this hour?
Dr. Lychill? What are you doing here?
Chase, what are you doing here this late?
I heard all the patients have been transferred here, so I figured I'd stop by for a visit.
Actually... I started my own investigation because a friend of mine fell sick after running into that fog.
I've been updating her on everything I've learned. To help with her recovery.
But after my own brush with the fog, I realized just how dangerous the whole thing really is. So I...
So I'm here to talk to her again. To see if there's anything else I can learn about the fog.
Still haven't given up, have you? I thought the kids at the Secrets Club were smart.
And you know what smart people do? They'd stay away from danger they cannot handle. Don't you agree?
I promise you, your friends here will be cured soon enough. It's late. You should head back.
Right. I suppose I should find a safer topic to work on...
Start a column, and rewrite the whole thing... ugh!
Anyway, I'll worry about that later. See you, Dr. Lychill!
I've wasted enough time. Better hurry and shut down that waterwheel.
Well, if it isn't Dr. Lychill. What brings you to the Herb Garden at this hour?
Just taking care of a few things...
I'd better stay here until nightfall.
I'd better stay here until nightfall.
The night fades, and the sun rises...
The night fades, and the sun rises...
And it's about time we set out.
Perilla isn't surprised by your disappearance. After reading Lychill's note, she understands what happened the previous night and chooses not to pursue the matter.
Miss Perilla! The patient admitted yesterday is gone! And I found the remains of a Moonelia Sprout and this note...
Got it. You can go back to your job now. Thanks to a "dear friend" of ours, we'll be getting quite busy.
<001>"Consider your favor returned. You're welcome."</> So you figured out why I kept you out of this...
But if you want to take matters into your own hands, that's your business.
And my favor? Don't flatter yourself! I don't care about you that much!
<001>“I appreciate the gesture, but let’s call it even—no thanks needed.”</> It seems they’ve guessed why I didn’t let them participate in the treatment...
zh_text: <001>“好意心领了，礼尚往来，不用谢”</>。看来是猜出我不让你参与治疗的原因了……
source_text: <001>“好意心领了，礼尚往来，不用谢”</>。看来是猜出我不让你参与治疗的原因了……

official_en_text: <001>“I appreciate the gesture, but let’s call it even—no thanks needed.”</> It seems they’ve guessed why I didn’t let them participate in the treatment...

text: Good intentions? What good intentions? Stop being so conceited! Who's worried about you!
zh_text: “好意”？什么好意，少自作多情了！谁担心你了！
source_text: “好意”？什么好意，少自作多情了！谁担心你了！
official_target_text: Good intentions? What good intentions? Stop being so conceited! Who's worried about you!
official_en_text: Good intentions? What good intentions? Stop being so conceited! Who's worried about you!

text: Lychill takes you directly out of the Herb Garden to continue your investigation.
So I just leave without telling Miss Perilla? Is that okay?
So I just leave without telling Miss Perilla? Is that okay?
Oh, don't worry! She's used to it by now.
The patients are recovering as expected. Now we can finally head out for our investigation.
Come on. Let's meet up at the forehill.
Lychill takes you directly out of the Herb Garden to continue your investigation.
Maybe the other patients can help me locate the fog.
Maybe the other patients can help me locate the fog.
Lychill discovers something else in the Herb Garden that is affecting the treatment. She plans to handle them on her own while you make your way to the mountaintop.
The little assistant has set out for the cliff...
I think there's still enough time for me to deal with the problem.
There's definitely something else here that's been affecting the treatment...
This strange smell in the air... How come no one has noticed?
Too bad I have plans for tonight.
Can't play with you for too long.
Solo dialogue—only you in the scene.
So many people out here at this hour. Those Herbalists really should learn about healthy routines...
If they notice me, they'll want to chat. Might even bring Perilla over.
I should go around and <001>avoid them.</>
We don't have much time. It's all on you now.
Now I should go shut down that waterwheel.
My assistant's waiting. Better hurry to the waterwheel.
I should take a detour. Don't want no trouble now.
Students here too. I'd better take a detour...
Ah, got a little carried away there.
A little surprise for you, Perilla...
You meet up with Lychill on the cliff and finalize the subsequent plan. \nYou sit side by side until the first light of dawn.
Well, since you're my assistant, it's only right I ensure your safety.
Oh? So you're curious about our story?
Perilla is a brilliant healer. I don't doubt she'll find a way to cure the patients. As for the real reason, though...
Great job. And the old medicine?
Perfect. I'll pass it to Perilla later.
Once I've checked on the patients tomorrow, we'll be ready to leave.
Mostly thanks to you, I do. Let's see...
Before we set out, here's something for you.
Don't worry. I have that covered.
I made you an antidote sachet based on Perilla's research notes. You should be okay with this.
Come and sit for a while. We won't have much chance to rest once we set off.
After all that work... funny to think the real investigation hasn't even begun.
Do you know where we should go?
Do you know where we should go?
The fog seems to have always appeared near Jixia Forehill... We can start our search there tomorrow.
While we still have some time... Anything you want to talk about?
What happened between you and Perilla?
I suppose it does look like things are a bit tense between us. Well, it started... not long after I got this job.
We had some disagreements on treatments and stuff, and we've stopped working together as much.
Privately though, I'd still call us friends.
That said, she's never refused my help like this time before.
Why? Wouldn't things be easier if you worked together?
Why? Wouldn't things be easier if you worked together?
Well, some people might think she still resents me for taking the position as the academy healer.
I did apologize once, you know. "Oops, sorry about that! Never thought they'd pick me!" But she didn't seem to take it well.
Teasing her now and then is kind of fun, though.
Well... that didn't sound like an apology to me...
Well... that didn't sound like an apology to me...
Of course it was. From the bottom of my heart.
They will. I've been working on this cure for quite a while now. Done countless tests.
And with your help, the last missing piece got to be filled.
The medicine you replaced will work. Have some faith in me, and in our efforts, too.
I was sleeping over half of the time...
I was sleeping over half of the time...
It's alright. That actually made my tests easier... A-hem, I mean, clinical observation.
Then let's rest while it's still dark.
Best to avoid running into anyone.
Automatically triggers after the black screen.
So you all saw shadowy figures in the fog... and it all happened at night... I see.
So you all saw shadowy figures in the fog... and it all happened at night... I see.
I wonder when this will end... If you ask me, I'll be good to go as long as the symptoms are gone.
But what if we're not fully recovered? What if there's permanent damage?
Still better than sitting in herbal baths here all day. If this keeps up, I'll be marinated inside out.
Alright guys, let's all get back to bed before Wu Bai nags us again.
You should go back and get some rest, too. And don't get caught by Miss Perilla if you ever try to sneak out.
Now... how am I supposed to contact Dr. Lychill from here?
Now... how am I supposed to contact Dr. Lychill from here?
Well done. You're not upset I gave you up to Perilla like that, are you?
Haha, I see. I promise it won't happen again, okay? So, have you met the other patients?
Yes, I spoke with them and marked all the locations where the fog appeared.
Yes, I spoke with them and marked all the locations where the fog appeared.
There are too many eyes in the Herb Garden during the day. I'll come find you tonight.
Seems I'll have to wait until dark to meet with Dr. Lychill again.
Seems I'll have to wait until dark to meet with Dr. Lychill again.
Good. Knew I could count on you.
She'll force the bitterest medicine down your throat, and... Trust me, you won't like it.
Oh hey! You're new here, right? Feeling a bit scared on your first day? No worries, you can ask me anything!
Uh... sure. Have you been here long?
Uh... sure. Have you been here long?
Well, I got sent here a week ago. Earlier than the other two... Why haven't the Fogdwellers come for me yet?
Fogdwellers... so you saw shadows in the fog too?
Fogdwellers... so you saw shadows in the fog too?
As the fog expands, the Fogdwellers will silently drag us all into their dark, misty realm! *Cough*
Found another newcomer to spook, huh? You should really give it a rest.
It's fine. We're all doomed anyway...
Oh, come on! Stop worrying so much! I've asked my friend at the Secrets Club to investigate. We'll have some answers in no time.
The Secrets Club... You mean Chase?
The Secrets Club... You mean Chase?
You know him? Wait, don't tell me he was the reason why... you ended up here?
Haha, so the Secrets Club failed, too... I should go write my will.
The investigation is not over yet. In fact, I wanted to ask you about what happened.
The investigation is not over yet. In fact, I wanted to ask you about what happened.
Can you tell me everything you remember about the fog? And mark its location on this map?
Can you tell me everything you remember about the fog? And mark its location on this map?
Come on, it's not like we have anything better to do. I'll go first. That night, I was about to...
“The person in the fog”... You saw a figure in the fog too?
zh_text: “雾中人”……你也在雾里看到人影了？
source_text: “雾中人”……你也在雾里看到人影了？
official_target_text: “The person in the fog”... You saw a figure in the fog too?

text: Hey, it's been a whole day. Miss me already?
And more importantly, how's your recovery?
Haven't seen you in a day, did you miss me?
zh_text: 一天不见，有没有想我呀？
source_text: 一天不见，有没有想我呀？
official_target_text: Haven't seen you in a day, did you miss me?
official_en_text: Haven't seen you in a day, did you miss me?

text: You reunite with Lychill, who wants to treat the other patients before continuing the investigation. She will shut down the waterwheel, while you take the opportunity to swap the medicine on it.
Your undercover mission is almost over. Perilla hasn't noticed anything, has she?
No, I don't think so... Oh, right, take the map. All the fog locations have been marked on it.
No, I don't think so... Oh, right, take the map. All the fog locations have been marked on it.
Well done. But before we head out, there's one more thing we need to take care of.
To <001>treat the patients</>, of course. I'm still the academy's healer, remember?
Thanks to your help with the tests, I've created the right antidote. I know I'm not authorized to participate in treatments, but since the patients are right here...
That's right. Now here's the plan... I'll shut down the waterwheel temporarily, while you go up there and make the replacement.
Maybe, but if any of the Herbalists spots you sneaking around the waterwheel, Perilla will hear about it for sure. And then...
You might be stuck here taking meds for a couple more days. Is that fine with you?
Watch your step. If you fall off, I'll have a hard time explaining to Perilla.
Let's keep in touch via my Big-eye Owlet. When you're done, I'll send a little something to pick you up. Ready?
I see what Perilla's trying to do here. Using the <001>waterwheel</> to mix the medicine with the garden's spring water.
So from what you just said, Perilla's medicine is... on the waterwheel?
So from what you just said, Perilla's medicine is... on the waterwheel?
The approach is sound, the problem lies with the formula. She's too cautious about side effects, thus wasting the best window for treatment.
Don't worry, I know what I'm doing.
As a professional healer, I'll never take my work lightly. Trust me, okay?
You're just gonna trust me like that? I'm touched.
Haha, I'm not saying that. As a professional healer, I'll never take my work lightly.
Am I not still a patient...?
I cannot be in two places at once. So... pretty please? Consider this a warm-up for the real work.
Well, if you put it that way... Alright then.

In that case... maybe it's best if I don't do this.

So, what's the plan? Should we look for another fog?

text: I'm the real damage dealer in the Team of Stars.
Hmph, don't ever let those old ideas cloud your judgment.
Meng's War Tactics. A masterpiece only for war masters.
As a Discipline Overseer, my cannons speak louder than words!
Good thing there's no one like my dad here to nag me all the time...
A place away from my dad—this is freedom!
Hmm... (thinking) Got it! (Starts writing) Now we're talking! (Looks at it) Eh, wait... (Twists pen)
《Meng's Art of War》 is generally not lent out, unless you have a discerning eye.

text: Time for a change of pace!
I heard from the fireflies that you need help.
Are you ready? Fragrance and trouble are coming together!
Ding-dong! Your delicious treat has arrived!
A crisp opening and a loud entrance!
Woof! The good doggy friend is here!
Falling leaves return to their roots.
Let me blow you a new hairstyle!
In the forest... silence is strictly enforced!
Get into trouble together, face the consequences together—that's what partners do!
The world is too quiet, so we'll just have to blow up some excitement!
Don't ask who chose whom; we just hit it off!
Falling leaves and flying flowers. Rise! Break!
The forest does not welcome you!
Don't rush, there's plenty to eat!
You are my master in the broad sense; I am your master-goose in the narrow sense.
Heave-ho... Huh? Where did that little bird go?
Heave-ho... Dabai, the forest smells so fluffy today.
May the embrace of the forest protect all living things.
Doesn't it get tired from jumping all the time? Oh, wait, it's a mechanism puppet.
zh_text: 一直跳，不累吗？哦，这个是机关人来着。
source_text: 一直跳，不累吗？哦，这个是机关人来着。
official_target_text: Doesn't it get tired from jumping all the time? Oh, wait, it's a mechanism puppet.
official_en_text: Doesn't it get tired from jumping all the time? Oh, wait, it's a mechanism puppet.

text: Oh no, my budget is going to explode.
Do I look fit for these Mechcrafts?
Those tricks only fool children. I won't pay that price.
Don't think you can intimidate me with that weapon!
I can sense the killing intent in your moves, but I'm not fazed!
Honesty may bring you better prices. But lies are not tolerated.
You look new here. Are you here to explore? I have some maps that might be useful to you.
Another experiment begins. I must do better than last time.
Credits are not only a motivation but also a key to the unknown.
Credits? I've all invested in Mechcraft.
The essence of Mechcraft lies in practicality, not complexity. I want more people to see its value.
Each experiment brings us closer to success.
Credits won't wait for anyone. Put it off till tomorrow, and tomorrow, and there's always a tomorrow.
Aerflow Weaver, I will slowly uncover your secrets.
Mozi Mechanoid, I'm coming. A new invention is about to be born.
My new invention will definitely bring me more credits.
Every Aersilk Mechanoid is the embodiment of my wisdom!
As a Mozi Mechanoid woven from Aersilk, I could earn more credits by creating superior works for the academy.
Not enough credits, new inventions won't work either, need to put in more effort.
Your actions remind me of that challenge, but I won't let you succeed so easily!
You seem to enjoy wielding weapons, but I prefer wisdom and strategy.
For me, credits in Jixia are a necessary step to improve my Mechcraft skills. There is no room for slacking off.
If you're here to challenge, I won't go easy on you!
I've seen it all. Your little tricks won't get to me.
This table can't handle your weight.
Every detail matters. Challenging Mechanoids is a test of oneself.
The path of martial arts is treacherous, but I shall press on with courage!
My master always says, practice makes perfect. I won't stop training today.
Nice moves, but they're not enough to shake me.
Are you here to challenge or cause trouble? I'm ready for you!
Don't be fooled by my age. I've come a long way in Martial Arts.
Please make way, I need to continue moving forward.
You look deep in thought. Maybe I should sit down and think about something too.
Dai Ran, can this autonomous tech carry passengers?
Sure, you can even find your own parking spot!
That's so convenient. No more worrying about parking spots.
Yeah, I'm working on a self-fueling system with Aerflow.
That way, you could travel nonstop, right?
Theoretically, yes. But we'll have to see how it works in practice.
This autonomous design is like the kite I made, moving with the wind while remaining steady.
That would require a precise wind direction prediction system, right?
Of course, there are also sensors woven from Aerflow.
Sounds high-tech, but what about the cost?
We're working to reduce costs and make it more affordable.
Can't wait to ride it soon, so I don't have to drive myself.
Your expectation is my biggest motivation, Ying!
Quan Ying, do you think future trains will still need drivers?
If the Craft Society's techniques are reliable, there's no need.
We've been working hard on it. I believe it won't be long before we succeed.
Perhaps we should rethink our rules?
Exactly. We'll have to teach them to follow the rules.
The future streets will be a battleground of wits.
This Mechcraft woven from Aersilk is truly ingenious. Even Chang'an artisans would envy it.
I'd heard of Jixia before, but seeing these Aersilk Mechcrafts with my own eyes is truly astounding.
Aersilk-woven clothing is light and breathable. This craft could bring in a fortune.
I think both have their strengths, it depends on the purpose.
Purpose? It flies high and sees far. Isn't that purpose enough?
But sometimes stability is important too, isn't it?
Stability is important, but I'm more concerned with observing distant star phenomena.
Then just use a flying Mechcraft. Who says Mechcrafts are unstable?
Haha, you two are too stubborn. Both walking and flying have their own charm.
You land Mechcrafts move as slow as turtles!
But we're safe and reliable, unlike you who fly fast but might fall and die.
I'm more concerned about how to protect the ruins from damage.
Safety is important, but efficiency and vision are also crucial.
Efficiency is life, flying Mechcrafts are the way!
It depends. Not every place is suited for flight.
Yes, we need to find the best solution.
Do you think Mechcrafts could play a significant role in archaeological excavations?
Ha, that depends on the design. If I were to design flying Mechcrafts, they would definitely outperform land ones.
They both have their advantages. Land Mechcrafts are superior in terms of stability.
Ultimately, any Mechcraft that helps us better understand this world is a good one.
As long as it helps me fly higher and farther, that's all that matters.
It would be awesome to use Mechcraft in hunting!
If only there was a Mechcraft device that could lead me to that Red Falcon.
If Mechcrafts could keep watch, my hunting trips would be so much easier!
The ingenuity of this Mechcraft seems to offer a glimpse into the secrets of the future.
I always learn something new from watching these students. Learning truly knows no end.
The bamboo abacus they use is my envy. It's incredibly accurate but lacks the complexity of Mechcraft.
I like your spirit, but here, not everything can be solved by fists.
Impressive move, but save the showing off for someone else.
Resting here? Stop loafing and get to work.
Their creativity knows no bounds. I couldn't learn that from the old masters.
Chang'an's bronze birds are no joke. With Aersilk, wouldn't they fly even farther?
If we combined Aersilk with Chang'an clocks, time would surely gain rhythm.
If I could merge Mechcraft with Aersilk, the market in Chang'an would go wild!
Dreaming of cooking with Mechanoids, how wonderful.
I heard cooking robots can outdo me. I must see for myself!
Remember that Mechanoid? Its cooking moves were so smooth. Too bad it's nowhere to be found now.
Every gear exudes wisdom, every trace embodies artisan spirit.
The intricacies of Mechcrafts in these toys are truly remarkable.
Every piece carries the craftsman's sweat and wisdom.
Such behavior will only make it hard for you to find your place in Jixia, young one.
Hmph. You think you can impress me with this little trick?
Excuse me. I don't have time for games.
The cannon workshop here is world-class.
Every nation's Mechcrafts have their own unique features. I need to absorb these essences.
A strand of Aersilk from a distant land, remarkably fine.
That's quite unique, but I don't get it.
Are you challenging me? Prepare to face the consequences!
Every Mechcraft holds its own wisdom and story.
Oh my, my friend, you're blocking my way. Are you looking for a challenge?
The power of Aerflow is truly amazing, with applications in so many fields.
Yes, the School of Mechcrafts is the best user of Aerflow.
Not just Aerflow, our Mechcrafts also incorporate many Sorcery techniques.
I'll work even harder to become a Sorcery master!
Scholars, please behold our newly developed Aerflow Generator.
Simple. It converts the flow of Aerflow into power.
It's a significant improvement over previous models, a major breakthrough for us.
Marvelous! This will be incredibly helpful for our Mechcraft research!
Look at this Mech Core, it's so exquisitely designed!
It's our latest development, capable of greatly improving efficiency.
Not bad, but it could be better if it incorporated more Sorcery principles.
Well said. I think we should consider the Sorcery elements as well.
I'll have my team consider the possibility of integration.
Then we'll have more opportunities to work together.
I've seen many Aersilk energy crystals, their energy is truly a marvel.
Every process requires meticulous refinement to unlock the true potential of Mechcrafts.
Aersilk energy is both exquisite and powerful, and it requires careful study.
May Aersilk guide me to the perfect balance.
Every detail must be flawless. The beauty of Mechcrafts lies in its intricacy.
Stay alert. Any unusual sounds could be a threat.
Precision is key when crafting Mechcrafts. My reputation's on the line.
I must ensure these parts are connected flawlessly, no room for error.
These gears are important. Don't lose them.
The stable operation of the Aersilk Picker is crucial. No room for error.
All Mechcrafts operate under certain principles and laws, and I must delve deeper into their workings.
Let's talk things out, I think there's a misunderstanding.
The flow of Aersilk is as unwavering as my duty.
Are you trying to be rude or just being rude? Watch out or I'll teach you a lesson!
Don't bump into me unless you want a taste of my wrath.
If I ever get to fight a true master one day, I'll know my training has been worthwhile.
My muscles need a challenge from a Mechcraft expert like you.
This Mechanoid looks sturdy. I'll have to test it with a punch later.
I need to organize these experiment data.
I need to study these designs carefully. There can't be any mistakes.
I'm trying something new, hoping for a breakthrough.
Please put down your weapons. This isn't the arena.
Do you really think you can earn respect by swinging your swords? Pathetic!
May I assist you with something? You're blocking my path.
The Aerflow is unusually clear today. Stay safe.
Don't belittle rules, they exist to maintain order.
Remember, safety first. Don't take any unnecessary risks.
Before you wield your weapon, unleash your mind.
Draw your blade. Perhaps your will shall be proven here.
I don't welcome people who block my way.
Are you sitting comfortably? Want me to teach you some postures?
The safety features of our Mechcrafts have been significantly enhanced this year.
Safe? I ended up on my back last time.
Don't worry, our Mechcrafts won't let you fall. They're very sturdy.
We've also taken flexibility into consideration. Feel free to give it a try.
That's a relief. I'm looking forward to the new Mechcraft!
Look at how intricately this Aersilk is woven. Our Mechcraft is impeccable.
Really? I don't want to get hit by any Mechcrafts during training.
Don't worry, this is much safer than your sparring matches.
Well, I trust Mechcrafts more than real opponents.
We'll keep refining to ensure the Mechcrafts function flawlessly.
I paid special attention to the safety of this Mech Core.
Haha, just don't hurt me again.
Don't worry. It's been tested many times.
Good, I don't want to be a test subject.
But the safety of a Mechcraft still depends on the user's caution.
Got it. I'll use it with care and never underestimate any opponent.
I need to teach these students that time isn't meant to be wasted.
Inspect every detail. A single flaw could affect the entire performance.
The quality of this Aersilk creation is such a headache. It never meets the requirements.
Drawing your sword—do you wish to duel? I won't hold back.
Hmph, bumped into me, huh? See if you can keep running amok in Jixia Academy now!
Your creativity is impressive, but remember, practice is the true test of any theory.
Do you think this new cannon Mechcraft would cause panic?
Panic? Ha, with enough firepower, panic never lasts.
Rest assured, the Cannoneers' techniques are top-notch.
Please consider the safety of my business.
Safety matters, but effectiveness is more important.
Don't worry, Taoliu. I'll ensure everything is safe.
Do you think that new cannon is over the top?
As long as it doesn't harm the people, it's fine.
Don't worry, I'll control it well.
I hope so. I don't want to get caught in a war.
New Mechcraft model. Curious about its gunpowder lethality.
Be careful. We can't let it get out of control.
Haha, don't worry. My cannons will blow your mind!
Stop bragging. What would you do if something really happened?
Guess what? I trained a Discipline Dog yesterday, and it helped me pick up things!
Exactly. Just remind them not to trigger those Mechcrafts.
I will! By the way, have you seen any suspicious people around?
Really? I'll keep an eye out. You be careful too.
Alright, I'll be careful. I'm a member of Aerwatch after all!
Haha. I feel much more at ease with you around.
The new Mechcraft dog is so cute! I thought they couldn't laugh.
Mechcraft dogs may not smile, but their efficient surveillance gives us peace of mind.
Exactly. They've made our job as Aerwatch much easier.
True, but we can't rely solely on them. We still need to stay alert.
Good idea. I'll check on the Discipline Dog now!
The new Discipline Dog is so smart, it can help with so many things!
Yes, but we must prevent them from falling into the wrong hands.
I'll teach them new commands and show you next time!
That's good. Anything for the academy's safety is worth it.
I'll do my best, I'm a member of Aerwatch after all!
How do you like the Aerflow Weaver display area?
Interesting, but I think the display could be more comprehensive.
It can display more information about the Aerflow conversion process.
The Aersilk exhibits are so exquisite.
Do you find our display layout reasonable?
The layout is nice, but it would be better with some Sorcery elements.
We'll consider incorporating works from the School of Sorcery.
Yes, like examples of how to use Telepathic Threads.
Good idea, I'll discuss it with my colleagues.
How do you think the Aersilk Weaver exhibition went this time?
Clever, but I'd rather see practical results.
We're constantly working to ensure every Mechcraft serves a purpose.
As long as I can practice Sorcery more comfortably, I'm satisfied.
I need to make sure these new Mechcrafts can work well in our fields.
I need to check if there are any new farm tools that can significantly boost productivity.
Agricultural Mechcrafts must be practical. I should take a closer look at these.
Ha! You dare to perform such petty tricks before me!?
Young one, wield your sword with care. Let not impulse cost you your life.
The market's full of all kinds of stuff—keep your eyes peeled.
If you want to talk, just say so. No need to use your body as a shield.
Whose wisdom could create such marvels? I must find out.
Omnicraft Garden is an ocean of knowledge. I must explore it thoroughly.
The exhibits at Wanqiao Garden are a veritable ocean of knowledge. I must explore them thoroughly.
zh_text: 万巧园的展示，简直是知识的海洋，我要好好探索一番。
source_text: 万巧园的展示，简直是知识的海洋，我要好好探索一番。
official_target_text: The exhibits at Wanqiao Garden are a veritable ocean of knowledge. I must explore them thoroughly.
official_en_text: The exhibits at Wanqiao Garden are a veritable ocean of knowledge. I must explore them thoroughly.

text: I'm curious about the story behind these Mechanoids. Their creator must be a genius.
Know your place before you challenge me.
I've been here for several days now, and it still feels like a dream. Everything in this garden is so novel and beautiful.
Are you... acting? Can I pretend I didn't see you?
The secret of Mechcraft lies in this small gear.
Watching these birds dance in the sky, I must invent a Mechcraft that can fly too.
Mechcrafts never cease to amaze, another new discovery today.
Please don't, I get scared easily.
I prefer peace over conflict. Please, go easy on me.
I heard someone is selling ancient Mechcraft designs at the market. What a rare treasure!
Don't think I don't know what you took. I'll tell everyone! Just wait!
Vandalism solves nothing. You need to respect others.
Oh, you're blocking my way, could you... let me pass? I'd really appreciate it.
Stop jumping on the table! I... I don't want anyone to get hurt.
Can't you see I'm busy? Go away!
The rain sounds like the sky is playing music just for me.
Clear skies, gentle sunlight, today is perfect for an adventure.
Raindrops falling on the garden soil, as if telling a story.
Oh, hello there. You look deep in thought. What are you thinking about? I can help you grab a book.
Today's design will surely help me craft something beyond the past.
I must ensure every gear is precise to complete the mission.
The world of Mechanoids, the fusion of machinery and art, I wish to dedicate myself to this.
That attack was just a test. Perhaps we can spar in another way.
Where the sword points is my land. Please halt.
Please... step aside. I need to leave.
Wow, can this flying Mechcraft really take to the skies? It's so cool!
Of course. It's designed based on real flight principles.
I want to study how it works and make one for myself someday!
Sure, start small. Like a model airplane.
Well, I'll start with a small plane and take it one step at a time!
Look at this. It's a Mechcraft Kite, and it can fly in the sky.
Sure, but be careful not to let it fly too far.
I get it now. I'll make sure everyone sees my flying Mechcraft!
Then let your Mechcraft be today's star!
Haha, I'm already imagining how it'll look in flight!
Look at this little Mechanoid. Isn't it amazing?
Yes, every gear is carefully designed, so the little Mechanoid can do a lot of things.
I want to invent something that makes kites fly higher and farther!
Great thinking! You'll make a renowned inventor someday!
Hehe, guess I'll start with these Mechcraft toys then!
We're always running out of basic materials woven by Aerflow.
Yeah, we need to cut the cost. It's expensive.
I've been testing new Aerflow extraction methods. It might boost productivity.
Great! Our work will be even more detailed now.
Yes, I can't wait to start new experiments.
Don't forget to take me with you, I'm interested in your new method.
Of course. Let's work together, for the future of the Craft Society.
The quality of these Mechcraft parts has been getting worse. It's so frustrating.
Yeah, but don't worry. I got my ways. The quality is guaranteed.
Really? You gotta introduce me then!
Of course, we must uphold the reputation of the Craft Society.
Exactly. I was thinking of using these parts to improve the transportation device.
Let's go together. Maybe we'll find some inspiration.
Zheng Zixuan, I bought new parts yesterday, and they work amazingly well!
Really? I'd like to try it too. Can I take a look?
Sure, I was planning to buy more. Wanna come along?
Sure, I happen to need a few key parts.
Fantastic! With these new components, our work will surely reach new heights!
My Mechcrafts are built with top-notch materials. You can't find better ones elsewhere.
Look at this exquisite detail. True artistry!
My goods are not just items, they're works of art. Take your time to appreciate them.
I'm open to making new friends, but not in a violent way.
Lay down your weapon, let's find peace.
Step aside! Your ignorance is nauseating.
You look extraordinary. My Mechcrafts are no ordinary items.
Dabai is deep in the effects of the stimulant potion, stubborn and hyperactive. You and Nivie decide to wait for the effects to wear off before talking to him again.

text: Thinking about my days working makes me black out. Better to stick with the boss.
We've been walking for so long, don't you want to take a break, Boss?
The blurring of boundaries between work and life is the true misery of the world.
With the boss looking out for me, being a proper good-for-nothing bird is quite comfortable.
Why is it that even as a bird, I can't escape the fate of being a beast of burden?
Sometimes I just want to go home and farm... wait, I don't know how to farm.
I'm not a lazy bird... Wait, I am a lazy bird now!
I really regret not slacking off more back then...
Working has left me all rusty... Good thing I followed the boss.
Chirp! Time to maintain my wings.
The flying competition champion is here... Chirp, just a minor slip-up!
Achoo! I'm fine, I'm fine, nothing happened!
Shake your legs, stretch your waist, focus on physical health.
Time to move around, or my body will rust!
Hop left, hop right... Boss, keep up with my moves!
Haven't exercised in a while... jumping around... is actually quite tiring!
After moving this brick, there's still... Squeak! Had a nightmare again!
Huff... huff... I wasn't sleeping, I was working!
Phew... I'm done with the odd jobs, but I still haven't slept enough.
So much work, I'll have to work overtime all night... Chirp! It really is a dream.
That was close, that was close, thank goodness it was just a dream... Chirp!
Is there anything fun here, chirps?
I heard it's very easy to find gold rings around here... How come I haven't found a single one?
Even though I'm not working anymore, I still have to stay alert for the boss's sake.
It's a whole different feeling when you're not working, chirp! Full of energy!
Boss, there seems to be something fishy around here... What's fishy? I don't know, chirp!
No work is a good chirp! No more back pain, no more sore waist!
Boss, the world is so big, I finally get to see it too!
A clear mind makes for a wide world, and no more working... That's how it goes, right, Boss?
Chirp... it's the taste of freedom!
It's here... my wings are about to smoke...
Kept up, kept up, finally kept up!
Boss, I hope I'm not late...
Go ahead, Boss! Don't worry about me!
Charge, Boss! I'll be right there!
You go first, Boss! I... I'll cover the rear!
Chirp—thank goodness, made it just in time.
Here! What are your orders, Boss?
Don't overwork yourself, Boss. I'm heading back now!
Work's done! Time to go home!
Time to go to sleep! Ahem, I mean, I'll head back first, chirp.
Chirp! Looks like... my skills haven't gotten rusty!
Heave-ho, nice, nice! My body feels so light now!
Front roll! Spiral lift-off! Ha, my agility is as good as ever, chirp!
No worries, just a little slip-up, chirp.
If you fall, you must get back up immediately!
I've seen Jixia at 4:00 AM, and it's just as cold as it is now...
My heart has long been calm; I no longer fear the biting frost.
Chirp! My shell doesn't change color just because of the cold.
Received, I'll fly right over to handle it... Terrible catchphrase.
Received, I'll be back in a jiffy... Oops, force of habit, chirp.
Boss, I'll help you, but I'm ignoring everyone else.
Good colleague, we meet again, chirp.
I didn't expect that so much time had passed since we parted ways. You've changed.
Really? You mean to say... I've become more prone to smiling?
Indeed, we are still as in sync as ever.
Chirp? This friend looks familiar, could it be...
Looks like another former colleague. Congratulations.
Since we both appeared here, it means we are the same—we are both free.
Stop it, I don't want to hear anything related to working.
It's like you read my mind... but the moment I see you, those scenes just automatically flood back into my head.
Same here... Let's not see each other for now.
It's been a while, you've changed a lot. Your shell even has a bit more luster.
You're the same—you move so much lighter now. Nothing like before, when you'd tremble with every flap...
Stop, stop, stop. Let's not reminisce about that.
Sigh, I want to get that memory out of my head too.
Years of working odd jobs have made me immune to all poisons.
Boss, my throat... almost forgot I'm immune to that.
Trying to make a living in such a stifling environment is no different from being trapped in poisonous miasma...
The little bird is here. You've come to visit, what can I do for you?
Hello... Greeting people with a smile has become part of my mechanical memory.
Hello, is there something you need?
Welcome home, Boss! Finally finished with work?
Home is the most comfortable! Sleep! Rest!
It's time to cast off this fatigue and just clear my mind...
Is the sky angry? Doesn't it get tired?
Boss, you're going out in this thunderstorm? Stay safe.
Thunder? I'm calling it a day... Sorry, just a habit.
I'm not afraid of fire, I'm afraid of the human heart.
Fire is so warm... nice and cozy... getting sleepy, cheep...
Bang—doesn't that sound like a heartbeat when you're pulling an all-nighter?
Is Boss working too hard? You seem flustered and shaky.
I understand this feeling of wanting to destroy everything.
Fishing doesn't require much movement. Seems like it suits me well.
Since that's the case, I'll just lie back and relax...
Boss, do you need me to accompany you with a retreat song?
I heard someone can summon a hundred birds by playing music. Why hasn't anyone summoned them for me?
It's rare to have some leisure time with the boss.
Can someone who makes a living by fishing still enjoy the pleasure of fishing?
Such leisurely time was once my lifelong dream...
Fishing is good! Slacking off is even better!
I also have an instrument I'm good at—the 'retreat drum'.
If it's just as a listener, I'm happy to do it, chirp.
This melody is dedicated to every soul that yearns for freedom.
Stop making those 'vital sign maintenance' meals. You can make something tasty over there.
I've suffered enough bitterness; let's have something good to eat today.
Working so hard every day, I should treat myself to some good food.
If you have any medicine for heart palpitations, prepare some for me too.
Add some liver-protecting herbs when making medicine...
Working so hard every day, I need to take some medicine to recover.
It looks alive, but it's actually been gone for a while.
Might as well just lie flat now. This is what you call a blessing in disguise, boss.
Even the heavens can't stand it anymore, take a break.
There's nothing to fear about thunder; endless work is what's truly scary.
Rumbling, why scare people for no reason.
Rumbling, is this... someone nearby brainstorming?
You did what I always wanted to do but never dared to...
I wish I could live as freely as you, chirp...
Was this intentional, or an accident?
These people... they're going to lose their jobs, chirp...
I didn't think your part-time job included serving food...
What dish is so good you have to jump on the table to grab it?
Playing chess is a nice sport, the kind that doesn't require much movement.
If you peck open the chess piece, what's inside?
On a chessboard, it's a piece; behind your back, it's a hidden weapon.
If I were a roast bird, I could just lie around forever.
This temperature isn't enough to affect my components...
Boss, if you don't come down soon, your shoes are going to suffer.
Even the most interesting things feel like work if you do them too much. Let's go play somewhere else.
Little fish, you can relax now.
Don't worry about the final result, just having fun is enough, chirp.
Your performance has received the approval of the 'Giving Up' virtuoso.
No need to be busy every day, and having the zither for company—life is pretty good right now.
This melody reminds me of the past, when I was young and naive...
Were you attacked by someone's bad joke?
Boss, stay warm while you're out working.
That's right. If I become cold and heartless, I won't get hurt again, right?
Sticking to the principle of taking whatever I can get, the more the better.
Boss, does your job include wilderness survival too?
Go ahead and take it, Boss, I'll keep watch.
Time to clock out... Doesn't that just make you feel fully restored?
What could have cost the boss such a heavy price...
It's fine, Boss. Worst case, we just lie flat.
Did someone accidentally drink some toxic chicken soup?
Since you've been poisoned, you might as well take the opportunity to lie down for a while.
Why is your complexion so bad? Did you rust too, Boss?
Go ahead, go ahead. Youth is great, so full of energy.
You want to spar now? I'm very weak...
Have mercy! My chassis isn't feeling well, I'd like to leave now.
Chirp, what occasion is the boss dressing up for?
Wearing my favorite new outfit makes me feel refreshed!
When people get annoyed enough, they get angry too.
I used to be full of passion and easily ignited, but now...
As expected of the boss, still full of fiery passion.
Chirp! This isn't good. How about we take a break here for a bit?
Boss is so busy, looking so haggard now.
Boss, if we can't win, don't force it. Let's just slip away.
You fight your fight, don't mind me, chirp.
Combat is such a physical chore, I'd rather just slip away, chirp.
On rainy days, one should stay in their cozy den and sleep.
This rain cannot dampen my enthusiasm. I'm not being sarcastic.
Who is it! Working in this wind and rain!
Why do I feel a strange sense of familiarity, chirp...
If the incense is always burning, doesn't it mean it's working every single moment? How miserable...
May life be this peaceful from now on...
I've got a belly full of old bitterness that even the sun can't dry out.
Clearing clouds to see the sun—just like how I feel now that I'm free.
An exhausted body can only be purified by sunlight.
The sun has clocked out, who's still working?
The sky turning gloomy must be everyone's resentment from working.
Gloomy weather is perfect for returning to the nest to sleep, chirp.
If I could, I'd really like to just sleep forever.
Working days were too exhausting, I don't even want to think about them anymore.
It's more comfortable to just be a useless bird.
Aren't you tired, Boss? Rest if you're tired.
Being human is so tiring. Boss, I feel for you.
New face? Are you here to see me?
I wish someone could carry me so I could just slack off!
I'm never going back to working. Not in this lifetime.
I don't want to move today... How about you come back tomorrow or the day after?
Accidentally entered power-saving mode... let's talk another day.
Chirp, is there something you need?
Poke, poke, poke... doesn't your hand hurt?
Clang-clang, clatter-clatter, does Boss want to hear this sound?
Life lies in stillness. Boss, stop poking me, let's rest.
Boss, no matter how much you poke me, I'll still react like this, chirp.
Boss, I'm sticking with you from now on!
I'm fine, I arrived just in time today.
Here! What are your orders, Boss?
Time for bed! Ahem, I mean, remember to get some rest too, Boss, chirp.
My fur stands on end whenever you get close! This is so not elegant!
zh_text: 一靠近你毛毛都炸开了，这样都不优雅了！
source_text: 一靠近你毛毛都炸开了，这样都不优雅了！

text: Beep, beep! There are so many things here I've never seen before!
Is this what freedom feels like? It's great!
You have to be careful when maintaining the shell!
Every day is a joy with you!
Beep, I like you! Every day!
Beep, beep! I will protect you!
My shell is the most majestic!
Beep, beep! Back in a flash!
Work hard, and you'll get praised!
Hold on, I'll be there in a bit.
I'm stuck! Wait for me, I'll be right there!
Coming! I need to go around this thing first.
I can't get through yet, please wait for me!
Going out to play is so fun!
Beep, beep! I'll bring back good things!
Beep, beep! I'm good at finding things, reliable!
I'll be back once I find something good!
Beep, beep! You're made of bronze too!
Beep, beep! We look exactly the same!
But my claws need to be a little bigger.
My previous home was a large ruin.
I'm here too. I've lived in the big hole for a long time.
But I really like my home now!
Because I met a very good person!
How do you usually take care of your shell?
Need to wipe it down, need to apply oil.
Also, try not to go out on rainy days.
The thunder is so loud! So noisy!
That's so loud! I don't like it!
Dangerous purple mist detected, stay away!
Strange purple mist, it's harmful to the body!
Beep, beep! I was just thinking about you, and here I am!
Beep, beep! Struck by lightning, emergency!
Underground, you can't even see the sun!
Beep, the clouds are blocking the sun.
The sky is dark and cold.
So much water, I don't like it!
It's so cold, I can't move!
Beep, beep! Danger, hold your breath!
You're not afraid of electricity? That's amazing!
Pretty outfit, it suits you so well!
Beep, beep! Good stuff, pick it up!
Beep, beep! Caught so many fish!
Feels great to come back with a full load!
I want to hear another one!
Beep, what fish will I catch this time?
Beep, be quiet when listening to music.
What kind of fish are here?
The trick to fishing is patience.
Want to play the zither? I love music!
Beep, listening to music makes me happy!
You can play the instrument, that's amazing!
Beep, you can make food over there!
Beep, do you need to eat?
If you aren't sick, you don't need to take medicine.
Beep, beep! Don't let anyone! Bully you!
A big table, set with food!
Beep, so tables are for stepping on!
Beep, beep! Standing so high, amazing!
Beep, beep! So many black and white stones, how fun!
There are so many little pebbles on the table. What are they for?
Beep, beep! So many squares, and black stones, white stones too!
Beep, beep! It's so hot here, is this a furnace?
Such a hot platform, what is it used for?
The platform is so hot, it's amazing!
Beep, beep! Take your medicine, take your medicine!
Beep, touching is a sign of closeness!
Beep, beep! Following you, protecting you!
Going out to play is so fun!
One strike and you're poor, one strike and you're rich, one strike and you're sleeping on a dirt road...
zh_text: 一刀穷，一刀富，一刀睡在小土路……
source_text: 一刀穷，一刀富，一刀睡在小土路……
official_target_text: One strike and you're poor, one strike and you're rich, one strike and you're sleeping on a dirt road...
official_en_text: One strike and you're poor, one strike and you're rich, one strike and you're sleeping on a dirt road...

official_target_text: This is obviously fake. Just tossing it for fun.
