text: Treasure hunting with Master is the best!
The key to bargaining is not fearing the other party's anger!
I love how the night sky sparkles with stars like diamonds.
Blue and red crystals, guess which is my favorite?
Gems are like candy, just one can make my day!
I've dominated the arena without a single defeat!
The whole point of competing is to win!
A celebration move exclusive to the champion!
Got it... Oops, that doesn't count!
Look, Master! I can throw it this high!
I can throw it even higher... Oops, dropped it!
Surely... no one would want to steal my trophy, right?
This trophy really suits the owner!
Such a beautiful trophy, who invented it?
Hehe, no one else has a trophy! Only I do!
Heehee, the trophy is so pretty!
I love my master first, and trophies second!
You can never have too many trophies!
The trophy is shiny and bright, it looks so good!
You can never have too many champion trophies!
Huli... this tanuki... is the strongest...
Master... I'll be just as amazing as you one day...
I'm a little bit stronger than I was yesterday!
This competition is a championship, and that competition... is also a championship!
I have so many trophies, hee hee.
We've won so many championships! It's okay to be a little proud, right?
Master, I was so worried about you!
That was dangerous. Did you find anything valuable?
Take care! I'll be waiting for you!
Something's off. Better hide for now!
Gem collecting time! Master, let's go!
Let's find the most beautiful gems!
Treasure hunting's exhausting. I need some rest.
Call me if you need anything!
Must find a safe place to hide the trophy!
Huh? Where did my trophy go?
If I hide the trophy here, no one will ever find it!
I'll make sure to protect the trophy!
If I don't hide the trophy well, I won't feel at ease!
Ice chunks sparkle like crystals, so sad they vanish in a jiffy.
Don't bring ice crystals near flames, or they'll melt and flee!
When sunlight touches ice, it shimmers with a rainbow of colors!
I'm the most skilled gatherer you'll ever find!
My master is the champion of champions!
My master is the greatest champion!
I don't accept this! Let's settle this!
Bring it on! This raccoon isn't afraid of you!
I don't care! My trophy is better!
You're bragging! I'm the most amazing one!
That's nonsense! I, the Tanuki, am definitely better than you!
Trophies should be with the most powerful people!
That's right! That's why I have so many trophies!
I have even more trophies than you!
I don't believe it. Let's compete!
I smell something dangerous. Better run.
Purple mist? This doesn't feel right.
It's poisonous! If I catch anything, you're paying up!
Wanna bring me gems as well?
Here to visit Master's home? Wanna check out my collection?
Welcome! To move forward, leave something valuable.
Master! I got a new gem for my collection!
While you were gone, I kept home safe, and nothing's missing!
As soon as this storm blows over, we'll collect even more gems!
A strike could uncover top-tier gems!
Those crackling little sparks are shiny too.
Those flames are blistering! Better run!
I'm going to take first place in the gathering competition too!
We'll definitely gather faster than anyone else! And get more!
Make sure to gather all of these, don't miss any!
Master, will we get fined for the damage? I'm penniless.
I love it when breaking things leads to unexpected surprises!
If Master were a Musician, you'd be rolling in fortune.
Sounds like pearls falling on jade plates, and gems colliding!
Yeah! Master's about to perform music!
As expected of Master, so talented!
Wouldn't it be splendid to embed some gems into that guqin?
I want to join the Cooking King competition!
Good medicine tastes bitter... I-I'm not afraid of taking medicine!
Master, if you become the champion, does that mean you don't have to take medicine anymore?
Champions don't need medicine! Because champions are the strongest!
That glittering thing over there, it's not a gem at all, it's a lightning monster!
So blue lightning monsters bite too!
No surprise Master has such foresight, standing so high.
Something fun on the table? Or perhaps there's a hidden treasure?
I can tell from here, it's just a plain old table.
Master must be starving. Sorry about that.
Master, if the food's bad, no need to make a scene. Just have them waive the bill.
Goodness, Master, come down. Surely I won't have to pay damages... right?
Smooth, warm, and pure-colored, this chess piece is made from fine material.
Mind your step. Doesn't the chess piece hurt your feet?
Chess pieces to actual fighting, huh?
Is Master bargaining? No need to stand so high.
I've seen it, this hot stand can forge incredible things.
Master, we can't afford it if you break it.
Why did you stop? I was enjoying the melody.
It makes me want to go on a treasure hunt!
Look, Master! Ice with hexagonal flowers!
Why won't ice grow on me?
Master, could you let the ice form a necklace on your skin next time?
Never knew you'd test toxins on yourself.
Are they trying to knock us both out and steal my gems?
Let's run. Wait, Master, are you feeling alright?
As expected of Master, shining like treasure!
Impressive! I can count on you now!
I'll train harder so I can be as capable as Master someday!
If there were a fashion contest, Master would surely rank at the top!
They bite. Poor Master, that must hurt.
Are those flames biting my Master?
Master is even better than a professional angler!
Master, is the fish you caught bigger than everyone else's?
Fishing actually seems kind of interesting!
Instead of fishing, I, the great Tanuki, prefer to race the fish in swimming!
Master, fishing takes such a long time...
If only there were fishing competitions too...
Master, did the lightning monster's bite leave you tingly?
We should collect gems that ward off lightning next time.
Watch out! I got near a lightning monster once, and my fur went wild!
You go, Master! Will there be a reward if you win? I want one too!
I'll bet a crystal on you!
With treasures as rewards, Master should to fight more!
A temporary setback cannot defeat the Master!
Adjust your state quickly, I won't let you lose!
Adversity is only temporary. We will never give up!
I once found a gemstone as big as a goose egg while hiding from the rain in a cave.
If only raindrops could transform into gems...
It's easier to find glittering stones after a good rain.
In the clear sky, the sun shines so brightly.
The sun shines, another good day!
Clear skies make everything shine like scattered diamonds.
Master, why do the clouds go all stony-gray on cloudy days?
Cloudy days feel suffocating, like I'm trapped in a cave.
Feeling as gray as the sky... I need to cheer up.
No one but my Master is allowed to touch my trophy!
My master is, of course, the greatest champion!
I love the feeling of winning!
The word 'lose' isn't in my dictionary!
You have to polish the trophy to make it shine!
You look strong! Come and compete with me!
Are you looking for me? You've got good taste!
Master, are you ready to head to the competition?
Master! Don't mess up my hair!
Don't worry, Master, I'll keep the trophy safe!
You're the most amazing person in my eyes, Master!
The champion's entrance pose must be flashy!

official_en_text: I dreamt of you just now. I'm so happy to see you when I wake up.

text: The home I cannot return to has blurred into the moon.
zh_text: 回不去的故乡，已经模糊成了月亮。
source_text: 回不去的故乡，已经模糊成了月亮。
official_target_text: The home I cannot return to has blurred into the moon.
official_en_text: The home I cannot return to has blurred into the moon.

text: Geese are born free, but sometimes they need to stop and think.
zh_text: 鹅生而自由，但有时需要停下来思考。
source_text: 鹅生而自由，但有时需要停下来思考。
official_target_text: Geese are born free, but sometimes they need to stop and think.
official_en_text: Geese are born free, but sometimes they need to stop and think.

text: Return to the dream, return to the dream that belongs to me.
zh_text: 回到梦中去吧，回到属于我的梦中。
source_text: 回到梦中去吧，回到属于我的梦中。
official_target_text: Return to the dream, return to the dream that belongs to me.
official_en_text: Return to the dream, return to the dream that belongs to me.

text: The harvested stems and leaves will turn into spring mud to nourish future flowers.
zh_text: 采撷过的茎叶，会化作春泥，滋养来日之花。
source_text: 采撷过的茎叶，会化作春泥，滋养来日之花。
official_target_text: The harvested stems and leaves will turn into spring mud to nourish future flowers.
official_en_text: The harvested stems and leaves will turn into spring mud to nourish future flowers.

text: Close contact with nature is one of the great joys of being a goose.
zh_text: 近距离接触自然，是鹅生的一大享受。
source_text: 近距离接触自然，是鹅生的一大享受。
official_target_text: Close contact with nature is one of the great joys of being a goose.
official_en_text: Close contact with nature is one of the great joys of being a goose.

text: Hello, honk. Are you a reflection of my inner self?
zh_text: 你好嘎，你是我内心的映射吗？
source_text: 你好嘎，你是我内心的映射吗？
official_target_text: Hello, honk. Are you a reflection of my inner self?
official_en_text: Hello, honk. Are you a reflection of my inner self?

text: Sorry, I've been confusing dreams with reality lately.
zh_text: 不好意思，最近入梦总是混淆现实。
source_text: 不好意思，最近入梦总是混淆现实。
official_target_text: Sorry, I've been confusing dreams with reality lately.
official_en_text: Sorry, I've been confusing dreams with reality lately.

text: Brother Goose, are you daydreaming while looking into the distance?
zh_text: 鹅兄，你看着远处是在发呆吗？
source_text: 鹅兄，你看着远处是在发呆吗？
official_target_text: Brother Goose, are you daydreaming while looking into the distance?
official_en_text: Brother Goose, are you daydreaming while looking into the distance?

text: Not at all, I am contemplating opposition and unity.
zh_text: 非也非也，本鹅在思考对立与同一。
source_text: 非也非也，本鹅在思考对立与同一。
official_target_text: Not at all, I am contemplating opposition and unity.
official_en_text: Not at all, I am contemplating opposition and unity.

text: Honk, the truth becomes clearer with debate.
official_target_text: Honk, the truth becomes clearer with debate.
official_en_text: Honk, the truth becomes clearer with debate.

text: When the rain comes, you are welcome to debate with me.
zh_text: 雨来临的时候，欢迎来找我辩论。
source_text: 雨来临的时候，欢迎来找我辩论。
official_target_text: When the rain comes, you are welcome to debate with me.
official_en_text: When the rain comes, you are welcome to debate with me.

text: Did we meet in a dream?
zh_text: 我们是在梦中相遇了吗？
source_text: 我们是在梦中相遇了吗？
official_target_text: Did we meet in a dream?
official_en_text: Did we meet in a dream?

text: No, we are both in reality. Master is still here.
zh_text: 不，我们都在现实里，主人还在呢。
source_text: 不，我们都在现实里，主人还在呢。
official_target_text: No, we are both in reality. Master is still here.
official_en_text: No, we are both in reality. Master is still here.

text: But my thoughts seem to still be stuck in the dream...
zh_text: 可本鹅的思绪好像还停留在梦中……
source_text: 可本鹅的思绪好像还停留在梦中……
official_target_text: But my thoughts seem to still be stuck in the dream...
official_en_text: But my thoughts seem to still be stuck in the dream...

text: It's okay, seize the moment and stand your ground.
zh_text: 没关系，把握当下，立足当下。
source_text: 没关系，把握当下，立足当下。
official_target_text: It's okay, seize the moment and stand your ground.
official_en_text: It's okay, seize the moment and stand your ground.

text: Hello, honk. Would you like to contemplate with me?
zh_text: 你好嘎，你愿意和我一起沉思吗？
source_text: 你好嘎，你愿意和我一起沉思吗？
official_target_text: Hello, honk. Would you like to contemplate with me?
official_en_text: Hello, honk. Would you like to contemplate with me?

text: All thoughts in this world will eventually fade with time.
zh_text: 世间种种思想，终会随时间消散。
source_text: 世间种种思想，终会随时间消散。
official_target_text: All thoughts in this world will eventually fade with time.
official_en_text: All thoughts in this world will eventually fade with time.

text: Not necessarily; both writing and language are ways to record thoughts.
zh_text: 并非如此，文字、语言都是记录思想的方式。
source_text: 并非如此，文字、语言都是记录思想的方式。
official_target_text: Not necessarily; both writing and language are ways to record thoughts.
official_en_text: Not necessarily; both writing and language are ways to record thoughts.

text: I see. We must create more valuable thoughts.
zh_text: 原来如此，我们要创造更多有价值的思想。
source_text: 原来如此，我们要创造更多有价值的思想。
official_target_text: I see. We must create more valuable thoughts.
official_en_text: I see. We must create more valuable thoughts.

zh_text: 本鹅嗅到了危险的味道。
source_text: 本鹅嗅到了危险的味道。

text: Master is back. I've been waiting for you.
official_target_text: Master is back. I've been waiting for you.
official_en_text: Master is back. I've been waiting for you.

text: Whose dream did the thunder wake?
official_target_text: Whose dream did the thunder wake?
official_en_text: Whose dream did the thunder wake?

text: Are there any treasures hidden inside?
official_target_text: Are there any treasures hidden inside?
official_en_text: Are there any treasures hidden inside?

text: Leave some behind, leave some room for maneuver.
official_target_text: Leave some behind, leave some room for maneuver.
official_en_text: Leave some behind, leave some room for maneuver.

text: You are not a fish, how do you know the joy of fish?
official_target_text: You are not a fish, how do you know the joy of fish?
official_en_text: You are not a fish, how do you know the joy of fish?

text: You are not me, how do you know I don't know the joy of fish?
zh_text: 子非我，安知我不知鱼之乐？
source_text: 子非我，安知我不知鱼之乐？
official_target_text: You are not me, how do you know I don't know the joy of fish?
official_en_text: You are not me, how do you know I don't know the joy of fish?

text: Fishing is about letting things take their course; you cannot force it.
zh_text: 钓鱼，就是要顺其自然，不能强求。
source_text: 钓鱼，就是要顺其自然，不能强求。
official_target_text: Fishing is about letting things take their course; you cannot force it.
official_en_text: Fishing is about letting things take their course; you cannot force it.

text: Honk, how did I end up by the water?
zh_text: 噫嘘嘎，鹅怎么会来到水边？
source_text: 噫嘘嘎，鹅怎么会来到水边？
official_target_text: Honk, how did I end up by the water?
official_en_text: Honk, how did I end up by the water?

text: Is that the scent of food? I won't eat; I must stay sharp to think.
zh_text: 那里有食物的香气？本鹅就不吃了，保持清醒才能思考。
source_text: 那里有食物的香气？本鹅就不吃了，保持清醒才能思考。
official_target_text: Is that the scent of food? I won't eat; I must stay sharp to think.
official_en_text: Is that the scent of food? I won't eat; I must stay sharp to think.

text: An alluring aroma. Are you hungry?
zh_text: 诱人的香气，可觉得肚饿？
source_text: 诱人的香气，可觉得肚饿？
official_target_text: An alluring aroma. Are you hungry?
official_en_text: An alluring aroma. Are you hungry?

text: Medicine can heal the body, but not the heart.
Herbs, like people, need to endure hardship to mature.
The scent of herbs there makes me feel refreshed.
You were actually struck by lightning? Am I still dreaming?
zh_text: 你竟会遭遇雷击？难道本鹅还在梦中？
source_text: 你竟会遭遇雷击？难道本鹅还在梦中？
official_target_text: You were actually struck by lightning? Am I still dreaming?
official_en_text: You were actually struck by lightning? Am I still dreaming?

text: Thunder gathered in one body—are you the chosen one?
zh_text: 雷霆万钧汇于一身，难道你是天选之人？
source_text: 雷霆万钧汇于一身，难道你是天选之人？
official_target_text: Thunder gathered in one body—are you the chosen one?
official_en_text: Thunder gathered in one body—are you the chosen one?

zh_text: 竟然遭遇了雷击？真是世事无常……
source_text: 竟然遭遇了雷击？真是世事无常……

text: Lightning and sparks in a dream, and now I see it today...
zh_text: 梦中电光石火，今日得见……
source_text: 梦中电光石火，今日得见……
official_target_text: Lightning and sparks in a dream, and now I see it today...
official_en_text: Lightning and sparks in a dream, and now I see it today...

text: Though I don't understand your behavior, I respect it.
zh_text: 虽然看不懂你的行为，但鹅表示尊重。
source_text: 虽然看不懂你的行为，但鹅表示尊重。
official_target_text: Though I don't understand your behavior, I respect it.
official_en_text: Though I don't understand your behavior, I respect it.

text: Food is the people's heaven, but doing this will get you hit, quack?
zh_text: 民以食为天，这样会讨打的嘎？
source_text: 民以食为天，这样会讨打的嘎？
official_target_text: Food is the people's heaven, but doing this will get you hit, quack?
official_en_text: Food is the people's heaven, but doing this will get you hit, quack?

text: To think you solved this chess game like that...
zh_text: 这局棋，竟是被你这样破解了……
source_text: 这局棋，竟是被你这样破解了……
official_target_text: To think you solved this chess game like that...
official_en_text: To think you solved this chess game like that...

text: Only by enduring the most extreme pain can one forge the sharpest blade.
zh_text: 只有忍受最极致的痛苦，才能打造最锋利的利刃。
source_text: 只有忍受最极致的痛苦，才能打造最锋利的利刃。
official_target_text: Only by enduring the most extreme pain can one forge the sharpest blade.
official_en_text: Only by enduring the most extreme pain can one forge the sharpest blade.

text: Life is fading, do you still have unfinished business?
zh_text: 生命在消逝，你还有未了之事吗？
source_text: 生命在消逝，你还有未了之事吗？
official_target_text: Life is fading, do you still have unfinished business?
official_en_text: Life is fading, do you still have unfinished business?

text: Everything is impermanent; life is slipping away.
official_target_text: Everything is impermanent; life is slipping away.
official_en_text: Everything is impermanent; life is slipping away.

text: You are my master in the broad sense; I am your master-goose in the narrow sense.
zh_text: 你是我广义上的主人，我是你狭义上的主鹅。
source_text: 你是我广义上的主人，我是你狭义上的主鹅。
official_target_text: You are my master in the broad sense; I am your master-goose in the narrow sense.
official_en_text: You are my master in the broad sense; I am your master-goose in the narrow sense.

text: This outfit suits you well; it makes me feel refreshed.
zh_text: 这件衣服很衬你，让鹅感觉焕然一新。
source_text: 这件衣服很衬你，让鹅感觉焕然一新。
official_target_text: This outfit suits you well; it makes me feel refreshed.
official_en_text: This outfit suits you well; it makes me feel refreshed.

text: When you touch the lightning, the lightning is also touching you.
zh_text: 你触碰雷电之时，雷电也在触碰你。
source_text: 你触碰雷电之时，雷电也在触碰你。
official_target_text: When you touch the lightning, the lightning is also touching you.
official_en_text: When you touch the lightning, the lightning is also touching you.

text: Enduring the power of thunder with your own body? Interesting.
zh_text: 以己身承受雷霆之力吗？有趣。
source_text: 以己身承受雷霆之力吗？有趣。
official_target_text: Enduring the power of thunder with your own body? Interesting.
official_en_text: Enduring the power of thunder with your own body? Interesting.

text: To pit one's own body against the power of thunder—this, too, is a form of ascetic practice.
zh_text: 以己身对抗雷霆之力，这也是一种苦修。
source_text: 以己身对抗雷霆之力，这也是一种苦修。
official_target_text: To pit one's own body against the power of thunder—this, too, is a form of ascetic practice.
official_en_text: To pit one's own body against the power of thunder—this, too, is a form of ascetic practice.

text: The sun is high, so where did the night moon rise from?
zh_text: 日照当空，哪里又升起了夜月呢？
source_text: 日照当空，哪里又升起了夜月呢？
official_target_text: The sun is high, so where did the night moon rise from?
official_en_text: The sun is high, so where did the night moon rise from?

text: I am thinking about the origin of everything...
The act of thinking itself holds infinite joy.
Naughty, I really can't do anything with you...
Help me preen my feathers, honk.
Is this a gesture of affection, honk?
Chasing white shadows in spring, wading in green waters at summer solstice, drinking frost and dew in mid-autumn, and covered in goose down in deep winter.
What should a goose strive for in its lifetime?
What counts as something meaningful to a goose?
The hardest thing is to maintain a calm heart.
How does one cultivate the heart if they don't want to be disturbed by external things?
You're my Master, and I'm your leader goose!
I look forward to every reunion with you.
I saw you in my dreams, and seeing you when I wake up brings me joy.
A new round of adventure will surely bring new opportunities.
The hometown we can't return to has blurred into the moon.
I'm born free, but sometimes I need to stop and think.
Let's return to dreams, return to the dream that belongs to me.
My heart aches terribly if I don't see my master for a single day.
zh_text: 一天不见主人，本鹅的心就痛苦万分。
source_text: 一天不见主人，本鹅的心就痛苦万分。
official_target_text: My heart aches terribly if I don't see my master for a single day.
official_en_text: My heart aches terribly if I don't see my master for a single day.

text: I miss my master after just a moment away.
zh_text: 一会不见，就有点想主人了呢。
source_text: 一会不见，就有点想主人了呢。
official_target_text: I miss my master after just a moment away.
official_en_text: I miss my master after just a moment away.

text: A song of parting brings two lines of tears, but this frog will be back soon.
zh_text: 一曲离歌两行泪，本呱会很快回来的。
source_text: 一曲离歌两行泪，本呱会很快回来的。
official_target_text: A song of parting brings two lines of tears, but this frog will be back soon.
official_en_text: A song of parting brings two lines of tears, but this frog will be back soon.

text: A song that breaks the heart, seeking a soulmate through high mountains and flowing water!
zh_text: 一曲肝肠断，高山流水觅知音！
source_text: 一曲肝肠断，高山流水觅知音！
official_target_text: A song that breaks the heart, seeking a soulmate through high mountains and flowing water!
official_en_text: A song that breaks the heart, seeking a soulmate through high mountains and flowing water!

text: A rod of wind and moon, a cloak of mist and rain—I love this kind of atmosphere!
zh_text: 一竿风月，一蓑烟雨，本呱喜欢这种意境！
source_text: 一竿风月，一蓑烟雨，本呱喜欢这种意境！
official_target_text: A rod of wind and moon, a cloak of mist and rain—I love this kind of atmosphere!
official_en_text: A rod of wind and moon, a cloak of mist and rain—I love this kind of atmosphere!

text: Don't look at me like I'm small, I'm actually very powerful!
Maybe one day, my tail will bloom with flowers too.
Why am I sleepy again right after waking up...
Someday, I will grow big and strong, and make you all fear me, roar!
Roar, do you like my horns too?
Water it with care, and even the smallest bud will bloom into a beautiful flower.
Will you stay with me forever, Master?
Today I am proud of Master, tomorrow Master will be proud of me.
I've grown a little bit more today, and made some progress too.
Let me see, are you hurt anywhere?
Only when I see the Master can I set my mind at ease.
I sense a dangerous aura... I'm going to hide.
If I can't find my master, master must remember to come find me...
Someday, I will be able to go on adventures with my master too...
Master! Master! It feels like we haven't seen each other in forever!
I made a wish to Huahua just now, and I actually saw my master!
Going on adventures with you, Master, is the thing I love most of all.
Will you miss me when I'm gone, Master?
I'll be even stronger when my master sees me next time.
I had so much fun with Master today, I want to remember this day forever.
It's suddenly gotten colder. I really want to take a nap...
Put on more clothes, Master, watch out for the cold.
Is winter here? Will my flowers wither?
If I'm in danger, will you come to save me, Master?
I'm a little scared to go out by myself. I'll try to be a bit braver!
Roar, roar-roar, you roar, you roar.
Did I offend you? I am truly sorry.
It's... it's okay, we can play together.
The weather is so nice today, where are you going?
Although I'd rather sleep at home, I'd rather be with my master.
Staying by my master's side is truly the happiest thing.
I hope Master thinks so too.
Whose horns are stronger, yours or mine?
After careful observation, it seems my horns are more impressive.
Practice makes perfect. Why don't we have a spar?
No, no, the Master said I have to be a good kid.
Hello there, what have you been busy with lately?
I've been working out lately. I want to become stronger.
There is no limit to becoming stronger, don't push yourself too hard.
Yeah, how old do you have to be to be considered grown up?
I'm so sleepy, did I get poisoned with something that makes me want to sleep?
There's a bad guy poisoning things. Let's not get too close.
The smell of this toxic gas... I feel like I've smelled it somewhere before.
Roar, I warn you, don't come any closer... Wait, a guest?
Hello... Are you here to see my master?
You're finally back, Master. I really want a hug.
I often feel uneasy when my master isn't around.
Just now, I think I dreamed of my master again... *sigh*...
Find a safe place to hide.
Can't be afraid, I can't be afraid, I must protect my master!
Clouds in the sky, could you please stop arguing?
Oh no, are the little plants on me about to get scorched?
It's so warm, I'm getting sleepy...
Fire is a dangerous fellow, let's not provoke it.
Is there something in there? I have a feeling there's something good!
Oh my, will someone find out?
Ripples on the water... is it a big fish or a sea monster...
Come on up, little fishies! My master is a really good person.
Master will definitely catch a big fish!
This melody sounds a bit sad, wuwuwu.
A sound like sunshine, dew, and a gentle breeze.
This hook is very sharp, so be extra careful.
Stay away from the edge, Master, watch out for falling into the water.
Some of these fish look so fierce. They aren't going to eat me, are they?
Is this zither also made of wood?
When I grow up, I want to be as talented as my master.
Are you missing someone while you play the zither, Master?
It's steaming over there, and there's a delicious smell.
Are you hungry, Master? It looks like you can cook over there!
I always hear people talk about sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy. What do they actually taste like?
It's not just flowers and leaves that can be used as medicine; many types of wood are medicinal too.
There's a scent of herbs over there. Could it be similar to the smell on me?
Don't you think the bottles and jars on that stand are magical, Master...
No matter what happens, I will never leave my master.
Roar, whoever is discharging electricity, don't you dare bully my master!
How could this be, it's so scary...
Thunder again. I don't want to stay here, I want to go home and sleep...
Rumbling, shiny things don't look very friendly...
When will this thunder stop? I'm so nervous.
Will the table fall apart? It's so dangerous.
Could you please come down? What if you fall?
Are you coming down, Master? Isn't that dangerous?
We're going to be good children together.
I really admire people who can play chess; they are as smart as my master.
Looking at the chessboard makes me dizzy, I feel so sleepy...
Is playing chess just black and white circles fighting each other?
So many sharp weapons, it looks dangerous.
How many hits does iron ore have to take before it becomes a sword...
It's so hot here, it's making me sleepy.
Let's leave here. Being near the water is too dangerous.
Caught so many fish, time for another delicious meal!
I gained a lot, but I'm a little scared of the fishies...
Why did it stop? Is there danger nearby?
I really like this piece of music.
Can my horns break the ice?
An ice sculpture in the shape of Master is quite a sight.
The master will thaw when spring comes.
Looks like I've gathered something incredible!
It looks so good, I wonder what it's used for?
Bad guys, go away! No one is allowed near Master!
Don't be afraid, don't be afraid, I'm right here by your side.
Master doesn't look well, let's find a place to hide.
Don't scare me, Master! Why are you turning purple?
Do you need some herbs or something to detoxify, Master?
Master, don't do that, you scared me.
What an impressive move, learned something new again!
Are you looking for someone to spar with, Master?
Strange, how come every one of Master's outfits looks so good?
Master is a Jixia superstar, as pretty as a little flower.
Different clothes bring a different mood.
Are you burned, Master? Let me take a look.
Although I'm afraid of fire, I must protect my master.
Where did you come from, you fiery villain? Don't bully my master.
Does it hurt, Master? When will it stop...
Master, Master, let's get out of here quickly.
What does it feel like to be struck by lightning? I'd love to try, but I'm a bit scared...
I'll be able to protect my master when I grow up!
Go and come back quickly, Master. I'm worried about you.
Roar, Master, hurry and use your horns to attack!
The moss on me has drunk its fill of water and become even thicker.
Sleepy again. Let's have a dream about a rainy day.
Cool, refreshing rain, come into my embrace.
Look, Master! What a magical flower!
One, two, three, four flowers—I want to give them all to the Master.
A spinning lotus, will it get dizzy?
Hello, Sun! Is Mu Li greeting you today?
Such lovely sunshine, sleeping in the grass is the most comfortable.
The sun shines down, making the world bright and warm.
The weather is so gloomy, I'm suddenly feeling so sleepy.
The sky is getting dark, I hope nothing dangerous happens...
A cloudy day just means the sun is taking a break.
I may be small now, but one day I'll grow into a towering tree.
I won't use my horns to poke people. I have to be polite.
When the master is by my side, I feel very at ease.
When will I be as impressive as the other wooden fences?
I want to roll around on the grass, *sigh*...
Hmm, so it was a dream. You scared me.
Don't underestimate me, getting hit by my horns really hurts, roar!
Be gentle, please. Don't hurt the little plants on my back.
I won't move around. Master can pet me for as long as they like.
Is this supposed to be tilling the soil for the little grass on my back?
I grew up while being petted.
Feels like we haven't seen each other in such a long time!
Thanks to me making a wish to Hua Hua, I was able to see my master again!
Going on adventures with you, Master, is the thing I love most.
Will you miss me when I'm gone, Master?
I'll be even stronger when I play with my master next time.
I had so much fun with Master today, I want to remember this day forever.
I've calculated that today is perfect for sightseeing and slacking off.
zh_text: 我掐爪一算，今日宜游山水、宜摸鱼。
source_text: 我掐爪一算，今日宜游山水、宜摸鱼。
official_target_text: I've calculated that today is perfect for sightseeing and slacking off.
official_en_text: I've calculated that today is perfect for sightseeing and slacking off.

text: Master, you should take your time and enjoy life.
zh_text: 主人，要慢慢地享受生活哦。
source_text: 主人，要慢慢地享受生活哦。
official_target_text: Master, you should take your time and enjoy life.
official_en_text: Master, you should take your time and enjoy life.

text: Purr, come back to me when you're tired.
zh_text: 呼噜噜，累了就回来找我吧。
source_text: 呼噜噜，累了就回来找我吧。
official_target_text: Purr, come back to me when you're tired.
official_en_text: Purr, come back to me when you're tired.

text: Have you been to see any scenery lately?
Nope, lately I just want to be best friends with my bed...
Actually, I think so too. If I weren't worried about my master...
Alright, alright, don't let the master overhear us.
Hello... By the way, do we know each other?
I don't know them. We just happened to lock eyes, so I thought I should say hello.
You're right... and then we can say goodbye, bye-bye.
I think I saw you at the Star Observatory last time. How have you been?
We've seen Lu? Life goes on as usual, and we're still catching fish as usual.
A peaceful and tranquil life is truly rare.
So you have to live every day carefully.
Judging by your demeanor, you must be an expert at slacking off.
You're too kind, I wouldn't call it mastery, just slowly feeling my way through it.
You're too modest. Let's exchange tips on slacking off sometime.
Maybe next time. I'm too lazy to talk right now.
It ended before I knew it. I'll listen carefully next time.
zh_text: 一不留神就结束了，下次我会认真倾听的。
source_text: 一不留神就结束了，下次我会认真倾听的。
official_target_text: It ended before I knew it. I'll listen carefully next time.
official_en_text: It ended before I knew it. I'll listen carefully next time.

text: Simple food can be enjoyable... as long as you can swallow it.
There are many ways to cook, and just as many ways to burn the pot.
Sweet, sour, bitter, spicy—life has many flavors, just go with the flow.
Making medicine is so tedious. I'd rather just get some ready-made ones.
My arms are too short to be of any help to my master.
Good medicine is bitter, but at least I'm not the one drinking it.
Instead of worrying every day, it's better to just lie down and sleep.
Purr, the world won't end if you don't finish everything. Take it easy.
Rather than struggling for a living, it's more important to enjoy life first.
Who's here? Don't rush me, let me sleep in a bit more...
Do you want to poke my tummy, Master?
Don't rush, don't rush, let me lie down for a while longer.
Pet the other side too, so it can be nice and round.
Are you my new slacking partner?
I've calculated that today is perfect for sightseeing and slacking off.
I didn't take too long to show up this time, did I?
Let's find a warm place to take a long nap today!
Master, you should take your time and enjoy life.
Purr, come back to me when you're tired.
Time to rest! I'm willing to share half my blanket with Master.
Where should we go to play later?
official_target_text: Where should we go to play later?
official_en_text: Where should we go to play later?

zh_text: 好开心！我们又可以一起了！
source_text: 好开心！我们又可以一起了！

text: I've arrived, and I'm bringing the heat!
Master, do you know how to turn up the heat?
With Master around, no one can bully me!
I'm hungry, I want something spicy!
With the master here, no one can look down on me!
Can't stop the spicy dance moves!
No sneak attacks on the Master allowed!
Something's not right, everyone be on alert!
I want to play a little longer...
I'm going to hide for a while!
I'll be there in a bit!
Cheep! I'm going to hide for a bit!
Rumbling, how dare it be louder than Master!
The sun feels so good, it's making me even hotter, cheep!
Cheep cheep cheep cheep, so cold!
It's chilly, I don't like it!
Cheep! The heat ahead is rising!
Master, it's getting spicy up ahead, let's hurry over!
Master, what's all that crackling up ahead?
Why do I feel all tingly?
It's tingling, let's get out of here!
Master! Your new outfit is as hot as me!
Master, this must be the spiciest look ever!
Leave it to me, Master, don't worry!
Don't worry, Master, I'm on fire today!
I'll find some spicy good stuff for you, Master!
Here to find your master, Ji?
Who are you? Are you a fan of my master?
You look so hot today, Master!
Master has arrived, everyone get out of the way!
Who do you think you are, blocking my master's path!
Cheep! Is Master preparing to play some spicy music?
Playing the zither? Master, you are truly multi-talented!
Cheep! It's time for some spicy music!
What is it, daring to ambush the Master!
Only a big shot like the Master would be chosen by lightning!
How do you feel, Master? Are you all fired up?
Cheep, these all belong to Master, no one else is allowed to snatch them!
Gather more! These are all good things!
Master, let's get out of here, you're hurt!
Master, let's go make something spicy and delicious!
It smells so good, Master! I'm starving, chirp!
Master, it's time to show off your spicy cooking skills!
Master can take them down with just a look!
I'm not targeting anyone, but everyone the Master is about to fight is trash.
Attention everyone, stop eating and look at your master!
Is there any spicy food? I love spicy food!
Why are you still eating! Hurry up and welcome your master!
What are you looking at? How dare you stare at your master!
This is the master's territory! Get away quickly!
Master is so amazing, of course you have to stand tall!
Go away! This is the master's territory now!
You are not allowed to play chess here without my master's permission!
How dare you be indifferent to your master's arrival! You are forbidden from playing chess as punishment!
It's so hot here. Are they stir-frying chili peppers?
I can't stay near the furnace, or I'll get too hot and spicy!
This place is nice, full of heat!
Master is frozen! Needs some hot support!
Oh no, Master needs to be thawed!
You look a bit strange, Master.
Master is just as hot and spicy as me!
Master, you're looking a bit spicy!
Master, that crackling is super spicy!
The spiciness... was washed away by the rain...
You should eat spicy food on rainy days and stay indoors...
So much rain, not spicy at all...
No more sun, no more spiciness!
It's gloomy and not spicy at all.
I want to eat something spicy...
Chili peppers are the most delicious thing in the world.
Cheep... W-what do you want with me...
Cheep! I'm very spicy and very powerful!
Be careful, Master, you might burn your hands!
Master, aren't you afraid of the spice?
Master! Are you ready to set the world on fire with me!
I've arrived, and I'm bringing the heat!
I want to play a little longer...
A prank that goes unnoticed is a good prank.
Heehee, Master, have you ever met a Dream Butterfly?
What do the five flavors humans talk about—sour, sweet, bitter, spicy, and salty—actually taste like?
My wish is to write a book called 'The Encyclopedia of Pranks'!
Whose dream should I go play in next time?
Eating and drinking, playing and having fun, I want to fly, fly away from my dreams.
I didn't do anything bad just now, I was just waiting for my master to come back, hee hee.
I'm back! Too bad I didn't find anything good just now.
No, no, I'm retreating for now!
Woo-hoo! Where are we going to play today?
Heehee, here I come! Setting off immediately!
I'm heading back now! Don't you dare eat all the good stuff behind my back!
I'm heading back now. Let's meet up earlier next time!
Master should only miss me, and miss me the most, most, most!
Brrr, the ice is so cold, it's freezing me to the bone.
There must be lots and lots and lots of ice pops nearby!
I wish I could eat some Dream Butterfly Shaved Ice.
Gathering is definitely no problem. As for where it came from, Master, don't ask.
Heehee, off we go! Time to go out and play again!
I love gathering things! I'm sure I'll find lots of yummy food!
Why do I feel dizzy, shaky, and my eyes are spinning...
Poisonous things can't be eaten or smelled. I know that!
Hello there, cutie! So happy to see you.
Heehee, am I pretty, cute, and smart?
Hello there, do you have anything tasty on you?
Heehee, Master's back! Did you have a fun day today?
Where did you go on an adventure today, Master? Tell me all about it!
Master, Master, I really, really missed you!
Shh... Thunder gave me the signal. It's time to move!
Heehee, thunder and rain are good friends, and you and I are good friends.
Thunder is the prelude to rain. It goes crackle-pop, then splash-splash.
Heehee, it's the smell of barbecue! Where's the barbecue?
Why do humans use the same word for 'saving from fire' and 'extinguishing fire'?
It's so hot, I don't like places that are too fiery.
So you also like to look for surprises everywhere?
Heehee, the Prank King is here, prepare to be shattered!
Is there something delicious hidden inside too?
Ding-ding, dong-dong, ding-dong! A wonderful melody!
The sound from the strings—are these threads singing?
Master is so absorbed in playing the zither...
These long strings look like spun sugar...
How about we call this song 'The Song of Mischief'?
How can one listen to zither music without some snacks?
If humans eat colorful food, will they turn those colors?
What are they doing over there? It smells so good!
I want to try cooking too, and be the first to let Master eat it, hee hee.
What kind of lightning game are you playing, Master? Can you teach me?
Zzzzt, zzzzt! Master got zapped, what should I do!
Does the sound of lightning go: zzz, sss, krr?
Who's secretly discharging electricity over there? Playing pranks right under my nose!
Who is teasing us with lightning? Come out now!
My goodness, is this the Jixia Dream Butterfly buffet?
Heehee, so many Dream Butterflies! Huh? Why did they fly away...
There are dreams and butterflies in books; no wonder the people of Jixia love to read.
Are you playing a high-jump game, Master? So cool!
Heehee, let me guess what's on the table...
The table is flat and tall, and the stools are wide and low.
Help me check, Master, are there any Dream Butterflies on the table?
So much delicious food, can I pack it all up to take home?
Do humans always jump onto the table to eat...
I bet the white stones are sweet and the black ones are sour.
If I secretly hide a few small round stones, will I be caught?
This is how the master plays the little stone game, who has a problem with that!
Heehee, these things look so shiny!
Are these all tools for pranks? I want to pick some out too.
This doesn't look very tasty, let's go.
Heehee, don't stop, I was just getting into it...
If we're not playing the zither, let's go pull a prank!
Next time the Master isn't looking, I'm going to try swapping out a few strings.
Heehee, Master can have popsicles anytime, anywhere now!
It's freezing cold, Master, you must drink something hot.
I'm frozen! Is Master performing a magic trick?
Can you give this to me? Perhaps...
Heehee, this looks delicious, I'll sneak a taste next time.
One for Master, two for me! Two for Master, eight for me! Tee-hee.
Don't worry, Master! I think you can still be saved!
I'll never fight my master for treats again. Please, Master, don't let anything happen to you!
Master looks so uncomfortable, I hope it's just a prank, boo hoo!
Do you have any bottles or jars with antidotes, Master?
What should I eat... What can Master eat to detoxify?
Stinky poison gas, I command you to get out of my master's body!
You scared me! That was a pretty good prank.
Whatever other tricks you have, bring them on!
Heehee, I guess that's part of the prank too.
This outfit looks great from the front, back, left, and right!
Master, you're even more eye-catching than me in that outfit!
Not fun! This hot prank is not fun at all!
Burning it with fire is too much! That's not a good prank!
It must be because the Master is so charming that even the flames want a hug.
So cool! Did you already master the power of lightning, Master?!
It's like a magic trick! I want to play too! Let me try!
Master is electrified! Is this the latest trend?
Pranks are better than fighting! No one gets hurt, and everyone gets a laugh!
After the fight, we'll go play!
Clatter, bang, clink, clank—you'll get hurt!
Heehee, rainy days are perfect for eating something warm.
I wish it would rain syrup from the sky.
The raindrop is so small, yet it ran away from home. Won't Mother Cloud be upset?
Why is there only one sun in the sky? Can we put a few more up there?
Master, this sun-ball is so blinding, can you turn it off?
The glowing big round cake is out! It's steaming hot!
Speak! You gray clouds, where did you hide the sun!
The sky is turning overcast, is it angry with me?
This must be a prank by the sun, making everyone unable to find it!
What fun should we find today?
Between human food and Dream Butterflies, which one tastes better?
I'm going to invent so many pranks to fill the world with laughter!
Heehee, where should we go to pull a prank next?
So bored, I want to go somewhere new to play...
I want to go out and play!
Heehee, let's go play pranks on others from now on!
Next time, I'm going to tickle your ticklish spots too!
Rub, rub, rub... This is what you call turning the tables!
Woo-hoo! Where are we going to play today?
Heehee, here I come! Setting off immediately!
Don't you dare eat the good stuff behind my back!
Master should only miss me, and miss me the most, most, most!
Is it really that important to you?
I was just a bit too slow...
If you can't hold on later, just shout my name.
zh_text: 一会你要是撑不住了就大喊我的名字。
source_text: 一会你要是撑不住了就大喊我的名字。
official_target_text: If you can't hold on later, just shout my name.
official_en_text: If you can't hold on later, just shout my name.

text: I swear, when my Mechcraft is ready...
You're lucky I didn't bring my stuff with me!
I thought this place was safe.
Are all people here rude like you?
Is this how Jixia welcomes guests?
What's your name? Which class are you from?
Master Zhuangzi shall teach you a lesson!
If you rip my clothes, you're done!
Hey, calm down! I'm just a messenger!
Wait here! I'll get my brother to teach you a lesson!
No face punching, please! I need it to earn a living!
Hey! Don't cut my money bag!
You're not robbing me, are you?
I'm warning you. Don't do anything stupid!
I don't want to fight you.
C-customer! Even if the deal doesn't go through, there's no need for hard feelings!
C-customer! Even if the deal doesn't go through, there's no need for hard feelings!
No, no, no! This shipment is for those guests. If you want to fight, go fight them!
No, no, no! This shipment is for those guests. If you want to fight, go fight them!
Young hero, please have mercy... How about I give you a discount?
Young hero, please have mercy... How about I give you a discount?
What was that? Show me again!
You'll get detained by the Aerwatch!
Who are you? Which school are you from?
You'd better explain your behavior just now.
The Student Affairs Committee is watching!
You wish to be hunted too?
Next time you go out, better watch your back.
If you want a fight, I'll give you one.
Excuse me, please move aside. I still have to deliver these sword blanks...
Excuse me, please move aside. I still have to deliver these sword blanks...
If you keep acting up, I'll let you taste the edge of the Cuoyun soldiers!
If you keep acting up, I'll let you taste the edge of the Cuoyun soldiers!
Look, the Mechcraft Kite is about to take off.
zh_text: 快来看呀，这机关鸢快要飞起来了。
source_text: 快来看呀，这机关鸢快要飞起来了。

text: Move! Don't ruin my quenching time!
Move! Don't ruin my quenching time!
In full armor, ready for the battlefield.
official_target_text: In full armor, ready for the battlefield.
official_en_text: In full armor, ready for the battlefield.

text: Last match, I pushed the enemy's defense tower.
I participated in the tactical operation to destroy the crystal last month!
The longer the match goes on, the less we're valued.
Exactly. I could hold my own at first, but later on, one hit and I was down.
It's unfair. I wish there was gear we could wear too.
Exactly. We should suggest that the Academy optimize the competition mechanics.
Where were you when the enemy pushed to the high ground that day?
I didn't see you when our crystal was destroyed the day before yesterday either.
Clear skies for miles, a good day for battle.
zh_text: 万里无云，作战的好天气。
source_text: 万里无云，作战的好天气。
official_target_text: Clear skies for miles, a good day for battle.
official_en_text: Clear skies for miles, a good day for battle.

text: Master has excellent taste in clothes!
Dressed impeccably, with the bearing of a commander.
I'll definitely return with a full load.
official_target_text: I'll definitely return with a full load.
official_en_text: I'll definitely return with a full load.

text: The most important thing in war is making sure the soldiers are well-fed.
An empty stomach is a soldier's worst enemy.
It smells delicious, but unfortunately, I cannot eat.

I always feel like before starting it, I should bathe, burn incense, and pray devoutly...
Though fireworks are fleeting, the memories will never fade.
Though fireworks are fleeting, the memories will never fade.
The water is overflowing. Better turn off the water dispenser.
The water is overflowing. Better turn off the water dispenser.
Please select a resonance to ban!
Don't give up, we can still turn this around.
My bad, that was a mistake.
Let's go, team! One final push!
Don't fight, wait for the team.
Wait for me to group up for a team fight.
Wait for me, I'll be there soon!
Another soul seeking answers within boundless dreams.

text: The heroes fight alongside you, clearing the obstacles ahead and escorting you to Di Xin. However, despite your best efforts, you fail to stop him. The world crumbles in his hands, and the Primordial Priest blocks a fatal blow for you, sending you away from this world.
They're all wounded, yet they press on fearlessly by your side.

You share your vague memories with Novar, who explains to you what the Wonders are. Then he invites you to participate in the Enlightenment Trials, as winners will have a chance to visit the Aercocoon, the Wonder in Jixia. Before long, you two arrive at Jixia.
But... I suppose you don't remember about them either, do you?
It's the Wonder of Jixia. The Aercocoon is known to possess immense wisdom.
Your bracer, your lost memories... Anything you're confused about, it will have an answer for you!
But to access it... Not as easy as you might think.
To do that, one must win the Enlightenment Trials first. This has always been the way of Jixia.
So, if you want to access the Wonder, you must become the winner.
Don't worry, though, cause you're looking at the reigning champion! I'll help you get started!
The Wonders are creations of ancient deities. They are scattered across Primaera.
Let me think. "Find the Wonders..." Maybe she wanted you to consult the Aercocoon?
That's right. It's the most important competition at Jixia Academy.
It is, according to Fuzi, "a crucial test for students to prove and truly understand themselves."
Look, the Wonder's just up there.
We'll talk more when we arrive.
You're awake. Looks like you've been recovering well.
Don't mention it. There's no way I'd just leave you adrift at sea like that!
Speaking of... you still can't remember anything?
Follow the Bracer and find the Wonders. That's what <001>she</> said to me.
Follow the Bracer and find the Wonders. That's what <001>she</> said to me.
The Flow moving in this... bracer of yours does remind me of the Wonders.
Seeking miracles... Ah, don't tell me you're going to ask the Cloud Silkworm for guidance.
zh_text: “寻找奇迹”……啊，该不会是让你向云蚕问道吧。
source_text: “寻找奇迹”……啊，该不会是让你向云蚕问道吧。

text: Everything began with the War of God's Fall. Nuwa and Dijun clashed over the Miracle, leading to the fall of all gods. Before she vanished, Nuwa left behind prophecies and hopes for the future, despite the Strife.
The heroes fight alongside you, but one by one they fall before the overwhelming power. They cleared the path for you and escorted you to Di Xin; you now face him carrying their will.
It's time to end this, Xin.
Only I can control the Wonders... and you know it.
No one can change this. Not even him.
No one can change this. Not even you.

Everything has been annihilated. A gentle yet powerful force flows from the bracelet, reshaping your body. An ethereal and gentle voice instructs you to follow the bracelet's guidance and seek out the miracle.

And where did <001>Vesper</> go? I must find him fast.
And where did <001>Vesper</> go? I must find him fast.
Didn't know Jixia has such a vast underground space...
Didn't know Jixia has such a vast underground space...
Just as you saw in your dream, the Zhuji Tree has resonated with his flow.
zh_text: 一如您梦中所见，珠玑树与他的流产生了共鸣。
source_text: 一如您梦中所见，珠玑树与他的流产生了共鸣。
official_target_text: Just as you saw in your dream, the Zhuji Tree has resonated with his flow.
official_en_text: Just as you saw in your dream, the Zhuji Tree has resonated with his flow.

text: Just as you saw in your dream, the Zhuji Tree has resonated with her flow.
zh_text: 一如您梦中所见，珠玑树与她的流产生了共鸣。
source_text: 一如您梦中所见，珠玑树与她的流产生了共鸣。
official_target_text: Just as you saw in your dream, the Zhuji Tree has resonated with her flow.
official_en_text: Just as you saw in your dream, the Zhuji Tree has resonated with her flow.

text: It's just a few Saepes. Shouldn't be a problem for you.
Oh, it's just in the south of Springbrook Plains.
It's a long-abandoned ruin. You'll know it when you see it.
What are the Seekers doing there?
Seclusion City is a haven of ancient findings. Imagine its appeal to them.
Also, a variety of natural mineral resources can be found there.
Sometimes I go there myself. To find materials for my fireworks.
It's just a few Saepes. I'm sure it'll be a cakewalk with your skills.
You heard about the situation just now?
Something's happened at the Seclusion City. Some Seekers have been trapped there.
I need you to go help them. They're not so good when it comes to combat.
Also I've heard about some of your story from Novar.
Winning the Dream Trial is no easy thing.
Their camp is just beneath the Seclusion City. Go help them out.
No problem. Win the Dream Trial, and I'll customize some epic fireworks for you!
Make more allies, and your journey will be smoother.
You heard about the situation just now, right?
There's been a problem in Seclusion City. It's a long-abandoned ruin, where the Jixia Seekers Society often conducts archaeological research.
Someone triggered the guards there by accident.
The Seeker Society excels at archeological research, but asking them to fight is indeed a bit of a stretch.
But with your skills, a few Mechanoids should be no problem.
I've heard a bit about you from Novar.
To pass the Enlightenment Trials, to access the Wonder... there's still a long way to go.
Make more allies, and your journey will be smoother.
Go to the Seeker Society camp near Seclusion City and assist them.
While you talk with Blazen, news of Saepes attacking people arrives from Seclusion City. With no time to lose, Blazen entrusts you with the task and gives you an "Aerrider" for faster transport.
It's just a few Saepes, but still, be careful at all times.
Not yet. I just talked to her Big-eye Owlet. She's still with the Chang'an Envoys.
Guess you'll have to wait here a bit longer.
By the way, what did you think of the fireworks last night?
You heard about what happened just now, right?
What? That's odd... That place's been deserted for a long time. Never heard of any Saepes activity there.
Okay, I'll handle it right away.
For now, you go and find somewhere safe. I'll send someone over in no time.
They're great at archaeology, but not so much in a fight. Someone must go help them.
It's just... I can't think of anyone here who's up for the job.
And it all happened so fast, we don't have time to notify the academy.
Wait... I just thought of someone perfect for this task!
First, the Puppet Show was no problem for him. So I guess a couple of Saepes shouldn't be one either.
And I'm sure as a Jixia student, he is responsible enough to help his teacher out...
First, the Puppet Show was no problem for her. So I guess a couple of Saepes shouldn't be one either.
And I'm sure as a Jixia student, she is responsible enough to help her teacher out...
I'll go give it a try then?
I'm sure you'll shine bright just like my fireworks!
Let's save the firework talk for later, Mr. Blazen...
Let's save the firework talk for later, Mr. Blazen...
Oh, you volunteered! The job is yours then.
Come on, you've got this in the bag!
You have the best combat skills among the new students this year.
So, I'll leave the Saepes to you then!
Which way is the academy again?
Hey, wait... Shye is still with the envoys. She isn't coming back anytime soon.
So why not give me a hand while you're here?
Don't worry, I'll let you know as soon as she returns.
If that's the case, then alright...
If that's the case, then alright...
Considering how you just defeated Yango's puppets, this job should be no sweat for you!
Speaking of... Why don't you go yourself, Mr. Blazen?
Speaking of... Why don't you go yourself, Mr. Blazen?
This job requires both skills and sharp judgment. It has to be someone like you.
I see. I'll do my best.
I see. I'll do my best.
Remember what I told you about my eyes?
Oh, I almost forgot — I've got something good for you. A reward for your trouble.
This is called an <001>"Aerrider"</>, a Flow-driven glideboard created by the Crafters. An adaptation from ancient mobility devices, actually.
Now use it to get to Seclusion City as fast as possible. Those Seekers are counting on you.
A large group of Saepes just appeared in Seclusion City!
Haha, I spent so much time on those. I knew you'd love them!
You've got good taste. I see great potential in you.
Say... Ever thought about learning the art of fireworks with me?
I'd love that, but there's something I must do first.
Sounds interesting... but there's something I must do first.
Oh, you mean the Enlightenment Trials? Shye did tell me about it.
That's good. Focus on your goals, and you shall shine like those fireworks someday.
But again, my classes are always open to curious minds.
Actually, they looked a bit... strange.
Strange, you say? Those were my signature Croaky Fireworks!
I put in great effort for that unique design. Testing trajectories, tweaking calculations, and more.
I never knew making fireworks was this complicated...
I never knew making fireworks was this complicated...
Of course! Looks like you have a lot to learn about them.
Mr. Blazen! We have a situation!
We couldn't hold them off and were driven out of the ruins.
You have a flair for cannons.
Hope you can be just as impressive at the academy. Don't disappoint me.
The shape was a bit... unusual.
It took me over thirty tries to make that Croaky look right.
Looks like I'll have to give you extra lessons on gunpowder ratios.
By the way, how were the fireworks last night? Impressive, right?
Shye is on her way already. Should be here soon.
You must be looking for Shye. She's on her way here now.
By the way, how were the fireworks last night? Impressive, right?
You have a flair for cannons.
I hope you flourish here at Jixia. Don't let me down.
The shape was a bit... unusual.
It took me over thirty tries to make that Croaky look right.
Looks like I'll have to give you extra lessons on the art of gunpowder.
Shye said she'd be waiting for me with Mr. Blazen.
Shye said she'd be waiting for me with Mr. Blazen.
I should go meet them now.
I should go meet them now.
Given their conversation, they're definitely behind those marks.
Given their conversation, they're definitely behind those marks.
This is bigger than I thought. Gotta inform Novar about this.
This is bigger than I thought. Gotta inform Novar about this.
From a distance, you see Vesper meet with a man in black. They seem to be waiting for someone.
Hmph, and what's this got to do with you?
Glory to the Sanctified! Glory to the Sanctified!
I'll be expecting good news then.
The old man that Vesper follows arrives. From their conversation, you gather that they are involved in some deal, and it appears to be related to the academy.
Now you... Why exactly did you release me from my seal in Chang'an?
But are you sure you're ready to face the Three Sages?
I can feel my powers coming back.
When I restore my full strength, no one shall be my match!
The underground passages here can lead everywhere. What could you possibly know?
Before we find what Master wants...
This is where my people rest.
I'll cut all the "help you" nonsense. Let's just call it a "trade."
While I... I yearn to witness the grand revival of your era.
Remember, there will be consequences if you lie to me.
What you're after, though... I'm very interested.
I couldn't care less about your plan.
It's funny you'd meet in a place like this, Sanctifier.
The world only talks about how great Fuzi is...
A mysterious old man has appeared. From their conversation, you learn that the old man and the man in black seem to have some kind of deal, and it all seems to be related to the academy.
zh_text: 一位神秘老者现身了。从他们的对话中，你了解到老者与黑衣人似乎存在某种交易，而这一切似乎都与学院有关。
source_text: 一位神秘老者现身了。从他们的对话中，你了解到老者与黑衣人似乎存在某种交易，而这一切似乎都与学院有关。
official_target_text: A mysterious old man has appeared. From their conversation, you learn that the old man and the man in black seem to have some kind of deal, and it all seems to be related to the academy.
official_en_text: A mysterious old man has appeared. From their conversation, you learn that the old man and the man in black seem to have some kind of deal, and it all seems to be related to the academy.

text: Helping is too hypocritical a reason; "a transaction" would be more honest.
zh_text: “帮”这个理由太虚伪了，“交易”会更诚实一些。
source_text: “帮”这个理由太虚伪了，“交易”会更诚实一些。
official_target_text: Helping is too hypocritical a reason; "a transaction" would be more honest.
official_en_text: Helping is too hypocritical a reason; "a transaction" would be more honest.

text: This huge thing is so tough to deal with.
This huge thing is so tough to deal with.
Guess I'll have to deal with them first.
Guess I'll have to deal with them first.
Shye urges you to head to the academy at once — Novar is waiting for you at the Aership Station.
I'm sure he didn't expect this either...
Luckily nothing happened to you... You should head for the academy now.
Novar is waiting for you at the Aership station. He'll take it from there.
Anything else you want to know before you go?
First time I've heard of it, too... Can't say I'm surprised, though, considering the long history Jixia has.
That said, the marks in this place are indeed related to Novar's mission.
Don't worry. I'll let you know if anything turns up.
Well, Novar was the one that brought you here in the first place, after all...
Or is it that you prefer me as your guide?
Much as I'd love to go with you, there are more important things at hand.
The strange marks, the Sanctified... I have to stay and dig deeper.
The academy is a bit far from Springbrook Plains. It'd be much faster to take an Aership.
It's a unique means of transportation in Jixia. I promise you, you'll love it.
Then you should hurry to the Aership station. Otherwise, Novar will start to worry.
Trust me, he is actually more reliable than he seems.
Just head towards Aerfall Highlands and you'll see the Aership Station. Safe travels.
Never knew Ground Shaker was sleeping here. Thank the Wonders you're all right...
I can't believe Mr. Blazen sent you to such a dangerous place alone... I mean, what was he thinking?
Hmph, I already gave him quite an earful for this.
When you meet him next time, tell him to make it up to you!
I don't care. He should've never sent a new student on a field mission.
Anyway, I won't hold it against him this time. I'm sure he regrets his decision, too.
Ling Qiu mentions that a suspicious man entered Seclusion City earlier and advises you to stay alert.
Ugh. We were studying the artifacts inside the ruins. Then a group of Saepes appeared out of nowhere and forced us out!
Just leave the Saepes to me.
Just leave the Saepes to me.
Be careful in there, okay? Those Saepes seemed unusually aggressive...
Wait, and there was something else!
On my way out, I saw someone suspicious breaking in. Some claim he's the one causing trouble... Best keep an eye out.
I will. Thanks for the warning.
I will. Thanks for the warning.
I'll go back and find the others now. Again, please be extra careful!
It went inside your body in the form of the Flow... I've never seen anything like this!
So what is this little thing?
So what is this little thing?
Oh, it's a Menki. A magical creature from Oneirland.
And... that thing on your wrist somehow just formed a life bond with it? That's incredible!
It's called a Bracer, and I'm not sure how it works, either... Anyway, Mr. Blazen sent me to help you. What happened?
It's called a Bracer, and I'm not sure how it works, either... Anyway, Mr. Blazen sent me to help you. What happened?
Luckily, no one was hurt bad. But all our research...
Mechcraft pedestals... Let's try activating them.
Mechcraft pedestals... Let's try activating them.
The trapped Seeker Ling Qiu descends from the pillar. Her Beastkind friend, Menki, shows fondness for you and goes into your Bracer in the form of the Flow.
This cute little one was a lifesaver just now...
Huh? It really seems to like you.
Thank you so much! That was really close.
How strange. The marks on these Saepes...
How strange. The marks on these Saepes...
These golden marks... What are they exactly?

You confront the young man after he retrieves a segment of a staff from a mysterious mark on the ground. Introducing himself as a Sanctified, he exchanges blows with you. To make a quick escape, he summons the Ground Shaker to hold you off — and leaves a name: Vesper.
... Yet I've seen no match for us.
Who are you? Why are you causing trouble here!?
Who are you? Why are you causing trouble here!?
Jixia people digging around on Sanctified turf.
And I'm the one causing trouble?
It's okay, Croakus. I got this.
I'm here to take back what's ours.
And that's all you need to know.
You're better than those cowards out there.
Too bad I have to go now. But it's okay...
Cause this big guy here will keep you entertained!
Gotta warn ya, he hates being woken up.
The name's Vesper, by the way!

A youth summons a divine staff from mysterious patterns and is about to leave when he runs straight into you. He calls himself a God-Smith and engages you in battle. To escape quickly, he summons a wild earth-shaking tree to hold you back and leaves behind his name—Xing Li.
zh_text: 一名少年从神秘的纹样中唤出一截神杖，正欲离开，却与你撞个正着。他自称神铸者，与你大打出手。为了尽快离开，他唤出撼地狂木拖住你，并留下了自己的名字——星离。
source_text: 一名少年从神秘的纹样中唤出一截神杖，正欲离开，却与你撞个正着。他自称神铸者，与你大打出手。为了尽快离开，他唤出撼地狂木拖住你，并留下了自己的名字——星离。
official_target_text: A youth summons a divine staff from mysterious patterns and is about to leave when he runs straight into you. He calls himself a God-Smith and engages you in battle. To escape quickly, he summons a wild earth-shaking tree to hold you back and leaves behind his name—Xing Li.
official_en_text: A youth summons a divine staff from mysterious patterns and is about to leave when he runs straight into you. He calls himself a God-Smith and engages you in battle. To escape quickly, he summons a wild earth-shaking tree to hold you back and leaves behind his name—Xing Li.

text: Someone's talking... The intruder? Let's go take a look.
Someone's talking... The intruder? Let's go take a look.
I should go to Seclusion City. See if I can find anyone there.
I should go to Seclusion City. See if I can find anyone there.
The Seekers' camp... but where is everybody?
The Seekers' camp... but where is everybody?
You meet Shye and recount what just happened. It turns out the mysterious marks are exactly what Novar has been investigating. Shye decides to stay and look for more information.
I was looking for you back in camp when I heard about this. Who did it?
A guy named Vesper. Called himself a... Sanctified?
A guy named Vesper. Called himself a... Sanctified?
Sanctified? I've never heard of it before...
I must take a closer look.
Meanwhile, you should go and meet Novar. He's waiting for you at the Aership station.
Strong Sorcery energy remains in here.
This mark... It's what Novar's been looking into.
He went upstairs. I should go after him.
He went upstairs. I should go after him.
He went upstairs. I gotta hurry.
He went upstairs. I gotta hurry.
This underground space is massive... How many more secrets does Jixia hold?
This underground space is massive... How many more secrets does Jixia hold?
Vesper has already noticed you tailing him. He declares this is the Sanctified's territory, and he can't have you leave as a witness. He awakens the Mechanoid guards here before leaping away.
To follow me all the way down here, your courage is almost... admirable.
Jixia? I care nothing about Jixia.
Who are you? What grudge do you hold against Jixia?
Who are you? What grudge do you hold against Jixia?
It was fun playing with you.
But now I'm starting to get bored.
Listen, kid — this place is called <001>the Underhall</>. It has always been the home of the Sanctified.
And only perfect people can be chosen to become one of us.
Now, since you've found the entrance...
It seems wherever <001>Vesper</> goes, these marks just come alive...
It seems wherever <001>Vesper</> goes, these marks just come alive...
This must be the Red Falcon Training Hall.
This must be the Red Falcon Training Hall.
You repeat Maple's concerns to Novar, but he lightly brushes them off with a joke and suggests you split up to complete the mission faster.
I can feel Head Trainer Maple cares a lot about us.
I can feel Head Trainer Maple cares a lot about us.
And why does she seem to be worried about you...
And why does she seem to be worried about you...
Well, you know... High hopes, higher demands. Makes sense to me.
Let's split up and finish this fast. Agreed?
Oh, the help I mentioned is here.
Okay, I understand now. Time to plan our next move.
I've marked the locations of those beasts on your map.
The Mechanoids seem unaffected by the marks...
The Mechanoids seem unaffected by the marks...
Still, I should take care of them first.
Still, I should take care of them first.
Not as tough as expected. What about you?
Okay... If this goes on, more people are going to get hurt. You be careful.
Just ran into a group of Spike Bears. They were much more aggressive and stronger than usual.
Just ran into a group of Spike Bears. They were much more aggressive and stronger than usual.
In the middle of the fight, Novar leaps up swinging his blade, ready to unleash his Star Power. However, the power fails him again, leaving him falling back to the ground, awkwardly.
Above the sky I reach the stars!
Getting close to the locations Ms. Maple mentioned.
Getting close to the locations Ms. Maple mentioned.
The vicious Flow Maple talked about... I think I sensed it too from that old man underground.
The vicious Flow Maple talked about... I think I sensed it too from that old man underground.
But if that's the case... why did that Vesper seem all fine?
But if that's the case... why did that Vesper seem all fine?
Anyway, let's focus on the task at hand.
Anyway, let's focus on the task at hand.

Novar introduces you to Head Trainer Maple, who notes that the marks on the beasts carry a vicious stream of the Flow. She expresses concern over Novar's Star Power, but Novar promises he'll be fine. Maple marks the locations of the beast activity before urging caution once more.
Come, let me introduce you to the one and only Head Trainer Maple.
You must be the new student Novar told me about.
You must be spending a lot of time around Novar.
I've heard about your mission. Indeed, the area's not been safe lately.
I already did some investigation before you came. Took out some beasts while I was out there, too.
It's just their number is growing too fast. Many students were hurt, and now we are a bit short-handed.
I would get rid of them myself, but the wounded need me here.
It's alright, Ms. Maple. We will help deal with the situation together.
Wouldn't that be too dangerous for a new student? Those beasts are no joke.
Don't worry. I've seen him fight. He'll be just fine.
It's alright, Ms. Maple. We will help deal with the situation together.
Wouldn't that be too dangerous for a new student? Those beasts are no joke.
Don't worry. I've seen her fight. She'll be just fine.
The marks on those beasts carry a vicious stream of Flow... Like it's been branded into their minds, driving them crazy.
So you must be very careful. Report back to Master Fuzi if necessary, okay?
It's alright, Head Trainer. I've got this.
Oh? Your Star Power is back?
Of course. Even the Tempest Dragon is no match for me now!
I'd actually believe it if it were Nora telling me this.
Star Power? The one you use to disappear every time?
Star Power? The one you use to disappear every time?
Kind of... It is pretty reliable in that respect.
Back to business. The beasts are scattered all over the area, so I'll mark their locations for you.
Remember—if things start to get out of hand, you guys come back right away.
Do not underestimate them, Novar. I mean it.
These bears are also affected by the marks...
They've been affected by the marks, too.
Seems like some kind of echo still lingers about this place.
Seems like some kind of echo still lingers about this place.
Hey, so far so good here. You?
Just took care of some Mechanoids, yet these marks don't seem to affect them.
Just took care of some Mechanoids, yet these marks don't seem to affect them.
Hum. Maybe they only work on sentient beings?
That could be a valuable lead. We should report it to Fuzi later.
The beasts should be nearby now. Gotta stay sharp.
The beasts should be nearby now. Gotta stay sharp.
Me too. The marks have made the Wolvines even harder to deal with.
Me too. The marks have made the Wolvines even harder to deal with.
Okay, stay alert then. There might be bigger trouble.
One pack down on my end. You?
You meet Novar at the entrance to Aermore Valley. He admits he has no confidence in defeating Cloudeater, and decides to share with you the story behind the"Frostcloud Legend"...
After all this time, never thought I'd be back here again.
Cloudeater has to be somewhere in there. Based on what the head trainer said, it's going to be a very tough fight.
Go back now. Don't risk your life with me.
You're not leaving me this time.
You... Alright. But to be honest, I don't know if I can do this.
I'm nowhere near getting back my Star Power, especially in a place like this.
Since we're here, let me tell you another story. Part of the "Frostcloud Legend" you've not heard about...
I'm glad I did. So this is the legendary Aermore Valley...
I'm glad I did. So this is the legendary Aermore Valley...
Novar unleashes the Star Power to finally take down Cloudeater and save you. He reaches his hand to you with a relieved smile and tells you he's found his inner strength.
The lesser and weak now seize my place...
Your games end here. With me!
Star Power straight from the sky!
Me, a true hero, falls in disgrace...
With me shining in the midst!

Consumed by rage, Cloudeater sweeps you into a dark mist. The mist then gathers into a whirlwind, and a mocking voice echoes from within. Novar shouts, only to see Cloudeater, now transformed into the form of "Dark Novar," steadily approaching.
One strike to break your body, two strikes to destroy your soul!
Take my hits as storm, and feel my rage like thunder!
It was your sister that did this to me!
Come on, it's me you want!
Ah, I see... I remember you now...
One strike cracks the mask, the second breeds malice!
zh_text: 一击面甲裂，二击恶意生！
source_text: 一击面甲裂，二击恶意生！
official_target_text: One strike cracks the mask, the second breeds malice!
official_en_text: One strike cracks the mask, the second breeds malice!

text: Cloudeater appears with a mask and an iron fan. Upon hearing Novar's name, Cloudeater flies into a rage, the yellow marks on it radiating as it jumps down to fight.
Against all odds my spirit grows, up in the clouds is where I will go.
In this valley I lie in wait, rising a dragon my final fate!
The name's Novar, and I will bring you down today.
I am. What? Have you heard about me already?
I've been wanting to get rid of your family. Ah ya ya!
If you have a death wish, then come and fight me!
Aermore Valley, veiled in sorrowful clouds, with misty mountain silhouettes.
Two youthful souls, brave without fear. Heroes in the making, witness the sky bears.
As they say, a fan's stroke, a blade in a smile.
Having come to accept himself, Novar has now truly mastered his Star Power. He thanks you and vows to win the Enlightenment Trials together. You agree to meet later at Enlightenment Plaza.
Huh, guess Cloudeater was not that tough after all.
Looks like your power is back.
Looks like your power is back.
Yes, and I think I know how to awaken it now.
No wonder Head Trainer Maple always says I'm not ready.
All this time... my sister's achievements were all I cared about.
So much that I forgot what I really needed.
She's really good. Much better than I am right now... But that does not define who I am.
I'm not her, and I'm not a genius. I'm just a kid from Frostcloud Town. As for my Star Power... at least now I know where it comes from.
Strange. I feel as if I've just gotten a little closer to her.
And sorry for getting you involved in all this.
Hey, you said, "This kind of mission is meant for great talents like us."
Hey, you said, "This kind of mission is meant for great talents like us."
Anyway, from now on, your business is my business.
I'll do everything I can to help you. You know, to win the Enlightenment Trials, and access the Wonder.
Haha, like I would forget a promise I made!
I'll report back to Red Falcon first. Let's meet at Enlightenment Plaza later.

Novar tells you the truth behind the "Frostcloud Legend": It was his sister, Nora, who defeated Cloudeater and saved him from the fight. Before she left, she told Novar, "You first and last enemy will always be yourself."
Am I just not good enough?
Once I'm done with you, your sister will be next.
You sure love your impersonation, don't you?
See if you can impersonate this!
It's time to write your own legend, Novar.
Wuah ya ya... Just stop fighting!
Novar asks you one last time if you're truly willing to face Cloudeater together. Encouraged by your resolve, he picks up the courage for the fight.
Well... Now I've told you everything.
Tell me, do you still wanna face Cloudeater with me?
We are standing here together, aren't we?
We are standing here together, aren't we?
It's time to overcome your fears.
It's time to overcome your fears.
Whatever happens, I'll be by your side.
Whatever happens, I'll be by your side.
Oh, but... a word of warning—the house has been unattended for a while...
There should still be some supplies in the cabinet. Let me check it out.
It won't take long. Make yourself at home!

Novar shows you around his residence along with some of his collections. He opens up about memories of his elder sister Nora, his admiration for the famous swordsman Li Bai, and the friendship shared in the Team of Stars. He then invites you for a special training to prepare for the upcoming mission.
So, when I was going through things...
You were admiring my collections, weren't you?
The boy in the picture there must be you, right? And the girl beside you...
The boy in the picture there must be you, right? And the girl beside you...
Haven't told you about her, right?
I was born in a neighboring country called Yong. She brought me here in my early teens. Been living together in Frostcloud Town ever since.
That actually feels like a lifetime ago...
Adorable, aren't they? Shye, Sun Bin, Meng Ya, and me... and the last one there is Luban, a genius Mechsmith.
First met them before the last Enlightenment Trials. Most of us were first-timers, so we decided to team up.
We were in a huge panic at first. A lot of mistakes were made.
But I guess... that was when our friendship started to build up.
We wouldn't have won have we not placed our trust in each other.
It was also the time I realized... the stars are not beyond reach.
*Laugh* Yeah, Novar. The brightest star in the sky.
The next Enlightenment Trials is coming soon. I'm sure you'll participate in the pursuit of the Wonders.
Master Zhuangzi once said. "Push past your fear and you shall reach the stars." I hope we'll both find ours.
Cool, right? Li Bai is my biggest hero.
He's unrivaled at both poetry and swordcraft. And above all that, he is always standing up for justice.
Since I first heard about his deeds as a kid, he has been my number one role model.
I hope I can become a hero like him someday...
The beast hunt won't be easy. I'll take you to my training ground for some practice first. Let's go.
I kind of clung to my sister when I was young...
But she was always out training. And I'd throw a fit whenever I got left alone.
Yeah... At that time, though, I was too busy being an annoying kid to think of her.
Then I went too far one time. Said some bad words that made her very angry.
She left not long after, then I found this picture on the table.
And there was a note. "Never stop training. I'll be back."
These two swords have obviously been well cared for.
These two swords have obviously been well cared for.
And there's a star map on the scabbard...
And there's a star map on the scabbard...
This one is just for display. If you want to try it on, there's a spare set in the closet!
The boy with a big smile must be Novar. Who's the serious-looking girl beside him?
The boy with a big smile must be Novar. Who's the serious-looking girl beside him?
