Little dolls lined up in a row. So cute!
These little dolls look so familiar...
They must have been designed after the Team of Stars.
They must have been designed after the Team of Stars.
Novar's so-called "secret training method" turns out to be role-playing. He admits that his Star Power has been unstable, and hopes a session with you might help.
What are we going to do?
What are we going to do?
It's called "Flowplay," my original role-playing training method!
A genius is ninety-nine percent hard work and one percent instinct.
And to awaken that instinct, I just need a little bit of stimulation.
Shye's probably mentioned this, right? The power formed by Flow within our bodies is unique due to our different constitutions.
For me, that's the Star Power.
Two years ago, that power led me to victory in the Enlightenment Trials.
Unfortunately, it works as unpredictably as I do.
I've tried every Trial Circle in Jixia, but nothing worked.
Judging by how you've done so far, however, I think you might be able to help.
Why do I have a bad feeling about this...
Why do I have a bad feeling about this...
When I was at my lowest, I fought with a man at the Stargazing Terrace. Somehow it awakened my Star Power.
Simply put, we're having a contest.
When I was at my lowest, I dueled with a man at the Stargazing Terrace. Somehow it awakened my Star Power.
In the training of Flow, sparring is an effective way for us to learn from each other and get inspiration.
Besides... the way you wield the Flow is really special.
I've been eager to test your skills since the first time we met.

Just as Novar confesses his doubt for himself. Maple returns gravely wounded and reports that Cloudeater, now corrupted by the mysterious marks, has come back. Before anyone can stop him, Novar rushes off alone to confront the threat. Worried about his safety, Maple urges you to head to Aermore Valley to help him fight.
That's why every time my power fails me... I think of her.
Bet she wouldn't have to worry about this kind of thing.
Maybe that's the difference between a genius and... well, me.
Keep trying, huh? You're right, giving up isn't my style.
Maybe... I know not everything can be achieved overnight.
That's the spirit. By the way, it's good to hear you confiding in me like this.
That's the spirit. By the way, it's good to hear you confiding in me like this.
Anyway, enough about me. Why hasn't Maple returned yet?
After being defeated by Nora, Cloudeater has been clinging to life deep inside Aermore Valley.
Anyway, it was my fault. I shouldn't have let my guard down.
I hit it with a few arrows, but I doubt that will hold it back for long. I must go back.
But you're in no condition to fight, Ms. Maple. Let me go instead.
No, you're not ready. Not right now.
I know... but I have to go.
Don't worry, I'm the reigning champion, remember? I got this.
Take care of the head trainer for me.
You're hurting, Ms. Maple. Please, take it slow.
You're hurting, Ms. Maple. Please, take it slow.
However dangerous you think Cloudeater is, it's more dangerous than that.
Novar stands no chance against it alone.
*Sigh*... I know how hard it's been for him over the past two years.
He often comes here to train at night and never leaves until dawn.
One day, I saw him standing just outside Aermore Valley, still as a statue, for a long time.
He wants to be better than his sister, I get it. And there's nothing wrong with that.
It's just... he needs to understand where his true power comes from.
Go be there for him. Help him defeat the devil inside.
I'll be with him this time.
My disciples have already sent for the Herbalists. I'll be okay.
Aermore Valley is southwest of here. Go, and be careful.
Head trainer's hurt! Someone get the Herbalist, now!
Are you alright, Ms. Maple? Did the beasts do this?
Are you alright, Ms. Maple? Did the beasts do this?
They could hardly get close to you most of the time. What happened?
Somehow it's broken free. Much stronger and more aggressive, too... And I saw those same marks on its body.
So even Cloudeater... I thought only less intelligent animals could be affected...
People will get hurt if it escapes from the valley. I can't let that happen...
A moment of carelessness, and I was ambushed by that Cloud-Simian...
zh_text: 一时不慎，被那云狌偷袭了……
source_text: 一时不慎，被那云狌偷袭了……
official_target_text: A moment of carelessness, and I was ambushed by that Cloud-Simian...
official_en_text: A moment of carelessness, and I was ambushed by that Cloud-Simian...

text: Novar takes out some props and acts out as his idol Li Bai, then challenges you.
You even got props for this?
You even got props for this?
Great poems, better wine... but nothing beats the blade of mine.
I travel, I see, with the whole world at my feet. The name's Marco Polo.
I travel, I see, with the whole world at my feet. The name's Marco Polo.
The story happened during a legendary battle in Chang'an.
I am Li Bai, the noble Green Lotus Swordsman of Chang'an.
Now that's what I'm talking about. Take this!
Sorry for having to beat you, Marco.
My sword is always ready! Take this!
I'm Miyamoto Musashi, a wandering blademaster.
I'm Miyamoto Musashi, a wandering blademaster.
I'm Miyamoto Musashi, a wandering blademaster.
I'm Miyamoto Musashi, a wandering blademaster.
You join Novar at Red Falcon and wait for Maple to return from patrol. While waiting, he decides to invite you for a special training session and promises he'll explain his recent struggles.
Head trainer's been gone for a while now... She should be back any moment.
Thank you. I'll wait here then.
Gone west for another beast disturbance. Things were getting worse, so she went to check it out herself.
Agreed. A few arrows will be enough to deal with those animals!
Don't worry. Ordinary beasts are no match for her.
Okay, so... what did we just fight?
Okay, so... what did we just fight?
A menacing beast called Embermane. It has the aspect of a leopard, with a flaming tail like a tiger.
Honestly, I still can't believe it was corrupted, too... We must let Fuzi know when we get back.
I'm sure he'll be pleased with what we have learned!
And... thanks for saving me back there.
Don't mention it. Still... are you sure you're alright?
Don't mention it. Still... are you sure you're alright?
Alright, how about this—I'll tell you after our special training!
The tail fire looks like a tiger, the basket water looks like a leopard. That is a Zhuorong, a famous fierce beast of the Yunluo Highlands.
zh_text: “尾火形似虎，箕水貌若豹”，那是灼绒，云落高地有名的凶兽。
source_text: “尾火形似虎，箕水貌若豹”，那是灼绒，云落高地有名的凶兽。
official_target_text: The tail fire looks like a tiger, the basket water looks like a leopard. That is a Zhuorong, a famous fierce beast of the Yunluo Highlands.
official_en_text: The tail fire looks like a tiger, the basket water looks like a leopard. That is a Zhuorong, a famous fierce beast of the Yunluo Highlands.

text: Novar explains that Nora was a prodigy kid in Jixia—that she took down the legendary beast Cloudeater when she was just a kid. To Novar, his sister's achievements are almost impossible to reach.
zh_text: 东方曜向你讲述姐姐东方镜的传奇往事——这位稷下天才，早早便独自制服凶兽云狌，成为霜云镇传说中的少年英杰。她的辉煌战绩如同难以逾越的高峰，至今无人能及。
source_text: 东方曜向你讲述姐姐东方镜的传奇往事——这位稷下天才，早早便独自制服凶兽云狌，成为霜云镇传说中的少年英杰。她的辉煌战绩如同难以逾越的高峰，至今无人能及。
official_target_text: Novar explains that Nora was a prodigy kid in Jixia—that she took down the legendary beast Cloudeater when she was just a kid. To him, Novar's achievements are almost impossible to reach.
official_en_text: Novar explains that Nora was a prodigy kid in Jixia—that she took down the legendary beast Cloudeater when she was just a kid. To him, Novar's achievements are almost impossible to reach.

text: Novar tells you that he's always chased after his sister's footsteps, yet no matter how hard he tries, he's never quite gotten there. When you ask what Nora was like, he pauses for a bit before answering...
What's going on with your Star Power?
What's going on with your Star Power?
Heh... I hope I could know.
In the last Enlightenment Trials, my sister's team was our final opponent.
I've never beaten her, not once since I was little.
So when I awakened my Star Power and won the championship, I thought I was finally ready.
But if you hadn't been there just now, I would've been defeated by a mere Embermane.
But whatever I do, I just can't get the Star Power.
I've tried in the last two years. Really, I have. All those Trial Circles, all kinds of training...
Maybe that champion title was just luck.
Efforts can only take you so far, I guess...
What kind of person is your sister, Nora?
What kind of person is your sister, Nora?
The job is gonna be tough. We must go prepared.
Go on now. Get some good practice.
That was fast. Come on out!
Novar leads you to the waterfall and explains his favorite Trial Circle lies just behind it — an ideal spot for solo training.
Are we in the right place?
The training ground is just behind the waterfall.
It's a combat simulation device set up by the Three Sages. All its enemy units are formed using Aerflow energy.
I always come here to train myself. Now it's your turn.
I have faith in you, but the mission we're on is very dangerous.
One misstep, and those crazed beasts... Anyway, we must be cautious.
Alright, I'll be waiting for you here.
Nah, it's better if you do it alone. Good luck!
After the training, Novar decides to leave first to visit Maple, the Head Trainer of Red Falcon Training Hall. You can join him whenever you're ready.
Impressive. Now I'm sure I won't have to worry about you.
Next, I'm going to the Red Falcon Training Hall to visit the Head Trainer there. Maple.
That's right. Maple's in charge of the Red Falcon Training Hall. And she's the best instructor in the area.
She can command Red Falcons to do scouting work. No prey can escape her sight.
With her help, we can locate those beasts in no time.
Once you're all set, come find me at the Red Falcon Training Hall.
I'll go there first. You, in the meantime, feel free to stay in town for a bit longer.
There are a few acquaintances of mine here. Ember at the Smithy, Tata at her food shop...
I've given them a heads-up already. If you need weapons or food, just go and find them.
Tell them you are a friend of Novar! They will take good care of you.
You bet! Everyone in town loves me!
Frostcloud Town is my home in Jixia.
Lived here before joining the academy.
And I still come back whenever I'm free.

The truth is, Novar was the one who wanted to challenge Cloudeater, while Nora was just trying to save her brother. After sealing the beast, Nora said to him, "Your first and final enemy is always yourself." He's still trying to figure out the meaning even now...
zh_text: 东方曜向你吐露霜云传说背后的真相：当年他贸然挑战云狌险些丧命，被姐姐东方镜所救，镜封印凶兽后，留下"第一个和最后一个敌人都是自己"的话语，但其中的含义，他至今都不明白。
source_text: 东方曜向你吐露霜云传说背后的真相：当年他贸然挑战云狌险些丧命，被姐姐东方镜所救，镜封印凶兽后，留下"第一个和最后一个敌人都是自己"的话语，但其中的含义，他至今都不明白。
official_target_text: The truth is, Novar was the one who wanted to challenge Cloudeater, while Nora was just trying to save her brother. After sealing the beast, Nora said to him, "Your first and final enemy is always yourself". He's still trying to figure out the meaning even now...
official_en_text: The truth is, Novar was the one who wanted to challenge Cloudeater, while Nora was just trying to save her brother. After sealing the beast, Nora said to him, "Your first and final enemy is always yourself". He's still trying to figure out the meaning even now...

text: Who's this, Novar? Aren't you going to introduce us?
The world outside may be nice, but nothing beats the life in Frostcloud Town.
Give me a few years, and I'll be the best Martial Artist in Jixia!
You? Even better than Novar and Nora?
We may not be heroes, but it's good enough to cheer for those who are.
With me shining in the midst!

zh_text: 好耶，有曜哥哥的奖励咯！
source_text: 好耶，有曜哥哥的奖励咯！
official_target_text: Yay! Novar's gonna bring us gifts!
official_en_text: Yay! Novar's gonna bring us gifts!

text: Novar tells you that beasts near Frostcloud Town are getting increasingly aggressive under the impact of the mysterious marks. He invites you to join him in town and plan a solution together.
Wild beasts here are getting unusually aggressive, leaving their dens and attacking people without warning...
And guess what? They were all carrying those same kind of marks.
Alright! But a quick question first: do you know what this place is?
Hey! It's my base of operations in Jixia. It's not nowhere!
Well, you could've pretended you were curious...
Can feel your desire to share...
You can? Then I won't keep you guessing any more!
Anyway, meet Frostcloud Town. The gathering place for all Societies in Jixia, especially the Intelligencers.
I have my eyes and ears all over the town, and they've got me the latest update of the situation.
Those strange marks you saw underground? Well, they've been seen around here as well.
Turns out it's not just the Saepes.
Animals going rogue, marks on their bodies... Anything come to mind?
With all these clues we have, I believe the mystery has been unraveled—by Novar the genius detective!
There must be a massive conspiracy behind everything. And if I'm right...
Someone has been corrupting the beasts with Sorcery power, and their ultimate goal... is to bring down the academy!
The situation is critical, and we are Jixia's last hope!
What's that saying again... "Many a pickle makes a muscle?" The state of affairs is not to be underestimated.
Fair point, but I think the actual quote is... "Many a little makes a mickle," right?
Fair point, but I think the actual quote is... "Many a little makes a mickle," right?
You think I have a point, too, right?
Anyway, this kind of mission is meant for great talents like us.
And you're planning to join the Enlightenment Trials, right? Think of this as a warm-up.
You and me, we're gonna do something big! Much bigger than the Power Rankings!
Wh-what? No! I don't care about her, or the rankings at all!
To go beast-hunting, of course. But before that, let's get you a tour around the town.
I'm good, and I know you are too. But it doesn't hurt to make some preparations.

The storyteller, An You, tells you that Novar is very popular among the children for often bringing them snacks and telling fun stories. As she offers to tell the story about the legendary "Cloudeater," though, Novar looks as if he's holding something back...
Hi, Novar. What brings you back to town this time?
The kids are talking about you all the time.
Haha. That's called the charm of a genius.
You do seem popular around here...
Of course I am! Who can resist a genius like me?
Novar brings these kids snacks and tells all kinds of stories, like every time... They're crazy about him.
Not quite right. It's MY snacks!
I'll share some with you next time!
Please, Novar, don't go... Let's play together!
Listen, kiddo, I have very important things to do. I'll play with you next time, okay?
But... We still need people for the battle against Cloudeater...
Ah, so you haven't heard about it.
It's your first time in Frostcloud Town, right? Allow me, then.
It's your first time in Frostcloud Town, right? Allow me, then.
Look at the mask here. This is the face of Cloudeater, one of Frostcloud's biggest enemies in the past!
Every kid in town knows about its story. Quite a heroic tale.
Umm, yeah... It is fascinating indeed.
Yeah, it's been quite a while since I played swords with them.
And this must be Novar's new friend, right?
Candies from Alsahraa, cookies from Chang'an... all the best ones I brought back from my missions.
I've been on missions everywhere. Witnessed so many interesting things.
Over time, I have all the fak... uh, funny stories to tell.
You know what? Let's save them for after we're done dealing with the beasts!
The Frostcloud Legend, that's what we call it. So what do you say? Interested?
The story began long long ago, here in Frostcloud Town...
After listening to the story, you can tell Novar is somehow down in spirits. Without any comment, he continues leading you back to his home.
A flick of my fan, one knock on wood, and the tale unfolds before you. Please, do come back for what happened after!
What? There's more to that story?
What? There's more to that story?
Ah, sorry. That was just out of habit. The story of Cloudeater is long over.
But who knows? Maybe a new legend is in the making just as we speak.
It's getting dark, so I guess it's time to call it a day. Until next time, guys.
Sorry for keeping you so long. She sure is a talker.
Don't worry about it. It was an interesting story.
Don't worry about it. It was an interesting story.
Yeah, everyone loves a chivalrous tale.
Anyway, we should get some rest now.
Well, well—all my "old friends" are here today.
This thing is stronger than I thought.

You arrive at Mirror Pass to find Novar locked in a fierce battle against Embermane. Novar attempts to unleash Star Power, but once again he fails. At the critical moment, you block a fatal strike for him and join the fight.
Star Power straight from the sky!
I'll take care of you in no time, you little cat!
Hey, got word of another rogue beast spotted in Mirror Pass. It's very close to the training hall.
Things could get pretty messy if more students get hurt.
Meet me there when you're done!
That's pretty convenient when you want to dodge the questions...
That's pretty convenient when you want to dodge the questions...
Anyway, I should return to Red Falcon now.
Anyway, I should return to Red Falcon now.
Sounds urgent. I should hurry up.
Sounds urgent. I should hurry up.
Together, you defeat Embermane. When you express concern about his power, Novar dodges the question again and dashes off after saying he'll meet you at Red Falcon Training Hall.
Good thing we took care of this Embermane, otherwise the consequences would be unimaginable.
Yes. We did it just in time.
Yes. We did it just in time.
Anyway, I think we've learned enough. Time to wrap up the investigation.
Come on. Let's meet back at the Training Hall.
You talk too much... Take this!
The boy who got crushed here years back... It was you!
Aermore Valley shall be mine and mine alone!
You don't know your place, son.
I'll show you what real power looks like!
Come on, show me what you've got!
That door just opened. Let's check it out.
Marks on this pedestal too... Things just keep getting more confusing. How about I activate it first?
You can take the <001>elevator</> to your right.
After discussion, you and Novar decide to leave for Forbidden Chamber at night to seek more information.
That power... I couldn't move at all just now.
They're definitely up to something shady. We have to find them before it's too late.
We wouldn't have stood a chance against him.
We wouldn't have stood a chance against him.
Oh right, I didn't get a chance to ask—have you seen them before?
Yes, in Seclusion City. The one with red hair, that's Vesper.
Yes, in Seclusion City. The one with red hair, that's Vesper.
According to the old man, we should find some answers in the Forbidden Chamber.
According to the old man, we should find some answers in the Forbidden Chamber.
It's a restricted area of the academy. Students are not allowed to go near the place. Not even me.
But there might be clues there.
Well, no point overthinking it. We have a lead right in front of us, let's go check it out.
But they call the place "forbidden" for a reason. It's too heavily guarded to get in during the day.
I'll go and scout the area first. Let's meet at the entrance to the <001>Forbidden Chamber</> tonight.
I hate to admit it, but... you're right.
Unexpectedly, the Rebel guy notices you. With no other choice, you'll have to fight first.
Look, that's him. Something's not right...
Via her Big-eye Owlet, Shye tells you that she has discovered the same marks on a Rebel in the Mausoleum. You and Novar decide to head there and join the investigation.
Yes, after leaving Seclusion City, I traced them all the way here...
Remember those marks we saw in Seclusion City? Well, I spotted the same thing on a group of Rebels in the Mausoleum.
But there are too many of them, so I figured I should talk to Novar first...
Your guess is as good as mine. So, what's our next move?
Well, if you ask me, my answer is obvious. And that's—
The Mausoleum... that's in East Aerfall Highlands, right?
A field trip to skip class?
What, I... of course not! I'm only doing this for the safety of Jixia. I mean ONLY.
Okay, let's meet at the entrance to the <001>Mausoleum</>. I'll share more details once you're here.
Got it. Let's get moving. See you later!
A great adventure for heroes like us. What do you say? You in?
Oh, hey, it's you! Come, join us in this.
Seclusion City, Aermore Valley, and now there... what exactly are those marks?
What did you say? Mysterious marks in the Mausoleum?
Shye? What are you talking about?
Shye? What are you talking about?
The Mausoleum is a memorial site dedicated to unsung heroes. Shye explains what she saw on the Rebel, and you decide to go inside the place and investigate further.
Now they wander around Jixia, looking for allies. That often puts them at odds with students.
A Rebel? Like the ones I sometimes bump into?
Most of them just cause little troubles...
Hi! That makes all of us. Shye, ready to fill us in?
But so much time has passed, their names have long been forgotten.
The place is rarely visited by anyone. Honestly, it's my first time here too.
We won't figure out anything just standing around. Since all three of us are here, why don't we go in and see for ourselves?
Honored for outstanding achievements in the Battle of Wonders, our people successfully repelled powerful enemies. A mausoleum is erected here to commemorate their accomplishments...
Someone so celebrated in Jixia must be a figure of great merit. But who could that be?
Yes, you've probably met them before.
Right. You already know the gist. Let me tell you about the Rebel.
I found him while investigating the Mausoleum. At first, I thought he was just scavenging ruins for treasures like he usually does.
That mark on him... He was way fiercer than ordinary Rebels.
I wasn't sure I could handle him alone, so I came looking for you two.
The Mausoleum, I heard it's a ruin dedicated to the ancient heroes.
They once belonged to the academy, but left because they disagreed with its principles.
Good, you're here. Let's activate this Mechcraft and see if anything happens.
Suddenly, there's a noise outside, so you decide to go out and check.
Whew, that was exciting. Guess we can't let our guard down even for a moment.
Yeah... Hold on, did you hear that? Come, let's have a look.

The murals tell of the primordial age, when the Enforcers first appeared. One of them, the Sanctifier, sacrificed mortals and turned those strong enough to survive into Sanctified using his staff. It also mentions the heroes who saved Jixia during the same era. Just as you ponder their identities, the Mechanoids around you are awakened.
The Sanctifier forged mortals with his staff, bestowed only upon the bravest and strongest. They are known as the Sanctified.
The Sanctifier forged mortals with his staff, bestowed only upon the bravest and strongest. They are known as the Sanctified.
At the dawn of time, the living languished. Thus rose the Enforcers, who carried the will of the ancients and brought peace to the world.
The Sanctifier, who roams the world to fulfill his divine mission.
The Enforcers... Master Fuzi used to be one of them.
The Enforcers... Master Fuzi used to be one of them.
When Jixia was ravaged by war... They saved the people from their torment. This mausoleum was built in their honor.
When Jixia was ravaged by war... They saved the people from their torment. This mausoleum was built in their honor.
These heroes that saved the people... Their names are too hard to make out now.
I remember... that Vesper guy calling himself a Sanctified.
I remember... that Vesper guy calling himself a Sanctified.
This mural just raises more questions... Don't you think things are getting complicated?
Yeah... wait, those Mechanoids are activating!
Yeah... wait, those Mechanoids are activating!

official_target_text: (gets furious after spotting the player) *effort sequence* Ah—
official_en_text: (gets furious after spotting the player) *effort sequence* Ah—

text: The big guy's much tougher than the usual ones!
Try not to get hit by them!
Let's see what more tricks you've got!
Tricky, but manageable... Is everyone okay?
Now! Don't give him a chance to recover!
Novar suspects that the Rebel may have been corrupted by the marks. To prevent any more danger, you decide to split up and search for him.
He broke free from my Mistveil...
He's way stronger than an average Rebel... Maybe he's corrupted by the marks, just like those beasts?
I don't think he could've gone far after our fight. How about we split up and search the place?
Power like that is dangerous both to himself and others...
Power like that is dangerous both to himself and others...
Which is why we need to find him fast.
Mechanoids? Must be the old guards here...
Mechanoids? Must be the old guards here...
Novar asks you to meet up with him to plan your next move.
Let's continue our investigation. I must find out what these marks really are.
Meet up with me first, then we'll figure out the next step.
Another piece of Master's staff. His powers will come back in no time.
Watch out! This is a big one!
Come on, is that all you've got?!

The Rebel falls unconscious from corruption, his condition critical. Shye decides to escort him back to the academy for treatment, while you and Novar continue deeper into the Mausoleum in search of more clues.
Pretty sure those marks did this to him.
It's me. Now how's he doing?
Sure. Then let's split up here.
Weak and confused. Like he's been drained of life...
Saepes, Cloudeater, and now Rebels... Things are getting out of hand.
We can't leave him like this. I'll take him back to the academy first.
We must put an end to this... Let's keep searching the Mausoleum. See if we can find more clues.
I'd love to go with you, but this guy's in really bad shape.
There's no telling what else you might run into here. Be extra careful, okay?
Forever laid to rest here in their homeland...
Forever laid to rest here in their homeland...
So the heroes buried here were Jixia people.
So the heroes buried here were Jixia people.
Never mind. Let's just finish them off!
What does this stone tablet say...
What does this stone tablet say...

They turn out to be the old man and Vesper you met in the Underhall. After immobilizing you with his power, the old man admits that he is the Sanctifier. Before leaving, he hints that Fuzi has been keeping secrets from you, and suggests you look for answers in the Forbidden Chamber.
Who are you? What do you have to do with those strange marks?
You mean my Divine Imprint? It's the Power of Sanctification.
The Forbidden Chamber holds the truth about Divine Imprint.
Next time you come here, you won't leave so easily.
What do you want? Those monsters, those Rebels... what's your goal?
That's not how you speak to my master.
Your Master Fuzi has been keeping you in the dark.
Not that he's in any position to talk about me.
That Bracer of yours is something else.
Now on the peak to your left stands the Stargazing Terrace, an observatory built by the three schools.
Welcome, dear students, to Jixia Academy.
Welcome aboard the Aership to Jixia Academy... Uh, hello? What's going on?
Let me check, Master Fuzi. Ugh, how does it work again...?
So none of that got recorded? Doing the opening once is enough already...
The recording is on now, Master...
Why don't you remind me! Hgh, ugh...
Welcome aboard the Aership to Jixia Academy.
We are flying across the "Harvest Fields" as we speak. The fertile lands below can provide the yield for all Jixia people.
Food is the cornerstone of civilization. Conservation of nature should be just as important as the pursuit of knowledge.
Harmony with heaven and earth brings deep understanding of the universe.
Look ahead. Jixia Academy is now in sight.
Our students are all driven by a passion for knowledge. One as boundless as the starry sky.
Different schools and societies only mean different paths. You, your heart, is what really takes you to the "truth."
As the founder of the academy, it's my great pleasure to introduce you to Jixia.
Up there, the whole galaxy unfolds. And mastering its laws offers a clearer lens on our world.
The prosperity of the people and the nation begins in the wild. I hope every student, while seeking knowledge, never forgets the land.
zh_text: 万民社稷，兴生于野，希望每位学子求学问道，亦不忘山野。
source_text: 万民社稷，兴生于野，希望每位学子求学问道，亦不忘山野。
official_target_text: The prosperity of the people and the nation begins in the wild. I hope every student, while seeking knowledge, never forgets the land.
official_en_text: The prosperity of the people and the nation begins in the wild. I hope every student, while seeking knowledge, never forgets the land.

text: “The I Ching aligns with heaven and earth, thus it can encompass the Dao of heaven and earth.”
zh_text: “易与天地准，故能弥纶天地之道。”
source_text: “易与天地准，故能弥纶天地之道。”
official_target_text: “The I Ching aligns with heaven and earth, thus it can encompass the Dao of heaven and earth.”
official_en_text: “The I Ching aligns with heaven and earth, thus it can encompass the Dao of heaven and earth.”

text: In the library, a mysterious woman warns Fuzi that Ziya has returned to Jixia and he must stay alert. Fuzi promises he will handle the matter—in his own way.
They are not why I came here.
The real problem is that the seal inside the Yin Yang Gate was shattered.
That broken seal is covered with some strange marks, on which a few words can be discerned—
After all this time... I should've known he'd be back.
It's not my place to ask about your history. But I've heard that he's in Jixia now.
Back in the day, you stripped him of his powers and sealed him under our city.
His desire for vengeance is to be expected.
And since he broke free, I'm afraid he's somehow regained his strength.
If I'm right, then... you have to be very careful, Fuzi.
I understand. And please convey my thanks to the Empress for her warning.
Ziya is our problem, and we will deal with him.
Whatever he is planning... I will stop him, once and for all.
Taking out a sentinel inside the Forbidden Chamber...
I really hope no one ever finds out.
Got the valve? Great. Now slot it back in, and watch how the Aerflow moves inside. You should have the door open in no time.
Whoa, you're here already? I thought we agreed to meet at night.
You know, get a better look at the place, so we don't make mistakes tonight.
Good thing I did. The place is riddled with Mechcrafts. If we just barged in, we'd be caught for sure.
We should stick to the plan and go in at night.
And there's more of them! I'm coming!
Ugh, let's just take it down!
The author must be obsessed with cannons... not this one...
The author must be obsessed with cannons... not this one...
I've checked everywhere here, but no sign of the valve.
I've checked everywhere here, but no sign of the valve.
Impressive. If there's a real secret, I bet they'll keep it here.
Let's see if we can find anything.
Another hidden room behind these bookshelves...
Another hidden room behind these bookshelves...
This... sure looks like an underground vault to me. We should look around.
Will we get punished for this...?
Will we get punished for this...?
Hard to say. I mean, they will find out if they want to. But for now, let's press on.
Didn't see that one coming... Well, this counts as self-defense, right?
Um... we did sneak in without permission in the first place...
Um... we did sneak in without permission in the first place...
All this noise... Won't we attract more sentinels...?
All this noise... Won't we attract more sentinels...?
Too late to worry about that now. Let's get moving!
So many books... This could take forever.
Sealed in an underground vault? Is Master Fuzi really hiding something...?
That was close, huh? Just the final stretch now. Let's go up there.
After sneaking into the Forbidden Chamber's library, you decide to split up and search for clues.
This door leads straight to the restricted library. Should be plenty of books there.
Right, I did some research on the layout of the Forbidden Chamber beforehand.
Alright, we made it in! Pretty solid route I picked, yeah?
Solid? We almost got pummeled by the sentinels...
Solid? We almost got pummeled by the sentinels...
Uh... there was a little hiccup, but we managed to turn danger into safety, didn't we?
We can look for clues about the Divine Imprint.
Think there are more sentinels inside?
Think there are more sentinels inside?
Just hide behind the bookshelves. They make perfect cover.
Once inside, we'll split up. We'll cover more ground that way.

Back then, Fuzi used the Wonder to build the academy, while Ziya sought "worthy" candidates for divinity. Things went very well at first, until Ziya's desire for power took him too far... To protect Jixia and its people, Fuzi had no choice but to shatter Ziya's staff and exile him.
Guided by the Deities, Ziya and I pledged ourselves to the protection of the mortal world.
I used the Wonder to build our academy, while he journeyed across the land seeking "the worthy ones."
However, the Power of Sanctification was just too much to take...
Then Ziya saw the potential of our students.
So he came to join me, determined to fulfill our mission together.
For a time, Jixia thrived like never before.
Yet his desire for power consumed him...
To protect my people, I shattered his staff and cast him out.
Just like that, a bond of a thousand years ended...
For a time, Jixia was unprecedentedly prosperous.
official_target_text: For a time, Jixia was unprecedentedly prosperous.
official_en_text: For a time, Jixia was unprecedentedly prosperous.

text: You sincerely admit your fault and share with Master Fuzi what you've learned so far.
The Divine Imprint... And what did you find?
Did you really think I wouldn't notice you?
Especially you, Novar. As a mentor, you should be setting an example.
Yet you led the way into the forbidden land, treating the academy rules as nothing!
Discipline. Rules. Must I teach them to you all over again?
Ah, you two... Speak up. Why are you here?
We were... looking for clues about Divine Imprints.
Th-that won't be necessary, Master Fuzi. We were in the wrong.
Learning that you have already met Ziya, Fuzi decides it's time to tell you the truth...
Very well. Perhaps it is time to tell you the truth.
And that's all that happened today.
Master Fuzi... what really happened between you and Ziya back then? And why did you seal everything away?
I expected him to seek me out first. As it turns out, he encountered you instead.
Novar recognizes the mysterious woman as Lady Shangguan from Chang'an. Seeing the two depart, you quietly follow after them.
They mentioned Ziya. He's the Sanctifier, right?
They mentioned Ziya. He's the Sanctifier, right?
Let's follow them and see what else they're up to.
I think so. Can't believe Chang'an is involved... It just keeps getting complicated.
Was that Lady Shangguan from Chang'an? What are they doing here?
You find a book, "The Last Enforcer", and decide to read it together.
The Last Enforcers... seems like what we're looking for.
The Last Enforcers... seems like what we're looking for.
You found it? Great, let's have a look!
Stay calm and... Actually, let's just take it down together!
Well, at least now we have nothing to worry about. Just hope Master Fuzi won't know it's us...
The Mechcraft is missing a round component called "Aerflow Valve." You'll need to search the area and find it.
There's a Mechcraft here, but it's missing a round part...
There's a Mechcraft here, but it's missing a round part...
A round part? You mean the <001>Aerflow Valve</>, right?
What you found is likely a lock Mechcraft. It typically has two parts.
The rectangular piece below is the Aerflow Container, and the disc on top is the Aerflow Valve.
Aerflow flows out of the Aerflow Container, through the Aerflow Valve, and into the gate. This will open the gate.
The Aerflow Valve is large and heavy, making it difficult to transport.
I guess... it's probably lying around here somewhere.
Well... guess they call it the Forbidden Chamber for a reason.
Hey, what's going on over there?
Ran into a few more Mechanoids.
Good thing they're just Mechanoids. Not berserk beasts. Or monsters. Or both.
Alright, alright, I'll shut up. You be careful!
Stop it... that's creeping me out...
Thanks... now I'm even more nervous.
According to the letter, Master Fuzi asked that records of the Sanctified be sealed underground to prevent further trouble. You decide to follow this lead and continue investigating.
Let's go get to the bottom of this!
Whatever the truth is, it must be buried inside that <001>underground vault</>.
Whatever the truth is, it must be buried inside that <001>underground vault</>.
According to the letter, Master Fuzi asked that records of the Sanctified be sealed underground to prevent further trouble.
But after all this time... what could possibly still be the problem?
Guess we'll have to go all the way to the bottom.

You have found half of a book related to the Sanctified, while the other half is sealed in a hidden chamber near "the Forbidden Drive." You split up again to continue the search, and Novar will stay in contact with his Big-eye Owlet.
Special treatment, huh? Now that's a secret worth digging into.
Good idea, but I don't like the idea of you acting alone. I'll send Big-eye Owlet with you. Stay in touch if anything happens.
We can split up again, like before.
We can split up again, like before.
<001>The Forbidden Drive</>... I think Sun Bin told me about it once. It's a massive blue sphere, keeping the whole place running like a heart.
But the Forbidden Chamber is so huge, with so many paths...
The books say the Sanctifier created the Sanctified.
The books say the Sanctifier created the Sanctified.
Sounds like a pretty obvious landmark. Let's look for it first.
Sounds like a pretty obvious landmark. Let's look for it first.
I haven't found a thing. Any luck on your end?
I found half a volume that mentions the Sanctified. The description matches the mural we saw in the Mausoleum...
I found half a volume that mentions the Sanctified. The description matches the mural we saw in the Mausoleum...
A note inside says it's kept in a secret chamber next to the Forbidden Drive.
A note inside says it's kept in a secret chamber next to the Forbidden Drive.
<001>The Secret Forbidden Hub</>... I think I've heard Sun Bin mention it. It looks like a giant blue orb of light, maintaining the operation of the Secret Forbidden Pavilion like a heart.
zh_text: <001>秘禁枢</>……我好像听孙膑提起过，看上去是个巨大的蓝色光球，如同心脏一般维系着秘禁阁的运转。
source_text: <001>秘禁枢</>……我好像听孙膑提起过，看上去是个巨大的蓝色光球，如同心脏一般维系着秘禁阁的运转。
official_target_text: <001>The Secret Forbidden Hub</>... I think I've heard Sun Bin mention it. It looks like a giant blue orb of light, maintaining the operation of the Secret Forbidden Pavilion like a heart.
official_en_text: <001>The Secret Forbidden Hub</>... I think I've heard Sun Bin mention it. It looks like a giant blue orb of light, maintaining the operation of the Secret Forbidden Pavilion like a heart.

text: We can go in through here!
Whoa, there's another one! Go back, back!
But... it looks like everyone's gone.
Good job! I can see you've got a knack for Mechcraft.
Over here! There's an elevator on my side. We can take it and go down together.
Okay, let me see how to open the door.
Okay, let me see how to open the door.
Puppet... It sure brings back memories.
Puppet... It sure brings back memories.
Although the Forbidden Chamber is heavily guarded, Novar tells you that by making use of the grass and walls, you can slip past the patrols and sneak inside.
Shh, keep it down. Come over here.
Those patrols are called <001>Forbidden Sentinel Drives</>.
You'll be banned from the Forbidden Land, and the academy will deduct your credits and issue a disciplinary notice.
Look, that's the Forbidden Chamber ahead.
Rumors say it houses not only forbidden books but also ancient Forbidden Artifacts.
Yes. They say all confiscated illegal books since Jixia's founding ended up here.
Stuff like dangerous formulas, forbidden techniques, occult journals... If there's a secret about Divine Imprint, it's probably in there.
Prohibited items recovered from all over Jixia.
Monsters that replicate infinitely, Mechanoids that won't stop dancing, even potions that can make someone disappear...
They have incredibly keen vision. Even a tiny Croaky would have trouble slipping past them, let alone us.
So, to protect the few credits we have left, we must be extra careful.
So we use the bushes and walls?
So we use the bushes and walls?
Yes. Stay close to me. One step at a time.
Dangerous is not going to stop me, or you. Just stay close, and be on your guard.
But if we can stay out of their line of sight, we can sneak in unnoticed.
See those bushes over there? And the walls... they all make perfect cover. Guess the Forbidden Chamber isn't foolproof, after all.
Sounds like you already have a plan?
Sounds like you already have a plan?
Of course I do. See those bushes over there? And the walls... they all make perfect cover. Guess the Forbidden Chamber isn't foolproof, after all.
This... must be the Forbidden Drive?
This... must be the Forbidden Drive?
Whoa... impressive! The secret chamber has to be nearby.
Careful now. You don't want those sentinels to spot you.
Nice. Now on to the next one.
Not so hard, right? More sentinels ahead. Stay sharp.
I'll teach you how to flash someday. It'd be really handy for times like this.
Almost there! Still, keep quiet now, or all this will be for nothing.
Like you've been quiet the whole time...
Like you've been quiet the whole time...
Maybe I should use it to go down.
Maybe I should use it to go down.
Be careful. The deeper we go, the more dangerous it might get.
Sounds like you've done this before.
Sounds like you've done this before.
Here's a tip—don't touch things you don't know, and don't switch on things that look weird!
But you've been doing the exact opposite...
But you've been doing the exact opposite...
Ruins, secret chambers... Experience tells me it's all the same thing.
Ahem... Needs must, you know. Wait, I think I'm stuck. Talk to you later.
Finally... Now back to the search.
Finally... Now back to the search.
Be careful. And stay low when moving.
Dark Side of the Flow... "Lethal Ways to Wield a Hammer"... No wonder these books are banned.
Here! "A Study of Golden Markings." Let's see... Nope, it's about venomous snakes.

Once there were two great sages. One wielded the Staff of Sanctification, the other the Ferule of Order. Then during the Battle of the Wonders, the Sanctifier depleted his power to protect Jixia, and after the war, the Sanctified faded into obscurity.
Once, two great sages were selected to be the Enforcers.
One received the Staff of Sanctification, the other the Ferule of Order.
After the Battle of the Wonders began...
They built an academy in Jixia, protecting the people from the struggles.
Yet the enemies just kept on getting stronger.
The Sanctifier exhausted his power and defended Jixia alongside the Sanctified.
And when the battle ended, the Sanctified were no more...
One gains the Staff of Deification, the other the Ruler of Worldly Rectification.
zh_text: 一得封神之杖，一得匡世戒尺。
source_text: 一得封神之杖，一得匡世戒尺。
official_target_text: One gains the Staff of Deification, the other the Ruler of Worldly Rectification.
official_en_text: One gains the Staff of Deification, the other the Ruler of Worldly Rectification.

text: Surprisingly, Fuzi and the Sanctifier were once close friends, and the Sanctified was actually the hero depicted in the mural. Feeling even more confused, you decide to leave and ask Fuzi for answers.
If he really wronged someone, he'd own up to it, not hush things up.
You're right, Master Fuzi is indeed widely regarded as a man of integrity...
You're right, Master Fuzi is indeed widely regarded as a man of integrity...
Besides, the recent corruption incidents are all linked to the Sanctifier. He's definitely not one to be trusted.
Maybe he did protect the academy, but there could be more to the story we don't know.
Remember, the recent corruption incidents in Jixia are all linked to the Sanctifier. He's not to be trusted.
Remember, the recent corruption incidents in Jixia are all linked to the Sanctifier. He's not to be trusted.
This could just be a ploy to turn us and Master Fuzi against each other.
This could just be a ploy to turn us and Master Fuzi against each other.
You have a point. Perhaps he did protect the academy once. But whatever was sealed away here... there's more to the story than we know.
Master Fuzi is acting strange. Sealing away secrets, hiding the truth... it's not like him.
Master Fuzi is acting strange. Sealing away secrets, hiding the truth... it's not like him.
But the Sanctifier is hardly benevolent. Remember, the recent corruption incidents in Jixia are all linked to him.
But the Sanctifier is hardly benevolent. Remember, the recent corruption incidents in Jixia are all linked to him.
He might have led us to investigate the Forbidden Chamber just to make us doubt Master Fuzi.
He might have led us to investigate the Forbidden Chamber just to make us doubt Master Fuzi.
You have a point. Perhaps he did protect the academy once. But whatever was sealed away here... there's more to the story than we know.
We can't just take his word for it... The more we investigate, the more confusing it gets. Once we're out, I'll confront Fuzi directly!
Hopefully then, all our questions will be answered.
This is what the Sanctifier wants us to believe.
He didn't blame them wrongly, did he...
What? So Master Fuzi and the Sanctifier were old friends, not enemies?
They became Enforcers and founded the academy...
Records in the Mausoleum show the Sanctifier and the Sanctified defended Jixia together in that war. The Sanctified died in the battle.
If that's true, then the Sanctified were the heroes depicted in the mural.
If that's true, then the Sanctified were the heroes depicted in the mural.
And the calamity that befell Jixia was caused by someone else.
And the calamity that befell Jixia was caused by someone else.
If the Sanctified truly were Jixia's heroes... why would Master Fuzi go so far to bury their history?
Perhaps back then, he misunderstood the Sanctified, and they had a falling-out.
Perhaps back then, he misunderstood the Sanctified, and they had a falling-out.
Afterward, he concealed the truth to cover up his mistake?
Afterward, he concealed the truth to cover up his mistake?
If it were anyone else, I'd say that's possible...
But Master Fuzi is my teacher and the headmaster of Jixia Academy. I know him as a person. He's not one to run from his mistakes.
The sentinel's back. Better stay low and wait for another chance.
The sentinel's back. Better stay low and wait for another chance.
Nothing here... Is it really the right place...?
After a brief exchange, Shangguan takes her leave. Then Fuzi turns around and asks you to come out—he's known you're here the whole time.
It was good to see you, Fuzi.
The Grand Ceremony is only a few days away. You should get some rest before the event.
Speaking of which... I suppose our other guest should be here by now?
Well, I wouldn't bet my Ringild on that. He'll show up when he feels like it.
He is a popular figure indeed. Well, I'll take my leave. Good night, Master Fuzi.
I'll report back to Chang'an after the ceremony.
As for him... he has no official duties this time.
So I imagine he'll stay in Jixia for a while longer.
My apologies in advance, for any inconvenience he may cause you.
That's totally fine. The students might actually like him more than they like me.
There's one in the hallway! Come, this way.
There's another floor below! Let's check it out.
There's another floor below! Let's check it out.
There, the <001>bushes</>. We can move in them when the sentinel isn't looking.
I'll use my power to take point. Wait for the right moment and follow, okay?
Let's try to keep a lower profile from now on... Stick with me.
What, you busted another one? You're not a Rebel, are you?
A third one? That's like, 150 credits gone...
Follow me now, okay? And try not to bankrupt me...
Let's just get through here quickly...
Wow! You took it out just like that?
Still, we'll lose credits if Master Fuzi finds out. Maybe don't do that again.
You beat me to it. Well done! Now you should search for that book.
Watch out! I knew they'd never fail to crash the party.
Already talking back to your mentor, are we?
I should take it back and see if it works.
I should take it back and see if it works.
This must be the Aerflow Valve!
This must be the Aerflow Valve!
This book mentions the Divine Imprints! But the second half is missing...
This book mentions the Divine Imprints! But the second half is missing...
I should check in with Novar first.
I should check in with Novar first.
I should wait until the sentinel looks away.
I should wait until the sentinel looks away.
Let's move before anyone notices. Follow me.
There's no need to worry, Lady Shangguan. Mozi already has a plan for the repairs in Chang'an.

Master Fuzi states that his grudge with Ziya is his own to settle and urges you to focus on preparing for the Enlightenment Trials. After he leaves, Novar invites you to join the Team of Stars, asking you to meet with Meng Ya tomorrow at Enlightenment Plaza.
Hey! You can't be seriously thinking about joining her team!
After everything we've been through, I thought...
So—of course I'm joining the Team of Stars.
So—of course I'm joining the Team of Stars.
It was entirely my idea. I should take all the blame.
Some measure of responsibility, at least... Then that's eighty credits off for you as punishment.
Eighty credits?! That... that'll take forever to earn them back...
Which is exactly why it'll serve as a good reminder for you.
I'll help you earn them back.
You promise? No taking it back, okay?
Promise. We got into this mess together, didn't we?
Promise. We got into this mess together, didn't we?
As for sneaking into the Forbidden Chamber today...
As my partner, you're bound to help me earn them back!
I'll need a team for that, right?
I'll need a team for that, right?
So that Rebel we encountered... was he corrupted by the Power of Sanctification...?
Precisely. Whoever accepts this power will gain unparalleled strength... but at a terrible price.
That... you will know about it when the time is right.
Ziya has come for me, so I shall handle this alone.
Meanwhile, the only thing you need to care about now is the upcoming Enlightenment Trials.
Not that it's a problem. Shye and Sun Bin are already on board.
Meng Ya is on the team too, right? Is he okay with it?
Meng Ya is on the team too, right? Is he okay with it?
That guy's been too busy with his cannons. Haven't had a chance to talk to him since I got back.
We're meeting at Enlightenment Plaza tomorrow. I'll ask him then.
As our headmaster, he will always protect us. And if Ziya really is coming for the academy...
Then what about that great war we read about?
Haha, I was just kidding. Let's do that together.
Haha, I was just kidding. Let's do that together.
It must be hard for Master Fuzi... you know, old friends turning against each other.
Good thing we were smart enough to find out the truth...
Master Fuzi said he'd handle it, then he'll handle it. Now let's get you set up for the Enlightenment Trials.
Still... despite me being the captain, a decision like this requires everyone's approval.
And I know Mr. Luban well enough to know he will welcome a new friend.
I see no reason for him to object, though. Actually, you should come. That sounds okay to you?
I'll take my leave now. You should go, too.
I had to put an end to it. That is why I wrote that letter to have everything sealed away.
Well, in fact... I've already got that sorted out for you.
How about you join us? The Team of Stars?
Yes, and also the championship team. With us, your chances of winning will improve greatly!
What do you think? Pretty impressive, huh?
The three schools of our academy are renowned across the land.
The School of Sorcery delves into the nature of things, while the School of Mechcraft bring ideas to life.
To me, of course, the School of Martial Arts will always be the best.
When you see how I fight with my sword, you'll know I'm right.
Also here at the academy, various Societies converge and collide.
Just a few days ago, we held the opening of the Debates of Societies. You should definitely check it out when you have time!
The ceremony requires the presence of all Three Sages of Jixia.
You've met me already. Now let me introduce you to the other two.
This is Mozi, headmaster of the School of Mechcraft.
And the headmaster of School of Sorcery. You may have heard of him—Zhuangzi.
So, you are that new student...
Another soul seeking answers within boundless dreams.
Yet I'm sensing something more in your heart. Something buried deeper...
Only the ones with control over their dreams can find the path to true awakening.
To help you find the right direction... that is our mission here at the academy.
So, would you like to join us?
You are now officially a student of Jixia Academy.
To promote love and peace with our own creations!
Cast your Flow into the Aercocoon.
On my path, I met two kindred spirits who share the same ideals.
If I don't pass, your credits...
zh_text: 万一我没通过，你的学分……
source_text: 万一我没通过，你的学分……
official_target_text: If I don't pass, your credits...
official_en_text: If I don't pass, your credits...

text: The “Bozhong Ranking” — the most prestigious list for Jixia students. I must introduce it to you.
zh_text: “伯仲榜”——稷下学子最看重的榜单，我必须为你介绍一下。
source_text: “伯仲榜”——稷下学子最看重的榜单，我必须为你介绍一下。
official_target_text: The “Bozhong Ranking” — the most prestigious list for Jixia students. I must introduce it to you.
official_en_text: The “Bozhong Ranking” — the most prestigious list for Jixia students. I must introduce it to you.

text: ...Are you a student of Jixia as well?
official_target_text: ...Are you a student of Jixia as well?
official_en_text: ...Are you a student of Jixia as well?

zh_text: 一个忠告：谨慎挑选你的队伍。
source_text: 一个忠告：谨慎挑选你的队伍。

text: This will definitely save a lot of time for inventing mechanisms.
zh_text: 一定能省下好多时间发明机关。
source_text: 一定能省下好多时间发明机关。
official_target_text: This will definitely save a lot of time for inventing mechanisms.
official_en_text: This will definitely save a lot of time for inventing mechanisms.
