official_target_text: Everything is still unknown, I wouldn't dare to make any bold claims... By the way, Novar looked so mysterious when he mentioned the Star-Gazing Platform. I'm curious, why hold the trial here?
official_en_text: Everything is still unknown, I wouldn't dare to make any bold claims... By the way, Novar looked so mysterious when he mentioned the Star-Gazing Platform. I'm curious, why hold the trial here?

text: One last test remains. Meng Ya invites you to join him in Smokescar Vale to investigate the rogue Fire Lizards. You agree to meet by the bulletin board at Traveler's Stop to plan your next steps.
Okay, you have passed your second test.
You know, that was the toughest formation combination I could find in Meng's War Tactics.
It's a book I wrote. It contains my interpretation of every school of military strategies.
I'll let you borrow it... after you pass the final test, that is!
First, I want you to answer this: What's the most important quality you look for in a teammate other than strength and strategic acumen?
Courage. Strategy gives you a plan, and courage makes sure you execute it.
They're hard to track down and even harder to fight. Many students accepted the commission, but none have succeeded. So, dare to do this?
Too late to back out now...
Okay. Then off to the third test we go.
Meet me by the bulletin board at Traveler's Stop. I'll give you the details there.
Hmm, I like this answer... Wait, did Novar tell you say that?
No, but in the face of all the challenges, our mind must be strong enough so we can keep going.
No, but in the face of all the challenges, our mind must be strong enough so we can keep going.
Hmm... Novar wouldn't have come up with that. I like it. Meanwhile, my answer for that is...
Are you saying the bond between teammates doesn't matter...?
Are you saying the bond between teammates doesn't matter...?
Of course it does... No, I mean, I'm talking about qualities in battle! Listen, my answer is...
Well... it's true that supplies are critical in a war.
So wealth does matter, yes. But what I'm talking about is bigger than just money. And that would be...
I simulated a variety of changes of tactics and strategies in battle, yet you were able to handle them all.
Alright... then what's the final test?
Alright... then what's the final test?
For our test of courage, you'll need to complete a new academy commission—to hunt down the fire lizards.
Alright, alright. I'll go with you this time, okay?
Courage. 'Strategy' is the guarantee for planning the battle, while 'courage' is about the belief in victory. Both are indispensable.
zh_text: “勇气”。“谋”是规划战局的保证，而“勇”关乎制胜的信念，二者缺一不可。
source_text: “勇气”。“谋”是规划战局的保证，而“勇”关乎制胜的信念，二者缺一不可。
official_target_text: Courage. 'Strategy' is the guarantee for planning the battle, while 'courage' is about the belief in victory. Both are indispensable.
official_en_text: Courage. 'Strategy' is the guarantee for planning the battle, while 'courage' is about the belief in victory. Both are indispensable.

text: You arrive at the main hall to find some disciples trying to scare Sun Bin off. The head trainer, Tigon, reveals that Aersilk Mech Core is kept inside a special training Mechanoid called "Tiger Palm", and promises to give it to you if you win the fight in the arena.
An interesting title. And what brings the two of you here?
You don't have any idea how things work here, do you?
Another big talker. What do you want now?
I'm more experienced in fighting than you are.
I'm more experienced in fighting than you are.
You can just sit back, relax, and cheer for me.
You can just sit back, relax, and cheer for me.
Why are you still standing here?
Only real fighters are allowed inside. You, a kid? You should leave before you get hurt.
You wanna talk to our master, you must get through us first.
I see, but... I'm no pushover! I'm ready for a challenge!
Got some fight in you, huh? Tell me, ever seen a fist the size of a sandbag?
Scared? You're right to be scared. Show him out!
Watch your tone right there! Our head trainer can take down Cloudeater without breaking a sweat. You'll see soon enough!
If you want to see the head trainer, you'll have to prove yourself first.
Moonhawk, Feralwolf, get ready. Show them what we've got!
Who's the best in Martial Arts?
The Roaring Tiger tops all charts!
We are the best. Now come to the test!
Who wants to see me? And what business do you have here?
An honor to finally meet you, Head Trainer Tigon. Your reputation precedes you.
An honor to finally meet you, Head Trainer Tigon. Your reputation precedes you.
At least you know your manners. What's your name?
We heard that you have an Aersilk Mech Core here...
We heard that you have an Aersilk Mech Core here...
We're building a Mechanoid, and we'd like to study the core's design.
We're building a Mechanoid, and we'd like to study the core's design.
Ah. So that's what you're after.
What kind of name is that...?
You have a problem with the name I picked?
Tiger Palm is a customized training Mechanoid made for us by the School of Mechcraft.
But it was a bit too powerful for many of my disciples, so I sealed it away prevent more from getting hurt.
After all, you're not gonna learn much in combat if you cannot hang on for long.
I don't mind lending the core to you, but nothing comes easy in my training hall. So how about this...
How about giving it to us?
I haven't agreed to anything! What I mean is, let's do this the Roaring Tiger way.
One of you, get in the arena. If you win, the Mech Core is yours. If you lose... then this conversation never happened.
And I'd love for a chance to test my skills here. Besides, they can't be stronger than Cloudeater, right?
And I'd love for a chance to test my skills here. Besides, they can't be stronger than Cloudeater, right?
In our place, you fight for what you want!
Greetings, sir. I'm Sun Bin from the School of Mechcraft. And this is...
The head trainer really has a loud voice...
The head trainer really has a loud voice...
Y-yes, and... we're wondering if it's possible to borrow it for a while.
The core is now being kept inside the most prized asset of my training hall—Tiger Palm.
Then let's do this. I'm Sun Bin, a-and... I'm ready for the challenge!
Ever heard about me? The name's Shadowclaw, and my fists write stories your bones will remember!
And I'm Galewings. I don't break a sweat—I break your heart!
We'd like to see your head trainer. Please let him know we're here.
We'd like to see your head trainer. Please let him know we're here.
Ever seen a sword two meters long?
Ever seen footwork light as a sparrow?
I would be honored to oblige.
official_target_text: I would be honored to oblige.
official_en_text: I would be honored to oblige.

text: Linghu Six-Six-Six is a sparring machine I specifically asked the Mechanism Academy to build.
zh_text: “凌虎六六六”是我特地请机关学院打造的陪练机关。
source_text: “凌虎六六六”是我特地请机关学院打造的陪练机关。
official_target_text: Linghu Six-Six-Six is a sparring machine I specifically asked the Mechanism Academy to build.
official_en_text: Linghu Six-Six-Six is a sparring machine I specifically asked the Mechanism Academy to build.

text: You're always welcome at Roaring Tiger Training Hall!
Watch out! He's got another move coming!
Anyone that spars with him will find pure joy in utter defeat!
When it comes to strength, Head Trainer Tigon's second to none.
How am I supposed to train now?
After getting his butt kicked inside, the student advises you not to challenge Roaring Tiger Training Hall.
Excuse me. I'm here to see Head Trainer Tigon.
Excuse me. I'm here to see Head Trainer Tigon.
Haven't you heard the rules? Whoever wants to go up there must first defeat those Mechanoids inside.
You asked the wrong person. I'm not a disciple here.
For them, if you don't have what it takes, you're not worth their time.
I see. So you're outside because...
I see. So you're outside because...
Enough! I'm done talking to you!
You want my opinion? Do yourself a favor and turn back while you still can!
Turn back isn't an option for me.
Whatever. If you wish to learn this the hard way, be my guest!
All materials are ready, though Sun Bin remains uncertain whether this will truly help Mr. Luban. With your encouragement, he shakes off the doubt inside and decides to press on.
We are ready to craft the Mechanoid, right? Hey, what's wrong? Something on your mind?
We are ready to craft the Mechanoid, right? Hey, what's wrong? Something on your mind?
I know everything's going as planned, but I can't shake this uneasy feeling.
Yes. Originally, they were designed for No. 7.
He's never made another Mechanoid since No. 7 went missing. Yet he just keeps working on the Mechwings...
I actually overheard him talking once, "If only I had given him the wings..."
I think is a regret he wants so bad to make up for.
I know what it's like to lose someone important—a very good friend who looked after me like a big brother.
After I lost him... it was him and the Team of Stars that gave me the courage to move on.
You already know what to do.
You're right... And nothing will change my mind.
After talking with you, I feel much more confident... Thank you.
Just focus on your work, and all will be fine.
Just focus on your work, and all will be fine.
Yes. I hope it will be a creation that carries our promise—that we're always there for him.
I... I'm fine! Thank you for getting the Mech Core for us. Now we just need to assemble the parts and start the fabrication.
What we're doing for him here... Is it really what he needs?
And now it's my turn to help him. I cannot fail.
That's why you're working so hard to make that Mechanoid.
That's why you're working so hard to make that Mechanoid.
Thanks! I'll go back to the school and test the Fabricator first. Let's meet when it's done!
Mr. Luban doesn't talk much, but he's always been supporting us in his own way.
I should've noticed this sooner. Like back when he gave me the Mechwings...
You're right. I should go back to work now.
I wish I could be as positive as you are. It's just... can we really do it?
Haha! That was a great fight!
Not bad, kid! Now let us have a go!
The Aersilk Mech Core is incredibly powerful. Even for the strongest combat Mechanoids.
Thank you, Head Trainer Tigon. We'll return the core to you once we're done.
Thank you, Head Trainer Tigon. We'll return the core to you once we're done.
But there's something I need to ask.
I believe in Sun Bin. He'll get it done.
I believe in Sun Bin. He'll get it done.
Way to go, kid! It's been a while since I had such a satisfying fight.
I'm a man of my word. The Mech Core is yours.
Are you sure what you're building can handle that power?
Nah, don't worry about that. Just take your time, and I wish your work a great success!
It was a great match, Head Trainer Tigon.
It was a great match, Head Trainer Tigon.
I'll study how Aerflow runs the core and come up with a solution suitable for smaller Mechanoids. It's hard, but not impossible.
You're not a Martial Arts student, but I see the fire in your eyes. I like that!
That was an awesome fight! But... are you hurt?
Not a scratch. And what's better is we got the Mech Core!
Not a scratch. And what's better is we got the Mech Core!
Honestly, I can't! There's no way I'd last against those hawk and claw guys...
You never know till you try. If you're interested in Martial Arts, I'll train with you next time.
You never know till you try. If you're interested in Martial Arts, I'll train with you next time.
Really? Then... I'll look forward to it...
I gave you my word, and I kept it.
Now, I think the exit is on the top, and since I cannot fly up there like you... Why don't you go first and I'll join you?
Now, I think the exit is on the top, and since I cannot fly up there like you... Why don't you go first and I'll join you?
Sun Bin cheers for you from the audience.
Fierce as a tiger, swift as a falcon! This will be an easy win!
Can't hear you! Whose side are you on, kid?
Go, Team of Stars! S-show them what you got!
Not bad at all! Keep going!
Where's Sun Bin? Has he gone up already? Then I should hurry.
Where's Sun Bin? Has he gone up already? Then I should hurry.
Again? Tsk, you didn't learn your lesson.
Come! Let's see how long you can do this!
The Roaring Tiger Training Hall. I should find a way to meet the head trainer and ask him about the Mech Core.
The Roaring Tiger Training Hall. I should find a way to meet the head trainer and ask him about the Mech Core.
Mr. Luban comes over and sees the new Mechanoid. You explain your intentions and, watching how the new Mechanoid interacts with everyone, he seems to be touched.
(attempts a graceful finish, but cape covers face) *effort sequence*
To let you know... we're always here.
It is time to move on...
You were the one who taught me that.
Don't trap yourself in the past.
Above the sky I reach the stars!
It is time to move on!
Uh, em? (trying to make sense of the world)
Uh...? (trying to figure out what's going on)
After No. 7 went missing, you've shut yourself off.
We know he can never replace No. 7...
Do not trap yourself in frozen time.
zh_text: “不要将自己困在静止的时间里。”
source_text: “不要将自己困在静止的时间里。”
official_target_text: Do not trap yourself in frozen time.
official_en_text: Do not trap yourself in frozen time.

text: Ever since Number Seven went missing, you've kept yourself closed off.
zh_text: 七号走丢后，你就一直把自己封闭起来。
source_text: 七号走丢后，你就一直把自己封闭起来。
official_target_text: Ever since Number Seven went missing, you've kept yourself closed off.
official_en_text: Ever since Number Seven went missing, you've kept yourself closed off.

text: You take turns to channel your Flow into the Mech Core.
You will find what you've lost.
Please, open your heart and let us in.
It is time to move on...
The Mechanoid has been built. Sun Bin invites everyone to channel their Flow into its core.
Just place the core in the center of the Fabricator. Together, we'll awaken its "heart."
Only one final step remains now.
We need to power this Mech Core with our Flow. And by doing that, we can channel our thoughts into the Mechanoid.
So, would you like to start?
Mr. Luban suggests naming the Mechanoid "Star No. 7." To celebrate the occasion, the team decides to head to their secret base — the rooftop of Enlightenment Plaza — for a gathering.
Never even got the chance to give him a name...
Never even got the chance to give him a name...
Since he's created by the Team of Stars... let's call him Star No. 7.
I think he likes it, too!
Mission: find the lost one and guide him home.
Well... guess it is time to come home.
That's why I know... how much effort you must have spent to bring him to life.
Tsk, it's our new teammate who did all the work... Right, Sun Bin?
Yes! Otherwise, Star No. 7 wouldn't be here.
You guys haven't changed a bit.
Hey, shouldn't we do something to celebrate the occasion?
Great idea! Speaking of, we haven't hung out at our secret base in ages!
Never thought I'd see another Mechanoid who can... think.
No worries, Mr. Luban! This is what a captain should do!
Yep! On the rooftop of Enlightenment Plaza. We'll go first to set things up. Come join us when you're ready!
I'm sorry, Mr. Luban... for taking your design and working on it by myself...
I recognized the design the moment I saw him.
I started working on this for our team after the last Enlightenment Trials. But it just kept reminding me of No. 7, and...
Thank you for finishing what I couldn't. This... means a lot to me.
Mr. Luban, I'm sure you'll be reunited with No. 7 one day.
Mr. Luban, I'm sure you'll be reunited with No. 7 one day.
Well said! After we win the Enlightenment Trials, we'll get your memories back. And then we'll get No. 7 back!
Get them back! Get them back!
It's settled then. See you at sunset!
After expressing her gratitude, Shye tells you that the creation is now in its final step—then leads you to the Fabricator.
You're here! Heard you were a lifesaver getting all the materials for us!
I'm glad things turned out well.
Come on, don't be so modest. Just take the credit!
That's the spirit! Now that everything's ready, let's meet the others at the Fabricator.
Also, I do want to apologize... We're supposed to help you, yet it has been the other way around.
It feels good to help out.
I got to learn all about Mechcraft.
Hmm... that's one way to look at it. Our next Mechcraft master in the making!
Is it too late to join Vlinder's team?
And I bet all the "things" were not easy. Great work out there, champion!
You better be! Can't let you run off now that we're finally a team.
For me, I believe teammates are supposed to help each other.
For me, I believe teammates are supposed to help each other.
To recreate Mr. Luban's best work... This is quite a challenge.
But then I guess... you never know if you don't try. What do you think?
I have every faith in Sun Bin. And in all of us.
I have every faith in Sun Bin. And in all of us.
Sun Bin believes it is love that makes Luban No. 7 so unique, and so he hopes that you can all share your love when completing the new creation.
As Master Mozi said, "Love and Mechcraft are one and the same."
As Master Mozi said, "Love and Mechcraft are one and the same."
Indeed... Now, time to press the button and begin the fabrication.
I was just thinking... we have all the materials to craft the Mechanoid, but I don't think that's enough...
I've been asking myself—what is the one thing that really gave No. 7 "life"?
Come on, we're doing this so he will join us again. Sun Bin, you're in charge!
What turned a weapon for battle to a child with feelings?
But as I look at you now, I believe I've finally found the answer.
I believe you do. Actually, you offered me the greatest inspiration.
The answer lies in every one of us. Our bond, our trust in each other... they'll become the heart of this new creation.
That's his lab ahead. Come with me!
Sun Bin tells the story about the close bond between Mr. Luban and Luban No. 7: They were like father and son, until No. 7 went missing one day...
Luban No. 7 is Mr. Luban's greatest creation.
He was built as a weapon, yet had the heart of a kid.
As they spent more time together, No. 7 became more like a real child.
Gift! A gift! Thank you, daddy...
And Mr. Luban became more like a father...
Then one day, No. 7 went missing on his way to Yong as a military support.
Mr. Luban searched all over the place... but he never found him...

Sun Bin states that at the time, the Cloud Silkworm did not answer Uncle Ban's question, but instead showed him his locked-tight heart. Sun Bin wants to unlock this heart, and his teammates respond one after another, helping out in different directions. You and Sun Bin agree to meet at the workshop in Tanying Camp.
zh_text: 孙膑表示，当时云蚕并未回答班叔的问题，而是向他展示了他紧锁的心门。孙膑想要打开这扇心门，队友们纷纷响应，分头帮忙。你和孙膑相约在潭影营地的工坊见面。
source_text: 孙膑表示，当时云蚕并未回答班叔的问题，而是向他展示了他紧锁的心门。孙膑想要打开这扇心门，队友们纷纷响应，分头帮忙。你和孙膑相约在潭影营地的工坊见面。

text: Stop babbling, you two! If you have nothing better to do, go clean the lab!
Actually, we're on it! Let's go, Meng Ya.
Great! Do you need any accessories for the look? I can give you a full set of star charms!
No. 7 will always be Mr. Luban's most cherished creation. One that can never be replaced.
But if we can complete his unfinished work and create a new Mechanoid for him...
Okay, then count me in. I'll help with the design in any way I can.
After that, we tried everything we could to locate No. 7, but nothing turned up.
We had hoped that together as a team, we might help him move on... But now it seems we were wrong.
Mr. Luban told me that he saw himself trapped in a giant Mechcraft labyrinth.
The gate was rusted, and the key was nowhere to be found. Time seemed to have stopped at the moment he lost No. 7.
He was stuck in the course of time, and... I'm afraid he still is.
I'm heading back to my workshop in Darkpool Camp to study Mr. Luban's notes. There must be something useful in there.
If you need my help, just say the word. It'll be a good chance for me to learn more about Mechcraft too.
If you need my help, just say the word. It'll be a good chance for me to learn more about Mechcraft too.
After the last Enlightenment Trials, did Mr. Luban ask the Wonder about No. 7?
After the last Enlightenment Trials, did Mr. Luban ask the Wonder about No. 7?
He did... But he didn't get the answer he wanted.
The Aercocoon weaves memories and emotions into a vision, but it offers no specific answers.
Dammit! What are we supposed to do? Build a new No. 7 from scratch?
Wait... Maybe we really can do that...
You're asking us to create a sentient Mechanoid? Even Mr. Luban couldn't build a second one.
I'll find a way... no matter how hard it is.
Perfect! Then you two should go together.
Maybe he will finally open his heart to us again.
Sorry for dragging you into this... I really wanted to help you learn about the Wonder, but in the end, you're the one helping us.
Maybe that's what the Wonder would want me to do. So what's our next step?
Maybe that's what the Wonder would want me to do. So what's our next step?
And Sun Bin, if I catch you skipping meals or staying up late again... you'll be in trouble. Got it?
Well, there are simply too many on our team who can't take care of themselves!
You heard her, right, Sun Bin?
O-okay... I'll keep that in mind...
It's settled then. Let's meet at your workshop later.
It's settled then. Let's meet at your workshop later.
Number Seven will always be the creation 'Master Luban' values most, irreplaceable... but we can create the key together to open his heart.
zh_text: 七号永远是“鲁班大师”最重视的造物，无法超越……但我们可以一起创造钥匙，开启他的心门。
source_text: 七号永远是“鲁班大师”最重视的造物，无法超越……但我们可以一起创造钥匙，开启他的心门。
official_target_text: Number Seven will always be the creation 'Master Luban' values most, irreplaceable... but we can create the key together to open his heart.
official_en_text: Number Seven will always be the creation 'Master Luban' values most, irreplaceable... but we can create the key together to open his heart.

text: Mr. Luban seems distracted and a bit down, and after a brief greeting, he goes straight back to work. Sun Bin notices a Mechcraft design sketch in the corner, and asks you to talk outside.
Now if you'll excuse me, I still have some Mechcraft parts to calibrate.
Greetings. Sun Bin already talked to me about you.
Hi, I'm the new member of the Team of Stars...
Hi, I'm the new member of the Team of Stars...
I'm fine. Just need some time alone to think about my research.
If there's anything you need from my lab—materials, documents—feel free to help yourself.
Sorry... I didn't get to properly introduce you this time. Mr. Luban, he...
It's okay. What do you think is troubling him?
It's okay. What do you think is troubling him?
He said it's about his research, but all the tools and instruments here are covered in dust.
Looks like the lab hasn't been used in a while.
Looks like the lab hasn't been used in a while.
I wonder what's weighing on his mind...
Focused on checking Sun Bin's Mechwings, Mr. Luban doesn't notice your visit.
There's no record of that in the Mechwings' logs.
I just updated the recorder. You'll get a detailed error report next time.
You know, I'm actually happy for Sun Bin.
He's a gentle soul, always looking out for everyone. But he hardly tells us his true opinions.
Today's the first time I've seen him speak his mind. And... I believe in him.
With all of us by his side, I'm sure we will work something out. Something great!
You meet Shye, ready to visit Mr. Luban. Before you go in, Shye gives you a reminder that Luban's been in a bad mood lately.
That's right. Like we said, I'm taking you to his lab for a proper introduction.
Don't worry, he's a very nice person. Whatever he knows, he will share it with you.
He's been staying at the academy for years, postponing his graduation to focus on his research and help junior students with their work.
Haha, I suppose you could say that.
Well, I think that's what he wants.
For someone who wants to dedicate their life to Mechcraft research, our academy is the ideal place to do so.
Nah, it's okay. To let him know we're having a new teammate? This might just cheer him up.
Hi there! How are you feeling?
I'm fine now. Thanks for asking. So... we are here to see Mr. Luban?
I'm fine now. Thanks for asking. So... we are here to see Mr. Luban?
After that, you two can each talk about what you saw in the Aercocoon.
But he seems to be in a bad mood lately... He always keeps things to himself, so it's hard to figure out what's really going on.
Is it a bad time for me to visit?
Is it a bad time for me to visit?
Novar and Meng Ya have been kicked out of the lab by Mr. Luban, while Sun Bin is still inside. Shye tells you to head in right away.
What are you two doing here?
I think you should not bother him when he doesn't want to be bothered.
But we're just worried about the man!
Alright. Now, time to introduce our new teammate.
Mr. Luban has locked himself in his lab. We went in to check on him, and... he kicked us out!
Since Sun Bin has always been his favorite... we figured we'd let him go in alone. See if he could find out what happened.

After looking through Mr. Luban's research logs, you find out that his repeated failed attempts to track down Luban No. 7—his favorite creation—have left him disheartened. It seems he may even be considering leaving the Team of Stars.
Ugh, never mind them. Mr. Luban has been down since the last Enlightenment Trials, and it's getting worse lately...
Hey, I'm just kidding. It's not on you, okay? Novar made such a bad plan! I'll handle it next time!
It all goes back to Mr. Luban's most prized Mechanoid. His masterpiece, Luban No. 7.
Back already? You messed up, didn't you, Sun Bin?
I believe it's still about that incident...
Mechanoid Research Journal? Well, let's see what it says. And if Mr. Luban gets angry... I'll take the blame!
The Mechcraft Kite returned yesterday. Still no sign of the kid.
Also, my attempt to make a Mechanoid for the Team of Stars failed... for the fifty-second time.
This is different from my other projects. Every time I try to test it, I see No. 7's face.
Without Mechcraft, what use am I to the team? Perhaps it's time to make a decision...
Why didn't he just talk to us? I mean, we can figure something out together!
What does he mean, "make a decision"? He's not... he's not quitting, is he?
After all this time trying—and failing—to find No. 7, he must be feeling crushed...
I used to think working on new Mechanoids would help him move on, but now it seems... He never really does.
While I was in there, I found an unfinished design draft...
I know I shouldn't have taken it without permission, but... I think you need to see this.
He always keeps everything to himself. That's just how he is.
Sun Bin, why don't you do the honor...
The search automaton returned yesterday, but even then, not a single trace of Number Seven could be found.
zh_text: “昨日，搜寻用机关鸢再次返回，哪怕是七号的一点蛛丝马迹，都未能寻到。”
source_text: “昨日，搜寻用机关鸢再次返回，哪怕是七号的一点蛛丝马迹，都未能寻到。”
official_target_text: The search automaton returned yesterday, but even then, not a single trace of Number Seven could be found.
official_en_text: The search automaton returned yesterday, but even then, not a single trace of Number Seven could be found.

text: “And the mechanical creation designed for the Star Team, the fifty-second experiment failed.”
zh_text: “而为星之队设计的机关造物，第五十二次试验失败。”
source_text: “而为星之队设计的机关造物，第五十二次试验失败。”
official_target_text: “And the mechanical creation designed for the Star Team, the fifty-second experiment failed.”
official_en_text: “And the mechanical creation designed for the Star Team, the fifty-second experiment failed.”

text: This is different from ordinary mechanism research. Every time I debug an intelligent creation, the shadow of Number Seven always appears before my eyes.
zh_text: “这和普通的机关研究不同。每一次调试智能造物时，我眼前总会浮现七号的影子。”
source_text: “这和普通的机关研究不同。每一次调试智能造物时，我眼前总会浮现七号的影子。”
official_target_text: This is different from ordinary mechanism research. Every time I debug an intelligent creation, the shadow of Number Seven always appears before my eyes.
official_en_text: This is different from ordinary mechanism research. Every time I debug an intelligent creation, the shadow of Number Seven always appears before my eyes.

text: What value does Luban have to the Star Team without his mechanical arts? Maybe I should make a decision...
zh_text: “失去机关术的鲁班，于星之队有何价值？也许我该做出决定了……”
source_text: “失去机关术的鲁班，于星之队有何价值？也许我该做出决定了……”
official_target_text: What value does Luban have to the Star Team without his mechanical arts? Maybe I should make a decision...
official_en_text: What value does Luban have to the Star Team without his mechanical arts? Maybe I should make a decision...

text: The puppet you salvaged offers a new riddle that points toward some "cave of puppets." You decide to go there and investigate.
The voice system is intact, and it's waterproofed. That's why we could hear it speaking.
Such incredible craftsmanship... I'd really like to learn how to do this.
I am! Anything to make the Mechanoid for Mr. Luban.
We have a lead right here. A couple of puppets won't scare me away.
Alright, then I'll go with you. After all, I have some experience with his... works.
Alright, then I'll go with you. After all, I have some experience with his... works.
To unravel the mystery of my creation, you must come to our cave. The cave of puppets.
Conquer your fear, and you shall find the beauty hidden in the dark.
A cave of puppets... It must be a place similar to Old Citadel. You know, distinctive and... eerie.
A cave of puppets... It must be a place similar to Old Citadel. You know, distinctive and... eerie.
Okay, then we know what we should look for.
The cave not far away... If I understand correctly, it's similar to the "Ancient Mound City stage," another bizarre place that concentrates the "Yuan Ge aesthetic"...
zh_text: “不远处的洞窟”……如果我没理解错，和“古丘城的舞台”相似，又是集中展现“元歌美学”的怪异场所……
source_text: “不远处的洞窟”……如果我没理解错，和“古丘城的舞台”相似，又是集中展现“元歌美学”的怪异场所……
official_target_text: The cave not far away... If I understand correctly, it's similar to the "Ancient Mound City stage," another bizarre place that concentrates the "Yuan Ge aesthetic"...
official_en_text: The cave not far away... If I understand correctly, it's similar to the "Ancient Mound City stage," another bizarre place that concentrates the "Yuan Ge aesthetic"...

text: Someone is talking at the bottom of the lake...
So, what we're looking for has been here all along.
So, what we're looking for has been here all along.
Yeah, let's hope we can get what we need down there...
You catch a faint whisper that sounds like Yango coming from beneath the water. You decide to go down there and take a look.
There is definitely something at the bottom of this pool.
There is definitely something at the bottom of this pool.
So... let's go and find out.
So... let's go and find out.
Well, that... that sounds like Senior Yango, right?
Shh... You hear it too, don't you?
Hold your breath and listen. A whisper from beneath the water...
“‘The most beautiful body, sleeping in the heart of the lake.’ This... sounds like Senior Yuange's voice.
zh_text: “至美之躯，眠于湖心。”这……好像是元歌学长的声音。
source_text: “至美之躯，眠于湖心。”这……好像是元歌学长的声音。
official_target_text: “‘The most beautiful body, sleeping in the heart of the lake.’ This... sounds like Senior Yuange's voice.
official_en_text: “‘The most beautiful body, sleeping in the heart of the lake.’ This... sounds like Senior Yuange's voice.

text: Sun Bin still needs a unique Mechanoid body to complete his design—the one Yango used to create one of his puppets. The puzzle left by Yango points toward Greenwhisper Pool.
Oh, you're here! I was just asking for advice from my instructor.
And you've done an excellent job, Sun Bin. It's such an impressive design!
This is mostly Mr. Luban's work, actually... and I still haven't figured out how to best craft the Mechanoid's body.
Oh, about that... I searched our school's archives after getting your message, and there's only one model that fits your requirements.
Highly malleable yet resilient, it's a brilliant creation by a rare Mechcraft genius...
Most of his works are now stored in Springbrook Plains. And his name is—
Mr. Luban said he discussed the designs of No. 7 with someone back in the days. It must've been Yango.
But... we can't just barge into Old Citadel and take apart his puppets. There has to be another way.
You know what... I heard he left some of his puppets here at Darkpool Camp...
In the clearest reflection... Perhaps he meant the Greenwhisper Pool?
In the clearest reflection... Perhaps he meant the Greenwhisper Pool?
Good luck to you guys, then! And if you do find something... can I take a look?
I'm excited just thinking about it!
That's right, Yango. Are you an admirer of his aesthetics as well?
Um, actually, that's not what I...
Um, actually, that's not what I...
The purest perfection lies sleeping in the clearest reflection. He even left a riddle for that.
I think you have a point there. Let's go!
Gaze upon the water to see the true reflection; the most beautiful form sleeps at the heart of the lake. The riddle he spoke himself still circulates in the camp to this day.
zh_text: “临水凝望，即见真影，至美之躯，眠于湖心”，他亲口说出的谜题，至今还在营地流传。
source_text: “临水凝望，即见真影，至美之躯，眠于湖心”，他亲口说出的谜题，至今还在营地流传。
official_target_text: Gaze upon the water to see the true reflection; the most beautiful form sleeps at the heart of the lake. The riddle he spoke himself still circulates in the camp to this day.

text: Mr. Luban pulls you aside for a private talk. He says he will not be taking part in the upcoming Enlightenment Trials, for he's already found his answers. Also, he believes you need this chance more than he does.
There's something I want to tell you before letting the others know.
The party was for you, and... I didn't want to ruin the mood.
I won't be taking part in the upcoming Enlightenment Trials.
I no longer need to consult the Wonder, for I already know the answer I once sought.
I'll do everything I can to help the team prepare. After the Grand Ceremony... it's game on.
I've been thinking about this for a while. And now, I've finally made up my mind.
Is this about the team roster?
Speaking of, what the Wonder showed me last time might be helpful to you.
The Enlightenment Trials allow teams to have substitutes. It's not about that.
What can you tell me about your lost memories? Anything that feels... special?
The Aercocoon can sense your thoughts and emotions to create a virtual space. One that only you can access.
While you... You need this chance more than I do.
I've seen images flash by in my dreams. But they're gone the moment I wake up.
I've seen images flash by in my dreams. But they're gone the moment I wake up.
I only remember a voice telling me to "find the Wonders." Her voice feels so close, yet so far away.
I only remember a voice telling me to "find the Wonders." Her voice feels so close, yet so far away.
A voice... That is similar to my search for No. 7.
The scenes in your dreams, the voice calling to you... their images might become clearer inside.
I'd love for an opportunity like that...
I'd love for an opportunity like that...
It won't be easy to win the Enlightenment Trials. There are many challenges to overcome. Are you ready?
Then prove to the Wonder that you're worthy.
A voice... much like searching for Number Seven, there are no concrete clues to follow.
zh_text: 一个声音啊……和寻找七号相似，没有确切的线索可循。
source_text: 一个声音啊……和寻找七号相似，没有确切的线索可循。
official_target_text: A voice... much like searching for Number Seven, there are no concrete clues to follow.
official_en_text: A voice... much like searching for Number Seven, there are no concrete clues to follow.

text: After chatting for a while, Mr. Luban gives you a Team of Stars badge — a keepsake for your friendship. They officially welcome you to the team, and you take a group photo to mark the occasion.
To me, this is the best time of the day.
Yeah? Then let it take all your worries away.
It's great to be with my friends...
You feel that too? That's great!
Uh... try harder? That's not how this was supposed to go...
So, how did you find this place?
So, how did you find this place?
Good question! Actually, it's all thanks to a stupid mistake made by you know who...
What? How do you know it was me?
C'mon, are you serious? Don't you know how disciplined I am?
Like... over-upgrading your cannons when Mr. Blazen told you not to?
Like... over-upgrading your cannons when Mr. Blazen told you not to?
You— l'll let this one slide, too.
As a Mechcraft researcher, I always pay attention to detail.
*Laugh* Your cleaning Mechanoid would beg to differ.
You know, Luban leaves his notes literally everywhere. If Sun Bin weren't there to help with the cleaning...
I just put the books back in order when I return them...
*Cough* That said, you can still rule me out.
Alright, here's the story. After we won last time, Novar decided to treat us to a meal.
But then he booked the wrong time at Pastoral Garden. The place was full, so we had to get everything to go.
It was Sun Bin who saved the day. He flew up into the sky and found this place.
Here, you can catch the sunset, watch the stars, and marvel at the scenery of Jixia.
It's great we can share these memories with you—and even better that we get to make new ones together from now.
The Team of Stars badge. A keepsake for the closest friends.
I made this one for you with a rare Starflow Crystal Shye gave me. It's very beautiful.
Whoa, didn't know you can be so generous, Shye!
Yeah, yeah. Guess what? I'm still the same stingy, mean girl to you.
And now, right before this year's Enlightenment Trials, we welcome a new friend.
Stars might be small, but together they can light up the sky.
Take this badge, and you're officially a member of our team.
So after that, we often come here to talk.
After forming the Team of Stars, we won the championship and have become friends for life.
Allow me to say—welcome aboard! And thank you for believing in us.
What's taking so long? I'm starving.
Now, what do you think we should do to celebrate?
That'd be amazing, but... we don't have any fireworks right now.
Let's do that at Upstream Camp next time. We'll have as many fireworks as you want! Any other ideas?
I... don't think I can eat another bite...
Proposal denied! No one wishes to end up in the infirmary from indigestion, right?
I like that idea... It's been a while since I had any academic discussion with others.
Hold on! Let's not turn a joyful occasion into a boring lecture...
Wish this moment could last forever.
That'd be great... Oh, we should take a picture!
And for our new teammate to access the Wonder!
Relax, man! Patience is key in life.
You're the one that's always late. Of course you're patient!
While we wait, I remember reading an article from the Secrets Club. About how Meng Ya led our new teammate into the lair of the Crimson Beast...
The headline was quite catchy: "Fighting Fire With Fire: A Test of Courage, or the Fall of Stars?"
Fall of stars? Sounds really dangerous...
Is that how you got those injuries, Meng Ya? Do you need help with your cannon maintenance?
Did that Chase guy write the article? I'm gonna blast his roof off!
Haha, I kinda like that vibe!
Oh hey! Here comes the star of the headlines!
Team of Stars for another championship!
Hope I made it in time.
Hope I made it in time.
Actually, you did. Unlike your slowpoke of a mentor.
Ha, you know what? I'll let this one slide today.
Anyway, this is our secret base! A perfect spot to overlook the entire academy.
Come over here and take a moment... What do you feel?
Meng Ya is questioning Novar's decision to invite you to the team. He insists you pass three tests first and tells you to meet him at Darkpool Camp.
How many times do I have to tell you?
When will you stop doing things on a whim?!
You can't just bring in new members like that!
I'm not doing this on a whim, and I don't recruit just anyone, okay?!
Whatever you say, I'm not accepting this without a test.
Now aren't you a man of truth!?
Alright, Meng Ya. Say hi to your new teammate.
Wait... I haven't agreed to anything.
Come on, have more faith in yourself! You've got this!
Anyone, come! Let me introduce you two!
He blows up a lot but cools down fast. All bark and no bite, y'know?
Look, it's not that I don't want you to join us, but... there are three tests you need to pass first.
Don't you know we already met in Upstream Camp? You're really being a good captain.
What are you talking about!? I don't bark! Or bite!
Look, I know you've got impressive skills, I've seen them. But winning as a team? It takes more than just that...
A new member means more time to develop chemistry and rework tactics. That said, you'd make a tough rival if you joined another team...
This is called strategizing. Unlike some idiot who always charges into fights without thinking first!
He's spent months working on team fight strategies for the Enlightenment Trials, and adding a new member at the last minute... it brings uncertainty to his plans.
Alright. I'm up for the challenge.
Alright. I'm up for the challenge.
On the contrary, you've at a perfect time!
Hehe, well... Then I'm sure you know how good he is!
So you heard it all from the start...
That's a strange way to talk...
Ha! I see. You actually agree with me on this, you just don't want to admit it!
Excuse me? Who's the one that's always "going full blast"?
I'll let you two work it out...
Great, then let's start with a real basic one. Meet me at Darkpool Camp when you're ready. I'll be waiting!
Sorry about that... but I get where he's coming from.
His father is Meng Tian, the Grand General of Yong.
Raised in a military family, he grew up studying war tactics.
I don't know what tests he has in store for you, but... I'm sure you'll be fine.
Get all the preparation you need, and I'll wait for you at <001>Darkpool Camp</>!
Sun Bin and I were there when he passed that special exam.
Sun Bin and I were there when she passed that special exam.
In the meantime, though... I don't recall celebrating with you.
Hehe, well... Then I'm sure you know how good she is!
It's okay, this is just how we talk to each other. All the time.
Right? We sound like we're fighting, but actually...
Just one left... I should hurry up.
Just one left... I should hurry up.

Meng Ya explains the rules of your first test—"Aersilk Orb Hunt": to think fast, act quick, and collect all Aersilk Orbs within the limited time. After giving you a rather theatrical introduction, Mr. Blazen announces the start of the challenge.
Hi there. Did I miss anything?
Hi there. Did I miss anything?
Here comes the star of the show!
Very well. Then it's time for you to get off the stage.
Hmph, told you—I know what I'm doing. And it'll be a great trial to test our new friend's true skills.
Hmph, told you—I know what I'm doing. And it'll be a great trial to test our new friend's true skills.
Just as water has no fixed shape, there are no fixed formations in warfare. I reviewed the previous Enlightenment Trials, and without exception, they all tested the ability to think quick.
Inspired by that, I designed this "Aersilk Orb Hunt" to improve our ability to... improvise.
Deadly is a bit of an exaggeration...
Deadly is a bit of an exaggeration...
And Novar's partner in their victorious battle against Cloudeater. A rising new legend indeed!
Now how will he amaze us this time? Let's find out!
Now how will she amaze us this time? Let's find out!
Hey! I'm the captain, and I'm not going anywhere! So, you designed this as a training activity for our team? Gotta say it's not a bad job.
Hey, I'm still your teacher, you know! I'm going to teach you some respect after this.
So Mr. Blazen is the judge...
You bet I am. I won't miss the chance for some excitement up close.
Don't worry about it, kid. I see things with more than just my eyes!
Now, allow me to introduce our challenger! The first student ever to pass the deadly Puppet Show during the entrance exam...
Basically, you'll need to collect all Aersilk Orbs within the limited time. Alright, judge, you're up!
Do I really have to introduce it like this...
official_target_text: Do I really have to introduce it like this...
official_en_text: Do I really have to introduce it like this...

text: Mr. Blazen announces that you have passed the first test with a record-breaking performance. Ackowledging your skills, Meng Ya states that the next test will take place at Stargazing Terrace.
Just shut up, Novar! As for you... you've got skills, I'll give you that.
Anyway, I think I know what he's planning.
I'm just setting the mood here... Alright, alright. On to the results!
That guy's always going on about... "Preparing to go unprepared." Bet he's trying to see if you've got that in you.
Haha, just go and meet him there. I'm sure you'll do great!
I heard this will decide if the Team of Stars is going to have a new member! This truly is a significant event—my heart is pounding already!
Time's up! That was intense, wasn't it!? Now for the results...
Our new student passed the challenge and even broke Meng Ya's record!
Oh? Don't get ahead of yourself!
Well, well, how do you like that? Impressed?
I was gonna ask the same thing!
Consider your first test passed. Now get ready for the next.
Have you ever been to the <001>Stargazing Terrace</>? Well, meet me there when you're ready.
I'm sorry, did he just leave like that?
*Laugh* Interesting! That's the first time I've ever heard Meng Ya praise someone.
You know, for him to say "you've got skills"? He must be really impressed.
That said, keep up the good work in the next test, okay? Prove to him you deserve his respect.
The Aersilk Orb Hunt begins... now!
When the challenge begins, Aersilk Orbs will be launched across the field. Your goal is to collect all the orbs before time runs out.
Quickly Gather Cloud Silk, officially begins!
official_target_text: Quickly Gather Cloud Silk, officially begins!
official_en_text: Quickly Gather Cloud Silk, officially begins!

text: You share with Senara the recent events, all while admiring the beautiful sunset over Jixia.
I see you've made some friends.
Yes. I'm a member of the Team of Stars now.
Yes. I'm a member of the Team of Stars now.
In fact, you're different now from when I first saw you.
Well, a lot has happened since then.
Well, a lot has happened since then.
Are you ready for the Enlightenment Trials?
Well done. But don't celebrate yet...
Now allow me to show you... the ultimate beauty of craftsmanship!
Sun Bin passes the test, and Yango's Puppet instructs Sun Bin to inspect its body.
Now, about the secret of a perfect Mechanoid body... It's right before you.
Take a closer look at me... What do you see?
Beauty comes from the grace of control. A creation, however sophisticated, is always connected to its creator.
This is true for me, and for all my fellow puppets.
So now it all comes down to you, Sun Bin? Tell me, what do you want?
I don't understand... What does this have to do with making a Mechanoid?
Crafting the body is a skill that everyone can learn.
Giving a creation life, on the other hand, requires strong inner connection. What is it that your heart desires?
Mr. Luban's inventions changed my life... Now it's my turn to help him.
So your idea begins with... friendship? Interesting.
Then, your wish shall be granted. For my life, too, was once changed by someone...
The final answer lies within me. Please, take your time.
So this is the real trick...
Do you get it now? Good. Farewell then...

Inspired by Yango's Puppet, Sun Bin now has an idea of how to make the Mechanoid. The next step is to find an Aersilk Mech Core to serve as the "heart". In Jixia, only the Roaring Tiger Training Hall possesses such a component. You agree to meet up in front of the place.
We need a "heart" for our Mechanoid... an Aersilk Mech Core.
Okay, then what do we do next?
Okay, then what do we do next?
If that's what you want... then alright.
If that's what you want... then alright.
I know you want to protect me, but... I did pass the test just now, didn't I? I can handle myself!
It went well. I think I know how to make the Mechanoid now. And... thank you for encouraging me back in the cave.
That's what friends are for. So how did you pass his test?
That's what friends are for. So how did you pass his test?
Uh, I'd rather not talk about it...
Mech Cores are the power source of Mechcraft creations. They're the key to giving a Mechanoid life.
Among them, the ones infused with Aerflow energy are the best. In Jixia, though, only Head Trainer Tigon at Roaring Tiger Training Hall has one.
But I don't know if he'd be willing to lend it to us...
That is the plan. It's just... I'm not sure if we can get to meet him...
To do that, one must fight and defeat all his disciples. And they are all very strong warriors!
Fight all of them...? Who told you that?
Fight all of them...? Who told you that?
Um... well, I'll go first and see if that's true.
Um... well, I'll go first and see if that's true.
You're going to fight them all?
Great. I'll see you at Roaring Tiger Training Hall!
The wonder of a puppet lies in its heart, not its form... We still need the 'heart' of the creation, which is the Cloudsilk Mechanism Core.
zh_text: “傀儡之妙，在于心而不在于形”……我们还需要造物的“心”，那就是云丝机关核。
source_text: “傀儡之妙，在于心而不在于形”……我们还需要造物的“心”，那就是云丝机关核。
official_target_text: The wonder of a puppet lies in its heart, not its form... We still need the 'heart' of the creation, which is the Cloudsilk Mechanism Core.
official_en_text: The wonder of a puppet lies in its heart, not its form... We still need the 'heart' of the creation, which is the Cloudsilk Mechanism Core.

text: It's okay. Just reach the end of the cave...
Can you see me? Then come closer...
A Yango's Puppet appears and asks Sun Bin to venture in alone. Though afraid, Sun Bin accepts the challenge.
Whoa! O-okay, so... is the secret to crafting Mechanoid bodies kept here?
Patience... To learn the craft, you must first pay the price.
Let's play a game of hide-and-seek. Find me in the cave... and what you seek shall be yours.
Wait... Am I seeing an old friend down there?
As much as I'd love another dance with you... this game is meant for only one player.
The answer sits at the end of the dark... for you, Sun Bin. And for you only...
I think he wants you to go alone.
I think he wants you to go alone.
If that's the rule, then... fine, I'll go by myself.
Are you sure you're going to be okay?
Are you sure you're going to be okay?
I'm a little scared... but I will get this done!
It... it's just a test. And I'll do everything I can to complete it.
Be careful, and don't force things.
I'll be careful... but I won't quit this time!

Shye is worried by your reckless actions, while Novar is just happy you have become teammates. The team wants you to meet Mr. Luban, hoping he can offer insights on how to recover your memories. You will regroup later at Luban's laboratory.
Hey! He just left like that? So ungrateful.
Maybe he's avoiding getting yelled at...
Would someone care to explain what happened?
But... I mean, who knew the Crimson Beast was there?
Ugh, whatever... Let me take a look at your wounds.
Haha, talk about a blessing in disguise!
Look at them getting along with each other now! Makes me so proud!
Yeah, I'm sure they did the best they could! Come on, I'll take you to the infirmary!
Trying to run off, Novar? Don't bother, I'm fine on my own! See ya!
Did you tell her about this?
Stop playing dumb, will you? I got word even before you limped back here.
A "test of courage" isn't supposed to be some suicide mission! What were you thinking!?
Guess I'll take my leave too...
Relax, I won't bite. Now back to business—we think it's time for you to meet Mr. Luban.
Novar told us about how you wanted to access the Wonder and recover lost memories.
After the last Enlightenment Trials, we all had a chance to consult the Wonder. And Mr. Luban...
No. But like you, there's something important to him that he must find.
He asked if there were ways to find something he'd lost. Sounds familiar?
We don't know exactly what was said in there. Still, can't hurt to have a chat, right?
It's just what a mentor should do. When you're ready, let's meet at Mr. Luban's lab.
At least the result was good, so... could you go easy on us this time...?
Still, I doubt it stands a chance against my Apocalyptor.
C'mon, rookie. Let's take the beast down!
The whole place is on fire... I must be getting close.
The whole place is on fire... I must be getting close.
The footprints here are clear... must have been recent.
The footprints here are clear... must have been recent.
Huge claws rip through the rift—the Crimson Beast roars as it appears before you.
I'm coming now. Hang in there!
Exhausted but your attacks, the Crimson Beast lets out a mournful howl and flees in panic into the rift... As the flames gradually die down, you and Meng Ya slowly make your way out together.
So much for the Crimson Beast, huh?
Umm... Fine. Come and give me a hand, will ya?
Turns out what you've been chasing is a Wreckflame Lizard, one that's far more dangerous than fire lizards. It is attacking students down the cliff, and you decide to go save them.
That thing's way more dangerous than fire lizards!
There are people down there. Let's go!
There are people down there. Let's go!
With cannons roaring, Meng Ya joins the fight against the Crimson Beast.
(using all strength to fend off) *combat grunt*
(using all strength to fend off) *combat grunt*
More tracks here. Let's keep going.
Fresh footprints... We are getting close!
So it was the Crimson Beast all along!
Let's save the jokes for later. Be careful!
Hey, I'm almost there. Where are you?
I'm nearing the end of Smokescar Vale, and... the place is still burning.
I'm nearing the end of Smokescar Vale, and... the place is still burning.
Shouldn't these lizards stay in somewhere... hotter?
Shouldn't these lizards stay in somewhere... hotter?
Yeah. Doesn't make sense they'd show up here.
Look at the flames on the ground... This is getting serious.
After discussing with Meng Ya, you agree to meet again later at the entrance to Smokescar Vale when ready.
Fire lizards usually stick to Smokescar Vale. But lately, they've been extending their range of activity.
It's Level A for a reason...
Exterminate fire lizards... Difficulty: Level A.
Exterminate fire lizards... Difficulty: Level A.
But so far, no one's managed to pull it off.
For a big job like this, every detail matters — That means some investigation is in order.
It's nothing... And I'm not doing this for you!
Finally! Right, let's cut to the chase. Check the top row of that bulletin board.
That's the one. Toughest commission in Jixia right now.
The big number of credits it offers has attracted many students to sign up.
This has significantly increased the chance of wildfires. We must stop them before it's too late.
This is only the first step. We'll need careful planning before getting into action.
When you're ready, meet me at the entrance to Smokescar Vale.
Woah, somebody's being confident. But let's not get ahead of ourselves.
You realize what you just defeated were actually Scorchtail Lizards. With no other leads, you have no choice but to start the search over.
Are they the fire lizards we're looking for?
Are they the fire lizards we're looking for?
Well... No, these are Scorchtail Lizards... They do look alike, though. Let's keep looking.
According to the Hunter Feng Ling, the fire lizards were acting very strange. Meng Ya insists on tagging along to "get all the details right," yet you know he's just worried about your safety.
Okay, let's go. You're making the call on this one.
I'm just here to make sure we get all the details right.
Hey there! Are you here to hunt down the lizard with Senior Meng Ya?
Oh, you're here. Just asked around—those lizards were last seen in this area.
I managed to hit one earlier, but it just got up and <001>ran south</> like it was nothing.
You don't say! Nothing can take a hit from me like that and run away!
I mean, seriously... It's just not possible!
Fire lizards are usually very aggressive, especially when being attacked. Something doesn't add up...
Maybe it wasn't a fire lizard?
Oh! That is an interesting thought...
Nope, I did not. I swear it upon the Wonders!
Come to think of it... Fire lizards have thick limbs and long claws. Doesn't quite match the tracks around here.
I'd like to follow those tracks and see where they lead.
I'd like to follow those tracks and see where they lead.
This is your test, after all.
You're more into this than I am...
Hey! It's not like I want to.
What are you waiting for? Let's move!
Despite the beast defeated, the area remains unusually hot. Suspect something's still going on, you decide to split up. Meng Ya will escort the injured back while you press on with the investigation.
Something's not right. Look at this place—the fire has shown no signs of going out.
Something's not right. Look at this place—the fire has shown no signs of going out.
Stay safe, okay? I'll stay in touch with my Big-eye Owlet!
Hey, you still seem worried. What's wrong?
I'd like to go further ahead and check things out. Make sure we miss nothing.
I'd like to go further ahead and check things out. Make sure we miss nothing.
Gotcha. Let's split up, then. I'll get them back to camp, then come find you.
Whew, we really thought we were gonna... Thank you guys so much!
I'm glad we arrived in time. How are your injuries?
I'm glad we arrived in time. How are your injuries?
You need a Herbalist for some serious treatment. C'mon, let's get you back to camp.
I never thought that even someone as powerful as the Sanctifier would have a side as a teacher.
I suppose the Sanctifying could allow for some flexibility.
The next game will be fun.
Only the true Sanctified is worthy of calling me Master.
Staff of Sanctification is just one step away from completion. There's no room for even the slightest error.
Victory was within my grasp. Useless pawns are best discarded.
When Staff of Sanctification is re-forged, I will personally reduce Jixia to dust.
I look forward to the Sanctifier's grand ambitions.
It's time I meet an old friend again...
A mere Jixia disciple, and yet you're getting pummeled.
I will reclaim that Staff of Sanctification, no matter what it takes...
What really happened to them, Ziya?
Only through the harshest trial can the true Sanctified be chosen.
If they can't survive this, how can we count on them to save the world?
You are putting our students' lives at risk. I cannot allow it!
There has to be another way to do this. For now, your trials must end!
Those students were all badly wounded...
Those students were all badly wounded...
They had a fierce argument over the Sanctification trials back then...
They had a fierce argument over the Sanctification trials back then...
Was the whole thing banned after that?
Was the whole thing banned after that?

Vesper musters his last strength to strike at you, but Fuzi arrives just in time and deflects it. However, as Fuzi moves to reclaim the staff, Ziya suddenly appears and intervenes. The collision of their power causes the underground chamber to collapse, and in the chaos, Fuzi hurries you away.
The Sanctified will never go down!
I must say this is quite a mayhem you have caused here.
Are you alright, kid? Did he hurt you?
The Power of Sanctification was never meant for mortal flesh.
This staff will be much safer with me.
Do you still believe in your old mission?
You and I both know the Deities are long gone—
Agh! (swinging axe then failing) *effort sequence* Aaagh— Ehhh—
I care nothing about the Deities!
I'm only here for one thing—to take back what's mine!
What exactly is behind this gate?
What exactly is behind this gate?
Seems there's no other way. I should go in.
Seems there's no other way. I should go in.
Come. Let's get this over with!
Is that the best you can do?

On the Altar of Sanctification, you are surprised to find a piece of the Staff of Sanctification. However, Vesper snatches it before you can, admitting they're trying to refroge the staff and take back Jixia. He then proposes a duel by the rules of the Sanctified.
You are the one who keeps getting in my way.
This power is not for someone like you.
What exactly are you planning to do here?
What exactly are you planning to do here?
To reforge Master's staff, of course. And restore his full strength.
You want to stop me? How cute.
Since you're on our territory, let's settle this by the rules of the Sanctified—
Today, only one of us walks away!
By then... Jixia will be ours for the taking!

You fall into the underground chamber, where Ziya's voice echoes from afar. Turns out this place was where the Sanctification ritual was held. With no other way out, you head toward the mysterious gate ahead.
Those who felled the Sentinels, please come forward.
The Sanctification ritual is about to begin.
I should go check it out, and see how I can get out of this place...
I should go check it out, and see how I can get out of this place...

You barely managed to suppress Vesper, but the staff, seemingly acknowledging your strength, begins to tremble faintly in your direction. Enraged at the thought of losing to a Jixia student, Vesper forcibly unleashed the power of the staff, summoning a divine-like Sentinel, and lunged at you once more.
Now this is what true power looks like!
Agh! (swinging axe then failing) *effort sequence* Aaagh— Ehhh—
Behold... the full power of Sanctification!

Ziya punishes Vesper severely for his failure, claiming no mistakes shall be tolerated now that he's one step away from getting back all that was lost. The mysterious man in black shows up again—it seems he's eager to meet an "old friend"...
I will reclaim that Staff of Sanctification, no matter what it takes...
A mere Jixia disciple, and yet you're getting pummeled.
Only the true Sanctified is worthy of calling me Master.
We're this close to reforging my staff... I will tolerate no mistakes.
I never thought that even someone as powerful as the Sanctifier would have a side as a teacher.
I suppose the Sanctifying could allow for some flexibility.
Victory was within my grasp. Useless pawns are best discarded.
Legacy stolen, honor striped away... When my staff is whole again, I shall bring back all that was taken from me!
I look forward to the Sanctifier's grand ambitions.
It's time I meet an old friend again...
The next game will be fun.
Master Fuzi brings you back to Dragon's Graveyard. Your teammates immediately gather around you with concern, asking what happened.
When Master Fuzi told us something went wrong, we got so worried...
Thank the Wonders you're back! Are you okay?
Are you sure? Don't push yourself too just to look tough.
That's good to hear... Still, you should go for a check-up just to be safe.
We can take you to the infirmary if you want!
The final challenge was just about to begin, then everything just...
The final challenge was just about to begin, then everything just...
I'm sure. Just need some rest is all.
I'm sure. Just need some rest is all.
I also told you to wait at the academy. And that I would bring him back.
I also told you to wait at the academy. And that I would bring her back.
But we couldn't just sit around when our teammate was in danger... What happened exactly?

You all want to contribute and stop Ziya from seizing the Wonder, but Fuzi firmly dismisses the idea. He then announces that you have successfully passed the first trial, and suggests you should focus on the remaining rounds of the Enlightenment Trials.
After I shattered his staff back then, I sealed one piece of it within the Altar of Sanctification.
My Flow was supposed to be the only thing that could break that seal... Guess I was wrong...
The Sentinels, Vesper, Ziya... So much happened while we weren't there...
Don't blame yourself. No one could've seen this coming.
Don't blame yourself. No one could've seen this coming.
Those Sanctified stirring things up again... I swear I'll make them regret it!
You just said Vesper came for another piece of the staff... Where is it now?
Oh, no... Did Ziya take it in the end?
Oh, no... Did Ziya take it in the end?
You think I'd let that happen? Look what I have here.
But Master... With everything they've done recently, their goals must be more than just reclaiming the staff, right?
Please tell us the truth, Master. If Jixia is in danger and we're left in the dark—how are we not supposed to worry?
*Sigh* I'm not trying to hide anything, it's just... I'm having my doubts of my own.
I thought Ziya was continuing his old duty as an Enforcer, yet just now he said he wanted to "take back what's his."
Meanwhile, you should stay out of this. And that is an order.
As your headmaster, it is my duty to protect you. I will never put you in harm's way just to keep the Wonder safe.
But surely there must be something we can do, right?
You mean to send another Big-eye Owlet for observation?
I'm not sure how Vesper got into the place and activated the Sentinels. Maybe fate had its own plans.
We haven't talked about what you did today.
Can't say I'm surprised... After all, we lost a lot of credits during the last Enlightenment Trials, too.
What you did does not meet the definition of cheating, and therefore...
You have passed the trials of Courage, Agility, and Strategy.
Although you didn't finish the final challenge, you demonstrated courage in the face of sudden danger and proved your strength.
Go back and get ready for the competition ahead. And no more Big-eye Owlets, okay?
Meanwhile, I will take care of the rest myself. If you want to help me, do me proud in the Enlightenment Trials.
Very well. I shall take my leave now.
I know Fuzi is right, but... I just can't let it go.
*Sigh* Guess we just have to focus on the task at hand.
Win the trials, consult the Wonder, and become stronger... So next time something like this happens, we'll be ready to help!
I should be to blame for what happened. Still, you did a great job stopping them from getting the staff, kid.
Hey, you all agreed to it, didn't you... Come on, we'll just earn them back together!
Yeah, knowing all this and not being able to do anything... it's so frustrating!
Guys, let's just focus on the Enlightenment Trials, okay?
I-I was thinking the same thing.
It's better not to act rashly.
Hate to admit it, but you're right... Master Fuzi must have a plan, and we should trust him.
The situation is far more complicated and dangerous than we imagined. We don't want to disrupt Master's plans.
Look at you, finally thinking like a real captain.
We've got some time before the next trial at Aerux Town. Let's all head back and and get some proper rest.
Heading back already? Shouldn't we start training for the upcoming competition?
After everything that's happened, I'm sure we're all exhausted—especially our MVP of the first round here. Some rest is called for.
I'll manage, but yeah, a lot did happen...
I'll manage, but yeah, a lot did happen...
In that case, let's go back and rest! Training can wait until we're back in top shape.
Alright then, I'll use this time to read more books on combat strategy.
I'll keep it in a secure location from now. As long as Ziya can't regain his full power, he won't be able to get what he wants.
I know you care about the academy, but ending all this is my responsibility.
So, as the chief examiner, I hereby announce—
Team of Stars will advance to the second round!
I think he meant the Wonder.
The Wonder? He wants to take the Aercocoon!?
From now on, the Team of Stars will guard it day and night. We won't let them get anywhere near the place!
Nonsense! I will strengthen the defenses around the Tower of Enlightenment.
Speaking of which... what is the result of the first round, Master Fuzi?
We... I swear we did not cheat, Master!
I trust you, but rules are rules. Forty credits will be deducted from each of you as a disciplinary measure.
What? Forty!? This is all your terrible idea, Novar!
Hey, you all agreed to it, didn't you... Come on, we'll just earn them back together!
Cyan joined Vlinder's team and, to reduce competition, he's trying to intimidate other participants into withdrawing with Maroon.
You get what I'm saying? This trial is no game. Back out now if you want to save your skin.
Really...? I'll... I'll think it over then...
Your idea to scare off other contestants is brilliant, Maroon! Fewer people means better chance to win.
Hah, this is what you call "use your bread"!
You mean "use your head," right, man?
Speaking of, I never thought Vlinder would recruit me despite all the objections.
Yeah, she actually saw your potential through that dumb face. Don't you let her down, alright?
I cannot compete myself, but I'm watching you!
More people heading this way. Let's move, brother – time to scare them off!
Before you set out for Dragon's Graveyard, Novar tells you that he has come up with a "great idea" of helping you...
Dragon's Graveyard, Tiger's Graveyard—who cares? Just smash your way through!
L-let's not be reckless. Making smart decisions is important as well.
Alright, alright. I think we've said enough.
Okay! When you pass the trial, whatever you want to eat is on me!
This isn't going to cost us any credits, is it?
You'll find out once you're there. Safe travels!
But before you go, you should know that I've already come up with a great idea of helping you...
Can't see me... can't see me...
What's that sound? It seems to be coming from over there.
What's that sound? It seems to be coming from over there.
Why can't we all participate together...
Luckily, I'm the one who got picked! Don't worry, I've got this!
Hey, show some faith in your teammate, okay!?
Someday, my banner will hang right there alongside the Team of Stars!
Still got a long way to go, though... Hopefully, I can put together a good team next time!
Hey, the trial's about to start. What are you looking around for?
Don't forget to oil the Mechcraft Armor!
Oh, right, right... Um, where did Li Bai go...
Meng Ya runs into fans of Li Bai and Shangguan arguing over who was better. Since he isn't a supporter of either side, he ends up getting no information.
Hey, what can you tell me about Dragon's...
You saw it too, right? Shangguan pulled off that brilliant calligraphy despite Li Bai crashing the scene!
Nonsense! The credit definitely goes to the one and only Swordmaster!
Hmph, this is pointless. When we meet in the Enlightenment Trials, I'll show you who knows better!
Anyone prefers my Apocalyptor... Ahem, I was wondering if you knew anything about Dragon's Graveyard?
Looking for intel, huh? Then tell me first: whose side are you on? Li Bai the Lyricist or Shangguan the Calligrapher?
Huh? What are you even talking about?
Then I've got nothing to say to you. Leave us be, will ya?
Shangguan tells Fuzi that to resolve the crisis in Chang'an, she will head back with Mozi right after the ceremony.
Thank you for the brilliant performance, Lady Shangguan.
The honor is mine, Fuzi. Didn't expect that man to disrupt me, though.
Haha, you know that's just how he is. There is no need to take it to heart.
And I'm sure our students loved it. Your epic duel back in the day is a legend to them.
Anyway, given the recent situation, I'll return to Chang'an with Master Mozi right after the ceremony.
I understand. The people there need you in the face of such an emergency.
And please, be very careful. We don't know what we're dealing with here.
We've been waiting for you! Hurry, the ceremony is about to start.
I got too excited last night and couldn't sleep at all...
I've calculated our odds of beating the Team of Stars this year...
I heard a special guest from Chang'an will join the Grand Ceremony!
Really? Could it be Lady Shangguan?
I've admired her for the longest time...
Oh gosh... my heart's racing just thinking about it...
Looking sharp, huh? Once we clinch the championship this year, we'll hang you up there as well!
Sun Bin encounters some of his biggest fans, but unfortunately, they know little about Dragon's Graveyard.
Senior Sun Bin! You're actually talking to me! Whatever you need, just say the word!
I, uh... I just wanted to ask about the trial site...
Trial sites, you mean? We've already asked around!
Our team is at Duskshroud Slope. Some other teams are assigned to Aermore Valley, Labyrinth Cave, Autumn Streams, Starflare Lake...
Um... have you heard anything about Dragon's Graveyard?
Not that I remember... But we're more than happy to ask around for you!
Information on Dragon's Graveyard! Let's go, quick!
W-wait... why aren't they listening to me...
Every time I see these kids working hard for the Enlightenment Trials, it just makes me feel young again.
Tell me about it. We won the trials and found our answers back in the day. May they find theirs too.
Of all the trials we've watched, which one stands out the most to you?
Has to be the year Kongming won.
And the Team of Stars was impressive last time. Solid individual skills and great teamwork.
True, I even made my students study Novar's combat style.
Say, how about we borrow them as my teaching assistants after this...?
Stay calm when you're there. And strike only after you see an opening.
Remember how you panicked and exhausted all your Sorcery energy at the very beginning last time?
You don't want to make the same mistake again...
I bought three big bags of herbs this time, so I can replenish my energy anytime!
You what... Ugh, whatever, just stay safe out there.
If we get to access the Wonder this year, what would you ask?
How to become the world's best Martial Artist, of course!
I know it's almost impossible to surpass Master Fuzi, but one is allowed to dream big, right?
I get you—'cause I want the same thing.
What about you? Do you want to become the best, too?
I... I'm not sure how to do that. To surpass Fuzi, is that all?
A Sorcery student claims Dragon's Graveyard is extremely dangerous and suggests Shye hand over her valuables to ward off the peril. Unfortunate for her, Shye sees right through her act.
Hmm... The voices in my dreams have spoken. This "Dragon's Graveyard" is a treacherous place!
But fear not. Simply hand over all your possessions, and the nightmare shall be dispelled.
Is that so? Then... why not dispel your own nightmares first?
I'm sensing dark, ominous energy around you. These nightmares must have been haunting you for at least three weeks now, right?
You... how did you know? I haven't slept properly for a long time now. Do you... have a fix for it?
Of course. But not for free.

A superstitious magic student claims the Dragon-Sorrow Land is extremely dangerous and demands Shye hand over her valuables to ensure safety. Unfortunately, her ruse was long ago seen through by Shye.
zh_text: 一名神叨叨的魔道学生称龙殇地凶险至极，让西施交出身上财物才可转危为安。可惜，她的伎俩早就被西施看穿。
source_text: 一名神叨叨的魔道学生称龙殇地凶险至极，让西施交出身上财物才可转危为安。可惜，她的伎俩早就被西施看穿。
official_target_text: A superstitious magic student claims the Dragon-Sorrow Land is extremely dangerous and demands Shye hand over her valuables to ensure safety. Unfortunately, her ruse was long ago seen through by Shye.
official_en_text: A superstitious magic student claims the Dragon-Sorrow Land is extremely dangerous and demands Shye hand over her valuables to ensure safety. Unfortunately, her ruse was long ago seen through by Shye.

text: Feeling a little overwhelmed, Nivie is hiding away from the crowds. Her teammate Minka finds her, offers a few words of comfort, and brings her back to the team.
It's okay, Nivie, no need to be afraid... I'll just be a stray feather by the roadside. Those scary people... they won't even notice me...
Really? But I can see you crystal clear, girl.
Minka? Wh-what are you doing here...?
I figured you'd try to disappear in such a crowd, so I came looking. How are you feeling now?
*Chuckle* Oh, so how's that staff I made you? Still feels right in your hands?
Yeah, I love it. We promised each other to win this together!
Glad to hear that. Now let's head back—they're all waiting for you!
Who's the brightest star of all? It's him who stands tall....
Look at this crowd! Definitely more people than last time.
It's fine to be nervous now. Just don't lose your cool when the action starts.
Finally, the Enlightenment Trials are about to begin.
Finally, the Enlightenment Trials are about to begin.
Novar said he'd be waiting outside the Tower of Enlightenment. I should go meet him now.
Novar said he'd be waiting outside the Tower of Enlightenment. I should go meet him now.
The moment has come. The three headmasters take their places to announce the rules of the Enlightenment Trials.
Welcome, dear students. The Grand Ceremony begins now.
As per tradition, we shall announce the rules of the Enlightenment trials.
Heaven, earth—all things are one. When the dream reaches its end, your real journey shall begin.
This year's Enlightenment Trials consist of three rounds: "Body," "Heart," and "Team Work." After explaining the rules, Fuzi introduces the special guests—Chang'an Envoys!
The truth is what you make of it. That has been our academy motto for ages.
We hope the Enlightenment Trials can serve as an inspiration. To guide you to your own truths.
Again, the team that wins the championship will earn the right to consult the Aercocoon.
The trials this year consist of three rounds: "Body," "Heart," and "Team Work."
After that, only one can stand before the Wonder.
May you seek truth through understanding your heart.
I hereby declare the Enlightenment Trials have officially begun!
Now, let's give a warm welcome to this year's special guests—the Chang'an Envoys!
“‘Tell yourself the truth’ is the school motto that has been passed down in Jixia to this day.
zh_text: “自己告诉自己真理”，是稷下传承至今的校训。
source_text: “自己告诉自己真理”，是稷下传承至今的校训。
official_target_text: “‘Tell yourself the truth’ is the school motto that has been passed down in Jixia to this day.
official_en_text: “‘Tell yourself the truth’ is the school motto that has been passed down in Jixia to this day.

text: After three trials, only one team can meet the miracle.
zh_text: 三场试炼后，只有一支队伍可以面见奇迹。
source_text: 三场试炼后，只有一支队伍可以面见奇迹。
official_target_text: After three trials, only one team can meet the miracle.
official_en_text: After three trials, only one team can meet the miracle.

text: Only the one member given the golden characters—meaning you—can take part in the first round. Sun Bin suggests gathering more information on Dragon's Graveyard before you go.
And these words in your hand... that's basically his personal message for us, right? Haha!
Why didn't you tell me Li Bai was coming, Shye? I could've gotten a much closer look.
You should focus on the trial, Captain!
Right... so, what do we know about Dragon's Graveyard?
It's an ancient ruin with few visitors lately, and... that's all.
Rumor has it the place is filled with intricate Mechcrafts and fierce beasts... sounds like a treacherous place to me.
Heh! That's what makes it fun!
A solo competition... Lucky I wasn't picked...
You guys done talking yet? Can we let the real star of the show get a word in?
No one has ever done that before, so I don't thin... B-but we can go ask together.
To win this competition—it's what I signed up for, right? And that's what I will do.
To win this competition—it's what I signed up for, right? And that's what I will do.
First step toward defending the title...
Our ticket to the next round...
The chance to access the Wonder...
And the fate of Team of Stars... All rest in your hands!
It's sad that I, the captain, cannot fight for our team... But yes, I'm sure you'll be fine.
I believe in you, too... Still, be careful, okay? We'd hate to see you get hurt.
Here—a collection of all my military tactics! Memorize them, and you're all set!
Stop overburdening the rookie, will ya?
Okay, everyone. There's one last thing before you go.
Told you, you should've joined my team. At least I wouldn't give you ridiculous advice like this.
