Wh-what? I was just passing by and trying to help you out!
Hmph. Anyway. This first round is no problem for my team. Hope we can see you in the next trial.
Hey, she just left like that? I mean, what was she even doing here?
The location of the first trial has been revealed.
Don't you get it? She's clearly trying to psych us out!
Don't fall for her tricks, okay? You've got this.
But why do I feel like Vlinder was trying to motivate you... in her own way...?
I wouldn't worry too much if I were you. With all the skills you've built through your training, this trial shouldn't be too hard.
Yango's Puppet, the Crimson Beast, and Cloudeater... You are more than ready.
Absolutely! Just give it your best, and we'll join you in the next round!
That's the spirit! Whenever you're ready, go break a leg!
You could also ask around a bit if you want to. Might be something useful...
As you must have noticed, one member from each team has received the "golden characters." Only they can participate in the trial.
Okay, see you all later then.
Okay, see you all later then.
After all, the ability to deal with the unexpected is itself part of the test.
Are you willing to trust your friend and place the team's fate in their hands?
And the ones selected—are you truly ready to carry the team to victory without your teammates' support?
What the... Three months spent upgrading my Apocalyptor, and I'm supposed to what? Sit on the bench!?
Go now, kids. And may you prove yourselves with unwavering resolve.
This must be the first trial location. And hey, what a way to reveal that!
You can say that again! Lady Shangguan's writing, Li Bai's sword dance, capped off with that cascade of golden streamers—shows from Chang'an never skimps on spectacle!
Of course, that's Li Bai you're talking about! From the graceful movements to the effortless swordplay, right down to those gleaming strands of hair...
Great idea! Then I'll teach you my Starlight Slice, plus Shye's Mistveil techniques and Sun Bin's time control—never hurts to have more skills!
Got it. I'll do whatever it takes!
Got it. I'll do whatever it takes!
Why... why didn't Li Bai choose me? Am I not his biggest fan...?
Novar asks Vlinder and Fen about Dragon's Graveyard, but they are busy searching for a bunny-eared girl.
Captain says we're willing to share what we know—but first, have you seen a girl with bunny ears?
Bunny ears? Don't think I have...
I know what she said. I'm standing right here, man!
Yeah, but Captain can't be bothered talking to someone below her.
Excuse me!? The Power Rankings means nothing. We'll win the Enlightenment Trials right in your face!
You reunite with the team. After a signature Team of Stars pep talk, you head inside the tower with both curiosity and excitement.
Ahem, As the captain of Team of Stars, I'd like to say a few words before we go in—
Alright, well said. Let's go now.
Hey! I stayed up all night working on this speech!
Who wants to hear it anyway...
Well, just another typical day of the great Team of Stars.
Come on, I'm just trying to bring the team together! So that we can work as one if I, uh, anyone, fails to deliver.
Oh, don't listen to that... We are going to deliver.
Hey, you're not getting cold feet, are you? I-I assure you we can be counted on.
Indeed! And if you're thinking about quitting, please don't! You're an important member of our team now!
What I want to say is we're in this together... because...
What I want to say is we're in this together... because...
I just got the team badge.
I feel really lucky to be part of the team. Let's win the competition together!
I feel really lucky to be part of the team. Let's win the competition together!
Woah, someone's being sentimental... But you're right, we'll make it happen as a team!
Speaking of, I wonder what the rules will be this year.
But... haven't you done this before?
But... haven't you done this before?
To keep things fair, the rules change every time.
Retrieving wooden plaques from flying Mechcrafts, passing through the maze in Dreamweave Plains...
Once, they even had us take on the Martial Artists in Warriors' Town.
The rules for this year will be announced at the Grand Ceremony.
Oh, yes, the Grand Ceremony... I can't wait to see the opening performance. Doesn't get any more excited than that, you know!?
The Mechcraft Kite fireworks show last time—truly spectacular.
This year, our School of Martial Arts will take the stage. Imagine some showstopper moves from Fuzi himself!
I... I'd love to watch a dozen Mozi models demonstrate the new combat formations...
It's almost time. Let's go in and see for ourselves!
“Trouble”? We’re all friends here. Even if I really did stir up some trouble, we’d surely share the blessings and the burdens together.
zh_text: “麻烦”？大家都是自己人，就算我真惹出什么事，肯定也是有福同享，有难同当啊。
source_text: “麻烦”？大家都是自己人，就算我真惹出什么事，肯定也是有福同享，有难同当啊。
official_target_text: “Trouble”? We’re all friends here. Even if I really did stir up some trouble, we’d surely share the blessings and the burdens together.
official_en_text: “Trouble”? We’re all friends here. Even if I really did stir up some trouble, we’d surely share the blessings and the burdens together.

text: Can't wait to see the defending champs in action!
Is that the new member of the Team of Stars?
This Sentinel is so tough to handle...
This Sentinel is so tough to handle...
Still, I'm adapting to his attack patterns now.
Still, I'm adapting to his attack patterns now.
Swift yet lethal, the "Ripper" can strike in a split second.
Two against one is just unfair...
Two against one is just unfair...
Wait, I can still see the traces!
Wait, I can still see the traces!
Just a little longer. Hang in there!
Vesper slips into the secret chamber underground and activates the Sentinel Trial. The three statues around you suddenly come to life and start to fight you.
Only by defeating the Sentinels can you rise as a Sanctified.
Fuzi's Flowgram tells you there's one final challenge left in this trial: to face yourself.
There's one final challenge left in this round: to face and overcome yourself.
When you're ready, channel your Flow into the central statue.
One more challenge... I should finish this quickly and meet up with the team!
One more challenge... I should finish this quickly and meet up with the team!

Fuzi's Flowgram appears and explains: this trial comprises three challenges, "Courage," "Strategy," and "Agility"—each corresponding to one of the three statues. Simply channel your Flow into a statue to begin its trial.
Welcome to the Enlightenment Trials, dear student.
The first round is called "The Way of the Body." It aims to push your body to the limit, so that your true potential can be achieved.
The three statues before you lead to three tests—"Courage," "Strategy," and "Agility." Simply channel your Flow into one to start the corresponding test.
Phew... So it's just his Flowgram. For a second, I thought we were about to get caught...
Wouldn't be the first time if you did.
Come on, it was only like four or five times... maybe ten... Anyway, let's focus on the trial.
Three tests... Which would you like to begin with?
Strategy determines how the body acts.
Only those with clear strategic planning shall pass this test.
Every puzzle follows a pattern. You only need to watch closely enough.
Okay, I'll keep that in mind.
Okay, I'll keep that in mind.
The Trial of Strategy is complete.
You've passed all three trials, then Novar's Big-eye Owlet gets caught red-handed by Fuzi. You say goodbye to your teammates before heading back to the center of the arena.
M-Master Fuzi? Where did you come from...?
Okay, we're getting out of here! See you back at the academy!
Mission accomplished! You did such a great job!
I couldn't have done it without your support.
I couldn't have done it without your support.
See, guys? Told you my Big-eye Owlet plan would work. And as long as Fuzi doesn't find out about this...
I should get back to the center now.
I should get back to the center now.
Wonderful job! You don't seem nervous to me at all.
Time to go check what the other trials are.
Time to go check what the other trials are.
The three trials are complete. Return to the center of the arena first.
zh_text: 三场试炼已毕，先回到场地中央来吧。
source_text: 三场试炼已毕，先回到场地中央来吧。
official_target_text: The three trials are complete. Return to the center of the arena first.
official_en_text: The three trials are complete. Return to the center of the arena first.

text: One more challenge... I should finish this quickly and meet up with the team!
One more challenge... I should finish this quickly and meet up with the team!

As you arrive at the trial site, Novar's Big-eye Owlet comes hovering over. Turns out his "great idea" was just to spectate in this way... Just like that, you enter the place "accompanied" by the whole team.
Well, it's not prohibited in the rules last time I checked.
Novar! So this "great idea" of yours... is having your Big-eye Owlet with me during the trial? Is it even allowed?
Novar! So this "great idea" of yours... is having your Big-eye Owlet with me during the trial? Is it even allowed?
Hmph, aren't you a walking rule book... Keep a low profile, okay? I'm not losing credits over this.
At least we can see how you're doing now, so I'm not complaining.
The three statues ahead mark the heart of Dragon's Graveyard, each leading to a unique area...
Um, spectate only, Sun Bin. We wouldn't want it to look like cheating.
Not bad. Still, would've been way cooler with my "Flash" move!
You'll have to teach me next time.
You'll have to teach me next time.
Oh, no! Are you all right?
I'm fine. Looks like I need to time my moves better...
I'm fine. Looks like I need to time my moves better...
Agility determines how the body moves.
Only those sharp on their eyes and quick on their feet shall pass this test.
Sounds like more than just a test of speed. Better watch your step.
The Trial of Agility is complete.
Looks like you need to be fast for this one.
Such a long staircase... It's clearly a race to the top. Go, go, go!
I doubt it'd be that simple...
I doubt it'd be that simple...
You think you're any better? I'm going bald if you keep yanking my hair like that!
Sounds like another battle is taking place on your end.
Sounds like another battle is taking place on your end.
Nicely done... And you—I understand you're nervous, but stop tugging at my cape!
Courage determines how the body endures.
Only those brave enough to face the most powerful foes shall pass this test.
The Trial of Courage is complete.
Guess I'll need to gear up for combat.
Guess I'll need to gear up for combat.
This can't be tougher than the Crimson Beast. Just go and do your thing!
Whoa, now these two are more like it.
I'm sure you will. You're doing much better than our great captain did last time.
He did nothing, and still managed to be the first one down. You know how hard we worked to secure that win?
Seriously? These Mechanoids look so weak...
Hey, quit pushing! Your hair's blocking everything!
Hello? Someone's in a trial now!
Hello? Someone's in a trial now!
This is bad... gotta be more careful.
This is bad... gotta be more careful.
Were all Sanctified selected in such a dangerous way?
Were all Sanctified selected in such a dangerous way?
Was that Ziya's voice? Something doesn't feel right...
Was that Ziya's voice? Something doesn't feel right...
Sentinels, Sanctified... I doubt this is all part of the final challenge.
Sentinels, Sanctified... I doubt this is all part of the final challenge.
Anyway, I should take this guy down first!
Anyway, I should take this guy down first!
I never thought that even someone as powerful as the Sanctifier would have a side as a teacher.
zh_text: 不曾想，强大如封神者，也有师者的一面。
source_text: 不曾想，强大如封神者，也有师者的一面。
official_target_text: I never thought that even someone as powerful as the Sanctifier would have a side as a teacher.
official_en_text: I never thought that even someone as powerful as the Sanctifier would have a side as a teacher.

text: So, as the chief examiner, I hereby announce—
zh_text: 所以，作为本轮试炼的主考官，我宣布——
source_text: 所以，作为本轮试炼的主考官，我宣布——
official_target_text: So, as the chief examiner of this trial, I hereby declare—
official_en_text: So, as the chief examiner of this trial, I hereby declare—

text: Team of Stars will advance to the second round!
zh_text: 你成功通过了试炼，星之队顺利晋级！
source_text: 你成功通过了试炼，星之队顺利晋级！
official_target_text: You've successfully passed the trial! Team of Stars advances!
official_en_text: You've successfully passed the trial! Team of Stars advances!

text: You think I'd let that happen? Look what I have here.
zh_text: 老夫可不会空手而归，你看这是什么？
source_text: 老夫可不会空手而归，你看这是什么？
official_target_text: I won't return empty-handed. Look at this.
official_en_text: I won't return empty-handed. Look at this.

text: My Flow was supposed to be the only thing that could break that seal... Guess I was wrong...
zh_text: 原本只有老夫的流能够解开那里的封印……不曾想……
source_text: 原本只有老夫的流能够解开那里的封印……不曾想……
official_target_text: I thought only my Flow could break the seal there... but it seems...
official_en_text: I thought only my Flow could break the seal there... but it seems...

text: I'm not sure how Vesper got into the place and activated the Sentinels. Maybe fate had its own plans.
zh_text: 或许一切都是机缘巧合，才让你和那位少年进入了封神台，激活了铸灵试炼。
source_text: 或许一切都是机缘巧合，才让你和那位少年进入了封神台，激活了铸灵试炼。
official_target_text: Perhaps it was all fate that led you and that young man into the Altar of Sanctification and activated the Sentinel Trial.
official_en_text: Perhaps it was all fate that led you and that young man into the Altar of Sanctification and activated the Sentinel Trial.

text: The name's Shangguan, and I'm honored to be invited.
zh_text: 有幸受邀，上官婉儿有礼了。
source_text: 有幸受邀，上官婉儿有礼了。
official_target_text: It's my honor to be invited, Shangguan.
official_en_text: It's my honor to be invited, Shangguan.

text: You get what I'm saying? This trial is no game. Back out now if you want to save your skin.
zh_text: 你懂了吧？这次的试炼可不是闹着玩的，要想保住小命，就自己退赛吧！
source_text: 你懂了吧？这次的试炼可不是闹着玩的，要想保住小命，就自己退赛吧！
official_target_text: This trial is no joke. If you want to live, withdraw now!
official_en_text: This trial is no joke. If you want to live, withdraw now!

text: Really...? I'll... I'll think it over then...
zh_text: 这么危险吗……我、我再考虑一下……
source_text: 这么危险吗……我、我再考虑一下……
official_target_text: That sounds... really dangerous. I'll have to think about it...
official_en_text: That sounds... really dangerous. I'll have to think about it...

text: Your idea to scare off other contestants is brilliant, Maroon! Fewer people means better chance to win.
zh_text: 大哥，不愧是你，想到恐吓参赛选手的法子。只要他们退赛，我们的竞争对手也就少了。
source_text: 大哥，不愧是你，想到恐吓参赛选手的法子。只要他们退赛，我们的竞争对手也就少了。
official_target_text: Bro, you're genius. Scaring off contestants means fewer rivals for us.
official_en_text: Bro, you're genius. Scaring off contestants means fewer rivals for us.

text: More people heading this way. Let's move, brother – time to scare them off!
zh_text: 那边又有人过来了，走，弟弟，开始恐吓！
source_text: 那边又有人过来了，走，弟弟，开始恐吓！
official_target_text: Someone's coming. Let's do it again!
official_en_text: Someone's coming. Let's do it again!

text: Dragon's Graveyard, Tiger's Graveyard—who cares? Just smash your way through!
zh_text: 管他什么龙殇地虎殇地的，一路痛快打过去就好了！
source_text: 管他什么龙殇地虎殇地的，一路痛快打过去就好了！
official_target_text: Who cares about the past? Just keep moving forward!
official_en_text: Who cares about the past? Just keep moving forward!

text: L-let's not be reckless. Making smart decisions is important as well.
zh_text: 也、也不能莽撞……兵来将挡，水来土掩，记得随机应变。
source_text: 也、也不能莽撞……兵来将挡，水来土掩，记得随机应变。
official_target_text: But... but don't be reckless... Just cope with the situation.
official_en_text: But... but don't be reckless... Just cope with the situation.

zh_text: 取胜后队长应该有所表示吧。
source_text: 取胜后队长应该有所表示吧。
official_target_text: The captain should say something after the victory.
official_en_text: The captain should say something after the victory.

text: Okay! When you pass the trial, whatever you want to eat is on me!
zh_text: 那当然！等你试炼通过，我来请客，想吃什么随便点！
source_text: 那当然！等你试炼通过，我来请客，想吃什么随便点！
official_target_text: Of course! Once you pass your trial, I'll treat you to whatever you want!
official_en_text: Of course! Once you pass your trial, I'll treat you to whatever you want!

text: Luckily, I'm the one who got picked! Don't worry, I've got this!
zh_text: 还好是我抽中了，哈哈，你放心，我保证完成任务！
source_text: 还好是我抽中了，哈哈，你放心，我保证完成任务！
official_target_text: It's a good thing I drew the short straw. Don't worry, I'll get the job done!
official_en_text: It's a good thing I drew the short straw. Don't worry, I'll get the job done!

official_target_text: Sigh... maybe we should just forfeit?
official_en_text: Sigh... maybe we should just forfeit?

text: Hey, show some faith in your teammate, okay!?
zh_text: 喂，对队友有点信心啊！很伤人诶！
source_text: 喂，对队友有点信心啊！很伤人诶！
official_target_text: Hey, have some faith in your teammate! That hurts!
official_en_text: Hey, have some faith in your teammate! That hurts!

text: Someday, my banner will hang right there alongside the Team of Stars!
zh_text: 总有一天，我会像星之队一样挂在那里！
source_text: 总有一天，我会像星之队一样挂在那里！
official_target_text: One day, I'll be up there like the Team of Stars!
official_en_text: One day, I'll be up there like the Team of Stars!

text: Still got a long way to go, though... Hopefully, I can put together a good team next time!
zh_text: 但我现在还太菜了……希望下次能凑齐队伍参赛！
source_text: 但我现在还太菜了……希望下次能凑齐队伍参赛！
official_target_text: But I'm not there yet... Hopefully, I'll get a team together for the next competition!
official_en_text: But I'm not there yet... Hopefully, I'll get a team together for the next competition!

text: Hey, the trial's about to start. What are you looking around for?
zh_text: 马上要开始试炼了，你还在东张西望什么呢？
source_text: 马上要开始试炼了，你还在东张西望什么呢？
official_target_text: The trial is about to begin. Why are you still looking around?
official_en_text: The trial is about to begin. Why are you still looking around?

text: Don't forget to oil the Mechcraft Armor!
official_target_text: Don't forget to oil the Mechanoid!
official_en_text: Don't forget to oil the Mechanoid!

text: Oh, right, right... Um, where did Li Bai go...
zh_text: 哦对对，奇怪，我的李白……不，我的机油去哪了呢？
source_text: 哦对对，奇怪，我的李白……不，我的机油去哪了呢？
official_target_text: Oh, right, right. Odd, where did my Li Bai... I mean, my lubricant go?
official_en_text: Oh, right, right. Odd, where did my Li Bai... I mean, my lubricant go?

text: You saw it too, right? Shangguan pulled off that brilliant calligraphy despite Li Bai crashing the scene!
zh_text: 你也看见了吧，就算被李白搅混水，我们婉儿大人还是完成了精彩的题字！
source_text: 你也看见了吧，就算被李白搅混水，我们婉儿大人还是完成了精彩的题字！
official_target_text: You saw it, right? Even when Li Bai stirred the water, Lady Shangguan still managed to finish the calligraphy!
official_en_text: You saw it, right? Even when Li Bai stirred the water, Lady Shangguan still managed to finish the calligraphy!

text: Nonsense! The credit definitely goes to the one and only Swordmaster!
zh_text: 胡说八道，要不是有剑仙协助，上官婉儿能写出那么好的字？
source_text: 胡说八道，要不是有剑仙协助，上官婉儿能写出那么好的字？
official_target_text: Nonsense! How could Shangguan Wan'er have written such beautiful calligraphy without the help of the Swordmaster?
official_en_text: Nonsense! How could Shangguan Wan'er have written such beautiful calligraphy without the help of the Swordmaster?

text: Hmph, this is pointless. When we meet in the Enlightenment Trials, I'll show you who knows better!
zh_text: 哼，和你说不通，不如归虚梦演里见，看看笔和剑到底哪个更强！
source_text: 哼，和你说不通，不如归虚梦演里见，看看笔和剑到底哪个更强！
official_target_text: Hmph, you just don't get it. Let's settle this in the Enlightenment Trials and see which one is superior!
official_en_text: Hmph, you just don't get it. Let's settle this in the Enlightenment Trials and see which one is superior!

text: Hey, what can you tell me about Dragon's...
official_target_text: Excuse me, do you know where I can find...
official_en_text: Excuse me, do you know where I can find...

text: Anyone prefers my Apocalyptor... Ahem, I was wondering if you knew anything about Dragon's Graveyard?
zh_text: 我看还是浑天更强些……不对！我是想问龙殇地的事情！
source_text: 我看还是浑天更强些……不对！我是想问龙殇地的事情！
official_target_text: I think the Apocalyptor is stronger... no, wait! I wanted to ask about Dragon's Graveyard!
official_en_text: I think the Apocalyptor is stronger... no, wait! I wanted to ask about Dragon's Graveyard!

text: Looking for intel, huh? Then tell me first: whose side are you on? Li Bai the Lyricist or Shangguan the Calligrapher?
zh_text: 想打探情报啊，那你先说，你是李白派，还是婉儿派？
source_text: 想打探情报啊，那你先说，你是李白派，还是婉儿派？
official_target_text: So you want some scoop, huh? First, tell me, are you Team Li Bai or Team Shangguan?
official_en_text: So you want some scoop, huh? First, tell me, are you Team Li Bai or Team Shangguan?

text: Huh? What are you even talking about?
Then I've got nothing to say to you. Leave us be, will ya?
zh_text: 哼，这你都不知道，那我们没什么可说的了。
source_text: 哼，这你都不知道，那我们没什么可说的了。
official_target_text: You have no idea. We're done here.
official_en_text: You have no idea. We're done here.

text: Thank you for the brilliant performance, Lady Shangguan.
The honor is mine, Fuzi. Didn't expect that man to disrupt me, though.
zh_text: 夫子不必客气。只是没想到那位会突然闯入场内，差点误了试炼之事。
source_text: 夫子不必客气。只是没想到那位会突然闯入场内，差点误了试炼之事。
official_target_text: No need for courtesy. I just didn't expect that one to suddenly barge into the arena, almost disrupting the trial.
official_en_text: No need for courtesy. I just didn't expect that one to suddenly barge into the arena, almost disrupting the trial.

text: Haha, you know that's just how he is. There is no need to take it to heart.
zh_text: 哈哈哈，他一向如此自在随性，上官大人何必介怀。
source_text: 哈哈哈，他一向如此自在随性，上官大人何必介怀。
official_target_text: Haha, he's always been like that. Don't take it to heart, Lady Shangguan.
official_en_text: Haha, he's always been like that. Don't take it to heart, Lady Shangguan.

text: Anyway, given the recent situation, I'll return to Chang'an with Master Mozi right after the ceremony.
zh_text: 那么，时间紧迫，大典过后，婉儿就和墨子老师先行回长安了。
source_text: 那么，时间紧迫，大典过后，婉儿就和墨子老师先行回长安了。
official_target_text: Time is short. After the ceremony, Shangguan and Master Mozi will return to Chang'an.
official_en_text: Time is short. After the ceremony, Shangguan and Master Mozi will return to Chang'an.

text: I understand. The people there need you in the face of such an emergency.
zh_text: 嗯，长安之事紧急，我也不便多留你们。
source_text: 嗯，长安之事紧急，我也不便多留你们。
official_target_text: Urgent matters await in Chang'an. I won't keep you any longer.
official_en_text: Urgent matters await in Chang'an. I won't keep you any longer.

text: And please, be very careful. We don't know what we're dealing with here.
zh_text: 此事事出突然，一定千万小心。
source_text: 此事事出突然，一定千万小心。
official_target_text: This is sudden. Please be careful.
official_en_text: This is sudden. Please be careful.

text: We've been waiting for you! Hurry, the ceremony is about to start.
zh_text: 等你好久了！快点，大典要开始了！
source_text: 等你好久了！快点，大典要开始了！
official_target_text: We've been waiting for you! Hurry, the ceremony is about to begin!
official_en_text: We've been waiting for you! Hurry, the ceremony is about to begin!

text: I got too excited last night and couldn't sleep at all...
zh_text: 对不起……昨天太激动，失眠了……
source_text: 对不起……昨天太激动，失眠了……
official_target_text: Sorry... I got too excited yesterday and couldn't sleep...
official_en_text: Sorry... I got too excited yesterday and couldn't sleep...

zh_text: 不知道这次的规则是什么样的。
source_text: 不知道这次的规则是什么样的。
official_target_text: Wonder what the rules are this time.
official_en_text: Wonder what the rules are this time.

zh_text: 有时候，运气比规则更重要。
source_text: 有时候，运气比规则更重要。
official_target_text: Sometimes luck matters more than rules.
official_en_text: Sometimes luck matters more than rules.

text: I've calculated our odds of beating the Team of Stars this year...
zh_text: 我算过了，我们今年赢过星之队的概率……
source_text: 我算过了，我们今年赢过星之队的概率……
official_target_text: I did the math. Our chances of beating the Team of Stars this year...
official_en_text: I did the math. Our chances of beating the Team of Stars this year...

text: I heard a special guest from Chang'an will join the Grand Ceremony!
zh_text: 我听说啊，这次大典好像有长安使团的嘉宾！
source_text: 我听说啊，这次大典好像有长安使团的嘉宾！
official_target_text: I heard the Chang'an Envoys are attending the ceremony!
official_en_text: I heard the Chang'an Envoys are attending the ceremony!

text: Really? Could it be Lady Shangguan?
zh_text: 真的吗？会不会是上官婉儿大人？
source_text: 真的吗？会不会是上官婉儿大人？

text: I've admired her for the longest time...
zh_text: 我、我仰慕上官大人很久了……
source_text: 我、我仰慕上官大人很久了……
official_target_text: I-I've admired you for a long time...
official_en_text: I-I've admired you for a long time...

text: Oh gosh... my heart's racing just thinking about it...

official_target_text: Look! It's the portrait of the Team of Stars!
official_en_text: Look! It's the portrait of the Team of Stars!

text: Looking sharp, huh? Once we clinch the championship this year, we'll hang you up there as well!
zh_text: 帅气吧？哈哈，等我们拿下这一届的冠军，就把你也一起挂上去！
source_text: 帅气吧？哈哈，等我们拿下这一届的冠军，就把你也一起挂上去！
official_target_text: Cool, right? Once we win this year's championship, we'll hang you up there too!
official_en_text: Cool, right? Once we win this year's championship, we'll hang you up there too!

text: Senior Sun Bin! You're actually talking to me! Whatever you need, just say the word!
zh_text: 你你你你是孙膑学长！孙膑学长和我搭话了！学长你有什么需要的？我万死不辞！
source_text: 你你你你是孙膑学长！孙膑学长和我搭话了！学长你有什么需要的？我万死不辞！
official_target_text: Y-you're Senior Sun Bin! Senior Sun Bin is talking to me! Is there anything you need? I'm at your service!
official_en_text: Y-you're Senior Sun Bin! Senior Sun Bin is talking to me! Is there anything you need? I'm at your service!

text: I, uh... I just wanted to ask about the trial site...
zh_text: 我……那个……我只是想问问试炼地……
source_text: 我……那个……我只是想问问试炼地……
official_target_text: I... uh... I just wanted to ask about the trial ground...
official_en_text: I... uh... I just wanted to ask about the trial ground...

text: Trial sites, you mean? We've already asked around!
zh_text: 学长是想知道大家的试炼地吗？我们已经打听过一圈了！
source_text: 学长是想知道大家的试炼地吗？我们已经打听过一圈了！
official_target_text: Are you trying to find out everyone's trial locations? We've asked around!
official_en_text: Are you trying to find out everyone's trial locations? We've asked around!

text: Our team is at Duskshroud Slope. Some other teams are assigned to Aermore Valley, Labyrinth Cave, Autumn Streams, Starflare Lake...
zh_text: 我们队在霞隐坡，其他队的地点有藏云谷、迷津洞、秋水涧、映星湖……
source_text: 我们队在霞隐坡，其他队的地点有藏云谷、迷津洞、秋水涧、映星湖……
official_target_text: Our team is at Duskshroud Slope, while others are assigned to Aermore Valley, Labyrinth Cave, Autumn Streams, and Starflare Lake...
official_en_text: Our team is at Duskshroud Slope, while others are assigned to Aermore Valley, Labyrinth Cave, Autumn Streams, and Starflare Lake...

text: Um... have you heard anything about Dragon's Graveyard?
zh_text: 请、请问……有没有在龙殇地的？
source_text: 请、请问……有没有在龙殇地的？
official_target_text: E-excuse me... are you going to Dragon's Graveyard?
official_en_text: E-excuse me... are you going to Dragon's Graveyard?

text: Not that I remember... But we're more than happy to ask around for you!
zh_text: 暂时没有听说……学长想了解龙殇地？我们这就去帮忙问问！
source_text: 暂时没有听说……学长想了解龙殇地？我们这就去帮忙问问！
official_target_text: Not that we know of... But we'll ask around for you!
official_en_text: Not that we know of... But we'll ask around for you!

official_target_text: And... don't worry about the trouble...
official_en_text: And... don't worry about the trouble...

text: Information on Dragon's Graveyard! Let's go, quick!
zh_text: 走走走，快，务必帮学长打听到龙殇地的情报！
source_text: 走走走，快，务必帮学长打听到龙殇地的情报！
official_target_text: Go get those intel from Dragon's Graveyard!
official_en_text: Go get those intel from Dragon's Graveyard!

text: Every time I see these kids working hard for the Enlightenment Trials, it just makes me feel young again.
zh_text: 哈哈，每次看到这些孩子为了归虚梦演努力的样子，我都觉得青春热血起来了。
source_text: 哈哈，每次看到这些孩子为了归虚梦演努力的样子，我都觉得青春热血起来了。
official_target_text: Haha, seeing these kids working hard for the Enlightenment Trials always gets my blood pumping.
official_en_text: Haha, seeing these kids working hard for the Enlightenment Trials always gets my blood pumping.

text: Tell me about it. We won the trials and found our answers back in the day. May they find theirs too.
zh_text: 是啊，我们当年曾经见过奇迹，得到了自己的答案。希望他们也能如愿。
source_text: 是啊，我们当年曾经见过奇迹，得到了自己的答案。希望他们也能如愿。
official_target_text: We once saw the Wonder and found our own answers. I hope they can, too.
official_en_text: We once saw the Wonder and found our own answers. I hope they can, too.

text: Of all the trials we've watched, which one stands out the most to you?
zh_text: 说起来，看了这么多届比赛，你对哪次印象最深？
source_text: 说起来，看了这么多届比赛，你对哪次印象最深？
official_target_text: Speaking of which, after watching so many competitions, which one left the deepest impression on you?
official_en_text: Speaking of which, after watching so many competitions, which one left the deepest impression on you?

text: Has to be the year Kongming won.
zh_text: 果然还是诸葛亮那次吧。
source_text: 果然还是诸葛亮那次吧。

text: And the Team of Stars was impressive last time. Solid individual skills and great teamwork.
zh_text: 对了，星之队也不错，不管是个人的战斗风格，还是团队配合，都令人印象深刻。
source_text: 对了，星之队也不错，不管是个人的战斗风格，还是团队配合，都令人印象深刻。
official_target_text: By the way, the Team of Stars was impressive, both in personal combat styles and teamwork.
official_en_text: By the way, the Team of Stars was impressive, both in personal combat styles and teamwork.

text: True, I even made my students study Novar's combat style.
zh_text: 确实不错，我还让我的学生好好研究东方曜的战斗方式呢，哈哈。
source_text: 确实不错，我还让我的学生好好研究东方曜的战斗方式呢，哈哈。
official_target_text: It's really impressive. I've even asked my students to study Novar's combat techniques, haha.
official_en_text: It's really impressive. I've even asked my students to study Novar's combat techniques, haha.

text: Say, how about we borrow them as my teaching assistants after this...?
zh_text: 不如等比赛结束后，把星之队抓来当我的助教吧……
source_text: 不如等比赛结束后，把星之队抓来当我的助教吧……
official_target_text: I should recruit Team of Stars as my assistants after the competition...
official_en_text: I should recruit Team of Stars as my assistants after the competition...

text: Stay calm when you're there. And strike only after you see an opening.
zh_text: 在赛场上不要慌乱，静心凝神，看清敌人破绽再出手。
source_text: 在赛场上不要慌乱，静心凝神，看清敌人破绽再出手。
official_target_text: Stay calm, focus your mind, spot the enemy's weakness, then strike.
official_en_text: Stay calm, focus your mind, spot the enemy's weakness, then strike.

text: Remember how you panicked and exhausted all your Sorcery energy at the very beginning last time?
zh_text: 可别像上次比试一样，心一慌，就把魔道术全都交出去了。
source_text: 可别像上次比试一样，心一慌，就把魔道术全都交出去了。
official_target_text: Don't give away all your Sorcery Techniques like last time.
official_en_text: Don't give away all your Sorcery Techniques like last time.

text: You don't want to make the same mistake again...
zh_text: 堂堂魔道学子，最后竟然只能肉搏……
source_text: 堂堂魔道学子，最后竟然只能肉搏……
official_target_text: A Sorcery student ended up having to brawl...
official_en_text: A Sorcery student ended up having to brawl...

text: I bought three big bags of herbs this time, so I can replenish my energy anytime!
zh_text: 我这次花了大钱，买了三大袋的草药，随时补充，绝对不会让黑历史再次上演！
source_text: 我这次花了大钱，买了三大袋的草药，随时补充，绝对不会让黑历史再次上演！
official_target_text: I spent a fortune on three large bags of herbs this time. I'll stay hydrated and won't repeat that mistake again!
official_en_text: I spent a fortune on three large bags of herbs this time. I'll stay hydrated and won't repeat that mistake again!

text: You what... Ugh, whatever, just stay safe out there.
zh_text: 百草家就是靠你养活的吧……算了算了，总之，要注意安全。
source_text: 百草家就是靠你养活的吧……算了算了，总之，要注意安全。
official_target_text: The Herb Society owes their life to you... Anyway, just be careful.
official_en_text: The Herb Society owes their life to you... Anyway, just be careful.

text: If we get to access the Wonder this year, what would you ask?
zh_text: 学长学姐，要是我们最后能够面见奇迹，你们想问奇迹什么问题啊？
source_text: 学长学姐，要是我们最后能够面见奇迹，你们想问奇迹什么问题啊？
official_target_text: If we get to meet Wonder, what would you ask it?
official_en_text: If we get to meet Wonder, what would you ask it?

text: How to become the world's best Martial Artist, of course!
zh_text: 那当然是要怎样成为武道第一了！
source_text: 那当然是要怎样成为武道第一了！
official_target_text: How to become the best in Martial Arts, of course!
official_en_text: How to become the best in Martial Arts, of course!

text: I know it's almost impossible to surpass Master Fuzi, but one is allowed to dream big, right?
zh_text: 虽然我很尊敬夫子，但不想当世间最强的武道人不是好学生。有了奇迹，说不定我也行！
source_text: 虽然我很尊敬夫子，但不想当世间最强的武道人不是好学生。有了奇迹，说不定我也行！
official_target_text: I respect Master Fuzi, but I don't want to be the best Martial Artist. With Wonder, maybe I can do it!
official_en_text: I respect Master Fuzi, but I don't want to be the best Martial Artist. With Wonder, maybe I can do it!

text: I get you—'cause I want the same thing.
zh_text: 哼哼，那到时候，我们两个就是对手了。
source_text: 哼哼，那到时候，我们两个就是对手了。

text: What about you? Do you want to become the best, too?
zh_text: 你呢，你也想成为最强之人吗？
source_text: 你呢，你也想成为最强之人吗？
official_target_text: Do you want to become the strongest?
official_en_text: Do you want to become the strongest?

text: I... I'm not sure how to do that. To surpass Fuzi, is that all?
zh_text: 我……我还不知道，到底什么才是“最强”呢，能战胜夫子就够了吗？
source_text: 我……我还不知道，到底什么才是“最强”呢，能战胜夫子就够了吗？
official_target_text: I... I don't know. What does it even mean to be "the strongest"? Is beating Master Fuzi enough?
official_en_text: I... I don't know. What does it even mean to be "the strongest"? Is beating Master Fuzi enough?

text: But fear not. Simply hand over all your possessions, and the nightmare shall be dispelled.
zh_text: 但无需担忧，只需回避金色之物，将尔身上财物尽数赠我，噩梦自会转危为安。
source_text: 但无需担忧，只需回避金色之物，将尔身上财物尽数赠我，噩梦自会转危为安。
official_target_text: But fear not, surrender all golden items and wealth to me, and your nightmares shall cease.
official_en_text: But fear not, surrender all golden items and wealth to me, and your nightmares shall cease.

text: You... how did you know? I haven't slept properly for a long time now. Do you... have a fix for it?
zh_text: 你、你怎么知道？我失眠三周零一天了，吃什么安神药都不管用，你有办法治吗？
source_text: 你、你怎么知道？我失眠三周零一天了，吃什么安神药都不管用，你有办法治吗？
official_target_text: How did you know? I've been awake for three weeks and one day. No sleeping pill works. Can you help me?
official_en_text: How did you know? I've been awake for three weeks and one day. No sleeping pill works. Can you help me?

text: Of course. But not for free.
zh_text: 当然可以，不过嘛……那可不是免费的。
source_text: 当然可以，不过嘛……那可不是免费的。
official_target_text: Sure, but it won't be free.
official_en_text: Sure, but it won't be free.

text: Hmm... The voices in my dreams have spoken. This "Dragon's Graveyard" is a treacherous place!
zh_text: 呵呵……梦中声已予我启示，你说的这龙殇地啊……凶险至极！
source_text: 呵呵……梦中声已予我启示，你说的这龙殇地啊……凶险至极！
official_target_text: Hah... the voices in my dream have given me a revelation. The place you mentioned, Dragon's Graveyard... it's extremely dangerous!
official_en_text: Hah... the voices in my dream have given me a revelation. The place you mentioned, Dragon's Graveyard... it's extremely dangerous!

text: Is that so? Then... why not dispel your own nightmares first?
zh_text: 噢，这么厉害的话，怎么不先替你自己解解噩梦？
source_text: 噢，这么厉害的话，怎么不先替你自己解解噩梦？
official_target_text: If it's so effective, why not use it on yourself first?
official_en_text: If it's so effective, why not use it on yourself first?

text: I'm sensing dark, ominous energy around you. These nightmares must have been haunting you for at least three weeks now, right?
zh_text: 我看你印堂青黑，身缠不祥之气，受梦魇惊扰夜不能寐的时间，起码超过三周了吧？
source_text: 我看你印堂青黑，身缠不祥之气，受梦魇惊扰夜不能寐的时间，起码超过三周了吧？
official_target_text: I see a dark aura around you. You've been haunted by nightmares for at least three weeks, haven't you?
official_en_text: I see a dark aura around you. You've been haunted by nightmares for at least three weeks, haven't you?

text: Who's the brightest star of all? It's him who stands tall....
zh_text: 夜观天象，是谁光芒万丈？是他是他，就是他……
source_text: 夜观天象，是谁光芒万丈？是他是他，就是他……
official_target_text: Who shines with radiance? Him, him, just him...
official_en_text: Who shines with radiance? Him, him, just him...

official_target_text: Ah... I'm starting to feel nervous...
official_en_text: Ah... I'm starting to feel nervous...

text: It's fine to be nervous now. Just don't lose your cool when the action starts.
zh_text: 现在紧张没关系，等打起架来可别手滑啊。
source_text: 现在紧张没关系，等打起架来可别手滑啊。
official_target_text: It's okay to be nervous now, but don't let it slip when you fight.
official_en_text: It's okay to be nervous now, but don't let it slip when you fight.

text: Novar said he'd be waiting outside the Tower of Enlightenment. I should go meet him now.
zh_text: 我记得东方曜说过，会在通天塔前等我。现在就去找他吧。
source_text: 我记得东方曜说过，会在通天塔前等我。现在就去找他吧。
official_target_text: Novar said he'd wait for me at the Tower of Enlightenment. Time to go.
official_en_text: Novar said he'd wait for me at the Tower of Enlightenment. Time to go.

text: Novar said he'd be waiting outside the Tower of Enlightenment. I should go meet him now.
zh_text: 我记得东方曜说过，会在通天塔前等我。现在就去找他吧。
source_text: 我记得东方曜说过，会在通天塔前等我。现在就去找他吧。
official_target_text: Novar said he'd wait for me at the Tower of Enlightenment. Time to go.
official_en_text: Novar said he'd wait for me at the Tower of Enlightenment. Time to go.

text: Finally, the Enlightenment Trials are about to begin.
zh_text: 归虚梦演终于要开始了。
source_text: 归虚梦演终于要开始了。
official_target_text: The Enlightenment Trials are about to begin.
official_en_text: The Enlightenment Trials are about to begin.

text: Finally, the Enlightenment Trials are about to begin.
zh_text: 归虚梦演终于要开始了。
source_text: 归虚梦演终于要开始了。
official_target_text: The Enlightenment Trials are about to begin.
official_en_text: The Enlightenment Trials are about to begin.

text: Welcome, dear students. The Grand Ceremony begins now.
zh_text: 各位学子久等，归虚大典今日开幕。
source_text: 各位学子久等，归虚大典今日开幕。
official_target_text: Dear disciples, the Grand Ceremony begins.
official_en_text: Dear disciples, the Grand Ceremony begins.

text: As per tradition, we shall announce the rules of the Enlightenment trials.
zh_text: 按照以往惯例，将由三位院长宣讲赛制。
source_text: 按照以往惯例，将由三位院长宣讲赛制。
official_target_text: Following tradition, the three headmasters will introduce the competition rules.
official_en_text: Following tradition, the three headmasters will introduce the competition rules.

text: Heaven, earth—all things are one. When the dream reaches its end, your real journey shall begin.
zh_text: 天地并生，万物为一。归虚之梦，由此而起。
source_text: 天地并生，万物为一。归虚之梦，由此而起。
official_target_text: The heavens and earth coexist, and all things are one. From here arises the Dream of Emptiness.
official_en_text: The heavens and earth coexist, and all things are one. From here arises the Dream of Emptiness.

text: The truth is what you make of it. That has been our academy motto for ages.
zh_text: “自己告诉自己真理”，是稷下传承至今的校训。
source_text: “自己告诉自己真理”，是稷下传承至今的校训。
official_target_text: “‘Tell yourself the truth’ is the school motto that has been passed down in Jixia to this day.
official_en_text: “‘Tell yourself the truth’ is the school motto that has been passed down in Jixia to this day.

text: Again, the team that wins the championship will earn the right to consult the Aercocoon.
zh_text: 在试炼中证明自身，赢得比赛的冠军队伍，便可获得云蚕参悟的机会。
source_text: 在试炼中证明自身，赢得比赛的冠军队伍，便可获得云蚕参悟的机会。
official_target_text: Prove yourself in the trials. The champion team will earn the chance to learn from Aercocoon.
official_en_text: Prove yourself in the trials. The champion team will earn the chance to learn from Aercocoon.

text: The trials this year consist of three rounds: "Body," "Heart," and "Team Work."
zh_text: 今年的试炼仍然为“身”、“心”、“众”三场。
source_text: 今年的试炼仍然为“身”、“心”、“众”三场。
official_target_text: This year's trial still consists of three rounds: physical, mental, and team.
official_en_text: This year's trial still consists of three rounds: physical, mental, and team.

text: After that, only one can stand before the Wonder.
zh_text: 三场试炼后，只有一支队伍可以面见奇迹。
source_text: 三场试炼后，只有一支队伍可以面见奇迹。
official_target_text: After three trials, only one team can meet the miracle.
official_en_text: After three trials, only one team can meet the miracle.

text: We hope the Enlightenment Trials can serve as an inspiration. To guide you to your own truths.
zh_text: 而归虚梦演的意义，便是为了勉励诸位不断修炼，领悟真理。
source_text: 而归虚梦演的意义，便是为了勉励诸位不断修炼，领悟真理。
official_target_text: The Enlightenment Trials are designed to motivate you to keep training and understand the truth.
official_en_text: The Enlightenment Trials are designed to motivate you to keep training and understand the truth.

text: I hereby declare the Enlightenment Trials have officially begun!
zh_text: 今稷下学子齐聚，老夫宣布，归虚梦演正式开始。
source_text: 今稷下学子齐聚，老夫宣布，归虚梦演正式开始。
official_target_text: Disciples of Jixia, you have all gathered here today. Without further ado, I hereby declare the Enlightenment Trials officially open.
official_en_text: Disciples of Jixia, you have all gathered here today. Without further ado, I hereby declare the Enlightenment Trials officially open.

text: Now, let's give a warm welcome to this year's special guests—the Chang'an Envoys!
zh_text: 接下来，让我们有请本届的嘉宾——长安使团！
source_text: 接下来，让我们有请本届的嘉宾——长安使团！
official_target_text: Now please welcome our special guests—the Chang'an Envoys!
official_en_text: Now please welcome our special guests—the Chang'an Envoys!

text: Why didn't you tell me Li Bai was coming, Shye? I could've gotten a much closer look.
zh_text: 说起来，这次的嘉宾竟然有李白，西施你怎么不早说？待会我一定要去……
source_text: 说起来，这次的嘉宾竟然有李白，西施你怎么不早说？待会我一定要去……
official_target_text: Li Bai is going to be there? Why didn't you tell me earlier, Shye? I must meet him...
official_en_text: Li Bai is going to be there? Why didn't you tell me earlier, Shye? I must meet him...

text: Right... so, what do we know about Dragon's Graveyard?
zh_text: 哦……对。关于这个龙殇地，大家都了解吗？
source_text: 哦……对。关于这个龙殇地，大家都了解吗？
official_target_text: Oh... right. Does anyone know about this Dragon's Graveyard?
official_en_text: Oh... right. Does anyone know about this Dragon's Graveyard?

official_target_text: I'm the only one who can compete...
official_en_text: I'm the only one who can compete...

official_target_text: I'm the only one who can compete...
official_en_text: I'm the only one who can compete...

text: Rumor has it the place is filled with intricate Mechcrafts and fierce beasts... sounds like a treacherous place to me.
zh_text: 据说，龙殇地中遍布着奇特的机关，周围又有凶狠的野兽……总之是个很危险的地方。
source_text: 据说，龙殇地中遍布着奇特的机关，周围又有凶狠的野兽……总之是个很危险的地方。
official_target_text: They say Dragon's Graveyard is full of strange Mechcrafts, and the area is guarded by ferocious beasts. A dangerous place.
official_en_text: They say Dragon's Graveyard is full of strange Mechcrafts, and the area is guarded by ferocious beasts. A dangerous place.

text: The location of the first trial has been revealed.
zh_text: 看来，你们都已经知道试炼地点了。
source_text: 看来，你们都已经知道试炼地点了。
official_target_text: I see you've found the trial location.
official_en_text: I see you've found the trial location.

text: You should focus on the trial, Captain!
zh_text: 你还是好好担心下试炼的事吧，队、长！
source_text: 你还是好好担心下试炼的事吧，队、长！

text: Heh! That's what makes it fun!
official_target_text: Come on! It's more fun this way!
official_en_text: Come on! It's more fun this way!

text: As you must have noticed, one member from each team has received the "golden characters." Only they can participate in the trial.
zh_text: 更重要的是，每组队伍中，只有拿到“金字”的同学才能参加试炼。
source_text: 更重要的是，每组队伍中，只有拿到“金字”的同学才能参加试炼。
official_target_text: More importantly, only students with a "Golden Promise" in each team can participate in the trial.
official_en_text: More importantly, only students with a "Golden Promise" in each team can participate in the trial.

text: What the... Three months spent upgrading my Apocalyptor, and I'm supposed to what? Sit on the bench!?
zh_text: 怎么回事！我可是花了足足三个月来改造浑天，好歹让我开一炮啊！
source_text: 怎么回事！我可是花了足足三个月来改造浑天，好歹让我开一炮啊！
official_target_text: Hey! I spent three months modifying my Apocalyptor! At least let me fire it once!
official_en_text: Hey! I spent three months modifying my Apocalyptor! At least let me fire it once!

text: It's an ancient ruin with few visitors lately, and... that's all.
zh_text: 那是一片古老的遗迹，平时很少有人靠近，我不太清楚。
source_text: 那是一片古老的遗迹，平时很少有人靠近，我不太清楚。
official_target_text: It's an ancient ruin, not many people go there. I'm not sure about the details.
official_en_text: It's an ancient ruin, not many people go there. I'm not sure about the details.

text: After all, the ability to deal with the unexpected is itself part of the test.
zh_text: 能应付意料之外的状况，何尝不是试炼的一环呢？
source_text: 能应付意料之外的状况，何尝不是试炼的一环呢？
official_target_text: The trial is meant to test your ability to handle the unexpected.
official_en_text: The trial is meant to test your ability to handle the unexpected.

text: Are you willing to trust your friend and place the team's fate in their hands?
zh_text: 未能参赛的同学，你们是否愿意相信队友，将队伍的命运交到他手中？
source_text: 未能参赛的同学，你们是否愿意相信队友，将队伍的命运交到他手中？
official_target_text: And those who can't participate, will you trust your teammates and place the team's fate in their hands?
official_en_text: And those who can't participate, will you trust your teammates and place the team's fate in their hands?

text: And the ones selected—are you truly ready to carry the team to victory without your teammates' support?
zh_text: 参赛的选手们，你们又是否有信心和觉悟，在无法得到队友帮助的前提下，拿到胜利？
source_text: 参赛的选手们，你们又是否有信心和觉悟，在无法得到队友帮助的前提下，拿到胜利？
official_target_text: Contestants, do you have the confidence and determination to win without your teammates' help?
official_en_text: Contestants, do you have the confidence and determination to win without your teammates' help?

text: Okay, everyone. There's one last thing before you go.
zh_text: 好了，大家稍安勿躁，老夫还有几句话要讲。
source_text: 好了，大家稍安勿躁，老夫还有几句话要讲。
official_target_text: Everyone, please calm down. I have a few more words to say.
official_en_text: Everyone, please calm down. I have a few more words to say.

text: Captain says we're willing to share what we know—but first, have you seen a girl with bunny ears?
zh_text: 队长说，想打探情报可以，但你要先说，有没有看到一个兔耳少女？
source_text: 队长说，想打探情报可以，但你要先说，有没有看到一个兔耳少女？
official_target_text: Captain said if you want info, you must first tell us, have you seen a girl with bunny ears?
official_en_text: Captain said if you want info, you must first tell us, have you seen a girl with bunny ears?

text: Bunny ears? Don't think I have...
official_target_text: A girl with bunny ears? Never seen her.
official_en_text: A girl with bunny ears? Never seen her.

official_target_text: Captain, he says he hasn't seen it.
official_en_text: Captain, he says he hasn't seen it.

official_target_text: Then there's nothing left to discuss.
official_en_text: Then there's nothing left to discuss.

text: I know what she said. I'm standing right here, man!
zh_text: 不是，我本人就在她面前啊，为什么还要你传话啊？
source_text: 不是，我本人就在她面前啊，为什么还要你传话啊？
official_target_text: No, I'm right here in front of her. Why do you need to pass on a message?
official_en_text: No, I'm right here in front of her. Why do you need to pass on a message?

text: Yeah, but Captain can't be bothered talking to someone below her.
zh_text: 这个我知道，因为队长不想和手下败将说话。
source_text: 这个我知道，因为队长不想和手下败将说话。
official_target_text: I get it. The captain doesn't want to talk to a loser.
official_en_text: I get it. The captain doesn't want to talk to a loser.

text: Excuse me!? The Power Rankings means nothing. We'll win the Enlightenment Trials right in your face!
zh_text: 哼，伯仲榜的名次不算什么，你们等着看归虚梦演的结果吧！
source_text: 哼，伯仲榜的名次不算什么，你们等着看归虚梦演的结果吧！
official_target_text: Rankings don't matter. Wait and see who wins the Enlightenment Trials!
official_en_text: Rankings don't matter. Wait and see who wins the Enlightenment Trials!

zh_text: 好了，这下大家都到齐了。
source_text: 好了，这下大家都到齐了。
official_target_text: Alright, now that we're all here—
official_en_text: Alright, now that we're all here—

text: Ahem, As the captain of Team of Stars, I'd like to say a few words before we go in—
zh_text: 咳咳，归虚梦演马上就要开始了，作为星之队的队长，我来简单说两句——
source_text: 咳咳，归虚梦演马上就要开始了，作为星之队的队长，我来简单说两句——
official_target_text: Ahem. The Enlightenment Trials is about to begin. As captain of the Team of Stars, I'd like to say a few words—
official_en_text: Ahem. The Enlightenment Trials is about to begin. As captain of the Team of Stars, I'd like to say a few words—

text: Alright, well said. Let's go now.
zh_text: 听完了，说得挺好，我们走吧。
source_text: 听完了，说得挺好，我们走吧。

text: Hey! I stayed up all night working on this speech!
zh_text: 哎呀，为了给大家加油打气，我想这段队长发言一直想到了凌晨呢！
source_text: 哎呀，为了给大家加油打气，我想这段队长发言一直想到了凌晨呢！
official_target_text: Ah, I stayed up all night thinking about this captain's speech to cheer everyone up!
official_en_text: Ah, I stayed up all night thinking about this captain's speech to cheer everyone up!

zh_text: 我还想去秘密基地看风景呢。
source_text: 我还想去秘密基地看风景呢。
official_target_text: I still want to see the view from the secret base.
official_en_text: I still want to see the view from the secret base.

text: Woah, someone's being sentimental... But you're right, we'll make it happen as a team!
zh_text: 干嘛突然煽情，让人怪不好意思的……总之，一起朝着冠军进发吧！
source_text: 干嘛突然煽情，让人怪不好意思的……总之，一起朝着冠军进发吧！
official_target_text: Stop that, it's embarrassing... Let's just aim for the championship!
official_en_text: Stop that, it's embarrassing... Let's just aim for the championship!

text: Indeed! And if you're thinking about quitting, please don't! You're an important member of our team now!
zh_text: 不行，这退队申请，本队长可不批！你已经是星之队的一员了，要想离开可没那么容易！
source_text: 不行，这退队申请，本队长可不批！你已经是星之队的一员了，要想离开可没那么容易！
official_target_text: No! I won't approve this! You're a member of the Team of Stars now, and leaving won't be that easy!
official_en_text: No! I won't approve this! You're a member of the Team of Stars now, and leaving won't be that easy!

text: The rules for this year will be announced at the Grand Ceremony.
zh_text: 而今年具体的规则，要在归虚大典上才会揭晓。
source_text: 而今年具体的规则，要在归虚大典上才会揭晓。
official_target_text: The rules for this year will be revealed during the Grand Ceremony.
official_en_text: The rules for this year will be revealed during the Grand Ceremony.

text: Well, just another typical day of the great Team of Stars.
zh_text: 哎，摊上我们这群不省心的队友，看来麻烦事不会少啊。
source_text: 哎，摊上我们这群不省心的队友，看来麻烦事不会少啊。
official_target_text: Ugh, with teammates like them, trouble's never far away.
official_en_text: Ugh, with teammates like them, trouble's never far away.

text: Who wants to hear it anyway...
zh_text: 谁要听你的长篇大论啊……
source_text: 谁要听你的长篇大论啊……
official_target_text: Who wants to hear your long-winded lectures...
official_en_text: Who wants to hear your long-winded lectures...

text: Come on, I'm just trying to bring the team together! So that we can work as one if I, uh, anyone, fails to deliver.
zh_text: “麻烦”？大家都是自己人，就算我真惹出什么事，肯定也是有福同享，有难同当啊。
source_text: “麻烦”？大家都是自己人，就算我真惹出什么事，肯定也是有福同享，有难同当啊。
official_target_text: “Trouble”? We’re all friends here. Even if I really did stir up some trouble, we’d surely share the blessings and the burdens together.
official_en_text: “Trouble”? We’re all friends here. Even if I really did stir up some trouble, we’d surely share the blessings and the burdens together.

text: Oh, don't listen to that... We are going to deliver.
zh_text: 哎，他胡说的……大家不会惹麻烦。
source_text: 哎，他胡说的……大家不会惹麻烦。
official_target_text: He's just talking nonsense... We won't cause any trouble.
official_en_text: He's just talking nonsense... We won't cause any trouble.

text: Hey, you're not getting cold feet, are you? I-I assure you we can be counted on.
zh_text: 哎……你想做什么？虽然他这人是有点不靠谱，但你不准退队。
source_text: 哎……你想做什么？虽然他这人是有点不靠谱，但你不准退队。
official_target_text: Hey... what's on your mind? Sure, he's a bit unreliable, but you can't quit the team.
official_en_text: Hey... what's on your mind? Sure, he's a bit unreliable, but you can't quit the team.

zh_text: 喂，你们别表现得像邪恶组织啊……
source_text: 喂，你们别表现得像邪恶组织啊……
official_target_text: Hey, stop acting like an evil organization...
official_en_text: Hey, stop acting like an evil organization...

text: What I want to say is we're in this together... because...
zh_text: 我是想说，事已至此，我们也只能有难同当了，因为……
source_text: 我是想说，事已至此，我们也只能有难同当了，因为……
official_target_text: What I'm trying to say is, at this point, we'll just have to face it together, because...
official_en_text: What I'm trying to say is, at this point, we'll just have to face it together, because...

text: What I want to say is we're in this together... because...
zh_text: 我是想说，事已至此，我们也只能有难同当了，因为……
source_text: 我是想说，事已至此，我们也只能有难同当了，因为……
official_target_text: What I'm trying to say is, at this point, we'll just have to face it together, because...
official_en_text: What I'm trying to say is, at this point, we'll just have to face it together, because...

text: I feel really lucky to be part of the team. Let's win the competition together!
zh_text: 很高兴能成为大家的队友，以后也一起加油吧。
source_text: 很高兴能成为大家的队友，以后也一起加油吧。
official_target_text: I'm glad to be part of the team. Let's keep pushing forward together!
official_en_text: I'm glad to be part of the team. Let's keep pushing forward together!

text: I feel really lucky to be part of the team. Let's win the competition together!
zh_text: 很高兴能成为大家的队友，以后也一起加油吧。
source_text: 很高兴能成为大家的队友，以后也一起加油吧。
official_target_text: I'm glad to be part of the team. Let's keep pushing forward together!
official_en_text: I'm glad to be part of the team. Let's keep pushing forward together!

text: Retrieving wooden plaques from flying Mechcrafts, passing through the maze in Dreamweave Plains...
zh_text: 比如从鹊小七身上夺取木牌，寻找织梦原森林迷宫的出口……
source_text: 比如从鹊小七身上夺取木牌，寻找织梦原森林迷宫的出口……
official_target_text: For example, snatch the wooden plaque from July, find the exit of the Dreamweave Plains forest maze...
official_en_text: For example, snatch the wooden plaque from July, find the exit of the Dreamweave Plains forest maze...

text: Oh, yes, the Grand Ceremony... I can't wait to see the opening performance. Doesn't get any more excited than that, you know!?
zh_text: 说到归虚大典，我最期待这开幕表演。可以说是除了比赛之外最激动人心的环节了。
source_text: 说到归虚大典，我最期待这开幕表演。可以说是除了比赛之外最激动人心的环节了。
official_target_text: Speaking of the Grand Ceremony, I'm most looking forward to the opening performance. It's the most exciting part aside from the competition itself.
official_en_text: Speaking of the Grand Ceremony, I'm most looking forward to the opening performance. It's the most exciting part aside from the competition itself.

text: I... I'd love to watch a dozen Mozi models demonstrate the new combat formations...
zh_text: 那……我更想看十八个墨子老师一起演示新兵法……
source_text: 那……我更想看十八个墨子老师一起演示新兵法……
official_target_text: Then I'd rather see eighteen Master Mos giving a joint lecture on new tactics...
official_en_text: Then I'd rather see eighteen Master Mos giving a joint lecture on new tactics...

text: It's almost time. Let's go in and see for ourselves!
zh_text: 时间快到了，走吧，去看看今天的表演到底有多精彩！
source_text: 时间快到了，走吧，去看看今天的表演到底有多精彩！
official_target_text: It's about time. Let's go and see how amazing today's performance will be!
official_en_text: It's about time. Let's go and see how amazing today's performance will be!

text: Speaking of, I wonder what the rules will be this year.
zh_text: 不过，还不知道这次试炼的规则是什么。
source_text: 不过，还不知道这次试炼的规则是什么。
official_target_text: But I don't know the rules of this trial yet.
official_en_text: But I don't know the rules of this trial yet.

text: But... haven't you done this before?
zh_text: 规则难道还没有确定吗？
source_text: 规则难道还没有确定吗？

text: But... haven't you done this before?
zh_text: 规则难道还没有确定吗？
source_text: 规则难道还没有确定吗？

text: The Mechcraft Kite fireworks show last time—truly spectacular.
zh_text: 我记得上次是机关学院编排的机关鸢烟花秀，啧啧，那排场可不得了。
source_text: 我记得上次是机关学院编排的机关鸢烟花秀，啧啧，那排场可不得了。
official_target_text: The last fireworks show was arranged by the School of Mechcraft. It was spectacular.
official_en_text: The last fireworks show was arranged by the School of Mechcraft. It was spectacular.

text: This year, our School of Martial Arts will take the stage. Imagine some showstopper moves from Fuzi himself!
zh_text: 今年轮到武道学院负责了，会不会是夫子亲自上场，表演一个徒手劈山？
source_text: 今年轮到武道学院负责了，会不会是夫子亲自上场，表演一个徒手劈山？
official_target_text: This year, it's the School of Martial Arts' turn. Could it be Master Fuzi himself, splitting mountains bare-handed?
official_en_text: This year, it's the School of Martial Arts' turn. Could it be Master Fuzi himself, splitting mountains bare-handed?

text: I just got the team badge.
zh_text: 我可是有星之队队徽的人。
source_text: 我可是有星之队队徽的人。
official_target_text: I'm a member of the Team of Stars.
official_en_text: I'm a member of the Team of Stars.

official_target_text: Look! It's the Team of Stars!
official_en_text: Look! It's the Team of Stars!

text: Can't wait to see the defending champs in action!
zh_text: 上一届的冠军诶，好期待他们的表现！
source_text: 上一届的冠军诶，好期待他们的表现！
official_target_text: Ooh, the defending champions! I'm so excited!
official_en_text: Ooh, the defending champions! I'm so excited!

text: Is that the new member of the Team of Stars?
zh_text: 这就是星之队的新成员吗？
source_text: 这就是星之队的新成员吗？
official_target_text: So you are the new member of the Team of Stars?
official_en_text: So you are the new member of the Team of Stars?

text: Against the edge of a spear, the only way to live is the way forward.
zh_text: 长戈之敌，锋芒难避。需谨记，进则生，退则死。
source_text: 长戈之敌，锋芒难避。需谨记，进则生，退则死。
official_target_text: The enemy of the long halberd cannot be avoided. Remember, advance to live, retreat to die.
official_en_text: The enemy of the long halberd cannot be avoided. Remember, advance to live, retreat to die.

text: To become a Sanctified, one must possess the strength to shatter the defense of all enemies.
zh_text: 神铸者，当掌握制敌之法，破军之力，方可成为护世之强者。
source_text: 神铸者，当掌握制敌之法，破军之力，方可成为护世之强者。
official_target_text: The Sanctified must master the arts of controlling the enemy and possessing the strength to break the enemy's formation, only then can you become a guardian of the world.
official_en_text: The Sanctified must master the arts of controlling the enemy and possessing the strength to break the enemy's formation, only then can you become a guardian of the world.

text: This Sentinel is so tough to handle...
official_target_text: This Sentinel is way too hard to handle...
official_en_text: This Sentinel is way too hard to handle...

text: This Sentinel is so tough to handle...
official_target_text: This Sentinel is way too hard to handle...
official_en_text: This Sentinel is way too hard to handle...

text: Swift yet lethal, the "Ripper" can strike in a split second.
zh_text: 影刃之敌，身法灵活，夺命于呼吸之间。
source_text: 影刃之敌，身法灵活，夺命于呼吸之间。
official_target_text: Enemies of the Shadow Ripper, agile and deadly, taking lives in the blink of an eye.
official_en_text: Enemies of the Shadow Ripper, agile and deadly, taking lives in the blink of an eye.

text: Two against one is just unfair...
official_target_text: Two against one? That's just cheating...
official_en_text: Two against one? That's just cheating...

text: Two against one is just unfair...
official_target_text: Two against one? That's just cheating...
official_en_text: Two against one? That's just cheating...

text: Only by defeating the Sentinels can you rise as a Sanctified.
zh_text: 唯有击败铸灵者，才可获得神铸之资。
source_text: 唯有击败铸灵者，才可获得神铸之资。
official_target_text: Only by defeating the Sentinels can one obtain the Sanctified Essence.
official_en_text: Only by defeating the Sentinels can one obtain the Sanctified Essence.

text: Maintain composure, seize the initiative—or be at your enemies' mercy.
zh_text: 若自乱阵脚，不能洞察先机，定会受制于人。
source_text: 若自乱阵脚，不能洞察先机，定会受制于人。
official_target_text: If you're disorganized and can't anticipate opportunities, you'll be at the mercy of others.
official_en_text: If you're disorganized and can't anticipate opportunities, you'll be at the mercy of others.

text: The arts of Sorcery are about being deceptive and unpredictable.
Welcome to the Enlightenment Trials, dear student.
zh_text: 欢迎你，参加试炼的学子。
source_text: 欢迎你，参加试炼的学子。

text: Welcome to the Enlightenment Trials, dear student.
zh_text: 欢迎你，参加试炼的学子。
source_text: 欢迎你，参加试炼的学子。

text: The three trials are complete. You have achieved the goal of 'seeking within yourself'.
zh_text: 三场试炼已毕，你已经做到了“以身向内而求索”。
source_text: 三场试炼已毕，你已经做到了“以身向内而求索”。
official_target_text: The three trials are complete. You have achieved the goal of 'seeking within yourself'.
official_en_text: The three trials are complete. You have achieved the goal of 'seeking within yourself'.

text: ...I hear the cry of a Kun.
official_target_text: ...I hear the cry of a Kun.
official_en_text: ...I hear the cry of a Kun.

text: ...I hear the cry of a Kun.
official_target_text: ...I hear the cry of a Kun.
official_en_text: ...I hear the cry of a Kun.

text: There, its corolla! Slowing it down!
Pay attention to the signs before the vines emerge...
You wanna hurt my friends, you gotta get through my Apocalyptor first!
Keep your distance, or you'll be exposed to the mist!
Watch your steps! Don't let it hit you!
A trapped Herbalist suggests you use Blaze Fruits to quickly burn away the Toxic Bubble Sprouts.
Are you hurt? You can head to the Shennong Hall for shelter.
Are you hurt? You can head to the Shennong Hall for shelter.
No, I'm not going anywhere! I'm this close to verify my theory! I can't just walk away now!
I think I've figured out a way to clear the mist efficiently!

Vlinder broke Novar's record? It's only getting more interesting from here... I need to hurry!
Actually yeah. I need a hit story ASAP, or else...
Ahem. Chase, column writer for the Secrets Club! How can I help you?
Are you all so stressed out at the Secrets Club?
Are you all so stressed out at the Secrets Club?
W-what? No, not at all! I can write a hit story within minutes!
So we've all been invited to the Harvest Festival...
zh_text: 原来，大家收到丰云庆典的邀请了啊……
source_text: 原来，大家收到丰云庆典的邀请了啊……

zh_text: 这可是稷下一年一度的大活动，当然要来了。
source_text: 这可是稷下一年一度的大活动，当然要来了。

zh_text: 星之队每年都会来织梦原参加丰云庆典，今年正赶上举办归虚梦演，可以顺便放松下紧绷的神经了。

official_target_text: The Team of Stars visits Dreamweave Plains every year for the Harvest Festival. This year, with the Enlightenment Trials taking place, it's a good opportunity to relax.
official_en_text: The Team of Stars visits Dreamweave Plains every year for the Harvest Festival. This year, with the Enlightenment Trials taking place, it's a good opportunity to relax.

text: Look like there's a lot to do here. Any recommendations?
zh_text: 庆典……听起来有不少活动啊，有推荐的吗？
source_text: 庆典……听起来有不少活动啊，有推荐的吗？
official_target_text: That sounds like a lot of fun. Any recommendation?
official_en_text: That sounds like a lot of fun. Any recommendation?

text: The Harvest Festival is meant to celebrate the Societies' efforts in saving the local people from a great calamity. Therefore, all activities are related to them, and the most popular one is...
zh_text: 丰云庆典是为纪念曾在灾难中拯救了丰云野的百家门人，每年活动花样不同，但往往都与百家有关，其中最受欢迎的应该是……
source_text: 丰云庆典是为纪念曾在灾难中拯救了丰云野的百家门人，每年活动花样不同，但往往都与百家有关，其中最受欢迎的应该是……
official_target_text: The Harvest Festival honors the Society members who saved Harvest Fields from disaster. Each year's event is different but always involves the Society. The most popular one is...
official_en_text: The Harvest Festival honors the Society members who saved Harvest Fields from disaster. Each year's event is different but always involves the Society. The most popular one is...

text: What exactly are all those activities?
What exactly are all those activities?
You know what? Let's split up, and you can see for yourself!
zh_text: 没事，等下咱们分头各自逛，你挨个体验体验就知道了。
source_text: 没事，等下咱们分头各自逛，你挨个体验体验就知道了。
official_target_text: Don't worry. We'll split up later. Just try each one yourself, and you'll see.
official_en_text: Don't worry. We'll split up later. Just try each one yourself, and you'll see.

text: Suit yourself, but remember to attend the bell-ringing ceremony together!
zh_text: 哎，别的可以各自玩，但敲钟仪式得一起参加，这可是咱们星之队的传统。
source_text: 哎，别的可以各自玩，但敲钟仪式得一起参加，这可是咱们星之队的传统。
official_target_text: You can wander off on your own, but we need to participate in the bell-ringing ceremony together. It's a tradition of our Team of Stars.
official_en_text: You can wander off on your own, but we need to participate in the bell-ringing ceremony together. It's a tradition of our Team of Stars.

text: You bet we will. Oh, shoot—almost forget to pick up the event specialties for Luban. Time to go now, Sun Bin!
zh_text: 放心吧……糟了，还要帮班叔买今年的庆典特产。孙膑，快走，去晚了可能要排队！
source_text: 放心吧……糟了，还要帮班叔买今年的庆典特产。孙膑，快走，去晚了可能要排队！
official_target_text: Don't worry... Oh, I almost forgot. We need to get Mr. Luban's festival souvenirs. Sun Bin, let's go before there's a line!
official_en_text: Don't worry... Oh, I almost forgot. We need to get Mr. Luban's festival souvenirs. Sun Bin, let's go before there's a line!

text: Oh, okay, see you later then! Meng Ya, wait...
zh_text: 那一会儿庆典里见！蒙犽，等等我……
source_text: 那一会儿庆典里见！蒙犽，等等我……
official_target_text: See you at the celebration! Meng Ya, wait up...
official_en_text: See you at the celebration! Meng Ya, wait up...

text: Huh, that guy. Well, guess I'd better head to the Herbal Faceoff now.
zh_text: 哎呀，真拿蒙犽没办法。那不如我就也……先去斗百草啦？
source_text: 哎呀，真拿蒙犽没办法。那不如我就也……先去斗百草啦？
official_target_text: Ugh, I can't do anything about Meng Ya. Guess I'll go see how the herb competition is doing.
official_en_text: Ugh, I can't do anything about Meng Ya. Guess I'll go see how the herb competition is doing.

text: Hehe, Shye's a better guide than me! Besides, I've got some records to beat...
zh_text: 啊哈哈……不如让更优秀的向导西施来给你介绍吧？那斗百草的最高记录还等着我去打破呢……
source_text: 啊哈哈……不如让更优秀的向导西施来给你介绍吧？那斗百草的最高记录还等着我去打破呢……
official_target_text: Haha... perhaps the better guide Shye can fill you in on the details? Meanwhile, I've still got that Herbal Face-Off record to break...
official_en_text: Haha... perhaps the better guide Shye can fill you in on the details? Meanwhile, I've still got that Herbal Face-Off record to break...

zh_text: 你就留我自己参加活动？
source_text: 你就留我自己参加活动？

text: Well... we all know Shye's a better guide than me! Besides, I've got some records to beat.
zh_text: 呃，这不还有西施嘛！论向导，她可比我称职。而且……斗百草的最高记录还等着我去打破呢。
source_text: 呃，这不还有西施嘛！论向导，她可比我称职。而且……斗百草的最高记录还等着我去打破呢。
official_target_text: Hey, Shye's here now! She'll make a much better guide. Besides... I've still got that Herbal Face-Off record to break.
official_en_text: Hey, Shye's here now! She'll make a much better guide. Besides... I've still got that Herbal Face-Off record to break.

text: Every year it's the same. The moment we get here, those boys just disappear. Anyway, I'll show you around.
zh_text: 每年都这样，说着一起逛庆典，结果一玩起来就忘了……哎呀，不管他们了，我来带你。
source_text: 每年都这样，说着一起逛庆典，结果一玩起来就忘了……哎呀，不管他们了，我来带你。
official_target_text: We say that every year, but somehow we always end up forgetting... Ugh, whatever. I'll show you around.
official_en_text: We say that every year, but somehow we always end up forgetting... Ugh, whatever. I'll show you around.

text: Shye's Exclusive Harvest Festival Day Tour! Don't miss out!
zh_text: 咳咳，“西施甄选丰云庆典一日游”，走过路过不能错过喔。
source_text: 咳咳，“西施甄选丰云庆典一日游”，走过路过不能错过喔。
official_target_text: Ahem. "Shye's Harvest Festival One-Day Tour." Don't miss out!
official_en_text: Ahem. "Shye's Harvest Festival One-Day Tour." Don't miss out!

text: The Harvest Bazaar is just across this field of Foxtail Wheat.
It's a local specialty! The folks here use it to make amazing food and drinks.
They're all available at the bazaar during the festival. We can grab some if you like.
The Aero Irrigators float so high in the air. How did they even come up with the idea of hanging onto one...
The Aero Irrigators float so high in the air. How did they even come up with the idea of hanging onto one...
Haha, have you met them? I wouldn't be surprised at anything.
Now since it can only carry one person at a time—how about you ride it first, and we'll meet up at the village entrance?
But I've never done this before...
It's easy. Just lock the grappler in place and hold on tight to the bar!
While you're on it, don't forget to enjoy the view! Go on now!
I'll find another one in the fields. Remember, just lock the grappler in place and hold on tight to the bar.
No need to be afraid. It'll be a special sightseeing ride!
Alright, I'll give it a try...
Alright, I'll give it a try...
I've never seen anything like this before...
I've never seen anything like this before...
It's beautiful... No wonder the Societies love this land so much...
It's beautiful... No wonder the Societies love this land so much...
I thought the festival was all about having fun... but that girl was in such a hurry.
If you saw how she was rushing things, you'd think we were at the Enlightenment Trials!
Anyway, I heard Chief Miaomiao set up something really interesting this year. It'll definitely be worth your while.
It's just about time to water the Foxtail Wheat. You might want to check <001>deep in the fields</>.
You'll see in a minute. Thanks, Fang Shan!
Shye! You're here for the bazaar too? Well, it's nothing really...
Vlinder was just asking about the Fish Talisman Hunt. We had nothing for her, so she just turned around and left...
Will do! By the way, do you know where we can find an <001>Aero Irrigator</> around here?
You'll find out in a moment. Brother Fang, thank you very much.
zh_text: 一会儿你就知道啦。方大哥，多谢你啦。
source_text: 一会儿你就知道啦。方大哥，多谢你啦。
official_target_text: You'll find out in a moment. Brother Fang, thank you very much.
official_en_text: You'll find out in a moment. Brother Fang, thank you very much.

text: What, you're leaving already...? I haven't finished...
It is her, and she seemed in a hurry... Let's ask what happened.
Wait till you're a bit older!
Wait till you're a bit older!
You hear that? You'll grow up before you know it.
That's what you said last year!
Look! That person's flying! I want to fly too!
I'm getting tired... Are we there yet?
I think we're close...? Just a little bit longer...
If there's a big crowd for the hunt, why don't we just go to the Herb Garden instead?
I do feel you, but... but we've skipped two events already!
Right, that's it for me. Off to stretch my legs at the bazaar.
All these people here for the festival... They're distracting me from my work!
Wait, why am I the only one still working?
Harvest Fields is right up ahead! Be careful!
The tower is way too tall, and Herbal Faceoff is way too intense...
Maybe the Fish Talisman Hunt is a better fit for me?
Huh? Is that a person up there in the sky?
That looks super dangerous... Forget it. I'm done!
A new stunt for this year's hunt, perhaps?
Accompanying line to the wheat field.
Aero Irrigators are a farming tool invented by the Crafters. We discovered by chance we could use them for a ride.
How did you figure that out...
How did you figure that out...
Once Novar and Meng Ya had a contest to see who could hang onto it longer...
Then the Aero Irrigator started moving, but neither of them wanted to lose...
And it carried them all the way to its base. The teacher there gave them a serious scolding.
They both said the other one fell first... so I guess it was a tie?
It's been a long time since I had such a wonderful day.
Would've been even better without that Herb Garden incident...
Would've been even better without that Herb Garden incident...
Well, things like that actually make moments like this all the more precious!
Hi there, Vlinder. Are you coming to ring the bell with us?
Hi there, Vlinder. Are you coming to ring the bell with us?
Appreciate the offer, but I'll pass.
I heard about what happened in the Herb Garden incident. Your team deserves this moment.
When the bell rings, it's a moment for everyone.
When the bell rings, it's a moment for everyone.
Fine. Considering how well you did today, whatever you say goes.
Don't flatter yourself. I didn't say that.
If you want to be as good as me... you do need more than today.
Alright, your friends are waiting for you over there. You should go.
Our team can't do without the two of us!
Not humble, Meng Ya, not humble!
Why are you only picking on me?! Keep talking and you'll know what my Apocalyptor can do!
You two are starting to sound more and more like Novar...
Why are you only picking on me?! Keep talking and you'll know what my Apocalyptor can do!
Actually, it was a team effort.
Actually, it was a team effort.
Humble big hero! No. 6 leading the way!
Trouble comes, hearts unite! Team of Stars, shining bright!
On my way, on my way!
The Herb Garden, stories tell! Team of Stars, ring the bell!
Hey, it's No. 6! Are you going to the ceremony?
Well, if it isn't the hero of the day!
Hello! Hello! No. 6 waiting for you!
Yes, yes, you are the last one.
You ring the Harvest Bell together with your teammates. The echoes carry far and wide into the distance...
Umm... and barns swell with grain!
The sound of the bell travels a thousand miles. Let's raise a glass—
The sound of the bell travels a thousand miles. Let's raise a glass—
Hehe, beat you to it this time!
You're finally here! Your teammates are making my ears explode...
You poor things... Now hurry up and ring the bell! We're all waiting for you!
Come on, get up here already!
Yeah, imagine having to listen to all that every day.
It's No. 6! Where are you going, No.6?
Miaomiao is not ringing the bell this year?
I heard she's letting the Team of Stars do it.
Hurry up! The bell-ringing ceremony is about to start!
The Harvest Bell is right there.
What blessings should we say again?
Chief Miaomiao's here... Are we late already?
Shye talks to you about how everyone may go their separate ways after the Enlightenment Trials. She feels grateful that you get to spend the rest of her school days together as friends.
Does take some getting used to...
We're all quite some character, right?
I have you and Novar guiding me.
Thanks, but don't tell Novar that—or he'll never let us hear the end of it.
Look at this place—so beautiful. All the people laughing and celebrating together...
Anyway, it's really good to see everyone unwind like this.
Okay, now let's get up there—those guys must be getting impatient.
Oh? Novar, is that you? I'm sure I just heard you talk.
I'm afraid... this might be the Team of Stars' last Enlightenment Trials.
Anyway, that's just my guess. We always know this day will come, but... let's just focus on right now.
I wish time could just stop right here, but we both know that won't happen. We all have our paths to take.
I just never expected I'd meet you before leaving here.
It's so strange that... from the moment I saw you, you felt familiar to me.
Ah, this journey has been so fun. It's really hard to let go when things are great, you know...
Sorry… got a bit sentimental there. I'm just glad you joined us, and I hope you find what you came for.
Maybe we really did meet before, in a... world that's been forgotten! Maybe I was always meant to be your guide!
Mr. Luban has been searching for No. 7 for a long time. And after the competition, he'll probably head off to somewhere farther.
Novar and Meng Ya have been training hard in every way they can. I believe they want to return to Yong someday and fight for their country...
Sun Bin will likely continue his research at the academy, while I... I've got a place I must return to and a promise I must keep.
We got to know each other because of the Enlightenment Trials. Perhaps it will also be the start of a new chapter in our lives...
And perhaps... it could be our chance to properly say goodbye.
Well, it's not every day our team gets to ring the bell.
Well, it's not every day our team gets to ring the bell.
Our team, huh? It's got a nice ring to it.
No. 6 is here! No. 6 complete the mission!
Sorry to keep you waiting. Where are the others?
Sorry to keep you waiting. Where are the others?
I just got here too. Those boys must have gone up already.
Of course we are. What I mean to say is, I'm happy we can do this together. As a team.
When Novar first invited you to our team, I was worried you might feel out of place with us.
But now it seems I was wrong.
Our Star Team... Oh my, that rolls off the tongue quite nicely.

source_text: “我们星之队”……哎呀，说得很顺口嘛。
