text: Hi, it's you. You saved my life...
How are you doing now? You seemed really scared earlier.
How are you doing now? You seemed really scared earlier.
Honestly, I don't know what would've happened if you hadn't come...
Yes, I am—oh, am I holding you up? You should go and ring the bell!
While ringing the bell, all your teammates made wishes for you. Now that the festival is over, the Team of Stars sets off again for the Enlightenment Trials!
Come on, after you made such a wonderful festival happen, it's the least we can do.
Don't see you guys talking so much when it comes to schoolwork.
You're telling me! My cannons need some serious maintenance—
Yeah. So wonderful fighting Toxic Bubble Sprouts with you, huh, Captain?
When we rang the bell just now, did you make a wish?
Shh, keep it to yourself! It won't come true if you say it out loud.
We're allowed to enjoy ourselves, right? Okay, it's been a long day—we should get back for some proper rest!
Don't we need to drop Mr. Luban's stuff at the express delivery?
Ahead of you on that—I've sent everything back already. Now, shall we go?
I, uh... I made a wish for you...
Rare for me and Novar to be on the same page.
Count me in too—That makes five wishes for you now, right?
It's okay, because... I made a wish for you.
Rare for me and Novar to be on the same page.
See? That's the power of a team. Including mine, that makes four wishes for you, right?
You're blaming me? I heard about your little "Croaky" time at the Cloudreach Tower!
I still have one bottle of Lightness Potion left. You'd better watch what you eat for the next few days!
Hey! I never thought you were from the Team of Stars!
It's you... Don't forget the promise you made earlier.
It's you... Don't forget the promise you made earlier.
I won't! Mr. Inkon's paintings will be taken good care of!
You know, that's really a wish come true...
There you are finally! Your friends have already gone up the mountain.
Great. We're waiting for you to ring the bell!
Get in line! We have rules to keep here.
The stall isn't far from the entrance. And make sure the artist is Inkon!
You find Meng Ya busy treating students accidentally turned into Croakies. He asks you to fetch the antidote from an Herbalist named Yuying.
What are you doing, Meng Ya?
What are you doing, Meng Ya?
Now that's the spirit! Come on, let's head to the tower. No way our team is losing to an outsider!
Though I bet there's a long queue at her door...
Seems like an emergency here. I'll leave you to it then...
Seems like an emergency here. I'll leave you to it then...
Well... I plan to challenge Vlinder's tower climb record, and Shye said I could use some advice from you.
Well... I plan to challenge Vlinder's tower climb record, and Shye said I could use some advice from you.
Did Vlinder provoke you into this?
Not really. Thought I'd benefit from a good run.
Not really. Thought I'd benefit from a good run.
I already gave him the antidote... It just isn't working yet.
How much potion did you take, man!?
Maybe you should stay for now?
But I already gave him the cure... It just isn't working yet.
How much potion did you take, man!?
Well... maybe I should keep an eye on him a bit longer. Could you help me fetch more antidotes?
Just go find an Herbalist named Yuying in a tent east of Cloudreach Tower. She's the head of the medical team.
No time to lose. I'm on my way.
No time to lose. I'm on my way.
Gosh, my hands are full and then some! All these student-turned-Croakies are waiting for their cure.
Quit croaking! You've had your antidote—just a minute and you'll be human again!
Yeah. Didn't I say these are student-turned-Croakies?
They took some sketchy "Lightness Potion" to climb faster... yet I doubt these new wings can let them fly.
Feeling rough, huh? Learned your lesson yet?
I should ask the Herbalist for the antidote...
I should ask the Herbalist for the antidote...
You're back already. Liu Lian didn't give you trouble, did he?
Just asked a few questions... but why do you ask?
Just asked a few questions... but why do you ask?
Believe me, I wasn't selling them for profit!
I... I'm a huge fan of his work. I wanted one more, but the stall owner wouldn't let me.
I... I swear! Here, take the antidote.
Remember to simmer it on low heat. The Herb Society expert emphasized that.
Hmm... I'll trust you this time. But I'll remember your face.
Hmm... I'll trust you this time. But I'll remember your face.
Don't worry, I'm fine. Now go find your friend.
Sun Bin learns from the notes there are hidden floating stairs on Cloudreach Tower that could make the climb easier.
You're back! Did you get the notes?
So those Crafters do keep notes of their work! I want a peek too.
Interesting... The notes mention floating stairs hidden around the tower.
Great! I'll go cheer you on later. See you at the tower!
Using them wisely can definitely make the climb easier. I'm sure Vlinder knew about this.
You bring the cure to Meng Ya, who tells you about concealed grappler points on Cloudreach Tower.
One thing to note is that it must be simmered over a low heat.
One thing to note is that it must be simmered over a low heat.
Alright, this medicine won't brew itself. See you at the tower!
You're back! Do you have the antidote?

It's alright, I'm just saying! One thing, though—don't forget to attend the bell-ringing ceremony later!

It's alright, I'm just saying! One thing, though—don't forget to attend the bell-ringing ceremony later!

text: One day, you will realize how lonely you are.
But together, we can overcome this nightmare called destiny.

You fall into the depths of your nightmare. Just as your consciousness fades, a mysterious voice wakes you from the dream. Following the calls of your friends, you grab the Team of Stars badge and awaken.

The man shows you a vision of the world's annihilation, claiming only he can save you from this preordained doom. To prove his point, he recreates your biggest "Nightmare"—one you cannot possibly defeat...
Don't you get it? This is the fate she's planned for you. A future doomed to annihilation.
Only by following my guidance can you escape this nightmare.
If you still don't believe me, then... you'll learn the hard way.

The man shows you a vision of the world's annihilation, claiming only he can save you from this preordained doom. To prove his point, he recreates your biggest "Nightmare"—one you cannot possibly defeat...

Just when you think it's all over, the man in black reappears. He is curious about where your determination comes from—is it the Star Team? But this struggle is meaningless; you will only drag them all into eternal doom. He strips the Star Team's flow from your bracelet, and the nightmare you just defeated absorbs it, reborn before your eyes.

You struggle in despair, but the Star Team's 'Flow' is touched by you, affecting the Nightmare and creating a opening for you. You reclaim the Star Team's 'Flow' with all your might, and with their help, you are about to defeat the Nightmare. The man in black is moved by your persistence and lets you consider whether to join him before pushing you out of the final layer of the dream.
They will never hear you again.
No... They're with me the whole time!
No... They're with me the whole time!
We will never let this happen!
We will never let this happen!

You struggle in despair, but the Star Team's 'Flow' is touched by you, affecting the Nightmare and creating a opening for you. You reclaim the Star Team's 'Flow' with all your might, and with their help, you are about to defeat the Nightmare. The man in black is moved by your persistence and lets you consider whether to join him before pushing you out of the final layer of the dream.
Yet this is far from over.
Do you really think you can fight it?
Our badge... I think this is it.
Our badge... I think this is it.
I should follow it and see where it leads.
I should follow it and see where it leads.
It turns into some kind of butterfly bridge... Will it take me to the treasure?
It turns into some kind of butterfly bridge... Will it take me to the treasure?
The same kind of glowing rocks here.
The same kind of glowing rocks here.
Looks like I have to <001>piece them together</> this time.
Looks like I have to <001>piece them together</> this time.
More glowing rocks. Guess that's another pattern to piece together.
More glowing rocks. Guess that's another pattern to piece together.
Maybe I need to <001>align their patterns</> to move forward?
Maybe I need to <001>align their patterns</> to move forward?
These glowing rocks...  They look like they're fragments of a whole.
These glowing rocks...  They look like they're fragments of a whole.
But... could it really be that easy?
But... could it really be that easy?
Is that our badge over there? Does that mean I can pass the trial?
Is that our badge over there? Does that mean I can pass the trial?
Is this one of the Dream Guidestones?
Is this one of the Dream Guidestones?
The challenge is over. I wonder where the butterfly will guide me next...
The challenge is over. I wonder where the butterfly will guide me next...
Looks like this is the last one.
Looks like this is the last one.
This doesn't seem to be over, though. I should keep going.
This doesn't seem to be over, though. I should keep going.
The butterfly is flying off that way. Time for a ride.
The butterfly is flying off that way. Time for a ride.
The patterns may line up from a different angle. Maybe I should move around a bit.
The patterns may line up from a different angle. Maybe I should move around a bit.
The butterfly points that way... Is that where our treasure is?
The butterfly points that way... Is that where our treasure is?
Anyway, I'll go down there and take a look.
Anyway, I'll go down there and take a look.
The Man in Black attempts to make you question your friendship with the Team of Stars by talking about the missing badge. He claims he's not your enemy and coaxes you into letting your guard down.
And why is that? Let me guess—
Because you're with Ziya, an enemy of the academy.
Such a naive way of thinking.
You just take the first thing you see as "justice" and become blinded by it.
Yet you never stop to ask whether your "enemy" is really what you imagine them to be.
I do know your schemes are putting people's lives in danger!
I do know your schemes are putting people's lives in danger!
Let's say that's true. How does that affect you, I wonder?
You refuse to trust me, simply because you believe I came with ill intent.
Didn't you come to Jixia to access the Wonder?
If I'm right, then... I have no intention of getting in your way.
In fact, I know how to help you do that sooner. Are you willing to become my friend now?
No. I already have friends I trust.
No. I already have friends I trust.
Wow... You really believe in them, don't you?
And you—do you really trust them as much as you say?
You are searching for your "treasure" in this Dreamscape. But the truth is, you can never find it.
You mean the badge that dissolved before you? If so, then why couldn't you hold on to it?
I did nothing. Its disappearance was merely a reflection of your true thoughts.
Deep down, you know exactly what I'm talking about.
I denied... the Team of Stars?
See? That wasn't so hard, was it?
Do you know what dreams really are?
They are a mirror. One that reveals your inner self.
Joy, fear... all your deepest emotions leave a trace here.
Dreams have a way of showing people who they really are—even the parts they refuse to acknowledge.
And you... you seem to have doubts about your true desires.
That's why I'm here. To help you make peace with what you've been afraid to accept.
But is that really the case?
It's just... do they really deserve the trust you've put in them?
Let's listen to the true voice of your dream.
Because you are with Jiang Ziya, you are an enemy of the Academy.
zh_text: “因为你与姜子牙是一伙的，是学院的敌人。”
source_text: “因为你与姜子牙是一伙的，是学院的敌人。”
official_target_text: Because you are with Jiang Ziya, you are an enemy of the Academy.
official_en_text: Because you are with Jiang Ziya, you are an enemy of the Academy.

text: You were with Ziya in the Underhall...
You were with Ziya in the Underhall...
Shh... I know the Sages care a lot about you.
But our conversation shouldn't be interrupted by outsiders.
And I am here to offer you some answers.
Any unusual activity in the area?
Let's hope it stays that way.
Why are you so nervous? You're not competing last time I checked...
I'm doing a simulation in my mind! So I can be better prepared in the future!
Hahaha, I say you should just sign up for real!
But if I do that now, there's a big chance I might be eliminated right away.
So what? For us Martial Arts students, failure is nothing to be afraid of!
You've got a point! So did you sign up this time?
I can't believe we made it to the second round!
Hmph, I told you! Just follow my training plan and we'll be fine!
All those sleepless nights of practice and meditation... We finally did it...
Thank you for not giving up on me, Captain! I-I'm getting a bit emotional...
Ah, the star of the show arrives! I've read all about your interview.
Fen, don't let some silly article get to you.
For us, the only thing that matters is how we do in the competition.
Team of Stars walks the red carpet.
Next up, please welcome our reigning champion team!
So, what's our slogan this time?
Next up, please welcome our reigning champion team!
So, what's our slogan this time?
So, what's our slogan this time?
Like a team slogan for our entrance. Didn't I tell you guys?
Well, I'm telling you now. A slogan is required for every team.
Next up, please welcome our reigning champion team!
Team of Stars! Team of Stars! Team of Stars!
It's okay! We'll just improvise! We'll be fine!
Team of Stars walks the red carpet.
After a heated discussion, you all decide to submit a Team of Stars badge—a symbol of your friendship—as the treasure. Together, you get ready to enter the trial.
What are the other teams thinking? Have you found anything useful?
Actually, I think many teams are struggling—it's hard to find something meaningful to everyone.
Teams that get along can at least talk about it.
Some teams are planning to just hand in something random...
But if it's not something that connects with their hearts, I doubt they can find it in the end...
That makes a lot of sense...
Then it's time to decide on ours. Does anyone have any ideas?
Shye, I think "treasure" should be your area of expertise, right...?
I know my treasures, yes. But one that's "unique to our team" is something we must pick together.
What do you think is most precious to us, the Team of Stars?
My sword, obviously! Its sharp edge and starry gleam have always been guiding us forward!
But my Apocalyptor is just as powerful! When people hear its roar, they'd know our team has come!
Our shared emotions... I think we do have something like that.
Our shared emotions... I think we do have something like that.
It is unique to us, and it symbolizes the bond we share.
It is unique to us, and it symbolizes the bond we share.
It is unique to us, and it symbolizes the friendship we share.
It is unique to us, and it symbolizes the friendship we share.
Our badge... It is our shared treasure, indeed.
We're all in agreement, right? Then it's decided!
It's almost time for us to go. I can already hear the crowd cheering!
Alright, let's go and get ourselves ready!
Hey, wait! Have you forgotten about our tradition?
Come on. "Team of Stars" on three, okay?
Okay, so should we get started?
But for those who are in a team with strangers... Nah.
Let's be serious here. I believe the treasure should be something that captures our shared emotions.
We're probably thinking of the same thing. What do you have in mind?
Our team name is engraved on our badges.
Our team name is engraved on our badges.
Then we should give one to Master Zhuangzi.
Talk about a team in sync! That's exactly what I was thinking!

After a heated discussion, you all unanimously decided to submit the Star Team badge, symbol of your camaraderie, as the treasure. With time running out, you cheered together, filled with fighting spirit as you prepared to enter the arena.
zh_text: 一番激烈的讨论后，你们一致决定将象征着团队情谊的星之队徽章作为珍宝提交。时间差不多，你们齐声呐喊加油，斗志昂扬地准备入场。
source_text: 一番激烈的讨论后，你们一致决定将象征着团队情谊的星之队徽章作为珍宝提交。时间差不多，你们齐声呐喊加油，斗志昂扬地准备入场。
official_target_text: After a heated discussion, you all unanimously decided to submit the Star Team badge, symbol of your camaraderie, as the treasure. With time running out, you cheered together, filled with fighting spirit as you prepared to enter the arena.
official_en_text: After a heated discussion, you all unanimously decided to submit the Star Team badge, symbol of your camaraderie, as the treasure. With time running out, you cheered together, filled with fighting spirit as you prepared to enter the arena.

text: Before Shye and Sun Bin can say anything about Novar and Meng Ya's childish contention, the rules reveal starts. You turn your attention to Master Zhuangzi...
Will you please cut it out? The next round is about to start.
Yeah. This won't help us during the competition...
Alright, alright, I agree. Let's all focus on the Enlightenment Trials now!
As the examiner for this round, Master Zhuangzi should be making his appearance soon.
I wonder what kind of test he has prepared for us this time.
After discussing the rules, Meng Ya suggests you talk with other teams for more information. Everyone agrees it's a good idea.
Hey, why don't we head to the lounge first? We talk to other teams and hear what they are thinking.
You know what—that's not a bad idea!
Sounds good to me. As the last team to go, we have plenty of time to scout around.
After we go in there, let's split up and talk to as many teams as possible.
And when it's time, let's regroup at the trial entrance.
So what do you say? Ready?
I'd like to take a look around.
Alright, I'll wait for you here.
This trial seems a bit similar to the last one, doesn't it?
Heart and dreams... Seems this trial requires us to look inward for an answer.
Are you ready to go to the lounge now?
And I'll wait for you here.

Your team takes the stage amidst thunderous cheers. When Master Zhuangzi asks for your slogan, your teammates turn to you. Thinking fast, you deliever one that wins a round of applause. After handing over your treasure—your team badge—Master Zhuangzi sends you to the trial arena.
May we blast through all obstacles!
May we blast through all obstacles!
The second round is about to begin. Is there anything you'd like to say to the audience?
Hello, we're the Team of Stars! We're thrilled to make it to the second round, and best of luck to all the remaining teams!
I like your spirit. So, what's your team's slogan?
That's right! May we all find the treasures we hold dear!
May we shine like the stars!
Yes! May we all shine like the brightest stars!
May we blast through all obstacles!
Exactly! Firepower is the best proof of strength!
Yes... We'll make every second count!
They seem to love our slogan!
We really didn't mean to put you on the spot.
Alright, alright. But you know what? No one could've done it better than you did!
Exactly. Shye's right—you're way more reliable than Novar.
Master Zhuangzi, can we head to the trial ground now?
Give me the treasure you have chosen, and you're free to go.
No problem! Our new member here will do the honor!
And memorable... May Team of Stars—
May we shine like the stars!
May we shine like the stars!
All the competing teams are here.
All the competing teams are here.
Now where are we supposed to regroup... I should look around.
Now where are we supposed to regroup... I should look around.
Welcome, competitors, to the second round of Enlightenment Trials—the Trial of the Heart.
All that your heart touches, it can be reflected in your dreams.
Only those with resilient spirits can find what they truly cherish among the illusions.
For this round, each team must select a treasure that's unique to you. I will place all of them within the Dreamscape.
Then you enter the place, and let your heart guide you to your own.
If you do that, you will advance to the next round.
Now, the trial is about to begin. Please get ready and enter in order.
Together, we'll take the beast down.
See? The fear deep in your heart is turning into your nightmare.
If my sister can do it, I can do it too!
Is there really not a single trance of doubt—why did he put your life on the line?
No. I trusted him. And he proved me right.
No. I trusted him. And he proved me right.
Unfortunately, the Dreamscape harbors no lies.
If you don't pass my tests, you're not joining our team! We don't want anyone that's weak!
Meng Ya, one of the most reckless souls there is. Pure-hearted, yes, but he never considers how others might feel.
Compromising for others is the hardest thing for him, wouldn't you say?
Haven't you ever felt uncomfortable being around him?
Hi... can you help me with something? I want to build another Mechanoid for Mr. Luban.
Sun Bin—a shy, introverted child. One cannot deny his kindness and compassion.
He brought you together to help Luban move on. And that was almost... touching.
But has he ever done the same for you?
Did something happen? Do you need help? Though—if I help, there will be a price to pay.
Shye's clever, quick-witted. But isn't she always attached to worldly things?
If you're really her friend, why must there be a price?
Has she ever helped you without asking for something in return?
Seems don't trust him as much as you say.
Really? Then why are you fighting alone now?
If Novar hadn't gotten you involved, none of this would have happened.
We wouldn't even be having this conversation.
The rest of your teammates are no different.
All they bring you is trouble—and danger.
They cannot help you find what you seek.
Can't you see? You don't need them as your friends.
They've always been there for me.
They've always been there for me.
They made me part of the team, and now I have a chance to see the Wonder!
They made me part of the team, and now I have a chance to see the Wonder!

After you defeat Nightmarish Cloudeater, the Man in Black appears again. He warns you that even winning the Enlightenment Trials won't help you access the Wonder—because Jixia Academy will be taken by Ziya and the Sanctified.
A chance to see the Wonder, is that right? It's certainly an offer that's hard to refuse.
Unfortunately... I'm afraid that won't be happening any time soon.
You've met Ziya and the Sanctified, haven't you? Seen what they're capable of?
By then, everything you're fighting for will be meaningless. And I assure you, there's no escape from this.
Do you really believe Jixia can survive until the end of the Enlightenment Trials?
Shye...? What's going on? Is she here, too?
Shye...? What's going on? Is she here, too?
This is a memory of yours in the Dreamscape.
Let's go over and take a look.
Let's go over and take a look.

The Man in Black attempts to drive a wedge between you and your teammates. He creates illusions based on your memories and asks: does Shye really want to help you or does she want something from you in return?
Here in the Dreamscape, everything you see comes from your own thoughts.
True memories, fabricated illusions—all derived from your mind.
Yet a person's thoughts are easily clouded by emotion.
Tell me—when you were in trouble, what did they do?
What I'm seeing now... Is this just my imagination?
What I'm seeing now... Is this just my imagination?
Or perhaps... they were just using you to do things that helped them?
They all helped me in every way they could...
They all helped me in every way they could...
Shye's clever, quick-witted. But isn't she always attached to worldly things?
Did you run into some trouble? I can help, but my service doesn't come for free.
If you're really her friend, why must there be a price?
Has she ever helped you without asking for something in return?
The man claims your friendship with the Team of Stars is not real, reminding you that Novar once put you in a dangerous situation.
Ever since you got here, how many problems have you solved for them?
They all have their troubles, and they all bring those troubles to you.
Yet again, none of those things was about you.
They've never given you anything in return, so why are you still doing this?
I was just doing what I could to help my friends.
I was just doing what I could to help my friends.
Are you saying that helping a friend is a mistake?
Are you saying that helping a friend is a mistake?
It's true. Friends are supposed to help each other's back. There's nothing wrong with that.
But what if what you need could put your friends in grave danger?
We wouldn't do that to each other.
We wouldn't do that to each other.
Oh, is that really the case?
Your "best friend," your "mentor," Novar—has he never put you in danger?
See? These are the people you call friends.
And yet... the truth begs to differ.
Setting aside their empty promises, all they have actually done is just take, and take, and take.
I was just doing the little things.
I was just doing the little things.
Are you saying that helping a friend is a mistake?
Are you saying that helping a friend is a mistake?
I know what you're trying to say, but I don't keep score when it comes to my friends.
I know what you're trying to say, but I don't keep score when it comes to my friends.
And I was just doing what I could. Nothing more.
And I was just doing what I could. Nothing more.
Are you saying that helping a friend is a mistake?
Are you saying that helping a friend is a mistake?
Leave Cloudeater to me—the greatest genius in Frostcloud Town!
I'm the champion of the Enlightenment Trials! This is nothing to me!
Cloudeater won't last a minute against my Star Power!
Such an ambitious kid... but he never thought about what would happen if he failed.
His recklessness dragged you into their fight, exposing you to the threat of Cloudeater.
Do you still think that's the right thing to do?
The Man in Black shows you a vision of Jixia's fall and advises you to leave the academy. A nightmarish version of Vesper appears and attacks you.
Again, what you see is only a reflection of your heart—Jixia's inevitable destruction.
We have one part of Ziya's staff. Without it, he won't stand a chance...
We have one part of Ziya's staff. Without it, he won't stand a chance...
But whether out of mercy or guilt, he just couldn't bring himself to deliver the final blow against Ziya.
In the face of an enemy, such "kindness" hurts just as much as cowardice.
He won't defeat a man who has nothing to lose.
Fuzi saved you the last time you fought Vesper. I doubt you'll be so lucky again.
Look, your nightmare has caught up to you...
The Sanctified have returned, and war is imminent.
I agree, Fuzi's strength is unmatched in this era.
Deep down, don't you already know what will happen in the end?
So, are you still willing to fight a war that's not yours, and pay the price for nothing?
If you continue on this path, I'm afraid you won't be able to get there.
The only thing you want is the Wonder, isn't it?
You saw them fight yourself—tell me I'm wrong.
You were lucky to escape last time. But that's not happening today.
Are you really willing to go down with it?
If you truly believe that, then why are you still here?
You see, your fears are following you like a shadow.
If you're so determined to die, then I'll oblige you!
Jixia is running out of time.
This burden was never yours to bear.
Their feud has nothing to do with you.
Leave with me, and I will take you to the Wonder you seek.
As a student of Jixia, I will stand with their people!
As a student of Jixia, I will stand with their people!
The Man in Black urges you to abandon Jixia and implies he knows your past. You chase after him into a deeper level of dreams...
What you're supposed to do is more important than anything that's happening here.
Don't you wish to find the answers you're so desperate for—the past you remember nothing about?
Your birth, your identity, and... your true purpose.
You're now in the Dreamscape. The trial begins here.
Dreams are full of the unknown. Only by trusting your heart can you find your way through the mist.
The Man in Black wants you to join him, but you don't trust him. Still, he seems to know more than you expected—about you, and even about Senara.
Tell me, what else do you know about me?
Tell me, what else do you know about me?
Seems you're finally ready to confront your inner self.
I thought in the happy life of Jixia, you have forgotten what you were searching for.
That's not true... I've never stopped searching.
That's not true... I've never stopped searching.
What the Three Sages can't answer you... I can give you the answers.
All you need to do is trust me… and join me.
No, I don't trust you. I know what I'm looking for, and I don't need your guidance.
No, I don't trust you. I know what I'm looking for, and I don't need your guidance.
Don't you have a promise to keep with <001>her</>?
Having second thoughts about my proposal?
... There's no way I'd trust you.
... There's no way I'd trust you.
The man claims he is your only true friend—and that only by following him can you find your answers. He is then going to show you "where Senara will lead you"...
I see through your doubts and fears.
And I understand your obsessions and confusion.
I know how to guide you onto the path—and lead you to the Wonders you're destined to find.
With me, you are no longer alone. I will be your only friend.
That's because every step you took, I have been there.
You walk a lonely path, where I am the only one who travels alongside you.
But they know nothing of your struggles.
They don't know what you're searching for, nor what you must ultimately face.
There is one who does, but... she chooses to remain silent.
She... I'm not sure about that...
She... I'm not sure about that...
I'm willing to tell you everything.
Everything they're hiding from you. The harsh truth they don't want you to see...
As long as you join my side.
Of course. I just want you to remember your past and escape the shackles of fate.
How do I know you're telling is the truth? Why should I believe you!?
How do I know you're telling is the truth? Why should I believe you!?
Because she... she doesn't want the same thing as you do.

I think you're just looking for a fight!

I see. And what's their record like?

No matter what kind of challenge you face, you must be brave enough to face it head-on.

The first part, terribly said. The second—couldn't agree more!
I totally believe in my teammates.
I totally believe in my teammates.

Should is a very... subtle choice of words.

Hmm, I suspect the defensive mechanisms at the second tower will be even stronger. Let's head over there to assess the situation before deciding how to take it.
Wait... that's the enemy's Guard! Quick, protect our minion wave!
(Pop-up) Longya has been sent back to the fountain! As expected of you guys!
(Pop-up) The Crimson Spirit Beast's buff is very powerful. Is everyone uninjured?
(Pop-up) Easy! No matter how strong the buff is, it can't beat a numbers advantage!
(Pop-up) That's right! There are only three of them left now. Shye and I are heading to the crystal, you guys hurry up too!
(Pop-up) Hmm, we'll head out once we take the second tower.
Thanks to Sun Bin and your cooperation, we achieved the best strategy for the team battle.
Quickly capture the Linglong Tower, then gather at the Honor Tower.
Come, let's capture the tower together!
Just touch the central mechanism with the flow like this.
Come, let's capture the tower together!
Just touch the central mechanism with the flow like this.
We have to hurry before Minka gets here.
Remember the secret weapon Uncle Ban gave me? It's an emergency—time to bring it out!
See the defense tower's mechanism core? That's our target.
You go left, I'll go right, let them taste the power of artillery!
We have to hurry before Minka gets here.
Remember the secret weapon Uncle Ban gave me? It's an emergency—time to bring it out!
See the defense tower's mechanism core? That's our target.
You go left, I'll go right, let them taste the power of artillery!
You and Meng Ya agree to split up to coordinate the battle, using the artillery to destroy the core of the Linglong Tower from a distance.
This is a secret weapon I researched with Uncle Ban overnight. Its name is—uh, let's just call it the Cannon for now.
You go left, I'll go right, let it taste the power of artillery!
Don't worry, I've already prepared a backup plan!
The details don't matter! Later, we'll use it to aim at the red <001>core</> of the Exquisite Tower and shatter it from a distance.
Finally done. That Linglong Tower hits pretty hard. Let's stay in the safe zone outside the tower and prepare first.
What do we do now? Are we just supposed to wait for the next batch of Guard Automatons? By the time they get here, the opponents will have arrived too.

What do we do now? Are we just supposed to wait for the next batch of Guard Automatons? By the time they get here, the opponents will have arrived too.
Sun Bin, nice work! Now that Dragon Fang is CC'd in place, let's attack!
Hmph, even if the shield is broken, you still won't win!
Sorry, but this tower is ours!
Sorry, but this tower is ours!
That was close. Next... let's go meet up with Meng Ya.
That was close. Next... let's go meet up with Meng Ya.
You'll find out in a bit. This area is rich in these shells; let's help pick some up.
zh_text: 一会你就知道了，这附近盛产这种贝壳，一起帮忙捡一些吧。
source_text: 一会你就知道了，这附近盛产这种贝壳，一起帮忙捡一些吧。
