text: Novar introduces you to the Power Rankings, a leaderboard sorted by credits. Turns out that he vouched for your special exam with his own credits. As you talk, you notice an unfamiliar name, "Vlinder," has now surpassed Novar on the rankings.
Novar shows you the Power Rankings.
Meet the "Power Rankings"—the ranking list that carries the most weight among students.
That's right. He's been there for millennia, no surprises at all.
Once the best student of the academy, and now a master strategist in the Three Kingdoms. Truly a legend.
From Sorcery techniques to war tactics, he excels at everything. That's why we often say: "There's always someone better... unless you're Kongming."
Even his limited-edition feather fans are always sold out. But seriously, a fan? No way it's cooler than a cape full of stars...
As expected. A rare genius from the School of Mechcraft, Sun Bin is second only to Senior Kongming.
And he's also among the top in the academy's "Popularity Rankings."
But for a shy boy like him, too much attention can be a burden... You know how it is.
As for me, I never worry about such things! Haha!
It's more like you enjoy it...
It's more like you enjoy it...
Doesn't seem to be much else.
Look at the numbers next to the names. Those are our credits.
Credits are very important to the students of Jixia Academy.
They determine our grades every year, and even earn us rewards.
In short, the more, the better. It's a testament to your "strength."
Besides, credits have many other uses. Sponsoring new students and such...
So for me to take that special exam...?
So for me to take that special exam...?
Don't mention it. I made a promise to take you to the Wonder, and I intend to keep it.
Besides, I knew you'd make it the moment I saw you.
I'm always confident in my judgment!
But if I didn't pass the exam...
Then my credits would be down the drain!
But I knew you'd make it the moment I saw you.
I'm always confident in my judgment!
That said, I don't want you to stress about it. Just do your best and you'll be okay.
Anyway, notice anything that stands out?
My name is on the list! See? Novar, right there, just below...
Huh? That one before me, I don't think I've seen her before...
What if I don't pass the exam...
official_target_text: What if I don't pass the exam...
official_en_text: What if I don't pass the exam...

text: This is Enlightenment Plaza, the liveliest place in the academy!
And of course, there's that thing we all care about the most.
It's also where the welcoming ceremony takes place every year.

Fen chimes in and introduces you to his captain, Vlinder. Vlinder then joins the conversation and asks you to consider joining their team for the Enlightenment Trials. Unimpressed by Novar, though, she chooses to ignore him.
That'd be my most brilliant captain, of course.
Hey there again! I heard you passed your special exam. Congratulations!
I saw your potential right from the start. That's why I've recommended you to my captain!
Who exactly is your captain, Fen?
What? I mean, how could you not have heard of her?
Remember the girl who caused a sensation during the Sorcery test this year?
Well, it does seem to ring a bell...
She comes from an ancient family of Sorcerers, carrying the finest powers her lineage has to offer.
A rising star both at the School of Sorcery and on the Power Rankings...
A prodigy with extraordinary talent and unfathomable strength—and that's Vlinder!
Did someone just say my name?
Here you are. Perfect timing, captain!
No way... I need something like that for myself... something even better!
You know, like, "the reigning champion of the Enlightenment Trials, the brightest star of Martial Arts..."
Okay, but I'm not saying that...
Okay, but I'm not saying that...
Hey, what happened to being there for your friend?
Feels like you lost this one, Novar.
No way... I need something like that for myself... something even better!
You know, like, "the reigning champion of the Enlightenment Trials, the brightest star of Martial Arts..."
Okay, but I'm not saying that...
Okay, but I'm not saying that...
Hey, what happened to being there for your friend?
Captain Vlinder, meet Novar. Captain of the Team of Stars. And this is the new student I told you about!
So... you're the one who passed the Puppet Show test?
That's impressive. But then... why are you with him?
Hey, what's that supposed to mean?
What's wrong with me? What's wrong with you!
I've heard about you, Novar. Winner of the Enlightenment Trials, a shining role model for all juniors.
But now I see you're nothing special. Just another name below me on the Power Rankings.
That's because I spent many of them for my team... Besides, you really believe it's gonna last!?
I only believe the fact. And the fact is, you're already behind me.
Now, you. Since you're here at the academy, I assume you'll be joining the Enlightenment Trials.
In that case, you'd better choose your team wisely.
My crack team happens to have a spot. If you're interested, come find me.
As for the amateur here, I've got nothing more to say.
My invitation stands. Be seeing you.
No hard feelings, guys. Some pride is to be expected when you're such a genius like her.
Still, if you're taking part in the Enlightenment Trials, our team is your best chance to win!
I'll be off now! Wait for me, captain—
She didn't just turn her back on me like that! I will get my revenge on her — mark my words!
So that's another round you've lost...
When we meet during the Enlightenment Trials, I will make you regret today!
He's not listening at all now...
He's not listening at all now...
What? No! I couldn't care less about what she said. Just let it go!
When we meet during the Enlightenment Trials, she'll see who the real genius is!
Anyway, let's drop it for now and get going. Fuzi's still waiting.
What do temporary credits matter! Besides, my credits were deducted because I covered too much for the Star Team...
zh_text: 一时的学分算得上什么！况且我的学分是因为替星之队抵扣太多……
source_text: 一时的学分算得上什么！况且我的学分是因为替星之队抵扣太多……
official_target_text: What do temporary credits matter! Besides, my credits were deducted because I covered too much for the Star Team...
official_en_text: What do temporary credits matter! Besides, my credits were deducted because I covered too much for the Star Team...

text: Having already briefed Fuzi on your encounter in the Underhall, Novar is waiting for you at the academy plaza. He will now take you to meet Fuzi so you can learn more about the Wonders.
You made it! So, how was the Aership ride? Pretty great, right?
Yes, I really enjoyed it. Thank you.
Yes, I really enjoyed it. Thank you.
Great! Now welcome to Jixia Academy, the highest seat of learning in Primaera!
Despite some twists and turns along the way, you're one step closer to encountering the Wonders.
And just so you know, I've already briefed Master Fuzi about what you encountered.
As for the Wonders and anything else you want to know, it's best if you talk with him in person.
Now come, take a walk with me!
He said he'd take over from here, so we don't have to worry too much for now.
Despite some twists and turns along the way, you're one step closer to encountering the Wonders.
zh_text: 一路虽然有些曲折，但是离接触奇迹总算是又近了一步。
source_text: 一路虽然有些曲折，但是离接触奇迹总算是又近了一步。
official_target_text: Although the journey had some twists and turns, we are finally one step closer to touching the miracle.
official_en_text: Although the journey had some twists and turns, we are finally one step closer to touching the miracle.

text: Fuzi explains that he once served as an Enforcer, carrying out the Deities' will. And he has long stepped down from that role. He believes people should chart their own paths, which is the very purpose of the Enlightenment Trials. He then tells you that every new student has a chance to approach the Aercocoon during the welcoming ceremony.
Master Fuzi seems to... know a lot about legends of the ancient times?
Master Fuzi seems to... know a lot about legends of the ancient times?
That's because I lived in that time.
I was once the right-hand of the "gods", one of the so-called Enforcers—carrying out the gods' will, guarding the Wonders.
But now I have long relinquished that title...
Divine enlightenment is a thing of the past. People should learn to find their own way forward, which is also the meaning of Enlightenment Trials.
Do you have any other questions?
I know this means a lot to you, but I cannot tell you in advance.
As usual, the rules will be announced at the Grand Ceremony.
Ha, just be patient. It's not too long from now.
Have you ever consulted the Wonder?
Yes, I have. And its answer for me was...
Exactly what I had in mind.
Very well... It's about time. Let's get down to business.
Winning the Enlightenment Trials to access the Wonder is a good thing...
But before that, all students have a chance to visit the Aercocoon—the welcoming ceremony.
Arrived at the Tower of Enlightenment.
Now, up ahead is the Tower of Enlightenment!
Master Fuzi officially welcomes you to Jixia. He explains that only by winning the Enlightenment Trials can you gain access to Jixia's Wonder. Then, he goes on to tell you about the Wonders' origins.
Meet the headmaster of Jixia Academy—the renowned sage—Fuzi!
Greetings to you, and welcome to our academy. I heard it hasn't been easy for you on your way here.
For you, it's nothing. You've dealt with the Puppet Show and The Underhall.
You really know how to make it sound easy...
Heh, you kids are kind of similar in this respect.
Confident and full of passion. That's a good thing.
I'm glad to see you've learned your lesson.
It's been quite an adventure indeed...
I'm talking to the new student. Why are you getting sentimental?
I'm just expressing how tough his journey has been! Much harder than mine back in the days.
At least you're not bragging about yourself this time.
Now, what you've done is commendable.
With all the challenges you've overcome, I can see you're strong in mind and keen for knowledge.
I'm glad to see you've learned your lesson.
You flatter me, Master Fuzi. I have much to learn from you in the future.
You flatter me, Master Fuzi. I have much to learn from you in the future.
Alright... Guess I've done all my part.
Now maybe Master Fuzi can tell our new student here what's special about Jixia, like... the Wonder?
As for me, I've already heard enough of those. Be waiting for you over there!
That boy... He must have given you quite the trouble.
I understand you're here for the Wonder.
You want to access the Wonder?
Yes, I have some questions... and I want answers.
Yes, I have some questions... and I want answers.
Yes, many students come to Jixia seeking the Wonders...
Only by proving yourself through victory in the Enlightenment Trials can you receive a response.
This has been Jixia's tradition for thousands of years, with no exception.
You mentioned the other Wonders... Are there any differences between them?
You mentioned the other Wonders... Are there any differences between them?
Novar hasn't told you about this? Then let me start from the beginning.
I'm just expressing how tough her journey has been! Much harder than mine back in the days.
What do you think? Pretty impressive, huh?
The three schools of our academy are renowned across the land.
The School of Sorcery delves into the nature of things, while the School of Mechcraft bring ideas to life.
To me, of course, the School of Martial Arts will always be the best.
When you see how I fight with my sword, you'll know I'm right.
Also here at the academy, various Societies converge and collide.
Just a few days ago, we held the opening of the Debates of Societies. You should definitely check it out when you have time!
The School of Sorcery delves into the nature of things, while the School of Mechcraft bring ideas to life.
zh_text: 尊崇“洞察本源，察思观己”的魔道学派，用实践验证真理的机关学派……
source_text: 尊崇“洞察本源，察思观己”的魔道学派，用实践验证真理的机关学派……
official_target_text: The School of Sorcery delves into the nature of things, while the School of Mechcraft brings ideas to life.
official_en_text: The School of Sorcery delves into the nature of things, while the School of Mechcraft brings ideas to life.

text: The enduring flame of civilization was kindled by them, still illuminating the continent to this day.
zh_text: 繁荣而绵延的文明之火自它们而燃起，至今都照耀着整片大陆。
source_text: 繁荣而绵延的文明之火自它们而燃起，至今都照耀着整片大陆。
official_target_text: They kindled the flames of enduring civilizations, whose vitality persists even to this day.
official_en_text: They kindled the flames of enduring civilizations, whose vitality persists even to this day.

text: But everything changed after the collapse.
zh_text: 只不过……神陨之后，一切都改变了。
source_text: 只不过……神陨之后，一切都改变了。
official_target_text: Since the Deities fell, however... everything has changed.
official_en_text: Since the Deities fell, however... everything has changed.

text: Novar leads you into the Tower of Enlightenment and briefly introduces Fuzi—revered by all as the leader of the Three Sages, while also a close friend with students in private.
That's it for the tour. Now let's go meet Master Fuzi.
To most people? Leader of the Three Sages and the pinnacle of Martial Arts.
But to me, he's more like an old friend. Kind and sweet most of the time.
Still, when you see him waving that ferule of his with a smile... you'd better run fast.
His "friendly advice" could surely leave a mark.
Haha, but don't worry. He won't be so hard on a new student like you.
You'll see for yourself! Let's go.
Everything going well so far? I've got some good news for you.
Do you not trust your mentor at all?
I need a partner for a special... project of mine. And you are my top pick!
Special project? What's with all the secrecy...?
Special project? What's with all the secrecy...?
Shh... I'm onto something big here. But we can't talk about it in the academy...
All I can say now is the intel came from Frostcloud Town. And I know that place like the back of my hand.
I promise, this is gonna be far more exciting than any school assignments! You in?
You do make it sound interesting...
You do make it sound interesting...
It's settled then! See you in Frostcloud Town!
Always in such a hurry... Well, I should go and see what he has in mind.
Always in such a hurry... Well, I should go and see what he has in mind.
During the welcoming ceremony, every disciple would present their question before the Wonder.
And finally, when you left Jixia, you found your own answers within it.
Starting from Jixia, you will embark on a path of your own. The stories are yours to write.
The Three Sages join the ceremony together, welcoming you to Jixia Academy.
Another soul seeking answers within boundless dreams.
To help you find the right direction... that is our mission here at the academy.
You are now officially a student of Jixia Academy.
To promote love and peace with our own creations!
Cast your Flow into the Aercocoon.
On my path, I met two kindred spirits who share the same ideals.

Witnessing your strong resonance with Aercocoon, the Three Sages have grown concerned about the immense power inside you. Zhuangzi admits he cannot see your dreams clearly, but can't shake the feeling that a storm is brewing. Meanwhile, Fuzi decides to deal with Ziya by himself.
Such strong resonance with the Aercocoon... Could he... be the one?
The Aercocoon is never mistaken. I believe the answer is clear. It's just...
His dreams, but very vaguely. I can only sense something in the distant future... something dark and disturbing.
And for someone with an uncertain path to have such unique, formidable powers...
Such strong resonance with the Aercocoon... Could she... be the one?
The Aercocoon is never mistaken. I believe the answer is clear. It's just...
Her dreams, but very vaguely. I can only sense something in the distant future... something dark and disturbing.
And for someone with an uncertain path to have such unique, formidable powers...
Still, there's no telling what may happen in the time ahead. We just have to wait and see.
I hope history does not repeat itself again.
The Divine Imprints those kids found are proof of Ziya's ill intentions. Things will get complicated from now.
He holds a grudge against us. We must prepare for the worst.
This is between him and me alone. I will take care of this.

The masters teach you to learn from the world and seek your own truth. Fuzi then officially assigns Novar as your mentor, hoping you will grow together. As the ceremony concludes, the Three Sages offer you their sincere blessings, wishing you a promising path ahead.
Yes. By traveling around the world, you can learn the way of all things.
While our academy has three schools, we do not want to confine our students to the classroom.
The paths to knowledge are countless. Go out there and find the ones that suit you best.
The truth is... what you make of it?
The truth is... what you make of it?
Good, you're getting there. I look forward to what you'll accomplish.
During your time here, I believe Novar would make a fitting mentor.
If you have any questions, feel free to ask him. I'd like to see you two motivate each other in your studies.
And that concludes the welcoming ceremony.
May your journey ahead be unobstructed.
May your scholarly endeavors at Jixia be rewarding.
May the truth you pursue be within your grasp.
Seeing your confusion, Master Zhuangzi assures you that answers will come when the time is right, and suggests you hone yourself skills using the Travelogue.
You'll know it when the time is right.
While you seek your answers, you should take this <001>Travelogue</> with you.

Following Fuzi's guidance, you channel your Flow into the Aercocoon. Unprecedentedly, the Aercocoon replies by showing visions of many heroes. The Three Sages are surprised as well, leading their attention to your unique Bracer.
The world is like a game of Weiqi.
The right mood doubles the firepower!
The most cherished for the most beloved.
See how bright the stars are?
You are the greatest masterpiece of my life.
My resolve will always remain firm.
I've never seen the Aercocoon react like this.
Your bracer is really something special.
Novar thrilled at learning that Fuzi has assigned him as your mentor. He suggests you follow the Travelogue to get some training first, before meeting up later at Enlightenment Plaza.
You're here! How was the ceremony? Did you see the Aercocoon? Quite a sight, isn't it?
After all that's happened, you are finally one of us. I'm really happy for you!
Which question should I answer first...
From the look on your face, I can tell it went well.
After all that's happened, you are finally one of us. I'm really happy for you!
We should find a place to celebrate later!
There's one more thing. Master Fuzi has appointed you as my mentor.
There's one more thing. Master Fuzi has appointed you as my mentor.
Master Fuzi, he... I-I'm at a loss for words! I knew I was his favorite!
Call me mentor now! Come on!
I guarantee that your time with me will be nothing short of exceptional!
Aw, don't be shy! I promise I'll live up to your expectations!
Now let's see... They must have told you about the <001>Travelogue</>, right? How about we start there?
In the meantime, I'll think about what else we can do together. Let's meet at Enlightenment Plaza later!
Oh, I forgot—you're new here, aren't you?
While on the Aership, we offer audio guides recorded by our three headmasters.
It's a great opportunity to learn about each school.
So that's his surprise for me.
So that's his surprise for me.
Alright, all set. The guided tour is ready now!
Novar has booked Master Fuzi's recording for you. It will start as soon as the ship departs.
Now on the peak to your left stands the Stargazing Terrace, an observatory built by the three schools.
Welcome, dear students, to Jixia Academy.
Welcome aboard the Aership to Jixia Academy... Uh, hello? What's going on?
Let me check, Master Fuzi. Ugh, how does it work again...?
So none of that got recorded? Doing the opening once is enough already...
The recording is on now, Master...
Why don't you remind me! Hgh, ugh...
Welcome aboard the Aership to Jixia Academy.
We are flying across the "Harvest Fields" as we speak. The fertile lands below can provide the yield for all Jixia people.
Food is the cornerstone of civilization. Conservation of nature should be just as important as the pursuit of knowledge.
Harmony with heaven and earth brings deep understanding of the universe.
Look ahead. Jixia Academy is now in sight.
Our students are all driven by a passion for knowledge. One as boundless as the starry sky.
Different schools and societies only mean different paths. You, your heart, is what really takes you to the "truth."
As the founder of the academy, it's my great pleasure to introduce you to Jixia.
Up there, the whole galaxy unfolds. And mastering its laws offers a clearer lens on our world.
The prosperity of the people and the nation begins in the wild. I hope every student, while seeking knowledge, never forgets the land.
zh_text: 万民社稷，兴生于野，希望每位学子求学问道，亦不忘山野。
source_text: 万民社稷，兴生于野，希望每位学子求学问道，亦不忘山野。
official_target_text: The prosperity of the people and the nation begins in the wild. I hope every student, while seeking knowledge, never forgets the land.
official_en_text: The prosperity of the people and the nation begins in the wild. I hope every student, while seeking knowledge, never forgets the land.

text: “The I Ching aligns with heaven and earth, thus it can encompass the Dao of heaven and earth.”
zh_text: “易与天地准，故能弥纶天地之道。”
source_text: “易与天地准，故能弥纶天地之道。”
official_target_text: “The I Ching aligns with heaven and earth, thus it can encompass the Dao of heaven and earth.”
official_en_text: “The I Ching aligns with heaven and earth, thus it can encompass the Dao of heaven and earth.”

text: Okay, the broadcast device looks good...
Just give me a second to finish the setup, and we'll be ready to go.
You finally meet Novar, who has been waiting anxiously at the Aership Station. Wasting no time, you tell him everything that just happened.
Oh, thank the Sages. What took you so long?
I've been waiting for you for like forever. You really got me worried.
What was so good about this place that you forgot about me?
I've been waiting for you for ages; I was worried sick.
zh_text: 一直没等到你，我可是担心了好半天呢。
source_text: 一直没等到你，我可是担心了好半天呢。
official_target_text: I've been waiting for you for ages; I was worried sick.
official_en_text: I've been waiting for you for ages; I was worried sick.

text: After hearing your account, Novar speculates that the mysterious marks you saw are connected to rogue beasts he's investigating. He needs to report to Fuzi immediately, so you have to take the Aership alone, again. As consolation, he's left a surprise for you on board and promises to regroup at the academy.
I must report this back immediately... Gotta go now.
Don't worry, I've already arranged an Aership for you.
So you're disappearing on me again.
Well, I can see you're still holding a grudge over what happened at the harbor...
Alright, it's about time. Just enjoy your trip, and we'll see each other soon!
Even the Underhall is involved. I'm afraid they're up to something bigger.
The Sanctified... Don't think I've heard of them. But the marks you saw are an important lead in my investigation.
The beasts in Jixia have become increasingly aggressive lately. And these marks might have something to do with that.
The Sanctified... the strange marks... They could all be connected.
I was going to travel with you to the academy, but now it seems...
Anyway, if it makes you feel any better, I got you a little surprise on the ship!
Don't worry. An Aership is ready to take you to the academy. And there's a surprise for you on board!
Ha, you'll find out once you're there!
I'll follow and take a look too.
Are you ready to face your end?
official_target_text: Are you ready for what comes next?
official_en_text: Are you ready for what comes next?

text: Sun Bin speculates that Shi Yu, in order to repair the pendulum clock, has gone to capture a giant bear to harness its energy. You two immediately set out to pursue him.
He's gone... Uncle Shi hasn't changed a bit...
Is there really no way to save him?
Is there really no way to save him?
Dr Bian is a master of medicine. I don't think we'll be able to reverse this...
We have to find him. No one knows how long that pill can last.
If I'm right, he's going to hunt that giant bear with the mysterious marks!
Huh? What does that have to do with a bear?
Huh? What does that have to do with a bear?
Ugh... It's my fault. Let's hurry, I'll explain on the way!
You know, considering how bad he wants to repair that pendulum clock...
Then what do we do now?
Then what do we do now?
But... do you know where he went?
But... do you know where he went?

Failing to capture the bear, Shi Yu decides to search for materials in an ancient Mechcraft ruin instead. Seeing Sun Bin doesn't understand his obsession, Shi Yu leads you to the waterfall to explain himself.
I... I knew you were after that bear. It's too dangerous...
Hey, kid, we've already said our goodbyes. Don't worry, I can take care of myself.
That's not what I meant... I'm here for a promise you made.
What do you think? You've scared my bear away!
When are you ever going to stop worrying about others, kid?
Do you think I came without a plan? See that trap there? I lured it here on purpose!
Then you showed up and it just went berserk!
Never mind. I must find another one before it's too late...
Um... You wanted to use the energy from the marks to repair the clock, right?
But the truth is, once these beasts die, the energy dissipates with them...
So I'm afraid your plan will not work...
Hmm... Well, it doesn't change my mind! I knew nothing would come easy.
There's an ancient Mechcraft ruin south of the mountains. Maybe I can find something useful there.
Can we... go with you? Just to be safe.
It's not that. You said you'd take us to travel around Jixia if the shop ever closed. And now the shop has closed...
A promise? Like I said, I've done everything I can for your pocket watch.
I did? My memory isn't what it used to be. Why are you being so serious?
Wait, kid! Why are your eyes red? Don't you dare start crying!
Fine... Follow me behind the waterfall!

The three of you arrive at Shi Yu's childhood hideout base behind the waterfall. There, Shi Yu recounts the story of his childhood friend, Zera: how she was ostracized by others as a prodigy in Sorcery, and how she exerted herself to help him repair the pendulum clock...
Childhood friend? You mean that girl you used to talked about? What was her name again...?
Oh, right. You said she was Master Zhuangzi's student, extremely talented in Sorcery...
That's all? I knew you weren't always listening!
And she was the prettiest one! You guys are always missing the point.
Uh... Okay... And I remember Tian Ji said you must have made up this story yourself.
And you just believed that!? Anyway, I'll tell you the whole story this time.
Honestly, she was the reason I wanted to fix that clock in the first place...
Then came the day when my master was about to retire. He said whoever fixed the pendulum clock would take over the shop.
Everyone in the shop tried their best, but the clock was just too old and too broken.
Even I was almost about to give up...
Then one day, Zera came to me and asked me to give her the clock's main wheel.
Besides that, though... she said nothing. Just took the thing and left. Until a few days later...
It started when I was just a nobody working in a clock shop, while she was the most popular student in the academy.
Then one day, I found her hiding in this cave, and outside the waterfall, many of her juniors were gossiping about her...
They said she was born under a curse that killed her parents, and that she would bring disaster to everyone close to her...
What? How could they say such things!?
Yeah, I was furious when I heard it. Wanted to go out and stop them, but she just smiled and told me to stay.
Later, when I asked her why, she said, "Slander and fear are just another proof that you're strong".
Anyway, we became friends after that. Two lone souls who found solace in each other. And this place was our sanctuary...
Never knew there's a place like this behind the waterfall...
Never knew there's a place like this behind the waterfall...
Why did you bring us here...
This cave was a secret hideout for me and a childhood friend of mine. Just like the ones you and Tian Ji had for experiments.
We used this place to... to escape from unpleasant things. Still looks the same as it did decades ago...
<001>Xin Ye</>! I don't blame you for not remembering; I think I only mentioned it once.
zh_text: <001>辛夜</>！也不怪你不记得，我好像就提过一次。
source_text: <001>辛夜</>！也不怪你不记得，我好像就提过一次。
official_target_text: <001>Xin Ye</>! I don't blame you for not remembering; I think I only mentioned it once.
official_en_text: <001>Xin Ye</>! I don't blame you for not remembering; I think I only mentioned it once.

text: Sun Bin comes to understand Shi Yu's intention and decides to honor his final wish. He opens up about his own past—how an accident cost him not only his legs, but also his best friend Tian Ji. You realize that they actually share the same yearning for a lost friend.
Thank you for saying this... Now let's hurry and find the materials to repair the clock.
But then he disappeared in an accident... and I lost my legs. Now the pocket watch is all I have...
So yes. I will help him.
But now I think that maybe struggling for a cure is not what he actually needs.
Actually, Tian Ji was the one that introduced me to Uncle Shi.
Actually, you and Uncle Shi are the same. You both just want to find your friend.
Actually, you and Uncle Shi are the same. You both just want to find your friend.
He was always a cheerful one. Not long after he joined the academy, he and Uncle Shi became close friends.
He often took me to the clock shop, and the three of us would spend the whole day studying Mechcrafts together...
I was in a slump for a long time after that...
Don't let Uncle Shi's attitude fool you. He was the one who first encouraged me to start the experiment...
I'm sure he'd love to see Tian Ji back just as I do...
Honestly, I was planning to convince him to see another doctor. But...

A few days later, Xin Ye returns pale with the main gear, truly restoring the grandfather clock to operation. Shiyu's master gives him the position of shopkeeper. But unexpectedly, this was the last time Shiyu and Xin Ye would ever see each other.
She returned with the wheel in her hand. Looking pale and weak.
After we installed it, the clock actually started working again! It only lasted three days, yet...
It made my master so happy. And he gave me the shop.
But I had never thought that would be the last time I saw Zera.

A few days later, Xin Ye returns pale with the main gear, truly restoring the grandfather clock to operation. Shiyu's master gives him the position of shopkeeper. But unexpectedly, this was the last time Shiyu and Xin Ye would ever see each other.
What? What are you doing here?!
Uncle Shi! We're here to help!
Looks like I have to go to the Dream Vale.
Looks like I have to go to the Dream Vale.

You find Zhang Chenxing, Shi Yu's apprentice, who explains that Shi Yu has closed the shop due to illness. The elderly man lingering outside was Shi Yu's fellow apprentice back in the day, Uncle Jia. Chenxing advises you to visit Shi Yu at Dream Vale and retrieve the flight timers. Sun Bin says he will join you there after completing the upgrades.
Uncle Shi is ill? How...? He was always so full of energy...
This is really worrying... Could you please go check on him?
I still have a few more upgrades to do, but I'll catch up as soon as I'm done.
I'm here to pick up the timers, but I saw the shop was closed.
I'm here to pick up the timers, but I saw the shop was closed.
Ah, the timers! You're from the academy, right? I've been expecting you.
Master told me you'd come before he left.
Ah, he fell ill recently. It seems pretty serious.
He used to work on clocks for days without rest. Always aiming for perfection.
Since he got sick, though, he's been collapsing at work every now and then...
Anyway, we all wanted to stay and help him recover.
But he got furious with us, saying we all should live our own lives...
Ugh, I'm rambling. Almost forgot about the real business here.
He told me that if someone from the academy came for the timers, they should go to his residence in the <001>Dream Vale</>.
He said he must close the final order of the shop himself.
By the way, there was an old man lingering outside the shop earlier. He seemed... upset with Mr. Shi Yu.
By the way, there was an old man lingering outside the shop earlier. He seemed... upset with Mr. Shi Yu.
Oh, you must be talking about Uncle Jia. He and our master were both apprentices back in the day. Always felt he should be the one inheriting the shop.
It's no big deal, really. Don't worry about him.
Got it. Then I'll be on my way.
Got it. Then I'll be on my way.
Dashing Wings upgraded by Senior Sun Bin? I gotta try this out!
Got it! Let's catch up with him!
Come on, let's go after them!
Uncle Shi! We're here to help!

Shi Yu admits that his true purpose in repairing the clock is to honor Zera in his final days. He also quotes Tian Ji, that "time is made up from of the past and hopes for the future." The group then splits up to begin the repair of the clock.
What do you think she looks like now?
What do you think she looks like now?
Hah, must be a kind and charming old lady!
So when I found out about my disease, my first thought was how nice it'd be to see her again.
I see now, but... even if you fix the clock, are you sure she will come back?
What makes up time? Is it the gears, the springs, the hands...?
Exactly. I was so impressed by that kid.
But just like Tian Ji said, Memories and hopes are what make up time—what make up us.
Anyway, sickness has already imprisoned me. And I don't want death to be my only way out.
Of course I know the clock won't bring her back.
You know this better than anyone, don't you, kid?
Good, then let's get to work! You want to help, help me fix the clock!
I went to the academy to look for her later, but Master Zhuangzi said she'd been sent on a mission and would never return...
It's memories of the past and hopes for the future. I remember.
You're right, I'm not. But remember when you and Tian Ji came to my house, wanting to get that clock ticking again?
Tian Ji just stared at the clock pointers and said...
Yeah, it was also my first time to learn that side of him...
Neither, it's people's memories and expectations. That's how Tian Ji answered at the time.
zh_text: “都不是啊，是人们的回忆和期待。”田忌那时是这样回答的。
source_text: “都不是啊，是人们的回忆和期待。”田忌那时是这样回答的。
official_target_text: Neither, it's people's memories and expectations. That's how Tian Ji answered at the time.
official_en_text: Neither, it's people's memories and expectations. That's how Tian Ji answered at the time.

text: The rescued student obediently accepts Sun Bin's safety education and agrees to go to the Student Affairs Committee to accept punishment.
Did you... not see the sign?
And don't ever, ever pull a stunt like that again.
Ugh, that was close. Thought I was done for...
A-are you okay? Did you get hurt anywhere?
I'm fine! No big deal, really.
Okay... but I still think you should visit a doctor. Just to be safe.
Yeah, I will. Thank you, guys! Wait, you-you're Senior Sun Bin?
Oh, you are! Did you come here just to save me? I-I'm so touched!
Can you sign something for me? I mean, I've always been a huge fan...
No... that was not why I...
Emm... what? Sorry, Senior Sun Bin, I couldn't hear you...
The sign? Oh, that one... I didn't pay much attention to it...
I heard you upgraded a batch of Mechcrafts in the mountains, so I just rushed over!
The sign has made it very clear: "The Dashing Wings are still under repair. Any attempt to use it now may result in extreme danger."
I... I always get too excited when it comes to your work... Sorry.
After you're cleared by the doctor, go to the Student Affairs Committee and read the regulations again. Carefully.
I will, senior! Oh, and after I'm done, can I still get that autograph...? Anyway, bye for now!
And all Mechcraft upgrades must be approved by the academy before they can be used. That's basic protocol.
The rescued student obediently accepts Sun Bin's safety education and agrees to go to the Student Affairs Committee to accept punishment.

In his search for a lost friend, Sun Bin conducted a temporal experiment that inadvertently caused the flight timer to malfunction. After discovering the issue, he immediately ordered a new batch of timers at Everkeep Clock Shop. He asks for your help to retrieve it, but also warns you to choose your words carefully when talking to the shop owner, Shi Yu, who is famed for his skill but notorious for his temper.
Well, I can't shake the feeling that this is partly my fault.
Why? Don't malfunctions happen all the time during Mechcraft upgrades?
Why? Don't malfunctions happen all the time during Mechcraft upgrades?
Not exactly. I just added an auto adjustment system to the speed module, inspired by Mr. Luban's designs.
It's supposed to make it easier for students to navigate in the air.
I think... it's because of an experiment I've been working on.
I-If I tell you... Promise you won't tell the Team of Stars... especially Novar.
It's actually a time experiment, which has been causing erratic time flows that interfere with the timers.
After I found out about it, I've been running tests on nearby Mechcrafts these past few days.
No wonder Novar said you were gone for quite some time...
No wonder Novar said you were gone for quite some time...
I thought the warning sign here would be enough, so I prioritized other devices over the Dashing Wings. But...
But I should've acted faster. A student almost got hurt...
Hey, don't blame yourself too hard. He broke the rules, remember? Still... why keep this from everyone?
Hey, don't blame yourself too hard. He broke the rules, remember? Still... why keep this from everyone?
Well, any project could be dangerous when time is involved...
If that's the case, then why are you still doing it?
If that's the case, then why are you still doing it?
If this works, I might be able to see him again.
But temporal manipulation... There are just too many uncertainties.
Chaotic time rifts, space being torn apart, enemies teleported from who-knows-where...
That's why it's better to keep this from everyone.
I get it. So how long do you expect the experiment will last?
I get it. So how long do you expect the experiment will last?
Emm... A long time, maybe. But I just have to try.
I appreciate you told me about this... very personal matter, and I can't just pretend it never happened.
I appreciate you told me about this... very personal matter, and I can't just pretend it never happened.
Look, I know I'm not an expert at Mechcrafts, but there has to be something I can do.
Look, I know I'm not an expert at Mechcrafts, but there has to be something I can do.
Well... I guess I'm not surprised.
Honestly, I think... deep down, I was hoping you could help.
You remind me of the friend I'm trying to find... Both so brave and so determined to walk your own path.
In fact... meeting you is what gives me confidence to find him.
I-I think I need your help. Thank you.
Great, then let's do it together. Where do you need me?
Great, then let's do it together. Where do you need me?
I'll stay here and check the other Mechcrafts. But to really solve the problem, we need to replace their timers.
Noted. I'll head over there now.
Noted. I'll head over there now.
Do you know what went wrong?
Hi. Do you think I came off too harsh just now?
It's more like... you didn't want to take no for answer.
It's more like... you didn't want to take no for answer.
Ha, I'm just kidding. But seriously, he was too reckless. You did the right thing.
Ha, I'm just kidding. But seriously, he was too reckless. You did the right thing.
And honestly, it's good to see this side of you. Principled and responsible.
And honestly, it's good to see this side of you. Principled and responsible.
I believe every part of the speed module is functioning normally.
So that leaves only one possibility: the issue was with the <001>Flight Timer</>.
Actually... all the timekeeping devices in this area have been a bit... off lately.
So... do you need my help?
So... do you need my help?
I've already ordered a new batch from <001>Everkeep Clock Shop</>. It's in Frostcloud Town.
Passed down from Navenia, the shop has over a hundred years of history. Its current owner, <001>Shi Yu</>, is a master clockmaker.
Collectors and even royalty from around the world have been fighting over his creations.
If nothing goes wrong, he should have my timers ready today.
But... please be very careful about how you talk to him...
His temper... can a bit eccentric sometimes. Novar and Meng Ya have both been on the receiving end once...
Remember when I told you that I lost my most important friend?
You find the shop closed, with a sign reading "Closed Indefinitely" on the door. Sun Bin asks you to ask around town for information and promises to join you shortly.
How did it go? Have you met Mr. Shi Yu yet?
Can you please ask around? I'll be there soon!
No, the shop's closed. There's a sign saying it's closed indefinitely.
No, the shop's closed. There's a sign saying it's closed indefinitely.
Closed indefinitely? How could that be...
He seemed fine when he took my order. Did something unexpected happen?
Let's see if anyone knows anything.
Let's see if anyone knows anything.
Why is the clock shop closed?
Let me think... His name is <001>Zhang Chenxing</>. Ever since the shop closed, he's been fishing by the river every day.
Excuse me, do you know why the clock shop has closed?
Excuse me, do you know why the clock shop has closed?
Not really. All I know is that Mr. Shi Yu left the shop a while ago and dismissed all his apprentices.
They didn't seem happy about it, but Mr. Shi Yu was adamant.
I think one of his apprentices is still here... Maybe you can ask him.
Okay. Where can I find him?
Okay. Where can I find him?
And um... I believe he's waiting for an old customer on behalf of his master.
Worried that you wouldn't be able to handle the eccentric Master Shiyu, Sun Bin rushed over as soon as he finished his tasks, working with you to crack the mechanisms in the room.
Yeah... I figured it'd be best if I joined you. You know, consider the condition he's in...
So I rushed over right after finishing my work. Glad I made it in time.
I see. That's very thoughtful of you.
I see. That's very thoughtful of you.
Don't mention it. I'm the one asking for your help, after all...
Let's go inside, then. But... this place doesn't look like somewhere people live.
Let's go inside, then. But... this place doesn't look like somewhere people live.
Oh, this... Mr. Shi Yu designed this place himself. Set up a lot of Mechcrafts around it.
We'll need to crack them to get inside.
Actually, solving them can be fun. Back when <001>Tian Ji</> was around, we'd always work together to crack them.
It used to drive Uncle Shi crazy... and he'd set up harder ones for us next time.
He's the one I've been looking for.
Since he disappeared... even the Mechcraft puzzles here have become a lot easier.
Mechcraft puzzles for his own house?
Anyway, it's been a long time since I had a partner to solve these puzzles... I-It actually feels... good.
Yeah... Back when <001>Tian Ji</> was around, we'd always work together to crack them.
It used to drive Uncle Shi crazy... and he'd set up harder ones for us next time.
Worried that you wouldn't be able to handle the eccentric Master Shiyu, Sun Bin rushed over as soon as he finished his tasks, working with you to crack the mechanisms in the room.
Now let's take a look at what we have here.
I've already told you, you still have a few more months if you cooperate!

It turns out Shi Yu is gravely ill but refuses treatment. With at most three months to live, he continues working on Sun Bin's order instead of resting in bed. Shinye, his healer, has no choice but to leave in frustration. Shi Yu notices your arrival and asks you two to come out.
Why won't you listen? It's you life we're talking about! Can you at least put that thing down for a second?!
*Cough*... Letting you in was a mistake.
This is Everkeep's final order... *Cough* And it's from that kid at the School of Mechcraft.
If I don't deliver it... *Cough*... I must deliver it.
I've heard the kid's been doing so well in that... Star Team or whatever.
Okay, good. So? You have to stop worrying about others now!
*Cough*... Hehe, so impatient yet kind. You remind me of when I was young.
*Cough* Hey, kid... if I take this "Revival Powder", will I still be able to continue my work?
Of course not! You'll need to have a good rest in bed. Let the medicine balance your Yin and Yang and dissolve the toxins...
What if I need to go out?
Go out? I'm offering a chance for you to live here, and all you care about is whether you can go out?
Please, you have to follow my instructions!
I see... *Cough*... Then you may go back.
What...? So you're refusing my treatment?
*Cough* With the new set of movement gears I've installed, that kid should be happy this time.
Some people fight desperately to live, while some don't seem to care at all. I should've learned to accept this by now.
I'm leaving now, but... ever change your mind, you know where to find me.
Just give me a straight answer today — do you trust me or not?
Last time, I said your "depressed emotions have caused meridian stagnation, stirring inner fire within the organs".
But after all the delay, your liver and spleen are both damaged and a tumor has formed. This is a fatal condition!
Luckily, you have me. My "Revival Powder" can at least buy you three more months!
Hmm, this movement plan seems even better...
*Cough*... You guys can come out now. I know you've been listening in for a while.

Having completed Sun Bin's order, Shi Yu suggests Sun Bin let go of the past. Sun Bin urges him to accept treatment, but Shi Yu deflects by asking you to retrieve the flight timers' instruction manual as well as a pocket watch.
Here for the timers, huh? You're just in time... *Cough*... Wait, who's this kid with you?
*Cough*... You know those Herbalists. Always exaggerate things even with the mildest symptoms!
What? Am I wrong? I know how much the Team of Stars to you. Still...
So you. A new friend, huh? *Cough* Hmm... You do look more reliable than Novar and Meng Ya.
Then you must be the one who helped Sun Bin uncover the secrets of Yango's puppet design...
And I heard you guys created Star No. 7 together. Finally lightened the load on Luban's heart.
Well, it was a team effort...
Well, it was a team effort...
*Cough*... Don't be too modest. I've known this kid for a long time. Know all that's going on in his mind.
*Cough* I'm old and sick, kid. And... I might not get another chance to say this.
Making Star No. 7 for Luban is great, but can old friendships really be replaced?
Oh? Hey kid, it's you. *Cough*... Then it's not surprising you got around the puzzle outside.
You always care so much about your friends, but you... you're still stuck in the past yourself, aren't you?
Stuck in the past? Are you talking about Tian Ji?
Stuck in the past? Are you talking about Tian Ji?
That was before I got sick. *Cough* The timers are ready. Take them and go.
You've heard about him? Then you two must be really close. *Cough*... Kid, do me a favor and talk some sense into him. Dwelling on the past isn't a good thing.
Here for the timers, huh? You're just in time... *Cough*... Wait, who's this kid with you?
Just bring it here first. And you, find the manual for the timers. It should be somewhere over there too.
The timers can wait, Uncle Shi. But your illness... are you really going to just give up?
Ahem... You kids are always worrying about others.
Now back to business. Go and grab that <001>pocket watch</> of yours from the bookshelf.
Quit standing here and go. *Cough*... A little pain is nothing for me.
T-This is a new member of the Team of Stars... and my new friend.
By the way, I heard you talking just now... How are you really feeling, Uncle Shi?
I... I just don't want to give up...
B-But... you were the one who encouraged me to keep searching before...
Shi Yu shows you and Sun Bin a century-old pendulum clock brought to Jixia by the shop's founder from Navenia. Its intricate design now lies silent, though, as it has stopped functioning.
Is this... the <001>Coral Gilt Pendulum Clock</> that the founder of Everkeep brought from Navenia a century ago?
Back then, the founder disassembled the clock into dozens of parts and shipped it across the ocean to Jixia. Caused a huge sensation here.
Even Master Mozi brought his students to admire the work together. Even now, he still speaks highly of its craftsmanship.
Then, our founder stayed and founded Everkeep Clock Shop in Jixia. It's been passed down for three generations now.
And this clock... it's always been here, standing witness to the passage of time.
Haha. Sadly, though, it's stopped working.
I heard it was originally created to boost the morale of soldiers during wartime.
Whenever they won a battle, it would play a special chime in the city center—
A stirring melody accompanied by deep, resonant bell sounds that echoed throughout the streets.
It let their families know they had returned victorious and they would soon reunite.
The mechanical structure inside is incredibly complex. In fact, it stopped working generations ago.
Back when the bell still rang, two exquisite mechanical figures would slide out from the sides and embrace each other.
But I only saw them do that once, when I was about your age.
You've bragged about it so many times...
Alright, that's the end of it.
A piece of passionate and melodious percussion music, accompanied by deep and resonant bell tolls, echoed throughout the city.
zh_text: 一段激昂悠扬的敲击音乐，伴以醇厚悠扬的钟声，响彻整座城市。
source_text: 一段激昂悠扬的敲击音乐，伴以醇厚悠扬的钟声，响彻整座城市。
official_target_text: A piece of passionate and melodious percussion music, accompanied by deep and resonant bell tolls, echoed throughout the city.
official_en_text: A piece of passionate and melodious percussion music, accompanied by deep and resonant bell tolls, echoed throughout the city.

text: U-Uncle Shi, I'm here to pick up the timers.
Shi Yu takes Dr. Bian's medicine while you're gone, gaining temporary strength to walk at the cost of hastening his death—he has important matters to attend to...
Exactly... And he sure lives up to his reputation.
This pill box... it's from Dr Bian!
They say it can bring someone back from the brink of death...
So... does that mean you are cured? That's good, right?
So... does that mean you are cured? That's good, right?
The pill can only remain effective for a limited time — a few weeks at most, or just a few days...
In fact... it's trading what little <001>time</> I have left for a period of full energy.
So by taking this pill... you're actually overloading yourself?
So by taking this pill... you're actually overloading yourself?
Look at me now. Isn't this better than just sitting there, barely clinging to life?
I can do what I want again... and no more coughing...
What?! You... you took that pill?
You always said you hoped no one would ever need to use it...
True, but things change, right? Hah, it's okay. I feel great now!
What kind of pill is it?
What kind of pill is it?
When Uncle Shi was young, he once crafted a sophisticated clock for Yong. Amazing work, indeed.
In return, he was gifted this... "magic pill".
A few days, a few weeks... what difference does it make when my death is certain?
Enough with the "buts". I still have important things to do. From now on, every second counts for me.
Oh, no more crying like you used to do? I'm glad you understand, kid.
So... what do you want to do?
Let's go! I wonder what's behind the waterfall...
Shi Yu... how dare you shut down our master's shop!
This really brings back memories... the time when Tian Ji was here.

Shi Yu explains that he took the medicine in order to repair this clock. As you part ways, he entrusts you with watching over Sun Bin, warning you not to let him venture into some "ruin." He hints that Sun Bin's lost legs are somehow connected to that place.
So this is your last wish...
To get it working again, yes.
Nothing is more important for me right now than <001>fixing this clock</>.
My life may have come to an end, but the clock... I hope it'll carry on the legacy of Everkeep.
And before I go... I want to hear the bell chime one more time and see those two figures again...
Are you sure you'll be fine? And why are you carrying these weapons?
Are you sure you'll be fine? And why are you carrying these weapons?
Of course I'll be fine. I paid a high price for it.
As for the weapons, they'll come in handy.
Okay, no time for chit-chat now. I'm literally on a clock here.
Oh, and Sun Bin... I'm afraid you'll have to find someone else to repair your pocket watch.
I've rebuilt the casing, so the time energy inside shouldn't be leaking anymore.
The energy's for opening that door, right? In any case, I hope you can see Tian Ji again one day.
And kid, can you keep an eye on Sun Bin for me? Until his theories are verified, don't let him near that damn ruin!
He does not want his Mechcraft legs to break again.
I'll explain when the time is right. A-And I promise I won't put myself... or my friends... in danger.
By the way, can we help with what you're doing?
It's okay. I want to do this myself.
So, I guess this is it then. I believe one day, you will be able to move on, with or without this pocket watch...
I'm grateful for all the time we've spent together, kid.
<001>Fixing this clock</>—that is, of course, the most important thing right now.
zh_text: <001>修好这座钟</>——当然就是现在最重要的事。
source_text: <001>修好这座钟</>——当然就是现在最重要的事。
official_target_text: <001>Fixing this clock</>—that is, of course, the most important thing right now.
official_en_text: <001>Fixing this clock</>—that is, of course, the most important thing right now.

text: This is goodbye now. Don't follow me.
I should use the rest of my time to do something that matters...

On the cliff behind the academy rests a pair of Dashing Wings, said to have been upgraded by Sun Bin himself. An admirer of his uses it to launch himself in the air, but fails to control the flight and falls from the sky. Fortunately, Sun Bin arrives just in time, and with his temporal powers, you two manage to save the student.
This is amazing! The wings can now maintain optimal speed in the air automatically!
I mean, how did he do this... Ah! What's happening?! Help!!!
I've got this. Now go and catch him!
(panicked landing, quick breaths then a relieved sigh) Um... Phew...
Last time I talked to Uncle Shi, I mentioned the beasts carrying mysterious marks in the mountains.
They found the energy was strong enough to power large Mechcrafts...
With those big weapons he had... I think he wants to try it on his clock!
Apparently, that giant bear has the strongest power. No one has been able to contain it.
Uncle Shi is already sick, and even with the magic pill, he'll stand no chance against the animal!
Fixing that clock must really mean the world to him.
Fixing that clock must really mean the world to him.
Just like how I want to fix my pocket watch, I understand how he feels. But he shouldn't risk his life for it...
Let's find him first. The giant bear is near the <001>Mauvemist Valley</> waterfall, to the northeast. We must hurry.
Got it. Then what about the timers?
Got it. Then what about the timers?
Don't worry, I'll have some of my classmates pick them up.
Some Mechcraft students have been extracting their energy for experiments, and...
Sun Bin receives the pocket watch.
Is this your pocket watch? It looks... broken?
Is this your pocket watch? It looks... broken?
It does... So even Uncle Shi couldn't fix it...
Huh? He's using a clock again... Just like the old times.
I'll power it up. You keep an eye on its pointer.
Why won't it open? Let me think...
There should be another trigger inside. We'll need to activate both Mechcrafts to unlock the door!
Thanks! I'll activate this one first.
Sun Bin hints at the mechcraft.
The other Mechcraft should be somewhere in this room...
Sun Bin prompts the player to shoot the target.
The clock has been activated. Now look at the targets around us.
Maybe the pointer's direction is the key?
I have to stay here and fix the Dashing Wings. Counting on you to collect the <001>flight timers</> now!
Why is the clock shop closed?
Excuse me, do you know why the clock shop closed?
Excuse me, do you know why the clock shop closed?
I'm not sure either. I wanted to visit yesterday, but it was already closed.
I heard the shop's craftsmanship comes from Navenia. Too bad it's closed...
Why is the clock shop closed?
Excuse me, do you know why the clock shop closed?
Excuse me, do you know why the clock shop closed?
Sorry, we don't. It's been closed for a few days now.
The owner, Shi Yu, has always been a bit odd. Who knows what he's up to?
Ah, here it is — "Flight Timer User Manual."
Ah, here it is — "Flight Timer User Manual."
Mr. Shi just locked the door on his way out...
Mr. Shi just locked the door on his way out...
He wanted to leave alone... Let me find a way to open it!
This must be the <001>Everkeep Clock Shop</> Sun Bin mentioned.
This must be the <001>Everkeep Clock Shop</> Sun Bin mentioned.
Who was that old man just now?
Who was that old man just now?
Closed until further notice? What do I do now?
Closed until further notice? What do I do now?
“Indefinite closure”...? Oh no, what should I do now?
zh_text: “无限期停业”……？糟糕，这下该怎么办呢？
source_text: “无限期停业”……？糟糕，这下该怎么办呢？
official_target_text: “Indefinite closure”...? Oh no, what should I do now?

text: Your attacks create an opening for Sun Bin to restrain the Mechanoid, allowing you to deliver a final, decisive blow. \nThe chaotic time field dissipates, and the objects suspended in midair drift gently back to the ground. All is calm once more.
The time and space here has been warped... This place must have been a Mechcraft trial ground before!
Defeat them first, but be careful!
Oh... That is a very big one...!
They used to train with this back in the day?
With everything in place, Sun Bin calls for Zera and Shi Yu to meet on the island.
I'm alright too. I'll have both of them come over here now.
Whew, finally... Are... are you okay?
The Intendant — I mean, Zera. Do you think she'll come?
The Intendant — I mean, Zera. Do you think she'll come?
I've done my part, and now... We can only try.
As for Uncle Shi... I'm sure he'll come.
Actually, before coming here, I sent him a message under Zera's name. I'm sure she'll have found out by now.
She never admits it, but I do believe she wants this reunion, too. Let's hope she'll come...
I see. What you have done for them is really impressive.
I see. What you have done for them is really impressive.
I... I just did what I had to do... Let's wait here, then.
It must have been reset by the time field...
How did it get back there again?
How did it get back there again?
This time field... You actually did it...
I've kept my promise. So... what do you think?
Then let's see this miracle of yours, kid.
Hi. Look, the Intendant is over there.

Shi Yu has passed away. Zera conveys his final words to Sun Bin—that what he seeks will come in time. Sun Bin's pocket watch advanced a single tick, and he suspects it could be a signal from Tian Ji. The Intendant permits him to continue his research within safety limits.
Intendant... T-This monument says... Shi Yu...?
Shinye told me his body was failing for years. It's a miracle he lasted this long.
And when we met, he said he had no regrets, and...
He was grateful to have known you. Tian Ji, and you two.
He was grateful to have known you. Tian Ji, and you two.
He also asked me to keep an eye on you—to be patient and stay safe in your search for Tian Ji.
He also told me—and all of us—not to be sad about this. He already lived a good life.
I thought you were being naive, but you proved me wrong through your actions.
Oh, and, the Forbidden Chamber has confirmed that the parameters of your experiments are within safety limits. You can continue.
By the way... After what we did that day, my pocket watch actually moved!
Oh? The one that's been broken for years?
Will come in time... I-I see...
The time field you created last time was incredibly intense. I've only seen such strong energy in the Temporal Ruins...
So... yes. There is a slight chance it was from him.
He felt so lucky that Tian Ji brought you to him. And in some way, it also gave us a chance to meet again.
It's okay, kid. Oh, and... he left you a message that day.
I was but a candle flickering out, yet in my final moments... I glimpsed a spark of hope.
Yeah, that stubborn man. Maybe he's still grumbling somewhere, mad at me for not seeing him all these years.
But still, you'll need to report to us regularly. And in case something comes up, I want you to progress the research together.
Even in his last moments, Uncle Shi was thinking of us...
You can count on us, Intendant.
You can count on us, Intendant.
Th-Thank you. I won't let you down.
Maybe... Maybe one day, you really will conquer time and find what you're determined to find.
Thank you, Intendant. I will remember your words. Strange, I kind of feel like Uncle Shi is still here with us...
Yes. And although it was only by one minute mark, could it be... a signal from Tian Ji...?
Thank you, kids, for freeing me from the cage of time. I couldn't think of a better ending than this.
“So, kid, never be afraid. Life is a grand dream; though it passes like water without a trace, as long as you persist, you will eventually hear an echo in the silence.”
Thank you for letting me break free from the eternal cage and witness the immortality of life. The end of time is nothing more than that.
zh_text: “谢谢你，让我挣脱永恒的牢笼，见证生命的不朽。时间的终局，也不过尔尔罢了。”
source_text: “谢谢你，让我挣脱永恒的牢笼，见证生命的不朽。时间的终局，也不过尔尔罢了。”
official_target_text: Thank you for letting me break free from the eternal cage and witness the immortality of life. The end of time is nothing more than that.
official_en_text: Thank you for letting me break free from the eternal cage and witness the immortality of life. The end of time is nothing more than that.

text: The Intendant wants to see Sun Bi and me. I wonder what it's about...
The Intendant wants to see Sun Bi and me. I wonder what it's about...

Sun Bin devises a plan to reverse time so that Zera and Shi Yu can meet at the same timeline, but he needs to confirm a few things first. He asks you to meet him at his workshop in Darkpool Camp to go over details.
We've been teleported out... I never expected the Intendant to be Zera.
We've been teleported out... I never expected the Intendant to be Zera.
Do you think... we should tell Mr. Shi Yu about this?
Do you think... we should tell Mr. Shi Yu about this?
At least not for now. You saw just how determined the Intendant was. I don't think we can change her mind any time soon.
So... what do we do now?
So... what do we do now?
I... I want to try something...
M-Maybe... But I need to verify my theories first... I'll explain later.
What? Can you really do that?
What? Can you really do that?
Can you meet me later at my <001>workshop</> in the <001>Darkpool Camp</>?
I want to make their timelines cross again. Back to when they were with each other.

Sun Bin explains that at the top of Stargazing Terrace, he has installed a Temporal Mech Core to collect scattered time energy into the pocket watch. This device can be used to alter the speed of time flow. He instructs you to follow the Grand Orbit outside to reach it.
Then I used the energy collected to create a small temporal field, and I was really able to alter the flow of time within its radius.
Okay, the device remains stable for now...
There at the very top of Stargazing Terrace — a <001>Temporal Mech Core</>.
Time energy? Here at the Stargazing Terrace?
Time energy? Here at the Stargazing Terrace?
According to it, every star in the universe anchors a unique spacetime dimension, radiating distinct energies.
I verified the theory and found that there really are faint traces of time energy in the air...
That's right. In fact, Uncle Shi was the one who told me about this. A hypothesis from Navenia.
Exactly. I made this core and placed it high up there to collect scattered time energy.
This way, I don't have to go to the Temporal Ruins and put myself in danger again. Then, the purest strands of the energy will be stored in my pocket watch.
I'll go first to make some preparations. You can go up by following the <001>Grand Orbital</> around the building.
You reach the top and see Sun Bin's Time-Energy Mechanism Core. It seems all the energy of the Stargazing Terrace is converging here, and you prepare to take it.
Incredible... It seems like all the energy is converging here...
Incredible... It seems like all the energy is converging here...
I've made multiple adjustments already, but the strong time energy is still making the extraction very difficult.
I'm going to take it down now. Be careful, there might be an energy surge...
It almost felt like an earthquake just now...
It almost felt like an earthquake just now...
Y-yes... The time flow inside is more chaotic than I expected. I might need your help later.
Uncle Shi mentioned that the last time he met Zera was on a small island in a lake.
Once I complete the preparation, I'll tell them to meet me there...
I want them to have one last reunion. To bring closure for them both.
You reach the top and see Sun Bin's Time-Energy Mechanism Core. It seems all the energy of the Stargazing Terrace is converging here, and you prepare to take it.
At the peak of Stargazing Terrace, you secure the Temporal Mech Core. Its power is overwhelming—recovering it sends ripples of energy through the nearby buildings. Luckily, everything remains intact.
It almost felt like an earthquake just now...
It almost felt like an earthquake just now...
Y-yes... The energy inside was even more chaotic than I expected. Luckily, the extraction was successful.
Uncle Shi mentioned that the last time he met Zera was on a small island in a lake.
I want them to have one last reunion there.
To bring closure for them both...

After setting up the device, Sun Bin prepares to activate the temporal field so that Zera and Shi Yu can meet across the time gap. Worried that the time flow could spiral out of control, he urges you to leave—but you insist that, as teammates, you must act together.
Next, I'll create the time field with the Mech Core. I'm not sure if it'll actually work, but...
This is the place... I've already completed the setup.
However, to reverse time, the scale of the field will have to be exceptionally large.
It is likely that the time flow on the entire island would spiral out of control...
If that happens, things can get very dangerous. Maybe... maybe you should stay away for now...?
And miss out on something like this? No way.
And miss out on something like this? No way.
Besides, we are teammates, aren't we? Or do you not trust me?
Besides, we are teammates, aren't we? Or do you not trust me?
We have to do this for them.
We have to do this for them.
Exactly. I hope this can finally help bridge the temporal rift between them for a long overdue reconciliation.
You must retrieve the Mech Core from midair. To keep you safe, Sun Bin entrusts you with the precious pocket watch containing time energy, which can be used to slow down obstacles around you.
Well... I was already being as careful as I could. But the energy flow was just too strong...
We need to keep powering up the field to stabilize it, but the Mech Core went up into the air...
No! It's too dangerous... What if...
But... I know how much it means to you...
But... I know how much it means to you...
Just as I told you, I've stored the purest time energy in this pocket watch.
It does. This is my best chance to find Tian Ji...
It can slow down time around you, making it safer for you to navigate through obstacles...
Alright, then I'll return it to you once I'm back.
Alright, then I'll return it to you once I'm back.
But now, I want it to keep you safe.
I think I can use the pocket watch to slow it down.
I think I can use the pocket watch to slow it down.
I'll stay here and keep working on the devices. You must be careful on your way up!

Examines the pocket watch, Sun Bin vows before his beloved uncle, Shi Yu, that he will reunite with Tian Ji. The pendulum clock chimes through the mountains once more, its sound commemorating the eternity of time...
I once asked Master Zhuangzi if what's beyond the Gate of Time was just a dream.
Now it seems... it's definitely more real than that...
Trust me, Uncle Shi... I will find a way to get Tian Ji back. No matter what it takes.
Sun Bin activates the Temporal Mech Core. Suddenly, the time energy erupts into a massive energy storm that lifts boulders and debris into the air, affecting the entire island.
Time flows ever onward, its whispers only the patient souls can hear.
Wish it could guide me one day...

Leafy returns to her youthful form upon entering the field. Shi Yu ascends the dial staircase, growing younger with each step. They finally meet, eyes brimming with tears, as Sun Bin uses his precious pocket-watch energy to secure their reunion.
The voice of Shi Yu reading the letter.
I was but a candle flickering out, yet in my final moments... I glimpsed a spark of hope.
Thank you, kids, for freeing me from the cage of time. I couldn't think of a better ending than this.
“So, kid, never be afraid. Life is a grand dream; though it passes like water without a trace, as long as you persist, you will eventually hear an echo in the silence.”
I was but a flickering candle, but with the help of the little ghost, in my final moments, I gained a fleeting moment of spring.
zh_text: “我本是残烛之身，得小鬼相助，于弥留之际，获春华一瞬。”
source_text: “我本是残烛之身，得小鬼相助，于弥留之际，获春华一瞬。”

text: All things must end, but the journey is still hopeful...

Sun Bin shows you the prosthetic legs Master Mozi made for him. He also explains his plan: to use time energy stored in the pocket watch—originally intended to locate Tian Ji—to help Shi Yu. Together, you set off for Stargazing Terrace to put the idea into practice.
Hey, sorry for keeping you waiting. I was a bit caught up in my work.
It's totally fine. I was just looking around. And I saw this...
It's totally fine. I was just looking around. And I saw this...
Oh... I-It's okay. These prosthetic legs are a part of me now. I don't mind the others seeing them.
I'm so happy to hear that.
I'm so happy to hear that.
I did cry when trying them on for the first time, but I bounced back quickly. After all, nothing is more important than saving my friend.
Besides, Master Mozi went through fifteen versions to perfect them for me. They are a masterpiece!
At first, every step was difficult for me. But after all the testing and upgrades, I was finally able to walk and jump like everyone else.
Later, I got a pair of Mechwings from Luban. Now I can go anywhere I want and fast!
That's really great to hear. The waterproofing on these materials still needs work, though.
That's really great to hear. The waterproofing on these materials still needs work, though.
Haha, I know. To be honest, I kind of prefer who I am now.
It's important you think that way.
Really? Th-Thank you. Anyway, we should get back to business.
I want to use the time energy I've collected to create a temporal array. It's supposed to reverse the flow of time to a preset point. Only for a short while, though...
This pocket watch contains the purest time energy I've gathered from my experiments.
But... aren't you saving it to open the Temporal Ruins and find Tian Ji?
But... aren't you saving it to open the Temporal Ruins and find Tian Ji?
It's okay. I can do it once, I can do it again...
What happened to Tian Ji taught me the most important lesson of time — "impermanence".
Like sometimes when I think of our Team of Stars, I'd fear the day we might part.
We'll all graduate someday... And what if there were to be another accident like the Temporal Ruins, separating us again?
Hmm... I think I understand you.
Hmm... I think I understand you.
Even just a month ago, who would've thought Uncle Shi would fall ill like this?
But unlike the last time, I will not give up easily, and... I want to make things different.
I will help Uncle Shi see Zera again, and I will get Tian Ji back...
Others may not believe me, but I do think I can take back what time has stolen from us.
I get it. Then let us fight time together.
I get it. Then let us fight time together.
Okay. Now there's one more thing we need before we get started. Let's go to <001>Stargazing Terrace</>.
At first, I couldn't jump onto slightly higher stone slopes or steps. After constant testing and upgrades, I was finally able to walk and jump like a normal person.
zh_text: 一开始，无法跳上稍高的石坡和阶梯，经过不断的测试升级，我才终于和常人一样能走能跳。
source_text: 一开始，无法跳上稍高的石坡和阶梯，经过不断的测试升级，我才终于和常人一样能走能跳。

Prototype 000 at your service. May all students achieve their dreams.
