A pair of Mechcraft prosthetics, just like the one Sun Bin is wearing...
A pair of Mechcraft prosthetics, just like the one Sun Bin is wearing...
This photo here... "First Prize in the Mechcraft Competition. Winning Work: Prototype Discipline Dog..."
This photo here... "First Prize in the Mechcraft Competition. Winning Work: Prototype Discipline Dog..."
There's Sun Bin. And the boy next to him... Tian Ji, perhaps?
There's Sun Bin. And the boy next to him... Tian Ji, perhaps?
You arrive at Sun Bin's home. Feeling bad for not hosting you properly last time, he invites you to look around.
The player arrives at Sun Bin's home.
You're here already? S-Sorry... I still need a bit more time.
Why don't you rest here for a while... or take a look around if you feel like it...
I didn't have enough time to take you for a quick tour here last time, and... I feel really bad about that...
Oh, it's nothing. I'll take a look around now.
Oh, it's nothing. I'll take a look around now.
She found the Temporal Ruins and repaired the pendulum clock. But it came at a terrible cost...
The time energy reshaped the "Flow" in her body, freezing her in the form of a young girl.
She tried everything, but to no avail.
Until one day, she heard another student had stumbled into those ruins...
His friend got sucked into the time vortex, and he lost his legs...
But that kid, like her, never gives up.
Both of them waiting... for a miracle that will never come.

Once, a girl entered the Temporal Ruins to help a close friend repair a clock. Tragically, she was frozen by the time energy in the form of a young girl and slept for decades. And when she woke up, she witnessed Sun Bin losing his legs and his best friend in the same place. She hopes he can let go of the past and stop chasing a miracle that will never come...
She found the Temporal Ruins and got the clock ticking again.
But it came at a terrible cost...
The time energy reshaped the "Flow" in her body, freezing her in the form of a young girl.
She tried all that she could to reverse it, only to fall into a decades-long slumber...
And when she finally woke up... Well, everything had changed.
Waiting for a miracle that will never come.
Once there was a girl who people believed was cursed. She had only one friend, a boy from the clock shop.
When the boy was struggling to fix an ancient clock, she offered to help without hesitation.
Among them, one student stumbled into the ruins just like her. And he suffered the same fate of losing his friend...
But that kid just won't give up. He's still trying, searching...
Umm... We have to cut the power for the energy source...
Done! You can go in now!
You must find the entrance. I'll stay here in case any Mechanoid shows up.
Sun Bin tells you that he was distracted because this is a fragment of the Space-Time Gate, which is how Tian Ji went missing.
T-Thank you... I would've touched it and set off the alarm if you hadn't come...
If so, we're going to get caught for sure...
You looked like a different person just now... What's inside?
You looked like a different person just now... What's inside?
A piece of the Gate of Time... Tian Ji disappeared because of it.
That day, I awakened this gate by accident and triggered a fluctuation of time. Almost fell off a cliff.
And when Tian Ji rushed to save me, he... I just watched him get pulled into the temporal vortex...
Now how did its fragment end up here...
Sun Bin tells you that he was distracted because this is a fragment of the Space-Time Gate, which is how Tian Ji went missing.

The Intendant, Leafy, appears. She gives Sun Bin three days to abandon all time experiments, or the devices will be confiscated. Sun Bin, in the meantime, notices traces of temporal turbulence within her body. To persuade him to stop, the Intendant shares a story:
Novar first, and now Sun Bin. And you — you're always with them.
Since you love here so much, why don't you just move in, huh?
Why? The Forbidden Chamber houses all kinds of dangerous items found in Jixia.
Speaking of which, are you still running time experiments at Stargazing Terrace? Maybe it's time I locked your equipment here?
Intendant, I see the fragment of the Gate of Time here... Why?
It's our chamber's job to know about these things. And that old man Shi Yu is still helping you make the timers.
I-Is that why you are investigating him?... M-My experiment has nothing to do with others!
Safe? Have you forgotten how unstable the energy can be within the Temporal Ruins?
Well, well, kids. Do you really think this is your playground?
You have three days to cease all your experiments at Stargazing Terrace. If you don't comply, we'll confiscate your equipment.
B-But Intendant... I've already made some improvements, and... I promise it's safe now.
You should know better than to tamper with it.
When we went to collect the fragment of the Game of Time, yes. Why do you ask?
Then... you must have also been exposed to the power of time.
Oh? What makes you say that?
We'll see about that. Now on behalf of the Forbidden Chamber, I issue a formal warning to you, Sun Bin from the School of Mechcraft.
Tian Ji and I went to your lecture years ago. And you described the place as if you had been there...
The Intendant possesses wisdom and insight far beyond her years. It's like she's got more time than us. Those were his exact words.
You kids sure have got some keen eyes. But this is no more than mere speculation.
And I can sense the chaotic time flow within your body every time we meet... one you're trying hard to suppress.
It's the same kind of power that broke my legs at the Temporal Ruins... I can't be wrong.
In that case... Okay, you're right. But if you think I'll go easy on you because of our similar experiences, you're mistaken.
Ah, you silly child... Look, I understand you. Trust me, I do. But there are things in this world that can't be fixed.
I won't give up, though... I'm willing to join Tian Ji if that's what it takes to bring him back.
In fact, the Forbidden Chamber has been watching you since you first started your time experiments.
I know how many risks you've taken to find your friend. But sometimes, things just don't go as planned.
I know, b-but... but you have been there too, have you?
You know what? Let me share you a story...
One I've always kept buried... until now. I hope it helps when it comes to making your own decisions.

Everyone who has met the Master of the Secret Pavilion says she is a genius girl, but she possesses a maturity and insight far beyond her years—it is not talent, but the accumulation of time. I still remember Tian Ji's words back then.
zh_text: “见过的人都说秘禁阁主是天才少女，可阁主有着远超年龄的成熟和见地，不是天赋而是时间的累积。”我还记得田忌当时的话。
source_text: “见过的人都说秘禁阁主是天才少女，可阁主有着远超年龄的成熟和见地，不是天赋而是时间的累积。”我还记得田忌当时的话。
official_target_text: Everyone who has met the Master of the Secret Pavilion says she is a genius girl, but she possesses a maturity and insight far beyond her years—it is not talent, but the accumulation of time. I still remember Tian Ji's words back then.
official_en_text: Everyone who has met the Master of the Secret Pavilion says she is a genius girl, but she possesses a maturity and insight far beyond her years—it is not talent, but the accumulation of time. I still remember Tian Ji's words back then.

text: The Intendant reveals that she is in fact Zera. Time energy has forever frozen her appearance, so she refuses to meet Shi Yu again out of fear it'd be too much for him to take. Drawing from her own experience, Zera warns Sun Bin to halt his experiments and instructs both of you to leave.
I understand you, but time has its own laws. Those who try to mess with them will get punished for it. I'm the best example.
After that incident, I pulled all the resources from the Forbidden Chamber in search of a cure, but... clearly that wasn't enough.
So when I see such strong determination in you, it starts to worry me...
You've already lost your legs. What will you lose next?
Thank you. I understand your concerns, but... Why didn't you just tell Uncle Shi the truth?
Time, very cruelly, created an irreversible gap between us.
After learning of his illness, I did consider paying him a visit.
But every time I looked in the mirror, I gave up on the idea. It's just... I don't think this is how Shi Yu wants to remember me.
I want "Zera" to stay in his memories as that beautiful young girl, and not this... ageless freak.
It's already too late. He's already in poor health, and if he doesn't take this too well... I don't want that.
It's enough that he remembers the happy memories we shared...
After waking up from the sleep, nothing in the world was as I remembered...
And Shi Yu, he... he had become an old man...
You? Wait, then the girl in the story... was you! You're... Zera?
Sometimes, others will suffer the consequences of the decisions we make. I don't want you to follow in my footsteps.
I see... But he still misses you so much...
So you had the Mechcraft Kite take the Coppercore to stop him from repairing the clock?
So you had the Mechcraft Kite take the Coppercore to stop him from repairing the clock?
You've been here too long. Time to leave now.
It's been confiscated. End of story.
I'm sure he wouldn't see you that way! T-There's still time... You can still do it before it's too late!
But if fails, he'll live the rest of his days in regret.
No, he'll live in regret if I don't show up after the clock is repaired.
So you won't see him... even at the end?
Wait! What if... what if I can reverse time?
Hah, this won't work, kid. I'm not a fan of hypotheticals.
Please, learn from my mistakes and stop your time experiments right away. Now, leave. I'm tired.
Enough. I've already made up my mind on this.
A miracle that will never come? N-No... that's not true. I-I... I will find him.
An impossible miracle? No, that's not it... I believe that as long as I can persist, I will definitely reach it.
zh_text: “毫无可能的奇迹”么？不、不是这样的……我相信只要能坚持，就一定能抵达。
source_text: “毫无可能的奇迹”么？不、不是这样的……我相信只要能坚持，就一定能抵达。
official_target_text: An impossible miracle? No, that's not it... I believe that as long as I can persist, I will definitely reach it.
official_en_text: An impossible miracle? No, that's not it... I believe that as long as I can persist, I will definitely reach it.

text: Sun Bin leads you to an underground ruin in search of a Cracked Coppercore, but the area is occupied by Rebels. To avoid damaging the relic during head-on confrontation, you decide to sneak in and activate their Mechanoids to lure them away. Sun Bin reminds you that the bushes can conceal your movements.
So what do we do now? Just charge in?
So what do we do now? Just charge in?
Got it. Leave it to me.
Got it. Leave it to me.
Uncle Shi wants to make a replica of it, and the School of Mechcraft has agreed to let us borrow it.
There's an underground ruin here. One that stores a unique ancient Mechcraft component — the Cracked Coppercore.
But it looks like the Rebels have taken the place for themselves.
But it looks like the Rebels have taken the place for themselves.
N-No... The Rebels don't play by the rules. And they can be very desperate sometimes.
Yeah, and they've found a way to shut down those Mechanoid guards sent by the academy.
When they cannot get what they want... Well, I've seen them destroy things more than once...
I've brought some energy cores. They should allow me to activate those Mechanoids from here.
That way, I can use them draw the Rebels away so we can search the camp.
But to install the cores, we'll need to <001>sneak in</> without being spotted.
Okay... I'll stay and keep watch here. You can use the bushes to cover your tracks.
It's not the first or second time they've just destroyed things in a panic...
zh_text: 一着急，把东西直接毁掉的事他们也不是做一次两次了……
source_text: 一着急，把东西直接毁掉的事他们也不是做一次两次了……
official_target_text: It's not the first or second time they've just destroyed things in a panic...
official_en_text: It's not the first or second time they've just destroyed things in a panic...

text: I-Impressive as always... Alright, here it goes...
I don't think they've solved the puzzle down there yet. Let's go take a look.
Hmm... This is definitely the place, but it looks pretty deep...
This must be the Coppercore. Guess I'll have to unlock the barrier first.
This must be the Coppercore. Guess I'll have to unlock the barrier first.

After defeating the Rebels, you and Sun Bin learn they were hired by an elderly woman to find the Cracked Coppercore. Sun Bin suspects the woman might be Zera. He lets the Rebels go with a warning, and you successfully retrieve the component.
Stop! Senior Sun Bin! We surrender!
Of course we do. We've heard all about you since our time at the School of Mechcraft. You and your iconic Mechwings.
An old person... Could it be... Zera?!
Of course, of course! We'll take our leave now.
Do you really think they'll follow the rules from now...?
Do you really think they'll follow the rules from now...?
You were from the School of Mechcraft...? No wonder you're after the Coppercore.
What, no... Actually, someone paid us a big price to get it.
So you are professional treasure hunters now?
So you are professional treasure hunters now?
Someone else is looking for it? Who?
An old person, I think. I didn't pay much attention to who it was. We just do what we're paid to do, period.
What a coincidence. Maybe we should wait here till the pickup time.
What a coincidence. Maybe we should wait here till the pickup time.
W-We'll let you go this time... But remember, you must not violate the academy regulations ever again.
I certainly hope so. Now who could've hired them...?
By the way, I got the part down there just now. Take a look.
By the way, I got the part down there just now. Take a look.
The one who shows up is not Zera, though—it's another familiar face...
Someone's coming... I don't think it's Zera.
Huh? Why does he look familiar to me?
Huh? Why does he look familiar to me?

Uncle Jia shows up. He intends to use the Coppercore as leverage to make Shi Yu hand over the clock shop. He believes Shi Yu only inherited the shop because of Zera's help. When he learns that Shi Yu is gravely ill, though, Uncle Jia is taken aback. He tells you to keep the component safe and sets out to find Shi Yu himself.
That's me. But I don't know you.
What... Who are you? Where are those Rebel guys?
You... You're the man I saw at the clock shop. Uncle Jia, right?
You... You're the man I saw at the clock shop. Uncle Jia, right?
Are you helping Uncle Shi repair the clock too?
Are you kidding me? I'm using the Coppercore as leverage to get him to hand over the shop to me.
He shouldn't have inherited the shop in the first place, and now he wants to close it?! He's throwing our legacy away!
If it weren't for the help of that "jinx", he never would've been able to fix the pendulum clock.
Ah, you know about her? That one was born with immense Sorcery Energy—but it's a curse that hurts anyone who gets close.
When she was sixteen, her power attracted some feral monsters that fed on it... Her parents died protecting her. Caused quite a stir back then.
No wonder she was isolated... How tragic.
Speaking of being tragic, she just left Shi Yu like that. And he's been waiting for her his whole life. Isn't that tragic?
And again, if it weren't for her help, the shop would've been mine. What a jinx to everybody.
Anyway, I must find a way to make him open the shop again... He has some explaining to do!
I see... You care about Uncle Shi, don't you? Otherwise, you could've done this years ago.
What? Are you serious!? That magic pill of his... Has he taken it?
That stupid old man... Where is he now? I must talk to him. As for this Coppercore, you can have it.
Who cares about him?! I'm just mad he's ruining our master's legacy!
The way you talk about him... I can tell you're actually worried about him.
Don't act like you know me, kid! Just get Shi Yu out here so we can settle this!
Actually, Uncle Shi is seriously ill, and... he doesn't have much time left. That's why he closed the shop...
Yes... And now he wants to fix the pendulum clock one last time before he...
You are telling the truth... right?
When the 'Star of Misfortune' was sixteen, her curse power even attracted monsters that fed on it... Her parents lost their lives trying to protect her. That was a sensational tragedy back then.
zh_text: “丧星”十六岁那年啊，她的诅咒力甚至招来了以此为食的魔物……父母为了保护她而丧命。这在当年也是轰动一时的惨案。
source_text: “丧星”十六岁那年啊，她的诅咒力甚至招来了以此为食的魔物……父母为了保护她而丧命。这在当年也是轰动一时的惨案。
official_target_text: When the 'Star of Misfortune' was sixteen, her curse power even attracted monsters that fed on it... Her parents lost their lives trying to protect her. That was a sensational tragedy back then.
official_en_text: When the 'Star of Misfortune' was sixteen, her curse power even attracted monsters that fed on it... Her parents lost their lives trying to protect her. That was a sensational tragedy back then.

text: Suddenly, a Mechcraft Kite from the Forbidden Chamber snatches the Coppercore away. Sun Bin recalls that Everkeep Clock Shop often receives orders from the Forbidden Chamber, so you two decide to head there for more information.
That mark... it's the Forbidden Chamber! What are they doing here?
The Forbidden Chamber...? I do recall that among the orders the shop used to get from the academy, most of them came from there...
But why...? I don't see a connection between the two places.
Looks like a visit to the Forbidden Chamber is in order...
Looks like a visit to the Forbidden Chamber is in order...
I agree. I'll wait for you there!
And I need to go check on that old bastard!
The Forbidden Chamber has tightened up the security since you and Novar broke in last time. Sun Bin decides to take you to a secret passage.
You're here. After you and Novar broke in last time, the security seems to become tighter.
Maybe not. I know a secret passage that leads directly inside. It's the Intendant's private route, though...
Then we're on the same page. Let's go.
Umm... And we have to do it again?
Umm... And we have to do it again?
The Forbidden Chamber is on high alert now. It's very likely we'll trigger the alarm when opening the passage.
So once you go in, you need to find the entrance fast.
Meanwhile, I'll stay here and hold off the Patrol Mechanoids.
Those Mechanoids just left by themselves! How was that even possible!?
Did we trigger some kind of protection mechanism? Are they heading back to the academy?
We can't let them expose us. Chase them!
I can't believe that actually worked. You're amazing!
I can't believe that actually worked. You're amazing!
D-Don't say that... What you just did was amazing too... Let's hurry and search the camp.
The entrance should be somewhere in there...
The Intendant's private quarters, I think. So many records and documents here...
The Intendant's private quarters, I think. So many records and documents here...

To your surprise, you find Shi Yu's medical records and the pendulum clock's blueprint. Suspecting the Intendant has noticed your movements, Sun Bin decides to scout ahead first while you will catch up when ready.
In front of the Forbidden Chamber - 2.
Frostcloud Town Archive File: Everkeep Clock Shop...
Frostcloud Town Archive File: Everkeep Clock Shop...
... Shi Yu was diagnosed with a serious disease two months ago — weak limbs, difficulty in walking...
According to Shinye's medical records, the patient's condition is terminal...
Shi Yu has declined treatment. To repair the Coral Gilt Pendulum Clock is now his final wish.
She's even got the blueprint of the pendulum clock here...
She's even got the blueprint of the pendulum clock here...
So the Intendant has been... investigating Uncle Shi? Why is that...?
Then does that mean she knows we're here...? I'll go ahead and take a look first. Follow my path carefully.
The mystery just keeps getting bigger...
Wait... If the Intendant knows about Uncle Shi's disease, she must know we're helping him, too...
Secretly retrieved the Baicao family's recent medical records, judging them... dead pulses are hard to revive...
zh_text: “秘密调取百草家常新野医案，判其……死脉难活……”
source_text: “秘密调取百草家常新野医案，判其……死脉难活……”
official_target_text: Secretly retrieved the Baicao family's recent medical records, judging them... dead pulses are hard to revive...
official_en_text: Secretly retrieved the Baicao family's recent medical records, judging them... dead pulses are hard to revive...

text: “Shi Yu refused treatment, making the repair of the sea-willow gilded mother-of-pearl grandfather clock his dying wish...”
zh_text: “时煜拒诊，以修好海柳鎏金贝母大摆钟为临终之志……”
source_text: “时煜拒诊，以修好海柳鎏金贝母大摆钟为临终之志……”
official_target_text: “Shi Yu refused treatment, making the repair of the sea-willow gilded mother-of-pearl grandfather clock his dying wish...”
official_en_text: “Shi Yu refused treatment, making the repair of the sea-willow gilded mother-of-pearl grandfather clock his dying wish...”

text: It would be bad if there's some kind of trap waiting... How about this: I'll go ahead to scout the core area, and you follow carefully behind.
zh_text: 万一有什么手段等着就不妙了……这样，我先去前面核心区域探查看看，你随后小心跟上。
source_text: 万一有什么手段等着就不妙了……这样，我先去前面核心区域探查看看，你随后小心跟上。
official_target_text: It would be bad if there's some kind of trap waiting... How about this: I'll go ahead to scout the core area, and you follow carefully behind.
official_en_text: It would be bad if there's some kind of trap waiting... How about this: I'll go ahead to scout the core area, and you follow carefully behind.

text: In front of the Forbidden Chamber.
The Intendant's private passage leads to... her own quarters, I think.
The Intendant is known for being elusive. Few in Jixia have actually seen her in person.
Now you've mentioned it... Novar and I didn't see her last time either...
Now you've mentioned it... Novar and I didn't see her last time either...
T-Then let's quickly search the place while she's out. It kinda feels bad, but really we have no choice...
This is our turf. Get lost!
What are you staring at? You're not welcome here!
I've found the entrance. Do you need my help outside?
I've found the entrance. Do you need my help outside?
No, we're running out of time. Just go, and I'll catch up!
The entrance to the underground ruin should be here, but why can't we find it?
Driven by his inner obsession, Sun Bin reaches for the fragment of the Gate of Time—but you stop him just in time.
This is... the fragment of the Gate of Time...
The water's too deep for my legs, so... I'm afraid I'll have to trouble you again...
Sun Bin confirms that it is indeed the Cracked Coppercore you need. He decides to stay and keep watch through the night, to see who might come for it.
Sun Bin studies the material and remarks.
Irregular cracks on the surface, the core made of copper... This is it! What a fine piece from the old times...
Let's leave it here for now. And see who shows up for the pickup.
Sun Bin reunites with you at the top.
I think I hear the Rebels coming back. Hurry and come on up!
Sun Bin prompts you to install the mechcraft.
Remember to move through the bushes. We don't want the sound of your running or jumping to alert the Rebels.
Sun Bin hints at solving the puzzle.
Hmm... There are four lamps on the wall and four switches underwater. Maybe they correspond to each other...
The lamps seem to light up in a certain order... Perhaps that's the key?
Sun Bin hints at the Aerpower Chip.
To open this door, we need an Aerpower Chip.
I think I just saw one under that tree. Go grab it!
It was you who rigged the Mechanoids, right? You little thieves...
W-Wait, that's Sun Bin... Let's run!
Okay! Wait... I think I just triggered the alarm...
Okay! Wait... I think I just triggered the alarm...
Oh, no! The Patrol Mechanoids are coming. I'll hold them off!
Looks like there's another puzzle to solve...
Looks like there's another puzzle to solve...
A pile of rocks inside the tent? Something's off...
A pile of rocks inside the tent? Something's off...
This room... Novar and I were here last time.
This room... Novar and I were here last time.
Where is the end of time...
The river of time flows on... Where are you, I wonder?
When did I last tweak my wings again?
Our time right now might be the future someone dreamed about.
Time has a funny way of taking things... and leaving surprises behind.
Another symposium? Oh no... I have to speak again?
Tik tak, tik tak, tik tak, tik tak...
The best time to plan is in the morning. Let's map out today's research.
zh_text: 一日之计在晨，规划下今天的研究吧。
source_text: 一日之计在晨，规划下今天的研究吧。
official_target_text: The best time to plan is in the morning. Let's map out today's research.
official_en_text: The best time to plan is in the morning. Let's map out today's research.

text: If I can be of help, I'd be delighted.
zh_text: 如果我能帮上忙就好了。
source_text: 如果我能帮上忙就好了。

text: (Panicked voice, struggling to balance) W... W-wait!
(Idle Animation Style 2) Leap and get ready.
My legs always ache when it's cloudy or rainy...
zh_text: 一到阴雨天腿就会有些疼……
source_text: 一到阴雨天腿就会有些疼……
official_target_text: My legs always ache when it's cloudy or rainy...
official_en_text: My legs always ache when it's cloudy or rainy...

text: I remember this place was full of cats before. Where are they now?
I remember this place was full of cats before. Where are they now?
You mean the ones Sun Bin used to keep?
He moved them to the new shelter after his application was approved.
So many students came to help—it was almost overwhelming for him.
You take a group photo with Sun Bin and your cat companions.
Look at the camera, everyone! One... two... three... Say "treat"!
I hope they can stay happy and healthy forever.
You take a group photo with Sun Bin and your cat companions.
You've met Yao's adopted kitten, "Jixia's Finest." Sun Bin has asked it to call over his new little friend.
That's Novar's cat, Top Charm. He likes to call it, um, Meowster. Maybe... we can ask it to find our new cat.
Hi Meowster! Can you call your new friend over?
It can summon other cats? Yeah... that's so Novar.
It can summon other cats? Yeah... that's so Novar.
You've met Yao's adopted kitten, "Jixia's Finest." Sun Bin has asked it to call over his new little friend.
Sun Bin says this is where he rescues kittens and invites you to help him find the one that is hiding.
What happened? Did you get into any trouble?
What happened? Did you get into any trouble?
You're here! But... who do you mean by "trouble"?
I thought you were in danger...
Oh, that... Sorry, I had my hands full with these little ones. I didn't mean to worry you.
So you asked me to come here...
So you asked me to come here...
Yes... sort of. I got permission from the academy to use this place as a shelter for sick and injured cats.
That sounds like a lot of work.
That sounds like a lot of work.
Actually, our teammates also help out when they have time. Adopted their own cats, too.
And that's why I asked you to come...
Well, other students would come here and adopt some from time to time. So I'll manage...
I was going to tell you earlier, b-but I didn't get a chance to finish my message.
You want me to join in?
You want me to join in?
That's right! You... you're our teammate now, and... an important friend of mine, too.
So I was wondering... Do you want to do this together?
You can adopt one today if you want to.
I'd love to help with the work here, but adopting a cat...
I'd love to help with the work here, but adopting a cat...
Oh, um... It's okay if you say no. And in fact, we are keeping all the cats we adopted here.
I'm in! Let's see the cats.
I'll have to think about it.
I-I understand. It's a big decision. Oh, how about I show you around first?
I just rescued a stray cat recently. It's beautiful, quite a character... I have a feeling you'd like it.
Its leg is still healing, though, so it might be a bit timid right now. Come on.
This way, we can all contribute and... it won't be too much work for one person...
Sun Bin says this is where he rescues kittens and invites you to help him find the one that is hiding.
Follow Meow-Shuai to find the cat hiding on the roof. Go and bring it down.
Well, um... Good job, Meowster. Now we're going to find the new member. I'll bring you snacks when we're back.
Do you know where it is, Meowster?
Do you know where it is, Meowster?
That white cat... Is it who we're looking for?
That white cat... Is it who we're looking for?
Is it the one on the roof over there?
Is it the one on the roof over there?
It is! But... how did it get up there so fast...
Um... do you think you can get it down? Its leg hasn't healed yet, and... I'm worried it'll hurt itself again.
It ran away when it heard us... Must be the one!
It ran away when it heard us... Must be the one!
Let's go take a look. Quietly, though. We don't want to scare it off.
Follow Meow-Shuai to find the cat hiding on the roof. Go and bring it down.
To get the kitten down from the high place, you decide to use snacks as bait.
This is too dangerous... Perhaps it's not a good idea.
I think we ended up spooking it even more...
Maybe we just grab it fast?
Can we lure it down with toys?
I don't think it'll work... It's already on high alert now.
I'll go get some food. Hopefully it'll come down when it's hungry.
I-I'm sorry... for causing you so much trouble again.
Come on, teammates are supposed to help each other. I'll get the food.
Come on, teammates are supposed to help each other. I'll get the food.
Th-thank you so much, then. I'll stay and keep an eye on it.
To get the kitten down from the high place, you decide to use snacks as bait.
(Sun Bin was delighted to see the cat's behavior and thanked the player for understanding that making oneself a cat owner did not reasonably consider the cat's feelings)
(Promise to respect the cat's nature and not control it out of personal worries)
(The protagonist thought of a name, too. He proposes to name the cat...)
(The protagonist thought of a name, too. He proposes to name the cat...)
(It interpreted the name, hoping the cat could be safe and healthy, and Sun Bin could be free from anxiety and embrace whatever comes.)
(It interpreted the name, hoping the cat could be safe and healthy, and Sun Bin could be free from anxiety and embrace whatever comes.)
(Sun Bin expresses gratitude to the player for this journey)
(Using cats as a metaphor for people, Sun Bin expresses some rather profound insights)
Sun Bin suggests you wait patiently for the kitten to relax.
All set, but... it doesn't seem interested.
All set, but... it doesn't seem interested.
Maybe it's still sacred of us because of earlier...
Let's move over to the side and give it some time.
Sun Bin suggests you wait patiently for the kitten to relax.

While recounting the story of healing a kitten, Sun Bin recalls the experience of stepping out from the shadow of losing his legs. After you agree to adopt the kitten, he suggests taking a group photo of the cats.
Then why would it hide in the dark for a whole day before... Was it because of what I did?
I was worried about its leg wounds, so I kept it in a cage for a few days...
But it did the opposite. It stopped eating, and I had to let it out. It's been hiding from me ever since...
I know you were just trying to help.
I know you were just trying to help.
Perhaps... I was wrong from the start.
I cleaned its wounds and gave it shelter. That should've been enough for it to heal.
But keeping it locked in a cage brought nothing but trauma.
Don't beat yourself up. You were coming from a good place.
Don't beat yourself up. You were coming from a good place.
Moreover... it has reminded me of myself.
When I first lost my legs... I spent a long time hiding in my room. Kept myself in complete darkness.
And when I finally got my Mechwings, my friends, they...

War has always been cruel and ruthless. People must always sacrifice something to protect what is more precious.
Jixia has been 'protected' too well by the Three Sages, but the Jixia of today is no greenhouse, and students can no longer be lambs.
You've already seen them, haven't you?
Go to the Bowwen Hall and find Shu Bingxing.

I've already arranged for the students who share your thoughts to scour the ancient texts for a cure for the divine pattern erosion. It's like looking for a needle in a haystack, but it's better than sitting around waiting to die. Maybe we'll find something.
They just wanted to protect everyone...
They just wanted to protect everyone...

Hmm, Doctor Lengchun... Uncle Ban said you're still looking for a way to treat them. Is there anything I can do to help?
You all... none of you can make up your minds, pinning your hopes on a miracle to turn the tide.
None of you understand how critical the situation really is.

It's not just a problem with the Star Team. After Master left, Jixia became precarious. Someone needs to step up and make decisions, but we clearly can't convince each other. We're wavering, and chaos will ensue sooner or later.
Star-Gleam is still keeping things from the students, and Zisu is indecisive—unable to let go of this or give up that—and in the end, she won't be able to grasp anything.
Master's death still hasn't been enough to wake them up.
Abandoning companions... is that part of it too?
Abandoning companions... is that part of it too?
If we can't save them... as doctors, we have already done our best.
Dr. Leng Chun, is there really no other way?
Dr. Leng Chun, is there really no other way?
But don't get your hopes up too high. Time waits for no one. If Zhuangzi exhausts his strength and can no longer maintain stability... I will make the necessary decision when absolutely forced to.
I... we'll try our best. Maybe a miracle will happen. I'm heading over now!
I... we'll try our best. Maybe a miracle will happen. I'm heading over now!
If someone could truly turn the tide and save the crumbling situation to preside over Jixia now, perhaps a miracle could really happen.
It's fine. There's always another way.
I sent students to search ancient texts for a cure for Divine Imprint corruption.

The lonely heart of a swordsman...
Her resolve has remained unwavering for centuries.
And her sword serves to protect Jixia.
We understand each other well, deeply knowing what we both hold dear in our hearts.
And the Quan Yuan I knew would never do such a thing.
And Master Quan Yuan... Was it because of Divine Imprint corruption?!
And Master Quan Yuan... Was it because of Divine Imprint corruption?!
But Master Quanyuan has been fighting the Divine Imprint for centuries, and it was all fine. How could... No, maybe...
But now the Aercocoon is gone, and the Aerflow in Jixia has withered...
It may not be the Ages' Delight, but it's still a rare brew.
Alright, since that's settled, let's go find her and get to the truth.
So, where are we headed next?
So, where are we headed next?
Longye, where in Mount Guye can I find more Aerflow remnants?
Hmm... Let me think... Several large Aerux have withered. That leaves only the Aerux Skywell!
Did Aerux Fragment... hold the key to finding Master Quan Yuan?
What if... regardless of whether it's due to the Divine Imprint or not, Master Quan Yuan has really changed?
I came here in the spirit of friendship. But if that's the case... the next time we meet, it won't be as old friends.
For people like us, there are always things greater than ourselves... Are you still the same, deep down?
We need to find her quickly.
She's waiting for me. I get it... Let's go.
Is that... a feather? With blood on it...
Is that... a feather? With blood on it...
This feather is really heavy, and it has a rather strange smell.
((Closed eyes) Go. Let's follow this trail, and we should be able to find her.)

text: (Same method as the previous attacks. One culprit, growing increasingly brutal.)
(Anxious, he asks Li Bai if he has ever heard of such a master? Practically rivaling the Swordmaster and Quan Yuan, especially since Master Quan Yuan has gone missing...)
(Li Bai seemed to understand, but he was hesitant. He asked if you had any clues. Weren't you here to visit a friend? What happened to Master Quan Yuan?)
(lets out a long sigh) I will see to it that this matter is handled properly.
(Li Bai and the master have agreed to help us. What a relief... Still, we cannot send all our hopes with them. The master is also sending more guards to the town.)
(Rest assured. We will not let this one slide.)
So... who do you think did it? Any idea?
What did the Aerwatch mean by...
What did the Aerwatch mean by...
("Heh, alright. Let's go. We need concrete evidence. But we're not far from the truth...)
Let's find the culprit and get to the bottom of this.
Maybe... there are more clues around.
Hmm? You want to investigate further?
The Aerwatch are thorough. Evidence is hard to come by, but there are many people here, so maybe we'll learn something.
You go get it. We'll wait here.
Don't spend too much time on any one clue. We need to move fast.
Yes, if you have other things to do!
(Could the real killer be around here?)
(You seem so sure... In fact, you must have some ideas about who the culprit is, right?)
The Aerwatch just mentioned one more person who couldn't clear their suspicion. That must be...
The Aerwatch just mentioned one more person who couldn't clear their suspicion. That must be...
Enough thinking. We'll know the truth once we see it. Let's go.
All these years, except for Master Fuzi, it's only been them.
Yes. They were my closest friends. No longer with me now.
Unable to leave Fairmaid Mountain, I had to make an effigy tomb here to pay my respects from afar.
It happened a long time ago...
Master Quan Yuan... she seems to be losing her mind.
Why else would she do this? She shouldn't...
(Walking toward the grave, whispering) She wouldn't... couldn't do something like this. And besides... look at all this destruction.
Then she is no longer the girl I once knew.
What is this place? Why would Master Quan Yuan come here? And how did you know about it?
What is this place? Why would Master Quan Yuan come here? And how did you know about it?
He let out a long breath, pausing for a moment in dismay.
She helped me rediscover my swordmanship spirit.
Remember, I came to Mount Guye under Master Fuzi's guidance.
You know, I once marched into Chang'an to avenge my friend Leiming. But after getting rebuffed by the Empress, I fell into despair and lost my way...
I doubted the sword I was using, and she brought me here...
... I never thought this day would come.
(Weren't they supposed to have been injured by the green flame?)
(Maybe. But the sword marks are of all shapes and sizes. Did swordsmen from all over the world help with this?)
(Deduction: Despite the varying injuries, it is clear they were all inflicted by the same person, a Blooming Blade wielder, rather than a sharp weapon.)
You're just trying to cover for the real culprit, aren't you?
We have gathered most of the evidence we need, but...
What's going on here? It's so chaotic... Isn't this—
Li Bai! You dare to show up again?!
He's the one who hurt those people. You should take him in!
You're not holding a grudge over the last time, are you? It was nothing serious, and clearly, it didn't cause you much harm...
Fine! You're just trying to frame Li Bai and us—and harm yourselves—
This girl can't tell, but surely you can, Li Bai!
Li Bai, does the trace of this green lotus sword look familiar to you?
Same wounds you left me with in Chang'an!
You don't know me, but I've remembered you every single day!

At that time, the greatest swordsman in the world lit up the Great Ming Palace with his blade, renowned throughout the land. People sang his praises, but no one spoke of the fate that befell the hapless Golden Guards who failed to intervene.
That was why I had to leave Chang'an and wander around. Never thought I'd meet you here!
I admit I got outclassed, but that was no excuse for you to lay hands on me, Li Bai!
Unfortunately, my companions here suffered severe injuries.
You hypocritical fraud! The greatest swordsman of all time? A true hero? You're showing your true colors now!
Li Bai would never hurt anyone! Besides, he's been with us the whole time!
Hah! Are you implying that I faked this wound? That I wouldn't have known it was you if not for this wound, Li Bai!
No one else can wield the Flickering Flurry like you, Li Bai.
(Blocking the protagonist) Ah... This... I regret that I truly know nothing about the matters in Chang'an.
I'm flattered, but I don't think I deserve such praise.
Captain, we're all set on our end.
Indeed, the situation is unclear. Since both parties are present and we've gathered the information, let's briefly explain the matter.
You quickly recapped the recent attacks and relevant clues.
( Meaning he wants to prove his whereabouts at the time had alibis. )
(Blame Li Bai... who knows if it's true or not)
(It shall finally clear Li Bai's name.)
Li Bai doesn't quite fit the profile of the suspect. And since it's the Martial Arts Contest, maybe some expert will come and mimic the sword techniques.
In the end, there's no concrete evidence to say it's not him!
But there's no solid proof it was Li Bai either!
You! Silver-tongued devil, I will not debate you!
I know you're all worried, but I, Li Bai, never have and never will commit such an act.
I'll find the killer and bring answers.
All this talk? It's getting old.
So what do you want from me? And why did Li Bai attack you in the first place?
He's probably angry that I embarrassed him earlier. With the weapon in his hands, he wants me to shut up.
I give you the Lyrical Blade, and I swear on my honor that I will uncover the truth.
If I fail to keep my promise, the Lyrical Blade is yours.
I still want you to know that a true swordsman's reputation comes not from their weapon, but from their unwavering heart and unshakeable will.
Random slashes may be deadly, but they have nothing to do with the spirit of the sword.
A true swordmaster wields no ordinary sword.
I apologize for the pain I caused you, but Li Bai has never regretted his choices.
You—Hmph, you go find out the truth before saying anything!
In that case, you have made your choice, Zhou Yu. Farewell.
Although it looks crumpled, it bears the fate of humanity.
A "Star of Tomorrow" nationwide talent show?
A "Star of Tomorrow" nationwide talent show?
Two pounds of eggs for signing up? Is that why you stopped me?
Two pounds of eggs for signing up? Is that why you stopped me?
That was to weed out the mediocre who only care about petty gains. The true reward was never about fame.
Superficial! Read these four words carefully again. "Star of Tomorrow".
You think it refers to a celebrity? Wrong. It refers to a real "star".
...You mean... they want to pick an astronaut? By singing and dancing?
...You mean... they want to pick an astronaut? By singing and dancing?
This organizer is actually the Galactic Embassy to Earth.
They are looking for a special sound wave. A frequency capable of resonating with the universe.
Used to start the mothership parked on the far side of the moon.
What does this have to do with me?
What does this have to do with me?
The roaring you do in the bathroom is practically designed to interfere with alien radar.
I was in the bathroom because the water was too hot.
I was in the bathroom because the water was too hot.
Despair, yet carrying a power that pierces the soul.
And you, you are all emotion, all destructive power.
Are you complimenting me or insulting me?
Are you complimenting me or insulting me?
I'm not going. I'd be too embarrassed.
I'm not going. I'd be too embarrassed.
This isn't just for you. It's for me. No, it's for all of humanity.
Just think about it. What if you're in the middle of a high note and get sucked away by a beam of light?
What a great honor that is.
What kind of glory is there in being sucked away?
What kind of glory is there in being sucked away?
And if it doesn't get sucked away, I'll have to carry the eggs home and be the laughingstock of the neighbors for a year.
And if it doesn't get sucked away, I'll have to carry the eggs home and be the laughingstock of the neighbors for a year.
I knew it. You went through all that trouble just to get those two jin of eggs.
I knew it. You went through all that trouble just to get those two jin of eggs.
A true warrior knows how to utilize every resource.
Are you going or not? For the peace of the galaxy!
Even if it's just for tomorrow's breakfast.
The egg is yours. The embarrassment is mine.
The egg is yours. The embarrassment is mine.
At this moment, the wheels of history began to turn.
Since you've been standing here for so long, if you don't intend to buy me a drink...
Why do you keep staring at my tail?
I'm not... that's not what I meant.
I'm not... that's not what I meant.
I just think... you always look so... radiant.
I just think... you always look so... radiant.
It took me two hours to put this outfit together. Beauty is hard work, you know.
I just wanted to ask... um...
I just wanted to ask... um...
If it's someone like me... is there still hope?
If it's someone like me... is there still hope?
No. I meant... regarding the outfit.
No. I meant... regarding the outfit.
I always feel like I'm just... dirt, all dusty and disheveled.
I always feel like I'm just... dirt, all dusty and disheveled.
I feel redundant standing next to you.
I feel redundant standing next to you.
Let me see, lift your chin.
Hmm... it's not all a disaster.
Don't talk about yourself like that.
Clothes should serve the person, not the other way around.
You're actually quite interesting; you've just been hiding it all this time.
Really? I want to become as confident as you too.
Really? I want to become as confident as you too.
My tuition is very expensive. And I am very strict.
You must be prepared to be reborn.
Good, I really like the way you are now.
Ambitious. Clear your schedule this weekend. You're going shopping with me.
Are those clouds over there moving really slowly?
Hmm. It's like everything has stopped.
Hmm. It's like everything has stopped.
If I go there, will I not be able to see clouds like these anymore?
That's Chang'an, you know. It takes a long, long time to fly there.
I heard it's winter there now, while it's still summer here.
It's really too far; it'll take a long time to adjust to the jet lag.
It's really too far; it'll take a long time to adjust to the jet lag.
Yes. It's too far. So far that...
I feel like I'm already homesick, even though I haven't even left yet.
Tears are welling up in my eyes.
That's normal, after all, it's your first time traveling far from home.
That's normal, after all, it's your first time traveling far from home.
I can't bear to leave the sugar water shop in Frostcloud Town. I can't bear to leave Er Pang next door.
Yesterday, he was crying when he told me. From now on, there's no one left to help him with his homework.
And Grandma. Her legs aren't very good.
Erpang will definitely be sad. Grandma surely can't bear to part with you either.
Erpang will definitely be sad. Grandma surely can't bear to part with you either.
If I miss her, I won't be able to just run a few steps and jump into her arms like I do now.
Chang'an is cold. I can't touch it, nor can I smell that scent of hers...
Although I really wanted to go to that school too.
But... the attachments here are too heavy, they make my heart ache.
Zhilu. No need to force yourself.
Zhilu. No need to force yourself.
Listen to the voice in your heart.
Listen to the voice in your heart.
No matter what you choose, I support you.
No matter what you choose, I support you.
Really? What if I decide to leave in the end?
Will everyone remember me when I return?
This will always be your home.
This will always be your home.
Then... let me just stand here for a little while longer.
Keep the wind here. All in your mind.

White really likes you. That's rare.

Let me take a look. It seems to recognize me.

I was, but the scenery here is so captivating that I decided to linger for a while.

I understand. Then we'll keep it.
I understand. Then we'll keep it.
You're right... let's do that. Thanks for helping me decide.

They'll wither. All the grapes will die.

I miss the festive scenery of the past, the lights along the long streets.
When the prosperity fades, only the memories remain, flickering and inextinguishable.
The warmth in that memory allows me to endure in the ice and snow.
The mountains and rivers of our homeland have been stained by memory.
The past is like a dream, shining and eternal.
I know not what day it is today.
Waking on my pillow, the moon shines lonely and bright.
The cold dream weighs heavy on the mountains, suddenly recalling my youth.
(R Skill) Never forget morning and night!
(Normal Q Skill) Lonely Peaks Stand Tall!
(Hold Q Skill 1) Thousand peaks, cold mist!
(Hold Q Skill 2) Ethereal dream, sinking mountains!
(Normal E Skill) Sorrow of the Past.
(Hold E Skill 2) Soul lingers, old mountains!
If I could, I'd like to visit the old places again.
Wandering between heaven and earth, when shall I return to old dreams?
The east turns white, and the dream drifts away with the wind.
The moon passes the courtyard; in memory, thousands of lamps are extinguished, and the water clock stops.
A thousand mountains in a midday dream, time flies like an arrow through the window.
Twilight illuminates the lanterns, old dreams reflect the home's shadow.
The flickering light of the cold lamp reflects the longing for home.
Reminds me of the rain in my youth, like a dream of mountains and rivers.
Drizzling rain locks the mountains and rivers... Clouds pass over ten thousand miles, veiling the journey home.
The sky is clear and cloudless, the thousand peaks as silent as they have always been.
The clear sky illuminates the journey home; my heart has already set foot on the path back.
Precious are the treasures, but even more precious... are companions.
Being thrifty... is a way of life.
Back in the Southlands, I went on similar adventures with a girl I knew.
Hidden corners often hold unexpected treasures.
I believe that we shape our own fate.
Where should we search for treasures next?
Little by little, a little becomes a lot.

Bit by bit, it adds up.

Well, that's not the main reason. She's a sincere person who only competes with those she believes are worthy.
Well... I wasn't at my best, and it's common to be unpopular.
The Swordmaster... can he have moments like this too?
The Swordmaster... can he have moments like this too?
Behind all the hype, I'm just an ordinary guy. Sometimes, I feel just as helpless as everyone else.
It took me a long time to understand this.
So don't blame yourself too much. I know you're feeling a lot of guilt and regret, but none of this is your fault.
You can feel for them, but don't let it weigh you down. Otherwise, what use are we to them?
We're almost there. Wiltspring Cave is right above us. Let's quicken our pace.
Hey, the story from just now...
My story with Quan Yuan has just begun. It's a long tale. Let's save it for when we meet her.
You... you're the new member of the Team of Stars!
Did you just come from the academy? How is it now? Is everyone alright?
I heard the academy suffered heavy losses... Many are still missing...
Is this true? What happened during the match? How are you okay?
What brings you to Mount Guye? Are you here for the Martial Arts Competition?
Your school is in such trouble, and you're here for the Martial Arts Competition?
(Li Bai's been in there for a while. Why isn't he coming out?)
(We can't wait any longer. We have to go in.)
(Li Bai will be back. We just have to wait.)
(Li Bai will be back. We just have to wait.)
(Sigh... look, the Divine Imprint power at the cave entrance has disappeared.)
(Sigh... look, the Divine Imprint power at the cave entrance has disappeared.)
(Something's wrong. We need to get in.)
(What are they talking about? Who's gone mad?)
(I don't know, but that person should be inside.)
(I don't know, but that person should be inside.)
(Strange. It looks like it was only just moments ago.)
(Better hurry and check Wiltspring Cave. He suspected Quan Yuan is not there.)
Never mind. I'm just a friend.
Rest assured, we have made arrangements for the upcoming Martial Arts Assembly. You can leave the rest to us.
I grew up hearing stories about Master Quan Yuan. After all these years...
Now that Master Quan Yuan has passed, what will happen to Fairmaid Mountain...
Now that Master Quan Yuan has passed, what will happen to Fairmaid Mountain...
The town and Aerforge Lodge have planned for this. And the Swordmaster will be there too. Even if you don't trust me, you can trust him, right?
No, not that! Uh... fine, I'll get going then...
No, not that! Uh... fine, I'll get going then...
Alright, off you go now. The academy isn't going to sort itself out.
Li Bai, Minka, thank you so much for your help.
Li Bai, Minka, thank you so much for your help.
Anytime. Hope next time we meet, your noisy teammates will be in better spirits.
Yes, things were really rushed this time. Next time you're here, I'll give you a proper tour... and bring your teammates along.
Yes! Hopefully, I can join you all next time.
Yes! Hopefully, I can join you all next time.
Guess I'll head back to the shop then. Next time you're at our shop getting your weapons maintained, I'll make sure to give you the swordmaster special discount!
So what about this year's Martial Arts Contest?
How did... No, I can't disappoint her!
Before word gets out, I need to change my plans...
Now... go and enjoy your drink.
The Five... So this is their monument. Master Quan Yuan is one of them.
The Five... So this is their monument. Master Quan Yuan is one of them.
So this is how Master Quan Yuan spent her centuries.
The lonely heart of a swordsman...
Her resolve has remained unwavering for centuries.
And her sword serves to protect Jixia.
We understand each other well, deeply knowing what we both hold dear in our hearts.
And the Quan Yuan I knew would never do such a thing.
And Master Quan Yuan... Was it because of Divine Imprint corruption?!
And Master Quan Yuan... Was it because of Divine Imprint corruption?!
But Master Quanyuan has been fighting the Divine Imprint for centuries, and it was all fine. How could... No, maybe...
But now the Aercocoon is gone, and the Aerflow in Jixia has withered...
The withering isn't that fast. She couldn't contain the Divine Imprint so quickly... Could Ziya's presence have accelerated her corruption?
The withering isn't that fast. She couldn't contain the Divine Imprint so quickly... Could Ziya's presence have accelerated her corruption?
We'll need to find her first to know for sure.
Alright, since that's settled, let's go find her and get to the truth.
So, where are we headed next?
So, where are we headed next?
Longye, where in Mount Guye can I find more Aerflow remnants?
Hmm... Let me think... Several large Aerux have withered. That leaves only the Aerux Skywell!
Did Aerux Fragment... hold the key to finding Master Quan Yuan?
She could just stay by herself. She would be in a better state.
Is she still aware? Does she know you've come to Mount Guye to find her?
Why not ask her? This way.
What if... regardless of whether it's due to the Divine Imprint or not, Master Quan Yuan has really changed?
I came here in the spirit of friendship. But if that's the case... the next time we meet, it won't be as old friends.
For people like us, there are always things greater than ourselves... Are you still the same, deep down?
Is this... a feather? With blood on it...?
Is this... a feather? With blood on it...?
This feather is really heavy, and it has a rather strange smell.
((Closed eyes) Go. Let's follow this trail, and we should be able to find her.)
Li Bai... You sure you're okay...
No more guessing. It's time... to face the truth.
On the path to the mountain.
(Why didn't Quan Yuan practice with you?)
(Why didn't Quan Yuan practice with you?)
(Could it be because you kept leaving graffiti at her doorstep?)
(Her nature was sincere and true, and she only compared swords with those who had swords in their hearts. I was in poor condition at the time, so naturally, I wasn't worthy of her attention.)
(Pretending to be deep in thought, but what you say does make sense...)
(Later... well, that's a long story. Let's go meet Quan Yuan first. The story of how I met her is too long to tell now. We can share it over a drink when we meet her.)
(Her expression changed. Something must have happened. I'll go ahead and check. Be careful and follow behind!)
(We should hurry over to take a look!)
Could it be that Master Quanyuan refuses to spar with you because you annoyed her by leaving messages at her doorstep...
Well, that's not the main reason. She's a sincere person who only competes with those she believes are worthy.
Well... I wasn't at my best, and it's common to be unpopular.
The Swordmaster... can he have moments like this too?
The Swordmaster... can he have moments like this too?
Behind all the hype, I'm just an ordinary guy. Sometimes, I feel just as helpless as everyone else.
It took me a long time to understand this.
So don't blame yourself too much. I know you're feeling a lot of guilt and regret, but none of this is your fault.
You can feel for them, but don't let it weigh you down. Otherwise, what use are we to them?
We're almost there. Wiltspring Cave is right above us. Let's quicken our pace.
Hey, the story from just now...
My story with Quan Yuan has just begun. It's a long tale. Let's save it for when we meet her.
Fair to say, things have been pretty restless around Guxie Mountain lately.
Apart from the conflicts between those martial artists, there have been several ambush incidents.
Can you tell me more about the attack?
Well? Want to help us out?
We have our own mission, but we can't just ignore your problem. We'll help you when we have the chance.

That sounds great. Apart from you, I'm not sure anyone else could face them. I've heard the assailant's swordsmanship is unparalleled, with ever-changing techniques; they could be considered a grandmaster of the sword...
Exquisite swordsmanship, worthy of a grandmaster... Are there any other rumors?
They say he's a martial arts master. Even when they found the scene right away, he was already gone without a trace, as if he had flown away into thin air.
Let me think... Oh, yes! I heard something else, too.

When the Aerwatch examined the victim's wounds, they concluded that the attacker did not use a sword, but a casually snapped tree branch... To use a branch as a sword—what kind of master must that be?
Everyone's terrified they'll be next. But honestly, I wouldn't mind running into that sword myself...
Why risk your life? If you want to spar, there are plenty of people dueling at the Training Field.
What's so interesting about those swordsmen's swords! You know me—if it weren't for a glimpse of Master Quan Yuan's sword, I wouldn't have stayed in Wulian Town for so long.
But it hasn't happened yet, has it?
That's fine. I got to meet the Swordmaster by pure chance!
Alright, as a reward for the information, I'll spar with you once I'm done with my business.
No worries. Just don't forget about me later!
Aerwatch examined the wounds and concluded they were not caused by a sword, but a casually snapped twig... A twig as sword, what kind of master would that be?
zh_text: 凌云卫辨别受伤者伤口时，认为伤人者用的不是剑，而是随手折的树枝……树枝作剑，那得是什么样的高手。
source_text: 凌云卫辨别受伤者伤口时，认为伤人者用的不是剑，而是随手折的树枝……树枝作剑，那得是什么样的高手。

text: Those swords are nothing special! You know me. If it weren't for a glimpse of Master Quan Yuan's sword, I wouldn't have stayed in Training Town so long.
zh_text: 那些剑客的剑有什么看头！您又不是不知道我，若不是为了一见泉渊大师的剑，我也不会在这武炼镇呆那么久。
source_text: 那些剑客的剑有什么看头！您又不是不知道我，若不是为了一见泉渊大师的剑，我也不会在这武炼镇呆那么久。
official_target_text: Those swords are nothing special! You know me. If it weren't for a glimpse of Master Quan Yuan's sword, I wouldn't have stayed in Training Town so long.

text: Oh, you're here. Found any clues?
No... nobody knows where Master Quan Yuan went.
No... nobody knows where Master Quan Yuan went.
Don't lose heart. I have an idea.
But there's something important here I need to grab. We'll need it later.
No need. You wait here for Minka. Hold onto the Abyssal Sword. I'll be right back.
Someone is coming. Is it Master Quan Yuan?
I can smell the Divine Imprint...
I can smell the Divine Imprint...
You? How did you get in?
That sword... it belongs to Quan Yuan.
(What's done is done. It's time to move on.)
("Those few points of sorrow are hard to shake off. Why not head to Fairmaid Mountain?")

(In Fairmaid Mountain, there's a wine called Heavenly Intoxication, renowned for its ability to dissolve worries. However, its brewer is eccentric, and it's rare for common people to get a jar. If you're curious, why not check it out?)
(Aunt... She Shan! This must be it.)
("I'll leave now. I know you have important things to do.")
(Am I onto something about Master Quan Yuan?)
(Am I onto something about Master Quan Yuan?)
(Now's not the time for drinking. We have to find the cure.)
(Now's not the time for drinking. We have to find the cure.)
(My teammates are still unconscious, I have to rescue them.)
(My teammates are still unconscious, I have to rescue them.)
("Life and death are predestined. I've done all I can.")
(How... how could you just stand by and do nothing? Aren't you the Swordmaster? Aren't you a hero?)
(How... how could you just stand by and do nothing? Aren't you the Swordmaster? Aren't you a hero?)
Li Bai, you're back. What did you go get?
Li Bai, you're back. What did you go get?
Wine, of course! I, Li Bai, cannot live a single day without wine. Haven't you heard?
No, thanks... When will you be done?
No, thanks... When will you be done?
No rush. Good wine needs to be savored. (Takes another sip)
Rich and full-bodied with a lingering finish. I haven't tasted anything this fine since I left Fairmaid Mountain.
That's why I came to Mount Guye.
But... it's not about Jixia or the secret medicine...
But... it's not about Jixia or the secret medicine...
Master Fuzi, and that... kid from the East. Ah, what a shame...
They'll be fine... as long as we retrieve the secret medicine...
They'll be fine... as long as we retrieve the secret medicine...
The secret medicine is indeed a hope, but I advise you not to hold your breath.
It's quite mysterious. I've been in Jixia for a while now, but I've rarely heard of it.
Maybe Quan Yuan would have such treasures, but she's nowhere to be found right now, isn't she?
Well, I just can't stand seeing you so downhearted.
We've come this far. Might as well tell you how I feel.
Given the current situation, your friends on the Team of Stars are beyond help. We can only hope for divine mercy.
That so-called miracle cure was probably just a story Kongming and Lychill made up to comfort you.
Legends and secrets abound in this world, and there are even divine objects that can bring people back to life. Do you believe in all of them?
They just wanted to keep you occupied, so you could gradually accept everything.
Loved ones passing, friends drifting apart... some things are just beyond our control.
I'm afraid there's nothing I can do about that.
They can only hope you let go and release them.
Drifting off to sleep, leaving without sickness or pain. Perhaps it's not necessarily a bad thing.
We worldly people must learn to let go.
If you can't relax, why not try a sip... You'll instantly feel as light as air, free from worldly worries.
Ugh, no... something's wrong... (The protagonist starts to feel dizzy)
Ugh, no... something's wrong... (The protagonist starts to feel dizzy)
How could you say something like that!
How could you say something like that!
You only cared about your wine, ignoring... ignoring the fact that people were dying!
You only cared about your wine, ignoring... ignoring the fact that people were dying!
Ugh... (The protagonist's head begins to ache severely)
Ugh... (The protagonist's head begins to ache severely)
(He said he had clues about Master Quan Yuan?)
(He said he had clues about Master Quan Yuan?)
(Joking, as if I could know the expert's clues.)
(Some scattered messages... I'll go to the Aerforge Lodge and ask about them.)
(Meet Li Bai at Li Zhi Loft. I'll join you shortly.)
Calm now, huh? Gentlemen, I believe drawing weapons outside someone else's home is not the best way to pay a visit.
(They followed Halcyon here, but found no one in Wiltspring Cave, only a sword. After Halcyon drew the sword, everything went dark.)
Quan Yuan left without his sword, and in a hurry... Maybe it's connected to this.
Where's Quan Yuan? You can't just take your word for it!
Well, if you have any faith in Quan Yuan and me, hear my words.
You... you saved us from madness. I trust you and Master Quan Yuan.
Yes! That's why we trust you!
Okay, what would you do then?
But with all the troubles Jixia is facing, maybe we should postpone the Martial Arts Contest. I'll find Quan Yuan, and we'll make new plans.
With the Swordmaster Li Bai as our guarantee, we trust you. Let's do this. We'll head out first and wait for your news in Wulian Town.
That's what you say. But neither Quan Yuan nor the treasure has been seen again...
I'd be unstoppable with a weapon like that. Hmph. Let's see what you have to say to that.
So... what's really going on here?
Where were you? You showed up so late.
I followed the sound they made, but halfway, I heard something strange. It was as if someone was lurking around...
I followed it, but... found nothing.
What? Someone can evade your tracking? What is he up to?
It's alright. We'll find Quan Yuan and then we'll know the truth.
If I remember right, she retired to <001>Wiltspring Cave</>.
Calm down? Gentlemen, it seems rather impolite to draw weapons in front of someone else's home, don't you think?
(They followed Hu Wanli straight up the mountain to investigate what Master Quan Yuan was doing and why he didn't hold the Martial Arts Competition.)
(No one was there when they arrived at Wiltspring Cave, only a sword. After Hu Wanli drew it, they were all affected.)
It seems... that sword turned everyone into this!
Ugh, exactly! All our troubles started from that sword!
I'm going to have a word with Quan Yuan. That sword of hers must be doing something weird to affect people's minds!

(Abyssal Sword was forged using ancient techniques, giving it a spirit that far surpasses common divine weapons. Those unable to control it will be consumed by its chaos. Explanations of its mystic nature follow.)
(If you hadn't stolen the sword, you wouldn't be in this mess. If you'd called the Aerwatch, they'd have made you regret it!)
(Out of consideration for your anxiety, if you leave now, I will let the matter of trespassing on Wiltspring Cave slide.)
(As for the Martial Arts Competition, I'll discuss the details with her after I find Quan Yuan.)
With the Swordmaster Li Bai as our guarantee, we trust you. Let's do this. We'll head out first and wait for your news in Wulian Town.
That's what you say. But neither Quan Yuan nor the treasure has been seen again...
I'd be unstoppable with a weapon like that. Hmph. Let's see what you have to say to that.
So... what's really going on here?
Left without his sword... Something must've made him leave in a hurry! No wonder the Martial Arts Competition was postponed...
Something's fishy... Maybe it's related to this sword... But why...
The answer might be in Wiltspring Cave... Let's go take a look.
What's wrong with you? Don't scare me!
You scared me... I just walked into the tavern and saw you about to slash Li Bai with your sword.
Li Bai... your wine jar's unopened... you haven't drunk...
Li Bai... your wine jar's unopened... you haven't drunk...
I got the wine and came straight back.
Uh... I think I just saw...
Uh... I think I just saw...
No more arguing for now. Follow me.
All these years, except for Master Fuzi, it's only been them.
Yes. They were my closest friends. No longer with me now.
Unable to leave Fairmaid Mountain, I had to make an effigy tomb here to pay my respects from afar.
It happened a long time ago...
(I'm keeping an eye on those who try to cause trouble at Mount Guye.)
(It's been a long time since I came here. Yet this place seems unchanged.)
(I remember my father mentioning that you spent a lot of time here a long time ago, but never returned after leaving.)
(You stayed here because of Master Quan Yuan?)
(Thanks to this, I got to know Quan Yuan. She's an outstanding swordswoman.)
(Curious about the truth behind Li Bai and Quan Yuan's story, I've heard several different versions.)
(Rumors say Master Quan Yuan sensed your sword's presence when you pierced the Great Ming Palace, and has been waiting for you ever since.)
(After you arrived, Master Quan Yuan made his move, causing chaos. You barely managed to defeat him, earning his respect and friendship.)
(This one seems exaggerated, like a made-up legend. I believe another story more.)
(That's right, I heard the other one from the tavern. You two are both alcoholics and met while competing in a drinking contest!)
(Right? I heard you two got so excited that you wagered a bottle of Master Quan Yuan's finest wine and had a friendly match, with you barely taking the win!)
(Finally, Master Quan Yuan gifted all his collection to you. Overjoyed, you became close friends.)
(Whoa, whoa, whoa, hold your horses. To be my friend, you gotta at least treat me all the drinks.)
(Treat me to a drink and we're square.)
(So it was all fake... I thought it was real! I even bought two extra drinks for the tavern owner.)
(Well... I mean, you could just ask me if you're so curious.)
(If... you don't mind talking about it!)
(Most of what you heard is nonsense. The meeting everyone imagines is a fight, then mutual respect, and finally, they become friends.)
(Well, that's true. Quan Yuan and I also became friends through swords.)
(However, we didn't bond right away when we first met.)
(She didn't really like me when we first met.)
(I was troubled and depressed, neglecting my appearance. After arriving in Jixia, Master Fuzi suggested I take a walk around Mount Guye...)
Now we have solid proof that it was all... Master Quan Yuan's doing.
Regardless of her reasons... these are all facts.
Mount Guye has been under her protection for centuries. I grew up hearing the legends about her.
Whenever my father forged his best swords, she would come to see him. I didn't see her often, but she seemed... cold, but very kind.
Why would she do that? She shouldn't have...
She isn't, and can't be, the kind of person who would do this. Besides... she wouldn't just destroy this place like this.
Then she's no longer the girl I once knew.
What is this place? Why did Master Quan Yuan come here? And how do you know?
What is this place? Why did Master Quan Yuan come here? And how do you know?
He let out a long breath, pausing for a moment in dismay.
Under her guidance, I rediscovered my own swordmanship.
Remember, I told you Master Fuzi advised me to come to Mount Guye?
I went to Chang'an to avenge my friend Leiming, but got rejected by the Empress.
I began to doubt my sword. After dueling with Quan Yuan countless times, she brought me here...
You... you're the new member of the Team of Stars!
Did you just come from the academy? How is it now? Is everyone alright?
I heard the academy suffered heavy losses... Many are still missing...
Is this true? What happened during the match? How are you okay?
What brings you to Mount Guye? Are you here for the Martial Arts Competition?
Your school is in such trouble, and you're here for the Martial Arts Competition?
(You are too? What happened here... Oh, the attack on Halcyon?)
(Sympathetic) Why is it always you working?
(He resignedly described the situation at Mount Guye: the chaos with Quan Yuan gone, and the attacks that have everyone on edge.)
(But this investigation has reached a conclusion.)
So, have you reached a conclusion?
("True. I've heard rumors that Halcyon suspected the Swordmaster. This could be a chance to clear Li Bai's name." )
(Weren't they supposed to have been injured by the green flame?)
(Maybe. But the sword marks are of all shapes and sizes. Did swordsmen from all over the world help with this?)
(Deduction: Despite the varying injuries, it is clear they were all inflicted by the same person, a Blooming Blade wielder, rather than a sharp weapon.)
(Similar attacks, escalating severity... Definitely the work of one person.)
(Anxious, he asks Li Bai if he has ever heard of such a master? Practically rivaling the Swordmaster and Quan Yuan, especially since Master Quan Yuan has gone missing...)
(Li Bai seemed to understand, but he was hesitant. He asked if you had any clues. Weren't you here to visit a friend? What happened to Master Quan Yuan?)
(He sighed and said that he would take care of the matter. He was currently tracing the... criminals to report to the Aerwatch.)
(Li Bai and the master have agreed to help us. What a relief... Still, we cannot send all our hopes with them. The master is also sending more guards to the town.)
(Rest assured. We will not let this one slide.)
So... who do you think did it? Any idea?
What did the Aerwatch mean by...
What did the Aerwatch mean by...
("Heh, alright. Let's go. We need concrete evidence. But we're not far from the truth...)
Maybe... there are more clues around.
Hmm? You want to investigate further?
The Aerwatch are thorough. Evidence is hard to come by, but there are many people here, so maybe we'll learn something.
You go get it. We'll wait here.
Don't spend too much time on any one clue. We need to move fast.
Yes, if you have other things to do!
They say Aerux Skywell is the home of Saepes, I've never seen it before...
I also heard Quan Yuan mention that she once befriended a group of Saepes while hiding from the world to recover.
The Divine Imprint is so powerful... it's overflowing...
The Divine Imprint is so powerful... it's overflowing...
This journey is perilous. I can protect myself, but I may not be able to care for others when swords clash.
If Quan Yuan is fully controlled by Divine Imprint, your Flow will be her last hope for recovery.
Besides... I don't want anyone interrupting my reunion with an old friend.
This sword doesn't feel right. You're lucky today...!
(Let him go. The Abyssal Blade isn't with him.)
Hu Wanli has clearly had his mind corroded by the Divine Imprint. But how did he get the Abyssal Blade?
Hu Wanli has clearly had his mind corroded by the Divine Imprint. But how did he get the Abyssal Blade?
Where did Master Quan Yuan go? Why would she leave her sword behind?
Let me look around for clues.
Yeah, he was the first to hush up the news of Hu Wanli's injury, and there were noises from Aerux Skywell. Could it be...
No doubt about it! He was also talking to the town chief just now. He must be the one who finally ended Quan Yuan... Alas, it's so tragic...
I refuse to believe it. Master Quan Yuan has been my idol since I was eight. There's no way...
What are you doing here? Your presence alone ruins my wine.
I'm offering you a drink. What, you too good for it?
I'm treating everyone on behalf of an old friend today. Enjoy!
Boss, bring us your finest wine! I'm covering the bill today!
Hic... T-Thank you, Swordmaster! I'll have another...
What? Who's offering to buy drinks? Li Bai? What's going on?
Who cares? Stop dragging it out! Here in Training Town, Mount Guye, we should drink today... let's get drunk today!
*Sob* Master Quan Yuan, hic... I'll join you in a drink...
Don't act like we're friends. Here, take back your sword.
I heard about what happened to Quanyuan. You were the one who finally...
For the sake of justice, I must strike this blow. For personal reasons... it is the same.
Quanyuan has protected this place for a century, truly living up to her name. I should not have spoken disparagingly or made reckless assumptions. I was wrong.
But I still haven't forgiven you, Li Bai!
One day, I will come for you to avenge the sword strike at Daming Palace!
Come on, it's on the Swordmaster! If we don't drink the owner dry, it'd be a disrespect!
Who cares about him? Keep it. I have better things to do!
Tsk, busy, huh? All that hustle for nothing. Not... not like me, drunk and happy...
Y-you guys made a pact! Give it all to me, t-to toast Master Quan Yuan—
Here it comes. Don't dive under the table again.
Here's to you, *burp* the Swordmaster... and the Swordmaster's wine!
Fair to say Gu Shi Mountain's beauty today is thanks to your hard work, my friend.
To Master Quan Yuan, to Mount Guye—
Brother Wanli, why are you leaving? This is wine treated by the Sword Immortal! If we don't drink the boss's cellar dry today, we're not giving the Sword Immortal any face!
zh_text: 万里哥，走什么走啊，这可是剑仙请的酒，今天不把老板的窖藏喝光，就是不给剑仙面子了啊！
source_text: 万里哥，走什么走啊，这可是剑仙请的酒，今天不把老板的窖藏喝光，就是不给剑仙面子了啊！
official_target_text: Brother Wanli, why are you leaving? This is wine treated by the Sword Immortal! If we don't drink the boss's cellar dry today, we're not giving the Sword Immortal any face!
official_en_text: Brother Wanli, why are you leaving? This is wine treated by the Sword Immortal! If we don't drink the boss's cellar dry today, we're not giving the Sword Immortal any face!

text: It's nothing. I'm her friend, so it's only right I fulfill her wishes and give the townspeople an answer.
You've done well. Rest assured, we'll take care of the rest.
I grew up hearing stories about Master Quan Yuan. After all these years...
Now that Master Quan Yuan has passed, what will happen to Fairmaid Mountain...
Now that Master Quan Yuan has passed, what will happen to Fairmaid Mountain...
Don't worry. We from the Aerforge will help keep the town in order. And the Swordmaster is watching too. Even if you don't trust me, surely you trust him?
You have more important things to worry about, right? Come on, I've arranged the Aership Station in advance, let's head back to the academy first.
Go back now. There are still people over there who need your help.
Li Bai, Minka, thank you so much for your help.
Li Bai, Minka, thank you so much for your help.
You're welcome. I hope your friends will be back to their best when we meet again.
Yes, things were really rushed this time. Next time you're here, I'll give you a proper tour... and bring your teammates along.
Yes! Hopefully, I can join you all next time.
Yes! Hopefully, I can join you all next time.
We'll be off then! Li Bai, come by my place next time you need weapon maintenance—I'll give you the Swordsman discount!
