You said you weren't here to help me sincerely. As an outsider with no ties to Jixia, why not just sit down and drink?
You said you weren't here to help me sincerely. As an outsider with no ties to Jixia, why not just sit down and drink?
But I don't see anything wrong with what was said.
I don't see anything wrong with that. I'm not one of Jixia's people to begin with, and I only took on this matter out of respect for Fuzi.
That's why he heeded Kongming's request and came here. But the recipe is so mysterious, and Quan Yuan has vanished without a trace. Whether we find it or not is all up to fate.
But... but the Team of Stars...
But... but the Team of Stars...
You promised to help us find Quan Yuan...
You promised to help us find Quan Yuan...
True, but Quan Yuan doesn't want to show up. What can I do?
Well, Novar and Novi were really good.
Did you get the wine? You—
You... you've been lying to me all along!
You... you've been lying to me all along!
You're thinking about drinking at a time like this? Someone is waiting for help!
You're thinking about drinking at a time like this? Someone is waiting for help!
You... How could you lie to me!
You... How could you lie to me!
Oh? Nice, you got it so quickly.
This jar of wine... so important that it needs special...
This jar of wine... so important that it needs special...
Of course, the wine matters. I know you're eager about the secret medicine.
I have some leads on this matter. Grab the wine and follow me.
Can I set up a sign that says "The Swordmaster's Choice"? That sounds like a fortune-maker.
Easy, easy. Business is booming, right? More customers than usual?
Looks like things are going pretty well for Li Bai too.
Looks like things are going pretty well for Li Bai too.
Why would I be? Of course I'm drinking. We are in a tavern.
We're looking for clues to the miracle cure, remember?

Finding the elusive medicine and Quan Yuan feels like a stroke of luck.

Let's not talk about that for now. Have you seen Master Quan Yuan recently?
No problem. I'll ask around then.
No problem. I'll ask around then.
Master Quan Yuan? No way. She hardly ever leaves her place...
I'll wait here! If you miss him and he can't find anyone, it would be a missed connection.
Alright... I'll go look for it.
Alright... I'll go look for it.
I should go and talk to him.
I should go and talk to him.

text: What's wrong with you? Don't scare me!
You scared me... You just quietly returned and pointed your sword at Li Bai.
Uh... I think I just saw...
Uh... I think I just saw...
Sounds like you've been affected by something. You seemed...
The chaotic Flow within you reminds me of those Martial Artists at the Swordplay Terrace.
Could I be affected by the Abyssal Sword as well?
Could I be affected by the Abyssal Sword as well?
But Li Bai had the Abyssal Sword! He only touched it for a bit back then.
It seems the Abyssal Sword had a far deeper impact. It affected your mind, deepened your bias and anxiety, and erupted when your spirit was most strained.
It's just that your mind is too tense right now, leaving room for weakness.
I'm sorry, I didn't explain everything. I wasn't completely sure myself, and I may have caused you confusion.
It's not your fault. You did what you had to. We can ask for your help, but we can't force you into anything.
It's not your fault. You did what you had to. We can ask for your help, but we can't force you into anything.
It's enough that you're willing to help us.
It's enough that you're willing to help us.
Uh... right, uh, but also not really... Anyway, it's fine if you have other plans, we understand!
I have a theory about Quan Yuan's whereabouts.
Remember what my drinking buddy said earlier? I'm a bit...
Hey, wanna come with me? There might be some clues.
What's wrong with you? Don't scare me!
You scared me... As soon as Li Bai returned, you stood up and shouted, threatening to kill him.
You didn't open your wine jars... You weren't drinking in the cellar...
You didn't open your wine jars... You weren't drinking in the cellar...
I got the wine and came straight back.
Uh... I think I just saw...
Uh... I think I just saw...

But it seems anxiety is troubling you.

Uh... right, uh, but also not really... Anyway, it's fine if you have other plans, we understand!
I have a theory about Quan Yuan's whereabouts.
But remember what my friend said earlier? I have a suspicion...
(The new student? Why is she here? I thought the Team of Stars...)
(I heard they were all badly injured saving him. How can they have the heart for this...)
You'll see when we get there.
Let's find the culprit and get to the bottom of this.
Do you know who... he is?
I'm not staying here. I just want to ask something.
Tsk... If you're not staying, why bother me? You're blocking my business.
I'm from the academy. I've got a few questions to ask.
I'm from the academy. I've got a few questions to ask.
Oh? Jixia Academy? They finally remembered us? That's great!
Feel free to ask me anything!
If you have any more questions, feel free to ask!
Isn't it the Martial Arts Contest? The inn should be busy.
Isn't it the Martial Arts Contest? The inn should be busy.
I do, but that's what troubles me...
They've been getting more aggressive lately, causing trouble everywhere. The Aerwatch is always called in to keep them in line.
Was it all just because of the Martial Arts Assembly and the Jixia incident...?
Was it all just because of the Martial Arts Assembly and the Jixia incident...?
(Not really... *whispers* There's been other stuff going on lately. I'm not sure about the details...)
(I suspect those troublemakers have run into problems. Someone taught them a lesson.)
(It seems pretty serious. Even the Aerwatch couldn't catch the culprit, and they've been laying low lately.)
(Someone is causing trouble, and even the Aerwatch can't find the truth... Is no one going to do anything? I heard Master Quanyuan is guarding the mountain here, isn't he?)
(Someone is causing trouble, and even the Aerwatch can't find the truth... Is no one going to do anything? I heard Master Quanyuan is guarding the mountain here, isn't he?)
(Speaking of which, it's odd that there's been no word from Master Quan Yuan. They're all starting to suspect that Master Quan Yuan isn't in Mount Guye at all.)
(Left Mount Guye? Where did she go?)
(Left Mount Guye? Where did she go?)
(Who knows? Maybe she's back at the academy helping Fuzi? Anyway, no one's heard about her leaving, and the Aerwatch seems to be in a bit of a bind.)
(Sigh, it's not a peaceful time. That's all I know. You don't seem like a student or a traveler to me. Stay safe.)
Whose...? Wait, how did you know?
Quan Yuan's Flow also points here.
Quan Yuan's Flow also points here.
Quan Yuan once brought me here. This is also where I'm taking you.
Master Quan Yuan... Master Quan Yuan! She looks unwell.
Could the attacker be Quan Yuan?
Could the attacker be Quan Yuan?
I had my suspicions, but I still can't believe it. Quan Yuan isn't that kind of person.
I don't believe it's Master Quan Yuan either.
What's special about this place? Why did Quan Yuan come here?
What's special about this place? Why did Quan Yuan come here?
This is one of the few places that Quan Yuan cared about.
It was also here that she guided me, helping me find the sword's heart that had been obscured by dust.
Actually, our bond goes beyond the friendly rivalry I mentioned earlier...
Master Quan Yuan's unwavering resolve is awe-inspiring.
Master Quan Yuan's unwavering resolve is awe-inspiring.
I knew it! Master Quan Yuan would never harm anyone without reason!
So, even though all the signs point to Quan Yuan, I never believed it.
Unless her injuries have worsened and she can't withstand the Divine Imprint.
The Divine Imprint does indeed corrupt one's mind.
The Divine Imprint does indeed corrupt one's mind.
We need to find Master Quan Yuan fast.
She's badly injured and needs to stop the bleeding.
She once mentioned Aerux Skywell to me.
Now that the Aercocoon is stolen, only Aerflow Pool might have enough Aerflow.
Then let's set off for Aerux Skywell.
I investigated and found traces of Quan Yuan here.
I investigated and found traces of Quan Yuan here.
That's exactly where I wanted to take you.
This place is important to Quan Yuan. Let me tell you about it.
So that's why you brought us here.
Quan Yuan will likely find a place to tend to her wounds. Let's go to Aerux Skywell.
Well, if it isn't Li Bai the Swordmaster!
(He bows, with a hearty smile. "Pleased to meet you all. Here's to you!)
(Well, he is the world's top swordsman. It's natural for people to be excited.)
(Your teammate Novar is a huge fan of Li Bai, right?)
(Oh right... Oops, I didn't mean to...)
("Come on, don't be discouraged. With Li Bai and me helping, we'll definitely complete the quest and find the secret medicine for you!")
Let's ride the Neon Kite together, it's very convenient.
zh_text: 一起乘坐霓鸢吧，很方便的。
source_text: 一起乘坐霓鸢吧，很方便的。

text: What brings you here? Is everything alright?
Not really. Minka and I waited for you for ages, so I figured I'd come see for myself.
Not really. Minka and I waited for you for ages, so I figured I'd come see for myself.
It's nothing. You know, I, uh, Li Bai cannot go a day without wine. Just a little, of course.
No, thanks... When will you be done?
No, thanks... When will you be done?
No rush. Good wine needs to be savored. (Takes another sip)
Rich and full-bodied with a lingering finish. I haven't tasted anything this fine since I left Fairmaid Mountain.
That's why I came to Mount Guye.
But... it's not about Jixia or the secret medicine...
But... it's not about Jixia or the secret medicine...
Master Fuzi, and that... kid from the East. Ah, what a shame...
They'll be fine... as long as we retrieve the secret medicine...
They'll be fine... as long as we retrieve the secret medicine...
The secret medicine is indeed a hope, but I advise you not to hold your breath.
It's quite mysterious. I've been in Jixia for a while now, but I've rarely heard of it.
Maybe Quan Yuan would have such treasures, but she's nowhere to be found right now, isn't she?
Well, I just can't stand seeing you so downhearted.
We've come this far. Might as well tell you how I feel.
Given the current situation, your friends on the Team of Stars are beyond help. We can only hope for divine mercy.
That so-called miracle cure was probably just a story Kongming and Lychill made up to comfort you.
Legends and secrets abound in this world, and there are even divine objects that can bring people back to life. Do you believe in all of them?
They just wanted to keep you occupied, so you could gradually accept everything.
Loved ones passing, friends drifting apart... some things are just beyond our control.
I'm afraid there's nothing I can do about that.
They can only hope you let go and release them.
Drifting off to sleep, leaving without sickness or pain. Perhaps it's not necessarily a bad thing.
We worldly people must learn to let go.
If you can't relax, why not try a sip... You'll instantly feel as light as air, free from worldly worries.
Ugh, no... something's wrong... (The protagonist starts to feel dizzy)
Ugh, no... something's wrong... (The protagonist starts to feel dizzy)
How could you say something like that!
How could you say something like that!
You only cared about your wine, ignoring... ignoring the fact that people were dying!
You only cared about your wine, ignoring... ignoring the fact that people were dying!
Ugh... (The protagonist's head begins to ache severely)
Ugh... (The protagonist's head begins to ache severely)
It's been a long time since I visited the town. Training Hamlet is as lively as ever.
Aren't you going to catch up with them?
Aren't you going to catch up with them?
No rush. Go find Quan Yuan first.
My father mentioned that you spent a lot of time at Mount Guye, and haven't returned since leaving.
You were here to visit Master Quan Yuan last time, too, right?
In fact, it was Master Fuzi who led me to Mount Guye, where I met Quan Yuan. She's an exceptional swordswoman.

It is said that when you lit up the Great Ming Palace with your sword, Quan Yuan, also a martial arts master, sensed your sword's spirit from afar and has since been waiting for you to arrive and compete.
They say that after you arrived, Master Quan Yuan went all out, causing chaos. In the end, you barely won, so Master Quan Yuan considered you a friend.
That sounds crazy, like a made-up legend. I believe another one more.
There are quite a few versions. What's the other one about?
The other thing I heard at Li Zhi Loft. You two are quite the drinkers, and you met during a drinking contest there!
That does sound like something I'd do.
I see. I heard you and Kongming dueled in a drunken bout for the last flask of wine, and you barely took the win.
Delighted, Master Quan Yuan gave you all of his wine collection, and you became close friends.
Wow, I had no idea my friendship came with such a price tag. Do you really need to treat me to all this wine to be my friend? One drink would have been more than enough.
So it was all fake? I bought so many of them just to find the rest!
Well, I suppose you're just... curious. If you want stories, you should just pay me for them.
Sure, I'll get you one later. For now, tell us all about it!
Is it very different from the legend?
I'm also quite curious about what you did.
The rumors were right. Quan Yuan and I did meet through wine and swords.
There was a time when I was troubled by some personal issues. I was feeling down and neglecting my appearance. Fuzi suggested that I take a break and travel from Jixia to Mount Guye.
The academy is so different from my time...
My history with Quan Yuan... Indeed, we first met through wine and blades.
Once inside, keep climbing up to reach Quan Yuan's residence.
The Emperor's ambition cannot be swayed. Once the dust has settled, it's time to move on.
I can see you're troubled by sorrow that no advice can ease. Perhaps a walk to Fairmaid Mountain might help?

Fairmaid Mountain is home to a fine wine called Intoxicating Brew. It's the best remedy for sorrow, but its brewer is quite eccentric, and the wine is hard to come by. If you're curious, you might want to check it out.

Fairmaid Mountain is home to a renowned wine called Heavenly Intoxication, known for its exceptional ability to lift spirits. However, its brewer is quite eccentric, making it rare for ordinary people to get their hands on a jar. If you're curious, why not pay a visit?

text: Minka, I didn't see you at the Smithy just now. Hmm... this one is a new face.
Everyone's trying to leave. What brought you to Mount Guye?
Relax, he's from the academy. Senior Kongming sent him.
Oh? Is Senior Kongming back? How's the academy doing?
I heard the Team of Stars was badly injured and unconscious. Are they awake now?
We have more pressing matters to attend to. Aren't you supposed to be on patrol?!
Ahem... right, can't be late for my duty.
Oh, and be careful. There have been attacks near Mount Guye.
Alright, you should get going. See you.
Hey, look at the arena. The crowd is getting bigger.
The Martial Arts Competition is about to start. Of course it's crowded.
I'm not skilled enough to embarrass myself up there.
Who do you think will win this year? The local Academy faction or those outsiders?
I don't care which faction wins, as long as the matches are exciting.
There's some noise at the arena. Wonder what happened. Why not check it out?
Conflicts exist within factions, let alone when people from all over gather.
Jixia's like this, what's the point of all this bickering?
True... Sigh... I wonder how the academy...
Sounds like someone's arguing. Let's hurry over.
There are conflicts even within a single sect, let alone when people from all over the world gather together.
zh_text: 一派之内还有矛盾呢，更别说这些天南海北人聚在一起了。

text: (In this moment of crisis, we must remain calm and cautious.)
(The academy is actively engaged in disaster relief and assistance. Aership Station is undergoing repairs. Please remain calm...)
(That's right. The Martial Arts Competition is coming up. Martial artists train both body and mind. Why not see this as a special kind of training?)
(Looking up to see Minka, the topic shifts, and you happily let Minka share news from the Academy.)
(Uh... Reassuring the crowd, everything at the academy is under control, the protagonist from the academy is here to help solve the problems.)
(The Martial Arts Competition is coming up. If you have any concerns, you might want to ask Master Quan Yuan.)
(That's right! Believe in the academy, believe in the Aerwatch, and believe in yourselves!)
The Training Town Arena is right below. We're almost there.
Hmm... Is someone giving a speech? There's quite a crowd.
Sure... no, wait, we need to get to the arena. We're trying to find someone.
The arena hosts Martial Arts competitions. Master Quan Yuan will appear there too.
Hopefully, it won't get out of hand. Let's hurry over.
Li Bai gives a brief account.
I wasn't in the best shape back then.
Fuzi mentioned a special wine called Heavenly Intoxication from Mount Guye, which drew my interest here.
This is where the Martial Arts Competition is held.
(He loudly declared that Quan Yuan would not come and had escaped the difficulties of Jixia, disregarding them, the outsiders trapped in Mount Guye.)
(He strongly opposed, insisting Quan Yuan wasn't that kind of person. Their argument escalated.)
(Explaining how, after the incident at Jixia, all the participants of the Martial Arts Competition got trapped here.)
(People are anxious, expecting Quan Yuan to come out and give an explanation.)
Those famous swordsmen are just seeking fame and fortune. Who are they to control our lives?
Oh no! They're going to fight!
Did I say something wrong? With everything that's happened at Jixia Academy, has this recluse of a master ever shown his face? And for a Martial Arts Tournament, no less!
Nonsense! Master Quan Yuan is no absconder! The two hundred years of peace in Mount Guye stand testament to her honor!
Please don't block here. Let's have a civilized conversation.
You Aerforge guys keep talking about virtuous heroes, just to sound lofty and pretentious, just like Quan Yuan...
The school had a great reputation, but what's the point if the headmaster is not here?
I am Quan Yuan, the one who brought peace to Mount Guye. I don't need advice from a cheap pen-for-hire like you!
Exactly! Stop stirring everyone up! This is just a gimmick by the Enlightenment Studio to drum up business!
You... Look, those famous swordmasters don't care about us. How much of those legends are true, we all know.
Exactly! Is the Martial Arts Contest still on? When can we leave Mount Guye? Someone give us an answer!
Even now, you're still nagging about that... You heartless brats, say one more word and see what I do!
If Quan Yuan doesn't show up now, we're gonna tear this place apart!
One sword to guard a mountain? Can she even guard it now? Everyone traveled thousands of miles to attend the Martial Arts Tournament, so where is she?
zh_text: 一剑镇一山？那她现在还镇得了吗？大家千里迢迢过来参加武道大会，她人呢？
source_text: 一剑镇一山？那她现在还镇得了吗？大家千里迢迢过来参加武道大会，她人呢？

The Intrepid Swordmaster? Can she still protect anyone? We're all here for the Martial Arts Contest, but where is she?
I am Quan Yuan, the one who brought peace to the Mount Guye. I don't need some cheap henchman telling me what to do.
Hah, still defending your own? You at Aerforge Lounge claim to be heroic warriors, but you're just puffing yourselves up like Quan Yuan.
I think you're the one putting on a show here with all this righteous indignation! Just trying to drum up business for your little photography studio, aren't you?

text: This is where the Martial Arts Competition is held.
(Quan Yuan won't be coming. She's running away from Jixia and its troubles. She won't care about us outsiders trapped in Mount Guye.)
(How can you make such unfounded accusations? Master Quan Yuan isn't that kind of person.)
(You dare to say you know who she is? You've only heard rumors!)
Those famous swordsmen are just seeking fame and fortune. Who are they to control our lives?
Exactly! Who cares about our safety?
(Master Quan Yuan never abandoned Mount Guye! I won't let you insult her like that!)
Oh no! They're going to fight!
This is the Martial Arts Competition, after all. Let's not make a scene. I hope you can give me some face and stay calm.
Li Bai... it's the Swordmaster Li Bai!
Is it really Li Bai? The Swordmaster is also at the Martial Arts Competition...
I believe Mayor Fuzi will be able to address your concerns. Shall we hear him out first?
Thank you all for coming. I assure you, the Martial Arts Competition this year will not be canceled.

Due to unforeseen circumstances, the conference preparations are not yet complete. To ensure everyone's safety, the conference will be postponed. The specific date will be announced later. We ask for your understanding.
If anything goes wrong, contact the Aerwatch in town. We'll assist.
If you're so into waiting, wait by yourself. I'm out—
The Swordmaster! Are you here for this year's Martial Arts Competition?
Li Daxia, I-I-I admire you so much! Will we get to see your Azure Lotus Sword in action this year?
Thank you for the compliment. I have other matters to attend to. Let's meet at the Martial Arts Competition if fate wills it.
Is he... saying hello to you?
Does he want us to follow him?
Does he want us to follow him?
How does it feel to be out here after staying in the academy for so long? Quite refreshing, right?
So you... you're the "perfect soldier" Senior Kongming mentioned?
So you... you're the "perfect soldier" Senior Kongming mentioned?
Yes, he sent me a letter asking me to help you retrieve the secret medicine from Quan Yuan.
I've also heard about what happened between Jixia and Fuzi.
I have a history with Master Fuzi. He once guided me out of confusion and assisted Jixia Academy. It's my honor to repay his kindness.
Don't thank me just yet. I'm new to Mount Guye and not familiar with the current situation here. Also... I've never heard Quan Yuan mention the formula you're asking about.
I haven't heard anyone mention Master Quan Yuan's whereabouts in town these past few days, and now the grand ceremony has been postponed... I hope she hasn't run into trouble too.
But we can't just wait. Come on, I'll take you to her.
Maybe this formula isn't going to be easy to get.
Quite a drama right after I got to Training Town. Some people are better suited for the stage than the Martial Arts Arena.
(We are at the Martial Arts Competition. It wouldn't look good if things got out of hand. Everyone, please do me a favor, put aside your grudges for now, and we'll talk about them later.)
Guess we'll just have to wait.
Go ahead and wait if you like. I'm outta here.
(He then shifted the tone, calming the group and convincing them to wait a bit longer.)
(Yes, that's you. Kongming sent me a letter and asked me to help you find ZhuYuan and seek medicine.)
(After asking about Jixia and the Team of Stars, the player greets Minka before turning to Minka.)
(I heard about the trouble at Jixia and with Fuzi... I have a history with him, and he once helped me out of a tough spot, so it's only right I lend a hand.)
(Then let's go. I'll take you to her.)
(Since the news of the Tower of Enlightenment arrived, things at Mount Guye have gotten complicated. People are on edge, and disputes are escalating...)
(When will it be settled... Any news from the academy?)
(Points at the protagonist, "Well, this one brought good news. The legendary Kongming has returned to the academy and is now stationed at the Tower of Enlightenment.")
(He must have found a way and sent members of the Team of Stars to locate Master Quan Yuan.)
(That's great... I hope the problems at the academy get sorted out soon. Best of luck.)
(However... Master Quan Yuan rarely shows himself publicly. It might take some effort to find him.)
(It's alright. The Martial Arts Competition is about to begin. Master Quan Yuan should make an appearance.)
(I hope so... We won't keep you any longer. Go.)
The Martial Arts Competition can go on smoothly, right?
With everything going on at the academy, I doubt Master Quan Yuan has the time for it.
But... if I can't get it done, those visiting Martial Artists are going to be even more dissatisfied.
But there was no other way... Who could've foreseen the raid on the Tower of Enlightenment?
Even Master Fuzi has gone silent... It's no wonder they're scared.
But it's not necessarily safe even if you leave Mount Guye. At least here we have Master Quan Yuan.
Yeah, at least Master Quan Yuan can still stand up for Mount Guye.
Aren't they waiting for Master Quan Yuan? Why isn't he here yet?
(The Aerwatch were right—tensions in Training Town are escalating. Let's move quickly and complete Senior Kongming's mission, so everyone can wake up...)
(In this moment of crisis, we must remain calm and cautious.)
(The academy is actively engaged in disaster relief and assistance. Aership Station is undergoing repairs. Please remain calm...)
(That's right. The Martial Arts Competition is coming up. Martial artists train both body and mind. Why not see this as a special kind of training?)
(Looking up to see Minka, the topic shifts, and you happily let Minka share news from the Academy.)
(Uh... Reassuring the crowd, everything at the academy is under control, the protagonist from the academy is here to help solve the problems.)
(The Martial Arts Competition is coming up. If you have any concerns, you might want to ask Master Quan Yuan.)
(That's right! Believe in the academy, believe in the Aerwatch, and believe in yourselves!)
Li Bai... it's the Swordmaster Li Bai!
This is a Martial Arts Convention. I hope you can all refrain from any violent outbursts. Besides...
That Aerwatch over there should be able to answer your questions.
Thank you all for coming. I assure you, the Martial Arts Competition this year will not be canceled.

Due to unforeseen circumstances, the conference preparations are not yet complete. To ensure everyone's safety, the conference will be postponed. The specific date will be announced later. We ask for your understanding.
If you're so into waiting, wait by yourself. I'm out—
Li Bai... it's the Swordmaster Li Bai!
This is the Martial Arts Competition, after all. Let's not make a scene. I hope you can give me some face and stay calm.
I believe Mayor Fuzi will be able to address your concerns. Shall we hear him out first?

Due to unforeseen circumstances, the conference preparations are not yet complete. To ensure everyone's safety, the conference will be postponed. The specific date will be announced later. We ask for your understanding.

Is he... saying hello to you?
The Swordmaster! Are you here for this year's Martial Arts Competition?
Li Daxia, I-I-I admire you so much! Will we get to see your Azure Lotus Sword in action this year?
Thank you for the compliment. I have other matters to attend to. Let's meet at the Martial Arts Competition if fate wills it.
Does he want us to follow him?
Does he want us to follow him?
Is it really Li Bai? The Swordmaster is also at the Martial Arts Competition...
If anything goes wrong, contact the Aerwatch in town. We'll assist.
(Master Swordmaster, I'm your fan. Can I have your autograph?)
(The Swordmaster has arrived at Mount Guye. Is he here to challenge Master Quan Yuan to another drinking contest?)
(Hahaha... I'll be there for sure if I get the chance.)
("We have urgent business to attend to today. Let's hold off on the drinks for now.")
(It's been a long time since I came here. Yet this place seems unchanged.)
(You stayed here because of Master Quan Yuan?)
(Thanks to this, I got to know Quan Yuan. She's an outstanding swordswoman.)
(Asked curiously about the truth behind Li Bai and Quan Yuan.)
(Asked curiously about the truth behind Li Bai and Quan Yuan.)
(It's a long story. Let's talk while we walk.)
(It was Master Fuzi that suggested I go to Mount Guye to take a walk...)
There's Training Town ahead. How do you feel?
Aerflow is strong around Mount Guye. I could feel it as soon as I got here. It's perfect for Martial Arts breathing training.
Aerflow is strong around Mount Guye. I could feel it as soon as I got here. It's perfect for Martial Arts breathing training.
Not bad, you know your stuff. Senior Kongming reckoned the secret medicine is at Mount Guye, and I guess it's for this reason.
But with all kinds of people here, conflicts are unavoidable.
We're not the only ones looking for Master Quan Yuan. Many other martial artists are trying to locate her as well.
Were they just... trying to meet Quan Yuan?
Were they just... trying to meet Quan Yuan?
Some wanted to challenge her swordsmanship, while others had ulterior motives.
Masters from all over Jixia regard Fuzi as the pinnacle of martial arts, and beneath him, Master Quan Yuan is considered a grandmaster.
When we say one person, one sword, one mountain, it's not just talk.
What if she doesn't show up at the Martial Arts Assembly?
What if she doesn't show up at the Martial Arts Assembly?
I doubt it... Master Quan Yuan has presided over the mountain for over two centuries. She's never been known to abandon Mount Guye.
And even if Master Quan Yuan isn't there, I have other ways to arrange a meeting!
Whether as a Jixia student or a Pavilion of Concealed Edge, I'll give it my all.
Huh? Why me? Lives are at stake! They're your allies and my classmates!
Besides, the Captain and Fen are also working hard for the academy, right?
Yes... Vlinder got into an argument with the Aerwatch because they refused to rest.
Yes... Vlinder got into an argument with the Aerwatch because they refused to rest.
Haha, that's her! I wouldn't listen to anyone else!
But I'm still better than your captain.
Sorry, I shouldn't bring that up now. Let's go.
One person and one sword guarding a mountain—that's not just talk.

text: Yes, you. Kongming sent me a message. I'm here to help you find the cure from Quan Yuan.
Didn't expect the trump card to be Li Bai. Have you met Quan Yuan?
I visited Mount Guye in advance but didn't see her. Perhaps she had something to do, so I decided to wait here, hoping she might show up.

Sure, let's wait here for now.

I'm curious how you two met.
I'm curious how you two met.
It's true that Quan Yuan and I bonded through a fight. Let me tell you about it.
Wake up, everyone! Quan Yuan isn't coming. Who knows where she is now? Not here for us, that's for sure.
Nonsense. Master Quan Yuan is no absconder.
Hah, like you knew her! "Master Swordmaster"... it's just a legend!
Those famous swordmasters are just empty reputations. They don't care about the well-being of us ordinary people!
Exactly! Is the Martial Arts Contest still on? Can we leave Mount Guye safely? Someone give us an answer!
Master Quan Yuan must be detained by something important. She has never left Mount Guye unattended!
You heartless scum. Say one more thing out of line and see what I'll do!
If Quan Yuan doesn't show up now, we're gonna tear this place apart!
Oh no! They're going to fight!

(I heard about the trouble at Jixia and with Fuzi... I have a history with him, and he once helped me out of a tough spot, so it's only right I lend a hand.)
(After asking about Jixia and the Team of Stars, the player greets Minka before turning to Minka.)
Li Bai... Hmph. Why did Senior Kongming send you here? Doesn't he trust me?
Hahaha, he's cautious. As an outsider, I can't handle everything in Mount Guye without Master Minka.
Fine, the more help the better. But it looks like... Master Quan Yuan isn't coming.
In the forest, I see deer; by the stream, I hear no bell...
Come, I'll show you the way.
What's with the Aership? When can we leave Jixia?
When Jixia faced such a crisis, protecting everyone was the top priority.
Everyone's here for the Martial Arts Competition. It's better to focus on training and aim for a good ranking.
The Martial Arts Competition is still on? I thought...
The Aerwatch hasn't been notified. Preparations are ongoing.
What about us, sir? We don't want to cause trouble, and we're not afraid of danger. We just want to help at the academy...
(Points to the protagonist, "Well, this one brought good news.")
(The legendary Kongming has returned to the academy and is now stationed at the Tower of Enlightenment.)
(Senior Kongming, that's wonderful... I hope the academy's problems can be solved soon.)
(We're here to seek Master Quan Yuan's assistance for the academy...)
(Perfect—today is the start of the Martial Arts Competition. Master Quan Yuan will be there!)
(But lately, I've been hearing rumors that due to the academy's incident, the Martial Arts Competition might not be held again...)
(But since the Aerwatch said so, it should be fine, right?)
(Then we won't keep you! Hurry to town, the meeting is about to start!))
(Turning to the Aerwatch Captain) I've heard those rumors too. Could they really cancel the camp due to academy affairs?
(Some speculate, but it's not really related to the academy. Instead, Master Quan Yuan, who rarely ventures out, has been nowhere to be seen lately.)
If there were any other arrangements, we would never know.
(But since there hasn't been any news, maybe it's not that serious. You might want to wait in town and see.)
I hope it doesn't come to that, or the town will be filled with gloomy atmosphere...
Please, Aerwatch, let us through. They must need all the help they can get...
Yes! Maybe you should contact the academy!
We're having trouble contacting the academy... but we've been ordered to defend Mount Guye.
If they don't let me through, I won't be stupid enough to head to Jixia Academy right now.
Let those guys leave then! Let us out, we're never coming back!
Jixia has entered a state of emergency. Aership Station access restricted...
No, they just blocked us here. What's going on, Jixia?!
But with what's happening in Jixia, keeping everyone safe is the top priority.
I promise it's not to make things difficult for everyone. It's to keep the academy informed.
Everyone's here for the Martial Arts Competition. It's better to focus on training and aim for a good ranking.
The Martial Arts Competition is still on? I thought...
The Aerwatch hasn't been notified. Preparations are ongoing.
Alright then... Just let us know when the Aership is ready to go!
What about us, sir? We don't want to cause trouble, and we're not afraid of danger. We just want to help at the academy...
(Soothing the students, the situation at the academy is now stable.)
(Points at the protagonist, "Well, this one brought good news. The legendary Kongming has returned to the academy and is now stationed at the Tower of Enlightenment.")
(Senior Kongming, that's wonderful... I hope the academy's problems can be solved soon.)

(But since the Aerwatch said so, it should be fine, right?)
(I knew it was fake news spread by those outsiders with ill intentions!)
(Then we won't keep you! Hurry to town, the meeting is about to start!)
(Turning to the Aerwatch Captain) I've heard those rumors too, but there's no solid evidence. Could the ceremony really be canceled due to academy affairs?
(Some speculate, but it's not really related to the academy. Instead, Master Quan Yuan, who rarely ventures out, has been nowhere to be seen lately.)
If she has no intention of opening it, or if she has other plans, we may never know.
(But since there hasn't been any news, maybe it's not that serious. You might want to wait in town and see.)
I hope it doesn't come to that, or the town will be filled with gloomy atmosphere...

text: First time in Training Town? Fancy a cup of tea at Guanglight Workshop? We can chat about what's happening outside...
Didn't you hear the Aerwatch say he's free to go? If your ears are deaf, we can take them off. I can fix them for you!
You... Hmph, I knew it. You're from the Aerforge. With the lockdown, you still managed to bring your own people in.
Who sent you? Trying to stop us from reaching the Martial Arts Competition?
With the recent attacks, we can't let anyone from Jixia enter town right now.
I just got off the Aership. It has nothing to do with what you mentioned.
I just got off the Aership. It has nothing to do with what you mentioned.
The Martial Arts Competition isn't a place for kids like you! Go back where you came from!
Instead of disrupting my duty, why not go train? That way, you won't embarrass Yongwang Light Industry at the competition!
Hello, routine inspection. Where are you from, and what brings you to Mount Guye?
We're here for the Martial Arts Competition. I heard Master Quan Yuan will be there.
We're here for the Martial Arts Competition. I heard Master Quan Yuan will be there.
I'm here to find Master Quan Yuan.

As for the Aership... it was specially arranged by the academy due to the circumstances.

The famous Celestial Squad has their hands beyond Mount Guye.
Aerwatch, may I enter town with my friend now?
Sure. Let's go. Welcome to Training Town.
Well, I'm from here. My family has some connections.
After the incident, the academy sent me back here to handle intelligence and communication.
Senior Kongming already briefed me. We must get that <001>miracle cure</>.
I'm fine... The medicine is for healing my teammates.
I'm fine... The medicine is for healing my teammates.
Of course I do! But you look out of shape at the moment.
Don't put everything on your shoulders! I know the area. We'll find <001>Master Quan Yuan</> in no time.
My master used to say, "Hesitation forges no fine sword." Well, that was the idea anyway.
Great, come with me. Let's head to the <001>Martial Arts Convention</>.
Senior Kongming has probably already told you about the Martial Arts Competition?
Yes, I'm here to seek a remedy from Master Quan Yuan.
Yes, I'm here to seek a remedy from Master Quan Yuan.
I've already spoken with Senior about your team's situation. Don't worry, with me here, I guarantee a smooth journey! Let's head back to Training Town first.
I'm... I'm fine. I wasn't hurt.
I'm... I'm fine. I wasn't hurt.
Look at you... You'll have me and the seniors from the academy helping you too. Don't carry everything on your own!
That's the spirit! Show them the fire you had when you were competing against us! Come on, I'll show you around.
Today is the opening day of the Martial Arts Competition, and Master Quan Yuan will definitely be there. If we explain the situation to her, she'll surely find a way to save them.
Can't they just stay put... If they're so eager to leave, they should grow wings and fly out!
I'm Minka's teammate. We fought in the Enlightenment Trials.
Things have been restless here lately. Several incidents have occurred, and now the Aerwatch are investigating. But don't worry, it's not your concern.
With the Martial Arts Ceremony coming up, could we revisit the price of the Aereader?
Fixed prices! We won't gouge, but fair prices for fine weapons.
Alright... I get your stance as a centuries-old swordsmith clan.
Hmph, and what if I buy myself a better sword from the Forbidden Market?
Suit yourself. Just don't come crying to the Raven Hideout when you get ripped off with the counterfeit.
I've got business to attend to. See you later.
Fixed price, fixed price! We won't hoard goods at a time like this, but we won't sell our weapons cheap either.

text: The Tower of Enlightenment collapsed, Master Fuzi is missing, and Quan Yuan might be assisting the academy...
I heard Wiltspring Cave is filled with martial arts manuals and weapons. How about we grab some?
Honestly, this Mount Guye should've been renamed long ago—uh!
You're the new member of the Team of Stars? Why did you come alone? Did you catch the ones attacking the academy? Is everyone okay?
First time here? Come have tea at Sky Lighting Shop, talk about the outside world...
How did you get in with the lockdown? When will the Aership resume?
Who are you? Is this how the locals treat outsiders at the Martial Arts Competition?
Hmph, just a naive boy! Go back where you came from, there's no place for kids here.
I'm not involved in any of this. I came for my own reasons. As for future Aership arrangements, I'm not sure.
I'm not involved in any of this. I came for my own reasons. As for future Aership arrangements, I'm not sure.
What is it? Is it related to the academy raid the other day? Then what happened recently...
Why are you all standing around?
You... aren't you the girl from Aerforge?
Move, or I'll smash things up!
Your hammer wasn't even better than mine... Fine, I'll let you handle it.
This is where the Martial Arts Contest is held.
I wonder if Master Quan Yuan is here. Let's go check.
Fewer people down here... Let's move fast before they hear about what we did upstairs.
The way that leads deeper in is being guarded.
The way that leads deeper in is being guarded.
That means we're in the right place.
I heard the boss has been away for a few days. I wonder if he's carrying the device to unlock the mechanism...
I heard the boss has been away for a few days. I wonder if he's carrying the device to unlock the mechanism...
You're overthinking the situation, my dear assistant.

When our path is blocked, we find a way to unblock it. Simple as that. Since this mechanism is blocking the way, we'll just stop it from working. After all, this school building has been abandoned for a long time, so it's no surprise if it malfunctions occasionally.
There should be a master switch for all the Mechcrafts in the academy. We can use that to send them a little surprise.
I see... Over there, Dr. Lychill. A room.
I see... Over there, Dr. Lychill. A room.
This used to be the Mechcraft room. Maybe I can find a control switch there...
Let's find the switch in that room and shut down the power to this floor.
This way, they won't come to you when you disable the lock.
*Cough*... (crackling sound) Can you hear me now?
I'm fine. The cave might have collapsed from the interrupted flow, but it's okay.
You shouldn't be here. I did tell you it's dangerous.
How could I leave at this point? Let me join the rest of the investigation, or I'll go on my own.
How could I leave at this point? Let me join the rest of the investigation, or I'll go on my own.
Alright then. Just make sure your safety comes first.
Both paths lead to the cave with the gas Mechcraft. You're closer.
Don't enter the cave until I catch up. Got it?
Got it. I'll go in after Dr. Lychill arrives.
Got it. I'll go in after Dr. Lychill arrives.
Good. Next, use the communication Mechcraft to contact us.
Lychill asks the protagonist to leave.
This is the master power switch. Press this, and the power to the underground will shut off instantly.
Great, let's shut it off and head underground.
Great, let's shut it off and head underground.
No, your mission is to leave this place.
You've already been a great help, though. I'll take it from here.
We haven't uncovered the truth yet. I can't back out now. Let me continue helping with the next steps.
We haven't uncovered the truth yet. I can't back out now. Let me continue helping with the next steps.
The underground routes are more complex than I expected. I might get distracted. I can't risk your safety.
As the academy's healer, your safety is always my top priority.
I'm the Head Trainer's assistant, and I can take care of myself!
I'm the Head Trainer's assistant, and I can take care of myself!
If we fail this operation, we'll surely alert the enemy, and it won't be easy to track them down again!
If we fail this operation, we'll surely alert the enemy, and it won't be easy to track them down again!
I trust your abilities, but this is my own business. I shouldn't drag you into it any further.
(Lychill walks over to operate the Mechcraft) While they're confused, I'll make a noise to draw their attention. You, leave.
Stay steady, we can win this!
Go for it, we've got this win.
Don't give up, there's still a chance.
Go for it, show your true strength.
Stay steady, we can win this!
Believe in yourself; I've got your back this time.
Mechcraft is built on deconstruction, invention, and practice. To Master Mozi, its greatest secret is truly loving the craft.
It must have taken you a lot of time to make such a huge Mechanoid, right?
It must have taken you a lot of time to make such a huge Mechanoid, right?
Of course. The Type II you see right now has already gone through countless cycles of <001>disassemblies and reconstructions</>.
Its design mimics the structure of a human body, but with greater detail.
Deconstruction, invention, and practice are the core of Mechcraft.
Keep doing them, and all problems can be solved. You may even come to understand the ultimate secret of Mechcrafts.
Now what do you think that could be?
The art of Mechcraft calls for both creativity and craftsmanship.
But to me, the answer is much simpler. And that's love. Deep, genuine love!
Love, combined with passion and ingenuity, is what it takes to create something truly remarkable.
That, I believe, is the ultimate secret of Mechcrafts.
I hope every one of you can use your talents in Mechcraft to bring love and peace to this world.
Also it features a selection of the latest mechanical <001>inventions</>, ensuring optimal performance with minimal consumption.
However, your <001>practice</> has only verified its functional integrity. It's still far from complete.
So when can it be considered "complete"?
So when can it be considered "complete"?
Sounds pretty hard, doesn't it? But actually, it's quite simple.
Master Mozi asks you to charge up and test Mozi Type II.
As you all know, even the most seasoned Mechcraft masters must put their creations through countless rounds of testing.
That's why today, we're going to test this colossal Mechanoid before you, the Mozi Type II.
Kid, do you want to volunteer?
It's a great chance to learn the intricacies of Mechcrafts. And we're only going to do some basic movement checks.
Alright, I'll give it a try.
Alright, I'll give it a try.
First, we need to charge the big fella.
I'm Bingxing, librarian of the School of Sorcery.
You just had a lesson with Master Zhuangzi, didn't you?
Come here, this is about you. And your future.
Sorcery is about reading the Flow and using its power. Master Zhuangzi will show you the way.
Is this a Sorcery Technique of yours, Master?
Is this a Sorcery Technique of yours, Master?
Sorcery, Martial Arts, Mechcraft... Essentially, they are just different ways to wield the Flow.
In the way of Sorcery, we learn these patterns and turn them into various techniques.
The Flow around us always moves in patterns.
Master Zhuangzi says he dreamed of your arrival and invites you to follow the butterfly.
Indeed, just as I foresaw in my dreams.
In your dreams... Is this a Sorcery Technique of yours, Master?
In your dreams... Is this a Sorcery Technique of yours, Master?
Once you understand Sorcery, such things will no longer seem strange.
If you wish to see its wonder, follow the butterfly.
Dreams have no boundaries. Neither should life. Come back when you're ready.
This is Hall of Insights, where Sorcery students with a clear purpose come to seek further advancement.
Whether you want to seek answers for the future or just enhance your power, there will be something for you here.
So... how am I supposed to do?
So... how am I supposed to do?
Hah... All answers lie within certain revelations. You just have to find them.
What we just saw was the movement of the Flow.
As you start to see its patterns, you should learn to control it. That's how Sorcery Techniques are devised.
Such differences could lead them down different paths.
Come with me and see for yourself.
The school only leads you to the gate of Sorcery. Where to go from here, though... That's your own decision.
Everyone understands its laws differently, and so their Sorcery Techniques vary.
The butterfly mark gives you a glimpse of your future. Master Zhuangzi says the true answer must be found in the world.
A duel between seniors is common, but these two... Quite rare indeed.
This is the final showdown between two of the most renowned graduates of our school, Zhou Yu and Kongming.
Kongming... He was the one at the affairs committee...
Kongming... He was the one at the affairs committee...
What do you think this means for me, Master Zhuangzi?
What do you think this means for me, Master Zhuangzi?
Maybe it sees the potential in you, and wants you to work hard and reach their heights.
Or maybe... well, it's not the right time yet.
The world is vast. Answers await in <001>Travelogue</>. When the time comes, you will understand.
Now let's end our first lesson here. Time to wake up.
Some speculate that after one restores the butterfly mark, what they see indicates their future achievements.
After all, geniuses of their caliber are hard to come by in any era.
With the pattern whole again, the Telepathic Player was activated.
The true purpose of this device is to connect people's minds for simulated duels.
But more than that, it can record and store the most epic matches for replays, like the one you're seeing now.
We're now at the Chamber of Perception. This is where we study the patterns of the Flow.
With the Arcane Analyzer, the Flow becomes clear.
Am I walking on the Flow...?
Am I walking on the Flow...?
It seems you are very confused about the answer to 'self'.
This is the deepest part of the dream. Those who venture here can see their truest selves.
Therefore, everyone sees something different here, but you saw nothing at all.
What exactly do you mean by 'self'?
What exactly do you mean by 'self'?
Why do you exist, in what capacity do you stand in this world, and what are you pursuing?
These are all questions you've been lost searching for, aren't they?
The heart has no foundation, so the road ahead is vast and the path behind is unseen; one does not know where one should go.
But there's no need to panic about it.
Just as you observe the world and resonate with others, everything in this world is also watching and responding to you.
The people you've met, the things you've experienced, and the emotions shared through resonance—these are all proof of your existence in this world.
Why not use this as a starting point?
All you need to do is step forward and find that answer.
The butterfly is made of the Flow... and my Bracer, too?
The butterfly is made of the Flow... and my Bracer, too?
Bingxing wakes you up. Shye sent her to help if you have any questions.
Was it a lesson or a dream?
Was it a lesson or a dream?
With our headmaster? It can be both. You'll get used to it...
I bet you're confused right now. But don't worry, Shye sent me to answer whatever questions you might have.

On the giant platform in front of the warship stood a broken wall inscribed with ancient text. As a scholar, I immediately understood its contents: this deep-sea vessel was actually a super-warship that sailed from another world in ancient times. Deep in its hull lies an ultimate weapon capable of firing blue-flame cannonballs that can pierce the seabed, triggering tsunamis to destroy Jixia.
Beyond that, it hides countless terrifying super-technologies and magical secrets, such as shining ore for forging ultimate divine weapons, an inexhaustible mechanical energy source, and an experimental base for mechanical beings from another world. Yet, the chroniclers sent by the Academy failed to make this ancient text public, instead providing a sloppy translation that resulted in a collection of obscure, incoherent poetry, leading to public misunderstanding.

The mysterious He-Ming Dojo master, Bai He, returns to Chunxi Plains regularly every year. This piques the curiosity of Meng Feng, a student from the Secret Society, who keeps watch at the dojo daily. You assist in the investigation and find a clue about a "Ming" wine pot at Haiyan Pier.

You and Meng Feng sneak into the master's room to steal materials and stumble upon years of dojo exam records. The name "Bai Ming" appears at the top of the list, sparking Meng Feng's speculation about his story with Ming.

Just as Meng Feng is gloating over his theory, a mysterious person confronts you both. After a fight, you learn the stranger is Bai Ming. The events of the past are explained in their master's diary: Bai He knew Bai Ming had a heart for adventure and took on the role of dojo master to allow him to pursue his dreams.

1. Damage Dealt: Damage dealt to enemy Flow Styles. 
2. Damage Taken: Damage taken from enemy Flow Styles. 
3. EXP: EXP gained during the match. 
4. Escort: Percentage of the target's advance time that the attacking team spent escorting it. 
5. Defense: Percentage of the target's contested time that the defending team spent contesting it. 
6. Healing: Percentage of the team's total healing that you provided to Flow Styles.
zh_text:
1. 输出伤害：对敌方共鸣造成的伤害。 
2. 承受伤害：承受来自敌方共鸣的伤害。 
3. 经验值：玩家局内获取的经验值。
